namespace Infragistics.Win
{
	[SuppressUnmanagedCodeSecurity]
	[ComVisible(false)]
	[SecurityCritical]
	internal class KeyboardHookManager
	{
		private delegate IntPtr HookProcCallback(int ncode, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam);

		private bool hookfailed;

		private IntPtr hookHandle = IntPtr.Zero;

		private HookProcCallback hookProc;

		private static KeyHookEventHandler keyHookDelegate;

		private static KeyboardHookManager keyHookManager;

		internal const int WH_KEYBOARD = 2;

		internal const int HC_ACTION = 0;

		internal const int HC_NOREMOVE = 3;

		internal const int KF_ALTDOWN = 8192;

		internal const int KF_DLGMODE = 2048;

		internal const int KF_EXTENDED = 256;

		internal const int KF_MENUMODE = 4096;

		internal const int KF_REPEAT = 16384;

		internal const int KF_UP = 32768;

		internal const int VK_CONTROL = 17;

		internal const int VK_SHIFT = 16;

		internal static event KeyHookEventHandler KeyHook
		{
			add
			{
				lock (typeof(KeyboardHookManager))
				{
					if (keyHookDelegate == null)
					{
						keyHookDelegate = value;
					}
					else
					{
						keyHookDelegate = (KeyHookEventHandler)Delegate.Combine(keyHookDelegate, value);
					}
					if (keyHookManager == null)
					{
						keyHookManager = new KeyboardHookManager();
					}
					keyHookManager.SetHook();
				}
			}
			remove
			{
				lock (typeof(KeyboardHookManager))
				{
					if (keyHookDelegate != null)
					{
						keyHookDelegate = (KeyHookEventHandler)Delegate.Remove(keyHookDelegate, value);
					}
					if (keyHookDelegate == null && keyHookManager != null)
					{
						keyHookManager.ReleaseHook();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		[DllImport("user32", CharSet = CharSet.Auto, ExactSpelling = true)]
		private static extern IntPtr CallNextHookEx(IntPtr hook, int nCode, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam);

		private static bool UnhookWindowsHookExApi(IntPtr hook)
		{
			return UnhookWindowsHookEx(hook);
		}

		[DllImport("user32", CharSet = CharSet.Auto, ExactSpelling = true)]
		[return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
		private static extern bool UnhookWindowsHookEx(IntPtr hook);

		private static IntPtr SetWindowsHookExApi(int id, HookProcCallback hookProc, IntPtr hmod, int dwThreadId)
		{
			return SetWindowsHookEx(id, hookProc, hmod, dwThreadId);
		}

		[DllImport("user32", CharSet = CharSet.Auto)]
		private static extern IntPtr SetWindowsHookEx(int id, HookProcCallback hookProc, IntPtr hmod, int dwThreadId);

		[DllImport("user32", CharSet = CharSet.Auto)]
		private static extern short GetKeyState(int nVirtKey);

		private static int GetCurrentThreadIdApi()
		{
			try
			{
				return GetCurrentThreadIdApiUnsafe();
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
			return AppDomain.GetCurrentThreadId();
		}

		private static int GetCurrentThreadIdApiUnsafe()
		{
			return GetCurrentThreadId();
		}

		[DllImport("kernel32")]
		private static extern int GetCurrentThreadId();

		private KeyboardHookManager()
		{
			hookProc = HookProc;
		}

		private void SetHook()
		{
			if (hookfailed || hookHandle != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				hookHandle = SetWindowsHookExApi(2, hookProc, IntPtr.Zero, GetCurrentThreadIdApi());
			}
			catch
			{
				hookfailed = true;
			}
		}

		private void ReleaseHook()
		{
			if (hookfailed || hookHandle == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				UnhookWindowsHookExApi(hookHandle);
				hookHandle = IntPtr.Zero;
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private IntPtr HookProc(int ncode, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam)
		{
			if (ncode >= 0)
			{
				Keys keys = (Keys)wParam.ToInt64();
				int num = (int)lParam.ToInt64();
				keys = (Keys)((int)keys | (((num & 0x2000) != 0) ? 262144 : 0));
				keys = (Keys)((int)keys | ((GetKeyState(17) < 0) ? 131072 : 0));
				keys = (Keys)((int)keys | ((GetKeyState(16) < 0) ? 65536 : 0));
				KeyEventType keyEventType = (((num & 0x8000) != 0) ? KeyEventType.KeyUp : KeyEventType.KeyDown);
				keyEventType = ((((num >> 31) & 1) != 0) ? KeyEventType.KeyUp : KeyEventType.KeyDown);
				KeyHookEventArgs e = new KeyHookEventArgs(ncode, keys, keyEventType);
				RaiseKeyHookEvent(e);
				if (e.Handled)
				{
					return (IntPtr)1;
				}
			}
			return CallNextHookEx(hookHandle, ncode, wParam, lParam);
		}

		private static void RaiseKeyHookEvent(KeyHookEventArgs e)
		{
			if (keyHookDelegate != null)
			{
				keyHookDelegate(null, e);
			}
		}
	}
	internal delegate void KeyHookEventHandler(object sender, KeyHookEventArgs e);
	internal enum KeyEventType
	{
		KeyDown,
		KeyUp
	}
	internal class KeyHookEventArgs : KeyEventArgs
	{
		private KeyEventType eventType;

		private int hookCode;

		public KeyEventType EventType => eventType;

		public int HookCode => hookCode;

		internal KeyHookEventArgs(int hookCode, Keys keyData, KeyEventType eventType)
			: base(keyData)
		{
			this.eventType = eventType;
			this.hookCode = hookCode;
		}
	}
}

	public class PagerControlResizeEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		private Size availableSize;

		private Orientation orientation;

		private Size controlSize;

		private Control control;

		public Orientation Orientation => orientation;

		public Control Control => control;

		public Size AvailableSize => availableSize;

		public Size NewControlSize
		{
			get
			{
				return controlSize;
			}
			set
			{
				controlSize = value;
			}
		}

		public PagerControlResizeEventArgs(Orientation orientation, Size availableSize, Size controlSize, Control control)
		{
			this.orientation = orientation;
			this.availableSize = availableSize;
			this.controlSize = controlSize;
			this.control = control;
		}
	}
	public delegate void PagerControlResizeEventHandler(object sender, PagerControlResizeEventArgs e);
	public class PagerContentAreaUIElement : UIElement
	{
		private PagerInfo Pager => ((PagerUIElement)(object)((UIElement)this).GetAncestor(typeof(PagerUIElement))).PagerInfo;

		public override UIElementBorderStyle BorderStyle
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				return (UIElementBorderStyle)(((??)Pager?.ContentAreaBorderStyleResolved) ?? 1);
			}
			set
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		protected override bool ClipSelf
		{
			get
			{
				PagerInfo pager = Pager;
				if (pager == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (pager.ContentControl == null)
				{
					return pager.Control != null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override UIRole UIRole => Pager?.UIRoleContentArea;

		public PagerContentAreaUIElement(PagerUIElement pagerElement)
			: base((UIElement)(object)pagerElement)
		{
		}

		protected override void DrawForeground(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			Pager?.DrawContentArea(ref drawParams);
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			Pager?.ResolveContentAreaAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			((UIElement)this).InitAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			PagerInfo pager = Pager;
			if (pager != null && pager.ContentControl != null)
			{
				pager.ContentControl.Bounds = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
			}
		}
	}

				contentControl.ControlToScrollChanged -= OnContentControlContainedControlChanged;

		{
			if (contentControl != null)
			{
				contentControl.PositionChanged += OnContentControlPositionChanged;
				contentControl.ControlToScrollChanged += OnContentControlContainedControlChanged;
				contentControl.MaxScrollPositionChanged += OnContentControlMaxScrollPositionChanged;

		}

		internal UIRole GetRoleFromScrollButtonType(ScrollButton buttonType)
		{
			UIRole uIRoleScrollButtonUp = UIRoleScrollButtonUp;
			UIRole uIRoleScrollButtonDown = UIRoleScrollButtonDown;
			if (buttonType == ScrollButton.Up || buttonType == ScrollButton.Left)
			{
				return uIRoleScrollButtonUp;
			}
			return uIRoleScrollButtonDown;
		}

			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

		private static void VerifyIsValidEnum(Type enumType, int value)
		{
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(enumType, value))

		private void SetPosition(int newPosition, bool notify)
		{
			if (position == newPosition)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = position;
			if (Control == null)
			{
				position = newPosition;
				return;
			}
			if (ContentControl != null)
			{
				int maxScrollPosition = ContentControl.GetMaxScrollPosition(Control);
				newPosition = Math.Min(maxScrollPosition, newPosition);
			}
			newPosition = Math.Max(0, newPosition);
			position = newPosition;
			if (ContentControl != null)
			{
				ContentControl.Position = newPosition;
				position = ContentControl.Position;
			}
			if (notify && num != Position)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PagerInfoPropertyIds.Position);
			}
		}

		internal bool IsScrollButtonVisible(bool leftTop, Size sizeAvailable, bool isFlatMode)
		{
			//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0046: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (Control == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (leftTop)
			{
				return Position > 0;
			}
			int num = ((Orientation != Orientation.Vertical) ? Control.Width : Control.Height);
			UIElementBorderWidths val = DrawUtility.CalculateBorderWidths(ContentAreaBorderStyleResolved, isFlatMode);
			sizeAvailable.Width -= ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Left + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Right;
			sizeAvailable.Height -= ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Top + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Bottom;
			if (IsScrollButtonVisible(leftTop: true, sizeAvailable, isFlatMode))
			{
				if (Orientation == Orientation.Vertical)
				{
					sizeAvailable.Height -= ButtonExtentResolved;
				}
				else
				{
					sizeAvailable.Width -= ButtonExtentResolved;
				}
			}
			int num2 = ((Orientation != Orientation.Vertical) ? sizeAvailable.Width : sizeAvailable.Height);
			if (num2 >= num - Position)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Position > 0 && num - (num2 + Position) <= ButtonExtentResolved)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void OnContentControlPositionChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			int num = ContentControl.Position;
			if (num < Position && num <= ButtonExtentResolved)
			{
				num = 0;
			}
			Position = num;
		}

		private void OnContentControlContainedControlChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			control = ContentControl.ControlToScroll;
			if (control == null)
			{
				SetPosition(0, notify: true);
			}
			OnPositionInfoChanged(EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		private void OnContentControlMaxScrollPositionChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			OnPositionInfoChanged(EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		internal void ProcessScrollButtonClick(PagerScrollButtonUIElement scrollButton)
		{
			if (scrollButton == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = Position;
			bool flag = false;
			switch (((ScrollButtonUIElement)scrollButton).ScrollButtonType)
			{
			case ScrollButton.Up:
			case ScrollButton.Left:
				num -= ScrollIncrementResolved;
				break;
			case ScrollButton.Down:
			case ScrollButton.Right:
				flag = true;
				num = ((Position >= ButtonExtentResolved) ? (num + ScrollIncrementResolved) : (ButtonExtentResolved + ScrollIncrementResolved));
				break;
			}
			int buttonExtentResolved = ButtonExtentResolved;
			if (!flag && num <= buttonExtentResolved)
			{
				num = 0;
			}
			if (num != Position)
			{
				CancelEventArgs e = new CancelEventArgs();
				OnScrolling(e);
				if (!e.Cancel)
				{
					Position = num;
					OnScrolled(EventArgs.Empty);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static bool ShouldSetAppearanceProperty(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, AppearancePropFlags appearanceProperty)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet(appearanceProperty))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return (AppearancePropFlags)(requestedProps & appearanceProperty) == appearanceProperty;
		}

		internal void OnPositionInfoChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (activeElement != null && ((UIElement)activeElement).Parent != null)
			{
				DirtyElements(parent: true, invalidate: true, verify: true);
			}
			if (this.PositionInfoChanged != null)
			{
				this.PositionInfoChanged(this, e);
			}
		}

		private void DirtyElements(bool parent, bool invalidate, bool verify)
		{
			if (activeElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UIElement val = (UIElement)(object)(parent ? ((PagerUIElement)(object)((UIElement)activeElement).Parent) : activeElement);
			if (val != null)
			{
				val.DirtyChildElements(invalidate);
				if (verify)
				{
					val.VerifyChildElements();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo)
		{
			if (propChangeInfo.PropId is PagerInfoPropertyIds)
			{
				switch ((PagerInfoPropertyIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId)
				{
				case PagerInfoPropertyIds.Position:
					DirtyElements(parent: false, invalidate: false, verify: false);
					break;
				case PagerInfoPropertyIds.Orientation:
					if (ContentControl != null && ActiveElement != null)
					{
						ContentControl.Bounds = ((UIElement)ActiveElement).RectInsideBorders;
						DirtyElements(parent: false, invalidate: true, verify: false);
					}
					break;
				case PagerInfoPropertyIds.ScrollButtonAppearance:
				case PagerInfoPropertyIds.HotTrackScrollButtonAppearance:
				case PagerInfoPropertyIds.ContentAreaAppearance:
				case PagerInfoPropertyIds.ButtonExtent:
				case PagerInfoPropertyIds.BorderStyle:
				case PagerInfoPropertyIds.ContentAreaBorderStyle:
				case PagerInfoPropertyIds.ButtonStyle:
				case PagerInfoPropertyIds.DisplayStyle:
					DirtyElements(parent: false, invalidate: true, verify: false);
					if (ContentControl != null && ContentControl.IsHandleCreated)
					{
						ContentControl.Invalidate();
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			base.OnObjectPropChanged(propChangeInfo);
		}

		internal void OnScrolling(CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.Scrolling != null)
			{
				this.Scrolling(this, e);
			}
		}

		internal void OnScrolled(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.Scrolled != null)
			{
				this.Scrolled(this, e);
			}
		}

		private void OnPagerControlResize(PagerControlResizeEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.PagerControlResize != null)
			{
				this.PagerControlResize(this, e);
			}
		}

		internal void BeforePositionPagerElements(PagerUIElement pagerElement)
		{
			if (pagerElement != ActiveElement || Control == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Size size = ((UIElement)pagerElement).Rect.Size;
			Size size2 = Control.Size;
			if (Orientation == Orientation.Vertical)
			{
				size2.Width = size.Width;
			}
			else
			{
				size2.Height = size.Height;
			}
			bool flag = ((Orientation == Orientation.Vertical) ? (size2.Width != lastResizeCalculatedSize.Width) : (size2.Height != lastResizeCalculatedSize.Height));
			if (!(lastResizeAvailableSize == size) || flag || lastResizeHashCode != Control.GetHashCode())
			{
				lastResizeAvailableSize = size;
				lastResizeCalculatedSize = size2;
				lastResizeHashCode = Control.GetHashCode();
				PagerControlResizeEventArgs e = new PagerControlResizeEventArgs(Orientation, size, size2, Control);
				OnPagerControlResize(e);
				Control.Size = e.NewControlSize;
				if (Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal && Control.Width <= size.Width)
				{
					SetPosition(0, notify: false);
				}
				else if (Orientation == Orientation.Vertical && Control.Height <= size.Height)
				{
					SetPosition(0, notify: false);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnPaintContentArea(PaintEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.PaintContentArea != null)
			{
				this.PaintContentArea(this, e);
			}
		}

		internal void DrawContentArea(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			if (ContentControl == null)
			{
				OnPaintContentArea(new PaintEventArgs(((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics, ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).InvalidRect));
			}
		}

	public class PagerScrollButtonUIElement : ScrollButtonUIElement
	{
		private PagerInfo Pager => ((PagerUIElement)(object)((UIElement)this).GetAncestor(typeof(PagerUIElement))).PagerInfo;

		public override UIElementButtonStyle ButtonStyle => Pager?.ButtonStyleResolved ?? ((ButtonUIElementBase)this).ButtonStyle;

		protected override bool AutoScrollOnMouseEnter
		{
			get
			{
				Control control = ((UIElement)this).Control;
				if (control != null && control.Site != null && control.Site.DesignMode)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return Pager?.AutoScroll ?? ((ScrollButtonUIElement)this).AutoScrollOnMouseEnter;
			}
		}

		public override UIRole UIRole => Pager?.GetRoleFromScrollButtonType(((ScrollButtonUIElement)this).ScrollButtonType);

		public PagerScrollButtonUIElement(PagerUIElement pagerElement)
			: base((UIElement)(object)pagerElement, ScrollButton.Up)
		{
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Pager?.ResolveScrollButtonAppearance(((ScrollButtonUIElement)this).ScrollButtonType, ((ButtonUIElementBase)this).ButtonState, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			((ButtonUIElementBase)this).InitAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		protected override bool ButtonClick()
		{
			PagerInfo pager = Pager;
			if (pager == null)
			{
				return ((ButtonUIElementBase)this).ButtonClick();
			}
			pager.ProcessScrollButtonClick(this);
			return false;
		}
	}

		public void Initialize(PagerInfo pagerInfo)
		{
			if (this.pagerInfo != null)
			{
				this.pagerInfo.ActiveElement = null;
			}
			this.pagerInfo = pagerInfo;
			if (this.pagerInfo != null)
			{
				this.pagerInfo.ActiveElement = this;
			}
		}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			((ArrayList)(object)((UIElement)this).ChildElements).Clear();
			Rectangle rectInsideBorders = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
			PagerInfo pagerInfo = this.pagerInfo;
			if (pagerInfo == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ControlUIElementBase controlElement = ((UIElement)this).ControlElement;
			if (controlElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = pagerInfo.Orientation == Orientation.Vertical;
			int buttonExtentResolved = pagerInfo.ButtonExtentResolved;
			bool isFlatMode = controlElement.UltraControl.IsFlatMode;
			PagerInfo.BeforePositionPagerElements(this);
			if (pagerInfo.IsScrollButtonVisible(leftTop: true, rectInsideBorders.Size, isFlatMode))
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					((UIElement)LeftTopScrollElement).Rect = new Rectangle(rectInsideBorders.X, rectInsideBorders.Y, rectInsideBorders.Width, buttonExtentResolved);
					((ScrollButtonUIElement)LeftTopScrollElement).Initialize(ScrollButton.Up, 50, 250);
					rectInsideBorders.Height -= buttonExtentResolved;
					rectInsideBorders.Y += buttonExtentResolved;
				}
				else
				{
					((UIElement)LeftTopScrollElement).Rect = new Rectangle(rectInsideBorders.X, rectInsideBorders.Y, buttonExtentResolved, rectInsideBorders.Height);
					((ScrollButtonUIElement)LeftTopScrollElement).Initialize(ScrollButton.Left, 50, 250);
					rectInsideBorders.Width -= buttonExtentResolved;
					rectInsideBorders.X += buttonExtentResolved;
				}
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)LeftTopScrollElement);
			}
			else if ((object)controlElement.ElementWithMouseCapture == LeftTopScrollElement)
			{
				controlElement.TerminateCapture();
			}
			if (pagerInfo.IsScrollButtonVisible(leftTop: false, rectInsideBorders.Size, isFlatMode))
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					((UIElement)RightBottomScrollElement).Rect = new Rectangle(rectInsideBorders.X, rectInsideBorders.Bottom - buttonExtentResolved, rectInsideBorders.Width, buttonExtentResolved);
					((ScrollButtonUIElement)RightBottomScrollElement).Initialize(ScrollButton.Down, 50, 250);
					rectInsideBorders.Height -= buttonExtentResolved;
				}
				else
				{
					((UIElement)RightBottomScrollElement).Rect = new Rectangle(rectInsideBorders.Right - buttonExtentResolved, rectInsideBorders.Y, buttonExtentResolved, rectInsideBorders.Height);
					((ScrollButtonUIElement)RightBottomScrollElement).Initialize(ScrollButton.Right, 50, 250);
					rectInsideBorders.Width -= buttonExtentResolved;
				}
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)RightBottomScrollElement);
			}
			else if ((object)controlElement.ElementWithMouseCapture == RightBottomScrollElement)
			{
				controlElement.TerminateCapture();
			}
			((UIElement)ContentElement).Rect = rectInsideBorders;
			((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)ContentElement);
		}
	}

		public UltraPagerContentControl()
		{
			ControlStyles flag = ControlStyles.ContainerControl | ControlStyles.UserPaint | ControlStyles.ResizeRedraw | ControlStyles.SupportsTransparentBackColor | ControlStyles.AllPaintingInWmPaint | ControlStyles.DoubleBuffer;
			SetStyle(flag, value: true);
			SetStyle(ControlStyles.Selectable, value: false);
		}

		private void PaintTransparentBackground(Graphics g, Rectangle clipRectangle)
		{
			Matrix transform = g.Transform;
			Rectangle clipRect = clipRectangle;
			clipRect.X += base.Left;
			clipRect.Y += base.Top;
			PaintEventArgs e = new PaintEventArgs(g, clipRect);
			g.TranslateTransform(-base.Left, -base.Top, MatrixOrder.Append);
			InvokePaintBackground(base.Parent, e);
			g.Transform = transform;
			g.TranslateTransform(-base.Left, -base.Top, MatrixOrder.Append);
			InvokePaint(base.Parent, e);
			g.Transform = transform;
			transform.Dispose();
		}

		internal int GetMaxScrollPosition(Control control)
		{
			if (control == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			bool flag = Orientation == Orientation.Vertical;
			int num = (flag ? control.Height : control.Width);
			if (flag)
			{
				return Math.Max(0, num - base.ClientSize.Height);
			}
			return Math.Max(0, num - base.ClientSize.Width);
		}

		private void SetControlToScroll(Control ctrl)
		{
			if (controlToScroll != ctrl)
			{
				controlToScroll = ctrl;
				OnControlToScrollChanged(EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		private void SetMaxScrollPosition(int maxScrollPosition)
		{
			maxScrollPosition = Math.Max(0, maxScrollPosition);
			if (maxScrollPosition != this.maxScrollPosition)
			{
				this.maxScrollPosition = maxScrollPosition;
				OnMaxScrollPositionChanged(EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		internal void OnPositionChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.PositionChanged != null)
			{
				this.PositionChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		internal void OnOrientationChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.OrientationChanged != null)
			{
				this.OrientationChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		internal void OnControlToScrollChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.ControlToScrollChanged != null)
			{
				this.ControlToScrollChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		internal void OnMaxScrollPositionChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.MaxScrollPositionChanged != null)
			{
				this.MaxScrollPositionChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected override ControlCollection CreateControlsInstance()
		{
			return new UltraPagerContentControlCollection(this);
		}

		protected override void OnControlAdded(ControlEventArgs e)
		{
			SetControlToScroll(e.Control);
			base.OnControlAdded(e);
		}

		protected override void OnControlRemoved(ControlEventArgs e)
		{
			SetControlToScroll(null);
			Position = 0;
			base.OnControlRemoved(e);
		}

		protected override void OnLayout(LayoutEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.HasChildren && base.IsHandleCreated)
			{
				Control control = ControlToScroll;
				if (control == null && !base.HasChildren)
				{
					return;
				}
				control = base.Controls[0];
				bool flag = Orientation == Orientation.Vertical;
				Size clientSize = base.ClientSize;
				Size size = control.Size;
				int num = (flag ? size.Height : size.Width);
				Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(Point.Empty, size);
				if (flag)
				{
					SetMaxScrollPosition(num - clientSize.Height);
					rectangle.Y = -Math.Max(0, Math.Min(position, num - clientSize.Height));
				}
				else
				{
					SetMaxScrollPosition(num - clientSize.Width);
					rectangle.X = -Math.Max(0, Math.Min(position, num - clientSize.Width));
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					DrawUtility.AdjustHAlign((HAlign)2, ref rectangle, DisplayRectangle);
				}
				else
				{
					DrawUtility.AdjustVAlign((VAlign)2, ref rectangle, DisplayRectangle);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					Position = Math.Max(0, -rectangle.Y);
				}
				else
				{
					Position = Math.Max(0, -rectangle.X);
				}
				control.Location = rectangle.Location;
				if (ControlToScroll == null)
				{
					SetControlToScroll(control);
				}
			}
			base.OnLayout(e);
		}

		protected override void OnPaint(PaintEventArgs e)
		{
			PaintTransparentBackground(e.Graphics, e.ClipRectangle);
			base.OnPaint(e);
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		void ISupportInitialize.BeginInit()
		{
		}

		void ISupportInitialize.EndInit()
		{
			PerformLayout();
		}
	}
}

		protected internal override void ResolveAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, bool drawAsActive)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0013: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0044: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0046: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0051: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ca: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_007e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01ea: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01f0: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0157: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_015e: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			ToolbarStyle styleResolved = ToolbarsManager.StyleResolved;
			if ((int)styleResolved == 9 || (int)styleResolved == 8)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.ResolvePopupItemAppearance((Tool != null) ? Tool.PopupTool : null, UIRole, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, drawAsActive, this);
				return;
			}
			if (drawAsActive && (int)styleResolved == 1 && ((ulong)requestedProps & 2uL) != 0L)
			{
				AppearancePropFlags requestedProps2 = (AppearancePropFlags)3;
				ToolbarsManager.ResolvePopupItemAppearance((Tool != null) ? Tool.PopupTool : null, UIRole, ref appearance, ref requestedProps2, drawAsActive: false, this);
				if ((int)requestedProps2 == 0)
				{
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFCuL);
				}
			}
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x10uL) != 0L)
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).TextHAlign = (HAlign)1;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEFuL);
			}

		{

			{
				if (Tool.VisibleWhenFloating)
				{
					if (Tool.SharedProps.Visible)
					{
						Tool.InstanceProps.Visible = (DefaultableBoolean)2;
					}
					else
					{
						Tool.InstanceProps.Visible = (DefaultableBoolean)0;
					}
				}
				else if (Tool.SharedProps.Visible)
				{
					Tool.InstanceProps.Visible = (DefaultableBoolean)0;
				}
				else
				{
					Tool.InstanceProps.Visible = (DefaultableBoolean)1;
				}
			}
			else if (Tool.VisibleWhenFloating)
			{
				Tool.CustomizedVisible = (DefaultableBoolean)2;
			}
			else
			{
				Tool.CustomizedVisible = (DefaultableBoolean)1;

					break;
				case "FooterToolbar":
					footerToolbar = (ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar), footerToolbar);
					break;
				case "Visible":
					deserializedVisible = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), deserializedVisible);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal override List<IKeyTipProvider> GetKeyTipProviders()
		{

				keyTipProviders.AddRange(ToolAreaRight.Tools.GetKeyTipProviders());

			else
			{

				foreach (MenuItemBase item in applicationMenuAgent.MenuItemsLeft)
				{
					keyTipProviders.AddRange(item.GetKeyTipProviders());
				}
				foreach (MenuItemBase item2 in applicationMenuAgent.MenuItemsRight)
				{
					keyTipProviders.AddRange(item2.GetKeyTipProviders());
				}
			}
			keyTipProviders.AddRange(FooterToolbar.Tools.GetKeyTipProviders());
			return keyTipProviders;
		}

		internal bool IsAnyOtherToolOnMenuActive(ToolBase excludeTool)
		{
			foreach (ToolBase tool in ToolAreaLeft.Tools)
			{
				if (!tool.Equals(excludeTool) && IsToolActive(tool))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			foreach (ToolBase tool2 in ToolAreaRight.Tools)
			{
				if (!tool2.Equals(excludeTool) && IsToolActive(tool2))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			foreach (ToolBase tool3 in FooterToolbar.Tools)
			{
				if (!tool3.Equals(excludeTool) && IsToolActive(tool3))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override void RefreshDropDownContents()
		{
			try
			{
				ApplicationMenuAgent applicationMenuAgent = ApplicationMenuAgent;
				MenuItemBase activeMenuItem = applicationMenuAgent.ActiveMenuItem;
				MenuItemBase[] oldMenuItems = ((!applicationMenuAgent.HasMenuItemsLeft) ? null : ((MenuItemBase[])applicationMenuAgent.MenuItemsLeft.All));
				MenuItemBase[] oldMenuItems2 = ((!applicationMenuAgent.HasMenuItemsRight) ? null : ((MenuItemBase[])applicationMenuAgent.MenuItemsRight.All));
				base.MenuAgent.ReInitialize();
				AddMenuItemsToCollection(applicationMenuAgent.MenuItemsLeft, ToolAreaLeft.Tools, oldMenuItems);
				AddMenuItemsToCollection(applicationMenuAgent.MenuItemsRight, ToolAreaRight.Tools, oldMenuItems2);
				toolsVersionLeft = ToolAreaLeft.Tools.Version;
				toolsVersionRight = toolAreaRight.Tools.Version;
				if (!base.IsOpen)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (activeMenuItem != null && base.MenuAgent.ActiveMenuItem == null)
				{
					foreach (MenuItemBase item in applicationMenuAgent.MenuItemsLeft)
					{
						if (item.IsSameMenuItem(activeMenuItem))
						{
							item.Activate();
							break;
						}
					}
					foreach (MenuItemBase item2 in applicationMenuAgent.MenuItemsRight)
					{
						if (item2.IsSameMenuItem(activeMenuItem))
						{
							item2.Activate();
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				base.MenuAgent.RecalculateDropdownSize();
				((UIElement)base.MenuAgent.PopupControl.ControlElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
				((UltraControlBase)base.MenuAgent.PopupControl).Update();
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		internal override void RefreshDropDownIfToolsWereChanged()
		{
			int count = ToolAreaLeft.Tools.Count;
			count = ToolAreaRight.Tools.Count;
			if (toolsVersionLeft != ToolAreaLeft.Tools.Version || toolsVersionRight != ToolAreaRight.Tools.Version)
			{
				RefreshDropDownContents();
			}
		}

		internal override void ResetDropDownVersion()
		{
			toolsVersionLeft = -1;
			toolsVersionRight = -1;
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		protected override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeFooterToolbar())

				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "FooterToolbar", footerToolbar);

			}
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
		}

		}

((PropertyIds)(-1)) : PropertyIds.NotificationBadgeSettings))));
			NotifyPropChange(propertyIds, propChange);
		}

		protected internal override bool ProcessMnemonic(char charCode)
		{
			List<IProcessMnemonic> list = new List<IProcessMnemonic>();
			ApplicationMenu.ToolAreaLeft.GetToolsThatMatchMnemonic(charCode, list);
			ApplicationMenu.ToolAreaRight.GetToolsThatMatchMnemonic(charCode, list);
			ApplicationMenu.FooterToolbar.GetToolsThatMatchMnemonic(charCode, list);
			return base.ToolbarsManager.ProcessMnemonicForTools(list, list.Count);
		}

		protected internal override bool ProcessNavigationKey(Keys keyCode)
		{
			object context = ((base.ActiveMenuItem != null) ? base.ActiveMenuItem : base.DefaultContext);
			ToolBase activeTool = base.ToolbarsManager.ActiveTool;
			bool flag = activeTool != null && activeTool.OwningToolbarInternal == ApplicationMenu.FooterToolbar;
			bool flag2 = !flag && IsOnLeftSide(context);
			switch (keyCode)
			{
			case Keys.Tab:
			{
				Keys modifierKeys = Control.ModifierKeys;
				if ((modifierKeys & Keys.Control) != Keys.None)
				{
					return false;
				}
				keyCode = (((modifierKeys & Keys.Shift) == 0) ? Keys.Down : Keys.Up);
				break;
			}
			case Keys.End:
			case Keys.Home:
				if (flag2)
				{
					return base.ProcessNavigationKey(keyCode);
				}
				return true;
			case Keys.Prior:
			case Keys.Next:
				return true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return ProcessNavigationKeyOnFooterToolbar(keyCode);
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				return ProcessNavigationOnLeftArea(keyCode);
			}
			return ProcessNavigationOnRightArea(keyCode);
		}

		protected internal override void ReInitialize()
		{
			if (menuItemsRight != null)
			{
				menuItemsRight.Clear();
			}
			if (scrollTimerRight != null)
			{
				scrollTimerRight.Enabled = false;
			}
			firstItemIndexRight = 0;
			base.ReInitialize();
		}

		protected internal override void ResolveIconAreaAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, bool isExpanded)
		{
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 1uL) != 0L)
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = Color.Transparent;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEuL);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ResolveMenuAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, object context)
		{
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0131: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0137: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			ApplicationMenuArea applicationMenuArea = ((!IsOnLeftSide(context)) ? ApplicationMenu.ToolAreaRight : ApplicationMenu.ToolAreaLeft);
			ResolutionOrderInfo resolutionOrder = StyleUtils.GetResolutionOrder(base.ToolbarsManager);
			UIRole uIRole = applicationMenuArea.UIRole;
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleBefore && uIRole != null)
			{
				uIRole.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseControlInfo)
			{
				if (applicationMenuArea.Settings.HasAppearance)
				{
					applicationMenuArea.Settings.Appearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
				if (base.ToolbarsManager.MenuSettings.HasAppearance)
				{
					base.ToolbarsManager.MenuSettings.Appearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
				if (base.ToolbarsManager.HasAppearance)
				{
					base.ToolbarsManager.Appearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleAfter && uIRole != null)
			{
				uIRole.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 1uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)1))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = Color.Transparent;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEuL);
			}
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 2uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)2))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ForeColor = SystemColors.MenuText;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFDuL);
			}
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 4uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)4))
			{
				if ((int)base.ToolbarsManager.StyleResolved == 4)
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor = XPItemColor.MenuDroppedBorder;
				}
				else if (base.ToolbarsManager.MSColors != null)
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor = base.ToolbarsManager.MSColors.PopupMenuBorder;
				}
				else
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor = base.ToolbarsManager.DefaultForeColor;
				}
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFBuL);
			}
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x40uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)64))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ImageHAlign = (HAlign)2;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFBFuL);
			}
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x80uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)128))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ImageVAlign = (VAlign)2;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFF7FuL);
			}
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x10uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)16))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).TextHAlign = (HAlign)1;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEFuL);
			}
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x20uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)32))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).TextVAlign = (VAlign)2;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFDFuL);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void SetFirstItemIndex(object context, int value)
		{
			if (IsOnLeftSide(context))
			{
				base.SetFirstItemIndex(context, value);
			}
			else
			{
				firstItemIndexRight = value;
			}
		}

		internal override void SetScrollDirection(ScrollDirection value, object context)
		{
			if (IsOnLeftSide(context))
			{
				base.SetScrollDirection(value, context);
			}
			scrollDirectionRight = value;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldShowAddRemoveCheckColumn(object context)
		{
			ApplicationMenuArea applicationMenuArea = ((!IsOnLeftSide(context)) ? ApplicationMenu.ToolAreaRight : ApplicationMenu.ToolAreaLeft);
			if (applicationMenuArea.SettingsResolved.ShowIconAreaResolved)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (ToolBase tool in applicationMenuArea.Tools)
			{
				if (tool is StateButtonTool || (tool is ListTool && ((ListTool)tool).DisplayCheckmark))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (tool is PopupToolBase { DropDownArrowStyleResolved: DropDownArrowStyle.SegmentedStateButton })
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldShowImages(object context)
		{
			if (IsOnLeftSide(context))
			{
				return ApplicationMenu.ToolAreaLeft.SettingsResolved.ShowIconAreaResolved;
			}
			return ApplicationMenu.ToolAreaRight.SettingsResolved.ShowIconAreaResolved;
		}

		internal override bool ShowToolbarList(Point screenPt, ToolBase tool)
		{
			if (tool != null)
			{
				base.ToolbarsManager.ShowToolbarListPopup(screenPt, tool, (Control)(object)base.PopupControl);
				return true;
			}
			return base.ShowToolbarList(screenPt, tool);
		}

		internal override void StartScroll(ScrollDirection scrollDirection, object context)
		{
			if (IsOnLeftSide(context))
			{
				base.StartScroll(scrollDirection, context);
			}
			else
			{
				MenuAgentBase.StartScrollHelper(scrollDirection, base.ToolbarsManager, ScrollTimerRight, ref scrollDirectionRight);
			}
		}

		internal override void StopScroll(object context)
		{
			if (IsOnLeftSide(context))
			{
				base.StopScroll(context);
				return;
			}
			ScrollTimerRight.Enabled = false;
			scrollDirectionRight = ScrollDirection.ScrollNone;
		}

		internal override void DropDown(Rectangle fileMenuButtonRect)
		{
			if (IsOpen || base.IsOpening)
			{
				CloseDropDown(delay: false);
				return;
			}
			ApplicationMenu.RefreshDropDownContents();
			Control ribbonContainer = (Control)(object)base.FileMenu.Ribbon.RibbonContainer;
			if (ribbonContainer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle exclusionRect = ribbonContainer.RectangleToScreen(fileMenuButtonRect);
			Point point = new Point(exclusionRect.Left, exclusionRect.Bottom);
			Point offsetFromButton = ApplicationMenu.OffsetFromButton;
			point.Offset(offsetFromButton.X, offsetFromButton.Y);
			exclusionRect.Size = new Size(exclusionRect.Width, Math.Max(0, exclusionRect.Height + offsetFromButton.Y));
			CancelEventArgs e = new CancelEventArgs();
			if (base.ToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				base.ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.BeforeApplicationMenuDropDown, e);
			}
			if (!e.Cancel || base.ToolbarsManager.EnforceOffice2007Resolution)
			{
				DropDown(ribbonContainer, point, exclusionRect, (DropDownPosition)0, delay: false, closeIfAlreadyOpen: true, alignRight: false, !base.ToolbarsManager.Customizing);
				if (base.ToolbarsManager != null)
				{
					base.ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.AfterApplicationMenuDropDown, EventArgs.Empty);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void PositionChildrenInControl(Size size)
		{
			if (ApplicationMenu.FooterDockArea != null)
			{
				((Control)(object)ApplicationMenu.FooterDockArea).Bounds = GetFooterDockAreaBounds(size);
				ApplicationMenu.FooterDockArea.DirtyChildElements();
			}
		}

		private bool ForwardNavigationToFooterToolbar(Keys keyCode, MenuItemsCollection sourceAreaMenuItems)
		{
			if (ApplicationMenu.FooterToolbar.Tools.Count > 0)
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = null;
				if (keyCode == Keys.Up && (base.ActiveMenuItem == null || sourceAreaMenuItems.GetPreviousMenuItem(base.ActiveMenuItem, selectableItemsOnly: true, HideNonRecentlyUsedItems, wrapAround: false) == null))
				{
					toolBase = ApplicationMenu.FooterToolbar.Tools.GetPreviousTool(null, visibleToolsOnly: true, selectableToolsOnly: true, recentlyUsedToolsOnly: false, wrapAround: false);
				}
				else if (keyCode == Keys.Down && sourceAreaMenuItems.GetNextMenuItem(base.ActiveMenuItem, selectableItemsOnly: true, HideNonRecentlyUsedItems, wrapAround: false) == null)
				{
					toolBase = ApplicationMenu.FooterToolbar.Tools.GetNextTool(null, visibleToolsOnly: true, selectableToolsOnly: true, recentlyUsedToolsOnly: false, wrapAround: false);
				}
				if (toolBase != null)
				{
					base.ToolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture = null;
					ApplicationMenu.FooterToolbar.ActivateToolViaKey(null, toolBase);
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ForwardNavigationToMenuItemArea(Keys keyCode, MenuItemsCollection sourceAreaMenuItems, MenuItemsCollection destinationAreaMenuItems)
		{
			if (destinationAreaMenuItems.Count > 0)
			{
				MenuItemBase menuItemBase = null;
				if (keyCode == Keys.Up && sourceAreaMenuItems.GetPreviousMenuItem(base.ActiveMenuItem, selectableItemsOnly: true, HideNonRecentlyUsedItems, wrapAround: false) == null)
				{
					menuItemBase = destinationAreaMenuItems.GetPreviousMenuItem(null, selectableItemsOnly: true, HideNonRecentlyUsedItems, wrapAround: false);
				}
				else if (keyCode == Keys.Down && sourceAreaMenuItems.GetNextMenuItem(base.ActiveMenuItem, selectableItemsOnly: true, HideNonRecentlyUsedItems, wrapAround: false) == null)
				{
					menuItemBase = destinationAreaMenuItems.GetNextMenuItem(null, selectableItemsOnly: true, HideNonRecentlyUsedItems, wrapAround: false);
				}
				if (menuItemBase != null)
				{
					base.ToolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture = null;
					ActivateMenuItem(menuItemBase);
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private Rectangle GetFooterDockAreaBounds(Size owningControlSize)
		{
			int height = ApplicationMenu.FooterToolbar.Height;
			return new Rectangle(2, owningControlSize.Height - height - 2, owningControlSize.Width - 4, height);
		}

		private bool IsOnLeftSide(object context)
		{
			if (context == base.DefaultContext)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (context is MenuItemBase value)
			{
				if (HasMenuItemsLeft)
				{
					return MenuItemsLeft.Contains(value);
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (context is ToolBase value2)
			{
				return ApplicationMenu.ToolAreaLeft.Tools.Contains(value2);
			}
			if (context is System.Windows.Forms.Timer timer)
			{
				return timer != scrollTimerRight;
			}
			return ApplicationMenu.ToolAreaLeft.ContainsElement((UIElement)((context is UIElement) ? context : null));
		}

		private bool NavigateToMenuItemInDirection(FindDirection direction)
		{
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (base.ActiveMenuItem == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			PopupMenuItemUIElement popupMenuItemUIElement = (PopupMenuItemUIElement)(object)UIElement.FindElementInDirection(direction, (FindElementEvaluator)(object)new FindPopupMenuItemElementEvaluator(base.ActiveMenuItem.UIElement));
			if (popupMenuItemUIElement != null)
			{
				base.ToolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture = null;
				ActivateMenuItem(popupMenuItemUIElement.MenuItem);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ProcessNavigationKeyOnFooterToolbar(Keys keyCode)
		{
			ToolBase activeTool = base.ToolbarsManager.ActiveTool;
			if (keyCode == Keys.Up || keyCode == Keys.Down)
			{
				Keys keyCode2 = ((keyCode != Keys.Up) ? Keys.Right : Keys.Left);
				if (ApplicationMenu.FooterToolbar.ProcessNavigationKey(activeTool, keyCode2, wrapAround: false))
				{
					return true;
				}
				MenuItemBase menuItemBase = null;
				if (keyCode == Keys.Up)
				{
					menuItemBase = MenuItemsRight.GetPreviousMenuItem(null, selectableItemsOnly: true, HideNonRecentlyUsedItems, wrapAround: false);
					if (menuItemBase == null)
					{
						menuItemBase = MenuItemsLeft.GetPreviousMenuItem(null, selectableItemsOnly: true, HideNonRecentlyUsedItems, wrapAround: false);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					menuItemBase = MenuItemsLeft.GetNextMenuItem(null, selectableItemsOnly: true, HideNonRecentlyUsedItems, wrapAround: false);
					if (menuItemBase == null)
					{
						menuItemBase = MenuItemsRight.GetNextMenuItem(null, selectableItemsOnly: true, HideNonRecentlyUsedItems, wrapAround: false);
					}
				}
				if (menuItemBase != null)
				{
					base.ToolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture = null;
					ActivateMenuItem(menuItemBase);
					return true;
				}
			}
			return ApplicationMenu.FooterToolbar.ProcessNavigationKey(activeTool, keyCode);
		}

		private bool ProcessNavigationOnLeftArea(Keys keyCode)
		{
			switch (keyCode)
			{
			case Keys.Left:
				if (NavigateToMenuItemInDirection((FindDirection)2))
				{
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case Keys.Right:
				return ProcessRightNavigationKeyOnLeftArea(keyCode);
			case Keys.Up:
				if (ForwardNavigationToFooterToolbar(keyCode, MenuItemsLeft))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (ForwardNavigationToMenuItemArea(keyCode, MenuItemsLeft, MenuItemsRight))
				{
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case Keys.Down:
				if (ForwardNavigationToMenuItemArea(keyCode, MenuItemsLeft, MenuItemsRight))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (ForwardNavigationToFooterToolbar(keyCode, MenuItemsLeft))
				{
					return true;
				}
				break;
			}
			return base.ProcessNavigationKey(keyCode);
		}

		private bool ProcessNavigationOnRightArea(Keys keyCode)
		{
			switch (keyCode)
			{
			case Keys.Left:
				if (NavigateToMenuItemInDirection((FindDirection)2))
				{
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case Keys.Up:
				if (ForwardNavigationToMenuItemArea(keyCode, MenuItemsRight, MenuItemsLeft))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (ForwardNavigationToFooterToolbar(keyCode, MenuItemsRight))
				{
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case Keys.Down:
				if (ForwardNavigationToFooterToolbar(keyCode, MenuItemsRight))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (ForwardNavigationToMenuItemArea(keyCode, MenuItemsRight, MenuItemsLeft))
				{
					return true;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (base.ProcessNavigationKey(keyCode))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (keyCode == Keys.Right && NavigateToMenuItemInDirection((FindDirection)3))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ProcessRightNavigationKeyOnLeftArea(Keys keyCode)
		{
			if (base.ProcessNavigationKey(keyCode))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (NavigateToMenuItemInDirection((FindDirection)3))
			{
				return true;
			}
			MenuItemBase previousMenuItem = MenuItemsRight.GetPreviousMenuItem(null, selectableItemsOnly: true, HideNonRecentlyUsedItems, wrapAround: false);
			if (previousMenuItem != null)
			{
				ActivateMenuItem(previousMenuItem);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ScrollTimerRightExpired(object source, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!scrollTimerRight.Enabled)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (scrollDirectionRight == ScrollDirection.ScrollNone)
			{
				ScrollTimerRight.Enabled = false;
				return;
			}
			ScrollTimerRight.Interval = 50;
			DoScroll(scrollDirectionRight == ScrollDirection.ScrollDown, selectableItemsOnly: false, ScrollTimerRight);
			((UIElement)base.PopupControl.ControlElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
			if (base.ToolbarsManager != null && base.ToolbarsManager.AreKeyTipsShown)
			{
				((UIElement)base.PopupControl.ControlElement).VerifyChildElements();
				base.ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.KeyTipManager.UpdateVisibleKeyTips();
			}
		}

		protected override MenuAgentBaseUiaProviderStub CreateUIAutomationStub()
		{
			return null;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class ApplicationMenuAgentBase : MenuItemMenuAgentBase
	{
		private ApplicationMenuBase fileMenu;

		internal override bool AllowCreatePopupToolbar => false;

		protected internal override bool HideNonRecentlyUsedItems => false;

		internal override bool IncludePaddingAroundMenuItems => false;

		protected override bool ShowSupplementalDropShadows => false;

		internal override UIRole UIRole => null;

		protected ApplicationMenuBase FileMenu => fileMenu;

		internal ApplicationMenuAgentBase(ApplicationMenuBase fileMenu)
			: base(fileMenu.Ribbon.ToolbarsManager)
		{
			this.fileMenu = fileMenu;
		}

		protected internal override void AfterDropDown()
		{
			InvalidateApplicationMenuButton();
			base.AfterDropDown();
		}

		protected internal override void BeforeDropDown(ref bool cancel)
		{
			if (!cancel && base.ToolbarsManager != null && base.ToolbarsManager.IsInEditMode)
			{
				cancel = !base.ToolbarsManager.ExitEditMode();
				if (!cancel)
				{
					base.ToolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture = null;
				}
			}
			FileMenu.RefreshDropDownIfToolsWereChanged();
			base.BeforeDropDown(ref cancel);
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			base.OnDispose();
			fileMenu = null;
		}

		internal void DropDown()
		{
			Rectangle rectForApplicationMenuButton = GetRectForApplicationMenuButton();
			DropDown(rectForApplicationMenuButton);
		}

		internal virtual void DropDown(Rectangle fileMenuButtonRect)
		{
		}

		internal Rectangle GetRectForApplicationMenuButton()
		{
			UIElement uIElement = base.ToolbarsManager.GetUIElement(typeof(ApplicationMenuButtonUIElementBase), null);
			Rectangle result = Rectangle.Empty;
			if (uIElement != null)
			{
				result = uIElement.Rect;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal void InvalidateApplicationMenuButton()
		{
			if (FileMenu.Ribbon != null)
			{
				FileMenu.Ribbon.InvalidateApplicationMenuButton();
			}
		}
	}
	[Serializable]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]
	public abstract class ApplicationMenuAreaBase : SubObjectBase, IToolsCollectionOwner, ISerializable, IDeserializationCallback
	{
		public abstract class ApplicationMenuAreaAccessibleObject : AccessibleObjectWrapper
		{
			private ApplicationMenuArea applicationMenuArea;

			public override Rectangle Bounds
			{
				get
				{
					Rectangle rectangle = Rectangle.Empty;
					MenuItemAreaUIElement menuItemAreaUIElement = MenuItemAreaUIElement;
					if (menuItemAreaUIElement != null)
					{
						rectangle = ((UIElement)menuItemAreaUIElement).Rect;
						rectangle = ((UIElement)menuItemAreaUIElement).Control.RectangleToScreen(rectangle);
					}
					else if (ApplicationMenuControl != null)
					{
						rectangle = ((Control)(object)ApplicationMenuControl).RectangleToScreen(rectangle);
					}
					return rectangle;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Parent
			{
				get
				{
					if (ApplicationMenuControl != null)
					{
						return ((Control)(object)ApplicationMenuControl).AccessibilityObject;
					}
					return null;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleRole Role => AccessibleRole.Grouping;

			public override AccessibleStates State
			{
				get
				{
					AccessibleStates accessibleStates = AccessibleStates.None;
					if (MenuItemAreaUIElement == null)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Invisible;
					}
					return accessibleStates;
				}
			}

			public ApplicationMenuArea ApplicationMenuArea => applicationMenuArea;

			private MenuItemAreaUIElement MenuItemAreaUIElement => applicationMenuArea.UIElement as MenuItemAreaUIElement;

			private ApplicationMenuControl ApplicationMenuControl
			{
				get
				{
					if (ApplicationMenuArea.ApplicationMenu == null || ApplicationMenuArea.ApplicationMenu.MenuAgent == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return ApplicationMenuArea.ApplicationMenu.MenuAgent.PopupControl as ApplicationMenuControl;
				}
			}

			public ApplicationMenuAreaAccessibleObject(ApplicationMenuArea applicationMenuArea)
			{
				this.applicationMenuArea = applicationMenuArea;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
			{
				if (index < ApplicationMenuArea.Tools.Count)
				{
					return ApplicationMenuArea.Tools[index].AccessibilityObject;
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override int GetChildCount()
			{
				int num = 0;
				return ApplicationMenuArea.Tools.Count;
			}

			protected override Control GetMarshallingControl()
			{
				return applicationMenuArea.ToolbarsManager?.DockWithinContainer;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				switch (navdir)
				{
				case AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild:
					return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).GetChild(0);
				case AccessibleNavigation.LastChild:
				{
					int num = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).GetChildCount() - 1;
					if (num < 0)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).GetChild(num);
				}
				case AccessibleNavigation.Down:
					return ApplicationMenuControl.ApplicationMenu.FooterToolbar.AccessibilityObject;
				default:
					return null;
				}
			}
		}

		private ApplicationMenuBase fileMenu;

		private int maxWidth;

		private int minWidth;

		private ApplicationMenuAreaSettings settings;

		private ToolsCollection tools;

		private ApplicationMenuAreaSettingsResolved settingsResolved;

		private AccessibleObject accessibilityObject;

		private NonInheritedTools nonInheritedTools;

		private const int DEFAULT_MAXWIDTH = 0;

		private const int DEFAULT_MINWIDTH = 0;

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_ApplicationMenuArea_P_MaxWidth")]
		public int MaxWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return maxWidth;
			}
			set
			{
				if (maxWidth != value)
				{
					if (value < 0)
					{
						throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", value, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ApplicationMenuArea_MaxWidthCannotBeNegative"));
					}
					maxWidth = value;
					if (MinWidthResolved > MaxWidthResolved)
					{
						MinWidth = value;
					}
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.MaxWidth);
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public int MaxWidthResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (maxWidth == 0)
				{
					return DefaultMaxWidth;
				}
				return maxWidth;
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_ApplicationMenuArea_P_MinWidth")]
		public int MinWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return minWidth;
			}
			set
			{
				if (minWidth != value)
				{
					if (value < 0)
					{
						throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", value, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ApplicationMenuArea_MinWidthCannotBeNegative"));
					}
					minWidth = value;
					if (MaxWidthResolved < MinWidthResolved)
					{
						MaxWidth = value;
					}
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.MinWidth);
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public int MinWidthResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (minWidth == 0)
				{
					return DefaultMinWidth;
				}
				return minWidth;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]

		internal ApplicationMenuAreaBase(ApplicationMenuBase fileMenu)
		{
			this.fileMenu = fileMenu;
		}

		protected ApplicationMenuAreaBase(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "MaxWidth":
					maxWidth = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), maxWidth);
					break;
				case "MinWidth":
					minWidth = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), minWidth);
					break;
				case "Settings":
					settings = (ApplicationMenuAreaSettings)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ApplicationMenuAreaSettings), settings);
					break;
				case "Tools":
					tools = (ToolsCollection)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ToolsCollection), tools);
					break;
				case "Tag":
					DeserializeTag(current);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeMaxWidth()
		{
			return MaxWidth != 0;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetMaxWidth()
		{
			MaxWidth = 0;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeMinWidth()
		{
			return MinWidth != 0;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetMinWidth()
		{
			MinWidth = 0;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeNonInheritedTools()
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeTools())
			{
				return NonInheritedTools.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetNonInheritedTools()
		{
			NonInheritedTools.Clear();
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeSettings()
		{
			if (settings != null)
			{
				return settings.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ResetSettings()
		{
			if (settings != null)
			{
				settings.Reset();
			}
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeTools()
		{
			if (tools != null)
			{
				return tools.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ResetTools()
		{
			if (tools != null)
			{
				tools.Clear();
			}
		}

		public virtual void Reset()
		{
			ResetMaxWidth();
			ResetMinWidth();
			ResetSettings();
			ResetTag();
			ResetTools();
		}

		public virtual bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeMaxWidth() && !ShouldSerializeMinWidth() && !ShouldSerializeSettings() && !ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeTools();
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal Size CalculateRequiredSize()
		{
			//IL_0065: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0070: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0075: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			FileMenu.MenuAgent.CalculateSizeRequiredForMenuItems(MenuItems, FirstItemIndex, out var _, out var minSize, out minSize, out minSize, out minSize);
			if (minSize.Width < MinWidthResolved)
			{
				minSize.Width = MinWidthResolved;
			}
			if (minSize.Width > MaxWidthResolved)
			{
				minSize.Width = MaxWidthResolved;
			}
			UIElementBorderWidths val = ToolbarsManager.CalculateBorderWidths(BorderStyle, BorderSides);
			minSize.Width += ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Right + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Left;
			minSize.Width += ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Top + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Bottom;
			return minSize;
		}

		internal bool ContainsElement(UIElement element)
		{
			if (UIElement == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			while (element != null)
			{
				if (element == UIElement)
				{
					return true;
				}
				element = element.Parent;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void DisconnectMergedItems()
		{
			if (HasTools)
			{
				Tools.DisconnectMergedTools();
			}
		}

		internal void GetToolsThatMatchMnemonic(char charCode, List<IProcessMnemonic> toolsForThisMnemonic)
		{
			foreach (MenuItemBase menuItem in MenuItems)
			{
				if (menuItem.IsMnemonic(charCode))
				{
					toolsForThisMnemonic.Add(menuItem);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void HookupTools()
		{
			Tools.HookUpTools();
		}

		internal void Initialize(ApplicationMenuBase fileMenu)
		{
			this.fileMenu = fileMenu;
			if (settings != null)
			{
				settings.Initialize(this);
			}
			if (tools != null)
			{
				tools.Initialize(this);
			}
		}

		internal void MergeMdiChild(ApplicationMenuAreaBase childApplicationMenuArea)
		{
			if (HasTools || childApplicationMenuArea.HasTools)
			{
				Tools.MergeMdiChildTools(childApplicationMenuArea.Tools);
			}
		}

		internal abstract void ResolveAppearance(UIRole role, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps);

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		protected virtual void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeMaxWidth())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MaxWidth", maxWidth);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeMinWidth())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MinWidth", minWidth);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeSettings())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Settings", settings);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeTools())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Tools", tools);
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
		}

		protected internal abstract UIElement GetUIElement(UIElement parent);

		protected virtual void OnToolAddedToCollection(ToolBase tool, ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnToolRemovedFromCollection(ToolBase tool, ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (settings != null)
			{
				settings.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				settings.Dispose();
			}
			if (tools != null)
			{
				tools.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				tools.Dispose();
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			PropertyIds propertyIds = ((propChange.Source == settings) ? PropertyIds.Settings : ((propChange.Source != tools) ? ((PropertyIds)(-1)) : PropertyIds.Tool));
			NotifyPropChange(propertyIds, propChange);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Empty;
		}

		bool IToolsCollectionOwner.CollectionIsReadOnly(ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
			return false;
		}

		AllowDuplicates IToolsCollectionOwner.AllowDuplicateKeysInCollection(ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
			return AllowDuplicates.Always;
		}

		bool IToolsCollectionOwner.AllowEmptyKeysInCollection(ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
			return false;
		}

		bool IToolsCollectionOwner.CloneToolsWhenAddedToCollection(ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
			return true;
		}

		void IToolsCollectionOwner.OnToolAddedToCollection(ToolBase tool, ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
			OnToolAddedToCollection(tool, toolsCollection);
		}

		void IToolsCollectionOwner.OnBeforeToolRemovedFromCollection(ToolBase tool, ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
		}

		void IToolsCollectionOwner.OnToolRemovedFromCollection(ToolBase tool, ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
			OnToolRemovedFromCollection(tool, toolsCollection);
		}

		bool IToolsCollectionOwner.CanAddTool(ToolBase tool, ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
			return tool != null;
		}

		void IDeserializationCallback.OnDeserialization(object sender)
		{
			if (settings != null)
			{
				settings.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (tools != null)
			{
				tools.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			GetObjectData(info, context);
		}

		{

			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ResolutionOrderInfo resolutionOrder = StyleUtils.GetResolutionOrder(base.ToolbarsManager);
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleBefore && role != null)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseControlInfo && base.Settings.HasAppearance)
			{
				base.Settings.Appearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);

			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleAfter && role != null)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);

				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFBuL);

			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x1000000000uL) != 0L)

				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFEFFFFFFFFFuL);
			}
		}

				//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (value != showIconArea)
				{
					VerifyCanBeModified();
					if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(DefaultableBoolean), value))
					{
						throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("InvalidDefaultableBooleanValue"));
					}
					showIconArea = value;
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ShowIconArea);
				}
			}
		}

		internal ApplicationMenuAreaSettings(object owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected ApplicationMenuAreaSettings(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0058: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				string name = current.Name;
				if (!(name == "ShowIconArea"))
				{
					if (name == "LabelDisplayStyle")
					{
						labelDisplayStyle = (LabelMenuDisplayStyle)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(LabelMenuDisplayStyle), labelDisplayStyle);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					showIconArea = (DefaultableBoolean)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(DefaultableBoolean), showIconArea);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			base.Reset();
			ResetLabelDisplayStyle();
			ResetShowIconArea();
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		protected override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (ShouldSerializeShowIconArea())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ShowIconArea", showIconArea);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeLabelDisplayStyle())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "LabelDisplayStyle", labelDisplayStyle);
			}
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeLabelDisplayStyle())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeShowIconArea();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal bool ShouldSerializeLabelDisplayStyle()
		{
			return labelDisplayStyle != LabelMenuDisplayStyle.Default;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetLabelDisplayStyle()
		{
			LabelDisplayStyle = LabelMenuDisplayStyle.Default;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeShowIconArea()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			return (int)ShowIconArea > 0;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetShowIconArea()
		{
			ShowIconArea = (DefaultableBoolean)0;
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			GetObjectData(info, context);
		}
	}
	public class ApplicationMenuAreaSettingsResolved
	{
		private ApplicationMenuAreaBase fileMenuArea;

		public LabelMenuDisplayStyle LabelDisplayStyleResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (fileMenuArea.Settings.LabelDisplayStyle != LabelMenuDisplayStyle.Default)
				{
					return fileMenuArea.Settings.LabelDisplayStyle;
				}
				if (fileMenuArea.ToolbarsManager.MenuSettings.LabelDisplayStyle != LabelMenuDisplayStyle.Default)
				{
					return fileMenuArea.ToolbarsManager.MenuSettings.LabelDisplayStyle;
				}
				return LabelMenuDisplayStyle.Standard;
			}
		}

		public bool ShowIconAreaResolved
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0023: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if ((int)fileMenuArea.Settings.ShowIconArea != 0)
				{
					return (int)fileMenuArea.Settings.ShowIconArea == 1;
				}
				return fileMenuArea.DefaultShowIconArea;
			}
		}

		public bool ShowToolTipsResolved
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0043: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_005a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0060: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0030: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if (fileMenuArea.HasSettings && (int)fileMenuArea.Settings.ShowToolTips != 0)
				{
					return (int)fileMenuArea.Settings.ShowToolTips == 1;
				}
				if ((int)fileMenuArea.ToolbarsManager.MenuSettings.ShowToolTips != 0)
				{
					return (int)fileMenuArea.ToolbarsManager.MenuSettings.ShowToolTips == 1;
				}
				return fileMenuArea.DefaultShowTooltips;
			}
		}

		public ToolDisplayStyle ToolDisplayStyleResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (fileMenuArea.Settings.ToolDisplayStyle != ToolDisplayStyle.Default)
				{
					return fileMenuArea.Settings.ToolDisplayStyle;
				}
				if (fileMenuArea.ToolbarsManager.MenuSettings.ToolDisplayStyle != ToolDisplayStyle.Default)
				{
					return fileMenuArea.ToolbarsManager.MenuSettings.ToolDisplayStyle;
				}
				return ToolDisplayStyle.DefaultForToolType;
			}
		}

		public bool UseLargeImagesResolved
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0023: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if ((int)fileMenuArea.Settings.UseLargeImages != 0)
				{
					return (int)fileMenuArea.Settings.UseLargeImages == 1;
				}
				return fileMenuArea.DefaultUseLargeImages;
			}
		}

		internal ApplicationMenuAreaSettingsResolved(ApplicationMenuAreaBase fileMenuArea)
		{
			this.fileMenuArea = fileMenuArea;
		}

		internal bool HasMenuAgent => menuAgent != null;

		internal int HeaderHeight
		{
			get

				switch (Ribbon.Style)
				{

				case RibbonStyle.Scenic:
				case RibbonStyle.Office2010:
				case RibbonStyle.Office2013:
					if (Ribbon != null)
					{
						return Ribbon.Metrics.TabItemAreaElementHeight;
					}
					return 24;
				}
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				if (menuAgent == null)

					menuAgent = CreateMenuAgent();
					RefreshDropDownContents();
				}
				return menuAgent;
			}
		}

				{

				case RibbonStyle.Scenic:
				case RibbonStyle.Office2010:
					return offsetFromButton;
				case RibbonStyle.Office2013:
					return Point.Empty;

			set

				offsetFromButton = value;

		internal virtual bool ShouldShowToolTipOnFileMenuButton => true;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public bool IsOpen
		{
			get
			{
				if (menuAgent == null)
				{
					return false;
