		System.Drawing.ContentAlignment IKeyTipProvider.Alignment => Ribbon.Style switch
		{
			RibbonStyle.Scenic => System.Drawing.ContentAlignment.TopLeft, 
			_ => System.Drawing.ContentAlignment.MiddleCenter, 
		};

		string IKeyTipProvider.AutoGeneratePrefix => null;

		string IKeyTipProvider.Caption => null;

		bool IKeyTipProvider.DeactivateParentContainersOnActivate => true;

		bool IKeyTipProvider.IsEnabled => MenuAgent.OkToDropDown;

		bool IKeyTipProvider.IsVisible => true;

		string IKeyTipProvider.KeyTipValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (keyTip != null && keyTip.Length > 0)
				{
					return keyTip;
				}
				if (Ribbon.ToolbarsManager.AutoGenerateKeyTipsResolved)
				{
					return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ApplicationMenuDefaultKeyTip");
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		Point IKeyTipProvider.Location
		{
			get
			{
				UIElement uIElement = Ribbon.ToolbarsManager.GetUIElement(typeof(ApplicationMenuButtonUIElementBase), null);
				if (uIElement == null)
				{
					return Point.Empty;
				}
				Rectangle rectangle = uIElement.Control.RectangleToScreen(uIElement.Rect);
				RibbonStyle style = Ribbon.Style;
				if (style == RibbonStyle.Office2010 || style == RibbonStyle.Office2013)
				{
					return new Point((rectangle.Left + rectangle.Right) / 2, rectangle.Bottom);
				}
				return new Point((rectangle.Left + rectangle.Right) / 2, (rectangle.Top + rectangle.Bottom) / 2);
			}
		}

		char IKeyTipProvider.Mnemonic => '\0';

		Control IKeyTipProvider.OwningControl
		{
			get
			{
				if (Ribbon == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (ribbon.DisplayModeResolved == RibbonDisplayMode.AutoHide && ribbon.IsAutoHidePopupOpen)
				{
					return (Control)(object)ribbon.AutoHideMenuAgent.DockArea;
				}
				return (Control)(object)Ribbon.RibbonContainer;
			}
		}

		bool IKeyTipContainer.ReuseParentKeyTips => false;

		bool INotificationBadgeSettingsOwner.HasNotificationBadgeSettings => notificationBadgeSettings != null;

		NotificationBadgeSettings INotificationBadgeSettingsOwner.NotificationBadgeSettings => (NotificationBadgeSettings)(object)NotificationBadgeSettings;

		INotificationBadgeSettingsOwner INotificationBadgeSettingsOwner.Parent => (INotificationBadgeSettingsOwner)(object)Ribbon;

		internal ApplicationMenuBase(Ribbon ribbon)
		{
			Initialize(ribbon);
		}

		protected ApplicationMenuBase(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "ToolTipText":
					toolTipText = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), toolTipText);
					break;
				case "ToolTipTextFormatted":
					toolTipTextFormatted = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), toolTipTextFormatted);
					break;
				case "ToolTipTitle":
					toolTipTitle = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), toolTipTitle);
					break;
				case "KeyTip":
					keyTip = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), keyTip);
					break;
				case "Tag":
					DeserializeTag(current);
					break;
				case "NotificationBadgeSettings":
					notificationBadgeSettings = (ToolNotificationBadgeSettings)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ToolNotificationBadgeSettings), notificationBadgeSettings);
					((SubObjectBase)(object)notificationBadgeSettings).SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (menuAgent != null)
			{
				menuAgent.Dispose();
				menuAgent = null;
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeNotificationBadgeSettings()
		{
			if (notificationBadgeSettings != null)
			{
				return ((NotificationBadgeSettings)notificationBadgeSettings).ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ResetNotificationBadgeSettings()
		{
			NotificationBadgeSettings = null;
		}

		public virtual void Reset()
		{
			ResetTag();
			string text = (ToolTipTitle = string.Empty);
			string text2 = (ToolTipTextFormatted = text);
			ToolTipText = text2;
			KeyTip = null;
			ResetNotificationBadgeSettings();
		}

		public virtual bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeTag() && (toolTipText == null || toolTipText.Length <= 0) && (toolTipTextFormatted == null || toolTipTextFormatted.Length <= 0) && (toolTipTitle == null || toolTipTitle.Length <= 0) && keyTip == null)
			{
				return ShouldSerializeNotificationBadgeSettings();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public virtual void DropDown()
		{
			FileMenuStyle fileMenuStyleResolved = Ribbon.FileMenuStyleResolved;
			if (fileMenuStyleResolved == FileMenuStyle && !IsOpen)
			{
				MenuAgent.DropDown();
			}
		}

		public virtual void CloseUp()
		{
			FileMenuStyle fileMenuStyleResolved = Ribbon.FileMenuStyleResolved;
			if (fileMenuStyleResolved == FileMenuStyle && IsOpen)
			{
				MenuAgent.DropDown();
			}
		}

		internal void AddMenuItemsToCollection(MenuItemsCollection menuItems, ToolsCollection tools, MenuItemBase[] oldMenuItems)
		{
			if (menuAgent != null)
			{
				menuItems.Clear();
				ToolbarsManagerUtilities.PopulateMenuItemsCollection(menuItems, tools, oldMenuItems);
			}
		}

		internal void BringIntoView(ToolBase tool)
		{
			if (!IsOpen)
			{
				MenuAgent.DropDown();
				if (!IsOpen)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (!tool.OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
			{
				MenuItemBase menuItemFromTool = MenuAgent.GetMenuItemFromTool(tool);
				if (menuItemFromTool != null && menuItemFromTool != MenuAgent.ActiveMenuItem)
				{
					MenuAgent.ActivateMenuItem(menuItemFromTool);
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual void CloseDropDown()
		{
			if (menuAgent != null)
			{
				menuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay: false);
			}
		}

		internal abstract ApplicationMenuAgentBase CreateMenuAgent();

		internal virtual List<IKeyTipProvider> GetKeyTipProviders()
		{
			return new List<IKeyTipProvider>();
		}

		internal virtual void HookupAllSubObjects()
		{
		}

		internal virtual void Initialize(Ribbon ribbon)
		{
			this.ribbon = ribbon;
		}

		internal virtual void RefreshDropDownContents()
		{
		}

		internal virtual void RefreshDropDownIfToolsWereChanged()
		{
		}

		internal virtual void ResetDropDownVersion()
		{
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		protected virtual void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			if (keyTip != null)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "KeyTip", keyTip);
			}
			if (toolTipText != null && toolTipText.Length > 0)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ToolTipText", toolTipText);
			}
			if (toolTipTextFormatted != null && toolTipTextFormatted.Length > 0)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ToolTipTextFormatted", toolTipTextFormatted);
			}
			if (toolTipTitle != null && toolTipTitle.Length > 0)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ToolTipTitle", toolTipTitle);
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
			if (ShouldSerializeNotificationBadgeSettings())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "NotificationBadgeSettings", notificationBadgeSettings);
			}
		}

		protected bool IsToolActive(ToolBase tool)
		{
			if (tool is PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool)
			{
				if (popupMenuTool.GetDrawAsActiveHelper(checkOtherTools: false))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			else if (tool.DrawAsActive)
			{
				MenuItemBase menuItemFromTool = MenuAgent.GetMenuItemFromTool(tool);
				if (menuItemFromTool == null || menuItemFromTool.IsActive)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		bool IKeyTipProvider.Activate()
		{
			if (IsOpen)
			{
				return true;
			}
			Ribbon.SetItemWithFocus(new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.ApplicationMenu, this));
			MenuAgent.DropDown();
			if (MenuAgent.IsOpen)
			{
				((Control)(object)MenuAgent.PopupControl).Refresh();
			}
			return IsOpen;
		}

		bool IKeyTipProvider.Equals(IKeyTipProvider provider)
		{
			return this == provider;
		}

		IKeyTipContainer IKeyTipProvider.GetContainer()
		{
			return this;
		}

		void IKeyTipContainer.Deactivate()
		{
			MenuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay: false, shouldHideAssociatedKeyTips: false);
		}

		IKeyTipProvider[] IKeyTipContainer.GetKeyTipProviders()
		{
			List<IKeyTipProvider> list = new List<IKeyTipProvider>();
			list.AddRange(GetKeyTipProviders());
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			GetObjectData(info, context);
		}
	}
	public class ApplicationMenuButtonUIElement : ApplicationMenuButtonUIElementBase
	{
		private bool DrawAsActive
		{
			get
			{
				bool flag = ((ButtonUIElementBase)this).IsHotTracked;
				Ribbon ribbon = base.Ribbon;
				if (flag)
				{
					if (ribbon != null && !ribbon.ApplicationMenu.IsOpen)
					{
						UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = ribbon?.ToolbarsManager;
						if (ultraToolbarsManager == null || ultraToolbarsManager.IsDesignMode)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						else if (ultraToolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture != null && !ultraToolbarsManager.CanHotTrackWhileInEditMode)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						else if (ultraToolbarsManager.CurrentPopupControl != null && !(ultraToolbarsManager.CurrentPopupControl is ApplicationMenuControl))
						{
							flag = false;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (ribbon != null && ribbon.ItemWithFocus != null && ribbon.ItemWithFocus.ItemType == RibbonItemType.ApplicationMenu)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				return flag;
			}
		}

		protected override bool ClipSelf => true;

		protected override bool IsButtonStyleMouseActive => true;

		public override bool IsPressed
		{
			get
			{
				if (((UIElement)this).Parent is ApplicationMenuControlUIElement)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (!((ButtonUIElementBase)this).IsPressed && !base.Ribbon.ApplicationMenu.IsOpen)
				{
					if (base.Ribbon.HasApplicationMenu2010)
					{
						return base.Ribbon.ApplicationMenu2010.IsOpen;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public override Region Region
		{
			get
			{
				using GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
				graphicsPath.AddEllipse(((UIElement)this).Rect);
				return new Region(graphicsPath);
			}
		}

		protected override bool WantsMouseHoverNotification
		{
			get
			{
				if (((ButtonUIElementBase)this).IsPressed)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (base.ToolbarsManager == null || base.ToolbarsManager.Customizing)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal ApplicationMenuButtonUIElement(RibbonAreaUIElement parent)
			: base((UIElement)(object)parent)
		{
		}

		internal ApplicationMenuButtonUIElement(ApplicationMenuControlUIElement parent)
			: base((UIElement)(object)parent)

		}

		protected override void DrawBackColor(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			if (Utilities.IsHighContrast)
			{
				Rectangle rect = ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Element.Rect;
				rect.Inflate(-5, -5);
				using GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
				graphicsPath.AddEllipse(rect);
				((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.FillPath(((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).BackBrush, graphicsPath);
				return;
			}
			((ButtonUIElementBase)this).DrawBackColor(ref drawParams);
		}

		protected override void DrawBorders(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			if (Utilities.IsHighContrast)
			{
				Rectangle rect = ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Element.Rect;
				int num = 4;
				rect.Inflate(-num + 1, -num + 1);
				Pen pen = ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).GetPen((PenType)0, ((AppearanceData)(ref drawParams.AppearanceData)).BorderColor);
				((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawEllipse(pen, rect);
				rect.Inflate(-1, -1);
				Pen pen2 = ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).GetPen((PenType)13, ((AppearanceData)(ref drawParams.AppearanceData)).BorderColor2);
				((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawEllipse(pen2, rect);
				rect.Inflate(-1, -1);
				((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawEllipse(pen, rect);
			}
			else
			{
				((ButtonUIElementBase)this).DrawBorders(ref drawParams);
			}
		}

		protected override void DrawImage(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			Image image = ((AppearanceData)(ref drawParams.AppearanceData)).GetImage((ImageList)null);
			if (image != null)
			{
				AnimatedImageManager.AnimateImage(image, (UIElement)(object)this);
				Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(size: new Size(Math.Min(image.Width, 32), Math.Min(image.Height, 32)), location: Point.Empty);
				DrawUtility.AdjustHAlign((HAlign)2, ref rectangle, ((UIElement)this).rectValue);
				DrawUtility.AdjustVAlign((VAlign)2, ref rectangle, ((UIElement)this).rectValue);
				((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).DrawImage(image, rectangle, true, (ImageAttributes)null, true);
			}
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearanceData, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			//IL_0057: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0079: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0088: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0082: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0099: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Ribbon ribbon = base.Ribbon;
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 1uL) != 0L)
			{
				if (Utilities.IsHighContrast)
				{
					if (((ButtonUIElementBase)this).IsHotTracked || ((ButtonUIElementBase)this).IsPressed)
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearanceData)).BackColor = SystemColors.Highlight;
					}
					else
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearanceData)).BackColor = SystemColors.Control;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearanceData)).BackColor = Color.Transparent;
				}
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps ^ 1uL);
			}
			ResolutionOrderInfo resolutionOrder = StyleUtils.GetResolutionOrder(base.ToolbarsManager);
			UIRole uIRole = ((UIElement)this).UIRole;
			bool drawAsActive = DrawAsActive;
			bool isPressed = ((ButtonUIElementBase)this).IsPressed;
			RoleState val = (isPressed ? ((RoleState)8) : ((!drawAsActive) ? ((RoleState)1) : ((RoleState)4)));
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleBefore && uIRole != null)
			{
				uIRole.ResolveAppearance(ref appearanceData, ref requestedProps, val);
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseControlInfo && ((ulong)requestedProps & 0x100uL) != 0L && ribbon != null && ribbon.ApplicationMenuButtonImage != null)
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearanceData)).Image = ribbon.ApplicationMenuButtonImage;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps ^ 0x100uL);
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleAfter && uIRole != null)
			{
				uIRole.ResolveAppearance(ref appearanceData, ref requestedProps, val);
			}
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x1000uL) != 0L && !Utilities.IsHighContrast)
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearanceData)).ImageBackground = ribbon.ToolbarsManager.GetApplicationMenuButtonImage(drawAsActive, isPressed);
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps ^ 0x1000uL);
			}
			if (Utilities.IsHighContrast)
			{
				if (((ulong)requestedProps & 4uL) != 0L)
				{
					if (((ButtonUIElementBase)this).IsMouseDownAndOver || ((ButtonUIElementBase)this).IsPressed)
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearanceData)).BorderColor = SystemColors.ControlDark;
					}
					else if (((ButtonUIElementBase)this).IsMouseOver)
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearanceData)).BorderColor = SystemColors.HighlightText;
					}
					else
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearanceData)).BorderColor = SystemColors.ControlLightLight;
					}
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps ^ 4uL);
				}
				if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x1000000000uL) != 0L)
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearanceData)).BorderColor2 = SystemColors.WindowFrame;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps ^ 0x1000000000uL);
				}
			}
			((ButtonUIElementBase)this).InitAppearance(ref appearanceData, ref requestedProps);
			requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)0;
		}

		protected override void OnAfterDraw(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			if (base.IsSelected)
			{
				using Pen pen = Utilities.CreatePen(SystemColors.ControlText, 2f);
				Rectangle rect = Rectangle.Inflate(((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders, -2, -2);
				rect.Width--;
				rect.Height--;
				((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawEllipse(pen, rect);
			}
			((UIElement)this).OnAfterDraw(ref drawParams);
		}

		protected override void OnDoubleClick(bool adjustableArea)
		{
			if (!adjustableArea && ((ButtonUIElementBase)this).leftButtonDown)
			{
				((ButtonUIElementBase)this).leftButtonDown = false;
				base.Ribbon?.OnApplicationMenuButtonDoubleClick();
			}
			else
			{
				((ButtonUIElementBase)this).OnDoubleClick(adjustableArea);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseHover()
		{
			if (base.ToolbarsManager != null && !base.ToolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				Point mousePosition = Control.MousePosition;
				mousePosition.Offset(0, 20);
				ApplicationMenuBase resolvedFileMenu = base.Ribbon.GetResolvedFileMenu();
				if (resolvedFileMenu != null && !resolvedFileMenu.ShouldShowToolTipOnFileMenuButton)
				{
					return;
				}
				base.ToolbarsManager.ImmediateToolTipDisplayMode = true;
				string toolTipText = resolvedFileMenu.ToolTipText;
				string toolTipTitle = resolvedFileMenu.ToolTipTitle;
				string toolTipTextFormatted = resolvedFileMenu.ToolTipTextFormatted;
				base.ToolbarsManager.DisplayToolTipHelper(toolTipText, toolTipTitle, toolTipTextFormatted, string.Empty, suppressShortcuts: true, Rectangle.Empty, mousePosition);
			}
			((UIElement)this).OnMouseHover();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager != null)
			{
				toolbarsManager.ImmediateToolTipDisplayMode = false;
				toolbarsManager.HideToolTip();
				if (toolbarsManager.Ribbon.AreTransitionsEnabled)
				{
					((UIElement)this).InitiateTransition(UltraToolbarsManager.DefaultTransitionSettings, (UIElementTransitionType)0);
				}
			}
			((ButtonUIElementBase)this).OnMouseLeave();
		}
	}

	public class ApplicationMenuControl : PopupControlBase

		public class ApplicationMenuControlAccessibleObject : Control.ControlAccessibleObject
		{
			public override string Name
			{
				get
				{
					string name = base.Name;
					if (name != null && name.Length > 0)
					{
						return name;
					}
					return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AccessibleName_ApplicationMenu");
				}
				set
				{
					base.Name = value;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Parent => ApplicationMenuControl.ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.ApplicationMenu.ApplicationMenuButtonAccessibilityObject;

			public override AccessibleRole Role => AccessibleRole.MenuPopup;

			public ApplicationMenuControl ApplicationMenuControl => base.Owner as ApplicationMenuControl;

			public ApplicationMenuControlAccessibleObject(ApplicationMenuControl applicationMenuControl)
				: base((Control)(object)applicationMenuControl)
			{
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
			{
				return index switch
				{
					0 => ApplicationMenuControl.ApplicationMenu.ToolAreaLeft.AccessibilityObject, 
					1 => ApplicationMenuControl.ApplicationMenu.ToolAreaRight.AccessibilityObject, 
					2 => ApplicationMenuControl.ApplicationMenu.FooterToolbar.AccessibilityObject, 
					_ => null, 
				};
			}

			public override int GetChildCount()
			{
				return 3;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				switch (navdir)
				{
				case AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild:
					return GetChild(0);
				case AccessibleNavigation.LastChild:
				{
					int index = GetChildCount() - 1;
					return GetChild(index);
				}
				default:
					return null;
				}
			}
		}

		private ApplicationMenu fileMenu;

		private ApplicationMenuControlUIElement mainElement;

		internal ApplicationMenu ApplicationMenu => fileMenu;

		internal ApplicationMenuControl(ApplicationMenuAgent menuAgent)
			: base(menuAgent)
		{
			fileMenu = menuAgent.ApplicationMenu;
		}

		internal static ApplicationMenuControl Create(ApplicationMenuAgent menuAgent)
		{
			try
			{
				UIPermission permission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
				ToolbarsManagerUtilities.VerifyPermission(permission);
				return CreatePopupGalleryControlFull(menuAgent);
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				return new ApplicationMenuControl(menuAgent);
			}
		}

		private static ApplicationMenuControl CreatePopupGalleryControlFull(ApplicationMenuAgent menuAgent)
		{
			try
			{
				return new ApplicationMenuControlTrusted(menuAgent);
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				return new ApplicationMenuControl(menuAgent);
			}
		}

		protected override AccessibleObject CreateAccessibilityInstance()
		{
			return base.ToolbarsManager.CreateAccessibilityInstance(this);
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar footerToolbar = ApplicationMenu.FooterToolbar;
			UltraToolbarsDockArea footerDockArea = ApplicationMenu.FooterDockArea;
			if (footerToolbar != null && footerDockArea != null)
			{
				foreach (ToolBase tool in footerToolbar.Tools)
				{
					ControlContainerTool controlContainerTool = tool as ControlContainerTool;
					if (controlContainerTool == null)
					{
						controlContainerTool = tool.UnderlyingTool as ControlContainerTool;
					}
					if (controlContainerTool != null && controlContainerTool.Control != null)
					{
						((Control)(object)footerDockArea).Controls.Remove(controlContainerTool.Control);
					}
				}
			}
			ApplicationMenu.ResetFooterDockArea();
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		protected internal override ControlUIElementBase GetControlUIElement()
		{
			if (mainElement == null)
			{
				mainElement = new ApplicationMenuControlUIElement(this);
			}
			return (ControlUIElementBase)(object)mainElement;
		}

		protected override void OnResize(EventArgs e)
		{
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnResize(e);
			((ApplicationMenuAgent)base.MenuAgent).PositionChildrenInControl(((Control)(object)this).Size);
		}
	}
	[ToolboxItem(false)]
	public class ApplicationMenuControlTrusted : ApplicationMenuControl
	{
		internal ApplicationMenuControlTrusted(ApplicationMenuAgent menuAgent)
			: base(menuAgent)
		{
		}

		[UIPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Window = UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows)]
		protected override bool ProcessDialogKey(Keys keyData)
		{
			Keys keys = keyData & ~(Keys.Shift | Keys.Control | Keys.Alt);
			switch (keys)
			{
			case Keys.Escape:
				if (base.MenuAgent.IsOpen)
				{
					return base.MenuAgent.ToolbarsManager.ProcessEscapeKey(passToPopupContainer: false);
				}
				break;
			case Keys.Return:
			case Keys.Left:
			case Keys.Up:
			case Keys.Right:
			case Keys.Down:
				return base.MenuAgent.ToolbarsManager.ProcessNavigationKey(keys, passToPopupContainer: false);
			}
			return ((Control)(object)this).ProcessDialogKey(keyData);
		}
	}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 4uL) != 0L)
			{
				switch (fileMenu.Ribbon.Style)
				{
				default:
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor = Office2007ColorTable.Colors.ApplicationMenuBorderColor;
					break;
				case RibbonStyle.Office2010:
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor = Office2010ColorTable.Colors.ApplicationMenu2010BorderColor;

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			((ArrayList)(object)((UIElement)this).ChildElements).Clear();
			if (!fileMenu.IsOpen && !fileMenu.IsOpening)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle rectInsideBorders = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
			int headerHeight = fileMenu.HeaderHeight;
			int sidebarWidthLeft = fileMenu.SidebarWidthLeft;
			int sidebarWidthRight = fileMenu.SidebarWidthRight;
			Rectangle rect = rectInsideBorders;
			rect.Height = headerHeight;
			((UIElement)HeaderElement).Rect = rect;
			((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)HeaderElement);
			Rectangle rectangle = rectInsideBorders;
			rectangle.X += sidebarWidthLeft;
			rectangle.Width -= sidebarWidthLeft + sidebarWidthRight;
			rectangle.Y += headerHeight;
			rectangle.Height -= ((Control)(object)fileMenu.FooterDockArea).Height + headerHeight;
			((UIElement)MainElement).Rect = rectangle;
			((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)MainElement);
			if (sidebarWidthLeft > 0)
			{
				Rectangle rect2 = rectangle;
				rect2.X -= sidebarWidthLeft;
				rect2.Width = sidebarWidthLeft;
				((UIElement)SideBarLeftElement).Rect = rect2;
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)SideBarLeftElement);
			}
			if (sidebarWidthRight > 0)
			{
				Rectangle rect3 = rectangle;
				rect3.X = rectangle.Right;
				rect3.Width = sidebarWidthRight;
				((UIElement)SideBarRightElement).Rect = rect3;
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)SideBarRightElement);
			}
			switch (fileMenu.Ribbon.Style)
			{
			case RibbonStyle.Scenic:
			case RibbonStyle.Office2010:
			case RibbonStyle.Office2013:
			{
				UIElement val = (UIElement)(object)(fileMenu.Ribbon.ToolbarsManager.GetUIElement(typeof(ScenicApplicationMenuButtonUIElement), null) as ScenicApplicationMenuButtonUIElement);
				if (val != null)
				{
					Point pt = ((UIElement)this).Control.PointToClient(val.Control.PointToScreen(val.Rect.Location));
					if (((UIElement)this).Rect.Contains(pt))
					{
						Rectangle rect4 = new Rectangle(pt.X, rect.Y, fileMenu.Ribbon.Metrics.ScenicApplicationMenuButtonWidth, rect.Height - 1);
						((UIElement)ScenicButtonElement).Rect = rect4;
						((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)ScenicButtonElement);
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			}
			UIElement val2 = (UIElement)(object)(fileMenu.Ribbon.ToolbarsManager.GetUIElement(typeof(ApplicationMenuButtonUIElement), null) as ApplicationMenuButtonUIElement);
			if (val2 != null)
			{
				Rectangle rect5 = ((UIElement)this).Control.RectangleToClient(val2.Control.RectangleToScreen(val2.Rect));
				if (((UIElement)this).Rect.IntersectsWith(rect5))
				{
					((UIElement)ButtonElement).Rect = rect5;
					((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)ButtonElement);
				}
			}
		}

		protected ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				string name = current.Name;
				if (name == "Settings")
				{
					settings = (ApplicationMenuFooterToolbarSettings)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ApplicationMenuFooterToolbarSettings), settings);
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(AccessibleEvents accEvent, int childID)
		{
			UltraToolbarsDockArea footerDockArea = ApplicationMenu.FooterDockArea;
			if (footerDockArea != null && !((Control)(object)footerDockArea).IsDisposed && !((Control)(object)footerDockArea).Disposing)
			{
				footerDockArea.AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(accEvent, childID);
			}
		}

			throw new NotSupportedException("The File Menu Footer Toolbar can not be cloned.");

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		protected override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{

				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Settings", settings);
			}
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
		}

		internal override void Initialize(object owner)
		{
			fileMenu = owner as ApplicationMenu;
			if (fileMenu != null)
			{
				manager = fileMenu.Ribbon.ToolbarsManager;
			}
			base.Initialize(owner);
			if (settings != null)
			{
				settings.Initialize(this);
			}
		}

		internal override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
		{
			switch (navdir)
			{
			case AccessibleNavigation.Up:
			case AccessibleNavigation.Previous:
				return ApplicationMenu.ToolAreaRight.AccessibilityObject;
			case AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild:
			case AccessibleNavigation.LastChild:
			{
				UltraToolbarsDockArea footerDockArea = ApplicationMenu.FooterDockArea;
				if (footerDockArea != null)
				{
					return footerDockArea.NavigateToolbar(this, navdir);
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (settings != null)
			{
				settings.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				settings.Dispose();
				settings = null;
			}
			fileMenu = null;
			manager = null;
			settingsResolved = null;
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (propChange.Source == base.Tools && ToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = base.UIElement;
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					uIElement.DirtyChildElements();
				}
			}
			if (propChange.Source == settings)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Settings, propChange);
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnSubObjectPropChanged(propChange);
			}
		}

		internal override void OnToolActivated(ToolBase tool)
		{
			base.OnToolActivated(tool);
			if (ApplicationMenu.IsOpen)
			{
				ApplicationMenuAgentBase menuAgent = ApplicationMenu.MenuAgent;
				if (menuAgent.ActiveMenuItem != null)
				{
					menuAgent.ActiveMenuItem.Deactivate();
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			ResetSettings();
			base.Reset();
		}

				//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0023: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if ((int)toolbar.Settings.ShowToolTips != 0)
				{
					return (int)toolbar.Settings.ShowToolTips == 1;
				}
				if (toolbar.ToolbarsManager != null && !toolbar.ToolbarsManager.ShowToolTips)

					return false;
				}
				return true;

		}

		{

				return 6;

				//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0023: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4

				if (toolbar.ToolbarsManager != null)

	public class UltraToolbarsManagerRole : ComponentRole
	{
		internal const string TOOLBARSMANAGER_ROLE_NAME = "UltraToolbarsManager";

		private UltraToolbarsManager manager;

		private string[] cachedRoleNames;

		public UltraToolbarsManager Manager => manager;

		protected override ISynchronizeInvoke SynchronizingObject => manager.DockWithinContainer;

		public UltraToolbarsManagerRole(UltraToolbarsManager manager)
			: base((Component)(object)manager, "UltraToolbarsManager")
		{
			this.manager = manager;
			((ComponentRole)this).PropertiesCacheCount = 16;
		}

		protected override string[] GetRoleNames()
		{
			if (cachedRoleNames == null)
			{
				cachedRoleNames = StyleUtils.GetSortedRoleNamesForCaching();
			}
			return cachedRoleNames;
		}

		protected override void OnStyleChanged()
		{
			if (manager.HasRibbon)
			{
				manager.Ribbon.DirtyAllMetrics();
			}
			manager.DirtyAllElements();
		}

		protected override void OnStyleCachedCleared()
		{
			manager.SynchronizeToolbarFormBorderStyle();
		}
	}

		private StyleUtils()
		{
		}

		internal static ResolutionOrderInfo GetResolutionOrder(UltraToolbarsManager manager)
		{
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (manager != null)
			{
				return ((UltraStylableComponent)manager).ComponentRole.GetResolutionOrderInfo();
			}
			return new ResolutionOrderInfo((ResolutionOrder)4);
		}

		internal static UIRole GetRole(UltraToolbarsManager manager, Role role)
		{
			return ((UltraStylableComponent)manager).ComponentRole.GetRole((int)role);
		}

		internal static UIRole GetRole(UltraToolbarsManager manager, Role role, out ResolutionOrderInfo resOrder)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ComponentRole componentRole = ((UltraStylableComponent)manager).ComponentRole;
			resOrder = componentRole.GetResolutionOrderInfo();
			return componentRole.GetRole((int)role);
		}

		internal static bool GetCachedPropertyVal(UltraToolbarsManager manager, CustomProperty prop, out object val)
		{
			return GetCachedPropertyVal(manager, (int)prop, out val);
		}

		private static bool GetCachedPropertyVal(UltraToolbarsManager manager, int prop, out object val)
		{
			ComponentRole componentRole = GetComponentRole(manager);
			if (componentRole != null)
			{
				return componentRole.GetCachedProperty(prop, ref val);
			}
			val = null;
			return false;
		}

		internal static object GetCachedPropertyVal(UltraToolbarsManager manager, CustomProperty prop, object controlVal, object defVal, object resolveVal)
		{
			if (!GetCachedPropertyVal(manager, prop, out var val))
			{
				return CachePropertyValue(manager, prop, controlVal, defVal, resolveVal);
			}
			return val;
		}

		private static object ResolveValueHelper(object val, object defVal, object resolveVal)
		{
			if (defVal != resolveVal && object.Equals(val, defVal))
			{
				return resolveVal;
			}
			return val;
		}

		internal static object CachePropertyValue(UltraToolbarsManager manager, CustomProperty prop, object controlVal, object notSetVal, object fallbackVal)
		{
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0048: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0076: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ComponentRole componentRole = GetComponentRole(manager);
			if (componentRole != null)
			{
				string customPropertyName = GetCustomPropertyName(prop);
				object obj = null;
				if (componentRole.HasProperty(customPropertyName))
				{
					obj = componentRole.GetProperty(customPropertyName);
				}
				if (prop == CustomProperty.Style && (!(obj is ToolbarStyle) || (int)(ToolbarStyle)obj == 0))
				{
					ViewStyle viewStyle = componentRole.ViewStyle;
					switch ((int)viewStyle)
					{
					case 2:
						obj = (object)(ToolbarStyle)1;
						break;
					case 4:
						obj = (object)(ToolbarStyle)2;
						break;
					case 5:
						obj = (object)(ToolbarStyle)3;
						break;
					case 1:
					case 3:
						obj = (object)(ToolbarStyle)4;
						break;
					case 6:
						obj = (object)(ToolbarStyle)5;
						break;
					case 7:
						obj = (object)(ToolbarStyle)7;
						break;
					case 8:
						obj = (object)(ToolbarStyle)8;
						break;
					case 9:
						obj = (object)(ToolbarStyle)9;
						break;
					default:
						obj = (object)(ToolbarStyle)0;
						break;
					}
				}
				return componentRole.CachePropertyValue(obj, controlVal, notSetVal, fallbackVal, (int)prop);
			}
			return ResolveValueHelper(controlVal, notSetVal, fallbackVal);
		}

		internal static void DirtyCachedPropertyVals(UltraToolbarsManager manager)
		{
			ComponentRole componentRole = GetComponentRole(manager);
			if (componentRole != null)
			{
				componentRole.ClearCachedPropertyValues();
			}
		}

		private static string[] GetCustomPropertyNames()
		{
			if (cachedCustomPropertyNames != null)
			{
				return cachedCustomPropertyNames;
			}
			object[] customPropertiesInfo = GetCustomPropertiesInfo();
			string[] array = new string[customPropertiesInfo.Length / 6];
			for (int i = 0; i < customPropertiesInfo.Length; i += 6)
			{
				array[i / 6] = (string)customPropertiesInfo[i];
			}
			return cachedCustomPropertyNames = array;
		}

		internal static string GetCustomPropertyName(CustomProperty prop)
		{
			string[] customPropertyNames = GetCustomPropertyNames();
			return customPropertyNames[(int)prop];
		}

	public class ArrowUIElement : ImageUIElementBase
	{
		public enum ArrowOrientation
		{
			Down,
			Up,
			Right,
			Left
		}

		public enum ArrowSize
		{
			Small,
			Medium,
			ExtraLarge,
			Large
		}

		private UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager;

		private ArrowOrientation orientation;

		private ArrowSize size;

		public override Image Image
		{
			get
			{
				return toolbarsManager.GetArrowBitmap(orientation, size);
			}
			set
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_0"));
			}
		}

		public ArrowUIElement(UIElement parentElement, UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager, ArrowOrientation orientation, ArrowSize size)
			: base(parentElement)
		{
			this.toolbarsManager = toolbarsManager;
			this.orientation = orientation;
			this.size = size;
		}

		protected override ImageAttributes GetImageAttributes(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			ImageAttributes imageAttributes = ((ImageUIElementBase)this).GetImageAttributes(ref drawParams);
			Color foreColor = ((AppearanceData)(ref drawParams.AppearanceData)).ForeColor;
			if (foreColor != Color.Magenta)
			{
				ColorMap[] array = new ColorMap[1]
				{
					new ColorMap()
				};
				array[0].NewColor = foreColor;
				array[0].OldColor = Color.Magenta;
				imageAttributes.SetRemapTable(array);
			}
			return imageAttributes;
		}

		protected internal void Initialize(ArrowOrientation orientation, ArrowSize size)
		{
			this.orientation = orientation;
			this.size = size;
		}
	}
	[Serializable]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(ButtonToolConverter))]
	public class ButtonTool : ToolBase, ISerializable
	{
		public class ButtonToolConverter : ExpandableObjectConverter
		{
			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(ButtonTool).GetConstructor(new Type[1] { typeof(string) });
					ButtonTool buttonTool = (ButtonTool)value;
					return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[1] { buttonTool.Key }, isComplete: false);
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		public class ButtonToolUiaProviderStub : ToolBaseUiaProviderStub
		{
			internal ButtonToolUiaProviderStub(ButtonTool tool)
				: base(tool)
			{
			}

			public override ControlType GetControlType()
			{
				return ControlType.Button;
			}
		}

		protected internal override AccessibleStates AccessibleState
		{
			get
			{
				AccessibleStates accessibleStates = base.AccessibleState;
				if (base.VisibleResolved && base.EnabledResolved)
				{
					accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Focusable;
				}
				return accessibleStates;
			}
		}

		internal override UIElementButtonStyle ButtonStyle
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManagerInControl = base.ToolbarsManagerInControl;
				if (toolbarsManagerInControl != null)
				{
					ToolbarStyle styleResolved = toolbarsManagerInControl.StyleResolved;
					return GetDefaultButtonStyle(styleResolved);
				}
				return base.ButtonStyle;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		protected internal override bool CanSetDisplayStyle => true;

		protected override AccessibleRole DefaultAccessibleRole
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.OwnerIsMenuInternal || base.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)
				{
					return AccessibleRole.MenuItem;
				}
				return AccessibleRole.PushButton;
			}
		}

		protected override string DefaultAction
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.EnabledResolved)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (base.OwnerIsMenuInternal || base.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)
				{
					return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DefaultAction_Item_On_Menu");
				}
				return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DefaultAction_ButtonTool_On_Toolbar");
			}

		protected internal override Rectangle GetTextArea()
		{
			ToolBase toolBeingDisplayed = base.ToolBeingDisplayed;
			if (!(toolBeingDisplayed.UIElement is ButtonToolUIElement buttonToolUIElement))
			{
				return Rectangle.Empty;
			}
			if (toolBeingDisplayed.IsLargeRibbonTool)
			{
				Size empty = Size.Empty;
				Point location = Point.Empty;
				UIElementEnumerator enumerator = ((UIElement)buttonToolUIElement).ChildElements.GetEnumerator();
				try
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						UIElement current = enumerator.Current;
						if (((object)current).GetType() == typeof(TextUIElement))
						{
							if (location.IsEmpty)
							{
								location = current.Rect.Location;
							}
							empty.Width += current.Rect.Width;
							empty.Height += current.Rect.Height;
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
					{
						disposable.Dispose();
					}
				}
				return new Rectangle(location, empty);
			}
			return ((UIElement)((ImageAndTextButtonUIElementBase)buttonToolUIElement).ImageAndTextElement.TextElement).Rect;
		}

		{
			mouseDownSinceLastClick = true;
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null || toolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!tool.EnabledResolved)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (toolbarsManager.ActiveTool != tool)

				toolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(tool, setOn: true, clearToolBeingEdited: true, clearToolbarWithCaptureIfNecessary: true);
			}

			{

		protected override void OnMouseEnter()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null || toolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (tool != null && tool.PopupTool != null)
			{
				((ButtonUIElementBase)this).OnMouseEnter();
				return;
			}
			tool.DisplayToolTip();
			if (!tool.EnabledResolved)
			{
				return;
			}
			toolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(tool, setOn: true, clearToolBeingEdited: false);
			ToolBase activeTool = toolbarsManager.ActiveTool;
			if (activeTool == null || !activeTool.Equals(tool))

				return;

			try

		protected override void OnMouseHover()
		{

		protected override void OnMouseLeave()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (toolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				((ButtonUIElementBase)this).OnMouseLeave();
				return;
			}
			ToolBase toolBase = tool;
			if (toolBase != null && toolBase.PopupTool != null)
			{
				((ButtonUIElementBase)this).OnMouseLeave();
				return;
			}
			if (toolBase != null)
			{
				toolBase.ForceDrawAsActive = false;
			}
			toolBase.HideToolTip();
			toolbarsManager.ImmediateToolTipDisplayMode = false;
			if (!toolBase.EnabledResolved)
			{
				return;
			}
			((ButtonUIElementBase)this).OnMouseLeave();
			if (toolBase.EnabledResolved)
			{
				ToolBase activeTool = toolbarsManager.ActiveTool;
				if (activeTool == toolBase || activeTool == toolBase.UnderlyingTool)
				{
					toolBase.DeactivateToolUnlessOwnerHasCapture();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager != null && !toolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				ToolBase activeTool = toolbarsManager.ActiveTool;
				if (activeTool == null)
				{
					tool.DisplayToolTip();
				}
				else if (activeTool.Equals(tool))
				{
					tool.DisplayToolTip();
					((ButtonUIElementBase)this).OnMouseMove(e);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseUp(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null || toolbarsManager.Customizing)

			}
			if (!tool.EnabledResolved)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!((UIElement)this).Rect.Contains(new Point(e.X, e.Y)))
			{
				return ((ButtonUIElementBase)this).OnMouseUp(e);
			}
			return DoClickProcessing(e);
		}

		private Corners CalculateRoundCorners()

		private bool DoClickProcessing(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			bool result = false;
			DateTime now = DateTime.Now;
			DateTime value = lastClickProcessedTime;
			if (!((ButtonUIElementBase)this).leftButtonDown)
			{
				return result;
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			try
			{
				if (toolbarsManager.Customizing)
				{
					return result;
				}
				if (!tool.EnabledResolved)
				{
					return result;
				}
				if (tool is SystemMenuTool)
				{
					return result;
				}
				PopupToolBase popupTool = tool.PopupTool;
				if (popupTool != null && popupTool.DisplayDropDownArrow && !popupTool.DisplayDropDownArrowSegmented)
				{
					return result;
				}
				if (e != null)
				{
					result = ((ButtonUIElementBase)this).OnMouseUp(e);
				}
				if (!mouseDownSinceLastClick && now.Subtract(value).TotalMilliseconds < (double)SystemInformation.DoubleClickTime)
				{
					return result;
				}
				tool.IncrementClickCount();
				if (toolbarsManager.ActiveTool != tool)
				{
					toolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(tool, setOn: true, clearToolBeingEdited: true, clearToolbarWithCaptureIfNecessary: true);
					if (toolbarsManager.ActiveTool != tool)
					{
						return result;
					}
				}
				toolbarsManager.PopupManager.CloseAllPopups(onlyCloseLeafContiguousPopupChain: true, onlyCloseDropDowns: true);
				((UIElement)this).DirtyChildElements();
				tool.OnToolClick();
				result = true;
				if (toolbarsManager == null || ((UIElement)this).Control == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (((UIElement)this).Control.IsDisposed)
				{
					return false;
				}
				((ButtonUIElementBase)this).ResetButtonState();
				if (toolbarsManager.ActiveTool == tool)
				{
					Control control = ((UIElement)this).Control;
					if (control != null && !control.IsDisposed && !control.Disposing)
					{
						Point pt = control.PointToClient(Control.MousePosition);
						if (!((UIElement)this).Rect.Contains(pt))
						{
							toolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(tool, setOn: false, clearToolBeingEdited: true);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				lastClickProcessedTime = DateTime.Now;
				mouseDownSinceLastClick = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private RibbonButtonGroupUIElement GetRibbonButtonGroupUIElement()
		{
			UIElement parent = ((UIElement)this).Parent;
			if (parent is RibbonButtonGroupUIElement)
			{
				return (RibbonButtonGroupUIElement)(object)parent;
			}
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			parent = parent.Parent;
			return parent as RibbonButtonGroupUIElement;
		}
	}

		internal void ResolveCaptionButtonAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearanceData, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, CaptionButtonAppearanceResolutionPhase phase)
		{
			switch (phase)
			{
			case CaptionButtonAppearanceResolutionPhase.Pressed:
				ResolvePressedAppearance(ref appearanceData, ref requestedProps);
				break;
			case CaptionButtonAppearanceResolutionPhase.HotTrack:
				ResolveHotTrackAppearance(ref appearanceData, ref requestedProps);
				break;
			case CaptionButtonAppearanceResolutionPhase.Tool:
				ResolveAppearance(ref appearanceData, ref requestedProps);
				break;
			}
		}

		internal AppearanceBase GetAppearance(int index)
		{
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			int appearancePropertyCount = AppearancePropertyCount;
			if (index < 0 || index >= appearancePropertyCount)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CreateAppearanceHolderArray(appearancePropertyCount);
			if (appearanceHolder[index] == null)
			{
				appearanceHolder[index] = new AppearanceHolder();
				appearanceHolder[index].SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			SetCollection(appearanceHolder[index]);
			return appearanceHolder[index].Appearance;
		}

		internal bool SetAppearance(int index, AppearanceBase value)
		{
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			int appearancePropertyCount = AppearancePropertyCount;
			if (index < 0 || index >= appearancePropertyCount)
			{
				return false;
			}
			CreateAppearanceHolderArray(appearancePropertyCount);
			if (appearanceHolder[index] == null)
			{
				appearanceHolder[index] = new AppearanceHolder();
				appearanceHolder[index].SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			else
			{
				appearanceHolder[index].SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			SetCollection(appearanceHolder[index]);
			if (value != appearanceHolder[index].Appearance)
			{
				appearanceHolder[index].Appearance = value;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void CreateAppearanceHolderArray(int propertyCount)
		{
			if (appearanceHolder == null)
			{
				appearanceHolder = (AppearanceHolder[])(object)new AppearanceHolder[propertyCount];
			}
		}

		internal bool GetHasAppearance(int index)
		{
			int appearancePropertyCount = AppearancePropertyCount;
			if (index < 0 || index >= appearancePropertyCount)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (appearanceHolder != null && appearanceHolder[index] != null)
			{
				return appearanceHolder[index].HasAppearance;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool GetShouldSerializeAppearance(int index)
		{
			int appearancePropertyCount = AppearancePropertyCount;
			if (index < 0 || index >= appearancePropertyCount)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (GetHasAppearance(index))
			{
				return appearanceHolder[index].ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void ResetAppearance(int index)
		{
			int appearancePropertyCount = AppearancePropertyCount;
			if (index >= 0 && index < appearancePropertyCount && GetShouldSerializeAppearance(index))
			{
				appearanceHolder[index].Reset();
				PropertyIds propertyIds = (PropertyIds)0;
				switch (index)
				{
				case 0:
					propertyIds = PropertyIds.Appearance;
					break;
				case 1:
					propertyIds = PropertyIds.HotTrackAppearance;
					break;
				case 2:
					propertyIds = PropertyIds.PressedAppearance;
					break;
				}
				if (propertyIds != 0)
				{
					NotifyPropChange(propertyIds);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetCollection(AppearanceHolder appearanceHolder)
		{
			if (appearanceHolder != null && appearanceHolder.Collection == null && Owner != null)
			{
				appearanceHolder.Collection = Owner.Appearances;
			}
		}

		internal void DisposeAppearances()
		{
			if (appearanceHolder == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int appearancePropertyCount = AppearancePropertyCount;
			for (int i = 0; i < appearancePropertyCount; i++)
			{
				AppearanceHolder val = appearanceHolder[i];
				if (val != null)
				{
					val.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					if (val.HasAppearance)
					{
						((DisposableObject)(object)val.Appearance).Dispose();
					}
					appearanceHolder[i] = null;
				}
			}
		}

		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			GetObjectDataHelper(info, context);
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		protected void GetObjectDataHelper(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			if (GetShouldSerializeAppearance(0))
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Appearance", appearanceHolder[0]);
			}
			if (GetShouldSerializeAppearance(1))
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "HotTrackAppearance", appearanceHolder[1]);
			}
			if (GetShouldSerializeAppearance(2))
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "PressedAppearance", appearanceHolder[2]);
			}
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MenuId", menuId);
			SerializeTag(info);
		}

		protected CaptionButtonAppearances(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			//IL_0093: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0099: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00ba: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c0: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00e1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e7: Expected O, but got Unknown
			int appearancePropertyCount = AppearancePropertyCount;
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "Appearance":
					CreateAppearanceHolderArray(appearancePropertyCount);
					appearanceHolder[0] = (AppearanceHolder)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(AppearanceHolder), null);
					break;
				case "HotTrackAppearance":
					CreateAppearanceHolderArray(appearancePropertyCount);
					appearanceHolder[1] = (AppearanceHolder)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(AppearanceHolder), null);
					break;
				case "PressedAppearance":
					CreateAppearanceHolderArray(appearancePropertyCount);
					appearanceHolder[2] = (AppearanceHolder)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(AppearanceHolder), null);
					break;
				case "MenuId":
					menuId = (SystemButtonId)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(SystemButtonId), (SystemButtonId)0);
					break;
				case "Tag":
					DeserializeTag(current);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

	internal enum CaptionButtonAppearanceResolutionPhase
	{
		Initial,
		HotTrack,
		Pressed,
		Tool,
		ToolOwner,
		Final
	}
	internal struct ResolveCaptionButtonAppearancePhaseInfo
	{
		private CaptionButtonAppearanceResolutionPhase phase;

		private UIRole uiRole;

		private UIRole ownerUIRole;

		private bool drawAsActive;

		private bool drawAsPressed;

		private bool isActiveTool;

		private UIElementButtonStyle buttonStyle;

		private bool isMaximizedMdiChild;

		private SystemButtonId menuId;

		public CaptionButtonAppearanceResolutionPhase Phase => phase;

		public UIRole UIRole => uiRole;

		public UIRole OwnerUIRole => ownerUIRole;

		public bool DrawAsActive => drawAsActive;

		public bool DrawAsPressed => drawAsPressed;

		public bool IsActiveTool => isActiveTool;

		public bool IsMaximizedMdiChild => isMaximizedMdiChild;

		public SystemButtonId MenuId => menuId;

		public UIElementButtonStyle ButtonStyle => buttonStyle;

		internal ResolveCaptionButtonAppearancePhaseInfo(UIRole uiRole, UIRole ownerUIRole, bool drawAsActive, bool drawAsPressed, bool isActiveTool, bool isMaximizedMdiChild, SystemButtonId menuId, UIElementButtonStyle buttonStyle)
		{
			//IL_003d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			phase = CaptionButtonAppearanceResolutionPhase.Initial;
			this.drawAsActive = drawAsActive;
			this.drawAsPressed = drawAsPressed;
			this.uiRole = uiRole;
			this.ownerUIRole = ownerUIRole;
			this.isActiveTool = isActiveTool;
			this.isMaximizedMdiChild = isMaximizedMdiChild;
			this.menuId = menuId;
			this.buttonStyle = buttonStyle;
		}

		internal static ResolveCaptionButtonAppearancePhaseInfo FromResolveAppearancePhaseInfo(ToolBase.ResolveAppearancePhaseInfo phaseInfo, bool isMaximizedMdiChild, SystemButtonId menuID, UIElementButtonStyle buttonStyle)
		{
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ResolveCaptionButtonAppearancePhaseInfo result = new ResolveCaptionButtonAppearancePhaseInfo(phaseInfo.UIRole, phaseInfo.OwnerUIRole, phaseInfo.DrawAsActive, phaseInfo.DrawAsPressed, isActiveTool: false, isMaximizedMdiChild, menuID, buttonStyle);
			result.SetPhase((CaptionButtonAppearanceResolutionPhase)phaseInfo.Phase);
			return result;
		}

		internal void SetPhase(CaptionButtonAppearanceResolutionPhase phase)
		{
			this.phase = phase;
		}

				return ButtonAppearancesCache[SystemButtonId.ContextHelp].ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			if (buttonAppearancesCache != null)
			{
				foreach (SystemButtonId key in buttonAppearancesCache.Keys)
				{
					ResetButtonAppearances(key);
				}
				buttonAppearancesCache.Clear();
			}
			ResetTag();
		}

		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (buttonAppearancesCache != null)
			{
				foreach (SystemButtonId key in buttonAppearancesCache.Keys)
				{
					if (buttonAppearancesCache[key].ShouldSerialize())
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return ShouldSerializeTag();
		}

		private CaptionButtonAppearances GetButtonAppearances(SystemButtonId menuId, bool create)
		{
			if (!HasCachedButtonAppearances(menuId))
			{
				if (!create)
				{
					return null;
				}
				CaptionButtonAppearances captionButtonAppearances = new CaptionButtonAppearances(Manager, menuId);
				captionButtonAppearances.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				ButtonAppearancesCache[menuId] = captionButtonAppearances;
			}
			return ButtonAppearancesCache[menuId];
		}

		private bool HasCachedButtonAppearances(SystemButtonId menuId)
		{
			if (buttonAppearancesCache != null && buttonAppearancesCache.ContainsKey(menuId))
			{
				return buttonAppearancesCache[menuId] != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetButtonAppearances(SystemButtonId menuId)
		{
			if (HasCachedButtonAppearances(menuId))
			{
				GetButtonAppearances(menuId, create: false).Reset();
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeOwner(UltraToolbarsManager owner)
		{
			manager = owner;
			foreach (SystemButtonId key in buttonAppearancesCache.Keys)
			{
				if (buttonAppearancesCache[key] != null)
				{
					buttonAppearancesCache[key].Owner = owner;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ResolveCaptionButtonAppearance(SystemButtonId menuId, CaptionButtonAppearanceResolutionPhase phase, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			CaptionButtonAppearances captionButtonAppearances = ((menuId != 0) ? GetButtonAppearances(menuId, create: false) : null);
			CaptionButtonAppearances buttonAppearances = GetButtonAppearances((SystemButtonId)0, create: false);
			bool flag = captionButtonAppearances != null;
			bool flag2 = buttonAppearances != null;
			if (flag)
			{
				captionButtonAppearances.ResolveCaptionButtonAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, phase);
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				buttonAppearances.ResolveCaptionButtonAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, phase);
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			GetObjectDataHelper(info, context);
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		protected void GetObjectDataHelper(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeDefaultButtonAppearances())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "DefaultButtonAppearances", DefaultButtonAppearances);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeCloseButtonAppearances())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "CloseButtonAppearances", CloseButtonAppearances);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeContextHelpButtonAppearances())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ContextHelpButtonAppearances", ContextHelpButtonAppearances);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeMaximizeButtonAppearances())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MaximizeButtonAppearances", MaximizeButtonAppearances);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeMinimizeButtonAppearances())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MinimizeButtonAppearances", MinimizeButtonAppearances);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeRestoreButtonAppearances())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "RestoreButtonAppearances", RestoreButtonAppearances);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeRibbonDisplayOptionsButtonAppearances())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "RibbonDisplayOptionsButtonAppearances", RibbonDisplayOptionsButtonAppearances);
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
		}
	}

		public int SelectedIndex
		{
			get
			{
				EmbeddableEditorBase editor = Editor;
				EditorWithCombo val = (EditorWithCombo)(object)((editor is EditorWithCombo) ? editor : null);
				if (val != null && ((EmbeddableEditorBase)val).IsInEditMode && base.IsInEditMode)
				{
					return val.SelectedIndex;
				}
				int result = -1;
				if (EditValue != null)
				{
					result = ((base.EditorContext is int) ? ((int)base.EditorContext) : ((IValueList)ValueList).SelectedItemIndex);
					((IValueList)ValueList).GetText(EditValue, ref result);
				}
				return result;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == SelectedIndex)
				{
					return;
				}
				EmbeddableEditorBase editor = Editor;
				EditorWithCombo val = (EditorWithCombo)(object)((editor is EditorWithCombo) ? editor : null);
				if (val != null && ((EmbeddableEditorBase)val).IsInEditMode && base.IsInEditMode)
				{
					val.SelectedIndex = value;
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.SelectedIndex);
					return;
				}
				if (value < 0)
				{
					base.EditorContext = null;
					EditValue = null;
				}
				else
				{
					base.EditorContext = value;
					EditValue = ((IValueList)ValueList).GetValue(value);
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.SelectedIndex);
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public object SelectedItem
		{
			get
			{
				if (SelectedIndex == -1)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (SelectedIndex < ((DisposableObjectCollectionBase)(object)ValueList.ValueListItems).Count)
				{
					return ValueList.ValueListItems[SelectedIndex];
				}
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == SelectedItem)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (value == null)
				{
					SelectedIndex = -1;
					return;
				}
				if (!(value is ValueListItem))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_116"));
				}
				int num = ValueList.ValueListItems.IndexOf(value);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_117"));
				}
				SelectedIndex = num;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public object Value
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.IsInEditMode && !Editor.IsEnteringEditMode)
				{
					if (Editor.IsValid)
					{
						return Editor.Value;
					}
					return null;
				}
				return ExtraSharedProps.Value;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ExtraSharedProps.Value == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (!base.IsInEditMode)
				{
					int num = 0;
					string text = ((IValueList)ValueList).GetText(value, ref num);
					if (num >= 0 && num < ((DisposableObjectCollectionBase)(object)ValueList.ValueListItems).Count)
					{
						InternalSetText(text);
					}
					else
					{
						InternalSetText(Utils.ConvertToString(value, useCurrentCulture: true));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Editor.Value = value;
				}
				ExtraSharedProps.SetValue(value, this);
				if (base.SharedProps == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (ToolBase toolInstance in base.SharedProps.ToolInstances)
				{
					UIElement uIElement = toolInstance.UIElement;
					if (uIElement != null)
					{
						uIElement.DirtyChildElements();
					}
				}
			}
		}

					break;

		protected internal override UIElement GetToolbarUIElement(ToolBase tool, UIElement parentElement, UIElement previousElement, bool drawAsActive, bool drawAsPressed)

			{
				return GetToolbarButtonUIElement(tool, parentElement, previousElement, drawAsActive, drawAsPressed);
			}
			UltraToolbarBase owningToolbarInternal = base.OwningToolbarInternal;
			if (owningToolbarInternal == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_1"));
			}
			return GetToolUIElement(tool, parentElement, previousElement, drawAsActive, drawAsPressed);
		}

		private static UIElement GetToolUIElement(ToolBase tool, UIElement parentElement, UIElement previousElement, bool drawAsActive, bool drawAsPressed)
		{
			ComboBoxToolUIElement comboBoxToolUIElement = null;
			if (previousElement != null && ((object)previousElement).GetType() == typeof(ComboBoxToolUIElement))
			{
				comboBoxToolUIElement = previousElement as ComboBoxToolUIElement;
			}
			if (comboBoxToolUIElement == null || ((UIElement)comboBoxToolUIElement).Parent != parentElement)
			{
				comboBoxToolUIElement = new ComboBoxToolUIElement(parentElement, tool);
			}
			else
			{
				comboBoxToolUIElement.InitializeElement(tool);
			}
			return (UIElement)(object)comboBoxToolUIElement;
		}

		protected internal override Type GetToolbarUIElementType()
		{
			if (base.IsVertical)
			{
				return typeof(ButtonToolUIElement);
			}
			return typeof(ComboBoxToolUIElement);
		}

		protected internal override Size CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstance()
		{
			if (base.IsVertical)
			{
				return CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstanceAsButton();
			}
			Size result = base.CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstance();
			int num = 12;
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager != null)
			{
				num = toolbarsManager.AdjustWidthForTouchMode(num, useLargeTouchSize: false);
			}
			result.Width += num;
			return result;
		}

		protected internal override ToolBase Clone(bool cloneNewInstance)
		{
			ComboBoxTool comboBoxTool = new ComboBoxTool(Key);
			comboBoxTool.InitializeFrom(this, cloneNewInstance);
			return comboBoxTool;
		}

		protected override void DoDefaultAction()
		{
			if (!base.EnabledResolved)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Editor.IsDroppedDown)
			{
				Editor.CloseUp();
			}
			else if ((base.OwnerIsToolbarInternal && base.OwningToolbarInternal.VisibleResolved) || (base.OwnerIsRibbonGroup && base.OwningRibbonGroup.IsInView(this)) || (base.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea && base.OwningApplicationMenuArea.ApplicationMenu.IsOpen) || (base.OwnerIsMenuInternal && base.OwningMenuInternal.IsOpen))
			{
				base.IsInEditMode = true;
				if (base.IsInEditMode)
				{
					Editor.DropDown();
				}
			}
		}

			}
			if (ShouldSerializeDropDownStyle())

				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "DropDownStyle", DropDownStyle);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeValueList())

				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ValueList", ValueList);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeValue())
			{
				Utils.SerializeObjectProperty(info, "Value", Value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void InitializeFrom(ToolBase sourceTool, bool cloneNewInstance)
		{
			//IL_0040: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0085: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0096: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00cc: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_011d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			base.InitializeFrom(sourceTool, cloneNewInstance);
			if (!(sourceTool is ComboBoxTool) || cloneNewInstance)
			{
				return;
			}
			ComboBoxTool comboBoxTool = sourceTool as ComboBoxTool;
			ExtraSharedProps.autoComplete = comboBoxTool.ExtraSharedProps.AutoComplete;
			ExtraSharedProps.dropDownStyle = comboBoxTool.ExtraSharedProps.DropDownStyle;
			ExtraSharedProps.toolValue = comboBoxTool.ExtraSharedProps.toolValue;
			ExtraSharedProps.ValueList.Appearance = (AppearanceBase)comboBoxTool.ValueList.Appearance.Clone();
			ExtraSharedProps.ValueList.DisplayStyle = comboBoxTool.ValueList.DisplayStyle;
			ExtraSharedProps.ValueList.DrawMode = comboBoxTool.ValueList.DrawMode;
			ExtraSharedProps.ValueList.DropDownListAlignment = comboBoxTool.ValueList.DropDownListAlignment;
			ExtraSharedProps.ValueList.DropDownListWidth = comboBoxTool.ValueList.DropDownListWidth;
			ExtraSharedProps.ValueList.MaxDropDownItems = comboBoxTool.ValueList.MaxDropDownItems;
			ExtraSharedProps.ValueList.SortStyle = comboBoxTool.ValueList.SortStyle;
			if (!CloneValueListItems)
			{
				return;
			}
			ValueListItemEnumerator enumerator = ((ComboBoxTool)sourceTool).ExtraSharedProps.ValueList.ValueListItems.GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (((DisposableObjectEnumeratorBase)(object)enumerator).MoveNext())
				{
					ValueListItem current = enumerator.Current;
					if (current.DataValue is ICloneable cloneable)
					{
						ExtraSharedProps.ValueList.ValueListItems.Add(cloneable.Clone(), current.DisplayText);
					}
					else
					{
						ExtraSharedProps.ValueList.ValueListItems.Add(current.DataValue, current.DisplayText);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			//IL_00ea: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0078: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (propChange.Source == this)
			{
				if (!(propChange.PropId is PropertyIds))
				{
					return;
				}
				PropertyIds propertyIds = (PropertyIds)(object)propChange.PropId;
				if (propertyIds != PropertyIds.Text)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (base.IsInEditMode)
				{
					string text = base.Text;
					if (ValueList != null)
					{
						IValueList valueList = (IValueList)(object)ValueList;
						int selectedIndex = ValueList.SelectedIndex;
						object value = valueList.GetValue(text, ref selectedIndex);
						if (value != null)
						{
							Editor.Value = value;
						}
						else if ((int)DropDownStyle == 0)
						{
							Editor.Value = text;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						Editor.Value = text;
					}
					return;
				}
				string text2 = base.Text;
				if (ValueList != null)
				{
					IValueList valueList2 = (IValueList)(object)ValueList;
					int selectedIndex2 = ValueList.SelectedIndex;
					object value2 = valueList2.GetValue(text2, ref selectedIndex2);
					if (value2 != null)
					{
						if (ExtraSharedProps != null)
						{
							ExtraSharedProps.toolValue = value2;
						}
					}
					else if ((int)DropDownStyle == 0)
					{
						if (ExtraSharedProps != null)
						{
							ExtraSharedProps.toolValue = value2;
						}
					}
					else if (ExtraSharedProps != null)
					{
						ExtraSharedProps.toolValue = null;
					}
				}
				if (base.SharedProps == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				{
					foreach (ToolBase toolInstance in base.SharedProps.ToolInstances)
					{
						UIElement uIElement = toolInstance.UIElement;
						if (uIElement != null)
						{
							uIElement.DirtyChildElements();
						}
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			if (propChange.Source == ExtraSharedProps.valueList)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ValueList, propChange);
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnSubObjectPropChanged(propChange);
			}
		}

		internal override void OnToolbarManagerDisposing()
		{
			ExtraSharedProps.DisposeValueList();
			base.OnToolbarManagerDisposing();
		}

		public class ContextualTabGroupAccessibleObject : AccessibleObjectWrapper
		{
			private ContextualTabGroup contextualTabGroup;

			public override Rectangle Bounds
			{
				get
				{
					Rectangle r = Rectangle.Empty;
					ContextualTabGroupCaptionUIElement contextualTabGroupCaptionUIElement = ContextualTabGroupCaptionUIElement;
					if (contextualTabGroupCaptionUIElement != null)
					{
						r = ((UIElement)contextualTabGroupCaptionUIElement).Rect;
					}
					return ((Control)(object)Ribbon.RibbonContainer)?.RectangleToScreen(r) ?? Rectangle.Empty;
				}
			}

			public override string Name
			{
				get
				{
					string name = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name;
					if (name != null && name.Length > 0)
					{
						return name;
					}
					return contextualTabGroup.Caption;
				}
				set
				{
					((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name = value;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Parent => Ribbon.RibbonCaptionAreaAccessibilityObject;

			public override AccessibleRole Role => AccessibleRole.PushButton;

			public override AccessibleStates State
			{
				get
				{
					AccessibleStates accessibleStates = AccessibleStates.None;
					if (ContextualTabGroupCaptionUIElement == null)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Invisible;
					}
					if (!contextualTabGroup.VisibleResolved)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Invisible;
					}
					return accessibleStates;
				}
			}

			private ContextualTabGroupCaptionUIElement ContextualTabGroupCaptionUIElement => Ribbon.GetRibbonElement(typeof(ContextualTabGroupCaptionUIElement), contextualTabGroup) as ContextualTabGroupCaptionUIElement;

			private Ribbon Ribbon => contextualTabGroup.Ribbon;

			public ContextualTabGroup ContextualTabGroup => contextualTabGroup;

			public ContextualTabGroupAccessibleObject(ContextualTabGroup contextualTabGroup)
			{
				this.contextualTabGroup = contextualTabGroup;
			}

			protected override Control GetMarshallingControl()
			{
				return Ribbon.ToolbarsManager?.DockWithinContainer;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				int num = contextualTabGroup.ParentCollection.Count - 1;
				switch (navdir)
				{
				case AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild:
				case AccessibleNavigation.LastChild:
					return null;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Left:
					if (contextualTabGroup.index > 0)
					{
						navdir = AccessibleNavigation.Previous;
						break;
					}
					return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Parent.Navigate(navdir);
				case AccessibleNavigation.Right:
					if (contextualTabGroup.index < num)
					{
						navdir = AccessibleNavigation.Next;
						break;
					}
					return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Parent.Navigate(navdir);
				case AccessibleNavigation.Up:
				case AccessibleNavigation.Down:
					return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Parent.Navigate(navdir);
				}
				int num2 = contextualTabGroup.Index;
				switch (navdir)
				{
				case AccessibleNavigation.Next:
					num2++;
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Previous:
					num2--;
					break;
				}
				if (num2 < 0 || num2 > num)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return contextualTabGroup.ParentCollection[num2].ContextualTabGroupAccessibilityObject;
			}
		}

				}
				return tabStubList[count - 1].Provider;
			}

			public override IRawElementProviderFragment NavigateChildren(FragmentUIAProviderStub childStub, bool forward)
			{
				int num = TabStubList.IndexOf(childStub);
				if (num != -1)
				{
					num += (forward ? 1 : (-1));
					if (num >= 0 && num < tabStubList.Count)
					{
						return tabStubList[num].Provider;
					}
				}
				return ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)this).NavigateChildren(childStub, forward);
			}

			internal void AddTabStub(RibbonTab.RibbonTabUiaProviderStub tabStub)
			{
				TabStubList.Add((FragmentUIAProviderStub)(object)tabStub);
			}

			internal void ClearStubs()
			{
				if (tabStubList != null)
				{
					tabStubList.Clear();
				}
			}
		}
