		protected bool ShouldSerializeCaptionAppearance()
		{
			if (captionAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				return captionAppearanceHolder.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ResetCaptionAppearance()
		{
			if (HasCaptionAppearance)
			{
				captionAppearanceHolder.Reset();
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.CaptionAppearance);
			}
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeGroupSettings()
		{
			if (groupSettings != null && groupSettings.Owner == this)
			{
				return groupSettings.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ResetGroupSettings()
		{
			if (groupSettings != null)
			{
				groupSettings.Reset();
			}
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeTabs()
		{
			if (tabs != null)
			{
				return tabs.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ResetTabs()
		{
			if (tabs != null)
			{
				tabs.Clear();
			}
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeTabSettings()
		{
			if (tabSettings != null && tabSettings.Owner == this)
			{
				return tabSettings.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ResetTabSettings()
		{
			if (tabSettings != null)
			{
				tabSettings.Reset();
			}
		}

		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (caption == null && !ShouldSerializeCaptionAppearance() && !ShouldSerializeTag() && !ShouldSerializeGroupSettings() && visible && !ShouldSerializeTabs())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeTabSettings();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			Caption = null;
			ResetCaptionAppearance();
			ResetTag();
			ResetGroupSettings();
			ResetTabs();
			Visible = true;
			ResetTabSettings();
		}

		internal int CalculatePreferredWidth()
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (Ribbon == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
			AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)65011720;
			ResolveCaptionAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			Font font = null;
			if (Ribbon.RibbonContainer != null)
			{
				font = Ribbon.RibbonContainer.Font;
			}
			int num = ((!ToolbarsManager.IsGlassSupported) ? 5 : 0);
			return Ribbon.ToolbarsManager.MeasureString(ref appearance, font, Caption).Width + num;
		}

		internal Color GetScenicTabPageBorderColor()
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
			AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)67108868;
			ResolveCaptionAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			if (!((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				return ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor;
			}
			return DefaultBackColor;
		}

		internal RibbonTab GetFirstTab(bool visibleOnly)
		{
			RibbonTab ribbonTab = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < Tabs.Count; i++)
			{
				if ((!visibleOnly || Tabs[i].VisibleResolved) && (ribbonTab == null || Tabs[i].Index < ribbonTab.Index))
				{
					ribbonTab = Tabs[i];
				}
			}
			return ribbonTab;
		}

		internal void Initialize()
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				if (groupSettings != null)
				{
					groupSettings.Initialize(this);
				}
				if (tabs != null)
				{
					tabs.Initialize(this);
				}
				if (tabSettings != null)
				{
					tabSettings.Initialize(this);
				}
				if (captionAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					captionAppearanceHolder.Collection = ToolbarsManager.Appearances;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeMdiMergeTabGroupFromChild(ContextualTabGroup group)
		{
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (group.caption != null)
			{
				caption = group.caption;
			}
			if (group.ShouldSerializeCaptionAppearance())
			{
				CaptionAppearance = (AppearanceBase)group.CaptionAppearance.Clone();
			}
			if (group.ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				Tag = group.Tag;
			}
			if (!group.visible)
			{
				visible = group.visible;
			}
		}

		internal void InternalSetUnderlyingTabGroup(ContextualTabGroup underlyingMdiChildTabGroup)
		{
			if (underlyingMdiChildTabGroup != underlyingContextualTabGroup && (underlyingMdiChildTabGroup == null || underlyingMdiChildTabGroup.ToolbarsManager == ToolbarsManager.ActiveMdiChildManager))
			{
				UnhookUnderlyingContextualTabGroup();
				underlyingContextualTabGroup = underlyingMdiChildTabGroup;
				HookUnderlyingContextualTabGroup();
				if (underlyingContextualTabGroup != null)
				{
					Visible = underlyingContextualTabGroup.Visible;
					Caption = underlyingContextualTabGroup.Caption;
					CaptionAppearance = underlyingContextualTabGroup.CaptionAppearance;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InvalidateCaption()
		{
			UIElement uIElement = UIElement;
			if (uIElement != null)
			{
				uIElement.Invalidate();
			}
		}

		internal void InvalidateGroupLayouts(bool invalidateItems)
		{
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = Tabs.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				tabs[i].InvalidateGroupLayouts(invalidateItems);
			}
		}

		internal bool IsVisible(bool considerCustomizeMode)
		{
			if (considerCustomizeMode)
			{
				Ribbon ribbon = Ribbon;
				if (ribbon != null && ribbon.Customizing && ribbon.IsDesignMode)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (IsHiddenByMdiMerge)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return visible;
		}

		internal void ResolveCaptionAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{

			//IL_0177: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4

			//IL_027d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4

		private void CreateAppearanceHolder(ref AppearanceHolder appearanceHolder)
		{
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (appearanceHolder == null)
			{
				appearanceHolder = new AppearanceHolder();
				appearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
		}

		private void DisposeAppearanceHolder(ref AppearanceHolder appearanceHolder)
		{
			if (appearanceHolder != null)
			{
				appearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				appearanceHolder.Reset();
				appearanceHolder = null;
			}
		}

		private void HookUnderlyingContextualTabGroup()
		{
			if (underlyingContextualTabGroup != null)
			{
				InternalSetSettings(underlyingContextualTabGroup.GroupSettings, ref groupSettings);
				InternalSetSettings(underlyingContextualTabGroup.TabSettings, ref tabSettings);
				underlyingContextualTabGroup.SubObjectPropChanged += UnderlyingContextualTabGroupPropChangedHandler;
			}
		}

		private void InternalSetSettings<T>(T newSettings, ref T settingsMember) where T : SubObjectBase
		{
			if (settingsMember != null)
			{
				SubObjectPropChangeEventHandler value = base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				settingsMember.SubObjectPropChanged -= value;
			}
			settingsMember = newSettings;
		}

		private void OnUnderlyingContextualTabGroupPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo)
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager != null && ToolbarsManager.Initialized && propChangeInfo.Source is ContextualTabGroup contextualTabGroup && propChangeInfo.PropId is PropertyIds)
			{
				switch ((PropertyIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId)
				{
				case PropertyIds.Caption:
					Caption = contextualTabGroup.Caption;
					break;
				case PropertyIds.CaptionAppearance:
					CaptionAppearance = contextualTabGroup.CaptionAppearance;
					break;
				case PropertyIds.Visible:
					Visible = contextualTabGroup.Visible;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void ProcessGroupSettingsChange(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (propChange != null && propChange.PropId is PropertyIds)
			{
				PropertyIds propertyIds = (PropertyIds)(object)propChange.PropId;
				if (propertyIds == PropertyIds.CanCollapse)
				{
					InvalidateGroupLayouts(invalidateItems: true);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UnhookUnderlyingContextualTabGroup()
		{
			if (underlyingContextualTabGroup != null)
			{
				InternalSetSettings(null, ref groupSettings);
				InternalSetSettings(null, ref tabSettings);
				underlyingContextualTabGroup.SubObjectPropChanged -= UnderlyingContextualTabGroupPropChangedHandler;
				underlyingContextualTabGroup = null;
			}
		}

		private void SetAppearanceHolder(ref AppearanceHolder appearanceHolder, AppearanceBase value)
		{
			if (appearanceHolder == null || !appearanceHolder.HasAppearance || value != appearanceHolder.Appearance)
			{
				if (appearanceHolder == null)
				{
					CreateAppearanceHolder(ref appearanceHolder);
				}
				appearanceHolder.Appearance = value;
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		protected virtual void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnDeserialization(object sender)
		{
		}

		void IDeserializationCallback.OnDeserialization(object sender)
		{
			if (groupSettings != null)
			{
				groupSettings.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (tabs != null)
			{
				tabs.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (tabSettings != null)
			{
				tabSettings.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (captionAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				captionAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			OnDeserialization(sender);
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			if (caption != null)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Caption", caption);
			}
			if (captionAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "CaptionAppearance", captionAppearanceHolder);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeGroupSettings())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "GroupSettings", groupSettings);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeTabSettings())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "TabSettings", tabSettings);
			}
			if (!visible)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Visible", visible);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeKey())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Key", Key);
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
			if (isMdiMergeContextualTabGroup)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "IsMdiMergeContextualTabGroup", isMdiMergeContextualTabGroup);
			}
			GetObjectData(info, context);
		}

		protected override void OnAddedToCollection(KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase primaryCollection)
		{
			if (primaryCollection is ContextualTabGroupCollection)
			{
				base.OnAddedToCollection(primaryCollection);
				Initialize();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			DisposeAppearanceHolder(ref captionAppearanceHolder);
			if (tabSettings != null)
			{
				tabSettings.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				tabSettings.Dispose();
				tabSettings = null;
			}
			if (groupSettings != null)
			{
				groupSettings.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				groupSettings.Dispose();
				groupSettings = null;
			}
			if (tabs != null)
			{
				tabs.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				tabs.Dispose();
				tabs = null;
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnRemovedFromCollection(KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase primaryCollection)
		{
			base.OnRemovedFromCollection(primaryCollection);
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			PropertyIds propertyIds;
			if (propChange.Source == tabs)
			{
				if (propChange.Trigger != null)
				{
					return;
				}
				propertyIds = PropertyIds.Tabs;
			}
			else if (propChange.Source == tabSettings)
			{
				propertyIds = PropertyIds.TabSettings;
			}
			else if (propChange.Source != groupSettings)
			{
				propertyIds = ((captionAppearanceHolder == null || propChange.Source != captionAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance) ? ((PropertyIds)(-1)) : PropertyIds.CaptionAppearance);
			}
			else
			{
				ProcessGroupSettingsChange(propChange.Trigger);
				propertyIds = PropertyIds.GroupSettings;
			}
			NotifyPropChange(propertyIds, propChange);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Format("{0}[ {1} ] - {2}", Inherited ? "*" : string.Empty, Key, Caption);
		}

			}
			((ImageAndTextUIElement)this).InitAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

			UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = ((controlElement != null) ? (controlElement.UltraControl as UltraToolbarsManager) : null);
			if (ultraToolbarsManager != null && ultraToolbarsManager.Customizing && ultraToolbarsManager.CustomizeDialog != null && ultraToolbarsManager.CustomizeDialog.SelectedObject == tabGroup)
			{
				ultraToolbarsManager.DrawToolSelectionRect(Rectangle.Inflate(((UIElement)this).Rect, -1, -1), ref drawParams);
			}
			((UIElement)this).OnAfterDraw(ref drawParams);
		}

		protected override void OnDoubleClick(bool adjustableArea)
		{
			if (!adjustableArea)
			{
				Ribbon ribbon = tabGroup.Ribbon;
				if (ribbon != null && ribbon.ToolbarsManager != null && ribbon.ToolbarsManager.IsFormRounded)
				{
					if (ribbon.ToolbarsManager.CurrentFormWindowState == FormWindowState.Maximized)
					{

					}
					else

					}
				}
			}
			((UIElement)this).OnDoubleClick(adjustableArea);
		}

				((tabGroup != null) ? tabGroup.ToolbarsManager : null)?.DisplayToolTip(((ImageAndTextUIElementEx)this).Text);
			}
			((UIElement)this).OnMouseHover();
		}

			((UIElement)this).OnMouseLeave();
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e, bool adjustableArea, ref UIElement captureMouseForElement)
		{
			lastButtonDown = e.Button;
			if (lastButtonDown == MouseButtons.Left && !adjustableArea)
			{
				captureMouseForElement = (UIElement)(object)this;
				return false;
			}
			return ((UIElement)this).OnMouseDown(e, adjustableArea, ref captureMouseForElement);
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseUp(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Button == MouseButtons.Left && lastButtonDown == MouseButtons.Left && tabGroup != null && ((UIElement)this).Rect.Contains(e.X, e.Y))
			{
				Ribbon ribbon = tabGroup.Ribbon;
				if (ribbon != null && (ribbon.SelectedTab == null || ribbon.SelectedTab.ContextualTabGroup != tabGroup))
				{
					RibbonTab firstTab = tabGroup.GetFirstTab(visibleOnly: true);
					if (firstTab != null)
					{
						if (ribbon.IsMinimized_Legacy)
						{
							ribbon.IsMinimized_Legacy = false;
						}
						ribbon.SelectedTab = firstTab;
					}
				}
			}
			lastButtonDown = MouseButtons.None;
			return ((UIElement)this).OnMouseUp(e);
		}

		protected ContextualTabGroupCollection(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.Value is ContextualTabGroup)
				{
					ContextualTabGroup contextualTabGroup = (ContextualTabGroup)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ContextualTabGroup), null);
					if (contextualTabGroup != null)
					{
						List.Add(contextualTabGroup);
					}
					continue;
				}
				string name = current.Name;
				if (!(name == "Count"))
				{
					if (name == "Tag")
					{
						DeserializeTag(current);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					initialCapacity = Math.Max(initialCapacity, (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), initialCapacity));
				}
			}
		}

			return new ContextualTabGroup[Count];
		}

		public ContextualTabGroup Add(string key)
		{
			ValidateKey(key, null);
			ValidateKeyInternal(key);
			ContextualTabGroup contextualTabGroup = new ContextualTabGroup(key);
			AddGroupHelper(contextualTabGroup, Count, notify: true, validateKey: false);
			return contextualTabGroup;

		public void AddRange(ContextualTabGroup[] groups)

				AddGroupHelper(contextualTabGroup, Count, notify: false, validateKey: true);
			}
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ContextualTabGroup);

		internal int AddGroupHelper(ContextualTabGroup group, int index, bool notify, bool validateKey)
		{
			if (group == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("group");
			}
			if (validateKey)
			{
				ValidateKey(group.Key, null);
			}
			OnInserting(group);
			group.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			List.Insert(index, group);
			((IKeyedSubObject)group).OnAddedToCollection((KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase)this);
			if (notify)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ContextualTabGroup);
			}
			return index;
		}

		private void CalcVisibleTabGroupCount()
		{
			int num = 0;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (this[i].VisibleResolved)
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			visibleTabGroupsCount = num;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			if (Count > 0)
			{
				ContextualTabGroup[] array = All as ContextualTabGroup[];
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					array[i].SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				InternalClear();
				for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
				{
					OnRemoved(array[j]);
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.RibbonTab);
			}
		}

		internal void DirtyVisibleTabGroups()
		{
			visibleTabGroupsCount = -1;
			ribbon.Metrics.Dirty(Ribbon.RibbonMetricsFlags.ContextualTabGroupVisibility);
		}

			DirtyVisibleTabGroups();

		internal int InternalAdd(ContextualTabGroup group, bool allowMdiTabReservedKeyName)
		{
			if (!allowMdiTabReservedKeyName)
			{
				ValidateKeyInternal(group.Key);
			}
			return AddGroupHelper(group, Count, notify: true, validateKey: true);
		}

		protected virtual void OnDeserialization(object sender)
		{
		}

		internal virtual void OnInserting(ContextualTabGroup group)
		{
			if (group.ToolbarsManager != null && group.ToolbarsManager != Ribbon.ToolbarsManager)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ItemBelongsToDifferentToolbarsManager", "ContextualTabGroup"));
			}
			DirtyVisibleTabGroups();
		}

		internal virtual void OnRemoved(ContextualTabGroup group)
		{
			DirtyVisibleTabGroups();
			if (Ribbon == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DirtyVisibleTabGroups();
			if (!isInCollectionEditorChange)
			{
				for (int num = group.Tabs.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					Ribbon.RemoveTabFromContextualTabGroup(group.Tabs[num]);
				}
				Ribbon.VerifySelectedTab();
			}
		}

		public void Remove(string key)
		{
			int index = IndexOf(key);
			RemoveAt(index);
		}

		public void Remove(ContextualTabGroup group)

			RemoveAt(index);
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			ContextualTabGroup contextualTabGroup = this[index];
			contextualTabGroup.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			InternalRemoveAt(index);
			OnRemoved(contextualTabGroup);
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ContextualTabGroup);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, ContextualTabGroup group)
		{
			if (group == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("group");
			}
			ValidateKeyInternal(group.Key);
			AddGroupHelper(group, index, notify: true, validateKey: true);
		}

		public ContextualTabGroup Insert(int index, string key)
		{
			ValidateKey(key, null);
			ValidateKeyInternal(key);
			ContextualTabGroup contextualTabGroup = new ContextualTabGroup(key);
			AddGroupHelper(contextualTabGroup, index, notify: true, validateKey: false);
			return contextualTabGroup;
		}

		public void InsertRange(int index, ContextualTabGroup[] groups)
		{
			if (groups == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("groups");
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < groups.Length; i++)
			{
				ContextualTabGroup contextualTabGroup = groups[i];
				ValidateKeyInternal(contextualTabGroup.Key);
				AddGroupHelper(contextualTabGroup, index + i, notify: false, validateKey: true);
			}
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ContextualTabGroup);
		}

		private static void ValidateKeyInternal(string key)
		{
			if (key != null && key.StartsWith("_mdichild.merge.contextualtabgroup.key_"))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ContextualTabGroupKeyReserved"));
			}
		}

		int IList.Add(object value)
		{
			int count = Count;
			((IList)this).Insert(count, value);
			return count;
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("value");
			}
			if (!(value is ContextualTabGroup contextualTabGroup))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("InvalidArgumentType", "value", "ContextualTabGroup"));
			}
			Insert(index, contextualTabGroup);
		}

			}
			if (!(value is ContextualTabGroup contextualTabGroup))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("InvalidArgumentType", "value", "ContextualTabGroup"));
			}
			Remove(contextualTabGroup);
		}

		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Count", Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, i.ToString(), this[i]);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				SerializeTag(info);
			}
			GetObjectData(info, context);
		}

			OnDeserialization(sender);
		}

	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class NonInheritedContextualTabGroups : ICollection, IEnumerable
	{
		private class NonInheritedContextualTabGroupEnumerator : IEnumerator
		{
			private NonInheritedContextualTabGroups collection;

			private int currentIndex = -1;

			public object Current
			{
				get
				{
					if (currentIndex == -1)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return collection[currentIndex];
				}
			}

			public NonInheritedContextualTabGroupEnumerator(NonInheritedContextualTabGroups collection)
			{
				this.collection = collection;
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				if (currentIndex < collection.Count - 1)
				{
					currentIndex++;
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				currentIndex = -1;
			}
		}

		private ContextualTabGroupCollection contextualTabGroups;

		public int Count
		{
			get
			{
				int num = 0;
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = contextualTabGroups.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					if (!contextualTabGroups[i].Inherited)
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		public bool IsSynchronized => contextualTabGroups.IsSynchronized;

		public object SyncRoot => contextualTabGroups.SyncRoot;

		public ContextualTabGroup this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = contextualTabGroups.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					ContextualTabGroup contextualTabGroup = contextualTabGroups[i];
					if (!contextualTabGroup.Inherited)
					{
						if (index == 0)
						{
							return contextualTabGroup;
						}
						index--;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public NonInheritedContextualTabGroups(ContextualTabGroupCollection contextualTabGroups)
		{
			this.contextualTabGroups = contextualTabGroups;
		}

		public void CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = contextualTabGroups.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				ContextualTabGroup contextualTabGroup = contextualTabGroups[i];
				if (!contextualTabGroup.Inherited)
				{
					array.SetValue(contextualTabGroup, index++);
				}
			}
		}

		public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new NonInheritedContextualTabGroupEnumerator(this);
		}

		public void AddRange(ContextualTabGroup[] contextualTabGroups)
		{
			this.contextualTabGroups.AddRange(contextualTabGroups);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			for (int num = contextualTabGroups.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (!contextualTabGroups[num].Inherited)
				{
					contextualTabGroups.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}
	}

		{
			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))

					ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(ControlContainerTool).GetConstructor(new Type[1] { typeof(string) });
					ControlContainerTool controlContainerTool = (ControlContainerTool)value;

				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}

		private class ControlContainerToolExtraSharedProps : SubObjectBase, IControlContainerExtraSharedProps
		{
			private ControlContainerTool owningTool;

			private Control control;

			private string controlName;

			private ToolBase toolWithControl;

			internal bool canSetWidth;

			private Point locationPreCustomize;

			private bool customizing;

			internal VerticalDisplayStyle verticalDisplayStyle;

			private bool synchronizingWidth;

			internal bool CanSetWidth
			{
				get
				{
					return canSetWidth;
				}
				set
				{
					if (value != canSetWidth)
					{
						owningTool.VerifyCanBeModified();
						canSetWidth = value;
						owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.CanSetWidth);
					}
				}
			}

			public Control Control
			{
				get
				{
					return control;
				}
				set
				{
					if (value != control)
					{
						owningTool.VerifyCanBeModified();
						if (owningTool.ToolWithContainedControl != null)
						{
							owningTool.ToolWithContainedControl.SetToolWithContainedControl(takeControlOwnership: false, null);
						}
						control = value;
						controlName = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetName(control);
						UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = owningTool.ToolbarsManager;
						if (control != null && toolbarsManager != null && toolbarsManager.Initialized)
						{
							toolbarsManager.InternalSetToolWithControlHelper(owningTool.ToolWithContainedControl, owningTool.SharedProps.RootTool, null);
						}
						owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Control);
						owningTool.OnControlSet();
					}
				}
			}

			internal string ControlName
			{
				get
				{
					if (control != null)
					{
						return ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetName(control);
					}
					return controlName;
				}
				set
				{
					if (value != null && value.Length == 0)
					{
						value = null;
					}
					if (value != controlName)
					{
						owningTool.VerifyCanBeModified();
						controlName = value;
						SyncControlWithName(allowUpdateControlName: false);
					}
				}
			}

			internal bool SynchronizingWidth
			{
				get
				{
					return synchronizingWidth;
				}
				set
				{
					synchronizingWidth = value;
				}
			}

			internal VerticalDisplayStyle VerticalDisplayStyle
			{
				get
				{
					return verticalDisplayStyle;
				}
				set
				{
					if (value != verticalDisplayStyle)
					{
						owningTool.VerifyCanBeModified();
						if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(VerticalDisplayStyle), value))
						{
							throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_51"));
						}
						verticalDisplayStyle = value;
						owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.VerticalDisplayStyle);
					}
				}
			}

			internal ToolBase ToolWithControl
			{
				get
				{
					if (toolWithControl == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					try
					{
						if (Control.Parent == null)
						{
							return null;
						}
					}
					catch
					{
					}
					return toolWithControl;
				}
				set
				{
					if (value != toolWithControl)
					{
						ControlContainerTool controlContainerTool = null;
						if (toolWithControl != null)
						{
							controlContainerTool = toolWithControl.UnderlyingTool as ControlContainerTool;
						}
						if (controlContainerTool != null && Control != null)
						{
							Control.Enter -= controlContainerTool.OnControlEnter;
						}
						toolWithControl = value;
						if (toolWithControl != null)
						{
							controlContainerTool = toolWithControl.UnderlyingTool as ControlContainerTool;
						}
						if (controlContainerTool != null && Control != null)
						{
							Control.Enter += controlContainerTool.OnControlEnter;
						}
					}
				}
			}

			internal ControlContainerToolExtraSharedProps(ControlContainerTool owningTool)
			{
				this.owningTool = owningTool;
			}

			internal void OnCustomizeModeBegin()
			{
				if (!customizing && control != null)
				{
					customizing = true;
					if (!owningTool.ToolbarsManager.IsDesignMode)
					{
						locationPreCustomize = control.Location;
						control.Location = new Point(-10000, -10000);
					}
				}
			}

			internal void OnCustomizeModeEnd()
			{
				if (customizing)
				{
					customizing = false;
					if (!owningTool.ToolbarsManager.IsDesignMode && control != null)
					{
						control.Location = locationPreCustomize;
					}
				}
			}

			public bool SyncControlWithName(bool allowUpdateControlName)
			{
				if (controlName == null)
				{
					if (allowUpdateControlName)
					{
						if (Control != null)
						{
							controlName = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetName(Control);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						Control = null;
					}
					return true;
				}
				if (control != null && ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetName(control) == controlName)
				{
					return true;
				}
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = owningTool.ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager != null && toolbarsManager.Initialized)
				{
					Control controlFromName = toolbarsManager.GetControlFromName(controlName);
					if (controlFromName != null)
					{
						Control = controlFromName;
						return true;
					}
				}
				Control = null;
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected ControlContainerTool(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "CanSetWidth":
				{
					bool succeeded;
					bool canSetWidth = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), false, out succeeded);
					if (succeeded)
					{
						SerializedProps.canSetWidth = canSetWidth;
					}
					break;
				}
				case "Control":
					controlName = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), controlName);
					break;
				case "VerticalDisplayStyle":
					SerializedProps.verticalDisplayStyle = (VerticalDisplayStyle)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(VerticalDisplayStyle), SerializedProps.verticalDisplayStyle);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnControlSet()
		{
			if (controlEventHooked != null)
			{
				controlEventHooked.Resize -= OnControlResized;
				controlEventHooked.Disposed -= OnControlDisposed;
			}
			controlEventHooked = ExtraSharedProps.Control;
			DirtyMetrics();
			if (controlEventHooked != null)
			{
				controlEventHooked.Resize += OnControlResized;
				controlEventHooked.Disposed += OnControlDisposed;
			}
		}

		internal void SetControlSize(Size size)
		{
			Control control = Control;
			if (control == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool synchronizingWidth = ExtraSharedProps.SynchronizingWidth;
			bool flag = isSettingSize;
			try
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.SynchronizingWidth = true;
				isSettingSize = true;
				control.Size = size;
				if (!(control.Size != size))
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (ToolBase toolInstance in base.SharedProps.ToolInstances)
				{
					RibbonGroup owningRibbonGroup = toolInstance.OwningRibbonGroup;
					if (owningRibbonGroup == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					owningRibbonGroup.DirtyAllMetrics();
					UIElement uIElement = owningRibbonGroup.UIElement;
					if (uIElement != null)
					{
						UIElement ancestor = uIElement.GetAncestor(typeof(RibbonTabPageUIElement));
						if (ancestor != null)
						{
							ancestor.DirtyChildElements();
						}
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				isSettingSize = flag;
				ExtraSharedProps.SynchronizingWidth = synchronizingWidth;
			}
		}

		internal static bool ShouldSerializeControlReference(ToolBase tool)
		{
			if (tool != null)
			{
				Control control = tool.Control;
				string name = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetName(control);
				if (name != null)
				{
					UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = tool.ToolbarsManager;
					if (toolbarsManager != null && toolbarsManager.GetControlFromName(name) == null)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void SyncControlWithName()
		{
			ControlContainerUtilities.SyncControlWithName(this, ExtraSharedProps);
		}

		private Size CalculateLogicalSizeHelper(bool calcMinimumSize)
		{
			return CalculateLogicalSizeHelper(calcMinimumSize, (Control != null) ? Control.Size : Size.Empty);
		}

		private Size CalculateLogicalSizeHelper(bool calcMinimumSize, Size controlSize)
		{
			//IL_005c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0068: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00fa: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0106: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_014e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0154: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0176: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_017a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (base.IsVertical)
			{
				return CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstanceAsButton();
			}
			Size empty = Size.Empty;
			bool drawAsActive = DrawAsActive;
			if (calcMinimumSize)
			{
				empty = new Size(8, 8);
			}
			else if (Control != null)
			{
				empty = controlSize;
				empty.Width = empty.Width;
				empty.Width = Math.Max(8, empty.Width);
			}
			else
			{
				AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
				AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)65011720;
				ResolveAppearance(editArea: false, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, drawAsActive, drawAsPressed: false);
				string text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ControlNotSet");
				empty = ((text == null || text.Length <= 0) ? MeasureString(ref appearance, null, "Wy") : MeasureString(ref appearance, null, text));
			}
			Size size = CalculateTextSize();
			if (!size.IsEmpty)
			{
				empty.Width += size.Width;
				empty.Height = Math.Max(empty.Height, size.Height);
			}
			if (base.InstanceDisplaysImage)
			{
				AppearanceData appearance2 = default(AppearanceData);
				AppearancePropFlags requestedProps2 = (AppearancePropFlags)256;
				ResolveAppearance(editArea: false, ref appearance2, ref requestedProps2, drawAsActive, drawAsPressed: false);
				Image image = ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance2)).GetImage(base.ImageList);
				if (image == null)
				{
					image = DefaultImage;
				}
				if (image != null)
				{
					UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManagerInControl = base.ToolbarsManagerInControl;
					Size size3;
					if (toolbarsManagerInControl != null)
					{
						Size size2 = new Size(2, 2);
						bool flag = (int)toolbarsManagerInControl.StyleResolved == 4;
						Size imageSizeResolved = base.ImageSizeResolved;
						ScaleImage val = (ScaleImage)(toolbarsManagerInControl.ShouldScaleImage(image.Size, imageSizeResolved) ? 1 : 0);
						size3 = ImageAndTextUIElement.CalculateImageSize(image, val, imageSizeResolved, flag);
					}
					else
					{
						size3 = base.ImageSizeResolved;
					}
					size3.Width += 4;
					size3.Height += 4;
					empty.Width += size3.Width;
					empty.Height = Math.Max(empty.Height, size3.Height);
				}
			}
			if (!calcMinimumSize && base.InstanceProps != null)
			{
				int maxWidthResolved = base.MaxWidthResolved;
				if (maxWidthResolved > 0)
				{
					empty.Width = Math.Min(empty.Width, maxWidthResolved);
				}
				empty.Width = Math.Max(empty.Width, base.MinWidthResolved);
			}
			return empty;
		}

		private Size CalculateTextSize()
		{
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Size result = Size.Empty;
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			if (base.InstanceDisplaysText && toolbarsManager != null)
			{
				string captionResolved = base.CaptionResolved;
				if (captionResolved != null && captionResolved.Length > 0)
				{
					AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
					AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)65011720;
					ResolveAppearance(editArea: false, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, DrawAsActive, drawAsPressed: false);
					result = MeasureString(ref appearance, null, captionResolved);
					result.Width += 2;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void OnControlDisposed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender == ExtraSharedProps.Control)
			{
				Control = null;
			}
		}

		private void OnControlEnter(object sender, EventArgs args)
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManagerInControl = base.ToolbarsManagerInControl;
			if ((toolbarsManagerInControl == null || toolbarsManagerInControl.ToolEnteringEditMode == null) && base.UIElement != null)
			{
				if (base.OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
				{
					base.ToolbarsManager.ActiveTool = this;
				}
				else if (base.OwnerIsToolbar && base.OwningToolbar.IsBumpedToolsToolbar)
				{
					base.ToolbarsManager.ActiveTool = this;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnControlResized(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			try
			{
				if (sender == ExtraSharedProps.Control)
				{
					SynchronizeToolWidthFromControl();
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private UIElement GetControlContainerToolUIElement(ToolBase tool, UIElement parentElement, UIElement previousElement, bool drawAsActive, bool drawAsPressed)
		{
			ControlContainerToolUIElement controlContainerToolUIElement = null;
			if (previousElement != null && ((object)previousElement).GetType() == typeof(ControlContainerToolUIElement))
			{
				controlContainerToolUIElement = previousElement as ControlContainerToolUIElement;
			}
			if (controlContainerToolUIElement == null)
			{
				controlContainerToolUIElement = new ControlContainerToolUIElement(parentElement, tool, Control);
			}
			else
			{
				controlContainerToolUIElement.InitializeElement(tool, Control);
			}
			return (UIElement)(object)controlContainerToolUIElement;
		}

		private void SetToolWidthHelper(int width)
		{
			base.SharedProps.Width = width;
			foreach (ToolBase toolInstance in base.SharedProps.ToolInstances)
			{
				if (!toolInstance.IsRootTool && toolInstance.InstanceProps != null)
				{
					toolInstance.InstanceProps.Width = width;
				}
			}
			if (base.OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
			{
				base.ToolbarsManagerInControl.GetToolbarDockArea(base.OwningToolbarInternal)?.DirtyChildElements();
			}
		}

		private void SynchronizeControlWidthFromTool()
		{
			if (ExtraSharedProps.SynchronizingWidth)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null || !toolbarsManager.Initialized || toolbarsManager.Loading)
			{
				return;
			}
			Control control = ExtraSharedProps.Control;
			if (control != null && !base.IsVertical && !base.IsToolbarBeingDragged)
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.SynchronizingWidth = true;
				int widthResolved = base.WidthResolved;
				int width = ToolForTextSize.CalculateLogicalSizeHelper(calcMinimumSize: false, Size.Empty).Width;
				widthResolved -= width;
				Size size = control.Size;
				if (widthResolved != size.Width)
				{
					control.Size = new Size(widthResolved, size.Height);
					SetToolWidthHelper(control.Size.Width + width);
				}
				ExtraSharedProps.SynchronizingWidth = false;
			}
		}

		private void SynchronizeToolWidthFromControl()
		{
			if (ExtraSharedProps.SynchronizingWidth)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null || !toolbarsManager.Initialized || toolbarsManager.Loading)
			{
				return;
			}
			Control control = ExtraSharedProps.Control;
			if (control == null || base.IsVertical || base.IsToolbarBeingDragged)
			{
				return;
			}
			ExtraSharedProps.SynchronizingWidth = true;
			try
			{
				ControlContainerTool toolForTextSize = ToolForTextSize;
				int num = toolForTextSize.CalculateWidthResolved(useCalculateLogicalSize: false);
				Size size = toolForTextSize.CalculateLogicalSizeHelper(calcMinimumSize: false);
				if (num != size.Width)
				{
					SetToolWidthHelper(size.Width);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			finally
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.SynchronizingWidth = false;
			}
		}

		private void SynchronizeVisibleSetting()
		{
			ControlContainerUtilities.SynchronizeVisibleSetting(this, ExtraSharedProps, typeof(UltraToolbarsDockArea), checkForUIElement: true);
		}

		{
			if (base.ToolBeingDisplayed.UIElement is ControlContainerToolUIElement controlContainerToolUIElement)
			{
				Rectangle result = Rectangle.Empty;
				UIElement descendant = ((UIElement)controlContainerToolUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(ControlContainerToolUIElement.ToolImageUIElement));
				if (descendant != null)
				{
					result = descendant.Control.RectangleToScreen(descendant.Rect);
				}
				return result;
			}
			return base.GetImageRect();
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		protected override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
			if (ShouldSerializeCanSetWidth())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "CanSetWidth", CanSetWidth);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeControl())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Control", ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetName(Control));
			}
			else if (ShouldSerializeControlName())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Control", ControlName);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeVerticalDisplayStyle())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "VerticalDisplayStyle", VerticalDisplayStyle);
			}
		}

		protected internal override UIElement GetRibbonToolUIElement(ToolBase tool, UIElement parentElement, UIElement previousElement, bool drawAsActive, bool drawAsPressed)
		{
			return GetControlContainerToolUIElement(tool, parentElement, previousElement, drawAsActive, drawAsPressed);
		}

		protected internal override Type GetRibbonToolUIElementType()
		{
			return typeof(ControlContainerToolUIElement);
		}

		protected internal override UIElement GetToolbarUIElement(ToolBase tool, UIElement parentElement, UIElement previousElement, bool drawAsActive, bool drawAsPressed)
		{
			if (base.IsVertical)
			{
				return GetToolbarButtonUIElement(tool, parentElement, previousElement, drawAsActive, drawAsPressed);
			}
			return GetControlContainerToolUIElement(tool, parentElement, previousElement, drawAsActive, drawAsPressed);
		}

		protected internal override Type GetToolbarUIElementType()
		{
			if (base.IsVertical)
			{
				return typeof(ButtonToolUIElement);
			}
			return typeof(ControlContainerToolUIElement);
		}

		protected internal override void Initialize(ToolsCollectionBase parentCollection)
		{
			base.Initialize(parentCollection);
			if (serializedProps != null)
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.canSetWidth = serializedProps.canSetWidth;
				ExtraSharedProps.verticalDisplayStyle = serializedProps.verticalDisplayStyle;
				serializedProps = null;
			}
			if (ControlContainerUtilities.InitializeControl(this, controlName))
			{
				SynchronizeControlWidthFromTool();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void InitializeFrom(ToolBase sourceTool, bool cloneNewInstance)
		{
			base.InitializeFrom(sourceTool, cloneNewInstance);
			if (sourceTool is ControlContainerTool controlContainerTool && !cloneNewInstance)
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.canSetWidth = controlContainerTool.ExtraSharedProps.CanSetWidth;
				ExtraSharedProps.verticalDisplayStyle = controlContainerTool.ExtraSharedProps.VerticalDisplayStyle;
				controlName = controlContainerTool.controlName;
			}
		}

		protected internal override void InternalSetToolWithContainedControl(ToolBase tool)
		{
			ExtraSharedProps.ToolWithControl = tool;
		}

		internal override bool IsVisibleOnToolbar(UltraToolbarBase toolbar)
		{
			if (base.IsVisibleOnToolbar(toolbar))
			{
				return toolbar is UltraToolbar;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override void OnActivate()
		{
			if (ExtraSharedProps.ToolWithControl == base.ToolBeingDisplayed && Control != null && !Control.ContainsFocus)
			{
				Control parent = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetParent(Control);
				if (parent != null)
				{
					IContainerControl containerControl = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetContainerControl(parent);
					if (containerControl != null)
					{
						ToolbarsManagerUtilities.SetActiveControl(containerControl, Control);
					}
				}
			}
			base.OnActivate();
		}

		protected internal override void OnCustomizeModeBegin()
		{
			ExtraSharedProps.OnCustomizeModeBegin();
		}

		protected internal override void OnCustomizeModeEnd()
		{
			ExtraSharedProps.OnCustomizeModeEnd();
		}

		protected internal override void OnDeactivate()
		{
			Control control = Control;
			if (control != null && control.Focused)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = base.UIElement;
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					for (Control control2 = uIElement.Control; control2 != null; control2 = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetParent(control2))
					{
						if (control2 is PopupControlBase popupControlBase)
						{
							popupControlBase.TakeFocus();
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			base.OnDeactivate();
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			ResizePending = true;
			base.OnSubObjectPropChanged(propChange);
			SynchronizeVisibleSetting();
			if (propChange.PropId is PropertyIds)
			{
				PropertyIds propertyIds = (PropertyIds)(object)propChange.PropId;
				if (propertyIds == PropertyIds.Width)
				{
					SynchronizeControlWidthFromTool();
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void OnToolbarManagerDisposing()
		{
			ControlContainerUtilities.OnToolbarManagerDisposing(this);
			base.OnToolbarManagerDisposing();
		}

		internal override void SyncControlAfterLoad()
		{
			if (!ExtraSharedProps.SyncControlWithName(allowUpdateControlName: true))
			{
				base.SyncControlAfterLoad();
				return;
			}
			if (ToolWithContainedControl == null)
			{
				base.ToolbarsManager.InternalSetToolWithControlHelper(null, this, null);
			}
			base.SyncControlAfterLoad();
		}

		protected internal override void OnVisibleChanged()
		{
			SynchronizeVisibleSetting();
		}

		protected override ToolBaseUiaProviderStub CreateUIAutomationStub()
		{
			return new ControlContainerToolUiaProviderStub(this);
		}
	}
	public class ControlContainerToolMenuItemUIElement : PopupMenuItemUIElement
	{
		public override Border3DSide BorderSides => (Border3DSide)0;

		public override UIElementBorderStyle BorderStyle => (UIElementBorderStyle)1;

		public override UIRole UIRole => Tool?.UIRoleOnMenus;

		public ToolBase Tool => base.MenuItem.Tool;

		internal ControlContainerToolMenuItemUIElement(UIElement parent, MenuItemBase menuItem)
			: base(parent, menuItem)
		{
			((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext = menuItem;
		}

		protected override void DrawForeground(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null)
			{
				base.DrawForeground(ref drawParams);
				return;
			}
			GetToolAndHost(out var tool, out var controlContainerHost);
			if (controlContainerHost != null)
			{
				if (!toolbarsManager.Customizing && tool.ToolWithContainedControl == Tool && (object)tool.Control.Parent == controlContainerHost)
				{
					base.DrawForeground(ref drawParams);
					return;
				}
				Rectangle containedControlBounds = GetContainedControlBounds(tool.Control);
				controlContainerHost.DrawContainedControl(tool.Control, ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics, containedControlBounds, ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).InvalidRect, 0.6f);
				base.DrawForeground(ref drawParams);
			}
		}

		private bool IsAdjacentToolRecentlyUsed(bool searchBackwards)
		{
			return false;
		}

		private Rectangle GetContainedControlBounds(Control control)
		{
			Size nonTextAreaSize = base.MenuItem.GetNonTextAreaSize();
			Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)this).Rect;
			return new Rectangle(rect.Left + nonTextAreaSize.Width, rect.Top + 4, control.Width, control.Height);
		}

		private void GetToolAndHost(out ControlContainerTool tool, out UltraToolbarsDockArea controlContainerHost)
		{
			tool = Tool as ControlContainerTool;
			controlContainerHost = null;
			if (tool != null && tool.Control != null)
			{
				PopupMenuTool owningMenu = tool.OwningMenu;
				if (owningMenu != null)
				{
					controlContainerHost = owningMenu.ControlContainerHost;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void PositionContainedControl(ref Region region)
		{
			GetToolAndHost(out var tool, out var controlContainerHost);
			if (controlContainerHost == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle containedControlBounds = GetContainedControlBounds(tool.Control);
			if (tool.ToolWithContainedControl != tool)
			{
				tool.SetToolWithContainedControl(takeControlOwnership: true, controlContainerHost);
				if (region == null)
				{
					region = new Region(containedControlBounds);
				}
				else
				{
					region.Union(containedControlBounds);
				}
			}
			if ((object)tool.Control.Parent == controlContainerHost)
			{
				tool.Control.Bounds = containedControlBounds;
			}
		}
	}
	public class ControlContainerToolUIElement : UIElement, IProvideToolElementResizeInfo
	{
		internal class ToolImageUIElement : ImageUIElement
		{
			internal ToolImageUIElement(UIElement parent, Image image)
				: base(parent, image)
			{
			}
		}

		private Control containedControl;

		private ControlContainerUIElement controlContainerElement;

		protected override int ChildElementArrayCapacity => 2;

		public override UIRole UIRole
		{
			get
			{
				ToolBase tool = Tool;
				if (tool != null)
				{
					if (tool.OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
					{
						return tool.UIRoleOnRibbonGroups;
					}
					return tool.UIRoleOnToolbars;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public Control ContainedControl => containedControl;

		public ToolBase Tool => ((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext as ToolBase;

		public UltraToolbarsManager ToolbarsManager => Tool.ToolbarsManager;

		bool IProvideToolElementResizeInfo.CanResizeHeight
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Tool.IsVertical)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!Tool.CanSetToolWidth)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		bool IProvideToolElementResizeInfo.CanResizeWidth
		{
			get
			{
				if (Tool.IsVertical)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!Tool.CanSetToolWidth)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public ControlContainerToolUIElement(UIElement parent, ToolBase tool, Control containedControl)
			: base(parent)
		{
			((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext = tool;
			this.containedControl = containedControl;
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			ToolBase tool = Tool;
			if (tool is PopupControlContainerToolBase && tool.IsOnBackStage)
			{
				if (((ulong)requestedProps & 1uL) != 0L)
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = Color.Transparent;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEuL);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Tool.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, Tool.DrawAsActive, drawAsPressed: false);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnAfterDraw(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				if (ToolbarsManager.CustomizingTool(Tool) && ToolbarsManager.ToolBeingResized != Tool)
				{
					ToolbarsManager.DrawToolSelectionRect((UIElement)(object)this, ref drawParams, Tool);
				}
				if (Tool != null)
				{
					Tool.DrawToolInsertionBar((UIElement)(object)this, ref drawParams);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e, bool adjustableArea, ref UIElement captureMouseForElement)
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ToolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.ToolBeingCustomized = Tool;
				ToolbarsManager.CloseAllOpenToolbarSubmenus();
				if (e.Button == MouseButtons.Right)
				{
					Control control = ((UIElement)this).Control;
					if (control != null && !control.IsDisposed && !control.Disposing)
					{
						Point pt = control.PointToScreen(new Point(e.X, e.Y));
						if (ToolbarsManager.CustomizeDialog != null)
						{
							ToolbarsManager.CustomizeDialog.DisplayToolContextMenu(Tool, pt);
						}
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (Tool.IsControlContainer)
			{
				Tool.SetToolWithContainedControl(takeControlOwnership: true, ((UIElement)this).Control as UltraToolbarsDockArea);
				((UIElement)this).DirtyChildElements(true);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool PointInAdjustableArea(Point point)
		{
			if (!Tool.CanSetToolWidth)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Tool.IsVertical)
			{
				return UltraToolbarsManager.PointInToolResizeArea(ToolResizeEdges.Top | ToolResizeEdges.Bottom, ((UIElement)this).Rect, point);
			}
			return UltraToolbarsManager.PointInToolResizeArea(ToolResizeEdges.Left | ToolResizeEdges.Right, ((UIElement)this).Rect, point);
		}

		internal void InitializeElement(ToolBase tool, Control containedControl)
		{
			((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext = tool;
			this.containedControl = containedControl;
		}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			//IL_0053: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_053d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0544: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00b0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b7: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_029a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_02a1: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_02a8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_02af: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00e3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e9: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_010b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_010f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Rectangle rectInsideBorders = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
			rectInsideBorders.Inflate(0, 0);
			ToolBase tool = Tool;
			UIElementsCollection childElements = ((UIElement)this).ChildElements;
			base.childElementsCollection = null;
			if (ToolbarsManager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool instanceDisplaysImage = tool.InstanceDisplaysImage;
			bool instanceDisplaysText = tool.InstanceDisplaysText;
			if ((instanceDisplaysImage || instanceDisplaysText) && !tool.IsOnBackStage)
			{
				AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
				AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)65012168;
				tool.ResolveAppearance(editArea: false, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, tool.DrawAsActive, drawAsPressed: false);
				if (instanceDisplaysImage)
				{
					Image image = ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).GetImage(tool.ImageList);
					if (image == null && !instanceDisplaysText)
					{
						image = tool.DefaultImage;
					}
					if (image != null)
					{
						ImageUIElement val = (ImageUIElement)UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)childElements, typeof(ToolImageUIElement), true);
						if (val == null)
						{
							val = (ImageUIElement)(object)new ToolImageUIElement((UIElement)(object)this, image);
						}
						else
						{
							((ImageUIElementBase)val).Image = image;
						}
						UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = tool.ToolbarsManager;
						Size size = new Size(2, 2);
						bool flag = (int)toolbarsManager.StyleResolved == 4;
						Size imageSizeResolved = tool.ImageSizeResolved;
						ScaleImage val2 = (ScaleImage)(toolbarsManager.ShouldScaleImage(image.Size, imageSizeResolved) ? 1 : 0);
						Size size2 = ImageAndTextUIElement.CalculateImageSize(image, val2, imageSizeResolved, flag);
						((ImageUIElementBase)val).ColorMaps = tool.GetColorRemapTable(((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).Image, isOnToolbar: true, isHotTracked: false);
						Rectangle rect = rectInsideBorders;
						if (!tool.IsVertical)
						{
							rect.X += size.Width;
							rect.Width = size2.Width;
							rect.Y += size.Height;
							rect.Height -= size.Height * 2;
							rectInsideBorders.X = rect.Right + size.Width;
							rectInsideBorders.Width -= rect.Width + size.Width * 2;
						}
						else
						{
							rect.Y += size.Height;
							rect.Height = size2.Height;
							rect.X += size.Width;
							rect.Width -= size.Width * 2;
							rectInsideBorders.Y = rect.Bottom + size.Height * 2;
							rectInsideBorders.Height -= rect.Height + size.Height * 2;
						}
						((UIElement)val).Rect = rect;
						((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)val);
					}
				}
				if (instanceDisplaysText)
				{
					string captionResolved = tool.CaptionResolved;
					if (captionResolved != null && captionResolved.Length > 0)
					{
						TextUIElement val3 = (TextUIElement)UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)childElements, typeof(TextUIElement), true);
						if (val3 == null)
						{
							val3 = new TextUIElement((UIElement)(object)this, captionResolved);
							((TextUIElementBase)val3).ShouldUseTypographicFormatString = tool.OwnerIsRibbonGroup;
						}
						else
						{
							((TextUIElementBase)val3).Text = captionResolved;
						}
						((TextUIElementBase)val3).HotkeyPrefix = tool.HotkeyPrefix;
						((TextUIElementBase)val3).MultiLine = true;
						Rectangle rect2 = rectInsideBorders;
						rect2.Width = tool.MeasureString(ref appearance, null, captionResolved).Width;
						rectInsideBorders.X = rect2.Right + 2;
						rectInsideBorders.Width -= rect2.Width + 2;
						((UIElement)val3).Rect = rect2;
						((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)val3);
					}
				}
			}
			if (tool.Control != null)
			{
				Size size3 = tool.Control.Size;
				if (controlContainerElement == null)
				{
					controlContainerElement = new ControlContainerUIElement((UIElement)(object)this, tool, containedControl);
				}
				else
				{
					controlContainerElement.InitializeElement(tool, containedControl);
				}
				if (tool.ToolWithContainedControl == null)
				{
					tool.SetToolWithContainedControl(takeControlOwnership: true, ((UIElement)this).Control as UltraToolbarsDockArea);
				}
				else if (tool.ToolWithContainedControl == tool && !ToolbarsManager.Customizing)
				{
					ToolbarsManager.ReparentControl(tool.Control, ((UIElement)this).Control, tool.SharedProps.RootTool);
				}
				else if (tool.ToolWithContainedControl != tool && tool.ToolWithContainedControl == tool.UnderlyingTool)
				{
					tool.SetToolWithContainedControl(takeControlOwnership: true, ((UIElement)this).Control as UltraToolbarsDockArea);
				}
				if (!tool.IsVertical && !tool.IsToolbarBeingDragged)
				{
					ToolBase underlyingTool = tool.UnderlyingTool;
					ControlContainerTool controlContainerTool = underlyingTool as ControlContainerTool;
					if (tool.ToolWithContainedControl == Tool && controlContainerTool != null && (controlContainerTool.ResizePending || (underlyingTool.SpringResolved && size3.Width != rectInsideBorders.Width)))
					{
						controlContainerTool.ResizePending = false;
						size3.Width = rectInsideBorders.Width;
						if (tool.OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
						{
							size3.Height = rectInsideBorders.Height;
						}
						if (!ToolbarsManager.IsDesignMode || ToolbarsManager.DesignerHost == null || !ToolbarsManager.DesignerHost.Loading)
						{
							controlContainerTool.SetControlSize(size3);
							size3.Height = tool.Control.Height;
						}
					}
				}
				if (size3.Height < rectInsideBorders.Height)
				{
					rectInsideBorders.Y += (1 + rectInsideBorders.Height - size3.Height) / 2;
				}
				((UIElement)controlContainerElement).Rect = rectInsideBorders;
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)controlContainerElement);
			}
			else if (ToolbarsManager.IsDesignMode)
			{
				TextUIElement val4 = new TextUIElement((UIElement)(object)this, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ControlNotSet"));
				((UIElement)val4).Rect = rectInsideBorders;
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)val4);
			}
		}

	public class ControlContainerUIElement : UIElement, IProvideToolElementResizeInfo
	{
		private Control containedControl;

		protected override int ChildElementArrayCapacity => 1;

		public Control ContainedControl => containedControl;

		public ToolBase Tool => ((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext as ToolBase;

		public UltraToolbarsManager ToolbarsManager => Tool.ToolbarsManager;

		internal bool ToolHasControl
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Tool.IsControlContainer || Tool.ToolWithContainedControl != Tool)
				{
					return false;
				}
				try
				{
					if (Tool.Control.Parent != ((UIElement)this).Control)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		bool IProvideToolElementResizeInfo.CanResizeHeight
		{
			get
			{
				if (((UIElement)this).Parent is IProvideToolElementResizeInfo provideToolElementResizeInfo)
				{
					return provideToolElementResizeInfo.CanResizeHeight;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		bool IProvideToolElementResizeInfo.CanResizeWidth
		{
			get
			{
				if (((UIElement)this).Parent is IProvideToolElementResizeInfo provideToolElementResizeInfo)
				{
					return provideToolElementResizeInfo.CanResizeWidth;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public ControlContainerUIElement(UIElement parent, ToolBase tool, Control containedControl)
			: base(parent)
		{
			((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext = tool;
			this.containedControl = containedControl;
		}

		protected override void DrawBackColor(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
		}

		protected override void DrawImageBackground(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
		}

		protected override void DrawForeground(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			if (((UIElement)((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).ControlElement).Control is UltraToolbarsDockArea ultraToolbarsDockArea && ToolbarsManager != null && ((ToolbarsManager.Customizing && containedControl != null) || !ToolHasControl))
			{
				ultraToolbarsDockArea.DrawContainedControl(containedControl, ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics, ((UIElement)this).Rect, ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).InvalidRect, 0.6f);
			}
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e, bool adjustableArea, ref UIElement captureMouseForElement)
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ToolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.ToolBeingCustomized = Tool;
				ToolbarsManager.CloseAllOpenToolbarSubmenus();
				if (e.Button == MouseButtons.Right)
				{
					Control control = ((UIElement)this).Control;
					if (control != null && !control.IsDisposed && !control.Disposing)
					{
						Point pt = control.PointToScreen(new Point(e.X, e.Y));
						if (ToolbarsManager.CustomizeDialog != null)
						{
							ToolbarsManager.CustomizeDialog.DisplayToolContextMenu(Tool, pt);
						}
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (Tool.IsControlContainer)
			{
				Tool.SetToolWithContainedControl(takeControlOwnership: true, ((UIElement)this).Control as UltraToolbarsDockArea);
				((UIElement)this).DirtyChildElements();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool PointInAdjustableArea(Point point)
		{
			return ((UIElement)this).Parent.PointInAdjustableArea(point);
		}

		internal void InitializeElement(ToolBase tool, Control containedControl)
		{
			((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext = tool;
			this.containedControl = containedControl;
		}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager != null && !(Tool is ControlContainerTool { IsSettingSize: not false }))
			{
				Point point = ((Tool is PopupControlContainerTool && !Tool.IsOnBackStage) ? Point.Empty : ((UIElement)this).Rect.Location);
				if (!ToolbarsManager.Customizing && ToolHasControl && containedControl.Dock != DockStyle.Fill && containedControl.Location != point)
				{
					containedControl.Location = point;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal static class ControlContainerUtilities
	{
		public static bool InitializeControl(ToolBase tool, string controlName)
		{
			if (controlName == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = tool.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			tool.Control = toolbarsManager.GetControlFromName(controlName);
			return true;
		}

		public static void OnToolbarManagerDisposing(ToolBase tool)
		{
			if (tool.Control != null)
			{
				tool.SetToolWithContainedControl(takeControlOwnership: false, null);
				tool.Control = null;
			}
		}

		public static bool SetControl(ToolBase tool, IControlContainerExtraSharedProps extraSharedProps, Control control)
		{
			if (control != extraSharedProps.Control)
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = tool.ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager != null && control != null && !toolbarsManager.Loading && tool.SharedProps.RootTool != null)
				{
					ToolBase controlContainerTool = toolbarsManager.GetControlContainerTool(control);
					if (controlContainerTool != null && controlContainerTool.SharedProps != tool.SharedProps)
					{
						throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_2", controlContainerTool.ToString()));
					}
				}
				extraSharedProps.Control = control;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static void SyncControlWithName(ToolBase tool, IControlContainerExtraSharedProps extraSharedProps)
		{
			extraSharedProps.SyncControlWithName(allowUpdateControlName: true);
			if (tool.ToolWithContainedControl == null)
			{
				tool.ToolbarsManager.InternalSetToolWithControlHelper(null, tool, null);
			}
		}

		public static void SynchronizeVisibleSetting(ToolBase sourceTool, IControlContainerExtraSharedProps extraSharedProps, Type expectedParentType, bool checkForUIElement)
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = sourceTool.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null || !toolbarsManager.Initialized || toolbarsManager.Loading)
			{
				return;
			}
			Control control = extraSharedProps.Control;
			if (control == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ToolBase toolBeingDisplayed = sourceTool.ToolBeingDisplayed;
			if (!toolBeingDisplayed.VisibleResolved)
			{
				if (control.Visible)
				{
					control.Visible = false;
				}
			}
			else if (!control.Visible && (!checkForUIElement || toolBeingDisplayed.UIElement != null))
			{
				Control parent = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetParent(control);
				if (parent != null && expectedParentType.IsAssignableFrom(parent.GetType()))
				{
					control.Visible = true;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal interface IControlContainerExtraSharedProps
	{
		Control Control { get; set; }

		bool SyncControlWithName(bool allowUpdateControlName);
	}
	internal abstract class ControlNativeWindow : NativeWindow
	{
		private Control control;

		private bool active;

		private bool assignHandleNeeded = true;

		public Control Control => control;

		protected ControlNativeWindow(Control control)
		{
			this.control = control;
			Activate();
		}

		private void HookControlEvents()
		{
			control.HandleCreated += OnControlHandleCreated;
			control.Disposed += OnControlDisposed;
		}

		private void UnhookControlEvents()
		{
			control.HandleCreated -= OnControlHandleCreated;
			control.Disposed -= OnControlDisposed;
		}

		private void OnControlDisposed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UnhookControlEvents();
		}

		private void OnControlHandleCreated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UnhookControlEvents();
			assignHandleNeeded = false;
			AssignHandle(control.Handle);
		}

		public virtual void Activate()
		{
			active = true;
			if (assignHandleNeeded)
			{
				if (control.IsHandleCreated)
				{
					assignHandleNeeded = false;
					AssignHandle(Control.Handle);
				}
				else
				{
					HookControlEvents();
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual void Deactivate()
		{
			active = false;
			UnhookControlEvents();
		}

		protected override void OnHandleChange()
		{
			if (control != null && !control.IsDisposed && !control.IsHandleCreated)
			{
				assignHandleNeeded = true;
				if (active)
				{
					HookControlEvents();
				}
			}
			base.OnHandleChange();
		}
	}
	public class CustomizeDialog : Form, IOwnedForm
	{
		internal class CustomizerDialogCustomizer : DesignTimeToolbarCustomizerBase
		{
			private CustomizeDialog dialog;

			public override bool ShouldDisplayToolbarList
			{
				get
				{
					if (!ManagerBeingDesigned.IsDesignMode)
					{
						return false;
					}
					foreach (UltraToolbar toolbar in ManagerBeingDesigned.Toolbars)
					{
						if (!toolbar.Inherited)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			public override bool IsEnabled
			{
				get
				{
					Form activeForm = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ActiveForm;
					if (activeForm != null && activeForm != dialog && activeForm.Modal && !(activeForm is CustomizeDialogRearrangeCommands))
					{
						return false;
					}
					return base.IsEnabled;
				}
			}

			public override IWin32Window DialogOwner => dialog;

			protected override bool IsDesignMode => dialog.designMode;

			protected override Control ControlToReceiveCapture => dialog;

			protected override Control DockWithinContainer => dialog;

			protected internal override UltraToolbarsManager ManagerBeingDesigned => dialog.toolbarsManager;

			internal CustomizerDialogCustomizer(CustomizeDialog dialog)
			{
				this.dialog = dialog;
			}

			public override bool IsCustomizeDialogHandle(IntPtr handle)
			{
				if (dialog != null && dialog.IsHandleCreated && dialog.Handle == handle)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.IsCustomizeDialogHandle(handle);
			}

			public override bool ShouldDisplayNewToolPlaceHolder(object toolsOwner)
			{
				return IsDesignMode;
			}

			public override void OnNewToolAdded(ToolBase tool)
			{
				dialog.ReSyncToolAndCategoryLists(tool);
				if (dialog.popupMenuDesigner != null)
				{
					dialog.popupMenuDesigner.OnNewToolCreated(tool);
				}
				base.OnNewToolAdded(tool);
			}

			public override void OnToolbarClicked(UltraToolbarBase toolbar)
			{
				if (toolbar is UltraToolbar)
				{
					dialog.OnToolbarClicked((UltraToolbar)toolbar);
					base.OnToolbarClicked(toolbar);
				}
			}

			public override void OnExistingToolsInserted(ToolsCollectionBase destination)
			{
				if (destination != null && destination.OwnerIsPopupMenu && dialog.popupMenuDesigner != null)
				{
					dialog.popupMenuDesigner.RefreshLists();
				}
				base.OnExistingToolsInserted(destination);
			}

			public override void OnNewCustomizeToolSelected(ToolBase tool, Point mousePoint)
			{
				dialog.OnNewCustomizeToolSelected(tool, mousePoint);
				base.OnNewCustomizeToolSelected(tool, mousePoint);
			}

			public override void OnToolbarsManagerInitialized(UltraToolbarsManager manager)
			{
				dialog.OnToolbarsManagerInitialized(manager);
				base.OnToolbarsManagerInitialized(manager);
			}

			public override void DragItemStart(DragItemType itemType)
			{
				dialog.DragToolStart();
				base.DragItemStart(itemType);
			}

			public override void DragItemEnd(DragItemType itemType)
			{
				dialog.DragToolEnd();
				base.DragItemEnd(itemType);
				if (!dialog.Disposing && !dialog.IsDisposed && dialog.Visible)
				{
					ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ActivateForm(dialog);
				}
			}

			public override bool IsPointOverCustomizer(Point screenPt)
			{
				if (!dialog.IsHandleCreated)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return dialog.RectangleToScreen(dialog.DisplayRectangle).Contains(screenPt);
			}

			public override bool IsPointInCurrentOpenSubForm(Point pt)
			{
				return dialog.IsPointInCurrentOpenSubForm(pt);
			}

			public override DialogResult ShowDialog(Form form)
			{
				return form.ShowDialog(dialog);
			}

			protected override void OnToolContextMenuDropDown(object sender, ToolDropdownEventArgs e)
			{
				if (e.Tool.OwnerIsToolbarsManager)
				{
					dialog.AcceptButton = null;
					dialog.CancelButton = null;
				}
				base.OnToolContextMenuDropDown(sender, e);
			}

			protected override void OnToolContextMenuCloseup(object sender, ToolDropdownEventArgs e)
			{
				base.OnToolContextMenuCloseup(sender, e);
				dialog.OnToolContextMenuCloseup(sender, e);
			}

			protected override void OnToolContextMenuClick(object sender, ToolClickEventArgs e)
			{
				base.OnToolContextMenuClick(sender, e);
				dialog.OnToolContextMenuClick(sender, e);
			}

			internal void ClearToolBeingCustomized()
			{
				base.PlaceHolderTool = null;
				base.ToolBeingEdited = null;
			}
		}

		private ToolBase SelectedTool
		{
			get
			{
				if (lstTools.SelectedIndex < 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (lstTools.SelectedIndex >= lstTools.Items.Count)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (lstTools.Items[lstTools.SelectedIndex] is ToolWrapper toolWrapper)
				{
					return toolWrapper.Tool;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		private bool SelectedToolHasUniqueProps
		{
			get
			{
				if (SelectedTool == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (SelectedTool.GetType() == typeof(ButtonTool) || SelectedTool.GetType() == typeof(LabelTool))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				OnToolDeselected();
				if (pgToolbars.SelectedObject != null)
				{
					((UltraToolbar)pgToolbars.SelectedObject).SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					pgToolbars.SelectedObject = null;
				}
				if (toolCustomizer != null)
				{
					toolCustomizer.Dispose();
					toolCustomizer = null;
				}
				if (designMode)
				{
					lstTools.Resize -= OnToolListResized;
				}
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		protected override void OnLoad(EventArgs e)
		{
			inboxControlStyler1.ApplyAppStyling = (ApplyAppStyling)((!useAppStyling) ? 1 : 2);
			inboxControlStyler1.DefaultStyleSetName = styleSetName;
			inboxControlStyler1.DefaultStyleLibraryName = styleLibraryName;
			base.OnLoad(e);
			StyleUtilities.SynchronizeComponentRoleSettingsOnChildren((Control)this, useAppStyling, StyleSetName, true, styleLibraryName);
			if (((UIElement)grpOther.UIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(GroupBoxHeaderUIElement)) is GroupBoxHeaderUIElement groupBoxHeaderUIElement)
			{
				((Control)(object)grpOther).Height = ((UIElement)groupBoxHeaderUIElement).Rect.Height;
			}
			if (((UIElement)grpPersonalized.UIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(GroupBoxHeaderUIElement)) is GroupBoxHeaderUIElement groupBoxHeaderUIElement2)
			{
				((Control)(object)grpPersonalized).Height = ((UIElement)groupBoxHeaderUIElement2).Rect.Height;
			}
		}

		private void spinFloatingToolbarFadeDelay_EditorSpinButtonClick(object sender, SpinButtonClickEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0099: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			object value = spinFloatingToolbarFadeDelay.Value;
			object maxValue = spinFloatingToolbarFadeDelay.MaxValue;
			int num = 0;
			if (value is IConvertible)
			{
				num = ((IConvertible)value).ToInt32(null);
			}
			int num2 = 0;
			if (maxValue is IConvertible)
			{
				num2 = ((IConvertible)maxValue).ToInt32(null);
			}
			if ((int)e.ButtonType == 1)
			{
				if (num + 100 > num2)
				{
					spinFloatingToolbarFadeDelay.Value = num2;
					return;
				}
				if (num + 100 > 9999999)
				{
					spinFloatingToolbarFadeDelay.MaskInput = "nnnnnnnnn";
				}
				spinFloatingToolbarFadeDelay.Value = num + 100;
			}
			else if ((int)e.ButtonType == 0)
			{
				if (num < 100)
				{
					spinFloatingToolbarFadeDelay.Value = 0;
				}
				else
				{
					spinFloatingToolbarFadeDelay.Value = num - 100;
				}
			}
		}

		private void CustomizeDialog_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			SuspendLayout();
			ResetListboxSelectionModes(forceNone: false);
			CreatePopupMenuDesignerTab();
			InitDialogFields();
			if (designMode)
			{
				tabMain.Tabs.Remove(tabMain.Tabs["Commands"]);
				spToolbars.Visible = true;
				pgToolbars.Visible = true;
				base.Width = (int)(1.3 * (double)base.Width);
				lstTools.Resize += OnToolListResized;
				((Control)(object)cmdImport).Enabled = toolbarsManager.FormMainMenu != null || toolbarsManager.FormToolbarControls != null;
				((Control)(object)cmdLoadSave).Visible = true;
				if (toolbarsManager.IsInherited)
				{
					((Control)(object)cmdLoadSave).Enabled = false;
				}
				else
				{
					((Control)(object)cmdLoadSave).Enabled = true;
				}
				((Control)(object)cmdKeyboard).Visible = false;
				((Control)(object)cmdResetToolbar).Visible = false;
				mnuResetToolbar.Visible = false;
			}
			else
			{
				tabMain.Tabs.Remove(tabMain.Tabs["Tools"]);
				spToolbars.Visible = false;
				pgToolbars.Visible = false;
				lstToolbars.Dock = DockStyle.Fill;
				((Control)(object)cmdResetUsageData).Enabled = true;
				((Control)(object)cmdImport).Visible = false;
				((Control)(object)cmdLoadSave).Visible = false;
				if (toolbarsManager.MSColors != null)
				{
					((Control)(object)lblSelectedCommand).Visible = false;
					((Control)(object)cmdCommandDescription).Visible = false;
					((Control)(object)cmdModifySelection).Location = ((Control)(object)lblSelectedCommand).Location;
					((Control)(object)cmdRearrangeCommands).Location = new Point(((Control)(object)cmdModifySelection).Location.X + ((Control)(object)cmdModifySelection).Width + 12, ((Control)(object)cmdModifySelection).Location.Y);
					((Control)(object)cmdRearrangeCommands).Visible = true;
				}
			}
			tabMain.SelectedTab = tabMain.Tabs[0];
			ApplySettingsFromRegistry();
			if (!IsFullTrust)
			{
				if (((Control)(object)lblForSizingMinWidthWhenUsingLargeFonts).Left > MinimumSize.Width)
				{
					MinimumSize = new Size(((Control)(object)lblForSizingMinWidthWhenUsingLargeFonts).Left, MinimumSize.Height);
				}
				if (((Control)(object)lblForSizingMinHeightWhenUsingLargeFonts).Top > MinimumSize.Height)
				{
					MinimumSize = new Size(MinimumSize.Width, ((Control)(object)lblForSizingMinHeightWhenUsingLargeFonts).Top);
				}
			}
			ResumeLayout();
			((Control)(object)label7).AutoSize = true;
			((Control)(object)coMenuAnimations).Location = new Point(((Control)(object)label7).Right + 4, ((Control)(object)coMenuAnimations).Top);
			if (!designMode)
			{
				((Control)(object)cmdKeyboard).Refresh();
			}
			((Control)(object)cmdClose).Refresh();
		}

		}

		private void cmdNewToolbar_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			CustomizeDialogNewToolbar customizeDialogNewToolbar = new CustomizeDialogNewToolbar(toolbarsManager);
