		private void lstToolbars_ItemCheck(object sender, ItemCheckEventArgs e)
		{
			if (loadingToolbarList || !(lstToolbars.Items[e.Index] is ToolbarListWrapper toolbarListWrapper))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (e.NewValue == CheckState.Unchecked && toolbarListWrapper.Toolbar.VisibleResolved && !toolbarListWrapper.Toolbar.SettingsResolved.AllowHidingResolved)
			{
				e.NewValue = CheckState.Checked;
				return;
			}
			ignoreToolbarVisiblePropChange = true;
			try
			{
				toolbarListWrapper.Toolbar.VerifyCanBeModified();
				toolbarListWrapper.Toolbar.InternalSetVisible(e.NewValue == CheckState.Checked, bypassDockUpdateForMergedToolbars: false);
			}
			catch
			{
				e.NewValue = e.CurrentValue;
			}
			ignoreToolbarVisiblePropChange = false;
		}

		private void cmdNewTool_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			string empty = string.Empty;
			if (coCategories.SelectedIndex > -1 && coCategories.Items[coCategories.SelectedIndex].DataValue is CategoryWrapper { Type: CategoryType.UserDefined } categoryWrapper)
			{
				empty = categoryWrapper.Text;
			}
			CustomizeDialogNewTool customizeDialogNewTool = new CustomizeDialogNewTool(toolbarsManager, ToolCustomizer, empty);
			ShowDialog(customizeDialogNewTool);
			customizeDialogNewTool.Dispose();
		}

		private void lstTools_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			OnToolDeselected();
			if (SelectedTool != null)
			{
				OnToolSelected();
				if (SelectedTool.InheritedResolved)
				{
					((Control)(object)cmdDeleteTool).Enabled = false;
					mnuDeleteTool.Enabled = false;
				}
				else
				{
					((Control)(object)cmdDeleteTool).Enabled = true;
					mnuDeleteTool.Enabled = true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				((Control)(object)cmdDeleteTool).Enabled = false;
				mnuDeleteTool.Enabled = false;
			}
		}

		private void coCategories_SelectionChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ReloadToolsList(null, selectFirstToolIfNotFound: true);
		}

		private void cmdDeleteToolbar_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (lstToolbars.SelectedIndex < 0)
			{
				((Control)(object)cmdDeleteToolbar).Enabled = false;
				return;
			}
			if (!(lstToolbars.Items[lstToolbars.SelectedIndex] is ToolbarListWrapper toolbarListWrapper))
			{
				((Control)(object)cmdDeleteToolbar).Enabled = false;
				return;
			}
			string text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeConfirmToolbarDelete", lstToolbars.Items[lstToolbars.SelectedIndex].ToString());
			DialogResult dialogResult = UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, text, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeConfirmToolbarDeleteTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.OKCancel, MessageBoxIcon.Question);
			if (dialogResult == DialogResult.OK)
			{
				toolbarsManager.Toolbars.Remove(toolbarListWrapper.Toolbar);
				int selectedIndex = lstToolbars.SelectedIndex;
				lstToolbars.Items.RemoveAt(lstToolbars.SelectedIndex);
				if (selectedIndex + 1 <= lstToolbars.Items.Count)
				{
					lstToolbars.SelectedIndex = selectedIndex;
				}
				else if (lstToolbars.Items.Count > 0)
				{
					lstToolbars.SelectedIndex = lstToolbars.Items.Count - 1;
				}
			}
		}

		private void lstToolbars_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((Control)(object)lblInheritedToolbarWarning).Visible = false;
			if (lstToolbars.SelectedIndex < 0)
			{
				UltraButton ultraButton = cmdDeleteToolbar;
				UltraButton ultraButton2 = cmdRenameToolbar;
				bool flag = (((Control)(object)cmdResetToolbar).Enabled = false);
				bool enabled = (((Control)(object)ultraButton2).Enabled = flag);
				((Control)(object)ultraButton).Enabled = enabled;
				ToolStripMenuItem toolStripMenuItem = mnuDeleteToolbar;
				ToolStripMenuItem toolStripMenuItem2 = mnuRenameToolbar;
				flag = (mnuResetToolbar.Enabled = false);
				enabled = (toolStripMenuItem2.Enabled = flag);
				toolStripMenuItem.Enabled = enabled;
				return;
			}
			if (!(lstToolbars.Items[lstToolbars.SelectedIndex] is ToolbarListWrapper toolbarListWrapper))
			{
				UltraButton ultraButton3 = cmdDeleteToolbar;
				UltraButton ultraButton4 = cmdRenameToolbar;
				bool flag = (((Control)(object)cmdResetToolbar).Enabled = false);
				bool enabled = (((Control)(object)ultraButton4).Enabled = flag);
				((Control)(object)ultraButton3).Enabled = enabled;
				ToolStripMenuItem toolStripMenuItem3 = mnuDeleteToolbar;
				ToolStripMenuItem toolStripMenuItem4 = mnuRenameToolbar;
				flag = (mnuResetToolbar.Enabled = false);
				enabled = (toolStripMenuItem4.Enabled = flag);
				toolStripMenuItem3.Enabled = enabled;
				return;
			}
			if (designMode)
			{
				if (toolbarListWrapper.Toolbar.Inherited)
				{
					((Control)(object)cmdDeleteToolbar).Enabled = false;
					((Control)(object)cmdRenameToolbar).Enabled = false;
					((Control)(object)lblInheritedToolbarWarning).Visible = true;
				}
				else
				{
					((Control)(object)cmdDeleteToolbar).Enabled = true;
					((Control)(object)cmdRenameToolbar).Enabled = true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				((Control)(object)cmdDeleteToolbar).Enabled = !toolbarListWrapper.Toolbar.IsStockToolbar;
				((Control)(object)cmdRenameToolbar).Enabled = !toolbarListWrapper.Toolbar.IsStockToolbar;
				((Control)(object)cmdResetToolbar).Enabled = true;
			}
			if (designMode)
			{
				if (pgToolbars.SelectedObject != null)
				{
					((UltraToolbar)pgToolbars.SelectedObject).SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				pgToolbars.SelectedObject = toolbarListWrapper.Toolbar;
				toolbarListWrapper.Toolbar.SubObjectPropChanged += SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			mnuDeleteToolbar.Enabled = ((Control)(object)cmdDeleteToolbar).Enabled;
			mnuRenameToolbar.Enabled = ((Control)(object)cmdRenameToolbar).Enabled;
			mnuResetToolbar.Enabled = ((Control)(object)cmdResetToolbar).Enabled;
		}

		private void cmdRenameToolbar_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (lstToolbars.SelectedIndex < 0)
			{
				((Control)(object)cmdRenameToolbar).Enabled = false;
				return;

			if (!(lstToolbars.Items[lstToolbars.SelectedIndex] is ToolbarListWrapper toolbarListWrapper))
			{
				((Control)(object)cmdRenameToolbar).Enabled = false;
				return;

			CustomizeDialogRenameToolbar customizeDialogRenameToolbar = new CustomizeDialogRenameToolbar(toolbarsManager, toolbarListWrapper.Toolbar);
			ShowDialog((Form)(object)customizeDialogRenameToolbar);
			if (((Form)(object)customizeDialogRenameToolbar).DialogResult == DialogResult.OK)
			{
				InitToolbarList(toolbarListWrapper.Toolbar);
			}
			((Component)(object)customizeDialogRenameToolbar).Dispose();
		}

		private void cmdResetToolbar_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (lstToolbars.SelectedIndex < 0)
			{
				((Control)(object)cmdResetToolbar).Enabled = false;
				return;
			}
			if (!(lstToolbars.Items[lstToolbars.SelectedIndex] is ToolbarListWrapper toolbarListWrapper))
			{
				((Control)(object)cmdResetToolbar).Enabled = false;
				return;
			}
			string text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeConfirmToolbarReset", lstToolbars.Items[lstToolbars.SelectedIndex].ToString());
			DialogResult dialogResult = UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, text, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeConfirmToolbarResetTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.OKCancel, MessageBoxIcon.Question);
			if (dialogResult == DialogResult.OK)
			{
				toolbarListWrapper.Toolbar.ResetState();
			}
		}

		private void cmdCommandDescription_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			DescriptionToolTipDialog descriptionToolTipDialog = null;
			if (lstCommands.SelectedIndex > -1)
			{
				if (!(lstCommands.Items[lstCommands.SelectedIndex] is ToolWrapper toolWrapper))
				{
					return;
				}
				descriptionToolTipDialog = new DescriptionToolTipDialog(toolWrapper.Tool.CaptionResolved, toolWrapper.Tool.CustomizerDescriptionResolved);
				descriptionToolTipDialog.Location = new Point(Control.MousePosition.X - descriptionToolTipDialog.Size.Width / 2, Control.MousePosition.Y + 10);
			}
			else
			{
				if (selectedCustomizeTool == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				descriptionToolTipDialog = new DescriptionToolTipDialog(selectedCustomizeTool.CaptionResolved, selectedCustomizeTool.CustomizerDescriptionResolved);
				descriptionToolTipDialog.Location = selectedCustomizeToolPoint;
			}
			descriptionToolTipDialog.Show();
		}

		private void cmdModifySelection_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Point point = ((Control)(object)cmdModifySelection).PointToScreen(new Point(0, ((Control)(object)cmdModifySelection).Height));
			Rectangle exclusionRect = ((Control)(object)cmdModifySelection).RectangleToScreen(((Control)(object)cmdModifySelection).ClientRectangle);
			DisplayToolContextMenu(selectedCustomizeTool, point, exclusionRect, (DropDownPosition)0);
		}

		private void cmdResetUsageData_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (designMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			DialogResult dialogResult = UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeConfirmResetUsageData"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeConfirmResetUsageDataTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.YesNo, MessageBoxIcon.Question);
			if (dialogResult != DialogResult.Yes)
			{
				return;
			}
			CancelEventArgs e2 = new CancelEventArgs();
			toolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.BeforeComponentReset, e2);
			if (e2.Cancel)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ToolBase tool in toolbarsManager.Tools)
			{
				foreach (ToolBase toolInstance in tool.SharedProps.ToolInstances)
				{
					toolInstance.ResetClickCount();
				}
			}
			toolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.AfterComponentReset, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		private void chAlwaysShowFullMenus_CheckedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (toolbarsManager.AlwaysShowMenusExpandedResolved != chAlwaysShowFullMenus.Checked)
			{
				toolbarsManager.AlwaysShowMenusExpanded = (DefaultableBoolean)(chAlwaysShowFullMenus.Checked ? 1 : 2);
				if (chAlwaysShowFullMenus.Checked)
				{
					((Control)(object)chShowFullMenusAfterShortDelay).Enabled = false;
				}
				else
				{
					((Control)(object)chShowFullMenusAfterShortDelay).Enabled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private void lstCategories_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (lstCategories.SelectedIndex < 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				lstCommands.BeginUpdate();
				lstCommands.Items.Clear();
				if (lstCategories.Items[lstCategories.SelectedIndex] is CategoryWrapper selectedCategory)
				{
					DesignerUtilities.LoadToolsList(toolbarsManager, lstCommands, selectedCategory, designMode);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				try
				{
					lstCommands.EndUpdate();
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
		}

		private void lstCommands_MouseDown(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Button == MouseButtons.Left && lstCommands.SelectedIndex > -1 && lstCommands.SelectedIndex < lstCommands.Items.Count && lstCommands.Items[lstCommands.SelectedIndex] is ToolWrapper toolWrapper)
			{
				toolbarsManager.OnDragToolBegin(toolWrapper.Tool);
				listBoxThatStartedToolDrag = lstCommands;
			}
		}

		private void lstTools_MouseDown(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Button == MouseButtons.Left && SelectedTool != null)
			{
				toolbarsManager.OnDragToolBegin(SelectedTool);
				listBoxThatStartedToolDrag = lstTools;
			}
			if (e.Button == MouseButtons.Right)
			{
				int num = lstTools.IndexFromPoint(e.X, e.Y);
				if (num > -1 && num < lstTools.Items.Count)
				{
					lstTools.SelectedIndex = num;
				}
			}
		}

		private void lstToolbars_MouseDown(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Button == MouseButtons.Right)
			{
				int num = lstToolbars.IndexFromPoint(e.X, e.Y);
				if (num > -1 && num < lstToolbars.Items.Count)
				{
					lstToolbars.SelectedIndex = num;
				}
			}
		}

		private void lstCommands_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((Control)(object)cmdCommandDescription).Enabled = lstCommands.SelectedIndex > -1 || selectedCustomizeTool != null;
			((Control)(object)cmdModifySelection).Enabled = selectedCustomizeTool != null;
			if (!designMode && lstCommands.SelectedIndex > -1)
			{
				selectedCustomizeTool = null;
				selectedCustomizeToolPoint = Point.Empty;
				toolbarsManager.ToolBeingCustomized = null;
			}
		}

			}
		}

		private void CustomizeDialog_MouseDown(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{

			{
				toolbarsManager.OnCustomizeDialogMouseDown(e);
			}
		}

		private void CustomizeDialog_MouseMove(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (toolbarsManager.CustomizeDialogHasCapture)
			{
				toolbarsManager.OnCustomizeDialogMouseMove(e);
			}
		}

		private void CustomizeDialog_MouseUp(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (toolbarsManager.CustomizeDialogHasCapture)
			{
				toolbarsManager.OnCustomizeDialogMouseUp(e);
			}
			if (listBoxThatStartedToolDrag != null)
			{
				if (listBoxThatStartedToolDrag == lstCommands)
				{
					lstCommands_SelectedIndexChanged(lstCommands, EventArgs.Empty);
				}
				else if (listBoxThatStartedToolDrag == lstTools)
				{
					lstTools_SelectedIndexChanged(lstTools, EventArgs.Empty);
				}
				listBoxThatStartedToolDrag = null;
			}
		}

		{
			SaveSettingsToRegistry();
			StoreListboxSelectionModes();
			ResetListboxSelectionModes(forceNone: true);
		}

		private void CustomizeDialog_KeyPress(object sender, KeyPressEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.KeyChar == '\r')
			{
				if (txtCaption.Focused)
				{
					UpdateSelectedToolCaption();
				}
				else if (txtKey.Focused)
				{
					UpdateSelectedToolKey();
				}
				else if (((Control)(object)coCategory).Focused)
				{
					UpdateSelectedToolCategory(clearActiveEditType: false);
				}
			}
			if (e.KeyChar == '\u001b' && toolbarsManager.ToolBeingDragged != null)
			{
				toolbarsManager.DragToolCancelled();
			}
		}

		}

		private void mnuCopyTool_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (SelectedTool == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ToolBase toolBase = SelectedTool.Clone(cloneNewInstance: false);
			if (toolBase == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeDlgCopyOf");
			string empty = string.Empty;
			empty = ((!toolBase.Key.StartsWith(text)) ? GetUniqueToolName(text + toolBase.Key) : GetUniqueToolName(toolBase.Key));
			if (empty != null && empty.Length > 0)
			{
				toolBase.Key = empty;
				if (!ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(toolBase.SharedProps.Caption) && !toolBase.SharedProps.Caption.StartsWith(text))
				{
					toolBase.SharedProps.Caption = text + toolBase.SharedProps.Caption;
				}
				toolbarsManager.Tools.Add(toolBase);
				ReloadToolsList(toolBase, selectFirstToolIfNotFound: true);
				toolCustomizer.OnNewToolAdded(toolBase);
			}
		}

		private void pnlBasicPropsInner_Resize(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			int num = ((Control)(object)opSmallImages).Width + ((Control)(object)opLargeImages).Width + 5;
			if (num > ((Control)(object)lblImage).Width)
			{
				((Control)(object)opSmallImages).Left = ((Control)(object)lblImage).Left;
			}
			else
			{
				((Control)(object)opSmallImages).Left = ((Control)(object)lblImage).Left + (((Control)(object)lblImage).Width - num) / 2;
			}
			((Control)(object)opLargeImages).Left = ((Control)(object)opSmallImages).Right + 5;
		}

		internal bool IsPointInCurrentOpenSubForm(Point point)
		{
			if (currentOpenSubForm != null)
			{
				return new Rectangle(currentOpenSubForm.Location, currentOpenSubForm.Size).Contains(point);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void OnNewCustomizeToolSelected(ToolBase tool, Point mousePoint)
		{
			if (activeEditType != ActiveEditType.None)
			{
				switch (activeEditType)
				{
				case ActiveEditType.Caption:
					UpdateSelectedToolCaption();
					break;
				case ActiveEditType.Category:
					UpdateSelectedToolCategory(clearActiveEditType: true);
					break;
				case ActiveEditType.Key:
					UpdateSelectedToolKey();
					break;
				case ActiveEditType.Shortcut:
					UpdateSelectedToolShortcut(clearActiveEditType: true);
					break;
				}
			}
			if (designMode)
			{
				if (tool == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				int num = FindToolInListBox(tool.SharedProps.RootTool, lstTools);
				if (num > -1)
				{
					lstTools.SelectedIndex = num;
					return;
				}
				CategoryWrapper categoryWrapper = ((coCategories.SelectedItem != null) ? (coCategories.SelectedItem.DataValue as CategoryWrapper) : null);
				if (categoryWrapper != null && categoryWrapper.Type == CategoryType.AllCommands)
				{
					return;
				}
				int num2 = DesignerUtilities.FindCategoryInListControl(CategoryType.AllCommands, string.Empty, (Control)(object)coCategories);
				if (num2 > -1)
				{
					coCategories.SelectedIndex = num2;
					num = FindToolInListBox(tool.SharedProps.RootTool, lstTools);
					if (num > -1)
					{
						lstTools.SelectedIndex = num;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				selectedCustomizeTool = tool;
				selectedCustomizeToolPoint = mousePoint;
				if (tool != null)
				{
					lstCommands.SelectedIndex = -1;
					((Control)(object)cmdModifySelection).Enabled = true;
					((Control)(object)cmdCommandDescription).Enabled = true;
				}
				else
				{
					((Control)(object)cmdModifySelection).Enabled = false;
					((Control)(object)cmdCommandDescription).Enabled = lstCommands.SelectedIndex > -1;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnToolbarClicked(UltraToolbar clickedToolbar)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < lstToolbars.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				if (lstToolbars.Items[i] is ToolbarListWrapper toolbarListWrapper && toolbarListWrapper.Toolbar == clickedToolbar)
				{
					lstToolbars.SelectedIndex = i;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnToolbarsManagerInitialized(UltraToolbarsManager manager)
		{
			ReloadToolsList(SelectedTool, selectFirstToolIfNotFound: true);
		}

		internal int ReSyncToolAndCategoryLists(ToolBase tool)
		{
			string category = tool.SharedProps.Category;
			if (coCategories.SelectedIndex < 0)
			{
				coCategories.SelectedIndex = 0;
			}
			int num = -1;
			int num2 = -1;
			if (category != null && category.Length > 0)
			{
				num = DesignerUtilities.FindCategoryInListControl(CategoryType.UserDefined, category, (Control)(object)coCategories);
				((Control)(object)coCategories).SuspendLayout();
				lstTools.SuspendLayout();
				pgTools.SuspendLayout();
				if (num < 0)
				{
					coCategories.Items.Clear();
					OnToolDeselected();
					DesignerUtilities.LoadCategoriesIntoControl(toolbarsManager, (Control)(object)coCategories, addUnassignedEntry: true, addAllCommandsEntry: true);
					num = DesignerUtilities.FindCategoryInListControl(CategoryType.UserDefined, category, (Control)(object)coCategories);
				}
				if (num > -1)
				{
					if (coCategories.SelectedIndex != num)
					{
						coCategories.SelectedIndex = num;
					}
					else
					{
						coCategories.SelectedIndex = -1;
						coCategories.SelectedIndex = num;
					}
					num2 = FindToolInListBox(tool, lstTools);
					if (num2 > -1)
					{
						lstTools.SelectedIndex = num2;
						OnToolSelected();
					}
				}
				pgTools.ResumeLayout();
				lstTools.ResumeLayout();
				((Control)(object)coCategories).ResumeLayout();
				return num2;
			}
			if (category == null || category.Length == 0)
			{
				num = DesignerUtilities.FindCategoryInListControl(CategoryType.UnassignedCommands, string.Empty, (Control)(object)coCategories);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				((Control)(object)coCategories).SuspendLayout();
				lstTools.SuspendLayout();
				if (coCategories.SelectedIndex != num)
				{
					coCategories.SelectedIndex = num;
				}
				else
				{
					coCategories.SelectedIndex = -1;
					coCategories.SelectedIndex = num;
				}
				num2 = FindToolInListBox(tool, lstTools);
				if (num2 > -1)
				{
					lstTools.SelectedIndex = num2;
				}
				lstTools.ResumeLayout();
				((Control)(object)coCategories).ResumeLayout();
				return num2;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private void ApplySettingsFromRegistry()
		{
			try
			{
				string name = Registry.CurrentUser.Name;
				RegistryPermission registryPermission = new RegistryPermission(RegistryPermissionAccess.AllAccess, name);
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					registryPermission.Assert();
				}
				RegistryKey registryKey = Registry.CurrentUser.CreateSubKey("Software\\Infragistics\\UltraWinToolbars\\CustomizeDialog");
				if (registryKey == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				base.Location = new Point(Convert.ToInt32(registryKey.GetValue("DialogX", base.Location.X)), Convert.ToInt32(registryKey.GetValue("DialogY", base.Location.Y)));
				if (designMode)
				{
					base.Size = new Size(Convert.ToInt32(registryKey.GetValue("DialogWidth", 440)), Convert.ToInt32(registryKey.GetValue("DialogHeight", 488)));
					spTools.SplitPosition = Convert.ToInt32(registryKey.GetValue("ToolsSplitterPosition", spTools.SplitPosition));
					spToolbars.SplitPosition = Convert.ToInt32(registryKey.GetValue("ToolbarsSplitterPosition", spToolbars.SplitPosition));
					if (Convert.ToBoolean(registryKey.GetValue("BasicProps", true)))
					{
						tabProps.SelectedTab = tabProps.Tabs[0];
					}
					else
					{
						tabProps.SelectedTab = tabProps.Tabs[1];
					}
					mnuSortTools.Checked = Convert.ToBoolean(registryKey.GetValue("SortTools", false));
					lstTools.Sorted = mnuSortTools.Checked;
				}
				else
				{
					mnuSortCommands.Checked = Convert.ToBoolean(registryKey.GetValue("SortCommands", false));
					lstCommands.Sorted = mnuSortCommands.Checked;
				}
				Rectangle workingArea = SystemInformation.WorkingArea;
				if (!workingArea.Contains(base.Bounds))
				{
					if (workingArea.Right < base.Right)
					{
						base.Left = workingArea.Right - base.Width;
					}
					if (base.Left < workingArea.Left)
					{
						base.Left = workingArea.Left;
					}
					if (workingArea.Bottom < base.Bottom)
					{
						base.Top = workingArea.Bottom - base.Height;
					}
					if (base.Top < workingArea.Top)
					{
						base.Top = workingArea.Top;
					}
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private void DeleteTool()
		{
			if (SelectedTool == null)
			{
				((Control)(object)cmdDeleteTool).Enabled = false;
				return;
			}
			string text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeConfirmToolDelete", SelectedTool.Key);
			DialogResult dialogResult = UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, text, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeConfirmToolDeleteTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.OKCancel, MessageBoxIcon.Question);
			if (dialogResult == DialogResult.OK)
			{
				if (SelectedTool is PopupToolBase)
				{
					((PopupToolBase)SelectedTool).ClosePopup();
				}
				toolbarsManager.Tools.Remove(SelectedTool);
				if (popupMenuDesigner != null)
				{
					popupMenuDesigner.OnToolDeleted(SelectedTool);
				}
				int selectedIndex = lstTools.SelectedIndex;
				lstTools.Items.RemoveAt(lstTools.SelectedIndex);
				if (selectedIndex + 1 <= lstTools.Items.Count)
				{
					lstTools.SelectedIndex = selectedIndex;
				}
				else if (lstTools.Items.Count > 0)
				{
					lstTools.SelectedIndex = lstTools.Items.Count - 1;
				}
			}
		}

		private static int FindToolInListBox(ToolBase tool, ListBox listBox)
		{
			if (tool == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < listBox.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				ToolWrapper toolWrapper = null;
				if (listBox.Items[i] is ToolWrapper toolWrapper2 && toolWrapper2.Tool.Key.Equals(tool.Key))
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private int FindToolbarInToolbarList(UltraToolbar toolbar)
		{
			if (toolbar == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < lstToolbars.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				ToolbarListWrapper toolbarListWrapper = null;
				if (lstToolbars.Items[i] is ToolbarListWrapper toolbarListWrapper2 && toolbarListWrapper2.Toolbar.Equals(toolbar))
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private string GetUniqueToolName(string baseName)
		{
			if (baseName != null && baseName.Length > 0 && !toolbarsManager.Tools.Exists(baseName))
			{
				return baseName;
			}
			string text = baseName;
			for (int i = 1; i < 5000; i++)
			{
				if (!toolbarsManager.Tools.Exists(text + i))
				{
					return text += i;
				}
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		private void InitDialogFields()
		{
			imageSelectionControl1.Initialize(toolbarsManager, null, isSmallImageList: true, null);
			imageSelectionControl2.Initialize(toolbarsManager, null, isSmallImageList: false, null);
			InitShortcutsList();
			InitToolbarList(null);
			InitCategoryAndToolsLists();
			InitCommandsTabFields();
			InitOptionsTabFields();
			mnuSortCommands.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeDialogContextMenuSortCommandsLiteral");
			mnuSortTools.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeDialogContextMenuSortToolsLiteral");
		}

		private void InitToolbarList(UltraToolbar toolbarToSelect)
		{
			try
			{
				loadingToolbarList = true;
				lstToolbars.BeginUpdate();
				lstToolbars.SelectedIndex = -1;
				lstToolbars.Items.Clear();
				foreach (UltraToolbar toolbar in toolbarsManager.Toolbars)
				{
					if ((designMode || toolbar.ShowInToolbarList) && (designMode || (!toolbar.IsHiddenByMdiMerge && (!toolbar.IsMdiMergeToolbar || toolbar.UnderlyingToolbar != null))))
					{
						ToolbarListWrapper item = new ToolbarListWrapper(toolbar);
						lstToolbars.Items.Add(item, toolbar.Visible ? CheckState.Checked : CheckState.Unchecked);
					}
				}
				if (lstToolbars.Items.Count > 0)
				{
					if (toolbarToSelect != null)
					{
						SelectToolbarInToolbarList(toolbarToSelect, selectFirstEntryIfNotFound: true);
					}
					else
					{
						lstToolbars.SelectedIndex = 0;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				loadingToolbarList = false;
				try
				{
					lstToolbars.EndUpdate();
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
		}

		private void InitCategoryAndToolsLists()
		{
			if (designMode)
			{
				coCategories.Items.Clear();
				lstTools.Items.Clear();
				DesignerUtilities.LoadCategoriesIntoControl(toolbarsManager, (Control)(object)coCategories, addUnassignedEntry: true, addAllCommandsEntry: true);
				coCategories.SelectedIndex = DesignerUtilities.FindCategoryInListControl(CategoryType.AllCommands, string.Empty, (Control)(object)coCategories);
			}
		}

		private void InitCommandsTabFields()
		{
			if (!designMode)
			{
				lstCategories.Items.Clear();
				lstCommands.Items.Clear();
				DesignerUtilities.LoadCategoriesIntoControl(toolbarsManager, lstCategories, addUnassignedEntry: true, addAllCommandsEntry: true);
				lstCategories.SelectedIndex = 0;
			}
		}

		private void InitOptionsTabFields()
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			bool flag = true;
			ResolutionOrderInfo resolutionOrder = StyleUtils.GetResolutionOrder(toolbarsManager);
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleBefore)
			{
				object property = ((UltraStylableComponent)toolbarsManager).ComponentRole.GetProperty("AlwaysShowMenusExpanded");
				if (property is DefaultableBoolean)
				{
					flag = (int)(DefaultableBoolean)property == 0;
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				((Control)(object)chAlwaysShowFullMenus).Visible = false;
				((Control)(object)chShowFullMenusAfterShortDelay).Visible = false;
			}
			else
			{
				chAlwaysShowFullMenus.Checked = toolbarsManager.AlwaysShowMenusExpandedResolved;
				if (toolbarsManager.ShowFullMenusDelay > 0)
				{
					chShowFullMenusAfterShortDelay.Checked = true;
				}
			}
			chLargeIconsOnMenus.Checked = toolbarsManager.UseLargeImagesOnMenu;
			chLargeIconsOnToolbars.Checked = toolbarsManager.UseLargeImagesOnToolbar;
			chFontNamesInFont.Checked = toolbarsManager.ShowFontNamesInFont;
			chShowToolTips.Checked = toolbarsManager.ShowToolTips;
			chShowShortcutKeys.Checked = toolbarsManager.ShowShortcutsInToolTips;
			if (toolbarsManager.FloatingToolbarFadeDelay > 9999999)
			{
				spinFloatingToolbarFadeDelay.MaskInput = "nnnnnnnnn";
			}
			spinFloatingToolbarFadeDelay.Value = toolbarsManager.FloatingToolbarFadeDelay;
			coMenuAnimations.Items.Add((object)Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeMenuAnimationNone"));
			coMenuAnimations.Items.Add((object)Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeMenuAnimationRandom"));
			coMenuAnimations.Items.Add((object)Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeMenuAnimationUnfold"));
			coMenuAnimations.Items.Add((object)Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeMenuAnimationSlide"));
			coMenuAnimations.Items.Add((object)Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeMenuAnimationFade"));
			coMenuAnimations.SelectedIndex = (int)toolbarsManager.MenuAnimationStyle;
		}

		private void InitShortcutsList()
		{
			Array values = Enum.GetValues(typeof(Shortcut));
			for (int i = 0; i < values.GetLength(0); i++)
			{
				coShortcut.Items.Add((object)new ShortcutWrapper((Shortcut)values.GetValue(i)));
			}
			coShortcut.SelectedIndex = 0;
		}

		}

		private void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo = propChange.FindPropId(PropertyIds.Category);
			if (propChangeInfo != null)
			{
				if (ignoreCategoryPropChange)
				{
					return;
				}
				ToolBase selectedTool = SelectedTool;
				if (selectedTool != null && string.Compare(selectedTool.SharedProps.Category, ((Control)(object)coCategories).Text, ignoreCase: true, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) != 0)
				{
					int selectedIndex = ReSyncToolAndCategoryLists(selectedTool);
					lstTools.SelectedIndex = selectedIndex;
					if (!isInCategorySelectionChanged)
					{
						ToolbarsManagerUtilities.FocusControl(lstTools);
					}
				}
			}
			propChangeInfo = propChange.FindPropId(PropertyIds.Text);
			if (propChangeInfo != null)
			{
				lstTools.Refresh();
			}
			propChangeInfo = propChange.FindPropId(PropertyIds.CustomizerCaption);
			if (propChangeInfo != null)
			{
				ReloadToolsList(SelectedTool, selectFirstToolIfNotFound: true);
			}
			propChangeInfo = propChange.FindPropId(PropertyIds.Caption);
			if (propChangeInfo != null)
			{
				ReloadToolsList(SelectedTool, selectFirstToolIfNotFound: true);
			}
			propChangeInfo = propChange.FindPropId(PropertyIds.Key);
			if (propChangeInfo != null)
			{
				ReloadToolsList(SelectedTool, selectFirstToolIfNotFound: true);
			}
			propChangeInfo = propChange.FindPropId(PropertyIds.Visible);
			if (propChangeInfo != null)
			{
				if (ignoreToolbarVisiblePropChange)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (propChangeInfo.Source is UltraToolbar ultraToolbar)
				{
					lstToolbars.SetItemChecked(lstToolbars.SelectedIndex, ultraToolbar.Visible);
				}
			}
			propChangeInfo = propChange.FindPropId(PropertyIds.IsMainMenuBar);
			if (propChangeInfo != null && propChangeInfo.Source is UltraToolbar { IsMainMenuBar: not false } ultraToolbar2)
			{
				lstToolbars.SetItemChecked(lstToolbars.SelectedIndex, ultraToolbar2.Visible);
			}
			propChangeInfo = propChange.FindPropId(PropertyIds.Text);
			if (propChangeInfo != null && propChangeInfo.Source is UltraToolbar)
			{
				lstToolbars.Refresh();
			}
			propChangeInfo = propChange.FindPropId(PropertyIds.DropDownArrowStyle);
			if (propChangeInfo != null)
			{
				lstTools.Refresh();
			}
			propChangeInfo = propChange.FindPropId((Enum)(object)(AppearancePropIds)9);
			if (propChangeInfo != null)
			{
				lstTools.Refresh();
			}
		}

		private void OnToolContextMenuClick(object sender, ToolClickEventArgs e)
		{
			if (popupMenuDesigner != null && tabMain.SelectedTab != null && tabMain.SelectedTab.Key == "PopupMenuDesigner")
			{
				popupMenuDesigner.RefreshLists();
			}
			if (this.OnToolContextMenuClicked != null)
			{
				this.OnToolContextMenuClicked(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		private void OnToolContextMenuCloseup(object sender, ToolDropdownEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Tool.OwnerIsToolbarsManager)
			{
				base.AcceptButton = cmdClose;
				base.CancelButton = cmdClose;
				if (popupMenuDesigner != null && tabMain.SelectedTab != null && tabMain.SelectedTab.Key == "PopupMenuDesigner")
				{
					popupMenuDesigner.RefreshLists();
				}
			}
			if (this.OnToolContextMenuClosed != null)
			{
				this.OnToolContextMenuClosed(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		private void OnToolDeselected()
		{
			if (pgTools.SelectedObject != null)
			{
				((ToolBase)pgTools.SelectedObject).SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				pgTools.SelectedObject = null;
				pgUniqueToolProps.SelectedObject = null;
			}
			((Control)(object)lblSelectedToolType).Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeDlgSelectedToolTypeLiteral", Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeDlgSelectedToolTypeLiteralNone"));
			((Control)(object)tabProps).Enabled = false;
		}

		private void OnToolListResized(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((Control)sender).Refresh();
		}

		private void OnToolSelected()
		{
			try
			{
				((Control)(object)tabProps).SuspendLayout();
				OnToolDeselected();
				Point autoScrollPosition = pnlBasicProps.AutoScrollPosition;
				if (SelectedTool == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				((Control)(object)tabProps).Enabled = true;
				pgTools.Enabled = true;
				pgUniqueToolProps.Enabled = true;
				SelectedTool.SubObjectPropChanged += SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				pgTools.SelectedObject = SelectedTool;
				txtCaption.Text = SelectedTool.SharedProps.Caption;
				txtKey.Text = SelectedTool.Key;
				chEnabled.Checked = SelectedTool.SharedProps.Enabled;
				chVisible.Checked = SelectedTool.SharedProps.Visible;
				((Control)(object)lblSelectedToolType).Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeDlgSelectedToolTypeLiteral", SelectedTool.GetType().Name);
				coCategory.Items.Clear();
				DesignerUtilities.LoadCategoriesIntoControl(toolbarsManager, (Control)(object)coCategory, addUnassignedEntry: true, addAllCommandsEntry: false);
				int num = -1;
				if (SelectedTool.CategoryResolved == null || SelectedTool.CategoryResolved.Length == 0)
				{
					num = DesignerUtilities.FindCategoryInListControl(CategoryType.UnassignedCommands, string.Empty, (Control)(object)coCategory);
					ignoreCategoryComboIndexChanged = true;
					coCategory.SelectedIndex = num;
					ignoreCategoryComboIndexChanged = false;
				}
				else
				{
					num = DesignerUtilities.FindCategoryInListControl(CategoryType.UserDefined, SelectedTool.CategoryResolved, (Control)(object)coCategory);
					ignoreCategoryComboIndexChanged = true;
					coCategory.SelectedIndex = num;
					ignoreCategoryComboIndexChanged = false;
				}
				SelectEntryInShortcutsList(SelectedTool.SharedProps.Shortcut);
				imageSelectionControl1.Initialize(toolbarsManager, toolbarsManager.ImageListSmallResolved, isSmallImageList: true, SelectedTool.SharedProps.AppearancesSmall.Appearance.Image);
				imageSelectionControl2.Initialize(toolbarsManager, toolbarsManager.ImageListLargeResolved, isSmallImageList: false, SelectedTool.SharedProps.AppearancesLarge.Appearance.Image);
				if (SelectedToolHasUniqueProps)
				{
					CustomizeToolSurrogate selectedObject = new CustomizeToolSurrogate(SelectedTool);
					pgUniqueToolProps.SelectedObject = selectedObject;
					((Control)(object)lblUniqueToolProps).Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeToolPropertiesLiteral");
					((Control)(object)lblUniqueToolProps).Visible = true;
					pgUniqueToolProps.Visible = true;
					if (pnlBasicProps.AutoScrollMinSize.Height < ((Control)(object)lblUniqueToolProps).Bottom + 160)
					{
						pnlBasicProps.AutoScrollMinSize = new Size(pnlBasicProps.AutoScrollMinSize.Width, ((Control)(object)lblUniqueToolProps).Bottom + 160);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					((Control)(object)lblUniqueToolProps).Visible = false;
					pgUniqueToolProps.Visible = false;
				}
				if (pnlBasicProps.AutoScrollPosition.X != autoScrollPosition.X || pnlBasicProps.AutoScrollPosition.Y != autoScrollPosition.Y)
				{
					pnlBasicProps.AutoScrollPosition = new Point(autoScrollPosition.X, autoScrollPosition.Y);
				}
				if (SelectedTool.InheritedResolved)
				{
					pnlBasicPropsInner.Enabled = false;
					((Control)(object)lblInheritedToolWarning).Visible = true;
				}
				else
				{
					pnlBasicPropsInner.Enabled = true;
					((Control)(object)lblInheritedToolWarning).Visible = false;
					pgUniqueToolProps.Refresh();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((Control)(object)tabProps).ResumeLayout();
			}
		}

		private void ProcessImageSizeChange()
		{
			if (opSmallImages.Checked)
			{
				pnlSmallImages.Visible = true;
				pnlLargeImages.Visible = false;
			}
			else
			{
				pnlSmallImages.Visible = false;
				pnlLargeImages.Visible = true;
			}
		}

		private void ReinitializeDialog()
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			ToolbarStyle styleResolved = toolbarsManager.StyleResolved;
			switch (styleResolved - 1)
			{
			case 0:
				spinFloatingToolbarFadeDelay.DisplayStyle = (EmbeddableElementDisplayStyle)1;
				break;
			case 1:
				spinFloatingToolbarFadeDelay.DisplayStyle = (EmbeddableElementDisplayStyle)3;
				break;
			case 3:
				spinFloatingToolbarFadeDelay.DisplayStyle = (EmbeddableElementDisplayStyle)2;
				break;
			case 2:
				spinFloatingToolbarFadeDelay.DisplayStyle = (EmbeddableElementDisplayStyle)4;
				break;
			case 4:
				spinFloatingToolbarFadeDelay.DisplayStyle = (EmbeddableElementDisplayStyle)6;
				break;
			case 5:
				spinFloatingToolbarFadeDelay.DisplayStyle = (EmbeddableElementDisplayStyle)7;
				break;
			}
			InitDialogFields();
		}

		private void ReloadToolsList(ToolBase toolToSelectAfterLoad, bool selectFirstToolIfNotFound)
		{
			if (coCategories.SelectedIndex < 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				lstTools.BeginUpdate();
				lstTools.Items.Clear();
				OnToolDeselected();
				if (!(coCategories.Items[coCategories.SelectedIndex].DataValue is CategoryWrapper selectedCategory))
				{
					return;
				}
				DesignerUtilities.LoadToolsList(toolbarsManager, lstTools, selectedCategory, designMode);
			}
			finally
			{
				try
				{
					lstTools.EndUpdate();
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			SelectToolInToolsList(toolToSelectAfterLoad, selectFirstToolIfNotFound);
		}

		private void RemoveToolFromList(int index)
		{
			lstTools.Items.RemoveAt(index);
		}

		private void ResetListboxSelectionModes(bool forceNone)
		{
			if (forceNone)
			{
				lstCategories.SelectionMode = SelectionMode.None;
				lstCommands.SelectionMode = SelectionMode.None;
				lstTools.SelectionMode = SelectionMode.None;
				lstToolbars.SelectionMode = SelectionMode.None;
			}
			else
			{
				lstCategories.SelectionMode = lastSelectModeCategories;
				lstCommands.SelectionMode = lastSelectModeCommands;
				lstTools.SelectionMode = lastSelectModeTools;
				lstToolbars.SelectionMode = lastSelectModeToolbars;
			}
		}

		private void SaveSettingsToRegistry()
		{
			try
			{
				string name = Registry.CurrentUser.Name;
				RegistryPermission registryPermission = new RegistryPermission(RegistryPermissionAccess.AllAccess, name);
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					registryPermission.Assert();
				}
				RegistryKey registryKey = Registry.CurrentUser.OpenSubKey("Software\\Infragistics\\UltraWinToolbars\\CustomizeDialog", writable: true);
				if (registryKey != null)
				{
					registryKey.SetValue("DialogX", base.Location.X);
					registryKey.SetValue("DialogY", base.Location.Y);
					if (designMode)
					{
						registryKey.SetValue("DialogWidth", base.Size.Width);
						registryKey.SetValue("DialogHeight", base.Size.Height);
						registryKey.SetValue("ToolsSplitterPosition", spTools.SplitPosition);
						registryKey.SetValue("ToolbarsSplitterPosition", spToolbars.SplitPosition);
						registryKey.SetValue("BasicProps", tabProps.SelectedTab.Index == 0);
						registryKey.SetValue("SortTools", mnuSortTools.Checked);
					}
					else
					{
						registryKey.SetValue("SortCommands", mnuSortCommands.Checked);
					}
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private void SelectEntryInShortcutsList(Shortcut shortcut)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < ((DisposableObjectCollectionBase)(object)coShortcut.Items).Count; i++)
			{
				if (coShortcut.Items[i].DataValue is ShortcutWrapper shortcutWrapper && shortcutWrapper.Shortcut == shortcut)
				{
					coShortcut.SelectedIndex = i;
					return;
				}
			}
			coShortcut.SelectedIndex = 0;
		}

		private void SelectToolInToolsList(ToolBase tool, bool selectFirstEntryIfNotFound)
		{
			int num = FindToolInListBox(tool, lstTools);
			if (num > -1 && num < lstTools.Items.Count)
			{
				lstTools.SelectedIndex = num;
			}
			else if (selectFirstEntryIfNotFound && lstTools.Items.Count > 0)
			{
				lstTools.SelectedIndex = 0;
			}
		}

		private void SelectToolbarInToolbarList(UltraToolbar toolbarToSelect, bool selectFirstEntryIfNotFound)
		{
			int num = FindToolbarInToolbarList(toolbarToSelect);
			if (num > -1 && num < lstToolbars.Items.Count)
			{
				lstToolbars.SelectedIndex = num;
			}
			else if (selectFirstEntryIfNotFound && lstToolbars.Items.Count > 0)
			{
				lstToolbars.SelectedIndex = 0;
			}
		}

		private void StoreListboxSelectionModes()
		{
			lastSelectModeCategories = lstCategories.SelectionMode;
			lastSelectModeCommands = lstCommands.SelectionMode;
			lastSelectModeTools = lstTools.SelectionMode;
			lastSelectModeToolbars = lstToolbars.SelectionMode;
		}

		private void UpdateSelectedToolCaption()
		{
			if (activeEditType == ActiveEditType.Caption)
			{
				if (SelectedTool != null)
				{
					SelectedTool.SharedProps.Caption = txtCaption.Text;
				}
				activeEditType = ActiveEditType.None;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSelectedToolCategory(bool clearActiveEditType)
		{
			if (activeEditType != ActiveEditType.Category)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (SelectedTool != null)
			{
				if (((Control)(object)coCategory).Text != Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeCategoryUnassigned"))
				{
					SelectedTool.SharedProps.Category = ((Control)(object)coCategory).Text;
				}
				else
				{
					SelectedTool.SharedProps.Category = "";
				}
			}
			if (clearActiveEditType)
			{
				activeEditType = ActiveEditType.None;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSelectedToolKey()
		{
			if (activeEditType != ActiveEditType.Key)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (SelectedTool != null)
			{
				try
				{
					SelectedTool.Key = txtKey.Text;
				}
				catch
				{
					string text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeToolKeyExistsError", txtKey.Text);
					UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, text, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeToolKeyExistsErrorTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation);
				}
			}
			activeEditType = ActiveEditType.None;
		}

		private void UpdateSelectedToolShortcut(bool clearActiveEditType)
		{
			if (activeEditType == ActiveEditType.Shortcut)
			{
				if (SelectedTool != null && coShortcut.SelectedIndex > -1 && coShortcut.Items[coShortcut.SelectedIndex].DataValue is ShortcutWrapper shortcutWrapper)
				{
					SelectedTool.SharedProps.Shortcut = shortcutWrapper.Shortcut;
				}
				if (clearActiveEditType)
				{
					activeEditType = ActiveEditType.None;
				}
			}
		}

		{
			CustomizeDialogRearrangeCommands customizeDialogRearrangeCommands = new CustomizeDialogRearrangeCommands(toolbarsManager, this);
			ShowDialog((Form)(object)customizeDialogRearrangeCommands);
			((Component)(object)customizeDialogRearrangeCommands).Dispose();
		}

		{
			if (designMode && tabMain.Tabs.IndexOf("PopupMenuDesigner") < 0)

				popupMenuDesigner = new PopupMenuDesignerControl(ToolCustomizer, toolbarsManager);
				popupMenuDesigner.Dock = DockStyle.Fill;
				tabMain.Tabs.Add("PopupMenuDesigner", Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeDialog_PopupMenuDesigner"));
				((Control)(object)tabMain.Tabs["PopupMenuDesigner"].TabPage).Controls.Add(popupMenuDesigner);
			}
		}

		private DialogResult ShowDialog(Form dialog)
		{
			AppStyledDialogBase val = (AppStyledDialogBase)(object)((dialog is AppStyledDialogBase) ? dialog : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				val.SetApplicationStylingProperties(StyleLibraryName, StyleSetName, UseAppStyling);
			}
			Form form = currentOpenSubForm;
			try
			{
				currentOpenSubForm = dialog;
				ToolCustomizer.ClearToolBeingCustomized();
				return dialog.ShowDialog(this);
			}
			finally
			{
				currentOpenSubForm = form;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class CustomizeDialogEx : CustomizeDialog
	{
		protected override bool IsFullTrust => true;

		internal CustomizeDialogEx(UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager, bool designMode)
			: base(toolbarsManager, designMode)
		{
		}

		protected override void WndProc(ref Message message)
		{
			if (message.Msg == 36)
			{
				base.WndProc(ref message);
				NativeWindowMethods.MINMAXINFO mINMAXINFO = (NativeWindowMethods.MINMAXINFO)Marshal.PtrToStructure(message.LParam, typeof(NativeWindowMethods.MINMAXINFO));
				Size size = new Size(384, 374);
				if (((Control)(object)lblForSizingMinWidthWhenUsingLargeFonts).Left > MinimumSize.Width)
				{
					size.Width = ((Control)(object)lblForSizingMinWidthWhenUsingLargeFonts).Left;
				}
				if (((Control)(object)lblForSizingMinHeightWhenUsingLargeFonts).Top > MinimumSize.Height)
				{
					size.Height = ((Control)(object)lblForSizingMinHeightWhenUsingLargeFonts).Top;
				}
				mINMAXINFO.ptMinTrackSize = new NativeWindowMethods.POINT(size.Width, size.Height);
				Marshal.StructureToPtr((object)mINMAXINFO, message.LParam, fDeleteOld: true);
				message.Result = IntPtr.Zero;
			}
			else
			{
				base.WndProc(ref message);
			}
		}
	}

		{
			get
			{
				if (lstCommands.SelectedIndex < 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (!(lstCommands.Items[lstCommands.SelectedIndex] is ToolWrapper toolWrapper))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return toolWrapper.Tool;
			}
		}

		private void CustomizeDialogAddCommand_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			InitDialogFields();
		}

		private void lstCategories_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (lstCategories.SelectedIndex < 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			lstCommands.Items.Clear();
			if (lstCategories.Items[lstCategories.SelectedIndex] is CategoryWrapper selectedCategory)
			{
				DesignerUtilities.LoadToolsList(toolbarsManager, lstCommands, selectedCategory, isDesignMode: false);
				if (lstCommands.Items.Count > 0)
				{
					lstCommands.SelectedIndex = 0;
				}
			}
		}

		private void lstCommands_MeasureItem(object sender, MeasureItemEventArgs e)
		{
			DesignerUtilities.ProcessMeasureItem(toolbarsManager, (Form)(object)this, sender, e);
		}

		private void lstCommands_DrawItem(object sender, DrawItemEventArgs e)
		{
			DesignerUtilities.ProcessDrawItem(toolbarsManager, (Form)(object)this, sender, e);
		}

		private void cmdOK_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((Form)this).Close();
		}

		private void cmdCancel_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((Form)this).Close();
		}

		private void InitDialogFields()
		{
			InitCategoriesAndCommandsLists();
		}

		private void InitCategoriesAndCommandsLists()
		{
			lstCategories.Items.Clear();
			lstCommands.Items.Clear();
			DesignerUtilities.LoadCategoriesIntoControl(toolbarsManager, lstCategories, addUnassignedEntry: false, addAllCommandsEntry: true);
			lstCategories.SelectedIndex = 0;
		}

		private void InitializeDialogStrings()
		{
			((Control)(object)this).Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeDlgAddCommand_Title");
			((Control)(object)lblChoose).Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeDlgAddCommand_Choose");
			((Control)(object)lblCategories).Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeDlgAddCommand_Categories");
			((Control)(object)lblCommands).Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeDlgAddCommand_Commands");
			((Control)(object)cmdOK).Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeDlgAddCommand_OK");
			((Control)(object)cmdCancel).Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeDlgAddCommand_Cancel");
			((Control)this).AccessibleName = ((Control)(object)this).Text;
			((Control)this).AccessibleDescription = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeDlgAddCommand_Title_AccessibleDescription");

		private void ApplySettingsFromRegistry()
		{
			try
			{
				string name = Registry.CurrentUser.Name;
				RegistryPermission registryPermission = new RegistryPermission(RegistryPermissionAccess.AllAccess, name);
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					registryPermission.Assert();
				}
				RegistryKey registryKey = Registry.CurrentUser.CreateSubKey("Software\\Infragistics\\UltraWinToolbars\\CustomizeDialog");
				if (registryKey != null)
				{
					base.Location = new Point(Convert.ToInt32(registryKey.GetValue("GenerateCodeDialogX", base.Location.X)), Convert.ToInt32(registryKey.GetValue("GenerateCodeDialogY", base.Location.Y)));
					base.Size = new Size(Convert.ToInt32(registryKey.GetValue("GenerateCodeDialogWidth", MinimumSize.Width)), Convert.ToInt32(registryKey.GetValue("GenerateCodeDialogHeight", MinimumSize.Height)));
					spMain.SplitPosition = Convert.ToInt32(registryKey.GetValue("GenerateCodeSplitterPosition", spMain.SplitPosition));
					string text = Convert.ToString(registryKey.GetValue("Language", "C#"));
					if (text == "VB")
					{
						opVB.Checked = true;
					}
					else
					{
						opCSharp.Checked = true;
					}
					chGenerateComments.Checked = Convert.ToBoolean(registryKey.GetValue("GenerateCodeComments", true));
					mnuSortTools.Checked = Convert.ToBoolean(registryKey.GetValue("SortTools", false));
					mnuShowToolKeys.Checked = Convert.ToBoolean(registryKey.GetValue("GenerateCodeShowKeys", false));
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private void InitCategoriesAndCommandsLists()
		{
			coCategories.Items.Clear();
			lstTools.Items.Clear();
			DesignerUtilities.LoadCategoriesIntoControl(toolbarsManager, coCategories, addUnassignedEntry: false, addAllCommandsEntry: true);
			int num = DesignerUtilities.FindCategoryInListControl(CategoryType.AllCommands, string.Empty, coCategories);
			if (num > -1)
			{
				coCategories.SelectedIndex = num;
			}
			else
			{
				coCategories.SelectedIndex = 0;
			}
		}

		private void GenerateCodeForSelectedTools()
		{
			if (suppressCodeGeneration)
			{
				return;
			}
			rtfGeneratedCode.Text = "";
			if (lstTools.SelectedItems.Count < 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			picCoverup.Parent = rtfGeneratedCode.Parent;
			picCoverup.Location = rtfGeneratedCode.Location;
			picCoverup.Size = rtfGeneratedCode.Size;
			picCoverup.BringToFront();
			picCoverup.Visible = true;
			Cursor.Current = Cursors.WaitCursor;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (opVB.Checked)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("Select Case e.Tool.Key\r\n");
			}
			else
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("switch (e.Tool.Key)\r\n");
				stringBuilder.Append("{\r\n");
			}
			foreach (ToolWrapper selectedItem in lstTools.SelectedItems)
			{
				if (selectedItem == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (opVB.Checked)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append("    Case \"");
					stringBuilder.Append(selectedItem.Tool.Key);
					stringBuilder.Append("\"");
					if (chGenerateComments.Checked)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append("    ' ");
						stringBuilder.Append(selectedItem.Tool.GetType().Name);
					}
					stringBuilder.Append("\r\n");
					if (chGenerateComments.Checked)
					{
						stringBuilder.AppendFormat("        {0}\r\n", Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeDlgGenerateCode_PlaceCodeHereComment_VB"));
					}
					stringBuilder.Append("\r\n");
					continue;
				}
				stringBuilder.Append("    case \"");
				stringBuilder.Append(selectedItem.Tool.Key);
				stringBuilder.Append("\":");
				if (chGenerateComments.Checked)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append("    // ");
					stringBuilder.Append(selectedItem.Tool.GetType().Name);
				}
				stringBuilder.Append("\r\n");
				if (chGenerateComments.Checked)
				{
					stringBuilder.AppendFormat("        {0}\r\n", Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeDlgGenerateCode_PlaceCodeHereComment_CSharp"));
				}
				stringBuilder.Append("        break;\r\n");
				stringBuilder.Append("\r\n");
			}
			if (opVB.Checked)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("End Select\r\n");
			}
			else
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("}\r\n");
			}
			rtfGeneratedCode.Text = stringBuilder.ToString();
			if (opVB.Checked)
			{
				SetTextColor("Select Case", Color.Blue);
				SetTextColor("Case", Color.Blue);
				SetTextColor("End Select", Color.Blue);
				SetCommentColor("'");
			}
			else
			{
				SetTextColor("switch", Color.Blue);
				SetTextColor("case", Color.Blue);
				SetTextColor("break", Color.Blue);
				SetCommentColor("//");
			}
			rtfGeneratedCode.SelectionLength = 0;
			picCoverup.Visible = false;
			Cursor.Current = Cursors.Arrow;
			Application.DoEvents();
			rtfGeneratedCode.Refresh();
		}

		private void SaveSettingsToRegistry()
		{
			try
			{
				string name = Registry.CurrentUser.Name;
				RegistryPermission registryPermission = new RegistryPermission(RegistryPermissionAccess.AllAccess, name);
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					registryPermission.Assert();
				}
				RegistryKey registryKey = Registry.CurrentUser.OpenSubKey("Software\\Infragistics\\UltraWinToolbars\\CustomizeDialog", writable: true);
				if (registryKey != null)
				{
					registryKey.SetValue("GenerateCodeDialogX", base.Location.X);
					registryKey.SetValue("GenerateCodeDialogY", base.Location.Y);
					registryKey.SetValue("GenerateCodeDialogWidth", base.Size.Width);
					registryKey.SetValue("GenerateCodeDialogHeight", base.Size.Height);
					registryKey.SetValue("GenerateCodeSplitterPosition", spMain.SplitPosition);
					registryKey.SetValue("Language", opCSharp.Checked ? "C#" : "VB");
					registryKey.SetValue("GenerateCodeComments", chGenerateComments.Checked);
					registryKey.SetValue("SortTools", mnuSortTools.Checked);
					registryKey.SetValue("GenerateCodeShowKeys", mnuShowToolKeys.Checked);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private void SetCommentColor(string commentCharacter)
		{
			int start = 0;
			int num = -1;
			while (true)
			{
				num = rtfGeneratedCode.Find(commentCharacter, start, RichTextBoxFinds.WholeWord | RichTextBoxFinds.MatchCase | RichTextBoxFinds.NoHighlight);
				if (num > -1)
				{
					int lineFromCharIndex = rtfGeneratedCode.GetLineFromCharIndex(num);
					int i;
					for (i = num; i < rtfGeneratedCode.Text.Length && rtfGeneratedCode.GetLineFromCharIndex(i) == lineFromCharIndex; i++)
					{
					}
					i--;
					if (i > num)
					{
						rtfGeneratedCode.SelectionStart = num;
						rtfGeneratedCode.SelectionLength = i - num;
						rtfGeneratedCode.SelectionColor = Color.Green;
						start = i + "\r\n".Length;
					}
					else
					{
						start = num + commentCharacter.Length;
					}
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private void SetTextColor(string text, Color color)
		{
			int start = 0;
			int num = -1;
			while (true)
			{
				num = rtfGeneratedCode.Find(text, start, RichTextBoxFinds.WholeWord | RichTextBoxFinds.MatchCase | RichTextBoxFinds.NoHighlight);
				if (num > -1)
				{
					rtfGeneratedCode.SelectionStart = num;
					rtfGeneratedCode.SelectionLength = text.Length;
					rtfGeneratedCode.SelectionColor = color;
					start = num + text.Length;
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private void CustomizeDialogGenerateCode_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeDialogGenerateToolClickCodeTitle");
			ApplySettingsFromRegistry();
			InitCategoriesAndCommandsLists();
		}

		private void coCategories_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (coCategories.SelectedIndex < 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			lstTools.Items.Clear();
			if (!(coCategories.Items[coCategories.SelectedIndex] is CategoryWrapper categoryWrapper))
			{
				return;
			}
			ToolWrapper toolWrapper = null;
			foreach (ToolBase tool in toolbarsManager.Tools)
			{
				if ((categoryWrapper.Type == CategoryType.AllCommands || (categoryWrapper.Type == CategoryType.UnassignedCommands && ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(tool.SharedProps.Category)) || (categoryWrapper.Type == CategoryType.UserDefined && string.Compare(tool.SharedProps.Category, categoryWrapper.ToString(), ignoreCase: true, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) == 0)) && !tool.IsHiddenByMdiMerge && (!tool.IsMdiMergeTool || tool.UnderlyingTool != null) && !(tool is ControlContainerTool))
				{
					toolWrapper = new ToolWrapper(tool);
					toolWrapper.IncludeKeyInToString = mnuShowToolKeys.Checked;
					lstTools.Items.Add(toolWrapper);
				}
			}
			if (lstTools.Items.Count > 0)
			{
				lstTools.SelectedIndex = 0;
			}
		}

		private void mnuSortTools_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			mnuSortTools.Checked = !mnuSortTools.Checked;
			lstTools.Sorted = mnuSortTools.Checked;
			if (!mnuSortTools.Checked)
			{
				coCategories_SelectedIndexChanged(coCategories, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		private void mnuShowToolKeys_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			mnuShowToolKeys.Checked = !mnuShowToolKeys.Checked;
			coCategories_SelectedIndexChanged(coCategories, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		private void cmdSelectAllTools_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			suppressCodeGeneration = true;
			lstTools.SuspendLayout();
			for (int i = 0; i < lstTools.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				lstTools.SetSelected(i, value: true);
			}
			lstTools.ResumeLayout();
			suppressCodeGeneration = false;
			GenerateCodeForSelectedTools();
		}

		private void cmdClearAllTools_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			suppressCodeGeneration = true;
			for (int i = 0; i < lstTools.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				lstTools.SetSelected(i, value: false);
			}
			suppressCodeGeneration = false;
			GenerateCodeForSelectedTools();
		}

		private void lstTools_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			GenerateCodeForSelectedTools();
		}

		private void opCSharp_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			GenerateCodeForSelectedTools();
		}

		private void opVB_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			GenerateCodeForSelectedTools();
		}

		private void cmdSelectAllCode_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			rtfGeneratedCode.SelectionStart = 0;
			rtfGeneratedCode.SelectionLength = rtfGeneratedCode.Text.Length;
		}

		private void cmdCopyToClipboard_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Clipboard.SetDataObject(rtfGeneratedCode.SelectedText, copy: false);
		}

		private void lstTools_MeasureItem(object sender, MeasureItemEventArgs e)
		{
			DesignerUtilities.ProcessMeasureItem(toolbarsManager, this, sender, e);
		}

		private void lstTools_DrawItem(object sender, DrawItemEventArgs e)
		{
			DesignerUtilities.ProcessDrawItem(toolbarsManager, this, sender, e);
		}

		private void rtfGeneratedCode_SelectionChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			cmdCopyToClipboard.Enabled = rtfGeneratedCode.SelectionLength > 0;
		}

		private void rtfGeneratedCode_TextChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			cmdSelectAllCode.Enabled = !ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(rtfGeneratedCode.Text);
		}

		private void CustomizeDialogGenerateCode_Closed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			SaveSettingsToRegistry();
		}

		private void chGenerateComments_CheckedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			GenerateCodeForSelectedTools();
		}
	}

			components.Add(fontDlg);
			saveFileDlg.Filter = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ImageEditor_SaveFileFilter");
			saveFileDlg.Title = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ImageEditor_SaveFileTitle");
			saveFileDlg.OverwritePrompt = true;
			saveFileDlg.AddExtension = true;
			saveFileDlg.DefaultExt = ".bmp";
			openFileDlg.Filter = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ImageEditor_LoadFileFilter");
			openFileDlg.Title = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ImageEditor_LoadFileTitle");
			openFileDlg.AddExtension = false;
			openFileDlg.CheckFileExists = true;
			openFileDlg.RestoreDirectory = false;
		}

				imgEditor.ResetModified();
				imgEditor.ClearUndoStack();
			}
			this.isEmbedded = isEmbedded;
		}

		private void Form1_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			bool flag = LoadPreviousState();
			((Control)(object)colorIndicator).Location = new Point(-10000, -10000);
			((Control)(object)colorPalette).Location = new Point(-10000, -10000);
			picPreview.Location = new Point(-10000, -10000);
			GetImageEditorFont(imgEditor.DrawingFont);
			SynchronizeColors(imgEditor.DrawingBackColor, (ImageEditColorType)0);
			SynchronizeColors(imgEditor.DrawingForeColor, (ImageEditColorType)1);
			OptionSet optionSet = tbmImageEditor.OptionSets["GradientStyles"];
			InitializeMenuImageFromKey(tbmImageEditor.Tools["GradientStyle"] as PopupMenuTool, (optionSet.SelectedTool == null) ? tbmImageEditor.Tools["GradientHorizontal"] : optionSet.SelectedTool);
			if (!flag)
			{
				InitializeMenuImageFromKey(tbmImageEditor.Tools["Move Image"] as PopupMenuTool, tbmImageEditor.Tools["Move Up"]);
				InitializeMenuImageFromKey(tbmImageEditor.Tools["Rectangle Types"] as PopupMenuTool, tbmImageEditor.Tools["DrawRectangleOutlineTool"]);
				InitializeMenuImageFromKey(tbmImageEditor.Tools["Ellipse Types"] as PopupMenuTool, tbmImageEditor.Tools["DrawEllipseOutlineTool"]);
			}
			ProcessBrushSizeToolClick(tbmImageEditor.OptionSets["BrushSizes"].SelectedTool);
			ProcessEraserSizeToolClick(tbmImageEditor.OptionSets["EraserSize"].SelectedTool);

		private static bool DoesFontFamilyExist(string fontFamily)
		{
			FontFamily[] families = FontFamily.Families;
			foreach (FontFamily fontFamily2 in families)
			{
				if (object.Equals(fontFamily2.Name, fontFamily))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SetImageEditorFont()
		{
			string text = (string)((FontListTool)tbmImageEditor.Tools["FontName"]).Value;
			if (!DoesFontFamilyExist(text))
			{
				return;
			}
			FontFamily fontFamily;
			try
			{
				fontFamily = new FontFamily(text);
			}
			catch
			{
				return;
			}
			FontStyle fontStyle = FontStyle.Regular;
			fontStyle = (FontStyle)((int)fontStyle | (((StateButtonTool)tbmImageEditor.Tools["Bold"]).Checked ? 1 : 0));
			fontStyle = (FontStyle)((int)fontStyle | (((StateButtonTool)tbmImageEditor.Tools["Italic"]).Checked ? 2 : 0));
			fontStyle = (FontStyle)((int)fontStyle | (((StateButtonTool)tbmImageEditor.Tools["Underlined"]).Checked ? 4 : 0));
			FontStyle fontStyle2 = fontStyle;
			if (!fontFamily.IsStyleAvailable(fontStyle))
			{
				FontStyle fontStyle3 = fontStyle & (FontStyle.Bold | FontStyle.Italic);
				FontStyle fontStyle4 = fontStyle & ~fontStyle3;
				if ((fontStyle3 & FontStyle.Italic) != FontStyle.Regular)
				{
					fontStyle3 ^= FontStyle.Italic;
				}
				if (!fontFamily.IsStyleAvailable(fontStyle3))
				{
					if ((fontStyle & FontStyle.Italic) != FontStyle.Regular)
					{
						fontStyle3 |= FontStyle.Italic;
					}
					if ((fontStyle3 & FontStyle.Bold) != FontStyle.Regular)
					{
						fontStyle3 ^= FontStyle.Bold;
					}
					if (!fontFamily.IsStyleAvailable(fontStyle3))
					{
						if ((fontStyle & (FontStyle.Bold | FontStyle.Italic)) != FontStyle.Regular)
						{
							fontStyle3 = FontStyle.Italic;
						}
						if (!fontFamily.IsStyleAvailable(fontStyle3))
						{
							fontStyle3 = FontStyle.Regular;
							if (fontFamily.IsStyleAvailable(FontStyle.Bold))
							{
								fontStyle3 = FontStyle.Bold;
							}
							else if (fontFamily.IsStyleAvailable(FontStyle.Italic))
							{
								fontStyle3 = FontStyle.Italic;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				fontStyle = fontStyle3 | fontStyle4;
			}
			fontFamily.Dispose();
			if (fontStyle != fontStyle2)
			{
				((StateButtonTool)tbmImageEditor.Tools["Bold"]).Checked = (fontStyle & FontStyle.Bold) != 0;
				((StateButtonTool)tbmImageEditor.Tools["Italic"]).Checked = (fontStyle & FontStyle.Italic) != 0;
				((StateButtonTool)tbmImageEditor.Tools["Underlined"]).Checked = (fontStyle & FontStyle.Underline) != 0;
			}
			imgEditor.DrawingFont = new Font(text, GetFontSize(), fontStyle);
			GetImageEditorFont(imgEditor.DrawingFont);
		}

		private void GetImageEditorFont(Font font)
		{
			bool allEventsEnabled = tbmImageEditor.EventManager.AllEventsEnabled;
			tbmImageEditor.EventManager.AllEventsEnabled = false;
			try
			{
				if (font != null)
				{
					((FontListTool)tbmImageEditor.Tools["FontName"]).Value = font.Name;
					((ComboBoxTool)tbmImageEditor.Tools["Font Size"]).Value = font.SizeInPoints.ToString();
					((StateButtonTool)tbmImageEditor.Tools["Bold"]).Checked = (font.Style & FontStyle.Bold) != 0;
					((StateButtonTool)tbmImageEditor.Tools["Italic"]).Checked = (font.Style & FontStyle.Italic) != 0;
					((StateButtonTool)tbmImageEditor.Tools["Underlined"]).Checked = (font.Style & FontStyle.Underline) != 0;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				tbmImageEditor.EventManager.AllEventsEnabled = allEventsEnabled;
			}
		}

		private float GetFontSize()
		{
			ComboBoxTool comboBoxTool = tbmImageEditor.Tools["Font Size"] as ComboBoxTool;
			if (!double.TryParse(comboBoxTool.Text, NumberStyles.Float, null, out var result))
			{
				return imgEditor.DrawingFont.Size;
			}
			return (float)result;
		}

		}

		private void UseGrayScalePalette()
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			CustomColorCollection val = new CustomColorCollection();

		}

		private void UseWebSafePalette()
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			CustomColorCollection val = new CustomColorCollection();
			int num = 16777215;
			do
			{
				val.Add(Color.FromArgb(255, Color.FromArgb(num)));
				if (num == 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				if ((num & 0xFF) == 0)
				{
					if ((num & 0xFF00) > 0)
					{
						num -= 13056;
						num += 255;
					}
					else
					{
						num -= 3342336;
						num += 65535;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num -= 51;
				}
			}
			while (num >= 0);
			colorPalette.ColorPalette = (ColorsCollectionBase)(object)val;
		}

		private void UseHSLPalette()
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			CustomColorCollection val = new CustomColorCollection();
			for (float num = 0f; num < 360f; num += 30f)
			{
				for (float num2 = 0f; num2 <= 1f; num2 += 0.1f)
				{
					for (float num3 = 0f; num3 <= 1f; num3 += 0.1f)
					{
						val.Add(XPItemColor.ColorFromHLS(num, num3, num2));
					}
				}
			}
			colorPalette.ColorPalette = (ColorsCollectionBase)(object)val;
		}

		private void UpdateColorInfo(Color color)
		{
			if (color.IsEmpty)
			{
				sbMain.Panels["RGB"].Text = string.Empty;
				sbMain.Panels["HLS"].Text = string.Empty;
			}
			else
			{
				sbMain.Panels["RGB"].Text = string.Format(RgbFormatString, color.R, color.G, color.B);
				sbMain.Panels["HLS"].Text = string.Format(HslFormatString, color.GetHue(), color.GetSaturation(), color.GetBrightness());
			}
		}

		private void UpdateMousePositionInfo(Point imagePt)
		{
			if (imagePt == InvalidPoint)
			{
				sbMain.Panels["Location"].Text = string.Empty;
			}
			else
			{
				sbMain.Panels["Location"].Text = string.Format(MousePosFormatString, imagePt.X, imagePt.Y);
			}
			Rectangle selectionRectangle = imgEditor.SelectionRectangle;
			if (selectionRectangle.IsEmpty)
			{
				sbMain.Panels["ImageSize"].Text = string.Empty;
			}
			else
			{
				sbMain.Panels["ImageSize"].Text = string.Format(SizeFormatString, selectionRectangle.Width, selectionRectangle.Height);
			}
		}

		private static string GetImageEditModeToolKey(ImageEditMode editMode)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004c: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			return (editMode - 1) switch
			{
				10 => "DrawPointTool", 
				9 => "DrawLineTool", 
				2 => "DrawArcTool", 
				3 => "DrawBrushTool", 
				11 => "DrawRectangleOutlineTool", 
				8 => "DrawFilledRectangleWithOutlineTool", 
				4 => "DrawEllipseOutlineTool", 
				6 => "DrawFilledEllipseWithOutlineTool", 
				13 => "EraseTool", 
				1 => "DrawAirbrushTool", 
				12 => "DrawTextTool", 
				5 => "DrawFilledEllipseTool", 
				7 => "DrawFilledRectangleTool", 
				16 => "SelectRectangleTool", 
				0 => "ColorSelectTool", 
				15 => "FillTool", 
				14 => "EraseColor", 
				_ => string.Empty, 
			};
		}

		private static ImageEditMode GetImageEditMode(string editModeKey)
		{
			return (ImageEditMode)(editModeKey switch
			{
				"DrawPointTool" => 11, 
				"DrawLineTool" => 10, 
				"DrawArcTool" => 3, 
				"DrawBrushTool" => 4, 
				"DrawRectangleOutlineTool" => 12, 
				"DrawFilledRectangleWithOutlineTool" => 9, 
				"DrawEllipseOutlineTool" => 5, 
				"DrawFilledEllipseWithOutlineTool" => 7, 
				"EraseTool" => 14,

		private void SynchronizeColors(Color color, ImageEditColorType colorType)
		{
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (inSynchronizeColors)
			{
				return;
			}
			inSynchronizeColors = true;
			try
			{
				if ((int)colorType == 0)
				{
					((PopupColorPickerTool)tbmImageEditor.Tools["BackColor"]).SelectedColor = color;
					imgEditor.DrawingBackColor = color;
					colorIndicator.SelectedBackColor = color;
				}
				else
				{
					((PopupColorPickerTool)tbmImageEditor.Tools["ForeColor"]).SelectedColor = color;
					imgEditor.DrawingForeColor = color;
					colorIndicator.SelectedForeColor = color;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				inSynchronizeColors = false;
			}
		}

		private void ProcessGradientToolClick(ToolBase tool)
		{
			//IL_0097: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (tool.Key == "GradientStyle")
			{
				PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool = tool as PopupMenuTool;
				if (popupMenuTool.SharedProps.Tag is string)
				{
					StateButtonTool stateButtonTool = tool.ToolbarsManager.Tools[(string)popupMenuTool.SharedProps.Tag] as StateButtonTool;
					stateButtonTool.Checked = popupMenuTool.Checked;
				}
				return;
			}
			StateButtonTool stateButtonTool2 = tool as StateButtonTool;
			PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool2 = tool.ToolbarsManager.Tools["GradientStyle"] as PopupMenuTool;
			if (stateButtonTool2.Checked)
			{
				imgEditor.DrawingGradientStyle = GetGradientStyle(tool.Key);
			}
			else
			{
				imgEditor.DrawingGradientStyle = (GradientStyle)1;
			}
			InitializeMenuImageFromKey(popupMenuTool2, stateButtonTool2);
			popupMenuTool2.Checked = stateButtonTool2.Checked;
		}

		private static void InitializeMenuImageFromKey(PopupMenuTool menuToInitialize, ToolBase toolWithImage)
		{
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!object.Equals(toolWithImage.Key, menuToInitialize.SharedProps.Tag))
			{
				menuToInitialize.SharedProps.Tag = toolWithImage.Key;
				AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
				AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)256;
				toolWithImage.ResolveAppearance(editArea: false, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, drawAsActive: false, drawAsPressed: false);
				menuToInitialize.SharedProps.AppearancesSmall.Appearance.Image = ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).Image;
			}
			if (menuToInitialize.DropDownArrowStyle == DropDownArrowStyle.SegmentedStateButton && toolWithImage is StateButtonTool)
			{
				menuToInitialize.Checked = ((StateButtonTool)toolWithImage).Checked;
			}
		}

		private static GradientStyle GetGradientStyle(string gradientToolKey)
		{
			return (GradientStyle)(gradientToolKey switch
			{
				"GradientHorizontal" => 3, 
				"GradientVertical" => 2, 
				"GradientHorizontalBump" => 6, 
				"GradientVerticalBump" => 7, 
				"GradientForwardDiagonal" => 5, 
				"GradientBackwardDiagonal" => 4, 
				"GradientCircular" => 8, 
				"GradientElliptical" => 10, 
				"GradientRectangular" => 9, 
				_ => 1, 
			});
		}

		private void ProcessMoveToolClick(ToolBase tool)
		{
			switch (tool.Key)
			{
			case "Move Image":
				if (tool.SharedProps.Tag is string key)
				{
					ProcessMoveToolClick(tool.ToolbarsManager.Tools[key]);
				}
				return;
			case "Move Up":
				imgEditor.OffsetImage(0, -1, false);
				break;
			case "Move Down":
				imgEditor.OffsetImage(0, 1, false);
				break;
			case "Move Left":
				imgEditor.OffsetImage(-1, 0, false);
				break;
			case "Move Right":
				imgEditor.OffsetImage(1, 0, false);
				break;
			}
			InitializeMenuImageFromKey(tool.ToolbarsManager.Tools["Move Image"] as PopupMenuTool, tool);
		}

		private void ProcessShapeToolClick(ToolBase tool)
		{
			//IL_017f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0184: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0186: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_018e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0132: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0137: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0138: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_013f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_019b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_014c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			switch (tool.Key)
			{
			case "Rectangle Types":
			case "Ellipse Types":
				if (tool.SharedProps.Tag is string key)
				{
					((StateButtonTool)tool.ToolbarsManager.Tools[key]).Checked = ((PopupMenuTool)tool).Checked;
				}
				break;
			case "DrawRectangleOutlineTool":
			case "DrawFilledRectangleWithOutlineTool":
			case "DrawFilledRectangleTool":
			{
				ImageEditMode imageEditMode2 = GetImageEditMode(tool.Key);
				if (imageEditMode2 != imgEditor.EditMode)
				{
					imgEditor.EditMode = imageEditMode2;
				}
				InitializeMenuImageFromKey(tool.ToolbarsManager.Tools["Rectangle Types"] as PopupMenuTool, tool);
				OnEditModeChanged();
				break;
			}
			case "DrawEllipseOutlineTool":
			case "DrawFilledEllipseWithOutlineTool":
			case "DrawFilledEllipseTool":
			{
				ImageEditMode imageEditMode = GetImageEditMode(tool.Key);
				if (imageEditMode != imgEditor.EditMode)
				{
					imgEditor.EditMode = imageEditMode;
				}
				InitializeMenuImageFromKey(tool.ToolbarsManager.Tools["Ellipse Types"] as PopupMenuTool, tool);
				OnEditModeChanged();
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		private void OnEditModeChanged()
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0046: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0074: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_015b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0162: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			string imageEditModeToolKey = GetImageEditModeToolKey(imgEditor.EditMode);
			if (!ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(imageEditModeToolKey))
			{
				StateButtonTool stateButtonTool = tbmImageEditor.Tools[imageEditModeToolKey] as StateButtonTool;
				if (!stateButtonTool.Checked)
				{
					stateButtonTool.Checked = true;
				}
				ImageEditMode editMode = imgEditor.EditMode;
				switch (editMode - 5)
				{
				case 0:
				case 1:
				case 2:
					((PopupMenuTool)stateButtonTool.ToolbarsManager.Tools["Ellipse Types"]).Checked = true;
					((PopupMenuTool)stateButtonTool.ToolbarsManager.Tools["Rectangle Types"]).Checked = false;
					break;
				case 3:
				case 4:
				case 7:
					((PopupMenuTool)stateButtonTool.ToolbarsManager.Tools["Ellipse Types"]).Checked = false;
					((PopupMenuTool)stateButtonTool.ToolbarsManager.Tools["Rectangle Types"]).Checked = true;
					break;
				default:
					((PopupMenuTool)stateButtonTool.ToolbarsManager.Tools["Ellipse Types"]).Checked = false;
					((PopupMenuTool)stateButtonTool.ToolbarsManager.Tools["Rectangle Types"]).Checked = false;
					break;
				}
				tbmImageEditor.Toolbars["TextTools"].Visible = (int)imgEditor.EditMode == 13;
			}
		}

		private void InitializeDialogStrings()
		{
			foreach (ToolBase tool in tbmImageEditor.Tools)
			{
				string text = BuildResourceName("CustomizeImg_Tool_", tool.Key);
				tool.SharedProps.Caption = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString(text);

				tool2.SharedProps.Category = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString(name);

			base.AccessibleDescription = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeImg_Title_AccessibleDescription");
		}

		private static string BuildResourceName(string prefix, string suffix)
		{
			string text = suffix.Replace(' ', '_');
			if (prefix == null || prefix.Length == 0)
			{
				return text;
			}
			return $"{prefix}{text}";
		}

		private bool LoadPreviousState()
		{
			//IL_00f8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_015d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (previousState == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			previousState.Position = 0L;
			tbmImageEditor.LoadFromBinary(previousState);
			SetImageEditorFont();
			imgEditor.AutoFitMagnifiedView = ((StateButtonTool)tbmImageEditor.Tools["ZoomFit"]).Checked;
			imgEditor.DrawingBackColor = ((PopupColorPickerTool)tbmImageEditor.Tools["BackColor"]).SelectedColor;
			imgEditor.DrawingForeColor = ((PopupColorPickerTool)tbmImageEditor.Tools["ForeColor"]).SelectedColor;
			imgEditor.DrawPixelGrid = ((StateButtonTool)tbmImageEditor.Tools["ShowGrid"]).Checked;
			imgEditor.EditMode = GetImageEditMode(tbmImageEditor.OptionSets["DrawingTool"].SelectedTool.Key);
			((Control)(object)sbMain).Visible = ((StateButtonTool)tbmImageEditor.Tools["StatusBar"]).Checked;
			ToolBase selectedTool = tbmImageEditor.OptionSets["GradientStyles"].SelectedTool;
			imgEditor.DrawingGradientStyle = GetGradientStyle((selectedTool == null) ? string.Empty : selectedTool.Key);
			SelectPalette(tbmImageEditor.OptionSets["Palette"].SelectedTool.Key);
			if (dialogX != -1)
			{
				Point point = new Point(dialogX, dialogY);
				Screen screen = Screen.FromPoint(point);
				if (screen.Bounds.Contains(point))
				{
					base.Location = point;
				}
				else
				{
					base.Location = new Point(0, 0);
				}
				base.ClientSize = new Size(dialogWidth, dialogHeight);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void OnClosed(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (previousState != null)
			{
				previousState.Close();
			}
			previousState = new MemoryStream();
			tbmImageEditor.SaveAsBinary(previousState, saveCustomizations: true);
			dialogX = base.Location.X;
			dialogY = base.Location.Y;
			dialogWidth = base.ClientSize.Width;
			dialogHeight = base.ClientSize.Height;
		}

		private void SelectPalette(string toolKey)
		{
			switch (toolKey)
			{
			case "Standard":
				UseDefaultPalette();
				break;
			case "Gray Scale":
				UseGrayScalePalette();
				break;
			case "Web Safe Colors":
				UseWebSafePalette();
				break;
			case "HSL Colors":
				UseHSLPalette();
				break;
			case "16 Colors":
				UseBasicPalette();
				break;
			}
		}

		private void ClearUndoStack()
		{
			if (!isEmbedded)
			{
				imgEditor.ResetModified();
			}
			imgEditor.ClearUndoStack();
			tbmImageEditor.Tools["Redo"].SharedProps.Enabled = imgEditor.CanRedo;
			tbmImageEditor.Tools["Undo"].SharedProps.Enabled = imgEditor.CanUndo;
		}
	}
