		private void CustomizeDialogKeyboard_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((Control)(object)this).Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeKeyboardTitle");
			InitDialogFields();
		}

		private void cmdClose_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((Form)this).Close();
		}

		private void lstCategories_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (lstCategories.SelectedIndex < 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			ResetDialogFieldsToDefaults();
			lstCommands.Items.Clear();
			if (lstCategories.Items[lstCategories.SelectedIndex] is CategoryWrapper selectedCategory)
			{
				DesignerUtilities.LoadToolsList(toolbarsManager, lstCommands, selectedCategory, designMode);
				if (lstCommands.Items.Count > 0)
				{
					lstCommands.SelectedIndex = 0;
				}
			}
		}

		private void lstCommands_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ResetDialogFieldsToDefaults();
			if (lstCommands.SelectedIndex > -1 && lstCommands.Items[lstCommands.SelectedIndex] is ToolWrapper { Tool: not null } toolWrapper)
			{
				SelectEntryInShortcutsList(toolWrapper.Tool.ShortcutResolved);
				((Control)(object)lblDescription).Text = toolWrapper.Tool.CustomizerDescriptionResolved;
				((Control)(object)coShortcut).Enabled = true;
				if (toolWrapper.Tool.ShortcutResolved != Shortcut.None)
				{
					((Control)(object)cmdRemove).Enabled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private void coShortcut_SelectionChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((Control)(object)lblAssignedTo).Text = string.Empty;
			((Control)(object)cmdAssign).Enabled = false;
			if (lstCommands.SelectedIndex < 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			ToolWrapper toolWrapper = lstCommands.Items[lstCommands.SelectedIndex] as ToolWrapper;
			ShortcutWrapper shortcutWrapper = coShortcut.Items[coShortcut.SelectedIndex].DataValue as ShortcutWrapper;
			if (toolWrapper == null || shortcutWrapper == null || coShortcut.SelectedIndex == 0 || toolWrapper.Tool.ShortcutResolved == shortcutWrapper.Shortcut)
			{
				return;
			}
			((Control)(object)cmdAssign).Enabled = true;
			if (shortcutWrapper != null && toolWrapper != null)
			{
				ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollectionBase = toolbarsManager.Tools;
				for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
				{
					foreach (ToolBase item in toolsCollectionBase)
					{
						ToolBase underlyingTool = item.UnderlyingTool;
						if (underlyingTool != null && underlyingTool.ShortcutResolved == shortcutWrapper.Shortcut)
						{
							((Control)(object)lblAssignedTo).Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeKeyboardShortcutAssignedLiteral", underlyingTool.CustomizerCaptionResolved);
							return;
						}
					}
					toolsCollectionBase = toolbarsManager.MergedTools;
				}
			}
			((Control)(object)lblAssignedTo).Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeKeyboardShortcutAssignedLiteral", Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeKeyboardShortcutUnassignedLiteral"));
		}

		private void cmdRemove_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (lstCommands.SelectedIndex > -1 && lstCommands.Items[lstCommands.SelectedIndex] is ToolWrapper { Tool: not null } toolWrapper)
			{
				toolWrapper.Tool.SharedProps.CustomizedShortcut = Shortcut.None;
				lstCommands_SelectedIndexChanged(lstCommands, new EventArgs());
			}
		}

		private void cmdAssign_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (lstCommands.SelectedIndex <= -1 || coShortcut.SelectedIndex <= -1)
			{
				return;
			}
			ToolWrapper toolWrapper = lstCommands.Items[lstCommands.SelectedIndex] as ToolWrapper;
			ShortcutWrapper shortcutWrapper = coShortcut.Items[coShortcut.SelectedIndex].DataValue as ShortcutWrapper;
			if (toolWrapper == null || toolWrapper.Tool == null || shortcutWrapper == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollectionBase = toolbarsManager.Tools;
			for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
			{
				foreach (ToolBase item in toolsCollectionBase)
				{
					if (item.ShortcutResolved == shortcutWrapper.Shortcut)
					{
						if (item.SharedProps.IsShortcutCustomized)
						{
							item.SharedProps.ResetCustomizedShortcut();
						}
						else
						{
							item.SharedProps.CustomizedShortcut = Shortcut.None;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				toolsCollectionBase = toolbarsManager.MergedTools;
			}
			toolWrapper.Tool.SharedProps.CustomizedShortcut = shortcutWrapper.Shortcut;
			lstCommands_SelectedIndexChanged(lstCommands, new EventArgs());
		}

		private void cmdResetAll_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			string text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeConfirmShortcutRemoval");
			DialogResult dialogResult = UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, text, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeConfirmShortcutRemovalTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.OKCancel, MessageBoxIcon.Question);
			if (dialogResult != DialogResult.OK)
			{
				return;
			}
			ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollectionBase = toolbarsManager.Tools;
			for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
			{
				foreach (ToolBase item in toolsCollectionBase)
				{
					ToolBase underlyingTool = item.UnderlyingTool;
					if (underlyingTool != null && underlyingTool.SharedProps.IsShortcutCustomized)
					{
						underlyingTool.SharedProps.ResetCustomizedShortcut();
					}
					if (item.SharedProps.IsShortcutCustomized)
					{
						item.SharedProps.ResetCustomizedShortcut();
					}
				}
				toolsCollectionBase = toolbarsManager.MergedTools;
			}
			if (lstCommands.SelectedIndex > -1)
			{
				lstCommands_SelectedIndexChanged(lstCommands, new EventArgs());
			}
		}

		private void InitDialogFields()
		{
			InitShortcutsList();
			InitCategoriesAndCommandsLists();
		}

		private void InitCategoriesAndCommandsLists()
		{
			lstCategories.Items.Clear();
			lstCommands.Items.Clear();
			DesignerUtilities.LoadCategoriesIntoControl(toolbarsManager, lstCategories, addUnassignedEntry: false, addAllCommandsEntry: true);
			lstCategories.SelectedIndex = 0;
		}

		private void InitShortcutsList()
		{
			Array values = Enum.GetValues(typeof(Shortcut));
			for (int i = 0; i < values.GetLength(0); i++)
			{
				Shortcut shortcut = (Shortcut)values.GetValue(i);
				if (excludedShortcuts == null || !excludedShortcuts.Contains(shortcut))
				{
					coShortcut.Items.Add((object)new ShortcutWrapper(shortcut));
				}
			}
			coShortcut.SelectedIndex = 0;
		}

		private void ResetDialogFieldsToDefaults()
		{
			coShortcut.SelectedIndex = 0;
			((Control)(object)lblAssignedTo).Text = string.Empty;
			((Control)(object)lblDescription).Text = string.Empty;
			UltraComboEditor ultraComboEditor = coShortcut;
			UltraButton ultraButton = cmdAssign;
			bool flag = (((Control)(object)cmdRemove).Enabled = false);
			bool enabled = (((Control)(object)ultraButton).Enabled = flag);
			((Control)(object)ultraComboEditor).Enabled = enabled;
		}

		private void SelectEntryInShortcutsList(Shortcut shortcut)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < ((DisposableObjectCollectionBase)(object)coShortcut.Items).Count; i++)
			{
				if (coShortcut.Items[i].DataValue is ShortcutWrapper shortcutWrapper && shortcutWrapper.Shortcut == shortcut)
				{
					if (coShortcut.SelectedIndex == i)
					{
						coShortcut_SelectionChanged(coShortcut, new EventArgs());
					}
					else
					{
						coShortcut.SelectedIndex = i;
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			coShortcut.SelectedIndex = 0;
		}
	}

		private void cmdGetFilename_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (opSave.Checked)
			{
				SaveFileDialog saveFileDialog = new SaveFileDialog();
				saveFileDialog.Title = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeLoadSave_SelectSaveFileDialogTitle");
				if (opBinary.Checked)
				{
					saveFileDialog.Filter = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeLoadSave_BinaryFilter");
				}
				else
				{
					saveFileDialog.Filter = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeLoadSave_XMLFilter");
				}
				saveFileDialog.OverwritePrompt = true;
				saveFileDialog.AddExtension = true;
				saveFileDialog.DefaultExt = ".dat";
				saveFileDialog.ShowDialog(this);
				if (!ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(saveFileDialog.FileName))
				{
					txtFilename.Text = saveFileDialog.FileName;
				}
				saveFileDialog.Dispose();
			}
			else
			{
				OpenFileDialog openFileDialog = new OpenFileDialog();
				openFileDialog.Title = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeLoadSave_SelectLoadFileDialogTitle");
				if (opBinary.Checked)
				{
					openFileDialog.Filter = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeLoadSave_BinaryFilter");
				}
				else
				{
					openFileDialog.Filter = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeLoadSave_XMLFilter");
				}
				openFileDialog.AddExtension = false;
				openFileDialog.CheckFileExists = true;
				openFileDialog.RestoreDirectory = false;
				openFileDialog.ShowDialog(this);
				if (!ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(openFileDialog.FileName))
				{
					txtFilename.Text = openFileDialog.FileName;
				}
				openFileDialog.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private void cmdLoadSave_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (opSave.Checked)
			{
				FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(txtFilename.Text, FileMode.OpenOrCreate);
				if (fileStream != null)
				{
					fileStream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
					try
					{
						if (opBinary.Checked)
						{
							toolbarsManager.SaveAsBinary(fileStream, saveCustomizations: true);
						}
						else
						{
							toolbarsManager.SaveAsXml(fileStream, saveCustomizations: true);
						}
						UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeLoadSave_SaveSuccessful"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeLoadSave_SaveSuccessfulTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Asterisk);
						fileStream.Close();
						Close();
						return;
					}
					catch
					{
						UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeLoadSave_SaveError"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeLoadSave_SaveErrorTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation);
						fileStream.Close();
						return;
					}
				}
				UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeLoadSave_SaveError"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeLoadSave_SaveErrorTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation);
				return;
			}
			FileStream fileStream2 = new FileStream(txtFilename.Text, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
			if (fileStream2 != null)
			{
				fileStream2.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
				try
				{
					if (opBinary.Checked)
					{
						toolbarsManager.LoadFromBinary(fileStream2);
					}
					else
					{
						toolbarsManager.LoadFromXml(fileStream2);
					}
					UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeLoadSave_LoadSuccessful"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeLoadSave_LoadSuccessfulTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Asterisk);
					fileStream2.Close();
					Close();
					return;
				}
				catch
				{
					UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeLoadSave_LoadError"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeLoadSave_LoadErrorTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation);
					fileStream2.Close();
					return;
				}
			}
			UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeLoadSave_LoadError"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeLoadSave_LoadErrorTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation);
		}

		private void cmdClose_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Close();
		}

		private void SetLoadSaveButtonEnabledStatus()
		{
			bool flag = !ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(txtFilename.Text);
			if (flag && opLoad.Checked)
			{
				flag = File.Exists(txtFilename.Text);
			}
			cmdLoadSave.Enabled = flag;
		}
	}

		private void CustomizeDialogNewTool_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeNewToolTitle");
			InitToolTypeCombo();
			InitCategoryCombo();
			InitCaptionAndKey();
		}

		private void cmdClose_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Close();
		}

		private void cmdAdd_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (toolbarsManager.Tools.Exists(txtToolKey.Text))
			{
				string text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeDuplicateToolMessage", txtToolKey.Text);
				UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, text, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeDuplicateToolTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation);
				return;
			}
			ToolBase toolBase = CreateTool();
			toolBase.SharedProps.Caption = txtToolCaption.Text;
			toolBase.SharedProps.CustomizerCaption = txtToolCustomizerCaption.Text;
			if (coCategory.Text != Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeEmptyCategoryLiteral"))
			{
				toolBase.SharedProps.Category = coCategory.Text;
			}
			try
			{
				toolbarsManager.Tools.Add(toolBase);
				customizeDialog.OnNewToolAdded(toolBase);
				if (coType.SelectedIndex > -1 && coType.Items[coType.SelectedIndex] is ToolDefinition toolDefinition)
				{
					lastToolID = toolDefinition.ToolID;
				}
				ResetTextChangedFlags();
				InitCaptionAndKey();
				ToolbarsManagerUtilities.FocusControl(txtToolCaption);
				txtToolCaption.SelectAll();
			}
			catch
			{
				string text2 = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeAddToolError", txtToolKey.Text);
				UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, text2, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeAddToolErrorTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation);
				return;
			}
			if (autoCloseDialog)
			{
				Close();
			}
		}

		private void txtToolKey_TextChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			cmdAdd.Enabled = txtToolKey.Text.Length > 0;
		}

		private void txtToolKey_KeyPress(object sender, KeyPressEventArgs e)
		{
			toolKeyChangedByUser = true;
		}

		private void txtToolCaption_KeyPress(object sender, KeyPressEventArgs e)
		{
			toolCaptionChangedByUser = true;
		}

		private void txtToolCaption_TextChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!toolKeyChangedByUser)
			{
				txtToolKey.Text = txtToolCaption.Text.Replace("&", string.Empty);
			}
		}

		private void coType_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!TextChangedByUser)
			{
				InitCaptionAndKey();
			}
		}

		private ToolBase CreateTool()
		{
			if (coType.SelectedIndex > -1)
			{
				if (coType.Items[coType.SelectedIndex] is ToolDefinition toolDefinition)
				{
					return toolDefinition.ToolProvider.CreateToolInstance(toolDefinition.ToolID, txtToolKey.Text);
				}
				return null;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private string GetDefaultToolName(string nameBase)
		{
			for (int i = 1; i < 1000; i++)
			{
				if (!toolbarsManager.Tools.Exists(nameBase + i))
				{
					return nameBase + i;
				}
			}
			string text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeCreateToolError");
			UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, text, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeCreateToolErrorTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation);
			return string.Empty;
		}

		private static bool IncludeToolInList(ToolDefinition toolDefinition, CustomizeDialogNewTool dialog)
		{
			if (dialog == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (dialog.limitToToolTypeId != Guid.Empty && UltraToolbarsManager.ToolTypes[dialog.limitToToolTypeId] is ToolDefinition toolDefinition2)
			{
				Type toolType = DesignerUtilities.GetPlacementInfo(toolDefinition2).ToolType;
				Type toolType2 = DesignerUtilities.GetPlacementInfo(toolDefinition).ToolType;
				if (toolType != null && toolType2 != null && !toolType.IsAssignableFrom(toolType2))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return DesignerUtilities.IsToolDefinitionValid(toolDefinition, dialog.ensureVisibleOnMenus, dialog.ensureVisibleOnToolbars, dialog.ensureVisibleOnVerticalToolbars, dialog.ensureVisibleOnRibbonGroup, dialog.ensureVisibleOnApplicationMenuArea, dialog.ensureVisibleOnQat, !dialog.toolbarsManager.SupportsOffice2007ViewStyle, dialog.taskPaneFilterMode);
		}

		private void InitCaptionAndKey()
		{
			if (coType.SelectedIndex > -1 && coType.Items[coType.SelectedIndex] is ToolDefinition toolDefinition)
			{
				TextBox textBox = txtToolCaption;
				string text = (txtToolKey.Text = GetDefaultToolName(toolDefinition.InstanceNameBase));
				textBox.Text = text;
			}
			txtToolCustomizerCaption.Text = string.Empty;
		}

		private void InitCategoryCombo()
		{
			coCategory.Items.Add(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeEmptyCategoryLiteral"));
			foreach (ToolBase tool in toolbarsManager.Tools)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				if (ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(tool.SharedProps.Category))
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (object item in coCategory.Items)
				{
					if (string.Compare(item.ToString(), tool.SharedProps.Category, ignoreCase: true, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) == 0)
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					coCategory.Items.Add(tool.SharedProps.Category);
				}
			}
			if (!ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(defaultCategory))
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < coCategory.Items.Count; i++)
				{
					if (string.Compare(coCategory.Items[i].ToString(), defaultCategory, ignoreCase: true, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) == 0)
					{
						coCategory.SelectedIndex = i;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				coCategory.SelectedIndex = 0;
			}
		}

		private void InitToolTypeCombo()
		{
			IDictionaryEnumerator enumerator = UltraToolbarsManager.ToolTypes.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				if (UltraToolbarsManager.ToolTypes[enumerator.Key] is ToolDefinition toolDefinition && (toolDefinition.IsCustom || toolbarsManager.ShowBuiltInToolTypesInCustomizer) && IncludeToolInList(toolDefinition, this))
				{
					coType.Items.Add(toolDefinition);
				}
			}
			Guid guid = ((limitToToolTypeId == Guid.Empty) ? lastToolID : limitToToolTypeId);
			for (int i = 0; i < coType.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				if (coType.Items[i] is ToolDefinition toolDefinition2 && toolDefinition2.ToolID == guid)
				{
					coType.SelectedIndex = i;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (coType.Items.Count <= 1)
			{
				coType.Enabled = false;
			}
			if (coType.SelectedIndex == -1 && coType.Items.Count > 0)
			{
				coType.SelectedIndex = 0;
			}
		}

		private void ResetTextChangedFlags()
		{
			toolKeyChangedByUser = false;
			toolCaptionChangedByUser = false;
		}
	}

		private void CustomizeDialogNewToolbar_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((Control)(object)this).Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeNewToolbarTitle");
			if (((Control)(object)txtToolbarName).Text == null || ((Control)(object)txtToolbarName).Text.Trim().Length == 0)
			{
				((Control)(object)txtToolbarName).Text = "UltraToolbar";
			}
			for (int i = 1; i < 1000; i++)
			{
				if (!toolbarsManager.Toolbars.Exists(((Control)(object)txtToolbarName).Text + i))
				{
					((Control)(object)txtToolbarName).Text += i;
					break;
				}
			}
			coLocation.Items.Add((object)Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeLocationDockedTop"));
			coLocation.Items.Add((object)Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeLocationDockedBottom"));
			coLocation.Items.Add((object)Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeLocationDockedLeft"));
			coLocation.Items.Add((object)Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeLocationDockedRight"));
			coLocation.Items.Add((object)Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeLocationFloating"));
			coLocation.SelectedIndex = 0;
			coToolbarType.Items.Add((object)Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeToolbarTypeStandard"));
			coToolbarType.Items.Add((object)Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeToolbarTypeTaskPane"));
			if (!ContainsMainMenuBar(toolbarsManager))
			{
				coToolbarType.Items.Add((object)Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeToolbarTypeMenuBar"));
			}
			if (!toolbarsManager.EnforceOffice2007Resolution)
			{
				coToolbarType.SelectedIndex = 0;
			}
			else
			{
				coToolbarType.SelectedIndex = 1;
			}
		}

		private static bool ContainsMainMenuBar(UltraToolbarsManager manager)
		{
			foreach (UltraToolbar toolbar in manager.Toolbars)
			{
				if (toolbar.IsMainMenuBar)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void cmdCancel_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((Form)this).Close();
		}

		private void cmdOK_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (toolbarsManager.Toolbars.Exists(((Control)(object)txtToolbarName).Text))
			{
				string text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeDuplicateToolbarMessage", ((Control)(object)txtToolbarName).Text);
				UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, text, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeDuplicateToolbarTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation);
				return;
			}
			if (toolbarsManager.EnforceOffice2007Resolution && coToolbarType.SelectedIndex != 1)
			{
				string text2 = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeStandardToolbarNotAllowedMessage");
				UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, text2, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ErrorMessageCaption"), MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation);
				return;
			}
			UltraToolbar ultraToolbar = null;
			if (coToolbarType.SelectedIndex == 0)
			{
				ultraToolbar = new UltraToolbar(((Control)(object)txtToolbarName).Text, toolbarsManager.IsDesignMode);
			}
			else if (coToolbarType.SelectedIndex == 1)
			{
				ultraToolbar = new UltraTaskPaneToolbar(((Control)(object)txtToolbarName).Text);
			}
			else if (coToolbarType.SelectedIndex == 2)
			{
				ultraToolbar = new UltraToolbar(((Control)(object)txtToolbarName).Text, toolbarsManager.IsDesignMode);
				ultraToolbar.IsMainMenuBar = true;
			}
			ultraToolbar.DockedPosition = (DockedPosition)coLocation.SelectedIndex;
			ultraToolbar.Text = ((Control)(object)txtToolbarName).Text;
			try
			{
				toolbarsManager.Toolbars.Add(ultraToolbar);
				newToolbar = ultraToolbar;
				((Form)this).DialogResult = DialogResult.OK;
				((Form)this).Close();
			}
			catch
			{
				string text3 = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeAddToolbarError", ((Control)(object)txtToolbarName).Text);
				UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, text3, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeAddToolbarErrorTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation);
			}
		}

		private void txtToolbarName_TextChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((Control)(object)cmdOK).Enabled = ((Control)(object)txtToolbarName).Text.Length > 0;
		}
	}
	public class CustomizeDialogRearrangeCommands : AppStyledDialogBase, IOwnedForm
	{
		private class ToolsHolder
		{
			private object toolsHolder;

			private string[] toolsHolderPath;

			internal PopupMenuTool PopupMenuTool => toolsHolder as PopupMenuTool;

			internal UltraToolbar Toolbar => toolsHolder as UltraToolbar;

			internal ToolsHolder(object toolsHolder, string[] toolsHolderPath)
			{
				this.toolsHolder = toolsHolder;
				this.toolsHolderPath = toolsHolderPath;
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(200);
				string[] array = toolsHolderPath;
				foreach (string value in array)
				{
					if (stringBuilder.Length > 0)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(" | ");
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(value);
				}
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
		}

		private class StackEx : Stack
		{
			internal StackEx()
			{
			}

			internal string[] ToStringArray()
			{
				List<string> list = new List<string>(5);
				IEnumerator enumerator = base.GetEnumerator();
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					if (enumerator.Current is UltraToolbar)
					{
						list.Add(((UltraToolbar)enumerator.Current).Text.Replace("&", ""));
					}
					else if (enumerator.Current is PopupMenuTool)
					{
						list.Add(((PopupMenuTool)enumerator.Current).CustomizerCaptionResolved.Replace("&", ""));
					}
				}
				list.TrimExcess();
				string[] array = list.ToArray();
				Array.Reverse(array);
				return array;
			}
		}

		private ToolsCollection CurrentSelectedToolsCollection
		{
			get
			{
				ToolsHolder toolsHolder = null;
				if (((Control)(object)coMenubar).Enabled)
				{
					if (coMenubar.SelectedIndex < 0)
					{
						return null;
					}
					toolsHolder = coMenubar.Items[coMenubar.SelectedIndex].DataValue as ToolsHolder;
				}
				else
				{
					if (!((Control)(object)coToolbar).Enabled)
					{
						return null;
					}
					if (coToolbar.SelectedIndex < 0)
					{
						return null;
					}
					toolsHolder = coToolbar.Items[coToolbar.SelectedIndex].DataValue as ToolsHolder;
				}
				if (toolsHolder != null)
				{
					if (toolsHolder.PopupMenuTool != null)
					{
						return toolsHolder.PopupMenuTool.Tools;
					}
					if (toolsHolder.Toolbar != null)
					{
						return toolsHolder.Toolbar.Tools;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		private ToolBase CurrentSelectedTool => CurrentSelectedToolWrapper?.Tool;

		private ToolWrapper CurrentSelectedToolWrapper
		{
			get
			{
				if (lstTools.SelectedIndex < 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return lstTools.Items[lstTools.SelectedIndex] as ToolWrapper;
			}
		}

		Control IOwnedForm.Owner
		{

				{
					return null;
				}
				return (Control)(object)toolbarsManager.GetDockAreas()[0];
			}
		}

		private void LoadMenubarCombo()
		{
			StackEx currentPath = new StackEx();
			foreach (UltraToolbar toolbar in toolbarsManager.Toolbars)
			{
				if (toolbar.IsMainMenuBar)
				{
					ProcessTools(toolbar.Tools, currentPath, coMenubar);
				}
			}
			if (((DisposableObjectCollectionBase)(object)coMenubar.Items).Count > 0)
			{
				coMenubar.SelectedIndex = 0;
			}
		}

		private void LoadToolbarCombo()
		{
			StackEx stackEx = new StackEx();
			foreach (UltraToolbar toolbar in toolbarsManager.Toolbars)
			{
				if (toolbar.VisibleResolved)
				{
					stackEx.Push(toolbar);
					ToolsHolder toolsHolder = new ToolsHolder(toolbar, stackEx.ToStringArray());
					coToolbar.Items.Add((object)toolsHolder);
					if (!toolbar.IsMainMenuBar)
					{
						ProcessTools(toolbar.Tools, stackEx, coToolbar);
					}
					stackEx.Pop();
				}
			}
			if (((DisposableObjectCollectionBase)(object)coToolbar.Items).Count > 0)
			{
				coToolbar.SelectedIndex = 0;
			}
		}

		private void LoadToolsList()
		{
			if (((Control)(object)coMenubar).Enabled && coMenubar.SelectedIndex > -1)
			{
				LoadToolsList(coMenubar.Items[coMenubar.SelectedIndex].DataValue as ToolsHolder);
			}
			else if (((Control)(object)coToolbar).Enabled && coToolbar.SelectedIndex > -1)
			{
				LoadToolsList(coToolbar.Items[coToolbar.SelectedIndex].DataValue as ToolsHolder);
			}
		}

		private void LoadToolsList(ToolsHolder toolsHolder)
		{
			if (toolsHolder != null)
			{
				lstTools.BeginUpdate();
				lstTools.Items.Clear();
				CategoryWrapper selectedCategory = new CategoryWrapper(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeCategoryAllCommands"), CategoryType.AllCommands);
				if (toolsHolder.PopupMenuTool != null)
				{
					DesignerUtilities.AddCollectionToolsToList(toolsHolder.PopupMenuTool.Tools, lstTools, selectedCategory, isDesignMode: false, addSeparatorEntries: true);
				}
				else if (toolsHolder.Toolbar != null)
				{
					DesignerUtilities.AddCollectionToolsToList(toolsHolder.Toolbar.Tools, lstTools, selectedCategory, isDesignMode: false, addSeparatorEntries: true);
				}
				if (lstTools.Items.Count > 0)
				{
					lstTools.SelectedIndex = 0;
				}
				lstTools.EndUpdate();
			}
			SetButtonsEnabledStatus();
		}

		private void ProcessTools(ToolsCollection tools, StackEx currentPath, UltraComboEditor combo)
		{
			foreach (ToolBase tool in tools)
			{
				if (!(tool is PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool))
				{
					continue;
				}
				bool flag = false;
				PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool2 = popupMenuTool;
				while (popupMenuTool2 != null && popupMenuTool2.OwnerIsMenuInternal)
				{
					if (popupMenuTool2.OwningMenuInternal.Key == tool.Key)
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
					popupMenuTool2 = popupMenuTool2.OwningMenuInternal;
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					currentPath.Push(tool);
					ToolsHolder toolsHolder = new ToolsHolder(tool, currentPath.ToStringArray());
					combo.Items.Add((object)toolsHolder);
					ProcessTools(popupMenuTool.Tools, currentPath, combo);
					currentPath.Pop();
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetButtonsEnabledStatus()
		{
			if (buttonEnabledStateSuspended)
			{
				return;
			}
			if ((((Control)(object)coMenubar).Enabled && coMenubar.SelectedIndex < 0) || (((Control)(object)coToolbar).Enabled && coToolbar.SelectedIndex < 0))
			{
				((Control)(object)cmdAdd).Enabled = false;
			}
			else
			{
				((Control)(object)cmdAdd).Enabled = true;
			}
			UltraButton ultraButton = cmdDelete;
			bool enabled = (((Control)(object)cmdModifySelection).Enabled = lstTools.SelectedIndex > -1);
			((Control)(object)ultraButton).Enabled = enabled;
			if (lstTools.SelectedIndex < 1)
			{
				((Control)(object)cmdMoveUp).Enabled = false;
			}
			else if (lstTools.SelectedIndex == 1)
			{
				ToolWrapper currentSelectedToolWrapper = CurrentSelectedToolWrapper;
				if (currentSelectedToolWrapper != null)
				{
					if (!currentSelectedToolWrapper.IsSeparator && currentSelectedToolWrapper.Tool.IsFirstInGroupResolved)
					{
						((Control)(object)cmdMoveUp).Enabled = false;
					}
					else if (currentSelectedToolWrapper.IsSeparator)
					{
						((Control)(object)cmdMoveUp).Enabled = false;
					}
					else
					{
						((Control)(object)cmdMoveUp).Enabled = true;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					((Control)(object)cmdMoveUp).Enabled = false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				((Control)(object)cmdMoveUp).Enabled = true;
			}
			ToolWrapper currentSelectedToolWrapper2 = CurrentSelectedToolWrapper;
			if (lstTools.SelectedIndex == lstTools.Items.Count - 1)
			{
				((Control)(object)cmdMoveDown).Enabled = false;
			}
			else if (lstTools.SelectedIndex == lstTools.Items.Count - 2)
			{
				if (currentSelectedToolWrapper2 != null)
				{
					if (currentSelectedToolWrapper2.IsSeparator)
					{
						((Control)(object)cmdMoveDown).Enabled = false;
					}
					else
					{
						((Control)(object)cmdMoveDown).Enabled = true;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					((Control)(object)cmdMoveDown).Enabled = false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				((Control)(object)cmdMoveDown).Enabled = true;
			}
			if (currentSelectedToolWrapper2 != null)
			{
				((Control)(object)cmdModifySelection).Enabled = !currentSelectedToolWrapper2.IsSeparator;
			}
			else
			{
				((Control)(object)cmdModifySelection).Enabled = false;
			}
			ValueListItemsCollection val = (((RadioButton)(object)opMenuBar).Checked ? coMenubar : (((RadioButton)(object)opToolbar).Checked ? coToolbar : null))?.Items;
			((Control)(object)cmdReset).Enabled = val != null && ((DisposableObjectCollectionBase)(object)val).Count > 0;
		}

			LoadMenubarCombo();
			LoadToolbarCombo();
			SetButtonsEnabledStatus();
		}

		}

		private void cmdAdd_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			CustomizeDialogAddCommand customizeDialogAddCommand = new CustomizeDialogAddCommand(toolbarsManager);
			((AppStyledDialogBase)customizeDialogAddCommand).SetApplicationStylingProperties(((AppStyledDialogBase)this).StyleLibraryName, ((AppStyledDialogBase)this).StyleSetName, ((AppStyledDialogBase)this).UseAppStyling);
			((Form)(object)customizeDialogAddCommand).ShowDialog((IWin32Window)this);
			if (((Form)(object)customizeDialogAddCommand).DialogResult == DialogResult.OK)
			{
				if (customizeDialogAddCommand.SelectedTool == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				ToolsCollection currentSelectedToolsCollection = CurrentSelectedToolsCollection;
				if (currentSelectedToolsCollection != null)
				{
					ToolBase currentSelectedTool = CurrentSelectedTool;
					int num = ((currentSelectedTool != null) ? currentSelectedToolsCollection.IndexOf(currentSelectedTool) : 0);
					if (num > -1)
					{
						try
						{
							int selectedIndex = ((lstTools.SelectedIndex >= 0) ? lstTools.SelectedIndex : 0);
							currentSelectedToolsCollection.InternalInsertAt(customizeDialogAddCommand.SelectedTool, num, honorReadOnlyStatus: false);
							LoadToolsList();
							lstTools.SelectedIndex = selectedIndex;
						}
						catch (Exception ex)
						{
							if (this == null)
							{
								throw ex;
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			((Component)(object)customizeDialogAddCommand).Dispose();
		}

		private void cmdDelete_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ToolWrapper currentSelectedToolWrapper = CurrentSelectedToolWrapper;
			if (currentSelectedToolWrapper == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ToolBase currentSelectedTool = CurrentSelectedTool;
			if (currentSelectedTool == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (currentSelectedToolWrapper.IsSeparator)
			{
				try
				{
					int selectedIndex = lstTools.SelectedIndex;
					currentSelectedTool.CustomizedIsFirstInGroup = (DefaultableBoolean)2;
					LoadToolsList();
					lstTools.SelectedIndex = selectedIndex;
					return;
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (this == null)
					{
						throw ex;
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			ToolsCollection currentSelectedToolsCollection = CurrentSelectedToolsCollection;
			if (currentSelectedToolsCollection != null)
			{
				int selectedIndex2 = lstTools.SelectedIndex;
				currentSelectedToolsCollection.Remove(currentSelectedTool);
				LoadToolsList();
				if (selectedIndex2 < lstTools.Items.Count)
				{
					lstTools.SelectedIndex = selectedIndex2;
				}
				else if (lstTools.Items.Count > 0)
				{
					lstTools.SelectedIndex = lstTools.Items.Count - 1;
				}
			}
		}

		private void cmdMoveUp_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			try
			{
				lstTools.BeginUpdate();
				cmdMoveUp_ClickHelper();
			}
			finally
			{
				lstTools.EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		private void cmdMoveUp_ClickHelper()
		{
			bool flag = buttonEnabledStateSuspended;
			buttonEnabledStateSuspended = true;
			try
			{
				ToolWrapper currentSelectedToolWrapper = CurrentSelectedToolWrapper;
				if (currentSelectedToolWrapper == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				ToolBase tool = currentSelectedToolWrapper.Tool;
				if (tool == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				ToolsCollection currentSelectedToolsCollection = CurrentSelectedToolsCollection;
				if (currentSelectedToolsCollection == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				int num = currentSelectedToolsCollection.IndexOf(currentSelectedToolWrapper.Tool);
				if (currentSelectedToolWrapper.IsSeparator)
				{
					if (num <= 1)
					{
						return;
					}
					try
					{
						int selectedIndex = lstTools.SelectedIndex;
						tool.CustomizedIsFirstInGroup = (DefaultableBoolean)2;
						currentSelectedToolsCollection[num - 1].CustomizedIsFirstInGroup = (DefaultableBoolean)1;
						LoadToolsList();
						lstTools.SelectedIndex = selectedIndex - 1;
						return;
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						if (this == null)
						{
							throw ex;
						}
						return;
					}
				}
				if (lstTools.SelectedIndex > 0)
				{
					ToolWrapper toolWrapper = lstTools.Items[lstTools.SelectedIndex - 1] as ToolWrapper;
					ToolWrapper toolWrapper2 = ((lstTools.Items.Count - 1 > lstTools.SelectedIndex) ? (lstTools.Items[lstTools.SelectedIndex + 1] as ToolWrapper) : null);
					if (toolWrapper.IsSeparator)
					{
						tool.CustomizedIsFirstInGroup = (DefaultableBoolean)2;
						if (toolWrapper2 != null && !toolWrapper2.IsSeparator)
						{
							toolWrapper2.Tool.CustomizedIsFirstInGroup = (DefaultableBoolean)1;
						}
						LoadToolsList();
						lstTools.SelectedIndex = IndexOfTool(lstTools.Items, tool);
						return;
					}
					if (lstTools.SelectedIndex > 1)
					{
						ToolWrapper toolWrapper3 = lstTools.Items[lstTools.SelectedIndex - 2] as ToolWrapper;
						if (toolWrapper3.IsSeparator)
						{
							toolWrapper.Tool.CustomizedIsFirstInGroup = (DefaultableBoolean)2;
							currentSelectedToolWrapper.Tool.CustomizedIsFirstInGroup = (DefaultableBoolean)1;
						}
					}
				}
				if (num <= 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					int selectedIndex2 = lstTools.SelectedIndex;
					currentSelectedToolsCollection.ChangeIndexOf(tool, num - 1);
					LoadToolsList();
					lstTools.SelectedIndex = IndexOfTool(lstTools.Items, tool);
				}
				catch (Exception ex2)
				{
					if (this == null)
					{
						throw ex2;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				buttonEnabledStateSuspended = flag;
				SetButtonsEnabledStatus();
			}
		}

		private static int IndexOfTool(IList list, ToolBase tool)
		{
			if (list != null && list.Count > 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					if (list[i] is ToolWrapper { Tool: not null, IsSeparator: false } toolWrapper && toolWrapper.Tool == tool)
					{
						return i;
					}
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private void cmdMoveDown_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			try
			{
				lstTools.BeginUpdate();
				cmdMoveDown_ClickHelper();
			}
			finally
			{
				lstTools.EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		private void cmdMoveDown_ClickHelper()
		{
			bool flag = buttonEnabledStateSuspended;
			buttonEnabledStateSuspended = true;
			try
			{
				ToolWrapper currentSelectedToolWrapper = CurrentSelectedToolWrapper;
				if (currentSelectedToolWrapper == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				ToolBase tool = currentSelectedToolWrapper.Tool;
				if (tool == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				ToolsCollection currentSelectedToolsCollection = CurrentSelectedToolsCollection;
				if (currentSelectedToolsCollection == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				int num = currentSelectedToolsCollection.IndexOf(currentSelectedToolWrapper.Tool);
				if (currentSelectedToolWrapper.IsSeparator)
				{
					if (num >= currentSelectedToolsCollection.Count - 1)
					{
						return;
					}
					try
					{
						int selectedIndex = lstTools.SelectedIndex;
						tool.CustomizedIsFirstInGroup = (DefaultableBoolean)2;
						currentSelectedToolsCollection[num + 1].CustomizedIsFirstInGroup = (DefaultableBoolean)1;
						LoadToolsList();
						lstTools.SelectedIndex = selectedIndex + 1;
						return;
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						if (this == null)
						{
							throw ex;
						}
						return;
					}
				}
				if (lstTools.SelectedIndex < lstTools.Items.Count - 1)
				{
					ToolWrapper toolWrapper = lstTools.Items[lstTools.SelectedIndex + 1] as ToolWrapper;
					if (toolWrapper.IsSeparator)
					{
						tool.CustomizedIsFirstInGroup = (DefaultableBoolean)1;
						toolWrapper.Tool.CustomizedIsFirstInGroup = (DefaultableBoolean)2;
						LoadToolsList();
						lstTools.SelectedIndex = IndexOfTool(lstTools.Items, tool);
						return;
					}
					if (lstTools.SelectedIndex > 0)
					{
						ToolWrapper toolWrapper2 = lstTools.Items[lstTools.SelectedIndex - 1] as ToolWrapper;
						if (toolWrapper2.IsSeparator)
						{
							tool.CustomizedIsFirstInGroup = (DefaultableBoolean)2;
							toolWrapper.Tool.CustomizedIsFirstInGroup = (DefaultableBoolean)1;
							LoadToolsList();
							lstTools.SelectedIndex = IndexOfTool(lstTools.Items, tool);
						}
					}
				}
				if (num >= currentSelectedToolsCollection.Count - 1)
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					int selectedIndex2 = lstTools.SelectedIndex;
					currentSelectedToolsCollection.ChangeIndexOf(tool, num + 1);
					LoadToolsList();
					lstTools.SelectedIndex = IndexOfTool(lstTools.Items, tool);
				}
				catch (Exception ex2)
				{
					if (this == null)
					{
						throw ex2;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				buttonEnabledStateSuspended = flag;
				SetButtonsEnabledStatus();
			}
		}

		private void cmdModifySelection_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ToolBase currentSelectedTool = CurrentSelectedTool;
			if (currentSelectedTool != null)
			{
				Point point = ((Control)(object)cmdModifySelection).PointToScreen(new Point(0, ((Control)(object)cmdModifySelection).Height));
				Rectangle exclusionRect = ((Control)(object)cmdModifySelection).RectangleToScreen(((Control)(object)cmdModifySelection).ClientRectangle);
				modifySelectionTool = CurrentSelectedTool;
				if (!hookedCustomizeDialogContextMenuClosedOrClickedEvent)
				{
					customizeDialog.OnToolContextMenuClosed += OnToolContextMenuClosedOrClicked;
					customizeDialog.OnToolContextMenuClicked += OnToolContextMenuClosedOrClicked;
					hookedCustomizeDialogContextMenuClosedOrClickedEvent = true;
				}
				customizeDialog.DisplayToolContextMenu(currentSelectedTool, point, exclusionRect, (DropDownPosition)0);
			}
		}

		private void cmdReset_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			string text;
			string text2;
			if (((Control)(object)coMenubar).Enabled)
			{
				text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeDlgRearrangeCommands_ResetMenuTitle");
				text2 = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeDlgRearrangeCommands_ResetMenuMessage", ((Control)(object)coMenubar).Text);
			}
			else
			{
				text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeDlgRearrangeCommands_ResetToolbarTitle");
				text2 = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeDlgRearrangeCommands_ResetToolbarMessage", ((Control)(object)coToolbar).Text);
			}
			DialogResult dialogResult = UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, text2, text, MessageBoxButtons.YesNo, MessageBoxIcon.Question, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button2);
			if (dialogResult != DialogResult.Yes)
			{
				return;
			}
			int selectedIndex = lstTools.SelectedIndex;
			CurrentSelectedToolsCollection?.ResetCustomizations();
			LoadToolsList();
			if (selectedIndex > -1 && lstTools.Items.Count > 0)
			{
				if (selectedIndex < lstTools.Items.Count)
				{
					lstTools.SelectedIndex = selectedIndex;
				}
				else
				{
					lstTools.SelectedIndex = lstTools.Items.Count - 1;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnToolContextMenuClosedOrClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			LoadToolsList();
			if (modifySelectionTool == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < lstTools.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				if (lstTools.Items[i] is ToolWrapper toolWrapper && toolWrapper.Tool == modifySelectionTool && !toolWrapper.IsSeparator)
				{
					lstTools.SelectedIndex = i;
					break;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	internal class CustomizeMenuItem : SpecialCommandMenuItemBase
	{
		private DefaultableBoolean isFirstInGroup;

		protected internal override bool IsFirstInGroup
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0009: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				DefaultableBoolean val = isFirstInGroup;
				if ((int)val != 1)
				{
					if ((int)val == 2)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (!(base.MenuAgent is ToolbarListMenuAgent))
					{
						return ToolbarsManager.IsNonOffice2000Style;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected internal override string Text => UltraToolbarsManager.CustomizeLiteral;

		public override UIRole UIRole
		{
			get
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager != null)
				{
					return StyleUtils.GetRole(toolbarsManager, StyleUtils.Role.MenuItemCustomize);
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal CustomizeMenuItem()
		{
		}

		internal CustomizeMenuItem(bool isFirstInGroup)
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (isFirstInGroup)
			{
				this.isFirstInGroup = (DefaultableBoolean)1;
			}
			else
			{
				this.isFirstInGroup = (DefaultableBoolean)2;
			}
		}

		protected internal override void CloseDropDown(bool delay)
		{
		}

		protected internal override void OnClick()
		{
			base.MenuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay: false);
			if (base.MenuAgent != null && base.MenuAgent.OwningControlForDropDown != null && base.MenuAgent.OwningControlForDropDown.IsHandleCreated)
			{
				base.MenuAgent.OwningControlForDropDown.BeginInvoke(new MethodInvoker(ToolbarsManager.Customize));
			}
			else
			{
				ToolbarsManager.Customize();
			}
		}

		protected override UIElement GetMenuUIElement(UIElement parentElement, UIElement previousElement)
		{
			CustomizeMenuItemUIElement customizeMenuItemUIElement = null;
			if (previousElement != null && ((object)previousElement).GetType() == typeof(CustomizeMenuItemUIElement) && previousElement.Parent == parentElement)
			{
				customizeMenuItemUIElement = previousElement as CustomizeMenuItemUIElement;
			}
			if (customizeMenuItemUIElement == null)
			{
				customizeMenuItemUIElement = new CustomizeMenuItemUIElement(parentElement, this);
			}
			customizeMenuItemUIElement.InitializeElement(this);
			return (UIElement)(object)customizeMenuItemUIElement;
		}

		protected internal override Type GetMenuUIElementType()
		{
			return typeof(CustomizeMenuItemUIElement);
		}

		internal override bool IsSameMenuItem(MenuItemBase menuItem)
		{
			CustomizeMenuItem customizeMenuItem = menuItem as CustomizeMenuItem;
			return customizeMenuItem != null;
		}
	}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(CustomizeToolSurrogateConverter))]
	internal class CustomizeToolSurrogate
	{
		private ToolBase tool;

		internal ToolBase Tool => tool;

		public CustomizeToolSurrogate(ToolBase tool)
		{
			this.tool = tool;
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public sealed class CustomizeToolSurrogateConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool GetPropertiesSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection result = null;
			if (value is CustomizeToolSurrogate customizeToolSurrogate)
			{
				PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(customizeToolSurrogate.Tool);
				int num = 0;
				foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in properties)
				{
					if (!ExcludeProperty(item))
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
				PropertyDescriptor[] array = new PropertyDescriptor[num];
				int num2 = 0;
				foreach (PropertyDescriptor item2 in properties)
				{
					if (!ExcludeProperty(item2))
					{
						array[num2] = new CustomizeToolSurrogatePropertyDescriptor(item2, item2.DisplayName, customizeToolSurrogate.Tool);
						num2++;
					}
				}
				result = new PropertyDescriptorCollection(array);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static bool ExcludeProperty(PropertyDescriptor propDescriptor)
		{
			if (!propDescriptor.IsBrowsable)
			{
				return true;
			}
			switch (propDescriptor.DisplayName)
			{
			case "InstanceProps":
			case "Key":
			case "SharedProps":
			case "Tag":
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class CustomizeToolSurrogatePropertyDescriptor : PropertyDescriptor
	{
		private PropertyDescriptor underlyingDescriptor;

		private ToolBase tool;

		public override string Category => underlyingDescriptor.Category;

		public override Type ComponentType => underlyingDescriptor.ComponentType;

		public override bool IsReadOnly => underlyingDescriptor.IsReadOnly;

		public override Type PropertyType => underlyingDescriptor.PropertyType;

		public override TypeConverter Converter => underlyingDescriptor.Converter;

		public override AttributeCollection Attributes => underlyingDescriptor.Attributes;

		public CustomizeToolSurrogatePropertyDescriptor(PropertyDescriptor underlyingDescriptor, string name, ToolBase tool)
			: base(name, null)
		{
			this.underlyingDescriptor = underlyingDescriptor;
			this.tool = tool;
		}

		public override bool CanResetValue(object component)
		{
			return underlyingDescriptor.CanResetValue(tool);
		}

		public override object GetValue(object component)
		{
			return underlyingDescriptor.GetValue(tool);
		}

		public override void ResetValue(object component)
		{
			underlyingDescriptor.ResetValue(tool);
		}

		public override void SetValue(object component, object value)
		{
			underlyingDescriptor.SetValue(tool, value);
		}

		public override bool ShouldSerializeValue(object component)
		{
			return underlyingDescriptor.ShouldSerializeValue(tool);
		}
	}

	{
		private Label lblToolText;

		internal DescriptionToolTipDialog(string toolText, string toolDescription)
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			lblToolText.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DescToolTipDlgNewWebPage");
			lblToolDescription.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DescToolTipDlgNewBlankWeb");
			lblNoHelpTopic.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DescToolTipDlgNoHelp");
			if (ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(toolText) || ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(toolDescription))
			{
				lblNoHelpTopic.Visible = true;
				lblToolDescription.Visible = false;
				lblToolText.Visible = false;
				base.Size = new Size(base.Size.Width, lblNoHelpTopic.Top + lblNoHelpTopic.Bottom);
				return;
			}
			lblNoHelpTopic.Visible = false;
			lblToolDescription.Text = toolDescription;
			lblToolDescription.Visible = true;
			lblToolText.Text = toolText;
			lblToolText.Visible = true;
			Size size = MeasureString(toolDescription + "ggggg ggggg ggggg ggggg ggggg ggggg ggggg", lblToolDescription.Width, (GdiDrawStringFlags)(lblToolDescription.UseCompatibleTextRendering ? 4 : 8));
			lblToolDescription.Height = size.Height;
			base.Height = lblToolDescription.Bottom + lblToolText.Top + 1;
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				if (components != null)
				{
					components.Dispose();
				}
				if (shadowManager != null)
				{
					shadowManager.Hide();
					((DisposableObject)(object)shadowManager).Dispose();
				}
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		private Size MeasureString(string stringToMeasure, int width, GdiDrawStringFlags gdiDrawStringFlags)
		{
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Graphics cachedGraphics = DrawUtility.GetCachedGraphics((Control)this);
			StringFormat stringFormat = new StringFormat();
			stringFormat.HotkeyPrefix = HotkeyPrefix.None;
			Size result = DrawUtility.MeasureString(cachedGraphics, stringToMeasure, Font, width, stringFormat, gdiDrawStringFlags).ToSize();
			DrawUtility.ReleaseCachedGraphics(cachedGraphics);
			stringFormat.Dispose();
			return result;
		}

	internal class ToolbarListWrapper
	{
		private UltraToolbar toolbar;

		internal UltraToolbar Toolbar => toolbar;

		internal ToolbarListWrapper(UltraToolbar toolbar)
		{
			this.toolbar = toolbar;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			int num = 0;
			string text = toolbar.Text;
			if (text == null || text.Length < 1)
			{
				text = toolbar.Key;
			}
			while (num < text.Length)
			{
				int num2 = text.IndexOf("&", num);
				if (num2 < 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (num2 < text.Length - 1 && text.Substring(num2 + 1, 1) != " ")
				{
					text = text.Remove(num2, 1);
					num = num2;
				}
				else
				{
					num = num2 + 1;
				}
			}
			return text;
		}
	}

		internal CategoryWrapper(string categoryText, CategoryType categoryType)
		{
			this.categoryText = categoryText;
			this.categoryType = categoryType;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return categoryText;
		}

		int IComparable.CompareTo(object obj)
		{
			return string.Compare(ToString(), obj.ToString(), ignoreCase: false, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
		}
	}
	internal class ToolWrapper : IComparable
	{
		private ToolBase tool;

		private bool includeKeyInToString;

		private bool isSeparator;

		internal bool IsSeparator => isSeparator;

		internal bool IncludeKeyInToString
		{
			get
			{
				return includeKeyInToString;
			}
			set
			{
				includeKeyInToString = value;
			}
		}

		internal ToolBase Tool => tool;

		internal ToolWrapper(ToolBase tool)
		{
			this.tool = tool;
		}

		internal ToolWrapper(ToolBase tool, bool isSeparator)
		{
			this.tool = tool;
			this.isSeparator = isSeparator;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string text = tool.CustomizerCaptionResolved.Replace("&", string.Empty);
			if (includeKeyInToString)
			{
				text = text + "  [" + tool.Key + "]";
			}
			return text;
		}

		int IComparable.CompareTo(object obj)
		{
			return string.Compare(ToString(), obj.ToString(), ignoreCase: false, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
		}
	}
	internal class ShortcutWrapper
	{
		private Shortcut shortcut;

		internal Shortcut Shortcut => shortcut;

		internal ShortcutWrapper(Shortcut shortcut)
		{
			this.shortcut = shortcut;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (shortcut == Shortcut.None)
			{
				return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeShortcutNoneLiteral");
			}
			return ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetLocalizedShortcutString(shortcut);
		}
	}

	internal class ToolPlacementInfo
	{
		private const int IsVisibleOnMenusFlag = 1;

		private const int IsVisibleOnToolbarsFlag = 2;

		private const int IsVisibleOnVerticalToolbarsFlag = 4;

		private const int IsVisibleOnRibbonGroupFlag = 8;

		private const int RequiresOffice2007SupportFlag = 16;

		private const int IsVisibleOnQatFlag = 32;

		private int visibleState;

		private Guid toolId;

		private Type toolType;

		internal Guid ToolId => toolId;

		internal Type ToolType => toolType;

		internal bool IsVisibleOnMenus => (visibleState & 1) != 0;

		internal bool IsVisibleOnToolbars => (visibleState & 2) != 0;

		internal bool IsVisibleOnVerticalToolbars => (visibleState & 4) != 0;

		internal bool IsVisibleOnRibbonGroup => (visibleState & 8) != 0;

		internal bool RequiresOffice2007Support => (visibleState & 0x10) != 0;

		internal bool IsVisibleOnQat => (visibleState & 0x20) != 0;

		private ToolPlacementInfo(Guid toolId, bool isVisibleOnMenus, bool isVisibleOnToolbars, bool isVisibleOnVerticalToolbars, bool isVisibleOnRibbonGroup, bool isVisibleOnQat, Type toolType, bool requiresOffice2007Support)
		{
			this.toolId = toolId;
			this.toolType = toolType;
			if (isVisibleOnMenus)
			{
				visibleState |= 1;
			}
			if (isVisibleOnToolbars)
			{
				visibleState |= 2;
			}
			if (isVisibleOnVerticalToolbars)
			{
				visibleState |= 4;
			}
			if (isVisibleOnRibbonGroup)
			{
				visibleState |= 8;
			}
			if (requiresOffice2007Support)
			{
				visibleState |= 16;
			}
			if (isVisibleOnQat)
			{
				visibleState |= 32;
			}
		}

		internal static ToolPlacementInfo CreatePlacementInfo(ToolDefinition toolDefinition)
		{
			if (toolDefinition == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			ToolBase toolBase = toolDefinition.ToolProvider.CreateToolInstance(toolDefinition.ToolID, toolDefinition.InstanceNameBase);
			return new ToolPlacementInfo(toolDefinition.ToolID, toolBase?.IsVisibleOnMenus ?? false, toolBase?.IsVisibleOnToolbars ?? false, toolBase?.IsVisibleOnVerticalToolbars ?? false, toolBase?.IsVisibleOnRibbonGroup ?? false, toolBase?.CanAddToQuickAccessToolbar ?? false, toolBase?.GetType(), toolBase?.RequiresOffice2007Support ?? false);
		}
	}

		public class EditorToolBaseConverter : ExpandableObjectConverter
		{
			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					ConstructorInfo constructor = value.GetType().GetConstructor(new Type[1] { typeof(string) });
					EditorToolBase editorToolBase = (EditorToolBase)value;
					return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[1] { editorToolBase.Key }, isComplete: false);
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public bool IsInEditMode
		{
			get
			{
				return base.IsToolInEditMode;
			}
			set
			{
				if (IsInEditMode != value)
				{
					if (!Editor.CanEditType(EditType))
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException("The tool's editor does not support entering edit mode.");
					}
					if (value)
					{
						EnterEditMode(EnterEditModeSource.Unspecified, throwExceptions: true, ensureToolIsActive: true);
					}
					else
					{
						ExitEditMode(forceExit: false, applyChanges: true);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		{

				//IL_0044: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (base.IsVertical && !CanEditorDisplayVertical)
				{
					return CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstanceAsButton();
				}
				if (base.OwnerIsToolbarInternal && base.OwningToolbarInternal != null && !base.InstanceDisplaysText)
				{
					return base.MinimumSize;
				}
				AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
				AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)65011720;
				ResolveAppearance(editArea: true, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, DrawAsActive, IsPressed);
				Size empty = Size.Empty;
				string captionResolved = base.CaptionResolved;
				Size size;
				if (captionResolved != null && captionResolved.Length > 0)
				{
					size = MeasureString(ref appearance, null, captionResolved);
				}
				else
				{
					size = MeasureString(ref appearance, null, "Wy");
					size.Width = 0;
				}
				if (base.InstanceDisplaysText || base.OwnerIsMenu || base.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)
				{
					empty.Width += size.Width + 2;
				}
				empty.Height = size.Height;
				empty.Width += MinimumEditorExtent;
				return empty;
			}

		protected internal override Size CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstance()
		{
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			Size size;

			{
				size = MeasureString(ref appearance, null, captionResolved);
			}
			else
			{
				size = MeasureString(ref appearance, null, "Wy");
				size.Width = 0;
			}

			}
			else

				Size size2 = Size.Empty;
				if (base.InstanceDisplaysImage)
				{
					Image image = ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).GetImage(base.ImageList);
					if (image == null)
					{

					}

						if (base.IsVertical)

						}
						size2.Width += 4;
						size2.Height += 4;
						if (base.OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
						{
							size2.Width++;
						}
					}
				}
				if (captionResolved != null && captionResolved.Length > 0 && base.InstanceDisplaysText)
				{
					defaultSize.Width += size.Width + 2;
				}
				defaultSize.Width += size2.Width;

				}

				}
			}

		}

		protected override void OnAfterDraw(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)

		protected override void OnClick()
		{
			if (leftButtonDown && tool != null && ToolbarsManager != null && !ToolbarsManager.Customizing && !tool.IsToolInEditMode && !tool.CanEnterEditMode && tool.EnabledResolved)
			{
				tool.IncrementClickCount();
				tool.OnToolClick();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDoubleClick(bool adjustableArea)
		{
			if (tool is EditorToolBase editorToolBase && ToolbarsManager != null && !ToolbarsManager.Customizing && editorToolBase.CanRaiseToolDoubleClick)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.ToolDoubleClick, new ToolEventArgs(tool));
			}
			else
			{
				((UIElement)this).OnDoubleClick(adjustableArea);
			}
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e, bool adjustableArea, ref UIElement captureMouseForElement)
		{
			leftButtonDown = (e.Button & MouseButtons.Left) == MouseButtons.Left;
			if (ToolbarsManager == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ToolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (leftButtonDown)
			{
				if (tool != null && tool.CanEnterEditMode && (editorElement == null || !((UIElement)editorElement).Contains(new Point(e.X, e.Y))))
				{
					tool.EnterEditMode(EnterEditModeSource.ClickOnLabel, throwExceptions: false, ensureToolIsActive: true);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return ((UIElement)this).OnMouseDown(e, adjustableArea, ref captureMouseForElement);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter()
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager == null || ToolbarsManager.Customizing || (ToolbarsManager.ToolBeingEdited != null && ToolbarsManager.ToolBeingEdited != tool && !ToolbarsManager.CanHotTrackWhileInEditMode))
			{
				return;
			}
			tool.DisplayToolTip();
			if (!tool.CanActivate)
			{
				return;
			}
			ToolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(tool, setOn: true, clearToolBeingEdited: false);
			if (ToolbarsManager.ActiveTool == null || !ToolbarsManager.ActiveTool.Equals(tool))
			{
				return;
			}
			ToolbarsManager.AllowToolbarCaptureRelease = false;
			try
			{
				if (tool.OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
				{
					if (tool.OwningToolbarInternal.QuickCustomizeTool != null && tool.OwningToolbarInternal.QuickCustomizeTool.IsOpen)
					{
						tool.OwningToolbarInternal.QuickCustomizeTool.MenuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay: true);
					}
					else
					{
						tool.OwningToolbarInternal.CloseOpenSubmenuTools(tool, delay: true);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				ToolbarsManager.AllowToolbarCaptureRelease = true;
			}
			((UIElement)this).OnMouseEnter();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseHover()
		{
			ToolbarsManager.ImmediateToolTipDisplayMode = true;
			if (ToolbarsManager.ActiveTool == null)
			{
				tool.DisplayToolTip();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave()
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager == null || ToolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				return;
			}
			tool.ForceDrawAsActive = false;
			tool.HideToolTip();
			ToolbarsManager.ImmediateToolTipDisplayMode = false;
			if (tool.EnabledResolved && ToolbarsManager.ToolBeingEdited == null)
			{
				((UIElement)this).OnMouseLeave();
				if (tool.EnabledResolved && (ToolbarsManager.ActiveTool == tool || ToolbarsManager.ActiveTool == tool.UnderlyingTool))
				{
					tool.DeactivateToolUnlessOwnerHasCapture();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager != null && !ToolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				tool.DisplayToolTip();
				((UIElement)this).OnMouseMove(e);
			}
		}

				int num2 = toolBase.CalculateWidthResolved(useCalculateLogicalSize: false);
				if (num2 > 0)
				{
					num = num2;
				}
				if (num < ((UIElement)this).Rect.Width)
				{
					int num3 = ((UIElement)this).Rect.Width - num;
					rectInsideBorders.X += num3;
					rectInsideBorders.Width -= num3;
				}
			}
			((UIElement)editorElement).Rect = rectInsideBorders;
			((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)editorElement);
		}

		internal void InitializeElement(ToolBase tool)
		{
			((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext = tool;
			this.tool = tool;
		}
	}

	internal class EmptyMenuItem : MenuItemBase
	{
		private object owner;

		protected internal override bool CanActivate => false;

		protected internal override bool DisplayImage => false;

		protected internal override bool DisplayText => false;

		protected internal override bool DrawAsActive => false;

		protected internal override bool DrawAsPressed => false;

		protected internal override bool DrawStateUsingCheckmark => false;

		protected internal override bool Enabled => false;

		protected internal override bool IsFirstInGroup => false;

		protected internal override bool RecentlyUsed => true;

		protected internal override string ShortcutText => string.Empty;

		protected internal override Size Size
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0097: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_009c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				Size result = new Size(0, 0);
				Size imageSize = base.MenuAgent.GetImageSize(this);
				result.Width = base.MenuAgent.Metrics.MenuitemTextPaddingLeft;
				if (base.MenuAgent.ShouldShowImages(this))
				{
					result.Width += imageSize.Width + (base.MenuAgent.Metrics.MenuitemImagePaddingLeft + base.MenuAgent.Metrics.MenuitemImagePaddingRight);
				}
				if (ToolbarsManager.IsNonOffice2000Style)
				{
					result.Width += 2;
				}
				else
				{
					UIElementBorderWidths val = ToolbarsManager.CalculateBorderWidths((UIElementBorderStyle)6);
					result.Width += ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Left + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Right;
				}
				result.Height += imageSize.Height + 2 * base.MenuAgent.Metrics.MenuitemPaddingTopBottom + 2 * base.MenuAgent.Metrics.MenuItemBorderThickness;
				return result;
			}
		}

		protected internal override string Text => string.Empty;

		public override UIRole UIRole
		{
			get
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager != null)
				{
					return StyleUtils.GetRole(toolbarsManager, StyleUtils.Role.MenuItem);
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal object Owner => owner;

		public EmptyMenuItem(object owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
		}

		protected internal override void DropDown(Control owningControl, Point point, Rectangle exclusionRect, DropDownPosition dropDownPosition, bool delay, bool closeIfAlreadyOpen, bool alignRight, bool autocloseDropdown)
		{
		}

		protected internal override void OnClick()
		{
		}

		protected override UIElement GetMenuUIElement(UIElement parentElement, UIElement previousElement)
		{
			if (previousElement == null)
			{
				return (UIElement)(object)new EmptyMenuItemUIElement(parentElement, ToolbarsManager, this);
			}
			((EmptyMenuItemUIElement)(object)previousElement).InitializeElement(this);
			return previousElement;
		}

		protected internal override Type GetMenuUIElementType()
		{
			return typeof(EmptyMenuItemUIElement);
		}

		internal override bool IsSameMenuItem(MenuItemBase menuItem)
		{
			if (menuItem is EmptyMenuItem emptyMenuItem)
			{
				return emptyMenuItem.owner.Equals(owner);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override void ResolveAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, bool drawAsActive)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (base.MenuAgent is ApplicationMenuAgent applicationMenuAgent)
			{
				if (applicationMenuAgent.GetMenuItems(this) == applicationMenuAgent.MenuItemsLeft)
				{
					applicationMenuAgent.ApplicationMenu.ToolAreaLeft.ResolveAppearance(UIRole, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
				else
				{
					applicationMenuAgent.ApplicationMenu.ToolAreaRight.ResolveAppearance(UIRole, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
				flag = true;
			}
			MenuAgentBase menuAgent = base.MenuAgent;
			PopupToolAgentBase popupToolAgentBase = menuAgent as PopupToolAgentBase;
			if (menuAgent is BackStageMenuAgent || (popupToolAgentBase != null && popupToolAgentBase.IsOnBackStage))
			{
				if (((ulong)requestedProps & 1uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)1))
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = Color.Transparent;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEuL);
				}
				if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x10000000uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)268435456))
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackGradientStyle = (GradientStyle)1;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFEFFFFFFFuL);
				}
			}
			if (!flag && ToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.ResolvePopupAppearance(base.MenuAgent.TearawayTool, UIRole, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			}
		}

		protected internal override Size GetTextAreaSize(int widthConstraint)
		{
			return Size.Empty;
		}
	}

		}

	public class EmptyToolbarToolUIElement : UIElement, IProvideToolCustomizeInfo
	{
		private UltraToolbarBase owningToolbar;

		public UltraToolbarsManager ToolbarsManager
		{
			get
			{
				if (((UIElement)this).GetAncestor(typeof(ToolbarUIElement)) is ToolbarUIElement toolbarUIElement)
				{
					return toolbarUIElement.ToolbarsManager;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal UltraToolbarBase Toolbar
		{
			get
			{
				if (((UIElement)this).GetAncestor(typeof(ToolbarUIElement)) is ToolbarUIElement toolbarUIElement)
				{
					return toolbarUIElement.ToolbarInternal;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		bool IProvideToolCustomizeInfo.OwnerIsMenu => false;

		bool IProvideToolCustomizeInfo.OwnerIsToolbar => true;

		PopupMenuTool IProvideToolCustomizeInfo.OwningMenu => null;

		UltraToolbar IProvideToolCustomizeInfo.OwningToolbar => Toolbar as UltraToolbar;

		UIElement IProvideToolCustomizeInfo.UIElement => (UIElement)(object)this;

		object IProvideToolCustomizeInfo.Owner => Toolbar;

		internal EmptyToolbarToolUIElement(UIElement parent, UltraToolbarBase owningToolbar)
			: base(parent)
		{
			this.owningToolbar = owningToolbar;
		}

		protected override void DrawForeground(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			((UIElement)this).DrawForeground(ref drawParams);
			if (ToolbarsManager.ShouldDisplayInsertionPoint(null, (UIElement)(object)this))
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager.DrawToolDragInsertionPoint(!owningToolbar.IsVertical, ToolbarsManager.DrawInsertionPointAtFarEnd, (UIElement)(object)this, ref drawParams);
			}
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = Color.Transparent;
			requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEuL);
			((UIElement)this).InitAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		internal void InitializeElement(UltraToolbarBase owningToolbar)
		{
			this.owningToolbar = owningToolbar;
		}
	}

	public class ToolbarsEventManager : EventManagerBase
	{
		private static int[] beforeEventIndexes;

		private static int[] afterEventIndexes;

		private static int[] AfterEventIndexes
		{
			get
			{
				if (afterEventIndexes == null)
				{
					afterEventIndexes = new int[23]
					{
						2, 3, 4, 7, 5, 6, 15, 25, 28, 31,
						33, 36, 40, 41, 49, 48, 46, 45, 56, 57,
						60, 65, 64
					};
				}
				return afterEventIndexes;
			}
		}

		private static int[] BeforeEventIndexes
		{
			get
			{
				if (beforeEventIndexes == null)
				{
					beforeEventIndexes = new int[20]
					{
						8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 24, 27, 29,
						30, 32, 35, 42, 47, 44, 55, 58, 59, 63
					};
				}
				return beforeEventIndexes;
			}
		}

		public ToolbarsEventManager(UltraToolbarsManager manager)
			: base(75)
		{
		}

		public bool InProgress(ToolbarEventIds eventid)
		{
			return InProgress((int)eventid);
		}

		public bool IsEnabled(ToolbarEventIds eventid)
		{
			return IsEnabled((int)eventid);
		}

		public void SetEnabled(ToolbarEventIds eventid, bool enabled)
		{
			SetEnabled((int)eventid, enabled);
		}

		public bool IsEnabled(EventGroups group)
		{
			return group switch
			{
				EventGroups.AllEvents => base.AllEventsEnabled, 
				EventGroups.BeforeEvents => IsEnabled(BeforeEventIndexes), 
				EventGroups.AfterEvents => IsEnabled(AfterEventIndexes), 
				_ => false, 
			};
		}

		public void SetEnabled(EventGroups group, bool enabled)
		{
			switch (group)
			{
			case EventGroups.AllEvents:
				base.AllEventsEnabled = enabled;
				break;
			case EventGroups.BeforeEvents:
				SetEnabled(BeforeEventIndexes, enabled);
				break;
			case EventGroups.AfterEvents:
				SetEnabled(AfterEventIndexes, enabled);
				break;
			}
		}

		internal void IncrementInProgress(ToolbarEventIds eventid)
		{
			IncrementInProgress((int)eventid);
		}

		internal void DecrementInProgress(ToolbarEventIds eventid)
		{
			DecrementInProgress((int)eventid);
		}

		internal bool CanFireEvent(ToolbarEventIds eventid)
		{
			return IsEnabled(eventid);
		}
	}

	public class GalleryPreviewButtonAreaUIElement : UIElement
	{
		public override Border3DSide BorderSides => Border3DSide.Top | Border3DSide.Right | Border3DSide.Bottom;

		public override UIElementBorderStyle BorderStyle => (UIElementBorderStyle)4;

		private PopupGalleryTool GalleryTool => ((UIElement)this).GetContext() as PopupGalleryTool;

		private UltraToolbarsManager ToolbarsManager => GalleryTool?.ToolbarsManager;

		public GalleryPreviewButtonAreaUIElement(UIElement parentElement)
			: base(parentElement)
		{
		}

		protected override void DrawBackColor(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			((UIElement)this).DrawBackColor(ref drawParams);
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ToolbarStyle styleResolved = toolbarsManager.StyleResolved;
			if ((int)styleResolved != 7 && (int)styleResolved != 8)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)this).Rect;
			Rectangle rect2 = new Rectangle(rect.X - 1, rect.Y, 4, rect.Height);
			using LinearGradientBrush brush = new LinearGradientBrush(rect2, Color.FromArgb(45, Color.Black), Color.FromArgb(0, Color.Black), LinearGradientMode.Horizontal);
			Rectangle rect3 = new Rectangle(rect.X, rect.Y, 3, rect.Height);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.FillRectangle(brush, rect3);
		}

					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEuL);

		{

				{
				case "AccessibleDescription":
					accessibleDescription = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), null);
					break;
				case "AccessibleName":
					accessibleName = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), null);
					break;
				case "Items":
					items = (GalleryToolItemKeysCollection)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(GalleryToolItemKeysCollection), null);
					break;
				case "ItemSettings":
					itemSettings = (GalleryToolItemSettings)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(GalleryToolItemSettings), null);
					break;
				case "Key":
					Key = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), null);
					break;
				case "Settings":
					settings = (GalleryToolItemGroupSettings)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(GalleryToolItemGroupSettings), null);
					break;
				case "Tag":
					DeserializeTag(current);
					break;
				case "Text":
					text = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), null);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		void IDeserializationCallback.OnDeserialization(object sender)
		{
			if (items != null)
			{
				items.Initialize(this);
				items.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (itemSettings != null)
			{
				itemSettings.Initialize(this);
				itemSettings.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (settings != null)
			{
				settings.Initialize(this);
				settings.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			OnDeserialization(sender);
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (items != null)
			{
				items.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				items.Dispose();
				items = null;
			}
			if (itemSettings != null)
			{
				itemSettings.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				itemSettings.Dispose();
				itemSettings = null;
			}
			if (settings != null)
			{
				settings.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				settings.Dispose();
				settings = null;
			}
			galleryTool = null;
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (items == propChange.Source)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Items, propChange);
			}
			else if (itemSettings == propChange.Source)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ItemSettings, propChange);
			}
			else if (settings == propChange.Source)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Settings, propChange);
			}
		}

			{
				stringBuilder.Append(this.text);
				flag = true;
			}
			string text = Key;
			if (text != null && text.Length > 0)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(" - [");
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append("[");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(Key);
				stringBuilder.Append("]");
			}
			else
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(" ");
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal int GetColumnsInRow(int row)
		{
			int columns = GetColumns();
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			foreach (GalleryToolItem item in (IEnumerable)Items)
			{
				if (num2 != 0 && num2 + item.ColumnSpan > columns)
				{
					if (num == row)
					{
						return num2;
					}
					num2 = 0;
					num++;
				}
				num2 += item.ColumnSpan;
			}
			return num2;
		}

		internal int GetRequiredHeight(int width, bool cacheWidth)
		{
			if (cacheWidth || cachedGroupWidth == 0)
			{
				cachedGroupWidth = width;
			}
			int num = GalleryTool.ItemSizeInDropDownResolved.Height + GalleryTool.ItemPadding.Height;
			return (ShowHeaderResolved ? HeaderHeight : 0) + Items.GetRows(GetColumns(width)) * num + GalleryTool.GroupItemAreaPadding.Height;
		}

		internal GalleryToolItem.ItemLocationInfo NavigateFromItem(GalleryToolItem.ItemLocationInfo startLocation, NavigationAction direction, int startingColumn, bool wrapAround)
		{
			if (!isFilteredIn)
			{
				return null;
			}
			GalleryToolItem galleryToolItem = items.NavigateFromItem(startLocation.Item, direction, startingColumn, wrapAround, GetColumns());
			if (galleryToolItem == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new GalleryToolItem.ItemLocationInfo(galleryToolItem, startLocation.GalleryInstance, this, startLocation.ItemLocation);
		}

			foreach (GalleryToolItem item in (IEnumerable)Items)
