				if (num2 != 0 && num2 + item.ColumnSpan > columns)
				{
					num2 = 0;
					num++;
				}
				if (num == row && num2 + item.ColumnSpan >= column + 1)
				{
					SetActiveItem(item, galleryInstance, itemLocation);
					break;
				}
				num2 += item.ColumnSpan;
			}
		}

		internal void SetActiveItem(GalleryToolItem item, PopupGalleryTool galleryInstance, GalleryArea itemLocation)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				SetContainsActiveItem(galleryInstance, containsActiveItem: false, itemLocation);
			}
			else if (Items.Contains(item))
			{
				SetContainsActiveItem(galleryInstance, containsActiveItem: true, itemLocation);
				galleryInstance.SetActiveItemInternal(item, itemLocation);
			}
		}

		private void SetContainsActiveItem(PopupGalleryTool galleryInstance, bool containsActiveItem, GalleryArea itemLocation)
		{
			if (this.containsActiveItem != containsActiveItem)
			{
				this.containsActiveItem = containsActiveItem;
				if (this.containsActiveItem)
				{
					galleryInstance.SetGroupWithActiveItem(this, itemLocation);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void SetIsFilteredInInternal(bool value)
		{
			isFilteredIn = value;
		}

		internal void UnhookAllSubObjects()
		{
			if (items != null)
			{
				items.UnhookAllSubObjects();
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyNotOwned()
		{
			if (ParentCollection != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("This group is already owned by another collection.");
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual GalleryToolItemGroup Clone()
		{
			GalleryToolItemGroup galleryToolItemGroup = new GalleryToolItemGroup(Key, text);
			galleryToolItemGroup.InitializeFrom(this);
			return galleryToolItemGroup;
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		protected virtual void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeAccessibleDescription())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "AccessibleDescription", accessibleDescription);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeAccessibleName())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "AccessibleName", accessibleName);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeItems())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Items", items);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeItemSettings())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ItemSettings", itemSettings);
			}
			if (base.ShouldSerializeKey())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Key", Key);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeSettings())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Settings", settings);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				SerializeTag(info);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeText())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Text", text);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeFrom(GalleryToolItemGroup group)
		{
			accessibleDescription = group.accessibleDescription;
			accessibleName = group.accessibleName;
			isFilteredIn = group.isFilteredIn;
			if (group.items != null)
			{
				items = group.items.Clone(this);
				items.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (group.itemSettings != null)
			{
				itemSettings = group.itemSettings.Clone(this);
				itemSettings.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (group.settings != null)
			{
				settings = group.settings.Clone(this);
				settings.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnDeserialization(object sender)
		{
		}

		private int GetColumns()
		{
			return GetColumns(cachedGroupWidth);
		}

		private int GetColumns(int width)
		{
			PopupGalleryTool popupGalleryTool = GalleryTool;
			Size size = new Size(popupGalleryTool.ItemSizeInDropDownResolved.Width + popupGalleryTool.ItemPadding.Width, popupGalleryTool.ItemSizeInDropDownResolved.Height + popupGalleryTool.ItemPadding.Height);
			int num = width - popupGalleryTool.GroupItemAreaPadding.Width;
			if (size.Width == 0)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return Math.Max(num / size.Width, 1);
		}

		private UIElement GetUIElementInDropDown(PopupGalleryTool galleryInstance)
		{
			UIElement dropDownItemAreaUIElement = (UIElement)(object)galleryInstance.DropDownItemAreaUIElement;
			if (dropDownItemAreaUIElement == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return dropDownItemAreaUIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(PopupGalleryGroupUIElement), (object)this);
		}

	public class GalleryToolItem : KeyedSubObjectBase, ISerializable, IDeserializationCallback, INotificationBadgeProvider, INotificationBadgeSettingsOwner
	{
		internal class GalleryToolItemUiaProviderStub : FragmentUIAProviderStubWithParent, IInvokeProvider, IScrollItemProvider
		{
			private bool previewOnRibbon;

			internal int Index => Item.Index;

			internal GalleryToolItem Item => ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)this).Context as GalleryToolItem;

			private UIElement UIElement
			{
				get
				{
					if (previewOnRibbon)
					{
						return (((FragmentUIAProviderStub)this).GetParentStub() as PopupGalleryTool.PopupGalleryToolUiaProviderStub.RibbonGalleryPreviewAreaUiaProviderStub).GetItemUIElement(Item);
					}
					return (((FragmentUIAProviderStub)this).GetParentStub() as GalleryToolItemGroup.GalleryToolItemGroupUiaProviderStub).GetItemUIElement(Item);
				}
			}

			internal GalleryToolItemUiaProviderStub(GalleryToolItem item, bool previewOnRibbon, FragmentUIAProviderStub parent)
				: base((object)item, parent)
			{
				this.previewOnRibbon = previewOnRibbon;
			}

			protected override string CreateAutomationId()
			{
				return $"GalleryTool Item : {Item.Key} - Index : {Index} ";
			}

			public override Rectangle GetBoundingRectangle()
			{
				UIElement uIElement = UIElement;
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					return uIElement.Control.RectangleToScreen(uIElement.Rect);
				}
				return Rectangle.Empty;
			}

			public override ControlType GetControlType()
			{
				return ControlType.MenuItem;
			}

			protected override string GetDefaultName()
			{
				return Item.Title;
			}

			public override IRawElementProviderFragmentRoot GetFragmentRoot()
			{
				return ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)this).GetParent()?.FragmentRoot;
			}

			protected override bool GetIsEnabled()
			{
				return true;
			}

			protected override bool GetIsKeyboardFocusable()
			{
				return false;
			}

			protected override bool GetIsOffscreen(out bool isOffScreen)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = UIElement;
				isOffScreen = uIElement == null;
				return true;
			}

			protected override Control GetMarshallingControl()
			{
				return Utilities.GetMarshallingControl(((FragmentUIAProviderStub)this).GetParent());
			}

			void IInvokeProvider.Invoke()
			{
				if (UIElement.GetContext(typeof(PopupGalleryTool)) is PopupGalleryTool popupGalleryTool)
				{
					popupGalleryTool.ClickItem(Item, null, previewOnRibbon ? GalleryArea.Preview : GalleryArea.DropDown);
				}
			}

			void IScrollItemProvider.ScrollIntoView()
			{
				FragmentUIAProviderStub parentStub = ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)this).GetParentStub();
				PopupGalleryTool popupGalleryTool = null;
				GalleryToolItemGroup owningGroup = null;
				if (previewOnRibbon)
				{
					PopupGalleryTool.PopupGalleryToolUiaProviderStub popupGalleryToolUiaProviderStub = Utilities.GetStub(parentStub.GetParent()) as PopupGalleryTool.PopupGalleryToolUiaProviderStub;
					popupGalleryTool = popupGalleryToolUiaProviderStub.PopupGalleryTool;
				}
				else
				{
					owningGroup = (parentStub as GalleryToolItemGroup.GalleryToolItemGroupUiaProviderStub).Group;
					GalleryToolMenuItem.GalleryToolMenuItemUiaProviderStub galleryToolMenuItemUiaProviderStub = Utilities.GetStub(Utilities.GetStub(parentStub.GetParent()).GetParent()) as GalleryToolMenuItem.GalleryToolMenuItemUiaProviderStub;
					popupGalleryTool = galleryToolMenuItemUiaProviderStub.PopupGalleryToolInstance;
				}
				if (popupGalleryTool != null)
				{
					Item.BringIntoView(popupGalleryTool, owningGroup, previewOnRibbon ? GalleryArea.Preview : GalleryArea.DropDown);
				}
			}
		}

		public class GalleryToolItemAccessibleObject : AccessibleObjectWrapper
		{
			private GalleryToolItem item;

			private PopupGalleryTool galleryInstance;

			private GalleryToolItemGroup group;

			private GalleryArea itemLocation;

			public override Rectangle Bounds
			{
				get
				{
					UIElement uIElement = item.GetUIElement(galleryInstance, group, itemLocation);
					if (uIElement == null || uIElement.Control == null)
					{
						return Rectangle.Empty;
					}
					return uIElement.Control.RectangleToScreen(uIElement.Rect);
				}
			}

			protected override bool CanPerformDefaultAction => true;

			public override string DefaultAction => galleryInstance.ItemStyle switch
			{
				ItemStyle.Button => Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("GalleryItemButtonDefaultAction"), 
				ItemStyle.StateButton => Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("GalleryItemStateButtonDefaultAction"), 
				_ => null, 
			};

			public override string Description
			{
				get
				{
					string accessibleDescription = item.AccessibleDescription;
					if (accessibleDescription != null && accessibleDescription.Length > 0)
					{
						return accessibleDescription;
					}
					accessibleDescription = item.ToolTipText;
					if (accessibleDescription != null && accessibleDescription.Length > 0)
					{
						return accessibleDescription;
					}
					return item.Title;
				}
			}

			public override string Name
			{
				get
				{
					string name = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name;
					if (name != null && name.Length > 0)
					{
						return name;
					}
					return item.AccessibleNameResolved;
				}
				set
				{
					((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name = value;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Parent => galleryInstance.GetAccessibleObject(itemLocation);

			public override AccessibleRole Role => AccessibleRole.ListItem;

			public override AccessibleStates State
			{
				get
				{
					AccessibleStates accessibleStates = AccessibleStates.None;
					accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Focusable;
					item.GetStateFlags(galleryInstance, group, itemLocation, mouseDownAndHasntLeft: false, out var active, out var pressed, out var selected);
					if (active)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Focused;
					}
					if (pressed)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Pressed;
					}
					if (selected)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Checked;
					}
					return accessibleStates;
				}
			}

			public GalleryToolItemAccessibleObject(GalleryToolItem item, PopupGalleryTool galleryInstance, GalleryToolItemGroup group, GalleryArea itemLocation)
			{
				this.item = item;
				this.galleryInstance = galleryInstance;
				this.group = group;
				this.itemLocation = itemLocation;
			}

			public override void DoDefaultAction()
			{
				galleryInstance.ClickItem(item, group, itemLocation);
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
			{
				return null;
			}

			public override int GetChildCount()
			{
				return 0;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetFocused()
			{
				if ((((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).State & AccessibleStates.Focused) != AccessibleStates.None)
				{
					return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).AccessibleObject;
				}
				return null;
			}

			protected override Control GetMarshallingControl()
			{
				return galleryInstance.ToolbarsManagerInControl?.DockWithinContainer;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetSelected()
			{
				return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).GetFocused();
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				if (itemLocation == GalleryArea.DropDown && !galleryInstance.IsOpen)
				{
					return null;
				}
				NavigationAction navigationAction;
				switch (navdir)
				{
				case AccessibleNavigation.Down:
					navigationAction = NavigationAction.Down;
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Left:
					navigationAction = NavigationAction.Left;
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Right:
					navigationAction = NavigationAction.Right;
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Up:
					navigationAction = NavigationAction.Up;
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Next:
					return item.GetNextItem(galleryInstance, group, itemLocation);
				case AccessibleNavigation.Previous:
				{
					AccessibleObject previousItem = item.GetPreviousItem(galleryInstance, group, itemLocation);
					if (previousItem != null)
					{
						return previousItem;
					}
					if (galleryInstance.ShowFilterBarResolved)
					{
						return galleryInstance.FilterBarAccessibleObject;
					}
					return null;
				}
				case AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild:
				case AccessibleNavigation.LastChild:
					return null;
				default:
					return null;
				}
				object obj = galleryInstance.TryNavigate(new ItemLocationInfo(item, galleryInstance, group, itemLocation), navigationAction, wrapAround: false);
				if (obj == null)
				{
					return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).AccessibleObject;
				}
				if (obj is GalleryToolItemGroupFilter)
				{
					return galleryInstance.FilterBarAccessibleObject;
				}
				if (obj is ItemLocationInfo itemLocationInfo)
				{
					return itemLocationInfo.Item.AccessibleObjects.GetAccessibleObject(itemLocationInfo.GalleryInstance, itemLocationInfo.Group, itemLocationInfo.ItemLocation);
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override void Select(AccessibleSelection flags)
			{
				if ((flags & (AccessibleSelection.TakeFocus | AccessibleSelection.TakeSelection | AccessibleSelection.ExtendSelection | AccessibleSelection.AddSelection)) != AccessibleSelection.None)
				{
					switch (itemLocation)
					{
					case GalleryArea.DropDown:
						if (galleryInstance.IsOpen)
						{
							galleryInstance.MenuAgent.CloseOpenSubmenuTools(null, delay: false);
							if (galleryInstance.CanActivateItem(item, group, itemLocation))
							{
								group.SetActiveItem(item, galleryInstance, itemLocation);
								((UIElement)galleryInstance.DropDownItemAreaUIElement).DirtyChildElements();
							}
						}
						break;
					case GalleryArea.Preview:
						if (galleryInstance.CanActivateItem(item, group, itemLocation))
						{
							group.SetActiveItem(item, galleryInstance, itemLocation);
							galleryInstance.PreviewUIElement.DirtyChildElements();
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				else if ((flags & AccessibleSelection.RemoveSelection) != AccessibleSelection.None)
				{
					galleryInstance.ClearActiveItem(leftItemArea: false, itemLocation);
				}
			}
		}

		internal class GalleryToolItemAccessibleObjectDictionary
		{
			private GalleryToolItem item;

			private Hashtable previewItems;

			private Hashtable dropDownItems;

			private Hashtable DropDownItems
			{
				get
				{
					if (dropDownItems == null)
					{
						dropDownItems = new Hashtable();
					}
					return dropDownItems;
				}
			}

			private Hashtable PreviewItems
			{
				get
				{
					if (previewItems == null)
					{
						previewItems = new Hashtable();
					}
					return previewItems;
				}
			}

			public GalleryToolItemAccessibleObjectDictionary(GalleryToolItem item)
			{
				this.item = item;
			}

			public AccessibleObject GetAccessibleObject(PopupGalleryTool galleryInstance, GalleryToolItemGroup group, GalleryArea itemLocation)
			{
				switch (itemLocation)
				{
				case GalleryArea.DropDown:
				{
					Hashtable hashtable = GetDropDownItems(galleryInstance);
					if (hashtable.ContainsKey(group))
					{
						return (AccessibleObject)hashtable[group];
					}
					AccessibleObject accessibleObject2 = item.CreateAccessibleObject(galleryInstance, group, itemLocation);
					hashtable.Add(group, accessibleObject2);
					return accessibleObject2;
				}
				case GalleryArea.Preview:
				{
					if (PreviewItems.ContainsKey(galleryInstance))
					{
						return (AccessibleObject)PreviewItems[galleryInstance];
					}
					AccessibleObject accessibleObject = item.CreateAccessibleObject(galleryInstance, null, itemLocation);
					PreviewItems.Add(galleryInstance, accessibleObject);
					return accessibleObject;
				}
				default:
					return null;
				}
			}

			private Hashtable GetDropDownItems(PopupGalleryTool galleryInstance)
			{
				if (DropDownItems.ContainsKey(galleryInstance))
				{
					return (Hashtable)DropDownItems[galleryInstance];
				}
				Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable();
				DropDownItems.Add(galleryInstance, hashtable);
				return hashtable;
			}
		}

		public class GalleryToolItemConverter : ExpandableObjectConverter
		{
			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(GalleryToolItem).GetConstructor(new Type[1] { typeof(string) });
					GalleryToolItem galleryToolItem = (GalleryToolItem)value;
					return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[1] { galleryToolItem.Key }, isComplete: false);
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		internal int Index
		{
			get
			{
				GalleryToolItemCollection parentCollection = ParentCollection;
				if (parentCollection == null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (cachedIndex < 0 || cachedIndex >= parentCollection.Count || this != parentCollection[cachedIndex])
				{
					cachedIndex = parentCollection.IndexOf(this);
				}
				return cachedIndex;
			}
		}

			: this(key, key)
		{
		}

			: base(key)
		{
			this.title = title;
		}

		protected GalleryToolItem(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "AccessibleDescription":
					accessibleDescription = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), null);
					break;
				case "AccessibleName":
					accessibleName = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), null);
					break;
				case "ColumnSpan":
					columnSpan = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), 1);
					break;
				case "Description":
					description = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), "");
					formattedDescription = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ParseFormattedText(description, throwError: false);
					break;
				case "Key":
					base.Key = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), base.Key);
					break;
				case "Settings":
					settings = (GalleryToolItemSettings)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(GalleryToolItemSettings), null);
					break;
				case "Tag":
					DeserializeTag(current);
					break;
				case "Title":
					title = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), title);
					break;
				case "ToolTipText":
					toolTipText = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), toolTipText);
					break;
				case "ToolTipTextFormatted":
					toolTipTextFormatted = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), toolTipTextFormatted);
					break;
				case "ToolTipTitle":
					toolTipTitle = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), toolTipTitle);
					break;
				case "NotificationBadgeSettings":
					notificationBadgeSettings = (ToolNotificationBadgeSettings)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ToolNotificationBadgeSettings), notificationBadgeSettings);
					break;
				case "NotificationBadgeText":
					notificationBadgeText = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), notificationBadgeText);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			GetObjectData(info, context);
		}

		void IDeserializationCallback.OnDeserialization(object sender)
		{
			if (settings != null)
			{
				settings.Initialize(this);
				settings.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (notificationBadgeSettings != null)
			{
				((SubObjectBase)(object)notificationBadgeSettings).SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			OnDeserialization(sender);
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (settings != null)
			{
				settings.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				settings.Dispose();
				settings = null;
			}
			if (notificationBadgeSettings != null)
			{
				((SubObjectBase)(object)notificationBadgeSettings).SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				((DisposableObject)(object)notificationBadgeSettings).Dispose();
				notificationBadgeSettings = null;
			}
			if (notificationBadgeSettingsResolved != null)
			{
				((NotificationBadgeSettingsResolved)notificationBadgeSettingsResolved).Dispose();
				notificationBadgeSettingsResolved = null;
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (settings == propChange.Source)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Settings, propChange);
			}
			else if (((INotificationBadgeSettingsOwner)this).HasNotificationBadgeSettings && NotificationBadgeSettings == propChange.Source)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.NotificationBadgeSettings, propChange);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override bool ShouldSerializeKey()
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			bool flag = false;
			if (title != null && title.Length > 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(title);
				flag = true;
			}
			string text = Key;
			if (text != null && text.Length > 0)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(" - [");
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append("[");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(Key);
				stringBuilder.Append("]");
			}
			else
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(" ");
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public void BringIntoView(PopupGalleryTool galleryInstance, GalleryToolItemGroup owningGroup, GalleryArea itemLocation)
		{
			switch (itemLocation)
			{
			case GalleryArea.DropDown:
				BringIntoViewInDropDown(galleryInstance, owningGroup);
				break;
			case GalleryArea.Preview:
				BringIntoViewInPreview(galleryInstance);
				break;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("InvalidGalleryArea"), "itemLocation");
			}
		}

		public UIElement GetUIElement(PopupGalleryTool galleryInstance, GalleryToolItemGroup owningGroup, GalleryArea itemLocation)
		{
			return (UIElement)(itemLocation switch
			{
				GalleryArea.DropDown => GetUIElementInDropDown(galleryInstance, owningGroup), 
				GalleryArea.Preview => GetUIElementInPreview(galleryInstance), 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("InvalidGalleryArea"), "itemLocation"), 
			});
		}

		internal Size CalculateCellSizeRequired(GalleryToolItemGroup owningGroup, bool showText)
		{
			Size result = CalculateItemSizeRequired(owningGroup, showText);
			if (columnSpan == 1)
			{
				return result;
			}
			int width = result.Width;
			width -= GalleryTool.ItemPadding.Width * (columnSpan - 1);
			width = (width - 1) / columnSpan + 1;
			return new Size(width, result.Height);
		}

		internal void GetStateFlags(PopupGalleryTool galleryInstance, GalleryToolItemGroup group, GalleryArea itemLocation, bool mouseDownAndHasntLeft, out bool active, out bool pressed, out bool selected)
		{
			active = IsActive(galleryInstance, group, itemLocation);
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = galleryInstance.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null || toolbarsManager.Customizing || !galleryInstance.CanHotTrackItems)
			{
				active = false;
			}
			if (active && itemLocation == GalleryArea.Preview && galleryInstance.OwnerIsRibbonGroup && !galleryInstance.OwningRibbonGroup.CanHotTrack)
			{
				active = false;
			}
			pressed = active && mouseDownAndHasntLeft;
			selected = IsSelected;
		}

		protected internal virtual void ResolveAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, UIRole itemUIRole, GalleryToolItemGroup owningGroup, bool drawAsSelected, bool drawAsPressed, bool drawAsActive)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ResolutionOrderInfo roi = StyleUtils.GetResolutionOrder(GalleryTool.ToolbarsManager);
			if (drawAsActive && drawAsSelected)
			{
				ResolveHotTrackSelectedAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, itemUIRole, owningGroup, ref roi);
			}
			if (drawAsPressed)
			{
				ResolvePressedAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, itemUIRole, owningGroup, ref roi);
			}
			if (drawAsSelected)
			{
				ResolveSelectedAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, itemUIRole, owningGroup, ref roi);
			}
			if (drawAsActive)
			{
				ResolveHotTrackAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, itemUIRole, owningGroup, ref roi);
			}
			ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, itemUIRole, owningGroup, ref roi);
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeFrom(GalleryToolItem item)
		{
			accessibleDescription = item.accessibleDescription;
			accessibleName = item.accessibleName;
			columnSpan = item.columnSpan;
			description = item.description;
			formattedDescription = item.formattedDescription;
			isSelected = item.isSelected;
			if (item.settings != null)
			{
				settings = item.settings.Clone(this);
				settings.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			title = item.title;
			toolTipText = item.toolTipText;
			toolTipTextFormatted = item.toolTipTextFormatted;
			toolTipTitle = item.toolTipTitle;
			if (item.ShouldSerializeNotificationBadgeSettings())
			{
				notificationBadgeSettings = (ToolNotificationBadgeSettings)((NotificationBadgeSettings)item.notificationBadgeSettings).Clone();
				((SubObjectBase)(object)notificationBadgeSettings).SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			notificationBadgeText = item.notificationBadgeText;
		}

		private void BringIntoViewInPreview(PopupGalleryTool galleryInstance)
		{
			if (!galleryInstance.IsPreviewVisible)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CantBringIntoViewIfPreviewHidden"));
			}
			galleryInstance.BringIntoView();
			galleryInstance.PreviewInfo.BringIntoView(this);
		}

		private void BringIntoViewInDropDown(PopupGalleryTool galleryInstance, GalleryToolItemGroup owningGroup)
		{
			if (!galleryInstance.IsOpen)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CantBringIntoViewIfDropDownClosed"));
			}
			if (owningGroup == null)
			{
				if (galleryInstance.Groups.Count > 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("OwningGroupNeededWhenGalleryHasGroups"), "owningGroup");
				}
				owningGroup = galleryInstance.DefaultGroup;
			}
			UIElement dropDownItemAreaUIElement = (UIElement)(object)galleryInstance.DropDownItemAreaUIElement;
			if (dropDownItemAreaUIElement != null)
			{
				PopupGalleryGroupAreaUIElement popupGalleryGroupAreaUIElement = (PopupGalleryGroupAreaUIElement)(object)dropDownItemAreaUIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(PopupGalleryGroupAreaUIElement));
				if (popupGalleryGroupAreaUIElement != null)
				{
					galleryInstance.MenuAgent.ActivateMenuItem(galleryInstance.ItemAreaMenuItem);
					popupGalleryGroupAreaUIElement.ScrollIntoView(owningGroup, owningGroup.GetVirtualLocation(this).Y);
				}
			}
		}

		private AccessibleObject GetNextItem(PopupGalleryTool galleryInstance, GalleryToolItemGroup group, GalleryArea itemLocation)
		{
			return GetRelativeItem(galleryInstance, group, itemLocation, forward: true);
		}

		private AccessibleObject GetPreviousItem(PopupGalleryTool galleryInstance, GalleryToolItemGroup group, GalleryArea itemLocation)
		{
			return GetRelativeItem(galleryInstance, group, itemLocation, forward: false);
		}

		private AccessibleObject GetRelativeItem(PopupGalleryTool galleryInstance, GalleryToolItemGroup group, GalleryArea itemLocation, bool forward)
		{
			return itemLocation switch
			{
				GalleryArea.DropDown => GetRelativeItemInDropDown(galleryInstance, group, forward), 
				GalleryArea.Preview => GetRelativeItemInPreview(galleryInstance, forward), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		private AccessibleObject GetRelativeItemInDropDown(PopupGalleryTool galleryInstance, GalleryToolItemGroup group, bool forward)
		{
			if (!galleryInstance.IsOpen)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = (forward ? 1 : (-1));
			int num2 = group.Items.IndexOf(this) + num;
			GalleryToolItem galleryToolItem;
			if (0 <= num2 && num2 < group.Items.Count)
			{
				galleryToolItem = group.Items[num2];
			}
			else
			{
				List<GalleryToolItemGroup> allVisibleGroups = galleryInstance.GetAllVisibleGroups();
				int i;
				for (i = allVisibleGroups.IndexOf(group) + num; i >= 0 && i < allVisibleGroups.Count && allVisibleGroups[i].Items.Count == 0; i += num)
				{
				}
				if (i < 0 || allVisibleGroups.Count <= i)
				{
					return null;
				}
				group = allVisibleGroups[i];
				galleryToolItem = group.Items[(!forward) ? (group.Items.Count - 1) : 0];
			}
			return galleryToolItem.AccessibleObjects.GetAccessibleObject(galleryInstance, group, GalleryArea.DropDown);
		}

		private AccessibleObject GetRelativeItemInPreview(PopupGalleryTool galleryInstance, bool forward)
		{
			if (!galleryInstance.IsOpen)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = (forward ? 1 : (-1));
			int num2 = galleryInstance.PreviewInfo.Items.IndexOf(this) + num;
			if (num2 < 0 || galleryInstance.PreviewInfo.Items.Count >= num2)
			{
				return null;
			}
			GalleryToolItem galleryToolItem = galleryInstance.PreviewInfo.Items[num2];
			return galleryToolItem.AccessibleObjects.GetAccessibleObject(galleryInstance, null, GalleryArea.Preview);
		}

		private UIElement GetUIElementInPreview(PopupGalleryTool galleryInstance)
		{
			UIElement previewUIElement = galleryInstance.PreviewUIElement;
			if (previewUIElement == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return previewUIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(GalleryPreviewItemUIElement), (object)this);
		}

		private UIElement GetUIElementInDropDown(PopupGalleryTool galleryInstance, GalleryToolItemGroup owningGroup)
		{
			UIElement val = (UIElement)(object)galleryInstance.DropDownItemAreaUIElement;
			if (val == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (owningGroup != null)
			{
				val = val.GetDescendant(typeof(PopupGalleryGroupUIElement), (object)owningGroup);
				if (val == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			return val.GetDescendant(typeof(PopupGalleryItemUIElement), (object)this);
		}

		private Size CalculateImageAreaSizeRequired(GalleryToolItemGroup owningGroup, ref AppearanceData appearance)
		{
			Size result = GalleryToolItemSettings.ResolveImageAreaSize(GalleryTool, owningGroup, this);
			if (((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).Image != null)
			{
				if (result.IsEmpty)
				{
					Image image = null;
					image = ((!GalleryTool.UseLargeImagesInItems) ? ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).GetImage(GalleryTool.ToolbarsManager.ImageListSmallResolved) : ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).GetImage(GalleryTool.ToolbarsManager.ImageListLargeResolved));
					if (image != null)
					{
						result = image.Size;
						result.Width += 4;
						result.Height += 4;
					}
				}
				return result;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private Size CalculateItemSizeRequired(GalleryToolItemGroup owningGroup, bool showText)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0054: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0059: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0063: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0066: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007c: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
			AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)65012168;
			ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (owningGroup == null) ? PreviewUIRole : DropDownUIRole, owningGroup, drawAsSelected: false, drawAsPressed: false, drawAsActive: false);
			Size size = CalculateImageAreaSizeRequired(owningGroup, ref appearance);
			Size size2 = ((!showText) ? Size.Empty : CalculateTextSizeRequired(ref appearance));
			TextPlacement val = GalleryToolItemSettings.ResolveTextPlacement(GalleryTool, owningGroup, this);
			Size size3 = default(Size);
			switch (val - 1)
			{
			case 0:
			case 1:
				size3.Width = Math.Max(size.Width, size2.Width);
				size3.Height = size.Height + size2.Height;
				break;
			default:
				size3.Width = size.Width + size2.Width;
				size3.Height = Math.Max(size.Height, size2.Height);
				break;
			}
			if (size3.Width < 1)
			{
				size3.Width = 1;
			}
			if (size3.Height < 1)
			{
				size3.Height = 1;
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager != null)
			{
				size3 = toolbarsManager.AdjustSizeForTouchMode(size3, GalleryTool.UseLargeImagesInItems);
			}
			size3.Width += 4;
			size3.Height += 4;
			return size3;
		}

		private Size CalculateTextSizeRequired(ref AppearanceData appearance)
		{
			//IL_0079: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			Size result = toolbarsManager.MeasureString(ref appearance, null, title);
			int height = toolbarsManager.MeasureString(ref appearance, null, "Wj").Height;
			result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, height);
			if (title == null || title.Length == 0)
			{
				result = Size.Empty;
			}
			if (formattedDescription != null)
			{
				Control control = (Control)(object)toolbarsManager.GetValidDockArea(DockedPosition.Top);
				if (control == null)
				{
					control = toolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer;
				}
				AppearanceData val = ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).Clone();
				((AppearanceData)(ref val)).FontData.Bold = (DefaultableBoolean)2;
				Size size = formattedDescription.CalcSize(control, ref val, 0);
				result.Width = Math.Max(result.Width, size.Width);
				result.Height += size.Height;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal bool IsActive(PopupGalleryTool galleryInstance, GalleryToolItemGroup group, GalleryArea itemLocation)
		{
			if (!isActive)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return itemLocation switch
			{
				GalleryArea.DropDown => galleryInstance.GroupWithActiveItem == group, 
				GalleryArea.Preview => true, 
				_ => isActive, 
			};
		}

		{
			return Rectangle.Empty;
		}

				SynchronizeGroupStubs();
				foreach (GalleryToolItemGroup item in allVisibleGroups)

					list.Add((FragmentUIAProviderStub)(object)groupStubList[item.Index]);
				}
				return list;
			}

			private void SynchronizeGroupStubs()
			{
				GalleryToolItemGroupCollection groups = PopupGalleryToolInstance.Groups;
				if (groups.Version == groupsVersion)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (groupStubList == null)
				{
					groupStubList = new List<GalleryToolItemGroup.GalleryToolItemGroupUiaProviderStub>(groups.Count);
				}
				else
				{
					groupStubList.Clear();
				}
				FragmentUIAProviderStub previewArea = PreviewArea;
				foreach (GalleryToolItemGroup item in (IEnumerable<GalleryToolItemGroup>)groups)
				{
					groupStubList.Add(new GalleryToolItemGroup.GalleryToolItemGroupUiaProviderStub(item, previewArea));
				}
				if (groupStubList.Count == 0)
				{
					groupStubList.Add(new GalleryToolItemGroup.GalleryToolItemGroupUiaProviderStub(PopupGalleryToolInstance.DefaultGroup, previewArea));
				}
				groupsVersion = groups.Version;
			}

		internal class GalleryToolMenuItemAccessibleObject : MenuItemAccessibleObject
		{
			private GalleryToolMenuItem menuItem;

			private PopupGalleryTool gallery;

			public override string KeyboardShortcut => null;

			public override AccessibleRole Role => AccessibleRole.List;

			public GalleryToolMenuItemAccessibleObject(GalleryToolMenuItem menuItem)
				: base(menuItem)
			{
				this.menuItem = menuItem;
				gallery = this.menuItem.GalleryTool;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
			{
				if (!gallery.IsOpen)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (gallery.ShowFilterBarResolved)
				{
					if (index == 0)
					{
						return gallery.FilterBarAccessibleObject;
					}
					index--;
				}
				GalleryToolItem item = null;
				GalleryToolItemGroup groupWithItem = null;
				foreach (GalleryToolItemGroup allVisibleGroup in gallery.GetAllVisibleGroups())
				{
					if (index < allVisibleGroup.Items.Count)
					{
						groupWithItem = allVisibleGroup;
						item = allVisibleGroup.Items[index];
						break;
					}
					index -= allVisibleGroup.Items.Count;
				}
				return GetAccessibleObjectForItem(item, groupWithItem);
			}

			public override int GetChildCount()
			{
				if (!gallery.IsOpen)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				int num = 0;
				if (gallery.ShowFilterBarResolved)
				{
					num++;
				}
				foreach (GalleryToolItemGroup allVisibleGroup in gallery.GetAllVisibleGroups())
				{
					num += allVisibleGroup.Items.Count;
				}
				return num;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetFocused()
			{
				if (gallery.ShowFilterBarResolved && gallery.IsFilterBarActive)
				{
					return gallery.FilterBarAccessibleObject;
				}
				return GetAccessibleObjectForItem(gallery.ActiveItem, gallery.GroupWithActiveItem);
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetSelected()
			{
				return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).GetFocused();
			}

			public override AccessibleObject HitTest(int x, int y)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = menuItem.UIElement;
				if (uIElement == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				Point point = uIElement.Control.PointToClient(new Point(x, y));
				UIElement val = uIElement.ElementFromPoint(point);
				if (val == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (val.GetAncestor(typeof(PopupGalleryFilterBarUIElement)) != null)
				{
					return gallery.FilterBarAccessibleObject;
				}
				GalleryToolItem galleryToolItem = (GalleryToolItem)val.GetContext(typeof(GalleryToolItem));
				GalleryToolItemGroup groupWithItem = (GalleryToolItemGroup)val.GetContext(typeof(GalleryToolItemGroup));
				if (galleryToolItem == null)
				{
					return base.HitTest(x, y);
				}
				return GetAccessibleObjectForItem(galleryToolItem, groupWithItem);
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				switch (navdir)
				{
				case AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild:
					foreach (GalleryToolItemGroup allVisibleGroup in gallery.GetAllVisibleGroups())
					{
						if (allVisibleGroup.Items.Count > 0)
						{
							return GetAccessibleObjectForItem(allVisibleGroup.Items[0], allVisibleGroup);
						}
					}
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.LastChild:
				{
					List<GalleryToolItemGroup> allVisibleGroups = gallery.GetAllVisibleGroups();
					for (int num = allVisibleGroups.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
					{
						GalleryToolItemGroup galleryToolItemGroup = allVisibleGroups[num];
						if (galleryToolItemGroup.Items.Count > 0)
						{
							return GetAccessibleObjectForItem(galleryToolItemGroup.Items[galleryToolItemGroup.Items.Count - 1], galleryToolItemGroup);
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				default:
					return base.Navigate(navdir);
				}
				if (gallery.ShowFilterBarResolved)
				{
					return gallery.FilterBarAccessibleObject;
				}
				return base.Navigate(navdir);
			}

			public override void Select(AccessibleSelection flags)
			{
			}

			private AccessibleObject GetAccessibleObjectForItem(GalleryToolItem item, GalleryToolItemGroup groupWithItem)
			{
				return item?.AccessibleObjects.GetAccessibleObject(gallery, groupWithItem, GalleryArea.DropDown);
			}
		}

				if (activeTool == tool || activeTool == tool.UnderlyingTool)

				}
			}
		}

		internal UIElementBorderStyle BorderStyle
		{

		public bool IsVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (!provider.IsVisible)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (value == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!value.StartsWith(keyTipManager.CurrentKeyTipValue))
				{
					return false;
				}
				Control control = provider.OwningControl;
				if (control != null && control.IsHandleCreated)
				{
					while (control != null)
					{
						if (!control.RectangleToScreen(control.ClientRectangle).IntersectsWith(Rect))
						{
							return false;
						}
						control = Utilities.GetParent(control);
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

						size.Width = Math.Max(size.Width, ToolbarsManager.MeasureString(ref appearance, null, "O").Width);
						UIElementBorderWidths val = DrawUtility.CalculateBorderWidths(BorderStyle, Border3DSide.All);
						size.Width += ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Left + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Right;

		internal static int GetKeyTipHeight(UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

		}

		private static Rectangle GetRect(Point location, Size size, System.Drawing.ContentAlignment alignment)
		{
			Point rectLocation = default(Point);
			switch (alignment)
			{
			default:
				rectLocation.X = location.X;
				break;
			case System.Drawing.ContentAlignment.TopCenter:
			case System.Drawing.ContentAlignment.MiddleCenter:
			case System.Drawing.ContentAlignment.BottomCenter:
				rectLocation.X = location.X - size.Width / 2;
				break;
			case System.Drawing.ContentAlignment.TopRight:
			case System.Drawing.ContentAlignment.MiddleRight:
			case System.Drawing.ContentAlignment.BottomRight:
				rectLocation.X = location.X - size.Width;
				break;
			}
			switch (alignment)
			{
			default:
				rectLocation.Y = location.Y;
				break;
			case System.Drawing.ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft:
			case System.Drawing.ContentAlignment.MiddleCenter:
			case System.Drawing.ContentAlignment.MiddleRight:
				rectLocation.Y = location.Y - size.Height / 2;
				break;
			case System.Drawing.ContentAlignment.BottomLeft:
			case System.Drawing.ContentAlignment.BottomCenter:
			case System.Drawing.ContentAlignment.BottomRight:
				rectLocation.Y = location.Y - size.Height;
				break;
			}
			return PositionKeyTipWithinScreen(rectLocation, size);
		}

		internal static Rectangle PositionKeyTipWithinScreen(Point rectLocation, Size size)
		{
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(rectLocation, size);
			Screen screen = Utilities.ScreenFromRectangle(rectangle);
			int left = screen.Bounds.Left;
			int right = screen.Bounds.Right;
			rectLocation.X = ((rectLocation.X < left) ? left : rectLocation.X);
			rectLocation.X = ((rectangle.Right > right) ? right : rectLocation.X);
			return new Rectangle(rectLocation, size);
		}

	internal class KeyTipCollection : ICollection<KeyTip>, IEnumerable<KeyTip>, IEnumerable
	{
		private class KeyTipComparer : IComparer<KeyTip>
		{
			public int Compare(KeyTip keyTip1, KeyTip keyTip2)
			{
				if (keyTip1 == null && keyTip2 == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (keyTip2 == null)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				if (keyTip1 == null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return string.Compare(keyTip1.Value, keyTip2.Value);
			}
		}

		private KeyTipManager owningManager;

		private List<KeyTip> keyTipList = new List<KeyTip>();

		private KeyTipComparer keyTipComparer = new KeyTipComparer();

		public KeyTip this[int index] => keyTipList[index];

		public int Count => keyTipList.Count;

		public bool IsReadOnly => false;

		public KeyTipCollection(KeyTipManager owningManager)
		{
			this.owningManager = owningManager;
		}

		private int AddHelper(KeyTip keyTip)
		{
			int count = Count;
			keyTipList.Add(keyTip);
			return count;
		}

		public KeyTipCollection Clone()
		{
			KeyTipCollection keyTipCollection = new KeyTipCollection(owningManager);
			keyTipCollection.keyTipList = new List<KeyTip>(keyTipList);
			return keyTipCollection;
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int i)
		{
			keyTipList.RemoveAt(i);
		}

		internal KeyTip Search(IKeyTipProvider provider)
		{
			using (IEnumerator<KeyTip> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					KeyTip current = enumerator.Current;
					if (current.Provider.Equals(provider))
					{
						return current;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void Sort()
		{
			Utilities.SortMergeGeneric<KeyTip>(keyTipList, (IComparer<KeyTip>)keyTipComparer);
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return keyTipList.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public void Add(KeyTip item)
		{
			AddHelper(item);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			keyTipList.Clear();
		}

		public bool Contains(KeyTip item)
		{
			return keyTipList.Contains(item);
		}

		public void CopyTo(KeyTip[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			keyTipList.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		public bool Remove(KeyTip item)
		{
			return keyTipList.Remove(item);
		}

		public IEnumerator<KeyTip> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return keyTipList.GetEnumerator();
		}
	}

	internal class KeyTipManager
	{
		private class ReservedMnemonicKeyTipProvider : IKeyTipProvider, IKeyTipContainer
		{
			private ToolBase tool;

			private bool isMenuTool;

			private string keyTipValue;

			private KeyTipManager manager;

			public System.Drawing.ContentAlignment Alignment => System.Drawing.ContentAlignment.TopLeft;

			public string AutoGeneratePrefix => null;

			public string Caption => null;

			public bool DeactivateParentContainersOnActivate => !isMenuTool;

			public bool IsEnabled => tool.EnabledResolved;

			public bool IsVisible => false;

			public string KeyTipValue => keyTipValue;

			public Point Location => Point.Empty;

			public char Mnemonic => '\0';

			public Control OwningControl => (Control)(object)manager.ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.RibbonContainer;

			public bool ReuseParentKeyTips => false;

			public ReservedMnemonicKeyTipProvider(ToolBase tool, char mnemonic, KeyTipManager manager)
			{
				this.tool = tool;
				keyTipValue = mnemonic.ToString();
				this.manager = manager;
				isMenuTool = tool is PopupToolBase;
			}

			public bool Activate()
			{
				if (isMenuTool)
				{
					manager.DisplayReservedMnemonicToolTip();
				}
				else
				{
					tool.OnToolClick();
				}
				return true;
			}

			public bool Equals(IKeyTipProvider provider)
			{
				return provider == this;
			}

			public IKeyTipContainer GetContainer()
			{
				if (isMenuTool)
				{
					return this;
				}
				return null;
			}

			public void Deactivate()
			{
			}

			public IKeyTipProvider[] GetKeyTipProviders()
			{
				if (!isMenuTool)
				{
					return new IKeyTipProvider[0];
				}
				List<IKeyTipProvider> list = new List<IKeyTipProvider>();
				IKeyTipProvider[] keyTipProviders = ((IKeyTipContainer)tool).GetKeyTipProviders();
				foreach (IKeyTipProvider keyTipProvider in keyTipProviders)
				{
					if (keyTipProvider is ToolBase toolBase)
					{
						char firstMnemonicChar = Utilities.GetFirstMnemonicChar(toolBase.CaptionResolved);
						if (firstMnemonicChar != 0)
						{
							list.Add(new ReservedMnemonicKeyTipProvider(toolBase, firstMnemonicChar, manager));
						}
					}
				}
				return list.ToArray();
			}
		}

			this.toolbarsManager = toolbarsManager;

		{
			HideKeyTips(deactivateParentContainers: false);
		}

		public void HideKeyTipsOfCurrentKeyTipContainer(bool deactivateCurrentContainer)
		{
			BackUpToParentContainer(deactivateCurrentContainer);
			if (currentKeyTipContainer == null)
			{
				CloseKeyTipForm();
			}
			else
			{
				ShowKeyTipsInCurrentContainer();
			}
		}

		public bool IsReserved(char c)
		{
			if (reservedKeyTips != null)
			{
				foreach (KeyTip reservedKeyTip in reservedKeyTips)
				{
					if (string.Compare(c.ToString(), reservedKeyTip.Value, ignoreCase: true, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) == 0)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ProcessEscKey()
		{
			if (IsActive)
			{
				if (currentKeyTipContainer is ReservedMnemonicKeyTipProvider)
				{
					HideReservedMnemonicToolTip();
					HideKeyTips();
					toolbarsManager.Ribbon.ClearItemWithFocus();
				}
				else
				{
					HideKeyTipsOfCurrentKeyTipContainer(deactivateCurrentContainer: true);
				}
			}
		}

		public void ProcessKey(char charCode)
		{
			ProcessKey(charCode, beepOnFail: true);
		}

		private bool ProcessKey(char charCode, bool beepOnFail)
		{
			if ((Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Control) != Keys.None)
			{
				if (beepOnFail)
				{
					Beep();
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (!IsValidKeyTipChar(charCode))
			{
				if (beepOnFail)
				{
					Beep();
				}
				return false;
			}
			string text = currentKeyTipValue + charCode;
			text = text.ToUpper(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (KeyTip currentKeyTip in CurrentKeyTips)
			{
				if (currentKeyTip.Provider.IsEnabled)
				{
					if (currentKeyTip.Value == text)
					{
						currentActivateKeyTip = text;
						providerPendingActivation = currentKeyTip.Provider;
						ActivateKeyTipProvider(providerPendingActivation, verifyProviderExists: false);
						return true;
					}
					if (currentKeyTip.Value.StartsWith(text))
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				if (beepOnFail)
				{
					Beep();
				}
				return false;
			}
			currentKeyTipValue = text;
			UpdateVisibleKeyTips();
			return true;
		}

		public bool ProcessKeyDuringPendingShow(char charCode)
		{
			if (charCode == '\0')
			{
				HideKeyTips();
				return false;
			}
			ShowKeyTips(showKeyTipWindow: false);
			if (ProcessKey(charCode, beepOnFail: false))
			{
				ShowKeyTipsInCurrentContainer();
				return true;
			}
			HideKeyTips();
			return false;
		}

		public void ShowKeyTips()
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager.Ribbon != null && ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.FileMenuStyleResolved == FileMenuStyle.ApplicationMenu2010 && ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.ApplicationMenu2010.IsOpen)
			{
				ShowKeyTips(showKeyTipWindow: false);
				ShowKeyTipsInContainer(ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.ApplicationMenu2010);
			}
			else
			{
				ShowKeyTips(showKeyTipWindow: true);
			}
		}

		private void ShowKeyTips(bool showKeyTipWindow)
		{
			CancelPendingShow();
			currentKeyTips = null;
			if (parentContainers != null)
			{
				parentContainers.Clear();
				parentKeyTips.Clear();
				parentReservedKeyTips.Clear();
				activatedKeyTips.Clear();
			}
			ShowKeyTipsInContainer(startingKeyTipContainer, showKeyTipWindow);
		}

		internal void ShowKeyTipsAfterDelay()
		{
			if (!ShowKeyTipsTimer.Enabled)
			{
				ShowKeyTipsTimer.Start();
			}
		}

		internal bool TryHideKeyTips()
		{
			if (ignoreNextHiding)
			{
				ignoreNextHiding = false;
				return false;
			}
			HideKeyTips();
			return true;
		}

		internal void UpdateVisibleKeyTips()
		{
			if (keyTipForm != null)
			{
				keyTipForm.Visible = false;
				keyTipForm.RefreshVisibleKeyTips();
				keyTipForm.Show();
			}
		}

		public void ActivateKeyTipProvider(IKeyTipProvider provider, bool verifyProviderExists)
		{
			if (!verifyProviderExists || CurrentKeyTips.Search(provider) != null)
			{
				IKeyTipContainer container = provider.GetContainer();
				if (keyTipForm != null)
				{
					keyTipForm.Hide();
				}
				if (container == null)
				{
					HideKeyTips(provider.DeactivateParentContainersOnActivate);
				}
				IKeyTipProviderWithDelay keyTipProviderWithDelay = provider as IKeyTipProviderWithDelay;
				KeyTipActivationResult keyTipActivationResult = (KeyTipActivationResult)(((int?)keyTipProviderWithDelay?.ActivateWithPotentialDelay()) ?? ((!provider.Activate()) ? 1 : 0));
				if (provider == providerPendingActivation)
				{
					providerPendingActivation = null;
				}
				switch (keyTipActivationResult)
				{
				case KeyTipActivationResult.Failed:
					HideKeyTips(provider.DeactivateParentContainersOnActivate);
					break;
				case KeyTipActivationResult.Succeeded:
					ShowKeyTipsAfterProviderActivate(container);
					break;
				case KeyTipActivationResult.Delay:
					keyTipProviderWithDelay.ActivationDelayComplete += keyTipProviderWithDelay_ActivationDelayComplete;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddInReservedKeyTips()
		{
			if (reservedKeyTips == null || reservedKeyTips.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (KeyTip reservedKeyTip in reservedKeyTips)
			{
				CurrentKeyTips.Add(reservedKeyTip);
			}
			CurrentKeyTips.Sort();
		}

		private void BackUpToParentContainer(bool deactivateCurrentContainer)
		{
			if (deactivateCurrentContainer)
			{
				currentKeyTipContainer.Deactivate();
			}
			DisposeCurrentKeyTips();
			if (parentContainers == null || parentContainers.Count == 0)
			{
				currentKeyTips = null;
				currentKeyTipContainer = null;
				reservedKeyTips = null;
			}
			else
			{
				currentKeyTipContainer = (IKeyTipContainer)ParentContainers.Pop();
				currentKeyTips = (KeyTipCollection)ParentKeyTips.Pop();
				reservedKeyTips = (KeyTipCollection)ParentReservedKeyTips.Pop();
			}
		}

		private static void Beep()
		{
			NativeWindowMethods.MessageBeepApi(0);
		}

		private void CancelPendingShow()
		{
			if (showKeyTipsTimer != null && showKeyTipsTimer.Enabled)
			{
				showKeyTipsTimer.Enabled = false;
			}
		}

		private void CloseKeyTipForm()
		{
			if (keyTipForm != null)
			{
				keyTipForm.Close();
				keyTipForm.Dispose();
				keyTipForm = null;
			}
		}

		private void CreateKeyTipsForContainer(IKeyTipContainer container)
		{
			if (container is Ribbon ribbon)
			{
				GenerateReservedKeyTips(ribbon);
			}
			IKeyTipProvider[] keyTipProviders = container.GetKeyTipProviders();
			foreach (IKeyTipProvider provider in keyTipProviders)
			{
				CurrentKeyTips.Add(new KeyTip(this, provider));
			}
			if (container.ReuseParentKeyTips)
			{
				ReuseKeyTipsInParent();
			}
			else
			{
				InitializeKeyTipsUsingKeyTips();
				if (ToolbarsManager.AutoGenerateKeyTipsResolved)
				{
					InitializeKeyTipsUsingMnemonics();
					InitializeKeyTipsUsingCaptions();
					InitializeRemainingKeyTips();
				}
			}
			RemoveInvalidKeyTips();
			ResolveConflicts();
			AddInReservedKeyTips();
		}

		private void DisplayReservedMnemonicToolTip()
		{
			HideReservedMnemonicToolTip();
			toolbarsManager.InitializeToolTip(toolbarsManager.Ribbon.ReservedKeyTipToolTipTextResolved, GetReservedKeyTipToolTipTitle(), isFormatted: true);
			toolbarsManager.ToolTip.DisplayShadow = true;
			if (toolbarsManager.Ribbon.UIElement is RibbonAreaUIElement ribbonAreaUIElement)
			{
				Rectangle rectangle = ((UIElement)ribbonAreaUIElement).Control.RectangleToScreen(((UIElement)ribbonAreaUIElement).Rect);
				Size size = toolbarsManager.ToolTip.CalcRequiredSize();
				Rectangle rectangle2 = new Rectangle(rectangle.X + (rectangle.Width - size.Width) / 2, rectangle.Y + (rectangle.Height - size.Height) / 2, size.Width, size.Height);
				toolbarsManager.ToolTip.Show(rectangle2);
				displayingToolTip = true;
			}
		}

		private void DisposeCurrentKeyTips()
		{
			if (currentKeyTips == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (KeyTip currentKeyTip in currentKeyTips)
			{
				currentKeyTip.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private void GenerateReservedKeyTips(Ribbon ribbon)
		{
			if (toolbarsManager.MainMenuBar == null || toolbarsManager.MainMenuBar.VisibleResolved || !toolbarsManager.HasRibbon || toolbarsManager.Ribbon != ribbon || !ribbon.ReserveMenuBarKeyTips)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ToolBase tool in toolbarsManager.MainMenuBar.Tools)
			{
				char firstMnemonicChar = Utilities.GetFirstMnemonicChar(tool.CaptionResolved);
				if (firstMnemonicChar != 0)
				{
					if (reservedKeyTips == null)
					{
						reservedKeyTips = new KeyTipCollection(this);
					}
					KeyTip keyTip = new KeyTip(this, new ReservedMnemonicKeyTipProvider(tool, firstMnemonicChar, this));
					keyTip.Value = firstMnemonicChar.ToString();
					reservedKeyTips.Add(keyTip);
				}
			}
			if (reservedKeyTips != null)
			{
				reservedKeyTips.Sort();
			}
		}

		private string GetReservedKeyTipToolTipTitle()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(toolbarsManager.Ribbon.ReservedKeyTipToolTipTitleResolved);
			string text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ReservedKeyTipSequenceSeparator");
			stringBuilder.Append(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ReservedKeyTipSequencePrefix") + text);
			foreach (string activatedKeyTip in ActivatedKeyTips)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat(" {0}{1}", activatedKeyTip, text);
			}
			stringBuilder.AppendFormat(" {0}{1}", currentActivateKeyTip, text);
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private char GetNonReservedChar()
		{
			char c = 'Z';
			while (true)
			{
				if (!char.IsLetter(c))
				{
					return '\0';
				}
				if (!IsReserved(c))
				{
					break;
				}
				c = (char)(c - 1);
			}
			return c;
		}

		private string GetValidAutoGeneratePrefix(IKeyTipProvider provider)
		{
			string autoGeneratePrefix = provider.AutoGeneratePrefix;
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (autoGeneratePrefix == null)
			{
				return text;
			}
			char[] array = autoGeneratePrefix.ToCharArray();
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				char c = array[i];
				if (text.Length != 0 || !IsReserved(c))
				{
					if (text.Length == 2)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (IsValidKeyTipChar(c))
					{
						text += c;
					}
				}
			}
			return text;
		}

		private void HideKeyTips(bool deactivateParentContainers)
		{
			CancelPendingShow();
			if (!isHiding)
			{
				isHiding = true;
				while (currentKeyTipContainer != null)
				{
					BackUpToParentContainer(deactivateParentContainers);
				}
				CloseKeyTipForm();
				isHiding = false;
			}
		}

		private void HideReservedMnemonicToolTip()
		{
			displayingToolTip = false;
			if (toolbarsManager.ToolTip.IsVisible)
			{
				toolbarsManager.ToolTip.Hide();
			}
		}

		private void InitializeKeyTipsUsingCaptions()
		{
			KeyTipCollection keyTipCollection = new KeyTipCollection(this);
			for (int i = 0; i < CurrentKeyTips.Count; i++)
			{
				KeyTip keyTip = CurrentKeyTips[i];
				if (keyTip.Value == null)
				{
					string caption = keyTip.Provider.Caption;
					if (caption != null && caption.Length != 0)
					{
						keyTipCollection.Add(keyTip);
					}
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < keyTipCollection.Count; j++)
			{
				KeyTip keyTip2 = keyTipCollection[j];
				string validAutoGeneratePrefix = GetValidAutoGeneratePrefix(keyTip2.Provider);
				string text = string.Empty;
				string caption2 = keyTip2.Provider.Caption;
				int num = 0;
				while (num < caption2.Length)
				{
					char c = caption2[num++];
					if (!IsValidKeyTipChar(c) || IsReserved(c))
					{
						continue;
					}
					string text2 = (validAutoGeneratePrefix + c).ToUpper(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
					if (text.Length == 0)
					{
						text = text2;
					}
					bool flag = false;
					foreach (KeyTip currentKeyTip in CurrentKeyTips)
					{
						if (currentKeyTip.Value != null && currentKeyTip.Value.StartsWith(text2))
						{
							flag = true;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						keyTip2.Value = text2;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (keyTip2.Value == null)
				{
					if (text.Length == 0)
					{
						keyTip2.Value = validAutoGeneratePrefix;
					}
					else
					{
						keyTip2.Value = text;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void InitializeKeyTipsUsingKeyTips()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < CurrentKeyTips.Count; i++)
			{
				KeyTip keyTip = CurrentKeyTips[i];
				if (keyTip.Value == null)
				{
					string keyTipValue = keyTip.Provider.KeyTipValue;
					if (keyTipValue != null && keyTipValue.Length != 0 && !IsReserved(keyTipValue[0]))
					{
						keyTip.Value = keyTipValue;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void InitializeKeyTipsUsingMnemonics()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < CurrentKeyTips.Count; i++)
			{
				KeyTip keyTip = CurrentKeyTips[i];
				if (keyTip.Value == null)
				{
					string validAutoGeneratePrefix = GetValidAutoGeneratePrefix(keyTip.Provider);
					char mnemonic = keyTip.Provider.Mnemonic;
					if (IsValidKeyTipChar(mnemonic) && !IsReserved(mnemonic))
					{
						keyTip.Value = validAutoGeneratePrefix + mnemonic;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void InitializeRemainingKeyTips()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < CurrentKeyTips.Count; i++)
			{
				KeyTip keyTip = CurrentKeyTips[i];
				if (keyTip.Value != null || keyTip.Provider is ToolBase { IsOnQat: not false })
				{
					continue;
				}
				string text = GetValidAutoGeneratePrefix(keyTip.Provider);
				if (text.Length == 0)
				{
					char nonReservedChar = GetNonReservedChar();
					if (nonReservedChar != 0)
					{
						text = nonReservedChar.ToString();
					}
				}
				keyTip.Value = text;
			}
		}

		private static bool IsValidKeyTipChar(char c)
		{
			return char.IsLetterOrDigit(c);
		}

		private void RemoveInvalidKeyTips()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < CurrentKeyTips.Count; i++)
			{
				KeyTip keyTip = CurrentKeyTips[i];
				if (keyTip.Value == null)
				{
					CurrentKeyTips.RemoveAt(i);
					i--;
				}
			}
		}

		private void ResolveConflicts()
		{
			KeyTipCollection keyTipCollection = CurrentKeyTips.Clone();
			int num = 0;
			bool flag;
			do
			{
				flag = false;
				keyTipCollection.Sort();
				List<KeyTip> list = null;
				for (int i = num; i < keyTipCollection.Count - 1; i++)
				{
					KeyTip keyTip = keyTipCollection[i];
					KeyTip keyTip2 = keyTipCollection[i + 1];
					if (keyTip.Value == keyTip2.Value)
					{
						if (list == null)
						{
							list = new List<KeyTip>();
						}
						else
						{
							list.Clear();
						}
						list.Add(keyTip);
						list.Add(keyTip2);
						for (i += 2; i < keyTipCollection.Count; i++)
						{
							KeyTip keyTip3 = keyTipCollection[i];
							if (keyTip3.Value != keyTip.Value)
							{
								break;
							}
							list.Add(keyTip3);
						}
						int length = (list.Count - 1).ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture).Length;
						string text = new string('0', length);
						for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
						{
							KeyTip keyTip4 = list[j];
							string text2 = (j + 1).ToString(text, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
							if (text2.Length > length)
							{
								text2 = text2.Substring(text2.Length - length);
							}
							keyTip4.Value += text2;
						}
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
					if (keyTip2.Value.StartsWith(keyTip.Value))
					{
						keyTip.Value += 1.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
					num = i + 1;
				}
			}
			while (flag);
		}

		private void ReuseKeyTipsInParent()
		{
			if (parentKeyTips == null || parentKeyTips.Count == 0 || !(parentKeyTips.Peek() is KeyTipCollection keyTipCollection))
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < CurrentKeyTips.Count; i++)
			{
				KeyTip keyTip = CurrentKeyTips[i];
				if (keyTip.Value == null)
				{
					KeyTip keyTip2 = keyTipCollection.Search(keyTip.Provider);
					if (keyTip2 != null)
					{
						keyTip.Value = keyTip2.Value;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void ShowKeyTipsAfterProviderActivate(IKeyTipContainer nextContainer)
		{
			if (nextContainer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ShowKeyTipsInContainer(nextContainer);
			if (providerPendingActivation != null)
			{
				IKeyTipProvider provider = CurrentKeyTips.Search(providerPendingActivation).Provider;
				if (provider != null && provider != providerPendingActivation)
				{
					providerPendingActivation = provider;
					ActivateKeyTipProvider(providerPendingActivation, verifyProviderExists: false);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ShowKeyTipsInContainer(IKeyTipContainer container)
		{
			ShowKeyTipsInContainer(container, showKeyTipWindow: true);
		}

		private void ShowKeyTipsInContainer(IKeyTipContainer container, bool showKeyTipWindow)
		{
			if (currentKeyTipContainer != null)
			{
				if (currentKeyTipContainer != container)
				{
					ParentContainers.Push(currentKeyTipContainer);
					ParentKeyTips.Push(currentKeyTips);
					ParentReservedKeyTips.Push(reservedKeyTips);
					ActivatedKeyTips.Push(currentActivateKeyTip);
				}
				currentKeyTips = null;
				reservedKeyTips = null;
				currentActivateKeyTip = null;
			}
			currentKeyTipContainer = container;
			CreateKeyTipsForContainer(currentKeyTipContainer);
			ShowKeyTipsInCurrentContainer(showKeyTipWindow);
		}

		private void ShowKeyTipsInCurrentContainer()
		{
			ShowKeyTipsInCurrentContainer(showKeyTipWindow: true);
		}

		private void ShowKeyTipsInCurrentContainer(bool showKeyTipWindow)
		{
			currentKeyTipValue = string.Empty;
			if (showKeyTipWindow)
			{
				if (keyTipForm == null)
				{
					keyTipForm = new KeyTipForm(this);
				}
				else
				{
					keyTipForm.RefreshVisibleKeyTips();
				}
				keyTipForm.Show();
			}
		}

		private void OnShowKeyTipsTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if ((Control.ModifierKeys & (Keys.Shift | Keys.Alt)) != (Keys.Shift | Keys.Alt) && !IsActive && ToolbarsManager.IsFormActiveInternal)
			{
				ShowKeyTips();
				ignoreNextHiding = true;
			}
			ShowKeyTipsTimer.Enabled = false;
		}

		private void keyTipProviderWithDelay_ActivationDelayComplete(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is IKeyTipProviderWithDelay keyTipProviderWithDelay)
			{
				keyTipProviderWithDelay.ActivationDelayComplete -= keyTipProviderWithDelay_ActivationDelayComplete;
				IKeyTipContainer container = keyTipProviderWithDelay.GetContainer();
				if (container != null)
				{
					ShowKeyTipsAfterProviderActivate(container);
				}
			}
		}
	}

		internal override bool IsLabelHeader
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.IsOnBackStage)
				{
					if (base.OwnerIsApplicationMenu2010NavigationMenu)
					{
						return base.ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.ApplicationMenu2010.NavigationMenu.SettingsResolved.LabelDisplayStyleResolved == LabelMenuDisplayStyle.Header;
					}
					return base.ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.ApplicationMenu2010.ContentArea.SettingsResolved.LabelDisplayStyleResolved == LabelMenuDisplayStyle.Header;
				}
				if (base.OwnerIsMenuInternal)
				{
					return base.OwningMenuInternal.SettingsResolved.LabelDisplayStyleResolved == LabelMenuDisplayStyle.Header;
				}
				if (base.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)
				{
					return base.OwningApplicationMenuArea.SettingsResolved.LabelDisplayStyleResolved == LabelMenuDisplayStyle.Header;
				}
				if (base.OwnerIsToolbarsManager)
				{
					return base.ToolbarsManager.MenuSettings.LabelDisplayStyle == LabelMenuDisplayStyle.Header;
				}
				return false;
			}

		public override UIRole UIRoleOnMenus
		{

					return null;

		protected internal override Rectangle GetImageRect()
		{
			if (!(base.ToolBeingDisplayed.UIElement is LabelToolUIElement labelToolUIElement))
			{
				return base.GetImageRect();
			}
			((UIElement)labelToolUIElement).VerifyChildElements();
			ImageUIElement val = null;
			UIElementEnumerator enumerator = ((UIElement)labelToolUIElement).ChildElements.GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					UIElement current = enumerator.Current;
					val = (ImageUIElement)(object)((current is ImageUIElement) ? current : null);
					if (val != null)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			if (val == null)
			{
				return base.GetImageRect();
			}
			return ((UIElement)val).Control.RectangleToScreen(((UIElement)val).Rect);
		}

		}

	internal abstract class MenuAgentBase : SubObjectBase, IProvideUIAutomation
	{
		internal class MenuAgentBaseUiaProviderStub : FragmentUIAProviderStub, IAutomationProviderFromPoint
		{
			internal MenuAgentBase MenuAgent => ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)this).Context as MenuAgentBase;

			internal MenuItemsCollection.MenuItemsCollectionUiaProviderStub MenuItemsStub => GetMenuItems().AutomationProviderStub;

			internal virtual UIElement UIElement
			{
				get
				{
					MenuAgentBase menuAgent = MenuAgent;
					PopupControlBase popupControl = menuAgent.PopupControl;
					if (popupControl != null)
					{
						if (popupControl is BackStageViewControl)
						{
							return ((UIElement)popupControl.ControlElement).GetDescendant(typeof(NavigationMenuAreaUIElement));
						}
						return (UIElement)(object)popupControl.ControlElement;
					}
					return menuAgent.ToolbarsManager.GetUIElement(typeof(MenuItemAreaUIElement), menuAgent);
				}
			}

			internal MenuAgentBaseUiaProviderStub(MenuAgentBase menuAgent)
				: base((object)menuAgent)
			{
			}

			protected override string CreateAutomationId()
			{
				string defaultName = ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)this).GetDefaultName();
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(defaultName))
				{
					return defaultName;
				}
				return "MenuAgent";
			}

			public override Rectangle GetBoundingRectangle()
			{
				UIElement uIElement = UIElement;
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					return uIElement.Control.RectangleToScreen(uIElement.Rect);
				}
				return Rectangle.Empty;
			}

			public override ControlType GetControlType()
			{
				return ControlType.Group;
			}

			protected override string GetDefaultName()
			{
				PopupToolBase popupTool = MenuAgent.PopupTool;
				if (popupTool != null)
				{
					string text = popupTool.CaptionResolved;
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
					{
						text = popupTool.ToolTipTextResolved;
					}
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
					{
						return text;
					}
				}
				return ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)this).GetDefaultName();
			}

			public override IRawElementProviderFragmentRoot GetFragmentRoot()
			{
				return ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)this).GetParent()?.FragmentRoot;
			}

			protected override bool GetIsEnabled()
			{
				IRawElementProviderFragment parent = ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)this).GetParent();
				if (parent == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return (bool)parent.GetPropertyValue(30010);
			}

			protected override bool GetIsKeyboardFocusable()
			{
				return false;
			}

			protected override Control GetMarshallingControl()
			{
				Control popupControl = (Control)(object)MenuAgent.PopupControl;
				if (popupControl != null)
				{
					return popupControl;
				}
				UIElement uIElement = UIElement;
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					return uIElement.Control;
				}
				return null;
			}

			protected override List<FragmentUIAProviderStub> GetOrderedChildStubList()
			{
				return new List<FragmentUIAProviderStub> { (FragmentUIAProviderStub)(object)MenuItemsStub };
			}

			protected override OrientationType GetOrientation()
			{
				return OrientationType.Vertical;
			}

			public override IRawElementProviderFragment GetParent()
			{
				for (UIElement parent = UIElement.Parent; parent != null; parent = parent.Parent)
				{
					if (parent.IsUiaElement)
					{
						return parent.UIAutomationProvider;
					}
				}
				Control control = UIElement.Control;
				IProvideUIAutomation val = (IProvideUIAutomation)(object)((control is IProvideUIAutomation) ? control : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					IRawElementProviderFragment uIAutomationProvider = val.UIAutomationProvider;
					if (uIAutomationProvider != null)
					{
						return uIAutomationProvider;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			protected virtual MenuItemsCollection GetMenuItems()
			{
				return MenuAgent.MenuItems;
			}

			internal virtual IRawElementProviderFragment GetProviderFromPoint(Point clientPoint)
			{
				if (UIElement == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				UIElement val = UIElement.ElementFromPoint(clientPoint);
				if (val != null)
				{
					return GetProviderFromUIElement(val);
				}
				return null;
			}

			internal virtual IRawElementProviderFragment GetProviderFromUIElement(UIElement elementUnderPoint)
			{
				if (elementUnderPoint.GetContext(typeof(MenuItemBase)) is MenuItemBase menuItemBase)
				{
					return ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)menuItemBase.AutomationProviderStub).Provider;
				}
				return null;
			}

			IRawElementProviderFragment IAutomationProviderFromPoint.AutomationProviderFromPoint(Point clientPoint)
			{
				return GetProviderFromPoint(clientPoint);
			}
		}

		internal class BackStageOwnedMenuAgentUiaProviderStub : MenuAgentBaseUiaProviderStub
		{
			internal BackStageOwnedMenuAgentUiaProviderStub(MenuAgentBase menuAgent)
				: base(menuAgent)
			{
			}

			protected override string CreateAutomationId()
			{
				int num = 0;
				PopupToolBase popupToolBase = base.MenuAgent.PopupTool;
				while (popupToolBase != null)
				{
					popupToolBase = popupToolBase.OwningMenuInternal;
					num++;
				}
				return $"Content Area Group {num}";
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			base.OnDispose();
			DestroyDropShadows();
			if (scrollTimer != null)
			{
				scrollTimer.Enabled = false;
				scrollTimer.Tick -= ScrollTimerExpired;
				scrollTimer.Dispose();
				scrollTimer = null;
			}
			if (showFullMenusTimer != null)
			{
				showFullMenusTimer.Enabled = false;
				showFullMenusTimer.Tick -= ShowFullMenusTimerExpired;
				showFullMenusTimer.Dispose();
				showFullMenusTimer = null;
			}
			if (menuItems != null)
			{
				menuItems.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				menuItems.Dispose();
				menuItems = null;
			}
			if (popupControl != null)
			{
				((Component)(object)popupControl).Dispose();
				popupControl = null;
			}
			if (shadowManager != null)
			{
				DestroyShadowManager(ref shadowManager);
			}
			if (shadowManagerSupplemental != null)
			{
				DestroyShadowManager(ref shadowManagerSupplemental);
			}
			if (associatedMiniToolbarWindow != null)
			{
				associatedMiniToolbarWindow.AssociatedPopup = null;
				associatedMiniToolbarWindow = null;
			}
			owningControlForDropDown = null;
			activeMenuItem = null;
			toolbarsManager = null;
		}

		internal void ActivateMenuItem(MenuItemBase itemToActivate)
		{
			if (activeMenuItem != null && activeMenuItem.ParentCollection != null && activeMenuItem != itemToActivate)
			{
				activeMenuItem.Deactivate();
			}
			if (itemToActivate.ParentCollection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			itemToActivate.Activate();
			if (itemToActivate.Index < GetFirstItemIndex(itemToActivate))
			{
				while (itemToActivate.Index < GetFirstItemIndex(itemToActivate))
				{
					DoScroll(scrollDown: false, selectableItemsOnly: true, itemToActivate);
				}
				((UIElement)PopupControl.ControlElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
				if (ToolbarsManager != null && ToolbarsManager.AreKeyTipsShown)
				{
					((UIElement)PopupControl.ControlElement).VerifyChildElements();
					ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.KeyTipManager.UpdateVisibleKeyTips();
				}
				return;
			}
			int lastItemIndex = GetLastItemIndex(itemToActivate);
			if (itemToActivate.Index <= lastItemIndex)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (itemToActivate.Index > lastItemIndex)
			{
				int num = GetFirstItemIndex(itemToActivate);
				DoScroll(scrollDown: true, selectableItemsOnly: true, itemToActivate);
				if (num == GetFirstItemIndex(itemToActivate))
				{
					break;
				}
				((UIElement)PopupControl.ControlElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
				((UIElement)PopupControl.ControlElement).VerifyChildElements(true);
				lastItemIndex = GetLastItemIndex(itemToActivate);
			}
			if (ToolbarsManager != null && ToolbarsManager.AreKeyTipsShown)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.KeyTipManager.UpdateVisibleKeyTips();
			}
		}
