		internal virtual void CalculateRequiredDropDownSize(out Size minSize, out Size preferredMinSize, out Size preferredSize, out Size maxSize)
		{
			//IL_015e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0169: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_016e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (IsParentLeftApplicationMenu)
			{
				Size size = ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.ApplicationMenu.LeftAreaOwnedMenuDropDownRect.Size;
				int num = 0;
				foreach (MenuItemBase menuItem in MenuItems)
				{
					if (!HideNonRecentlyUsedItems || menuItem.RecentlyUsed)
					{
						num = ((!menuItem.AllowResize) ? Math.Max(num, menuItem.CachedSize.Height) : Math.Max(num, menuItem.MinimumSize.Height));
						maxShortcutTextWidth = Math.Max(maxShortcutTextWidth, menuItem.ShortcutTextWidth);
					}
				}
				num += GetNonMenuItemHeight();
				size.Height = Math.Max(size.Height, num);
				minSize = (preferredMinSize = (preferredSize = (maxSize = size)));
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				DrawUtility.BeginGraphicsCaching();
				CalculateSizeRequiredForMenuItems(MenuItems, firstItemIndex, out displayMoreItemsChevron, out minSize, out preferredMinSize, out preferredSize, out maxSize);
				Size size2 = new Size(0, 0);
				if (IncludePaddingAroundMenuItems)
				{
					size2.Height += 2 * Metrics.PaddingAroundMenuitem;
				}
				UIElementBorderWidths val = ToolbarsManager.CalculateBorderWidths(DropDownBorderStyle, DropDownBorderSides);
				if (IsSideStripVisible)
				{
					size2.Width += SideStripWidth;
				}
				size2.Width += ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Left + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Right;
				if (IncludePaddingAroundMenuItems)
				{
					size2.Width += 2 * Metrics.PaddingAroundMenuitem;
				}
				size2.Height += GetNonMenuItemHeight();
				minSize = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.AddSizesWithoutOverflow(minSize, size2);
				preferredMinSize = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.AddSizesWithoutOverflow(preferredMinSize, size2);
				preferredSize = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.AddSizesWithoutOverflow(preferredSize, size2);
				maxSize = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.AddSizesWithoutOverflow(maxSize, size2);
			}
			finally
			{
				DrawUtility.EndGraphicsCaching();
			}
		}

		internal void CalculateSizeRequiredForMenuItems(MenuItemsCollection menuItems, int firstItemIndex, out bool displayMoreItemsChevron, out Size minSize, out Size preferredMinSize, out Size preferredSize, out Size maxSize)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			MenuItemBase menuItemBase = null;
			Size size = Size.Empty;
			for (int i = 0; i < menuItems.Count; i++)
			{
				MenuItemBase menuItemBase2 = menuItems[i];
				if (!HideNonRecentlyUsedItems || menuItemBase2.RecentlyUsed)
				{
					num2++;
					int num3 = 2 * menuItemBase2.Padding.Width;
					if (menuItemBase != null || !menuItemBase2.AllowResize || !AllowResizeResolved)
					{
						num = ((!menuItemBase2.AllowResize || !AllowResizeResolved) ? Math.Max(num, menuItemBase2.CachedSize.Width + num3) : Math.Max(num, menuItemBase2.MinimumSize.Width + num3));
						continue;
					}
					menuItemBase = menuItemBase2;
					size = menuItemBase2.CachedSize;
					size.Width += num3;
				}
			}
			if (num2 == 0)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < menuItems.Count; j++)
				{
					MenuItemBase menuItemBase3 = menuItems[j];
					Size cachedSize = menuItemBase3.CachedSize;
					cachedSize.Width += 2 * menuItemBase3.Padding.Width;
					num = Math.Max(num, cachedSize.Width);
				}
			}
			displayMoreItemsChevron = false;
			Size size2 = default(Size);
			int paddingBetweenMenuItems = Metrics.PaddingBetweenMenuItems;
			for (int k = firstItemIndex; k < menuItems.Count; k++)
			{
				MenuItemBase menuItemBase4 = menuItems[k];
				if (HideNonRecentlyUsedItems && !menuItemBase4.RecentlyUsed)
				{
					displayMoreItemsChevron = true;
					continue;
				}
				Size size3 = ((menuItemBase == null || menuItemBase == menuItemBase4 || !menuItemBase4.AllowResize) ? menuItemBase4.CachedSize : menuItemBase4.MinimumSize);
				size3.Height += 2 * menuItemBase4.Padding.Height;
				size2.Height += size3.Height;
				if (menuItemBase4.IsFirstInGroupResolved)
				{
					size2.Height += Metrics.MenuitemSeparatorHeight;
				}
				size2.Height += paddingBetweenMenuItems;
				maxShortcutTextWidth = Math.Max(maxShortcutTextWidth, menuItemBase4.ShortcutTextWidth);
			}
			size2.Width = num;
			if (AllowResizeResolved && menuItemBase != null)
			{
				preferredSize = (maxSize = (minSize = (preferredMinSize = size2)));
				Size maximumSize = menuItemBase.MaximumSize;
				Size minimumSize = menuItemBase.MinimumSize;
				Size preferredMinimumSize = menuItemBase.PreferredMinimumSize;
				Size preferredSize2 = menuItemBase.PreferredSize;
				preferredSize.Width = Math.Max(preferredSize.Width, preferredSize2.Width);
				preferredSize.Height += menuItemBase.GetRequiredHeight(preferredSize.Width) - size.Height;
				maxSize.Width = Math.Max(preferredSize.Width, maximumSize.Width);
				maxSize.Height += maximumSize.Height - size.Height;
				minSize.Width = Math.Max(size2.Width, minimumSize.Width);
				minSize.Height += minimumSize.Height - size.Height;
				preferredMinSize.Width = Math.Max(size2.Width, preferredMinimumSize.Width);
				preferredMinSize.Height += preferredMinimumSize.Height - size.Height;
			}
			else
			{
				minSize = (preferredMinSize = (preferredSize = (maxSize = size2)));
			}
		}

		internal static void CancelPendingDropDowns(MenuItemsCollection menuItems)
		{
			foreach (MenuItemBase menuItem in menuItems)
			{
				PopupToolBase popupToolBase = null;
				if (menuItem.Tool != null)
				{
					popupToolBase = menuItem.Tool as PopupToolBase;
				}
				if (popupToolBase != null && popupToolBase.IsMenuAgentCreated)
				{
					popupToolBase.MenuAgent.CancelPendingDropDown();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void CancelPendingFullMenuDisplay()
		{
			if (showFullMenusTimer != null)
			{
				showFullMenusTimer.Enabled = false;
			}
		}

		internal virtual void CancelPendingSubmenuDropDowns()

		}

				}
			}
		}

		internal void CloseDropDown(bool delay)

		}

		internal void CloseDropDown(bool delay, bool shouldHideAssociatedKeyTips)
		{
			CloseDropDown(delay, shouldHideAssociatedKeyTips, onlyCloseDropDowns: false);
		}

		internal void CloseDropDown(bool delay, bool shouldHideAssociatedKeyTips, bool onlyCloseDropDowns)
		{
			if (!IsOpen || OnPopupClosing())
			{
				return;
			}
			if (toolbarsManager != null && ToolbarsManager.IsInEditMode)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.ForceExitEditMode(onlyIfFormIsInActive: false);
				delay = true;
			}
			if (delay)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.DropdownCloseupManager.AddCloseupRequest(this);
				return;
			}
			if (shouldHideAssociatedKeyTips && ToolbarsManager.AreKeyTipsShown)
			{
				KeyTipManager keyTipManager = ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.KeyTipManager;
				if (PopupTool == keyTipManager.CurrentKeyTipContainer)
				{
					keyTipManager.HideKeyTipsOfCurrentKeyTipContainer(deactivateCurrentContainer: false);
				}
			}
			if (OwningControlForDropDown != null)
			{
				DropDownManager.CloseDropDown(OwningControlForDropDown);
			}
			if (onlyCloseDropDowns)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			Control control = null;
			if (ultraToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				control = ultraToolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer;
			}
			if (control != null)
			{
				PopupControlBase popupControlBase = PopupControl;
				if (popupControlBase != null && Utilities.GetParent((Control)(object)popupControlBase) == control)
				{
					control.Controls.Remove((Control)(object)popupControlBase);
					ToolbarsManager.PopupManager.PopupClosed(this, null);
					OnPopupClosed(this, EventArgs.Empty);
				}
				PerformUpdatesAfterDropDownClose();
			}
		}

		internal static void DoScrollHelper(bool scrollDown, bool selectableItemsOnly, MenuItemsCollection menuItems, System.Windows.Forms.Timer scrollTimer, bool hideNonRecentlyUsedItems, ref int firstItemIndex)
		{
			MenuItemBase menuItemBase = menuItems[firstItemIndex];
			if (menuItemBase == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			MenuItemBase nextMenuItem;
			if (scrollDown)
			{
				nextMenuItem = menuItems.GetNextMenuItem(menuItemBase, selectableItemsOnly, hideNonRecentlyUsedItems, wrapAround: false);
				if (nextMenuItem != null)
				{
					firstItemIndex = nextMenuItem.Index;
				}
				return;
			}
			nextMenuItem = menuItems.GetPreviousMenuItem(menuItemBase, selectableItemsOnly, hideNonRecentlyUsedItems, wrapAround: false);
			firstItemIndex = 0;
			if (nextMenuItem != null && menuItems.GetPreviousMenuItem(nextMenuItem, selectableItemsOnly, hideNonRecentlyUsedItems, wrapAround: false) != null)
			{
				firstItemIndex = nextMenuItem.Index;
			}
			if (firstItemIndex < 1)
			{
				scrollTimer.Enabled = false;
			}
		}

		internal void DropDown(Control owningControl, Point point, Rectangle exclusionRect, DropDownPosition dropDownPosition, bool delay, bool closeIfAlreadyOpen, bool alignRight, bool autocloseDropdown)
		{
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SplitMonitorAction splitMonitorAction = (SplitMonitorAction)((PopupTool is PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool) ? ((int)ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ResolveSplitMonitorAction(popupMenuTool.SettingsResolved.MultiMonitorDropDownBehaviorResolved, (SplitMonitorAction)0)) : 0);

		internal static MenuItemBase ExtractExistingMenuItem(ToolBase tool, MenuItemBase[] oldItems)
		{
			if (oldItems != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < oldItems.Length; i++)
				{
					if (oldItems[i] is ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem && tool == toolMenuItem.Tool)
					{
						oldItems[i] = null;
						return toolMenuItem;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal Rectangle GetImageRect(UIElement element, bool drawAsActive, VAlign imageVerticalAlignment)
		{
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0061: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_0106: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_0145: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_018a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_018f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0191: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0194: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			if (!ShouldShowImages(element) && !ShouldShowAddRemoveCheckColumn(element))

			}

			if (popupTool != null)

			}

			{
			case 1:
				result.Y += Metrics.MenuitemPaddingTopBottom + Metrics.MenuItemBorderThickness;
				break;
			default:
				result.Y += (rectangle.Height - imageSize.Height) / 2;
				break;
			case 3:
				result.Y = rectangle.Bottom - (imageSize.Height + Metrics.MenuitemPaddingTopBottom + Metrics.MenuItemBorderThickness);
				break;
			}
			result.X += Metrics.MenuitemImagePaddingLeft;
			result.Size = GetImageBaseSize(element);
			if ((int)ToolbarsManager.StyleResolved == 1 && drawAsActive && !ShouldShowAddRemoveCheckColumn(element))
			{
				result.Inflate(1, 1);
			}

			{
				result.Width = 0;
			}
			else if ((int)ToolbarsManager.StyleResolved == 6)
			{
				result = rectangle;
				result.Width = result.Height;
			}

			{
				result.Height += 2;

				{
				case 0:
				case 2:
				case 3:
				case 4:
					result.Height += 2;
					result.Width += 2;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (ShouldShowAddRemoveCheckColumn(element))
			{
				Size checkMarkElementSize = ToolbarsManager.CheckMarkElementSize;
				result.Width += checkMarkElementSize.Width + 1;
				if (ToolbarsManager.IsNonOffice2000Style)
				{
					result.Width++;
				}
				result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, checkMarkElementSize.Height);
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal MenuItemBase GetMenuItemFromTool(ToolBase item)
		{
			foreach (MenuItemBase menuItem in GetMenuItems(item))
			{
				ToolBase tool = menuItem.Tool;
				if (tool != null && tool.Equals(item))
				{
					return menuItem;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal int GetMenuItemWidthDelta(MenuItemBase menuItem)
		{
			MenuItemsCollection menuItemsCollection = GetMenuItems(menuItem);
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < menuItemsCollection.Count; i++)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, menuItemsCollection[i].CachedSize.Width);
			}
			return num - menuItem.CachedSize.Width;
		}

		internal void PositionSupplementalShadows()
		{
			//IL_003f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0045: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0141: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle exclusionRect = ExclusionRect;
			if (exclusionRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				if (shadowManagerSupplemental != null)
				{
					shadowManagerSupplemental.Hide();
				}
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				Form form = UltraToolbarsManager.FindFormHelper((Control)(object)popupControl);
				if (form == null)
				{
					return;
				}

				if (PopupTool != null && PopupTool.OverlapMenuBorders)
				{
					Rectangle rectangle = Rectangle.Intersect(exclusionRect, dropDownRect);
					if (rectangle.Width < rectangle.Height)
					{
						if (rectangle.Right == exclusionRect.Right)
						{
							exclusionRect.Width++;
						}
					}
					else if (rectangle.Bottom == exclusionRect.Bottom)
					{
						exclusionRect.Height++;
					}
				}
				if (shadowManagerSupplemental == null)
				{
					shadowManagerSupplemental = new ShadowManager(form, exclusionRect, dropDownRect, true, true);
				}
				shadowManagerSupplemental.Show(dropDownRect, exclusionRect);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		internal bool ProcessMnemonicHelper(char charCode, MenuItemsCollection menuItems)
		{
			if (HideNonRecentlyUsedItems && !IsShowFullMenuTimerExpired)
			{
				CancelPendingFullMenuDisplay();
				ShowFullMenu(ShowFullMenuDelayLong);
			}
			if (menuItems != null && menuItems.Count > 0)
			{
				List<IProcessMnemonic> list = new List<IProcessMnemonic>();
				foreach (MenuItemBase menuItem in menuItems)
				{
					if (menuItem.IsMnemonic(charCode))
					{
						list.Add(menuItem);
					}
				}
				return ToolbarsManager.ProcessMnemonicForTools(list, list.Count);
			}
			return false;
		}

		{

		internal void ShowFullMenu(int delay)
		{
			if (dropDownHidden)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (delay == 0 || delay == -1)
			{
				showFullMenuTimerExpired = true;
				if (delay == -1)
				{
					if (!MenuItemsActivated)
					{
						ResizeDropdownAndShowFullMenu();
					}
					else if (PopupControl != null)
					{
						((UIElement)PopupControl.ControlElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
					}
				}
			}
			else if (!ShowFullMenusTimer.Enabled)
			{
				showFullMenuTimerExpired = false;
				ShowFullMenusTimer.Enabled = true;
				ShowFullMenusTimer.Interval = delay;
			}
			else if (ShowFullMenusTimer.Interval != delay)
			{
				ShowFullMenusTimer.Interval = delay;
			}
		}

		internal virtual void StartScroll(ScrollDirection scrollDirection, object context)

		}

		internal static void StartScrollHelper(ScrollDirection newScrollDirection, UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager, System.Windows.Forms.Timer scrollTimer, ref ScrollDirection scrollDirection)
		{
			if (!toolbarsManager.IsInEditMode || toolbarsManager.ExitEditMode())
			{
				scrollDirection = newScrollDirection;
				if (!scrollTimer.Enabled)
				{
					scrollTimer.Enabled = true;
					scrollTimer.Interval = 100;
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual void StopScroll(object context)
		{

		}

		}

		private static Size GetActualMinimumSize(Size preferredMinimumSize, Size actualPopupSize)
		{
			Size result = preferredMinimumSize;
			result.Width = Math.Min(result.Width, actualPopupSize.Width);
			result.Height = Math.Min(result.Height, actualPopupSize.Height);
			return result;
		}

		private bool ForwardNavigateToToolbarTool(Keys keyCode)
		{
			ToolBase toolBase = null;
			toolBase = ((this is PopupMenuAgent) ? ((PopupMenuAgent)this).PopupMenuTool : ((!(this is QuickCustomizeAgentBase)) ? ((PopupToolBase)TearawayTool) : ((PopupToolBase)((QuickCustomizeAgentBase)this).QuickCustomizeTool)));
			if (toolBase != null)
			{
				while (toolBase.OwnerIsMenuInternal)
				{
					toolBase = toolBase.OwningMenuInternal;
				}
				if (toolBase.OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
				{
					return toolBase.OwningToolbarInternal.ProcessNavigationKey(toolBase, keyCode);
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		{

		private void ShowFullMenusTimerExpired(object source, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!ShowFullMenusTimer.Enabled)
			{
				return;
			}
			ShowFullMenusTimer.Enabled = false;
			showFullMenuTimerExpired = true;
			if (!dropDownHidden)
			{
				if (!MenuItemsActivated)
				{
					ResizeDropdownAndShowFullMenu();
				}
				else if (PopupControl != null)
				{
					((UIElement)PopupControl.ControlElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ScrollTimerExpired(object source, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!ScrollTimer.Enabled)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (scrollDirection == ScrollDirection.ScrollNone)
			{
				ScrollTimer.Enabled = false;
				return;
			}
			ScrollTimer.Interval = 50;
			DoScroll(scrollDirection == ScrollDirection.ScrollDown, selectableItemsOnly: false, ScrollTimer);
			((UIElement)PopupControl.ControlElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
			if (ToolbarsManager != null && ToolbarsManager.AreKeyTipsShown)
			{
				((UIElement)PopupControl.ControlElement).VerifyChildElements();
				ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.KeyTipManager.UpdateVisibleKeyTips();
			}
		}

					popupControlBase.AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(AccessibleEvents.SystemMenuStart, -1);
				}
			}
			toolbarsManager.NotifyAccessibilityFocusChange();
		}

			if (childElements != null)

				PopupMenuScrollItemUIElement popupMenuScrollItemUIElement = null;

				{
					if (childElements[num2] is PopupMenuScrollItemUIElement)
					{

						{

							{

		}

		protected internal virtual bool ProcessLeftArrowKey()
		{
			if (PopupTool != null && PopupTool.OwnerIsToolbarInternal && PopupTool.IsVertical)
			{
				CloseDropDown(delay: false);
				ToolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture = PopupTool.OwningToolbarInternal;
				ToolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(PopupTool, setOn: true, clearToolBeingEdited: true);
				PopupTool.DirtyOwnerElements();
				return true;
			}
			return ForwardNavigateToToolbarTool(Keys.Left);
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ProcessNavigationKey(Keys keyCode)
		{
			bool controlKey = (Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Control) == Keys.Control;
			bool shiftKey = (Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Shift) == Keys.Shift;
			return ProcessNavigationKeyHelper(keyCode, controlKey, shiftKey);
		}

		internal bool ProcessNavigationKeyHelper(Keys keyCode, bool controlKey, bool shiftKey)
		{
			if (HideNonRecentlyUsedItems && !IsShowFullMenuTimerExpired)
			{
				CancelPendingFullMenuDisplay();
				ShowFullMenu(ShowFullMenuDelayLong);
			}
			if (keyCode == Keys.Down && controlKey)
			{
				if (HideNonRecentlyUsedItems)
				{
					ShowFullMenu(-1);
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			((UIElement)PopupControl.ControlElement).VerifyChildElements(true);
			try
			{
				if (activeMenuItem != null && activeMenuItem.Tool != null && activeMenuItem.Tool.PreProcessNavigationKey(keyCode))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (keyCode == Keys.Tab)
				{
					if (controlKey && ToolbarsManager != null)
					{
						return ToolbarsManager.ProcessCtrlTabNavigation();
					}
					keyCode = ((!shiftKey) ? Keys.Down : Keys.Up);
					if (activeMenuItem != null && activeMenuItem.IsInEditMode)
					{
						MenuItemBase menuItemBase = activeMenuItem;
						UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
						bool allowToolbarCaptureRelease = ultraToolbarsManager?.AllowToolbarCaptureRelease ?? false;
						if (ultraToolbarsManager != null)
						{
							ultraToolbarsManager.AllowToolbarCaptureRelease = false;
						}
						try
						{
							menuItemBase.IsInEditMode = false;
							if (menuItemBase != activeMenuItem || menuItemBase.IsInEditMode)
							{
								return true;
							}
						}
						finally
						{
							if (ultraToolbarsManager != null)
							{
								ultraToolbarsManager.AllowToolbarCaptureRelease = allowToolbarCaptureRelease;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				object context = ((activeMenuItem != null) ? activeMenuItem : DefaultContext);
				MenuItemBase menuItemBase2 = null;
				switch (keyCode)
				{
				case Keys.Return:
					if (activeMenuItem != null && activeMenuItem.Enabled)
					{
						return activeMenuItem.ProcessEnterKey();
					}
					break;
				case Keys.Right:
					if (activeMenuItem != null && activeMenuItem.IsPopup && activeMenuItem.Enabled)
					{
						activeMenuItem.DropDown(delay: false, closeIfAlreadyOpen: false, autocloseDropdown: true);
						PopupControlBase currentPopupControl = ToolbarsManager.CurrentPopupControl;
						if (currentPopupControl != null && currentPopupControl.MenuAgent != this)
						{
							MenuItemsCollection menuItemsCollection2 = currentPopupControl.MenuAgent.MenuItems;
							if (menuItemsCollection2 != null && menuItemsCollection2.Count > 0)
							{
								menuItemsCollection2.GetNextMenuItem(null, selectableItemsOnly: true, HideNonRecentlyUsedItems, wrapAround: false)?.Activate();
							}
							if (ToolbarsManager.AreKeyTipsShown)
							{
								IKeyTipProvider dropDownKeyTipProvider = activeMenuItem.DropDownKeyTipProvider;
								if (dropDownKeyTipProvider != null)
								{
									ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.KeyTipManager.ActivateKeyTipProvider(dropDownKeyTipProvider);
								}
								else
								{
									ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.KeyTipManager.HideKeyTips();
								}
							}
						}
						return true;
					}
					return ForwardNavigateToToolbarTool(keyCode);
				case Keys.Left:
					return ProcessLeftArrowKey();
				case Keys.Up:
				{
					if (!HasMenuItems(context))
					{
						break;
					}
					MenuItemsCollection menuItemsCollection = GetMenuItems(context);
					menuItemBase2 = menuItemsCollection.GetPreviousMenuItem(activeMenuItem, selectableItemsOnly: true, HideNonRecentlyUsedItems, wrapAround: false);
					if (menuItemBase2 != null)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (BumpedToolsToolbar != null && BumpedToolsToolbar.Tools.Count > 0)
					{
						if (activeMenuItem != null && activeMenuItem.ParentCollection != null)
						{
							activeMenuItem.Deactivate();
						}
						ToolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture = BumpedToolsToolbar;
						ToolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(BumpedToolsToolbar.Tools.GetPreviousTool(null, visibleToolsOnly: true, selectableToolsOnly: true, recentlyUsedToolsOnly: false, wrapAround: false), setOn: true, clearToolBeingEdited: false);
						return true;
					}
					menuItemBase2 = menuItemsCollection.GetPreviousMenuItem(null, selectableItemsOnly: true, HideNonRecentlyUsedItems, wrapAround: false);
					break;
				}
				case Keys.Down:
				{
					if (!HasMenuItems(context))
					{
						break;
					}
					MenuItemsCollection menuItemsCollection3 = GetMenuItems(context);
					menuItemBase2 = menuItemsCollection3.GetNextMenuItem(activeMenuItem, selectableItemsOnly: true, HideNonRecentlyUsedItems, wrapAround: false);
					if (menuItemBase2 != null)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (BumpedToolsToolbar != null && BumpedToolsToolbar.Tools.Count > 0)
					{
						if (activeMenuItem != null && activeMenuItem.ParentCollection != null)
						{
							activeMenuItem.Deactivate();
						}
						ToolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture = BumpedToolsToolbar;
						ToolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(BumpedToolsToolbar.Tools.GetNextTool(null, visibleToolsOnly: true, selectableToolsOnly: true, recentlyUsedToolsOnly: false, wrapAround: false), setOn: true, clearToolBeingEdited: false);
						return true;
					}
					if (HideNonRecentlyUsedItems)
					{
						ShowFullMenu(-1);
						menuItemBase2 = menuItemsCollection3.GetNextMenuItem(activeMenuItem, selectableItemsOnly: true, HideNonRecentlyUsedItems, wrapAround: true);
					}
					else
					{
						menuItemBase2 = menuItemsCollection3.GetNextMenuItem(null, selectableItemsOnly: true, HideNonRecentlyUsedItems, wrapAround: false);
					}
					break;
				}
				case Keys.Space:
					if (activeMenuItem != null && activeMenuItem.Enabled)
					{
						bool flag = activeMenuItem.Tool?.ClosesApplicationMenuOnToolClick ?? true;
						activeMenuItem.OnClick();
						if (flag)
						{
							ToolbarsManager.PopupManager.CloseAllPopups(onlyCloseLeafContiguousPopupChain: true);
						}
					}
					break;
				case Keys.Home:
					if (HasMenuItems(context))
					{
						menuItemBase2 = GetMenuItems(context).GetFirstMenuItem(selectableItemsOnly: true, HideNonRecentlyUsedItems);
					}
					break;
				case Keys.End:
					if (HasMenuItems(context))
					{
						menuItemBase2 = GetMenuItems(context).GetLastMenuItem(selectableItemsOnly: true, HideNonRecentlyUsedItems);
					}
					break;
				case Keys.Prior:
				case Keys.Next:
					return false;
				}
				if (menuItemBase2 != null && menuItemBase2 != activeMenuItem)
				{
					ActivateMenuItem(menuItemBase2);
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (activeMenuItem != null && activeMenuItem.Tool != null)
				{
					activeMenuItem.Tool.PostProcessNavigationKey(keyCode);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnAutoCloseUpCallback(AutoCloseUpInfo closeUpInfo)
		{
			if (closeUpInfo.Control == null || closeUpInfo.IsNonClientAreaMessage || closeUpInfo.Control is UltraToolbarsDockArea || closeUpInfo.Control is PopupControlBase || closeUpInfo.Control is UltraStatusBar || closeUpInfo.Button != MouseButtons.Left)
			{
				closeUpInfo.EatMouseMessage = false;
			}
			else if (ToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				if (ToolbarsManager.GetToolThatContainsControl(closeUpInfo.Control) != null)
				{
					closeUpInfo.EatMouseMessage = false;
				}
				else if (ToolbarsManager.EnforceOffice2007Resolution)
				{
					closeUpInfo.EatMouseMessage = true;
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnPopupClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (associatedMiniToolbarWindow != null)
			{
				associatedMiniToolbarWindow.AssociatedPopup = null;
				associatedMiniToolbarWindow = null;
			}
			PopupToolBase popupTool = PopupTool;
			if (popupTool != null && popupTool.OwnerIsToolbarBase && popupTool.OwningToolbarBase is MiniToolbar { Window: { } window })
			{
				window.ZeroDistance = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.CalculateDistanceFromRect(window.Bounds, Cursor.Position);
			}
			if (PopupControl != null)
			{
				((Control)(object)PopupControl).SizeChanged -= OnPopupSizeChanged;
			}
			showFullMenuTimerExpired = false;
			PopupControlBase popupControlBase = PopupControl;
			if (popupControlBase != null && PopupTool is PopupMenuTool)
			{
				if (toolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture == null && toolbarsManager.CurrentPopupControl == popupControlBase)
				{
					popupControlBase.AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(AccessibleEvents.SystemMenuEnd, -1);
				}
				popupControlBase.AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(AccessibleEvents.SystemMenuPopupEnd, -1);
			}
			if (!(this is PopupToolAgentBase))
			{
				ToolbarsManager.PopupManager.PopupClosed(this, PopupTool);
			}
			CancelPendingSubmenuDropDowns();
			DestroyDropShadows();
			if (popupControl != null)
			{
				((Component)(object)popupControl).Dispose();
			}
			PopupControl = null;
			DeactivateTimers();
			firstItemIndex = 0;
			if (PopupStyle == PopupStyle.Toolbar)
			{
				ToolBase activeTool = ToolbarsManager.ActiveTool;
				if (activeTool != null && activeTool.OwnerIsToolbarInternal && PopupTool != null && activeTool.OwningToolbarInternal.TearawayToolOwnerInternal == PopupTool)
				{
					if (ToolbarsManager.ToolbarWithCapture == activeTool.OwningToolbarInternal)
					{
						if (PopupTool.OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
						{
							ToolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture = PopupTool.OwningToolbarInternal;
						}
						else
						{
							ToolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture = null;
						}
					}
					ToolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(PopupTool, setOn: true, clearToolBeingEdited: false);
				}
			}
			owningControlForDropDown = null;
			toolbarsManager.NotifyAccessibilityFocusChange();
		}

		{
			return false;
		}

			OnPopupWidthChanged(((Control)(object)PopupControl).Width);
		}

		internal virtual AccessibleStates AccessibleState
		{
			get
			{
				AccessibleStates accessibleStates = AccessibleStates.None;
				accessibleStates = (Enabled ? (accessibleStates | AccessibleStates.Focusable) : (accessibleStates | AccessibleStates.Unavailable));
				if (IsCheckedAsVisible)
				{
					accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Checked;
				}
				if (MenuAgent != null && this == MenuAgent.ActiveMenuItem && MenuAgent.PopupControl == MenuAgent.ToolbarsManager.CurrentPopupControl)
				{
					accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Focused;
				}
				return accessibleStates;
			}
		}

		internal Size CachedSize
		{
			get
			{
				int widthConstraint = MenuAgent.GetWidthConstraint(this);
				if (cachedSize.IsEmpty || widthConstraint < lastWidthConstraint || lastLayoutVersion != ToolbarsManager.ToolLayoutVersion)
				{
					cachedSize = Size;
					if (Tool != null)
					{
						Tool.AdjustMenuItemSize(ref cachedSize);
					}
					lastWidthConstraint = cachedSize.Width;
					lastLayoutVersion = ToolbarsManager.ToolLayoutVersion;
				}
				return cachedSize;
			}
		}

		internal virtual string KeyboardShortcut
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Enabled)
				{
					return null;
				}
				string text = Text;
				int num = text.IndexOf('&');
				if (num < 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				for (int num2 = num; num2 < text.Length - 2; num2 = num)
				{
					char c = text[num2 + 1];
					if (char.IsLetterOrDigit(c))
					{
						return new string(c, 1);
					}
					num = text.IndexOf('&', num2 + 2);
					if (num <= num2)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

				switch (styleResolved - 5)

		protected internal virtual Size Size
		{
			get
			{
				Size nonTextAreaSize = GetNonTextAreaSize();
				int widthConstraint = MenuAgent.GetWidthConstraint(this);
				Size textAreaSize = GetTextAreaSize(widthConstraint - nonTextAreaSize.Width);
				nonTextAreaSize.Height = Math.Max(textAreaSize.Height + 2 * MenuAgent.Metrics.MenuitemPaddingTopBottom + 2 * MenuAgent.Metrics.MenuItemBorderThickness, nonTextAreaSize.Height);
				nonTextAreaSize.Width += textAreaSize.Width;
				nonTextAreaSize = ToolbarsManager.AdjustSizeForTouchMode(nonTextAreaSize, useLargeTouchSize: false);
				if (nonTextAreaSize.Width > widthConstraint)
				{
					nonTextAreaSize.Width = widthConstraint;
				}
				return nonTextAreaSize;
			}
		}

		internal int Index
		{
			get
			{
				MenuItemsCollection parentCollection = ParentCollection;
				if (parentCollection != null)
				{
					if (cachedIndex < 0 || cachedIndex >= parentCollection.Count || parentCollection[cachedIndex] != this)
					{
						cachedIndex = parentCollection.IndexOf(this);
					}
					return cachedIndex;
				}
				return -1;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsInEditMode
		{
			get
			{
				if (ToolbarsManager == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Editor != null)
				{
					if (Tool != null && !Tool.IsToolInEditMode)
					{
						return false;
					}
					return Editor.IsInEditMode;
				}
				return false;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Editor != null && (Tool == null || Tool.CanEnterEditMode) && IsInEditMode != value)
				{
					if (value)
					{
						Tool.EnterEditMode(EnterEditModeSource.Unspecified, throwExceptions: false, ensureToolIsActive: true);
					}
					else if (Tool != null)
					{
						Tool.ExitEditMode(forceExit: false, applyChanges: true);
					}
					else
					{
						Editor.ExitEditMode(false, true);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsFirstInGroupResolved
		{
			get
			{
				int index = Index;
				if (index == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!IsFirstInGroup)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (index > 0)
				{
					MenuItemsCollection parentCollection = ParentCollection;
					if (parentCollection != null)
					{
						MenuItemBase previousMenuItem = parentCollection.GetPreviousMenuItem(this, selectableItemsOnly: false, MenuAgent.HideNonRecentlyUsedItems, wrapAround: false);
						if (previousMenuItem == null || previousMenuItem == this || !previousMenuItem.SupportsTrailingSeparators)
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected Rectangle NotificationBadgeBounds()
		{
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			UIElement uIElement = UIElement;

			{

			DisplayArea preferredDisplayArea = NotificationBadgeSettingsResolved.PreferredDisplayArea;

			{
			case 0:
			case 1:
			{

				if (imageArea != Rectangle.Empty)
				{
					result = imageArea;
					break;
				}

				if (textArea2 != Rectangle.Empty)

		protected internal virtual Size GetTextAreaSize(int widthConstraint)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
			AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)65011720;
			ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, DrawAsActive);
			Size result;
			if (CanSetToolWidth)
			{
				result = Tool.CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstance();
				if (Tool.InstanceProps != null)
				{
					result.Width = Tool.WidthResolved;
					if (Tool.InstanceProps.Width > 0 || Tool.SharedProps.Width > 0)
					{
						widthConstraint = Math.Min(widthConstraint, result.Width);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				result = GetTextSize(ref appearance);
			}
			Size size = Size.Empty;
			string shortcutText = ShortcutText;
			if (Editor == null && !ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(shortcutText))
			{
				size = MeasureString(ref appearance, null, shortcutText);
				shortcutTextWidth = size.Width;
			}
			if (size.Width > 0)
			{
				result.Width += MenuAgent.Metrics.MenuitemTextToShortcutPadding + size.Width;
			}
			int num = widthConstraint - MenuAgent.Metrics.MenuitemArrowAreaWidth;
			result.Width = Math.Min(result.Width, num);
			Size descriptionSize = GetDescriptionSize(num);
			if (result.Height > 0 && descriptionSize.Height > 0)
			{
				result.Height += 8;
			}
			result.Height += descriptionSize.Height;
			result.Width = Math.Max(result.Width, descriptionSize.Width);
			result.Width += MenuAgent.Metrics.MenuitemArrowAreaWidth;
			return result;
		}

		internal void DropDown(bool delay, bool closeIfAlreadyOpen, bool autocloseDropdown)
		{
			if (ParentCollection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			PopupControlBase popupControl = MenuAgent.PopupControl;
			if (popupControl == null || ((Control)(object)popupControl).IsDisposed || ((Control)(object)popupControl).Disposing)
			{
				return;
			}
			UIElement uIElement = UIElement;
			if (uIElement != null)
			{
				Rectangle rect = uIElement.Rect;
				if (ToolbarsManager.IsNonOffice2000Style && uIElement.GetAncestor(typeof(PopupMenuControlUIElement)) is PopupMenuControlUIElement popupMenuControlUIElement)
				{
					rect = ((UIElement)popupMenuControlUIElement).Rect;
					rect.Y = uIElement.Rect.Y;
					rect.Inflate(-1, -1);
				}
				Control control = uIElement.Control;
				if (control != null && !control.IsDisposed && !control.Disposing)
				{
					Rectangle rectangle = control.RectangleToScreen(rect);
					Rectangle exclusionRect = rectangle;
					bool rightAlignedMenusResolved = ToolbarsManager.RightAlignedMenusResolved;
					Point point = ((Tool != null && Tool.OwningApplicationMenuArea is ApplicationMenuLeftArea) ? control.PointToScreen(ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.ApplicationMenu.LeftAreaOwnedMenuDropDownRect.Location) : ((!rightAlignedMenusResolved) ? new Point(exclusionRect.Right, rectangle.Top) : new Point(exclusionRect.Left, rectangle.Top)));
					DropDown((Control)(object)popupControl, point, exclusionRect, (DropDownPosition)(rightAlignedMenusResolved ? 1 : 2), delay, closeIfAlreadyOpen, rightAlignedMenusResolved, autocloseDropdown);
				}
			}
		}

		internal Size GetNonTextAreaSize()
		{
			//IL_0104: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0109: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Size result = new Size(0, 0);
			Size imageSize = MenuAgent.GetImageSize(this);
			result.Width = MenuAgent.Metrics.MenuitemTextPaddingLeft;
			bool isLabelHeader = IsLabelHeader;
			if (!isLabelHeader && MenuAgent.ShouldShowImages(this))
			{
				result.Width += imageSize.Width + MenuAgent.Metrics.MenuitemImagePaddingLeft + MenuAgent.Metrics.MenuitemImagePaddingRight;
			}
			else if (!ToolbarsManager.TouchMetricsEnabledResolved)
			{
				imageSize.Height = 0;
			}
			if (MenuAgent.IsSideStripVisible)
			{
				result.Width += MenuAgent.SideStripWidth;
			}
			if (MenuAgent.IsSideStripVisible)
			{
				result.Width += MenuAgent.SideStripWidth;
			}
			if (ToolbarsManager.IsNonOffice2000Style)
			{
				result.Width += 2;
			}
			else
			{
				UIElementBorderWidths val = ToolbarsManager.CalculateBorderWidths((UIElementBorderStyle)6);
				result.Width += ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Left + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Right;
			}
			Size size;
			if (!isLabelHeader && MenuAgent.ShouldShowAddRemoveCheckColumn(this))
			{
				size = ToolbarsManager.CheckMarkElementSize;
				result.Width += size.Width + 2;
			}
			else
			{
				size = new Size(0, 0);
			}
			result.Height += Math.Max(imageSize.Height + 2 * MenuAgent.Metrics.MenuitemPaddingTopBottom + 2 * MenuAgent.Metrics.MenuItemBorderThickness, size.Height);
			return result;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ProcessEnterKey()
		{
			if (!IsPopup || DropDownArrowStyle == DropDownArrowStyle.Segmented || DropDownArrowStyle == DropDownArrowStyle.SegmentedStateButton)
			{
				Deactivate();
				ToolbarsManager.PopupManager.CloseAllPopups(onlyCloseLeafContiguousPopupChain: true);
			}
			OnClick();
			return true;
		}

		internal virtual void CalculateMinimumMenuItemRect(ref Rectangle rectWork, int itemTop, ref AppearanceData appearanceData)
		{
			rectWork.X += Padding.Width;
			rectWork.Width -= 2 * Padding.Width;
			rectWork.Y = itemTop;
			rectWork.Height = MinimumSize.Height + 2 * Padding.Height;
		}

		internal virtual void CalculateMenuItemRect(ref Rectangle rectWork, int itemTop, ref AppearanceData appearanceData)
		{
			rectWork.X += Padding.Width;
			rectWork.Width -= 2 * Padding.Width;
			rectWork.Y = itemTop;
			rectWork.Height = CachedSize.Height + 2 * Padding.Height;
		}

		protected internal virtual void CloseDropDown(bool delay)
		{
			PopupToolBase popupToolBase = null;
			if (Tool != null)
			{
				popupToolBase = Tool.PopupTool;
			}
			if (popupToolBase != null && popupToolBase.IsMenuAgentCreated)
			{
				if (MenuAgent != popupToolBase.MenuAgent)
				{
					popupToolBase.MenuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay);
				}
				UIElement uIElement = UIElement;
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					uIElement.DirtyChildElements(true);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual AccessibleObject CreateAccessibilityInstance()
		{
			return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new MenuItemAccessibleObject(this)).AccessibleObject;
		}

		protected internal virtual void Deactivate()
		{
			if (MenuAgent != null)
			{
				MenuAgent.OnMenuItemDeactivated(this);
			}
			UIElement uIElement = UIElement;
			if (uIElement != null)
			{
				if (MenuAgent != null && MenuAgent.AreTransitionsEnabled)
				{
					uIElement.InitiateTransition(UltraToolbarsManager.DefaultTransitionSettings, (UIElementTransitionType)0);
				}
				uIElement.DirtyChildElements();
			}
		}

			}

		private Size GetDescriptionSize(int widthConstraint)
		{
			//IL_0030: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Control control = (Control)(object)MenuAgent.PopupControl;
			if (control == null)
			{
				control = (Control)(object)MenuAgent.ToolbarsManager.GetValidDockArea(DockedPosition.Top);
			}
			ParsedFormattedTextValue formattedDescriptionOnMenu = FormattedDescriptionOnMenu;
			if (control != null && formattedDescriptionOnMenu != null)
			{
				AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
				AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)62914568;
				ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, DrawAsActive);
				Size result = formattedDescriptionOnMenu.CalcSize(control, ref appearance, widthConstraint);
				result.Width = Math.Min(widthConstraint, result.Width);
				return result;
			}
			return Size.Empty;
		}

		bool IProcessMnemonic.Activate()
		{
			MenuAgentBase menuAgent = MenuAgent;
			if (menuAgent == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (menuAgent.ActiveMenuItem != this)
			{
				if (menuAgent.ActiveMenuItem != null)
				{
					menuAgent.ActiveMenuItem.Deactivate();
				}
				Activate();
			}
			return menuAgent.ActiveMenuItem == this;
		}

		bool IProcessMnemonic.ProcessMnemonic()
		{
			MenuAgentBase menuAgent = MenuAgent;
			if (menuAgent == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!((IProcessMnemonic)this).Activate())
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ProcessEnterKey();
		}

		public Rectangle GetNotificationBadgeBounds()
		{
			return NotificationBadgeBounds();
		}

	internal class MenuItemsCollection : KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase, IProvideUIAutomation

		internal class MenuItemsCollectionUiaProviderStub : FragmentUIAProviderStub
		{
			private int currentVersion = -1;

			private List<MenuItemBase.MenuItemBaseUiaProviderStub> itemStubList;

			public override bool IsDelegatingProvider => true;

			internal MenuItemsCollection ItemsCollection => ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)this).Context as MenuItemsCollection;

			internal List<MenuItemBase.MenuItemBaseUiaProviderStub> ItemStubList
			{
				get
				{
					SynchronizeItemStubs();
					return itemStubList;
				}
			}

			internal MenuItemsCollectionUiaProviderStub(MenuItemsCollection itemsCollection)
				: base((object)itemsCollection)
			{
			}

			protected override string CreateAutomationId()
			{
				string arg = ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)this).GetParent().GetPropertyValue(30011) as string;
				return $"{arg} Items";
			}

			public override Rectangle GetBoundingRectangle()
			{
				return Rectangle.Empty;
			}

			public override ControlType GetControlType()
			{
				return ControlType.Group;
			}

			public override IRawElementProviderFragmentRoot GetFragmentRoot()
			{
				return ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)this).GetParent()?.FragmentRoot;
			}

			protected override bool GetIsEnabled()
			{
				IRawElementProviderFragment parent = ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)this).GetParent();
				if (parent == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return (bool)parent.GetPropertyValue(30010);
			}

			protected override bool GetIsKeyboardFocusable()
			{
				return false;
			}

			protected override Control GetMarshallingControl()
			{
				return Utilities.GetMarshallingControl(((FragmentUIAProviderStub)this).GetParent());
			}

			public override IRawElementProviderFragment GetParent()
			{
				MenuItemsCollection itemsCollection = ItemsCollection;
				if (itemsCollection.MenuAgent is ApplicationMenuAgent applicationMenuAgent)
				{
					if (itemsCollection == applicationMenuAgent.MenuItemsRight)
					{
						return applicationMenuAgent.RightUIAutomationProvider;
					}
					return applicationMenuAgent.LeftUIAutomationProvider;
				}
				IProvideUIAutomation menuAgent = (IProvideUIAutomation)(object)itemsCollection.MenuAgent;
				if (menuAgent == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return menuAgent.UIAutomationProvider;
			}

			public override IRawElementProviderFragment GetFirstChild()
			{
				if (ItemStubList.Count == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)itemStubList[0]).Provider;
			}

			public override IRawElementProviderFragment GetLastChild()
			{
				int count = ItemStubList.Count;
				if (count == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)itemStubList[count - 1]).Provider;
			}

			public override IRawElementProviderFragment NavigateChildren(FragmentUIAProviderStub childStub, bool forward)
			{
				if (childStub is MenuItemBase.MenuItemBaseUiaProviderStub { Index: var index })
				{
					int num = index + (forward ? 1 : (-1));
					if (num >= 0 && num < ItemStubList.Count)
					{
						return ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)itemStubList[num]).Provider;
					}
				}
				return ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)this).NavigateChildren(childStub, forward);
			}

			private void SynchronizeItemStubs()
			{
				if (ItemsCollection.Version == currentVersion)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (itemStubList == null)
				{
					itemStubList = new List<MenuItemBase.MenuItemBaseUiaProviderStub>();
				}
				itemStubList.Clear();
				foreach (MenuItemBase item in ItemsCollection)
				{
					MenuItemBase.MenuItemBaseUiaProviderStub automationProviderStub = item.AutomationProviderStub;
					((FragmentUIAProviderStub)automationProviderStub).ClearCachedAutomationId();
					itemStubList.Add(item.AutomationProviderStub);
				}
				currentVersion = ItemsCollection.Version;
			}
		}

		private void BumpVersion()
		{
			if (version == int.MaxValue)
			{
				version = int.MinValue;
			}
			else
			{
				version++;
			}
		}

		{
			this.menuAgent = menuAgent;
		}

		internal int Add(MenuItemBase menuItem)
		{
			if (menuItem == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_29"));
			}
			return InternalAdd(menuItem);
		}

		internal void Clear()
		{
			InternalClear();
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.MenuItems);
		}

		public MenuItemEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new MenuItemEnumerator(this);
		}

		internal MenuItemBase GetFirstMenuItem(bool selectableItemsOnly, bool recentlyUsedItemsOnly)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				if ((!selectableItemsOnly || (this[i].Enabled && this[i].CanActivate)) && (!recentlyUsedItemsOnly || this[i].RecentlyUsed))
				{
					return this[i];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal MenuItemBase GetLastMenuItem(bool selectableItemsOnly, bool recentlyUsedItemsOnly)
		{
			for (int num = Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if ((!selectableItemsOnly || (this[num].Enabled && this[num].CanActivate)) && (!recentlyUsedItemsOnly || this[num].RecentlyUsed))
				{
					return this[num];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal MenuItemBase GetNextMenuItem(MenuItemBase startAtMenuItem, bool selectableItemsOnly, bool recentlyUsedItemsOnly, bool wrapAround)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (startAtMenuItem != null)
			{
				num = IndexOf(startAtMenuItem) + 1;
			}
			for (int i = num; i < Count; i++)
			{
				if ((!selectableItemsOnly || (this[i].Enabled && this[i].CanActivate)) && (!recentlyUsedItemsOnly || this[i].RecentlyUsed))
				{
					return this[i];
				}
			}
			if (wrapAround && num > 0)
			{
				return GetNextMenuItem(null, selectableItemsOnly, recentlyUsedItemsOnly, wrapAround: false);
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal MenuItemBase GetPreviousMenuItem(MenuItemBase startAtMenuItem, bool selectableItemsOnly, bool recentlyUsedItemsOnly, bool wrapAround)
		{
			int num = Count - 1;
			if (startAtMenuItem != null)
			{
				num = IndexOf(startAtMenuItem) - 1;
			}
			for (int num2 = num; num2 >= 0; num2--)
			{
				if ((!selectableItemsOnly || (this[num2].Enabled && this[num2].CanActivate)) && (!recentlyUsedItemsOnly || this[num2].RecentlyUsed))
				{
					return this[num2];
				}
			}
			if (wrapAround && num < Count - 1)
			{
				return GetPreviousMenuItem(null, selectableItemsOnly, recentlyUsedItemsOnly, wrapAround: false);
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal int InternalAdd(MenuItemBase menuItem)
		{
			menuItem.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			int result = InternalAdd((IKeyedSubObject)menuItem);
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.MenuItems);
			return result;
		}

		protected override object[] CreateArray()
		{
			return new MenuItemBase[Count];
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			MenuItemEnumerator menuItemEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (menuItemEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					MenuItemBase current = menuItemEnumerator.Current;
					current.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					current.Dispose();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = menuItemEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			menuAgent = null;
			InternalClear();
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.MenuItems, propChange);
		}
	}

		internal int SystemDpi
		{
			get
			{
				if (cachedDpi == -1)
				{
					cachedDpi = 96;
					UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
					if (ultraToolbarsManager != null && ultraToolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer != null)
					{
						try
						{
							UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.SafeSubWindows);
							if (Utilities.CanAssert)
							{
								uIPermission.Assert();
							}
							using Graphics graphics = ultraToolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer.CreateGraphics();
							cachedDpi = (int)Math.Round(graphics.DpiY);
						}
						catch
						{
						}
					}
				}
				return cachedDpi;
			}
		}

		private Point CursorOffset

				int y = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.InterpolateValue(0, 96, SystemDpi, 0, -14, ensureInRange: false);
				return new Point(x, y);
			}
		}

		internal MiniToolbar(UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager)
		{
			this.toolbarsManager = toolbarsManager;
		}

		protected MiniToolbar(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "AutoShow":
					autoShow = (MiniToolbarAutoShow)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(MiniToolbarAutoShow), autoShow);
					break;
				case "Settings":
					settings = (MiniToolbarSettings)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(MiniToolbarSettings), settings);
					break;
				case "ToolRowCount":
					toolRowCount = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), toolRowCount);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		protected override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
			if (autoShow != MiniToolbarAutoShow.OnContextMenuClick)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "AutoShow", autoShow);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeSettings())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Settings", settings);
			}
			if (toolRowCount != 2)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ToolRowCount", toolRowCount);
			}
		}

		internal override void AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(AccessibleEvents accEvent, int childID)
		{
			DockArea?.AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(accEvent, childID);
		}

		internal override UltraToolbarBase Clone()
		{
			MiniToolbar miniToolbar = new MiniToolbar(toolbarsManager);
			miniToolbar.InitializeFrom(this);
			return miniToolbar;
		}

		internal override void Initialize(object owner)
		{
			if (owner is UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager)
			{
				toolbarsManager = ultraToolbarsManager;
			}
			base.Initialize(owner);
			if (settings != null)
			{
				settings.Initialize(this);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override bool ShouldSerializeKey()
		{
			return false;
		}

		internal override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
		{
			return DockArea?.NavigateToolbar(this, navdir);
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (settings != null)
			{
				settings.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				settings.Dispose();
			}
			toolbarsManager = null;
			settingsResolved = null;
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo)
		{
			if (propChangeInfo.Source == Tools)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Tools, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (propChangeInfo.Source == settings)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Settings, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (((INotificationBadgeSettingsOwner)this).HasNotificationBadgeSettings && base.NotificationBadgeSettings == propChangeInfo.Source)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.NotificationBadgeSettings, propChangeInfo);
			}
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			base.Reset();
			AutoShow = MiniToolbarAutoShow.OnContextMenuClick;
			ResetSettings();
			ToolRowCount = 2;
		}

		public override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && AutoShow == MiniToolbarAutoShow.OnContextMenuClick && !ShouldSerializeSettings())
			{
				return ToolRowCount != 2;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void Show()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (ultraToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager mdiParentManagerInternal = ultraToolbarsManager.MdiParentManagerInternal;
				if (mdiParentManagerInternal != null)
				{
					mdiParentManagerInternal.MiniToolbar.Show();
					return;
				}
			}
			if (!isShowing)
			{
				ShowMiniToolbarWindow(CreateMiniToolbarWindow(Cursor.Position, offset: true), setZeroDistanceToBeCurrentDistance: false);
			}
		}

		public void Show(Point screenLocation)
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (ultraToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager mdiParentManagerInternal = ultraToolbarsManager.MdiParentManagerInternal;
				if (mdiParentManagerInternal != null)
				{
					mdiParentManagerInternal.MiniToolbar.Show(screenLocation);
					return;
				}
			}
			if (!isShowing)
			{
				ShowMiniToolbarWindow(CreateMiniToolbarWindow(screenLocation, offset: false), setZeroDistanceToBeCurrentDistance: true);
			}
		}

		internal MiniToolbarWindow CreateMiniToolbarWindow(Point screenLocation, bool offset)
		{
			return CreateMiniToolbarWindow(screenLocation, offset, isTopLevel: true);
		}

		internal MiniToolbarWindow CreateMiniToolbarWindow(Point screenLocation, bool offset, bool isTopLevel)
		{
			return CreateMiniToolbarWindow(screenLocation, offset, isTopLevel, null, null);
		}

		internal MiniToolbarWindow CreateMiniToolbarWindow(Point screenLocation, bool offset, bool isTopLevel, PopupToolBase popupTool, Control sourceControl)
		{
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (ultraToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				BeforeMiniToolbarShownEventArgs e = new BeforeMiniToolbarShownEventArgs(popupTool, sourceControl);
				ultraToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.BeforeMiniToolbarShown, e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			Size sizeNeededForItemArea = GetSizeNeededForItemArea();
			if (sizeNeededForItemArea == Size.Empty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (ultraToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				UIElementBorderWidths val = ultraToolbarsManager.CalculateBorderWidths(BorderStyle);
				sizeNeededForItemArea.Width += ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Left + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Right;
				sizeNeededForItemArea.Height += ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Top + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Bottom;
			}
			sizeNeededForItemArea.Width += PaddingLeftResolved + PaddingRightResolved;
			sizeNeededForItemArea.Height += PaddingTopResolved + PaddingBottomResolved;
			if (offset)
			{
				Point cursorOffset = CursorOffset;
				screenLocation.Offset(cursorOffset.X, cursorOffset.Y);
				screenLocation.Offset(0, -sizeNeededForItemArea.Height);
			}
			MiniToolbarWindow miniToolbarWindow = ((!isTopLevel) ? new MiniToolbarWindow(this, isTopLevel) : MiniToolbarWindow.Create(this));
			miniToolbarWindow.Location = screenLocation;
			miniToolbarWindow.Size = sizeNeededForItemArea;
			return miniToolbarWindow;
		}

		internal void ShowDesigner()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (ultraToolbarsManager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool designerChangeNotificationsEnabled = ((IUltraComponent)ultraToolbarsManager).DesignerChangeNotificationsEnabled;
			((IUltraComponent)ultraToolbarsManager).DesignerChangeNotificationsEnabled = false;
			IUltraToolbarsManagerDesigner ultraToolbarsManagerDesigner = null;
			MiniToolbarCustomizer miniToolbarCustomizer = null;
			bool customizing = ultraToolbarsManager.Customizing;
			try
			{
				ultraToolbarsManagerDesigner = ultraToolbarsManager.DesignerHost.GetDesigner((IComponent)ultraToolbarsManager) as IUltraToolbarsManagerDesigner;
				if (!customizing)
				{
					miniToolbarCustomizer = new MiniToolbarCustomizer(ultraToolbarsManagerDesigner);
					miniToolbarCustomizer.EnterCustomizeMode();
				}
				MiniToolbarDesigner form = (ultraToolbarsManager.MiniToolbarDesigner = new MiniToolbarDesigner(this));
				ultraToolbarsManagerDesigner.ShowDialogInternal(form, null);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				UltraMessageBoxManager.Show(ex.Message, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ErrorMessageCaption"));
			}
			finally
			{
				ultraToolbarsManager.MiniToolbarDesigner = null;
				((IUltraComponent)ultraToolbarsManager).DesignerChangeNotificationsEnabled = designerChangeNotificationsEnabled;
				if (!customizing)
				{
					miniToolbarCustomizer?.ExitCustomizeMode();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ShowMiniToolbarWindow(MiniToolbarWindow window, bool setZeroDistanceToBeCurrentDistance)
		{
			//IL_0076: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (this.window != null && this.window != null)
			{
				this.window.Close();
			}
			if (window == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			IntPtr hWndInsertAfter = IntPtr.Zero;
			if (ultraToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				Control dockWithinContainer = ultraToolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer;
				if (dockWithinContainer != null)
				{
					hWndInsertAfter = UltraToolbarsManager.FindFormHelper(dockWithinContainer)?.Handle ?? dockWithinContainer.Handle;
				}
			}
			this.window = window;
			this.window.Closed += OnWindowClosed;
			DropDownRepositionInfo val = default(DropDownRepositionInfo);
			((DropDownRepositionInfo)(ref val)).LeaveRoomForShadows = true;
			this.window.Bounds = DropDownManager.CalculateDropRect(Rectangle.Empty, this.window.Bounds, (Control)null, false, (DropDownPosition)0, val);
			if (setZeroDistanceToBeCurrentDistance)
			{
				this.window.ZeroDistance = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.CalculateDistanceFromRect(this.window.Bounds, Cursor.Position);
			}
			try
			{
				NativeWindowMethods.SetWindowPosApi(this.window.Handle, hWndInsertAfter, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1555);
				NativeWindowMethods.ShowWindowApi(this.window.Handle, 8);
				this.window.Visible = true;
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				this.window.Show();
			}
			isShowing = true;
			if (ultraToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				AfterMiniToolbarShownEventArgs e = new AfterMiniToolbarShownEventArgs();
				ultraToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.AfterMiniToolbarShown, e);
			}
		}

		private Size GetSizeNeededForItemArea()
		{
			ToolBase[] array = GetTools();
			if (array.Length == 0)
			{
				return Size.Empty;
			}
			int toolSpacingResolved = ToolSpacingResolved;
			int num = 0;
			List<MiniToolbarLayoutItem> list = new List<MiniToolbarLayoutItem>();
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = 0;
			int val = 0;
			foreach (ToolBase toolBase in array)
			{
				if (toolBase.VisibleResolved)
				{
					if (list.Count > 0)
					{
						num2 += toolSpacingResolved;
					}
					if (toolBase.IsFirstInGroupResolved && list.Count > 0)
					{
						MiniToolbarSeparatorLayoutItem miniToolbarSeparatorLayoutItem = new MiniToolbarSeparatorLayoutItem();
						miniToolbarSeparatorLayoutItem.Size.Width = 6;
						list.Add(miniToolbarSeparatorLayoutItem);
						num2 += miniToolbarSeparatorLayoutItem.Size.Width;
					}
					MiniToolbarLayoutItem miniToolbarLayoutItem = new MiniToolbarLayoutItem();
					miniToolbarLayoutItem.Size.Width = toolBase.WidthResolved;
					miniToolbarLayoutItem.Size.Height = toolBase.Height;
					list.Add(miniToolbarLayoutItem);
					num2 += miniToolbarLayoutItem.Size.Width;
					num3 = Math.Max(num3, miniToolbarLayoutItem.Size.Height);
					val = Math.Max(val, miniToolbarLayoutItem.Size.Width);
					num++;
				}
			}
			if (num == 0)
			{
				return Size.Empty;
			}
			if (ToolRowCount == 1)
			{
				return new Size(num2, num3);
			}
			int num4 = Math.Min(num, ToolRowCount);
			int num5 = Math.Max(val, num2 / num4);
			int num6 = int.MaxValue;
			int num7 = 0;
			int j = 0;
			int num8 = 0;
			int num9 = 0;
			for (int k = 0; k < num4; k++)
			{
				int num10 = 0;
				int num11 = 0;
				int num12 = 0;
				for (; j < list.Count; j++)
				{
					MiniToolbarLayoutItem miniToolbarLayoutItem2 = list[j];
					bool flag = miniToolbarLayoutItem2 is MiniToolbarSeparatorLayoutItem;
					if (!flag || num11 != 0)
					{
						if (num11 > 0 && k != num4 - 1 && num10 + miniToolbarLayoutItem2.Size.Width > num5)
						{
							break;
						}
						if (!flag)
						{
							num11++;
							num12 = Math.Max(num12, miniToolbarLayoutItem2.Size.Height);
							num10 += toolSpacingResolved;
						}
						num10 += miniToolbarLayoutItem2.Size.Width;
					}
				}
				if (num11 > 0)
				{
					num10 -= toolSpacingResolved;
				}
				MiniToolbarLayoutItem miniToolbarLayoutItem3 = list[j - 1];
				if (miniToolbarLayoutItem3 is MiniToolbarSeparatorLayoutItem)
				{
					num10 -= miniToolbarLayoutItem3.Size.Width;
				}
				if (num10 > num5)
				{
					num5++;
					num9 = 0;
					j = 0;
					num8 = 0;
					k = -1;
				}
				else
				{
					num8 = Math.Max(num8, num10);
					num9 += num12;
				}
			}
			if (num8 < num6 || (num8 == num6 && num9 < num7))
			{
				num6 = num8;
				num7 = num9;
			}
			return new Size(num6, num7);
		}

		private ToolBase[] GetTools()
		{
			int count = Tools.Count;
			count += ExtraTools.Length;
			ToolBase[] array = new ToolBase[count];
			Tools.CopyTo(array, 0);
			Array.Copy(ExtraTools, 0, array, Tools.Count, ExtraTools.Length);
			return array;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeSettings()
		{
			if (settings != null)
			{
				return settings.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetSettings()
		{
			if (settings != null)
			{
				settings.Reset();
			}
		}

		private void OnWindowClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			CloseOpenSubmenuTools(null);
			window.Closed -= OnWindowClosed;
			window.Dispose();
			window = null;
			isShowing = false;
		}
	}
	public class MiniToolbarControlElement : ControlUIElementBase
	{
		private MiniToolbar miniToolbar;

		public override bool AreTouchMetricsEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (miniToolbar.ToolbarsManager != null)
				{
					return miniToolbar.ToolbarsManager.TouchMetricsEnabledResolved;
				}
				return ((ControlUIElementBase)this).AreTouchMetricsEnabled;
			}
		}

		public override UIElementBorderStyle BorderStyle => miniToolbar.BorderStyle;

		public MiniToolbarControlElement(MiniToolbarWindow control)
			: base((Control)control, (IUltraControl)(object)control.MiniToolbar.ToolbarsManager)
		{
			miniToolbar = control.MiniToolbar;
			((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext = miniToolbar;
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			miniToolbar.ToolbarsManager?.ResolveToolbarAppearance(miniToolbar, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			((ControlUIElementBase)this).InitAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}
	}

			((System.ComponentModel.ISupportInitialize)this.nudToolRowCount).EndInit();
			base.ResumeLayout(false);
		}

			{
				components.Dispose();
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		{

			lbDescription.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("MiniToolbarDesignerDescription");
			lbToolRowCount.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("MiniToolbarDesignerToolRowCount");
			btOK.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("MiniToolbarDesignerOK");
		}

		private void PositionMiniToolbar()
		{
			window = miniToolbar.CreateMiniToolbarWindow(Point.Empty, offset: false, isTopLevel: false);
			if (window != null)
			{
				if (window.Width > pnlMiniToolbarHolder.Width)
				{
					int num = window.Width - pnlMiniToolbarHolder.Width;
					base.Left -= num / 2;
					base.Width += num;
				}
				if (window.Height > pnlMiniToolbarHolder.Height)
				{
					int num2 = window.Height - pnlMiniToolbarHolder.Height;
					base.Top -= num2 / 2;
					base.Height += num2;
				}
				SetMiniToolbarWindowLocation();
				window.Visible = true;
				pnlMiniToolbarHolder.Controls.Add(window);
			}
		}

		private void SetMiniToolbarWindowLocation()
		{
			window.Location = new Point((pnlMiniToolbarHolder.Width - window.Width) / 2, (pnlMiniToolbarHolder.Height - window.Height) / 2);
		}

		internal void UpdateDesigner()
		{
			if (window != null)
			{
				if (window.MiniToolbar.ToolbarsManager.PopupControls.Count != 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				pnlMiniToolbarHolder.Controls.Remove(window);
				window.Dispose();
			}
			PositionMiniToolbar();
		}

		private void miniToolbar_SubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			UpdateDesigner();
		}

		private void nudToolRowCount_ValueChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			miniToolbar.ToolRowCount = (int)nudToolRowCount.Value;
		}

		private void pnlMiniToolbarHolder_SizeChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			SetMiniToolbarWindowLocation();
		}

		private int CloseThreshold => ToolbarsManagerUtilities.InterpolateValue(destinationRangeEnd: (!hasMouseGoneOverMiniToolbar) ? 117 : 184, sourceRangeStart: 0, sourceRangeEnd: 96, sourceValue: miniToolbar.SystemDpi, destinationRangeStart: 0, ensureInRange: false);

		private int TransparencyThreshold => ToolbarsManagerUtilities.InterpolateValue(destinationRangeEnd: (!hasMouseGoneOverMiniToolbar) ? 17 : 84, sourceRangeStart: 0, sourceRangeEnd: 96, sourceValue: miniToolbar.SystemDpi, destinationRangeStart: 0, ensureInRange: false);

		private System.Windows.Forms.Timer TransparencyTimer
		{
			get
			{
				if (transparencyTimer == null)
				{
					transparencyTimer = new System.Windows.Forms.Timer();
					transparencyTimer.Interval = 50;
					transparencyTimer.Tick += OnTransparancyTimerTick;
				}
				return transparencyTimer;
			}
		}

		internal MiniToolbarWindow(MiniToolbar miniToolbar)
			: this(miniToolbar, isTopLevel: true)
		{
		}

		internal MiniToolbarWindow(MiniToolbar miniToolbar, bool isTopLevel)
		{
			//IL_010f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0114: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0119: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00d7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e1: Expected O, but got Unknown
			this.miniToolbar = miniToolbar;
			this.isTopLevel = isTopLevel;
			base.TopLevel = isTopLevel;
			base.FormBorderStyle = FormBorderStyle.None;
			base.StartPosition = FormStartPosition.Manual;
			base.MinimizeBox = false;
			MinimumSize = new Size(1, 1);
			base.MaximizeBox = false;
			base.ControlBox = false;
			base.HelpButton = false;
			base.ShowInTaskbar = false;
			SetStyle(ControlStyles.FixedHeight, value: true);
			SetStyle(ControlStyles.FixedWidth, value: true);
			SetStyle(ControlStyles.Selectable, value: false);
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = this.miniToolbar.ToolbarsManager;
			if (this.isTopLevel)
			{
				base.Opacity = 0.0;
				if (toolbarsManager != null)
				{
					Form form = toolbarsManager.FindForm();
					if (form != null)
					{
						Form mdiParent = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetMdiParent(form);
						if (mdiParent != null)
						{
							base.Owner = mdiParent;
						}
						else
						{
							base.Owner = form;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						WPFInteropUtilities.SetWindowAsOwner(toolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer, (Form)this);
					}
				}
				shadowManager = new ShadowManager((Form)this, Rectangle.Empty);
				shadowManager.Opacity = 0.0;
			}
			SuspendLayout();
			if (toolbarsManager != null)
			{
				UIElementBorderWidths val = this.miniToolbar.ToolbarsManager.CalculateBorderWidths(this.miniToolbar.BorderStyle);
				base.DockPadding.Bottom = ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Bottom;
				base.DockPadding.Top = ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Top;
				base.DockPadding.Left = ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Left;
				base.DockPadding.Right = ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Right;
			}
			dockArea = new UltraToolbarsDockArea(DockedPosition.Floating);
			dockArea.ToolbarsManager = this.miniToolbar.ToolbarsManager;
			((Control)(object)dockArea).Name = "DockArea";
			dockArea.AddToolbar(this.miniToolbar, 0, 0);
			base.Controls.Add((Control)(object)dockArea);
			ResumeLayout(performLayout: false);
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				if (element != null)
				{
					((DisposableObject)(object)element).Dispose();
					element = null;
				}
				if (transparencyTimer != null)
				{
					transparencyTimer.Dispose();
					transparencyTimer = null;
				}
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		protected override void OnClosed(EventArgs e)
		{
			isFiringClosedEvent = true;
			base.OnClosed(e);
			isFiringClosedEvent = false;
			Application.EnterThreadModal -= OnApplicationEnterThreadModal;
			Application.LeaveThreadModal -= OnApplicationLeaveThreadModal;
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = miniToolbar.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager != null)
			{
				AfterMiniToolbarHiddenEventArgs e2 = new AfterMiniToolbarHiddenEventArgs();
				toolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.AfterMiniToolbarHidden, e2);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnLoad(EventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (isTopLevel)
			{
				shadowManager.Show();
				TransparencyTimer.Start();
			}
			try
			{
				base.Region = DrawUtility.CreateBorderRegion(base.ClientRectangle, miniToolbar.BorderStyle);
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
			modalCounter = 0;
			Application.EnterThreadModal += OnApplicationEnterThreadModal;
			Application.LeaveThreadModal += OnApplicationLeaveThreadModal;
			base.OnLoad(e);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (isTopLevel)
			{
				hasMouseGoneOverMiniToolbar = true;
				TransparencyTimer.Stop();
				UpdateWindow();
			}
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (isTopLevel)
			{
				TransparencyTimer.Start();
			}
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
		}

		protected override void OnPaint(PaintEventArgs pe)
		{
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			base.OnPaint(pe);
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = miniToolbar.ToolbarsManager;
			if (UIElement != null && toolbarsManager != null && !((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)toolbarsManager).IsUpdating)
			{
				((UIElement)UIElement).Draw(pe.Graphics, pe.ClipRectangle, !GetStyle(ControlStyles.OptimizedDoubleBuffer), ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)toolbarsManager).AlphaBlendMode);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateOpacity(double newOpacity)
		{
			if (newOpacity == 1.0)
			{
				newOpacity = 0.99999;
			}
			base.Opacity = newOpacity;
			shadowManager.Opacity = newOpacity;
		}

		private void UpdateWindow()
		{
			if (isFiringClosedEvent)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (modalCounter > 0)
			{
				UpdateOpacity(1.0);
				return;
			}
			if (!isTopLevel)
			{
				UpdateOpacity(1.0);
				return;
			}
			Point position = Cursor.Position;
			if (position == lastCursorPosition)
			{
				return;
			}
			lastCursorPosition = position;
			if (associatedPopup != null && associatedPopup.MenuAgent.IsOpen)
			{
				UpdateOpacity(1.0);
				return;
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = miniToolbar.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager != null)
			{
				ToolBase toolBeingEdited = toolbarsManager.ToolBeingEdited;
				if (toolBeingEdited != null && toolBeingEdited.Owner == MiniToolbar)
				{
					UpdateOpacity(1.0);
					return;
				}
				PopupControlBase currentPopupControl = toolbarsManager.CurrentPopupControl;
				if (currentPopupControl != null)
				{
					PopupToolBase popupTool = currentPopupControl.MenuAgent.PopupTool;
					if (popupTool != null && popupTool.UltimateOwner == MiniToolbar)
					{
						UpdateOpacity(1.0);
						return;
					}
				}
				if (toolbarsManager.EventManager.InProgress(ToolbarEventIds.ToolClick))
				{
					Control dockWithinContainer = toolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer;
					if (dockWithinContainer != null && !dockWithinContainer.Disposing && !dockWithinContainer.IsDisposed && dockWithinContainer.Visible)
					{
						zeroDistance = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.CalculateDistanceFromRect(base.Bounds, position);
						UpdateOpacity(1.0);
						return;
					}
				}
				UIElement val = toolbarsManager.UIElementFromPoint(position);
				if (val != null && val.GetAncestor(typeof(RibbonAreaUIElement)) != null)
				{
					Close();
					return;
				}
			}
			int num = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.CalculateDistanceFromRect(base.Bounds, position);
			if (num - zeroDistance >= CloseThreshold)
			{
				Close();
				return;
			}
			if (num < zeroDistance)
			{
				zeroDistance = num;
			}
			int num2 = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.InterpolateValueInverted(zeroDistance, zeroDistance + TransparencyThreshold, num, 0, 255, ensureInRange: true);
			UpdateOpacity((double)num2 / 255.0);
		}

		internal static MiniToolbarWindow Create(MiniToolbar miniToolbar)
		{
			try
			{
				UIPermission permission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
				ToolbarsManagerUtilities.VerifyPermission(permission);
				return CreateUnsafe(miniToolbar);
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				return new MiniToolbarWindow(miniToolbar);
			}
		}

		private static MiniToolbarWindow CreateUnsafe(MiniToolbar miniToolbar)
		{
			try
			{
				return new MiniToolbarWindowTrusted(miniToolbar);
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				return new MiniToolbarWindow(miniToolbar);
			}
		}

		private void OnApplicationEnterThreadModal(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			modalCounter++;
		}

		private void OnApplicationLeaveThreadModal(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			modalCounter--;
			if (modalCounter == 0)
			{
				zeroDistance = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.CalculateDistanceFromRect(base.Bounds, Cursor.Position);
			}
		}

		private void OnTransparancyTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateWindow();
		}
	}
	public sealed class MiniToolbarWindowTrusted : MiniToolbarWindow, IMessageFilter
	{
		internal MiniToolbarWindowTrusted(MiniToolbar miniToolbar)
			: base(miniToolbar)
		{
			try
			{
				SecurityPermission securityPermission = new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode);
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					securityPermission.Assert();
				}
				Utilities.AddMessageFilter((IMessageFilter)this);
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
		}

		protected override void OnClosed(EventArgs e)
		{
			try
			{
				SecurityPermission securityPermission = new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode);
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					securityPermission.Assert();
				}
				Utilities.RemoveMessageFilter((IMessageFilter)this);
				CodeAccessPermission.RevertAssert();
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
			base.OnClosed(e);
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, UnmanagedCode = true)]
		protected override void WndProc(ref Message m)
		{
			switch (m.Msg)
			{
			case 28:
				Close();
				break;
			case 33:
				m.Result = (IntPtr)3;
				return;
			}
			base.WndProc(ref m);
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode)]
		bool IMessageFilter.PreFilterMessage(ref Message m)
		{
			switch (m.Msg)
			{
			case 257:
				if ((int)m.WParam == 27)
				{
					Close();
				}
				break;
			case 161:
			case 162:
			case 163:
			case 164:
			case 165:
			case 166:
			case 167:
			case 168:
			case 169:
			case 256:
			case 260:
			case 513:
			case 514:
			case 515:
			case 516:
			case 517:
			case 518:
			case 519:
			case 520:
			case 521:
			case 522:
			{
				int num = (int)m.WParam.ToInt64();
				if (num != 17 && num != 16)
				{
					CloseIfControlIsNotOwned(m.HWnd);
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void CloseIfControlIsNotOwned(IntPtr hwnd)
		{
			if (base.IsDisposed || base.Disposing)
			{
				return;
			}
			Control control = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ControlFromChildHandle(hwnd);
			if (control == null)
			{
				try
				{
					IntPtr handle = base.Handle;
					IntPtr intPtr = IntPtr.Zero;
					if (base.AssociatedPopup != null)
					{
						if (((Control)(object)base.AssociatedPopup).Handle == hwnd)
						{
							return;
						}
						Form form = UltraToolbarsManager.FindFormHelper((Control)(object)base.AssociatedPopup);
						if (form != null)
						{
							intPtr = form.Handle;
						}
					}
					while (true)
					{
						if (hwnd == handle || hwnd == intPtr)
						{
							return;
						}
						IntPtr parentApi = NativeWindowMethods.GetParentApi(hwnd);
						IntPtr windowLong = NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowLong(hwnd, -8);
						if (parentApi != IntPtr.Zero)
						{
							hwnd = parentApi;
							continue;
						}
						if (windowLong != IntPtr.Zero)
						{
							hwnd = windowLong;
							continue;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
				}
				Close();
			}
			else
			{
				if (control == this)
				{
					return;
				}
				Form form2 = null;
				if (base.AssociatedPopup != null)
				{
					if ((object)control == base.AssociatedPopup)
					{
						return;
					}
					form2 = UltraToolbarsManager.FindFormHelper((Control)(object)base.AssociatedPopup);
					if (form2 == control)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				Form form3 = control as Form;
				if (form3 == null)
				{
					form3 = UltraToolbarsManager.FindFormHelper(control);
				}
				while (form3 != null)
				{
					if (form3 == this || form3 == form2)
					{
						return;
					}
					form3 = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetOwner(form3);
				}
				Close();
			}
		}
	}
