			private List<MenuItemBase> GetListWithFocus(MenuItemsCollection menuItems)
			{
				if (menuItems == null || menuItems.Disposed)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (menuItems.Count == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				PopulateMenuItemList(ref listWithFocus, menuItems);
				return listWithFocus;
			}

			private MenuItemBase GetToolWithFocus(MenuItemsCollection collection)
			{
				if (collection == null || toolWithFocus == null || !toolWithFocus.ContainsKey(collection))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return toolWithFocus[collection];
			}

			private bool SetToolWithFocus(MenuItemBase menuItem, MenuItemsCollection collection)
			{
				if (collection == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				ToolBase toolBase = menuItem?.Tool;
				if (toolBase == null || !CanActivate(menuItem))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (toolWithFocus == null)
				{
					toolWithFocus = new Dictionary<MenuItemsCollection, MenuItemBase>();
				}
				if (!toolWithFocus.ContainsKey(collection))
				{
					toolWithFocus.Add(collection, null);
				}
				toolWithFocus[collection] = menuItem;
				return true;
			}

			private static void PopulateMenuItemList(ref List<MenuItemBase> list, MenuItemsCollection menuItems)
			{
				if (list == null)
				{
					list = new List<MenuItemBase>(menuItems.Count);
				}
				else
				{
					list.Clear();
				}
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = menuItems.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					MenuItemBase menuItemBase = menuItems[i];
					if (CanActivate(menuItemBase))
					{
						list.Add(menuItemBase);
					}
				}
			}

			private static MenuItemBase ToMenuItem(PopupToolBase tool)

				return ((owningMenu != null) ? owningMenu.MenuAgent : applicationMenuBase.MenuAgent)?.GetMenuItemFromTool(tool);
			}

			internal bool ProcessNavigationKey(Keys keyCode)
			{
				bool controlKey = (Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Control) == Keys.Control;
				bool shiftKey = (Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Shift) == Keys.Shift;
				return ProcessNavigationKey(keyCode, controlKey, shiftKey, isSimulation: false);
			}

			internal bool ProcessNavigationKey(Keys keyCode, bool controlKey, bool shiftKey, bool isSimulation)
			{
				//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				bool flag = false;
				MenuItemsCollection collectionToFocus = null;
				List<KeyAction> actions = GetActions(keyCode, controlKey, shiftKey, out collectionToFocus);
				flag = PerformAction(actions, collectionToFocus, isSimulation);
				if (flag)
				{
					RefreshDisplay();
				}
				lastUIAction = (UIAction)8;
				return flag;
			}

			private List<KeyAction> GetActions(Keys keyCode, bool controlKey, bool shiftKey, out MenuItemsCollection collectionToFocus)
			{
				List<KeyAction> list = new List<KeyAction>(1);
				PopupToolBase activeContentTool = NavigationMenu.ActiveContentTool;
				MenuItemsCollection menuItems = NavigationMenu.MenuItems;
				MenuItemBase menuItemBase = GetToolWithFocus(collectionWithFocus ?? menuItems);
				ToolBase toolBase = menuItemBase?.Tool;
				PopupToolBase popupToolBase = toolBase as PopupToolBase;
				PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool = toolBase as PopupMenuTool;
				PopupControlContainerToolBase popupControlContainerToolBase = toolBase as PopupControlContainerToolBase;
				if (menuAgent.PopupControlContainerToolHasFocus)
				{
					collectionToFocus = null;
					list.Clear();
					list.Add(KeyAction.None);
					return list;
				}
				if (collectionWithFocus == null)
				{
					collectionWithFocus = menuItems;
				}
				collectionToFocus = collectionWithFocus;
				switch (keyCode)
				{
				case Keys.Up:
				case Keys.Down:
					if (!controlKey)
					{
						bool flag = keyCode == Keys.Up;
						list.Add(flag ? KeyAction.PreviousTool : KeyAction.NextTool);
					}
					break;
				case Keys.Tab:
					if (controlKey)
					{
						collectionToFocus = menuItems;
						list.Add(KeyAction.FocusCollection);
						list.Add(shiftKey ? KeyAction.PreviousTool : KeyAction.NextTool);
					}
					else if (shiftKey && collectionWithFocus == menuItems)
					{
						bool flag2 = false;
						List<BackStageManager.MenuInfo> list2 = menuAgent.ApplicationMenu2010.BackStageManager?.MenuInfoList;
						if (list2 != null && list2.Count > 0)
						{
							BackStageManager.MenuInfo menuInfo = list2[list2.Count - 1];
							PopupControlContainerToolBase popupControlContainerToolBase2 = menuInfo.Tool as PopupControlContainerToolBase;
							PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool2 = menuInfo.Tool as PopupMenuTool;
							if (popupControlContainerToolBase2 != null || popupMenuTool2 != null)
							{
								collectionToFocus = popupMenuTool2?.MenuAgent.MenuItems;
								flag2 = true;
							}
						}
						list.Add((!flag2) ? KeyAction.NoOp : KeyAction.FocusLeafContentArea);
					}
					else
					{
						if (collectionWithFocus == null)
						{
							break;
						}
						if (toolBase is PopupToolBase)
						{
							if (shiftKey)
							{
								collectionToFocus = GetParentCollection(collectionWithFocus);
								list.Add(KeyAction.FocusCollection);
							}
							else
							{
								list = GetActions(Keys.Right, controlKey: false, shiftKey: false, out collectionToFocus);
							}
						}
						else if (shiftKey && (GetListWithFocus(collectionWithFocus)?.IndexOf(menuItemBase) ?? (-1)) == 0)
						{
							collectionToFocus = GetParentCollection(collectionWithFocus);
							list.Add(KeyAction.FocusCollection);
							MenuItemBase menuItemBase2 = GetToolWithFocus(collectionToFocus);
							list.Add((menuItemBase2 == null) ? KeyAction.LastTool : KeyAction.ActivateTool);
						}
						else
						{
							list = GetActions(shiftKey ? Keys.Up : Keys.Down, controlKey: false, shiftKey: false, out collectionWithFocus);
						}
					}
					break;
				case Keys.Right:
					if (popupMenuTool != null && popupMenuTool.HasToolsCollectionBeenCreated && popupMenuTool.Tools.Count > 0)
					{
						collectionToFocus = popupMenuTool.MenuAgent.MenuItems;
						list.Add(KeyAction.FocusCollection);
						MenuItemBase menuItemBase3 = GetToolWithFocus(collectionToFocus);
						list.Add((menuItemBase3 == null) ? KeyAction.FirstTool : KeyAction.ActivateTool);
					}
					else if (popupControlContainerToolBase != null)
					{
						collectionToFocus = null;
						list.Add(KeyAction.FocusControl);
					}
					break;
				case Keys.Return:
				case Keys.Space:
					if (popupToolBase != null)
					{
						return GetActions(Keys.Right, controlKey: false, shiftKey: false, out collectionToFocus);
					}
					list.Add(KeyAction.ToolClick);
					break;
				}
				if (list.Count == 0)
				{
					list.Add(KeyAction.None);
				}
				return list;
			}

			private bool PerformAction(List<KeyAction> actions, MenuItemsCollection collectionToFocus, bool isSimulation)
			{
				if (actions == null || actions.Count == 0 || actions[0] == KeyAction.None)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (actions[0] == KeyAction.NoOp)
				{
					return true;
				}
				foreach (KeyAction action in actions)
				{
					PerformAction(action, collectionToFocus, isSimulation);
				}
				return true;
			}

			private bool PerformAction(KeyAction action, MenuItemsCollection collectionToFocus, bool isSimulation)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				NavigationMenu navigationMenu = NavigationMenu;
				switch (action)
				{
				case KeyAction.None:
					flag = true;
					break;
				case KeyAction.FocusCollection:
					collectionWithFocus = collectionToFocus;
					flag = true;
					break;
				case KeyAction.FocusControl:
				{
					MenuItemBase menuItemBase = GetToolWithFocus(collectionWithFocus);
					PopupControlContainerToolBase popupControlContainerToolBase2 = ((menuItemBase != null) ? (menuItemBase.Tool as PopupControlContainerToolBase) : null);
					collectionWithFocus = collectionToFocus;
					Control control = popupControlContainerToolBase2?.Control;
					FocusControl(control);
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
				case KeyAction.FirstTool:
				case KeyAction.LastTool:
					if (collectionWithFocus != null)
					{
						List<MenuItemBase> list2 = GetListWithFocus(collectionWithFocus);
						if (list2 != null && list2.Count > 0)
						{
							MenuItemBase menuItem = ((action == KeyAction.FirstTool) ? list2[0] : list2[list2.Count - 1]);
							SetToolWithFocus(menuItem, collectionWithFocus);
							PerformAction(KeyAction.ActivateTool, collectionWithFocus, isSimulation);
						}
					}
					break;
				case KeyAction.NextTool:
				case KeyAction.PreviousTool:
				{
					bool flag2 = action == KeyAction.PreviousTool;
					List<MenuItemBase> list3 = GetListWithFocus(collectionWithFocus);
					int num = list3?.Count ?? 0;
					if (num == 0)
					{
						break;
					}
					MenuItemBase menuItemBase3 = GetToolWithFocus(collectionWithFocus);
					int num2 = ((menuItemBase3 != null) ? list3.IndexOf(menuItemBase3) : (flag2 ? num : (-1)));
					int num3 = (flag2 ? (num2 - 1) : (num2 + 1));
					if (collectionWithFocus == navigationMenu.MenuItems)
					{
						if (num3 >= num)
						{
							num3 = 0;
						}
						else if (num3 < 0)
						{
							num3 = num - 1;
						}
					}
					if (num3 >= 0 && num3 < num)
					{
						SetToolWithFocus(list3[num3], collectionWithFocus);
						PerformAction(KeyAction.ActivateTool, collectionWithFocus, isSimulation);
					}
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
				case KeyAction.OpenActiveContentTool:
					if (collectionWithFocus != null)
					{
						if (isSimulation)
						{
							Application.DoEvents();
						}
						MenuItemBase menuItemBase2 = GetToolWithFocus(collectionWithFocus);
						PopupToolBase popupToolBase2 = ((menuItemBase2 != null) ? (menuItemBase2.Tool as PopupToolBase) : null);
						if (popupToolBase2 != null && CanOpen(popupToolBase2))
						{
							OpenPopup(popupToolBase2, byKeyboard: true);
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					break;
				case KeyAction.ToolClick:
				{
					MenuItemBase menuItemBase4 = GetToolWithFocus(collectionWithFocus);
					ToolBase toolBase2 = menuItemBase4?.Tool;
					if (!GeneratesToolClick(toolBase2))
					{
						break;
					}
					UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager2 = NavigationMenu.ToolbarsManager;
					if (toolbarsManager2 == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					toolbarsManager2.ActiveTool = toolBase2;
					if (toolBase2 == toolbarsManager2.ActiveTool && toolBase2.VisibleResolved)
					{
						if (CloseOnToolClick(toolBase2))
						{
							menuAgent.ApplicationMenu2010.CloseDropDown();
						}
						menuItemBase4.OnClick();
						flag = true;
					}
					break;
				}
				case KeyAction.ActivateTool:
				{
					if (isSimulation)
					{
						Application.DoEvents();
					}
					ToolBase toolBase = GetToolWithFocus(collectionWithFocus)?.Tool;
					PopupToolBase popupToolBase = toolBase as PopupToolBase;
					UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = NavigationMenu.ToolbarsManager;
					if (toolbarsManager != null)
					{
						toolbarsManager.ActiveTool = toolBase;
					}
					BackStageViewControl backStageViewControl = menuAgent.PopupControl as BackStageViewControl;
					backStageViewControl.BringIntoView(toolBase);
					if (popupToolBase != null && toolbarsManager.ActiveTool == popupToolBase)
					{
						PerformAction(KeyAction.OpenActiveContentTool, collectionWithFocus, isSimulation);
					}
					else if (popupToolBase == null && toolBase != null && toolBase.CanEnterEditMode)
					{
						toolBase.EnterEditMode(viaMouse: false);
					}
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
				case KeyAction.FocusLeafContentArea:
					if (collectionToFocus != null)
					{
						collectionWithFocus = collectionToFocus;
						PerformAction(KeyAction.LastTool, collectionWithFocus, isSimulation);
					}
					else
					{
						List<BackStageManager.MenuInfo> list = menuAgent.ApplicationMenu2010.BackStageManager?.MenuInfoList;
						if (list != null && list.Count > 0)
						{
							BackStageManager.MenuInfo menuInfo = list[list.Count - 1];
							if (menuInfo.Tool is PopupControlContainerToolBase { OwningMenu: not null } popupControlContainerToolBase)
							{
								FocusControl(popupControlContainerToolBase.Control);
							}
						}
					}
					flag = true;
					break;
				default:
					flag = false;
					break;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					RefreshDisplay();
				}
				return flag;
			}

			private MenuItemsCollection GetParentCollection(MenuItemsCollection collectionWithFocus)
			{
				if (collectionWithFocus == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				MenuItemsCollection result = null;
				PopupToolBase popupTool = collectionWithFocus.MenuAgent.PopupTool;
				if (popupTool != null)
				{
					result = ((!popupTool.OwnerIsApplicationMenu2010NavigationMenu) ? (popupTool.OwningMenu?.MenuAgent)?.MenuItems : NavigationMenu.MenuItems);
				}
				return result;
			}

			private MenuItemsCollection GetParentCollection(ToolBase tool)
			{
				if (tool == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				PopupMenuTool owningMenu = tool.OwningMenu;
				if (owningMenu != null)
				{
					return owningMenu.MenuAgent.MenuItems;
				}
				return tool.OwningApplicationMenu2010NavigationMenu?.MenuItems;
			}

			private bool OpenPopup(PopupToolBase popup, bool byKeyboard)
			{
				if (popup == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				try
				{
					if (byKeyboard)
					{
						isOpeningPopupByKeyboard = true;
					}
					popup.DropDown();
					return popup.IsOpen;
				}
				finally
				{
					if (byKeyboard)
					{
						isOpeningPopupByKeyboard = false;
					}
				}
			}

			private void RefreshDisplay()
			{
				ApplicationMenu2010 applicationMenu = menuAgent.ApplicationMenu2010;
				applicationMenu.DirtyUIElement();
			}

			internal bool IsFocused(ToolBase tool)
			{
				if (tool == null || collectionWithFocus == null || toolWithFocus == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				MenuItemBase value = null;
				toolWithFocus.TryGetValue(collectionWithFocus, out value);
				if (value != null)
				{
					return value.Tool == tool;
				}
				return false;
			}

			internal bool IsFocused(MenuItemBase tool)
			{
				if (tool == null || collectionWithFocus == null || toolWithFocus == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				MenuItemBase value = null;
				toolWithFocus.TryGetValue(collectionWithFocus, out value);
				return tool == value;
			}

			internal bool ShouldDrawFocused(ToolBase tool)
			{
				//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0012: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if (!IsFocused(tool))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return (int)lastUIAction == 8;
			}

			private void OnAfterApplicationMenu2010Displayed(object sender, EventArgs e)
			{
				SetInitialFocus(sender as UltraToolbarsManager);
			}

			private void OnPopupDropDown(UltraToolbarsManager sender, PopupToolBase popupTool)
			{
				if (!isOpeningPopupByKeyboard)
				{
					SyncFocus(popupTool, isOpening: true, removeFocusRect: true);
				}
			}

			private void OnActiveContentToolOpened(BackStageManager sender, PopupToolBase popupTool)
			{
				if (popupTool != null && !isOpeningPopupByKeyboard)
				{
					SyncFocus(popupTool, isOpening: true, removeFocusRect: true);
				}
			}

			private void OnActiveContentToolClickedWhileOpen(BackStageManager sender, PopupToolBase popupTool)
			{
				if (popupTool != null)
				{
					SyncFocus(popupTool, isOpening: false, removeFocusRect: false);
				}
			}

			private void SyncFocus(ToolBase tool, bool isOpening, bool removeFocusRect)
			{
				//IL_0094: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				ApplicationMenu2010 applicationMenu = menuAgent.ApplicationMenu2010;
				if (applicationMenu.IsOpen)
				{
					PopupToolBase popupToolBase = tool as PopupToolBase;
					MenuItemsCollection parentCollection = GetParentCollection(tool);
					if (collectionWithFocus != parentCollection)
					{
						PerformAction(KeyAction.FocusCollection, parentCollection, isSimulation: false);
					}
					MenuItemBase menuItemBase = ((collectionWithFocus != null) ? collectionWithFocus.MenuAgent : null)?.GetMenuItemFromTool(tool);
					MenuItemBase menuItemBase2 = GetToolWithFocus(collectionWithFocus);
					if (menuItemBase2 != menuItemBase)
					{
						SetToolWithFocus(menuItemBase, collectionWithFocus);
					}
					PerformAction(KeyAction.ActivateTool, collectionWithFocus, isSimulation: false);
					if (removeFocusRect)
					{
						lastUIAction = (UIAction)0;
					}
				}
			}

			internal void Dispose()
			{
				collectionWithFocus = null;
				toolWithFocus = null;
				listWithFocus = null;
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = menuAgent.ToolbarsManager;
				ApplicationMenu2010 applicationMenu = menuAgent.ApplicationMenu2010;
				BackStageManager backStageManager = ((applicationMenu != null && applicationMenu.HasBackStageManager) ? applicationMenu.BackStageManager : null);
				if (backStageManager != null)
				{
					backStageManager.ActiveContentToolOpened -= OnActiveContentToolOpened;
					backStageManager.ActiveContentToolClickedWhileOpen -= OnActiveContentToolClickedWhileOpen;
				}
				if (toolbarsManager != null)
				{
					toolbarsManager.AfterApplicationMenu2010Displayed -= OnAfterApplicationMenu2010Displayed;
				}
			}

			internal static bool CanOpen(ToolBase tool)
			{
				return CanOpen(tool as PopupToolBase);
			}

			internal static bool CanOpen(PopupToolBase popupTool)
			{
				if (popupTool != null && popupTool.EnabledResolved && !popupTool.IsOpen)
				{
					return !popupTool.IsOpening;
				}
				return false;
			}

			internal static bool CanActivate(ToolBase tool)
			{
				if (tool != null && tool.EnabledResolved && tool.VisibleResolved)
				{
					return tool.CanActivate;
				}
				return false;
			}

			internal static bool CanActivate(MenuItemBase menuItem)
			{
				if (menuItem != null && menuItem.Enabled)
				{
					return menuItem.CanActivate;
				}
				return false;
			}

			internal static bool GeneratesToolClick(ToolBase tool)
			{
				if (tool != null)
				{
					return !(tool is PopupMenuTool);
				}
				return false;
			}

			internal static bool CloseOnToolClick(ToolBase tool)
			{
				if (tool != null && tool.ClosesApplicationMenuOnToolClick)
				{
					return !(tool is PopupToolBase);
				}
				return false;
			}

			private static bool FocusControl(Control control)
			{
				if (control == null || !control.CanFocus)
				{
					return false;
				}
				ToolbarsManagerUtilities.FocusControl(control);
				return control.Focused;
			}
		}

		internal void DropDown(Rectangle fileMenuButtonRect, bool resetActiveContentTool)
		{
			//IL_027e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0283: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0285: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0288: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_02b5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_02b8: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_028a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_028d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_028f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0293: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_01dc: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01e3: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			this.fileMenuButtonRect = fileMenuButtonRect;
			if (IsOpen || base.IsOpening)
			{
				CloseDropDown(delay: false);
				return;
			}
			Control containerControl = ContainerControl;
			if (containerControl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Ribbon ribbon = base.FileMenu.Ribbon;
			Control ribbonContainer = (Control)(object)ribbon.RibbonContainer;
			if (ribbonContainer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			PopupToolBase popupToolBase = null;
			NavigationMenu navigationMenu = ApplicationMenu2010.NavigationMenu;
			if (navigationMenu != null)
			{
				if (resetActiveContentTool)
				{
					ApplicationMenu2010.BackStageManager.AssignDefaultContentTool();
				}
				popupToolBase = navigationMenu.ActiveContentTool;
			}
			BeforeApplicationMenu2010DisplayedEventArgs e = new BeforeApplicationMenu2010DisplayedEventArgs(popupToolBase);
			if (base.ToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				base.ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.BeforeApplicationMenu2010Displayed, e);
			}
			if (e.Cancel)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (e.ActiveContentTool != popupToolBase && navigationMenu != null)
			{
				navigationMenu.ActiveContentTool = e.ActiveContentTool;
			}
			ApplicationMenu2010.RefreshDropDownContents();
			lastSelectedTab = ribbon.TabManager.SelectedTabItem;
			ribbon.TabManager.SelectedTabItem = null;
			if (ribbon.IsAutoHidePopupOpen)
			{
				ribbon.AutoHideMenuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay: false);
			}
			if (!base.ToolbarsManager.IsDesignMode)
			{
				originalSizeOfContainer = containerControl.Size;
				originalMinSizeOfContainer = containerControl.MinimumSize;
				if (containerControl is Form && ApplicationMenu2010 != null)
				{
					containerControl.MinimumSize = ApplicationMenu2010.MinimumFormSize;
				}
				autoSizedContainerSize = containerControl.Size;
				BackStageManager backStageManager = ApplicationMenu2010.BackStageManager;
				backStageManager.FireBeforeDropDownEvents(navigationMenu.ActiveContentTool);
				int y = fileMenuButtonRect.Bottom;
				UIElement ribbonElement = ribbon.GetRibbonElement(typeof(RibbonTabItemAreaUIElement));
				if (ribbonElement != null)
				{
					y = GetElementRectRelativeToContainer(ribbonElement, containerControl).Bottom;
				}
				else
				{
					ribbonElement = ribbon.GetRibbonElement(typeof(RibbonTabAreaUIElement));
					if (ribbonElement != null)
					{
						y = GetElementRectRelativeToContainer(ribbonElement, containerControl).Top + ribbon.Metrics.TabItemAreaElementHeight;
					}
				}
				int x = base.ToolbarsManager.RoundedFormBorderWidth;
				if ((int)ribbon.ToolbarsManager.StyleResolved == 9)
				{
					x = 1;
				}
				Point location = new Point(x, y);
				PopupControlBase popupControlBase = GetPopupControl();
				((Control)(object)popupControlBase).Location = location;
				((Control)(object)popupControlBase).Anchor = AnchorStyles.Top | AnchorStyles.Bottom | AnchorStyles.Left | AnchorStyles.Right;
				base.PopupControl = popupControlBase;
				base.ToolbarsManager.PopupManager.PopupOpened(this, null);
				containerControl.Controls.Add((Control)(object)popupControlBase);
				((Control)(object)popupControlBase).BringToFront();
				backStageManager.FireAfterDropDownEvents(navigationMenu.ActiveContentTool);
				ribbon.UIElement.DirtyChildElements(true);
			}
			else
			{
				Rectangle exclusionRect = ribbonContainer.RectangleToScreen(fileMenuButtonRect);
				Point point = new Point(exclusionRect.Left, exclusionRect.Bottom);
				ToolbarStyle styleResolved = base.ToolbarsManager.StyleResolved;
				if ((int)styleResolved == 7 || (int)styleResolved == 8 || (int)styleResolved == 9)
				{
					exclusionRect.Size = new Size(exclusionRect.Width, Math.Max(0, exclusionRect.Height));
					if ((int)styleResolved == 8)
					{
						point.X -= ApplicationMenu2010.FileMenuButtonOffsetFromLeftBorder;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Point offsetFromButton = ApplicationMenu2010.OffsetFromButton;
					point.Offset(offsetFromButton.X, offsetFromButton.Y);
					exclusionRect.Size = new Size(exclusionRect.Width, Math.Max(0, exclusionRect.Height + offsetFromButton.Y + ribbon.Metrics.TabItemAreaElementHeight));
				}
				DropDown(containerControl, point, exclusionRect, (DropDownPosition)0, delay: false, closeIfAlreadyOpen: true, alignRight: false, !base.ToolbarsManager.Customizing);
				if (ApplicationMenu2010.DisplayStyleResolved == ApplicationMenu2010DisplayStyle.Office2013)
				{
					UIElement uIElement = ribbon.UIElement;
					if (uIElement != null)
					{
						uIElement.DirtyChildElements();
						uIElement.VerifyChildElements();
					}
				}
			}
			if (base.ToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				base.ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.AfterApplicationMenu2010Displayed, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool OnPopupClosing()
		{
			if (ApplicationMenu2010.CausesValidationOnClose)
			{
				Control control = (Control)(object)base.PopupControl;
				if (control.IsHandleCreated && !control.IsDisposed)
				{
					try
					{
						if (((Control)(object)base.PopupControl).GetContainerControl() is ContainerControl containerControl && !containerControl.ValidateChildren())
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
					catch (SecurityException)
					{
					}
				}
			}
			BeforeApplicationMenu2010ClosedEventArgs e = new BeforeApplicationMenu2010ClosedEventArgs();
			if (base.ToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				base.ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.BeforeApplicationMenu2010Closed, e);
			}
			return e.Cancel;
		}

		protected internal override void OnPopupClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Ribbon ribbon = ApplicationMenu2010?.Ribbon;
			RibbonItem ribbonItem = ribbon?.ItemWithFocus;
			if (ribbonItem != null && ribbonItem.ItemType == RibbonItemType.ApplicationMenu)
			{
				IList visibleTabs = ribbon.Tabs.VisibleTabs;
				RibbonItem itemWithFocus = null;
				if (visibleTabs.Count > 0)
				{
					itemWithFocus = new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.TabItem, visibleTabs[0]);
				}
				ribbon.SetItemWithFocus(itemWithFocus);
			}
			ApplicationMenu2010.BackStageManager.FireCloseUpEvents(ApplicationMenu2010.NavigationMenu.ActiveContentTool);
			if (base.FileMenu.Ribbon != null && base.FileMenu.Ribbon.UIElement != null)
			{
				base.FileMenu.Ribbon.UIElement.DirtyChildElements(true);
			}
			if (base.ToolbarsManager != null && base.ToolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer != null)
			{
				base.ToolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer.Update();
			}
			if (initialControlsSize != null && initialControlsSize.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (Control item in initialControlsSize.Keys.ToList())
				{
					item.Size = initialControlsSize[item];
				}
				initialControlsSize.Clear();
			}
			if (base.ToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				base.ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.AfterApplicationMenu2010Closed, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
			base.OnPopupClosed(sender, e);
		}

		internal override void PerformUpdatesAfterDropDownClose()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			Control control = null;
			if (ultraToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				control = ultraToolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer;
			}
			if (control != null && !ultraToolbarsManager.IsDesignMode)
			{
				control.MinimumSize = originalMinSizeOfContainer;
				if (control.Size == autoSizedContainerSize)
				{
					control.Size = originalSizeOfContainer;
				}
			}
			Ribbon ribbon = base.FileMenu.Ribbon;
			if (ribbon.TabManager.SelectedTabItem == null)
			{
				ribbon.TabManager.SelectedTabItem = lastSelectedTab;
			}
		}

		}

						break;

		private void TrimNavigationItems()
		{
			int num = ((backHistory != null) ? backHistory.Count : 0) + ((forwardHistory != null) ? forwardHistory.Count : 0) + ((currentItem != null) ? 1 : 0);
			if (num > maximumNavigationItems && backHistory != null)
			{
				for (int num2 = num - maximumNavigationItems; num2 > 0; num2--)
				{
					backHistory.RemoveAt(0);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void NavigateBackInternal(int numPlaces, bool fireEvents, NavigationSource source)
		{
			if (fireEvents)
			{
				int index = ((numPlaces <= BackHistoryInternal.Count - 1) ? (BackHistoryInternal.Count - numPlaces) : 0);
				NavigationHistoryItem newItem = BackHistoryInternal[index];
				if (FireBeforeNavigationEvent(newItem, source))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			ForwardHistoryInternal.Insert(0, currentItem);
			for (int i = 0; i < numPlaces; i++)
			{
				if (BackHistoryInternal.Count == 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (i < numPlaces - 1)
				{
					NavigationHistoryItem item = BackHistoryInternal[BackHistoryInternal.Count - 1];
					BackHistoryInternal.Remove(item);
					ForwardHistoryInternal.Insert(0, item);
				}
			}
			currentItem = BackHistoryInternal[BackHistoryInternal.Count - 1];
			BackHistoryInternal.Remove(currentItem);
			UIElement uIElement = base.UIElement;
			if (uIElement != null)
			{
				uIElement.DirtyChildElements();
			}
			if (fireEvents)
			{
				FireAfterNavigationEvent(source);
			}
		}

		internal void NavigateForwardInternal(int numPlaces, bool fireEvents, NavigationSource source)
		{
			if (fireEvents)
			{
				int index = Math.Min(numPlaces, ForwardHistoryInternal.Count) - 1;
				NavigationHistoryItem newItem = ForwardHistoryInternal[index];
				if (FireBeforeNavigationEvent(newItem, source))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			BackHistoryInternal.Add(currentItem);
			for (int i = 0; i < numPlaces; i++)
			{
				if (ForwardHistoryInternal.Count == 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (i < numPlaces - 1)
				{
					NavigationHistoryItem item = ForwardHistoryInternal[0];
					ForwardHistoryInternal.Remove(item);
					BackHistoryInternal.Add(item);
				}
			}
			currentItem = ForwardHistoryInternal[0];
			ForwardHistoryInternal.Remove(currentItem);
			UIElement uIElement = base.UIElement;
			if (uIElement != null)
			{
				uIElement.DirtyChildElements();
			}
			if (fireEvents)
			{
				FireAfterNavigationEvent(source);
			}
		}

		}

			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I8
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0040: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I8
			//IL_00b9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0045: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I8
			//IL_0103: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0106: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I8
			//IL_0108: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_010b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I8
			ResolutionOrderInfo resolutionOrder = StyleUtils.GetResolutionOrder(ToolbarsManager);
			UIRole role = StyleUtils.GetRole(ToolbarsManager, StyleUtils.Role.NavigationToolbarRecentHistoryButton);
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleBefore && role != null)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, state);
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseControlInfo)
			{
				if ((long)state != 1)
				{
					if ((long)state != 4)
					{
						if ((long)state == 8 && Settings.HasRecentHistoryButtonPressedAppearance)
						{
							Settings.RecentHistoryButtonPressedAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
						}
					}
					else if (Settings.HasRecentHistoryButtonHotTrackedAppearance)
					{
						Settings.RecentHistoryButtonHotTrackedAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
					}
				}
				else if (Settings.HasRecentHistoryButtonAppearance)
				{
					Settings.RecentHistoryButtonAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleAfter && role != null)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, state);
			}
			if (!((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)1) && ((ulong)requestedProps & 1uL) != 0L)
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = Color.Transparent;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps ^ 1uL);
			}
			if (!((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)256) && ((ulong)requestedProps & 0x100uL) != 0L)
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).Image = ToolbarsManager.GetNavigationButtonImage(NavigationToolbarButtonType.RecentHistory, (long)state == 4, (long)state == 8, enabled);
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps ^ 0x100uL);
			}
			if (!((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)268435456) && ((ulong)requestedProps & 0x10000000uL) != 0L)
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackGradientStyle = (GradientStyle)1;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps ^ 0x10000000uL);
			}
		}

		internal void ResolveRecentHistoryMenuItemAppearance(NavigationToolbarListMenuItem item, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, bool drawAsActive)
		{
			UIRole role = StyleUtils.GetRole(ToolbarsManager, StyleUtils.Role.NavigationToolbarRecentHistoryMenuItem);
			PopupItemInfo popupItemInfo = PopupItemInfo.NavigationMenuItem;
			if (drawAsActive)
			{
				popupItemInfo |= PopupItemInfo.Active;
			}
			if (CurrentItem == item.NavigationItem)
			{
				popupItemInfo |= PopupItemInfo.Selected;
			}
			if (backHistory != null && backHistory.Contains(item.NavigationItem))
			{
				popupItemInfo |= PopupItemInfo.NavigationMenuItemBack;
			}
			else if (forwardHistory != null && forwardHistory.Contains(item.NavigationItem))
			{
				popupItemInfo |= PopupItemInfo.NavigationMenuItemForward;
			}
			ToolbarsManager.ResolvePopupItemAppearance(null, role, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, item.MenuAgent.UIRole, popupItemInfo);
		}

		internal void ResolveRecentHistoryMenuItemAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, PopupItemInfo popupInfo)
		{
			bool flag = (popupInfo & PopupItemInfo.Active) != 0;
			bool flag2 = (popupInfo & PopupItemInfo.Selected) != 0;
			bool flag3 = (popupInfo & PopupItemInfo.NavigationMenuItem) != 0;
			bool flag4 = (popupInfo & PopupItemInfo.NavigationMenuItemBack) != 0;
			bool flag5 = (popupInfo & PopupItemInfo.NavigationMenuItemForward) != 0;
			if (!flag3)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (!((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)256) && ((ulong)requestedProps & 0x100uL) != 0L && ToolbarsManager != null)
				{
					if (flag4)
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).Image = ToolbarsManager.GetRecentHistoryImage(RecentHistoryImageType.Back);
						requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps ^ 0x100uL);
					}
					else if (flag5)
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).Image = ToolbarsManager.GetRecentHistoryImage(RecentHistoryImageType.Forward);
						requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps ^ 0x100uL);
					}
				}
				if (MenuSettings.HasHotTrackAppearance)
				{
					MenuSettings.HotTrackAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				if (!((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)256) && ((ulong)requestedProps & 0x100uL) != 0L && ToolbarsManager != null)
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).Image = ToolbarsManager.GetRecentHistoryImage(RecentHistoryImageType.Selected);
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps ^ 0x100uL);
				}
				if (menuSettings != null && menuSettings.HasPressedAppearance)
				{
					menuSettings.PressedAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
			}
			if (menuSettings != null && menuSettings.HasAppearance)
			{
				menuSettings.Appearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			}
		}

		internal void SetCurrentItem(NavigationHistoryItem item, NavigationToolbarMenuItemType itemType, NavigationSource source)
		{
			if (item == CurrentItem)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			switch (itemType)
			{
			default:
				return;
			case NavigationToolbarMenuItemType.Back:
				num = BackHistoryInternal.Count - BackHistoryInternal.IndexOf(item);
				if (num <= 0 || FireBeforeNavigationEvent(item, source))
				{
					return;
				}
				NavigateBackInternal(num, fireEvents: false, source);
				break;
			case NavigationToolbarMenuItemType.Forward:
				num = ForwardHistoryInternal.IndexOf(item) + 1;
				if (num <= 0 || FireBeforeNavigationEvent(item, source))
				{
					return;
				}
				NavigateForwardInternal(num, fireEvents: false, source);
				break;
			}
			FireAfterNavigationEvent(source);
		}

		internal void ShowRecentHistoryMenu(Rectangle recentHistoryButtonRect)
		{
			if (CanNavigateBack || CanNavigateForward)
			{
				MenuAgent.MenuItems.Clear();
				for (int num = ForwardHistoryInternal.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					NavigationHistoryItem item = ForwardHistoryInternal[num];
					MenuAgent.MenuItems.Add(new NavigationToolbarListMenuItem(item, this, NavigationToolbarMenuItemType.Forward));
				}
				MenuAgent.MenuItems.Add(new NavigationToolbarListMenuItem(CurrentItem, this, NavigationToolbarMenuItemType.Current));
				for (int num2 = BackHistoryInternal.Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
				{
					NavigationHistoryItem item2 = BackHistoryInternal[num2];
					MenuAgent.MenuItems.Add(new NavigationToolbarListMenuItem(item2, this, NavigationToolbarMenuItemType.Back));
				}
				Control dockWithinContainer = ToolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer;
				Rectangle rectangle = dockWithinContainer.RectangleToScreen(base.UIElement.Rect);
				Point point = new Point(rectangle.Left, rectangle.Bottom);
				MenuAgent.DropDown(dockWithinContainer, point, Rectangle.Empty, (DropDownPosition)0, delay: false, closeIfAlreadyOpen: true, alignRight: false, autocloseDropdown: true);
			}
		}

		public void InitializeHistory(NavigationHistoryItem[] backHistory, NavigationHistoryItem[] forwardHistory, NavigationHistoryItem currentItem)
		{
			if (currentItem == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("currentItem");
			}
			if (backHistory != null && backHistory.Length != 0)
			{
				this.backHistory = new List<NavigationHistoryItem>(backHistory);
			}
			this.currentItem = currentItem;
			if (forwardHistory != null && forwardHistory.Length != 0)
			{
				this.forwardHistory = new List<NavigationHistoryItem>(forwardHistory);
			}
			UIElement uIElement = base.UIElement;
			if (uIElement != null)
			{
				uIElement.DirtyChildElements();
			}
		}

		public void NavigateBack()
		{
			NavigateBack(1);
		}

		public void NavigateBack(int numPlaces)
		{
			if (numPlaces < 1)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Must provide a value greater than zero", "numPlaces");
			}
			if (!CanNavigateBack)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot navigate backwards");
			}
			NavigateBackInternal(numPlaces, fireEvents: true, NavigationSource.Manual);
		}

		public void NavigateForward()
		{
			NavigateForward(1);
		}

		public void NavigateForward(int numPlaces)
		{
			if (numPlaces < 1)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Must provide a value greater than zero", "numPlaces");
			}
			if (!CanNavigateForward)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot navigate forward");
			}
			NavigateForwardInternal(numPlaces, fireEvents: true, NavigationSource.Manual);
		}

		public void NavigateTo(string text, object tag)
		{
			NavigationHistoryItem item = new NavigationHistoryItem(text, tag);
			NavigateTo(item);
		}

		public void NavigateTo(NavigationHistoryItem item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("item");
			}
			if (!FireBeforeNavigationEvent(item, NavigationSource.Manual))
			{
				if (currentItem != null)
				{
					BackHistoryInternal.Add(currentItem);
				}
				ForwardHistoryInternal.Clear();
				currentItem = item;
				TrimNavigationItems();
				UIElement uIElement = base.UIElement;
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					uIElement.DirtyChildElements();
				}
				FireAfterNavigationEvent(NavigationSource.Manual);
			}
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			ResetSettings();
			Visible = false;
			ResetNavigationHistory();
			MaximumNavigationItems = 10;
			ResetMenuSettings();
			base.Reset();
		}

		public void ResetNavigationHistory()
		{
			ForwardHistoryInternal.Clear();
			BackHistoryInternal.Clear();
			currentItem = null;
			UIElement uIElement = base.UIElement;
			if (uIElement != null && VisibleResolvedInternal)
			{
				uIElement.DirtyChildElements();
			}
		}

		internal override void AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(AccessibleEvents accEvent, int childID)
		{
			NavigationToolbarContainer?.AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(accEvent, childID);
		}

		internal override UltraToolbarBase Clone()
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NavigationToolbarCantBeCloned"));
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		protected override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeMenuSettings())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MenuSettings", menuSettings);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeSettings())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Settings", settings);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeVisible())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Visible", visible);
			}
			if (maximumNavigationItems != 10)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MaximumNavigationItems", maximumNavigationItems);
			}
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
		}

		internal override void Initialize(object owner)
		{
			if (owner is UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager)
			{
				toolbarsManager = ultraToolbarsManager;
			}
			base.Initialize(owner);
			if (settings != null)
			{
				settings.Initialize(this);
			}
			if (menuSettings != null)
			{
				menuSettings.Initialize(this);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override bool ShouldSerializeKey()
		{
			return false;
		}

		internal override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
		{
			switch (navdir)
			{
			case AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild:
				return BackButtonAccessibleObject;
			case AccessibleNavigation.LastChild:
			{
				UltraToolbarsDockArea navigationToolbarContainer = NavigationToolbarContainer;
				if (navigationToolbarContainer != null)
				{
					return navigationToolbarContainer.NavigateToolbar(this, navdir);
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (settings != null)
			{
				settings.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				settings.Dispose();
			}
			if (menuSettings != null)
			{
				menuSettings.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				menuSettings.Dispose();
			}
			if (backHistory != null)
			{
				backHistory.Clear();
			}
			if (forwardHistory != null)
			{
				forwardHistory.Clear();
			}
			toolbarsManager = null;
			currentItem = null;
			menuAgent = null;
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (propChange.Source == base.Tools)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Tools, propChange);
			}
			else if (propChange.Source == settings)
			{
				if ((PropertyIds)(object)propChange.PropId == PropertyIds.NavigationToolbarRecentHistoryButtonOffset && base.UIElement != null)
				{
					base.UIElement.DirtyChildElements();
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.NavigationToolbarSettings, propChange);
			}
			else if (propChange.Source == menuSettings)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.NavigationToolbarMenuSettings, propChange);
			}
			else if (((INotificationBadgeSettingsOwner)this).HasNotificationBadgeSettings && base.NotificationBadgeSettings == propChange.Source)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.NotificationBadgeSettings, propChange);
			}
		}

		public override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && MaximumNavigationItems == 10 && !ShouldSerializeMenuSettings() && !ShouldSerializeSettings())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeVisible();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override UltraToolbarBaseUiaProviderStub CreateUIAutomationStub(UIElement element)
		{
			return new NavigationToolbarUiaProviderStub(element);
		}
	}
	public class NavigationToolbarButtonAccessibleObject : AccessibleObjectWrapper
	{
		private NavigationToolbar toolbar;

		private NavigationToolbarButtonType buttonType;

		public override Rectangle Bounds
		{
			get
			{
				Rectangle result = Rectangle.Empty;
				UIElement uIElement = toolbar.UIElement;
				if (uIElement == null)
				{
					return result;
				}
				UIElement val = null;
				switch (buttonType)
				{
				case NavigationToolbarButtonType.Back:
				case NavigationToolbarButtonType.Forward:
					val = uIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(NavigationToolbarButtonUIElement), (object)buttonType);
					break;
				case NavigationToolbarButtonType.RecentHistory:
					val = uIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(NavigationToolbarRecentHistoryButtonUIElement));
					break;
				}
				if (val != null && ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).MarshallingControl != null)
				{
					result = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).MarshallingControl.RectangleToScreen(val.Rect);
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		public override string DefaultAction
		{
			get
			{
				switch (buttonType)
				{
				case NavigationToolbarButtonType.Back:
				case NavigationToolbarButtonType.Forward:
					return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DefaultAction_ButtonTool_On_Toolbar");
				case NavigationToolbarButtonType.RecentHistory:
					if (toolbar.IsRecentHistoryMenuShown)
					{
						return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DefaultAction_Popup_Opened");
					}
					return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DefaultAction_Popup_Closed");
				default:
					return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).DefaultAction;
				}
			}
		}

		public override string Name
		{
			get
			{
				string name = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name;
				if (name != null && name.Length > 0)
				{
					return name;
				}
				return buttonType switch
				{
					NavigationToolbarButtonType.Back => Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AccessibleName_NavigationToolbarBackButton"), 
					NavigationToolbarButtonType.Forward => Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AccessibleName_NavigationToolbarForwardButton"), 
					NavigationToolbarButtonType.RecentHistory => Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AccessibleName_NavigationToolbarRecentHistoryButton"), 
					_ => null, 
				};
			}
			set
			{
				((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name = value;
			}
		}

		public override AccessibleObject Parent => toolbar.AccessibilityObject;

		public override AccessibleRole Role
		{
			get
			{
				if (buttonType == NavigationToolbarButtonType.RecentHistory)
				{
					return AccessibleRole.ButtonMenu;
				}
				return AccessibleRole.PushButton;
			}
		}

		public NavigationToolbarButtonAccessibleObject(NavigationToolbar toolbar, NavigationToolbarButtonType buttonType)
		{
			this.toolbar = toolbar;
			this.buttonType = buttonType;
		}

		public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
		{
			return null;
		}

		public override int GetChildCount()
		{
			return 0;
		}

		protected override Control GetMarshallingControl()
		{
			return toolbar.ToolbarsManager?.DockWithinContainer;
		}

		public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
		{
			switch (navdir)
			{
			case AccessibleNavigation.Left:
			case AccessibleNavigation.Previous:
				switch (buttonType)
				{
				case NavigationToolbarButtonType.Back:
					return null;
				case NavigationToolbarButtonType.Forward:
					return toolbar.BackButtonAccessibleObject;
				case NavigationToolbarButtonType.RecentHistory:
					return toolbar.ForwardButtonAccessibleObject;
				}
				break;
			case AccessibleNavigation.Right:
			case AccessibleNavigation.Next:
				switch (buttonType)
				{
				case NavigationToolbarButtonType.Back:
					return toolbar.ForwardButtonAccessibleObject;
				case NavigationToolbarButtonType.Forward:
					return toolbar.RecentHistoryButtonAccessibleObject;
				case NavigationToolbarButtonType.RecentHistory:
					if (toolbar.Tools.Count > 0)
					{
						return toolbar.Tools[0].AccessibilityObject;
					}
					return null;
				}
				break;
			case AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild:
			case AccessibleNavigation.LastChild:
				return null;
			}
			return toolbar.Navigate(navdir);
		}
	}
	public class NavigationToolbarButtonAreaUIElement : UIElement
	{
		private NavigationToolbarButtonUIElement backButton;

		private NavigationToolbarButtonUIElement forwardButton;

		private const int NAVIGATION_BUTTON_SPACING = 3;

		private const int NAVIGATION_BUTTON_PADDING = 2;

		private static readonly Size NavigationButtonSize = new Size(25, 25);

		private NavigationToolbarButtonUIElement BackButton
		{
			get
			{
				if (backButton == null)
				{
					backButton = new NavigationToolbarButtonUIElement((UIElement)(object)this, NavigationToolbarButtonType.Back);
				}
				return backButton;
			}
		}

		private Region BackgroundRegion
		{
			get
			{
				int x = (int)(0.875f * (float)NavigationButtonSize.Width) + ((UIElement)this).Rect.Left + 2;
				Rectangle rect = new Rectangle(x, ((UIElement)this).Rect.Top + 4, 12, NavigationButtonSize.Height - 6);
				Region region = ((UIElement)BackButton).Region;
				region.Union(((UIElement)ForwardButton).Region);
				region.Union(rect);
				return region;
			}
		}

		private Region BorderRegion
		{
			get
			{
				Region region = ((UIElement)this).Region;
				region.Xor(BackgroundRegion);
				region.Union(new Rectangle(((UIElement)this).Rect.Left, ((UIElement)this).Rect.Top, base.rectValue.Width, 2));
				return region;
			}
		}

		private NavigationToolbarButtonUIElement ForwardButton
		{
			get
			{
				if (forwardButton == null)
				{
					forwardButton = new NavigationToolbarButtonUIElement((UIElement)(object)this, NavigationToolbarButtonType.Forward);
				}
				return forwardButton;
			}
		}

		private NavigationToolbar NavigationToolbar => ((UIElement)this).GetContext(typeof(NavigationToolbar)) as NavigationToolbar;

		protected override bool ClipSelf => true;

		public override UIRole UIRole
		{
			get
			{
				NavigationToolbar navigationToolbar = NavigationToolbar;
				if (navigationToolbar != null)
				{
					UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = navigationToolbar.ToolbarsManager;
					if (toolbarsManager != null)
					{
						return StyleUtils.GetRole(toolbarsManager, StyleUtils.Role.NavigationToolbarButtonArea);
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal NavigationToolbarButtonAreaUIElement(UIElement parent)
			: base(parent)
		{
		}

		protected override void DrawBorders(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			Region borderRegion = BorderRegion;
			RectangleF bounds = borderRegion.GetBounds(((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics);
			LinearGradientBrush brush = new LinearGradientBrush(bounds, ((AppearanceData)(ref drawParams.AppearanceData)).BorderColor, ((AppearanceData)(ref drawParams.AppearanceData)).BorderColor2, LinearGradientMode.Vertical);
			SmoothingMode smoothingMode = ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.SmoothingMode;
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.SmoothingMode = SmoothingMode.AntiAlias;
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.FillRegion(brush, borderRegion);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.SmoothingMode = smoothingMode;
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			if (NavigationToolbar != null)
			{
				NavigationToolbar.ResolveNavigationButtonAreaAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			}
			((UIElement)this).InitAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			((ArrayList)(object)((UIElement)this).ChildElements).Clear();
			Rectangle rectInsideBorders = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
			NavigationToolbarButtonUIElement navigationToolbarButtonUIElement = BackButton;
			rectInsideBorders.X += 2;
			rectInsideBorders.Y += Math.Abs(rectInsideBorders.Height - NavigationButtonSize.Height) / 2;
			((UIElement)navigationToolbarButtonUIElement).Rect = new Rectangle(rectInsideBorders.Location, NavigationButtonSize);
			((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)navigationToolbarButtonUIElement);
			NavigationToolbarButtonUIElement navigationToolbarButtonUIElement2 = ForwardButton;
			rectInsideBorders.X += ((UIElement)navigationToolbarButtonUIElement).Rect.Width + 3;
			((UIElement)navigationToolbarButtonUIElement2).Rect = new Rectangle(rectInsideBorders.Location, NavigationButtonSize);
			((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)navigationToolbarButtonUIElement2);
		}
	}
	public class NavigationToolbarButtonUIElement : ImageAndTextButtonUIElement
	{
		private NavigationToolbarButtonType navigationButtonType;

		private NavigationToolbar NavigationToolbar => ((UIElement)this).GetContext(typeof(NavigationToolbar)) as NavigationToolbar;

		public override UIElementButtonStyle ButtonStyle => (UIElementButtonStyle)9;

		public override bool Enabled
		{
			get
			{
				switch (navigationButtonType)
				{
				case NavigationToolbarButtonType.Back:
					if (NavigationToolbar != null)
					{
						return NavigationToolbar.CanNavigateBack;
					}
					break;
				case NavigationToolbarButtonType.Forward:
					if (NavigationToolbar != null)
					{
						return NavigationToolbar.CanNavigateForward;
					}
					break;
				}
				return ((ButtonUIElementBase)this).Enabled;
			}
		}

		public override UIRole UIRole
		{
			get
			{
				if (NavigationToolbar != null)
				{
					switch (navigationButtonType)
					{
					case NavigationToolbarButtonType.Back:
						return StyleUtils.GetRole(NavigationToolbar.ToolbarsManager, StyleUtils.Role.NavigationToolbarBackButton);
					case NavigationToolbarButtonType.Forward:
						return StyleUtils.GetRole(NavigationToolbar.ToolbarsManager, StyleUtils.Role.NavigationToolbarForwardButton);
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public NavigationToolbarButtonUIElement(UIElement parent, NavigationToolbarButtonType type)
			: base(parent)
		{
			navigationButtonType = type;
			((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext = type;
		}

		protected override void DrawImage(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			Image image = ((AppearanceData)(ref drawParams.AppearanceData)).GetImage(NavigationToolbar.ImageListResolved);
			if (image != null)
			{
				((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).DrawImage(image, ((UIElement)this).Rect, true, (ImageAttributes)null);
			}
		}

		protected override bool DrawTheme(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (NavigationToolbar != null)
			{
				RoleState state = (((ButtonUIElementBase)this).IsMouseDown ? ((RoleState)8) : ((!((ButtonUIElementBase)this).IsHotTracked) ? ((RoleState)1) : ((RoleState)4)));
				NavigationToolbar.ResolveNavigationButtonAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, state, navigationButtonType);
			}
			((ImageAndTextButtonUIElement)this).InitAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		protected override void OnClick()
		{
			if (NavigationToolbar != null && ((UIElement)this).Enabled)
			{
				switch (navigationButtonType)
				{
				case NavigationToolbarButtonType.Back:
					NavigationToolbar.NavigateBackInternal(1, fireEvents: true, NavigationSource.BackButton);
					break;
				case NavigationToolbarButtonType.Forward:
					NavigationToolbar.NavigateForwardInternal(1, fireEvents: true, NavigationSource.ForwardButton);
					break;
				}
			}
			((ImageAndTextButtonUIElement)this).OnClick();
		}
	}

	internal class NavigationToolbarMenuAgent : MenuItemMenuAgentBase
	{
		private NavigationToolbar navigationToolbar;

		protected internal override bool IsSideStripVisible => true;

		internal override UIRole UIRole
		{
			get
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
				if (ultraToolbarsManager != null)
				{
					return StyleUtils.GetRole(ultraToolbarsManager, StyleUtils.Role.NavigationToolbarRecentHistoryMenu);
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal NavigationToolbarMenuAgent(UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager, NavigationToolbar navigationToolbar)
			: base(toolbarsManager)
		{
			this.navigationToolbar = navigationToolbar;
		}

		protected internal override void CreateDropShadows()
		{
		}

		protected internal override PopupControlBase GetPopupControl()
		{
			NavigationToolbarListMenuControl navigationToolbarListMenuControl = new NavigationToolbarListMenuControl(this);
			((Control)(object)navigationToolbarListMenuControl).Size = CalculateRequiredDropDownSize();
			return navigationToolbarListMenuControl;
		}

		protected internal override void OnPopupClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (navigationToolbar != null)
			{
				navigationToolbar.UIElement.DirtyChildElements();
			}
			base.OnPopupClosed(sender, e);
		}

		protected internal override void ResolveIconAreaAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, bool isExpanded)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ResolutionOrderInfo resolutionOrder = StyleUtils.GetResolutionOrder(base.ToolbarsManager);
			UIRole role = StyleUtils.GetRole(base.ToolbarsManager, StyleUtils.Role.NavigationToolbarRecentHistoryMenuItemIconArea);
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleBefore)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseControlInfo)
			{
				if (navigationToolbar != null && navigationToolbar.MenuSettings.HasIconAreaAppearance)
				{
					navigationToolbar.MenuSettings.IconAreaAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
				if (base.ToolbarsManager != null && base.ToolbarsManager.MenuSettings.HasIconAreaAppearance)
				{
					base.ToolbarsManager.MenuSettings.IconAreaAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleAfter)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (base.ToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				ResolveIconAreaAppearanceDefaults(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, isExpanded);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ResolveMenuAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, object context)
		{
			base.ToolbarsManager?.ResolvePopupAppearance(null, UIRole, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, isNavigationToolbarMenu: true);
		}
	}
	public class NavigationToolbarRecentHistoryButtonUIElement : DropDownButtonUIElement
	{
		private NavigationToolbar NavigationToolbar => ((UIElement)this).GetContext(typeof(NavigationToolbar)) as NavigationToolbar;

		public override UIElementButtonStyle ButtonStyle => (UIElementButtonStyle)9;

		protected override bool ClipSelf => true;

		public override bool Enabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (NavigationToolbar != null)
				{
					if (!NavigationToolbar.CanNavigateBack)
					{
						return NavigationToolbar.CanNavigateForward;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return ((ButtonUIElementBase)this).Enabled;
			}
		}

		public override UIRole UIRole
		{
			get
			{
				NavigationToolbar navigationToolbar = NavigationToolbar;
				if (navigationToolbar != null)
				{
					UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = navigationToolbar.ToolbarsManager;
					if (toolbarsManager != null)
					{
						return StyleUtils.GetRole(toolbarsManager, StyleUtils.Role.NavigationToolbarRecentHistoryButton);
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public NavigationToolbarRecentHistoryButtonUIElement(UIElement parent)
			: base(parent)
		{
		}

		protected override void DrawImage(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			Image image = ((AppearanceData)(ref drawParams.AppearanceData)).GetImage(NavigationToolbar.ImageListResolved);
			if (image != null)
			{
				bool flag = image.Height > ((UIElement)this).Rect.Height || image.Width > ((UIElement)this).Rect.Width;
				((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).DrawImage(image, ((UIElement)this).Rect, flag, (ImageAttributes)null);
			}
		}

		protected override void DrawForeground(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
		}

		protected override bool DrawTheme(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearanceData, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (NavigationToolbar != null)
			{
				RoleState state = ((((ButtonUIElementBase)this).IsPressed || NavigationToolbar.IsRecentHistoryMenuShown) ? ((RoleState)8) : ((!((ButtonUIElementBase)this).IsHotTracked) ? ((RoleState)1) : ((RoleState)4)));
				NavigationToolbar.ResolveRecentHistoryButtonAppearance(ref appearanceData, ref requestedProps, state, ((UIElement)this).Enabled);
			}
			((ButtonUIElementBase)this).InitAppearance(ref appearanceData, ref requestedProps);
		}

		protected override void OnClick()
		{
			if (((UIElement)this).Enabled)
			{
				if (NavigationToolbar.IsRecentHistoryMenuShown)
				{
					NavigationToolbar.CloseRecentHistoryMenu();
				}
				else
				{
					NavigationToolbar.ShowRecentHistoryMenu(((UIElement)this).Rect);
				}
			}
		}
	}

		protected NavigationToolbarSettings(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			//IL_005b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0065: Expected O, but got Unknown
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				string name = current.Name;
				if (!(name == "Appearances"))
				{
					if (name == "RecentHistoryButtonOffset")
					{
						recentHistoryButtonOffset = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), recentHistoryButtonOffset);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					appearances = (AppearancesManager)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(AppearancesManager), appearances);
				}
			}
		}

		{

		{
			return recentHistoryButtonOffset != -4;
		}

		public void ResetRecentHistoryButtonOffset()
		{
			recentHistoryButtonOffset = -4;
		}

		{
			AppearanceManager.ResetAppearance(9);
		}

		private void CreateAppearancesManager()
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Enum[] appearanceManagerPropIds = AppearanceManagerPropIds;
			appearances = new AppearancesManager(appearanceManagerPropIds);
			((SubObjectBase)(object)appearances).SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			if (base.ToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				appearances.Appearances = base.ToolbarsManager.Appearances;
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		protected override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
			if (appearances != null && appearances.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Appearances", appearances);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeRecentHistoryButtonOffset())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "RecentHistoryButtonOffset", recentHistoryButtonOffset);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (appearances != null)
			{
				((SubObjectBase)(object)appearances).SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				((DisposableObject)(object)appearances).Dispose();
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (propChange.Source == appearances)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(propChange.PropId, propChange.Trigger);
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnSubObjectPropChanged(propChange);
			}
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			base.Reset();
			if (appearances != null)
			{
				appearances.Reset();
			}
			ResetRecentHistoryButtonOffset();
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeRecentHistoryButtonOffset())
			{
				if (appearances != null)
				{
					return appearances.ShouldSerialize();
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			GetObjectData(info, context);
		}
	}

			: base(parent, toolbar, dockArea)

		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			if (NavigationToolbar != null && NavigationToolbar.IsOnGlassArea)
			{
				if (((ulong)requestedProps & 1uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)1))
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = Color.Transparent;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps ^ 1uL);
				}
				if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x10000000uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)268435456))
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackGradientStyle = (GradientStyle)1;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps ^ 0x10000000uL);
				}
			}
			base.InitAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}
	}
	public class ActivePopupNotchUIElement : UIElement
	{
		internal static Size DefaultSizeOnNavigationMenu = new Size(8, 16);

		internal static Size DefaultSizeOnContentArea = new Size(6, 14);

		private ApplicationMenu2010 applicationMenu;

		private PopupToolBase owningTool;

		protected override bool ClipSelf => true;

		public override Region Region => CreateRegion(((UIElement)this).Rect);

		internal ActivePopupNotchUIElement(UIElement parentElement, ApplicationMenu2010 backStage, PopupToolBase tool)
			: base(parentElement)
		{
			applicationMenu = backStage;
			owningTool = tool;
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			applicationMenu.ContentArea.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		internal Point[] CreatePointsArray(Rectangle rect)
		{
			return new Point[4]
			{
				new Point(rect.Right, rect.Top),
				new Point(rect.Left, rect.Top + rect.Height / 2),
				new Point(rect.Right, rect.Bottom),
				new Point(rect.Right, rect.Top)
			};
		}

		private Region CreateRegion(Rectangle rect)
		{
			Point[] pts = CreatePointsArray(rect);
			byte[] types = new byte[4] { 1, 1, 1, 1 };
			return new Region(new GraphicsPath(pts, types));
		}
	}

			//IL_01c3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01cd: Expected O, but got Unknown
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "NavigationMenu":
					navigationMenu = (NavigationMenu)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(NavigationMenu), navigationMenu);
					break;
				case "ContentArea":
					contentArea = (ContentArea)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ContentArea), contentArea);
					break;
				case "Appearances":
					appearances = (AppearancesManager)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(AppearancesManager), appearances);
					break;
				case "MinimumFormSize":
					minimumFormSize = (Size)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(Size), minimumFormSize);
					break;
				case "ShowDefaultContextMenu":
					showDefaultContextMenu = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), showDefaultContextMenu);
					break;
				case "DisableQAT":
					disableQAT = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), disableQAT);
					break;
				case "DisplayStyle":
					displayStyle = (ApplicationMenu2010DisplayStyle)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ApplicationMenu2010DisplayStyle), displayStyle);
					break;
				case "CausesValidationOnClose":
					causesValidationOnClose = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), causesValidationOnClose);
					break;

			}

		internal override ApplicationMenuAgentBase CreateMenuAgent()

		internal override List<IKeyTipProvider> GetKeyTipProviders()
		{
			List<IKeyTipProvider> keyTipProviders = base.GetKeyTipProviders();
			if (!base.IsOpen)
			{
				keyTipProviders.AddRange(NavigationMenu.Tools.GetKeyTipProviders());
			}
			else
			{
				BackStageMenuAgent backStageMenuAgent = BackStageMenuAgent;
				foreach (MenuItemBase menuItem in backStageMenuAgent.MenuItems)
				{
					keyTipProviders.AddRange(menuItem.GetKeyTipProviders());
				}
			}
			return keyTipProviders;
		}

				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MinimumFormSize", minimumFormSize);

				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ShowDefaultContextMenu", showDefaultContextMenu);

			if (ShouldSerializeDisableQAT())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "DisableQAT", disableQAT);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeDisplayStyle())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "DisplayStyle", displayStyle);

		internal override void Initialize(Ribbon ribbon)
		{
			base.Initialize(ribbon);
			if (navigationMenu != null)
			{
				navigationMenu.Initialize(this);
			}
			if (contentArea != null)
			{
				contentArea.Initialize(this);
			}
			if (appearances != null && ToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				appearances.Appearances = ToolbarsManager.Appearances;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (appearances != null)
			{
				((SubObjectBase)(object)appearances).SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				((DisposableObject)(object)appearances).Dispose();
			}
			if (navigationMenu != null)
			{
				navigationMenu.Dispose();
				navigationMenu.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (contentArea != null)
			{
				contentArea.Dispose();
				contentArea.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (backStageManager != null)
			{
				backStageManager.Dispose();
				backStageManager = null;
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			DirtyUIElement();
			PropertyIds propertyIds;
			if (propChange.Source == navigationMenu)
			{
				propertyIds = PropertyIds.NavigationMenu;
			}
			else if (propChange.Source == contentArea)
			{
				propertyIds = PropertyIds.ContentArea;
			}
			else if (propChange.Source != appearances)
			{
				propertyIds = ((!((INotificationBadgeSettingsOwner)this).HasNotificationBadgeSettings || base.NotificationBadgeSettings != propChange.Source) ? ((PropertyIds)(-1)) : PropertyIds.NotificationBadgeSettings);
			}
			else
			{
				propertyIds = (PropertyIds)(object)propChange.PropId;
				propChange = propChange.Trigger;
			}
			NotifyPropChange(propertyIds, propChange);
		}

		internal override void RefreshDropDownContents()
		{
			try
			{
				BackStageMenuAgent backStageMenuAgent = BackStageMenuAgent;
				MenuItemBase activeMenuItem = backStageMenuAgent.ActiveMenuItem;
				MenuItemBase[] oldMenuItems = ((!backStageMenuAgent.HasMenuItems(backStageMenuAgent.DefaultContext)) ? null : ((MenuItemBase[])backStageMenuAgent.MenuItems.All));
				base.MenuAgent.ReInitialize();
				AddMenuItemsToCollection(backStageMenuAgent.MenuItems, NavigationMenu.Tools, oldMenuItems);
				if (BackStageManager.HasMenuInfoList)
				{
					int i = 0;
					for (int count = BackStageManager.MenuInfoList.Count; i < count; i++)
					{
						BackStageManager.RefreshMenuList();
						BackStageManager.MenuInfoList[i].Tool.RefreshDropDownContents();
					}
					DirtyUIElement();
				}
				toolsVersion = NavigationMenu.Tools.Version;
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager == null || !toolbarsManager.Initialized || !base.IsOpen)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (activeMenuItem != null && base.MenuAgent.ActiveMenuItem == null)
				{
					foreach (MenuItemBase menuItem in backStageMenuAgent.MenuItems)
					{
						if (menuItem.IsSameMenuItem(activeMenuItem))
						{
							menuItem.Activate();
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				base.MenuAgent.RecalculateDropdownSize();
				Refresh();
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		internal override void RefreshDropDownIfToolsWereChanged()
		{
			int count = NavigationMenu.Tools.Count;
			if (toolsVersion != NavigationMenu.Tools.Version)
			{
				RefreshDropDownContents();
			}
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			ResetNavigationMenu();
			if (appearances != null)
			{
				appearances.Reset();
			}
			ResetMinimumFormSize();
			ResetShowDefaultContextMenu();
			ResetContentArea();
			ResetDisableQAT();
			ResetDisplayStyle();
			ResetCausesValidationOnClose();
			base.Reset();
		}

		internal override void ResetDropDownVersion()
		{
			toolsVersion = -1;
		}

		public override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && (appearances == null || !appearances.ShouldSerialize()) && !ShouldSerializeNavigationMenu() && !ShouldSerializeMinimumFormSize() && !ShouldSerializeShowDefaultContextMenu() && !ShouldSerializeContentArea() && !ShouldSerializeDisableQAT() && !ShouldSerializeDisplayStyle())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeCausesValidationOnClose();
			}
			return true;
		}

			}
		}

		internal void ResolveBackButtonAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, bool isPressed, bool isHotTracked, UIRole role)
		{

		private void ResolveBackButtonAppearancePhaseDefaults(ApplicationMenuBackButtonUIElement.AppearanceResolutionPhase phase, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			Ribbon ribbon = base.Ribbon;
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ribbon.ToolbarsManager;
			switch (phase)

					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFDuL);
				}
				break;
			case ApplicationMenuBackButtonUIElement.AppearanceResolutionPhase.HotTracked:
				if ((long)((ulong)requestedProps & 2uL) > 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)2))
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ForeColor = Office2013ColorTable.Colors.ButtonPressedGradientDark;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFDuL);
				}
				break;
			case ApplicationMenuBackButtonUIElement.AppearanceResolutionPhase.Normal:
				if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x100uL) == 256)
				{
					Image image = null;
					if (ribbon != null)
					{
						image = toolbarsManager.ApplicationMenuBackBitmap;
					}
					if (image != null)
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).Image = image;
						requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps ^ 0x100uL);
					}
				}
				if ((long)((ulong)requestedProps & 1uL) > 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)1))
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = Office2013ColorTable.Colors.ApplicationMenu2010NavigationAreaBackGroundGradientLight;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEuL);
				}
				if ((long)((ulong)requestedProps & 2uL) > 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)2))
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ForeColor = Office2013ColorTable.Colors.ApplicationMenu2010ContentAreaBackGroundColor;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFDuL);

		internal bool ShouldDrawToolAsActive(PopupToolBase tool)
		{
			if (tool == NavigationMenu.ActiveContentTool)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!HasBackStageManager)
			{
				NavigationMenu.OnActiveContentToolChanged(NavigationMenu.ActiveContentTool);
			}
			return BackStageManager.ContainsTool(tool);
		}

				((SubObjectBase)(object)appearances).SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				appearances.Initialize((AppearancesCollection)null, AppearanceManagerPropIds);
			}
		}

		internal void BringIntoView(ToolBase tool)
		{
			if (tool == null || tool.UIElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle toolRect = tool.UIElement.Rect;
			if (tool.Index == 0)
			{
				toolRect = new Rectangle(toolRect.X, 0, toolRect.Width, toolRect.Bottom);
			}
			Size size = IsInView(toolRect);
			if (size.IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				int value = ScrollPanel.HorizontalScrollProperties.Value;
				int value2 = ScrollPanel.VerticalScrollProperties.Value;
				value = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(ScrollPanel.HorizontalScrollProperties.Maximum, value + size.Width));
				value2 = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(ScrollPanel.VerticalScrollProperties.Maximum, value2 + size.Height));
				((Control)(object)ScrollPanel).SuspendLayout();
				ScrollPanel.HorizontalScrollProperties.Value = value;
				scrollPanel.VerticalScrollProperties.Value = value2;
				((Control)(object)ScrollPanel).ResumeLayout();
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private Size IsInView(Rectangle toolRect)
		{
			int width = 0;
			int height = 0;
			Size size = ((Control)(object)ScrollPanel.ClientArea).ClientRectangle.Size;
			Infragistics.Win.Misc.ScrollProperties horizontalScrollProperties = ScrollPanel.HorizontalScrollProperties;
			if (horizontalScrollProperties.Visible)
			{
				if (toolRect.Left < horizontalScrollProperties.Value)
				{
					width = toolRect.Left - horizontalScrollProperties.Value;
				}
				else if (toolRect.Right > horizontalScrollProperties.Value + size.Width)
				{
					width = toolRect.Right - (horizontalScrollProperties.Value + size.Width);
				}
			}
			horizontalScrollProperties = ScrollPanel.VerticalScrollProperties;
			if (horizontalScrollProperties.Visible)
			{
				if (toolRect.Top < horizontalScrollProperties.Value)
				{
					height = toolRect.Top - horizontalScrollProperties.Value;
				}
				else if (toolRect.Bottom > horizontalScrollProperties.Value + size.Height)
				{
					height = toolRect.Bottom - (horizontalScrollProperties.Value + size.Height) + 1;
				}
			}
			return new Size(width, height);
		}

		[UIPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Window = UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows)]
		protected override bool ProcessDialogKey(Keys keyData)
		{
			Keys keys = keyData & ~(Keys.Shift | Keys.Control | Keys.Alt);
			switch (keys)
			{
			case Keys.Escape:
				if (base.MenuAgent.IsOpen)
				{
					return base.MenuAgent.ToolbarsManager.ProcessEscapeKey(passToPopupContainer: false);
				}
				break;
			case Keys.Return:
			case Keys.Left:
			case Keys.Up:
			case Keys.Right:
			case Keys.Down:
				return base.MenuAgent.ToolbarsManager.ProcessNavigationKey(keys, passToPopupContainer: false);
			}
			return ((Control)(object)this).ProcessDialogKey(keyData);
		}
	}
