			}

			internal UIElement GetUIElement(UIElement parent)
			{
				if (uiElement != null)
				{
					if (uiElement.Parent == parent)
					{
						return uiElement;
					}
					((DisposableObject)(object)uiElement).Dispose();
				}
				if (Tool is PopupMenuTool)
				{
					uiElement = (UIElement)(object)new BackStageContentAreaMenuUIElement(parent, MenuAgent);
				}
				else if (Tool is PopupControlContainerToolBase)
				{
					PopupControlContainerToolBase popupControlContainerToolBase = Tool as PopupControlContainerToolBase;
					uiElement = (UIElement)(object)new ControlContainerToolUIElement(parent, popupControlContainerToolBase, popupControlContainerToolBase.Control);
				}
				return uiElement;
			}
		}

		internal delegate void PopupToolHandler(BackStageManager sender, PopupToolBase popupTool);

		private const int TOOLRECURSIONLIMIT = 1;

		private PopupToolBase activeContentTool;

		private ApplicationMenu2010 backStage;

		private Size backStageSize = Size.Empty;

		private List<MenuInfo> menuInfoList;

		internal PopupToolBase ActiveContentTool
		{
			get
			{
				return activeContentTool;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != activeContentTool)
				{
					UnhookControlContainerEvents(activeContentTool as PopupControlContainerToolBase);
					activeContentTool = value;
					GenerateMenuInfoList(value, backStage.IsOpen);
					HookControlContainerEvents(activeContentTool as PopupControlContainerToolBase);
					RaiseActiveContentToolOpened(value);
				}
			}
		}

		internal Size BackStageSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (backStageSize.IsEmpty)
				{
					backStageSize = CalculateRequiredBackStageSize();
				}
				return backStageSize;
			}
		}

		internal ContentArea ContentArea => backStage.ContentArea;

		internal List<MenuInfo> MenuInfoList
		{
			get
			{
				if (menuInfoList == null)
				{
					menuInfoList = new List<MenuInfo>();
				}
				return menuInfoList;
			}
		}

		internal bool HasMenuInfoList => menuInfoList != null;

		internal event PopupToolHandler ActiveContentToolOpened;

		internal event PopupToolHandler ActiveContentToolClickedWhileOpen;

		internal BackStageManager(ApplicationMenu2010 backStage)
		{
			this.backStage = backStage;
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			ResetActiveContentTool();
			backStage = null;
		}

		internal void DirtyBackStageSize()
		{
			backStageSize = Size.Empty;
		}

		private Size CalculateRequiredBackStageSize()
		{
			if (!HasMenuInfoList && ActiveContentTool != null)
			{
				GenerateMenuInfoList(ActiveContentTool, fireEvents: false);
			}
			Size size = backStage.NavigationMenu.CalculateRequiredSize();
			int num = size.Height;
			int num2 = size.Width;
			foreach (MenuInfo menuInfo in MenuInfoList)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, menuInfo.PreferredSize.Height);
				num2 += menuInfo.PreferredSize.Width;
			}
			num += backStage.BackStageHeaderHeight + ContentArea.DistanceFromTop;
			int count = MenuInfoList.Count;
			num2 += (count + 1) * ContentArea.SpaceBetweenColumns;
			return new Size(num2, num);
		}

		private void GenerateMenuInfoList(PopupToolBase activeTool, bool fireEvents)
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = GetToolbarsManager();
			if (toolbarsManager == null || toolbarsManager.IsDisposing || toolbarsManager.IsDisposed)
			{
				return;
			}
			DirtyBackStageSize();
			if (activeTool == null && HasMenuInfoList)
			{
				if (fireEvents)
				{
					FireCloseUpEvents(backStage.NavigationMenu.ActiveContentTool);
				}
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = MenuInfoList.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					MenuInfoList[i].Dispose();
				}
				MenuInfoList.Clear();
				return;
			}
			List<PopupToolBase> list = new List<PopupToolBase>();
			PopupToolBase currentTool;
			for (currentTool = activeTool; currentTool != null; currentTool = currentTool.OwningMenu)
			{
				list.Insert(0, currentTool);
			}
			currentTool = activeTool;
			PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool = currentTool as PopupMenuTool;
			while (popupMenuTool != null)
			{
				currentTool = null;
				foreach (ToolBase tool in popupMenuTool.Tools)
				{
					currentTool = tool as PopupToolBase;
					if (currentTool != null && currentTool.VisibleResolved && currentTool.EnabledResolved)
					{
						if (list.FindAll((PopupToolBase listTool) => listTool.Key == currentTool.Key).Count >= 1)
						{
							currentTool = null;
							break;
						}
						list.Add(currentTool);
						popupMenuTool = currentTool as PopupMenuTool;
						break;
					}
					currentTool = null;
				}
				if (currentTool == null)
				{
					currentTool = popupMenuTool;
					popupMenuTool = null;
				}
			}
			int num = -1;
			int num2 = 0;
			int count2 = list.Count;
			int num3 = MenuInfoList.Count;
			for (; num2 < count2; num2++)
			{
				if (num2 < num3)
				{
					if (list[num2] == MenuInfoList[num2].Tool)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (MenuInfoList[num3 - 1].MenuAgent is PopupControlContainerAgent)
					{
						MenuInfoList[num3 - 1].Tool.SetToolWithContainedControl(takeControlOwnership: false, null);
					}
					if (fireEvents)
					{
						FireCloseUpEvents(MenuInfoList[num2].Tool);
					}
					for (int num4 = num2; num4 < num3; num4++)
					{
						MenuInfoList[num4].Dispose();
					}
					MenuInfoList.RemoveRange(num2, num3 - num2);
					num3 = -1;
				}
				if (num < 0)
				{
					num = num2;
				}
				MenuInfoList.Add(new MenuInfo(list[num2]));
			}
			if (fireEvents)
			{
				PopupToolBase rootTool = list[num];
				FireBeforeDropDownEvents(rootTool);
				FireAfterDropDownEvents(rootTool);
			}
			list.Clear();
			if (backStage != null)
			{
				backStage.DirtyUIElement();
			}
		}

		private UltraToolbarsManager GetToolbarsManager()
		{
			if (backStage == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (backStage.ribbon == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return backStage.ribbon.ToolbarsManager;
		}

		private void HookControlContainerEvents(PopupControlContainerToolBase tool)
		{
			if (tool != null && tool.Control != null)
			{
				tool.Control.SizeChanged += OnControlSizeChanged;
			}
		}

		private void OnControlSizeChanged(object sender, EventArgs args)
		{
			if (backStage != null && backStage.IsOpen && ((Control)sender).Dock == DockStyle.None)
			{
				backStage.RefreshDropDownContents();
			}
		}

		private void UnhookControlContainerEvents(PopupControlContainerToolBase tool)
		{
			if (tool != null && tool.Control != null)
			{
				tool.Control.SizeChanged += OnControlSizeChanged;
			}
		}

		internal void AssignDefaultContentTool()
		{
			NavigationMenu navigationMenu = backStage.NavigationMenu;
			foreach (ToolBase tool in navigationMenu.Tools)
			{
				if (tool.UnderlyingTool is PopupToolBase { VisibleResolved: not false, EnabledResolved: not false } popupToolBase)
				{
					ResetActiveContentTool();
					ToolBase toolBase = null;
					try
					{
						toolBase = tool.ToolBeingDisplayed.AttachToUnderlyingTool();
						navigationMenu.ActiveContentTool = popupToolBase;
						break;
					}
					finally
					{
						toolBase?.AttachToUnderlyingTool();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool ContainsTool(PopupToolBase tool)
		{
			if (HasMenuInfoList)
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = menuInfoList.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					if (menuInfoList[i].Tool == tool)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void FireAfterDropDownEvents(PopupToolBase rootTool)
		{
			if (rootTool == null || !ContainsTool(rootTool))
			{
				return;
			}
			PopupControlBase popupControl = backStage.MenuAgent.PopupControl;
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = backStage.MenuAgent.ToolbarsManager;
			int num = MenuInfoList.Count - 1;
			while (num >= 0)
			{
				PopupToolBase tool = MenuInfoList[num].Tool;
				toolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.AfterToolDropdown, new ToolDropdownEventArgs(tool, (Control)(object)popupControl));
				if (tool != rootTool)
				{
					num--;
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		internal void FireBeforeDropDownEvents(PopupToolBase rootTool)
		{
			if (rootTool == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int i = 0;
			int count = MenuInfoList.Count;
			PopupControlBase popupControl = backStage.MenuAgent.PopupControl;
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = backStage.MenuAgent.ToolbarsManager;
			for (; i < count && rootTool != MenuInfoList[i].Tool; i++)
			{
			}
			for (; i < count; i++)
			{
				bool cancel = false;
				MenuInfoList[i].MenuAgent.BeforeDropDown(ref cancel);
				if (cancel)
				{
					MenuInfoList.RemoveRange(i, count - i);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void FireCloseUpEvents(PopupToolBase rootTool)
		{
			if (rootTool == null || !ContainsTool(rootTool))
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = MenuInfoList.Count - 1;
			while (num >= 0)
			{
				MenuInfoList[num].MenuAgent.OnPopupClosed(this, EventArgs.Empty);
				MenuItemsCollection menuItems = MenuInfoList[num].MenuAgent.MenuItems;
				foreach (MenuItemBase item in menuItems)
				{
					item.ResetCachedSize();
				}
				if (MenuInfoList[num].Tool != rootTool)
				{
					num--;
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		internal IKeyTipProvider[] GetKeyTipProviders(bool includeRootTool)
		{
			List<IKeyTipProvider> list = new List<IKeyTipProvider>();
			int num = ((!includeRootTool) ? 1 : 0);
			if (HasMenuInfoList)
			{
				int i = num;
				for (int count = MenuInfoList.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					list.AddRange(MenuInfoList[i].GetKeyTipProviders());
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal void RefreshMenuList()
		{
			if (activeContentTool != null)
			{
				GenerateMenuInfoList(null, fireEvents: false);
			}
			GenerateMenuInfoList(activeContentTool, fireEvents: false);
		}

		internal bool RemovePopupToolFromActiveContentList(PopupToolBase popupTool)
		{
			if (!HasMenuInfoList)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = -1;
			int count = MenuInfoList.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (num < 0 && MenuInfoList[i].Tool == popupTool)
				{
					num = i;
				}
				if (num == 0)
				{
					ResetActiveContentTool();
					return true;
				}
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					MenuInfoList[i].Dispose();
				}
			}
			if (num != -1)
			{
				MenuInfoList.RemoveRange(num, count - num);
			}
			return num >= 0;
		}

		internal void ResetActiveContentTool()
		{
			UnhookControlContainerEvents(activeContentTool as PopupControlContainerToolBase);
			activeContentTool = null;
			if (!HasMenuInfoList)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (MenuInfo menuInfo in menuInfoList)
			{
				menuInfo.Dispose();
			}
			menuInfoList.Clear();
			menuInfoList = null;
		}

		internal void RaiseActiveContentToolOpened(PopupToolBase tool)
		{
			if (tool != null)
			{
				if (this.ActiveContentToolOpened != null)
				{
					this.ActiveContentToolOpened(this, tool);
				}
				if (tool.ToolbarsManager != null)
				{
					tool.ToolbarsManager.RaiseActiveContentToolOpenedEvent(tool);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RaiseActiveContentToolClickedWhileOpen(PopupToolBase tool)
		{
			if (tool != null && this.ActiveContentToolClickedWhileOpen != null)
			{
				this.ActiveContentToolClickedWhileOpen(this, tool);
			}
		}
	}

	public class ContentAreaSettings : SettingsBase, ISerializable
	{
		private LabelMenuDisplayStyle labelDisplayStyle;

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_MenuSettings_P_LabelDisplayStyle")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Appearance")]
		public LabelMenuDisplayStyle LabelDisplayStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return labelDisplayStyle;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != labelDisplayStyle)
				{
					if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(LabelMenuDisplayStyle), value))
					{
						throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_128"));
					}
					labelDisplayStyle = value;
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.LabelDisplayStyle);
				}
			}
		}

		internal ContentAreaSettings(object owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected ContentAreaSettings(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				string name = current.Name;
				if (!(name == "LabelDisplayStyle"))
				{
					if (name == "Tag")
					{
						DeserializeTag(current);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					labelDisplayStyle = (LabelMenuDisplayStyle)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(LabelMenuDisplayStyle), labelDisplayStyle);
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
			if (ShouldSerializeLabelDisplayStyle())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "LabelDisplayStyle", labelDisplayStyle);
			}
		}

		internal override SettingsBase Clone(object newOwner)
		{
			ContentAreaSettings contentAreaSettings = new ContentAreaSettings(newOwner);
			contentAreaSettings.InitializeFrom(this);
			return contentAreaSettings;
		}

		internal override void InitializeFrom(SettingsBase settings)
		{
			base.InitializeFrom(settings);
			if (settings is ContentAreaSettings contentAreaSettings)
			{
				labelDisplayStyle = contentAreaSettings.labelDisplayStyle;
			}
		}

		protected internal bool ShouldSerializeLabelDisplayStyle()
		{
			return labelDisplayStyle != LabelMenuDisplayStyle.Default;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetLabelDisplayStyle()
		{
			LabelDisplayStyle = LabelMenuDisplayStyle.Default;
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			base.Reset();
			ResetLabelDisplayStyle();
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeLabelDisplayStyle();
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

		public class NavigationMenuAccessibleObject : AccessibleObjectWrapper
		{
			private NavigationMenu navigationMenu;

			public override Rectangle Bounds
			{
				get
				{
					Rectangle rectangle = Rectangle.Empty;
					MenuItemAreaUIElement menuItemAreaUIElement = MenuItemAreaUIElement;
					if (menuItemAreaUIElement != null)
					{
						rectangle = ((UIElement)menuItemAreaUIElement).Rect;
						rectangle = ((UIElement)menuItemAreaUIElement).Control.RectangleToScreen(rectangle);
					}
					else if (BackStageViewControl != null)
					{
						rectangle = ((Control)(object)BackStageViewControl).RectangleToScreen(rectangle);
					}
					return rectangle;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Parent
			{
				get
				{
					if (BackStageViewControl != null)
					{
						return ((Control)(object)BackStageViewControl).AccessibilityObject;
					}
					return null;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleRole Role => AccessibleRole.Grouping;

			public override AccessibleStates State
			{
				get
				{
					AccessibleStates accessibleStates = AccessibleStates.None;
					if (MenuItemAreaUIElement == null)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Invisible;
					}
					return accessibleStates;
				}
			}

			public NavigationMenu NavigationMenu => navigationMenu;

			private MenuItemAreaUIElement MenuItemAreaUIElement => navigationMenu.UIElement as MenuItemAreaUIElement;

			private BackStageViewControl BackStageViewControl
			{
				get
				{
					if (NavigationMenu.ApplicationMenu2010 == null || NavigationMenu.ApplicationMenu2010.MenuAgent == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return NavigationMenu.ApplicationMenu2010.MenuAgent.PopupControl as BackStageViewControl;
				}
			}

			public NavigationMenuAccessibleObject(NavigationMenu navigationMenu)
			{
				this.navigationMenu = navigationMenu;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
			{
				if (index < NavigationMenu.Tools.Count)
				{
					return NavigationMenu.Tools[index].AccessibilityObject;
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override int GetChildCount()
			{
				int num = 0;
				return NavigationMenu.Tools.Count;
			}

			protected override Control GetMarshallingControl()
			{
				return navigationMenu.ToolbarsManager?.DockWithinContainer;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				switch (navdir)
				{
				case AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild:
					return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).GetChild(0);
				case AccessibleNavigation.LastChild:
				{
					int num = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).GetChildCount() - 1;
					if (num < 0)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).GetChild(num);
				}
				default:
					return null;
				}
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public PopupToolBase ActiveContentTool
		{
			get
			{
				BackStageManager backStageManager = ApplicationMenu2010.BackStageManager;
				if (backStageManager.HasMenuInfoList && backStageManager.MenuInfoList.Count > 0)
				{
					return backStageManager.MenuInfoList[0].Tool;
				}
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != null)
				{
					if (!VerifyToolOnNavigationMenu(value, checkSubMenus: true))
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NavigationMenu_ToolDoesNotExist_Exception"));
					}
					if (!value.EnabledResolved || !value.VisibleResolved)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NavigationMenu_ToolNotVisibleEnabled_Exception"));
					}
				}
				if (value != ActiveContentTool)
				{
					OnActiveContentToolChanged(value);
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ActiveContentTool);
				}
			}
		}

			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

		private bool ContainsTool(ToolsCollection tools, PopupToolBase tool, bool recursive)
		{
			if (tools == null || tool == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (tools.IndexOf(tool.ToolBeingDisplayed) >= 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (recursive)
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = tools.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					if (tools[i] is PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool && ContainsTool(popupMenuTool.Tools, tool, recursive))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFBFFFFFFuL);

		{
			int num = 6;

			using LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new LinearGradientBrush(rect2, Color.Transparent, borderColor, LinearGradientMode.Horizontal);
			Rectangle rect3 = new Rectangle(rect2.X + 1, rect2.Y, rect2.Width - 1, rect2.Height);
			Blend blend = new Blend(4);
			blend.Factors = new float[4] { 0f, 0.1f, 0.4f, 1f };

			linearGradientBrush.Blend = blend;

		}

		internal bool TakeFocus()
		{
			if (((Control)this).IsDisposed || ((Control)this).Disposing)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (focusControl == null)
			{
				focusControl = new TextBox();
				focusControl.Location = new Point(-10000, -10000);
				((Control)this).Controls.Add(focusControl);
			}
			return ToolbarsManagerUtilities.FocusControl(focusControl);
		}

		private void AnimationCleanup()
		{
			if (animationTimer != null)
			{
				animationTimer.Enabled = false;
				animationTimer.Tick -= AnimationTimerTick;
				animationTimer.Dispose();
				animationTimer = null;
			}
			if (animationImage != null)
			{
				animationImage.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private void AnimationTimerTick(object source, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!AnimationTimer.Enabled)
			{
				return;
			}
			inAnimationTimerTick = true;
			try
			{
				SetRectsForNextAnimation();
				MenuAgent.ResizeDropDown(animationDestRect.Size);
				((Control)this).Location = new Point(animationDestRect.Width - ((Control)this).Size.Width, animationDestRect.Height - ((Control)this).Size.Height);
				((UltraControlBase)this).Invalidate();
				try
				{
					if (animationStyle == MenuAnimationStyle.Fade)
					{
						try
						{
							UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
							if (Utilities.CanAssert)
							{
								uIPermission.Assert();
							}
							Form form = ((Control)this).FindForm();
							if (form != null && !form.Disposing && !form.IsDisposed)
							{
								if (animationStepCurrent >= animationStepTotal)
								{
									form.Opacity = 1.0;
								}
								else
								{
									form.Opacity = Convert.ToDouble(animationStepCurrent) / Convert.ToDouble(animationStepTotal);
								}
							}
						}
						catch (SecurityException)
						{
						}
					}
					((UltraControlBase)this).Update();
				}
				catch (ObjectDisposedException)
				{
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				inAnimationTimerTick = false;
			}
		}

		private void EstablishMenuAnimationStyle()
		{
			switch (ToolbarsManager.MenuAnimationStyle)
			{
			case MenuAnimationStyle.Fade:
				animationStyle = MenuAnimationStyle.Fade;
				break;
			case MenuAnimationStyle.Random:
				animationStyle = (MenuAnimationStyle)ToolbarsManager.GetNextRandomNumber(2, 5);
				break;
			case MenuAnimationStyle.Slide:
				animationStyle = MenuAnimationStyle.Slide;
				break;
			case MenuAnimationStyle.Unfold:
				animationStyle = MenuAnimationStyle.Unfold;
				break;
			}
		}

		private void InitializeMenuAnimationVariables()
		{
			switch (animationStyle)
			{
			case MenuAnimationStyle.Fade:
				animationStepTotal = 10;
				animationTimerInterval = 24;
				break;
			case MenuAnimationStyle.Random:
			case MenuAnimationStyle.Slide:
				if (ToolbarsManager.IsNonOffice2000Style)
				{
					animationStepTotal = 12;
					animationTimerInterval = 15;
				}
				else
				{
					animationStepTotal = 10;
					animationTimerInterval = 16;
				}
				break;
			case MenuAnimationStyle.Unfold:
				if (ToolbarsManager.IsNonOffice2000Style)
				{
					animationStepTotal = 12;
					animationTimerInterval = 15;
				}
				else
				{
					animationStepTotal = 15;
					animationTimerInterval = 15;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private void PerformNextAnimationStep(PaintEventArgs pe)
		{
			switch (animationStyle)
			{
			case MenuAnimationStyle.Fade:
				PerformNextFadeAnimationStep(pe);
				break;
			case MenuAnimationStyle.Random:
			case MenuAnimationStyle.Slide:
				PerformNextSlideAnimationStep(pe);
				break;
			case MenuAnimationStyle.Unfold:
				PerformNextUnfoldAnimationStep(pe);
				break;
			}
		}

		private void PerformNextFadeAnimationStep(PaintEventArgs pe)
		{
			Form form = ((Control)this).FindForm();
			if (form != null)
			{
				Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(new Point(0, 0), ((Control)this).Size);
				pe.Graphics.DrawImage(animationImage, rectangle, rectangle, GraphicsUnit.Pixel);
			}
		}

		private void PerformNextSlideAnimationStep(PaintEventArgs pe)
		{
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(new Point(0, 0), ((Control)this).Size);
			pe.Graphics.DrawImage(animationImage, rectangle, rectangle, GraphicsUnit.Pixel);
		}

		private void PerformNextUnfoldAnimationStep(PaintEventArgs pe)
		{
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(new Point(0, 0), ((Control)this).Size);
			pe.Graphics.DrawImage(animationImage, rectangle, rectangle, GraphicsUnit.Pixel);
		}

		private void ResetOwnerAnimationStatus()
		{
			MenuAgent.IsMenuAnimationActive = false;
		}

		private void SetRectsForNextAnimation()
		{
			switch (animationStyle)
			{
			case MenuAnimationStyle.Fade:
				SetRectsForNextFadeAnimation();
				break;
			case MenuAnimationStyle.Random:
			case MenuAnimationStyle.Slide:
				SetRectsForNextSlideAnimation();
				break;
			case MenuAnimationStyle.Unfold:
				SetRectsForNextUnfoldAnimation();
				break;
			}
		}

		private void SetRectsForNextFadeAnimation()
		{
			animationSourceRect = new Rectangle(new Point(0, 0), ((Control)this).Size);
			animationDestRect = animationSourceRect;
		}

		private void SetRectsForNextSlideAnimation()
		{
			int num = ((Control)this).Size.Height / animationStepTotal;
			animationSourceRect = new Rectangle(new Point(0, 0), ((Control)this).Size);
			animationDestRect = animationSourceRect;
			animationDestRect.Height = num * animationStepCurrent;
			animationSourceRect.Offset(0, ((Control)this).Size.Height - num * animationStepCurrent);
		}

		private void SetRectsForNextUnfoldAnimation()
		{
			int num = ((Control)this).Size.Height / animationStepTotal;
			int num2 = ((Control)this).Size.Width / (animationStepTotal + 2);
			int num3 = num * animationStepCurrent;
			int num4 = Math.Min(((Control)this).Size.Width, num2 * animationStepCurrent);
			animationSourceRect = new Rectangle(new Point(0, 0), ((Control)this).Size);
			animationDestRect = animationSourceRect;
			animationDestRect.Width = num4;
			animationDestRect.Height = num3;
			animationSourceRect.Offset(((Control)this).Size.Width - num4, ((Control)this).Size.Height - num3);
		}

		{

				((UltraControlBase)this).OnGestureStarting(e);
			}
			if (((IGestureConsumer)this).GesturesEnabled)
			{
				prevTouchPoint = null;
				gestureContext = null;
				CurrentGestureArea = UltraToolbarsDockArea.GestureAreaType.None;
				UIElement gestureContainerUIElement = GetGestureContainerUIElement(e.Location, startingGesture: true);
				if (gestureContainerUIElement != null && !(gestureContainerUIElement is PopupGalleryGroupAreaUIElement))

				((UltraControlBase)this).OnPanGesture(e);
			}
			if (!((GestureEventArgs)e).Handled && ((IGestureConsumer)this).GesturesEnabled)
			{
				DoTouchScroll(e);
			}
		}

		private void DoTouchScroll(PanGestureEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!prevTouchPoint.HasValue)
			{
				return;
			}
			Point location = e.Location;
			int num = prevTouchPoint.Value.Y - location.Y;
			int num2 = Math.Abs(num);
			int num3 = 0;
			if (num == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraToolbarsDockArea.GestureAreaType gestureAreaType = CurrentGestureArea;
			if (gestureAreaType != UltraToolbarsDockArea.GestureAreaType.MenuArea || !(GetGestureContainerUIElement(UltraToolbarsDockArea.GestureAreaType.MenuArea) is MenuItemAreaUIElement menuItemAreaUIElement))
			{
				return;
			}
			MenuAgentBase menuAgentBase = MenuAgent;
			int firstItemIndex = menuAgentBase.GetFirstItemIndex(menuItemAreaUIElement);
			int lastItemIndex = menuAgentBase.GetLastItemIndex(menuItemAreaUIElement);
			int num4 = lastItemIndex - firstItemIndex;
			if (num4 <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num5 = ((Control)this).Height / num4;
			if (num2 >= num5)
			{
				num3 = num / num5;
			}
			if (num3 != 0)
			{
				int num6 = firstItemIndex + num3;
				if (num6 >= 0 && num6 + num4 < menuAgentBase.GetVisibleMenuItemCount(menuItemAreaUIElement))
				{
					menuAgentBase.SetFirstItemIndex(menuItemAreaUIElement, num6);
					((UIElement)menuItemAreaUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
					prevTouchPoint = location;
					((GestureEventArgs)e).Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		internal UIElement GetGestureContainerUIElement(Point location, bool startingGesture)
		{
			UIElement controlElement = (UIElement)(object)ControlElement;
			if (controlElement == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UIElement val = controlElement.ElementFromPoint(location);
			if (val != null)
			{
				UIElement ancestor = val.GetAncestor(typeof(PopupGalleryGroupAreaUIElement));
				if (ancestor != null && ((PopupGalleryGroupAreaUIElement)(object)ancestor).GalleryTool.ShowScrollBarInDropDown())
				{
					if (startingGesture)
					{
						CurrentGestureArea = UltraToolbarsDockArea.GestureAreaType.GalleryPreviewArea;
						gestureContext = ancestor.GetContext();
					}
					return ancestor;
				}
				ancestor = val.GetAncestor(typeof(MenuItemAreaUIElement));
				if (ancestor != null)
				{
					if (startingGesture)
					{
						CurrentGestureArea = UltraToolbarsDockArea.GestureAreaType.MenuArea;
						gestureContext = ancestor.GetContext();
					}
					return ancestor;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private UIElement GetGestureContainerUIElement(UltraToolbarsDockArea.GestureAreaType gestureArea)
		{
			UIElement controlElement = (UIElement)(object)ControlElement;
			if (controlElement == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (UIElement)(gestureArea switch
			{
				UltraToolbarsDockArea.GestureAreaType.MenuArea => controlElement.GetDescendant(typeof(MenuItemAreaUIElement), gestureContext), 
				UltraToolbarsDockArea.GestureAreaType.GalleryPreviewArea => controlElement.GetDescendant(typeof(PopupGalleryGroupAreaUIElement)), 
				_ => null, 
			});
		}

		private void ScrollToBottom(GalleryToolItemGroup group, int row)
		{
			int num = GalleryTool.ItemSizeInDropDownResolved.Height + GalleryTool.ItemPadding.Height;
			if (row == 0 && group == group.GalleryTool.GetFirstVisibleGroup(mustHaveItems: false))
			{
				ScrollBarInfo.Value = 0;
				return;
			}
			int val = int.MaxValue;
			if (row > 0)
			{
				val = GetItemVirtualY(group, row - 1);
			}
			else
			{
				int visibleIndex = group.VisibleIndex;
				if (visibleIndex > 0)
				{

					if (visibleGroup != null)

					}
				}
			}
			int itemVirtualY = GetItemVirtualY(group, row);
			itemVirtualY -= ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders.Height - num;
			ScrollBarInfo.Value = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(itemVirtualY, val));
		}

		{
			GalleryToolItemGroupFilter selectedGroupFilter = group.GalleryTool.SelectedGroupFilter;

					return Utilities.GetMarshallingControl(((FragmentUIAProviderStub)this).GetParent());
				}

				public override IRawElementProviderFragment GetFirstChild()
				{
					if (ItemStubList.Count > 0)
					{
						return ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)itemStubList[0]).Provider;
					}
					return null;
				}

				public override IRawElementProviderFragment GetLastChild()
				{
					int count = ItemStubList.Count;
					if (count > 0)
					{
						return ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)itemStubList[count - 1]).Provider;
					}
					return null;
				}

				public override IRawElementProviderFragment NavigateChildren(FragmentUIAProviderStub childStub, bool forward)
				{
					if (childStub is GalleryToolItem.GalleryToolItemUiaProviderStub galleryToolItemUiaProviderStub)
					{
						int num = PreviewInfo.Items.IndexOf(galleryToolItemUiaProviderStub.Item);
						num += (forward ? 1 : (-1));
						if (num >= 0 && num < ItemStubList.Count)
						{
							return ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)itemStubList[num]).Provider;
						}
					}
					return ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)this).NavigateChildren(childStub, forward);
				}

				internal UIElement GetItemUIElement(GalleryToolItem item)
				{
					if (((FragmentUIAProviderStub)this).GetParentStub() is PopupGalleryToolUiaProviderStub popupGalleryToolUiaProviderStub)
					{
						return item.GetUIElement(popupGalleryToolUiaProviderStub.PopupGalleryTool, null, GalleryArea.Preview);
					}
					return null;
				}

				internal IRawElementProviderFragment GetProviderFromUIElement(UIElement elementAtPoint)
				{
					if (elementAtPoint.GetAncestor(typeof(GalleryPreviewItemUIElement)) is GalleryPreviewItemUIElement { Item: var item })
					{
						foreach (GalleryToolItem.GalleryToolItemUiaProviderStub itemStub in ItemStubList)
						{
							if (itemStub.Item == item)
							{
								return ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)itemStub).Provider;
							}
						}
					}
					return null;
				}

				private void SynchronizeList()
				{
					GalleryPreviewInfo previewInfo = PreviewInfo;
					GalleryToolItemKeysCollection items = previewInfo.Items;
					if (!previewInfo.HasPreviewInfoChanged(ref itemsVersion, ref groupsVersion, ref filterVersion, ref filterKey))
					{
						return;
					}
					if (itemStubList == null)
					{
						itemStubList = new List<GalleryToolItem.GalleryToolItemUiaProviderStub>(items.Count);
					}
					itemStubList.Clear();
					foreach (GalleryToolItem item in (IEnumerable)items)
					{
						itemStubList.Add(new GalleryToolItem.GalleryToolItemUiaProviderStub(item, previewOnRibbon: true, (FragmentUIAProviderStub)(object)this));
					}
				}
			}

			internal class GalleryToolButtonUiaProviderStub : FragmentUIAProviderStubWithParent, IInvokeProvider
			{
				private PopupGalleryToolUiaProviderStub PopupGalleryToolStub => ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)this).GetParentStub() as PopupGalleryToolUiaProviderStub;

				private GalleryToolSubItemType SubItemType => (GalleryToolSubItemType)((FragmentUIAProviderStub)this).Context;

				private UIElement UIElement => PopupGalleryToolStub.GetChildUIElement(UIElementType, null);

				internal Type UIElementType => SubItemType switch
				{
					GalleryToolSubItemType.DropDown => typeof(GalleryPreviewDropDownButtonUIElement), 
					GalleryToolSubItemType.ScrollDown => typeof(GalleryPreviewScrollDownButtonUIElement), 
					GalleryToolSubItemType.ScrollUp => typeof(GalleryPreviewScrollUpButtonUIElement), 
					_ => null, 
				};

				internal GalleryToolButtonUiaProviderStub(GalleryToolSubItemType itemType, FragmentUIAProviderStub parent)
					: base((object)itemType, parent)
				{
					switch (itemType)
					{
					}
				}

				protected override string CreateAutomationId()
				{
					return SubItemType switch
					{
						GalleryToolSubItemType.DropDown => "DropDown", 
						GalleryToolSubItemType.ScrollUp => "Scroll Up", 
						GalleryToolSubItemType.ScrollDown => "Scroll Down", 
						_ => ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)this).CreateAutomationId(), 
					};
				}

				public override Rectangle GetBoundingRectangle()
				{
					UIElement uIElement = UIElement;
					if (uIElement != null)
					{
						return uIElement.Control.RectangleToScreen(uIElement.Rect);
					}
					return Rectangle.Empty;
				}

				public override ControlType GetControlType()
				{
					return ControlType.Button;
				}

				protected override string GetDefaultName()
				{
					return SubItemType switch
					{
						GalleryToolSubItemType.DropDown => "Drop Down", 
						GalleryToolSubItemType.ScrollUp => "Row Up", 
						GalleryToolSubItemType.ScrollDown => "Row Down", 
						_ => ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)this).GetDefaultName(), 
					};
				}

				public override IRawElementProviderFragmentRoot GetFragmentRoot()
				{
					return ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)PopupGalleryToolStub).GetFragmentRoot();
				}

				protected override bool GetIsEnabled()
				{
					return SubItemType switch
					{
						GalleryToolSubItemType.ScrollDown => PopupGalleryToolStub.PopupGalleryTool.PreviewInfo.CanScrollDown, 
						GalleryToolSubItemType.ScrollUp => PopupGalleryToolStub.PopupGalleryTool.PreviewInfo.CanScrollUp, 
						_ => true, 
					};
				}

				protected override bool GetIsKeyboardFocusable()
				{
					return false;
				}

				protected override Control GetMarshallingControl()
				{
					return Utilities.GetMarshallingControl(((FragmentUIAProviderStub)this).GetParent());
				}

				void IInvokeProvider.Invoke()
				{
					PopupGalleryTool popupGalleryTool = PopupGalleryToolStub.PopupGalleryTool;
					switch (SubItemType)
					{
					case GalleryToolSubItemType.ScrollUp:
						if (popupGalleryTool.PreviewInfo.CanScrollUp)
						{
							popupGalleryTool.PreviewInfo.CurrentRow--;
						}
						break;
					case GalleryToolSubItemType.ScrollDown:
						if (popupGalleryTool.PreviewInfo.CanScrollDown)
						{
							popupGalleryTool.PreviewInfo.CurrentRow++;
						}
						break;
					case GalleryToolSubItemType.DropDown:
						popupGalleryTool.DropDown();
						break;
					}
				}
			}

			internal enum GalleryToolSubItemType
			{
				ScrollUp,
				ScrollDown,
				DropDown,
				Item
			}

			internal PopupGalleryToolUiaProviderStub(PopupGalleryTool tool)
				: base(tool)
			{
			}

			protected override List<FragmentUIAProviderStub> GetOrderedChildStubList()
			{
				if (PopupGalleryTool.IsPreviewVisible)
				{
					return new List<FragmentUIAProviderStub>(4)
					{
						(FragmentUIAProviderStub)(object)PreviewAreaStub,
						PreviewAreaScrollUpStub,
						PreviewAreaScrollDownStub,
						PreviewAreaDropDownStub
					};
				}
				return base.GetOrderedChildStubList();
			}

			internal override IRawElementProviderFragment GetProviderFromUIElement(UIElement elementUnderPoint)
			{
				if (PopupGalleryTool.IsPreviewVisible)
				{
					foreach (FragmentUIAProviderStub orderedChildStub in ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)this).GetOrderedChildStubList())
					{
						if (orderedChildStub is GalleryToolButtonUiaProviderStub galleryToolButtonUiaProviderStub && elementUnderPoint.GetAncestor(galleryToolButtonUiaProviderStub.UIElementType) != null)
						{
							return ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)galleryToolButtonUiaProviderStub).Provider;
						}
					}
					if (elementUnderPoint.GetAncestor(PreviewAreaStub.UIElementType) != null)
					{
						IRawElementProviderFragment providerFromUIElement = PreviewAreaStub.GetProviderFromUIElement(elementUnderPoint);
						if (providerFromUIElement == null)
						{
							return ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)PreviewAreaStub).Provider;
						}
						return providerFromUIElement;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			internal UIElement GetChildUIElement(Type uiElementType, object context)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = base.Tool.UIElement;
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					return uIElement.GetDescendant(uiElementType, context);
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public class PopupGalleryToolConverter : ExpandableObjectConverter
		{
			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(PopupGalleryTool).GetConstructor(new Type[1] { typeof(string) });
					PopupGalleryTool popupGalleryTool = (PopupGalleryTool)value;
					return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[1] { popupGalleryTool.Key }, isComplete: false);
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

			internal Size ItemSizeInDropDownResolved
			{
				get
				{
					if (ShouldSerializeItemSizeInDropDown())
					{
						return itemSizeInDropDown;
					}
					if (cachedItemSizeInDropDown.IsEmpty)
					{
						foreach (GalleryToolItemGroup allGroup in GetAllGroups())
						{
							foreach (GalleryToolItem item in (IEnumerable)allGroup.Items)
							{
								GetMaxCellSize(item, allGroup, owningTool.ShowItemTextInDropDown, ref cachedItemSizeInDropDown);
							}
						}
					}
					return cachedItemSizeInDropDown;
				}
			}

			internal Size ItemSizeInPreviewResolved
			{
				get
				{
					if (ShouldSerializeItemSizeInPreview())
					{
						return itemSizeInPreview;
					}
					if (cachedItemSizeInPreview.IsEmpty && showPreviewInRibbon)
					{
						foreach (GalleryToolItem item in (IEnumerable)Items)
						{
							GetMaxCellSize(item, null, owningTool.ShowItemTextInPreview, ref cachedItemSizeInPreview);
						}
					}
					return cachedItemSizeInPreview;
				}
			}

				}
				set
				{
					if (itemStyle != value)
					{
						owningTool.VerifyCanBeModified();
						if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(ItemStyle), value))
						{
							throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("value", (int)value, typeof(ItemStyle));
						}
						itemStyle = value;
						if (itemStyle == ItemStyle.Button)
						{
							SelectedItem = null;
						}
						owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ItemStyle);
					}
				}
			}

			internal int MaxDropDownColumns
			{
				get
				{
					return maxDropDownColumns;
				}
				set
				{
					if (value < 0)
					{
						throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", value, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("InvalidMaxDropDownColumns"));
					}
					if (maxDropDownColumns == value)
					{
						return;
					}
					owningTool.VerifyCanBeModified();
					if (value != 0)
					{
						if (minDropDownColumns > value)
						{
							MinDropDownColumns = value;
						}
						if (preferredDropDownColumns > value)
						{
							PreferredDropDownColumns = value;
						}
					}
					maxDropDownColumns = value;
					owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.MaxDropDownColumns);
				}
			}

			internal int MaxPreviewColumns
			{
				get
				{
					return maxPreviewColumns;
				}
				set
				{
					if (value < 1)
					{
						throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", value, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("InvalidMaxPreviewColumnsMustBePositive"));
					}
					if (value > 255)
					{
						throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", value, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("InvalidMaxPreviewColumnsMustBeUnder256"));
					}
					if (maxPreviewColumns != value)
					{
						owningTool.VerifyCanBeModified();
						if (minPreviewColumns > value)
						{
							MinPreviewColumns = value;
						}
						maxPreviewColumns = value;
						owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.MaxPreviewColumns);
					}
				}
			}

			internal int MinDropDownColumns
			{
				get
				{
					return minDropDownColumns;
				}
				set
				{
					if (value < 1)
					{
						throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", value, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("InvalidMinDropDownColumns"));
					}
					if (minDropDownColumns != value)
					{
						owningTool.VerifyCanBeModified();
						if (maxDropDownColumns != 0 && maxDropDownColumns < value)
						{
							MaxDropDownColumns = value;
						}
						if (preferredDropDownColumns < value)
						{
							PreferredDropDownColumns = value;
						}
						minDropDownColumns = value;
						owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.MinDropDownColumns);
					}
				}
			}

			internal int MinPreviewColumns

				get

				set

					if (value < 1)

					if (minPreviewColumns != value)

						if (maxPreviewColumns < value)

			internal AppearanceBase PreviewItemAreaAppearance
			{
				get
				{
					//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					//IL_0013: Expected O, but got Unknown
					if (previewItemAreaAppearanceHolder == null)
					{
						previewItemAreaAppearanceHolder = new AppearanceHolder();
						previewItemAreaAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					}
					ToolbarsManagerUtilities.SetAppearanceHolderCollection(previewItemAreaAppearanceHolder, owningTool.ToolbarsManager);
					return previewItemAreaAppearanceHolder.Appearance;
				}
				set
				{
					//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					//IL_0036: Expected O, but got Unknown
					if (previewItemAreaAppearanceHolder == null || !previewItemAreaAppearanceHolder.HasAppearance || value != previewItemAreaAppearanceHolder.Appearance)
					{
						if (previewItemAreaAppearanceHolder == null)
						{
							previewItemAreaAppearanceHolder = new AppearanceHolder();
							previewItemAreaAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
						}
						ToolbarsManagerUtilities.SetAppearanceHolderCollection(previewItemAreaAppearanceHolder, owningTool.ToolbarsManager);
						previewItemAreaAppearanceHolder.Appearance = value;
						if (!isInitializing)
						{
							NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.PreviewItemAreaAppearance);
						}
					}
				}
			}

			internal bool HasPreviewItemAreaAppearance
			{
				get
				{
					if (previewItemAreaAppearanceHolder != null)
					{
						return previewItemAreaAppearanceHolder.HasAppearance;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			internal GalleryToolItemGroupFilter SelectedGroupFilter
			{
				get
				{
					VerifyGroupsInSelectedFilter();
					return selectedGroupFilter;
				}
				set
				{
					if (selectedGroupFilter == value)
					{
						return;
					}
					if (value != null && !GroupFilters.Contains(value))
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NewSelectedGroupFilterNotInCollection"), "value");
					}
					if (value == null && GroupFilters.Count > 0)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("SelectedGroupFilterMustBeNonNull"), "value");
					}
					owningTool.VerifyCanBeModified();
					if (selectedGroupFilter != null)
					{
						selectedGroupFilter.SetIsSelectedInternal(value: false);
					}
					else
					{
						foreach (GalleryToolItemGroup item in (IEnumerable<GalleryToolItemGroup>)Groups)
						{
							item.SetIsFilteredInInternal(value: false);
						}
					}
					selectedGroupFilter = value;
					selectedGroupFilterKey = value?.Key;
					if (selectedGroupFilter != null)
					{
						selectedGroupFilter.SetIsSelectedInternal(value: true);
					}
					else
					{
						foreach (GalleryToolItemGroup item2 in (IEnumerable<GalleryToolItemGroup>)Groups)
						{
							item2.SetIsFilteredInInternal(value: true);
						}
					}
					owningTool.RefreshOpenDropDowns();
					owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.SelectedGroupFilter);
				}
			}

			public string SelectedGroupFilterKey
			{
				get
				{
					return selectedGroupFilterKey;
				}
				set
				{
					if (selectedGroupFilterKey != value)
					{
						owningTool.VerifyCanBeModified();
						if (owningTool.ToolbarsManager != null && owningTool.ToolbarsManager.Initialized)
						{
							SetSelectedFilterByKey(value, throwError: true);
						}
						else
						{
							selectedGroupFilterKey = value;
						}
					}
				}
			}

			internal GalleryToolItem SelectedItem
			{
				get
				{
					return selectedItem;
				}
				set
				{
					if (selectedItem != value)
					{
						if (value != null && !Items.Contains(value))
						{
							throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NewSelectedItemNotInCollection"), "value");
						}
						if (value != null && ItemStyle == ItemStyle.Button)
						{
							throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NoSelectedItemWhenItemStyleIsButton"));
						}
						owningTool.VerifyCanBeModified();
						if (selectedItem != null)
						{
							selectedItem.SetIsSelectedInternal(value: false);
						}
						selectedItem = value;
						selectedItemKey = value?.Key;
						if (selectedItem != null)
						{
							selectedItem.SetIsSelectedInternal(value: true);
						}
						owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.SelectedItem);
					}
				}
			}

			internal GalleryToolExtraSharedProps(PopupGalleryTool owningTool)
			{
				this.owningTool = owningTool;
			}

			protected override void OnDispose()
			{
				if (activationTimer != null)
				{
					activationTimer.Tick -= activationTimer_Tick;
					activationTimer.Dispose();
					activationTimer = null;
				}
				if (defaultGroup != null)
				{
					defaultGroup.Dispose();
					defaultGroup = null;
				}
				if (filterBarAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					filterBarAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					filterBarAppearanceHolder = null;
				}
				if (groupFilters != null)
				{
					groupFilters.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					groupFilters.Dispose();
					groupFilters = null;
				}
				if (groupItemAreaPadding != null)
				{
					((SubObjectBase)(object)groupItemAreaPadding).SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					((DisposableObject)(object)groupItemAreaPadding).Dispose();
					groupItemAreaPadding = null;
				}
				if (groups != null)
				{
					groups.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					groups.Dispose();
					groups = null;
				}
				if (groupSettings != null)
				{
					groupSettings.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					groupSettings.Dispose();
					groupSettings = null;
				}
				if (hotTrackFilterBarAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					hotTrackFilterBarAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					hotTrackFilterBarAppearanceHolder = null;
				}
				if (hotTrackPreviewItemAreaAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					hotTrackPreviewItemAreaAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					hotTrackPreviewItemAreaAppearanceHolder = null;
				}
				if (previewItemAreaAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					previewItemAreaAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					previewItemAreaAppearanceHolder = null;
				}
				if (defaultGroup != null)
				{
					defaultGroup.Dispose();
					defaultGroup = null;
				}
				if (itemPadding != null)
				{
					((SubObjectBase)(object)itemPadding).SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					((DisposableObject)(object)itemPadding).Dispose();
					itemPadding = null;
				}
				if (items != null)
				{
					items.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					items.Dispose();
					items = null;
				}
				if (itemSettings != null)
				{
					itemSettings.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					itemSettings.Dispose();
					itemSettings = null;
				}
				activeItem = null;
				groupWithActiveItem = null;
				lastActivatedItem = null;
				selectedGroupFilter = null;
				selectedItem = null;
				owningTool = null;
				galleryInstanceWithActiveItem = null;
				base.OnDispose();
			}

			protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
			{
				ResetCache();
				if (items == propChange.Source)
				{
					if (propChange.PropId.Equals(PropertyIds.Items) && defaultGroup != null)
					{
						defaultGroup.Items.Clear();
						foreach (GalleryToolItem item in (IEnumerable)Items)
						{
							defaultGroup.Items.Add(item.Key);
						}
					}
					owningTool.Tools.BumpVersion();
					owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Items, propChange);
				}
				else if (groups == propChange.Source)
				{
					if (propChange.PropId.Equals(PropertyIds.Groups) && defaultGroup != null)
					{
						defaultGroup.Dispose();
						defaultGroup = null;
					}
					owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Groups, propChange);
				}
				else if (groupFilters == propChange.Source)
				{
					if (SelectedGroupFilter == null && GroupFilters.Count > 0)
					{
						SelectedGroupFilter = GroupFilters[0];
					}
					if (!GroupFilters.Contains(SelectedGroupFilter))
					{
						if (GroupFilters.Count > 0)
						{
							SelectedGroupFilter = GroupFilters[0];
						}
						else
						{
							SelectedGroupFilter = null;
						}
					}
					owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.GroupFilters, propChange);
				}
				else if (itemSettings == propChange.Source)
				{
					owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ItemSettings, propChange);
				}
				else if (groupSettings == propChange.Source)
				{
					owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.GroupSettings, propChange);
				}
				else if (itemPadding == propChange.Source)
				{
					owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ItemPadding, propChange);
				}
				else if (groupItemAreaPadding == propChange.Source)
				{
					owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.GroupItemAreaPadding, propChange);
				}
				else if (HasFilterBarAppearance && filterBarAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChange.Source)
				{
					owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.FilterBarAppearance, propChange);
				}
				else if (HasHotTrackFilterBarAppearance && hotTrackFilterBarAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChange.Source)
				{
					owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.HotTrackFilterBarAppearance, propChange);
				}
				else if (HasPreviewItemAreaAppearance && previewItemAreaAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChange.Source)
				{
					owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.PreviewItemAreaAppearance, propChange);
				}
				else if (HasHotTrackPreviewItemAreaAppearance && hotTrackPreviewItemAreaAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChange.Source)
				{
					owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.HotTrackPreviewItemAreaAppearance, propChange);
				}
			}

			internal void DeactivateItemOnLeave(PopupGalleryTool galleryInstance, GalleryArea itemLocation)
			{
				if (initialItemActivationFired)
				{
					initialItemActivationFired = false;
					owningTool.ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.GalleryToolActiveItemChange, new GalleryToolItemEventArgs(galleryInstance, null, null, itemLocation));
				}
			}

			internal List<GalleryToolItemGroup> GetAllGroups()
			{
				List<GalleryToolItemGroup> list = new List<GalleryToolItemGroup>(Groups);
				if (list.Count == 0)
				{
					list.Add(DefaultGroup);
				}
				return list;
			}

			internal List<GalleryToolItemGroup> GetAllVisibleGroups()
			{
				if (SelectedGroupFilter != null)
				{
					return new List<GalleryToolItemGroup>(SelectedGroupFilter.Groups);
				}
				return GetAllGroups();
			}

			internal SubObjectPropChangeEventHandler GetSubObjectPropChangeHandler()
			{
				return base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}

			internal void HookupAllSubObjects()
			{
				if (items != null && items.Count > 0)
				{
					SetSelectedItemByKey(selectedItemKey, throwError: false);
				}
				if (groupFilters != null)
				{
					groupFilters.HookupAllSubObjects();
					if (groupFilters.Count > 0)
					{
						if (selectedGroupFilterKey == null)
						{
							SelectedGroupFilter = groupFilters[0];
						}
						else
						{
							SetSelectedFilterByKey(selectedGroupFilterKey, throwError: false);
						}
					}
				}
				if (groups != null)
				{
					groups.HookupAllSubObjects();
				}
			}

			internal void InitializeFrom(GalleryToolExtraSharedProps source)
			{
				//IL_004e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0058: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_0092: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_009c: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_0186: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0190: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_01a4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_01ae: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_01c2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_01cc: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_01e0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_01ea: Expected O, but got Unknown
				isInitializing = true;
				try
				{
					activationActionDelay = source.activationActionDelay;
					activationInitialActionDelay = source.activationInitialActionDelay;
					allowResizeDropDown = source.allowResizeDropDown;
					groupFilters = source.groupFilters.Clone(owningTool);
					groupItemAreaPadding = (Margins)source.groupItemAreaPadding.Clone();
					groups = source.groups.Clone(owningTool);
					groupSettings = source.groupSettings.Clone(owningTool);
					itemPadding = (Margins)source.itemPadding.Clone();
					items = source.items.Clone(owningTool);
					itemSettings = source.itemSettings.Clone(owningTool);
					itemSizeInDropDown = source.itemSizeInDropDown;
					itemSizeInPreview = source.itemSizeInPreview;
					itemStyle = source.itemStyle;
					maxDropDownColumns = source.maxDropDownColumns;
					maxPreviewColumns = source.maxPreviewColumns;
					minDropDownColumns = source.minDropDownColumns;
					minPreviewColumns = source.minPreviewColumns;
					preferredDropDownColumns = source.preferredDropDownColumns;
					selectedGroupFilterKey = source.selectedGroupFilterKey;
					selectedItemKey = source.selectedItemKey;
					showFilterBar = source.showFilterBar;
					showItemText = source.showItemText;
					showPreviewInRibbon = source.showPreviewInRibbon;
					useLargeImagesInItems = source.useLargeImagesInItems;
					if (source.HasFilterBarAppearance)
					{
						FilterBarAppearance = (AppearanceBase)source.FilterBarAppearance.Clone();
					}
					if (source.HasHotTrackFilterBarAppearance)
					{
						HotTrackFilterBarAppearance = (AppearanceBase)source.HotTrackFilterBarAppearance.Clone();
					}
					if (source.HasHotTrackPreviewItemAreaAppearance)
					{
						HotTrackPreviewItemAreaAppearance = (AppearanceBase)source.HotTrackPreviewItemAreaAppearance.Clone();
					}
					if (source.HasPreviewItemAreaAppearance)
					{
						PreviewItemAreaAppearance = (AppearanceBase)source.PreviewItemAreaAppearance.Clone();
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					isInitializing = false;
				}
			}

			internal void SetActiveItem(PopupGalleryTool galleryInstance, GalleryToolItem item, GalleryArea itemLocation)
			{
				if (activeItem == item && activeItemLocation == itemLocation)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (item != null && !Items.Contains(item))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("The new item is not in the Items collection.", "value");
				}
				owningTool.VerifyCanBeModified();
				if (activeItem != null)
				{
					UIElement uIElement = activeItem.GetUIElement(galleryInstanceWithActiveItem, groupWithActiveItem, activeItemLocation);
					if (uIElement != null && owningTool.AreItemTransitionsEnabled)
					{
						uIElement.InitiateTransition(UltraToolbarsManager.DefaultTransitionSettings, (UIElementTransitionType)0);
					}
					activeItem.SetIsActiveInternal(value: false);
				}
				activeItem = item;
				activeItemLocation = itemLocation;
				galleryInstanceWithActiveItem = galleryInstance;
				if (activeItem != null)
				{
					activeItem.SetIsActiveInternal(value: true);
					int activationDelay = ((itemLocation != GalleryArea.Preview || owningTool.ToolbarsManager == null || !owningTool.ToolbarsManager.EnforceOffice2007Resolution) ? (initialItemActivationFired ? ActivationActionDelay : ActivationInitialActionDelayResolved) : ((!initialItemActivationFired) ? 250 : 0));
					FireActiveItemChangeEvent(galleryInstance, activationDelay, itemLocation);
					owningTool.ToolbarsManagerInControl.NotifyAccessibilityFocusChange();
				}
			}

			internal void SetGroupWithActiveItem(PopupGalleryTool galleryInstance, GalleryToolItemGroup group, GalleryArea itemLocation)
			{
				if (groupWithActiveItem != group)
				{
					if (groupWithActiveItem != null)
					{
						groupWithActiveItem.SetActiveItem(null, galleryInstance, itemLocation);
					}
					groupWithActiveItem = group;
					if (groupWithActiveItem != null)
					{
						IsFilterBarActive = false;
					}
				}
			}

			internal void VerifyGroupsInSelectedFilter()
			{
				if (groups == null || groupsVersionForSelectedFilter == groups.Version)
				{
					return;
				}
				groupsVersionForSelectedFilter = groups.Version;
				if (selectedGroupFilter != null)
				{
					foreach (GalleryToolItemGroup item in (IEnumerable<GalleryToolItemGroup>)groups)
					{
						item.SetIsFilteredInInternal(value: false);
					}
					SelectedGroupFilter.SetIsSelectedInternal(value: true);
					return;
				}
				foreach (GalleryToolItemGroup item2 in (IEnumerable<GalleryToolItemGroup>)groups)
				{
					item2.SetIsFilteredInInternal(value: true);
				}
			}

			private void FireActiveItemChangeEvent(PopupGalleryTool galleryInstance, int activationDelay, GalleryArea itemLocation)
			{
				lastActivatedItem = activeItem;
				if (activationDelay == 0)
				{
					FireActiveItemChangeEvent();
					return;
				}
				if (activationTimer != null)
				{
					activationTimer.Stop();
				}
				ActivationTimer.Interval = activationDelay;
				ActivationTimer.Start();
			}

			private void FireActiveItemChangeEvent()
			{
				if (lastActivatedItem == activeItem)
				{
					initialItemActivationFired = true;
					GalleryToolItemGroup galleryToolItemGroup = groupWithActiveItem;
					if (galleryToolItemGroup == defaultGroup)
					{
						galleryToolItemGroup = null;
					}
					owningTool.ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.GalleryToolActiveItemChange, new GalleryToolItemEventArgs(galleryInstanceWithActiveItem, galleryToolItemGroup, activeItem, activeItemLocation));
				}
			}

			private static void GetMaxCellSize(GalleryToolItem item, GalleryToolItemGroup group, bool showText, ref Size maxSize)
			{
				Size size = item.CalculateCellSizeRequired(group, showText);
				maxSize.Height = Math.Max(maxSize.Height, size.Height);
				maxSize.Width = Math.Max(maxSize.Width, size.Width);
			}

			internal void ResetCache()
			{
				cachedItemSizeInDropDown = Size.Empty;
				cachedItemSizeInPreview = Size.Empty;
			}

			private void SetPreferredDropDownColumns(int value, bool enforceMaxMin)
			{
				if (preferredDropDownColumns == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				owningTool.VerifyCanBeModified();
				if (enforceMaxMin && (value < minDropDownColumns || (maxDropDownColumns != 0 && value > maxDropDownColumns)))
				{
					UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = owningTool.ToolbarsManager;
					if (toolbarsManager != null && toolbarsManager.Initialized)
					{
						throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", value, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("InvalidPreferredDropDownColumns"));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					preferredDropDownColumns = value;
					owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.PreferredDropDownColumns);
				}
			}

			private void SetSelectedFilterByKey(string key, bool throwError)
			{
				if (key == null)
				{
					SelectedGroupFilter = null;
					return;
				}
				foreach (GalleryToolItemGroupFilter item in (IEnumerable)GroupFilters)
				{
					if (item.Key == key)
					{
						SelectedGroupFilter = item;
						return;
					}
				}
				if (!throwError)
				{
					return;
				}
				throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("PopupGalleryTool_FilterKeyNotFound"), key), "value");
			}

			private void SetSelectedItemByKey(string key, bool throwError)
			{
				if (key == null)
				{
					SelectedItem = null;
					return;
				}
				foreach (GalleryToolItem item in (IEnumerable)Items)
				{
					if (item.Key == key)
					{
						SelectedItem = item;
						return;
					}
				}
				if (!throwError)
				{
					return;
				}
				throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("PopupGalleryTool_ItemKeyNotFound"), key), "value");
			}

		internal class DropDownFilterBarAccessibleObject : AccessibleObjectWrapper
		{
			private PopupGalleryTool galleryInstance;

			public override Rectangle Bounds
			{
				get
				{
					if (galleryInstance.FilterBarUIElement == null || galleryInstance.FilterBarUIElement.Control == null)
					{
						return Rectangle.Empty;
					}
					return galleryInstance.FilterBarUIElement.Control.RectangleToScreen(galleryInstance.FilterBarUIElement.Rect);
				}
			}

			protected override bool CanPerformDefaultAction
			{
				get
				{
					if (galleryInstance.IsOpen)
					{
						return galleryInstance.FilterBarUIElement != null;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			public override string DefaultAction
			{
				get
				{
					if (galleryInstance.FilterListDropedDown)
					{
						return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("GalleryFilterListClosedDefaultAction");
					}
					return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("GalleryFilterListOpenedDefaultAction");
				}
			}

			public override string Description
			{
				get
				{
					GalleryToolItemGroupFilter selectedGroupFilter = galleryInstance.SelectedGroupFilter;
					string accessibleDescription = selectedGroupFilter.AccessibleDescription;
					if (accessibleDescription != null && accessibleDescription.Length > 0)
					{
						return accessibleDescription;
					}
					return selectedGroupFilter.Text;
				}
			}

			public override string Name
			{
				get
				{
					string name = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name;
					if (name != null && name.Length > 0)
					{
						return name;
					}
					GalleryToolItemGroupFilter selectedGroupFilter = galleryInstance.SelectedGroupFilter;
					name = selectedGroupFilter.AccessibleName;
					if (name != null && name.Length > 0)
					{
						return name;
					}
					return selectedGroupFilter.Text;
				}
				set
				{
					((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name = value;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Parent => galleryInstance.GetAccessibleObject(GalleryArea.DropDown);

			public override AccessibleRole Role => AccessibleRole.MenuItem;

			public override AccessibleStates State
			{
				get
				{
					AccessibleStates accessibleStates = AccessibleStates.None;
					accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Focusable;
					accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.HasPopup;
					if (galleryInstance.FilterListDropedDown)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Pressed;
					}
					if (galleryInstance.IsFilterBarActive)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Focused;
					}
					return accessibleStates;
				}
			}

			public DropDownFilterBarAccessibleObject(PopupGalleryTool galleryInstance)
			{
				this.galleryInstance = galleryInstance;
			}

			public override void DoDefaultAction()
			{
				if (galleryInstance.IsOpen && galleryInstance.FilterBarUIElement != null)
				{
					galleryInstance.ShowFilterListPopup(galleryInstance.FilterBarUIElement.Control, galleryInstance.FilterBarUIElement.Rect, activateFirstItem: true);
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
			{
				return null;
			}

			public override int GetChildCount()
			{
				return 0;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetFocused()
			{
				if ((((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).State & AccessibleStates.Focused) != AccessibleStates.None)
				{
					return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).AccessibleObject;
				}
				return null;
			}

			protected override Control GetMarshallingControl()
			{
				return galleryInstance.ToolbarsManagerInControl?.DockWithinContainer;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetSelected()
			{
				return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).GetFocused();
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				if (!galleryInstance.IsOpen)
				{
					return null;
				}
				switch (navdir)
				{
				case AccessibleNavigation.Down:
				case AccessibleNavigation.Next:
				{
					object obj = galleryInstance.TryNavigate(new GalleryToolItem.ItemLocationInfo(null, galleryInstance, null, GalleryArea.DropDown), NavigationAction.Down, wrapAround: false);
					if (obj == null)
					{
						return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).AccessibleObject;
					}
					if (obj is GalleryToolItemGroupFilter)
					{
						return galleryInstance.FilterBarAccessibleObject;
					}
					if (obj is GalleryToolItem.ItemLocationInfo itemLocationInfo)
					{
						return itemLocationInfo.Item.AccessibleObjects.GetAccessibleObject(itemLocationInfo.GalleryInstance, itemLocationInfo.Group, itemLocationInfo.ItemLocation);
					}
					return null;
				}
				case AccessibleNavigation.Up:
				case AccessibleNavigation.Left:
				case AccessibleNavigation.Right:
				case AccessibleNavigation.Previous:
					return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).AccessibleObject;
				case AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild:
				case AccessibleNavigation.LastChild:
					return null;
				default:
					return null;
				}
			}

			public override void Select(AccessibleSelection flags)
			{
				if (galleryInstance.IsOpen)
				{
					if ((flags & (AccessibleSelection.TakeFocus | AccessibleSelection.TakeSelection | AccessibleSelection.ExtendSelection | AccessibleSelection.AddSelection)) != AccessibleSelection.None)
					{
						galleryInstance.MenuAgent.CloseOpenSubmenuTools(null, delay: false);
						galleryInstance.IsFilterBarActive = true;
					}
					else if ((flags & AccessibleSelection.RemoveSelection) != AccessibleSelection.None)
					{
						galleryInstance.ClearActiveItem(leftItemArea: false, GalleryArea.DropDown);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public class ItemReferenceConverter : TypeConverter
		{
			private class ItemComparer : IComparer<GalleryToolItem>
			{
				private ItemReferenceConverter converter;

				public ItemComparer(ItemReferenceConverter converter)
				{
					this.converter = converter;
				}

				public int Compare(GalleryToolItem item1, GalleryToolItem item2)
				{
					string strA = converter.ConvertToString(item1);
					string strB = converter.ConvertToString(item2);
					return string.Compare(strA, strB, ignoreCase: false, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
			}

			private static readonly string none = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("PopupGalleryTool_ItemReferenceConverter_None");

			public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
			{
				if (sourceType == typeof(string) && context != null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
			}

			public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
			{
				if (!(value is string))
				{
					return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
				}
				string text = ((string)value).Trim();
				if (text.Equals(none))
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (context != null && context.Instance is PopupGalleryTool popupGalleryTool)
				{
					PopupGalleryTool popupGalleryTool2 = (PopupGalleryTool)popupGalleryTool.SharedProps.RootTool;
					if (popupGalleryTool2 != null)
					{
						foreach (GalleryToolItem item in (IEnumerable)popupGalleryTool2.Items)
						{
							if (item.Key == text)
							{
								return item;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("destinationType");
				}
				if (destinationType != typeof(string))
				{
					return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
				}
				if (!(value is GalleryToolItem galleryToolItem))
				{
					return none;
				}
				return galleryToolItem.Key;
			}

			public override StandardValuesCollection GetStandardValues(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				List<GalleryToolItem> list = new List<GalleryToolItem>();
				if (context != null)
				{
					if (context.Instance is PopupGalleryTool popupGalleryTool)
					{
						foreach (GalleryToolItem item in (IEnumerable)popupGalleryTool.Items)
						{
							list.Add(item);
						}
					}
					list.Sort(new ItemComparer(this));
				}
				list.Insert(0, null);
				return new StandardValuesCollection(list);
			}

			public override bool GetStandardValuesExclusive(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				return true;
			}

			public override bool GetStandardValuesSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				return true;
			}
		}

		public class GroupFilterReferenceConverter : TypeConverter
		{
			private class GroupFilterComparer : IComparer<GalleryToolItemGroupFilter>
			{
				private GroupFilterReferenceConverter converter;

				public GroupFilterComparer(GroupFilterReferenceConverter converter)
				{
					this.converter = converter;
				}

				public int Compare(GalleryToolItemGroupFilter item1, GalleryToolItemGroupFilter item2)
				{
					string strA = converter.ConvertToString(item1);
					string strB = converter.ConvertToString(item2);
					return string.Compare(strA, strB, ignoreCase: false, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
			}

			public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
			{
				if (sourceType == typeof(string) && context != null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
			}

			public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
			{
				if (!(value is string))
				{
					return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
				}
				string text = ((string)value).Trim();
				if (context != null && context.Instance is PopupGalleryTool popupGalleryTool)
				{
					PopupGalleryTool popupGalleryTool2 = (PopupGalleryTool)popupGalleryTool.SharedProps.RootTool;
					if (popupGalleryTool2 != null)
					{
						foreach (GalleryToolItemGroupFilter item in (IEnumerable)popupGalleryTool2.GroupFilters)
						{
							if (item.Key == text)
							{
								return item;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("destinationType");
				}
				if (destinationType != typeof(string))
				{
					return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
				}
				if (!(value is GalleryToolItemGroupFilter galleryToolItemGroupFilter))
				{
					if (context.Instance is PopupGalleryTool popupGalleryTool && popupGalleryTool.GroupFilters.Count > 0)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException("The value cannot be null");
					}
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return galleryToolItemGroupFilter.Key;
			}

			public override StandardValuesCollection GetStandardValues(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				if (context != null)
				{
					List<GalleryToolItemGroupFilter> list = new List<GalleryToolItemGroupFilter>();
					if (context.Instance is PopupGalleryTool popupGalleryTool)
					{
						foreach (GalleryToolItemGroupFilter item in (IEnumerable)popupGalleryTool.GroupFilters)
						{
							list.Add(item);
						}
					}
					list.Sort(new GroupFilterComparer(this));
					return new StandardValuesCollection(list);
				}
				return base.GetStandardValues(context);
			}

			public override bool GetStandardValuesExclusive(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				return true;
			}

			public override bool GetStandardValuesSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal class GalleryPreviewAccessibleObject : ToolAccessibleObject
		{
			private PopupGalleryTool galleryInstance;

			public override AccessibleRole Role => AccessibleRole.List;

			public GalleryPreviewAccessibleObject(PopupGalleryTool galleryInstance)
				: base(galleryInstance)
			{
				this.galleryInstance = galleryInstance;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
			{
				if (index < 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (index < galleryInstance.PreviewInfo.Items.Count)
				{
					GalleryToolItem item = galleryInstance.PreviewInfo.Items[index];
					return GetAccessibleObjectForItem(item);
				}
				index -= galleryInstance.Items.Count;
				_ = 3;
				return null;
			}

			public override int GetChildCount()
			{
				int num = 0;
				foreach (GalleryToolItemGroup allVisibleGroup in galleryInstance.GetAllVisibleGroups())
				{
					num += allVisibleGroup.Items.Count;
				}
				return num + 3;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetFocused()
			{
				if (galleryInstance.ActiveItem != null)
				{
					return GetAccessibleObjectForItem(galleryInstance.ActiveItem);
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetSelected()
			{
				return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).GetFocused();
			}

			private AccessibleObject GetAccessibleObjectForItem(GalleryToolItem item)
			{
				return item?.AccessibleObjects.GetAccessibleObject(galleryInstance, null, GalleryArea.Preview);
			}
		}

		protected internal class GalleryPreviewToolSizeInfo : RibbonToolSizeInfo
		{
			private int previewColumns;

			public int PreviewColumns => previewColumns;

			internal GalleryPreviewToolSizeInfo(int previewColumns)
				: base(RibbonToolSize.Large)
			{
				if (previewColumns < 1)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
				}
				this.previewColumns = previewColumns;
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				if (obj == this)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (obj is GalleryPreviewToolSizeInfo galleryPreviewToolSizeInfo)
				{
					return galleryPreviewToolSizeInfo.previewColumns == previewColumns;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return previewColumns;
			}
		}

		protected internal override int AccessibleChildCount
		{
			get
			{
				int num = base.AccessibleChildCount;
				if (ShowFilterBarResolved || HasVisibleItems())
				{
					num++;
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		protected internal override string AccessibleValue
		{
			get
			{
				string result = base.AccessibleValue;
				if (ItemStyle == ItemStyle.StateButton && SelectedItem != null)
				{
					result = SelectedItem.AccessibleNameResolved;
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		protected internal override RibbonToolSize DefaultPreferredSizeOnRibbon
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.HasInstanceProps && base.InstanceProps.ShouldSerializeButtonGroup())
				{
					return RibbonToolSize.ImageOnly;
				}
				if (ShowPreviewInRibbon)
				{
					return RibbonToolSize.Large;
				}
				return base.DefaultPreferredSizeOnRibbon;
			}
		}

		internal override SplitMonitorAction DefaultSplitMonitorAction
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (IsPreviewVisible)
				{
					return (SplitMonitorAction)3;
				}
				return base.DefaultSplitMonitorAction;
			}
		}

		internal override UIRole MenuUIRole
		{
			get
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManagerInControl = base.ToolbarsManagerInControl;
				if (toolbarsManagerInControl == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return StyleUtils.GetRole(toolbarsManagerInControl, StyleUtils.Role.PopupGallery);
			}
		}

		protected internal override ToolSizeInfo PreferredRibbonToolSizeInfo
		{
			get
			{
				ToolSizeInfo toolSizeInfo = base.PreferredRibbonToolSizeInfo;
				if (RibbonToolSizeInfo.Large.Equals(toolSizeInfo) && ShowPreviewInRibbon)
				{
					toolSizeInfo = new GalleryPreviewToolSizeInfo(MinPreviewColumns);
				}
				return toolSizeInfo;
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManagerInControl = base.ToolbarsManagerInControl;
				if (toolbarsManagerInControl == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (ShowPreviewInRibbon && base.CurrentToolSizeInfo is GalleryPreviewToolSizeInfo)
				{
					return StyleUtils.GetRole(toolbarsManagerInControl, StyleUtils.Role.RibbonGroupItemGalleryPreview);
				}
				return StyleUtils.GetRole(toolbarsManagerInControl, StyleUtils.Role.RibbonGroupItemPopupGallery);
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_PopupGalleryTool_P_PreferredDropDownColumns")]
		public int PreferredDropDownColumns
		{
			get
			{

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public int PreferredDropDownColumnsResolved
		{
			get
			{
				int minDropDownColumnsResolved = MinDropDownColumnsResolved;
				if (SettingsOwner.ExtraSharedProps.ShouldSerializePreferredDropDownColumns())
				{
					return Math.Max(minDropDownColumnsResolved, PreferredDropDownColumns);
				}
				if (base.CurrentToolSizeInfo is GalleryPreviewToolSizeInfo)
				{
					UIElement uIElement = base.UIElement;
					if (uIElement != null)
					{
						((UIElement)uIElement.ControlElement).VerifyChildElements();
					}
					int val = Math.Min((MaxDropDownColumns == 0) ? int.MaxValue : MaxDropDownColumns, GetDropDownColumnsNeededToSpanWidth(CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstance().Width));
					return Math.Max(minDropDownColumnsResolved, val);
				}
				return minDropDownColumnsResolved;
			}
		}
