		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_PopupGalleryTool_P_SelectedGroupFilter")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(GroupFilterReferenceConverter))]
		public GalleryToolItemGroupFilter SelectedGroupFilter
		{
			get
			{
				return SettingsOwner.ExtraSharedProps.SelectedGroupFilter;
			}
			set
			{
				bool flag = value != null && value != SelectedGroupFilter;
				SettingsOwner.ExtraSharedProps.SelectedGroupFilter = value;
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
				if (flag)
				{
					toolbarsManager?.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.GalleryToolFilterChange, new GalleryToolFilterChangeEventArgs(this, value));
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		public string SelectedGroupFilterKey
		{
			get
			{
				return SettingsOwner.ExtraSharedProps.SelectedGroupFilterKey;
			}
			set
			{
				GalleryToolItemGroupFilter selectedGroupFilter = SelectedGroupFilter;
				bool flag = selectedGroupFilter == null || (value != null && value != selectedGroupFilter.Key);
				SettingsOwner.ExtraSharedProps.SelectedGroupFilterKey = value;
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
				selectedGroupFilter = SelectedGroupFilter;
				if (flag && toolbarsManager != null && selectedGroupFilter != null && selectedGroupFilter.Key == value)
				{
					toolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.GalleryToolFilterChange, new GalleryToolFilterChangeEventArgs(this, selectedGroupFilter));
				}
			}
		}

		internal int ButtonAreaWidth
		{
			get
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager != null && toolbarsManager.TouchMetricsEnabledResolved)
				{
					return toolbarsManager.AdjustWidthForTouchMode(16, (TouchElementSizes)1);
				}
				return 16;
			}
		}

		internal AccessibleObject FilterBarAccessibleObject
		{
			get

		internal override bool CalculateDropDownInfo(out Control dropDownOwner, out Point dropDownPoint, out Rectangle rectInScreenCoordinates, out DropDownPosition dropDownPosition, out bool rightAligned)
		{
			if (IsPreviewVisible && previewUIElement != null)
			{
				Rectangle rectangle = ((UIElement)previewUIElement).Control.RectangleToScreen(((UIElement)previewUIElement).Rect);
				Rectangle rectangle2 = rectangle;
				rectangle2.Height = 0;
				dropDownOwner = ((UIElement)previewUIElement).Control;
				dropDownPoint = rectangle.Location;
				rectInScreenCoordinates = rectangle2;
				dropDownPosition = (DropDownPosition)0;
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager != null)
				{
					rightAligned = toolbarsManager.RightAlignedMenusResolved;
				}
				else
				{
					rightAligned = SystemInformation.RightAlignedMenus;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return base.CalculateDropDownInfo(out dropDownOwner, out dropDownPoint, out rectInScreenCoordinates, out dropDownPosition, out rightAligned);
		}

		protected internal override Size CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstance()
		{
			//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Size result = base.CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstance();
			if (ShowPreviewInRibbon && base.OwnerIsRibbonGroup && base.CurrentToolSizeInfo is GalleryPreviewToolSizeInfo galleryPreviewToolSizeInfo)
			{
				PreviewInfo.AvailableHeight = result.Height - 2;
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
				int totalBorderWidth = GalleryPreviewUIElement.GetTotalBorderWidth((ToolbarStyle)((toolbarsManager == null) ? 5 : ((int)toolbarsManager.StyleResolved)));
				return new Size(totalBorderWidth + ButtonAreaWidth + (ItemSizeInPreviewResolved.Width + ItemPadding.Width) * galleryPreviewToolSizeInfo.PreviewColumns, result.Height);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected internal override AccessibleObject GetAccessibleChild(int index)

			{

				index--;
			}
			return base.GetAccessibleChild(index);
		}

		internal override void GetKeyTipLocationInfo(out Point location, out System.Drawing.ContentAlignment alignment)
		{
			location = Point.Empty;
			alignment = System.Drawing.ContentAlignment.TopLeft;
			base.GetKeyTipLocationInfo(out location, out alignment);
			if (!IsPreviewVisible)
			{
				return;
			}
			UIElement val = PreviewUIElement;
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UIElement descendant = val.GetDescendant(typeof(GalleryPreviewDropDownButtonUIElement));
			if (descendant != null)
			{
				val = descendant;
			}
			Rectangle rectangle = val.Control.RectangleToScreen(val.Rect);
			RibbonGroup owningRibbonGroup = base.OwningRibbonGroup;
			if (owningRibbonGroup != null)
			{
				int y = rectangle.Y;
				RibbonGroupLayoutItem currentToolLayout = owningRibbonGroup.GetCurrentToolLayout(onlyIfOpen: false);
				if (currentToolLayout != null)
				{
					y = owningRibbonGroup.GetKeyTipCenterLine(currentToolLayout.GetKeyTipToolRowNumber(this));
				}
				int x = (rectangle.Left + rectangle.Right) / 2;
				location = new Point(x, y);
			}
		}

		protected internal override ToolSizeInfo GetLargerToolSizeInfo(ToolSizeInfo toolSizeInfo)
		{
			if (ShowPreviewInRibbon)
			{
				if (!(toolSizeInfo is GalleryPreviewToolSizeInfo galleryPreviewToolSizeInfo))
				{
					if (RibbonToolSizeInfo.Large.Equals(toolSizeInfo))
					{
						return new GalleryPreviewToolSizeInfo(MinPreviewColumns);
					}
					return new GalleryPreviewToolSizeInfo(MaxPreviewColumns);
				}
				if (ItemSizeInPreviewResolved.Width <= 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (galleryPreviewToolSizeInfo.PreviewColumns >= MaxPreviewColumns || galleryPreviewToolSizeInfo.PreviewColumns >= PreviewInfo.GetMaxColumnsInPreview())
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (galleryPreviewToolSizeInfo.PreviewColumns < MinPreviewColumns)
				{
					return new GalleryPreviewToolSizeInfo(MinPreviewColumns);
				}
				return new GalleryPreviewToolSizeInfo(galleryPreviewToolSizeInfo.PreviewColumns + 1);
			}
			return base.GetLargerToolSizeInfo(toolSizeInfo);
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		protected override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
			if (ShouldSerializeActivationActionDelay())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ActivationActionDelay", ExtraSharedProps.activationActionDelay);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeActivationInitialActionDelay())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ActivationInitialActionDelay", ExtraSharedProps.activationInitialActionDelay);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeAllowResizeDropDown())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "AllowResizeDropDown", ExtraSharedProps.allowResizeDropDown);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeFilterBarAppearance())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "FilterBarAppearance", ExtraSharedProps.filterBarAppearanceHolder);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeGroupFiltersInternal())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "GroupFilters", ExtraSharedProps.groupFilters);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeGroupItemAreaPadding())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "GroupItemAreaPadding", ExtraSharedProps.groupItemAreaPadding);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeGroupsInternal())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Groups", ExtraSharedProps.groups);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeGroupSettings())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "GroupSettings", ExtraSharedProps.groupSettings);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeHotTrackFilterBarAppearance())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "HotTrackFilterBarAppearance", ExtraSharedProps.hotTrackFilterBarAppearanceHolder);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeHotTrackPreviewItemAreaAppearance())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "HotTrackPreviewItemAreaAppearance", ExtraSharedProps.hotTrackPreviewItemAreaAppearanceHolder);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeItemPadding())
			{

			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ItemSizeInDropDown", ExtraSharedProps.itemSizeInDropDown);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeItemSizeInPreview())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ItemSizeInPreview", ExtraSharedProps.itemSizeInPreview);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeItemStyle())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ItemStyle", ExtraSharedProps.itemStyle);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeMaxDropDownColumns())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MaxDropDownColumns", ExtraSharedProps.maxDropDownColumns);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeMaxPreviewColumns())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MaxPreviewColumns", ExtraSharedProps.maxPreviewColumns);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeMinDropDownColumns())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MinDropDownColumns", ExtraSharedProps.minDropDownColumns);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeMinPreviewColumns())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MinPreviewColumns", ExtraSharedProps.minPreviewColumns);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializePreferredDropDownColumns())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "PreferredDropDownColumns", ExtraSharedProps.preferredDropDownColumns);

			if (ShouldSerializePreviewItemAreaAppearance())

		protected internal override Type GetRibbonToolUIElementType()
		{
			if (ShowPreviewInRibbon && base.CurrentToolSizeInfo is GalleryPreviewToolSizeInfo)
			{
				return typeof(GalleryPreviewUIElement);
			}
			return base.GetRibbonToolUIElementType();
		}

		protected internal override UIElement GetRibbonToolUIElement(ToolBase tool, UIElement parentElement, UIElement previousElement, bool drawAsActive, bool drawAsPressed)
		{
			if (ShowPreviewInRibbon && base.CurrentToolSizeInfo is GalleryPreviewToolSizeInfo)
			{
				return GetPreviewUIElement(tool, parentElement, previousElement, drawAsActive, drawAsPressed);
			}
			return base.GetRibbonToolUIElement(tool, parentElement, previousElement, drawAsActive, drawAsPressed);
		}

		protected internal override ToolSizeInfo GetSmallerToolSizeInfo(ToolSizeInfo toolSizeInfo)
		{
			if (ShowPreviewInRibbon && toolSizeInfo is GalleryPreviewToolSizeInfo)
			{
				if (!(toolSizeInfo is GalleryPreviewToolSizeInfo galleryPreviewToolSizeInfo))
				{
					return RibbonToolSizeInfo.Large;
				}
				if (galleryPreviewToolSizeInfo.PreviewColumns <= MinPreviewColumns)
				{
					return RibbonToolSizeInfo.Large;
				}
				return new GalleryPreviewToolSizeInfo(galleryPreviewToolSizeInfo.PreviewColumns - 1);
			}
			return base.GetSmallerToolSizeInfo(toolSizeInfo);
		}

		protected internal override void Initialize(ToolsCollectionBase parentCollection)
		{
			base.Initialize(parentCollection);
			if (serializedProps == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			GalleryToolExtraSharedProps extraSharedProps = ExtraSharedProps;
			extraSharedProps.activationActionDelay = serializedProps.activationActionDelay;
			extraSharedProps.activationInitialActionDelay = serializedProps.activationInitialActionDelay;
			extraSharedProps.allowResizeDropDown = serializedProps.allowResizeDropDown;
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			if (serializedProps.filterBarAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				if (extraSharedProps.filterBarAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					extraSharedProps.filterBarAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= extraSharedProps.GetSubObjectPropChangeHandler();
				}
				extraSharedProps.filterBarAppearanceHolder = serializedProps.filterBarAppearanceHolder;
				extraSharedProps.filterBarAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += extraSharedProps.GetSubObjectPropChangeHandler();
				if (toolbarsManager != null)
				{
					extraSharedProps.filterBarAppearanceHolder.Collection = toolbarsManager.Appearances;
				}
			}
			if (serializedProps.groupFilters != null)
			{
				if (extraSharedProps.groupFilters != null)
				{
					extraSharedProps.groupFilters.SubObjectPropChanged -= extraSharedProps.GetSubObjectPropChangeHandler();
				}
				extraSharedProps.groupFilters = serializedProps.groupFilters;
				extraSharedProps.groupFilters.Initialize(this);
				extraSharedProps.groupFilters.SubObjectPropChanged += extraSharedProps.GetSubObjectPropChangeHandler();
			}
			if (serializedProps.groupItemAreaPadding != null)
			{
				if (extraSharedProps.groupItemAreaPadding != null)
				{
					((SubObjectBase)(object)extraSharedProps.groupItemAreaPadding).SubObjectPropChanged -= extraSharedProps.GetSubObjectPropChangeHandler();
				}
				extraSharedProps.groupItemAreaPadding = serializedProps.groupItemAreaPadding;
				((SubObjectBase)(object)extraSharedProps.groupItemAreaPadding).SubObjectPropChanged += extraSharedProps.GetSubObjectPropChangeHandler();
			}
			if (serializedProps.groups != null)
			{
				if (extraSharedProps.groups != null)
				{
					ExtraSharedProps.groups.SubObjectPropChanged -= extraSharedProps.GetSubObjectPropChangeHandler();
				}
				extraSharedProps.groups = serializedProps.groups;
				extraSharedProps.groups.Initialize(this);
				extraSharedProps.groups.SubObjectPropChanged += extraSharedProps.GetSubObjectPropChangeHandler();
			}
			if (serializedProps.hotTrackFilterBarAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				if (extraSharedProps.hotTrackFilterBarAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					extraSharedProps.hotTrackFilterBarAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= extraSharedProps.GetSubObjectPropChangeHandler();
				}
				extraSharedProps.hotTrackFilterBarAppearanceHolder = serializedProps.hotTrackFilterBarAppearanceHolder;
				extraSharedProps.hotTrackFilterBarAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += extraSharedProps.GetSubObjectPropChangeHandler();
				if (toolbarsManager != null)
				{
					extraSharedProps.hotTrackFilterBarAppearanceHolder.Collection = toolbarsManager.Appearances;
				}
			}
			if (serializedProps.hotTrackPreviewItemAreaAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				if (extraSharedProps.hotTrackPreviewItemAreaAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					extraSharedProps.hotTrackPreviewItemAreaAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= extraSharedProps.GetSubObjectPropChangeHandler();
				}
				extraSharedProps.hotTrackPreviewItemAreaAppearanceHolder = serializedProps.hotTrackPreviewItemAreaAppearanceHolder;
				extraSharedProps.hotTrackPreviewItemAreaAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += extraSharedProps.GetSubObjectPropChangeHandler();
				if (toolbarsManager != null)
				{
					extraSharedProps.hotTrackPreviewItemAreaAppearanceHolder.Collection = toolbarsManager.Appearances;
				}
			}
			if (serializedProps.itemPadding != null)
			{
				if (extraSharedProps.itemPadding != null)
				{
					((SubObjectBase)(object)extraSharedProps.itemPadding).SubObjectPropChanged -= extraSharedProps.GetSubObjectPropChangeHandler();
				}
				extraSharedProps.itemPadding = serializedProps.itemPadding;
				((SubObjectBase)(object)extraSharedProps.itemPadding).SubObjectPropChanged += extraSharedProps.GetSubObjectPropChangeHandler();
			}
			if (serializedProps.items != null)
			{
				if (extraSharedProps.items != null)
				{
					extraSharedProps.items.SubObjectPropChanged -= extraSharedProps.GetSubObjectPropChangeHandler();
				}
				extraSharedProps.items = serializedProps.items;
				extraSharedProps.items.Initialize(this);
				extraSharedProps.items.SubObjectPropChanged += extraSharedProps.GetSubObjectPropChangeHandler();
			}
			if (serializedProps.itemSettings != null)
			{
				if (extraSharedProps.itemSettings != null)
				{
					extraSharedProps.itemSettings.SubObjectPropChanged -= extraSharedProps.GetSubObjectPropChangeHandler();
				}
				extraSharedProps.itemSettings = serializedProps.itemSettings;
				extraSharedProps.itemSettings.SubObjectPropChanged += extraSharedProps.GetSubObjectPropChangeHandler();
			}
			extraSharedProps.itemStyle = serializedProps.itemStyle;
			extraSharedProps.maxDropDownColumns = serializedProps.maxDropDownColumns;
			extraSharedProps.maxPreviewColumns = serializedProps.maxPreviewColumns;
			extraSharedProps.minDropDownColumns = serializedProps.minDropDownColumns;
			extraSharedProps.minPreviewColumns = serializedProps.minPreviewColumns;
			extraSharedProps.preferredDropDownColumns = serializedProps.preferredDropDownColumns;
			if (serializedProps.previewItemAreaAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				if (extraSharedProps.previewItemAreaAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					extraSharedProps.previewItemAreaAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= extraSharedProps.GetSubObjectPropChangeHandler();
				}
				extraSharedProps.previewItemAreaAppearanceHolder = serializedProps.previewItemAreaAppearanceHolder;
				extraSharedProps.previewItemAreaAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += extraSharedProps.GetSubObjectPropChangeHandler();
				if (toolbarsManager != null)
				{
					extraSharedProps.previewItemAreaAppearanceHolder.Collection = toolbarsManager.Appearances;
				}
			}
			extraSharedProps.selectedGroupFilterKey = serializedProps.selectedGroupFilterKey;
			extraSharedProps.selectedItemKey = serializedProps.selectedItemKey;
			extraSharedProps.showFilterBar = serializedProps.showFilterBar;
			extraSharedProps.showItemText = serializedProps.showItemText;
			extraSharedProps.showPreviewInRibbon = serializedProps.showPreviewInRibbon;
			extraSharedProps.useLargeImagesInItems = serializedProps.useLargeImagesInItems;
			extraSharedProps.itemSizeInDropDown = serializedProps.itemSizeInDropDown;
			extraSharedProps.itemSizeInPreview = serializedProps.itemSizeInPreview;
			serializedProps = null;
		}

		protected internal override void InitializeFrom(ToolBase sourceTool, bool cloneNewInstance)
		{
			base.InitializeFrom(sourceTool, cloneNewInstance);
			if (sourceTool is PopupGalleryTool popupGalleryTool && !cloneNewInstance)
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.InitializeFrom(popupGalleryTool.ExtraSharedProps);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnAddedToCollection(KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase collection)
		{
			base.OnAddedToCollection(collection);
			if (base.IsRootTool && base.PrimaryCollection == collection && base.ToolbarsManager.Initialized)
			{
				HookupAllSubObjects();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (previewInfo != null)
			{
				previewInfo.Dispose();
				previewInfo = null;
			}
			if (filterListMenuAgent != null)
			{
				filterListMenuAgent.Dispose();
				filterListMenuAgent = null;
			}
			filterBarUIElement = null;
			dropDownItemAreaUIElement = null;
			previewUIElement = null;
			itemAreaMenuItem = null;
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (!propChange.PropId.Equals(PropertyIds.SelectedItem))
			{
				DirtyMetrics();
			}
			if (propChange.PropId.Equals(PropertyIds.SelectedGroupFilter))
			{
				foreach (PopupGalleryTool toolInstance in base.SharedProps.ToolInstances)
				{
					if (toolInstance.itemAreaMenuItem != null)
					{
						toolInstance.itemAreaMenuItem.SetSizeInternal(Size.Empty);
					}
				}
			}
			base.OnObjectPropChanged(propChange);
		}

		protected override void OnRemovedFromCollection(KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase collection)
		{
			if (base.IsRootTool && base.PrimaryCollection == collection)
			{
				if (ShouldSerializeItems())
				{
					Items.InternalClear(isDisposing: true);
				}
				if (ShouldSerializeGroups())
				{
					Groups.InternalClear(isDisposing: true);
				}
				if (ShouldSerializeGroupFilters())
				{
					GroupFilters.InternalClear(isDisposing: true);
				}
			}
			base.OnRemovedFromCollection(collection);
		}

		internal override void OnToolbarsManagerInitialized()
		{
			HookupAllSubObjects();
			base.OnToolbarsManagerInitialized();
		}

		internal override void PopulateMenuItems(MenuAgentBase menuAgent, MenuItemBase[] oldMenuItems)
		{
			if (ShowFilterBarResolved || HasVisibleItems())
			{
				menuAgent.MenuItems.Add(ItemAreaMenuItem);
			}
			base.PopulateMenuItems(menuAgent, oldMenuItems);
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			base.Reset();
			ResetActivationActionDelay();
			ResetActivationInitialActionDelay();
			ResetAllowResizeDropDown();
			ResetExtraSharedPropsCache();
			ResetFilterBarAppearance();
			ResetGroupFilters();
			ResetGroupItemAreaPadding();
			ResetGroups();
			ResetGroupSettings();
			ResetHotTrackFilterBarAppearance();
			ResetHotTrackPreviewItemAreaAppearance();
			ResetItemPadding();
			ResetItems();
			ResetItemSettings();
			ResetItemSizeInDropDown();
			ResetItemSizeInPreview();
			ResetItemStyle();
			ResetMaxDropDownColumns();
			ResetMaxPreviewColumns();
			ResetMinDropDownColumns();
			ResetMinPreviewColumns();
			ResetPreferredDropDownColumns();
			ResetPreviewItemAreaAppearance();
			ResetSelectedGroupFilter();
			ResetSelectedGroupFilterKey();
			ResetSelectedItem();
			ResetSelectedItemKey();
			ResetShowFilterBar();
			ResetShowItemText();
			ResetShowPreviewInRibbon();
			ResetUseLargeImagesInItems();
		}

		protected internal override PopupStyle ResolvePopupStyle(PopupStyle popupStyle)
		{
			if (popupStyle == PopupStyle.Toolbar)
			{
				return PopupStyle.Menu;
			}
			return popupStyle;
		}

		internal bool ShowScrollBarInDropDown()
		{
			if (ItemAreaMenuItem != null && ItemAreaMenuItem.UIElement != null)
			{
				return ShowScrollBarInDropDown(ItemAreaMenuItem.UIElement.Rect.Size);
			}
			if (AllowResizeDropDown)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ShowScrollBarInDropDown(Size itemAreaSize)
		{
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0063: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (AllowResizeDropDown)
			{
				return true;
			}
			Size size = itemAreaSize;
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			UIElementBorderWidths val = toolbarsManager.CalculateBorderWidths((UIElementBorderStyle)1, Border3DSide.All);
			size.Height -= ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Top + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Bottom;
			size.Width -= ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Left + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Right;
			UIElementBorderWidths val2 = toolbarsManager.CalculateBorderWidths((UIElementBorderStyle)14, Border3DSide.Bottom);
			size.Height -= ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val2)).Top + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val2)).Bottom;
			size.Width -= ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val2)).Left + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val2)).Right;
			if (ShowFilterBarResolved)
			{
				size.Height -= FilterBarHeight;
			}
			foreach (GalleryToolItemGroup allVisibleGroup in GetAllVisibleGroups())
			{
				size.Height -= allVisibleGroup.GetRequiredHeight(size.Width, cacheWidth: false);
				if (size.Height < 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual AccessibleObject CreateFilterBarAccessibleObject()

			return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new DropDownFilterBarAccessibleObject(this)).AccessibleObject;
		}

		internal bool CanActivateItem(GalleryToolItem item, GalleryToolItemGroup group, GalleryArea itemLocation)
		{
			if (CanHotTrackItems && !item.IsActive(this, group, itemLocation) && !FilterListDropedDown)
			{
				return !base.ToolbarsManager.Customizing;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void ClearActiveItem(bool leftItemArea, GalleryArea itemLocation)
		{
			IsFilterBarActive = false;
			SetActiveItemInternal(null, itemLocation);
			SetGroupWithActiveItem(null, itemLocation);
			if (leftItemArea)
			{
				if (delayItemDeactivation)
				{
					itemDeactivationPending = true;
				}
				else
				{
					SettingsOwner.ExtraSharedProps.DeactivateItemOnLeave(this, itemLocation);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ClickItem(GalleryToolItem item, GalleryToolItemGroup group, GalleryArea itemLocation)
		{
			if (!Items.Contains(item))
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (group != null)
			{
				if (!group.Items.Contains(item))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (group == SettingsOwner.ExtraSharedProps.defaultGroup)
				{
					group = null;
				}
			}
			itemDeactivationPending = false;
			delayItemDeactivation = true;
			if (base.IsOpen)
			{
				toolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(null, setOn: false, clearToolBeingEdited: true);
			}
			toolbarsManager.PopupManager.CloseAllPopups(onlyCloseLeafContiguousPopupChain: true);
			delayItemDeactivation = false;
			DirtyPreviewContents();
			DirtyDropDownContents();
			if (ItemStyle == ItemStyle.StateButton)
			{
				SelectedItem = item;
			}
			toolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.GalleryToolItemClick, new GalleryToolItemEventArgs(this, group, item, itemLocation));
			if (itemDeactivationPending)
			{
				itemDeactivationPending = false;
				SettingsOwner.ExtraSharedProps.DeactivateItemOnLeave(this, itemLocation);
			}
		}

		internal AccessibleObject GetAccessibleObject(GalleryArea area)
		{
			switch (area)
			{
			case GalleryArea.DropDown:
				if (ItemAreaMenuItem == null || !base.IsOpen)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ItemAreaMenuItem.AccessibilityObject;
			case GalleryArea.Preview:
				return base.AccessibilityObject;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal GalleryToolItemGroup GetFirstVisibleGroup(bool mustHaveItems)
		{
			GalleryToolItemGroupFilter selectedGroupFilter = SelectedGroupFilter;
			if (selectedGroupFilter == null)
			{
				return Groups.FindFirstGroup(mustBeFilteredIn: true, mustHaveItems);
			}
			return selectedGroupFilter.Groups.FindFirstGroup(mustHaveItems);
		}

		internal GalleryToolItemGroup GetLastVisibleGroup(bool mustHaveItems)
		{
			GalleryToolItemGroupFilter selectedGroupFilter = SelectedGroupFilter;
			if (selectedGroupFilter == null)
			{
				return Groups.FindLastGroup(mustBeFilteredIn: true, mustHaveItems);
			}
			return selectedGroupFilter.Groups.FindLastGroup(mustHaveItems);
		}

		internal GalleryToolItemGroup GetVisibleGroup(int startIndex, int increment, bool mustHaveItems)
		{
			GalleryToolItemGroupFilter selectedGroupFilter = SelectedGroupFilter;
			if (selectedGroupFilter == null)
			{
				return Groups.FindGroup(startIndex, increment, mustBeFilteredIn: true, mustHaveItems);
			}
			return selectedGroupFilter.Groups.FindGroup(startIndex, increment, mustHaveItems);
		}

		internal bool HasVisibleItems()
		{
			foreach (GalleryToolItemGroup allVisibleGroup in GetAllVisibleGroups())
			{
				if (allVisibleGroup.Items.Count > 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void ShowFilterListPopup(Control owningControl, Rectangle filterBarRect, bool activateFirstItem)
		{
			FilterListMenuAgent.MenuItems.Clear();
			MenuItemBase menuItemBase = null;
			foreach (GalleryToolItemGroupFilter item in (IEnumerable)GroupFilters)
			{
				GalleryToolFilterMenuItem galleryToolFilterMenuItem = new GalleryToolFilterMenuItem(item);
				if (item == SelectedGroupFilter)
				{
					menuItemBase = galleryToolFilterMenuItem;
				}
				FilterListMenuAgent.MenuItems.Add(galleryToolFilterMenuItem);
			}
			if (menuItemBase == null)
			{
				menuItemBase = FilterListMenuAgent.MenuItems.GetFirstMenuItem(selectableItemsOnly: true, recentlyUsedItemsOnly: true);
			}
			Point p = new Point(filterBarRect.X, filterBarRect.Bottom);
			p = owningControl.PointToScreen(p);
			p.Offset(7, 0);
			Rectangle exclusionRect = filterBarRect;
			exclusionRect.Offset(owningControl.PointToScreen(Point.Empty));
			FilterListDropedDown = true;
			FilterListMenuAgent.DropDown(owningControl, p, exclusionRect, (DropDownPosition)0, delay: false, closeIfAlreadyOpen: true, base.ToolbarsManager.RightAlignedMenusResolved, autocloseDropdown: true);
			if (activateFirstItem)
			{
				FilterListMenuAgent.ActivateMenuItem(menuItemBase);
			}
		}

		internal object TryNavigate(GalleryToolItem.ItemLocationInfo startLocation, NavigationAction navigationAction, bool wrapAround)
		{
			return startLocation.ItemLocation switch
			{
				GalleryArea.DropDown => TryNavigateInDropDown(startLocation, navigationAction, wrapAround), 
				GalleryArea.Preview => TryNavigateInPreview(startLocation, navigationAction, wrapAround), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		internal object TryNavigateInDropDown(GalleryToolItem.ItemLocationInfo startLocation, NavigationAction navigationAction, bool wrapAround)
		{
			if (ItemAreaMenuItem == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int startIndex;
			int num;
			switch (navigationAction)
			{
			default:
				startIndex = 0;
				num = 1;
				break;
			case NavigationAction.Up:
			case NavigationAction.Left:
			case NavigationAction.End:
			{
				GalleryToolItemGroupFilter selectedGroupFilter = SelectedGroupFilter;
				startIndex = ((selectedGroupFilter != null) ? (selectedGroupFilter.Groups.Count - 1) : ((Groups.Count != 0) ? (Groups.Count - 1) : 0));
				num = -1;
				break;
			}
			case NavigationAction.PageUp:
			{
				GalleryToolItemGroup galleryToolItemGroup2 = startLocation.Group;
				if (galleryToolItemGroup2 == null)
				{
					return ItemAreaMenuItem.GetPageUpItem(null, -1);
				}
				return ItemAreaMenuItem.GetPageUpItem(galleryToolItemGroup2, galleryToolItemGroup2.GetVirtualLocation(startLocation.Item).Y);
			}
			case NavigationAction.PageDown:
			{
				GalleryToolItemGroup galleryToolItemGroup = startLocation.Group;
				if (galleryToolItemGroup == null)
				{
					return ItemAreaMenuItem.GetPageDownItem(null, -1);
				}
				return ItemAreaMenuItem.GetPageDownItem(galleryToolItemGroup, galleryToolItemGroup.GetVirtualLocation(startLocation.Item).Y);
			}
			}
			if (navigationAction == NavigationAction.Up && IsFilterBarActive)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (navigationAction == NavigationAction.Home || navigationAction == NavigationAction.End)
			{
				GalleryToolItemGroup visibleGroup = GetVisibleGroup(startIndex, num, mustHaveItems: true);
				if (visibleGroup != null)
				{
					GalleryToolItem.ItemLocationInfo itemLocationInfo = visibleGroup.NavigateFromItem(new GalleryToolItem.ItemLocationInfo(null, this, null, GalleryArea.DropDown), navigationAction, -1, wrapAround);
					if (itemLocationInfo != null)
					{
						return itemLocationInfo;
					}
					return null;
				}
				return null;
			}
			int startingColumn = -1;
			GalleryToolItemGroup galleryToolItemGroup3 = startLocation.Group;
			if (galleryToolItemGroup3 != null)
			{
				startingColumn = galleryToolItemGroup3.GetVirtualLocation(startLocation.Item).X;
				GalleryToolItem.ItemLocationInfo itemLocationInfo2 = galleryToolItemGroup3.NavigateFromItem(startLocation, navigationAction, wrapAround);
				if (itemLocationInfo2 != null)
				{
					return itemLocationInfo2;
				}
				startIndex = galleryToolItemGroup3.VisibleIndex + num;
			}
			GalleryToolItemGroup visibleGroup2;
			do
			{
				visibleGroup2 = GetVisibleGroup(startIndex, num, mustHaveItems: true);
				if (visibleGroup2 != null)
				{
					GalleryToolItem.ItemLocationInfo itemLocationInfo3 = visibleGroup2.NavigateFromItem(new GalleryToolItem.ItemLocationInfo(null, this, null, GalleryArea.DropDown), navigationAction, startingColumn, wrapAround);
					if (itemLocationInfo3 != null)
					{
						return itemLocationInfo3;
					}
					startIndex = visibleGroup2.VisibleIndex + num;
				}
			}
			while (visibleGroup2 != null);
			if (visibleGroup2 == null && navigationAction == NavigationAction.Up && ShowFilterBarResolved)
			{
				return SelectedGroupFilter;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal GalleryToolItem.ItemLocationInfo TryNavigateInPreview(GalleryToolItem.ItemLocationInfo startLocation, NavigationAction navigationAction, bool wrapAround)
		{
			if (!IsPreviewVisible)
			{
				return null;
			}
			GalleryToolItem galleryToolItem = PreviewInfo.NavigateFromItem(startLocation.Item, navigationAction, wrapAround);
			if (galleryToolItem == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new GalleryToolItem.ItemLocationInfo(galleryToolItem, this, null, GalleryArea.Preview);
		}

		internal void VerifyGroupsInSelectedFilter()
		{
			SettingsOwner.ExtraSharedProps.VerifyGroupsInSelectedFilter();
		}

		internal void ResetExtraSharedPropsCache()
		{
			if (GetExtraSharedProps(base.ExtraSharedPropsCount) is GalleryToolExtraSharedProps galleryToolExtraSharedProps)
			{
				galleryToolExtraSharedProps.ResetCache();
			}
		}

		private void DirtyDropDownContents()
		{
			if (DropDownItemAreaUIElement != null)
			{
				((UIElement)DropDownItemAreaUIElement).DirtyChildElements();
			}
		}

		private void DirtyPreviewContents()
		{
			if (PreviewUIElement != null)
			{
				PreviewUIElement.DirtyChildElements();
			}
		}

		private int GetDropDownColumnsNeededToSpanWidth(int width)
		{
			if (AllowResizeDropDown)
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
				ComponentRole val = ((toolbarsManager != null) ? ((UltraStylableComponent)toolbarsManager).ComponentRole : null);
				Control control = toolbarsManager?.DockWithinContainer;
				int verticalScrollBarWidthResolved = ScrollBarLook.GetVerticalScrollBarWidthResolved(control, (ScrollBarLook)null, val);
				width -= verticalScrollBarWidthResolved;
			}
			width -= GroupItemAreaPadding.Width;
			int num = Math.Max(1, ItemSizeInDropDownResolved.Width + ItemPadding.Width);
			return (width - 1) / num + 1;
		}

		private int GetMaximumItemColumnsForItem()
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (GalleryToolItemGroup allVisibleGroup in GetAllVisibleGroups())
			{
				int maximumItemColumnsForItem = allVisibleGroup.GetMaximumItemColumnsForItem();
				if (maximumItemColumnsForItem > num)
				{
					num = maximumItemColumnsForItem;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal int GetMinimumHeight(int width)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (GalleryToolItemGroup allVisibleGroup in GetAllVisibleGroups())
			{
				num += allVisibleGroup.GetRequiredHeight(width, cacheWidth: false);
			}
			int num2 = (ShowFilterBarResolved ? FilterBarHeight : 0);
			return num + num2 + 2;
		}

		private UIElement GetPreviewUIElement(ToolBase tool, UIElement parentElement, UIElement previousElement, bool drawAsActive, bool drawAsPressed)
		{
			previewUIElement = null;
			if (previousElement != null && ((object)previousElement).GetType() == typeof(GalleryPreviewUIElement))
			{
				previewUIElement = previousElement as GalleryPreviewUIElement;
			}
			if (previewUIElement == null)
			{
				previewUIElement = new GalleryPreviewUIElement(parentElement, (PopupGalleryTool)tool);
			}
			else
			{
				previewUIElement.InitializeElement((PopupGalleryTool)tool);
			}
			return (UIElement)(object)previewUIElement;
		}

		private void RefreshOpenDropDowns()
		{
			foreach (PopupGalleryTool toolInstance in base.SharedProps.ToolInstances)
			{
				if (toolInstance.IsOpen)
				{
					toolInstance.RefreshDropDownContents();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsItemVisible(GalleryToolItem galleryToolItem)
		{
			List<GalleryToolItemGroup> allVisibleGroups = GetAllVisibleGroups();
			foreach (GalleryToolItemGroup item in allVisibleGroups)
			{
				if (item.Items.Contains(galleryToolItem))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private class PopupToolExtraSharedProps : SubObjectBase
		{
			private PopupToolBase owningTool;

			internal DropDownArrowStyle dropDownArrowStyle;

			internal EventHandler popupProviderCloseDelegate;

			internal bool isChecked;

			internal string keyTipForSegmentedButton;

			internal bool Checked
			{
				get
				{
					return isChecked;
				}
				set
				{
					if (value != isChecked)
					{
						owningTool.VerifyCanBeModified();
						isChecked = value;
						owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Checked);
					}
				}
			}

			internal DropDownArrowStyle DropDownArrowStyle
			{
				get
				{
					return dropDownArrowStyle;
				}
				set
				{
					if (value != dropDownArrowStyle)
					{
						owningTool.VerifyCanBeModified();
						if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(DropDownArrowStyle), value))
						{
							throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_44"));
						}
						dropDownArrowStyle = value;
						owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.DropDownArrowStyle);
					}
				}
			}

			internal string KeyTipForSegmentedButton
			{
				get
				{
					return keyTipForSegmentedButton;
				}
				set
				{
					ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ValidateKeyTip(ref value);
					if (value != keyTipForSegmentedButton)
					{
						owningTool.VerifyCanBeModified();
						keyTipForSegmentedButton = value;
						NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.KeyTipForSegmentedButton);
					}
				}
			}

			internal PopupToolExtraSharedProps(PopupToolBase owningTool)
			{
				this.owningTool = owningTool;
				dropDownArrowStyle = owningTool.DefaultDropDownArrowStyle;
			}
		}

		internal override UIElementButtonStyle ButtonStyle
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0058: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0013: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0049: Expected I4, but got Unknown
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager != null)
				{
					ToolbarStyle styleResolved = toolbarsManager.StyleResolved;
					if ((int)styleResolved == 6)
					{
						return (UIElementButtonStyle)19;
					}
					if (!base.OwnerIsToolbarInternal || !base.OwningToolbarInternal.IsMainMenuBarInternal)
					{
						switch (styleResolved - 5)
						{
						case 0:
							return (UIElementButtonStyle)17;
						case 2:
							return (UIElementButtonStyle)21;
						case 3:
							return (UIElementButtonStyle)23;
						case 4:
							return (UIElementButtonStyle)25;
						}
					}
				}
				return base.ButtonStyle;
			}
		}

		protected override string DefaultAction
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.EnabledResolved)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (IsOpen)
				{

			}

		protected internal override bool DrawAsActive
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsOpen && base.OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
				{
					return false;
				}
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
				if (base.OwnerIsToolbarInternal && toolbarsManager != null && base.OwningToolbarInternal.AutoDropDownMode && !toolbarsManager.AllowToolbarCaptureRelease)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (base.IsActiveTool)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (base.OwnerIsMenuInternal && IsOpen)
				{
					if (base.OwningMenuInternal.IsAnyOtherToolOnMenuActive(this))
					{
						return false;
					}
					return true;
				}
				if (base.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea && IsOpen)
				{
					if (base.OwningApplicationMenuArea.ApplicationMenu.IsAnyOtherToolOnMenuActive(this))
					{
						return false;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return base.DrawAsActive;
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_StateButtonTool_P_Checked")]

				if (base.UnderlyingToolRaw is PopupToolBase && base.UnderlyingToolRaw != this)
				{
					return ((PopupToolBase)base.UnderlyingToolRaw).Checked;
				}
				return ExtraSharedProps.Checked;
			}
			set
			{
				if (base.UnderlyingToolRaw is PopupToolBase && base.UnderlyingToolRaw != this)
				{
					((PopupToolBase)base.UnderlyingToolRaw).Checked = value;
				}
				else if (ExtraSharedProps.Checked != value)
				{
					ExtraSharedProps.Checked = value;
					UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
					if (toolbarsManager != null && toolbarsManager.Initialized && ExtraSharedProps.Checked == value)
					{
						ToolClickEventArgs e = new ToolClickEventArgs(this, null);
						toolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.ToolClick, e);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual bool DisplayDropDownArrow
		{
			get
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = UnderlyingTool;
				UltraToolbarBase owningToolbarInternal = base.OwningToolbarInternal;
				if (toolBase != null && toolBase is PopupMenuTool && base.InstanceProps != null && owningToolbarInternal != null && owningToolbarInternal.IsMainMenuBarInternal)

					return IsSegmentedDropDownArrowStyle;
				}
				return DropDownArrowStyleResolved != DropDownArrowStyle.None;
			}

		internal DropDownLocation DropDownLocation
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsOpen)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_36"));
				}
				Rectangle rectangle = default(Rectangle);
				UIElement uIElement = base.UIElement;
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					Control control = uIElement.Control;
					if (control != null && !control.IsDisposed && !control.Disposing)
					{
						rectangle = control.RectangleToScreen(uIElement.Rect);
					}
				}
				if (base.OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
				{
					if (base.IsArrangedVertically)
					{
						if (MenuAgent.DropDownRect.Left < rectangle.Left)
						{
							return DropDownLocation.Left;
						}
						return DropDownLocation.Right;
					}
					if (MenuAgent.DropDownRect.Bottom < rectangle.Bottom)
					{
						return DropDownLocation.Above;
					}
					return DropDownLocation.Below;
				}
				if (base.OwnerIsMenuInternal || base.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)
				{
					if (MenuAgent.DropDownRect.Left < rectangle.Left)
					{
						return DropDownLocation.Left;
					}
					return DropDownLocation.Right;
				}
				return DropDownLocation.Right;
			}
		}

		protected PopupToolBase(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "Checked":
					SerializedProps.isChecked = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), SerializedProps.isChecked);
					break;
				case "DropDownArrowStyle":
					SerializedProps.dropDownArrowStyle = (DropDownArrowStyle)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(DropDownArrowStyle), SerializedProps.dropDownArrowStyle);
					break;
				case "KeyTipForSegmentedButton":
					SerializedProps.keyTipForSegmentedButton = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), SerializedProps.keyTipForSegmentedButton);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		void IPopupItem.Close()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager != null && base.SharedProps != null && base.SharedProps.RootTool != null)
			{
				((PopupToolBase)base.SharedProps.RootTool).CloseDropDown();
			}
		}

		void IPopupItem.Show(PopupInfo info)
		{
			//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			base.ToolbarsManager?.ShowPopup(Key, info.PreferredLocation, info.SourceControl, info.ExclusionRect, info.Position, info.Owner, info.AlignRight);
		}

		KeyTipActivationResult IKeyTipProviderWithDelay.ActivateWithPotentialDelay()
		{
			bool flag = ((IKeyTipProvider)this).Activate();
			if (flag && IsSubMenuAnimationActive && MenuAgent.IsMenuAnimationActive && base.ToolbarsManager.MenuAnimationEnabled && base.ToolbarsManager.MenuAnimationStyle != MenuAnimationStyle.None)
			{
				return KeyTipActivationResult.Delay;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return KeyTipActivationResult.Failed;
			}
			return KeyTipActivationResult.Succeeded;
		}

		internal void OnActivateAnimationComplete()
		{
			if (activateDelayCompleteDelegate != null)
			{
				activateDelayCompleteDelegate(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected internal override Size CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstance()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null)
			{
				return DefaultSize;
			}
			object owner = base.Owner;
			object ownerInternal = base.OwnerInternal;
			if (owner == null || owner is UltraToolbarsManager || ownerInternal is PopupMenuTool || owner is ApplicationMenuAreaBase)
			{
				return DefaultSize;
			}
			Size size = Size.Empty;
			bool displayDropDownArrow = DisplayDropDownArrow;
			if (displayDropDownArrow)
			{
				size = toolbarsManager.GetArrowBitmap(ArrowUIElement.ArrowOrientation.Down, ArrowSize).Size;
			}
			Size result = ButtonTool.CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstanceHelper(this);
			if (displayDropDownArrow)
			{
				if (base.IsVertical)
				{
					if (toolbarsManager.TouchMetricsEnabledResolved)
					{
						size.Height = Math.Max(size.Height, base.ImageSizeResolved.Height);
					}
					result.Height += size.Width + 4;
				}
				else
				{
					if (toolbarsManager.TouchMetricsEnabledResolved)
					{
						size.Width = Math.Max(size.Width, base.ImageSizeResolved.Width);
					}
					result.Width += size.Width + 4;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void DoDefaultAction()
		{
			if (base.EnabledResolved)
			{
				if (IsOpen)
				{
					CloseDropDown();
				}
				else if ((base.OwnerIsToolbarInternal && base.OwningToolbarInternal.VisibleResolved) || (base.OwnerIsRibbonGroup && base.OwningRibbonGroup.IsVisibleResolved) || (base.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea && base.OwningApplicationMenuArea.ApplicationMenu.IsOpen) || (base.OwnerIsMenuInternal && base.OwningMenuInternal.IsOpen))
				{
					DropDown(delay: false);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override Rectangle GetImageRect()
		{
			ToolBase toolBeingDisplayed = base.ToolBeingDisplayed;
			if (!(toolBeingDisplayed.UIElement is PopupToolUIElement popupToolUIElement))
			{
				return base.GetImageRect();
			}
			((UIElement)popupToolUIElement).VerifyChildElements();
			if (!(((UIElement)popupToolUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(ButtonToolUIElement), (object)toolBeingDisplayed) is ButtonToolUIElement buttonToolUIElement) || ((ImageAndTextButtonUIElement)buttonToolUIElement).Image == null)
			{
				return base.GetImageRect();
			}
			return ((UIElement)buttonToolUIElement).Control.RectangleToScreen(((UIElement)((ImageAndTextButtonUIElementBase)buttonToolUIElement).ImageAndTextElement.ImageElement).Rect);
		}

		internal override IKeyTipContainer GetKeyTipContainer()
		{
			if (DisplaySegmentedButtonKeyTip)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (base.IsOnBackStage)
			{
				return base.ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.ApplicationMenu2010.ContentArea;
			}
			return base.GetKeyTipContainer();
		}

		internal virtual void GetKeyTipForSegmentedButtonLocationInfo(out Point location, out System.Drawing.ContentAlignment alignment)
		{
			location = Point.Empty;
			alignment = System.Drawing.ContentAlignment.TopLeft;
			ToolBase toolBeingDisplayed = base.ToolBeingDisplayed;
			UIElement uIElement = toolBeingDisplayed.UIElement;
			if (uIElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			uIElement.VerifyChildElements();
			UIElement val = null;
			if (uIElement is PopupMenuItemUIElement)
			{
				UIElementEnumerator enumerator = uIElement.ChildElements.GetEnumerator();
				try
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						UIElement current = enumerator.Current;
						val = (UIElement)(object)(current as ArrowUIElement);
						if (val != null)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
					{
						disposable.Dispose();
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				UIElementEnumerator enumerator2 = uIElement.ChildElements.GetEnumerator();
				try
				{
					while (enumerator2.MoveNext())
					{
						UIElement current2 = enumerator2.Current;
						val = (UIElement)(object)(current2 as PopupToolDropDownButtonUIElement);
						if (val != null)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					if (enumerator2 is IDisposable disposable2)
					{
						disposable2.Dispose();
					}
				}
			}
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle rectangle = val.Control.RectangleToScreen(val.Rect);
			int y = rectangle.Y;
			if (toolBeingDisplayed.OwnerIsMenu || toolBeingDisplayed.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)
			{
				y = (rectangle.Top + rectangle.Bottom) / 2;
			}
			else if (toolBeingDisplayed.OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
			{
				RibbonGroup owningRibbonGroup = toolBeingDisplayed.OwningRibbonGroup;
				RibbonGroupLayoutItem currentToolLayout = owningRibbonGroup.GetCurrentToolLayout(onlyIfOpen: false);
				if (currentToolLayout != null)
				{
					y = owningRibbonGroup.GetKeyTipCenterLine(currentToolLayout.GetKeyTipToolRowNumber(toolBeingDisplayed));
					if (toolBeingDisplayed.CurrentToolSizeInfo.Equals(RibbonToolSizeInfo.Large))
					{
						alignment = System.Drawing.ContentAlignment.MiddleCenter;
					}
					else
					{
						alignment = System.Drawing.ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft;
					}
				}
			}
			int x = (rectangle.Left + rectangle.Right) / 2;
			location = new Point(x, y);
		}

		internal override void GetKeyTipLocationInfo(out Point location, out System.Drawing.ContentAlignment alignment)
		{
			base.GetKeyTipLocationInfo(out location, out alignment);
			ToolBase toolBeingDisplayed = base.ToolBeingDisplayed;
			if (toolBeingDisplayed.OwnerIsRibbonGroup && toolBeingDisplayed.CurrentToolSizeInfo.Equals(RibbonToolSizeInfo.Large) && DisplaySegmentedButtonKeyTip)
			{
				location.Y = toolBeingDisplayed.OwningRibbonGroup.GetKeyTipCenterLine(1);
			}
		}

		internal override IKeyTipProvider[] GetKeyTipProviders()
		{
			List<IKeyTipProvider> list = new List<IKeyTipProvider>(base.GetKeyTipProviders());
			if (DisplaySegmentedButtonKeyTip)
			{
				list.Add(SegmentedButtonKeyTipProvider);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		protected override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
			if (ShouldSerializeDropDownArrowStyle())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "DropDownArrowStyle", DropDownArrowStyle);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeChecked())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Checked", Checked);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeKeyTipForSegmentedButton())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "KeyTipForSegmentedButton", KeyTipForSegmentedButton);
			}
		}

		private static UIElement GetToolUIElement(ToolBase tool, UIElement parentElement, UIElement previousElement, bool drawAsActive, bool drawAsPressed)
		{
			PopupToolUIElement popupToolUIElement = null;
			if (previousElement != null && ((object)previousElement).GetType() == typeof(PopupToolUIElement))
			{
				popupToolUIElement = previousElement as PopupToolUIElement;
			}
			if (popupToolUIElement == null)
			{
				popupToolUIElement = new PopupToolUIElement(parentElement, tool);
			}
			else
			{
				popupToolUIElement.InitializeElement(tool);
			}
			return (UIElement)(object)popupToolUIElement;
		}

		{
			return typeof(PopupToolUIElement);
		}

		protected internal override void Initialize(ToolsCollectionBase parentCollection)
		{
			base.Initialize(parentCollection);
			if (serializedProps != null)
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.isChecked = serializedProps.isChecked;
				ExtraSharedProps.DropDownArrowStyle = serializedProps.dropDownArrowStyle;
				serializedProps = null;
			}
		}

		protected internal override void InitializeFrom(ToolBase sourceTool, bool cloneNewInstance)
		{
			base.InitializeFrom(sourceTool, cloneNewInstance);
			if (sourceTool is PopupToolBase popupToolBase && !cloneNewInstance)
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.dropDownArrowStyle = popupToolBase.ExtraSharedProps.DropDownArrowStyle;
				ExtraSharedProps.isChecked = popupToolBase.ExtraSharedProps.Checked;
			}
		}

		protected internal override void OnAfterToolCloseup(ToolDropdownEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnAfterToolCloseup(e);
			if (base.SharedProps != null && base.IsRootTool)
			{
				ToolBase parentRootTool = base.ToolbarsManager.GetParentRootTool(this);
				PopupToolBase popupToolBase = parentRootTool as PopupToolBase;
				if (popupToolBase == null)
				{
					popupToolBase = this;
				}
				popupToolBase.ExtraSharedProps.popupProviderCloseDelegate?.Invoke(popupToolBase, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool OnEnterKeyPressed()
		{
			OnToolClick();
			return true;
		}

		internal override bool OnKeyTipActivate()
		{
			if (DisplaySegmentedButtonKeyTip)
			{
				return base.OnKeyTipActivate();
			}
			return DropDownOnKeyTipActivation(base.ToolBeingDisplayed);
		}

		protected internal override bool OnMnemonicPressed()
		{
			try
			{
				isProcessingMnemonic = true;
				return base.OnMnemonicPressed();
			}
			finally
			{
				isProcessingMnemonic = false;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnRemovedFromCollection(KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase collection)
		{
			if (menuAgent != null && MenuAgent.IsOpen)
			{
				MenuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay: false);
			}
			base.OnRemovedFromCollection(collection);
		}

		protected internal override void OnShortcutKeyPressed()
		{
			if (DropDownArrowStyle == DropDownArrowStyle.SegmentedStateButton)
			{
				Checked = !Checked;
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnShortcutKeyPressed();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void OnToolClick()
		{
			if (DropDownArrowStyleResolved == DropDownArrowStyle.Segmented)
			{
				base.OnToolClick();
			}
			else if (DropDownArrowStyleResolved == DropDownArrowStyle.SegmentedStateButton)
			{
				base.ToolbarsManagerInControl.PopupManager.CloseAllPopups(onlyCloseLeafContiguousPopupChain: true);
				Checked = !Checked;
			}
			else if (!IsOpen && base.EnabledResolved)
			{
				DropDown(delay: false);
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager.AreKeyTipsShown)
				{
					IKeyTipProvider dropDownKeyTipProvider = DropDownKeyTipProvider;
					if (dropDownKeyTipProvider != null)
					{
						toolbarsManager.Ribbon.KeyTipManager.ActivateKeyTipProvider(dropDownKeyTipProvider);
					}
					else
					{
						toolbarsManager.Ribbon.KeyTipManager.HideKeyTips();
					}
				}
				if ((base.OwnerIsMenuInternal || isProcessingMnemonic) && MenuAgent.IsOpen && MenuAgent.ActiveMenuItem == null && !base.IsOnBackStage)
				{
					MenuAgent.MenuItems.GetNextMenuItem(null, selectableItemsOnly: true, MenuAgent.HideNonRecentlyUsedItems, wrapAround: false)?.Activate();
				}
			}
			else if (IsOpen && base.IsOnBackStage)
			{
				((base.UltimateOwner is NavigationMenu navigationMenu) ? navigationMenu.ApplicationMenu2010.BackStageManager : null)?.RaiseActiveContentToolClickedWhileOpen(this);
			}
		}

		internal override void ResolveAppearancePhaseDefaults(ref ResolveAppearancePhaseInfo phaseInfo, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003e: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_015e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0164: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (phaseInfo.Phase == AppearanceResolutionPhase.ToolOwner)
			{
				bool flag = IsOpen;
				if (!flag && base.AttachedParentTool is PopupToolBase { IsOpen: not false })
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (flag && (int)phaseInfo.Manager.StyleResolved == 6)
				{
					UltraToolbar owningToolbar = base.OwningToolbar;
					if (owningToolbar != null && !owningToolbar.IsMainMenuBar)
					{
						flag = false;
					}
				}
				if (phaseInfo.ToolbarSettingsBase != null && flag && phaseInfo.Manager.MSColors != null)
				{
					if (((ulong)requestedProps & 1uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)1))
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = phaseInfo.Manager.MSColors.PopupMenuToolOpenGradientLight;
						requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEuL);
					}
					if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x4000000uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)67108864))
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor2 = phaseInfo.Manager.MSColors.PopupMenuToolOpenGradientDark;
						requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFBFFFFFFuL);
					}
					if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x10000000uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)268435456))
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackGradientStyle = (GradientStyle)2;
						requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFEFFFFFFFuL);
					}
					if (((ulong)requestedProps & 2uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)2))
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ForeColor = phaseInfo.Manager.MSColors.PopupMenuToolOpenForecolor;
						requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFDuL);
					}
				}
				if (((ulong)requestedProps & 4uL) != 0L && base.OwnerIsToolbarInternal && flag && phaseInfo.Manager.IsNonOffice2000Style)
				{
					if ((int)phaseInfo.Manager.StyleResolved == 4)
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor = XPItemColor.MenuDroppedBorder;
					}
					else

					}
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFBuL);

		private void AdjustDropdownInfo(ref DropDownPosition dropDownPosition, ref Point dropDownPoint, Rectangle exclusionRect, bool alignRight)
		{
			if (base.OwnerIsMenuInternal && base.OwningMenuInternal.IsOpen && base.OwningMenuInternal.OwnerIsMenuInternal && base.OwningMenuInternal.OwningMenuInternal.IsOpen)
			{
				Control owningControlForDropDown = base.OwningMenuInternal.MenuAgent.OwningControlForDropDown;
				Rectangle dropDownScreenRect = DropDownManager.GetDropDownScreenRect(owningControlForDropDown);
				Rectangle exclusionScreenRect = DropDownManager.GetExclusionScreenRect(owningControlForDropDown);
				if (!alignRight && dropDownScreenRect.Right <= exclusionScreenRect.Left)
				{
					dropDownPosition = (DropDownPosition)1;
					dropDownPoint.X = exclusionRect.X;
				}
				else if (alignRight && dropDownScreenRect.Left >= exclusionScreenRect.Right)
				{
					dropDownPosition = (DropDownPosition)2;
					dropDownPoint.X = exclusionRect.Right;
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsTearawayToolbarAncestor()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager != null)
			{
				foreach (UltraToolbar toolbar in toolbarsManager.Toolbars)
				{
					if (IsTearawayToolbarAncestor(toolbar))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsTearawayToolbarAncestor(UltraToolbar toolbar)
		{
			if (toolbar.ToolbarType != ToolbarType.Tearaway)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ToolBase toolBase = toolbar.TearawayToolOwner;
			if (toolBase == this)
			{
				return false;
			}
			while (toolBase != null)
			{
				object owner = toolBase.Owner;
				PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool = toolBase.OwnerInternal as PopupMenuTool;
				RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = owner as RibbonGroup;
				if (popupMenuTool != null)
				{
					toolBase = popupMenuTool;
				}
				else if (ribbonGroup != null)
				{
					if (ribbonGroup.OwningPopupTool == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					toolBase = ribbonGroup.OwningPopupTool;
				}
				else
				{
					toolBase = owner as ToolBase;
				}
				if (toolBase == this)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal virtual bool CalculateDropDownInfo(out Control dropDownOwner, out Point dropDownPoint, out Rectangle rectInScreenCoordinates, out DropDownPosition dropDownPosition, out bool rightAligned)
		{
			dropDownOwner = null;
			dropDownPoint = Point.Empty;
			rectInScreenCoordinates = Rectangle.Empty;
			dropDownPosition = (DropDownPosition)1;
			rightAligned = SystemInformation.RightAlignedMenus;
			ToolBase toolBeingDisplayed = base.ToolBeingDisplayed;
			UIElement uIElement = toolBeingDisplayed.UIElement;
			if (uIElement == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Control control = uIElement.Control;
			if (control == null || control.IsDisposed || control.Disposing)
			{
				return false;
			}
			rectInScreenCoordinates = control.RectangleToScreen(uIElement.Rect);
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = toolBeingDisplayed.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager != null)
			{
				rightAligned = toolbarsManager.RightAlignedMenusResolved;
			}
			if (toolBeingDisplayed.OwnerIsMenuInternal)
			{
				dropDownOwner = (Control)(object)toolBeingDisplayed.OwningMenuInternal.MenuAgent.PopupControl;
				if (rightAligned)
				{
					dropDownPoint = new Point(rectInScreenCoordinates.Left, rectInScreenCoordinates.Top);
					dropDownPosition = (DropDownPosition)1;
				}
				else
				{
					dropDownPoint = new Point(rectInScreenCoordinates.Right, rectInScreenCoordinates.Top);
					dropDownPosition = (DropDownPosition)2;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (toolBeingDisplayed.IsOnBackStage)
				{
					NavigationMenu navigationMenu = toolBeingDisplayed.UltimateOwner as NavigationMenu;
					dropDownOwner = (Control)(object)navigationMenu.FileMenu.MenuAgent.PopupControl;
					dropDownPosition = (DropDownPosition)0;
					dropDownPoint = Point.Empty;
					rectInScreenCoordinates = Rectangle.Empty;
					rightAligned = true;
					return true;
				}
				if (toolBeingDisplayed.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)
				{
					dropDownOwner = (Control)(object)toolBeingDisplayed.OwningApplicationMenuArea.ApplicationMenu.MenuAgent.PopupControl;
					if (toolBeingDisplayed.OwningApplicationMenuArea is ApplicationMenuLeftArea)
					{
						dropDownPoint = control.PointToScreen(toolbarsManager.Ribbon.ApplicationMenu.LeftAreaOwnedMenuDropDownRect.Location);
						dropDownPosition = (DropDownPosition)2;
					}
					else if (rightAligned)
					{
						dropDownPoint = new Point(rectInScreenCoordinates.Left, rectInScreenCoordinates.Top);
						dropDownPosition = (DropDownPosition)1;
					}
					else
					{
						dropDownPoint = new Point(rectInScreenCoordinates.Right, rectInScreenCoordinates.Top);
						dropDownPosition = (DropDownPosition)2;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					bool flag = !OverlapMenuBorders;
					if (this is TaskPaneToolbarMenuTool)
					{
						dropDownPosition = (DropDownPosition)0;
						if (flag)
						{
							dropDownPoint = new Point(rectInScreenCoordinates.Right - MenuAgent.CalculateRequiredDropDownSize().Width, rectInScreenCoordinates.Bottom);
						}
						else
						{
							dropDownPoint = new Point(rectInScreenCoordinates.Right - MenuAgent.CalculateRequiredDropDownSize().Width, rectInScreenCoordinates.Bottom - 1);
						}
					}
					else if (toolBeingDisplayed.IsArrangedVertically)
					{
						if (rightAligned)
						{
							dropDownPosition = (DropDownPosition)1;
							dropDownPoint = new Point(rectInScreenCoordinates.X, rectInScreenCoordinates.Top);
						}
						else
						{
							dropDownPosition = (DropDownPosition)2;
							if (flag)
							{
								dropDownPoint = new Point(rectInScreenCoordinates.Right, rectInScreenCoordinates.Top);
							}
							else
							{
								dropDownPoint = new Point(rectInScreenCoordinates.Right - 1, rectInScreenCoordinates.Top);
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						dropDownPosition = (DropDownPosition)0;
						if (rightAligned)
						{
							if (flag)
							{
								dropDownPoint = new Point(rectInScreenCoordinates.Right, rectInScreenCoordinates.Bottom);
							}
							else
							{
								dropDownPoint = new Point(rectInScreenCoordinates.Right, rectInScreenCoordinates.Bottom - 1);
							}
						}
						else if (flag)
						{
							dropDownPoint = new Point(rectInScreenCoordinates.X, rectInScreenCoordinates.Bottom);
						}
						else
						{
							dropDownPoint = new Point(rectInScreenCoordinates.X, rectInScreenCoordinates.Bottom - 1);
						}
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						rectInScreenCoordinates = PopupToolUIElement.GetMenuDropDownExclusionRect(rectInScreenCoordinates, dropDownPosition);
					}
					dropDownOwner = GetDropDownOwner(uIElement);
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		}

		internal void DropDown(bool delay, SplitMonitorAction splitMonitorAction)
		{
			//IL_0200: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0215: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ToolBase toolBeingDisplayed = base.ToolBeingDisplayed;
			if (toolBeingDisplayed.IsRootTool)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_38"));
			}
			if (toolBeingDisplayed.OwnerIsMenuInternal)
			{
				if (!toolBeingDisplayed.OwningMenuInternal.IsOpen)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_39"));
				}
			}
			else if (toolBeingDisplayed.OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
			{
				if ((!(toolBeingDisplayed.OwningToolbarInternal.TearawayToolOwnerInternal is PopupToolBase { IsMenuAgentCreated: not false } popupToolBase) || !popupToolBase.MenuAgent.IsOpen) && !toolBeingDisplayed.OwningToolbarInternal.VisibleResolved)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_40"));
				}
				if (toolBeingDisplayed is PopupControlContainerTool { ShowAsDropDownControl: not false })
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			else if (toolBeingDisplayed.OwnerIsApplicationMenuAreaBase)
			{
				if (!toolBeingDisplayed.OwningApplicationMenuAreaBase.FileMenu.IsOpen)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_39"));
				}
			}
			else if (toolBeingDisplayed.OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
			{
				RibbonGroup owningRibbonGroup = toolBeingDisplayed.OwningRibbonGroup;
				if (owningRibbonGroup.OwningPopupTool != null)
				{
					if (!owningRibbonGroup.OwningPopupTool.IsOpen)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("PopupToolBase_InvalidDropOntoHiddenGroup"));
					}
				}
				else if (!owningRibbonGroup.Ribbon.IsTabPageInView || owningRibbonGroup.Tab != owningRibbonGroup.Ribbon.SelectedTab || (owningRibbonGroup.Layout.IsCollapsed && !owningRibbonGroup.IsGroupPopupOpen))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("PopupToolBase_InvalidDropOntoHiddenGroup"));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (!toolBeingDisplayed.IsOnBackStage)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_41"));
				}
				if (!toolBeingDisplayed.ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.ApplicationMenu2010.IsOpen)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_39"));
				}
			}
			if (!toolBeingDisplayed.EnabledResolved)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_42"));
			}
			if (!IsOpen)
			{
				if (toolBeingDisplayed.IsOnBackStage)
				{
					toolBeingDisplayed.ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.ApplicationMenu2010.NavigationMenu.SetActiveContentToolInternal(this);
				}
				if (CalculateDropDownInfo(out var dropDownOwner, out var dropDownPoint, out var rectInScreenCoordinates, out var dropDownPosition, out var rightAligned))
				{
					DropDown(dropDownOwner, dropDownPoint, rectInScreenCoordinates, dropDownPosition, delay, closeIfAlreadyOpen: false, rightAligned, !toolBeingDisplayed.ToolbarsManager.Customizing, null, splitMonitorAction);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void DropDown(Control owningControl, Point point, Rectangle exclusionRect, DropDownPosition dropDownPosition, bool delay, bool closeIfAlreadyOpen, bool alignRight, bool autocloseDropdown, Control sourceControl)
		{
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

		internal void DropDown(Control owningControl, Point point, Rectangle exclusionRect, DropDownPosition dropDownPosition, bool delay, bool closeIfAlreadyOpen, bool alignRight, bool autocloseDropdown, Control sourceControl, SplitMonitorAction splitMonitorAction, bool showMiniToolbar)
		{
			//IL_0085: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (menuAgent == null)
			{
				menuAgent = CreateMenuAgent();
			}
			else
			{
				if (menuAgent is PopupControlContainerAgent && base.AttachedParentTool != null)
				{
					((PopupControlContainerAgent)menuAgent).VerifyParentTool(base.AttachedParentTool);
				}
				RefreshDropDownContents();
			}
			if (menuAgent != null)
			{
				if (menuAgent is PopupToolAgentBase)
				{
					((PopupToolAgentBase)menuAgent).InternalSetSourceControl(sourceControl);
				}
				AdjustDropdownInfo(ref dropDownPosition, ref point, exclusionRect, alignRight);
				menuAgent.DropDown(owningControl, point, exclusionRect, dropDownPosition, delay, closeIfAlreadyOpen, alignRight, autocloseDropdown, splitMonitorAction, showMiniToolbar);
			}
		}

		internal bool DropDownOnKeyTipActivation(IKeyTipProvider activatedProvider)
		{
			ToolBase toolBeingDisplayed = base.ToolBeingDisplayed;
			KeyTipManager keyTipManager = toolBeingDisplayed.ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.KeyTipManager;
			bool flag = keyTipManager.ProviderPendingActivation == activatedProvider;
			if (toolBeingDisplayed.OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
			{
				if (toolBeingDisplayed.OwningRibbonGroup.Layout.IsCollapsed)
				{
					keyTipManager.ActivateKeyTipProvider(toolBeingDisplayed.OwningRibbonGroup);
				}
			}
			else if (toolBeingDisplayed.OwnerIsToolbarInternal && toolBeingDisplayed.BumpedFromToolbar && toolBeingDisplayed.OwningToolbarInternal.QuickCustomizeTool != null)
			{
				keyTipManager.ActivateKeyTipProvider(toolBeingDisplayed.OwningToolbarInternal.QuickCustomizeTool);
			}
			if (flag && keyTipManager.ProviderPendingActivation != activatedProvider)
			{
				return false;
			}
			toolBeingDisplayed.BringIntoView();
			DropDown();
			return IsOpen;
		}

		internal Control GetDropDownOwner(Control control)
		{
			Control control2 = null;
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			if (base.OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
			{
				return ((object)control == toolbarsManager.Ribbon.RibbonContainer) ? toolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer : control;
			}
			if (base.OwningToolbarInternal.ToolbarType == ToolbarType.Standard || base.OwningToolbarInternal.ToolbarType == ToolbarType.QuickAccessToolbar)
			{
				return toolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer;
			}
			return control;
		}

		internal Control GetDropDownOwner(UIElement element)
		{
			return GetDropDownOwner(element.Control);
		}

		internal Point GetDropDownPoint(Rectangle popupToolRect)
		{
			bool rightAlignedMenusResolved = base.ToolbarsManager.RightAlignedMenusResolved;
			bool overlapMenuBorders = OverlapMenuBorders;
			if (base.IsArrangedVertically)
			{
				if (rightAlignedMenusResolved)
				{
					if (!overlapMenuBorders)
					{
						return new Point(popupToolRect.X, popupToolRect.Top);
					}
					return new Point(popupToolRect.X + 1, popupToolRect.Top);
				}
				if (!overlapMenuBorders)
				{
					return new Point(popupToolRect.Right, popupToolRect.Top);
				}
				return new Point(popupToolRect.Right - 1, popupToolRect.Top);
			}
			if (rightAlignedMenusResolved)
			{
				if (!overlapMenuBorders)
				{
					return new Point(popupToolRect.Right, popupToolRect.Bottom);
				}
				return new Point(popupToolRect.Right, popupToolRect.Bottom - 1);
			}
			if (!overlapMenuBorders)
			{
				return new Point(popupToolRect.X, popupToolRect.Bottom);
			}
			return new Point(popupToolRect.X, popupToolRect.Bottom - 1);
		}

		internal void RemoveDescendantTearawayToolbars()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			object[] all = toolbarsManager.Toolbars.All;
			object[] array = all;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				UltraToolbar ultraToolbar = (UltraToolbar)array[i];
				if (ultraToolbar.ToolbarType == ToolbarType.Tearaway && toolbarsManager.Toolbars.IndexOf(ultraToolbar) >= 0 && IsTearawayToolbarAncestor(ultraToolbar))
				{
					toolbarsManager.Toolbars.Remove(ultraToolbar);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RepositionDropDown(Point newLocation, Rectangle newExclusionRect)
		{
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (IsOpen)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				flag = base.ToolbarsManager?.RightAlignedMenusResolved ?? SystemInformation.RightAlignedMenus;
				DropDownPosition dropDownPosition = (DropDownPosition)(flag ? 1 : 2);
				AdjustDropdownInfo(ref dropDownPosition, ref newLocation, newExclusionRect, flag);
				MenuAgent.RepositionDropDown(newLocation, newExclusionRect);
			}
		}

		internal SplitMonitorAction GetSplitMonitorAction()
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool = this as PopupMenuTool;
			SplitMonitorAction val = DefaultSplitMonitorAction;
			if (popupMenuTool != null)
			{
				val = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ResolveSplitMonitorAction(popupMenuTool.SettingsResolved.MultiMonitorDropDownBehaviorResolved, val);
			}
			return val;
		}

		public void ClosePopup()
		{
			if (base.AttachedParentTool != null)
			{
				foreach (ToolBase toolInstance in base.AttachedParentTool.SharedProps.ToolInstances)
				{
					if (toolInstance != null && toolInstance.UnderlyingTool is PopupToolBase { IsOpen: not false } popupToolBase)
					{
						popupToolBase.CloseDropDown();
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (PopupToolBase toolInstance2 in base.SharedProps.ToolInstances)
			{
				if (toolInstance2 != null && toolInstance2.IsOpen)
				{
					toolInstance2.CloseDropDown();
				}
			}
			if (IsOpen)
			{
				CloseDropDown();
			}
		}

		}

			ResetChecked();
		}

	internal class QatCustomizeMenuAgent : PopupToolAgentBase
	{
		private QatCustomizeMenuTool customizeTool;

		protected internal override bool CanResize => false;

		protected internal override bool HideNonRecentlyUsedItems => false;

		protected internal override bool OkToDropDown => base.VisibleMenuItemCount != 0;

		protected override bool ShowSupplementalDropShadows => false;

		internal override UIRole UIRole
		{
			get
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
				if (ultraToolbarsManager == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return StyleUtils.GetRole(ultraToolbarsManager, StyleUtils.Role.QatCustomizeMenu);
			}
		}

		internal QatCustomizeMenuAgent(QatCustomizeMenuTool customizeTool)
			: base(customizeTool)
		{
			this.customizeTool = customizeTool;
		}

		protected internal override void BeforeDropDown(ref bool cancel)
		{
			customizeTool.HideToolTip();
			UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			ultraToolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture = customizeTool.Owner;
			ultraToolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(null, setOn: false, clearToolBeingEdited: true);
			base.BeforeDropDown(ref cancel);
		}

		protected internal override PopupControlBase GetPopupControl()
		{
			QatCustomizeMenuControl qatCustomizeMenuControl = QatCustomizeMenuControl.Create(this);
			((Control)(object)qatCustomizeMenuControl).Size = CalculateRequiredDropDownSize();
			return qatCustomizeMenuControl;
		}

		protected internal override void OnPopupClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UIElement val = ((customizeTool != null) ? customizeTool.UIElement : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				val.Invalidate();
			}
			base.OnPopupClosed(sender, e);
		}

		protected internal override void ResolveMenuAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, object context)
		{
			base.ToolbarsManager.ResolvePopupAppearance(null, UIRole, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldShowAddRemoveCheckColumn(object context)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldShowImages(object context)
		{
			return false;
		}
	}

	internal class QatCustomizeMenuControlTrusted : QatCustomizeMenuControl
	{
		internal QatCustomizeMenuControlTrusted(QatCustomizeMenuAgent agent)
			: base(agent)
		{
		}

		[UIPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Window = UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows)]
		protected override bool ProcessDialogKey(Keys keyData)
		{
			Keys keys = keyData & ~(Keys.Shift | Keys.Control | Keys.Alt);
			switch (keys)
			{
			case Keys.Escape:
				if (base.MenuAgent.IsOpen)
				{
					return base.MenuAgent.ToolbarsManager.ProcessEscapeKey(passToPopupContainer: false);
				}
				break;
			case Keys.Tab:
			case Keys.Return:
			case Keys.Left:
			case Keys.Up:
			case Keys.Right:
			case Keys.Down:
				return base.MenuAgent.ToolbarsManager.ProcessNavigationKey(keys, passToPopupContainer: false);
			}
			return ((Control)(object)this).ProcessDialogKey(keyData);
		}
	}

		{
			get

				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManagerInControl = base.ToolbarsManagerInControl;
				if (toolbarsManagerInControl == null)

					return null;
				}
				return StyleUtils.GetRole(toolbarsManagerInControl, StyleUtils.Role.QatCustomizeMenu);
			}

			: base("")
		{

			OnAddedToCollection(toolbar.Tools);
			base.SharedProps.InternalSetRootTool(this);
