		{
			base.ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.QuickAccessToolbar.AddQatMenuItems(menuAgent, this);
		}

		protected internal override Size CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstance()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			Image customize2007Bitmap = toolbarsManager.GetCustomize2007Bitmap(Toolbar);
			int width = customize2007Bitmap.Width;
			int num = Math.Max(customize2007Bitmap.Height, base.ImageSizeResolved.Height);
			int num2 = width + 2 + 2;
			int height = num + 2 + 2;
			if (toolbarsManager.MSColors != null)
			{
				num2 += 2;
			}
			return new Size(num2, height);
		}

		protected internal override ToolBase Clone(bool cloneNewInstance)
		{
			QatCustomizeMenuTool qatCustomizeMenuTool = new QatCustomizeMenuTool(toolbar);
			qatCustomizeMenuTool.InitializeFrom(this, cloneNewInstance);
			return qatCustomizeMenuTool;
		}

		[StrongNameIdentityPermission(SecurityAction.InheritanceDemand, PublicKey = "")]
		internal override MenuAgentBase CreateMenuAgent()
		{
			QatCustomizeMenuAgent result = new QatCustomizeMenuAgent(this);
			AddMenuItemsToAgent(result);
			return result;
		}

		protected internal override AccessibleObject GetAccessibleChild(int index)
		{
			if (!base.IsOpen)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (base.MenuAgent is QatCustomizeMenuAgent qatCustomizeMenuAgent && index >= 0 && index < qatCustomizeMenuAgent.MenuItems.Count)
			{
				return qatCustomizeMenuAgent.MenuItems[index].AccessibilityObject;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override UIElement GetToolbarUIElement(ToolBase tool, UIElement parentElement, UIElement previousElement, bool drawAsActive, bool drawAsPressed)
		{
			QatCustomizeMenuToolUIElement qatCustomizeMenuToolUIElement = null;
			if (previousElement != null && ((object)previousElement).GetType() == typeof(QatCustomizeMenuToolUIElement))
			{
				qatCustomizeMenuToolUIElement = previousElement as QatCustomizeMenuToolUIElement;
			}
			if (qatCustomizeMenuToolUIElement == null || ((UIElement)qatCustomizeMenuToolUIElement).Parent != parentElement)
			{
				qatCustomizeMenuToolUIElement = new QatCustomizeMenuToolUIElement(parentElement, this);
			}
			else
			{
				qatCustomizeMenuToolUIElement.Initialize(this);
			}
			return (UIElement)(object)qatCustomizeMenuToolUIElement;
		}

		protected internal override Type GetToolbarUIElementType()
		{
			return typeof(QatCustomizeMenuToolUIElement);
		}

		protected internal override void OnDeactivate()
		{
			DirtyOwnerElements();
		}

		protected internal override void RefreshDropDownContents()
		{
			MenuItemBase activeMenuItem = base.MenuAgent.ActiveMenuItem;
			base.MenuAgent.ReInitialize();
			AddMenuItemsToAgent(base.MenuAgent);
			if (!base.IsOpen)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (activeMenuItem != null && base.MenuAgent.ActiveMenuItem == null)
			{
				foreach (MenuItemBase menuItem in base.MenuAgent.MenuItems)
				{
					if (menuItem.IsSameMenuItem(activeMenuItem))
					{
						menuItem.Activate();
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			base.MenuAgent.RecalculateDropdownSize();
			((UIElement)base.MenuAgent.PopupControl.ControlElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
			((UltraControlBase)base.MenuAgent.PopupControl).Update();
		}

		protected override ToolBaseUiaProviderStub CreateUIAutomationStub()
		{
			return new QuickCustomizeToolBase.QuickCustomizeToolBaseUiaProviderStub(this);
		}

		{
			UltraToolbarBase owningToolbarInternal = base.OwningToolbarInternal;
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManagerInControl = base.ToolbarsManagerInControl;
			if (toolbarsManagerInControl != null)
			{
				Image customize2007Bitmap = toolbarsManagerInControl.GetCustomize2007Bitmap(owningToolbarInternal);
				Image customizeBumped2007Bitmap = toolbarsManagerInControl.GetCustomizeBumped2007Bitmap(owningToolbarInternal);
				int extent = Math.Max(customize2007Bitmap.Width, customizeBumped2007Bitmap.Width);
				int val = Math.Max(customize2007Bitmap.Height, customizeBumped2007Bitmap.Height);
				val = Math.Max(val, base.ImageSizeResolved.Height);
				extent = toolbarsManagerInControl.AdjustWidthForTouchMode(extent, useLargeTouchSize: false);
				int num = extent + 2 + 2;
				int height = val + 2 + 2;
				if (toolbarsManagerInControl.MSColors != null)
				{
					num += 2;
				}
				return new Size(num, height);
			}
			return base.CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstance();
		}

		internal override void ResolveAppearancePhaseDefaults(ref ResolveAppearancePhaseInfo phaseInfo, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0025: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (phaseInfo.Phase == AppearanceResolutionPhase.ToolOwner)
			{
				if (((ulong)requestedProps & 2uL) != 0L)
				{
					ToolbarStyle styleResolved = phaseInfo.Manager.StyleResolved;
					if ((int)styleResolved == 7 || (int)styleResolved == 8 || (int)styleResolved == 9)
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ForeColor = (base.EnabledResolved ? ScenicRibbonColorTable.Colors.RibbonQATGlyphDark : ((MicrosoftColorTable)ScenicRibbonColorTable.Colors).ToolDisabledForecolor);
					}
					else
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ForeColor = (base.EnabledResolved ? Office2007ColorTable.Colors.RibbonQATGlyphDark : ((MicrosoftColorTable)Office2007ColorTable.Colors).ToolDisabledForecolor);
					}
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFDuL);
				}
				if (Utilities.IsHighContrast)
				{
					if (((ulong)requestedProps & 1uL) != 0L && base.ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.QuickAccessToolbar.Location == QuickAccessToolbarLocation.AboveRibbon && !DrawAsActive && !IsPressed)
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = SystemColors.Control;
						requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEuL);
					}
					if (((ulong)requestedProps & 4uL) != 0L)
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor = SystemColors.ControlLightLight;
						requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFBuL);
					}
					if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x1000000000uL) != 0L)
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor2 = SystemColors.ControlDark;
						requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFEFFFFFFFFFuL);
					}
				}
			}
			else if (Utilities.IsHighContrast && phaseInfo.Phase == AppearanceResolutionPhase.HotTrack)
			{
				if (((ulong)requestedProps & 4uL) != 0L)
				{
					if (IsPressed)
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor = SystemColors.ControlDark;
					}
					else
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor = SystemColors.ControlLightLight;
					}
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFBuL);
				}
				if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x1000000000uL) != 0L)
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor2 = SystemColors.ControlDark;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFEFFFFFFFFFuL);
				}
			}
			base.ResolveAppearancePhaseDefaults(ref phaseInfo, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

	public class QatQuickCustomizeToolUIElement : SpecialPopupToolUIElement
	{
		private QuickCustomizeToolBase QuickCustomizeTool => ((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext as QuickCustomizeToolBase;

		internal QatQuickCustomizeToolUIElement(UIElement parent, QuickCustomizeToolBase tool)
			: base(parent, tool)
		{
			((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext = tool;
		}

		protected override void DrawImage(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0086: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0090: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a2: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager != null)
			{
				QuickCustomizeToolBase quickCustomizeToolBase = base.Tool as QuickCustomizeToolBase;
				Image image = ((!quickCustomizeToolBase.Toolbar.ToolsHaveBeenBumped) ? toolbarsManager.GetCustomize2007Bitmap(quickCustomizeToolBase.Toolbar) : (((int)toolbarsManager.StyleResolved != 8) ? toolbarsManager.GetCustomizeBumped2007Bitmap(quickCustomizeToolBase.Toolbar) : toolbarsManager.GetCustomizeBumped2010Bitmap(quickCustomizeToolBase.Toolbar)));
				if (image != null)
				{
					using ImageAttributes imageAttributes = new ImageAttributes();
					ColorMap[] array = new ColorMap[2]
					{
						new ColorMap(),
						null
					};
					array[0].OldColor = Color.Black;
					ToolbarStyle styleResolved = toolbarsManager.StyleResolved;
					switch (styleResolved - 7)
					{
					case 0:
						array[0].NewColor = ScenicRibbonColorTable.Colors.RibbonQATGlyphLight;
						break;
					case 1:
						array[0].NewColor = Office2010ColorTable.Colors.RibbonQATGlyphLight;
						break;
					case 2:
						array[0].NewColor = Office2013ColorTable.Colors.RibbonQATGlyphLight;
						break;
					default:
						array[0].NewColor = Office2007ColorTable.Colors.RibbonQATGlyphLight;
						break;
					}
					array[1] = new ColorMap();
					array[1].OldColor = Color.White;
					array[1].NewColor = ((AppearanceData)(ref drawParams.AppearanceData)).ForeColor;
					imageAttributes.SetRemapTable(array);
					Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)this).Rect;
					Size size = image.Size;
					Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(rect.X + (rect.Width - size.Width) / 2, rect.Y + (rect.Height - size.Height) / 2, size.Width, size.Height);
					((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).DrawImage(image, rectangle, true, imageAttributes);
				}
			}
			((UIElement)this).DrawImage(ref drawParams);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter()
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave()
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave();
			QuickAccessToolbar quickAccessToolbar = ((base.Tool is QatQuickCustomizeTool qatQuickCustomizeTool) ? (qatQuickCustomizeTool.OwningToolbarInternal as QuickAccessToolbar) : null);
			if (quickAccessToolbar != null && quickAccessToolbar.Ribbon != null && quickAccessToolbar.Ribbon.AreTransitionsEnabled)
			{
				((UIElement)this).InitiateTransition(UltraToolbarsManager.DefaultTransitionSettings, (UIElementTransitionType)0);
			}
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseUp(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Button == MouseButtons.Right && QuickCustomizeTool != null && QuickCustomizeTool.Toolbar != null && !QuickCustomizeTool.Toolbar.ToolsHaveBeenBumped)
			{
				Control control = ((UIElement)this).Control;
				if (control != null && control.IsHandleCreated)
				{
					Point screenPoint = control.PointToScreen(new Point(e.X, e.Y));
					QuickCustomizeTool.ShowPopup(screenPoint);
					return false;
				}
			}
			return ((UIElement)this).OnMouseUp(e);
		}
	}

				}

			private PopupToolBase QuickCustomizeTool
			{
				get
				{
					UltraToolbarBase quickAccessToolbar = QuickAccessToolbar;
					if (quickAccessToolbar.ShowQuickCustomizeTool || quickAccessToolbar.ToolbarType == ToolbarType.QuickAccessToolbar)
					{
						return quickAccessToolbar.QuickCustomizeTool;
					}
					if (quickAccessToolbar.IsBumpedToolsToolbar)
					{
						UltraToolbarBase[] rootToolbars = quickAccessToolbar.RootToolbars;
						foreach (UltraToolbarBase ultraToolbarBase in rootToolbars)
						{
							if (ultraToolbarBase.ToolbarType != ToolbarType.QuickAccessToolbar)
							{
								continue;
							}
							ToolBase[] extraTools = quickAccessToolbar.ExtraTools;
							foreach (ToolBase toolBase in extraTools)
							{
								if (toolBase is QatCustomizeMenuTool result)
								{
									return result;
								}
							}
						}
					}
					return null;
				}
			}

					rectangle = uIElement.Control.RectangleToScreen(uIElement.Rect);
				}
				FragmentUIAProviderStub quickCustomizeToolStub = (FragmentUIAProviderStub)(object)QuickCustomizeToolStub;
				Rectangle rectangle2 = Rectangle.Empty;
				if (quickCustomizeToolStub != null)
				{
					rectangle2 = quickCustomizeToolStub.GetBoundingRectangle();
				}
				if (!rectangle2.IsEmpty && !rectangle.IsEmpty)
				{
					return Rectangle.Union(rectangle2, rectangle);
				}
				if (!rectangle2.IsEmpty)
				{
					return rectangle2;
				}
				if (!rectangle.IsEmpty)
				{
					return rectangle;
				}
				return Rectangle.Empty;
			}

					(FragmentUIAProviderStub)(object)QuickCustomizeToolStub
				};
			}

			protected override OrientationType GetOrientation()
			{
				return OrientationType.Horizontal;
			}

			public override IRawElementProviderFragment GetParent()
			{
				IProvideUIAutomation ribbon = (IProvideUIAutomation)(object)QuickAccessToolbar.Ribbon;
				if (ribbon == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ribbon.UIAutomationProvider;
			}

			public override IRawElementProviderFragmentRoot GetFragmentRoot()
			{
				IProvideUIAutomation dockArea = (IProvideUIAutomation)(object)DockArea;
				if (dockArea == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return dockArea.UIAutomationProvider as IRawElementProviderFragmentRoot;
			}

			internal IRawElementProviderFragment GetProviderFromPoint(Point clientPoint)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = UIElement;
				if (uIElement == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				UIElement val = uIElement.ElementFromPoint(clientPoint);
				if (val != null)
				{
					return GetProviderFromUIElement(val);
				}
				return null;
			}

			internal IRawElementProviderFragment GetProviderFromUIElement(UIElement elementUnderPoint)
			{
				if (elementUnderPoint.GetContext(typeof(ToolBase)) is ToolBase toolBase)
				{
					return ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)toolBase.AutomationProviderStub).Provider;
				}
				return null;
			}

			IRawElementProviderFragment IAutomationProviderFromPoint.AutomationProviderFromPoint(Point clientPoint)
			{
				return GetProviderFromPoint(clientPoint);
			}
		}

		internal class ContextMenuToolsEditor : UITypeEditor
		{
			public override UITypeEditorEditStyle GetEditStyle(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				return UITypeEditorEditStyle.Modal;
			}

			public override object EditValue(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IServiceProvider provider, object value)
			{
				if (provider != null)
				{
					IWindowsFormsEditorService windowsFormsEditorService = (IWindowsFormsEditorService)provider.GetService(typeof(IWindowsFormsEditorService));
					if (windowsFormsEditorService != null && value is ToolsCollection toolsCollection && toolsCollection.Owner is QuickAccessToolbar)
					{
						QuickAccessToolbar quickAccessToolbar = toolsCollection.Owner as QuickAccessToolbar;
						string[] array = quickAccessToolbar.ContextMenuToolKeys;
						if (array == null)
						{
							array = new string[0];
						}
						QatContextMenuToolsDialog dialog = new QatContextMenuToolsDialog(toolsCollection.ToolbarsManager);
						if (windowsFormsEditorService.ShowDialog(dialog) == DialogResult.Cancel)
						{
							quickAccessToolbar.ContextMenuToolKeys = array;
							quickAccessToolbar.LoadContextMenuTools();
						}
					}
				}
				return value;
			}
		}

				if (ContextMenuTools.Count > 0)

					array = new string[ContextMenuTools.Count];
					int i = 0;
					for (int count = ContextMenuTools.Count; i < count; i++)

						array[i] = ContextMenuTools[i].Key;
					}
				}
				return array;
			}
			set

				contextMenuToolKeys = value;
			}
		}

		}

		internal QuickAccessToolbar(Ribbon ribbon)
		{
			this.ribbon = ribbon;
		}

		protected QuickAccessToolbar(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "Settings":
					settings = (QuickAccessToolbarSettings)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(QuickAccessToolbarSettings), settings);
					break;
				case "Location":
					location = (QuickAccessToolbarLocation)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(QuickAccessToolbarLocation), location);
					break;
				case "Visible":
					visible = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), visible);
					break;
				case "ContextMenuToolKeys":
					contextMenuToolKeys = (string[])Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string[]), null);
					break;
				case "HiddenMergedContextMenuToolKeys":
					if (UltraToolbarsManager.UsingBinaryFormat)
					{
						hiddenMergedContextMenuToolKeys = (List<string>)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(List<string>), hiddenMergedContextMenuToolKeys);
					}
					else
					{
						hiddenMergedContextMenuToolKeys = new List<string>((string[])Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(List<string>), (hiddenMergedContextMenuToolKeys == null) ? hiddenMergedContextMenuToolKeys.ToArray() : null));
					}
					break;
				case "NonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys":
					if (UltraToolbarsManager.UsingBinaryFormat)
					{
						nonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys = (List<string>)Utils.DeserializeObjectProperty(current);
					}
					else
					{
						nonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys = new List<string>((string[])Utils.DeserializeObjectProperty(current));
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(AccessibleEvents accEvent, int childID)
		{
			Ribbon.RibbonContainer?.AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(accEvent, childID);
		}

		internal override UltraToolbarBase Clone()
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException("The Quick Access Toolbar can not be cloned.");
		}

		internal override void CloseOpenSubmenuTools(ToolBase excludeTool, bool delay)
		{
			if (qatCustomizeMenuTool != null && excludeTool != qatCustomizeMenuTool && qatCustomizeMenuTool.IsMenuAgentCreated)
			{
				qatCustomizeMenuTool.CloseDropDown(delay);
			}
			base.CloseOpenSubmenuTools(excludeTool, delay);
		}

		internal override QuickCustomizeToolBase CreateQuickCustomizeTool()
		{
			return new QatQuickCustomizeTool(this);
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		protected override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeSettings())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Settings", settings);
			}
			if (!visible)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Visible", visible);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeLocation())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Location", location);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeContextMenuToolKeys())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ContextMenuToolKeys", ContextMenuToolKeys);
			}
			if (hiddenMergedContextMenuToolKeys != null && hiddenMergedContextMenuToolKeys.Count > 0)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "HiddenMergedContextMenuToolKeys", UltraToolbarsManager.UsingBinaryFormat ? ((object)hiddenMergedContextMenuToolKeys) : ((object)hiddenMergedContextMenuToolKeys.ToArray()));
			}
			if (HasNonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys)
			{
				Utils.SerializeObjectProperty(info, "NonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys", UltraToolbarsManager.UsingBinaryFormat ? ((object)nonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys) : ((object)nonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys.ToArray()));
			}
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
		}

		internal override UltraToolbarBase[] GetToolbarPickerRootToolbars()
		{
			return new UltraToolbarBase[1] { this };
		}

		internal override void InitializeFrom(UltraToolbarBase toolbar)
		{
			base.InitializeFrom(toolbar);
			if (toolbar is QuickAccessToolbar quickAccessToolbar)
			{
				location = quickAccessToolbar.location;
				visible = quickAccessToolbar.visible;
			}
		}

		internal override void MergeMdiChildToolbar(UltraToolbarBase toolbar)
		{
			base.MergeMdiChildToolbar(toolbar);
			QuickAccessToolbar quickAccessToolbar = (QuickAccessToolbar)toolbar;
			if (HasContextMenuTools || quickAccessToolbar.HasContextMenuTools)
			{
				ContextMenuTools.MergeMdiChildTools(quickAccessToolbar.ContextMenuTools);
				SyncHiddenContextMenuToolKeys();
			}
		}

		internal override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
		{
			switch (navdir)
			{
			case AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild:
			case AccessibleNavigation.LastChild:
				return ribbon.RibbonContainer?.NavigateToolbar(this, navdir);
			case AccessibleNavigation.Up:
			case AccessibleNavigation.Down:
			case AccessibleNavigation.Left:
			case AccessibleNavigation.Right:
			case AccessibleNavigation.Next:
			case AccessibleNavigation.Previous:
				return Ribbon.Navigate(RibbonAccessibleChildItem.QAT, navdir);
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal override void OnBeforeToolRemovedFromCollection(ToolBase tool, ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
			base.OnBeforeToolRemovedFromCollection(tool, toolsCollection);
			Ribbon.Metrics.Dirty(Ribbon.RibbonMetricsFlags.QatSizeChanged);
			if (toolsCollection == base.Tools)
			{
				Ribbon.RibbonContainer?.RefreshDockAreaSize();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			base.OnDispose();
			if (settings != null)
			{
				settings.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				settings.Dispose();
				settings = null;
			}
			if (qatCustomizeMenuTool != null)
			{
				qatCustomizeMenuTool.Dispose();
				qatCustomizeMenuTool = null;
			}
			if (contextMenuTools != null)
			{
				contextMenuTools.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				contextMenuTools.Dispose();
				contextMenuTools = null;
			}
			ribbon = null;
			settingsResolved = null;
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			PropertyIds propertyIds;
			if (propChange.Source == settings)
			{
				propertyIds = PropertyIds.Settings;
			}
			else
			{
				if (propChange.Source != contextMenuTools)
				{
					base.OnSubObjectPropChanged(propChange);
					return;
				}
				propertyIds = PropertyIds.ContextMenuTools;
			}
			NotifyPropChange(propertyIds, propChange);
		}

		internal override void OnToolAddedToCollection(ToolBase tool, ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
			base.OnToolAddedToCollection(tool, toolsCollection);
			Ribbon.Metrics.Dirty(Ribbon.RibbonMetricsFlags.QatSizeChanged);
			if (tool is MdiMergePlaceholderTool && NonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys.Contains(tool.Key))
			{
				NonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys.Remove(tool.Key);
			}
			if (toolsCollection == base.Tools)
			{
				Ribbon.RibbonContainer?.RefreshDockAreaSize();
			}
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			ResetLocation();
			Visible = true;
			if (settings != null)
			{
				Settings.Reset();
			}
			base.Reset();
		}

		internal override void ResolveDefaultAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 1uL) != 0L)
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = Color.Transparent;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps ^ 1uL);
			}
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x4000000uL) != 0L)
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor2 = Color.Transparent;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps ^ 0x4000000uL);
			}
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x10000000uL) != 0L)
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackGradientStyle = (GradientStyle)1;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps ^ 0x10000000uL);
			}
		}

		public override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeContextMenuToolKeys() && !ShouldSerializeLocation() && !ShouldSerializeSettings())
			{
				return !Visible;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override INotificationBadgeSettingsOwner GetNotificationSettingsOwnerParent()
		{
			return (INotificationBadgeSettingsOwner)(object)Ribbon;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeContextMenuTools()
		{
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetContextMenuTools()
		{
			if (contextMenuTools != null)
			{
				contextMenuTools.Clear();
			}
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeContextMenuToolKeys()
		{
			if (contextMenuTools != null)
			{
				return contextMenuTools.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeLocation()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (location != QuickAccessToolbarLocation.AboveRibbon)
			{
				if (Ribbon != null && Ribbon.IsDesignMode && toolbarsManager != null)
				{
					return !toolbarsManager.EnforceOffice2007Resolution;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ResetLocation()
		{
			Location = QuickAccessToolbarLocation.AboveRibbon;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeSettings()
		{
			if (settings != null)
			{
				return settings.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetSettings()
		{
			if (settings != null)
			{
				settings.Reset();
			}
		}

		internal void AddQatMenuItems(MenuAgentBase menuAgent, ToolBase qatCustomizeTool)
		{
			QatCustomizeMenuTool qatCustomizeMenuTool = qatCustomizeTool as QatCustomizeMenuTool;
			menuAgent.MenuItems.Clear();
			if (qatCustomizeMenuTool == null && base.ToolsHaveBeenBumped)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (contextMenuTools != null)
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = ContextMenuTools.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase = contextMenuTools[i];
					if ((!toolBase.IsMdiMergeTool || toolBase.UnderlyingTool != null) && toolBase.SharedProps.Visible)
					{
						if (!flag)
						{
							menuAgent.MenuItems.Add(new QatCustomizeHeaderMenuItem(menuAgent));
							flag = true;
						}
						menuAgent.MenuItems.Add(new QatCustomizeToolMenuItem(toolBase));
					}
				}
			}
			bool isFirstInGroup = menuAgent.MenuItems.Count > 0;
			IRibbonCustomizationProvider ribbonCustomizationProvider = ((Ribbon != null) ? Ribbon.RibbonCustomizationProvider : null);
			if (ribbonCustomizationProvider != null && ribbonCustomizationProvider.AllowQATCustomizationResolved)
			{
				menuAgent.MenuItems.Add(new CustomizeQATMenuItem(isFirstInGroup: true, flag));
				isFirstInGroup = false;
			}
			menuAgent.MenuItems.Add(new QuickAccessToolbarPositionMenuItem(isFirstInGroup));
			if (ribbon != null && ribbon.TabItemAreaDisplayStyleResolved == TabItemAreaDisplayStyle.Visible)
			{
				menuAgent.MenuItems.Add(new MinimizeRibbonMenuItem(isFirstInGroup: false));
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public QuickAccessToolbarChangeType AddRemoveTool(ToolBase tool, int position)
		{
			base.Tools.VerifyUncustomizedToolsCached(onlyWhenCustomizing: false);
			ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollectionBase = (tool.IsOnQat ? tool.ParentCollection : base.Tools);
			bool synchronizeUnCustomizedTools = toolsCollectionBase.SynchronizeUnCustomizedTools;
			toolsCollectionBase.SynchronizeUnCustomizedTools = false;
			try
			{
				if (tool.IsOnQat)
				{
					tool.Delete();
					return QuickAccessToolbarChangeType.ToolRemoved;
				}
				if (position < 0 || position > base.Tools.Count)
				{
					base.Tools.Add(tool);
				}
				else
				{
					base.Tools.Insert(position, tool);
				}
				return QuickAccessToolbarChangeType.ToolAdded;
			}
			finally
			{
				toolsCollectionBase.SynchronizeUnCustomizedTools = synchronizeUnCustomizedTools;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool CanAddTool(ToolBase tool, ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
			return ((IToolsCollectionOwner)this).CanAddTool(tool, toolsCollection);
		}

		internal string GetKeyTipAtIndex(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			KeyTipManager keyTipManager = ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.KeyTipManager;
			int num = index + 1;
			for (int i = 1; i <= num && i < 10; i++)
			{
				char c = i.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture)[0];
				if (keyTipManager.IsReserved(c))
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			if (num <= 9)
			{
				return num.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
			}
			if (keyTipManager.IsReserved(0.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture)[0]))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (num <= 18)
			{
				return (19 - num).ToString("00", CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
			}
			char c2 = Convert.ToChar(65 + (num - 19));
			if (!char.IsLetter(c2))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return 0.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) + c2;
		}

		internal ToolBase GetNextTool(ToolBase startAtTool, bool visibleToolsOnly, bool selectableToolsOnly)
		{
			ToolBase toolBase = null;
			if (base.Tools.Count > 0)
			{
				toolBase = base.Tools.GetNextTool(startAtTool, visibleToolsOnly, selectableToolsOnly, recentlyUsedToolsOnly: false, wrapAround: false);
			}
			if (toolBase == null && base.QuickCustomizeTool != null && !ShowQuickCustomizeTool)
			{
				if (startAtTool is QatQuickCustomizeTool)
				{
					startAtTool = null;
				}
				else if ((!visibleToolsOnly || base.QuickCustomizeTool.VisibleResolved) && (!selectableToolsOnly || (base.QuickCustomizeTool.EnabledResolved && base.QuickCustomizeTool.CanActivate)))
				{
					toolBase = base.QuickCustomizeTool;
				}
			}
			return toolBase;
		}

		internal ToolBase GetPreviousTool(ToolBase startAtTool, bool visibleToolsOnly, bool selectableToolsOnly)
		{
			ToolBase toolBase = null;
			if ((startAtTool == null || startAtTool.Index < 0) && base.QuickCustomizeTool != null && !ShowQuickCustomizeTool)
			{
				if (startAtTool == base.QuickCustomizeTool)
				{
					startAtTool = null;
				}
				else if ((!visibleToolsOnly || base.QuickCustomizeTool.VisibleResolved) && (!selectableToolsOnly || (base.QuickCustomizeTool.EnabledResolved && base.QuickCustomizeTool.CanActivate)))
				{
					toolBase = base.QuickCustomizeTool;
				}
			}
			if (toolBase == null && base.Tools.Count > 0)
			{
				toolBase = base.Tools.GetPreviousTool(startAtTool, visibleToolsOnly, selectableToolsOnly, recentlyUsedToolsOnly: false, wrapAround: false);
			}
			return toolBase;
		}

		internal ToolBase GetQatCustomizeMenuTool(UltraToolbar bumpedToolbar)
		{
			if (qatCustomizeMenuTool == null || qatCustomizeMenuTool.Owner != bumpedToolbar)
			{
				if (qatCustomizeMenuTool != null)
				{
					qatCustomizeMenuTool.Dispose();
				}
				qatCustomizeMenuTool = new QatCustomizeMenuTool(bumpedToolbar);
			}
			return qatCustomizeMenuTool;
		}

		internal void HookupAllSubObjects()
		{
			HookupTools();
			LoadContextMenuTools();
		}

		internal override void Initialize(object owner)
		{
			Ribbon ribbon = owner as Ribbon;
			this.ribbon = ribbon;
			base.Initialize(owner);
			if (settings != null)
			{
				settings.Initialize(this);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void InitializeFromQAT(QuickAccessToolbar src)
		{
			InitializeFrom(src);
			ResetTools();
			foreach (ToolBase tool in src.Tools)
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = null;
				if (tool is PopupRibbonGroupTool { UnderlyingGroup: var underlyingGroup })
				{
					if (underlyingGroup.Tab != null)
					{
						int num = Ribbon.Tabs.IndexOf(underlyingGroup.Tab.Key);
						if (num >= 0)
						{
							int num2 = Ribbon.Tabs[num].Groups.IndexOf(underlyingGroup.Key);
							if (num2 >= 0)
							{
								RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = Ribbon.Tabs[num].Groups[num2];
								if (!ribbonGroup.IsRootPopupGroupToolInQat)
								{
									ribbonGroup.AddToQuickAccessToolbar();
								}
								toolBase = base.Tools[ribbonGroup.GetPopupGroupKey()];
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					toolBase = base.Tools.InsertToolForRibbonCustomization(base.Tools.Count, tool, clone: true, null);
				}
				if (toolBase != null)
				{
					toolBase.CopyToolSettings(tool);
					toolBase.IsStockItem = tool.IsStockItem;
				}
			}
			if (HasNonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys)
			{
				NonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys.Clear();
			}
			if (src.HasNonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys)
			{
				NonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys.AddRange(src.NonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys.ToArray());
			}
			Settings.InitializeFrom(src.Settings);
		}

		internal bool IsMergedContextMenuToolHidden(ToolBase tool)
		{
			if (hiddenMergedContextMenuToolKeys == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return hiddenMergedContextMenuToolKeys.Contains(tool.Key);
		}

		internal void LoadContextMenuTools()
		{
			if (contextMenuToolKeys == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ContextMenuTools.ClearInternal();
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			contextMenuTools.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			string[] array = contextMenuToolKeys;
			foreach (string text in array)
			{
				int num = toolbarsManager.Tools.IndexOf(text);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					ContextMenuTools.AddTool(text);
					continue;
				}
				num = toolbarsManager.MergedTools.IndexOf(text);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase = toolbarsManager.MergedTools[num];
					ToolBase tool = toolBase.Clone(cloneNewInstance: true);
					ContextMenuTools.Add(tool);
				}
			}
			contextMenuTools.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			contextMenuToolKeys = null;
			SyncHiddenContextMenuToolKeys();
		}

		protected virtual void OnDeserialization(object sender)
		{
		}

		public void ResetState()
		{
			base.Tools.ResetCustomizations();
			if (base.UIElement != null)
			{
				base.UIElement.Parent.DirtyChildElements();
			}
		}

		internal void SetMergedContextMenuToolVisibility(ToolBase tool, bool visible)
		{
			if (visible)
			{
				if (hiddenMergedContextMenuToolKeys != null)
				{
					hiddenMergedContextMenuToolKeys.Remove(tool.Key);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (hiddenMergedContextMenuToolKeys == null)
				{
					hiddenMergedContextMenuToolKeys = new List<string>();
				}
				hiddenMergedContextMenuToolKeys.Add(tool.Key);
			}
			ToolbarsManager.DirtyAllElements();
			Ribbon.Metrics.Dirty(Ribbon.RibbonMetricsFlags.QatSizeChanged);
		}

		internal void SyncHiddenContextMenuToolKeys()
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			string[] array = ContextMenuToolKeys;
			if (array == null)
			{
				hiddenMergedContextMenuToolKeys = null;
				return;
			}
			string[] array2 = array;
			foreach (string item in array2)
			{
				if (base.Tools.Exists(item))
				{
					ToolBase toolBase = base.Tools[item];
					if (!toolBase.IsRootTool && !toolBase.VisibleResolved && (toolBase.UnderlyingToolRaw != null || (hiddenMergedContextMenuToolKeys != null && hiddenMergedContextMenuToolKeys.Contains(item))))
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
			}
			hiddenMergedContextMenuToolKeys = list;
		}

		void IDeserializationCallback.OnDeserialization(object sender)
		{
			if (settings != null)
			{
				settings.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			OnDeserialization(sender);
		}

		AllowDuplicates IToolsCollectionOwner.AllowDuplicateKeysInCollection(ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
			return AllowDuplicates.AllowMergePlaceholderDuplicates;
		}

		bool IToolsCollectionOwner.CloneToolsWhenAddedToCollection(ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
			return toolsCollection == base.Tools;
		}

		bool IToolsCollectionOwner.CanAddTool(ToolBase tool, ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
			if (toolsCollection == contextMenuTools)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return tool?.CanAddToQuickAccessToolbar ?? false;
		}

		void IToolsCollectionOwner.OnToolRemovedFromCollection(ToolBase tool, ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
			PopupRibbonGroupTool popupRibbonGroupTool = tool as PopupRibbonGroupTool;
			if (toolsCollection == base.Tools && popupRibbonGroupTool != null)
			{
				RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = popupRibbonGroupTool.Group;
				if (ribbonGroup != null && ribbonGroup.UnderlyingGroup != null)
				{
					ribbonGroup.UnderlyingGroup.RemoveRootPopupGroupTool(onlyIfNotInQat: false);
				}
			}
			if (ToolbarsManager != null && ToolbarsManager.RibbonCustomizationInProgress)
			{
				base.Tools.CacheMdiMergeToolsPositionsAndOccurrences(base.Tools.CloneIntoList(), forceCaching: true);
				if (tool is MdiMergePlaceholderTool && !NonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys.Contains(tool.Key))
				{
					NonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys.Add(tool.Key);
				}
			}
		}
	}

		protected internal override AccessibleObject GetAccessibleChild(int index)
		{
			if (!base.IsOpen)
			{
				return null;
			}
			MenuAgentBase menuAgentBase = base.MenuAgent;
			if (menuAgentBase != null && menuAgentBase.BumpedToolsToolbar != null)
			{
				if (index >= 0 && index < menuAgentBase.BumpedToolsToolbar.Tools.Count)
				{
					return menuAgentBase.BumpedToolsToolbar.Tools[index].AccessibilityObject;
				}
				index -= menuAgentBase.BumpedToolsToolbar.Tools.Count;
			}
			if (menuAgentBase != null && menuAgentBase.BumpedToolsToolbar != null && index >= 0 && index < menuAgentBase.BumpedToolsToolbar.Tools.Count)
			{
				return menuAgentBase.MenuItems[index].AccessibilityObject;
			}
			return null;
		}

		{
			DirtyOwnerElements();
		}

		protected internal override void RefreshDropDownContents()
		{
			if (base.MenuAgent != null)
			{
				base.MenuAgent.ReInitialize();
			}
		}

		void IKeyTipContainer.Deactivate()
		{
			base.MenuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay: false, shouldHideAssociatedKeyTips: false);
		}

		IKeyTipProvider[] IKeyTipContainer.GetKeyTipProviders()
		{
			IKeyTipProvider[] array = new IKeyTipProvider[base.MenuAgent.BumpedToolsToolbar.Tools.Count];
			base.MenuAgent.BumpedToolsToolbar.Tools.CopyTo(array, 0);
			return array;
		}

		{
			if (typeof(RibbonGroupUIElement) == type || typeof(TaskPaneToolbarUIElement) == type)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (contexts != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < contexts.Length; i++)
				{
					if (contexts[i] is UltraToolbarBase)
					{
						UltraToolbarBase ultraToolbarBase = (UltraToolbarBase)contexts[i];
						if (!(ultraToolbarBase is QuickAccessToolbar))
						{
							return ultraToolbarBase is RibbonTabItemToolbar;
						}
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

				cancel = !base.ToolbarsManager.ExitEditMode();
				if (!cancel)

		}

			return popupMenuControl;
		}

		}

			{
				buttonUIElement.Invalidate(true);
			}
		}

		{
		}

		internal void DropDown()
		{
			Rectangle rectForButton = GetRectForButton();
			DropDown(rectForButton);
		}

		internal virtual void DropDown(Rectangle fileMenuButtonRect)
		{
			if (IsOpen || base.IsOpening)
			{
				CloseDropDown(delay: false);
				return;
			}
			if (!HasMenuItems(this))
			{
				base.MenuItems.Add(new RibbonDisplayOptionMenuItem(RibbonDisplayMode.AutoHide));
				if (ribbon != null && ribbon.TabItemAreaDisplayStyleResolved == TabItemAreaDisplayStyle.Visible)
				{
					base.MenuItems.Add(new RibbonDisplayOptionMenuItem(RibbonDisplayMode.TabsOnly));
				}
				base.MenuItems.Add(new RibbonDisplayOptionMenuItem(RibbonDisplayMode.Full));
			}
			Control ribbonContainer = (Control)(object)base.ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.RibbonContainer;
			if (ribbonContainer != null)
			{
				Rectangle exclusionRect = ribbonContainer.RectangleToScreen(fileMenuButtonRect);
				Point point = new Point(exclusionRect.Left, exclusionRect.Bottom);
				DropDown(ribbonContainer, point, exclusionRect, (DropDownPosition)0, delay: false, closeIfAlreadyOpen: true, alignRight: false, !base.ToolbarsManager.Customizing);
			}
		}

		internal Rectangle GetRectForButton()
		{
			Rectangle result = Rectangle.Empty;
			UIElement buttonUIElement = GetButtonUIElement();
			if (buttonUIElement != null)
			{
				result = buttonUIElement.Rect;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private UIElement GetButtonUIElement()
		{
			UIElement uIElement = base.ToolbarsManager.GetUIElement(typeof(RibbonCaptionAreaUIElement), null);
			if (uIElement != null)
			{
				return uIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(RibbonCaptionButtonUIElement), (object)SystemButtonId.RibbonDisplayOptions);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected RibbonGroupCollection(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.Value is RibbonGroup)
				{
					RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = (RibbonGroup)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(RibbonGroup), null);
					if (ribbonGroup != null)
					{
						List.Add(ribbonGroup);
					}
					continue;
				}
				string name = current.Name;
				if (!(name == "Count"))
				{
					if (name == "Tag")
					{
						DeserializeTag(current);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					initialCapacity = Math.Max(initialCapacity, (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), initialCapacity));
				}
			}
		}

		internal int AddGroupHelper(RibbonGroup group, int index, bool notify, bool validateKey)
		{
			if (group == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("group");
			}
			if (group.Tab != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("RibbonGroupBelongsToDifferentTab"));
			}
			if (validateKey)
			{
				ValidateKey(group.Key, null);
			}
			OnInserting(group);
			group.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			List.Insert(index, group);
			((IKeyedSubObject)group).OnAddedToCollection((KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase)this);
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = Tab.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager != null && toolbarsManager.Initialized)
			{
				group.HookupAllSubObjects();
			}
			OnInserted(group);
			if (notify)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.RibbonGroup);
			}
			return index;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			if (Count > 0)
			{
				RibbonGroup[] array = All as RibbonGroup[];
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					array[i].SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				InternalClear();
				for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
				{
					OnRemoved(array[j]);
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.RibbonTab);
			}
		}

			}

		protected virtual void OnDeserialization(object sender)
		{
		}

		internal virtual void OnInserting(RibbonGroup group)
		{
			if (group.ToolbarsManager != null && group.ToolbarsManager != Tab.ToolbarsManager)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ItemBelongsToDifferentToolbarsManager", "RibbonGroup"));
			}
		}

		internal virtual void OnInserted(RibbonGroup group)
		{
			BumpVersion();
			tab.Layout.InvalidateLayoutItems();
			if (tab.NonAutogenerateMergeGroupKeys.Contains(group.Key))
			{
				tab.NonAutogenerateMergeGroupKeys.Remove(group.Key);
			}
			group.SynchronizeRibbonCustomizationMergedKeys();
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = tab.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null || toolbarsManager.ActiveMdiChildManager == null || !group.HasTools)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ToolBase tool in group.Tools)
			{
				if (!tool.DelayUnderlyingToolHookup)
				{
					continue;
				}
				int num = toolbarsManager.ActiveMdiChildManager.Tools.IndexOf(tool.Key);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase = toolbarsManager.ActiveMdiChildManager.Tools[num];
					if (toolBase.UnderlyingToolTypeID == tool.UnderlyingToolTypeID)
					{
						tool.InternalSetUnderlyingTool(toolBase);
						tool.DelayUnderlyingToolHookup = false;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual void OnRemoved(RibbonGroup group)
		{
			BumpVersion();
			tab.Layout.InvalidateLayoutItems();
			RibbonTab ribbonTab = tab;
			if (ribbonTab.ToolbarsManager != null && ribbonTab.ToolbarsManager.RibbonCustomizationInProgress && !ribbonTab.NonAutogenerateMergeGroupKeys.Contains(group.Key))
			{
				ribbonTab.NonAutogenerateMergeGroupKeys.Add(group.Key);
			}
		}

		public void Remove(string key)
		{
			int index = IndexOf(key);
			RemoveAt(index);
		}

		public void Remove(RibbonGroup group)
		{
			int index = IndexOf(group);
			RemoveAt(index);
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = this[index];
			ribbonGroup.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			InternalRemoveAt(index);
			OnRemoved(ribbonGroup);
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.RibbonGroup);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, RibbonGroup group)
		{
			AddGroupHelper(group, index, notify: true, validateKey: true);
		}

		public RibbonGroup Insert(int index, string key)
		{
			ValidateKey(key, null);
			RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = new RibbonGroup(key);
			AddGroupHelper(ribbonGroup, index, notify: true, validateKey: false);
			return ribbonGroup;
		}

		public void InsertRange(int index, RibbonGroup[] groups)
		{
			if (groups == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("groups");
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < groups.Length; i++)
			{
				AddGroupHelper(groups[i], index + i, notify: false, validateKey: true);
			}
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.RibbonGroup);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public RibbonGroup InsertGroupInternal(int index, RibbonGroup group, bool clone, List<string> excludedToolKeys)
		{
			RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = (clone ? group.CloneForRibbonCustomization(excludedToolKeys) : group);
			index = AddGroupHelper(ribbonGroup, index, notify: false, validateKey: true);
			ribbonGroup = this[index];
			ribbonGroup.SynchronizeRibbonCustomizationMergedKeys();
			return ribbonGroup;
		}

		internal void Sort(IComparer comparer)
		{
			Utilities.SortMerge(List, comparer);
		}

		int IList.Add(object value)
		{
			int count = Count;
			((IList)this).Insert(count, value);
			return count;
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("value");
			}
			if (!(value is RibbonGroup ribbonGroup))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("InvalidArgumentType", "value", "RibbonGroup"));
			}
			Insert(index, ribbonGroup);
		}

		void IList.Remove(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("value");
			}
			if (!(value is RibbonGroup ribbonGroup))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("InvalidArgumentType", "value", "RibbonGroup"));
			}
			Remove(ribbonGroup);
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Count", Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, i.ToString(), this[i]);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				SerializeTag(info);
			}
			GetObjectData(info, context);
		}

		void IDeserializationCallback.OnDeserialization(object sender)
		{
			foreach (RibbonGroup item in (IEnumerable)this)
			{
				item.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				((IKeyedSubObject)item).OnAddedToCollection((KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase)this);
			}
			OnDeserialization(sender);
		}

		bool IList.Contains(object value)
		{
			return Contains(value);
		}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			//IL_0162: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Rectangle rectInsideBorders = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
			UIElementsCollection childElementsCollection = base.childElementsCollection;
			base.childElementsCollection = null;
			if (rectInsideBorders.Height <= 0 && rectInsideBorders.Width <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = Group;
			if (ribbonGroup == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Ribbon ribbon = ribbonGroup.Ribbon;
			if (ribbon != null)
			{
				int defaultGroupCaptionHeightWithBorders = ribbon.Metrics.DefaultGroupCaptionHeightWithBorders;
				Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)this).Rect;
				rect.Y = rect.Bottom - defaultGroupCaptionHeightWithBorders;
				rect.Height = defaultGroupCaptionHeightWithBorders;
				((UIElement)CaptionAreaElement).Rect = rect;
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)CaptionAreaElement);
				if ((ribbon.Style == RibbonStyle.Scenic || ribbon.Style == RibbonStyle.Office2013) && !Utilities.IsHighContrast && group.OwningPopupTool == null && !group.Layout.IsCollapsed)
				{
					Rectangle rect2 = new Rectangle(((UIElement)this).Rect.Right - 3, ((UIElement)this).Rect.Top + 5, 3, ((UIElement)this).Rect.Height - 10);
					((UIElement)SeparatorElement).Rect = rect2;
					((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)SeparatorElement);
				}
				else if (ribbon.Style == RibbonStyle.Office2010 && !Utilities.IsHighContrast && group.OwningPopupTool == null && !group.Layout.IsCollapsed)
				{
					UIElementBorderStyle borderStyle = (UIElementBorderStyle)1;
					int padding = 0;
					int groupSeparatorWidthOffice = Ribbon.RibbonMetrics.GetGroupSeparatorWidthOffice2010(out padding, out borderStyle);
					int num = groupSeparatorWidthOffice - padding + 1;
					Rectangle rect3 = new Rectangle(((UIElement)this).Rect.Right - num, ((UIElement)this).Rect.Top, num, ((UIElement)this).Rect.Height);
					((UIElement)Office2010SeparatorElement).Rect = rect3;
					((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)Office2010SeparatorElement);
				}
				rectInsideBorders.Height -= ribbon.Metrics.DefaultGroupCaptionHeight;
				group.LayoutItems(rectInsideBorders, this, (ArrayList)(object)childElementsCollection);
			}
		}

		protected override bool WantsInputNotification(UIElementInputType inputType, Point point)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (group != null)
			{
				return !group.PreventMouseInputNotification(inputType);
			}
			return false;
		}

		[PermissionSet(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Name = "linkcheck", Unrestricted = true)]
		public sealed class DialogBoxLauncherToolUITypeEditor : UITypeEditor
		{
			private IWindowsFormsEditorService edSvc;

			public override UITypeEditorEditStyle GetEditStyle(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				return UITypeEditorEditStyle.DropDown;
			}

			public override object EditValue(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IServiceProvider provider, object value)
			{
				if (context != null && context.Instance != null && provider != null)
				{
					edSvc = (IWindowsFormsEditorService)provider.GetService(typeof(IWindowsFormsEditorService));
					if (edSvc != null)
					{
						List<string> list = new List<string>();
						if (!(context.Instance is RibbonGroup { ToolbarsManager: var toolbarsManager } ribbonGroup))
						{
							return value;
						}
						if (toolbarsManager == null)
						{
							return value;
						}
						string text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NoneLiteral");
						list.Add(text);
						foreach (ToolBase tool in toolbarsManager.Tools)
						{
							if (tool is ButtonTool)
							{
								list.Add(tool.Key);
							}
						}
						object[] items = list.ToArray();
						object dialogBoxLauncherKey = ribbonGroup.DialogBoxLauncherKey;
						DropDownListBox dropDownListBox = new DropDownListBox(items, dialogBoxLauncherKey, sorted: true);
						dropDownListBox.Click += OnListClick;
						edSvc.DropDownControl(dropDownListBox);
						if (dropDownListBox.SelectedItem != null && dropDownListBox.WasItemClicked)
						{
							value = dropDownListBox.SelectedItem as string;
							if (value == text)
							{
								value = null;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				return value;
			}

			private void OnListClick(object sender, EventArgs e)
			{
				if (edSvc != null)
				{
					edSvc.CloseDropDown();
				}
			}
		}

		public class RibbonGroupAccessibleObject : AccessibleObjectWrapper
		{
			private RibbonGroup ribbonGroup;

			public override Rectangle Bounds
			{
				get
				{
					Rectangle empty = Rectangle.Empty;
					RibbonGroupUIElement ribbonGroupUIElement = RibbonGroupUIElement;
					if (ribbonGroupUIElement != null)
					{
						empty = ((UIElement)ribbonGroupUIElement).Rect;
						return ((UIElement)ribbonGroupUIElement).Control.RectangleToScreen(empty);
					}
					Control ribbonContainer = (Control)(object)ribbonGroup.Ribbon.RibbonContainer;
					if (ribbonContainer != null)
					{
						return Rectangle.Empty;
					}
					return ribbonContainer.RectangleToScreen(empty);
				}
			}

			public override string Name
			{
				get
				{
					string name = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name;
					if (name != null && name.Length > 0)
					{
						return name;
					}
					return ribbonGroup.Caption;
				}
				set
				{
					((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name = value;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Parent
			{
				get
				{
					if (ribbonGroup.owningPopupTool != null)
					{
						return ribbonGroup.owningPopupTool.AccessibilityObject;
					}
					if (ribbonGroup.Layout.IsCollapsed)
					{
						return ribbonGroup.RibbonGroupButtonAccessiblilityObject;
					}
					return ribbonGroup.Ribbon.RibbonGroupAreaAccessibilityObject;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleRole Role => AccessibleRole.ToolBar;

			public override AccessibleStates State
			{
				get
				{
					AccessibleStates accessibleStates = AccessibleStates.None;
					if (RibbonGroupUIElement == null)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Invisible;
					}
					return accessibleStates;
				}
			}

			protected internal RibbonGroup RibbonGroup => ribbonGroup;

			private RibbonGroupUIElement RibbonGroupUIElement => ribbonGroup.UIElement as RibbonGroupUIElement;

			private bool IsOnPopup
			{
				get
				{
					if (ribbonGroup.owningPopupTool == null)
					{
						return ribbonGroup.Layout.IsCollapsed;
					}
					return true;
				}
			}

			public RibbonGroupAccessibleObject(RibbonGroup ribbonGroup)
			{
				this.ribbonGroup = ribbonGroup;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
			{
				if (index < ribbonGroup.Tools.Count)
				{
					return ribbonGroup.Tools[index].AccessibilityObject;
				}
				index -= ribbonGroup.Tools.Count;
				if (index == 0 && ribbonGroup.DialogBoxLauncherTool != null)
				{
					return ribbonGroup.DialogBoxLauncherAccessiblilityObject;
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override int GetChildCount()
			{
				int num = 0;
				num = ribbonGroup.Tools.Count;
				if (ribbonGroup.DialogBoxLauncherTool != null)
				{
					num++;
				}
				return num;
			}

			protected override Control GetMarshallingControl()
			{
				return ribbonGroup.Ribbon.ToolbarsManager?.DockWithinContainer;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				switch (navdir)
				{
				case AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild:
					return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).GetChild(0);
				case AccessibleNavigation.LastChild:
				{
					int num4 = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).GetChildCount() - 1;
					if (num4 < 0)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).GetChild(num4);
				}
				default:
					if (IsOnPopup)
					{
						return null;
					}
					switch (navdir)
					{
					case AccessibleNavigation.Left:
					case AccessibleNavigation.Previous:
					{
						int num3 = this.ribbonGroup.Index - 1;
						if (num3 < 0)
						{
							return null;
						}
						RibbonGroup ribbonGroup2 = this.ribbonGroup.Tab.Groups[num3];
						if (ribbonGroup2.Layout.IsCollapsed)
						{
							return ribbonGroup2.RibbonGroupButtonAccessiblilityObject;
						}
						return ribbonGroup2.RibbonGroupAccessiblilityObject;
					}
					case AccessibleNavigation.Right:
					case AccessibleNavigation.Next:
					{
						int num = this.ribbonGroup.Tab.Groups.Count - 1;
						int num2 = this.ribbonGroup.Index + 1;
						if (num2 <= num)
						{
							RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = this.ribbonGroup.Tab.Groups[num2];
							if (ribbonGroup.Layout.IsCollapsed)
							{
								return ribbonGroup.RibbonGroupButtonAccessiblilityObject;
							}
							return ribbonGroup.RibbonGroupAccessiblilityObject;
						}
						return this.ribbonGroup.Ribbon.RibbonGroupAreaPagerButtonLeftAccessibilityObject;
					}
					default:
						return null;
					}
				}
			}
		}

			public override AccessibleStates State
			{
				get
				{
					AccessibleStates accessibleStates = AccessibleStates.None;
					accessibleStates = ((RibbonGroupButtonUIElement != null) ? (accessibleStates | AccessibleStates.Focusable) : (accessibleStates | AccessibleStates.Invisible));
					RibbonItem ribbonItem = null;
					ribbonItem = ((!base.RibbonGroup.Ribbon.IsMinimized_Legacy) ? base.RibbonGroup.Ribbon.ItemWithFocus : base.RibbonGroup.Ribbon.TabMenuAgent.ItemWithFocus);
					if (ribbonItem != null && ribbonItem.ItemType == RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDropDownButton && ribbonItem.Context == base.RibbonGroup)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Focused;
					}
					return accessibleStates;
				}
			}

			private RibbonGroupButtonUIElement RibbonGroupButtonUIElement => base.RibbonGroup.DropDownButtonUIElement as RibbonGroupButtonUIElement;

			public RibbonGroupButtonAccessibleObject(RibbonGroup ribbonGroup)
				: base(ribbonGroup)
			{
			}

			public override void DoDefaultAction()
			{
				base.RibbonGroup.OnGroupButtonClicked(RibbonGroupButtonUIElement);
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
			{
				if (index == 0 && base.RibbonGroup.IsGroupPopupOpen)
				{
					return base.RibbonGroup.RibbonGroupAccessiblilityObject;
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override int GetChildCount()
			{
				int num = 0;
				if (base.RibbonGroup.IsGroupPopupOpen)
				{
					num++;
				}
				return num;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				if (navdir == AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild || navdir == AccessibleNavigation.LastChild)
				{
					return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).GetChild(0);
				}
				return base.Navigate(navdir);
			}
		}

		public class DialogBoxLauncherAccessibleObject : AccessibleObjectWrapper
		{
			private RibbonGroup ribbonGroup;

			public override Rectangle Bounds
			{
				get
				{
					Rectangle empty = Rectangle.Empty;
					RibbonGroupDialogBoxLauncherUIElement ribbonGroupDialogBoxLauncherUIElement = RibbonGroupDialogBoxLauncherUIElement;
					if (ribbonGroupDialogBoxLauncherUIElement != null)
					{
						empty = ((UIElement)ribbonGroupDialogBoxLauncherUIElement).Rect;
						return ((UIElement)ribbonGroupDialogBoxLauncherUIElement).Control.RectangleToScreen(empty);
					}
					Control ribbonContainer = (Control)(object)ribbonGroup.Ribbon.RibbonContainer;
					if (ribbonContainer != null)
					{
						return Rectangle.Empty;
					}
					return ribbonContainer.RectangleToScreen(empty);
				}
			}

			public override string DefaultAction
			{
				get
				{
					if (Tool == null)
					{
						return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Description;
					}
					return Tool.DefaultActionInternal;
				}
			}

			public override string Description
			{
				get
				{
					ToolBase tool = Tool;
					if (tool == null)
					{
						return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Description;
					}
					string text = null;
					ToolBase underlyingTool = tool.UnderlyingTool;
					if (underlyingTool != null)
					{
						text = underlyingTool.SharedProps.AccessibleDescription;
						if (text != null && text.Length > 0)
						{
							return text;
						}
					}
					text = tool.ToolTipTextResolved;
					if (text != null && text.Length > 0)
					{
						return text;
					}
					return tool.CaptionAsToolTip;
				}
			}

			public override string KeyboardShortcut
			{
				get
				{
					if (Tool == null)
					{
						return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).KeyboardShortcut;
					}
					return Tool.KeyboardShortcut;
				}
			}

			public override string Name
			{
				get
				{
					if (Tool == null)
					{
						return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AccessibleName_DialogBoxLauncher");
					}
					string name = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name;
					if (name != null && name.Length > 0)
					{
						return name;
					}
					if (Tool.UnderlyingTool != null)
					{
						name = Tool.UnderlyingTool.SharedProps.AccessibleName;
						if (name != null && name.Length > 0)
						{
							return name;
						}
						if (Tool.UnderlyingTool is QuickCustomizeTool)
						{
							return Tool.ToolTipTextResolved;
						}
					}
					return Tool.CaptionAsToolTip;
				}
				set
				{
					((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name = value;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Parent => ribbonGroup.RibbonGroupAccessiblilityObject;

			public override AccessibleRole Role
			{
				get
				{
					if (Tool == null)
					{
						return AccessibleRole.PushButton;
					}
					return Tool.AccessibleRoleResolved;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleStates State
			{
				get
				{
					if (Tool == null)
					{
						return AccessibleStates.Unavailable | AccessibleStates.Invisible;
					}
					AccessibleStates accessibleStates = AccessibleStates.None;
					if (((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Bounds.Size.IsEmpty)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Invisible;
					}
					else if (Tool.EnabledResolved)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Focusable;
					}
					RibbonItem ribbonItem = null;
					ribbonItem = ((ribbonGroup.OwningPopupTool != null) ? ((RibbonGroupMenuAgent)ribbonGroup.OwningPopupTool.MenuAgent).ItemWithFocus : ((!ribbonGroup.Layout.IsCollapsed) ? ribbonGroup.Ribbon.ItemWithFocus : ribbonGroup.GroupMenuAgent.ItemWithFocus));
					if (ribbonItem != null && ribbonItem.ItemType == RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDialogBoxLauncher && ribbonItem.Context == ribbonGroup)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Focused;
					}
					AccessibleStates accessibleState = Tool.AccessibleState;
					if ((accessibleState & AccessibleStates.Checked) == AccessibleStates.Checked)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Checked;
					}
					return accessibleStates;
				}
			}

			public override string Value
			{
				get
				{
					if (Tool == null)
					{
						return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Value;
					}
					return Tool.AccessibleValue;
				}
				set
				{
					if (Tool == null)
					{
						((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Value = value;
					}
					else
					{
						Tool.AccessibleValue = value;
					}
				}
			}

			public ToolBase Tool => ribbonGroup.DialogBoxLauncherTool;

			private RibbonGroupUIElement RibbonGroupUIElement => ribbonGroup.UIElement as RibbonGroupUIElement;

			private RibbonGroupDialogBoxLauncherUIElement RibbonGroupDialogBoxLauncherUIElement
			{
				get
				{
					if (Tool == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					RibbonGroupUIElement ribbonGroupUIElement = RibbonGroupUIElement;
					if (ribbonGroupUIElement == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return ((UIElement)ribbonGroupUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(RibbonGroupDialogBoxLauncherUIElement)) as RibbonGroupDialogBoxLauncherUIElement;
				}
			}

			public DialogBoxLauncherAccessibleObject(RibbonGroup ribbonGroup)
			{
				this.ribbonGroup = ribbonGroup;
			}

			public override void DoDefaultAction()
			{
				if (Tool == null)
				{
					((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).DoDefaultAction();
				}
				else
				{
					Tool.DoDefaultActionInternal();
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
			{
				if (Tool == null)
				{
					return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).GetChild(index);
				}
				return Tool.GetAccessibleChild(index);
			}

			public override int GetChildCount()
			{
				if (Tool == null)
				{
					return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).GetChildCount();
				}
				return Tool.AccessibleChildCount;
			}

			protected override Control GetMarshallingControl()
			{
				return ribbonGroup.Ribbon.ToolbarsManager?.DockWithinContainer;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				if (navdir == AccessibleNavigation.Up || navdir == AccessibleNavigation.Previous)
				{
					int num = ribbonGroup.Tools.Count - 1;
					if (num < 0)
					{
						return null;
					}
					ToolBase toolBase = ribbonGroup.Tools[num];
					return toolBase.AccessibilityObject;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public RibbonGroup AttachedParentMdiGroup
		{
			get
			{
				if (cachedAttachedParentMdiGroup == null)
				{
					RibbonTab tab = Tab;
					if (tab == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					RibbonTab attachedParentTab = tab.AttachedParentTab;
					if (attachedParentTab == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					string text = KeyLowercaseInterned;
					foreach (RibbonGroup item in (IEnumerable)attachedParentTab.Groups)
					{
						if (item.KeyLowercaseInterned == text)
						{
							cachedAttachedParentMdiGroup = item;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				return cachedAttachedParentMdiGroup;
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_RibbonGroup_P_DialogBoxLauncherKey")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		[DefaultValue("")]
		[Editor(typeof(DialogBoxLauncherToolUITypeEditor), typeof(UITypeEditor))]
		public string DialogBoxLauncherKey
		{
			get
			{
				if (UnderlyingGroup != null)
				{
					return UnderlyingGroup.DialogBoxLauncherKey;
				}
				return dialogBoxLauncherKey;
			}
			set
			{
				if (UnderlyingGroup != null)
				{
					UnderlyingGroup.DialogBoxLauncherKey = value;
					return;
				}
				if (value == null)
				{
					value = string.Empty;
				}
				if (value != dialogBoxLauncherKey)
				{
					UnhookDialogBoxLauncherTool();
					dialogBoxLauncherKey = value;
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.DialogBoxLauncherKey);
				}
			}
		}

					((SubObjectBase)(object)notificationBadgeSettings).SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				return notificationBadgeSettings;
			}
			set
			{
				if (notificationBadgeSettings != value)
				{
					if (notificationBadgeSettings != null)
					{
						((SubObjectBase)(object)notificationBadgeSettings).SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					}
					notificationBadgeSettings = value;
					if (notificationBadgeSettings != null)
					{
						((SubObjectBase)(object)notificationBadgeSettings).SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					}
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.NotificationBadgeSettings);
				}
			}
		}

		internal ButtonTool DialogBoxLauncherTool
		{
			get
			{
				if (UnderlyingGroup != null)
				{
					return UnderlyingGroup.DialogBoxLauncherTool;
				}
				Ribbon ribbon = Ribbon;
				if (ribbon != null)
				{
					string dialogBoxLauncherKeyResolved = DialogBoxLauncherKeyResolved;
					ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollectionBase = ((dialogBoxLauncherKeyResolved == mergedDialogBoxLauncherKey) ? ((ToolsCollectionBase)ribbon.ToolbarsManager.MergedTools) : ((ToolsCollectionBase)ribbon.ToolbarsManager.Tools));
					if (lastDialogBoxLauncherVersion != toolsCollectionBase.Version)
					{
						if (dialogBoxLauncherTool == null || dialogBoxLauncherKeyResolved != dialogBoxLauncherTool.Key || dialogBoxLauncherTool.ToolbarsManager != ribbon.ToolbarsManager)
						{
							int num = toolsCollectionBase.IndexOf(dialogBoxLauncherKeyResolved);
							if (num >= 0)
							{
								UnhookDialogBoxLauncherTool();
								ToolBase toolBase = toolsCollectionBase[num];
								dialogBoxLauncherTool = toolBase.UnderlyingTool as ButtonTool;
								if (dialogBoxLauncherTool == null)
								{
									dialogBoxLauncherTool = toolBase as ButtonTool;
								}
								if (toolsCollectionBase is RootToolsCollection && dialogBoxLauncherTool != null && dialogBoxLauncherTool.IsHiddenByMdiMerge)
								{
									dialogBoxLauncherTool = null;
									mergedDialogBoxLauncherKey = dialogBoxLauncherKey;
									return DialogBoxLauncherTool;
								}
								HookDialogBoxLauncherTool();
							}
						}
						lastDialogBoxLauncherVersion = toolsCollectionBase.Version;
					}
				}
				return dialogBoxLauncherTool;
			}
		}

		internal bool AreTransitionsEnabled => Ribbon?.AreTransitionsEnabled ?? false;

		internal RibbonGroup(PopupRibbonGroupTool owner, RibbonGroup underlyingGroup)
			: base(null)

			owningPopupTool = owner;
			this.underlyingGroup = underlyingGroup;
		}

		protected RibbonGroup(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "Caption":
					caption = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), caption);
					break;
				case "DialogBoxLauncherKey":
					dialogBoxLauncherKey = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), dialogBoxLauncherKey);
					break;
				case "Settings":
					settings = (RibbonGroupSettings)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(RibbonGroupSettings), settings);
					break;
				case "Tools":
					tools = (ToolsCollection)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ToolsCollection), tools);
					break;
				case "Visible":
					visible = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), visible);
					break;
				case "LayoutDirection":
					layoutDirection = (RibbonGroupToolLayoutDirection)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(RibbonGroupToolLayoutDirection), layoutDirection);
					break;
				case "Key":
					Key = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), Key);
					break;
				case "Tag":
					DeserializeTag(current);
					break;
				case "PreferredToolSize":
					preferredToolSize = (RibbonToolSize)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(RibbonToolSize), preferredToolSize);
					break;
				case "KeyTip":
					keyTip = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), keyTip);
					break;
				case "LayoutAlignment":
					layoutAlignment = (RibbonGroupLayoutAlignment)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(RibbonGroupLayoutAlignment), layoutAlignment);
					break;
				case "MergeOrder":
					mergeOrder = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), mergeOrder);
					break;
				case "IsMdiMergeGroup":
					isMdiMergeGroup = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), isMdiMergeGroup);
					break;
				case "IsStockItem":
					IsStockItem = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), false);
					break;
				case "RibbonCustomizedCaptionImage":
					ribbonCustomizedCaptionImage = Utils.DeserializeObjectProperty(current);
					break;
				case "RibbonCustomizedCollapsedImage":
					ribbonCustomizedCollapsedImage = Utils.DeserializeObjectProperty(current);
					break;
				case "RibbonCustomizedStockCaptionImage":
					ribbonCustomizedStockCaptionImage = Utils.DeserializeObjectProperty(current);
					break;
				case "RibbonCustomizedStockCollapsedImage":
					ribbonCustomizedStockCollapsedImage = Utils.DeserializeObjectProperty(current);
					break;
				case "RibbonCustomizationMergedTabKey":
					ribbonCustomizationMergedTabKey = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), ribbonCustomizationMergedTabKey);
					break;
				case "RibbonCustomizationMergedGroupKey":
					ribbonCustomizationMergedGroupKey = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), ribbonCustomizationMergedGroupKey);
					break;
				case "NonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys":
					if (UltraToolbarsManager.UsingBinaryFormat)
					{
						nonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys = (List<string>)Utils.DeserializeObjectProperty(current);
					}
					else
					{
						nonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys = new List<string>((string[])Utils.DeserializeObjectProperty(current));
					}
					break;
				case "NotificationBadgeSettings":
					notificationBadgeSettings = (ToolNotificationBadgeSettings)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ToolNotificationBadgeSettings), null);
					((SubObjectBase)(object)notificationBadgeSettings).SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					break;
				}
			}
		}
