		public bool ShouldSerializeSettings()
		{
			if (UnderlyingGroup != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (settings != null && settings.Owner == this)
			{
				return settings.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ResetSettings()
		{
			if (UnderlyingGroup != null)
			{
				UnderlyingGroup.ResetSettings();
			}
			else if (settings != null)
			{
				settings.Reset();
			}
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeTools()
		{
			if (tools != null)
			{
				return tools.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ResetTools()
		{
			if (tools != null)
			{
				tools.Clear();
			}
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeNotificationBadgeSettings()
		{
			if (notificationBadgeSettings != null)
			{
				return ((NotificationBadgeSettings)notificationBadgeSettings).ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ResetNotificationBadgeSettings()
		{
			NotificationBadgeSettings = null;
		}

		internal void InitializeMdiMergeGroupFromChild(RibbonGroup group)
		{
			if (group.caption != null)
			{
				caption = group.caption;
			}
			if (!ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(group.dialogBoxLauncherKey))
			{
				dialogBoxLauncherKey = group.dialogBoxLauncherKey;
			}
			if (group.layoutAlignment != RibbonGroupLayoutAlignment.Default)
			{
				layoutAlignment = group.layoutAlignment;
			}
			if (group.layoutDirection != RibbonGroupToolLayoutDirection.Vertical)
			{
				layoutDirection = group.layoutDirection;
			}
			if (group.keyTip != null)
			{
				keyTip = group.keyTip;
			}
			if (group.preferredToolSize != RibbonToolSize.Default)
			{
				preferredToolSize = group.preferredToolSize;
			}
			if (group.ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				Tag = group.Tag;
			}
			if (!group.visible)
			{
				visible = group.visible;
			}
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeRibbonCustomizationMergedGroupKey()
		{
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(RibbonCustomizationMergedGroupKey);
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeRibbonCustomizationMergedTabKey()
		{
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(RibbonCustomizationMergedTabKey);
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeRibbonCustomizedStockCaptionImage()
		{
			return RibbonCustomizedStockCaptionImage != null;
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeRibbonCustomizedStockCollapsedImage()
		{
			return RibbonCustomizedStockCollapsedImage != null;
		}

		public void AddToQuickAccessToolbar()
		{
			if (OwningPopupTool != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CannotAddPopupRibbonGroupToQat"));
			}
			if (rootPopupGroupTool != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("RibbonGroupAlreadyInQat"));
			}
			if (Tab == null || Ribbon == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("RibbonGroupNotInRibbon"));
			}
			VerifyNotDisposed();
			PopupRibbonGroupTool rootPopupTool = GetRootPopupTool();
			Ribbon.QuickAccessToolbar.Tools.AddTool(rootPopupTool.Key);
		}

		public void BringIntoView()
		{
			if (Ribbon == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("RibbonGroup_NotAddedToRibbon"));
			}
			Ribbon.BringIntoView(this);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public RibbonGroup CloneForRibbonCustomization(List<string> excludedToolKeys)
		{
			RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = new RibbonGroup(Key);
			if (caption != null)
			{
				ribbonGroup.caption = caption;
			}
			if (!ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(dialogBoxLauncherKey))
			{
				ribbonGroup.dialogBoxLauncherKey = dialogBoxLauncherKey;
			}
			if (layoutAlignment != RibbonGroupLayoutAlignment.Default)
			{
				ribbonGroup.layoutAlignment = layoutAlignment;
			}
			if (layoutDirection != RibbonGroupToolLayoutDirection.Vertical)
			{
				ribbonGroup.layoutDirection = layoutDirection;
			}
			if (keyTip != null)
			{
				ribbonGroup.keyTip = keyTip;
			}
			if (preferredToolSize != RibbonToolSize.Default)
			{
				ribbonGroup.preferredToolSize = preferredToolSize;
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeSettings())
			{
				ribbonGroup.settings = (RibbonGroupSettings)settings.Clone(ribbonGroup);
				ribbonGroup.settings.SubObjectPropChanged += ribbonGroup.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeRibbonCustomizedCaptionImage())
			{
				if (ribbonCustomizedCaptionImage is string)
				{
					ribbonGroup.ribbonCustomizedCaptionImage = ((string)ribbonCustomizedCaptionImage).Clone();
				}
				else if (ribbonCustomizedCaptionImage is Image)
				{
					ribbonGroup.ribbonCustomizedCaptionImage = ((Image)ribbonCustomizedCaptionImage).Clone();
				}
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeRibbonCustomizedCollapsedImage())
			{
				if (ribbonCustomizedCollapsedImage is string)
				{
					ribbonGroup.ribbonCustomizedCollapsedImage = ((string)ribbonCustomizedCollapsedImage).Clone();
				}
				else if (ribbonCustomizedCollapsedImage is Image)
				{
					ribbonGroup.ribbonCustomizedCollapsedImage = ((Image)ribbonCustomizedCollapsedImage).Clone();
				}
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeRibbonCustomizedStockCaptionImage())
			{
				if (ribbonCustomizedStockCaptionImage is string)
				{
					ribbonGroup.ribbonCustomizedStockCaptionImage = ((string)ribbonCustomizedStockCaptionImage).Clone();
				}
				else if (ribbonCustomizedStockCaptionImage is Image)
				{
					ribbonGroup.ribbonCustomizedStockCaptionImage = ((Image)ribbonCustomizedStockCaptionImage).Clone();
				}
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeRibbonCustomizedStockCollapsedImage())
			{
				if (ribbonCustomizedStockCollapsedImage is string)
				{
					ribbonGroup.ribbonCustomizedStockCollapsedImage = ((string)ribbonCustomizedStockCollapsedImage).Clone();
				}
				else if (ribbonCustomizedStockCollapsedImage is Image)
				{
					ribbonGroup.ribbonCustomizedStockCollapsedImage = ((Image)ribbonCustomizedStockCollapsedImage).Clone();
				}
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				ribbonGroup.Tag = Tag;
			}
			if (!visible)
			{
				visible = ribbonGroup.visible;
			}
			if (HasTools)
			{
				foreach (ToolBase tool in tools)
				{
					if (excludedToolKeys == null || !excludedToolKeys.Contains(tool.Key))
					{
						ribbonGroup.Tools.InsertToolForRibbonCustomization(-1, tool, clone: true, excludedToolKeys);
					}
				}
			}
			ribbonGroup.isMdiMergeGroup = isMdiMergeGroup;
			ribbonGroup.underlyingGroup = underlyingGroup;
			ribbonGroup.underlyingMdiGroup = underlyingMdiGroup;
			return ribbonGroup;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void InsertIntoQuickAccessToolbar(int position)
		{
			if (OwningPopupTool != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CannotAddPopupRibbonGroupToQat"));
			}
			if (rootPopupGroupTool != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("RibbonGroupAlreadyInQat"));
			}
			if (Tab == null || Ribbon == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("RibbonGroupNotInRibbon"));
			}
			VerifyNotDisposed();
			PopupRibbonGroupTool rootPopupTool = GetRootPopupTool();
			Ribbon.QuickAccessToolbar.Tools.InsertTool(position, rootPopupTool.Key);
		}

		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (caption == null && (dialogBoxLauncherKey == null || dialogBoxLauncherKey.Length <= 0) && !ShouldSerializeTag() && !ShouldSerializeTools() && !ShouldSerializeSettings() && layoutDirection == RibbonGroupToolLayoutDirection.Vertical && preferredToolSize == RibbonToolSize.Default && keyTip == null && layoutAlignment == RibbonGroupLayoutAlignment.Default && preferredToolSize == RibbonToolSize.Default && mergeOrder == 0 && visible)
			{
				return ShouldSerializeNotificationBadgeSettings();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			Caption = null;
			DialogBoxLauncherKey = string.Empty;
			LayoutDirection = RibbonGroupToolLayoutDirection.Vertical;
			ResetTag();
			ResetTools();
			ResetSettings();
			KeyTip = null;
			LayoutAlignment = RibbonGroupLayoutAlignment.Default;
			PreferredToolSize = RibbonToolSize.Default;
			MergeOrder = 0;
			Visible = true;
			RibbonCustomizedCaptionImage = null;
			RibbonCustomizedCollapsedImage = null;
			ribbonCustomizedStockCaptionImage = null;
			ribbonCustomizedStockCollapsedImage = null;
			ResetNotificationBadgeSettings();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SynchronizeRibbonCustomizationMergedKeys()
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager != null && !ToolbarsManager.RibbonCustomizationInProgress)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (IsMdiMergeGroup && UnderlyingMdiGroup != null)
			{
				RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = UnderlyingMdiGroup;
				RibbonTab tab = ribbonGroup.Tab;
				ribbonCustomizationMergedGroupKey = ribbonGroup.KeyLowercaseInterned;
				if (tab != null)
				{
					ribbonCustomizationMergedTabKey = tab.Key;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ribbonCustomizationMergedGroupKey = null;
			}
		}

		internal Size CalculateCaptionSize(bool includeBorder)
		{
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Size result = CalculateCaptionSize();
			if (includeBorder)
			{
				UIElementBorderWidths val = (UIElementBorderWidths)(((??)Ribbon?.GetGroupBorderWidths()) ?? default(UIElementBorderWidths));
				result.Width += ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Left + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Right;
				result.Height += ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Bottom;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal void CloseAllOpenSubmenus(ToolBase excludeTool, bool delay)
		{
			foreach (ToolBase tool in Tools)
			{
				if (!tool.Equals(excludeTool) && tool.PopupTool != null)
				{
					PopupToolBase popupTool = tool.PopupTool;
					if (popupTool.IsMenuAgentCreated)
					{
						popupTool.MenuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		{

				GroupMenuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay: false);
			}
			CloseAllOpenSubmenus(null);
		}

		internal void DropDown(UIElement btnElement, SplitMonitorAction splitMonitorAction)
		{
			//IL_003d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0044: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0059: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_00d3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (btnElement == null || toolbarsManager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ControlUIElementBase controlElement = btnElement.ControlElement;
			Control control = ((controlElement != null) ? ((UIElement)controlElement).Control : null);
			if (control == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool rightAlignedMenusResolved = toolbarsManager.RightAlignedMenusResolved;
			Rectangle rect = btnElement.Rect;
			ToolbarStyle styleResolved = toolbarsManager.StyleResolved;
			switch (styleResolved - 7)
			{
			case 0:
			case 1:
			case 2:
			{
				UIElement ancestor = btnElement.GetAncestor(typeof(RibbonTabPageUIElement));
				if (ancestor != null)
				{
					rect.Height = ancestor.Rect.Bottom - rect.Top;
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			Rectangle exclusionRect = control.RectangleToScreen(rect);
			Point point = ((!rightAlignedMenusResolved) ? new Point(exclusionRect.X, exclusionRect.Bottom) : new Point(exclusionRect.Right, exclusionRect.Bottom));
			DropDown(control, point, exclusionRect, delay: false, closeIfAlreadyOpen: false, rightAlignedMenusResolved, autocloseDropdown: true, splitMonitorAction);
		}

		internal void DropDown(Control owningControl, Point point, Rectangle exclusionRect, bool delay, bool closeIfAlreadyOpen, bool alignRight, bool autocloseDropdown, SplitMonitorAction splitMonitorAction)

			}
		}

		internal int GetKeyTipCenterLine(int keyTipRow)
		{
			UIElement val = ((UIElement == null) ? DropDownButtonUIElement : UIElement);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			Rectangle rectangle = val.Control.RectangleToScreen(val.Rect);
			RibbonGroupCaptionAreaUIElement ribbonGroupCaptionAreaUIElement = (RibbonGroupCaptionAreaUIElement)(object)val.GetDescendant(typeof(RibbonGroupCaptionAreaUIElement));
			int num = 0;
			if (ribbonGroupCaptionAreaUIElement != null)
			{
				num = ((UIElement)ribbonGroupCaptionAreaUIElement).Rect.Height;
			}
			return keyTipRow switch
			{
				0 => rectangle.Top, 
				1 => rectangle.Top + (rectangle.Height - num) / 2, 
				2 => rectangle.Bottom - num, 
				3 => rectangle.Bottom + Infragistics.Win.UltraWinToolbars.KeyTip.GetKeyTipHeight(ToolbarsManager) / 2, 
				_ => rectangle.Bottom, 
			};
		}

		internal IKeyTipProvider[] GetKeyTipProviders()
		{
			IKeyTipProvider[] keyTipProviders = Tools.GetKeyTipProviders();
			int num = keyTipProviders.Length;
			ButtonTool buttonTool = DialogBoxLauncherTool;
			if (buttonTool != null)
			{
				num++;
			}
			IKeyTipProvider[] array = new IKeyTipProvider[num];
			int num2 = 0;
			keyTipProviders.CopyTo(array, num2);
			num2 += keyTipProviders.Length;
			if (buttonTool != null)
			{
				array[num2++] = new DialogBoxLauncherKeyTipProvider(buttonTool, this);
			}
			return array;
		}

		internal string GetPopupGroupKey()
		{
			if (Tab != null)
			{
				return "_PopupRibbonGroupTool.key_" + Tab.Key + "." + Key;
			}
			return "_PopupRibbonGroupTool.key_" + Key;
		}

		internal PopupRibbonGroupTool GetRootPopupTool()
		{
			if (rootPopupGroupTool == null && owningPopupTool == null && ToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				string popupGroupKey = GetPopupGroupKey();
				rootPopupGroupTool = new PopupRibbonGroupTool(popupGroupKey);
				rootPopupGroupTool.Initialize(this);
				ToolbarsManager.Tools.Add(rootPopupGroupTool);
			}
			return rootPopupGroupTool;
		}

		internal RibbonGroupLayoutItem GetCurrentToolLayout(bool onlyIfOpen)
		{
			if (OwningPopupTool != null)
			{
				if (onlyIfOpen && !OwningPopupTool.IsOpen && !OwningPopupTool.IsOpening)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ((RibbonGroupMenuAgent)OwningPopupTool.MenuAgent).GroupLayout;
			}
			if (Layout.IsCollapsed)
			{
				if (onlyIfOpen && !IsGroupPopupOpening && !IsGroupPopupOpen)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return GroupMenuAgent.GroupLayout;
			}
			return Layout;
		}

		internal void GetToolsThatMatchMnemonic(char charCode, List<IProcessMnemonic> toolsForThisMnemonic)
		{
			foreach (ToolBase tool in Tools)
			{
				if (tool.IsMnemonic(charCode))
				{
					toolsForThisMnemonic.Add(tool);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void HideContainedControls()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Tools.Count; i++)
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = Tools[i];
				ControlContainerTool controlContainerTool = toolBase as ControlContainerTool;
				if (controlContainerTool == null && toolBase != null)
				{
					controlContainerTool = toolBase.UnderlyingTool as ControlContainerTool;
				}
				if (controlContainerTool != null && (controlContainerTool == controlContainerTool.ToolWithContainedControl || controlContainerTool.ToolWithContainedControl == toolBase))
				{
					controlContainerTool.SetToolWithContainedControl(takeControlOwnership: false, null);
				}
			}
		}

		}

		}

		internal void Initialize()
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				if (tools != null)
				{
					tools.Initialize(this);
					tools.BumpVersion();
				}
				if (settings != null)
				{
					settings.Initialize(this);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InternalSetUnderlyingGroup(RibbonGroup underlyingMdiChildGroup)
		{
			if (underlyingMdiChildGroup != underlyingMdiGroup && (underlyingMdiChildGroup == null || underlyingMdiChildGroup.ToolbarsManager == ToolbarsManager.ActiveMdiChildManager))
			{
				UnhookUnderlyingMdiGroup();
				underlyingMdiGroup = underlyingMdiChildGroup;
				HookUnderlyingMdiGroup();
			}
		}

		internal void InvalidateElements()
		{
			UIElement uIElement = UIElement;
			if (uIElement != null)
			{
				uIElement.Invalidate(false);
			}
			if (!Layout.IsCollapsed)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager != null)
			{
				UIElement uIElement2 = toolbarsManager.GetUIElement(typeof(RibbonGroupButtonUIElement), this);
				if (uIElement2 != null)
				{
					uIElement2.DirtyChildElements();
				}
			}
		}

			}
		}

		internal bool IsInView(ToolBase tool)
		{
			if (OwningPopupTool != null && !OwningPopupTool.IsOpen)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Layout.IsCollapsed && GroupMenuAgent.IsOpen)
			{
				return false;

			return true;
		}

		internal bool IsMnemonic(char charCode)
		{
			if (!IsVisibleResolved)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Control.IsMnemonic(charCode, Caption);
		}

			{
				GroupMenuAgent.GroupLayout.LayoutContainer(rect, (UIElement)(object)element, oldElements);

			}
		}

		internal void MergeMdiChildGroup(RibbonGroup childGroup)
		{
			if (childGroup.ToolbarsManager == ToolbarsManager.ActiveMdiChildManager)
			{
				if (IsMdiMergeGroup)
				{
					InternalSetUnderlyingGroup(childGroup);
					DialogBoxLauncherKey = childGroup.DialogBoxLauncherKey;
				}
				if (HasTools || childGroup.HasTools)
				{
					Tools.MergeMdiChildTools(childGroup.Tools);
				}
				mergedDialogBoxLauncherKey = childGroup.dialogBoxLauncherKey;
				UnhookDialogBoxLauncherTool();
				if (childGroup.IsRootPopupGroupToolInQat && !IsRootPopupGroupToolInQat)
				{
					AddToQuickAccessToolbar();
					rootPopupGroupTool.SharedProps.MergeOrder = childGroup.rootPopupGroupTool.SharedProps.MergeOrder;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnGroupButtonClicked(RibbonGroupButtonUIElement buttonElement)
		{
			//IL_0030: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0040: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (IsGroupPopupOpen)
			{
				GroupMenuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay: false);
				return;
			}
			ControlUIElementBase controlElement = ((UIElement)buttonElement).ControlElement;
			BringIntoView();

			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			SplitMonitorAction val = (SplitMonitorAction)1;
			if (toolbarsManager != null)
			{
				val = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ResolveSplitMonitorAction(toolbarsManager.MultiMonitorDropDownBehavior, val);
			}
			DropDown(val);
		}

		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			switch (inputType - 5)

				if (ribbon == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;

				if (!ribbon.IsDesignMode && ribbon.AreTransitionsEnabled && !toolbarsManager.IsInResize && !ribbon.CanHotTrack(this))

			}

		}

		internal void SetNestedItemWithFocus(RibbonItem newItemWithFocus, bool bringIntoView)
		{
			if (Layout.IsCollapsed)
			{
				if (bringIntoView && !IsGroupPopupOpen)
				{
					BringIntoView();
					DropDown();
					if (!IsGroupPopupOpen)
					{
						Tab.SetNestedItemWithFocus(new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDropDownButton, this), bringIntoView);
						return;
					}
				}
				if (IsGroupPopupOpen)
				{
					GroupMenuAgent.ItemWithFocus = newItemWithFocus;
				}
				Tab.SetNestedItemWithFocus(new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDropDownButton, this), bringIntoView);
			}
			else if (OwningPopupTool != null)
			{
				RibbonGroupMenuAgent ribbonGroupMenuAgent = OwningPopupTool.MenuAgent as RibbonGroupMenuAgent;
				if (bringIntoView && !ribbonGroupMenuAgent.IsOpen)
				{
					OwningPopupTool.BringIntoView();
					OwningPopupTool.DropDown();
					_ = ribbonGroupMenuAgent.IsOpen;
				}
				ribbonGroupMenuAgent.ItemWithFocus = newItemWithFocus;
			}
			else
			{
				Tab.SetNestedItemWithFocus(newItemWithFocus, bringIntoView);
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyCanBeModified()
		{
			if (!CanBeModified)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_113"));
			}
		}

		private Size CalculateCaptionSize()
		{
			Ribbon ribbon = Ribbon;
			Size result;
			if (ribbon != null)
			{
				result = ribbon.CalculateGroupCaptionSize(this);
				result.Height = ribbon.Metrics.DefaultGroupCaptionHeight;
			}
			else
			{
				result = Size.Empty;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void ClearCachedMdiInfo()
		{
			cachedAttachedParentMdiGroup = null;
		}

		private void HookDialogBoxLauncherTool()
		{
			if (dialogBoxLauncherTool is StateButtonTool)
			{
				dialogBoxLauncherTool.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
		}

		private void HookUnderlyingMdiGroup()
		{
			if (underlyingMdiGroup != null)
			{
				InternalSetSettings(underlyingMdiGroup.Settings);
				underlyingMdiGroup.SubObjectPropChanged += UnderlyingRibbonGroupPropChangedHandler;
			}
		}

		private void InternalSetSettings(RibbonGroupSettings settings)
		{
			if (this.settings != null)
			{
				this.settings.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			this.settings = settings;
		}

		private void OnUnderlyingRibbonGroupPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo)
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager != null && ToolbarsManager.Initialized && propChangeInfo.Source is RibbonGroup ribbonGroup && propChangeInfo.PropId is PropertyIds)
			{
				switch ((PropertyIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId)
				{
				case PropertyIds.Caption:
					Caption = ribbonGroup.Caption;
					break;
				case PropertyIds.KeyTip:
					KeyTip = ribbonGroup.KeyTip;
					break;
				case PropertyIds.LayoutAlignment:
					LayoutAlignment = ribbonGroup.LayoutAlignment;
					break;
				case PropertyIds.LayoutDirection:
					LayoutDirection = ribbonGroup.LayoutDirection;
					break;
				case PropertyIds.PreferredToolSize:
					PreferredToolSize = ribbonGroup.PreferredToolSize;
					break;
				case PropertyIds.Visible:
					Visible = ribbonGroup.Visible;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UnhookDialogBoxLauncherTool()
		{
			if (dialogBoxLauncherTool is StateButtonTool)
			{
				dialogBoxLauncherTool.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if ((Ribbon == null || Ribbon.IsDesignMode) && dialogBoxLauncherTool != null)
			{
				dialogBoxLauncherKey = dialogBoxLauncherTool.Key;
			}
			dialogBoxLauncherTool = null;
			lastDialogBoxLauncherVersion = int.MinValue;
		}

		private void UnhookUnderlyingMdiGroup()
		{
			if (underlyingMdiGroup != null)
			{
				InternalSetSettings(null);
				underlyingMdiGroup.SubObjectPropChanged -= UnderlyingRibbonGroupPropChangedHandler;
				underlyingMdiGroup = null;
			}
		}

		private void SynchronizePopupGroupToolKey()
		{
			if (rootPopupGroupTool != null)
			{
				rootPopupGroupTool.Key = GetPopupGroupKey();
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		protected virtual void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnDeserialization(object sender)
		{
		}

		protected override void OnAddedToCollection(KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase primaryCollection)
		{
			if (primaryCollection is RibbonGroupCollection ribbonGroupCollection)
			{
				base.OnAddedToCollection(primaryCollection);
				parentCollection = ribbonGroupCollection;
				Initialize();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (tools != null)
			{
				tools.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				tools.Dispose();
			}
			if (HasSettings)
			{
				settings.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				settings.Dispose();
			}
			UnhookDialogBoxLauncherTool();
			RemoveRootPopupGroupTool(onlyIfNotInQat: false);
			if (groupMenuAgent != null)
			{
				groupMenuAgent.Dispose();
				groupMenuAgent = null;
			}
			parentCollection = null;
			settingsResolved = null;
			underlyingGroup = null;
			owningPopupTool = null;
			underlyingMdiGroup = null;
			if (notificationBadgeSettings != null)
			{
				((SubObjectBase)(object)notificationBadgeSettings).SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				((DisposableObject)(object)notificationBadgeSettings).Dispose();
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnRemovedFromCollection(KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase primaryCollection)
		{
			if (primaryCollection == parentCollection)
			{
				parentCollection = null;
				UnhookDialogBoxLauncherTool();
				RemoveRootPopupGroupTool(onlyIfNotInQat: false);
			}
			base.OnRemovedFromCollection(primaryCollection);
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (propChange.Source == dialogBoxLauncherTool)
			{
				if (PropertyIds.Checked.Equals(propChange.PropId))
				{
					UIElement uIElement = UIElement;
					if (uIElement != null)
					{
						uIElement.DirtyChildElements(true);
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo = propChange.FindTrigger(null);
			if (propChangeInfo.PropId is PropertyIds)
			{
				PropertyIds propertyIds = (PropertyIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId;
				if (propertyIds == PropertyIds.Tools || propertyIds == PropertyIds.CanCollapse)
				{
					InvalidateLayoutItems();
				}
			}
			PropertyIds propertyIds2 = ((propChange.Source == tools) ? PropertyIds.Tools : ((propChange.Source == settings) ? PropertyIds.Settings : ((notificationBadgeSettings != propChange.Source) ? ((PropertyIds)(-1)) : PropertyIds.NotificationBadgeSettings)));
			NotifyPropChange(propertyIds2, propChange);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"[ {Key} ] - {Caption}";
		}

		bool IToolsCollectionOwner.CollectionIsReadOnly(ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
			return false;
		}

		AllowDuplicates IToolsCollectionOwner.AllowDuplicateKeysInCollection(ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
			return AllowDuplicates.Always;
		}

		bool IToolsCollectionOwner.AllowEmptyKeysInCollection(ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
			return false;
		}

		bool IToolsCollectionOwner.CloneToolsWhenAddedToCollection(ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
			return true;
		}

		void IToolsCollectionOwner.OnToolAddedToCollection(ToolBase tool, ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
			InvalidateLayoutItems();
			if (ToolbarsManager != null && ToolbarsManager.RibbonCustomizationInProgress)
			{
				Tools.CacheMdiMergeToolsPositionsAndOccurrences(Tools.CloneIntoList(), forceCaching: true);
			}
			if (tool is MdiMergePlaceholderTool && NonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys.Contains(tool.Key))
			{
				NonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys.Remove(tool.Key);
			}
		}

		void IToolsCollectionOwner.OnBeforeToolRemovedFromCollection(ToolBase tool, ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
		}

		void IToolsCollectionOwner.OnToolRemovedFromCollection(ToolBase tool, ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
			tool.SetCurrentToolSize(null);
			InvalidateLayoutItems();
			if (ToolbarsManager != null && ToolbarsManager.RibbonCustomizationInProgress)
			{
				Tools.CacheMdiMergeToolsPositionsAndOccurrences(Tools.CloneIntoList(), forceCaching: true);
				if (tool is MdiMergePlaceholderTool && !NonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys.Contains(tool.Key))
				{
					NonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys.Add(tool.Key);
				}
			}
		}

		bool IToolsCollectionOwner.CanAddTool(ToolBase tool, ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
			return tool != null;
		}

		void IDeserializationCallback.OnDeserialization(object sender)
		{
			if (tools != null)
			{
				tools.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (settings != null)
			{
				settings.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			OnDeserialization(sender);
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			if (caption != null)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Caption", caption);
			}
			if (dialogBoxLauncherKey != null)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "DialogBoxLauncherKey", dialogBoxLauncherKey);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeTools())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Tools", tools);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeSettings())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Settings", settings);
			}
			if (!visible)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Visible", visible);
			}
			if (layoutDirection != RibbonGroupToolLayoutDirection.Vertical)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "LayoutDirection", layoutDirection);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeKey())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Key", Key);
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
			if (preferredToolSize != RibbonToolSize.Default)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "PreferredToolSize", preferredToolSize);
			}
			if (keyTip != null)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "KeyTip", keyTip);
			}
			if (layoutAlignment != RibbonGroupLayoutAlignment.Default)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "LayoutAlignment", layoutAlignment);
			}
			if (mergeOrder != 0)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MergeOrder", mergeOrder);
			}
			if (isMdiMergeGroup)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "IsMdiMergeGroup", isMdiMergeGroup);
			}
			if (isStockItem)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "IsStockItem", isStockItem);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeRibbonCustomizedCaptionImage())
			{
				Utils.SerializeObjectProperty(info, "RibbonCustomizedCaptionImage", RibbonCustomizedCaptionImage);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeRibbonCustomizedCollapsedImage())
			{
				Utils.SerializeObjectProperty(info, "RibbonCustomizedCollapsedImage", RibbonCustomizedCollapsedImage);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeRibbonCustomizedStockCaptionImage())
			{
				Utils.SerializeObjectProperty(info, "RibbonCustomizedStockCaptionImage", RibbonCustomizedStockCaptionImage);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeRibbonCustomizedStockCollapsedImage())
			{
				Utils.SerializeObjectProperty(info, "RibbonCustomizedStockCollapsedImage", RibbonCustomizedStockCollapsedImage);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeRibbonCustomizationMergedTabKey())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "RibbonCustomizationMergedTabKey", ribbonCustomizationMergedTabKey);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeRibbonCustomizationMergedGroupKey())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "RibbonCustomizationMergedGroupKey", ribbonCustomizationMergedGroupKey);
			}
			if (HasNonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys)
			{
				Utils.SerializeObjectProperty(info, "NonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys", UltraToolbarsManager.UsingBinaryFormat ? ((object)nonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys) : ((object)nonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys.ToArray()));
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeNotificationBadgeSettings())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "NotificationBadgeSettings", notificationBadgeSettings);
			}
			GetObjectData(info, context);
		}

		bool IKeyTipProvider.Activate()
		{
			DropDown();
			return GroupMenuAgent.IsOpen;
		}

		bool IKeyTipProvider.Equals(IKeyTipProvider provider)
		{
			return this == provider;
		}

		IKeyTipContainer IKeyTipProvider.GetContainer()
		{
			return this;
		}

		void IKeyTipContainer.Deactivate()
		{
			CloseAllPopups();
			Tab.SetNestedItemWithFocus(new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDropDownButton, this), bringIntoView: true);
		}

		IKeyTipProvider[] IKeyTipContainer.GetKeyTipProviders()
		{
			return GetKeyTipProviders();
		}
	}
	internal abstract class RibbonMenuItemBase : SpecialCommandMenuItemBase
	{
		private bool isFirstInGroup;

		protected internal override bool Enabled => ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.VisibleResolved;

		protected internal override bool IsFirstInGroup => isFirstInGroup;

		internal RibbonMenuItemBase(bool isFirstInGroup)
		{
			this.isFirstInGroup = isFirstInGroup;
		}

		internal override bool IsSameMenuItem(MenuItemBase menuItem)
		{
			if (menuItem is RibbonMenuItemBase ribbonMenuItemBase)
			{
				return ribbonMenuItemBase.GetType() == GetType();
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class QuickAccessToolbarPositionMenuItem : RibbonMenuItemBase
	{
		protected internal override string Text
		{
			get
			{
				if (ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.QuickAccessToolbar.Location == QuickAccessToolbarLocation.AboveRibbon)
				{
					if (base.MenuAgent is QatCustomizeMenuAgent || base.MenuAgent is QatQuickCustomizeMenuAgent)
					{
						return UltraToolbarsManager.CustomizeQatBelowRibbonLiteral;
					}
					return UltraToolbarsManager.QatBelowRibbonLiteral;
				}
				if (base.MenuAgent is QatCustomizeMenuAgent || base.MenuAgent is QatQuickCustomizeMenuAgent)
				{
					return UltraToolbarsManager.CustomizeQatAboveRibbonLiteral;
				}
				return UltraToolbarsManager.QatAboveRibbonLiteral;
			}
		}

		public override UIRole UIRole
		{
			get
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return StyleUtils.GetRole(toolbarsManager, StyleUtils.Role.MenuItemQatPosition);
			}
		}

		internal QuickAccessToolbarPositionMenuItem(bool isFirstInGroup)
			: base(isFirstInGroup)
		{
		}

		protected override UIElement GetMenuUIElement(UIElement parentElement, UIElement previousElement)
		{
			QuickAccessToolbarPositionUIElement quickAccessToolbarPositionUIElement = previousElement as QuickAccessToolbarPositionUIElement;
			if (quickAccessToolbarPositionUIElement == null)
			{
				quickAccessToolbarPositionUIElement = new QuickAccessToolbarPositionUIElement(parentElement, this);
			}
			quickAccessToolbarPositionUIElement.InitializeElement(this, parentElement);
			return (UIElement)(object)quickAccessToolbarPositionUIElement;
		}

		protected internal override Type GetMenuUIElementType()
		{
			return typeof(QuickAccessToolbarPositionUIElement);
		}

		protected internal override void OnClick()
		{
			ToolbarsManager.CloseAllOpenToolbarSubmenus();
			base.MenuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay: false);
			ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.ClearItemWithFocus();
			if (ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.QuickAccessToolbar.Location == QuickAccessToolbarLocation.AboveRibbon)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.QuickAccessToolbar.Location = QuickAccessToolbarLocation.BelowRibbon;
			}
			else
			{
				ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.QuickAccessToolbar.Location = QuickAccessToolbarLocation.AboveRibbon;
			}
			QuickAccessToolbarModifiedEventArgs e = new QuickAccessToolbarModifiedEventArgs(QuickAccessToolbarChangeType.Location);
			ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.QuickAccessToolbarModified, e);
		}
	}
	internal class QuickAccessToolbarAddRemoveMenuItem : RibbonMenuItemBase
	{
		private ToolBase tool;

		protected internal override bool Enabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Enabled && tool != null)
				{
					if (tool.IsOnQat)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (tool.CanAddToQuickAccessToolbar && !tool.IsSpecialTool && !ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.QuickAccessToolbar.Tools.Exists(tool.Key))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected internal override string Text
		{
			get
			{
				if (tool == null || !tool.IsOnQat)
				{
					if (tool is PopupGalleryTool)
					{
						return UltraToolbarsManager.AddGalleryToQatLiteral;
					}
					return UltraToolbarsManager.AddToQatLiteral;
				}
				return UltraToolbarsManager.RemoveFromQatLiteral;
			}
		}

		public override UIRole UIRole
		{
			get
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return StyleUtils.GetRole(toolbarsManager, StyleUtils.Role.MenuItemQatAddRemove);
			}
		}

		internal QuickAccessToolbarAddRemoveMenuItem(bool isFirstInGroup, ToolBase tool)
			: base(isFirstInGroup)
		{
			this.tool = tool;
		}

		protected override UIElement GetMenuUIElement(UIElement parentElement, UIElement previousElement)
		{
			QuickAccessToolbarAddRemoveUIElement quickAccessToolbarAddRemoveUIElement = previousElement as QuickAccessToolbarAddRemoveUIElement;
			if (quickAccessToolbarAddRemoveUIElement == null)
			{
				quickAccessToolbarAddRemoveUIElement = new QuickAccessToolbarAddRemoveUIElement(parentElement, this);
			}
			quickAccessToolbarAddRemoveUIElement.InitializeElement(this, parentElement);
			return (UIElement)(object)quickAccessToolbarAddRemoveUIElement;
		}

		protected internal override Type GetMenuUIElementType()
		{
			return typeof(QuickAccessToolbarAddRemoveUIElement);
		}

		protected internal override void OnClick()
		{
			ToolbarsManager.CloseAllOpenToolbarSubmenus();
			base.MenuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay: false);
			if (tool != null)
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager != null)
				{
					QuickAccessToolbarChangeType quickAccessToolbarChangeType = toolbarsManager.Ribbon.QuickAccessToolbar.AddRemoveTool(tool, -1);
					QuickAccessToolbarModifiedEventArgs e = new QuickAccessToolbarModifiedEventArgs(quickAccessToolbarChangeType, tool);
					toolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.QuickAccessToolbarModified, e);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	internal class QatCustomizeToolMenuItem : SpecialToolMenuItem
	{
		protected internal override bool CanDisplayToolTip => true;

		internal override bool CanSetToolWidth => false;

		protected internal override bool IsCheckedAsVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (!ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.QuickAccessToolbar.Tools.Exists(Tool.Key))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.QuickAccessToolbar.Tools[Tool.Key].IsVisible(considerBumpedStatus: false);
			}
		}

		protected internal override string ShortcutText => string.Empty;

		public override UIRole UIRole
		{
			get
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager != null)
				{
					return StyleUtils.GetRole(toolbarsManager, StyleUtils.Role.MenuItemQatCustomizeTool);
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal QatCustomizeToolMenuItem(ToolBase tool)
			: base(tool)
		{
		}

		protected internal override void DisplayToolTip()
		{
			string toolTipText = (IsCheckedAsVisible ? UltraToolbarsManager.RemoveFromQatLiteralToolTip : UltraToolbarsManager.AddToQatLiteralToolTip);
			if (ToolbarsManager.ImmediateToolTipDisplayMode)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.DisplayToolTip(toolTipText);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void OnClick()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			toolbarsManager.Ribbon.QuickAccessToolbar.Tools.VerifyUncustomizedToolsCached(onlyWhenCustomizing: false);
			QuickAccessToolbar quickAccessToolbar = ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.QuickAccessToolbar;
			int num = quickAccessToolbar.Tools.IndexOf(Tool.Key);
			quickAccessToolbar.CloseOpenSubmenuTools(null);
			toolbarsManager.Ribbon.ClearItemWithFocus();
			QuickAccessToolbarChangeType quickAccessToolbarChangeType;
			if (num >= 0 && quickAccessToolbar.Tools[num].IsVisible(considerBumpedStatus: false))
			{
				if (Tool.IsRootTool)
				{
					quickAccessToolbar.Tools.RemoveAt(num);
				}
				else
				{
					quickAccessToolbar.SetMergedContextMenuToolVisibility(Tool, visible: false);
				}
				quickAccessToolbarChangeType = QuickAccessToolbarChangeType.ToolRemoved;
			}
			else if (num >= 0 && quickAccessToolbar.Tools[num].ShouldSerializeRibbonCustomizedVisibility())
			{
				quickAccessToolbar.Tools[num].RibbonCustomizedVisibility = (DefaultableBoolean)0;
				quickAccessToolbarChangeType = QuickAccessToolbarChangeType.ToolAdded;
				toolbarsManager.Ribbon.DirtyAllMetrics();
			}
			else
			{
				if (Tool.IsRootTool)
				{
					quickAccessToolbar.Tools.AddTool(Tool.Key);
				}
				else
				{
					quickAccessToolbar.SetMergedContextMenuToolVisibility(Tool, visible: true);
				}
				quickAccessToolbarChangeType = QuickAccessToolbarChangeType.ToolAdded;
			}
			QuickAccessToolbarModifiedEventArgs e = new QuickAccessToolbarModifiedEventArgs(quickAccessToolbarChangeType, Tool);
			toolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.QuickAccessToolbarModified, e);
		}

		protected override NotificationBadgeSettingsResolved GetMenuItemNotificationBadgeSettingsResolved()
		{
			return null;
		}
	}
	internal class QatCustomizeHeaderMenuItem : MenuItemBase
	{
		protected internal override bool CanActivate => false;

		internal override bool IsLabelHeader => true;

		protected internal override string Text => UltraToolbarsManager.QatCustomizeHeader;

		public override UIRole UIRole
		{
			get
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager != null)
				{

		{

		private void DisplayToolTip()
		{
			if (!toolTipDisplayed && ToolbarsManager.ImmediateToolTipDisplayMode)
			{
				string closeWindowTooltip = ToolbarsManager.CloseWindowTooltip;
				if (closeWindowTooltip != null && closeWindowTooltip.Length > 0)
				{
					ToolbarsManager.DisplayToolTip(closeWindowTooltip);
					toolTipDisplayed = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private void HideToolTip()
		{
			if (toolTipDisplayed)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.HideToolTip();
				toolTipDisplayed = false;
			}
			ToolbarsManager.ImmediateToolTipDisplayMode = false;
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e, bool adjustableArea, ref UIElement captureMouseForElement)
		{
			if ((e.Button & MouseButtons.Right) == MouseButtons.Right)
			{
				if (ToolbarsManager.Customizing && ToolbarsManager.CustomizeDialog.ShouldDisplayToolbarList)
				{
					Point p = new Point(e.X, e.Y);
					Point screenPt = ((UIElement)this).Control.PointToScreen(p);
					ToolbarsManager.CustomizeDialog.DisplayToolbarList(screenPt);
					return true;
				}
				if (!ToolbarsManager.Customizing && !ToolbarsManager.IsDesignMode)
				{
					Point p2 = new Point(e.X, e.Y);
					ToolbarsManager.ShowToolbarListPopup(((UIElement)this).Control.PointToScreen(p2), null, null);
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (adjustableArea && (e.Button & MouseButtons.Left) == MouseButtons.Left)

				Point p3 = new Point(e.X, e.Y);
				resize = GetResizeBorder(new Point(e.X, e.Y));
				if (resize == (ResizeBorder)0)
				{
					return false;

		protected override void OnMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if ((object)((UIElement)this).ControlElement.ElementWithMouseCapture != this)
			{
				return;
			}
			Point mousePosition = Control.MousePosition;
			if (mousePosition == capturePointInScreenCoords)
			{
				return;
			}
			Size empty = Size.Empty;
			Rectangle bounds;
			switch (resize)
			{
			case ResizeBorder.Top:
				if (!(floatingToolbarWindow.Toolbar is UltraTaskPaneToolbar))
				{
					if (lastSizeDelta.Height > 0)
					{
						bounds = floatingToolbarWindow.Bounds;
						if (mousePosition.Y > bounds.Top && mousePosition.Y < bounds.Top + lastSizeDelta.Height + 4)
						{
							return;
						}
					}
					else if (lastSizeDelta.Height < 0)
					{
						bounds = floatingToolbarWindow.Bounds;
						if (mousePosition.Y > bounds.Top - (4 - lastSizeDelta.Height) && mousePosition.Y < bounds.Top)
						{
							return;
						}
					}
				}
				empty.Height = capturePointInScreenCoords.Y - mousePosition.Y;
				break;
			case ResizeBorder.Bottom:

				{
					if (lastSizeDelta.Height > 0)
					{
						bounds = floatingToolbarWindow.Bounds;
						if (mousePosition.Y < bounds.Bottom && mousePosition.Y > bounds.Bottom - (lastSizeDelta.Height + 4))
						{
							return;
						}
					}
					else if (lastSizeDelta.Height < 0)
					{
						bounds = floatingToolbarWindow.Bounds;
						if (mousePosition.Y > bounds.Bottom && mousePosition.Y < bounds.Bottom - (lastSizeDelta.Height + 4))
						{
							return;
						}
					}
				}
				empty.Height = mousePosition.Y - capturePointInScreenCoords.Y;
				break;
			case ResizeBorder.Left:

				break;
			case ResizeBorder.Right:

				break;

					empty.Width = mousePosition.X - capturePointInScreenCoords.X;
				}
				if ((resize & ResizeBorder.Top) != 0)
				{
					empty.Height = capturePointInScreenCoords.Y - mousePosition.Y;
				}
				else if ((resize & ResizeBorder.Bottom) != 0)
				{
					empty.Height = mousePosition.Y - capturePointInScreenCoords.Y;
				}
				break;

			{

			}

				newSize = size;
				newSize.Width += empty.Width;
				newSize.Height += empty.Height;
				newSize = ultraTaskPaneToolbar.EnforceFloatingSizeMinMax(size, newSize);
			}
			else
			{
				size = resizeMetrics.Size;
				ToolbarSettingsResolved settingsResolved = floatingToolbarWindow.Toolbar.SettingsResolved;
				size.Width -= settingsResolved.PaddingLeftResolved + settingsResolved.PaddingRightResolved;
				size.Height -= settingsResolved.PaddingTopResolved + settingsResolved.PaddingBottomResolved;
				resizeMetrics.CalculateFloatingMetrics(size, empty);

				size.Height += settingsResolved.PaddingTopResolved + settingsResolved.PaddingBottomResolved;

			}

			}

			{

			}
			else if ((resize & ResizeBorder.Left) != 0)
			{
				empty2.X = -empty3.Width;
				capturePointInScreenCoords.X += empty2.X;
			}
			if ((resize & ResizeBorder.Bottom) != 0)
			{
				capturePointInScreenCoords.Y += empty3.Height;
			}
			else if ((resize & ResizeBorder.Top) != 0)
			{
				empty2.Y = -empty3.Height;
				capturePointInScreenCoords.Y += empty2.Y;
			}
			bounds = floatingToolbarWindow.Bounds;
			bounds.X += empty2.X;
			bounds.Y += empty2.Y;
			bounds.Width += empty3.Width;
			bounds.Height += empty3.Height;

				bounds.X = bounds2.X;
			}
			else if ((resize & ResizeBorder.Left) != 0)
			{
				bounds.X = bounds2.Right - floatingToolbarWindow.Width;
			}
			if ((resize & ResizeBorder.Bottom) != 0)
			{
				bounds.Y = bounds2.Y;
			}
			else if ((resize & ResizeBorder.Top) != 0)
			{
				bounds.Y = bounds2.Bottom - floatingToolbarWindow.Height;
			}
			floatingToolbarWindow.Location = bounds.Location;
			floatingToolbarWindow.Update();
			ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.ToolbarModified, new ToolbarModifiedEventArgs(floatingToolbarWindow.Toolbar, ToolbarChangeType.Resized));
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseUp(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			resizeMetrics = null;
			if (floatingToolbarWindow != null && floatingToolbarWindow.Toolbar != null)
			{
				floatingToolbarWindow.Toolbar.OnResizeEnd();
			}
			return ((UIElement)this).OnMouseUp(e);
		}

		protected override bool OnPreMouseDown(ref MouseMessageInfo msgInfo)
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager != null && ToolbarsManager.IsDesignMode)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.EnsureComponentIsSelectedInDesigner();
			}
			return ((ControlUIElementBase)this).OnPreMouseDown(ref msgInfo);
		}

		public override bool PointInAdjustableArea(Point point)
		{
			ToolBase tearawayToolOwner = floatingToolbarWindow.Toolbar.TearawayToolOwner;
			if (tearawayToolOwner != null)
			{
				ToolBase underlyingTool = tearawayToolOwner.UnderlyingTool;
				if (underlyingTool is PopupControlContainerToolBase)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)this).Rect;
			if (point.Y <= rect.Top + 3 || point.Y >= rect.Bottom - 3)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (point.X <= rect.Left + 3 || point.X >= rect.Right - 3)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)this).Rect;
			((ArrayList)(object)((UIElement)this).ChildElements).Clear();
			if (floatingToolbarWindow != null && floatingToolbarWindow.Toolbar.ShowFloatingWindowCaption)
			{
				rect.Inflate(-3, -3);
				rect.Height = ToolbarsManager.FloatingToolbarCaptionHeight;
				((UIElement)CaptionArea).Rect = rect;
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)CaptionArea);
			}
		}

		private ResizeBorder GetResizeBorder(Point point)
		{
			Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)this).Rect;
			if (floatingToolbarWindow != null && floatingToolbarWindow.Toolbar is UltraTaskPaneToolbar)
			{
				bool flag = point.X <= rect.Left + 3;
				bool flag2 = !flag && point.X >= rect.Right - 3;
				bool flag3;
				bool flag4;
				if (flag || flag2)
				{
					flag3 = point.Y <= rect.Top + 10;
					flag4 = !flag3 && point.Y >= rect.Bottom - 10;
				}
				else
				{
					flag3 = point.Y <= rect.Top + 3;
					flag4 = !flag3 && point.Y >= rect.Bottom - 3;
					flag = point.X <= rect.Left + 10;
					flag2 = !flag && point.X >= rect.Right - 10;
				}
				ResizeBorder resizeBorder = (ResizeBorder)0;
				if (flag)
				{
					resizeBorder |= ResizeBorder.Left;
				}
				else if (flag2)
				{
					resizeBorder |= ResizeBorder.Right;
				}
				if (flag3)
				{
					resizeBorder |= ResizeBorder.Top;
				}
				else if (flag4)
				{
					resizeBorder |= ResizeBorder.Bottom;
				}
				return resizeBorder;
			}
			if (point.Y <= rect.Top + 3)
			{
				return ResizeBorder.Top;
			}
			if (point.Y >= rect.Bottom - 3)
			{
				return ResizeBorder.Bottom;
			}
			if (point.X <= rect.Left + 3)
			{
				return ResizeBorder.Left;
			}
			if (point.X >= rect.Right - 3)
			{
				return ResizeBorder.Right;
			}
			return (ResizeBorder)0;
		}
	}
	public class FloatingToolbarWindowBase : Form, IUltraControlElement, IOwnedForm
	{
		protected class FloatingToolbarWindowAccessibleObject : UltraControlAccessibleObject
		{
			private FloatingToolbarWindowBase floatingToolbarWindow;

			public override string Name
			{
				get
				{
					string name = ((ControlAccessibleObject)this).Name;
					if (name != null && name.Length > 0)
					{
						return name;
					}
					name = floatingToolbarWindow.Toolbar.AccessibleName;
					if (name != null && name.Length > 0)
					{
						return name;
					}
					return FloatingToolbarWindow.Toolbar.Text;
				}
				set
				{
					((ControlAccessibleObject)this).Name = value;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleRole Role
			{
				get
				{
					if (floatingToolbarWindow.AccessibleRole != AccessibleRole.Default)
					{
						return ((ControlAccessibleObject)this).Role;
					}
					return AccessibleRole.ToolBar;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleStates State
			{
				get
				{
					AccessibleStates accessibleStates = AccessibleStates.Moveable;
					if (!floatingToolbarWindow.Enabled)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Unavailable;
					}
					else if (floatingToolbarWindow.Visible)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Focusable;
						if (floatingToolbarWindow.ContainsFocus)
						{
							accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Focused;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Invisible;
					}
					if (((AccessibleObject)(object)this).Bounds.IsEmpty)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Offscreen;
					}
					return accessibleStates;
				}
			}

			public FloatingToolbarWindowBase FloatingToolbarWindow => floatingToolbarWindow;

			private bool HasQuickCustomizeToolUIElement => GetQuickCustomizeToolUIElement() != null;

			private bool HasFloatingToolbarCloseButtonUIElement => GetFloatingToolbarCloseButtonUIElement() != null;

			public FloatingToolbarWindowAccessibleObject(FloatingToolbarWindowBase floatingToolbarWindow)
				: base((Control)floatingToolbarWindow)
			{
				this.floatingToolbarWindow = floatingToolbarWindow;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
			{
				switch (index)
				{
				case 0:
				{
					UIElement floatingToolbarCloseButtonUIElement = GetQuickCustomizeToolUIElement();
					if (floatingToolbarCloseButtonUIElement != null)
					{
						return floatingToolbarCloseButtonUIElement.AccessibilityInstance;
					}
					floatingToolbarCloseButtonUIElement = GetFloatingToolbarCloseButtonUIElement();
					if (floatingToolbarCloseButtonUIElement != null)
					{
						return floatingToolbarCloseButtonUIElement.AccessibilityInstance;
					}
					return ((Control)(object)floatingToolbarWindow.DockArea).AccessibilityObject;
				}
				case 1:
					if (HasQuickCustomizeToolUIElement)
					{
						UIElement floatingToolbarCloseButtonUIElement = GetFloatingToolbarCloseButtonUIElement();
						if (floatingToolbarCloseButtonUIElement != null)
						{
							return floatingToolbarCloseButtonUIElement.AccessibilityInstance;
						}
						return ((Control)(object)floatingToolbarWindow.DockArea).AccessibilityObject;
					}
					if (HasFloatingToolbarCloseButtonUIElement)
					{
						return ((Control)(object)floatingToolbarWindow.DockArea).AccessibilityObject;
					}
					break;
				case 2:
					if (HasFloatingToolbarCloseButtonUIElement && HasQuickCustomizeToolUIElement)
					{
						return ((Control)(object)floatingToolbarWindow.DockArea).AccessibilityObject;
					}
					break;
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override int GetChildCount()
			{
				int num = 1;
				if (HasFloatingToolbarCloseButtonUIElement)
				{
					num++;
				}
				if (HasQuickCustomizeToolUIElement)
				{
					num++;
				}
				return num;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetFocused()
			{
				return ((UltraControlAccessibleObject)this).GetFocusedChildControl();
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetSelected()
			{
				return null;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject HitTest(int x, int y)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = (UIElement)(object)floatingToolbarWindow.UIElement;
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					Point p = new Point(x, y);
					p = FloatingToolbarWindow.PointToClient(p);
					UIElement val = uIElement.ElementFromPoint(p);
					if (val is QuickCustomizeToolUIElement)
					{
						return FloatingToolbarWindow.Toolbar.QuickCustomizeTool.AccessibilityObject;
					}
					if (val != null)
					{
						val = val.GetAncestor(typeof(QuickCustomizeToolUIElement));
						if (val != null)
						{
							return FloatingToolbarWindow.Toolbar.QuickCustomizeTool.AccessibilityObject;
						}
					}
				}
				AccessibleObject accessibleObject = ((UltraControlAccessibleObject)this).HitTest(x, y);
				if ((object)accessibleObject != this)
				{
					return accessibleObject;
				}
				if (uIElement == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return uIElement.HitTest(x, y);
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				return ((AccessibleObject)this).Navigate(navdir);
			}

			private UIElement GetQuickCustomizeToolUIElement()
			{
				UIElement uIElement = (UIElement)(object)floatingToolbarWindow.UIElement;
				if (uIElement == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return uIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(QuickCustomizeToolUIElement));
			}

			private UIElement GetFloatingToolbarCloseButtonUIElement()
			{
				UIElement uIElement = (UIElement)(object)floatingToolbarWindow.UIElement;
				if (uIElement == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return uIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(FloatingToolbarCloseButtonUIElement));
			}
		}

		internal const double MINIMUM_OPACITY = 0.31;

		internal const double FADE_OUT_DELTA = 0.02;

		internal const double FADE_IN_DELTA = 0.23;

		private Container components;

		private UltraToolbar toolbar;

		private UltraToolbarsDockArea dockArea;

		private System.Windows.Forms.Timer fadeTimer;

		private FloatingToolbarUIElement element;

		private bool isMouseOver;

		private bool isDraggingTranslucent;

		private int lastMouseDownTickCount;

		public override Cursor Cursor
		{
			get
			{
				if (UIElement != null)
				{
					Cursor currentCursor = ((ControlUIElementBase)UIElement).CurrentCursor;
					if (null != currentCursor)
					{
						return currentCursor;
					}
				}
				return base.Cursor;
			}
		}

		internal UltraToolbarsDockArea DockArea => dockArea;

		protected virtual bool IsFullTrust => false;

		public UltraToolbar Toolbar => toolbar;

		public UltraToolbarsManager ToolbarsManager => toolbar.ToolbarsManager;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public FloatingToolbarUIElement UIElement
		{
			get
			{
				if (element == null)
				{
					element = new FloatingToolbarUIElement(this);
				}
				return element;
			}
		}

		ControlUIElementBase IUltraControlElement.MainUIElement => (ControlUIElementBase)(object)UIElement;

		Control IOwnedForm.Owner
		{
			get
			{
				if (ToolbarsManager != null)
				{
					return ToolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal FloatingToolbarWindowBase(UltraToolbar toolbar)
		{
			if (toolbar == null)
			{
				throw new NullReferenceException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_4"));
			}
			if (toolbar.ToolbarsManager == null)
			{
				throw new NullReferenceException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_5"));
			}
			SuspendLayout();
			components = new Container();
			this.toolbar = toolbar;
			Font = UltraToolbarsManager.FloatingCaptionFont;
			if (toolbar.ToolbarsManager == null || !toolbar.ToolbarsManager.IsDesignMode)
			{
				SetStyle(ControlStyles.Selectable, value: false);
			}
			else
			{
				SetStyle(ControlStyles.Selectable, value: false);
			}
			SetStyle(ControlStyles.ContainerControl, value: true);
			SetStyle(ControlStyles.OptimizedDoubleBuffer, value: true);
			SetStyle(ControlStyles.ResizeRedraw, value: true);
			SetStyle(ControlStyles.UserMouse, value: true);
			SetStyle(ControlStyles.FixedHeight, value: true);
			SetStyle(ControlStyles.FixedWidth, value: true);
			SetStyle(ControlStyles.AllPaintingInWmPaint, value: true);
			base.ControlBox = false;
			base.FormBorderStyle = FormBorderStyle.None;
			base.HelpButton = false;
			base.MaximizeBox = false;
			base.MinimizeBox = false;
			base.ShowInTaskbar = false;
			base.TopLevel = true;
			base.Visible = false;
			if (!IsFullTrust)
			{
				MinimumSize = toolbar.GetMinimumFloatingSize();
			}
			SetWindowSize();
			base.Location = this.toolbar.ToolbarsManager.GetFloatingWindowLocation(this.toolbar);
			base.StartPosition = FormStartPosition.Manual;
			dockArea = new UltraToolbarsDockArea(DockedPosition.Floating);
			((Control)(object)dockArea).SuspendLayout();
			((Control)(object)dockArea).Name = "DockArea";
			dockArea.ToolbarsManager = this.toolbar.ToolbarsManager;
			SetDockPadding();
			base.Controls.Add((Control)(object)dockArea);
			Form form = this.toolbar.ToolbarsManager.FindForm();
			if (form != null)
			{
				Form mdiParent = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetMdiParent(form);
				if (mdiParent != null)
				{
					base.Owner = mdiParent;
				}
				else
				{
					base.Owner = form;
				}
			}
			Form owner = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetOwner(this);
			if (owner != null && owner.TopMost)
			{
				base.TopMost = true;
			}
			if (form == null)
			{
				Control dockWithinContainer = this.toolbar.ToolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer;
				if (WPFInteropUtilities.SetWindowAsOwner(dockWithinContainer, (Form)this))
				{
					base.TopMost = WPFInteropUtilities.IsControlOnTopMostWindow(dockWithinContainer);
				}
			}
			((Control)(object)dockArea).ResumeLayout(performLayout: false);
			ResumeLayout(performLayout: false);
			this.toolbar.ToolbarsManager.CheckFloatingToolbarFadeTimerState();
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				if (fadeTimer != null)
				{
					fadeTimer.Enabled = false;
					fadeTimer.Tick -= OnFadeTimer;
					fadeTimer.Dispose();
					fadeTimer = null;
				}
				if (components != null)
				{
					components.Dispose();
				}
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			int tickCount = Environment.TickCount;
			if (toolbar.ToolbarsManager.Customizing && tickCount - lastMouseDownTickCount <= SystemInformation.DoubleClickTime && ((UIElement)UIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(FloatingToolbarCaptionAreaUIElement)) is FloatingToolbarCaptionAreaUIElement floatingToolbarCaptionAreaUIElement && ((UIElement)floatingToolbarCaptionAreaUIElement).Contains(new Point(e.X, e.Y)))
			{
				floatingToolbarCaptionAreaUIElement.ProcessDoubleClick();
				return;
			}
			lastMouseDownTickCount = tickCount;
			if (!toolbar.ToolbarsManager.Customizing || !toolbar.ToolbarsManager.ProcessToolbarMouseDownWhileCustomizing((ControlUIElementBase)(object)UIElement, e))
			{
				MakeTopWindow();
				base.OnMouseDown(e);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
		}

		protected override void OnPaint(PaintEventArgs pe)
		{
			//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (UIElement != null && !((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)toolbar.ToolbarsManager).IsUpdating)
			{
				((UIElement)UIElement).Draw(pe.Graphics, pe.ClipRectangle, !GetStyle(ControlStyles.OptimizedDoubleBuffer), ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)toolbar.ToolbarsManager).AlphaBlendMode);
			}
			base.OnPaint(pe);
		}

		protected override AccessibleObject CreateAccessibilityInstance()
		{
			return (AccessibleObject)(object)new FloatingToolbarWindowAccessibleObject(this);
		}

		private void OnFadeTimer(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (isMouseOver)
			{
				base.Opacity = Math.Min(1.0, base.Opacity + 0.23);
				fadeTimer.Enabled = base.Opacity < 1.0;
			}
			else
			{
				base.Opacity = Math.Max(0.31, base.Opacity - 0.02);
				fadeTimer.Enabled = base.Opacity > 0.31;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnActivated(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnActivated(e);
			if (toolbar is UltraTaskPaneToolbar && ((UltraTaskPaneToolbar)toolbar).WasEnterInvokedForContentControl)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.OnTaskPaneContentControlEnter(toolbar as UltraTaskPaneToolbar);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDeactivate(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnDeactivate(e);
			if (Toolbar is UltraTaskPaneToolbar)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.InvalidateToolbar(((UltraTaskPaneToolbar)Toolbar).HeaderToolbar);
			}
			Form activeForm = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ActiveForm;
			if (activeForm == null || (activeForm.Owner != this && activeForm != this))
			{
				if (toolbar != null && toolbar.ToolbarsManager != null && toolbar == toolbar.ToolbarsManager.ToolbarWithCapture)
				{
					toolbar.ToolbarsManager.PerformExitEditModeTasks();
					toolbar.ToolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture = null;
					toolbar.ToolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(null, setOn: false, clearToolBeingEdited: true);
				}
				toolbar.ToolbarsManager.CheckActiveForm();
			}
		}

		private void SetDockPadding()
		{
			if (toolbar.ShowFloatingWindowCaption)
			{
				base.DockPadding.Top = ToolbarsManager.FloatingToolbarCaptionHeight + 2;
			}
			else
			{
				base.DockPadding.Top = 2;
			}
			base.DockPadding.Bottom = 2;
			base.DockPadding.Left = 3;
			base.DockPadding.Right = 3;
			base.DockPadding.Top++;
			base.DockPadding.Bottom++;
			base.DockPadding.Top--;
			base.DockPadding.Bottom--;
		}

		internal void DirtyChildElements()
		{
			((UIElement)UIElement).DirtyChildElements();
			DockArea.DirtyChildElements();
			SetWindowSize();
		}

		internal void ForwardMouseDownMessage(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			OnMouseDown(e);
		}

		internal void ForwardMouseEnter(EventArgs e)
		{
			OnMouseEnter(e);
		}

		internal void ForwardMouseLeave(EventArgs e)
		{
			OnMouseLeave(e);
		}

		internal void ForwardMouseMoveMessage(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			OnMouseMove(e);
		}

		internal void ForwardMouseUpMessage(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			OnMouseUp(e);
		}

		internal void MakeTopWindow()
		{
			if (!IsFullTrust)
			{
				base.TopMost = true;
				base.TopMost = false;
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				NativeWindowMethods.SetWindowPosApi(base.Handle, NativeWindowMethods.HWND_TOPMOST, base.Location.X, base.Location.Y, 0, 0, 17);
				NativeWindowMethods.SetWindowPosApi(base.Handle, NativeWindowMethods.HWND_NOTOPMOST, base.Location.X, base.Location.Y, 0, 0, 17);
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				base.TopMost = true;
				base.TopMost = false;
			}
		}

		internal void OnControlElementMouseEnter()
		{
			isMouseOver = true;
			OnFloatingToolbarFadeTimer();
		}

		internal void OnControlElementMouseLeave()
		{
			isMouseOver = false;
		}

		internal void OnFloatingToolbarFadeTimer()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = toolbar.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager.FloatingToolbarFadeDelay < 1 || !toolbarsManager.FloatingToolbarFadeTimer.Enabled || toolbar.IsAnyToolOpen)
			{
				base.Opacity = 1.0;
				return;
			}
			if (toolbarsManager.ToolBeingEdited != null && toolbarsManager.ToolBeingEdited.OwnerInternal == toolbar)
			{
				base.Opacity = 1.0;
				return;
			}
			if (toolbarsManager.FloatingWindowBeingDragged == this)
			{
				isDraggingTranslucent = true;
				base.Opacity = 0.31;
				return;
			}
			if (isDraggingTranslucent)
			{
				isDraggingTranslucent = false;
				base.Opacity = 1.0;
				return;
			}
			if (fadeTimer == null)
			{
				fadeTimer = Utilities.CreateTimer();
				fadeTimer.Tick += OnFadeTimer;
				fadeTimer.Interval = 50;
			}
			if (isMouseOver)
			{
				fadeTimer.Enabled = base.Opacity < 1.0;
			}
			else
			{
				fadeTimer.Enabled = base.Opacity > 0.31;
			}
		}

		internal void SetWindowSize()
		{
			if ((ToolbarsManager == null || !ToolbarsManager.IsMergingMdiChild) && toolbar.DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Floating && toolbar.VisibleResolved)
			{
				Size size = toolbar.CalculateFloatingWindowSize();
				toolbar.InternalSetFloatingSize(size);
				if (toolbar.ShowFloatingWindowCaption)
				{
					size.Height += ToolbarsManager.FloatingToolbarCaptionHeight;
				}
				size.Width += 4;
				if (!(toolbar is UltraTaskPaneToolbar))
				{
					size.Width += 2;
					size.Height += 2;
				}
				size.Height += 4;
				if (size != base.Size)
				{
					SetDockPadding();
					base.Size = size;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ShowNoActivate()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (!IsFullTrust)
			{
				base.Visible = true;
				toolbarsManager?.OnFloatingToolbarWindowShown(this);
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				NativeWindowMethods.SetWindowPosApi(base.Handle, IntPtr.Zero, base.Location.X, base.Location.Y, 0, 0, 17);
				NativeWindowMethods.ShowWindowApi(base.Handle, 8);
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				base.Visible = true;
			}
			toolbarsManager?.OnFloatingToolbarWindowShown(this);
		}
	}
	public sealed class FloatingToolbarWindow : FloatingToolbarWindowBase
	{
		private const int WM_MOUSEACTIVATE = 33;

		private const int MA_NOACTIVATE = 3;

		private const int MA_NOACTIVATEANDEAT = 4;

		protected override CreateParams CreateParams
		{
			[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode)]
			[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.InheritanceDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode)]
			get
			{
				CreateParams createParams = base.CreateParams;
				createParams.ExStyle |= 128;
				return createParams;
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsFullTrust => true;

		internal FloatingToolbarWindow(UltraToolbar toolbar)
			: base(toolbar)
		{
		}

		[UIPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Window = UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows)]
		protected override bool ProcessDialogKey(Keys keyData)
		{
			if (keyData == (Keys.F4 | Keys.Alt))
			{
				if (base.Owner != null)
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.CloseForm(base.Owner);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return base.ProcessDialogKey(keyData);
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, UnmanagedCode = true)]
		protected override void WndProc(ref Message m)
		{
			switch (m.Msg)
			{
			case 28:
				if (base.ToolbarsManager != null)
				{
					BeginInvoke(new MethodInvoker(base.ToolbarsManager.SyncAssociatedObjectsVisibleState));
				}
				break;
			case 33:
				m.Result = (IntPtr)3;
				return;
			case 36:
			{
				base.WndProc(ref m);
				NativeWindowMethods.MINMAXINFO mINMAXINFO = (NativeWindowMethods.MINMAXINFO)Marshal.PtrToStructure(m.LParam, typeof(NativeWindowMethods.MINMAXINFO));
				Size minimumFloatingSize = base.Toolbar.GetMinimumFloatingSize();
				mINMAXINFO.ptMinTrackSize = new NativeWindowMethods.POINT(minimumFloatingSize.Width, minimumFloatingSize.Height);
				Marshal.StructureToPtr((object)mINMAXINFO, m.LParam, fDeleteOld: true);
				m.Result = IntPtr.Zero;
				return;
			}
			}
			base.WndProc(ref m);
		}
	}

		public void AddRange(ICollection c)
		{
			if (c == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_17"));
			}
			if (c.Count < 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			FontListMruItem[] array = new FontListMruItem[c.Count];
			int num = 0;
			foreach (object item in c)
			{
				if (item == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_17"));
				}
				array[num] = new FontListMruItem(item.ToString());
				num++;
			}
			List.AddRange(array);
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.MruItems);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)

				{
					galleryToolMenuItem.Activate();

		}

		protected override bool OnMouseUp(MouseEventArgs e)

				}
				return SystemColors.ControlDarkDark;
			default:
				return SystemColors.ControlDark;
			}
		}

		internal string GetDisplayedRowsString()
		{
			GalleryPreviewInfo previewInfo = GalleryTool.PreviewInfo;
			if (previewInfo.FullyVisibleRows > 1)
			{
				return string.Format(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("GalleryPreviewButton_RowRange"), previewInfo.CurrentRow + 1, previewInfo.CurrentRow + previewInfo.FullyVisibleRows, previewInfo.TotalRows);
			}
			return string.Format(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("GalleryPreviewButton_Row"), previewInfo.CurrentRow + 1, previewInfo.TotalRows);
		}

		private void DisplayToolTip()
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager != null && !ToolbarsManager.Customizing && !toolTipDisplayed && ToolbarsManager.ImmediateToolTipDisplayMode)
			{
				string toolTipTextResolved = GalleryTool.ToolTipTextResolved;
				string toolTipTitle = ToolTipTitle;
				string toolTipTextFormattedResolved = GalleryTool.ToolTipTextFormattedResolved;
				Rectangle exclusionRect = Rectangle.Empty;
				Point point = Cursor.Position;
				point.Offset(0, 20);
				UIElement ancestor = ((UIElement)this).GetAncestor(typeof(RibbonAreaUIElement));
				if (ancestor == null)
				{
					ancestor = ((UIElement)this).GetAncestor(typeof(RibbonTabPageUIElement));
				}
				if (ancestor == null)
				{
					ancestor = ((UIElement)this).GetAncestor(typeof(RibbonGroupUIElement));
				}
				Control control = ((UIElement)this).Control;
				if (control != null && ancestor != null)
				{
					exclusionRect = control.RectangleToScreen(ancestor.Rect);
					point = control.PointToScreen(new Point(((UIElement)this).Rect.Left, ancestor.Rect.Bottom + 5));
				}
				if ((toolTipTextResolved != null && toolTipTextResolved.Length > 0) || (toolTipTitle != null && toolTipTitle.Length > 0) || (toolTipTextFormattedResolved != null && toolTipTextFormattedResolved.Length > 0))
				{
					ToolbarsManager.DisplayToolTipHelper(toolTipTextResolved, toolTipTitle, toolTipTextFormattedResolved, null, suppressShortcuts: true, exclusionRect, point);
					toolTipDisplayed = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private void HideToolTip()
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager != null && !ToolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				if (toolTipDisplayed)
				{
					ToolbarsManager.HideToolTip();
					toolTipDisplayed = false;
				}
				ToolbarsManager.ImmediateToolTipDisplayMode = false;
			}
		}

	internal class GalleryPreviewInfo : SubObjectBase
	{
		private PopupGalleryTool gallery;

		private GalleryToolItemKeysCollection items;

		private int availableColumns;

		private int availableHeight;

		private int currentRow;

		private int totalRows;

		private int firstVisibleItemIndex;

		private int fullyVisibleRows = 1;

		private GalleryToolItemCollection galleryItems;

		private int galleryItemsVersion = -1;

		private int galleryGroupsVersion = -1;

		private int galleryFiltersVersion = -1;

		private string gallerySelectedFilterKey;

		private ToolBase.ToolSizeInfo galleryToolSize;

		public int AvailableColumns
		{
			get
			{
				VerifyPreviewItems();
				return availableColumns;
			}
		}

		public int AvailableHeight
		{
			get
			{
				return availableHeight;
			}
			set
			{
				VerifyPreviewItems();
				if (availableHeight != value)
				{
					availableHeight = value;
					VerifyAvailableColumns(forceVerify: true);
					NotifyPropChange(GalleryPreviewInfoPropertyIds.AvailableHeight);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool CanScrollDown => CurrentRow + FullyVisibleRows < TotalRows;

		public bool CanScrollUp => CurrentRow > 0;

		public int CurrentRow
		{
			get
			{
				VerifyPreviewItems();
				return currentRow;
			}
			set
			{
				VerifyPreviewItems();
				if (value >= TotalRows)
				{
					value = TotalRows - 1;
				}
				if (value < 0)
				{
					value = 0;
				}
				if (currentRow != value)
				{
					currentRow = value;
					LayoutItems(maintainCurrentRow: true);
					NotifyPropChange(GalleryPreviewInfoPropertyIds.CurrentRow);
				}
			}
		}

		public int FirstVisibleItemIndex
		{
			get
			{
				VerifyPreviewItems();
				return firstVisibleItemIndex;
			}
		}

		public int FullyVisibleRows
		{
			get
			{
				VerifyPreviewItems();
				return fullyVisibleRows;
			}
		}

		public GalleryToolItemKeysCollection Items
		{
			get
			{
				VerifyPreviewItems();
				return items;
			}
		}

		public int TotalRows
		{
			get
			{
				VerifyPreviewItems();
				return totalRows;
			}
		}

		public GalleryPreviewInfo(PopupGalleryTool galleryInstance)
		{
			gallery = galleryInstance;
			if (galleryInstance.SharedProps.RootTool is PopupGalleryTool popupGalleryTool)
			{
				popupGalleryTool.SubObjectPropChanged += gallery_SubObjectPropChanged;
				items = new GalleryToolItemKeysCollection(popupGalleryTool);
				VerifyPreviewItems();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (items != null)
			{
				items.Dispose();
				items = null;
			}
			if (gallery.SharedProps.RootTool is PopupGalleryTool popupGalleryTool)
			{
				popupGalleryTool.SubObjectPropChanged -= gallery_SubObjectPropChanged;
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		internal void BringIntoView(GalleryToolItem item)
		{
			if (!items.Contains(item))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("BringIntoViewItemNotInPreview"));
			}
			VerifyPreviewItems();
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			foreach (GalleryToolItem item2 in (IEnumerable)items)
			{
				if (num > 0 && num + item2.ColumnSpan > availableColumns)
				{
					num2++;
					num = 0;
				}
				if (item2 == item)
				{
					BringIntoView(num2);
					break;
				}
				num += item2.ColumnSpan;
			}
		}

		internal int GetMaxColumnsInPreview()
		{
			VerifyPreviewItems();
			int num = 0;
			foreach (GalleryToolItem item in (IEnumerable)items)
			{
				num += item.ColumnSpan;
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal bool HasPreviewInfoChanged(ref int itemsVersion, ref int groupsVersion, ref int filtersVersion, ref string filterKey)
		{
			if (itemsVersion != galleryItemsVersion || groupsVersion != galleryGroupsVersion || filtersVersion != galleryFiltersVersion || filterKey != gallerySelectedFilterKey)
			{
				itemsVersion = galleryItemsVersion;
				groupsVersion = galleryGroupsVersion;
				filtersVersion = galleryFiltersVersion;
				filterKey = gallerySelectedFilterKey;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal GalleryToolItem NavigateFromItem(GalleryToolItem startItem, NavigationAction direction, bool wrapAround)
		{
			if (Items.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Items.NavigateFromItem(startItem, direction, wrapAround, AvailableColumns);
		}

		private void BringIntoView(int row)
		{
			if (row < CurrentRow)
			{
				CurrentRow = row;
			}
			else if (row >= CurrentRow + FullyVisibleRows)
			{
				CurrentRow = row - FullyVisibleRows + 1;
			}
		}

		private void LayoutItems(bool maintainCurrentRow)
		{
			if (VerifyAvailableColumns(forceVerify: false))
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = 0;
			int num4 = -1;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = items.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				GalleryToolItem galleryToolItem = items[i];
				num4++;
				if (num > 0 && num + galleryToolItem.ColumnSpan > availableColumns)
				{
					num3 = num4;
					num2++;
					num = 0;
				}
				if (maintainCurrentRow && currentRow == num2)
				{
					firstVisibleItemIndex = num3;
				}
				if (!maintainCurrentRow && num4 == firstVisibleItemIndex)
				{
					firstVisibleItemIndex = num3;
					currentRow = num2;
				}
				num += galleryToolItem.ColumnSpan;
			}
			totalRows = num2 + 1;
			int val = (availableHeight + gallery.ItemPadding.Bottom) / Math.Max(1, gallery.ItemSizeInPreviewResolved.Height + gallery.ItemPadding.Height);
			fullyVisibleRows = Math.Max(1, Math.Min(val, totalRows));
		}

		private void VerifyPreviewItems()
		{
			if (items == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			GalleryToolItemCollection galleryToolItemCollection = gallery.Items;
			int version = gallery.Items.Version;
			int version2 = gallery.Groups.Version;
			int version3 = gallery.GroupFilters.Version;
			string selectedGroupFilterKey = gallery.SelectedGroupFilterKey;
			if (galleryItems != galleryToolItemCollection || galleryItemsVersion != version || galleryGroupsVersion != version2 || galleryFiltersVersion != version3 || gallerySelectedFilterKey != selectedGroupFilterKey)
			{
				galleryItems = galleryToolItemCollection;
				galleryItemsVersion = version;
				galleryGroupsVersion = version2;
				galleryFiltersVersion = version3;
				gallerySelectedFilterKey = selectedGroupFilterKey;
				galleryToolSize = gallery.CurrentToolSizeInfo;
				items.Clear();
				foreach (GalleryToolItemGroup allVisibleGroup in gallery.GetAllVisibleGroups())
				{
					foreach (GalleryToolItem item in (IEnumerable)allVisibleGroup.Items)
					{
						if (!items.Exists(item.Key))
						{
							items.Add(item.Key);
						}
					}
				}
				LayoutItems(maintainCurrentRow: false);
			}
			else if (!object.Equals(galleryToolSize, gallery.CurrentToolSizeInfo))
			{
				galleryToolSize = gallery.CurrentToolSizeInfo;
				LayoutItems(maintainCurrentRow: false);
			}
		}

		private bool VerifyAvailableColumns(bool forceVerify)
		{
			if (gallery.CurrentToolSizeInfo is PopupGalleryTool.GalleryPreviewToolSizeInfo galleryPreviewToolSizeInfo && (forceVerify || galleryPreviewToolSizeInfo.PreviewColumns != availableColumns))
			{
				availableColumns = galleryPreviewToolSizeInfo.PreviewColumns;
				LayoutItems(maintainCurrentRow: false);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void gallery_SubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if ((propChange.PropId.Equals(PropertyIds.Items) || propChange.PropId.Equals(PropertyIds.Groups) || propChange.PropId.Equals(PropertyIds.GroupFilters) || propChange.PropId.Equals(PropertyIds.SelectedGroupFilter)) && gallery.PreviewUIElement != null)
			{
				gallery.PreviewUIElement.DirtyChildElements();
			}
			if (propChange.PropId.Equals(PropertyIds.ItemSizeInPreview))
			{
				VerifyAvailableColumns(forceVerify: true);
				if (gallery.PreviewUIElement != null)
				{
					gallery.PreviewUIElement.DirtyChildElements();
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal enum GalleryPreviewInfoPropertyIds
	{
		AvailableHeight,
		CurrentRow
	}

		{
			get
			{
				if (ToolbarsManager == null || !ToolbarsManager.Customizing || ToolbarsManager.CustomizeDialog == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return ToolbarsManager.CustomizeDialog.SelectedObject == this;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ToolbarsManager != null && ToolbarsManager.Customizing && ToolbarsManager.CustomizeDialog != null)
				{
					ToolbarsManager.CustomizeDialog.OnGalleryFilterClicked(Filter);
					((UIElement)base.UIElement.ControlElement).Invalidate();
					if (base.MenuAgent.OwningControlForDropDown is PopupGalleryControl popupGalleryControl)
					{
						((UIElement)popupGalleryControl.ControlElement).Invalidate();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool IsFirstInGroup => false;

		protected internal override bool IsOpen => false;

		protected internal override bool IsPopup => false;

		protected internal override bool RecentlyUsed => true;

		protected internal override string ShortcutText => string.Empty;

		protected internal override string Text => Filter.Text;
