			((GalleryToolFilterListMenuAgent)base.MenuAgent).GalleryTool.SelectedGroupFilter = Filter;
		}

		{

			}
			((GalleryToolFilterMenuItemUIElement)(object)previousElement).InitializeElement(this, parentElement);
			return previousElement;
		}

			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
			AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)65011720;
			ToolbarsManager.ResolvePopupAppearance(null, UIRole, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);

		protected internal override void ResolveAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, bool drawAsActive)
		{
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x10uL) != 0L)
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).TextHAlign = (HAlign)1;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEFuL);
			}
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x20uL) != 0L)
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).TextVAlign = (VAlign)2;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFDFuL);
			}
			ToolbarsManager.ResolvePopupItemAppearance(null, UIRole, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, drawAsActive, this);
		}

		protected GalleryToolItemCollection(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.Value is GalleryToolItem)
				{
					GalleryToolItem galleryToolItem = (GalleryToolItem)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(GalleryToolItem), null);
					if (galleryToolItem != null)
					{
						DeserializedItems.Add(galleryToolItem);
					}
					continue;
				}
				string name = current.Name;
				if (!(name == "Count"))
				{
					if (name == "Tag")
					{
						DeserializeTag(current);
					}
					continue;
				}
				int num = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), initialCapacity);
				initialCapacity = Math.Max(initialCapacity, num);
				if (num > 0 && deserializedItems == null)
				{
					deserializedItems = new List<GalleryToolItem>(num);
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Count", Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, i.ToString(), this[i]);
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
		}

		internal void Initialize(PopupGalleryTool galleryTool)
		{
			owner = galleryTool;
			foreach (GalleryToolItem deserializedItem in DeserializedItems)
			{
				InternalAdd(deserializedItem);
			}
		}

		internal void InternalAdd(int index, GalleryToolItem item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("item");
			}
			item.VerifyNotDisposed();
			item.VerifyNotOwned();
			version++;
			item.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			InternalInsert(index, item);
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Items);
		}

		internal void InternalClear(bool isDisposing)
		{
			version++;
			if (owner != null)
			{
				owner.ClearActiveItem(leftItemArea: false, GalleryArea.Preview);
			}
			foreach (GalleryToolItem item in (IEnumerable)this)
			{
				item.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				if (isDisposing)
				{
					item.Dispose();
				}
			}
			InternalClear();
			if (!isDisposing)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Items);
			}
		}

		internal void InternalRemove(GalleryToolItem item)
		{
			if (item != null)
			{
				version++;
				if (owner != null && owner.ActiveItem == item)
				{
					owner.ClearActiveItem(leftItemArea: false, GalleryArea.Preview);
				}
				InternalRemove((IKeyedSubObject)item);
				item.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				item.Dispose();
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Items);
			}
		}

		int IList.Add(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)

				throw new ArgumentNullException("value", "Can't add a null value to a Items collection");
			}
			if (!(value is GalleryToolItem item))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException($"Can't add a '{value.GetType().Name}' object to a Items collection");
			}
			return Add(item);
		}

		internal GalleryToolItemGroup FindFirstGroup(bool mustBeFilteredIn, bool mustHaveItems)
		{
			return FindGroup(0, 1, mustBeFilteredIn, mustHaveItems);
		}

		internal GalleryToolItemGroup FindGroup(int startIndex, int increment, bool mustBeFilteredIn, bool mustHaveItems)
		{
			if (increment == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("The search will never terminate with a zero increment", "increment");
			}
			if (Count == 0)
			{
				if (GalleryTool.DefaultGroup == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (mustHaveItems && GalleryTool.DefaultGroup.Items.Count == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (startIndex != 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return GalleryTool.DefaultGroup;
			}
			for (int i = startIndex; 0 <= i && i < Count; i += increment)
			{
				GalleryToolItemGroup galleryToolItemGroup = this[i];
				if ((!mustBeFilteredIn || galleryToolItemGroup.IsFilteredIn) && (!mustHaveItems || galleryToolItemGroup.Items.Count != 0))
				{
					return galleryToolItemGroup;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal GalleryToolItemGroup FindLastGroup(bool mustBeFilteredIn, bool mustHaveItems)
		{
			return FindGroup(Count - 1, -1, mustBeFilteredIn, mustHaveItems);
		}

		internal void HookupAllSubObjects()
		{
			foreach (GalleryToolItemGroup item in (IEnumerable<GalleryToolItemGroup>)this)
			{
				item.HookupAllSubObjects();
			}
		}

		internal void Initialize(PopupGalleryTool galleryTool)
		{
			owningGallery = galleryTool;
			foreach (GalleryToolItemGroup deserializedGroup in DeserializedGroups)
			{
				InternalAdd(deserializedGroup);
			}
		}

		internal void InternalAdd(int index, GalleryToolItemGroup group)
		{
			if (group == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("group");
			}
			group.VerifyNotDisposed();
			group.VerifyNotOwned();
			version++;
			group.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			InternalInsert(index, group);
			group.HookupAllSubObjects();
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Groups);
		}

		internal void InternalClear(bool isDisposing)
		{
			version++;
			foreach (GalleryToolItemGroup item in (IEnumerable<GalleryToolItemGroup>)this)
			{
				item.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				if (isDisposing)
				{
					item.Dispose();
				}
				else
				{
					item.UnhookAllSubObjects();
				}
			}
			InternalClear();
			if (!isDisposing)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Groups);
			}
		}

		internal void InternalRemove(GalleryToolItemGroup group)
		{
			if (group != null)
			{
				version++;
				InternalRemove((IKeyedSubObject)group);
				group.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				group.UnhookAllSubObjects();
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Groups);
			}
		}

		protected GalleryToolItemGroupFilter(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "AccessibleDescription":
					accessibleDescription = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), null);
					break;
				case "AccessibleName":
					accessibleName = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), null);
					break;
				case "Groups":
					groups = (GalleryToolItemGroupKeysCollection)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(GalleryToolItemGroupKeysCollection), null);
					break;
				case "Key":
					Key = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), null);
					break;
				case "Tag":
					DeserializeTag(current);
					break;
				case "Text":
					text = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), null);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		void IDeserializationCallback.OnDeserialization(object sender)
		{
			if (groups != null)
			{
				groups.Initialize(this);
				groups.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			OnDeserialization(sender);
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (groups != null)
			{
				groups.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				groups.Dispose();
				groups = null;
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnRemovedFromCollection(KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase collection)
		{
			base.OnRemovedFromCollection(collection);
			if (base.PrimaryCollection == collection)
			{
				Groups.Clear();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (groups != propChange.Source)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (propChange.PropId.Equals(PropertyIds.Groups) && isSelected)
			{
				PopupGalleryTool galleryTool = GalleryTool;
				if (galleryTool != null)
				{
					foreach (GalleryToolItemGroup item in (IEnumerable<GalleryToolItemGroup>)galleryTool.Groups)
					{
						item.SetIsFilteredInInternal(Groups.Contains(item));
					}
				}
			}
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Groups, propChange);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override bool ShouldSerializeKey()
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			bool flag = false;
			if (this.text != null && this.text.Length > 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(this.text);
				flag = true;
			}
			string text = Key;
			if (text != null && text.Length > 0)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(" - [");
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append("[");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(Key);
				stringBuilder.Append("]");
			}
			else
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(" ");
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

			if (ShouldSerializeText())

				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Text", text);
			}
		}

				if (current.Value is GalleryToolItemGroupFilter)

					GalleryToolItemGroupFilter galleryToolItemGroupFilter = (GalleryToolItemGroupFilter)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(GalleryToolItemGroupFilter), null);
					if (galleryToolItemGroupFilter != null)

			}

	[Editor(typeof(GalleryToolItemGroupKeysCollectionUITypeEditor), typeof(UITypeEditor))]
	public class GalleryToolItemGroupKeysCollection : KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase, ISerializable, IList, ICollection, IEnumerable, IEnumerable<GalleryToolItemGroup>
	{
		private class GalleryToolItemGroupKeysCollectionEnumerator : IEnumerator, IEnumerator<GalleryToolItemGroup>, IDisposable
		{
			private int position = -1;

			private GalleryToolItemGroupKeysCollection groups;

			object IEnumerator.Current => ((IEnumerator<GalleryToolItemGroup>)this).Current;

			GalleryToolItemGroup IEnumerator<GalleryToolItemGroup>.Current
			{
				get
				{
					groups.VerifyContents();
					return (GalleryToolItemGroup)groups.GetItem(position);
				}
			}

			public GalleryToolItemGroupKeysCollectionEnumerator(GalleryToolItemGroupKeysCollection groups)
			{
				this.groups = groups;
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				groups.VerifyContents();
				if (position < groups.Count - 1)
				{
					position++;
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				position = -1;
			}

			void IDisposable.Dispose()
			{
			}
		}

		public sealed class GalleryToolItemGroupKeysCollectionUITypeEditor : UITypeEditor
		{
			private ITypeDescriptorContext context;

			private bool ignoreChangedEvents;

			private bool ignoreChangingEvents;

			public override UITypeEditorEditStyle GetEditStyle(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				return UITypeEditorEditStyle.Modal;
			}

			public override object EditValue(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IServiceProvider provider, object value)
			{
				if (provider != null)
				{
					IWindowsFormsEditorService windowsFormsEditorService = (IWindowsFormsEditorService)provider.GetService(typeof(IWindowsFormsEditorService));
					if (windowsFormsEditorService == null)
					{
						return value;
					}
					this.context = context;
					if (!(value is GalleryToolItemGroupKeysCollection galleryToolItemGroupKeysCollection))
					{
						return value;
					}
					string[] array = new string[galleryToolItemGroupKeysCollection.Count];
					for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
					{
						array[i] = galleryToolItemGroupKeysCollection[i].Key;
					}
					GalleryToolItemGroupKeysCollectionEditorForm galleryToolItemGroupKeysCollectionEditorForm = new GalleryToolItemGroupKeysCollectionEditorForm(galleryToolItemGroupKeysCollection);
					bool flag = true;
					IComponentChangeService componentChangeService = null;
					try
					{
						if (this.context != null)
						{
							componentChangeService = (IComponentChangeService)this.context.GetService(typeof(IComponentChangeService));
							if (componentChangeService != null)
							{
								ignoreChangingEvents = false;
								ignoreChangedEvents = false;
								componentChangeService.ComponentChanged += OnComponentChanged;
								componentChangeService.ComponentChanging += OnComponentChanging;
							}
						}
						if (windowsFormsEditorService.ShowDialog(galleryToolItemGroupKeysCollectionEditorForm) == DialogResult.OK)
						{
							return value;
						}
						flag = false;
					}
					finally
					{
						if (!flag)
						{
							galleryToolItemGroupKeysCollection.Clear();
							galleryToolItemGroupKeysCollection.AddRange(array);
						}
						if (componentChangeService != null)
						{
							componentChangeService.ComponentChanged -= OnComponentChanged;
							componentChangeService.ComponentChanging -= OnComponentChanging;
						}
						galleryToolItemGroupKeysCollectionEditorForm.Dispose();
					}
				}
				return value;
			}

			private void OnComponentChanged(object sender, ComponentChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				if (!ignoreChangedEvents && sender != context.Instance)
				{
					ignoreChangedEvents = true;
					context.OnComponentChanged();
				}
			}

			private void OnComponentChanging(object sender, ComponentChangingEventArgs e)
			{
				if (!ignoreChangingEvents && sender != context.Instance)
				{
					ignoreChangingEvents = true;
					context.OnComponentChanging();
				}
			}
		}

		private List<string> groupKeys = new List<string>();

		private bool isHookedToGallery;

		private int lastGroupsVersion = -1;

		private GalleryToolItemGroupFilter owner;

		public override bool AllowDuplicateKeys => false;

		public override bool AllowEmptyKeys => false;

		public override int Count
		{
			get
			{
				VerifyContents();
				return base.Count;
			}
		}

		protected override int InitialCapacity => 5;

		public override bool IsReadOnly => false;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected override bool PreventSerialization => Count == 0;

		public GalleryToolItemGroup this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				VerifyContents();
				return (GalleryToolItemGroup)base.GetItem(index);
			}
		}

		public GalleryToolItemGroup this[string key]
		{
			get
			{
				VerifyContents();
				return (GalleryToolItemGroup)base.GetItem(key);
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public UltraToolbarsManager ToolbarsManager => owner.ParentCollection?.ToolbarsManager;

		internal PopupGalleryTool GalleryTool => owner.ParentCollection?.GalleryTool;

		bool IList.IsFixedSize => false;

		object IList.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return this[index];
			}
			set
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("Set not supported in GroupKeys collection");
			}
		}

		public GalleryToolItemGroupKeysCollection(GalleryToolItemGroupFilter owner)
		{
			Initialize(owner);
		}

		protected GalleryToolItemGroupKeysCollection(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.Value is string)
				{
					string text = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), null);
					if (text != null)
					{
						Add(text);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					string name = current.Name;
					if (name == "Tag")
					{
						DeserializeTag(current);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, i.ToString(), this[i].Key);
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			PopupGalleryTool galleryTool = owner.GalleryTool;
			if (isHookedToGallery && galleryTool != null)
			{
				isHookedToGallery = false;
			}
			InternalClear(notifyListeners: false, removeKeys: true);
			owner = null;
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			base.OnSubObjectPropChanged(propChange);
			if (propChange.PropId.Equals(NotifyId.Key) && propChange.Source is GalleryToolItemGroup galleryToolItemGroup)
			{
				int num = groupKeys.IndexOf(galleryToolItemGroup.LastKey);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					groupKeys.RemoveAt(num);
					groupKeys.Insert(num, galleryToolItemGroup.Key);
				}
			}
		}

		public GalleryToolItemGroup Add(string key)
		{
			if (isHookedToGallery)
			{
				GalleryToolItemGroup galleryToolItemGroup = owner.GalleryTool.Groups[key];
				if (galleryToolItemGroup != null)
				{
					InternalAdd(Count, galleryToolItemGroup);
					return galleryToolItemGroup;
				}
				throw new ArgumentException("An group with the specified key does not exist in the gallery.");
			}
			groupKeys.Add(key);
			return null;
		}

		public void AddRange(string[] keys)
		{
			foreach (string key in keys)
			{
				Add(key);
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			InternalClear(notifyListeners: true, removeKeys: true);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, string key)
		{
			if (isHookedToGallery)
			{
				GalleryToolItemGroup galleryToolItemGroup = owner.GalleryTool.Groups[key];
				if (galleryToolItemGroup == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("An item with the specified key does not exist in the gallery.");
				}
				InternalAdd(index, galleryToolItemGroup);
			}
			else
			{
				groupKeys.Insert(index, key);
			}
		}

		public void Remove(string key)
		{
			if (isHookedToGallery)
			{
				GalleryToolItemGroup galleryToolItemGroup = this[key];
				if (galleryToolItemGroup != null)
				{
					InternalRemove(galleryToolItemGroup);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				groupKeys.Remove(key);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			if (isHookedToGallery)
			{
				GalleryToolItemGroup galleryToolItemGroup = this[index];
				if (galleryToolItemGroup != null)
				{
					InternalRemove(galleryToolItemGroup);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				groupKeys.RemoveAt(index);
			}
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			ResetTag();
			Clear();
		}

		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				return Count > 0;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal GalleryToolItemGroupKeysCollection Clone(GalleryToolItemGroupFilter newFilter)
		{
			GalleryToolItemGroupKeysCollection galleryToolItemGroupKeysCollection = new GalleryToolItemGroupKeysCollection(newFilter);
			galleryToolItemGroupKeysCollection.isHookedToGallery = isHookedToGallery;
			if (isHookedToGallery)
			{
				{
					IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
					try
					{
						while (enumerator.MoveNext())
						{
							GalleryToolItemGroup galleryToolItemGroup = (GalleryToolItemGroup)enumerator.Current;
							galleryToolItemGroupKeysCollection.InternalAdd(Count, galleryToolItemGroup);
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
						if (disposable != null)
						{
							disposable.Dispose();
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				groupKeys = new List<string>(groupKeys);
			}
			return galleryToolItemGroupKeysCollection;
		}

		internal GalleryToolItemGroup FindFirstGroup(bool mustHaveItems)
		{
			return FindGroup(0, 1, mustHaveItems);
		}

		internal GalleryToolItemGroup FindGroup(int startIndex, int increment, bool mustHaveItems)
		{
			if (increment == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("The search will never terminate with a zero increment", "increment");
			}
			int i = startIndex;
			for (int count = Count; 0 <= i && i < count; i += increment)
			{
				GalleryToolItemGroup galleryToolItemGroup = this[i];
				if (!mustHaveItems || galleryToolItemGroup.Items.Count != 0)
				{
					return galleryToolItemGroup;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal GalleryToolItemGroup FindLastGroup(bool mustHaveItems)
		{
			return FindGroup(Count - 1, -1, mustHaveItems);
		}

		internal string[] GetKeys()
		{
			return groupKeys.ToArray();
		}

		internal void HookupAllSubObjects()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = GalleryTool.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager != null && toolbarsManager.Initialized && !isHookedToGallery)
			{
				isHookedToGallery = true;
				string[] keys = groupKeys.ToArray();
				groupKeys.Clear();
				AddRange(keys);
			}
		}

		internal void Initialize(GalleryToolItemGroupFilter owningFilter)
		{
			owner = owningFilter;
			PopupGalleryTool galleryTool = owner.GalleryTool;
			if (galleryTool != null)
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = galleryTool.ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager != null && toolbarsManager.Initialized)
				{
					isHookedToGallery = true;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InternalAdd(int index, GalleryToolItemGroup group)
		{
			group.VerifyNotDisposed();
			if (group == GalleryTool.DefaultGroup)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("The default group cannot be added to a group filter");
			}
			VerifyContents();
			group.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			InternalInsert(index, group);
			groupKeys.Insert(index, group.Key);
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Groups);
		}

		internal void InternalClear(bool notifyListeners, bool removeKeys)
		{
			if (notifyListeners)
			{
				VerifyContents();
			}
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					GalleryToolItemGroup galleryToolItemGroup = (GalleryToolItemGroup)enumerator.Current;
					galleryToolItemGroup.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			InternalClear();
			if (removeKeys)
			{
				groupKeys.Clear();
			}
			if (notifyListeners)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Groups);
			}
		}

		internal void InternalRemove(GalleryToolItemGroup group)
		{
			if (group != null)
			{
				VerifyContents();
				int num = IndexOf(group);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					InternalRemove((IKeyedSubObject)group);
					groupKeys.RemoveAt(num);
				}
				group.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Groups);
			}
		}

		internal void UnhookAllSubObjects()
		{
			if (isHookedToGallery)
			{
				isHookedToGallery = false;
				InternalClear(notifyListeners: false, removeKeys: false);
			}
		}

		private void VerifyContents()
		{
			PopupGalleryTool galleryTool = GalleryTool;
			if (galleryTool == null || galleryTool.Groups.Version == lastGroupsVersion)
			{
				return;
			}
			lastGroupsVersion = galleryTool.Groups.Version;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				GalleryToolItemGroup galleryToolItemGroup = base.GetItem(i) as GalleryToolItemGroup;
				if (galleryToolItemGroup.Disposed || !galleryTool.Groups.Contains(galleryToolItemGroup))
				{
					InternalRemoveAt(i);
					groupKeys.RemoveAt(i);
					i--;
				}
			}
		}

		int IList.Add(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("value", "Can't add a null value to a GroupKeys collection");
			}
			if (value is string key)
			{
				Add(key);
				return Count - 1;
			}
			if (!(value is GalleryToolItemGroup galleryToolItemGroup))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException($"Can't add a '{value.GetType().Name}' object to a GroupKeys collection");
			}
			Add(galleryToolItemGroup.Key);
			return Count - 1;
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("value", "Can't insert a null value into a GroupKeys collection");
			}
			if (value is string key)
			{
				Insert(index, key);
			}
			if (!(value is GalleryToolItemGroup galleryToolItemGroup))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException($"Can't insert a '{value.GetType().Name}' object to a GroupKeys collection");
			}
			Insert(index, galleryToolItemGroup.Key);
		}

		void IList.Remove(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("Can't remove a null value from a GroupKeys collection");
			}
			if (value is string key)
			{
				Remove(key);
			}
			if (!(value is GalleryToolItemGroup galleryToolItemGroup))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException($"Can't remove a '{value.GetType().Name}' object from a GroupKeys collection");
			}
			Remove(galleryToolItemGroup.Key);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new GalleryToolItemGroupKeysCollectionEnumerator(this);
		}

		IEnumerator<GalleryToolItemGroup> IEnumerable<GalleryToolItemGroup>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new GalleryToolItemGroupKeysCollectionEnumerator(this);
		}

		bool IList.Contains(object value)
		{
			return Contains(value);
		}
	}

		private static void RemoveGroupsContainedInFilter(List<GalleryToolItemGroup> groups, GalleryToolItemGroupKeysCollection filterGroups)
		{
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = filterGroups.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				GalleryToolItemGroup item = filterGroups[i];
				int num = groups.IndexOf(item);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					groups.RemoveAt(num);
					i--;
				}
			}
		}

		private void RepopulateAvailableKeys()
		{
			List<GalleryToolItemGroup> list = new List<GalleryToolItemGroup>();
			PopupGalleryTool galleryTool = collection.GalleryTool;
			foreach (GalleryToolItemGroup item in (IEnumerable<GalleryToolItemGroup>)galleryTool.Groups)
			{
				list.Add(item);
			}
			if (cbFilterType.SelectedIndex == 0)
			{
				foreach (GalleryToolItemGroupFilter item2 in (IEnumerable)galleryTool.GroupFilters)
				{
					RemoveGroupsContainedInFilter(list, item2.Groups);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				RemoveGroupsContainedInFilter(list, collection);
			}
			lbAvailableKeys.BeginUpdate();
			lbAvailableKeys.Items.Clear();
			lbAvailableKeys.Items.AddRange(list.ToArray());
			lbAvailableKeys.EndUpdate();
			SetButtonsEnabledState();
		}

		private void RepopulateFilterKeys()
		{
			lbKeysInCollection.BeginUpdate();
			lbKeysInCollection.Items.Clear();
			foreach (GalleryToolItemGroup item in collection)
			{
				lbKeysInCollection.Items.Add(item);
			}
			lbKeysInCollection.EndUpdate();
			SetButtonsEnabledState();
		}

		private void SetButtonsEnabledState()
		{
			btAdd.Enabled = lbAvailableKeys.SelectedItems.Count > 0;
			if (lbKeysInCollection.SelectedItems.Count > 0)
			{
				btRemove.Enabled = true;
				btMoveUp.Enabled = lbKeysInCollection.SelectedIndices[0] != 0;
				btMoveDown.Enabled = lbKeysInCollection.SelectedIndices[lbKeysInCollection.SelectedIndices.Count - 1] != lbKeysInCollection.Items.Count - 1;
			}
			else
			{
				Button button = btRemove;
				Button button2 = btMoveDown;
				bool flag = (btMoveUp.Enabled = false);
				bool enabled = (button2.Enabled = flag);
				button.Enabled = enabled;
			}
		}

		private void btAdd_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			foreach (GalleryToolItemGroup selectedItem in lbAvailableKeys.SelectedItems)
			{
				collection.Add(selectedItem.Key);
			}
			int val = lbAvailableKeys.SelectedIndices[0];
			RepopulateAvailableKeys();
			RepopulateFilterKeys();
			if (lbAvailableKeys.Items.Count > 0)
			{
				lbAvailableKeys.SelectedIndex = Math.Min(lbAvailableKeys.Items.Count - 1, val);
			}
			SetButtonsEnabledState();
		}

		private void btMoveDown_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			int[] array = new int[lbKeysInCollection.SelectedItems.Count];
			for (int num = lbKeysInCollection.SelectedItems.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				GalleryToolItemGroup galleryToolItemGroup = (GalleryToolItemGroup)lbKeysInCollection.SelectedItems[num];
				int num2 = collection.IndexOf(galleryToolItemGroup);
				array[num] = num2 + 1;
				collection.RemoveAt(num2);
				collection.Insert(num2 + 1, galleryToolItemGroup.Key);
			}
			lbKeysInCollection.BeginUpdate();
			RepopulateFilterKeys();
			int[] array2 = array;
			foreach (int index in array2)
			{
				lbKeysInCollection.SetSelected(index, value: true);
			}
			lbKeysInCollection.EndUpdate();
			SetButtonsEnabledState();
		}

		private void btMoveUp_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			int[] array = new int[lbKeysInCollection.SelectedItems.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < lbKeysInCollection.SelectedItems.Count; i++)
			{
				GalleryToolItemGroup galleryToolItemGroup = (GalleryToolItemGroup)lbKeysInCollection.SelectedItems[i];
				int num = collection.IndexOf(galleryToolItemGroup);
				array[i] = num - 1;
				collection.RemoveAt(num);
				collection.Insert(num - 1, galleryToolItemGroup.Key);
			}
			lbKeysInCollection.BeginUpdate();
			RepopulateFilterKeys();
			int[] array2 = array;
			foreach (int index in array2)
			{
				lbKeysInCollection.SetSelected(index, value: true);
			}
			lbKeysInCollection.EndUpdate();
			SetButtonsEnabledState();
		}

		private void btRemove_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			foreach (GalleryToolItemGroup selectedItem in lbKeysInCollection.SelectedItems)
			{
				collection.Remove(selectedItem.Key);
			}
			int val = lbKeysInCollection.SelectedIndices[0];
			RepopulateAvailableKeys();
			RepopulateFilterKeys();
			if (lbKeysInCollection.Items.Count > 0)
			{
				lbKeysInCollection.SelectedIndex = Math.Min(lbKeysInCollection.Items.Count - 1, val);
			}
			SetButtonsEnabledState();
		}

		private void cbFilterType_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			RepopulateAvailableKeys();
			SetButtonsEnabledState();
		}

		private void GalleryToolItemKeysCollectionEditorForm_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			cbFilterType.SelectedIndex = 0;
			RepopulateFilterKeys();
			if (lbAvailableKeys.Items.Count > 0)
			{
				lbAvailableKeys.SelectedIndex = 0;
			}
		}

		private void lbAvailableKeys_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			SetButtonsEnabledState();
		}

		private void lbKeysInCollection_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			SetButtonsEnabledState();
		}
	}

		{
			int num = 0;
			if (ShouldSerializeHeaderAppearance())
			{
				num++;
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeItemAreaAppearance())
			{
				num++;
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeShowHeader())
			{
				num++;
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				num++;
			}
			if (num == 1)
			{
				return "1 Property Modified";
			}
			if (num > 1)
			{
				return num + " Properties Modified";
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

	[Serializable]
	[ListBindable(false)]
	[Editor(typeof(GalleryToolItemKeysCollectionUITypeEditor), typeof(UITypeEditor))]
	public class GalleryToolItemKeysCollection : KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase, ISerializable, IList, ICollection, IEnumerable
	{
		private class GalleryToolItemKeysCollectionEnumerator : IEnumerator
		{
			private int position = -1;

			private GalleryToolItemKeysCollection items;

			object IEnumerator.Current
			{
				get
				{
					items.VerifyContents();
					return items.GetItem(position);
				}
			}

			public GalleryToolItemKeysCollectionEnumerator(GalleryToolItemKeysCollection items)
			{
				this.items = items;
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				items.VerifyContents();
				if (position < items.Count - 1)
				{
					position++;
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				position = -1;
			}
		}

		public sealed class GalleryToolItemKeysCollectionUITypeEditor : UITypeEditor
		{
			private ITypeDescriptorContext context;

			private bool ignoreChangedEvents;

			private bool ignoreChangingEvents;

			public override UITypeEditorEditStyle GetEditStyle(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				return UITypeEditorEditStyle.Modal;
			}

			public override object EditValue(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IServiceProvider provider, object value)
			{
				if (provider != null)
				{
					IWindowsFormsEditorService windowsFormsEditorService = (IWindowsFormsEditorService)provider.GetService(typeof(IWindowsFormsEditorService));
					if (windowsFormsEditorService == null)
					{
						return value;
					}
					this.context = context;
					if (!(value is GalleryToolItemKeysCollection galleryToolItemKeysCollection))
					{
						return value;
					}
					string[] array = new string[galleryToolItemKeysCollection.Count];
					for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
					{
						array[i] = galleryToolItemKeysCollection[i].Key;
					}
					GalleryToolItemKeysCollectionEditorForm galleryToolItemKeysCollectionEditorForm = new GalleryToolItemKeysCollectionEditorForm(galleryToolItemKeysCollection);
					bool flag = true;
					IComponentChangeService componentChangeService = null;
					try
					{
						if (this.context != null)
						{
							componentChangeService = (IComponentChangeService)this.context.GetService(typeof(IComponentChangeService));
							if (componentChangeService != null)
							{
								ignoreChangingEvents = false;
								ignoreChangedEvents = false;
								componentChangeService.ComponentChanged += OnComponentChanged;
								componentChangeService.ComponentChanging += OnComponentChanging;
							}
						}
						if (windowsFormsEditorService.ShowDialog(galleryToolItemKeysCollectionEditorForm) == DialogResult.OK)
						{
							return value;
						}
						flag = false;
					}
					finally
					{
						if (!flag)
						{
							galleryToolItemKeysCollection.Clear();
							galleryToolItemKeysCollection.AddRange(array);
						}
						if (componentChangeService != null)
						{
							componentChangeService.ComponentChanged -= OnComponentChanged;
							componentChangeService.ComponentChanging -= OnComponentChanging;
						}
						galleryToolItemKeysCollectionEditorForm.Dispose();
					}
				}
				return value;
			}

			private void OnComponentChanged(object sender, ComponentChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				if (!ignoreChangedEvents && sender != context.Instance)
				{
					ignoreChangedEvents = true;
					context.OnComponentChanged();
				}
			}

			private void OnComponentChanging(object sender, ComponentChangingEventArgs e)
			{
				if (!ignoreChangingEvents && sender != context.Instance)
				{
					ignoreChangingEvents = true;
					context.OnComponentChanging();
				}
			}
		}

		internal PopupGalleryTool GalleryTool
		{
			get
			{
				if (cachedGalleryTool != null)
				{
					return cachedGalleryTool;
				}
				PopupGalleryTool popupGalleryTool = owner as PopupGalleryTool;
				if (popupGalleryTool == null)
				{
					popupGalleryTool = ((GalleryToolItemGroup)owner).GalleryTool;
				}
				cachedGalleryTool = popupGalleryTool;
				return popupGalleryTool;
			}
		}

		internal GalleryToolItemGroup Group
		{
			get
			{
				if (cachedGroup == null)
				{
					cachedGroup = owner as GalleryToolItemGroup;
				}
				return cachedGroup;
			}
		}

		{

			set
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("Set not supported in ItemKeys collection");

		public GalleryToolItemKeysCollection(PopupGalleryTool owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = owner.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager != null && toolbarsManager.Initialized)
			{
				isHookedToGallery = true;
			}
		}

		public GalleryToolItemKeysCollection(GalleryToolItemGroup owner)
		{
			Initialize(owner);
		}

		protected GalleryToolItemKeysCollection(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.Value is string)
				{
					string text = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), null);
					if (text != null)
					{
						Add(text);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					string name = current.Name;
					if (name == "Tag")
					{
						DeserializeTag(current);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, i.ToString(), this[i].Key);
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			PopupGalleryTool galleryTool = GalleryTool;
			if (galleryTool != null)
			{
				isHookedToGallery = false;
			}
			InternalClear(notifyListeners: false, removeKeys: true);
			owner = null;
			cachedGalleryTool = null;
			cachedGroup = null;
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		public GalleryToolItem Add(string key)
		{
			if (isHookedToGallery)
			{
				GalleryToolItem galleryToolItem = GalleryTool.Items[key];
				if (galleryToolItem != null)
				{
					InternalAdd(Count, galleryToolItem);
					return galleryToolItem;
				}
				throw new ArgumentException("An item with the specified key does not exist in the gallery.");
			}
			itemKeys.Add(key);
			return null;
		}

		public void AddRange(string[] keys)
		{
			foreach (string key in keys)
			{
				Add(key);
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			InternalClear(notifyListeners: true, removeKeys: true);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, string key)
		{
			if (isHookedToGallery)
			{
				GalleryToolItem galleryToolItem = GalleryTool.Items[key];
				if (galleryToolItem == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("An item with the specified key does not exist in the gallery.");
				}
				InternalAdd(index, galleryToolItem);
			}
			else
			{
				itemKeys.Insert(index, key);
			}
		}

		public void Remove(string key)
		{
			if (isHookedToGallery)
			{
				GalleryToolItem galleryToolItem = this[key];
				if (galleryToolItem != null)
				{
					InternalRemove(galleryToolItem);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				itemKeys.Remove(key);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			if (isHookedToGallery)
			{
				GalleryToolItem galleryToolItem = this[index];
				if (galleryToolItem != null)
				{
					InternalRemove(galleryToolItem);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				itemKeys.RemoveAt(index);
			}
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			ResetTag();
			Clear();
		}

		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				return Count > 0;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal GalleryToolItemKeysCollection Clone(GalleryToolItemGroup newGroup)
		{
			GalleryToolItemKeysCollection galleryToolItemKeysCollection = new GalleryToolItemKeysCollection(newGroup);
			galleryToolItemKeysCollection.isHookedToGallery = isHookedToGallery;
			if (isHookedToGallery)
			{
				foreach (GalleryToolItem item in (IEnumerable)this)
				{
					galleryToolItemKeysCollection.InternalAdd(Count, item);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				itemKeys = new List<string>(itemKeys);
			}
			return galleryToolItemKeysCollection;
		}

		internal int GetColumnsInRow(int row, int layoutColumns)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			foreach (GalleryToolItem item in (IEnumerable)this)
			{
				if (num2 != 0 && num2 + item.ColumnSpan > layoutColumns)
				{
					if (num == row)
					{
						return num2;
					}
					num2 = 0;
					num++;
				}
				num2 += item.ColumnSpan;
			}
			return num2;
		}

		internal GalleryToolItem GetItem(int row, int column, int layoutColumns)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			foreach (GalleryToolItem item in (IEnumerable)this)
			{
				if (num2 != 0 && num2 + item.ColumnSpan > layoutColumns)
				{
					num2 = 0;
					num++;
				}
				if (num == row && num2 + item.ColumnSpan >= column + 1)
				{
					return item;
				}
				num2 += item.ColumnSpan;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal string[] GetKeys()
		{
			return itemKeys.ToArray();
		}

		internal int GetRows(int layoutColumns)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (Count > 0)
			{
				num++;
				int num2 = 0;
				foreach (GalleryToolItem item in (IEnumerable)this)
				{
					if (num2 != 0 && num2 + item.ColumnSpan > layoutColumns)
					{
						num2 = 0;
						num++;
					}
					num2 += item.ColumnSpan;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal Point GetVirtualLocation(GalleryToolItem item, int layoutColumns)
		{
			if (!Contains(item))
			{
				return Point.Empty;
			}
			Point result = new Point(0, 0);
			foreach (GalleryToolItem item2 in (IEnumerable)this)
			{
				if (result.X != 0 && result.X + item2.ColumnSpan > layoutColumns)
				{
					result.X = 0;
					result.Y++;
				}
				if (item2 == item)
				{
					return result;
				}
				result.X += item2.ColumnSpan;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal void HookupAllSubObjects()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = GalleryTool.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager != null && toolbarsManager.Initialized && !isHookedToGallery)
			{
				if (GalleryTool == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("This collection's associated owner does not belong to a gallery");
				}
				isHookedToGallery = true;
				string[] keys = itemKeys.ToArray();
				itemKeys.Clear();
				AddRange(keys);
			}
		}

		internal void Initialize(GalleryToolItemGroup owningGroup)
		{
			ResetCache();
			owner = owningGroup;
			PopupGalleryTool galleryTool = owningGroup.GalleryTool;
			if (galleryTool != null)
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = galleryTool.ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager != null && toolbarsManager.Initialized)
				{
					isHookedToGallery = true;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InternalAdd(int index, GalleryToolItem item)
		{
			item.VerifyNotDisposed();
			VerifyContents();
			item.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			InternalInsert(index, item);
			itemKeys.Insert(index, item.Key);
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Items);
		}

		internal void InternalClear(bool notifyListeners, bool removeKeys)
		{
			if (notifyListeners)
			{
				VerifyContents();
			}
			foreach (GalleryToolItem item in (IEnumerable)this)
			{
				item.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			InternalClear();
			if (removeKeys)
			{
				itemKeys.Clear();
			}
			if (notifyListeners)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Items);
			}
		}

		internal void InternalRemove(GalleryToolItem item)
		{
			if (item != null)
			{
				VerifyContents();
				int num = IndexOf(item);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					InternalRemove((IKeyedSubObject)item);
					itemKeys.RemoveAt(num);
				}
				item.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Items);
			}
		}

		internal GalleryToolItem NavigateFromItem(GalleryToolItem startItem, NavigationAction direction, bool wrapAround, int layoutColumns)
		{
			return NavigateFromItem(startItem, direction, GetVirtualLocation(startItem, layoutColumns).X, wrapAround, layoutColumns);
		}

		internal GalleryToolItem NavigateFromItem(GalleryToolItem startItem, NavigationAction direction, int startingColumn, bool wrapAround, int layoutColumns)
		{
			Point point = ((startItem != null) ? GetVirtualLocation(startItem, layoutColumns) : new Point(-1, -1));
			switch (direction)
			{
			case NavigationAction.Up:
			{
				int rows = GetRows(layoutColumns);
				int num = point.Y;
				if (num < 0)
				{
					num = rows;
				}
				if (startingColumn < 0)
				{
					startingColumn = GetColumnsInRow(rows - 1, layoutColumns) - 1;
				}
				do
				{
					num--;
					if (num < 0)
					{
						return null;
					}
				}
				while (startingColumn >= GetColumnsInRow(num, layoutColumns));
				point.Y = num;
				point.X = startingColumn;
				break;
			}
			case NavigationAction.Down:
			{
				int rows2 = GetRows(layoutColumns);
				int num2 = point.Y;
				if (num2 < 0)
				{
					num2 = -1;
				}
				if (startingColumn < 0)
				{
					startingColumn = 0;
				}
				do
				{
					num2++;
					if (num2 >= rows2)
					{
						return null;
					}
				}
				while (startingColumn >= GetColumnsInRow(num2, layoutColumns));
				point.Y = num2;
				point.X = startingColumn;
				break;
			}
			case NavigationAction.Left:
				if (point.Y < 0)
				{
					point.Y = GetRows(layoutColumns) - 1;
				}
				point.X = startingColumn - 1;
				if (point.X < 0)
				{
					if (wrapAround)
					{
						point.X = GetColumnsInRow(point.Y, layoutColumns) - 1;
					}
					else
					{
						point.X = 0;
					}
				}
				break;
			case NavigationAction.Right:
				if (point.Y < 0)
				{
					point.Y = 0;
				}
				if (startItem == null)
				{
					point.X = 0;
				}
				else
				{
					point.X = startingColumn + startItem.ColumnSpan;
				}
				if (point.X >= GetColumnsInRow(point.Y, layoutColumns))
				{
					if (wrapAround)
					{
						point.X = 0;
					}
					else
					{
						point.X = GetColumnsInRow(point.Y, layoutColumns) - 1;
					}
				}
				break;
			case NavigationAction.Home:
				point.Y = 0;
				point.X = 0;
				break;
			case NavigationAction.End:
				point.Y = GetRows(layoutColumns) - 1;
				point.X = GetColumnsInRow(point.Y, layoutColumns) - 1;
				break;
			default:
				return null;
			}
			return GetItem(point.Y, point.X, layoutColumns);
		}

		internal void UnhookAllSubObjects()
		{
			if (isHookedToGallery)
			{
				isHookedToGallery = false;
				InternalClear(notifyListeners: false, removeKeys: false);
			}
		}

		private void ResetCache()
		{
			cachedGalleryTool = null;
			cachedGroup = null;
		}

		private void VerifyContents()
		{
			PopupGalleryTool galleryTool = GalleryTool;
			if (galleryTool == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			GalleryToolItemCollection items = galleryTool.Items;
			if (items.Version == lastItemsVersion)
			{
				return;
			}
			lastItemsVersion = items.Version;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				GalleryToolItem galleryToolItem = base.GetItem(i) as GalleryToolItem;
				if (galleryToolItem.Disposed || !items.Contains(galleryToolItem))
				{
					InternalRemoveAt(i);
					itemKeys.RemoveAt(i);
					i--;
				}
			}
		}

		int IList.Add(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("value", "Can't add a null value to a ItemKeys collection");
			}
			if (value is string key)
			{
				Add(key);
				return Count - 1;
			}
			if (!(value is GalleryToolItem galleryToolItem))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException($"Can't add a '{value.GetType().Name}' object to a ItemKeys collection");
			}
			Add(galleryToolItem.Key);
			return Count - 1;
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("value", "Can't insert a null value into a ItemKeys collection");
			}
			if (value is string key)
			{
				Insert(index, key);
			}
			if (!(value is GalleryToolItem galleryToolItem))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException($"Can't insert a '{value.GetType().Name}' object to a ItemKeys collection");
			}
			Insert(index, galleryToolItem.Key);
		}

		void IList.Remove(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("Can't remove a null value from a ItemKeys collection");
			}
			if (value is string key)
			{
				Remove(key);
			}
			if (!(value is GalleryToolItem galleryToolItem))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException($"Can't remove a '{value.GetType().Name}' object from a ItemKeys collection");
			}
			Remove(galleryToolItem.Key);
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new GalleryToolItemKeysCollectionEnumerator(this);
		}

		bool IList.Contains(object value)
		{
			return Contains(value);
		}
	}

		private void LocalizeStrings()

		private static void RemoveItemsContainedInGroup(List<GalleryToolItem> items, GalleryToolItemKeysCollection groupItems)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < groupItems.Count; i++)
			{
				GalleryToolItem item = groupItems[i];
				int num = items.IndexOf(item);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					items.RemoveAt(num);
					i--;
				}
			}
		}

		private void RepopulateAvailableKeys()
		{
			List<GalleryToolItem> list = new List<GalleryToolItem>();
			foreach (GalleryToolItem item in (IEnumerable)collection.GalleryTool.Items)
			{
				list.Add(item);
			}
			if (cbFilterType.SelectedIndex == 0)
			{
				foreach (GalleryToolItemGroup allGroup in collection.GalleryTool.GetAllGroups())
				{
					RemoveItemsContainedInGroup(list, allGroup.Items);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				RemoveItemsContainedInGroup(list, collection);
			}
			lbAvailableKeys.BeginUpdate();
			lbAvailableKeys.Items.Clear();
			lbAvailableKeys.Items.AddRange(list.ToArray());
			lbAvailableKeys.EndUpdate();
			SetButtonsEnabledState();
		}

		private void RepopulateGroupKeys()
		{
			lbKeysInCollection.BeginUpdate();
			lbKeysInCollection.Items.Clear();
			foreach (GalleryToolItem item in (IEnumerable)collection)
			{
				lbKeysInCollection.Items.Add(item);
			}
			lbKeysInCollection.EndUpdate();
			SetButtonsEnabledState();
		}

		private void SetButtonsEnabledState()
		{
			btAdd.Enabled = lbAvailableKeys.SelectedItems.Count > 0;
			if (lbKeysInCollection.SelectedItems.Count > 0)
			{
				btRemove.Enabled = true;
				btMoveUp.Enabled = lbKeysInCollection.SelectedIndices[0] != 0;
				btMoveDown.Enabled = lbKeysInCollection.SelectedIndices[lbKeysInCollection.SelectedIndices.Count - 1] != lbKeysInCollection.Items.Count - 1;
			}
			else
			{
				Button button = btRemove;
				Button button2 = btMoveDown;
				bool flag = (btMoveUp.Enabled = false);
				bool enabled = (button2.Enabled = flag);
				button.Enabled = enabled;
			}
		}

		private void btAdd_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			foreach (GalleryToolItem selectedItem in lbAvailableKeys.SelectedItems)
			{
				collection.Add(selectedItem.Key);
			}
			int val = lbAvailableKeys.SelectedIndices[0];
			RepopulateAvailableKeys();
			RepopulateGroupKeys();
			if (lbAvailableKeys.Items.Count > 0)
			{
				lbAvailableKeys.SelectedIndex = Math.Min(lbAvailableKeys.Items.Count - 1, val);
			}
			SetButtonsEnabledState();
		}

		private void btMoveDown_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			int[] array = new int[lbKeysInCollection.SelectedItems.Count];
			for (int num = lbKeysInCollection.SelectedItems.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				GalleryToolItem galleryToolItem = (GalleryToolItem)lbKeysInCollection.SelectedItems[num];
				int num2 = collection.IndexOf(galleryToolItem);
				array[num] = num2 + 1;
				collection.RemoveAt(num2);
				collection.Insert(num2 + 1, galleryToolItem.Key);
			}
			lbKeysInCollection.BeginUpdate();
			RepopulateGroupKeys();
			int[] array2 = array;
			foreach (int index in array2)
			{
				lbKeysInCollection.SetSelected(index, value: true);
			}
			lbKeysInCollection.EndUpdate();
			SetButtonsEnabledState();
		}

		private void btMoveUp_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			int[] array = new int[lbKeysInCollection.SelectedItems.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < lbKeysInCollection.SelectedItems.Count; i++)
			{
				GalleryToolItem galleryToolItem = (GalleryToolItem)lbKeysInCollection.SelectedItems[i];
				int num = collection.IndexOf(galleryToolItem);
				array[i] = num - 1;
				collection.RemoveAt(num);
				collection.Insert(num - 1, galleryToolItem.Key);
			}
			lbKeysInCollection.BeginUpdate();
			RepopulateGroupKeys();
			int[] array2 = array;
			foreach (int index in array2)
			{
				lbKeysInCollection.SetSelected(index, value: true);
			}
			lbKeysInCollection.EndUpdate();
			SetButtonsEnabledState();
		}

		private void btRemove_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			foreach (GalleryToolItem selectedItem in lbKeysInCollection.SelectedItems)
			{
				collection.Remove(selectedItem.Key);
			}
			int val = lbKeysInCollection.SelectedIndices[0];
			RepopulateAvailableKeys();
			RepopulateGroupKeys();
			if (lbKeysInCollection.Items.Count > 0)
			{
				lbKeysInCollection.SelectedIndex = Math.Min(lbKeysInCollection.Items.Count - 1, val);
			}
			SetButtonsEnabledState();
		}

		{
			RepopulateAvailableKeys();
			SetButtonsEnabledState();
		}

		private UltraToolbarsManager ToolbarsManager
		{
			get
			{
				if (owner == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (owner is PopupGalleryTool popupGalleryTool)
				{
					return popupGalleryTool.ToolbarsManager;
				}
				if (owner is GalleryToolItemGroup { GalleryTool: var galleryTool })
				{
					return galleryTool?.ToolbarsManager;
				}
				if (owner is GalleryToolItem { ParentCollection: var parentCollection })
				{
					return parentCollection?.ToolbarsManager;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		void IDeserializationCallback.OnDeserialization(object sender)
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (appearanceHolder != null)
			{
				appearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				if (toolbarsManager != null)
				{
					appearanceHolder.Collection = toolbarsManager.Appearances;
				}
			}
			if (hotTrackAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				hotTrackAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				if (toolbarsManager != null)
				{
					hotTrackAppearanceHolder.Collection = toolbarsManager.Appearances;
				}
			}
			if (hotTrackSelectedAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				hotTrackSelectedAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				if (toolbarsManager != null)
				{
					hotTrackSelectedAppearanceHolder.Collection = toolbarsManager.Appearances;
				}
			}
			if (imageHighlightAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				imageHighlightAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				if (toolbarsManager != null)
				{
					imageHighlightAppearanceHolder.Collection = toolbarsManager.Appearances;
				}
			}
			if (imagePadding != null)
			{
				((SubObjectBase)(object)imagePadding).SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (pressedAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				pressedAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				if (toolbarsManager != null)
				{
					pressedAppearanceHolder.Collection = toolbarsManager.Appearances;
				}
			}
			if (selectedAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				selectedAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				if (toolbarsManager != null)
				{
					selectedAppearanceHolder.Collection = toolbarsManager.Appearances;
				}
			}
			OnDeserialization(sender);
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (appearanceHolder != null)
			{
				appearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				appearanceHolder = null;
			}
			if (hotTrackAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				hotTrackAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				hotTrackAppearanceHolder = null;
			}
			if (hotTrackSelectedAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				hotTrackSelectedAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				hotTrackSelectedAppearanceHolder = null;
			}
			if (imageHighlightAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				imageHighlightAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				imageHighlightAppearanceHolder = null;
			}
			if (imagePadding != null)
			{
				((SubObjectBase)(object)imagePadding).SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				((DisposableObject)(object)imagePadding).Dispose();
				imagePadding = null;
			}
			if (pressedAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				pressedAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				pressedAppearanceHolder = null;
			}
			if (selectedAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				selectedAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				selectedAppearanceHolder = null;
			}
			owner = null;
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (HasAppearance && appearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChange.Source)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Appearance, propChange);
			}
			else if (imagePadding == propChange.Source)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ImagePadding, propChange);
			}
			else if (HasHotTrackAppearance && hotTrackAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChange.Source)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.HotTrackAppearance, propChange);
			}
			else if (HasHotTrackSelectedAppearance && hotTrackSelectedAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChange.Source)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.HotTrackSelectedAppearance, propChange);
			}
			else if (HasImageHighlightAppearance && imageHighlightAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChange.Source)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ImageHighlightAppearance, propChange);
			}
			else if (HasPressedAppearance && pressedAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChange.Source)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.PressedAppearance, propChange);
			}
			else if (HasSelectedAppearance && selectedAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChange.Source)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.SelectedAppearance, propChange);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (ShouldSerializeAppearance())
			{
				num++;
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeTextPlacement())
			{
				num++;
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeHotTrackAppearance())
			{
				num++;
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeHotTrackSelectedAppearance())
			{
				num++;
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeImageAreaSize())
			{
				num++;
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeImageHighlightAppearance())
			{
				num++;
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeImagePadding())
			{
				num++;
			}
			if (ShouldSerializePressedAppearance())
			{
				num++;
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeSelectedAppearance())
			{
				num++;
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeSelectionDisplayStyle())
			{
				num++;
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				num++;
			}
			if (num == 1)
			{
				return "1 Property Modified";
			}
			if (num > 1)
			{
				return num + " Properties Modified";
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			ResetAppearance();
			ResetTextPlacement();
			ResetHotTrackAppearance();
			ResetHotTrackSelectedAppearance();
			ResetImageAreaSize();
			ResetImageHighlightAppearance();
			ResetImagePadding();
			ResetPressedAppearance();
			ResetSelectedAppearance();
			ResetSelectionDisplayStyle();
			ResetTag();
		}

		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeAppearance() && !ShouldSerializeTextPlacement() && !ShouldSerializeHotTrackAppearance() && !ShouldSerializeHotTrackSelectedAppearance() && !ShouldSerializeImageAreaSize() && !ShouldSerializeImageHighlightAppearance() && !ShouldSerializeImagePadding() && !ShouldSerializePressedAppearance() && !ShouldSerializeSelectedAppearance() && !ShouldSerializeSelectionDisplayStyle())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeTag();
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void Initialize(object owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
		}

		protected internal virtual GalleryToolItemSettings Clone(object newOwner)
		{

		private void ImageSelectionControl_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
		}

		private void lstImages_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (ignoreNextImageSelection)
			{
				ignoreNextImageSelection = false;
				return;
			}
			if (lstImages.SelectedIndex < 0)
			{
				newImage = null;
			}
			else
			{
				newImage = lstImages.SelectedIndex;
			}
			OnNewImageSelected();
		}

		private void cmdSelectImageFromFile_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Image image = null;
			try
			{
				UITypeEditor uITypeEditor = TypeDescriptor.GetEditor(typeof(Image), typeof(UITypeEditor)) as UITypeEditor;
				ITypeDescriptorContext typeDescriptorContext = new TypeDescriptorContext((Component)(object)toolbarsManager, this, TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(this)["SelectedImage"]);
				image = uITypeEditor.EditValue(typeDescriptorContext, typeDescriptorContext, newImage ?? currentImage) as Image;
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				string message = ex.Message;
				UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, message, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AppearanceImageEditor_SelectImageFileErrorTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
			}
			if (image != null && image != newImage)
			{
				newImage = image;
				OnNewImageSelected();
			}
		}

		private void lstImages_MeasureItem(object sender, MeasureItemEventArgs e)
		{
			if (imageList != null)
			{
				e.ItemHeight = imageList.ImageSize.Height + 6;
				e.ItemWidth = imageList.ImageSize.Width + 6;
			}
			else
			{
				Size imageSizeSmallResolved = toolbarsManager.ImageSizeSmallResolved;
				e.ItemHeight = imageSizeSmallResolved.Height + 6;
				e.ItemWidth = imageSizeSmallResolved.Width + 6;
			}
		}

		private void lstImages_DrawItem(object sender, DrawItemEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Index >= 0 && e.Index <= ((ListBox)sender).Items.Count && ((ListBox)sender).Items[e.Index] is Image image)
			{
				Rectangle bounds = e.Bounds;
				e.Graphics.FillRectangle(SystemBrushes.Window, bounds);
				if ((e.State & DrawItemState.Selected) == DrawItemState.Selected)
				{
					e.Graphics.FillRectangle(SystemBrushes.Highlight, bounds);
					ControlPaint.DrawFocusRectangle(e.Graphics, bounds, SystemColors.HighlightText, SystemColors.Highlight);
				}
				ImageAttributes imageAttributes = new ImageAttributes();
				imageAttributes.ClearColorKey();
				Color color = ((imageList == null || !(imageList.TransparentColor != Color.Transparent)) ? toolbarsManager.ImageTransparentColorResolved : imageList.TransparentColor);
				if (color != Color.Transparent)
				{
					ColorMap colorMap = new ColorMap();
					colorMap.NewColor = Color.Transparent;
					colorMap.OldColor = color;
					imageAttributes.SetRemapTable(new ColorMap[1] { colorMap });
				}
				Rectangle destRect = new Rectangle(bounds.X + (bounds.Width - imageList.ImageSize.Width) / 2, bounds.Y + (bounds.Height - imageList.ImageSize.Height) / 2, imageList.ImageSize.Width, imageList.ImageSize.Height);
				e.Graphics.DrawImage(image, destRect, 0, 0, destRect.Width, destRect.Height, GraphicsUnit.Pixel, imageAttributes);
			}
		}

		private void cmdRemoveImage_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			newImage = null;
			OnNewImageSelected();
		}

		private void lblImagePreview_Paint(object sender, PaintEventArgs e)
		{
			if (previewImage == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ImageAttributes imageAttributes = new ImageAttributes();
			imageAttributes.ClearColorKey();
			Color color = ((imageList == null || !(imageList.TransparentColor != Color.Transparent)) ? toolbarsManager.ImageTransparentColorResolved : imageList.TransparentColor);
			if (color != Color.Transparent)
			{
				ColorMap colorMap = new ColorMap();
				colorMap.NewColor = Color.Transparent;
				colorMap.OldColor = color;
				imageAttributes.SetRemapTable(new ColorMap[1] { colorMap });
			}
			try
			{
				Rectangle clientRectangle = lblImagePreview.ClientRectangle;
				Rectangle destRect = new Rectangle(clientRectangle.X + (clientRectangle.Width - previewImage.Size.Width) / 2, clientRectangle.Y + (clientRectangle.Height - previewImage.Size.Height) / 2, previewImage.Size.Width, previewImage.Size.Height);
				e.Graphics.DrawImage(previewImage, destRect, 0, 0, destRect.Width, destRect.Height, GraphicsUnit.Pixel, imageAttributes);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		internal void Initialize(UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager, ImageList imageList, bool isSmallImageList, object currentImage)
		{
			this.toolbarsManager = toolbarsManager;
			this.imageList = imageList;
			this.currentImage = currentImage;
			if (isSmallImageList)
			{
				lblNoImageList.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ImgSelectionCtrlImageListSmallNotSet");
			}
			else
			{
				lblNoImageList.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ImgSelectionCtrlImageListLargeNotSet");
			}
			if (this.currentImage == null)
			{
				previewImage = this.toolbarsManager.GetDefaultButtonBitmap();
			}
			else if (this.currentImage is Image)
			{
				previewImage = (Image)this.currentImage;
			}
			else if (this.currentImage.GetType() == typeof(int) && this.imageList != null && (int)this.currentImage < this.imageList.Images.Count)
			{
				previewImage = this.imageList.Images[(int)this.currentImage];
			}
			else
			{
				previewImage = this.toolbarsManager.GetDefaultButtonBitmap();
			}
			lblImagePreview.Refresh();
			if (this.imageList != null)
			{
				lstImages.ItemHeight = this.imageList.ImageSize.Height + 6;
				lstImages.ColumnWidth = this.imageList.ImageSize.Width + 6;
				lstImages.Items.Clear();
				for (int i = 0; i < imageList.Images.Count; i++)
				{
					lstImages.Items.Add(imageList.Images[i]);
				}
				if (this.currentImage != null)
				{
					int num = -1;
					if (this.currentImage is string)
					{
						num = this.imageList.Images.IndexOfKey(this.currentImage as string);
					}
					else if (this.currentImage is int)
					{
						num = (int)this.currentImage;
					}
					if (num >= 0 && num < lstImages.Items.Count)
					{
						ignoreNextImageSelection = true;
						lstImages.SelectedIndex = num;
					}
				}
				lstImages.Visible = true;
				lblNoImageList.Visible = false;
			}
			else
			{
				lstImages.Visible = false;
				lblNoImageList.Visible = true;
			}
		}

		private void OnNewImageSelected()
		{
			if (newImage is Image)
			{
				previewImage = (Image)newImage;
			}
			else if (newImage is int && imageList != null)
			{
				previewImage = imageList.Images[(int)newImage];
			}
			else if (newImage is string && imageList != null && imageList.Images.ContainsKey((string)newImage))
			{
				previewImage = imageList.Images[(string)newImage];
			}
			else
			{
				previewImage = toolbarsManager.GetDefaultButtonBitmap();
				if (lstImages.SelectedIndex > -1)
				{
					lstImages.SelectedIndex = -1;
				}
			}
			lblImagePreview.Refresh();
			this.OnImageSelected(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}
	}

		private void InitMenuTree()
		{
			tvMenus.Nodes.Clear();
			if (toolbarsManager.FormMainMenu != null)
			{
				TreeNode treeNode = tvMenus.Nodes.Add("Main Menu Bar");
				ProcessMenuItemsAndLoadTree(toolbarsManager.FormMainMenu.MenuItems, treeNode, isMainMenuCollection: true);
				treeNode.Expand();
			}
		}

		private void ProcessMenuItemsAndLoadTree(Menu.MenuItemCollection menuItems, TreeNode parentNode, bool isMainMenuCollection)
		{
			MainMenu formMainMenu = toolbarsManager.FormMainMenu;
			foreach (MenuItem menuItem in menuItems)
			{
				if (!isMainMenuCollection || menuItem.Parent == formMainMenu)
				{
					TreeNode treeNode = null;
					if (parentNode != null)
					{
						treeNode = parentNode.Nodes.Add(menuItem.Text);
						treeNode.Tag = menuItem;
					}
					else
					{
						treeNode = tvMenus.Nodes.Add(menuItem.Text);
						treeNode.Tag = menuItem;
					}
					if (menuItem.IsParent && treeNode != null)
					{
						ProcessMenuItemsAndLoadTree(menuItem.MenuItems, treeNode, isMainMenuCollection: false);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void ProcessMenuItemsAndCreateTools(Menu.MenuItemCollection menuItems, object toolsOwner, bool isMainMenuCollection)
		{
			MainMenu formMainMenu = toolbarsManager.FormMainMenu;
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (MenuItem menuItem in menuItems)
			{
				if (isMainMenuCollection && menuItem.Parent != formMainMenu)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (menuItem.Text == "-")
				{
					flag = true;
					continue;
				}
				ToolBase toolBase = null;
				string empty = string.Empty;
				empty = ((menuItem.Site == null || ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(menuItem.Site.Name)) ? menuItem.Text : menuItem.Site.Name);
				string uniqueToolName = GetUniqueToolName(empty.Replace(" ", ""));
				toolBase = ((menuItem.IsParent || menuItem.Parent.GetType() == typeof(MainMenu)) ? new PopupMenuTool(uniqueToolName) : ((!menuItem.MdiList) ? ((ToolBase)new ButtonTool(uniqueToolName)) : ((ToolBase)new MdiWindowListTool(uniqueToolName))));
				toolBase.SharedProps.Category = txtCategory.Text;
				toolBase.SharedProps.Caption = menuItem.Text;
				toolBase.SharedProps.Shortcut = menuItem.Shortcut;
				toolBase.SharedProps.Visible = menuItem.Visible;
				toolBase.SharedProps.Enabled = menuItem.Enabled;
				toolBase.SharedProps.MergeOrder = menuItem.MergeOrder;
				toolBase.SharedProps.MergeType = (MenuMergeType)menuItem.MergeType;
				toolbarsManager.Tools.Add(toolBase);
				if (toolsOwner is UltraToolbar)
				{
					((UltraToolbar)toolsOwner).Tools.Add(toolBase);
					if (flag)
					{
						((UltraToolbar)toolsOwner).Tools[toolBase.Key].InstanceProps.IsFirstInGroup = true;
						flag = false;
					}
				}
				else if (toolsOwner is ToolBase && toolsOwner is ToolBase { UnderlyingTool: not null } toolBase2 && toolBase2.UnderlyingTool is PopupMenuTool)
				{
					((PopupMenuTool)toolBase2.UnderlyingTool).Tools.Add(toolBase);
					if (flag)
					{
						((PopupMenuTool)toolBase2.UnderlyingTool).Tools[toolBase.Key].InstanceProps.IsFirstInGroup = true;
						flag = false;
					}
				}
				ultraProgressBar1.PerformStep();
				if (menuItem.IsParent)
				{
					ProcessMenuItemsAndCreateTools(menuItem.MenuItems, toolBase, isMainMenuCollection: false);
				}
			}
		}

		private string GetUniqueToolName(string baseName)
		{
			if (!ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(baseName) && !toolbarsManager.Tools.Exists(baseName))
			{
				return baseName;
			}
			string text = baseName;
			for (int i = 1; i < 5000; i++)
			{
				if (!toolbarsManager.Tools.Exists(text + i))
				{
					return text += i;
				}
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		private string GetUniquToolbarName(string baseName)
		{
			if (!ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(baseName) && !toolbarsManager.Toolbars.Exists(baseName))
			{
				return baseName;
			}
			string text = baseName;
			for (int i = 1; i < 5000; i++)
			{
				if (!toolbarsManager.Toolbars.Exists(text + i))
				{
					return text += i;
				}
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		private void SetupProgressBar()
		{
			int maximum = 0;
			MainMenu formMainMenu = toolbarsManager.FormMainMenu;
			if (formMainMenu != null)
			{
				maximum = formMainMenu.MenuItems.Count;
			}
			ultraProgressBar1.Minimum = 0;
			ultraProgressBar1.Maximum = maximum;
			ultraProgressBar1.Step = 1;
			ultraProgressBar1.Value = 0;
			((Control)(object)ultraProgressBar1).Visible = true;
			((Control)(object)ultraProgressBar1).Refresh();
			lblImporting.Visible = true;
			lblImporting.Refresh();
		}

		private void cmdCancel_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Close();
		}

		private void cmdImport_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			MainMenu formMainMenu = toolbarsManager.FormMainMenu;
			if (formMainMenu == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				Cursor.Current = Cursors.WaitCursor;
				SetupProgressBar();
				UltraToolbar ultraToolbar = toolbarsManager.MainMenuBar;
				if (ultraToolbar == null)
				{
					ultraToolbar = new UltraToolbar(GetUniquToolbarName("ImportedMainMenuBar"));
					ultraToolbar.IsMainMenuBar = true;
					ultraToolbar.Text = ultraToolbar.Key;
					toolbarsManager.Toolbars.Add(ultraToolbar);
				}
				ProcessMenuItemsAndCreateTools(formMainMenu.MenuItems, ultraToolbar, isMainMenuCollection: true);
				Cursor.Current = Cursors.Arrow;
				UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ImportMainMenuDlg_ImportSuccessful"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ImportMainMenuDlg_ImportSuccessfulTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Asterisk);
			}
			catch
			{
				Cursor.Current = Cursors.Arrow;
				UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ImportMainMenuDlg_ImportError"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ImportMainMenuDlg_ImportErrorTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation);
			}
			finally
			{
				((Control)(object)ultraProgressBar1).Visible = false;
				lblImporting.Visible = false;
				Close();
			}
		}
	}
