		private string GetUniqueToolName(string baseName)
		{
			if (baseName != null && baseName.Length > 0 && !toolbarsManager.Tools.Exists(baseName))
			{
				return baseName;
			}
			string text = baseName;
			for (int i = 1; i < 5000; i++)
			{
				if (!toolbarsManager.Tools.Exists(text + i))
				{
					return text += i;
				}
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		private string GetUniquToolbarName(string baseName)
		{
			if (baseName != null && baseName.Length > 0 && !toolbarsManager.Toolbars.Exists(baseName))
			{
				return baseName;
			}
			string text = baseName;
			for (int i = 1; i < 5000; i++)
			{
				if (!toolbarsManager.Toolbars.Exists(text + i))
				{
					return text += i;
				}
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		private static int IndexOfIconInImageList(ImageList imageList, Icon icon)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < imageList.Images.Count; i++)
			{
				if ((object)imageList.Images[i] == icon)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private void InitDialog()
		{
			if (toolbarsManager.ImageListSmall == null && toolbarsManager.ImageListLarge == null)
			{
				opAddImagesToTool.Checked = true;
				opAddImagesToImagelist.Enabled = false;
				pnlImageListOptions.Enabled = false;
			}
			else
			{
				opAddImagesToImagelist.Checked = true;
				pnlImageOptions.Enabled = false;
				if (toolbarsManager.ImageListSmall != null)
				{
					opImageListSmall.Checked = true;
				}
				else
				{
					opImageListLarge.Checked = true;
				}
			}
			ToolBar[] formToolbarControls = toolbarsManager.FormToolbarControls;
			if (formToolbarControls == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < formToolbarControls.Length; i++)
			{
				ToolbarPickerControl toolbarPickerControl = new ToolbarPickerControl();
				toolbarPickerControl.Initialize(formToolbarControls[i]);
				toolbarPickerControl.Location = new Point(0, num);
				toolbarPickerControl.Width = pnlToolbars.Width - ScaledSystemInformation.GetVerticalScrollBarWidth((Control)toolbarPickerControl);
				pnlToolbars.Controls.Add(toolbarPickerControl);
				toolbarPickerControl.Visible = true;
				num += toolbarPickerControl.Height;
				if (pnlToolbars.Height < num)
				{
					pnlToolbars.AutoScrollMinSize = new Size(pnlToolbars.Width, num);
				}
				toolbarPickerControl.OnSelectionChanged += OnToolBarSelectionChanged;
			}
		}

		private void OnToolBarSelectionChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			bool enabled = false;
			foreach (ToolbarPickerControl control in pnlToolbars.Controls)
			{
				if (control != null && control.Selected)
				{
					enabled = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			cmdImport.Enabled = enabled;
		}

		private void ProcessSelectedToolbars(ToolBar[] toolbars)
		{
			if (toolbars == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ToolbarPickerControl control in pnlToolbars.Controls)
			{
				if (control == null || !control.Selected || control.Toolbar == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				string text = (ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(control.Toolbar.Text) ? control.Toolbar.Name : control.Toolbar.Text);
				UltraToolbar ultraToolbar = new UltraToolbar(GetUniquToolbarName(text.Replace(" ", "")));
				ultraToolbar.Text = ultraToolbar.Key;
				ultraToolbar.Visible = control.Toolbar.Visible;
				switch (control.Toolbar.TextAlign)
				{
				case ToolBarTextAlign.Underneath:
					ultraToolbar.Settings.CaptionPlacement = (TextPlacement)2;
					break;
				case ToolBarTextAlign.Right:
					ultraToolbar.Settings.CaptionPlacement = (TextPlacement)4;
					break;
				}
				switch (control.Toolbar.BorderStyle)
				{
				case BorderStyle.FixedSingle:
					ultraToolbar.Settings.BorderStyleDocked = (UIElementBorderStyle)4;
					break;
				case BorderStyle.Fixed3D:
					ultraToolbar.Settings.BorderStyleDocked = (UIElementBorderStyle)8;
					break;
				}
				switch (control.Toolbar.Dock)
				{
				case DockStyle.Left:
					ultraToolbar.DockedPosition = DockedPosition.Left;
					break;
				case DockStyle.Top:
					ultraToolbar.DockedPosition = DockedPosition.Top;
					break;
				case DockStyle.Right:
					ultraToolbar.DockedPosition = DockedPosition.Right;
					break;
				case DockStyle.Bottom:
					ultraToolbar.DockedPosition = DockedPosition.Bottom;
					break;
				}
				toolbarsManager.Toolbars.Add(ultraToolbar);
				ToolBase toolBase = null;
				bool flag = false;
				string empty = string.Empty;
				foreach (ToolBarButton button in control.Toolbar.Buttons)
				{
					empty = string.Empty;
					if (button.Text.Length > 0)
					{
						empty = button.Text;
					}
					else if (button.Site != null)
					{
						empty = button.Site.Name;
					}
					switch (button.Style)
					{
					case ToolBarButtonStyle.DropDownButton:
						if (empty.Length == 0)
						{
							empty = "PopupMenuTool";
						}
						toolBase = new PopupMenuTool(GetUniqueToolName(empty.Replace(" ", "")));
						if (control.Toolbar.DropDownArrows)
						{
							((PopupMenuTool)toolBase).DropDownArrowStyle = DropDownArrowStyle.Segmented;
						}
						break;
					case ToolBarButtonStyle.PushButton:
						if (empty.Length == 0)
						{
							empty = "ButtonTool";
						}
						toolBase = new ButtonTool(GetUniqueToolName(empty.Replace(" ", "")));
						break;
					case ToolBarButtonStyle.Separator:
						flag = true;
						ultraProgressBar1.PerformStep();
						continue;
					case ToolBarButtonStyle.ToggleButton:
						if (empty.Length == 0)
						{
							empty = "StateButtonTool";
						}
						toolBase = new StateButtonTool(GetUniqueToolName(empty.Replace(" ", "")));
						((StateButtonTool)toolBase).Checked = button.Pushed;
						break;
					}
					toolBase.SharedProps.Category = txtCategory.Text;
					toolBase.SharedProps.Enabled = button.Enabled;
					toolBase.SharedProps.Caption = button.Text;
					toolBase.SharedProps.Tag = button.Tag;
					toolBase.SharedProps.ToolTipText = button.ToolTipText;
					object obj = null;
					if (button.ImageIndex > -1)
					{
						obj = control.Toolbar.ImageList.Images[button.ImageIndex];
					}
					else if (button.ImageKey != null && button.ImageKey.Length > 0)
					{
						obj = control.Toolbar.ImageList.Images[button.ImageKey];
					}
					if (obj != null)
					{
						if (toolBase.SharedProps.Caption != null && toolBase.SharedProps.Caption.Length > 0)
						{
							toolBase.SharedProps.DisplayStyle = ToolDisplayStyle.ImageAndText;
						}
						if (opAddImagesToTool.Checked)
						{
							if (opAssignToSmallImage.Checked)
							{
								toolBase.SharedProps.AppearancesSmall.Appearance.Image = obj;
							}
							else
							{
								toolBase.SharedProps.AppearancesLarge.Appearance.Image = obj;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							Icon icon = obj as Icon;
							Image value = obj as Image;
							if (opImageListSmall.Checked)
							{
								if (icon != null)
								{
									toolbarsManager.ImageListSmall.Images.Add(icon);
									int num = IndexOfIconInImageList(toolbarsManager.ImageListSmall, icon);
									if (num > -1)
									{
										toolBase.SharedProps.AppearancesSmall.Appearance.Image = num;
									}
								}
								else
								{
									toolBase.SharedProps.AppearancesSmall.Appearance.Image = toolbarsManager.ImageListSmall.Images.Add(value, control.Toolbar.ImageList.TransparentColor);
								}
							}
							else if (icon != null)
							{
								toolbarsManager.ImageListLarge.Images.Add(icon);
								int num2 = IndexOfIconInImageList(toolbarsManager.ImageListLarge, icon);
								if (num2 > -1)
								{
									toolBase.SharedProps.AppearancesLarge.Appearance.Image = num2;
								}
							}
							else
							{
								toolBase.SharedProps.AppearancesLarge.Appearance.Image = toolbarsManager.ImageListLarge.Images.Add(value, control.Toolbar.ImageList.TransparentColor);
							}
						}
					}
					toolbarsManager.Tools.Add(toolBase);
					ultraToolbar.Tools.Add(toolBase);
					ultraToolbar.Tools[toolBase.Key].InstanceProps.Visible = (DefaultableBoolean)(button.Visible ? 1 : 2);
					if (flag)
					{
						ultraToolbar.Tools[toolBase.Key].InstanceProps.IsFirstInGroup = true;
						flag = false;
					}
					ultraProgressBar1.PerformStep();
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetupProgressBar()
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (ToolbarPickerControl control in pnlToolbars.Controls)
			{
				if (control != null && control.Selected)
				{
					num += control.Toolbar.Buttons.Count;
				}
			}
			ultraProgressBar1.Minimum = 0;
			ultraProgressBar1.Maximum = num;
			ultraProgressBar1.Value = 0;
			ultraProgressBar1.Step = 1;
			((Control)(object)ultraProgressBar1).Visible = true;
			((Control)(object)ultraProgressBar1).Refresh();
			lblImporting.Visible = true;
			lblImporting.Refresh();
		}

		private void cmdCancel_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Close();
		}

		private void cmdImport_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ToolBar[] formToolbarControls = toolbarsManager.FormToolbarControls;
			if (formToolbarControls == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				Cursor.Current = Cursors.WaitCursor;
				SetupProgressBar();
				ProcessSelectedToolbars(formToolbarControls);
				Cursor.Current = Cursors.Arrow;
				UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ImportToolbarControlsDlg_ImportSuccessful"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ImportToolbarControlsDlg_ImportSuccessfulTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Asterisk);
			}
			catch
			{
				Cursor.Current = Cursors.Arrow;
				UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ImportToolbarControlsDlg_ImportError"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ImportToolbarControlsDlg_ImportErrorTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Asterisk);
			}
			finally
			{
				((Control)(object)ultraProgressBar1).Visible = false;
				lblImporting.Visible = false;
				Close();
			}
		}

		private void opAddImagesToImagelist_CheckedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!opAddImagesToImagelist.Checked)
			{
				pnlImageListOptions.Enabled = false;
				return;
			}
			pnlImageListOptions.Enabled = true;
			opImageListSmall.Enabled = toolbarsManager.ImageListSmall != null;
			opImageListLarge.Enabled = toolbarsManager.ImageListLarge != null;
			if (opImageListSmall.Enabled && opImageListLarge.Enabled && !opImageListSmall.Checked && !opImageListLarge.Checked)
			{
				opImageListSmall.Checked = true;
			}
		}

		private void opAddImagesToTool_CheckedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			pnlImageOptions.Enabled = opAddImagesToTool.Checked;
			if (opAddImagesToTool.Checked && !opAssignToSmallImage.Checked && !opAssignToLargeImage.Checked)
			{
				opAssignToSmallImage.Checked = true;
			}
		}
	}

			InitializeFrom((ToolPropsBase)sourceProps);
			isFirstInGroup = sourceProps.isFirstInGroup;
			recentlyUsed = sourceProps.RecentlyUsed;
			spring = sourceProps.Spring;

			tagValue = sourceProps.Tag;
			preferredSizeOnRibbon = sourceProps.preferredSizeOnRibbon;
			minimumSizeOnRibbon = sourceProps.minimumSizeOnRibbon;
			buttonGroup = sourceProps.buttonGroup;
		}

			return true;

	public class LabelToolUIElement : UIElement, IProvideToolElementResizeInfo
	{
		private bool leftButtonDown;

		protected override bool WantsMouseHoverNotification
		{
			get
			{
				if (ToolbarsManager == null || ToolbarsManager.Customizing)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Tool != null)
				{
					return Tool.ToolTipTextResolved.Length > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override UIRole UIRole
		{
			get
			{
				ToolBase tool = Tool;
				if (tool != null)
				{
					if (tool.OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
					{
						return tool.UIRoleOnRibbonGroups;
					}
					return tool.UIRoleOnToolbars;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected override INotificationBadgeProvider NotificationBadgeProvider => (INotificationBadgeProvider)(object)Tool;

		public ToolBase Tool => ((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext as ToolBase;

		public UltraToolbarsManager ToolbarsManager => Tool.ToolbarsManager;

		bool IProvideToolElementResizeInfo.CanResizeHeight => Tool.IsVertical;

		bool IProvideToolElementResizeInfo.CanResizeWidth => !Tool.IsVertical;

		internal LabelToolUIElement(UIElement parent, ToolBase labelTool)
			: base(parent)
		{
			if (labelTool.OwnerIsToolbarInternal || labelTool.OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
			{
				((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext = labelTool;
			}
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0033: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_007c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0081: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0084: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0089: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0096: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			object context = null;
			bool flag = false;
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager != null)
			{
				ToolbarStyle styleResolved = toolbarsManager.StyleResolved;
				switch (styleResolved - 5)
				{
				case 0:
				case 2:
				case 3:
				case 4:
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				context = new ToolBase.ResolveAppearanceRibbonButtonInfo((UIElementButtonType)0, (UIElementButtonState)0);
			}
			Tool.ResolveAppearance(editArea: false, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, drawAsActive: false, drawAsPressed: false, context);
			if (Tool.IsVertical && ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)16) && ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)32))
			{
				HAlign textHAlign = ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).TextHAlign;
				VAlign textVAlign = ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).TextVAlign;
				DrawUtility.VerticalTranslateAlignment(ref textHAlign, ref textVAlign, false);
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).TextHAlign = textHAlign;
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).TextVAlign = textVAlign;
			}
			if (Tool.OwningToolbarBase is QuickAccessToolbar { Location: QuickAccessToolbarLocation.AboveRibbon })
			{
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFEFFFFuL);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnAfterDraw(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				if (ToolbarsManager.CustomizingTool(Tool))
				{
					ToolbarsManager.DrawToolSelectionRect((UIElement)(object)this, ref drawParams, Tool);
				}
				if (Tool != null)
				{
					Tool.DrawToolInsertionBar((UIElement)(object)this, ref drawParams);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnClick()
		{
			if (leftButtonDown && ToolbarsManager != null && !ToolbarsManager.Customizing && Tool.EnabledResolved)
			{
				Tool.IncrementClickCount();
				Tool.OnToolClick();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDoubleClick(bool adjustableArea)
		{
			if (!(Tool is TaskPaneToolbarLabelTool) && Tool != null && Tool.OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.ToolDoubleClick, new ToolEventArgs(Tool));
			}
			else
			{
				((UIElement)this).OnDoubleClick(adjustableArea);
			}
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e, bool adjustableArea, ref UIElement captureMouseForElement)
		{
			leftButtonDown = (e.Button & MouseButtons.Left) == MouseButtons.Left;
			if (ToolbarsManager == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ToolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (Tool is TaskPaneToolbarLabelTool)
			{
				return ((UIElement)this).OnMouseDown(e, adjustableArea, ref captureMouseForElement);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter()
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager != null && !ToolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.ImmediateToolTipDisplayMode = true;
				Tool.DisplayToolTip();
				((UIElement)this).OnMouseEnter();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseHover()
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.ImmediateToolTipDisplayMode = true;
				if (ToolbarsManager.ActiveTool == null)
				{
					Tool.DisplayToolTip();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave()
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager != null && !ToolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				Tool.HideToolTip();
				ToolbarsManager.ImmediateToolTipDisplayMode = false;
				((UIElement)this).OnMouseLeave();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager != null && !ToolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				Tool.DisplayToolTip();
				((UIElement)this).OnMouseMove(e);
			}
		}

	[Serializable]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(ListToolConverter))]
	public class ListTool : ToolBase, ISerializable
	{
		public class ListToolItemAccessibleObject : AccessibleObjectWrapper
		{
			private ListTool tool;

			private int itemIndex;

			public override Rectangle Bounds
			{
				get
				{
					UIElement uIElement = tool.UIElement;
					if (uIElement == null)
					{
						return Rectangle.Empty;
					}
					Rectangle rect = uIElement.Rect;
					UIElementEnumerator enumerator = uIElement.Parent.ChildElements.GetEnumerator();
					try
					{
						while (enumerator.MoveNext())
						{
							UIElement current = enumerator.Current;
							if (current is PopupMenuItemUIElement popupMenuItemUIElement && popupMenuItemUIElement.MenuItem is ListToolMenuItem && tool.IsSameLogicalTool(popupMenuItemUIElement.MenuItem.Tool.UnderlyingTool))
							{
								ListToolMenuItem listToolMenuItem = popupMenuItemUIElement.MenuItem as ListToolMenuItem;
								if (listToolMenuItem.ListToolItemIndex == itemIndex)
								{
									rect = ((UIElement)popupMenuItemUIElement).Rect;
									break;
								}
							}
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
						{
							disposable.Dispose();
						}
					}
					if (rect.IsEmpty)
					{
						return rect;
					}
					try
					{
						return uIElement.Control.RectangleToScreen(rect);
					}
					catch
					{
						return Rectangle.Empty;
					}
				}
			}

			public override string DefaultAction => Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DefaultAction_Item_On_Menu");

			public override string Description => null;

			public override string KeyboardShortcut
			{
				get
				{
					char firstMnemonicChar = Utilities.GetFirstMnemonicChar(tool.GetItemText(itemIndex));
					if (object.Equals(firstMnemonicChar, '\0'))
					{
						return null;
					}
					return new string(firstMnemonicChar, 1);
				}
			}

			public override string Name
			{
				get
				{
					string name = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name;
					if (name != null && name.Length > 0)
					{
						return name;
					}
					return Utilities.StripMnemonics(tool.GetItemText(itemIndex));
				}
				set
				{
					((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name = value;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Parent => tool.AccessibilityObject;

			public override AccessibleRole Role => AccessibleRole.ListItem;

			public override AccessibleStates State
			{
				get
				{
					AccessibleStates accessibleStates = AccessibleStates.Selectable;
					if (tool.SelectedItemIndex == itemIndex)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Selected | AccessibleStates.Checked;
					}
					return accessibleStates;
				}
			}

			internal ListTool Tool => tool;

			internal int ItemIndex => itemIndex;

			public ListToolItemAccessibleObject(ListTool tool, int itemIndex)
			{
				this.tool = tool;
				this.itemIndex = itemIndex;
			}

			public override void DoDefaultAction()
			{
				tool.DoDefaultActionForItem(itemIndex);
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
			{
				return null;
			}

			public override int GetChildCount()
			{
				return 0;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetFocused()
			{
				AccessibleObject focused = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Parent.GetFocused();
				if (focused == ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).AccessibleObject)
				{
					return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).AccessibleObject;
				}
				return null;
			}

			protected override Control GetMarshallingControl()
			{
				return tool.ToolbarsManagerInControl?.DockWithinContainer;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetSelected()
			{
				return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).GetFocused();
			}

			public override AccessibleObject HitTest(int x, int y)
			{
				return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).HitTest(x, y);
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				switch (navdir)
				{
				case AccessibleNavigation.Down:
					navdir = AccessibleNavigation.Next;
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Up:
					navdir = AccessibleNavigation.Previous;
					break;
				default:
					return null;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Next:
				case AccessibleNavigation.Previous:
					break;
				}
				UIElement uIElement = tool.UIElement;
				if (uIElement == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				bool flag = false;
				ListToolMenuItem listToolMenuItem = null;
				ListToolMenuItem listToolMenuItem2 = null;
				UIElementEnumerator enumerator = uIElement.Parent.ChildElements.GetEnumerator();
				try
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						UIElement current = enumerator.Current;
						if (!(current is PopupMenuItemUIElement popupMenuItemUIElement) || !(popupMenuItemUIElement.MenuItem is ListToolMenuItem) || !tool.IsSameLogicalTool(popupMenuItemUIElement.MenuItem.Tool.UnderlyingTool))
						{
							continue;
						}
						ListToolMenuItem listToolMenuItem3 = popupMenuItemUIElement.MenuItem as ListToolMenuItem;
						if (listToolMenuItem3.ListToolItemIndex == itemIndex)
						{
							if (navdir == AccessibleNavigation.Previous)
							{
								listToolMenuItem2 = listToolMenuItem;
								break;
							}
							flag = true;
						}
						else
						{
							if (flag && navdir == AccessibleNavigation.Next)
							{
								listToolMenuItem2 = listToolMenuItem3;
								break;
							}
							listToolMenuItem = listToolMenuItem3;
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
					{
						disposable.Dispose();
					}
				}
				if (listToolMenuItem2 != null)
				{
					int accessibleIndex = tool.GetAccessibleIndex(listToolMenuItem2.ListToolItemIndex);
					if (accessibleIndex >= 0)
					{
						return tool.GetAccessibleChild(accessibleIndex);
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override void Select(AccessibleSelection flags)
			{
				MenuAgentBase menuAgentBase = null;
				if (tool.OwnerIsMenuInternal)
				{
					if (!tool.OwningMenuInternal.IsMenuAgentCreated || !tool.OwningMenuInternal.IsOpen)
					{
						return;
					}
					menuAgentBase = tool.OwningMenuInternal.MenuAgent;
				}
				else
				{
					if (!tool.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea || !tool.OwningApplicationMenuArea.ApplicationMenu.IsOpen)
					{
						return;
					}
					menuAgentBase = tool.OwningApplicationMenuArea.ApplicationMenu.MenuAgent;
				}
				ListToolMenuItem listToolMenuItem = menuAgentBase.ActiveMenuItem as ListToolMenuItem;
				if ((flags & (AccessibleSelection.TakeFocus | AccessibleSelection.TakeSelection | AccessibleSelection.ExtendSelection | AccessibleSelection.AddSelection)) != AccessibleSelection.None)
				{
					if (listToolMenuItem != null && listToolMenuItem.ListToolItemIndex == itemIndex)
					{
						return;
					}
					{
						foreach (ListToolMenuItem menuItem in menuAgentBase.GetMenuItems(Tool))
						{
							if (menuItem.ListToolItemIndex == itemIndex)
							{
								if (menuItem.Enabled)
								{
									menuAgentBase.CloseOpenSubmenuTools(null, delay: false);
									menuItem.Activate();
								}
								break;
							}
						}
						return;
					}
				}
				if ((flags & AccessibleSelection.RemoveSelection) != AccessibleSelection.None && listToolMenuItem != null && listToolMenuItem.ListToolItemIndex == itemIndex)
				{
					menuAgentBase.CloseOpenSubmenuTools(null, delay: false);
					listToolMenuItem.Deactivate();
				}
			}
		}

		public class ListToolConverter : ExpandableObjectConverter
		{
			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(ListTool).GetConstructor(new Type[1] { typeof(string) });
					ListTool listTool = (ListTool)value;
					return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[1] { listTool.Key }, isComplete: false);
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

						return;
					}
					owningTool.VerifyCanBeModified();
					if (value < 0)
					{
						selectedItemIndex = -1;
						cachedSelectedItem = null;
						return;
					}
					if (value > ListToolItems.Count - 1)
					{
						throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_11"));
					}
					selectedItemIndex = value;
					cachedSelectedItem = ListToolItems[selectedItemIndex];
				}
			}

			internal ListToolExtraSharedProps(ListTool owningTool)
			{
				this.owningTool = owningTool;
				moreItemsText = this.owningTool.DefaultMoreItemsText;
			}

			internal void VefirySelectedItem()
			{
				if (cachedSelectedItem != null)
				{
					selectedItemIndex = ListToolItems.IndexOf(cachedSelectedItem);
					if (selectedItemIndex < 0)
					{
						cachedSelectedItem = null;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public override Rectangle Bounds
		{
			get
			{
				UIElement uIElement = base.UIElement;
				if (uIElement == null)
				{
					return Rectangle.Empty;
				}
				Rectangle rectangle = uIElement.Rect;
				UIElementEnumerator enumerator = uIElement.Parent.ChildElements.GetEnumerator();
				try
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						UIElement current = enumerator.Current;
						if (current != uIElement && current.GetContext(typeof(ToolBase), false) is ToolBase toolBase && toolBase.UnderlyingTool == this)
						{
							rectangle = Rectangle.Union(rectangle, current.Rect);
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
					{
						disposable.Dispose();
					}
				}
				if (rectangle.IsEmpty)
				{
					return rectangle;
				}
				try
				{
					return uIElement.Control.RectangleToScreen(rectangle);
				}
				catch
				{
					return Rectangle.Empty;
				}
			}
		}

		protected ListTool(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "ListToolItems":
					SerializedProps.listToolItems = (ListToolItemsCollection)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ListToolItemsCollection), null);
					break;
				case "MaxItemsToDisplay":
					SerializedProps.maxItemsToDisplay = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), MaxItemsToDisplay);
					break;
				case "MoreItemsText":
					SerializedProps.moreItemsText = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), MoreItemsText);
					break;
				case "DisplayCheckmark":
					SerializedProps.displayCheckmark = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), DisplayCheckmark);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void AddListItemsToAgent(MenuAgentBase menuAgent, ToolBase toolInMenu, bool isTabbedMdi)
		{
			if (menuAgent != null)
			{
				AddListItemsToAgent(menuAgent.MenuItems, toolInMenu, isTabbedMdi);
			}
		}

		internal void AddListItemsToAgent(MenuItemsCollection menuItems, ToolBase toolInMenu, bool isTabbedMdi)
		{
			MenuItemBase menuItemBase = null;
			moreToolsItemAddedToAgent = false;
			commandsAddedToAgent = 0;
			itemsAddedToAgent = 0;
			if (this is MdiWindowListTool)
			{
				MdiWindowListTool mdiWindowListTool = this as MdiWindowListTool;
				mdiWindowListTool.RefreshWindowList();
				if (!isTabbedMdi && (mdiWindowListTool.DisplayArrangeIconsCommand == MdiWindowListCommandDisplayStyle.DisplayOnMenu || mdiWindowListTool.DisplayArrangeIconsCommand == MdiWindowListCommandDisplayStyle.DisplayOnMenuAndDialog))
				{
					AddCommandToAgentHelper(menuItems, toolInMenu, -3);
				}
				if (!isTabbedMdi && (mdiWindowListTool.DisplayCascadeCommand == MdiWindowListCommandDisplayStyle.DisplayOnMenu || mdiWindowListTool.DisplayCascadeCommand == MdiWindowListCommandDisplayStyle.DisplayOnMenuAndDialog))
				{
					AddCommandToAgentHelper(menuItems, toolInMenu, -4);
				}
				if (mdiWindowListTool.DisplayCloseWindowsCommand == MdiWindowListCommandDisplayStyle.DisplayOnMenu || mdiWindowListTool.DisplayCloseWindowsCommand == MdiWindowListCommandDisplayStyle.DisplayOnMenuAndDialog)
				{
					AddCommandToAgentHelper(menuItems, toolInMenu, -5);
				}
				if (!isTabbedMdi && (mdiWindowListTool.DisplayTileHorizontalCommand == MdiWindowListCommandDisplayStyle.DisplayOnMenu || mdiWindowListTool.DisplayTileHorizontalCommand == MdiWindowListCommandDisplayStyle.DisplayOnMenuAndDialog))
				{
					AddCommandToAgentHelper(menuItems, toolInMenu, -6);
				}
				if (!isTabbedMdi && (mdiWindowListTool.DisplayTileVerticalCommand == MdiWindowListCommandDisplayStyle.DisplayOnMenu || mdiWindowListTool.DisplayTileVerticalCommand == MdiWindowListCommandDisplayStyle.DisplayOnMenuAndDialog))
				{
					AddCommandToAgentHelper(menuItems, toolInMenu, -7);
				}
				if (!isTabbedMdi && (mdiWindowListTool.DisplayMinimizeCommand == MdiWindowListCommandDisplayStyle.DisplayOnMenu || mdiWindowListTool.DisplayMinimizeCommand == MdiWindowListCommandDisplayStyle.DisplayOnMenuAndDialog))
				{
					AddCommandToAgentHelper(menuItems, toolInMenu, -8);
				}
			}
			int num = ((MaxItemsToDisplay == 0) ? ListToolItems.Count : MaxItemsToDisplay);
			int num2 = Math.Min(num, ListToolItems.Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
			{
				menuItemBase = new ListToolMenuItem(toolInMenu, i);
				menuItems.Add(menuItemBase);
				itemsAddedToAgent++;
			}
			if (ListToolItems.Count > num)
			{
				menuItemBase = new ListToolMenuItem(toolInMenu, -2);
				menuItems.Add(menuItemBase);
				moreToolsItemAddedToAgent = true;
			}
		}

		private void AddCommandToAgentHelper(MenuItemsCollection menuItems, ToolBase toolInMenu, int commandIndex)
		{
			MenuItemBase menuItemBase = new ListToolMenuItem(toolInMenu, commandIndex);
			((ListToolMenuItem)menuItemBase).ForceFirstInGroup = commandsAddedToAgent == 0 && base.IsFirstInGroupResolved;
			menuItems.Add(menuItemBase);
			if (commandsAddedIndices == null)
			{
				commandsAddedIndices = new int[6];
			}
			else if (commandsAddedToAgent == 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++)
				{
					commandsAddedIndices[i] = 0;
				}
			}
			commandsAddedIndices[commandsAddedToAgent] = commandIndex;
			commandsAddedToAgent++;
		}

		internal virtual void DoDefaultActionForItem(int itemIndex)
		{
			if (itemIndex >= 0)
			{
				if (itemIndex < ListToolItems.Count)
				{
					SelectedItemIndex = itemIndex;
				}
			}
			else if (itemIndex == -2)
			{
				CancelableToolEventArgs e = new CancelableToolEventArgs(this);
				base.ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.BeforeDisplayMoreItemsDialog, e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (UnderlyingTool != null && UnderlyingTool is MdiWindowListTool)
				{
					MoreWindowsDialog moreWindowsDialog = new MoreWindowsDialog(base.ToolbarsManagerInControl, UnderlyingTool as MdiWindowListTool);
					((Form)(object)moreWindowsDialog).StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterParent;
					((Form)(object)moreWindowsDialog).ShowDialog((IWin32Window)base.ToolbarsManagerInControl.FindContainer());
					if (moreWindowsDialog.IndexToActivate != -1)
					{
						SelectedItemIndex = moreWindowsDialog.IndexToActivate;
						DoDefaultActionForItem(moreWindowsDialog.IndexToActivate);
					}
					((Component)(object)moreWindowsDialog).Dispose();
				}
				else
				{
					MoreItemsDialog moreItemsDialog = new MoreItemsDialog(this);
					((Form)(object)moreItemsDialog).StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterParent;
					((Form)(object)moreItemsDialog).ShowDialog((IWin32Window)base.ToolbarsManagerInControl.FindContainer());
					((Component)(object)moreItemsDialog).Dispose();
				}
			}
			else if (UnderlyingTool is MdiWindowListTool mdiWindowListTool)
			{
				switch (itemIndex)
				{
				case -3:
					mdiWindowListTool.ArrangeIcons();
					break;
				case -4:
					mdiWindowListTool.CascadeWindows();
					break;
				case -5:
					mdiWindowListTool.CloseAllWindows();
					break;
				case -6:
					mdiWindowListTool.TileWindowsHorizontally();
					break;
				case -7:
					mdiWindowListTool.TileWindowsVertically();
					break;
				case -8:
					mdiWindowListTool.MinimizeAllWindows();
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal int GetAccessibleIndex(int listItemIndex)
		{
			if (listItemIndex >= 0)
			{
				return listItemIndex + commandsAddedToAgent;
			}
			if (listItemIndex == -2)
			{
				return commandsAddedToAgent + itemsAddedToAgent;
			}
			if (commandsAddedIndices == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < commandsAddedIndices.Length; i++)
			{
				if (commandsAddedIndices[i] == listItemIndex)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return 0;
		}

		internal string GetItemText(int itemIndex)
		{
			if (itemIndex >= 0)
			{
				if (itemIndex < ListToolItems.Count)
				{
					return ListToolItems[itemIndex].Text;
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return itemIndex switch
			{
				-3 => Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("MdiCommandArrangeIcons"), 
				-4 => Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("MdiCommandCascade"), 
				-5 => Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("MdiCommandCloseWindows"), 
				-6 => Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("MdiCommandTileHorizontal"), 
				-7 => Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("MdiCommandTileVertical"), 
				-8 => Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("MdiCommandMinimizeWindows"), 
				-2 => MoreItemsText, 
				_ => string.Empty, 
			};
		}

		internal bool IsDisplayed(ListToolItem listToolItem)
		{
			int num = ListToolItems.IndexOf(listToolItem);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (MaxItemsToDisplay != 0 && MaxItemsToDisplay <= num)
			{
				return false;
			}
			UIElement uIElementForItem = (UIElement)(object)GetUIElementForItem(listToolItem);
			if (uIElementForItem == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.ToolBeingDisplayed.IsOnBackStage)
			{
				Control control = uIElementForItem.Control;
				if (control == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				Control parent = Utilities.GetParent(control);
				if (parent == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				Rectangle rect = uIElementForItem.Rect;
				rect.Offset(parent.DisplayRectangle.Location);
				return parent.ClientRectangle.IntersectsWith(rect);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal Point GetKeyTipLocation(ListToolItem listToolItem)
		{
			PopupMenuItemUIElement uIElementForItem = GetUIElementForItem(listToolItem);
			return GetKeyTipLocation(uIElementForItem);
		}

		internal static Point GetKeyTipLocation(PopupMenuItemUIElement menuItemUIElement)
		{
			if (menuItemUIElement == null)
			{
				return Point.Empty;
			}
			Control control = ((UIElement)menuItemUIElement).Control;
			if (control == null || control.Disposing || control.IsDisposed)
			{
				return Point.Empty;
			}
			Rectangle imageRect = menuItemUIElement.GetImageRect();
			Rectangle rectangle = ((!imageRect.IsEmpty) ? control.RectangleToScreen(imageRect) : control.RectangleToScreen(((UIElement)menuItemUIElement).Rect));
			return new Point((rectangle.Left + rectangle.Right) / 2, (rectangle.Top + rectangle.Bottom) / 2);
		}

		internal void SetSelectedItem(ListToolItem listToolItem)
		{
			int num = ListToolItems.IndexOf(listToolItem);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				SelectedItemIndex = num;
			}
		}

		internal void SetSelectedItemIndex(int value, bool fireEvents)
		{
			if (DisplayCheckmark)
			{
				if (ExtraSharedProps.SelectedItemIndex == value)
				{
					ExtraSharedProps.SelectedItemIndex = -1;
				}
				else
				{
					ExtraSharedProps.SelectedItemIndex = value;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.SelectedItemIndex = value;
			}
			if (fireEvents)
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager != null && toolbarsManager.Initialized && value > -1 && value < ListToolItems.Count)
				{
					ToolClickEventArgs e = new ToolClickEventArgs(this, ListToolItems[value]);
					toolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.ToolClick, e);
				}
			}
		}

		private PopupMenuItemUIElement GetUIElementForItem(ListToolItem listToolItem)
		{
			MenuAgentBase menuAgentBase = null;
			ToolBase toolBeingDisplayed = base.ToolBeingDisplayed;
			if (toolBeingDisplayed.OwnerIsMenuInternal)
			{
				menuAgentBase = toolBeingDisplayed.OwningMenuInternal.MenuAgent;
			}
			else if (toolBeingDisplayed.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)
			{
				menuAgentBase = toolBeingDisplayed.OwningApplicationMenuArea.ApplicationMenu.MenuAgent;
			}
			else if (toolBeingDisplayed.OwnerIsApplicationMenu2010NavigationMenu)
			{
				menuAgentBase = toolBeingDisplayed.OwningApplicationMenu2010NavigationMenu.ApplicationMenu2010.MenuAgent;
			}
			if (menuAgentBase == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			MenuItemsCollection menuItems = menuAgentBase.GetMenuItems(toolBeingDisplayed);
			if (menuItems == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ListToolMenuItem listToolMenuItem = null;
			foreach (MenuItemBase item in menuItems)
			{
				listToolMenuItem = item as ListToolMenuItem;
				if (listToolMenuItem != null && listToolMenuItem.ListToolItemIndex >= 0 && listToolMenuItem.Tool == toolBeingDisplayed && ListToolItems[listToolMenuItem.ListToolItemIndex] == listToolItem)
				{
					break;
				}
				listToolMenuItem = null;
			}
			if (listToolMenuItem == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return listToolMenuItem.UIElement as PopupMenuItemUIElement;
		}

		internal override void AddMenuItems(ToolBase tool, MenuItemsCollection menuItems, MenuItemBase[] oldMenuItems)
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = tool.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null || toolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				base.AddMenuItems(tool, menuItems, oldMenuItems);
			}
			else
			{
				AddListItemsToAgent(menuItems, tool, this is MdiWindowListTool && toolbarsManager.IsTabbedMdi);
			}
		}

		protected internal override ToolBase Clone(bool cloneNewInstance)
		{
			ListTool listTool = new ListTool(Key);
			listTool.InitializeFrom(this, cloneNewInstance);
			return listTool;
		}

		protected internal override AccessibleObject GetAccessibleChild(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (index < commandsAddedToAgent)
			{
				int num = 0;
				if (commandsAddedIndices != null)
				{
					num = commandsAddedIndices[index];
				}
				if (num < -2)
				{
					if (commandAccessibleObjects == null)
					{
						commandAccessibleObjects = new AccessibleObject[6];
					}
					int num2 = Math.Abs(num) - 3;
					if (commandAccessibleObjects[num2] == null)
					{
						commandAccessibleObjects[num2] = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new ListToolItemAccessibleObject(this, num)).AccessibleObject;
					}
					return commandAccessibleObjects[num2];
				}
				return null;
			}
			index -= commandsAddedToAgent;
			if (index < itemsAddedToAgent && index < ListToolItems.Count)
			{
				return ListToolItems[index].GetAccessibilityObject(this);
			}
			if (moreToolsItemAddedToAgent)
			{
				if (moreToolsAccessibleObject == null)
				{
					moreToolsAccessibleObject = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new ListToolItemAccessibleObject(this, -2)).AccessibleObject;
				}
				return moreToolsAccessibleObject;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal override IKeyTipProvider[] GetKeyTipProviders()
		{
			return new IKeyTipProvider[0];
		}

		protected internal override void Initialize(ToolsCollectionBase parentCollection)
		{

				return;
			}
			ExtraSharedProps.maxItemsToDisplay = serializedProps.maxItemsToDisplay;
			ExtraSharedProps.moreItemsText = serializedProps.moreItemsText;
			if (serializedProps.listToolItems != null)
			{
				if (ExtraSharedProps.listToolItems != null)
				{
					ExtraSharedProps.listToolItems.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				ExtraSharedProps.listToolItems = serializedProps.listToolItems;
				ExtraSharedProps.listToolItems.Initialize(this);
				ExtraSharedProps.listToolItems.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			ExtraSharedProps.displayCheckmark = serializedProps.displayCheckmark;
			serializedProps = null;
		}

		protected internal override void InitializeFrom(ToolBase sourceTool, bool cloneNewInstance)
		{
			base.InitializeFrom(sourceTool, cloneNewInstance);
			ListTool listTool = sourceTool as ListTool;
			if (!cloneNewInstance && listTool != null)
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.maxItemsToDisplay = listTool.ExtraSharedProps.MaxItemsToDisplay;
				ExtraSharedProps.moreItemsText = listTool.ExtraSharedProps.MoreItemsText;
				ExtraSharedProps.displayCheckmark = listTool.ExtraSharedProps.DisplayCheckmark;
				for (int i = 0; i < listTool.ExtraSharedProps.ListToolItems.Count; i++)
				{
					ExtraSharedProps.ListToolItems.Add(listTool.ExtraSharedProps.ListToolItems[i].Clone());
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (ExtraSharedProps.listToolItems != null)
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.listToolItems.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				ExtraSharedProps.listToolItems.Dispose();
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (propChange.Source == ExtraSharedProps.listToolItems)
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.VefirySelectedItem();
				if (base.SharedProps != null)
				{
					foreach (ToolBase toolInstance in base.SharedProps.ToolInstances)
					{
						if (toolInstance.OwnerIsMenuInternal)
						{
							toolInstance.OwningMenuInternal.ResetDropDownVersion();
						}
						else if (toolInstance.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)
						{
							toolInstance.OwningApplicationMenuArea.ApplicationMenu.ResetDropDownVersion();
						}
					}
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ListToolItems, propChange);
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnSubObjectPropChanged(propChange);
			}
		}

		protected ListToolItem(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			//IL_01bc: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01c6: Expected O, but got Unknown
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "Appearance":
					appearanceHolder = (AppearanceHolder)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(AppearanceHolder), appearanceHolder);
					break;
				case "Key":
					base.Key = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), base.Key);
					break;
				case "Tag":
					DeserializeTag(current);
					break;
				case "Text":
					text = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), text);
					break;
				case "Value":
					itemValue = Utils.DeserializeObjectProperty(current);
					break;
				case "Enabled":
					enabled = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), true);
					break;
				case "DescriptionOnMenu":
					descriptionOnMenu = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), descriptionOnMenu);
					formattedDescriptionOnMenu = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ParseFormattedText(descriptionOnMenu, throwError: false);
					break;
				case "KeyTip":
					keyTip = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), keyTip);
					break;
				case "NotificationBadgeSettings":
					notificationBadgeSettings = (ToolNotificationBadgeSettings)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ToolNotificationBadgeSettings), notificationBadgeSettings);
					((SubObjectBase)(object)notificationBadgeSettings).SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					break;
				case "NotificationBadgeText":
					notificationBadgeText = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), notificationBadgeText);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeAppearance())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Appearance", appearanceHolder);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeKey())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Key", Key);
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
			if (ShouldSerializeText())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Text", text);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeValue())
			{
				Utils.SerializeObjectProperty(info, "Value", itemValue);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeEnabled())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Enabled", enabled);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeDescriptionOnMenu())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "DescriptionOnMenu", descriptionOnMenu);
			}
			if (keyTip != null)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "KeyTip", keyTip);
			}
			GetObjectData(info, context);
			if (ShouldSerializeNotificationBadgeSettings())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "NotificationBadgeSettings", notificationBadgeSettings);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeNotificationBadgeText())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "NotificationBadgeText", notificationBadgeText);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			bool flag = false;
			if (this.text != null && this.text.Length > 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(this.text);
				flag = true;
			}
			string text = Key;
			if (text != null && text.Length > 0)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(" - [");
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append("[");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(Key);
				stringBuilder.Append("]");
			}
			else
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(" ");
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeAppearance()
		{
			if (HasAppearance)
			{
				return appearanceHolder.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetAppearance()
		{
			if (HasAppearance)
			{
				appearanceHolder.Reset();
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Appearance);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerializeDescriptionOnMenu()
		{
			return !ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(descriptionOnMenu);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetDescriptionOnMenu()
		{
			DescriptionOnMenu = string.Empty;
		}

		public override bool ShouldSerializeKey()
		{
			return Key.Length > 0;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public override void ResetKey()
		{
			Key = string.Empty;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		protected internal bool ShouldSerializeText()
		{
			return !ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(text);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetText()
		{
			Text = string.Empty;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		protected internal bool ShouldSerializeValue()
		{
			return itemValue != null;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetValue()
		{
			Value = null;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		protected internal bool ShouldSerializeEnabled()
		{
			return !enabled;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetEnabled()
		{
			Enabled = true;
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeNotificationBadgeSettings()
		{
			if (notificationBadgeSettings != null)
			{
				return ((NotificationBadgeSettings)notificationBadgeSettings).ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ResetNotificationBadgeSettings()
		{
			NotificationBadgeSettings = null;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		protected internal bool ShouldSerializeNotificationBadgeText()
		{
			return !ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(NotificationBadgeText);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetNotificationBadgeText()
		{
			NotificationBadgeText = null;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			ResetAppearance();
			ResetTag();
			ResetText();
			ResetValue();
			ResetEnabled();
			ResetDescriptionOnMenu();
			KeyTip = null;
			ResetNotificationBadgeSettings();
			ResetNotificationBadgeText();
		}

		internal ListToolItem Clone()
		{
			ListToolItem listToolItem = new ListToolItem(Key, text, isChecked);
			listToolItem.enabled = enabled;
			listToolItem.itemValue = itemValue;
			listToolItem.descriptionOnMenu = descriptionOnMenu;
			if (appearanceHolder != null)
			{
				listToolItem.appearanceHolder = appearanceHolder.Clone();
			}
			return listToolItem;
		}

		internal AccessibleObject GetAccessibilityObject(ListTool listTool)
		{
			if (accessibleObjectWrapper == null || accessibleObjectWrapper.Tool != listTool || accessibleObjectWrapper.ItemIndex != Index)
			{
				accessibleObjectWrapper = new ListTool.ListToolItemAccessibleObject(listTool, Index);
			}
			return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)accessibleObjectWrapper).AccessibleObject;
		}

		internal void Initialize(ListToolItemsCollection parentCollection)
		{
			if (appearanceHolder != null)
			{
				appearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				appearanceHolder.Collection = ParentCollection.ToolbarsManager.Appearances;
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		protected virtual void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
		}

		Rectangle INotificationBadgeProvider.GetNotificationBadgeBounds()
		{
			return Rectangle.Empty;
		}
	}
	internal class ListToolItemKeyTipProvider : IKeyTipProvider
	{
		private ListToolItem listToolItem;

		private ListTool listToolInstance;

		private ListToolMenuItem listToolMenuItem;

		private ToolBase toolBeingDisplayed;

		System.Drawing.ContentAlignment IKeyTipProvider.Alignment => System.Drawing.ContentAlignment.TopLeft;

		string IKeyTipProvider.AutoGeneratePrefix => null;

		string IKeyTipProvider.Caption => listToolItem.Text;

		bool IKeyTipProvider.DeactivateParentContainersOnActivate => true;

		bool IKeyTipProvider.IsEnabled => listToolItem.Enabled;

		bool IKeyTipProvider.IsVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (toolBeingDisplayed != listToolInstance)
				{
					ToolBase underlyingTool = toolBeingDisplayed.UnderlyingTool;
					if (underlyingTool != null)
					{
						ToolBase toolBase = null;
						try
						{
							toolBase = toolBeingDisplayed.AttachToUnderlyingTool();
							return listToolInstance.IsDisplayed(listToolItem);
						}
						finally
						{
							toolBase?.AttachToUnderlyingTool();
						}
					}
				}
				return listToolInstance.IsDisplayed(listToolItem);
			}
		}

		string IKeyTipProvider.KeyTipValue => listToolItem.KeyTip;

		Point IKeyTipProvider.Location
		{
			get
			{
				if (toolBeingDisplayed != listToolInstance)
				{
					ToolBase underlyingTool = toolBeingDisplayed.UnderlyingTool;
					if (underlyingTool != null)
					{
						ToolBase toolBase = null;
						try
						{
							toolBase = toolBeingDisplayed.AttachToUnderlyingTool();
							return listToolInstance.GetKeyTipLocation(listToolItem);
						}
						finally
						{
							toolBase?.AttachToUnderlyingTool();
						}
					}
				}
				return listToolInstance.GetKeyTipLocation(listToolItem);
			}
		}

		char IKeyTipProvider.Mnemonic => Utilities.GetFirstMnemonicChar(((IKeyTipProvider)this).Caption);

		Control IKeyTipProvider.OwningControl
		{
			get
			{
				UIElement uIElement = listToolMenuItem.UIElement;
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					return uIElement.Control;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public ListToolItemKeyTipProvider(ListToolItem listToolItem, ListTool listToolInstance, ListToolMenuItem listToolMenuItem)
		{
			toolBeingDisplayed = listToolInstance.ToolBeingDisplayed;
			this.listToolInstance = listToolInstance;
			this.listToolItem = listToolItem;
			this.listToolMenuItem = listToolMenuItem;
		}

		bool IKeyTipProvider.Activate()
		{
			listToolInstance.SetSelectedItem(listToolItem);
			return true;
		}

		bool IKeyTipProvider.Equals(IKeyTipProvider provider)
		{
			return provider == this;
		}

		IKeyTipContainer IKeyTipProvider.GetContainer()
		{
			return null;
		}
	}

			public ListToolItemEnumerator(ListToolItemsCollection listToolItems)
				: base(listToolItems)

		private List<ListToolItem> DeserializedTools
		{
			get
			{
				if (deserializedTools == null)

					deserializedTools = new List<ListToolItem>(InitialCapacity);
				}
				return deserializedTools;

		bool IList.IsFixedSize => false;

		object IList.this[int index]
		{

		internal ListToolItemsCollection(ListTool listTool)
		{
			this.listTool = listTool;
		}

		protected ListToolItemsCollection(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.Value is ListToolItem)
				{
					ListToolItem listToolItem = (ListToolItem)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ListToolItem), null);
					if (listToolItem != null)
					{
						DeserializedTools.Add(listToolItem);
					}
					continue;
				}
				string name = current.Name;
				if (!(name == "Count"))
				{
					if (name == "Tag")
					{
						DeserializeTag(current);
					}
					continue;
				}
				int num = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), initialCapacity);
				initialCapacity = Math.Max(initialCapacity, num);
				if (num > 0)
				{
					deserializedTools = new List<ListToolItem>(num);
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Count", Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, i.ToString(), this[i]);
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public int Add(object obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_12"));
			}
			if (!(obj is ListToolItem listToolItem))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_4", obj.GetType().Name));
			}
			return InternalAdd(listToolItem);
		}

		public ListToolItem Add(string key)
		{
			ListToolItem listToolItem = new ListToolItem(key);
			try
			{
				InternalAdd(listToolItem);
				return listToolItem;
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		public ListToolItem Add(string key, string text)
		{
			ListToolItem listToolItem = new ListToolItem(key, text, isChecked: false);
			try
			{
				InternalAdd(listToolItem);
				return listToolItem;
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		public ListToolItem Add(string key, string text, bool isChecked)
		{
			ListToolItem listToolItem = new ListToolItem(key, text, isChecked);
			int num = -1;
			try
			{
				num = InternalAdd(listToolItem);
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (isChecked && num > -1)
			{
				ListTool.SelectedItemIndex = num;
			}
			return listToolItem;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			ClearHelper(notifyListeners: true);
		}

		public ListToolItemEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new ListToolItemEnumerator(this);
		}

		public ListToolItem Insert(int index, string key)
		{
			if (index < 0 || index > Count)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_121"));
			}
			ListToolItem listToolItem = new ListToolItem(key);
			try
			{
				InternalInsert(index, listToolItem);
				return listToolItem;
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		public ListToolItem Insert(int index, string key, string text)

				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_121"));
			}
			ListToolItem listToolItem = new ListToolItem(key, text, isChecked: false);
			try
			{
				InternalInsert(index, listToolItem);
				return listToolItem;
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;

		public ListToolItem Insert(int index, string key, string text, bool isChecked)
		{
			if (index < 0 || index > Count)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_121"));
			}
			ListToolItem listToolItem = new ListToolItem(key, text, isChecked);
			try
			{
				InternalInsert(index, listToolItem);
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (isChecked && index > -1)
			{
				ListTool.SelectedItemIndex = index;
			}
			return listToolItem;

		public void Remove(ListToolItem listToolItem)
		{
			if (listToolItem == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_13"));
			}
			InternalRemove(listToolItem);
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			if (index > Count || index < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_8"));
			}
			ListToolItem listToolItem = this[index];
			if (listToolItem != null)
			{
				InternalRemove(listToolItem);
			}
		}

		internal void ClearHelper(bool notifyListeners)
		{
			ListToolItemEnumerator listToolItemEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (listToolItemEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					ListToolItem current = listToolItemEnumerator.Current;
					current.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = listToolItemEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			InternalClear();
			if (notifyListeners)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ListToolItems);
			}
		}

		internal void Initialize(ListTool listTool)
		{
			this.listTool = listTool;
			foreach (ListToolItem deserializedTool in DeserializedTools)
			{
				InternalAdd(deserializedTool);
				deserializedTool.Initialize(this);
			}
		}

		internal int InternalAdd(ListToolItem listToolItem)
		{
			if (listToolItem == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("listToolItem");
			}
			listToolItem.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			int result = InternalAdd((IKeyedSubObject)listToolItem);
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ListToolItems);
			return result;
		}

		internal void InternalInsert(int index, ListToolItem listToolItem)
		{
			if (listToolItem == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("listToolItem");
			}
			listToolItem.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			InternalInsert(index, (IKeyedSubObject)listToolItem);
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ListToolItems);
		}

		internal void InternalRemove(ListToolItem listToolItem)
		{
			if (listToolItem != null)
			{
				InternalRemove((IKeyedSubObject)listToolItem);
				listToolItem.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ListToolItems);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			ListToolItemEnumerator listToolItemEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (listToolItemEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					ListToolItem current = listToolItemEnumerator.Current;
					current.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					current.Dispose();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = listToolItemEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			listTool = null;
			InternalClear();
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ListToolItem, propChange);
		}

		int IList.Add(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_14"));
			}
			if (!(value is ListToolItem obj))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_4", value.GetType().Name));
			}
			return Add(obj);
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_16"));
			}
			if (!(value is ListToolItem listToolItem))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_4", value.GetType().Name));
			}
			InternalInsert(index, listToolItem);
		}

		void IList.Remove(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_18"));
			}
			if (!(value is ListToolItem listToolItem))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_5", value.GetType().Name));
			}
			Remove(listToolItem);
		}

		bool IList.Contains(object value)
		{
			return Contains(value);
		}

	internal class ListToolMenuItem : ToolMenuItem
	{
		private int listToolItemIndex = -1;

		private bool activated;

		private bool forceFirstInGroup;

		private bool isBeingCustomized;

		internal const int MOREITEMS_ENTRY = -2;

		internal const int ARRANGEICONS_ENTRY = -3;

		internal const int CASCADE_ENTRY = -4;

		internal const int CLOSEWINDOWS_ENTRY = -5;

		internal const int TILEHORIZONTAL_ENTRY = -6;

		internal const int TILEVERTICAL_ENTRY = -7;

		internal const int MINIMIZE_ENTRY = -8;

		internal const int MAX_COMMANDS = 6;

		protected override bool ActivatesTool => true;

		protected internal override bool CanActivate => base.CanActivate;

		internal override string DefaultAction
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Enabled)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DefaultAction_Item_On_Menu");
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool DisplayImage => !DrawStateUsingCheckmark;

		protected internal override bool DisplayText => true;

		protected internal override bool DrawAsActive
		{
			get
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = Tool;
				NavigationMenu navigationMenu = ((toolBase != null) ? (toolBase.UltimateOwner as NavigationMenu) : null);
				BackStageMenuAgent backStageMenuAgent = ((navigationMenu != null) ? (navigationMenu.ApplicationMenu2010.MenuAgent as BackStageMenuAgent) : null);
				if (backStageMenuAgent != null && backStageMenuAgent.HasKeyNavigationManager && backStageMenuAgent.KeyNavigationManager.IsFocused(this))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (activated && base.MenuAgent != null && base.MenuAgent.MenuItemsActivated && ToolbarsManager != null)
				{
					return !ToolbarsManager.IsToolbarListMenuAgentOpen;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool DrawAsPressed
		{
			get
			{
				if (ListTool == null || IsSpecialEntry || (!DrawStateUsingCheckmark && !ListTool.OwnerIsApplicationMenu2010NavigationMenu))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (ListTool.SelectedItem == ListToolItem)
				{
					return !IsSpecialEntry;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool DrawStateUsingCheckmark
		{
			get
			{
				if (ListTool != null)
				{
					if (ListTool.OwnerIsApplicationMenu2010NavigationMenu)
					{
						return false;
					}
					return ListTool.DisplayCheckmark;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected internal override EmbeddableEditorBase Editor => null;

		protected internal override bool Enabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsArrangeIconsEntry || IsCascadeEntry || IsCloseWindowsEntry || IsTileHorizontalEntry || IsTileVerticalEntry || IsMoreItemsEntry || IsMinimizeEntry)
				{
					return ListTool.ListToolItems.Count > 0;
				}
				if (Tool is MdiWindowListTool)
				{
					if (ListToolItem != null && ListToolItem.Value is Form form)
					{
						return form.Enabled;
					}
					return true;
				}
				if (ListToolItem != null && ListToolItem.Enabled)
				{
					return Tool.EnabledResolved;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal override ParsedFormattedTextValue FormattedDescriptionOnMenu
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsSpecialEntry)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ListToolItem?.FormattedDescriptionOnMenu;
			}
		}

		protected internal override ImageList ImageList => ListTool.ImageList;

		protected internal override bool IsBeingCustomized
		{
			get
			{
				return isBeingCustomized;
			}
			set
			{
				isBeingCustomized = value;
				if (value)
				{
					ToolbarsManager.ToolBeingCustomized = Tool;
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool IsCheckedAsVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (ListTool != null && ListTool.DisplayCheckmark && ListToolItem != null)
				{
					return ListToolItem == ListTool.SelectedItem;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool IsFirstInGroup
		{
			get
			{
				if (forceFirstInGroup)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (listToolItemIndex != 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				MdiWindowListTool mdiWindowListTool = MdiWindowListTool;
				if (mdiWindowListTool != null && mdiWindowListTool.HasVisibleMenuCommands)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return ListTool.IsFirstInGroupResolved;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool IsOpen => false;

		protected internal override bool IsPopup => false;

		protected internal override Size Padding
		{
			get
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = Tool;
				if (toolBase != null && toolBase.OwnerIsApplicationMenu2010NavigationMenu)
				{
					return new Size(0, 3);
				}
				return base.Padding;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool RecentlyUsed => true;

		protected internal override string ShortcutText => string.Empty;

		protected internal override string Text
		{
			get
			{
				ListTool listTool = ListTool;
				if (listTool == null)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return listTool.GetItemText(listToolItemIndex);
			}
		}

		protected internal override ToolBase Tool => base.Tool;

		internal bool ForceFirstInGroup
		{

			}
		}

		internal int ListToolItemIndex => listToolItemIndex;

		private INotificationBadgeProvider NotificationBadgeProvider
		{
			get
			{
				if (MdiWindowListTool != null)
				{
					return (INotificationBadgeProvider)(object)MdiWindowListTool.ToolBeingDisplayed;
				}
				return (INotificationBadgeProvider)(object)ListToolItem;
			}
		}

		private bool IsArrangeIconsEntry => listToolItemIndex == -3;

		private bool IsCascadeEntry => listToolItemIndex == -4;

		private bool IsCloseWindowsEntry => listToolItemIndex == -5;

		private bool IsMinimizeEntry => listToolItemIndex == -8;

		private bool IsMoreItemsEntry => listToolItemIndex == -2;

		private bool IsSpecialEntry => listToolItemIndex < -1;

		private bool IsTileHorizontalEntry => listToolItemIndex == -6;

		private bool IsTileVerticalEntry => listToolItemIndex == -7;

		private ListTool ListTool
		{
			get
			{
				if (Tool == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return Tool.UnderlyingTool as ListTool;
			}
		}

		private ListToolItem ListToolItem
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsSpecialEntry)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (listToolItemIndex < 0 || listToolItemIndex >= ListTool.ListToolItems.Count)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ListTool.ListToolItems[listToolItemIndex];
			}
		}

			activated = false;

		{
		}

		{
			ListTool.DoDefaultActionForItem(listToolItemIndex);
		}

		protected internal override object GetContext(Type type)
		{
			if (type != null && type.IsAssignableFrom(typeof(ListToolItem)))
			{
				return ListToolItem;
			}
			return base.GetContext(type);
		}

		internal override IKeyTipProvider[] GetKeyTipProviders()
		{
			ListToolItem listToolItem = ListToolItem;
			if (listToolItem != null)
			{
				ToolBase underlyingTool = Tool.UnderlyingTool;
				if (underlyingTool != null)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase = null;
					try
					{
						toolBase = Tool.AttachToUnderlyingTool();
						return new IKeyTipProvider[1]
						{
							new ListToolItemKeyTipProvider(listToolItem, ListTool, this)
						};
					}
					finally
					{
						toolBase?.AttachToUnderlyingTool();
					}
				}
				return new IKeyTipProvider[1]
				{
					new ListToolItemKeyTipProvider(listToolItem, ListTool, this)
				};
			}
			return new IKeyTipProvider[1]
			{
				new ListToolMenuItemKeyTipProvider(this, ListTool)
			};
		}

		protected override UIElement GetMenuUIElement(UIElement parentElement, UIElement previousElement)
		{
			return base.GetMenuUIElement(parentElement, previousElement);
		}

		protected internal override Type GetMenuUIElementType()
		{
			return base.GetMenuUIElementType();
		}

		protected internal override Size GetTextSize()
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
			AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)65011720;
			ResolutionOrderInfo resolutionOrder = StyleUtils.GetResolutionOrder(ToolbarsManager);
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseControlInfo && !IsSpecialEntry)
			{
				ListToolItem.Appearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			}
			ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, DrawAsActive);
			return GetTextSize(ref appearance);
		}

		protected internal override Size GetTextSize(ref AppearanceData appearance)
		{
			return MeasureString(ref appearance, null, Text);
		}

		protected internal override int IncrementClickCount()
		{
			return base.IncrementClickCount();
		}

		internal override bool IsSameMenuItem(MenuItemBase menuItem)
		{
			if (!base.IsSameMenuItem(menuItem))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (menuItem is ListToolMenuItem listToolMenuItem)
			{
				return ListToolItem == listToolMenuItem.ListToolItem;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override void ResolveAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, bool drawAsActive)
		{
			if (Tool.UnderlyingTool is ListTool listTool)
			{
				listTool.ResolveAppearance(listToolItemIndex, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, drawAsActive, DrawAsPressed);
			}
		}

		protected internal override Size GetTextAreaSize(int widthConstraint)
		{
			Size textAreaSize = base.GetTextAreaSize(widthConstraint);
			int minWidthResolved = ListTool.MinWidthResolved;
			int maxWidthResolved = ListTool.MaxWidthResolved;
			if (ListTool.HasInstanceProps && ListTool.InstanceProps.ShouldSerializeWidth())
			{
				textAreaSize.Width = ListTool.InstanceProps.Width;
			}
			else if (ListTool.SharedProps.ShouldSerializeWidth())
			{
				textAreaSize.Width = ListTool.SharedProps.Width;
			}
			if (textAreaSize.Width < minWidthResolved)
			{
				textAreaSize.Width = minWidthResolved;
			}
			else if (textAreaSize.Width > maxWidthResolved && maxWidthResolved > 0)
			{
				textAreaSize.Width = maxWidthResolved;
			}
			return textAreaSize;
		}

		protected override INotificationBadgeSettingsOwner GetMenuItemNotificationBadgeOwner()
		{
			if (MdiWindowListTool != null)
			{
				return (INotificationBadgeSettingsOwner)(object)MdiWindowListTool.ToolBeingDisplayed;
			}
			return (INotificationBadgeSettingsOwner)(object)ListToolItem;
		}

		protected override string GetMenuItemNotificationBadgeText()
		{
			return NotificationBadgeProvider.NotificationBadgeText;
		}

		protected override NotificationBadgeSettingsResolved GetMenuItemNotificationBadgeSettingsResolved()
		{
			INotificationBadgeProvider notificationBadgeProvider = NotificationBadgeProvider;
			if (notificationBadgeProvider == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return notificationBadgeProvider.NotificationBadgeSettingsResolved;
		}

	internal class ListToolMenuItemKeyTipProvider : IKeyTipProvider
	{
		private ListToolMenuItem listToolMenuItem;

		private ListTool listToolInstance;

		System.Drawing.ContentAlignment IKeyTipProvider.Alignment => System.Drawing.ContentAlignment.TopLeft;

		string IKeyTipProvider.AutoGeneratePrefix => null;

		string IKeyTipProvider.Caption => listToolInstance.GetItemText(listToolMenuItem.ListToolItemIndex);

		bool IKeyTipProvider.DeactivateParentContainersOnActivate => true;

		bool IKeyTipProvider.IsEnabled => listToolMenuItem.Enabled;

		bool IKeyTipProvider.IsVisible
		{
			get
			{
				UIElement uIElement = listToolMenuItem.UIElement;
				if (uIElement == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (listToolInstance.ToolBeingDisplayed.IsOnBackStage)
				{
					Control control = uIElement.Control;
					if (control == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					Control parent = Utilities.GetParent(control);
					if (parent == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					Rectangle rect = uIElement.Rect;
					rect.Offset(parent.DisplayRectangle.Location);
					return parent.ClientRectangle.IntersectsWith(rect);
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		string IKeyTipProvider.KeyTipValue
		{
			get
			{
				char mnemonic = ((IKeyTipProvider)this).Mnemonic;
				if (char.IsLetterOrDigit(mnemonic))
				{
					return mnemonic.ToString();
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		Point IKeyTipProvider.Location => ListTool.GetKeyTipLocation(listToolMenuItem.UIElement as PopupMenuItemUIElement);

		char IKeyTipProvider.Mnemonic => Utilities.GetFirstMnemonicChar(((IKeyTipProvider)this).Caption);

		Control IKeyTipProvider.OwningControl
		{
			get
			{
				UIElement uIElement = listToolMenuItem.UIElement;
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					return uIElement.Control;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public ListToolMenuItemKeyTipProvider(ListToolMenuItem listToolMenuItem, ListTool listToolInstance)
		{
			this.listToolInstance = listToolInstance;
			this.listToolMenuItem = listToolMenuItem;
		}

		bool IKeyTipProvider.Activate()
		{
			listToolInstance.DoDefaultActionForItem(listToolMenuItem.ListToolItemIndex);
			return true;
		}

		bool IKeyTipProvider.Equals(IKeyTipProvider provider)
		{
			return provider == this;
		}

		IKeyTipContainer IKeyTipProvider.GetContainer()
		{
			return null;
		}
	}

		protected internal override bool IsFirstInGroup => isFirstInGroup;

		protected internal override string Text => UltraToolbarsManager.LockToolbarsLiteral;

		public override UIRole UIRole
		{
			get
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager != null)
				{
					return StyleUtils.GetRole(toolbarsManager, StyleUtils.Role.MenuItemLockToolbars);
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal LockToolbarsMenuItem(bool isFirstInGroup)
		{
			this.isFirstInGroup = isFirstInGroup;
		}

		protected override UIElement GetMenuUIElement(UIElement parentElement, UIElement previousElement)
		{
			LockToolbarsUIElement lockToolbarsUIElement = null;
			if (previousElement != null && ((object)previousElement).GetType() == typeof(LockToolbarsUIElement) && previousElement.Parent == parentElement)
			{
				lockToolbarsUIElement = previousElement as LockToolbarsUIElement;
			}
			if (lockToolbarsUIElement == null)
			{
				lockToolbarsUIElement = new LockToolbarsUIElement(parentElement, this);
			}
			lockToolbarsUIElement.InitializeElement(this, parentElement);
			return (UIElement)(object)lockToolbarsUIElement;
		}

		protected internal override Type GetMenuUIElementType()
		{
			return typeof(LockToolbarsUIElement);
		}

		internal override bool IsSameMenuItem(MenuItemBase menuItem)
		{
			LockToolbarsMenuItem lockToolbarsMenuItem = menuItem as LockToolbarsMenuItem;
			return lockToolbarsMenuItem != null;
		}

		protected internal override void OnClick()
		{
			base.MenuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay: false);
			ToolbarsManager.LockToolbars = !ToolbarsManager.LockToolbars;
		}
	}

		{

				return MdiContainerFormInternal;
			}

		internal Form MdiContainerFormInternal
		{
			get
			{
				if (mdiContainerFormChecked)
				{
					return mdiContainerForm;
				}
				Form form = base.ToolbarsManager.FindForm();
				if (form != null)
				{
					if (form.IsMdiContainer)
					{
						mdiContainerForm = form;
					}
					else
					{
						try
						{
							UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
							if (Utilities.CanAssert)
							{
								uIPermission.Assert();
							}
							mdiContainerForm = form.MdiParent;
						}
						catch (Exception)
						{
						}
					}
				}
				mdiContainerFormChecked = true;
				return mdiContainerForm;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]

		{
			get
			{
				foreach (ListToolItem listToolItem in base.ListToolItems)
				{
					if (listToolItem.Value == MdiContainerFormInternal.ActiveMdiChild)
					{
						return listToolItem.Index;
					}
				}
				return -1;
			}
			set
			{
				base.SelectedItemIndex = value;
			}
		}

				{
					return true;

				return IsVisibleOnMenu(DisplayCloseWindowsCommand);
			}

		{
			if (base.IsRootTool)
			{
				return DisplayCloseWindowsCommand != MdiWindowListCommandDisplayStyle.DisplayOnMenuAndDialog;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetDisplayCloseWindowsCommand()
		{
			DisplayCloseWindowsCommand = MdiWindowListCommandDisplayStyle.DisplayOnMenuAndDialog;
		}
