		public void ArrangeIcons()
		{
			MdiContainerFormInternal?.LayoutMdi(MdiLayout.ArrangeIcons);
		}

		public void CascadeWindows()
		{
			MdiContainerFormInternal?.LayoutMdi(MdiLayout.Cascade);
		}

		public void CloseAllWindows()
		{
			Form mdiContainerFormInternal = MdiContainerFormInternal;
			if (mdiContainerFormInternal == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Form[] mdiChildren = mdiContainerFormInternal.MdiChildren;
			Form[] array = mdiChildren;
			foreach (Form form in array)
			{
				if (form.Visible)
				{
					form.Close();
				}
			}
			base.ListToolItems.ClearHelper(notifyListeners: false);
		}

		public void MinimizeAllWindows()
		{
			Form mdiContainerFormInternal = MdiContainerFormInternal;
			if (mdiContainerFormInternal == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Form[] mdiChildren = mdiContainerFormInternal.MdiChildren;
			foreach (Form form in mdiChildren)
			{
				if (form.Visible)
				{
					form.WindowState = FormWindowState.Minimized;
				}
			}
		}

		public void RefreshWindowList()
		{
			base.ListToolItems.ClearHelper(notifyListeners: false);
			Form mdiContainerFormInternal = MdiContainerFormInternal;
			if (mdiContainerFormInternal == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Form[] mdiChildren = mdiContainerFormInternal.MdiChildren;
			Regex regex = ((mdiChildren.Length == 0) ? null : new Regex("(?<start>^|[^&])\\&(?<end>[^&])"));
			for (int i = 0; i < mdiChildren.Length; i++)
			{
				Form form = mdiChildren[i];
				if (form.Visible)
				{
					ListToolItem listToolItem = new ListToolItem();
					string text = regex.Replace(form.Text, "${start}&&${end}");
					if (i < 9)
					{
						listToolItem.Text = $"&{i + 1} {text}";
					}
					else if (i == 9)
					{
						listToolItem.Text = $"1&0 {text}";
					}
					else
					{
						listToolItem.Text = $"{i + 1} {text}";
					}
					listToolItem.Value = form;
					if (MdiContainerFormInternal.ActiveMdiChild == form)
					{
						SetSelectedItemIndex(base.ListToolItems.Add(listToolItem), fireEvents: false);
					}
					else
					{
						base.ListToolItems.Add(listToolItem);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void TileWindowsHorizontally()
		{
			MdiContainerFormInternal?.LayoutMdi(MdiLayout.TileHorizontal);
		}

		public void TileWindowsVertically()
		{
			MdiContainerFormInternal?.LayoutMdi(MdiLayout.TileVertical);
		}

		private static bool IsVisibleOnMenu(MdiWindowListCommandDisplayStyle displayStyle)
		{
			if (displayStyle != MdiWindowListCommandDisplayStyle.DisplayOnMenu)
			{
				return displayStyle == MdiWindowListCommandDisplayStyle.DisplayOnMenuAndDialog;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override ToolBase Clone(bool cloneNewInstance)
		{
			MdiWindowListTool mdiWindowListTool = new MdiWindowListTool(Key);
			mdiWindowListTool.InitializeFrom(this, cloneNewInstance);
			return mdiWindowListTool;
		}

		internal override void DoDefaultActionForItem(int itemIndex)
		{
			bool flag = base.ListToolItems.Count == 0;
			if (flag)
			{
				RefreshWindowList();
			}
			base.DoDefaultActionForItem(itemIndex);
			if (itemIndex > -1 && itemIndex < base.ListToolItems.Count && base.ListToolItems[itemIndex].Value is Form)
			{
				Form form = (Form)base.ListToolItems[itemIndex].Value;
				if (form.WindowState == FormWindowState.Minimized)
				{
					FormWindowState windowState = FormWindowState.Normal;
					if (form.IsMdiChild)
					{
						Form activeMdiChild = form.ParentForm.ActiveMdiChild;
						if (activeMdiChild != null && form != activeMdiChild && activeMdiChild.WindowState == FormWindowState.Maximized)
						{
							windowState = FormWindowState.Maximized;
						}
					}
					form.WindowState = windowState;
				}
				else
				{
					ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ActivateForm(form);
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				base.ListToolItems.ClearHelper(notifyListeners: false);
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		protected override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
			if (ShouldSerializeDisplayArrangeIconsCommand())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "DisplayArrangeIconsCommand", DisplayArrangeIconsCommand);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeDisplayCascadeCommand())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "DisplayCascadeCommand", DisplayCascadeCommand);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeDisplayCloseWindowsCommand())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "DisplayCloseWindowsCommand", DisplayCloseWindowsCommand);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeDisplayMinimizeCommand())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "DisplayMinimizeCommand", DisplayMinimizeCommand);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeDisplayTileHorizontalCommand())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "DisplayTileHorizontalCommand", DisplayTileHorizontalCommand);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeDisplayTileVerticalCommand())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "DisplayTileVerticalCommand", DisplayTileVerticalCommand);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void Initialize(ToolsCollectionBase parentCollection)
		{
			base.Initialize(parentCollection);
			if (serializedProps != null)
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.displayArrangeIconsCommand = serializedProps.displayArrangeIconsCommand;
				ExtraSharedProps.displayCascadeCommand = serializedProps.displayCascadeCommand;
				ExtraSharedProps.displayCloseWindowsCommand = serializedProps.displayCloseWindowsCommand;
				ExtraSharedProps.displayMinimizeCommand = serializedProps.displayMinimizeCommand;
				ExtraSharedProps.displayTileHorizontalCommand = serializedProps.displayTileHorizontalCommand;
				ExtraSharedProps.displayTileVerticalCommand = serializedProps.displayTileVerticalCommand;
				serializedProps = null;
			}
		}

		protected internal override void InitializeFrom(ToolBase sourceTool, bool cloneNewInstance)
		{
			base.InitializeFrom(sourceTool, cloneNewInstance);
			MdiWindowListTool mdiWindowListTool = sourceTool as MdiWindowListTool;
			if (!cloneNewInstance && mdiWindowListTool != null)
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.displayArrangeIconsCommand = mdiWindowListTool.ExtraSharedProps.DisplayArrangeIconsCommand;
				ExtraSharedProps.displayCascadeCommand = mdiWindowListTool.ExtraSharedProps.DisplayCascadeCommand;
				ExtraSharedProps.displayCloseWindowsCommand = mdiWindowListTool.ExtraSharedProps.DisplayCloseWindowsCommand;
				ExtraSharedProps.displayMinimizeCommand = mdiWindowListTool.ExtraSharedProps.DisplayMinimizeCommand;
				ExtraSharedProps.displayTileHorizontalCommand = mdiWindowListTool.ExtraSharedProps.DisplayTileHorizontalCommand;
				ExtraSharedProps.displayTileVerticalCommand = mdiWindowListTool.ExtraSharedProps.DisplayTileVerticalCommand;
			}
		}

		protected override bool ShouldSerializeListToolItems()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (HasSideStripAppearance && sideStripAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChange.Source)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.SideStripAppearance, propChange);
			}
			else if (HasIconAreaAppearance && iconAreaAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChange.Source)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.IconAreaAppearance, propChange);
			}
			else if (HasIconAreaExpandedAppearance && iconAreaExpandedAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChange.Source)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.IconAreaExpandedAppearance, propChange);
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnSubObjectPropChanged(propChange);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void Initialize(object owner)
		{
			bool flag = base.ToolbarsManager != null;
			base.Initialize(owner);
			if (!flag && base.ToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				if (iconAreaAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					iconAreaAppearanceHolder.Collection = base.ToolbarsManager.Appearances;
					iconAreaAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				if (iconAreaExpandedAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					iconAreaExpandedAppearanceHolder.Collection = base.ToolbarsManager.Appearances;
					iconAreaExpandedAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				if (sideStripAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					sideStripAppearanceHolder.Collection = base.ToolbarsManager.Appearances;
					sideStripAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeIconAreaAppearance() && !ShouldSerializeIconAreaExpandedAppearance() && !ShouldSerializeIsSideStripVisible() && !ShouldSerializeLabelDisplayStyle() && !ShouldSerializePopupStyle() && !ShouldSerializeSideStripAppearance() && !ShouldSerializeSideStripImagePadding() && !ShouldSerializeSideStripText() && !ShouldSerializeSideStripWidth() && !ShouldSerializeMultiMonitorDropDownBehavior())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeRightAlignShortcutText();
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

PopupStyle.Menu : ((popupMenuTool.Settings.PopupStyle != PopupStyle.Default) ? popupMenuTool.Settings.PopupStyle : ((popupMenuTool.ToolbarsManager.MenuSettings.PopupStyle == PopupStyle.Default) ? PopupStyle.Menu : popupMenuTool.ToolbarsManager.MenuSettings.PopupStyle))));
				if (!popupMenuTool.AllowPopupStyle(popupStyle))

					popupStyle = popupMenuTool.ResolvePopupStyle(popupStyle);
				}
				return popupStyle;
			}
		}

				}

				}

			((Control)(object)cmdOK).Enabled = IsItemEnabled(lstItems.SelectedIndex);
		}

		{
			if (IsItemEnabled(lstItems.SelectedIndex))
			{
				cmdOK_Click(cmdOK, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		private void lstItems_DrawItem(object sender, DrawItemEventArgs e)
		{
			bool flag = IsItemEnabled(e.Index);
			string text = lstItems.Items[e.Index] as string;
			bool flag2 = (e.State & DrawItemState.Selected) == DrawItemState.Selected;
			bool flag3 = (e.State & DrawItemState.Focus) == DrawItemState.Focus;
			int num = (int)DrawUtility.MeasureString(e.Graphics, text, e.Font, (GdiDrawStringFlags)8).Width;
			if (lstItems.HorizontalExtent < num)
			{
				lstItems.HorizontalExtent = num;
			}
			Color color;
			Color color2;
			if (!flag)
			{
				color = SystemColors.Window;
				color2 = SystemColors.GrayText;
			}
			else if (flag2)
			{
				color = SystemColors.Highlight;
				color2 = SystemColors.HighlightText;
			}
			else
			{
				color = SystemColors.Window;
				color2 = SystemColors.WindowText;
			}
			color = Color.FromArgb(color.ToArgb());
			color2 = Color.FromArgb(color2.ToArgb());
			Rectangle bounds = e.Bounds;
			using (Brush brush = new SolidBrush(color))
			{
				e.Graphics.FillRectangle(brush, bounds);
			}
			using (SolidBrush solidBrush = new SolidBrush(color2))
			{
				DrawUtility.DrawString(e.Graphics, text, e.Font, solidBrush, new RectangleF(bounds.X, bounds.Y, bounds.Width, bounds.Height), (GdiDrawStringFlags)8);
			}
			if (flag3)
			{
				ControlPaint.DrawFocusRectangle(e.Graphics, bounds, color2, color);
			}
		}

		private bool IsItemEnabled(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || index >= listTool.ListToolItems.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return listTool.ListToolItems[index].Enabled;
		}

		private void InitDialog()
		{
			int itemHeight = lstItems.ItemHeight;
			lstItems.DrawMode = DrawMode.OwnerDrawFixed;
			lstItems.ItemHeight = itemHeight;
			foreach (ListToolItem listToolItem in listTool.ListToolItems)
			{
				string item = Utilities.StripMnemonics(listToolItem.Text);
				lstItems.Items.Add(item);
			}
		}

		{
			inboxControlStyler1.DefaultStyleLibraryName = styleLibraryName;
			((AppStyledDialogBase)this).OnStyleLibraryNameChanged(styleLibraryName);
		}

		{
			inboxControlStyler1.DefaultStyleSetName = styleSetName;
			((AppStyledDialogBase)this).OnStyleSetNameChanged(styleSetName);
		}

		{
			inboxControlStyler1.ApplyAppStyling = (ApplyAppStyling)(useAppStyling ? 2 : 3);
			((AppStyledDialogBase)this).OnUseAppStylingChanged(useAppStyling);
		}
	}

		private void cmdActivate_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (lstWindows.SelectedIndices.Count == 1)
			{
				((Form)this).Close();
				indexToActivate = lstWindows.SelectedIndex;
			}
		}

		private void cmdCloseWindows_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			foreach (int selectedIndex in lstWindows.SelectedIndices)
			{
				if (mdiWindowListTool.ListToolItems[selectedIndex].Value is Form form)
				{
					form.Close();
				}
			}
			mdiWindowListTool.RefreshWindowList();
			LoadWindowList();
		}

		private void cmdTileHorizontally_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			mdiWindowListTool.TileWindowsHorizontally();
		}

		private void cmdTileVertically_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			mdiWindowListTool.TileWindowsVertically();
		}

		private void cmdMinimize_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			mdiWindowListTool.MinimizeAllWindows();
		}

		private void cmdCascade_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			mdiWindowListTool.CascadeWindows();
		}

		private void cmdArrangeIcons_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			mdiWindowListTool.ArrangeIcons();
		}

		private void lstWindows_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ResetCommandButtonsEnabledStatus();
		}

		private void lstWindows_DoubleClick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			cmdActivate_Click(cmdActivate, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		private void InitDialog()
		{
			((Control)(object)this).Text = Utilities.StripMnemonics(mdiWindowListTool.MoreItemsText);
			bool isTabbedMdi = toolbarsManager.IsTabbedMdi;
			if (isTabbedMdi || (mdiWindowListTool.DisplayArrangeIconsCommand != MdiWindowListCommandDisplayStyle.DisplayOnDialog && mdiWindowListTool.DisplayArrangeIconsCommand != MdiWindowListCommandDisplayStyle.DisplayOnMenuAndDialog))
			{
				((Control)(object)cmdArrangeIcons).Visible = false;
			}
			if (isTabbedMdi || (mdiWindowListTool.DisplayCascadeCommand != MdiWindowListCommandDisplayStyle.DisplayOnDialog && mdiWindowListTool.DisplayCascadeCommand != MdiWindowListCommandDisplayStyle.DisplayOnMenuAndDialog))
			{
				((Control)(object)cmdCascade).Visible = false;
			}
			if (mdiWindowListTool.DisplayCloseWindowsCommand != MdiWindowListCommandDisplayStyle.DisplayOnDialog && mdiWindowListTool.DisplayCloseWindowsCommand != MdiWindowListCommandDisplayStyle.DisplayOnMenuAndDialog)
			{
				((Control)(object)cmdCloseWindows).Visible = false;
			}
			if (isTabbedMdi || (mdiWindowListTool.DisplayTileHorizontalCommand != MdiWindowListCommandDisplayStyle.DisplayOnDialog && mdiWindowListTool.DisplayTileHorizontalCommand != MdiWindowListCommandDisplayStyle.DisplayOnMenuAndDialog))
			{
				((Control)(object)cmdTileHorizontally).Visible = false;
			}
			if (isTabbedMdi || (mdiWindowListTool.DisplayTileVerticalCommand != MdiWindowListCommandDisplayStyle.DisplayOnDialog && mdiWindowListTool.DisplayTileVerticalCommand != MdiWindowListCommandDisplayStyle.DisplayOnMenuAndDialog))
			{
				((Control)(object)cmdTileVertically).Visible = false;
			}
			if (isTabbedMdi || (mdiWindowListTool.DisplayMinimizeCommand != MdiWindowListCommandDisplayStyle.DisplayOnDialog && mdiWindowListTool.DisplayMinimizeCommand != MdiWindowListCommandDisplayStyle.DisplayOnMenuAndDialog))
			{
				((Control)(object)cmdMinimize).Visible = false;
			}
			LoadWindowList();
			ResetCommandButtonsEnabledStatus();
		}

		private void LoadWindowList()
		{
			lstWindows.Items.Clear();
			foreach (ListToolItem listToolItem in mdiWindowListTool.ListToolItems)
			{
				if (listToolItem.Value is Form form)
				{
					lstWindows.Items.Add(form.Text);
				}
				else
				{
					lstWindows.Items.Add(listToolItem.Text);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ResetCommandButtonsEnabledStatus()
		{
			if (lstWindows.SelectedIndices.Count < 1)
			{
				((Control)(object)cmdActivate).Enabled = false;
				((Control)(object)cmdCloseWindows).Enabled = false;
			}
			else
			{
				((Control)(object)cmdActivate).Enabled = lstWindows.SelectedIndices.Count == 1;
				((Control)(object)cmdCloseWindows).Enabled = true;
			}
			if (toolbarsManager.IsTabbedMdi || lstWindows.Items.Count < 1)
			{
				((Control)(object)cmdTileHorizontally).Enabled = false;
				((Control)(object)cmdTileVertically).Enabled = false;
				((Control)(object)cmdMinimize).Enabled = false;
				((Control)(object)cmdArrangeIcons).Enabled = false;
				((Control)(object)cmdCascade).Enabled = false;
			}
			else
			{
				((Control)(object)cmdTileHorizontally).Enabled = true;
				((Control)(object)cmdTileVertically).Enabled = true;
				((Control)(object)cmdMinimize).Enabled = true;
				((Control)(object)cmdArrangeIcons).Enabled = true;
				((Control)(object)cmdCascade).Enabled = true;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnStyleLibraryNameChanged(string styleLibraryName)
		{
			inboxControlStyler1.DefaultStyleLibraryName = styleLibraryName;
			((AppStyledDialogBase)this).OnStyleLibraryNameChanged(styleLibraryName);
		}

		protected override void OnStyleSetNameChanged(string styleSetName)
		{

		{
			inboxControlStyler1.ApplyAppStyling = (ApplyAppStyling)(useAppStyling ? 2 : 3);
			((AppStyledDialogBase)this).OnUseAppStylingChanged(useAppStyling);
		}

	[ComVisible(false)]
	[SecurityCritical]
	internal class NativeWindowMethods
	{
		[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Pack = 1)]
		internal struct BLENDFUNCTION
		{
			public byte BlendOp;

			public byte BlendFlags;

			public byte SourceConstantAlpha;

			public byte AlphaFormat;
		}

		internal struct CWPSTRUCT
		{
			internal IntPtr lparam;

			internal IntPtr wparam;

			internal int message;

			internal IntPtr hwnd;
		}

		internal struct NCCALCSIZE_PARAMS
		{
			internal RECT rectProposed;

			internal RECT rectBeforeMove;

			internal RECT rectClientBeforeMove;

			internal IntPtr ptrWindowPos;
		}

		internal struct MENUITEMINFO
		{
			internal uint cbSize;

			internal uint fMask;

			internal uint fType;

			internal uint fState;

			internal uint wID;

			internal IntPtr hSubMenu;

			internal IntPtr hbmpChecked;

			internal IntPtr hbmpUnchecked;

			internal IntPtr dwItemData;

			internal IntPtr dwTypeData;

			internal uint cch;

			internal IntPtr hbmpItem;
		}

		internal struct MOUSEHOOKSTRUCT
		{
			internal POINT pt;

			internal IntPtr hwnd;

			internal int hitTestCode;

			internal IntPtr extraInfo;
		}

		internal struct MSG
		{
			internal IntPtr hwnd;

			internal int message;

			internal IntPtr wparam;

			internal IntPtr lparam;

			internal int time;

			internal POINT pt;
		}

		internal struct POINT
		{
			internal int X;

			internal int Y;

			internal Point Point => new Point(X, Y);

			internal POINT(int x, int y)
			{
				X = x;
				Y = y;
			}

			internal static POINT FromPoint(Point point)
			{
				return new POINT(point.X, point.Y);
			}
		}

		internal struct RECT
		{
			internal int left;

			internal int top;

			internal int right;

			internal int bottom;

			internal Rectangle Rect => new Rectangle(left, top, right - left, bottom - top);

			internal RECT(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
			{
				this.left = left;
				this.top = top;
				this.right = right;
				this.bottom = bottom;
			}
		}

		internal struct SIZE
		{
			public int width;

			public int height;

			internal static SIZE FromSize(Size size)
			{
				return new SIZE
				{
					width = size.Width,
					height = size.Height
				};
			}
		}

		internal struct STYLESTRUCT
		{
			internal int styleOld;

			internal int styleNew;
		}

		internal struct WINDOWPOS
		{
			internal IntPtr hwnd;

			internal IntPtr hWndInsertAfter;

			internal int x;

			internal int y;

			internal int cx;

			internal int cy;

			internal uint flags;
		}

		internal struct MINMAXINFO
		{

		internal static bool IsDWMCompositionEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (Environment.OSVersion.Version.Major < 6)
				{
					return false;
				}
				try
				{
					return UnsafeIsDWMCompositionEnabled();
				}
				catch
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
		}

		private NativeWindowMethods()
		{
		}

		internal static void CloseForm(Form form)
		{
			if (form == null || !form.IsHandleCreated || form.Disposing || form.IsDisposed)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				SecurityPermission securityPermission = new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode);
				securityPermission.Demand();
				SendMessageApi(form.Handle, 274, new IntPtr(61536), IntPtr.Zero);
			}
			catch
			{
				form.Close();
			}
		}

		internal static void ResetTreeTooltips(TreeView tree)
		{
			if (tree == null || !tree.IsHandleCreated)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				ResetTreeToolTipsAPI(tree);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private static void ResetTreeToolTipsAPI(TreeView tree)
		{
			IntPtr handle = tree.Handle;
			IntPtr windowLong = GetWindowLong(handle, -16);
			if (!AreBitsPresent(windowLong, 128))
			{
				SetWindowLong(handle, -16, AddBits(windowLong, 128));
				SetWindowLong(handle, -16, RemoveBits(windowLong, 128));
			}
		}

			Point point = PointToClientHelper(hwndParent, screenPt);

			if (intPtr == IntPtr.Zero || intPtr == hwndParent)

		}

		internal static char[] VKeyToAscii(IntPtr wParam, out DeadKeyInfo deadKeyInfo)
		{
			return VKeyToAscii(wParam, useZeroScanCode: false, out deadKeyInfo);
		}

		internal static char[] VKeyToAscii(IntPtr wParam, bool useZeroScanCode, out DeadKeyInfo deadKeyInfo)
		{
			deadKeyInfo = null;
			byte[] array = new byte[256];
			int num = ((!useZeroScanCode) ? MapVirtualKey(wParam.ToInt32(), 0u) : 0);
			GetKeyboardState(array);
			byte[] array2 = new byte[2] { 0, 0 };
			int num2 = ToUnicode(wParam.ToInt32(), num, array, array2, 2, 0u);
			if (num2 > 0 && array2.Length != 0)
			{
				string text = Encoding.Unicode.GetString(array2);
				return text.ToCharArray();
			}
			if (num2 < 0)
			{
				deadKeyInfo = new DeadKeyInfo(wParam.ToInt32(), num, array);
			}
			return new char[0];
		}

		internal static IntPtr AddBits(IntPtr ptr, int bitsToAdd)
		{
			if (IntPtr.Size == 4)
			{
				return new IntPtr(ptr.ToInt32() | bitsToAdd);
			}
			return new IntPtr(ptr.ToInt64() | (uint)bitsToAdd);
		}

		internal static bool AreBitsPresent(IntPtr ptr, int bits)
		{
			if (IntPtr.Size == 4)
			{
				return (ptr.ToInt32() & bits) == bits;
			}
			return (ptr.ToInt64() & bits) == bits;
		}

		internal static IntPtr RemoveBits(IntPtr ptr, int bitsToRemove)
		{
			if (IntPtr.Size == 4)
			{
				return new IntPtr(ptr.ToInt32() & ~bitsToRemove);
			}
			return new IntPtr(ptr.ToInt64() & ~bitsToRemove);
		}

		internal static long FindBitsInType(IntPtr ptr, int bits)
		{
			if (IntPtr.Size == 4)
			{
				return ptr.ToInt32() & bits;
			}
			return ptr.ToInt64() & bits;
		}

		internal static FormWindowState GetWindowState(Form form)
		{
			FormWindowState result = FormWindowState.Normal;
			if (form != null)
			{
				if (form.IsHandleCreated)
				{
					WINDOWPLACEMENT lpwndpl = default(WINDOWPLACEMENT);
					lpwndpl.length = Marshal.SizeOf((object)lpwndpl);
					bool windowPlacement = GetWindowPlacement(form.Handle, ref lpwndpl);
					result = ((lpwndpl.showCmd == 2) ? FormWindowState.Minimized : ((lpwndpl.showCmd == 3) ? FormWindowState.Maximized : FormWindowState.Normal));
				}
				else
				{
					result = form.WindowState;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal static IntPtr EncodeSize(Size size)
		{
			return new IntPtr((size.Height << 16) | size.Width);
		}

		public static int GetLowWord(IntPtr param)
		{
			long num = ((IntPtr.Size == 4) ? param.ToInt32() : param.ToInt64());
			return (short)(num & 0xFFFF);
		}

		public static int GetHiWord(IntPtr param)
		{
			long num = ((IntPtr.Size == 4) ? param.ToInt32() : param.ToInt64());
			return (short)((num >> 16) & 0xFFFF);
		}
	}

		{
			get

				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager == null)

					return SystemColors.ControlDark;
				}
				Color result = (Color)StyleUtils.GetCachedPropertyVal(toolbarsManager, StyleUtils.CustomProperty.NavigationToolSeparatorColor, Color.Empty, Color.Empty, Color.Empty);
				if (!result.IsEmpty)
				{
					return result;
				}
				return toolbarsManager.MSColors.TaskPaneNavigationToolSeparatorDark;
			}
		}

		private Color SeparatorColor2
		{
			get
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;

		public class OptionSetConverter : ExpandableObjectConverter
		{
			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					ConstructorInfo constructor = value.GetType().GetConstructor(new Type[1] { typeof(string) });
					OptionSet optionSet = (OptionSet)value;
					return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[1] { optionSet.Key }, isComplete: false);
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		private bool allowAllUp = true;

		private ToolsCollection tools;

		private bool inherited;

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_OptionSet_P_AllowAllUp")]

		public bool AllowAllUp
		{
			get
			{
				return allowAllUp;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != allowAllUp)
				{
					VerifyCanBeModified();
					allowAllUp = value;
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.AllowAllUp);
				}
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]

		public override string Key

			get

				return base.Key;

				base.Key = value;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public StateButtonTool SelectedTool
		{
			get
			{
				foreach (StateButtonTool tool in Tools)
				{
					if (tool.Checked)
					{
						return tool;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!Tools.Exists(value.Key))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_32"));
				}
				foreach (StateButtonTool tool in Tools)
				{
					if ((object)((IKeyedSubObjectEx)tool).KeyLowercaseInterned == ((IKeyedSubObjectEx)value).KeyLowercaseInterned)
					{
						tool.Checked = true;
					}
					else
					{
						tool.Checked = false;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal OptionSet(bool allowAllUp, string key)
		{
			this.allowAllUp = allowAllUp;
			base.Key = key;
		}

		protected OptionSet(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "AllowAllUp":
					allowAllUp = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), allowAllUp);
					break;
				case "Key":
					base.Key = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), base.Key);
					break;
				case "Tag":
					DeserializeTag(current);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeAllowAllUp())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "AllowAllUp", allowAllUp);
			}
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Key", Key);
			SerializeTag(info);
			GetObjectData(info, context);
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeAllowAllUp()
		{
			return !allowAllUp;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetAllowAllUp()
		{
			AllowAllUp = true;
		}

		public override bool ShouldSerializeKey()
		{
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public override void ResetKey()
		{
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			ResetAllowAllUp();
			ResetTag();
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo = propChange.FindPropId(PropertyIds.Checked);
			if (propChangeInfo != null && propChangeInfo.Source is StateButtonTool { Checked: not false } stateButtonTool)
			{
				foreach (ToolBase tool in Tools)
				{
					if (tool is StateButtonTool stateButtonTool2 && !stateButtonTool2.Equals(stateButtonTool))
					{
						stateButtonTool2.CheckedInternal = false;
					}
				}
			}
			propChangeInfo = propChange.FindPropId(PropertyIds.Tools);
			if (propChangeInfo != null)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				foreach (ToolBase tool2 in Tools)
				{
					if (tool2 is StateButtonTool { Checked: not false } stateButtonTool3)
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							stateButtonTool3.CheckedInternal = false;
						}
						else
						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Tool, propChange);
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		protected virtual void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual void Initialize(OptionSetsCollection parentCollection)
		{
			base.PrimaryCollection = parentCollection;
		}

		internal void VerifyCanBeModified()
		{
			if (inherited && ToolbarsManager != null && ToolbarsManager.IsDesignMode)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_113"));
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			base.OnDispose();
			if (tools != null)
			{
				tools.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				tools.ClearInternal();
				tools = null;
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append("'");
			stringBuilder.Append(Key);
			stringBuilder.Append("', [AllowAllUp = ");
			stringBuilder.Append(AllowAllUp.ToString());
			stringBuilder.Append("]");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public override bool AllowEmptyKeys => false;

		public OptionSet this[int index] => (OptionSet)base.GetItem(index);

		public OptionSet this[string key] => (OptionSet)base.GetItem(key);

		protected override int InitialCapacity => initialCapacity;

		public override bool IsReadOnly => false;

		public UltraToolbarsManager ToolbarsManager => toolbarsManager;

		private List<OptionSet> DeserializedOptionSets
		{
			get
			{
				if (deserializedOptionSets == null)
				{
					deserializedOptionSets = new List<OptionSet>();
				}
				return deserializedOptionSets;
			}
		}

		internal OptionSetsCollection(UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager)
		{
			this.toolbarsManager = toolbarsManager;
		}

		protected OptionSetsCollection(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.Value is OptionSet)
				{
					OptionSet optionSet = (OptionSet)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(OptionSet), null);
					if (optionSet != null)
					{
						DeserializedOptionSets.Add(optionSet);
					}
					continue;
				}
				string name = current.Name;
				if (!(name == "Count"))
				{
					if (name == "Tag")
					{
						DeserializeTag(current);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					initialCapacity = Math.Max(initialCapacity, (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), initialCapacity));
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Count", Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, i.ToString(), this[i]);
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public int Add(object obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_33"));
			}
			if (!(obj is OptionSet optionSet))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_6", obj.GetType().Name));
			}
			return InternalAdd(optionSet);
		}

		public int Add(bool allowAllUp, string key)
		{
			OptionSet optionSet = new OptionSet(allowAllUp, key);
			return InternalAdd(optionSet);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			OptionSetEnumerator optionSetEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (optionSetEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					OptionSet current = optionSetEnumerator.Current;
					InternalRemove(current, notifyListeners: false);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = optionSetEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.OptionSets);
		}

		public OptionSetEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new OptionSetEnumerator(this);
		}

		public void Remove(OptionSet optionSet)
		{
			if (optionSet == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_34"));
			}
			InternalRemove(optionSet, notifyListeners: true);
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			if (index > Count || index < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_8"));
			}
			OptionSet optionSet = this[index];
			if (optionSet != null)
			{
				InternalRemove(optionSet, notifyListeners: true);
			}
		}

		internal void Initialize(UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager)
		{
			this.toolbarsManager = toolbarsManager;
			foreach (OptionSet deserializedOptionSet in DeserializedOptionSets)
			{
				if (deserializedOptionSet.Key != null && deserializedOptionSet.Key.Length >= 1)
				{
					InternalAdd((IKeyedSubObject)deserializedOptionSet);
					deserializedOptionSet.Initialize(this);
					deserializedOptionSet.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
			}
			deserializedOptionSets = null;
		}

		internal int InternalAdd(OptionSet optionSet)
		{
			optionSet.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			int result = InternalAdd((IKeyedSubObject)optionSet);
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.OptionSets);
			return result;
		}

		internal void InternalRemove(OptionSet optionSet, bool notifyListeners)
		{
			if (optionSet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			InternalRemove(optionSet);
			foreach (ToolBase tool in optionSet.Tools)
			{
				if (tool is StateButtonTool stateButtonTool)
				{
					stateButtonTool.OptionSetKey = string.Empty;
				}
			}
			optionSet.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			if (notifyListeners)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.OptionSets);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			OptionSetEnumerator optionSetEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (optionSetEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					OptionSet current = optionSetEnumerator.Current;
					current.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					current.Dispose();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = optionSetEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			InternalClear();
			toolbarsManager = null;
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.OptionSets, propChange);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("OptionSetsToStringLiteral"));
			stringBuilder.Append(Count);
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}

		private void cmdNew_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			OptionSetsCollectionTypeEditorForm2 optionSetsCollectionTypeEditorForm = new OptionSetsCollectionTypeEditorForm2(optionSetsCollection);
			optionSetsCollectionTypeEditorForm.ShowDialog(this);
			if (optionSetsCollectionTypeEditorForm.DialogResult == DialogResult.OK)
			{
				LoadOptionSets(optionSetsCollection[optionSetsCollection.Count - 1]);
			}
			optionSetsCollectionTypeEditorForm.Dispose();
		}

		private void liOptionSets_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (currentOptionSet != null)
			{
				currentOptionSet.SubObjectPropChanged -= OnOptionSetPropChanged;
			}
			currentOptionSet = SelectedOptionSet;
			if (currentOptionSet != null)
			{
				currentOptionSet.SubObjectPropChanged += OnOptionSetPropChanged;
			}
			propertyGrid1.SelectedObject = currentOptionSet;
			cmdRemove.Enabled = currentOptionSet != null && !currentOptionSet.Inherited;
		}

		private void OnOptionSetPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (propChange.PropId is SubObjectBase.NotifyId && SubObjectBase.NotifyId.Key == (SubObjectBase.NotifyId)(object)propChange.PropId)
			{
				LoadOptionSets(SelectedOptionSet);
			}
		}

		private void cmdRemove_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			OptionSet selectedOptionSet = SelectedOptionSet;
			if (selectedOptionSet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("OptionSetEditorConfirmDelete", selectedOptionSet.Key);
			DialogResult dialogResult = UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, text, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("OptionSetEditorConfirmDeleteTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.OKCancel, MessageBoxIcon.Question);
			if (dialogResult == DialogResult.OK)
			{
				optionSetsCollection.Remove(selectedOptionSet);
				int selectedIndex = liOptionSets.SelectedIndex;
				liOptionSets.Items.RemoveAt(liOptionSets.SelectedIndex);
				if (selectedIndex + 1 <= liOptionSets.Items.Count)
				{
					liOptionSets.SelectedIndex = selectedIndex;
				}
				else if (liOptionSets.Items.Count > 0)
				{
					liOptionSets.SelectedIndex = liOptionSets.Items.Count - 1;
				}
			}
		}

		private void cmdClose_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Close();
		}

		private void LoadOptionSets(OptionSet selectedOptionSet)
		{
			if (loadingList)
			{
				return;
			}
			loadingList = true;
			OptionSetListEntry optionSetListEntry = null;
			try
			{
				liOptionSets.BeginUpdate();
				liOptionSets.Items.Clear();
				liOptionSets.Sorted = false;
				foreach (OptionSet item in optionSetsCollection)
				{
					OptionSetListEntry optionSetListEntry2 = new OptionSetListEntry(item);
					liOptionSets.Items.Add(optionSetListEntry2);
					if (item == selectedOptionSet)
					{
						optionSetListEntry = optionSetListEntry2;
					}
				}
				liOptionSets.Sorted = true;
				if (optionSetListEntry != null)
				{
					liOptionSets.SelectedItem = optionSetListEntry;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				try
				{
					liOptionSets.EndUpdate();
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				loadingList = false;
			}
		}
	}

		private void cmdOK_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(txtName.Text))
			{
				string text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("OptionSetEditorNameError");
				UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, text, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("OptionSetEditorNameErrorTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation);
				ToolbarsManagerUtilities.FocusControl(txtName);
				return;
			}
			if (optionSetsCollection.Exists(txtName.Text))
			{
				string text2 = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("OptionSetEditorNameExistsError", txtName.Text);
				UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, text2, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("OptionSetEditorNameExistsErrorTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation);
				ToolbarsManagerUtilities.FocusControl(txtName);
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				optionSetsCollection.Add(chAllowAllUp.Checked, txtName.Text);
			}
			catch
			{
				string text3 = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("OptionSetEditorAddError");
				UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, text3, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("OptionSetEditorAddErrorTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
				ToolbarsManagerUtilities.FocusControl(txtName);
				return;
			}
			base.DialogResult = DialogResult.OK;
			Close();
		}

		private void txtName_TextChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			cmdOK.Enabled = txtName.Text.Length > 0;
		}
	}

		private void InitializeComponent()

		private void AddOptionSet()
		{
			if (ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(txtName.Text))
			{
				string text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("OptionSetEditorNameError");
				UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, text, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("OptionSetEditorNameErrorTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation);
				ToolbarsManagerUtilities.FocusControl(txtName);
				return;
			}
			if (ultraToolbarsManager.OptionSets.Exists(txtName.Text))
			{
				string text2 = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("OptionSetEditorNameExistsError", txtName.Text);
				UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, text2, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("OptionSetEditorNameExistsErrorTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation);
				ToolbarsManagerUtilities.FocusControl(txtName);
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				ultraToolbarsManager.OptionSets.Add(chAllowAllUp.Checked, txtName.Text);
			}
			catch
			{
				string text3 = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("OptionSetEditorAddError");
				UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, text3, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("OptionSetEditorAddErrorTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
				ToolbarsManagerUtilities.FocusControl(txtName);
				return;
			}
			ListViewItem listViewItem = lvOptionSets.Items.Add(txtName.Text);
			listViewItem.SubItems.Add(chAllowAllUp.Checked.ToString());
			listViewItem.Selected = true;
			lvOptionSets.EnsureVisible(listViewItem.Index);
			txtName.Text = "";
		}

		private static Color DarkenColor(Color color, int amount)
		{
			return Color.FromArgb(color.A, Math.Max(color.R - amount, 0), Math.Max(color.G - amount, 0), Math.Max(color.B - amount, 0));
		}

		private void LoadOptionSets(string existingOptionSet)
		{
			lvOptionSets.BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				foreach (OptionSet optionSet in ultraToolbarsManager.OptionSets)
				{
					ListViewItem listViewItem = lvOptionSets.Items.Add(optionSet.Key);
					listViewItem.SubItems.Add(optionSet.AllowAllUp.ToString());
					if (!ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(existingOptionSet) && existingOptionSet == optionSet.Key)
					{
						listViewItem.Selected = true;
					}
				}
				lvOptionSets.Sorting = SortOrder.Ascending;
				lvOptionSets.Sort();
			}
			finally
			{
				try
				{
					lvOptionSets.EndUpdate();
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
		}

		private void RemoveOptionSet()
		{
			if (lvOptionSets.SelectedItems.Count != 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("OptionSetEditorConfirmDelete", lvOptionSets.SelectedItems[0].Text);
			DialogResult dialogResult = UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, text, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("OptionSetEditorConfirmDeleteTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.OKCancel, MessageBoxIcon.Question);
			if (dialogResult == DialogResult.OK)
			{
				ultraToolbarsManager.OptionSets.Remove(ultraToolbarsManager.OptionSets[lvOptionSets.SelectedItems[0].Text]);
				int num = lvOptionSets.SelectedIndices[0];
				lvOptionSets.Items.RemoveAt(lvOptionSets.SelectedIndices[0]);
				if (num + 1 <= lvOptionSets.Items.Count)
				{
					lvOptionSets.Items[num].Selected = true;
				}
				else if (lvOptionSets.Items.Count > 0)
				{
					lvOptionSets.Items[lvOptionSets.Items.Count - 1].Selected = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private void cmdClose_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Close();
		}

		private void OptionSetTypeEditorForm_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			lvOptionSets.Columns[1].Width = lvOptionSets.ClientRectangle.Width - lvOptionSets.Columns[0].Width;
			pnlAddNew.BackColor = DarkenColor(pnlAddNew.BackColor, 20);
			if (lvOptionSets.Items.Count < 1)
			{
				ToolbarsManagerUtilities.FocusControl(txtName);
			}
			mnuRemoveOptionSet.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("RemoveOptionSetContextMenuItem");
		}

		private void cmdNew_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			AddOptionSet();
		}

		private void lvOptionSets_MouseUp(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Button == MouseButtons.Left)
			{
				Close();
			}
		}

		private void cmdEnter_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if ((txtName.Focused || chAllowAllUp.Focused || cmdNew.Focused) && txtName.Text.ToString().Length > 0)
			{
				AddOptionSet();
			}
			else
			{
				Close();
			}
		}

		private void txtName_TextChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Button button = cmdNew;
			bool enabled = (chAllowAllUp.Enabled = txtName.Text.ToString().Length > 0);
			button.Enabled = enabled;
		}

		private void contextMenu1_Popup(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			mnuRemoveOptionSet.Enabled = lvOptionSets.SelectedItems.Count == 1;
		}

		private void mnuRemoveOptionSet_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			RemoveOptionSet();
		}

		private void lvOptionSets_KeyUp(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.KeyCode == Keys.Delete)
			{
				RemoveOptionSet();
			}
		}
	}

			{

					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))

			}

						owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ReplaceableColor);
					}
				}
			}

			internal Color SelectedColor
			{
				get
				{
					return selectedColor;
				}
				set
				{
					if (selectedColor != value)
					{
						owningTool.VerifyCanBeModified();
						selectedColor = value;
						owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.SelectedColor);
					}
				}
			}

			internal bool ShowTransparentColor
			{
				get
				{
					return showTransparentColor;
				}
				set
				{
					if (value != showTransparentColor)
					{
						owningTool.VerifyCanBeModified();
						showTransparentColor = value;
						owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ShowTransparentColor);
					}
				}
			}

			internal bool ShowAutomaticColor
			{
				get
				{
					return showAutomaticColor;
				}
				set
				{
					if (value != showAutomaticColor)
					{
						owningTool.VerifyCanBeModified();
						showAutomaticColor = value;
						owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ShowAutomaticColor);
					}
				}
			}

			internal PopupColorPickerToolExtraSharedProps(PopupColorPickerTool owningTool)
			{
				this.owningTool = owningTool;
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_PopupColorPickerTool_P_ReplaceableColor")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Appearance")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		public Color ReplaceableColor
		{
			get
			{
				return ExtraSharedProps.ReplaceableColor;
			}
			set
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.ReplaceableColor = value;
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_PopupColorPickerTool_P_SelectedColor")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Data")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		public Color SelectedColor
		{
			get
			{
				return ExtraSharedProps.SelectedColor;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(ExtraSharedProps.SelectedColor != value))
				{
					return;
				}
				ExtraSharedProps.SelectedColor = value;
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager == null || !toolbarsManager.Initialized)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (PopupColorPickerTool toolInstance in base.SharedProps.ToolInstances)
				{
					if (!toolInstance.IsRootTool)
					{
						toolInstance.SynchronizeColorChange();
					}
				}
				toolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.ToolValueChanged, new ToolEventArgs(this));
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_PopupColorPickerTool_P_ShowTransparentColor")]

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override Control Control
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_001b: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (colorControl == null && base.ToolbarsManager != null)
				{
					colorControl = new CustomColorBox();
					((Control)(object)colorControl).Name = "CustomColorBox";
					colorControl.ColorChanged += OnColorChange;
					((Component)(object)colorControl).Disposed += OnControlDisposed;
					colorControl.BeforeShowMoreColorsDialog += OnBeforeShowMoreColorsDialog;
					SynchronizeColorChange();
				}
				return (Control)(object)colorControl;
			}
			set
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_35"));
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				PopupColorPickerToolExtraSharedProps popupColorPickerToolExtraSharedProps = GetExtraSharedProps(base.ExtraSharedPropsCount) as PopupColorPickerToolExtraSharedProps;
				if (popupColorPickerToolExtraSharedProps == null)
				{
					popupColorPickerToolExtraSharedProps = ((base.SharedProps.RootTool == null) ? new PopupColorPickerToolExtraSharedProps(this) : new PopupColorPickerToolExtraSharedProps(base.SharedProps.RootTool as PopupColorPickerTool));
					SetExtraSharedProps(popupColorPickerToolExtraSharedProps, base.ExtraSharedPropsCount);
				}
				return popupColorPickerToolExtraSharedProps;
			}
		}

		public PopupColorPickerTool(string key)
			: base(key)
		{
		}

		protected PopupColorPickerTool(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "ReplaceableColor":
					SerializedProps.replaceableColor = (Color)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(Color), SerializedProps.replaceableColor);
					break;
				case "SelectedColor":
					SerializedProps.selectedColor = (Color)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(Color), SerializedProps.selectedColor);
					break;
				case "ShowTransparentColor":
					SerializedProps.showTransparentColor = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), SerializedProps.showTransparentColor);
					break;
				case "ShowAutomaticColor":
					SerializedProps.showAutomaticColor = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), SerializedProps.showAutomaticColor);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

			return false;
		}

			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ResetSelectedColor()
		{
			SelectedColor = Color.Empty;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeShowTransparentColor()
		{
			if (base.IsRootTool && ShowTransparentColor)

			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ResetShowTransparentColor()
		{
			ShowTransparentColor = false;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeShowAutomaticColor()
		{
			if (base.IsRootTool && !ShowAutomaticColor)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetShowAutomaticColor()
		{
			ShowAutomaticColor = true;
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			base.Reset();
			ResetSelectedColor();
		}

		internal void SynchronizeColorChange()
		{
			//IL_0044: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0072: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			if (colorControl != null)
			{
				colorControl.Color = SelectedColor;
				colorControl.ShowTransparentColor = ShowTransparentColor;
				colorControl.ShowAutomaticColor = ShowAutomaticColor;
				ToolbarStyle styleResolved = base.ToolbarsManager.StyleResolved;
				switch (styleResolved - 2)
				{
				case 2:
					colorControl.DisplayStyle = (CustomColorBoxDisplayStyle)1;
					break;
				case 0:
					colorControl.DisplayStyle = (CustomColorBoxDisplayStyle)3;
					break;
				case 1:
					colorControl.DisplayStyle = (CustomColorBoxDisplayStyle)4;
					break;
				case 3:
				case 5:
				case 6:
					colorControl.DisplayStyle = (CustomColorBoxDisplayStyle)5;
					break;
				case 7:
					colorControl.DisplayStyle = (CustomColorBoxDisplayStyle)6;
					break;
				default:
					colorControl.DisplayStyle = (CustomColorBoxDisplayStyle)2;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void DisposeColorControl()
		{
			if (colorControl != null)
			{
				((Component)(object)colorControl).Disposed -= OnControlDisposed;
				colorControl.ColorChanged -= OnColorChange;
				((Component)(object)colorControl).Dispose();
				colorControl = null;
			}
		}

		private void OnBeforeShowMoreColorsDialog(object sender, CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			if (colorControl != null)
			{
				colorControl.ColorChanged += OnMoreColorsDialogColorChanged;
				if (customColors != null)
				{
					colorControl.CustomColors = customColors;
				}
			}
			if (!base.IsOnBackStage)
			{
				base.ToolbarsManager.PopupManager.CloseAllPopups();
			}
		}

		private void OnMoreColorsDialogColorChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			CustomColorBox val = (CustomColorBox)((sender is CustomColorBox) ? sender : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				SelectedColor = val.Color;
				val.ColorChanged -= OnMoreColorsDialogColorChanged;
				customColors = val.CustomColors;
			}
		}

		private void OnColorChange(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			SelectedColor = colorControl.Color;
			base.ToolbarsManager.PopupManager.CloseAllPopups(onlyCloseLeafContiguousPopupChain: true);
		}

		private void OnControlDisposed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (colorControl != null)
			{
				((Component)(object)colorControl).Disposed -= OnControlDisposed;
				colorControl.ColorChanged -= OnColorChange;
				colorControl.BeforeShowMoreColorsDialog -= OnBeforeShowMoreColorsDialog;
				colorControl = null;
			}
		}

		protected internal override ToolBase Clone(bool cloneNewInstance)
		{
			PopupColorPickerTool popupColorPickerTool = new PopupColorPickerTool(Key);
			popupColorPickerTool.InitializeFrom(this, cloneNewInstance);
			return popupColorPickerTool;
		}

		protected internal override ColorMap[] GetColorRemapTable(object image, bool isOnToolbar, bool isHotTracked)
		{
			ColorMap transparentColorMap = base.ToolbarsManager.GetTransparentColorMap(image, isOnToolbar);
			int num = 0;
			ColorMap[] array;
			if (transparentColorMap != null)
			{
				array = new ColorMap[2] { transparentColorMap, null };
				num = 1;
			}
			else
			{
				array = new ColorMap[1];
				num = 0;
			}
			array[num] = new ColorMap();
			array[num].NewColor = SelectedColor;
			array[num].OldColor = ReplaceableColor;
			return array;
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		protected override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
			if (ShouldSerializeReplaceableColor())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ReplaceableColor", ReplaceableColor);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeSelectedColor())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "SelectedColor", SelectedColor);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeShowTransparentColor())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ShowTransparentColor", ShowTransparentColor);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeShowAutomaticColor())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ShowAutomaticColor", ShowAutomaticColor);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void Initialize(ToolsCollectionBase parentCollection)
		{
			base.Initialize(parentCollection);
			if (serializedProps != null)
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.replaceableColor = serializedProps.replaceableColor;
				ExtraSharedProps.selectedColor = serializedProps.selectedColor;
				ExtraSharedProps.showTransparentColor = serializedProps.showTransparentColor;
				ExtraSharedProps.showAutomaticColor = serializedProps.showAutomaticColor;
				serializedProps = null;
			}
		}

		protected internal override void InitializeFrom(ToolBase sourceTool, bool cloneNewInstance)
		{
			base.InitializeFrom(sourceTool, cloneNewInstance);
			PopupColorPickerTool popupColorPickerTool = sourceTool as PopupColorPickerTool;
			if (!cloneNewInstance && popupColorPickerTool != null)
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.selectedColor = popupColorPickerTool.ExtraSharedProps.SelectedColor;
				ExtraSharedProps.replaceableColor = popupColorPickerTool.ExtraSharedProps.ReplaceableColor;
				ExtraSharedProps.showTransparentColor = popupColorPickerTool.ExtraSharedProps.ShowTransparentColor;
				ExtraSharedProps.showAutomaticColor = popupColorPickerTool.ExtraSharedProps.showAutomaticColor;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			DisposeColorControl();
			if (base.IsRootTool)
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.Dispose();
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		internal override void OnToolbarManagerDisposing()
		{
			DisposeColorControl();
			base.OnToolbarManagerDisposing();
		}
	}
	internal class PopupControlContainerAgent : PopupToolAgentBase
	{
		private ToolBase parentTool;

		private PopupControlContainerToolBase popupControlTool;

		protected internal override bool AllowTearaway
		{
			get
			{
				if (PopupControlTool.AllowTearawayResolved)
				{
					return TearawayTool != null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool CanResize => false;

		protected internal override Control ContainedControl => PopupControlTool.Control;

		protected internal override bool IsControlContainer => true;

		protected internal override bool IsMenuAnimationActive
		{
			get
			{
				return false;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool IsSideStripVisible => false;

		protected internal override bool OkToDropDown
		{
			get
			{
				if (popupControlTool.EnabledResolved)
				{
					return popupControlTool.Control != null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected internal override PopupStyle PopupStyle => PopupStyle.Toolbar;

		protected internal override int SideStripWidth => 0;

		protected internal override string SideStripText => string.Empty;

		protected internal override TearawayToolBase TearawayTool
		{
			get
			{
				parentTool.AttachToUnderlyingTool();
				return popupControlTool;
			}
		}

		internal override UIRole UIRole
		{
			get
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
				if (ultraToolbarsManager != null)
				{
					return StyleUtils.GetRole(ultraToolbarsManager, StyleUtils.Role.PopupControlContainer);
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal PopupControlContainerToolBase PopupControlTool => popupControlTool;

		public PopupControlContainerAgent(ToolBase tool)
			: base(tool.PopupTool)
		{
			parentTool = tool;
			popupControlTool = tool.UnderlyingTool as PopupControlContainerToolBase;
			tool.AttachToUnderlyingTool();
		}

		protected internal override void AfterDropDown()
		{
			base.ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.AfterToolDropdown, new ToolDropdownEventArgs(PopupControlTool, base.SourceControl));
			base.AfterDropDown();
		}

		protected internal override void BeforeDropDown(ref bool cancel)
		{
			parentTool.AttachToUnderlyingTool();
			BeforeToolDropdownEventArgs e = new BeforeToolDropdownEventArgs(PopupControlTool, base.SourceControl);
			base.ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.BeforeToolDropdown, e);
			if (!parentTool.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea || !base.ToolbarsManager.EnforceOffice2007Resolution)
			{
				cancel = e.Cancel;
			}
			base.BeforeDropDown(ref cancel);
		}

		internal override void CalculateRequiredDropDownSize(out Size minSize, out Size preferredMinSize, out Size preferredSize, out Size maxSize)
		{
			Size size;
			if (base.PopupControl != null)
			{
				size = ((Control)(object)base.PopupControl).Size;
			}
			else if (base.IsOnBackStage && ContainedControl != null)
			{
				size = ContainedControl.Bounds.Size;
				if (PopupTool is PopupControlContainerTool popupControlContainerTool)
				{
					Size? dockedSize = popupControlContainerTool.GetDockedSize();
					if (dockedSize.HasValue)
					{
						size = dockedSize.Value;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				size = new Size(8, 8);
			}
			minSize = (preferredMinSize = (preferredSize = (maxSize = size)));
		}

		protected override void DropDownFailed()
		{
			base.DropDownFailed();
			ReleaseContainedControl();
		}

		protected internal override PopupControlBase GetPopupControl()
		{
			Control control = PopupControlTool.Control;
			UltraToolbarsDockArea ultraToolbarsDockArea = new UltraToolbarsDockArea(DockStyle.None);
			ultraToolbarsDockArea.ToolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			ultraToolbarsDockArea.AddToolbar(PopupControlTool.PopupToolbar, 0, 0);
			((Control)(object)ultraToolbarsDockArea).Name = "DockArea";
			Size size;
			if (control != null)
			{
				if (!control.IsDisposed && !control.Disposing && !control.IsHandleCreated)
				{
					IntPtr handle = control.Handle;
				}
				bool flag = false;
				Control newParent = null;
				if (!PopupTool.IsControlContainer || PopupTool.IsContainedControlShared)
				{
					try
					{
						UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
						if (Utilities.CanAssert)
						{
							uIPermission.Assert();
						}
						newParent = control.Parent;
						flag = true;
					}
					catch (SecurityException)
					{
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					ToolbarsManagerUtilities.SetParent(control, (Control)(object)ultraToolbarsDockArea);
				}
				size = control.Bounds.Size;
				if (flag)
				{
					ToolbarsManagerUtilities.SetParent(control, newParent);
				}
				size.Height = size.Height;
				size.Width = size.Width;
			}
			else
			{
				size = new Size(10, 20);
			}
			((Control)(object)ultraToolbarsDockArea).Size = size;
			PopupControlTool.PopupToolbar.InternalSetFloatingSize(size);
			PopupMenuControl popupMenuControl = PopupMenuControl.Create(this, ultraToolbarsDockArea);
			Size size2 = size;
			size2.Height += 2 * base.ToolbarsManager.Metrics.MenuBorderThickness;
			size2.Width += 2 * base.ToolbarsManager.Metrics.MenuBorderThickness;
			if (AllowTearaway)
			{
				int tearawayStripHeight = base.ToolbarsManager.Metrics.TearawayStripHeight;
				size2.Height += tearawayStripHeight + base.ToolbarsManager.Metrics.PaddingAroundMenuitem;
				((Control)(object)popupMenuControl).Size = size2;
				((Control)(object)ultraToolbarsDockArea).Location = new Point(base.ToolbarsManager.Metrics.MenuBorderThickness, tearawayStripHeight + base.ToolbarsManager.Metrics.PaddingAroundMenuitem + base.ToolbarsManager.Metrics.MenuBorderThickness);
			}
			else
			{
				((Control)(object)popupMenuControl).Size = size2;
				((Control)(object)ultraToolbarsDockArea).Location = new Point(base.ToolbarsManager.Metrics.MenuBorderThickness, base.ToolbarsManager.Metrics.MenuBorderThickness);
			}
			((Control)(object)popupMenuControl).Controls.Add((Control)(object)ultraToolbarsDockArea);
			if (PopupTool.IsControlContainer && !PopupTool.IsContainedControlShared)
			{
				((Control)(object)ultraToolbarsDockArea).Controls.Add(PopupTool.Control);
			}
			return popupMenuControl;
		}

		protected internal override void OnPopupClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ReleaseContainedControl();
			base.ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.AfterToolCloseup, new ToolDropdownEventArgs(PopupControlTool, base.SourceControl));
			if (PopupTool != null)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = parentTool.UIElement;
				if (uIElement == null)
				{
					parentTool.ToolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(parentTool, setOn: false, clearToolBeingEdited: true);
				}
				else if (parentTool.ToolbarsManager.ActiveTool == parentTool)
				{
					Control control = uIElement.Control;
					if (control != null && !control.IsDisposed && !control.Disposing)
					{
						Point pt = control.PointToClient(Control.MousePosition);
						if (!uIElement.Rect.Contains(pt))
						{
							parentTool.ToolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(parentTool, setOn: false, clearToolBeingEdited: true);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			base.OnPopupClosed(sender, e);
		}

		internal void VerifyParentTool(ToolBase tool)
		{
			parentTool = tool;
			popupControlTool = tool.UnderlyingTool as PopupControlContainerToolBase;
			tool.AttachToUnderlyingTool();
		}

		private void ReleaseContainedControl()
		{
			PopupControlContainerToolBase popupControlContainerToolBase = PopupControlTool;
			if (popupControlContainerToolBase != null && popupControlContainerToolBase.PopupToolbar.Tools.Count > 0 && popupControlContainerToolBase.ToolWithContainedControl == popupControlContainerToolBase.PopupToolbar.Tools[0])
			{
				popupControlContainerToolBase.PopupToolbar.Tools[0].SetToolWithContainedControl(takeControlOwnership: false, null);
			}
			if (popupControlContainerToolBase != null && popupControlContainerToolBase.IsTearawayToolbarCreated && popupControlContainerToolBase.TearawayToolbar.Tools.Count > 0)
			{
				popupControlContainerToolBase.TearawayToolbar.Tools[0].SetToolWithContainedControl(takeControlOwnership: true, base.ToolbarsManager.GetToolbarDockArea(popupControlContainerToolBase.TearawayToolbar));
			}
			if (popupControlContainerToolBase != null && popupControlContainerToolBase.IsOnBackStage)
			{
				popupControlContainerToolBase.SetToolWithContainedControl(takeControlOwnership: false, null);
				if (!popupControlContainerToolBase.IsContainedControlShared && popupControlContainerToolBase.ToolWithContainedControl != null)
				{
					popupControlContainerToolBase.Control.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}
	}
	[Serializable]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(PopupControlContainerToolConverter))]
	public class PopupControlContainerTool : PopupControlContainerToolBase, ISerializable
	{
		public class PopupControlContainerToolConverter : ExpandableObjectConverter
		{
			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(PopupControlContainerTool).GetConstructor(new Type[1] { typeof(string) });
					PopupControlContainerTool popupControlContainerTool = (PopupControlContainerTool)value;
					return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[1] { popupControlContainerTool.Key }, isComplete: false);
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		private class PopupControlContainerToolExtraSharedProps : SubObjectBase, IControlContainerExtraSharedProps
		{
			private PopupControlContainerTool owningTool;

			private Control control;

			private string controlName;

			private ToolBase toolWithControl;

			private bool enabledPreCustomize;

			private bool customizing;

			private DockStyle? controlDock = DockStyle.None;

			private Size controlSize = Size.Empty;

			public Control Control
			{
				get
				{
					return control;
				}
				set
				{
					if (value == control)
					{
						return;
					}
					owningTool.VerifyCanBeModified();
					if (owningTool.ToolWithContainedControl != null)
					{
						owningTool.ToolWithContainedControl.SetToolWithContainedControl(takeControlOwnership: false, null);
					}
					control = value;
					controlName = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetName(control);
					UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = owningTool.ToolbarsManager;
					if (control != null && toolbarsManager != null && toolbarsManager.Initialized)
					{
						ControlDock = control.Dock;
						ControlSize = control.Size;
						toolbarsManager.InternalSetToolWithControlHelper(owningTool.ToolWithContainedControl, owningTool.SharedProps.RootTool, null);
					}
					ToolsCollection toolInstances = owningTool.SharedProps.ToolInstances;
					int i = 0;
					for (int count = toolInstances.Count; i < count; i++)
					{
						if (toolInstances[i].IsOnBackStage)
						{
							PopupControlContainerTool popupControlContainerTool = toolInstances[i] as PopupControlContainerTool;
							if (popupControlContainerTool.IsOpen)
							{
								toolbarsManager.Ribbon.ApplicationMenu2010.BackStageManager.RefreshMenuList();
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Control);
				}
			}

			internal string ControlName
			{
				get
				{
					if (control != null)
					{
						return ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetName(control);
					}
					return controlName;
				}
				set
				{
					if (value != null && value.Length == 0)
					{
						value = null;
					}
					if (value != controlName)
					{
						owningTool.VerifyCanBeModified();
						controlName = value;
						SyncControlWithName(allowUpdateControlName: false);
					}
				}
			}

			internal ToolBase ToolWithControl
			{
				get
				{
					if (toolWithControl == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					if (ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetParent(Control) == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return toolWithControl;
				}
				set
				{
					if (value != toolWithControl)
					{
						toolWithControl = value;
					}
				}
			}

			internal DockStyle? ControlDock
			{
				get
				{
					return controlDock;
				}
				set
				{
					controlDock = value;
				}
			}

			internal Size ControlSize
			{
				get
				{
					return controlSize;
				}
				set
				{
					controlSize = value;
				}
			}

			internal PopupControlContainerToolExtraSharedProps(PopupControlContainerTool owningTool)
			{
				this.owningTool = owningTool;
			}

			internal void OnCustomizeModeBegin()
			{
				if (!customizing && control != null && (owningTool.ToolbarsManagerInControl == null || !owningTool.ToolbarsManagerInControl.IsDesignMode))
				{
					customizing = true;
					enabledPreCustomize = control.Enabled;
					control.Enabled = false;
				}
			}

			internal void OnCustomizeModeEnd()
			{
				if (customizing)
				{
					customizing = false;
					if (control != null)
					{
						control.Enabled = enabledPreCustomize;
					}
				}
			}

			public bool SyncControlWithName(bool allowUpdateControlName)
			{
				if (controlName == null)
				{
					if (allowUpdateControlName)
					{
						if (Control != null)
						{
							controlName = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetName(Control);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						Control = null;
					}
					return true;
				}
				if (control != null && ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetName(control) == controlName)
				{
					return true;
				}
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = owningTool.ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager != null && toolbarsManager.Initialized)
				{
					Control controlFromName = toolbarsManager.GetControlFromName(controlName);
					if (controlFromName != null)
					{
						Control = controlFromName;
						return true;
					}
				}
				Control = null;
				return false;
			}
		}

		private string controlName;

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_PopupControlContainerTool_P_Control")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		[TypeConverter("Infragistics.Win.UltraWinToolbars.Design.ContainerToolControlConverter, Infragistics4.Win.v21.1.Design, Version=21.1.20211.24, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=7dd5c3163f2cd0cb")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Always)]
		[Browsable(true)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		public override Control Control
		{
			get
			{
				return ExtraSharedProps.Control;
			}
			set
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.ControlDock = value?.Dock;
				if (ControlContainerUtilities.SetControl(this, ExtraSharedProps, value))
				{
					controlName = null;
				}
				else if (value == null && controlName != null && base.ToolbarsManager.ForceControlNameToExtraSharedProps)
				{
					ExtraSharedProps.ControlName = controlName;
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		public string ControlName
		{
			get
			{
				return ExtraSharedProps.ControlName;
			}
			set
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.ControlName = value;
			}
		}

		protected override AccessibleRole DefaultAccessibleRole => AccessibleRole.ButtonDropDown;

		public override bool IsControlContainer => true;

		protected internal override bool IsContainedControlShared => true;

		protected internal override ToolBase ToolWithContainedControl => ExtraSharedProps.ToolWithControl;

		public override UIRole UIRoleOnMenus => StyleUtils.GetRole(base.ToolbarsManagerInControl, StyleUtils.Role.MenuItemPopupControlContainer);

		public override UIRole UIRoleOnRibbonGroups
		{
			get
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManagerInControl = base.ToolbarsManagerInControl;
				if (toolbarsManagerInControl == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return StyleUtils.GetRole(toolbarsManagerInControl, StyleUtils.Role.RibbonGroupItemPopupControlContainer);
			}
		}

		public override UIRole UIRoleOnToolbars => StyleUtils.GetRole(base.ToolbarsManagerInControl, StyleUtils.Role.ToolbarItemPopupControlContainer);

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		protected override int ExtraSharedPropsCount => base.ExtraSharedPropsCount + 1;

		private PopupControlContainerToolExtraSharedProps ExtraSharedProps
		{
			get
			{
				PopupControlContainerToolExtraSharedProps popupControlContainerToolExtraSharedProps = GetExtraSharedProps(base.ExtraSharedPropsCount) as PopupControlContainerToolExtraSharedProps;
				if (popupControlContainerToolExtraSharedProps == null)
				{
					popupControlContainerToolExtraSharedProps = ((base.SharedProps.RootTool == null) ? new PopupControlContainerToolExtraSharedProps(this) : new PopupControlContainerToolExtraSharedProps(base.SharedProps.RootTool as PopupControlContainerTool));
					SetExtraSharedProps(popupControlContainerToolExtraSharedProps, base.ExtraSharedPropsCount);
				}
				return popupControlContainerToolExtraSharedProps;
			}
		}

		public PopupControlContainerTool(string key)
			: base(key)
		{
		}

		protected PopupControlContainerTool(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				string name = current.Name;
				if (name == "Control")
				{
					controlName = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), controlName);
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			GetObjectData(info, context);
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeControl()
		{
			if (base.IsRootTool)
			{
				return ControlContainerTool.ShouldSerializeControlReference(this);
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetControl()
		{
			ExtraSharedProps.Control = null;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeControlName()
		{
			if (base.IsRootTool && ExtraSharedProps.ControlName != null)
			{
				return !ShouldSerializeControl();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			ResetControl();
		}

		internal void SyncControlWithName()
		{
			ControlContainerUtilities.SyncControlWithName(this, ExtraSharedProps);
		}

		internal bool ResizeControlToFillArea(Rectangle fillArea)
		{
			Control control = Control;
			if (control == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			PopupControlContainerToolExtraSharedProps extraSharedProps = ExtraSharedProps;
			if (extraSharedProps != null && !extraSharedProps.ControlDock.HasValue)
			{
				extraSharedProps.ControlDock = control.Dock;
			}
			if (extraSharedProps.ControlDock.Value == DockStyle.Fill)
			{
				control.Dock = DockStyle.None;
				control.Location = fillArea.Location;
				Size size = fillArea.Size;
				size.Height -= base.ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.ApplicationMenu2010.BackStageHeaderHeight;
				control.Size = size;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal Size? GetDockedSize()
		{
			if (Control == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PopupControlContainerToolExtraSharedProps extraSharedProps = ExtraSharedProps;
			if (!extraSharedProps.ControlDock.HasValue || extraSharedProps.ControlDock.Value != DockStyle.Fill)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Size.Empty;
		}

		internal Size GetControlSize()
		{
			return ExtraSharedProps.ControlSize;
		}

		protected internal override ToolBase Clone(bool cloneNewInstance)
		{
			PopupControlContainerTool popupControlContainerTool = new PopupControlContainerTool(Key);
			popupControlContainerTool.InitializeFrom(this, cloneNewInstance);
			return popupControlContainerTool;
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		protected override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
			if (ShouldSerializeControl())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Control", ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetName(Control));
			}
			else if (ShouldSerializeControlName())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Control", ControlName);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void Initialize(ToolsCollectionBase parentCollection)
		{
			base.Initialize(parentCollection);
			ControlContainerUtilities.InitializeControl(this, controlName);
		}

		protected internal override void InitializeFrom(ToolBase sourceTool, bool cloneNewInstance)
		{
			base.InitializeFrom(sourceTool, cloneNewInstance);
			if (sourceTool is PopupControlContainerTool)
			{
				controlName = ((PopupControlContainerTool)sourceTool).controlName;
			}
		}

		protected internal override void InternalSetToolWithContainedControl(ToolBase tool)
		{
			ExtraSharedProps.ToolWithControl = tool;
		}

		protected internal override void OnCustomizeModeBegin()
		{
			ExtraSharedProps.OnCustomizeModeBegin();
		}

		protected internal override void OnCustomizeModeEnd()
		{
			ExtraSharedProps.OnCustomizeModeEnd();
		}

		internal override void OnToolbarManagerDisposing()
		{
			ControlContainerUtilities.OnToolbarManagerDisposing(this);
			base.OnToolbarManagerDisposing();
		}

		internal override void SyncControlAfterLoad()
		{
			SyncControlWithName();
			base.SyncControlAfterLoad();
		}
	}

			internal AppearanceBase PopupAppearance
			{
				get
				{
					//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					//IL_0013: Expected O, but got Unknown
					if (popupAppearanceHolder == null)

						popupAppearanceHolder = new AppearanceHolder();
						popupAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					}
					ToolbarsManagerUtilities.SetAppearanceHolderCollection(popupAppearanceHolder, owningTool.ToolbarsManager);
					return popupAppearanceHolder.Appearance;
				}
				set
				{
					//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					//IL_0036: Expected O, but got Unknown
					if (popupAppearanceHolder == null || !popupAppearanceHolder.HasAppearance || value != popupAppearanceHolder.Appearance)
					{
						if (popupAppearanceHolder == null)
						{
							popupAppearanceHolder = new AppearanceHolder();
							popupAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
						}
						ToolbarsManagerUtilities.SetAppearanceHolderCollection(popupAppearanceHolder, owningTool.ToolbarsManager);
						popupAppearanceHolder.Appearance = value;
						owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.PopupAppearance);

			{
				this.owningTool = owningTool;
			}

			internal bool ShouldSerializePopupAppearance()
			{
				if (HasPopupAppearance)
				{
					return popupAppearanceHolder.ShouldSerialize();
				}
				return false;
			}

			internal void ResetPopupAppearance()
			{
				if (HasPopupAppearance)
				{
					popupAppearanceHolder.Reset();
					owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.PopupAppearance);
				}
			}
