		internal bool ShowAsDropDownControl
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
				{
					ToolBase tearawayToolOwnerInternal = base.OwningToolbarInternal.TearawayToolOwnerInternal;
					if (tearawayToolOwnerInternal != null)
					{
						if (tearawayToolOwnerInternal is PopupMenuTool)
						{
							return false;
						}
						if (base.OwningToolbarInternal.ToolbarType == ToolbarType.Tearaway || tearawayToolOwnerInternal.OwnerIsToolbarsManager || tearawayToolOwnerInternal is MdiMergePlaceholderTool)
						{
							return true;
						}
						if (IsSameLogicalTool(tearawayToolOwnerInternal))
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]

		{
			get

					popupControlContainerToolBaseSharedProps = ((base.SharedProps.RootTool == null) ? new PopupControlContainerToolBaseSharedProps(this) : new PopupControlContainerToolBaseSharedProps(base.SharedProps.RootTool as PopupControlContainerToolBase));
					SetExtraSharedProps(popupControlContainerToolBaseSharedProps, base.ExtraSharedPropsCount);

				return popupControlContainerToolBaseSharedProps;

		protected PopupControlContainerToolBase(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			//IL_0044: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				string name = current.Name;
				if (name == "PopupAppearance")
				{
					serializedPopupAppearanceHolder = (AppearanceHolder)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(AppearanceHolder), serializedPopupAppearanceHolder);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override Size CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstance()
		{
			Size size = new Size(0, 0);
			Size size2 = new Size(0, 0);
			if (ShowAsDropDownControl)
			{
				UltraToolbarBase owningToolbarInternal = base.OwningToolbarInternal;
				if (owningToolbarInternal.TearawayToolOwnerInternal != null)
				{
					if (Control != null)
					{
						if (base.IsVertical)
						{
							return new Size(Control.Size.Height, Control.Size.Width);
						}
						return Control.Size;
					}
					return DefaultSize;
				}
			}
			return base.CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstance();
		}

		protected internal override UIElement GetToolbarUIElement(ToolBase tool, UIElement parentElement, UIElement previousElement, bool drawAsActive, bool drawAsPressed)
		{
			if (ShowAsDropDownControl)

				ControlContainerUIElement controlContainerUIElement = null;
				if (previousElement != null && ((object)previousElement).GetType() == typeof(ControlContainerUIElement))
				{
					controlContainerUIElement = previousElement as ControlContainerUIElement;
				}
				if (controlContainerUIElement == null)
				{
					controlContainerUIElement = new ControlContainerUIElement(parentElement, tool, Control);
				}
				else
				{
					controlContainerUIElement.InitializeElement(tool, Control);
				}
				return (UIElement)(object)controlContainerUIElement;
			}
			return base.GetToolbarUIElement(tool, parentElement, previousElement, drawAsActive, drawAsPressed);
		}

		protected internal override Type GetToolbarUIElementType()
		{
			if (ShowAsDropDownControl)
			{
				return typeof(ControlContainerUIElement);
			}
			return base.GetToolbarUIElementType();
		}

		protected internal override void Initialize(ToolsCollectionBase parentCollection)
		{
			base.Initialize(parentCollection);
			if (serializedPopupAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.popupAppearanceHolder = serializedPopupAppearanceHolder;
				ExtraSharedProps.popupAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				serializedPopupAppearanceHolder = null;
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager != null && ExtraSharedProps.popupAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.popupAppearanceHolder.Collection = toolbarsManager.Appearances;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (ExtraSharedProps != null && ExtraSharedProps.popupAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.popupAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				ExtraSharedProps.popupAppearanceHolder = null;
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnPopupToolbarCreated()
		{
			base.PopupToolbar.Settings.AllowDockTop = (DefaultableBoolean)2;
			base.PopupToolbar.Settings.AllowDockBottom = (DefaultableBoolean)2;
			base.PopupToolbar.Settings.AllowDockLeft = (DefaultableBoolean)2;
			base.PopupToolbar.Settings.AllowDockRight = (DefaultableBoolean)2;
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (HasPopupAppearance && propChange.Source == ExtraSharedProps.popupAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.PopupAppearance, propChange);
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnSubObjectPropChanged(propChange);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnTearawayToolbarCreated()
		{
			base.TearawayToolbar.Settings.AllowDockTop = (DefaultableBoolean)2;
			base.TearawayToolbar.Settings.AllowDockBottom = (DefaultableBoolean)2;
			base.TearawayToolbar.Settings.AllowDockLeft = (DefaultableBoolean)2;
			base.TearawayToolbar.Settings.AllowDockRight = (DefaultableBoolean)2;
		}

		internal override void SyncControlAfterLoad()
		{
			if (ToolWithContainedControl == null)
			{
				base.ToolbarsManager.InternalSetToolWithControlHelper(null, this, null);
			}
			base.SyncControlAfterLoad();
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializePopupAppearance()
		{
			if (base.IsRootTool)
			{
				return ExtraSharedProps.ShouldSerializePopupAppearance();
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetPopupAppearance()
		{
			ExtraSharedProps.ResetPopupAppearance();
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			base.Reset();
			ResetPopupAppearance();
		}

		internal void CleanupForMerge()
		{
			if (IsContainedControlShared)
			{
				RemoveMenuAgent();
				if (base.HasPopupToolbar)
				{
					base.PopupToolbar.Tools.ClearInternal();
					ReattachPopupToolbarOnMerge(null);
				}
			}
		}

	internal class PopupGalleryAgent : PopupMenuAgent
	{
		private PopupGalleryTool popupGalleryTool;

		private bool isInNavigation;

		private NavigationAction currentNavigationAction;

		protected internal override bool AllowResize => popupGalleryTool.AllowResizeDropDown;

		protected internal override bool AllowTearaway => false;

		internal override UIRole UIRole
		{
			get
			{
				if (popupGalleryTool != null)
				{
					return popupGalleryTool.MenuUIRole;
				}
				UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
				if (ultraToolbarsManager != null)
				{
					return StyleUtils.GetRole(ultraToolbarsManager, StyleUtils.Role.PopupGallery);
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal PopupGalleryTool PopupGalleryTool => popupGalleryTool;

		public PopupGalleryAgent(PopupGalleryTool popupGalleryTool)
			: base(popupGalleryTool)
		{
			this.popupGalleryTool = popupGalleryTool;
		}

		internal override void CalculateRequiredDropDownSize(out Size minSize, out Size preferredMinSize, out Size preferredSize, out Size maxSize)
		{
			base.CalculateRequiredDropDownSize(out minSize, out preferredMinSize, out preferredSize, out maxSize);
			if (base.ToolbarsManager.EnforceOffice2007Resolution && PopupGalleryTool.IsPreviewVisible)
			{
				UIElement previewUIElement = PopupGalleryTool.PreviewUIElement;
				if (previewUIElement != null)
				{
					int height = previewUIElement.Rect.Height;
					minSize.Height = Math.Max(minSize.Height, height);
					preferredMinSize.Height = Math.Max(preferredMinSize.Height, height);
					preferredSize.Height = Math.Max(preferredSize.Height, height);
					maxSize.Height = Math.Max(maxSize.Height, height);
				}
			}
			if (base.ToolbarsManager.EnforceOffice2007Resolution && !base.IsParentLeftApplicationMenu && !base.IsOnBackStage)
			{
				int val = SystemInformation.WorkingArea.Height * 2 / 3;
				minSize.Height = Math.Min(minSize.Height, val);
				preferredMinSize.Height = Math.Min(preferredMinSize.Height, val);
				preferredSize.Height = Math.Min(preferredSize.Height, val);
				maxSize.Height = Math.Min(maxSize.Height, val);
			}
		}

		protected internal override PopupControlBase GetPopupControl()
		{
			PopupMenuControl popupMenuControl = PopupGalleryControl.Create(this);
			CalculateRequiredDropDownSize(out var minSize, out var _, out var preferredSize, out var maxSize);
			((Control)(object)popupMenuControl).Size = preferredSize;
			popupMenuControl.MinimumDropDownSize = minSize;
			popupMenuControl.MaximumDropDownSize = maxSize;
			return popupMenuControl;
		}

		protected internal override void OnPopupClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			PopupGalleryTool.ClearActiveItem(leftItemArea: true, GalleryArea.DropDown);
			if (!PopupGalleryTool.IsOnBackStage)
			{
				PopupGalleryTool.ItemAreaMenuItem = null;
			}
			base.OnPopupClosed(sender, e);
		}

		protected internal override bool ProcessNavigationKey(Keys keyCode)
		{
			try
			{
				isInNavigation = true;
				switch (keyCode)
				{
				case Keys.Return:
				case Keys.Space:
					if (PopupGalleryTool.IsFilterBarActive)
					{
						PopupGalleryTool.ShowFilterListPopup((Control)(object)base.PopupControl, PopupGalleryTool.FilterBarUIElement.Rect, activateFirstItem: true);
						return true;
					}
					if (PopupGalleryTool.ActiveItem != null)
					{
						PopupGalleryTool.ClickItem(PopupGalleryTool.ActiveItem, PopupGalleryTool.GroupWithActiveItem, GalleryArea.DropDown);
						return true;
					}
					break;
				case Keys.Up:
					currentNavigationAction = NavigationAction.Up;
					break;
				case Keys.Down:
					currentNavigationAction = NavigationAction.Down;
					break;
				case Keys.Left:
					if (PopupGalleryTool.OwnerIsMenuInternal || PopupGalleryTool.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)
					{
						GalleryToolItemGroup groupWithActiveItem = PopupGalleryTool.GroupWithActiveItem;
						if (groupWithActiveItem != null && groupWithActiveItem.GetVirtualLocation(PopupGalleryTool.ActiveItem).X == 0 && base.ProcessNavigationKey(keyCode))
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
					currentNavigationAction = NavigationAction.Left;
					break;
				case Keys.Right:
					currentNavigationAction = NavigationAction.Right;
					break;
				case Keys.Home:
					currentNavigationAction = NavigationAction.Home;
					if (ActivateGallery())
					{
						return true;
					}
					break;
				case Keys.End:
					currentNavigationAction = NavigationAction.End;
					if (ActivateGallery())
					{
						return true;
					}
					break;
				case Keys.Prior:
					currentNavigationAction = NavigationAction.PageUp;
					if (ActivateGallery())
					{
						return true;
					}
					break;
				case Keys.Next:
					currentNavigationAction = NavigationAction.PageDown;
					if (ActivateGallery())
					{
						return true;
					}
					break;
				default:
					return base.ProcessNavigationKey(keyCode);
				}
				if (base.ActiveMenuItem is GalleryToolMenuItem galleryToolMenuItem)
				{
					if (TryNavigate())
					{
						galleryToolMenuItem.UIElement.Invalidate();
						return true;
					}
					if (currentNavigationAction == NavigationAction.Down && base.MenuItems.GetNextMenuItem(galleryToolMenuItem, selectableItemsOnly: true, HideNonRecentlyUsedItems, wrapAround: false) == null)
					{
						galleryToolMenuItem.Deactivate();
					}
					else if (currentNavigationAction == NavigationAction.Up && base.MenuItems.GetPreviousMenuItem(galleryToolMenuItem, selectableItemsOnly: true, HideNonRecentlyUsedItems, wrapAround: false) == null)
					{
						galleryToolMenuItem.Deactivate();
					}
				}
				return base.ProcessNavigationKey(keyCode);
			}
			finally
			{
				isInNavigation = false;
			}
		}

		internal bool TryNavigate()
		{
			if (base.ActiveMenuItem != PopupGalleryTool.ItemAreaMenuItem)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!isInNavigation)
			{
				return false;
			}
			object obj = PopupGalleryTool.TryNavigateInDropDown(new GalleryToolItem.ItemLocationInfo(PopupGalleryTool.ActiveItem, PopupGalleryTool, PopupGalleryTool.GroupWithActiveItem, GalleryArea.DropDown), currentNavigationAction, wrapAround: true);
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (obj is GalleryToolItemGroupFilter)
			{
				PopupGalleryTool.IsFilterBarActive = true;
				return true;
			}
			if (obj is GalleryToolItem.ItemLocationInfo itemLocationInfo)
			{
				itemLocationInfo.Group.SetActiveItem(itemLocationInfo.Item, itemLocationInfo.GalleryInstance, itemLocationInfo.ItemLocation);
				itemLocationInfo.Item.BringIntoView(itemLocationInfo.GalleryInstance, itemLocationInfo.Group, itemLocationInfo.ItemLocation);
				((PopupGalleryGroupAreaUIElement)(object)((UIElement)PopupGalleryTool.DropDownItemAreaUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(PopupGalleryGroupAreaUIElement)))?.Update();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ActivateGallery()
		{
			MenuItemBase firstMenuItem = base.MenuItems.GetFirstMenuItem(selectableItemsOnly: false, recentlyUsedItemsOnly: false);
			if (firstMenuItem != null && base.ActiveMenuItem != firstMenuItem)
			{
				ActivateMenuItem(firstMenuItem);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	[ToolboxItem(false)]
	public class PopupGalleryControl : PopupMenuControl
	{
		private PopupGalleryControlUIElement mainElement;

		internal PopupGalleryControl(MenuAgentBase galleryAgent)
			: base(galleryAgent)
		{
		}

		internal new static PopupGalleryControl Create(MenuAgentBase menuAgent)
		{
			return Create(menuAgent, null);
		}

		internal new static PopupGalleryControl Create(MenuAgentBase menuAgent, UltraToolbarsDockArea dockArea)
		{
			try
			{
				UIPermission permission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
				ToolbarsManagerUtilities.VerifyPermission(permission);
				return CreatePopupGalleryControlFull(menuAgent);
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				return new PopupGalleryControl(menuAgent);
			}
		}

		private static PopupGalleryControl CreatePopupGalleryControlFull(MenuAgentBase menuAgent)
		{
			try
			{
				return new PopupGalleryControlTrusted(menuAgent);
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				return new PopupGalleryControl(menuAgent);
			}
		}

		protected internal override ControlUIElementBase GetControlUIElement()
		{
			if (mainElement == null)
			{
				mainElement = new PopupGalleryControlUIElement(this);
			}
			return (ControlUIElementBase)(object)mainElement;
		}
	}
	[ToolboxItem(false)]
	public class PopupGalleryControlTrusted : PopupGalleryControl
	{
		internal PopupGalleryControlTrusted(MenuAgentBase menuAgent)
			: base(menuAgent)
		{
		}

		[UIPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Window = UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows)]
		protected override bool ProcessDialogKey(Keys keyData)
		{
			Keys keys = keyData & ~(Keys.Shift | Keys.Control | Keys.Alt);
			switch (keys)
			{
			case Keys.Escape:
				if (base.MenuAgent.IsOpen)
				{
					return base.MenuAgent.ToolbarsManager.ProcessEscapeKey(passToPopupContainer: false);
				}
				break;
			case Keys.Return:
			case Keys.Left:
			case Keys.Up:
			case Keys.Right:
			case Keys.Down:
				return base.MenuAgent.ToolbarsManager.ProcessNavigationKey(keys, passToPopupContainer: false);
			}
			return ((Control)(object)this).ProcessDialogKey(keyData);
		}
	}
	public class PopupGalleryControlUIElement : PopupMenuControlUIElement
	{
		internal PopupGalleryControlUIElement(PopupControlBase popupControl)
			: base(popupControl)
		{
		}

		protected override void DrawChildElements(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0044: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			((UIElement)this).DrawChildElements(ref drawParams);
			if ((int)((UIElement)this).BorderStyle == 10)
			{

			if (PopupMenuTool.PopupStyleResolved == PopupStyle.Toolbar)
			{
				Size size = PopupMenuTool.PopupToolbar.GetMetrics(new Size(150, 0), Size.Empty).Size;
				UltraToolbarsDockArea ultraToolbarsDockArea = new UltraToolbarsDockArea(DockStyle.None);
				((Control)(object)ultraToolbarsDockArea).Size = size;
				ultraToolbarsDockArea.ToolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
				ultraToolbarsDockArea.AddToolbar(PopupMenuTool.PopupToolbar, 0, 0);
				((Control)(object)ultraToolbarsDockArea).Name = "DockArea";
				PopupMenuTool.PopupToolbar.InternalSetFloatingSize(size);
				popupMenuControl = PopupMenuControl.Create(this, ultraToolbarsDockArea);
				SetControlSizeForPopupStyleToolbar(popupMenuControl, ultraToolbarsDockArea);
				((Control)(object)popupMenuControl).Controls.Add((Control)(object)ultraToolbarsDockArea);
			}
			else
			{
				popupMenuControl = PopupMenuControl.Create(this);
				((Control)(object)popupMenuControl).Size = CalculateRequiredDropDownSize();
				SyncControlContainerHost((Control)(object)popupMenuControl);
			}
			return popupMenuControl;
		}

		protected internal override void OnPopupClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (PopupMenuTool != null && PopupMenuTool.HasPopupToolbar && base.PopupControl != null && ((Control)(object)base.PopupControl).Controls.Count > 0 && ((Control)(object)base.PopupControl).Controls[0] is UltraToolbarsDockArea ultraToolbarsDockArea)
			{
				ultraToolbarsDockArea.RemoveToolbar(PopupMenuTool.PopupToolbar);
			}
			foreach (MenuItemBase menuItem in base.MenuItems)
			{
				if (menuItem is ControlContainerToolMenuItem controlContainerToolMenuItem)
				{
					controlContainerToolMenuItem.ResetCache();
				}
				if (menuItem.Tool is ControlContainerTool controlContainerTool)
				{
					controlContainerTool.SetToolWithContainedControl(takeControlOwnership: false, null);
				}
			}
			if (base.IsOnBackStage && base.ActiveMenuItem != null && base.ToolbarsManager != null && !base.ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.ApplicationMenu2010.IsOpen)
			{
				base.ActiveMenuItem.Deactivate();
			}
			popupMenuTool.ControlContainerHost = null;
			base.ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.AfterToolCloseup, new ToolDropdownEventArgs(PopupMenuTool, base.SourceControl));
			base.OnPopupClosed(sender, e);
		}

		internal override void OnPopupWidthChanged(int newWidth)
		{
			base.OnPopupWidthChanged(newWidth - 2 * base.Metrics.PaddingAroundMenuitem);
		}

		protected internal override bool ProcessLeftArrowKey()
		{
			PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool = PopupMenuTool;
			if (popupMenuTool != null)
			{
				if (popupMenuTool.OwnerIsMenuInternal)
				{
					CloseDropDown(delay: false);
					PopupMenuTool owningMenuInternal = popupMenuTool.OwningMenuInternal;
					if (owningMenuInternal.IsOpen && owningMenuInternal.MenuAgent != null)
					{
						foreach (MenuItemBase menuItem in owningMenuInternal.MenuAgent.MenuItems)
						{
							if (menuItem.Tool == popupMenuTool && menuItem.CanActivate)
							{
								menuItem.Activate();
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					return true;
				}
				if (popupMenuTool.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)
				{
					CloseDropDown(delay: false);
					ApplicationMenu applicationMenu = popupMenuTool.OwningApplicationMenuArea.ApplicationMenu;
					if (applicationMenu.IsOpen)
					{
						applicationMenu.MenuAgent.GetMenuItemFromTool(popupMenuTool)?.Activate();
					}
					return true;
				}
			}
			return base.ProcessLeftArrowKey();
		}

		protected internal override void ResolveSideStripAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			base.ToolbarsManager.ResolveSideStripAppearance(PopupMenuTool, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		internal override bool ShowToolbarList(Point screenPt, ToolBase tool)
		{
			if (tool != null)
			{
				base.ToolbarsManager.ShowToolbarListPopup(screenPt, tool, (Control)(object)base.PopupControl);
				return true;
			}
			return base.ShowToolbarList(screenPt, tool);
		}

		protected internal override void ResolveIconAreaAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, bool isExpanded)
		{
			if (!base.ToolbarsManager.IsNonOffice2000Style)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (isExpanded)
			{
				if (popupMenuTool.Settings.HasIconAreaExpandedAppearance)
				{
					popupMenuTool.Settings.IconAreaExpandedAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
			}
			else if (popupMenuTool.Settings.HasIconAreaAppearance)
			{
				popupMenuTool.Settings.IconAreaAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			}
			base.ResolveIconAreaAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, isExpanded);
		}

		internal void RefreshContentsForPopupStyleToolbar()
		{
			if (PopupMenuTool.PopupStyleResolved == PopupStyle.Toolbar && IsOpen && base.PopupControl != null && ((Control)(object)base.PopupControl).Controls[0] is UltraToolbarsDockArea ultraToolbarsDockArea)
			{
				Size size = PopupMenuTool.PopupToolbar.GetMetrics(new Size(150, 0), Size.Empty).Size;
				PopupMenuTool.PopupToolbar.InternalSetFloatingSize(size);
				((Control)(object)ultraToolbarsDockArea).Size = size;
				size = SetControlSizeForPopupStyleToolbar(base.PopupControl, ultraToolbarsDockArea);
				ResizeDropDown(size);
				((UIElement)base.PopupControl.ControlElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
				((UIElement)ultraToolbarsDockArea.ControlElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
				((UltraControlBase)base.PopupControl).Update();
			}
		}

		internal void SyncControlContainerHost(Control menuControl)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (MenuItemBase menuItem in base.MenuItems)
			{
				if (menuItem is ControlContainerToolMenuItem)
				{
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				UltraToolbarsDockArea ultraToolbarsDockArea = new UltraToolbarsDockArea(DockStyle.Fill, isControlContainerHostForPopupMenu: true);
				((Control)(object)ultraToolbarsDockArea).Name = "DockArea";
				popupMenuTool.ControlContainerHost = ultraToolbarsDockArea;
				ultraToolbarsDockArea.ToolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
				ultraToolbarsDockArea.AddToolbar(new UltraToolbar(string.Empty, popupMenuTool, ToolbarType.ControlContainerHostForPopupMenu), 0, 0);
				((Control)(object)ultraToolbarsDockArea).Parent = menuControl;
			}
			else if (popupMenuTool.ControlContainerHost != null)
			{
				((Control)(object)popupMenuTool.ControlContainerHost).Parent = null;
				((Component)(object)popupMenuTool.ControlContainerHost).Dispose();
				popupMenuTool.ControlContainerHost = null;
			}
		}

		internal Size SetControlSizeForPopupStyleToolbar(PopupControlBase popupMenuControl, UltraToolbarsDockArea dockArea)
		{
			Size size = ((Control)(object)dockArea).Size;
			size.Height += 2 * base.ToolbarsManager.Metrics.MenuBorderThickness;
			size.Width += 2 * base.ToolbarsManager.Metrics.MenuBorderThickness;
			if (AllowTearaway)
			{
				int tearawayStripHeight = base.ToolbarsManager.Metrics.TearawayStripHeight;
				size.Height += tearawayStripHeight + base.ToolbarsManager.Metrics.PaddingAroundMenuitem;
				((Control)(object)popupMenuControl).Size = size;
				((Control)(object)dockArea).Location = new Point(base.ToolbarsManager.Metrics.MenuBorderThickness, tearawayStripHeight + base.ToolbarsManager.Metrics.PaddingAroundMenuitem + base.ToolbarsManager.Metrics.MenuBorderThickness);
			}
			else
			{
				((Control)(object)popupMenuControl).Size = size;
				((Control)(object)dockArea).Location = new Point(base.ToolbarsManager.Metrics.MenuBorderThickness, base.ToolbarsManager.Metrics.MenuBorderThickness);
			}
			return size;
		}
	}

	[ToolboxItem(false)]
	public class PopupMenuControl : PopupControlBase
	{
		private PopupMenuControlUIElement mainElement;

		protected internal override bool SupportsAnimation => true;

		internal PopupMenuControl(MenuAgentBase menuAgent)
			: base(menuAgent)
		{
		}

		internal static PopupMenuControl Create(MenuAgentBase menuAgent)
		{
			return Create(menuAgent, null);
		}

		internal static PopupMenuControl Create(MenuAgentBase menuAgent, UltraToolbarsDockArea dockArea)
		{
			try
			{
				UIPermission permission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
				ToolbarsManagerUtilities.VerifyPermission(permission);
				return CreatePopupMenuControlFull(menuAgent);
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				return new PopupMenuControl(menuAgent);
			}
		}

		private static PopupMenuControl CreatePopupMenuControlFull(MenuAgentBase menuAgent)
		{
			try
			{
				return new PopupMenuControlTrusted(menuAgent);
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				return new PopupMenuControl(menuAgent);
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			PopupToolBase popupTool = base.MenuAgent.PopupTool;
			if (popupTool != null && popupTool.HasPopupToolbar && this != null && ((Control)(object)this).Controls.Count > 0 && ((Control)(object)this).Controls[0] is UltraToolbarsDockArea ultraToolbarsDockArea)
			{
				ultraToolbarsDockArea.RemoveToolbar(popupTool.PopupToolbar);
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		[UIPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Window = UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows)]
		protected override bool ProcessMnemonic(char charCode)
		{
			if (base.ToolbarsManager != null && !base.ToolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				return base.ToolbarsManager.ProcessMnemonic(charCode);
			}
			return ((Control)(object)this).ProcessMnemonic(charCode);
		}

		protected internal override ControlUIElementBase GetControlUIElement()
		{
			if (mainElement == null)
			{
				mainElement = new PopupMenuControlUIElement(this);
			}
			return (ControlUIElementBase)(object)mainElement;
		}
	}
	public class PopupMenuControlTrusted : PopupMenuControl
	{
		internal PopupMenuControlTrusted(MenuAgentBase menuAgent)
			: base(menuAgent)
		{
		}

		[UIPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Window = UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows)]
		protected override bool ProcessDialogKey(Keys keyData)
		{
			Keys keys = keyData & ~(Keys.Shift | Keys.Control | Keys.Alt);
			switch (keys)
			{
			case Keys.Escape:
				if (base.MenuAgent.IsOpen)
				{
					return base.MenuAgent.ToolbarsManager.ProcessEscapeKey(passToPopupContainer: false);
				}
				break;
			case Keys.Return:
			case Keys.Left:
			case Keys.Up:
			case Keys.Right:
			case Keys.Down:
				return base.MenuAgent.ToolbarsManager.ProcessNavigationKey(keys, passToPopupContainer: false);
			}
			return ((Control)(object)this).ProcessDialogKey(keyData);
		}
	}

				{
				case 0:
				case 2:
				case 3:
				case 4:
					DrawBorderAroundImage(ref drawParams);
					break;
				case 1:
					break;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e, bool adjustableArea, ref UIElement captureMouseForElement)
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			toolbarsManager.LeftButtonDownOnMenuItem = (e.Button & MouseButtons.Left) == MouseButtons.Left;
			mouseDownSinceLastClick = true;
			if (toolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				return true;
			}
			MenuAgentBase menuAgent = MenuAgent;
			if (toolbarsManager.ToolBeingEdited != null && toolbarsManager.ToolBeingEdited != MenuItem.Tool && ((toolbarsManager.ToolBeingEdited.OwnerIsMenuInternal && toolbarsManager.ToolBeingEdited.OwningMenuInternal == menuAgent.PopupTool) || (toolbarsManager.ToolBeingEdited.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea && toolbarsManager.ToolBeingEdited.OwningApplicationMenuArea.ApplicationMenu.MenuAgent == menuAgent) || (toolbarsManager.ToolBeingEdited.IsOnBackStage && IsOnBackStage)))
			{
				toolbarsManager.ForceExitEditMode();
				if (!MenuItem.IsActive)
				{
					MenuItem.Activate();
					PopupControlBase popupControl = PopupControl;
					if (popupControl != null && popupControl.ControlElement != null)
					{
						((UIElement)popupControl.ControlElement).DirtyChildElements();
					}
				}
			}
			bool result = ((UIElement)this).OnMouseDown(e, adjustableArea, ref captureMouseForElement);
			if (e.Button == MouseButtons.Left && MenuItem.IsPopup)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				if (IsSegmentedPopupTool)
				{
					Rectangle arrowElementRect = GetArrowElementRect();
					if (!arrowElementRect.IsEmpty && !arrowElementRect.Contains(e.X, e.Y))
					{
						flag = false;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					if (!MenuItem.IsActive)
					{
						MenuItem.Activate();
					}
					if (MenuItem.IsActive && !IsOnBackStage)
					{
						toolbarsManager.DropdownCloseupManager.ClearPendingRequests();
						menuAgent.CancelPendingSubmenuDropDowns();
						menuAgent.CancelPendingFullMenuDisplay();
						DropdownPopupItem(delay: false, closeIfAlreadyOpen: false);
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				return;
			}
			((UIElement)this).OnMouseEnter();
			if (MenuItem != null && MenuItem.CanDisplayToolTip)
			{
				MenuItem.DisplayToolTip();
			}
			MenuAgentBase menuAgent = MenuAgent;
			if ((toolbarsManager.ToolBeingEdited != null && toolbarsManager.ToolBeingEdited.OwnerIsMenuInternal && toolbarsManager.ToolBeingEdited.OwningMenuInternal == menuAgent.PopupTool) || (toolbarsManager.ToolBeingEdited != null && toolbarsManager.ToolBeingEdited.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea && toolbarsManager.ToolBeingEdited.OwningApplicationMenuArea.ApplicationMenu.MenuAgent == menuAgent) || (toolbarsManager.ToolBeingEdited != null && toolbarsManager.ToolBeingEdited.IsOnBackStage && IsOnBackStage))
			{
				return;
			}
			MenuItem.Activate();
			if (!MenuItem.IsActive)
			{
				return;
			}
			((UIElement)this).DirtyChildElements();
			((UIElement)this).Parent.Invalidate();
			if (IsOnBackStage)
			{
				return;
			}
			menuAgent.CloseOpenSubmenuTools(MenuItem, delay: true);
			menuAgent.CancelPendingSubmenuDropDowns();
			toolbarsManager.DropdownCloseupManager.CancelPendingCloseup(menuAgent);
			if (menuAgent.PopupTool != null && menuAgent.PopupTool.OwnerIsMenuInternal)
			{
				menuAgent.PopupTool.OwningMenuInternal.MenuAgent.CancelPendingSubmenuDropDowns();
			}
			else if (menuAgent.PopupTool != null && menuAgent.PopupTool.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)
			{
				menuAgent.PopupTool.OwningApplicationMenuArea.ApplicationMenu.MenuAgent.CancelPendingSubmenuDropDowns();
			}
			if (!menuAgent.IsShowFullMenuTimerExpired)
			{
				menuAgent.CancelPendingFullMenuDisplay();
				menuAgent.ShowFullMenu(menuAgent.ShowFullMenuDelayLong);
			}
			if (MenuItem.Enabled && MenuItem.IsPopup)
			{
				if (MenuItem.Tool.PopupTool.IsMenuAgentCreated)
				{
					toolbarsManager.DropdownCloseupManager.CancelPendingCloseup(MenuItem.Tool.PopupTool.MenuAgent);
				}
				menuAgent.CancelPendingFullMenuDisplay();
				DropdownPopupItem(delay: true, closeIfAlreadyOpen: false);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseHover()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager != null && MenuItem != null && MenuItem.CanDisplayToolTip)
			{
				toolbarsManager.ImmediateToolTipDisplayMode = true;
				ToolBase tool = MenuItem.Tool;
				bool flag = false;
				if (tool != null)
				{
					flag = tool.OwnerIsApplicationMenu2010ContentArea;
				}
				if (toolbarsManager.ActiveTool == null || flag)
				{
					MenuItem.DisplayToolTip();
				}
			}
			((UIElement)this).OnMouseHover();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager != null && !toolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				((UIElement)this).OnMouseLeave();
				if (MenuItem != null)
				{
					MenuItem.HideToolTip();
				}
				toolbarsManager.ImmediateToolTipDisplayMode = false;
				if (MenuAgent.IsOpen)
				{
					MenuItem.Deactivate();
					((UIElement)this).DirtyChildElements();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseUp(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!((UIElement)this).Rect.Contains(new Point(e.X, e.Y)))
			{
				return ((UIElement)this).OnMouseUp(e);
			}
			return DoClickProcessing(e);
		}

		public override bool PointInAdjustableArea(Point point)
		{
			if (MenuItem.Tool != null && MenuItem.Tool.CanSetToolWidth && MenuItem.IsBeingCustomized)
			{
				return UltraToolbarsManager.PointInToolResizeArea(ToolResizeEdges.Left | ToolResizeEdges.Right, ((UIElement)this).Rect, point);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void DrawFocus(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			if (ShouldDrawFocus())
			{
				Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)this).Rect;
				rect.Y++;
				rect.Height--;
				((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).DrawFocusRectangle(rect);
			}
			else
			{
				((UIElement)this).DrawFocus(ref drawParams);
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldDrawFocus()
		{
			MenuItemBase menuItem = MenuItem;
			PopupToolBase popupToolBase = ((menuItem != null) ? (menuItem.Tool as PopupToolBase) : null);
			if (popupToolBase != null)
			{
				BackStageMenuAgent.KeyboardNavigationManager keyboardNavigationManager = ((PopupControl.MenuAgent is BackStageMenuAgent { HasKeyNavigationManager: not false } backStageMenuAgent) ? backStageMenuAgent.KeyNavigationManager : null);
				if (keyboardNavigationManager != null && keyboardNavigationManager.ShouldDrawFocused(popupToolBase))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

				DropdownPopupItem(delay, closeIfAlreadyOpen: true);
			}
		}

		internal Rectangle GetImageRect()
		{
			bool hasImage;

		internal Rectangle GetImageRect(out bool hasImage)
		{
			//IL_00d9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			hasImage = false;
			MenuAgentBase menuAgent = MenuAgent;
			if (menuAgent == null || MenuItem == null || MenuItem.MenuAgent != menuAgent)
			{
				return Rectangle.Empty;
			}
			Rectangle imageRect = MenuItem.GetImageRect((UIElement)(object)this);
			if (!IsLabelHeader)
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
				if (menuAgent.ShouldShowAddRemoveCheckColumn(MenuItem))
				{
					int num = toolbarsManager.CheckMarkElementSize.Width + 1;
					if (toolbarsManager.IsNonOffice2000Style)
					{
						num++;
					}
					imageRect.X += num;
					imageRect.Width -= num;
				}
				if (MenuItem.DrawStateUsingCheckmark && (toolbarsManager.IsNonOffice2000Style || MenuItem.DrawAsPressed))
				{
					hasImage = true;
					return imageRect;
				}
				if (menuAgent.ShouldShowImages(MenuItem) && MenuItem.DisplayImage)
				{
					AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
					AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)448;
					MenuItem.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, MenuItem.DrawAsActive);
					if (((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).Image != null)
					{
						Image image = ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).GetImage(MenuItem.ImageList);
						if (image != null && toolbarsManager.IsNonOffice2000Style && MenuItem.DrawAsPressed && !menuAgent.ShouldShowAddRemoveCheckColumn(MenuItem))
						{
							imageRect.Inflate(1, 1);
						}
						if (image != null)
						{
							hasImage = true;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return imageRect;
		}

		private bool IsAdjacentToolRecentlyUsed(bool searchBackwards)
		{
			int index = MenuItem.Index;
			if (index == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			MenuItemsCollection parentCollection = MenuItem.ParentCollection;
			if (parentCollection == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (searchBackwards)
			{
				if (index > 0)
				{
					return parentCollection[index - 1].RecentlyUsed;
				}
			}
			else if (index < parentCollection.Count - 1)
			{
				return parentCollection[index + 1].RecentlyUsed;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool DoClickProcessing(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			bool result = false;
			DateTime now = DateTime.Now;
			DateTime value = lastClickProcessedTime;
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (!toolbarsManager.LeftButtonDownOnMenuItem)
			{
				return result;
			}
			toolbarsManager.LeftButtonDownOnMenuItem = false;
			try
			{
				if (!mouseDownSinceLastClick && now.Subtract(value).TotalMilliseconds < (double)SystemInformation.DoubleClickTime)
				{
					return result;
				}
				if (toolbarsManager.Customizing)
				{
					return result;
				}
				if (!MenuItem.Enabled)
				{
					return result;
				}
				if (MenuItem.Editor != null)
				{
					if (MenuItem.Tool != null)
					{
						MenuItem.Tool.EnterEditMode(EnterEditModeSource.ClickOnLabel, throwExceptions: false, ensureToolIsActive: true);
					}
					else
					{
						MenuItem.IsInEditMode = true;
					}
					if (MenuItem.IsInEditMode && MenuItem.Editor.CanFocus)
					{
						MenuItem.Editor.Focus();
					}
					return result;
				}
				if (e != null)
				{
					result = ((UIElement)this).OnMouseUp(e);
				}
				else
				{
					((UIElement)this).OnClick();
				}
				MenuItem.IncrementClickCount();
				if (!MenuItem.IsActive)
				{
					MenuItem.Activate();
				}
				if (MenuItem.IsActive)
				{
					bool flag = !MenuItem.IsPopup;
					bool flag2 = false;
					if (IsSegmentedPopupTool)
					{
						if (e != null && GetArrowElementRect().Contains(e.X, e.Y))
						{
							flag2 = true;
						}
						else
						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					if (MenuItem is AddRemoveToolMenuItem)
					{
						((UIElement)this).DirtyChildElements(true);
					}
					else if (flag)
					{
						if (MenuItem.CloseAllMenusWhenClicked)
						{
							ToolBase tool = MenuItem.Tool;
							if (tool == null || tool.ClosesApplicationMenuOnToolClick)
							{
								toolbarsManager.PopupManager.CloseAllPopups(onlyCloseLeafContiguousPopupChain: true);
							}
							toolbarsManager.ExitHotkeyMode();
							if (toolbarsManager.HasMiniToolbar && toolbarsManager.MiniToolbar.Window != null)
							{
								ToolBase tool2 = MenuItem.Tool;

		private Point GetMenuDropDownPoint()
		{

			if (MenuItem.Tool != null && MenuItem.Tool.OwningApplicationMenuArea is ApplicationMenuLeftArea)
			{

				}

				{

				}

					{

					}
				}

				int num = result.Y + size.Height - leftAreaOwnedMenuDropDownRect.Bottom;
				if (0 < num)

		}

		}

			return ((UIElement)this).OnMouseDown(e, adjustableArea, ref captureMouseForElement);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ToolbarsManager.IsTearawayBeingDragged(MenuAgent.TearawayTool))
			{
				if ((object)PopupControl.ControlElement.ElementWithMouseCapture == this)
				{
					ToolbarsManager.OnDragTearawayMove();
				}
				else
				{
					ToolbarsManager.OnDragTearawayEnd();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				DisplayToolTip();
				((UIElement)this).OnMouseMove(e);
			}
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseUp(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager != null && ToolbarsManager.IsTearawayBeingDragged(MenuAgent.TearawayTool))
			{
				ToolbarsManager.OnDragTearawayEnd();
			}
			return ((UIElement)this).OnMouseUp(e);
		}

		protected internal virtual ImageUIElementBase GetImageElement(UIElementsCollection oldElements, Rectangle rectParent)
		{
			return null;
		}

		private void DrawForegroundOfficeXP(UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)this).Rect;
			int num = 32;
			if (num > rect.Width)
			{
				num = rect.Width / 2;
			}
			int num2 = rect.X + (rect.Width - num) / 2;
			int num3 = 0;
			Pen pen = null;
			int num4 = 0;
			if (DrawAsActive)
			{
				pen = ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).GetPen((PenType)0, SystemColors.ControlText);
				num3 = rect.Y + 2;
				num4 = rect.Bottom - 2;
			}
			else
			{
				pen = ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).GetPen((PenType)10, SystemColors.ControlDark);
				num3 = rect.Y;
				num4 = rect.Bottom - 2;
			}
			for (; num3 < num4; num3 += 2)
			{
				((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(pen, new Point(num2, num3), new Point(num2 + num, num3));
			}
		}

		private void DrawForegroundOffice2003(UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)this).Rect;
			Brush brush = ((ToolbarsManager.MSColors == null) ? Utilities.CreateSolidBrush(((MicrosoftColorTable)Office2003ColorTable.Colors).GrabHandleDarkSquare) : Utilities.CreateSolidBrush(ToolbarsManager.MSColors.GrabHandleDarkSquare));
			Brush white = Brushes.White;
			int num = 72;
			if (num > rect.Width)
			{
				num = rect.Width / 2;
			}
			int num2 = rect.X + (rect.Width - num) / 2;
			int num3 = rect.Y + (rect.Height - 2) / 2;
			int num4 = (num + 1) / 4;
			for (int i = 0; i < num4; i++)
			{
				((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.FillRectangle(white, num2 + 1, num3 + 1, 2, 2);
				((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.FillRectangle(brush, num2, num3, 2, 2);
				num2 += 4;
			}
			brush.Dispose();
		}

		private void DisplayToolTip()
		{
			if (!toolTipDisplayed && ToolbarsManager.ImmediateToolTipDisplayMode)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.DisplayToolTip(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("TearawayToolTip"));
				toolTipDisplayed = true;
			}
		}

		private void HideToolTip()
		{
			if (toolTipDisplayed)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.HideToolTip();
				toolTipDisplayed = false;
			}
			ToolbarsManager.ImmediateToolTipDisplayMode = false;
		}

		{
		}

		public class PopupMenuToolConverter : ExpandableObjectConverter
		{
			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(PopupMenuTool).GetConstructor(new Type[1] { typeof(string) });
					PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool = (PopupMenuTool)value;
					return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[1] { popupMenuTool.Key }, isComplete: false);
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		{
			private PopupMenuTool owningTool;

			internal MenuSettings settings;

			private MenuSettingsResolved settingsResolved;

			internal MenuSettings Settings
			{
				get
				{
					if (settings == null)
					{
						settings = new MenuSettings(owningTool);
						settings.SubObjectPropChanged += owningTool.GetSubObjectPropChangeHandler();
					}
					return settings;
				}
			}

			internal bool HasSettings => settings != null;

			internal MenuSettingsResolved SettingsResolved
			{
				get
				{
					if (settingsResolved == null)
					{
						settingsResolved = new MenuSettingsResolved(owningTool);
					}
					return settingsResolved;
				}
			}

			internal PopupMenuToolExtraSharedProps(PopupMenuTool owningTool)
			{
				this.owningTool = owningTool;
			}

			internal void VerifyOwnerIsRootTool()
			{
				if (owningTool != null && !owningTool.IsRootTool)
				{
					if (settingsResolved != null && settingsResolved.OwningTool != owningTool)
					{
						settingsResolved.InitializeOwningTool(owningTool);
					}
					if (settings != null && settings.Owner != owningTool)
					{
						settings.Initialize(owningTool);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsMdiChildMenu
		{
			get
			{
				if ((base.MdiMergeState & MdiMergeState.CreatedInstanceAndRootToHostChildMenu) == MdiMergeState.CreatedInstanceAndRootToHostChildMenu)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return IsReplacedByMdiChildMenu;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value)
				{
					base.MdiMergeState |= MdiMergeState.CreatedInstanceAndRootToHostChildMenu;
				}
				else
				{
					base.MdiMergeState &= ~MdiMergeState.CreatedInstanceAndRootToHostChildMenu;
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsReplacedByMdiChildMenu
		{
			get
			{
				MdiMergeState mdiMergeState = base.MdiMergeState;
				if (!base.IsRootTool)
				{
					ToolBase rootTool = base.SharedProps.RootTool;
					if (rootTool != null)
					{
						mdiMergeState = rootTool.MdiMergeState;
					}
				}
				return (mdiMergeState & MdiMergeState.ExistingParentReplacedByMdiChildMenu) == MdiMergeState.ExistingParentReplacedByMdiChildMenu;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value)
				{
					base.MdiMergeState |= MdiMergeState.ExistingParentReplacedByMdiChildMenu;
				}
				else
				{
					base.MdiMergeState &= ~MdiMergeState.ExistingParentReplacedByMdiChildMenu;
				}
			}
		}

		private PopupMenuToolExtraSharedProps ExtraSharedProps
		{

				if (popupMenuToolExtraSharedProps == null)

					popupMenuToolExtraSharedProps = ((base.SharedProps.RootTool == null) ? new PopupMenuToolExtraSharedProps(this) : new PopupMenuToolExtraSharedProps(base.SharedProps.RootTool as PopupMenuTool));

		public PopupMenuTool(string key)
			: base(key)
		{
		}

		protected PopupMenuTool(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "IsMdiChildMenu":
				{
					bool flag = (base.MdiMergeState & MdiMergeState.CreatedInstanceAndRootToHostChildMenu) == MdiMergeState.CreatedInstanceAndRootToHostChildMenu;
					IsMdiChildMenu = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), flag);
					break;
				}
				case "Settings":
					serializedSettings = (MenuSettings)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(MenuSettings), null);
					break;
				case "Tools":
					tools = (ToolsCollection)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ToolsCollection), null);
					HookupDeserializedToolsInstance();
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			GetObjectData(info, context);
		}

		protected internal bool ShouldSerializeSettings()
		{
			if (this is TaskPaneToolbarMenuTool)
			{
				if (ExtraSharedProps.HasSettings)
				{
					return ExtraSharedProps.Settings.ShouldSerialize();
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (base.IsRootTool && ExtraSharedProps.HasSettings)
			{
				return ExtraSharedProps.Settings.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetSettings()
		{
			if (ExtraSharedProps.HasSettings)
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.Settings.Reset();
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeTools()
		{
			bool isRootTool = base.IsRootTool;
			if (isRootTool && tools != null && (tools.Count > 0 || tools.HasUncustomizedTools) && (!IsMdiChildMenu || tools.HasCustomizations))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!isRootTool && tools != null && tools.Count > 0 && !IsMdiChildMenu)
			{
				return IsTearawayToolbarAncestor();
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetTools()
		{
			Tools.Clear();
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			base.Reset();
			ResetSettings();
			ResetTools();
		}

		internal void BringIntoView(ToolBase tool)
		{
			if (!base.IsOpen)
			{
				DropDown();
				if (!base.IsOpen)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			MenuItemBase menuItemFromTool = base.MenuAgent.GetMenuItemFromTool(tool);
			if (menuItemFromTool != null && menuItemFromTool != base.MenuAgent.ActiveMenuItem)
			{
				base.MenuAgent.ActivateMenuItem(menuItemFromTool);
			}
		}

		internal void ResetDropDownVersion()
		{
			dropDownToolsVersion = -1;
		}

		internal void InitializeTools(ToolsCollectionBase parentCollection)
		{
			if (tools != null && !initialized)
			{
				initialized = true;
				tools.Initialize(this);
				tools.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				tools.BumpVersion();
			}
			if (tools != null && (base.MdiMergeState & MdiMergeState.CreatedInstanceAndRootToHostChildMenu) == MdiMergeState.CreatedInstanceAndRootToHostChildMenu)
			{
				Tools.BumpVersion();
			}
		}

		internal void InternalSetTools(ToolsCollection tools)
		{
			if (this.tools != null)
			{
				this.tools.SubObjectPropChanged -= GetSubObjectPropChangeHandler();
			}
			this.tools = tools;
			this.tools.SubObjectPropChanged += GetSubObjectPropChangeHandler();
		}

		internal void InternalSetMenuSettings(MenuSettings settings, bool initializeOwner)
		{
			if (ExtraSharedProps.settings != null)
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.settings.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			ExtraSharedProps.settings = settings;
			if (initializeOwner)
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.settings.Initialize(this);
				ExtraSharedProps.settings.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsAnyOtherToolOnMenuActive(ToolBase excludeTool)
		{
			foreach (ToolBase tool in Tools)
			{
				if (tool.Equals(excludeTool))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (tool is PopupMenuTool)
				{
					if (((PopupMenuTool)tool).GetDrawAsActiveHelper(checkOtherTools: false))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				else if (tool.DrawAsActive)
				{
					MenuItemBase menuItemFromTool = base.MenuAgent.GetMenuItemFromTool(tool);
					if (menuItemFromTool == null || menuItemFromTool.IsActive)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void HookupToolsSharedProps()
		{
			Tools.CacheUnCustomizedToolInfoOnTools();
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Tools.Count; i++)
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = Tools[i];
				ToolBase rootTool = toolbarsManager.GetRootTool(toolBase);
				if (rootTool != null)
				{
					toolBase.InternalSetSharedProps(rootTool.SharedProps);
					if (base.IsRootTool || !(base.SharedProps.RootTool is PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool))
					{
						continue;
					}
					ToolBase toolBase2 = popupMenuTool.Tools[i];
					if (toolBase2.SharedProps == toolBase.SharedProps && toolBase2.InstanceProps != toolBase.InstanceProps)
					{
						if (toolBase.InstanceProps != null && toolBase.InstanceProps.ShouldSerialize() && !toolBase2.InstanceProps.ShouldSerialize())
						{
							toolBase2.InternalSetInstanceProps(toolBase.InstanceProps);
						}
						else
						{
							toolBase.InternalSetInstanceProps(toolBase2.InstanceProps);
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Tools.RemoveAt(i);
					i--;
				}
			}
			Tools.BumpVersion();
		}

		internal void HookupDeserializedToolsInstance()
		{
			if (base.IsRootTool || tools == null || tools.Owner != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			tools.Initialize(this);
			foreach (ToolBase tool in tools)
			{
				if (tool is PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool)
				{
					popupMenuTool.HookupDeserializedToolsInstance();
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void OnBeforeSetUnderlyingTool(ToolBase underlyingTool)
		{
			base.OnBeforeSetUnderlyingTool(underlyingTool);
			if (underlyingTool != null)
			{
				if (originalInstanceProps == null && base.HasInstanceProps)
				{
					originalInstanceProps = base.InstanceProps;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				InternalSetInstanceProps(originalInstanceProps);
				originalInstanceProps = null;
			}
		}

		internal void RefreshDropDownIfToolsWereChanged()
		{
			int count = Tools.Count;
			if (dropDownToolsVersion != Tools.Version)
			{
				RefreshDropDownContents();
			}
		}

		internal void VerifySettingsToolOwner()
		{
			if (GetExtraSharedProps(base.ExtraSharedPropsCount) != null)
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.VerifyOwnerIsRootTool();
			}
		}

			return true;
		}

				AddMenuItemsToAgent(popupMenuAgent);
			}

		}

			ToolbarsManagerUtilities.PopulateMenuItemsCollection(menuAgent.MenuItems, Tools, oldMenuItems);
		}

		private void AddMenuItemsToAgent(MenuAgentBase menuAgent)
		{
			AddMenuItemsToAgent(menuAgent, null);
		}

		private void AddMenuItemsToAgent(MenuAgentBase menuAgent, MenuItemBase[] oldMenuItems)
		{
			if (menuAgent != null && PopupStyleResolved == PopupStyle.Menu)
			{
				OnPopulate();
				menuAgent.MenuItems.Clear();
				PopulateMenuItems(menuAgent, oldMenuItems);
				dropDownToolsVersion = Tools.Version;
			}
		}

		internal bool GetDrawAsActiveHelper(bool checkOtherTools)
		{
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (!base.EnabledResolved)
			{
				return false;
			}
			object ownerInternal = base.OwnerInternal;
			UltraToolbarBase ultraToolbarBase = ownerInternal as UltraToolbarBase;
			if (base.IsOpen && ultraToolbarBase != null && (int)ButtonStyle != 19)
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			if (ultraToolbarBase != null && toolbarsManager != null && ultraToolbarBase.AutoDropDownMode && !toolbarsManager.AllowToolbarCaptureRelease)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.ForceDrawAsActive)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (base.IsActiveTool)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ownerInternal is PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool && base.IsOpen)
			{
				if (checkOtherTools && popupMenuTool.IsAnyOtherToolOnMenuActive(this))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			ApplicationMenuArea owningApplicationMenuArea = base.OwningApplicationMenuArea;
			if (owningApplicationMenuArea != null && base.IsOpen)
			{
				if (checkOtherTools && owningApplicationMenuArea.ApplicationMenu.IsAnyOtherToolOnMenuActive(this))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void DirtyMenuInfoListPreferredSize()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null || !toolbarsManager.HasRibbon)
			{
				return;
			}
			Ribbon ribbon = toolbarsManager.Ribbon;
			ApplicationMenu2010 applicationMenu = (ribbon.HasApplicationMenu2010 ? ribbon.ApplicationMenu2010 : null);
			if (applicationMenu == null || !applicationMenu.IsOpen)
			{
				return;
			}
			BackStageManager backStageManager = applicationMenu.BackStageManager;
			List<BackStageManager.MenuInfo> menuInfoList = backStageManager.MenuInfoList;
			if (menuInfoList == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (BackStageManager.MenuInfo menuInfo in backStageManager.MenuInfoList)
			{
				menuInfo.DirtyPreferredSize();
			}
		}

		protected internal override ToolBase Clone(bool cloneNewInstance)
		{
			PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool = new PopupMenuTool(Key);
			popupMenuTool.InitializeFrom(this, cloneNewInstance);
			return popupMenuTool;
		}

		[StrongNameIdentityPermission(SecurityAction.InheritanceDemand, PublicKey = "")]
		internal override MenuAgentBase CreateMenuAgent()
		{
			PopupMenuAgent result = new PopupMenuAgent(this);
			InitializeMenuAgent(result);
			return result;
		}

		internal override ToolBase CreateMergeToolHelper(UltraToolbarsManager parentManager, bool createRootTool)
		{
			PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool = CreateMenuForMdiMerge();
			if (createRootTool)
			{
				popupMenuTool.IsMdiChildMenu = true;
			}
			else
			{
				if (base.HasInstanceProps)
				{
					popupMenuTool.InstanceProps.InitializeFrom(base.InstanceProps);
				}
				PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool2 = null;
				if (base.SharedProps.MergeType == MenuMergeType.Add)
				{
					popupMenuTool.IsMdiChildMenu = true;
					popupMenuTool2 = parentManager.GetRootTool(popupMenuTool) as PopupMenuTool;
				}
				else
				{
					popupMenuTool2 = parentManager.GetRootTool(popupMenuTool) as PopupMenuTool;
					if (popupMenuTool2 == null)
					{
						popupMenuTool.IsMdiChildMenu = true;
						popupMenuTool2 = parentManager.GetRootTool(popupMenuTool) as PopupMenuTool;
					}
				}
				if (popupMenuTool2 != null)
				{
					popupMenuTool.InternalSetSharedProps(popupMenuTool2.SharedProps);
					popupMenuTool.IsMdiChildMenu = popupMenuTool2.IsMdiChildMenu;
				}
				else
				{
					popupMenuTool.IsMdiChildMenu = true;
				}
			}
			return popupMenuTool;
		}

		protected internal override AccessibleObject GetAccessibleChild(int index)
		{
			if (index >= 0 && index < Tools.Count)
			{
				return Tools[index].AccessibilityObject;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal override IKeyTipProvider[] GetKeyTipsInDropDown()
		{
			if (!base.IsOpen)
			{
				return Tools.GetKeyTipProviders();
			}
			List<IKeyTipProvider> list = new List<IKeyTipProvider>();
			foreach (MenuItemBase menuItem in base.MenuAgent.MenuItems)
			{
				list.AddRange(menuItem.GetKeyTipProviders());
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		protected override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
			if (ShouldSerializeSettings())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Settings", Settings);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeTools())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Tools", tools);
			}
			bool flag = (base.MdiMergeState & MdiMergeState.CreatedInstanceAndRootToHostChildMenu) == MdiMergeState.CreatedInstanceAndRootToHostChildMenu;
			if (flag)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "IsMdiChildMenu", flag);
			}
		}

		internal override ToolsCollectionBase GetTools()
		{
			return Tools;
		}

		protected internal override void Initialize(ToolsCollectionBase parentCollection)
		{
			base.Initialize(parentCollection);
			if (serializedSettings != null)
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.settings = serializedSettings;
				ExtraSharedProps.settings.Initialize(this);
				ExtraSharedProps.settings.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				serializedSettings = null;
			}
		}

		protected internal override void InitializeFrom(ToolBase sourceTool, bool cloneNewInstance)
		{
			PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool = sourceTool as PopupMenuTool;
			if (popupMenuTool != null)
			{
				IsMdiChildMenu = (popupMenuTool.MdiMergeState & MdiMergeState.CreatedInstanceAndRootToHostChildMenu) == MdiMergeState.CreatedInstanceAndRootToHostChildMenu;
			}
			base.InitializeFrom(sourceTool, cloneNewInstance);
			if (!cloneNewInstance && popupMenuTool != null)
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.settings = (MenuSettings)popupMenuTool.ExtraSharedProps.Settings.Clone(this);
				PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool2 = sourceTool as PopupMenuTool;
				for (int i = 0; i < popupMenuTool2.Tools.Count; i++)
				{
					Tools.Add(popupMenuTool2.Tools[i].Clone(cloneNewInstance: true));
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void MergeWithChildRootTool(MenuMergeType mergeType, ToolBase childRootTool, out bool isMergeToolRequired)
		{
			if (mergeType == MenuMergeType.Replace)
			{
				IsHiddenByMdiMerge = false;
				IsReplacedByMdiChildMenu = true;
				InternalSetUnderlyingTool(childRootTool);
				isMergeToolRequired = false;
			}
			else
			{
				base.MergeWithChildRootTool(mergeType, childRootTool, out isMergeToolRequired);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (tools != null)
			{
				tools.SubObjectPropChanged -= GetSubObjectPropChangeHandler();
				tools.Dispose();
				tools = null;
			}
			originalInstanceProps = null;
			controlContainerHost = null;
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			DirtyMenuInfoListPreferredSize();
			if (propChange.Source is MenuSettings && propChange.Source == ExtraSharedProps.Settings)
			{
				PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo = propChange.FindPropId(PropertyIds.PopupStyle);
				if (propChangeInfo != null)
				{
					foreach (ToolBase toolInstance in base.SharedProps.ToolInstances)
					{
						if (toolInstance is PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool)
						{
							popupMenuTool.CloseDropDown();
						}
					}
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.MenuSettings, propChange);
			}
			else if (propChange.Source == tools)
			{
				if (base.IsRootTool)
				{
					tools.BumpVersion();
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Tools, propChange);
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnSubObjectPropChanged(propChange);
			}
		}

		internal override void OnToolbarsManagerInitialized()
		{
			HookupToolsSharedProps();
			base.OnToolbarsManagerInitialized();
		}

		protected internal override void RefreshDropDownContents()
		{
			try
			{
				if (PopupStyleResolved == PopupStyle.Menu)
				{
					MenuItemBase activeMenuItem = base.MenuAgent.ActiveMenuItem;
					object context = ((activeMenuItem != null) ? activeMenuItem : base.MenuAgent.DefaultContext);
					MenuItemBase[] oldMenuItems = ((!base.MenuAgent.HasMenuItems(context)) ? null : ((MenuItemBase[])base.MenuAgent.MenuItems.All));
					base.MenuAgent.ReInitialize();
					AddMenuItemsToAgent(base.MenuAgent, oldMenuItems);
					if (!base.IsOpen)
					{
						return;
					}
					if (activeMenuItem != null && base.MenuAgent.ActiveMenuItem == null)
					{
						foreach (MenuItemBase menuItem in base.MenuAgent.MenuItems)
						{
							if (menuItem.IsSameMenuItem(activeMenuItem))
							{
								menuItem.Activate();
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					if (base.MenuAgent is PopupMenuAgent popupMenuAgent)
					{
						popupMenuAgent.SyncControlContainerHost((Control)(object)base.MenuAgent.PopupControl);
					}
					base.MenuAgent.RecalculateDropdownSize();
					if (base.IsOnBackStage)
					{
						base.MenuAgent.ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.ApplicationMenu2010.DirtyUIElement();
						return;
					}
					((UIElement)base.MenuAgent.PopupControl.ControlElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
					((UltraControlBase)base.MenuAgent.PopupControl).Update();
				}
				else if (base.IsOpen && base.MenuAgent is PopupMenuAgent popupMenuAgent2)
				{
					base.MenuAgent.ReInitialize();
					popupMenuAgent2.RefreshContentsForPopupStyleToolbar();
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		internal override void ResetParentMergeState()
		{
			IsReplacedByMdiChildMenu = false;
			InternalSetUnderlyingTool(null);
			base.ResetParentMergeState();
		}

		internal override bool OnKeyTipActivate()
		{
			ToolBase toolBeingDisplayed = base.ToolBeingDisplayed;
			KeyTipManager keyTipManager = toolBeingDisplayed.ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.KeyTipManager;
			bool flag = keyTipManager.ProviderPendingActivation == toolBeingDisplayed;
			if (toolBeingDisplayed.OwnerIsToolbarInternal && toolBeingDisplayed.BumpedFromToolbar && toolBeingDisplayed.OwningToolbarInternal.QuickCustomizeTool != null)
			{
				keyTipManager.ActivateKeyTipProvider(toolBeingDisplayed.OwningToolbarInternal.QuickCustomizeTool);
			}
			if (flag && keyTipManager.ProviderPendingActivation != toolBeingDisplayed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return base.OnKeyTipActivate();
		}

		internal override void ResolveAppearancePhaseDefaults(ref ResolveAppearancePhaseInfo phaseInfo, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)base.ToolbarsManagerInControl.StyleResolved == 5)
			{
				switch (phaseInfo.Phase)
				{
				case AppearanceResolutionPhase.HotTrack:
					if (((ulong)requestedProps & 1uL) != 0L)
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = Office2007ColorTable.Colors.PopupRibbonGroupButtonHotTrackedGradientLight;
						requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEuL);
					}
					if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x4000000uL) != 0L)
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor2 = Office2007ColorTable.Colors.PopupRibbonGroupButtonHotTrackedGradientDark;
						requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFBFFFFFFuL);
					}
					if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x10000000uL) != 0L)
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackGradientStyle = (GradientStyle)5;
						requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFEFFFFFFFuL);
					}
					if (((ulong)requestedProps & 4uL) != 0L)
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor = Office2007ColorTable.Colors.PopupRibbonGroupButtonHotTrackedBorderColor;
						requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFBuL);
					}
					if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x1000000000uL) != 0L)
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor2 = Office2007ColorTable.Colors.PopupRibbonGroupButtonHotTrackedBorderColor2;
						requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFEFFFFFFFFFuL);
					}
					if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x40000000uL) != 0L)
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor3DBase = Color.Transparent;
						requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFBFFFFFFFuL);
					}
					break;
				case AppearanceResolutionPhase.ToolOwner:
					if (((ulong)requestedProps & 1uL) != 0L)
					{
						if (base.IsOpen)
						{
							((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = Office2007ColorTable.Colors.PopupRibbonGroupButtonPressedGradientDark;
						}
						else
						{
							((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = Office2007ColorTable.Colors.PopupRibbonGroupButtonGradientLight;
						}
						requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEuL);
					}
					if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x4000000uL) != 0L)
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor2 = Office2007ColorTable.Colors.PopupRibbonGroupButtonPressedGradientLight;
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor2 = Office2007ColorTable.Colors.PopupRibbonGroupButtonGradientDark;
						requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFBFFFFFFuL);
					}
					if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x10000000uL) != 0L)
					{
						if (Utilities.IsHighContrast)
						{
							((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackGradientStyle = (GradientStyle)1;
						}
						else if (base.IsOpen)
						{
							((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackGradientStyle = (GradientStyle)5;
						}
						else
						{
							((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackGradientStyle = (GradientStyle)2;
						}
						requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFEFFFFFFFuL);
					}
					if (((ulong)requestedProps & 4uL) != 0L)
					{
						if (base.IsOpen)
						{
							((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor = Office2007ColorTable.Colors.PopupRibbonGroupButtonPressedBorderColor;
						}
						else
						{
							((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor = Office2007ColorTable.Colors.PopupRibbonGroupButtonBorderColor;
						}
						requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFBuL);
					}
					if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x1000000000uL) != 0L)
					{
						if (base.IsOpen)
						{
							((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor2 = Office2007ColorTable.Colors.PopupRibbonGroupButtonPressedBorderColor2;
						}
						else
						{
							((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor2 = Office2007ColorTable.Colors.PopupRibbonGroupButtonBorderColor2;
						}
						requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFEFFFFFFFFFuL);
					}
					if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x40000000uL) != 0L)
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor3DBase = Color.Transparent;
						requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFBFFFFFFFuL);
					}

				}
			}
			base.ResolveAppearancePhaseDefaults(ref phaseInfo, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

			InvalidateParentMenuItem(recursive: true);
		}

		{
			InvalidateParentMenuItem();
			if (PopupTool is QuickCustomizeToolBase)
			{
				ResetActiveTool();
			}
			base.ToolbarsManager.PopupManager.PopupClosed(this, PopupTool);
			PopupTool.IsSubMenuAnimationActive = true;
			base.OnPopupClosed(sender, e);
		}

		protected internal override void ResolveMenuAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, object ocntext)
		{

		}

		{
			this.sourceControl = sourceControl;
		}

		internal void InvalidateParentMenuItem()
		{
			InvalidateParentMenuItem(recursive: false);
		}

		internal void InvalidateParentMenuItem(bool recursive)
		{
			if (PopupTool != null && PopupTool.OwnerIsMenu)
			{
				MenuAgentBase menuAgent = PopupTool.OwningMenu.MenuAgent;
				InvalidateParentMenuItem(recursive, menuAgent);
			}
			if (PopupTool != null && PopupTool.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)
			{
				MenuAgentBase menuAgent2 = PopupTool.OwningApplicationMenuArea.ApplicationMenu.MenuAgent;
				InvalidateParentMenuItem(recursive, menuAgent2);
			}
		}

		private void InvalidateParentMenuItem(bool recursive, MenuAgentBase agent)
		{
			UIElement val = (agent?.GetMenuItemFromTool(PopupTool))?.UIElement;
			if (val != null)
			{
				val.Invalidate(false);
			}
			if (recursive && agent is PopupToolAgentBase)
			{
				((PopupToolAgentBase)agent).InvalidateParentMenuItem(recursive);
			}
		}

		private void ResetActiveTool()
		{
			if (PopupTool == null || base.ToolbarsManager == null || base.ToolbarsManager.ActiveTool != PopupTool)
			{
				return;
			}
			UIElement uIElement = PopupTool.UIElement;
			ControlUIElementBase val = ((uIElement == null) ? null : uIElement.ControlElement);
			UIElement val2 = ((val == null) ? null : val.LastElementEntered);
			if (val2 == null || (val2 != uIElement && !val2.HasAncestor(uIElement)))
			{
				base.ToolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(PopupTool, setOn: false, clearToolBeingEdited: false);
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					uIElement.Invalidate();
				}
			}
		}

	internal class SegmentedButtonKeyTipProvider : IKeyTipProvider
	{
		private PopupToolBase popupTool;

		private ToolBase toolBeingDisplayed;

		System.Drawing.ContentAlignment IKeyTipProvider.Alignment
		{
			get
			{
				Point location;
				System.Drawing.ContentAlignment alignment;
				if (toolBeingDisplayed != popupTool)
				{
					ToolBase underlyingTool = toolBeingDisplayed.UnderlyingTool;
					if (underlyingTool != null)
					{
						ToolBase toolBase = null;
						try
						{
							toolBase = toolBeingDisplayed.AttachToUnderlyingTool();
							popupTool.GetKeyTipForSegmentedButtonLocationInfo(out location, out alignment);
							return alignment;
						}
						finally
						{
							toolBase?.AttachToUnderlyingTool();
						}
					}
				}
				popupTool.GetKeyTipForSegmentedButtonLocationInfo(out location, out alignment);
				return alignment;
			}
		}

		string IKeyTipProvider.AutoGeneratePrefix => null;

		string IKeyTipProvider.Caption => popupTool.CaptionResolved;

		bool IKeyTipProvider.DeactivateParentContainersOnActivate => true;

		bool IKeyTipProvider.IsEnabled => popupTool.EnabledResolved;

		bool IKeyTipProvider.IsVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (toolBeingDisplayed.UIElement != null)
				{
					return popupTool.DisplayDropDownArrowSegmented;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		string IKeyTipProvider.KeyTipValue => popupTool.KeyTipForSegmentedButton;

		Point IKeyTipProvider.Location
		{
			get
			{
				Point location;
				System.Drawing.ContentAlignment alignment;
				if (toolBeingDisplayed != popupTool)
				{
					ToolBase underlyingTool = toolBeingDisplayed.UnderlyingTool;
					if (underlyingTool != null)
					{
						ToolBase toolBase = null;
						try
						{
							toolBase = toolBeingDisplayed.AttachToUnderlyingTool();
							popupTool.GetKeyTipForSegmentedButtonLocationInfo(out location, out alignment);
							return location;
						}
						finally
						{
							toolBase?.AttachToUnderlyingTool();
						}
					}
				}
				popupTool.GetKeyTipForSegmentedButtonLocationInfo(out location, out alignment);
				return location;
			}
		}

		char IKeyTipProvider.Mnemonic => Utilities.GetFirstMnemonicChar(((IKeyTipProvider)popupTool).Caption);

		Control IKeyTipProvider.OwningControl
		{
			get
			{
				UIElement uIElement = popupTool.UIElement;
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					return uIElement.Control;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public SegmentedButtonKeyTipProvider(PopupToolBase popupTool)
		{
			this.popupTool = popupTool;
			toolBeingDisplayed = this.popupTool.ToolBeingDisplayed;
		}

		bool IKeyTipProvider.Activate()
		{
			if (toolBeingDisplayed != popupTool)
			{
				ToolBase underlyingTool = toolBeingDisplayed.UnderlyingTool;
				if (underlyingTool != null)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase = null;
					try
					{
						toolBase = toolBeingDisplayed.AttachToUnderlyingTool();
						return popupTool.DropDownOnKeyTipActivation(this);
					}
					finally
					{
						toolBase?.AttachToUnderlyingTool();
					}
				}
			}
			return popupTool.DropDownOnKeyTipActivation(this);
		}

		bool IKeyTipProvider.Equals(IKeyTipProvider provider)
		{
			return this == provider;
		}

		IKeyTipContainer IKeyTipProvider.GetContainer()
		{
			return popupTool;
		}

						graphics.DrawLine(pen, pt, pt2);
					}
					int num = (ribbonButtonGroupUIElement.HasOnlyButtons ? 1 : 0);
					if (!flag)
					{
						Pen pen2 = ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).GetPen((PenType)0, Office2007ColorTable.Colors.ButtonGroupSeparatorLight);

						Point pt4 = new Point(rectInsideBorders.Left + num, rectInsideBorders.Bottom - 2);
						graphics.DrawLine(pen2, pt3, pt4);
					}
				}
			}

				}
			}

			}
		}

		protected override void OnAfterDraw(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager != null)
			{
				if (toolbarsManager.CustomizingTool(base.Tool))
				{
					toolbarsManager.DrawToolSelectionRect((UIElement)(object)this, ref drawParams, base.Tool);

					base.Tool.DrawToolInsertionBar((UIElement)(object)this, ref drawParams);

		protected override void OnClick()
		{
			DoClickProcessing();
		}

		protected override void OnDoubleClick(bool adjustableArea)
		{
			base.OnDoubleClick(adjustableArea);
			DoClickProcessing();
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e, bool adjustableArea, ref UIElement captureMouseForElement)
		{
			if (base.ToolbarsManager == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			base.ToolbarsManager.LeftButtonDownOnMenuItem = (e.Button & MouseButtons.Left) == MouseButtons.Left;
			mouseDownSinceLastClick = true;
			if (base.ToolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if ((e.Button & MouseButtons.Left) == MouseButtons.Left && PopupTool != null)
			{
				if (PopupTool.IsOpen)
				{
					PopupTool.ClosePopup();
					if (base.ToolbarsManager.ActiveTool == base.Tool && (base.Tool.OwnerIsToolbarInternal || base.Tool.OwnerIsRibbonGroup))
					{
						((UltraToolbarsDockArea)(object)((UIElement)this).Control).IgnoreNextMouseClick = true;
						ignoreNextClick = true;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (base.ToolbarsManager.ActiveTool != base.Tool)
					{
						base.ToolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(base.Tool, setOn: true, clearToolBeingEdited: true, clearToolbarWithCaptureIfNecessary: true);
					}
					if (base.ToolbarsManager.ActiveTool == base.Tool)
					{
						DropDownPopupMenu(delay: false, closeIfAlreadyOpen: true, autocloseDropdown: true);
						if (base.Tool.OwnerIsToolbarInternal || base.Tool.OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
						{
							((UltraToolbarsDockArea)(object)((UIElement)this).Control).IgnoreNextMouseClick = true;
							ignoreNextClick = true;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if ((e.Button & MouseButtons.Right) == MouseButtons.Right)
			{
				return ((UIElement)this).OnMouseDown(e, adjustableArea, ref captureMouseForElement);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void OnMouseHover()
		{
			if (base.Tool != null && base.Tool.ShouldDisplayToolTip)
			{
				base.ToolbarsManager.ImmediateToolTipDisplayMode = true;
				base.Tool.DisplayToolTip();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave()
		{
			isMouseOver = false;
			if (base.ToolbarsManager != null && !base.ToolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				base.Tool.HideToolTip();
				base.ToolbarsManager.ImmediateToolTipDisplayMode = false;
				base.OnMouseLeave();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter()
		{
			isMouseOver = true;
			if (base.ToolbarsManager.Customizing || (base.ToolbarsManager.ToolBeingEdited != null && !base.ToolbarsManager.CanHotTrackWhileInEditMode))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (base.Tool.OwnerIsToolbarInternal && base.Tool.OwningToolbarInternal.Equals(base.ToolbarsManager.ToolbarWithCapture))
			{
				base.ToolbarsManager.AllowToolbarCaptureRelease = false;
				bool delay = false;
				try
				{
					base.Tool.OwningToolbarInternal.CancelPendingSubmenuDropDowns();
					if (base.Tool.OwningToolbarInternal.QuickCustomizeTool != null && base.Tool.OwningToolbarInternal.QuickCustomizeTool.IsOpen)
					{
						base.Tool.OwningToolbarInternal.QuickCustomizeTool.MenuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay: true);
						delay = true;
					}
					else
					{
						base.Tool.OwningToolbarInternal.CloseOpenSubmenuTools(base.Tool);
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					base.ToolbarsManager.AllowToolbarCaptureRelease = true;
				}
				if (base.Tool.OwningToolbarInternal.AutoDropDownMode)
				{
					if (PopupTool != null && PopupTool.IsMenuAgentCreated)
					{
						base.ToolbarsManager.DropdownCloseupManager.CancelPendingCloseup(PopupTool.MenuAgent);
					}
					if (PopupTool == null || !PopupTool.IsOpen)
					{
						DropDownPopupMenu(delay, closeIfAlreadyOpen: false, autocloseDropdown: true);
					}
				}
			}
			base.OnMouseEnter();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager != null && !toolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				if (base.Tool != null)
				{
					base.Tool.DisplayToolTip();
				}
				((UIElement)this).OnMouseMove(e);
			}
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseUp(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (((UIElement)this).Rect.Contains(new Point(e.X, e.Y)))
			{
				DoClickProcessing();
			}
			return ((UIElement)this).OnMouseUp(e);
		}

		void IPopupElement.ShowDropdown(bool delay)
		{
			DropDownPopupMenu(delay, closeIfAlreadyOpen: true, !base.ToolbarsManager.Customizing);
		}

			bool flag4 = (int)base.Tool.ButtonStyle == 23;
			if (!flag2 && !flag3 && !flag4 && !flag)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((flag3 || flag4) && Utilities.IsHighContrast)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (flag && base.Tool.IsOnMainMenuBar)
			{
				return false;
			}
			PopupToolBase popupTool = base.Tool.PopupTool;
			if (popupTool == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!checkSegmentedStyle || !PopupTool.IsSegmentedDropDownArrowStyle)
			{
				UIElementButtonState buttonState = ButtonState;
				if ((popupTool.DrawAsActive && (buttonState & 8) == 8) || (buttonState & 2) == 2)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (popupTool is PopupRibbonGroupTool)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private Corners CalculateRoundCorners()
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0040: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_0069: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0092: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0095: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			if (!ShouldDrawRoundedBorders(checkSegmentedStyle: false))

			}

			Corners val = (Corners)0;
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
