			if (ribbonButtonGroupUIElement == null)
			{
				val = (((int)popupTool.ButtonStyle != 21 || !popupTool.IsSegmentedDropDownArrowStyle) ? ((Corners)15) : ((Corners)5));
			}
			else
			{
				val = (Corners)0;
				if (((UIElement)this).Rect.Left == ((UIElement)ribbonButtonGroupUIElement).Rect.Left)
				{
					val = (Corners)(val | 5);
				}
				if (((UIElement)this).Rect.Right == ((UIElement)ribbonButtonGroupUIElement).Rect.Right && popupTool == null)
				{
					val = (Corners)(val | 0xA);
				}
			}
			return val;
		}

		private void DropDownPopupMenu(bool delay, bool closeIfAlreadyOpen, bool autocloseDropdown)
		{
			//IL_00df: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ca: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			PopupToolBase popupTool = PopupTool;
			if (popupTool == null || base.ToolbarsManager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (base.ToolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				if (!(base.Tool is PopupMenuTool))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (base.ToolbarsManager.ActiveTool != base.Tool)
				{
					base.ToolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(base.Tool, setOn: true, clearToolBeingEdited: false);
				}
				if (base.ToolbarsManager.ActiveTool != base.Tool)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			base.Tool.AttachToUnderlyingTool();
			Control control = null;
			control = popupTool.GetDropDownOwner((UIElement)(object)this);
			Control control2 = ((UIElement)this).Control;
			if (control2 != null && !control2.IsDisposed && !control2.Disposing && control != null && !control.IsDisposed && !control.Disposing)
			{
				Rectangle rectangle = control2.RectangleToScreen(((UIElement)this).Rect);
				if (PopupTool.OverlapMenuBorders)
				{
					rectangle = GetMenuDropDownExclusionRect(rectangle, GetMenuDropDownPosition());
				}
				popupTool.DropDown(control, GetMenuDropDownPoint(), rectangle, GetMenuDropDownPosition(), delay, closeIfAlreadyOpen, base.ToolbarsManager.RightAlignedMenusResolved, autocloseDropdown, null);
			}
		}

		internal static Rectangle GetMenuDropDownExclusionRect(Rectangle rect, DropDownPosition dropdownPosition)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)dropdownPosition == 0)
			{
				return Rectangle.Inflate(rect, 0, -1);
			}
			return Rectangle.Inflate(rect, -1, 0);
		}

		private Point GetMenuDropDownPoint()
		{
			Control control = ((UIElement)this).Control;
			if (control != null && !control.IsDisposed && !control.Disposing)
			{
				bool overlapMenuBorders = PopupTool.OverlapMenuBorders;
				if (PopupTool is TaskPaneToolbarMenuTool)
				{
					if (!overlapMenuBorders)
					{
						return control.PointToScreen(new Point(((UIElement)this).Rect.Right - PopupTool.MenuAgent.CalculateRequiredDropDownSize().Width, ((UIElement)this).Rect.Bottom));
					}
					return control.PointToScreen(new Point(((UIElement)this).Rect.Right - PopupTool.MenuAgent.CalculateRequiredDropDownSize().Width, ((UIElement)this).Rect.Bottom - 1));
				}
				Point dropDownPoint = PopupTool.GetDropDownPoint(((UIElement)this).Rect);
				return control.PointToScreen(dropDownPoint);
			}
			return Point.Empty;
		}

		private DropDownPosition GetMenuDropDownPosition()
		{
			if (base.Tool.IsArrangedVertically)
			{
				if (!base.ToolbarsManager.RightAlignedMenusResolved)
				{
					return (DropDownPosition)2;
				}
				return (DropDownPosition)1;
			}
			return (DropDownPosition)0;
		}

		private RibbonButtonGroupUIElement GetRibbonButtonGroupUIElement()
		{
			UIElement parent = ((UIElement)this).Parent;
			if (parent is RibbonButtonGroupUIElement result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			parent = parent.Parent;
			return parent as RibbonButtonGroupUIElement;
		}

		private void DoClickProcessing()
		{
			if (PopupTool == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DateTime now = DateTime.Now;
			DateTime value = lastClickProcessedTime;
			if (base.ToolbarsManager == null || !base.ToolbarsManager.LeftButtonDownOnMenuItem)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.ToolbarsManager.LeftButtonDownOnMenuItem = false;
			try
			{
				if (!mouseDownSinceLastClick && now.Subtract(value).TotalMilliseconds < (double)SystemInformation.DoubleClickTime)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (base.Tool.OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
				{
					if (!ignoreNextClick && PopupTool.IsOpen && (base.Tool.OwningToolbarInternal.Equals(base.ToolbarsManager.ToolbarWithCapture) || base.Tool.OwningToolbarInternal.ToolbarType == ToolbarType.Popup))
					{
						PopupTool.MenuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay: false);
					}
				}
				else if (base.Tool.OwnerIsRibbonGroup && !ignoreNextClick && PopupTool.IsOpen && base.Tool.OwningRibbonGroup.Equals(base.ToolbarsManager.RibbonGroupWithCapture))
				{
					PopupTool.MenuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay: false);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				lastClickProcessedTime = DateTime.Now;
				mouseDownSinceLastClick = false;
			}
			ignoreNextClick = false;
		}
	}

			private static ProgressBarStyle ToolStyleToProgressStyle(ProgressBarToolStyle toolStyle)
			{
				switch (toolStyle)
				{
				default:
					return (ProgressBarStyle)(-1);
				case ProgressBarToolStyle.System:
				case ProgressBarToolStyle.Continuous:
					return (ProgressBarStyle)0;
				case ProgressBarToolStyle.Segmented:
					return (ProgressBarStyle)1;
				case ProgressBarToolStyle.SegmentedPartial:
					return (ProgressBarStyle)2;
				}
			}

				{
					progressAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					progressAppearanceHolder = null;
				}
				if (editor != null)
				{
					((DisposableObject)(object)editor).Dispose();
					editor = null;
				}
				owningTool = null;
				base.OnDispose();
			}

			protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
			{
				if (owningTool != null)
				{
					owningTool.OnSubObjectPropChanged(propChange);
				}
			}

				ExtraSharedProps.SetValue(value, this);
				if (base.SharedProps == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (ToolBase toolInstance in base.SharedProps.ToolInstances)
				{
					UIElement uIElement = toolInstance.UIElement;
					if (uIElement != null)
					{
						uIElement.DirtyChildElements();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (HasProgressFillAppearance && propChange.Source == ExtraSharedProps.progressFillAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ProgressFillAppearance, propChange);
			}
			else if (HasProgressAppearance && propChange.Source == ExtraSharedProps.progressAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ProgressAppearance, propChange);
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnSubObjectPropChanged(propChange);
			}
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			if (base.IsRootTool)
			{
				ResetMinimum();
				ResetMaximum();
				Value = Minimum;
				ResetStyle();
				ResetProgressFillAppearance();
				ResetProgressAppearance();
				ResetProgressFormat();
				ResetProgressText();
				ResetProgressBorderStyle();
			}
			base.Reset();
		}

		internal override void ResolveAppearancePhaseDefaults(ref ResolveAppearancePhaseInfo phaseInfo, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			if (phaseInfo.Phase == AppearanceResolutionPhase.Final)
			{
				if ((0x80000000uL & (ulong)requestedProps) == 2147483648u)
				{
					if (Style == ProgressBarToolStyle.System || Style == ProgressBarToolStyle.Default)
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ThemedElementAlpha = (Alpha)2;
					}
					else
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ThemedElementAlpha = (Alpha)3;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (phaseInfo.Phase == AppearanceResolutionPhase.Initial && phaseInfo.EditArea && ((ulong)requestedProps & 0x10uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)16))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).TextHAlign = (HAlign)2;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEFuL);
			}
			base.ResolveAppearancePhaseDefaults(ref phaseInfo, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		protected internal override bool ResolveEditorAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, EmbeddableEditorArea area, bool hotTracking, string customArea)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0005: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_006b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0040: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)area != 0)
			{
				if ((int)area == 6)
				{
					if (ExtraSharedProps.progressFillAppearanceHolder != null && ExtraSharedProps.progressFillAppearanceHolder.HasAppearance)
					{
						ResolutionOrderInfo resolutionOrder = StyleUtils.GetResolutionOrder(base.ToolbarsManagerInControl);

					}
					return true;

			}
			ResolveAppearance(editArea: true, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, base.IsActiveTool, drawAsPressed: false);

		}

		internal static GraphicsPath GetBorderPath(Rectangle rect, bool isApplicationMenuVisible)
		{
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
			graphicsPath.AddLine(new Point(rect.Right, rect.Top), new Point(rect.Left, rect.Top));
			if (isApplicationMenuVisible)
			{
				graphicsPath.AddPath(GetLeftCurvePath(rect, isBorderPath: true), connect: false);
			}
			else
			{
				graphicsPath.AddLine(new Point(rect.Left + 1, rect.Top + 1), new Point(rect.Left, rect.Top + 2));
				graphicsPath.AddLine(new Point(rect.Left, rect.Top + 1), new Point(rect.Left, rect.Bottom - 3));
				graphicsPath.AddLine(new Point(rect.Left, rect.Bottom - 3), new Point(rect.Left + 1, rect.Bottom - 2));
			}
			graphicsPath.AddLine(new Point(rect.Left, rect.Bottom - 1), new Point(rect.Right, rect.Bottom - 1));
			graphicsPath.AddPath(GetRightCurvePath(rect, isBorderPath: true), connect: false);
			return graphicsPath;
		}

		internal static Region GetCurvedRegion(Rectangle rect, bool isApplicationMenuVisible)
		{
			Region region = new Region(rect);
			if (isApplicationMenuVisible)
			{
				GraphicsPath leftCurvePath = GetLeftCurvePath(rect, isBorderPath: false);
				region.Union(leftCurvePath);
				leftCurvePath.Dispose();
			}
			else
			{
				region.Xor(new Rectangle(new Point(rect.Left, rect.Top), new Size(2, 1)));
				region.Xor(new Rectangle(new Point(rect.Left, rect.Top + 1), new Size(1, 1)));
				region.Xor(new Rectangle(new Point(rect.Left, rect.Bottom - 1), new Size(2, 1)));
				region.Xor(new Rectangle(new Point(rect.Left, rect.Bottom - 2), new Size(1, 1)));
			}
			GraphicsPath rightCurvePath = GetRightCurvePath(rect, isBorderPath: false);
			region.Union(rightCurvePath);
			rightCurvePath.Dispose();
			return region;
		}

		private static GraphicsPath GetLeftCurvePath(Rectangle rect, bool isBorderPath)
		{
			int num = 12;
			int num2 = 21;
			int num3 = 25;
			int num4 = (int)Math.Pow(num3, 2.0);

			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				int num6 = ((i == 0) ? num5 : (1 + array[i - 1].X));
				int num7 = point.Y - (int)Math.Sqrt((double)num4 - Math.Pow(num6 - point.X, 2.0));
				if (num7 < rect.Top)
				{
					num7 = rect.Top;
				}
				array[i] = new Point(num6, num7);
				array2[i] = (byte)((i != 0) ? 1u : 0u);
			}
			if (!isBorderPath)
			{
				List<Point> list = new List<Point>();
				for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
				{
					list.Add(array[j]);
					if (j == array.Length - 1)
					{
						continue;
					}
					int num8 = array[j + 1].Y - array[j].Y;
					if (num8 > 1)
					{
						int num9 = ((num8 > 4) ? ((int)Math.Round((double)(num8 / 2))) : 2);
						for (int k = 1; k < num9; k++)
						{
							list.Add(new Point(array[j].X, array[j].Y + k));
						}
					}
				}
				byte[] array3 = new byte[list.Count];
				array3[0] = 0;
				for (int l = 1; l < array3.Length; l++)
				{
					array3[l] = 1;
				}
				array = list.ToArray();
				array2 = array3;
			}
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath(new Point[2]
			{
				new Point(rect.Left, rect.Top),
				new Point(rect.Left - num, rect.Top)
			}, new byte[2] { 0, 1 });
			graphicsPath.AddPath(new GraphicsPath(array, array2), connect: true);
			return graphicsPath;
		}

		private static GraphicsPath GetRightCurvePath(Rectangle rect, bool isBorderPath)
		{
			int num = 8;
			int num2 = (int)Math.Pow(num, 2.0);

				}
				array[i] = new Point(num3, y);

			{

				}

			{

				pathGradientBrush.SurroundColors = new Color[1] { Color.Transparent };
				((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.FillRectangle(pathGradientBrush, rect);
			}
			((UIElement)this).DrawForeground(ref drawParams);
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			Ribbon?.ResolveQatTopAreaAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			((UIElement)this).InitAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override int GetNonClientHitTestCode(Point point)
		{
			return 1;
		}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			ToolbarUIElement toolbarUIElement = UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)base.childElementsCollection, typeof(ToolbarUIElement), true) as ToolbarUIElement;
			((ArrayList)(object)((UIElement)this).ChildElements).Clear();
			Ribbon ribbon = Ribbon;
			if (ribbon != null && ribbon.RibbonContainer != null)
			{
				if (toolbarUIElement == null)
				{
					toolbarUIElement = new ToolbarUIElement((UIElement)(object)this, ribbon.QuickAccessToolbar, ribbon.RibbonContainer);
				}
				else
				{
					toolbarUIElement.InitializeElement(ribbon.QuickAccessToolbar);
				}
				ribbon.Metrics.AdjustQatWidthIfNecessary();
				((UIElement)toolbarUIElement).Rect = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)toolbarUIElement);
			}
		}
	}

	internal abstract class QuickCustomizeAgentBase : PopupToolAgentBase
	{
		private QuickCustomizeToolBase quickCustomizeTool;

		private UltraToolbar bumpedToolsToolbar;

		private UltraToolbarsDockArea bumpedToolsDockArea;

		private WeakReference disposedBumpedToolsToolbar;

		protected internal override UltraToolbar BumpedToolsToolbar => bumpedToolsToolbar;

		protected internal override bool OkToDropDown
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.MenuItems.Count <= 0)
				{
					return QuickCustomizeTool.Toolbar.ToolsHaveBeenBumped;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal UltraToolbarsDockArea BumpedToolsDockArea => bumpedToolsDockArea;

		internal QuickCustomizeToolBase QuickCustomizeTool => quickCustomizeTool;

		internal UltraToolbarBase Toolbar => quickCustomizeTool.Toolbar;

		internal virtual UltraToolbarBase[] RootToolbars
		{
			get
			{
				if (bumpedToolsToolbar != null)
				{
					return bumpedToolsToolbar.RootToolbars;
				}
				return new UltraToolbarBase[1] { Toolbar };
			}
		}

		public QuickCustomizeAgentBase(QuickCustomizeToolBase quickCustomizeTool)
			: base(quickCustomizeTool)
		{
			this.quickCustomizeTool = quickCustomizeTool;
		}

		protected internal override void BeforeDropDown(ref bool cancel)
		{
			RemoveDisposedBumpedToolbarTools();
			quickCustomizeTool.HideToolTip();
			base.ToolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(null, setOn: false, clearToolBeingEdited: true, clearToolbarWithCaptureIfNecessary: true);
			if (base.ToolbarsManager == null || base.ToolbarsManager.IsInEditMode)
			{
				cancel = true;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ToolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture = Toolbar;
			}
			base.BeforeDropDown(ref cancel);
		}

		internal override void CalculateRequiredDropDownSize(out Size minSize, out Size preferredMinSize, out Size size, out Size maxSize)
		{
			base.CalculateRequiredDropDownSize(out minSize, out preferredMinSize, out size, out maxSize);
			if (bumpedToolsToolbar != null)
			{
				Size size2 = CalculateDockAreaSizeHelper(size);
				if (base.MenuItems.Count > 0)
				{
					size2.Height += size.Height + base.ToolbarsManager.Metrics.MenuitemSeparatorHeight;
				}
				else
				{
					size2.Height += 2 * base.ToolbarsManager.Metrics.MenuBorderThickness;
				}
				size2.Width += 2 * base.ToolbarsManager.Metrics.MenuBorderThickness;
				size = size2;
				minSize = (preferredMinSize = (maxSize = size));
			}
		}

		internal override bool ContainsTool(ToolBase tool)
		{
			if (tool != null)
			{
				if (!tool.IsWithinOwner(BumpedToolsToolbar))
				{
					return GetMenuItemFromTool(tool) != null;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override PopupControlBase GetPopupControl()
		{
			QuickCustomizePopupControl quickCustomizePopupControl = QuickCustomizePopupControl.Create(this);
			DisposeBumpedToolbar();
			bumpedToolsToolbar = quickCustomizeTool.Toolbar.GetBumpedToolsToolbar();
			((Control)(object)quickCustomizePopupControl).Size = CalculateRequiredDropDownSize();
			if (bumpedToolsToolbar != null)
			{
				base.CalculateRequiredDropDownSize(out var _, out var _, out var preferredSize, out var _);
				Size size = CalculateDockAreaSizeHelper(preferredSize);
				bumpedToolsDockArea = new UltraToolbarsDockArea(DockStyle.None);
				((Control)(object)bumpedToolsDockArea).Size = size;
				bumpedToolsDockArea.ToolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
				bumpedToolsDockArea.AddToolbar(bumpedToolsToolbar, 0, 0);
				((Control)(object)bumpedToolsDockArea).Name = "DockArea";
				bumpedToolsToolbar.InternalSetFloatingSize(size);
				((Control)(object)bumpedToolsDockArea).Location = new Point(base.ToolbarsManager.Metrics.MenuBorderThickness, base.ToolbarsManager.Metrics.MenuBorderThickness);
				((Control)(object)quickCustomizePopupControl).Controls.Add((Control)(object)bumpedToolsDockArea);
			}
			return quickCustomizePopupControl;
		}

		protected internal override void OnPendingDropDownCancelled()
		{
			base.OnPendingDropDownCancelled();
			PerformCleanup();
		}

		protected internal override void OnPopupClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			PerformCleanup();
			base.OnPopupClosed(sender, e);
		}

		protected void ReinitializeBumpedToolbar()
		{
			if (bumpedToolsDockArea != null && bumpedToolsToolbar != null)
			{
				if (bumpedToolsToolbar != null)
				{
					disposedBumpedToolsToolbar = new WeakReference(bumpedToolsToolbar);
					bumpedToolsDockArea.RemoveToolbar(bumpedToolsToolbar);
					bumpedToolsToolbar.Dispose();
					bumpedToolsToolbar = null;
				}
				bumpedToolsToolbar = quickCustomizeTool.Toolbar.GetBumpedToolsToolbar();
				if (bumpedToolsToolbar != null)
				{
					Size size = CalculateDockAreaSizeHelper(CalculateRequiredDropDownSize());
					((Control)(object)bumpedToolsDockArea).Size = size;
					bumpedToolsDockArea.AddToolbar(bumpedToolsToolbar, 0, 0);
					bumpedToolsToolbar.InternalSetFloatingSize(size);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual Size CalculateDockAreaSizeHelper(Size baseSize)
		{
			if (bumpedToolsToolbar == null)
			{
				return Size.Empty;
			}
			Size size = bumpedToolsToolbar.GetMetrics(baseSize, Size.Empty).Size;
			size.Height += 2;
			size.Width += 2;
			if (base.MenuItems.Count > 0)
			{
				size.Width = Math.Max(baseSize.Width - 2 * base.ToolbarsManager.Metrics.MenuBorderThickness, size.Width);
			}
			return size;
		}

		private void DisposeBumpedToolbar()
		{
			if (bumpedToolsDockArea != null)
			{
				bumpedToolsDockArea.ReparentContainedControls(takeOwnership: false);
				((Control)(object)bumpedToolsDockArea).Hide();
				((Component)(object)bumpedToolsDockArea).Dispose();
				bumpedToolsDockArea = null;
			}
			if (bumpedToolsToolbar != null)
			{
				disposedBumpedToolsToolbar = new WeakReference(bumpedToolsToolbar);
				bumpedToolsToolbar.Dispose();
				bumpedToolsToolbar = null;
			}
		}

		private void PerformCleanup()
		{
			if (bumpedToolsToolbar != null && base.ToolbarsManager.ActiveTool != null && base.ToolbarsManager.ActiveTool.UltimateOwner == bumpedToolsToolbar)
			{
				base.ToolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(null, setOn: false, clearToolBeingEdited: false);
			}
			DisposeBumpedToolbar();
		}

		private void RemoveDisposedBumpedToolbarTools()
		{
			if (disposedBumpedToolsToolbar != null)
			{
				if (disposedBumpedToolsToolbar.IsAlive && disposedBumpedToolsToolbar.Target is UltraToolbar ultraToolbar)
				{
					ultraToolbar.Tools.ClearInternal();
				}
				disposedBumpedToolsToolbar = null;
			}
		}
	}

		internal override UIRole UIRole

			}

		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldShowImages(object context)

			return false;
		}
	}

		{
		}

		[UIPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Window = UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows)]
		protected override bool ProcessDialogKey(Keys keyData)
		{
			Keys keys = keyData & ~(Keys.Shift | Keys.Control | Keys.Alt);
			switch (keys)
			{
			case Keys.Escape:
				if (base.MenuAgent.IsOpen)
				{
					return base.MenuAgent.ToolbarsManager.ProcessEscapeKey(passToPopupContainer: false);
				}
				break;
			case Keys.Tab:
			case Keys.Return:
			case Keys.Left:
			case Keys.Up:
			case Keys.Right:
			case Keys.Down:
				return base.MenuAgent.ToolbarsManager.ProcessNavigationKey(keys, passToPopupContainer: false);
			}
			return ((Control)(object)this).ProcessDialogKey(keyData);
		}
	}

	internal sealed class QuickCustomizeTool : QuickCustomizeToolBase

		internal bool AreAnyToolbarsCustomizable
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.Toolbar.ShowAddRemoveButtonsInQuickCustomize)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (base.ToolbarsManagerInControl != null && base.ToolbarsManagerInControl.ShowQuickCustomizeButton)
				{
					UltraToolbarBase[] toolbarPickerRootToolbars = base.Toolbar.GetToolbarPickerRootToolbars();
					if (toolbarPickerRootToolbars == null || toolbarPickerRootToolbars.Length < 1)
					{
						return base.Toolbar.AllowCustomizeResolved;
					}
					UltraToolbarBase[] array = toolbarPickerRootToolbars;
					foreach (UltraToolbarBase ultraToolbarBase in array)
					{
						if (ultraToolbarBase.AllowCustomizeResolved)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				return false;
			}

		protected internal override Size CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstance()
		{
			Image chevronBitmap = base.ToolbarsManager.GetChevronBitmap(forUseOnToolbar: true, base.IsVertical, base.UseLargeImagesOnToolbarResolved);
			int num;
			int num2;
			if (base.IsVertical)
			{
				num = chevronBitmap.Height + 1 + 2;
				num2 = chevronBitmap.Height * 2 + 2;
			}
			else
			{
				num = chevronBitmap.Width + 1 + 2;
				num2 = chevronBitmap.Width * 2 + 2;
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager.TouchMetricsEnabledResolved)
			{
				Size size = (base.UseLargeImagesOnToolbarResolved ? toolbarsManager.ImageSizeTouchLarge : toolbarsManager.ImageSizeTouchSmall);
				num = Math.Max(num, size.Width);
				num2 = Math.Max(num2, size.Height);
			}
			if (base.ToolbarsManager.MSColors != null && !base.Toolbar.IsFloating)
			{
				num += 2;
			}
			return new Size(num, num2);
		}

		internal override void CancelPendingDropDowns()
		{
			if (toolbarPickerAgent != null)

		internal void CloseAddRemoveButtonsMenu()
		{
			if (addRemoveButtonsAgent != null)
			{
				if (addRemoveButtonsAgent.IsOpen)
				{
					addRemoveButtonsAgent.CloseDropDown(delay: false);

				base.ToolbarsManager.DropdownCloseupManager.CancelPendingDropdownRequest(addRemoveButtonsAgent);
			}
			addRemoveButtonsToolbar = null;
			if (base.MenuAgent.PopupControl != null)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)base.MenuAgent.PopupControl).Invalidate();
			}
		}

		internal void CloseToolbarPickerMenu()
		{
			CloseAddRemoveButtonsMenu();
			if (toolbarPickerAgent != null)

				if (toolbarPickerAgent.IsOpen)

					toolbarPickerAgent.CloseDropDown(delay: false);

			}
			if (base.MenuAgent.PopupControl != null)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)base.MenuAgent.PopupControl).Invalidate();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter()
		{
			isMouseOver = true;
			if (ToolbarsManager.Customizing || (ToolbarsManager.ToolBeingEdited != null && !ToolbarsManager.CanHotTrackWhileInEditMode))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!Toolbar.QuickCustomizeTool.IsOpen)
			{
				Toolbar.QuickCustomizeTool.DisplayToolTip();
			}
			((UIElement)this).OnMouseEnter();
			if (ToolbarsManager.IsInEditMode)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(Toolbar.QuickCustomizeTool, setOn: true, clearToolBeingEdited: false);
			}
			else if (ActiveBorders)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(Toolbar.QuickCustomizeTool, setOn: true, clearToolBeingEdited: true);
			}
			if (Toolbar.Equals(ToolbarsManager.ToolbarWithCapture))
			{
				ToolbarsManager.AllowToolbarCaptureRelease = false;
				try
				{
					Toolbar.CancelPendingSubmenuDropDowns();
					Toolbar.CloseOpenSubmenuTools(Toolbar.QuickCustomizeTool);
				}
				finally
				{
					ToolbarsManager.AllowToolbarCaptureRelease = true;
				}
				if (Toolbar.AutoDropDownMode)
				{
					if (Toolbar.QuickCustomizeTool != null && Toolbar.QuickCustomizeTool.IsMenuAgentCreated)
					{
						ToolbarsManager.DropdownCloseupManager.CancelPendingCloseup(Toolbar.QuickCustomizeTool.MenuAgent);
					}
					DropDownPopupMenu(delay: true, closeIfAlreadyOpen: false);
				}
			}
			if (ActiveBorders)
			{
				((UIElement)this).Invalidate(true);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseHover()
		{
			if (Toolbar != ToolbarsManager.ToolbarWithCapture)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.ImmediateToolTipDisplayMode = true;
				Toolbar.QuickCustomizeTool.DisplayToolTip();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave()
		{
			Toolbar.QuickCustomizeTool.ForceDrawAsActive = false;
			isMouseOver = false;
			if (ToolbarsManager == null || ToolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				return;
			}
			Toolbar.QuickCustomizeTool.HideToolTip();
			ToolbarsManager.ImmediateToolTipDisplayMode = false;
			((UIElement)this).OnMouseLeave();
			if (ActiveBorders)
			{
				if (ToolbarsManager.ActiveTool == Toolbar.QuickCustomizeTool)
				{
					ToolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(Toolbar.QuickCustomizeTool, setOn: false, clearToolBeingEdited: false);
				}
				((UIElement)this).Invalidate(true);
			}
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e, bool adjustableArea, ref UIElement captureMouseForElement)
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if ((e.Button & MouseButtons.Left) == MouseButtons.Left)
			{
				if (Toolbar.QuickCustomizeTool.IsOpen)
				{
					popupAlreadyOpen = true;
				}
				else
				{
					DropDownPopupMenu(delay: false, closeIfAlreadyOpen: false);
					if (((UIElement)this).Control is UltraToolbarsDockArea ultraToolbarsDockArea)
					{
						ultraToolbarsDockArea.IgnoreNextMouseClick = true;
					}
				}
				captureMouseForElement = (UIElement)(object)this;
				return true;
			}
			popupAlreadyOpen = false;
			return ((UIElement)this).OnMouseDown(e, adjustableArea, ref captureMouseForElement);
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseUp(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (popupAlreadyOpen)
			{
				popupAlreadyOpen = false;
				Point pt = new Point(e.X, e.Y);
				if (((UIElement)this).Rect.Contains(pt))
				{
					((QuickCustomizeTool)Toolbar.QuickCustomizeTool).CloseToolbarPickerMenu();
					Toolbar.QuickCustomizeTool.MenuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay: false);
				}
			}
			return ((UIElement)this).OnMouseUp(e);
		}

	internal class ResetToolbarMenuItem : SpecialCommandMenuItemBase
	{
		private UltraToolbar toolbar;

		protected internal override bool IsFirstInGroup => true;

		protected internal override string Text => UltraToolbarsManager.ResetToolbarLiteral;

		public override UIRole UIRole
		{
			get
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager != null)
				{
					return StyleUtils.GetRole(toolbarsManager, StyleUtils.Role.MenuItemResetToolbar);
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal ResetToolbarMenuItem(UltraToolbar toolbar)
		{
			this.toolbar = toolbar;
		}

		protected internal override void OnClick()
		{
			toolbar.ResetState();
		}

		protected override UIElement GetMenuUIElement(UIElement parentElement, UIElement previousElement)
		{
			ResetToolbarUIElement resetToolbarUIElement = null;
			if (previousElement != null && ((object)previousElement).GetType() == typeof(ResetToolbarUIElement) && previousElement.Parent == parentElement)
			{
				resetToolbarUIElement = previousElement as ResetToolbarUIElement;
			}
			if (resetToolbarUIElement == null)
			{
				resetToolbarUIElement = new ResetToolbarUIElement(parentElement, this);
			}
			resetToolbarUIElement.InitializeElement(this);
			return (UIElement)(object)resetToolbarUIElement;
		}

		protected internal override Type GetMenuUIElementType()
		{
			return typeof(ResetToolbarUIElement);
		}

		internal override bool IsSameMenuItem(MenuItemBase menuItem)
		{
			if (menuItem is ResetToolbarMenuItem resetToolbarMenuItem)
			{
				return resetToolbarMenuItem.toolbar == toolbar;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

				this.control = control;
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				string text = control.Site.Name;
				if (control is UltraPanelClientArea ultraPanelClientArea)
				{
					Control parent = Utilities.GetParent((Control)(object)ultraPanelClientArea);
					if (parent != null)
					{
						text = parent.Site.Name + "." + text;
					}
				}
				return text;
			}
		}

		private void ResolveDockWithinContainerDialog_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			InitializeDialogStrings();
			IDesignerHost designerHost = toolbarsManager.DesignerHost;
			if (designerHost != null && !designerHost.Loading && designerHost.Container != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < designerHost.Container.Components.Count; i++)
				{
					Control control = designerHost.Container.Components[i] as Control;
					if (control is UltraPanel ultraPanel)
					{
						control = (Control)(object)ultraPanel.ClientArea;
					}
					if (UltraToolbarsManager.CanControlBeDockWithinContainer(control, allowNullControl: false))
					{
						lstEligibleControls.Items.Add(new ControlWrapper(control));
					}
				}
			}
			if (lstEligibleControls.Items.Count < 1)
			{
				opSetProperty.Enabled = false;
			}
			else
			{
				lstEligibleControls.SelectedIndex = 0;
			}
		}

		private void cmdOK_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			_ = opDontSetProperty.Checked;
			if (opSetProperty.Checked && lstEligibleControls.SelectedIndex > -1 && lstEligibleControls.Items[lstEligibleControls.SelectedIndex] is ControlWrapper controlWrapper)
			{
				selectedDockWithinContainer = controlWrapper.Control;
			}
			if (opCancel.Checked)
			{
				ProcessCancelOption();
			}
			Hide();
			if (!chDontShowDialogAgain.Checked)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				string name = Registry.CurrentUser.Name;
				RegistryPermission registryPermission = new RegistryPermission(RegistryPermissionAccess.AllAccess, name);
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					registryPermission.Assert();
				}
				Registry.CurrentUser.OpenSubKey("Software\\Infragistics\\UltraWinToolbars", writable: true)?.SetValue("SuppressDockWithinContainerResolutionDialog", chDontShowDialogAgain.Checked);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private void cmdCancel_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ProcessCancelOption();
			Hide();
		}

		private void opSetProperty_CheckedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			lstEligibleControls.Enabled = opSetProperty.Checked;
		}

		private void InitializeDialogStrings()
		{
			Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ResolveDockWithinContainer_DialogTitle");
			lblHeading.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ResolveDockWithinContainer_Heading");
			lblChoose.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ResolveDockWithinContainer_Choose");
			opDontSetProperty.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ResolveDockWithinContainer_DontSetProperty");
			opSetProperty.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ResolveDockWithinContainer_SetProperty");
			opCancel.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ResolveDockWithinContainer_CancelCreation", ((Component)(object)toolbarsManager).Site.Name);
			chDontShowDialogAgain.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ResolveDockWithinContainer_DontShowDialogAgain");
		}

		private void ProcessCancelOption()
		{
			IDesignerHost designerHost = toolbarsManager.DesignerHost;
			if (designerHost == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < designerHost.Container.Components.Count; i++)
			{
				if (designerHost.Container.Components[i] == toolbarsManager)
				{
					designerHost.Container.Remove((IComponent)toolbarsManager);
					break;
				}
			}
		}
	}

			protected override void ShouldDrawGlow(ITabItem tab, out bool shouldDraw, out Color glowColor, out GlowOrientation glowOrientation, out int circleExtentPercentage, out int firstFalloff, out int secondFalloff, out bool drawAmbientGlow)
			{
				//IL_0040: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0046: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_005d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0063: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0065: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_0071: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0077: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_009e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00a4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00a6: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_00d2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00d8: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_00e7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00ed: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_014c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0151: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0152: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0154: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_017a: Expected I4, but got Unknown
				//IL_012b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0131: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_01d3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_01d9: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_017c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0182: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_0199: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_019f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_01b6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_01bc: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_01de: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_01e4: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_0187: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_018d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_01a4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_01aa: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_01c1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_01c7: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if (ribbon.ToolbarsManager.GestureInProgress)
				{
					shouldDraw = false;
					glowColor = Color.Empty;
					glowOrientation = (GlowOrientation)0;
					circleExtentPercentage = 0;
					firstFalloff = 0;
					secondFalloff = 0;
					drawAmbientGlow = false;
				}
				else if ((int)ribbon.ToolbarsManager.StyleResolved == 5 && tab.HotTrack && (((TabManager)this).TabProvider.GetTabItemState(tab) & 3) == 2 && (((TabManager)this).TabProvider.GetTabItemState(tab) & 4) == 0)
				{
					shouldDraw = true;
					glowColor = Office2007ColorTable.Colors.TabNonSelectedHotTrackedGlowColor;
					RibbonTab ribbonTab = tab as RibbonTab;
					bool flag = (((TabManager)this).TabProvider.GetTabItemState(tab) & 1) > 0;
					drawAmbientGlow = false;
					if (!ribbonTab.IsDefaultNonSelectedHotTrackedAppearance || Utilities.IsHighContrast)
					{
						((TabManager)this).ShouldDrawGlow(tab, ref shouldDraw, ref glowColor, ref glowOrientation, ref circleExtentPercentage, ref firstFalloff, ref secondFalloff, ref drawAmbientGlow);
						return;
					}
					bool flag2 = false;
					if ((int)Office2007ColorTable.ColorSchemeResolved == 3 && ribbonTab != null && ribbonTab.ContextualTabGroup != null)
					{
						flag2 = true;
					}
					if ((int)Office2007ColorTable.ColorSchemeResolved == 2 || flag2)
					{
						if (ribbonTab != null && ribbonTab.ContextualTabGroup != null)
						{
							shouldDraw = false;
							glowColor = Color.Empty;
							glowOrientation = (GlowOrientation)0;
							circleExtentPercentage = 0;
							firstFalloff = 0;
							secondFalloff = 0;
							return;
						}
						circleExtentPercentage = 40;
						firstFalloff = 5;
						secondFalloff = 100;
						if ((int)Office2007ColorTable.ColorSchemeResolved == 2 && !flag)
						{
							drawAmbientGlow = true;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						circleExtentPercentage = 80;
						firstFalloff = 50;
						secondFalloff = 90;
					}
					TabOrientation tabOrientationResolved = ((TabManager)this).TabOrientationResolved;
					switch (tabOrientationResolved - 1)
					{
					case 2:
					case 3:
						if ((int)Office2007ColorTable.ColorSchemeResolved == 1 || (!flag2 && (int)Office2007ColorTable.ColorSchemeResolved == 3))
						{
							glowOrientation = (GlowOrientation)0;
						}
						else
						{
							glowOrientation = (GlowOrientation)2;
						}
						break;
					case 4:
					case 5:
						if ((int)Office2007ColorTable.ColorSchemeResolved == 1 || (!flag2 && (int)Office2007ColorTable.ColorSchemeResolved == 3))
						{
							glowOrientation = (GlowOrientation)1;
						}
						else
						{
							glowOrientation = (GlowOrientation)3;
						}
						break;
					case 6:
					case 7:
						if ((int)Office2007ColorTable.ColorSchemeResolved == 1 || (!flag2 && (int)Office2007ColorTable.ColorSchemeResolved == 3))
						{
							glowOrientation = (GlowOrientation)3;
						}
						else
						{
							glowOrientation = (GlowOrientation)1;
						}
						break;
					default:
						if ((int)Office2007ColorTable.ColorSchemeResolved == 1 || (!flag2 && (int)Office2007ColorTable.ColorSchemeResolved == 3))
						{
							glowOrientation = (GlowOrientation)2;
						}
						else
						{
							glowOrientation = (GlowOrientation)0;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					((TabManager)this).ShouldDrawGlow(tab, ref shouldDraw, ref glowColor, ref glowOrientation, ref circleExtentPercentage, ref firstFalloff, ref secondFalloff, ref drawAmbientGlow);
				}
			}

			protected override bool ShouldSuppressTabHighlightGlow(ITabItem tab)

				//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

				if (ribbon.ToolbarsManager.GestureInProgress)

					return true;

			}

				//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00a2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

				{
					ribbon.ApplicationMenu2010.CloseUp();
					return;
				}
				ribbon.pendingDropDownSplitMonitorAction = (SplitMonitorAction)2;
				bool flag = ribbon.IsTabPopupOpen && (object)ribbon.SelectedTab == tab;
				((TabManager)this).TabClick(tab);
				if (ribbon.IsMinimized_Legacy && flag == (ribbon.IsTabPopupOpen && (object)ribbon.SelectedTab == tab))
				{
					ribbon.DropDown();
				}
				ribbon.pendingDropDownSplitMonitorAction = (SplitMonitorAction)3;
			}

			internal Rectangle CalculateTabItemRect(RibbonTab tab)
			{

					num += ScenicApplicationMenuButtonWidth;
					break;

					{
						break;

			}

					{

						if (captionAreaButtons == FormCaptionButtons.RibbonDisplayOptions)
						{
							size = GetCaptionButtonSize(SystemButtonId.RibbonDisplayOptions);
						}
						return new Size(pvAttribute.right - pvAttribute.left + size.Width, pvAttribute.bottom - pvAttribute.top + size.Height);
					}
				}
				if ((captionAreaButtons & FormCaptionButtons.Close) != 0)
				{
					Size captionButtonSize = GetCaptionButtonSize(SystemButtonId.Close);
					num = Math.Max(num, captionButtonSize.Height);
					num2 += captionButtonSize.Width;
				}
				if ((captionAreaButtons & FormCaptionButtons.Maximize) != 0)
				{
					Size captionButtonSize = GetCaptionButtonSize(SystemButtonId.Maximize);
					num = Math.Max(num, captionButtonSize.Height);
					num2 += captionButtonSize.Width;
				}
				if ((captionAreaButtons & FormCaptionButtons.Minimize) != 0)
				{
					Size captionButtonSize = GetCaptionButtonSize(SystemButtonId.Minimize);
					num = Math.Max(num, captionButtonSize.Height);
					num2 += captionButtonSize.Width;
				}
				if ((captionAreaButtons & FormCaptionButtons.Restore) != 0)
				{
					Size captionButtonSize = GetCaptionButtonSize(SystemButtonId.Restore);
					num = Math.Max(num, captionButtonSize.Height);
					num2 += captionButtonSize.Width;
				}
				if ((captionAreaButtons & FormCaptionButtons.ContextHelp) != 0)
				{
					Size captionButtonSize = GetCaptionButtonSize(SystemButtonId.ContextHelp);
					num = Math.Max(num, captionButtonSize.Height);
					num2 += captionButtonSize.Width;
				}
				if ((captionAreaButtons & FormCaptionButtons.RibbonDisplayOptions) != 0)
				{
					Size captionButtonSize = GetCaptionButtonSize(SystemButtonId.RibbonDisplayOptions);
					num = Math.Max(num, captionButtonSize.Height);
					num2 += captionButtonSize.Width;
				}
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ribbon.toolbarsManager;
				if ((int)toolbarsManager.StyleResolved != 5)
				{
					num2 = ((!toolbarsManager.ThemesActive) ? (num2 + 2) : (num2 + (buttonCount - 1) * 2));
				}
				return new Size(num2, num);
			}

			internal int GetRibbonHeight(bool isAutoHideRibbonPopup)
			{
				int num = 0;
				num += CaptionAreaHeight;
				if (ribbon.DisplayModeResolved != RibbonDisplayMode.AutoHide || isAutoHideRibbonPopup)
				{
					if (ribbon.IsTabAreaVisible)
					{
						num += TabAreaHeight;
					}
					if (ribbon.IsQatBelowRibbon)
					{
						num += QatBottomAreaHeight;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}

			internal int GetStartingTabOffset()
			{
				UltraToolbarsDockArea ribbonContainer = ribbon.RibbonContainer;
				int num = 0;
				if (ribbonContainer != null)
				{
					num = ribbonContainer.ClientAreaRect.X;
				}
				switch (ribbon.FileMenuButtonStyleResolved)
				{
				case FileMenuButtonStyle.Orb:
					num += ApplicationMenuButtonSize.Width;
					break;
				case FileMenuButtonStyle.TabShaped:
					num += ScenicApplicationMenuButtonWidth;
					break;
				}
				num -= ribbon.tabItemAreaScrollPos;
				return num + ribbon.TabManager.SpaceBeforeTabsResolved;
			}

			internal RibbonTab GetTabItemFromOffset(int offsetX)
			{
				if (ribbon.TabItemAreaDisplayStyleResolved != TabItemAreaDisplayStyle.Visible)
				{
					return null;
				}
				IList visibleTabs = ribbon.Tabs.VisibleTabs;
				TabManager tabManager = ribbon.TabManager;
				int interTabSpacingResolved = tabManager.InterTabSpacingResolved;
				int num = int.MinValue;
				RibbonTab ribbonTab = null;
				int num2 = GetStartingTabOffset();
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = visibleTabs.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					RibbonTab ribbonTab2 = (RibbonTab)visibleTabs[i];
					if (!ribbonTab2.VisibleResolved)
					{
						continue;
					}
					int width = tabManager.GetTabItemSize((ITabItem)(object)ribbonTab2).Width;
					num2 += width;
					if (num2 >= offsetX)
					{
						if (ribbonTab != null && offsetX < num2 - width)
						{
							int num3 = num2 - width - offsetX;
							int num4 = offsetX - num;
							if (num3 <= num4)
							{
								return ribbonTab2;
							}
							return ribbonTab;
						}
						return ribbonTab2;
					}
					num = num2;
					ribbonTab = ribbonTab2;
					num2 += interTabSpacingResolved;
				}
				return null;
			}

			internal Rectangle GetTabItemToolbarRect()
			{
				Rectangle empty = Rectangle.Empty;
				if (ribbon.IsTabItemToolbarVisible)
				{
					empty.Width = TabItemToolbarWidth;
					empty.Height = TabItemAreaElementHeight;
					empty.Y = CaptionAreaHeight;
					UltraToolbarsDockArea ribbonContainer = ribbon.RibbonContainer;
					if (ribbonContainer != null)
					{
						empty.X += ribbonContainer.ClientAreaRect.X;
					}
					empty.X += ribbon.RibbonContainerExtent;
					empty.X -= empty.Width;
				}
				return empty;
			}

			internal RibbonGroup GetGroupFromOffset(RibbonTab tab, int offsetX)
			{
				VerifyTabLayout(tab, force: false);
				RibbonGroupCollection groups = tab.Groups;
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = groups.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = groups[i];
					if (ribbonGroup.VisibleResolved && ribbonGroup.Layout.LastPosition.Contains(offsetX, ribbonGroup.Layout.LastPosition.Top))
					{
						return ribbonGroup;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			internal void VerifyTabLayout(RibbonTab tab, bool force)
			{
				//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_002e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (force || tab != ribbon.SelectedTab)
				{
					int ribbonContainerExtent = ribbon.RibbonContainerExtent;
					UIElementBorderWidths val = ribbon.CalculateBorderWidths(TabPageBorderStyle);
					ribbonContainerExtent -= ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Left + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Right;
					tab.Layout.SetCurrentExtent(ribbonContainerExtent);
					tab.Layout.LastPosition = CalculateTabPageLayoutRect(tab.Layout);
					tab.Layout.CalculateItemPositions();
				}
			}

			internal bool ShouldHideRibbonArea(Size formSize)
			{
				if (ribbon.IsDesignMode)
				{
					return false;
				}
				ApplicationMenu2010 applicationMenu = ribbon.ApplicationMenu2010;
				if (applicationMenu != null && (applicationMenu.IsOpen || applicationMenu.IsOpening))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (formSize.Width >= ribbon.AutoCollapseThresholdHorizontalResolved)
				{
					return formSize.Height < ribbon.AutoCollapseThresholdVerticalResolved;
				}
				return true;
			}

			internal static SystemButtonType GetThemedWindowSystemButtonType(SystemButtonId id)
			{
				return (SystemButtonType)(id switch
				{
					SystemButtonId.Close => 5, 
					SystemButtonId.Maximize => 2, 
					SystemButtonId.Minimize => 1, 
					SystemButtonId.Restore => 3, 
					SystemButtonId.ContextHelp => 4, 
					SystemButtonId.RibbonDisplayOptions => 4, 
					_ => 5, 
				});
			}

			internal void UnhookUserPreferenceChanged()
			{
				try
				{
					SystemEvents.UserPreferenceChanged -= SystemEvents_UserPreferenceChanged;
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
				}
			}

			internal void OnToolsChanged(PropChangeInfo pci)
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ribbon.ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager != null && toolbarsManager.ToolLayoutVersion != toolsLayoutVersion)
				{
					Dirty(RibbonMetricsFlags.QatSizeChanged);
				}
			}

			internal void ResetCachedScenicApplicationMenuButtonWidth()
			{
				cachedScenicApplicationMenuButtonWidth = -1;
				maxAvailableTabAreaSize = Size.Empty;
			}

			private void SystemEvents_UserPreferenceChanged(object sender, UserPreferenceChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				captionFont = null;
			}
		}

		public class RibbonAccessibleObject : AccessibleObjectWrapper
		{
			private Ribbon ribbon;

			public override Rectangle Bounds
			{
				get
				{
					UIElement uIElement = ribbon.UIElement;
					if (uIElement == null)
					{
						return Rectangle.Empty;
					}
					return uIElement.Control.RectangleToScreen(uIElement.Rect);
				}
			}

			public override string Description => ribbon.AccessibleDescription;

			public override string Name
			{
				get
				{
					string name = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name;
					if (name != null && name.Length > 0)
					{
						return name;
					}
					return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AccessibleName_Ribbon");
				}
				set
				{
					((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name = value;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Parent => ((Control)(object)ribbon.RibbonContainer)?.AccessibilityObject;

			public override AccessibleRole Role => AccessibleRole.PropertyPage;

			public override AccessibleStates State
			{
				get
				{
					AccessibleStates accessibleStates = AccessibleStates.None;
					if (!ribbon.VisibleResolved)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Invisible;
					}
					return accessibleStates;
				}
			}

			public Ribbon Ribbon => ribbon;

			public RibbonAccessibleObject(Ribbon ribbon)
			{
				this.ribbon = ribbon;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
			{
				return index switch
				{
					0 => ribbon.QuickAccessToolbar.AccessibilityObject, 
					1 => ribbon.QuickAccessToolbar.QuickCustomizeTool.AccessibilityObject, 
					2 => ribbon.RibbonCaptionAreaAccessibilityObject, 
					3 => ribbon.RibbonCaptionMinimizeButtonAccessibilityObject, 
					4 => ribbon.RibbonCaptionMaximizeButtonAccessibilityObject, 
					5 => ribbon.RibbonCaptionCloseButtonAccessibilityObject, 
					6 => ribbon.RibbonTabItemAreaAccessibilityObject, 
					7 => ribbon.TabItemToolbar.AccessibilityObject, 
					8 => ribbon.ApplicationMenu.ApplicationMenuButtonAccessibilityObject, 
					9 => ribbon.RibbonGroupAreaAccessibilityObject, 
					10 => ribbon.ToolbarsManager.GetFocusedAccessibleObject(), 
					_ => null, 
				};
			}

			public override int GetChildCount()
			{
				return 10;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetFocused()
			{
				return Ribbon.ToolbarsManager.GetFocusedAccessibleObject();
			}

			protected override Control GetMarshallingControl()
			{
				return ribbon.ToolbarsManager?.DockWithinContainer;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				switch (navdir)
				{
				case AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild:
					return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).GetChild(0);
				case AccessibleNavigation.LastChild:
				{
					int num = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).GetChildCount() - 2;
					return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).GetChild(num);
				}
				default:
					return null;
				}
			}
		}

					Rectangle r = Rectangle.Empty;

				get
				{
					string text = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name;
					if (text != null && text.Length > 0)
					{
						return text;
					}
					switch (ButtonId)
					{
					case SystemButtonId.Minimize:
						text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AccessibleName_RibbonCaptionButtonMinimize");
						break;
					case SystemButtonId.Maximize:
						text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AccessibleName_RibbonCaptionButtonMaximize");
						break;
					case SystemButtonId.Restore:
						switch (buttonType)
						{
						case 61472:
							text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AccessibleName_RibbonCaptionButtonRestoreUp");
							break;
						case 61488:
							text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AccessibleName_RibbonCaptionButtonRestoreDown");
							break;
						}
						break;
					case SystemButtonId.Close:
						text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AccessibleName_RibbonCaptionButtonClose");
						break;
					case SystemButtonId.ContextHelp:
						text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AccessibleName_RibbonCaptionButtonContextHelp");
						break;
					case SystemButtonId.RibbonDisplayOptions:
						text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AccessibleName_RibbonCaptionButtonDisplayOptions");
						break;
					}
					return text;
				}
				set
				{
					((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name = value;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Parent => ribbon.AccessibilityObject;

			public override AccessibleRole Role => AccessibleRole.PushButton;

			{
				get
				{
					AccessibleStates accessibleStates = AccessibleStates.None;
					if (RibbonCaptionButtonUIElement == null)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Invisible;
					}
					if (!((UIElement)RibbonCaptionButtonUIElement).Enabled)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Unavailable;
					}
					return accessibleStates;
				}
			}

			internal SystemButtonId ButtonId
			{
				get
				{
					switch (buttonType)
					{
					case 61472:
						if (FormWindowState != FormWindowState.Minimized)
						{
							return SystemButtonId.Minimize;
						}
						return SystemButtonId.Restore;
					case 61488:
						if (FormWindowState != FormWindowState.Maximized)
						{
							return SystemButtonId.Maximize;
						}
						return SystemButtonId.Restore;
					case 61536:
						return SystemButtonId.Close;
					case 61824:
						return SystemButtonId.ContextHelp;
					case 1:
						return SystemButtonId.RibbonDisplayOptions;
					default:
						return (SystemButtonId)0;
					}
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
			{
				int count = ribbon.Tabs.VisibleTabs.Count;
				if (index < count)
				{
					object obj = ribbon.Tabs.VisibleTabs[index];
					ITabItem val = (ITabItem)((obj is ITabItem) ? obj : null);
					return val.AccessibilityObject;
				}
				index -= count;
				if (index == 0)
				{
					return ribbon.RibbonTabPagerButtonLeftAccessibilityObject;
				}
				index--;
				if (index == 0)
				{
					return ribbon.RibbonTabPagerButtonRightAccessibilityObject;
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override int GetChildCount()
			{
				int num = 0;
				num += ribbon.Tabs.VisibleTabs.Count;
				return num + 2;
			}

			protected override Control GetMarshallingControl()
			{
				return ribbon.ToolbarsManager?.DockWithinContainer;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				switch (navdir)
				{
				case AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild:
					return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).GetChild(0);
				case AccessibleNavigation.LastChild:
				{
					int num = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).GetChildCount() - 1;
					return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).GetChild(num);
				}
				case AccessibleNavigation.Up:
				case AccessibleNavigation.Down:
				case AccessibleNavigation.Left:
				case AccessibleNavigation.Right:
				case AccessibleNavigation.Next:
				case AccessibleNavigation.Previous:
					return ribbon.Navigate(RibbonAccessibleChildItem.RibbonTabItemArea, navdir);
				default:
					return null;
				}
			}
		}

		public abstract class RibbonPagerButtonAccessibleObject : AccessibleObjectWrapper
		{
			private Ribbon ribbon;

			private ScrollButton scrollButton = ScrollButton.Left;

			public override Rectangle Bounds
			{
				get
				{
					Rectangle empty = Rectangle.Empty;
					RibbonPagerButtonUIElement ribbonPagerButtonUIElement = RibbonPagerButtonUIElement;
					if (ribbonPagerButtonUIElement != null)
					{
						empty = ((UIElement)ribbonPagerButtonUIElement).Rect;
						return ((UIElement)ribbonPagerButtonUIElement).Control.RectangleToScreen(empty);
					}
					return ((Control)(object)Ribbon.RibbonContainer)?.RectangleToScreen(empty) ?? Rectangle.Empty;
				}
			}

			public override string DefaultAction => Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DefaultAction_RibbonPagerButton");

			public override string Description => scrollButton switch
			{
				ScrollButton.Left => Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AccessibleDescription_RibbonPagerButtonLeft"), 
				ScrollButton.Right => Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AccessibleDescription_RibbonPagerButtonRight"), 
				_ => ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Description, 
			};

			public override string Name
			{
				get
				{
					string text = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name;
					if (text != null && text.Length > 0)
					{
						return text;
					}
					switch (scrollButton)
					{
					case ScrollButton.Left:
						text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AccessibleName_RibbonPagerButtonLeft");
						break;
					case ScrollButton.Right:
						text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AccessibleName_RibbonPagerButtonRight");
						break;
					}
					return text;
				}
				set
				{
					((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name = value;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleRole Role => AccessibleRole.PushButton;

			public override AccessibleStates State
			{
				get
				{
					AccessibleStates accessibleStates = AccessibleStates.None;
					if (RibbonPagerButtonUIElement == null)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Invisible;
					}
					return accessibleStates;
				}
			}

			public Ribbon Ribbon => ribbon;

			protected abstract RibbonPagerButtonUIElement RibbonPagerButtonUIElement { get; }

			public ScrollButton ScrollButton => scrollButton;

			public RibbonPagerButtonAccessibleObject(Ribbon ribbon, ScrollButton scrollButton)
			{
				this.ribbon = ribbon;
				this.scrollButton = scrollButton;
			}

			public override void DoDefaultAction()
			{
				RibbonPagerButtonUIElement ribbonPagerButtonUIElement = RibbonPagerButtonUIElement;
				if (ribbonPagerButtonUIElement != null && ((UIElement)ribbonPagerButtonUIElement).Parent is RibbonPagerAreaUIElement ribbonPagerAreaUIElement)
				{
					ribbonPagerAreaUIElement.ProcessScrollButtonClick(RibbonPagerButtonUIElement);
				}
			}

			protected override Control GetMarshallingControl()
			{
				return ribbon.ToolbarsManager?.DockWithinContainer;
			}
		}

		public class RibbonTabPagerButtonAccessibleObject : RibbonPagerButtonAccessibleObject
		{
			public override AccessibleObject Parent => base.Ribbon.RibbonTabItemAreaAccessibilityObject;

			protected override RibbonPagerButtonUIElement RibbonPagerButtonUIElement
			{
				get
				{
					if (!(base.Ribbon.GetRibbonElement(typeof(RibbonTabAreaUIElement)) is RibbonTabAreaUIElement ribbonTabAreaUIElement))
					{
						return null;
					}
					return ((UIElement)ribbonTabAreaUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(RibbonPagerButtonUIElement), (object)base.ScrollButton) as RibbonPagerButtonUIElement;
				}
			}

			public RibbonTabPagerButtonAccessibleObject(Ribbon ribbon, ScrollButton scrollButton)
				: base(ribbon, scrollButton)
			{
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				switch (navdir)
				{
				case AccessibleNavigation.Left:
				case AccessibleNavigation.Previous:
					switch (base.ScrollButton)
					{
					case ScrollButton.Right:
						return base.Ribbon.RibbonTabPagerButtonLeftAccessibilityObject;
					case ScrollButton.Left:
					{
						int num = base.Ribbon.Tabs.VisibleTabs.Count - 1;
						if (num < 0)
						{
							return null;
						}
						object obj = base.Ribbon.Tabs.VisibleTabs[num];
						ITabItem val = (ITabItem)((obj is ITabItem) ? obj : null);
						if (val == null)
						{
							return null;
						}
						return val.AccessibilityObject;
					}
					}
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Right:
				case AccessibleNavigation.Next:
				{
					ScrollButton scrollButton = base.ScrollButton;
					if (scrollButton != ScrollButton.Left)
					{
						_ = 3;
						return null;
					}
					return base.Ribbon.RibbonTabPagerButtonRightAccessibilityObject;
				}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public class RibbonGroupAreaPagerButtonAccessibleObject : RibbonPagerButtonAccessibleObject
		{
			public override AccessibleObject Parent => base.Ribbon.RibbonGroupAreaAccessibilityObject;

			private RibbonTabPageUIElement RibbonTabPageUIElement
			{
				get
				{
					if (!base.Ribbon.IsMinimized_Legacy)
					{
						return base.Ribbon.GetRibbonElement(typeof(RibbonTabPageUIElement)) as RibbonTabPageUIElement;
					}
					if (base.Ribbon.IsTabPageInView && base.Ribbon.ToolbarsManager != null)
					{
						return base.Ribbon.ToolbarsManager.GetUIElement(typeof(RibbonTabPageUIElement), base.Ribbon.SelectedTab) as RibbonTabPageUIElement;
					}
					return null;
				}
			}

			protected override RibbonPagerButtonUIElement RibbonPagerButtonUIElement
			{
				get
				{
					RibbonTabPageUIElement ribbonTabPageUIElement = RibbonTabPageUIElement;
					if (ribbonTabPageUIElement == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return ((UIElement)ribbonTabPageUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(RibbonPagerButtonUIElement), (object)base.ScrollButton) as RibbonPagerButtonUIElement;
				}
			}

			public RibbonGroupAreaPagerButtonAccessibleObject(Ribbon ribbon, ScrollButton scrollButton)
				: base(ribbon, scrollButton)
			{
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				switch (navdir)
				{
				case AccessibleNavigation.Left:
				case AccessibleNavigation.Previous:
					switch (base.ScrollButton)
					{
					case ScrollButton.Right:
						return base.Ribbon.RibbonGroupAreaPagerButtonLeftAccessibilityObject;
					case ScrollButton.Left:
					{
						if (base.Ribbon.SelectedTab == null)
						{
							return null;
						}
						int num = base.Ribbon.SelectedTab.Groups.Count - 1;
						if (num < 0)
						{
							return null;
						}
						RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = base.Ribbon.SelectedTab.Groups[num];
						if (ribbonGroup.Layout.IsCollapsed)
						{
							return ribbonGroup.RibbonGroupButtonAccessiblilityObject;
						}
						return ribbonGroup.RibbonGroupAccessiblilityObject;
					}
					}
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Right:
				case AccessibleNavigation.Next:
				{
					ScrollButton scrollButton = base.ScrollButton;
					if (scrollButton != ScrollButton.Left)
					{
						_ = 3;
						return null;
					}
					return base.Ribbon.RibbonGroupAreaPagerButtonRightAccessibilityObject;
				}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public class RibbonGroupAreaAccessibleObject : AccessibleObjectWrapper
		{
			private Ribbon ribbon;

			public override Rectangle Bounds
			{
				get
				{
					Rectangle empty = Rectangle.Empty;
					RibbonTabPageUIElement ribbonTabPageUIElement = RibbonTabPageUIElement;
					if (ribbonTabPageUIElement != null)
					{
						empty = ((UIElement)ribbonTabPageUIElement).Rect;
						return ((UIElement)ribbonTabPageUIElement).Control.RectangleToScreen(empty);
					}
					return ((Control)(object)ribbon.RibbonContainer)?.RectangleToScreen(empty) ?? Rectangle.Empty;
				}
			}

			public override string Name
			{
				get
				{
					string name = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name;
					if (name != null && name.Length > 0)
					{
						return name;
					}
					if (ribbon.SelectedTab != null)
					{
						return ribbon.SelectedTab.Caption;
					}
					return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AccessibleName_RibbonGroupArea");
				}
				set
				{
					((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name = value;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Parent => ribbon.AccessibilityObject;

			public override AccessibleRole Role => AccessibleRole.PropertyPage;

			public override AccessibleStates State
			{
				get
				{
					AccessibleStates accessibleStates = AccessibleStates.None;
					if (RibbonTabPageUIElement == null)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Invisible;
					}
					return accessibleStates;
				}
			}

			private RibbonTabPageUIElement RibbonTabPageUIElement
			{
				get
				{
					if (!ribbon.IsMinimized_Legacy)
					{
						return ribbon.GetRibbonElement(typeof(RibbonTabPageUIElement)) as RibbonTabPageUIElement;
					}
					if (ribbon.IsTabPageInView && ribbon.ToolbarsManager != null)
					{
						return ribbon.ToolbarsManager.GetUIElement(typeof(RibbonTabPageUIElement), ribbon.SelectedTab) as RibbonTabPageUIElement;
					}
					return null;
				}
			}

			public RibbonGroupAreaAccessibleObject(Ribbon ribbon)
			{
				this.ribbon = ribbon;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
			{
				if (ribbon.SelectedTab != null)
				{
					int count = ribbon.SelectedTab.Groups.Count;
					if (index < count)
					{
						RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = ribbon.SelectedTab.Groups[index];
						if (ribbonGroup.Layout.IsCollapsed)
						{
							return ribbonGroup.RibbonGroupButtonAccessiblilityObject;
						}
						return ribbonGroup.RibbonGroupAccessiblilityObject;
					}
					index -= count;
				}
				if (index == 0)
				{
					return ribbon.RibbonGroupAreaPagerButtonLeftAccessibilityObject;
				}
				index--;
				if (index == 0)
				{
					return ribbon.RibbonGroupAreaPagerButtonRightAccessibilityObject;
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override int GetChildCount()
			{
				int num = 0;
				if (ribbon.SelectedTab != null)
				{
					num += ribbon.SelectedTab.Groups.Count;
				}
				return num + 2;
			}

			protected override Control GetMarshallingControl()
			{
				return ribbon.ToolbarsManager?.DockWithinContainer;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				switch (navdir)
				{
				case AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild:
					return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).GetChild(0);
				case AccessibleNavigation.LastChild:
				{
					int num = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).GetChildCount() - 1;
					return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).GetChild(num);
				}
				case AccessibleNavigation.Up:
				case AccessibleNavigation.Down:
				case AccessibleNavigation.Left:
				case AccessibleNavigation.Right:
				case AccessibleNavigation.Next:
				case AccessibleNavigation.Previous:
					return ribbon.Navigate(RibbonAccessibleChildItem.LowerRibbon, navdir);
				default:
					return null;
				}
			}
		}

					return null;

			{
				get
				{
					if (!Ribbon.IsMinimized_Legacy)

						return ExpandCollapseState.Expanded;
					}
					return ExpandCollapseState.Collapsed;

			}

				: base(ribbonElement)

			}

				return "Ribbon";
			}

			{
				return ControlType.Pane;
			}

			protected override string GetDefaultName()
			{
				return "ribbon";
			}

			public override IRawElementProviderFragment GetFirstChild()
			{
				FragmentUIAProviderStub quickAccessToolbarStub = QuickAccessToolbarStub;
				if (quickAccessToolbarStub != null)
				{
					return quickAccessToolbarStub.Provider;
				}
				return ((UIElementUIAProviderStub)this).GetFirstChild();
			}

			protected override bool GetIsKeyboardFocusable()
			{
				return false;
			}

			protected override OrientationType GetOrientation()
			{
				return OrientationType.None;
			}

			public override IRawElementProviderFragment NavigateChildren(FragmentUIAProviderStub childStub, bool forward)
			{
				FragmentUIAProviderStub quickAccessToolbarStub = QuickAccessToolbarStub;
				if (childStub == quickAccessToolbarStub)
				{
					if (forward)
					{
						return ((UIElementUIAProviderStub)this).GetFirstChild();
					}
					return null;
				}
				IRawElementProviderFragment rawElementProviderFragment = ((UIElementUIAProviderStub)this).NavigateChildren(childStub, forward);
				if (rawElementProviderFragment == null && !forward && quickAccessToolbarStub != null)
				{
					return quickAccessToolbarStub.Provider;
				}
				return rawElementProviderFragment;
			}

			internal IRawElementProviderFragment GetProviderFromPoint(Point clientPoint)
			{
				if (((UIElementUIAProviderStub)this).UIElement == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				UIElement val = ((UIElementUIAProviderStub)this).UIElement.ElementFromPoint(clientPoint);
				if (val != null)
				{
					return GetProviderFromUIElement(val);
				}
				return null;
			}

			internal IRawElementProviderFragment GetProviderFromUIElement(UIElement elementUnderPoint)
			{
				if (elementUnderPoint != null && elementUnderPoint.GetContext(typeof(ToolBase)) is ToolBase toolBase)
				{
					return ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)toolBase.AutomationProviderStub).Provider;
				}
				return null;
			}

			IRawElementProviderFragment IAutomationProviderFromPoint.AutomationProviderFromPoint(Point clientPoint)
			{
				return GetProviderFromPoint(clientPoint);
			}

			void IExpandCollapseProvider.Collapse()
			{
				Ribbon.IsMinimized_Legacy = true;
			}

			void IExpandCollapseProvider.Expand()
			{
				Ribbon.IsMinimized_Legacy = false;
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_Ribbon_P_AccessibleDescription")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Accessibility")]
		public string AccessibleDescription
		{
			get
			{
				return accessibleDescription;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != accessibleDescription)
				{
					accessibleDescription = value;
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.AccessibleDescription);
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public AccessibleObject AccessibilityObject
		{
			get
			{
				if (accessibleObject == null)
				{
					if (ToolbarsManager != null)
					{
						return ToolbarsManager.CreateAccessibilityInstance(this);
					}
					accessibleObject = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new RibbonAccessibleObject(this)).AccessibleObject;
				}
				return accessibleObject;
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_Ribbon_P_AutoCollapseThresholdHorizontal")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		[DefaultValue(-1)]
		public int AutoCollapseThresholdHorizontal
		{
			get
			{
				return autoCollapseThresholdHorizontal;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != autoCollapseThresholdHorizontal)
				{
					if (value < -1)
					{
						throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Ribbon_MinimumThreshold_Exception"));
					}
					autoCollapseThresholdHorizontal = value;
					VerifyAutoCollapseState();
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.AutoCollapseThresholdHorizontal);
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public int AutoCollapseThresholdHorizontalResolved
		{
			get
			{
				bool flag = toolbarsManager != null && toolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer is Form;
				if (flag && toolbarsManager.EnforceOffice2007Resolution)
				{
					return 300;
				}
				if (autoCollapseThresholdHorizontal != -1)
				{
					return autoCollapseThresholdHorizontal;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					return 300;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_Ribbon_P_AutoCollapseThresholdVertical")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		[DefaultValue(-1)]
		public int AutoCollapseThresholdVertical
		{
			get
			{
				return autoCollapseThresholdVertical;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != autoCollapseThresholdVertical)
				{
					if (value < -1)
					{
						throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Ribbon_MinimumThreshold_Exception"));
					}
					if (value != 250 && value != -1 && toolbarsManager != null && toolbarsManager.EnforceOffice2007Resolution)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CannotChangeAutoThresholdWhenCompatibilityIsEnabled"));
					}
					autoCollapseThresholdVertical = value;
					VerifyAutoCollapseState();
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.AutoCollapseThresholdVertical);
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public int AutoCollapseThresholdVerticalResolved
		{
			get
			{
				bool flag = toolbarsManager != null && toolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer is Form;
				if (flag && toolbarsManager.EnforceOffice2007Resolution)
				{
					return 250;
				}
				if (autoCollapseThresholdVertical != -1)
				{
					return autoCollapseThresholdVertical;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					return 250;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

					throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("RibbonNotSupportedWhenMerging"));
				}
				if (value && toolbarsManager != null && toolbarsManager.Office2007UICompatibility && toolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer != null && (!(toolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer is Form form) || (!IsDesignMode && !form.TopLevel)))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("RibbonCannotBeShownInContainer"));

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_Ribbon_P_DisplayMode")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		public RibbonDisplayMode DisplayMode
		{
			get
			{
				return displayMode;
			}
			set
			{
				//IL_006a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_006f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0070: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0081: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0088: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_0073: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0075: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(RibbonDisplayMode), value))
				{
					throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("value", (int)value, typeof(RibbonDisplayMode));
				}
				if (value == RibbonDisplayMode.AutoHide && !AllowAutoHideResolved && toolbarsManager != null && !toolbarsManager.Initializing)
				{
					bool flag = !toolbarsManager.IsGlassSupportedResolved;
					if (!Visible)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					else
					{
						DefaultableBoolean val = allowAutoHide;
						if ((int)val != 0)
						{
							if ((int)val == 2)
							{
								flag = true;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							flag = (int)toolbarsManager.StyleResolved != 9;
						}
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Ribbon_CannotSetToAutoHide_Exception"));
					}
				}
				if (displayMode == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				bool isMinimized_Legacy = IsMinimized_Legacy;
				if (value != RibbonDisplayMode.Full && ToolbarsManager != null && !ToolbarsManager.ExitEditMode())
				{
					return;
				}
				displayMode = value;
				Metrics.Dirty(RibbonMetricsFlags.RibbonMinimizedChanged);
				ClearItemWithFocus();
				if (DisplayModeResolved != RibbonDisplayMode.Full)
				{
					if (selectedTab != null)
					{
						selectedTab.HideContainedControls();
					}
					ToolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(null, setOn: false, clearToolBeingEdited: true);
					ToolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture = null;
					if (displayMode == RibbonDisplayMode.TabsOnly)
					{
						InitializeTabManagerSelectedTab(null, ignoreSelectedTabEvents: true);
					}
					else if ((object)TabManager.SelectedTabItem != selectedTab)
					{
						InitializeTabManagerSelectedTab((ITabItem)(object)selectedTab, ignoreSelectedTabEvents: true);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (IsTabPopupOpen)
					{
						TabMenuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay: false);
					}
					if (IsAutoHidePopupOpen)
					{
						AutoHideMenuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay: false);
					}
					if ((object)TabManager.SelectedTabItem != selectedTab)
					{
						InitializeTabManagerSelectedTab((ITabItem)(object)selectedTab, ignoreSelectedTabEvents: true);
					}
				}
				if (isMinimized_Legacy || displayMode == RibbonDisplayMode.TabsOnly)
				{
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.IsMinimized);
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.DisplayMode);
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				Form form = ToolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer as Form;
				FormCaptionButtons formCaptionButtons = (FormCaptionButtons)0;
				if (form != null && form.IsMdiContainer)
				{
					Form activeMdiChild = form.ActiveMdiChild;
					if (activeMdiChild != null && activeMdiChild.WindowState == FormWindowState.Maximized)
					{
						if (activeMdiChild.ControlBox)
						{
							formCaptionButtons |= FormCaptionButtons.Close;
						}
						if (activeMdiChild.MaximizeBox)
						{
							formCaptionButtons |= FormCaptionButtons.Restore;
						}
						if (activeMdiChild.MinimizeBox)
						{
							formCaptionButtons |= FormCaptionButtons.Minimize;
						}
					}
				}
				return formCaptionButtons;
			}
		}

					return FileMenuStyle.None;
				}

				if (ultraToolbarsManager != null && ultraToolbarsManager.Office2007UICompatibility)
				{
					ToolbarStyle styleResolved = ultraToolbarsManager.StyleResolved;
					switch (styleResolved - 7)

					case 2:

		internal bool AllowAutoHideResolved
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0043: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

				//IL_0047: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4

			}

					return RibbonDisplayMode.Full;

			}
