		public void ShowRibbonCustomizationDialog(RibbonCustomizationType customizationType)
		{
			if (ribbonCustomizationProvider == null || ToolbarsManager == null || (customizationType == RibbonCustomizationType.QuickAccessToolbar && !ribbonCustomizationProvider.AllowQATCustomizationResolved) || (customizationType == RibbonCustomizationType.Ribbon && !ribbonCustomizationProvider.AllowRibbonCustomizationResolved))
			{
				return;
			}
			BeforeRibbonCustomizationDialogDisplayedEventArgs e = new BeforeRibbonCustomizationDialogDisplayedEventArgs(customizationType);
			ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.BeforeRibbonCustomizationDialogDisplayed, e);
			if (e.Cancel)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = new UltraToolbarsManager();
			try
			{
				ultraToolbarsManager.ForceControlNameToExtraSharedProps = true;
				CopyToolbarsManager(ToolbarsManager, ultraToolbarsManager);
				ultraToolbarsManager.Office2007UICompatibility = ToolbarsManager.Office2007UICompatibility;
				ultraToolbarsManager.ImageListLarge = ToolbarsManager.ImageListLarge;
				ultraToolbarsManager.ImageListSmall = ToolbarsManager.ImageListSmall;
				ultraToolbarsManager.ImageSizeLarge = ToolbarsManager.ImageSizeLarge;
				ultraToolbarsManager.ImageSizeSmall = ToolbarsManager.ImageSizeSmall;
				ultraToolbarsManager.ImageListTouchLarge = ToolbarsManager.ImageListTouchLarge;
				ultraToolbarsManager.ImageListTouchSmall = ToolbarsManager.ImageListTouchSmall;
				ultraToolbarsManager.ImageSizeTouchLarge = ToolbarsManager.ImageSizeTouchLarge;
				ultraToolbarsManager.ImageSizeTouchSmall = ToolbarsManager.ImageSizeTouchSmall;
				ultraToolbarsManager.HasBeenRibbonCustomized = ToolbarsManager.HasBeenRibbonCustomized;
				ultraToolbarsManager.restorePointStream = new MemoryStream();
				ToolbarsManager.restorePointStream.WriteTo(ultraToolbarsManager.restorePointStream);
				UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager2 = null;
				UltraToolbarsManager activeMdiChildManager = ToolbarsManager.ActiveMdiChildManager;
				if (activeMdiChildManager != null)
				{
					ultraToolbarsManager2 = new UltraToolbarsManager();
					ultraToolbarsManager2.ForceControlNameToExtraSharedProps = true;
					CopyToolbarsManager(activeMdiChildManager, ultraToolbarsManager2);
					ultraToolbarsManager2.Office2007UICompatibility = activeMdiChildManager.Office2007UICompatibility;
					ultraToolbarsManager2.ImageListLarge = activeMdiChildManager.ImageListLarge;
					ultraToolbarsManager2.ImageListSmall = activeMdiChildManager.ImageListSmall;
					ultraToolbarsManager2.ImageSizeLarge = activeMdiChildManager.ImageSizeLarge;
					ultraToolbarsManager2.ImageSizeSmall = activeMdiChildManager.ImageSizeSmall;
					ultraToolbarsManager2.ImageListTouchLarge = activeMdiChildManager.ImageListTouchLarge;
					ultraToolbarsManager2.ImageListTouchSmall = activeMdiChildManager.ImageListTouchSmall;
					ultraToolbarsManager2.ImageSizeTouchLarge = activeMdiChildManager.ImageSizeTouchLarge;
					ultraToolbarsManager2.ImageSizeTouchSmall = activeMdiChildManager.ImageSizeTouchSmall;
					ultraToolbarsManager2.RibbonCustomizationInProgress = true;
					if (!activeMdiChildManager.HasRestorePoint)
					{
						activeMdiChildManager.CreateRestorePoint();
					}
					ultraToolbarsManager2.restorePointStream = new MemoryStream();
					activeMdiChildManager.restorePointStream.WriteTo(ultraToolbarsManager2.restorePointStream);
					ultraToolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveMdiChildManager(ultraToolbarsManager2, calledFromMdiChildActivate: false);
				}
				ultraToolbarsManager.RibbonCustomizationInProgress = true;
				UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager3 = ToolbarsManager;
				DialogResult dialogResult = ribbonCustomizationProvider.ShowCustomizationDialog(ultraToolbarsManager, customizationType);
				if (dialogResult == DialogResult.OK)
				{
					ultraToolbarsManager3.HasBeenRibbonCustomized = true;
					CopyToolbarsManager(ultraToolbarsManager, ultraToolbarsManager3);
				}
				ultraToolbarsManager3.Ribbon.DirtyAllMetrics();
				AfterRibbonCustomizationDialogClosedEventArgs e2 = new AfterRibbonCustomizationDialogClosedEventArgs(dialogResult);
				ultraToolbarsManager3.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.AfterRibbonCustomizationDialogClosed, e2);
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)ultraToolbarsManager)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private void CopyToolbarsManager(UltraToolbarsManager srcToolbarsManager, UltraToolbarsManager destToolbarsManager)
		{
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			srcToolbarsManager.SaveAsBinary(memoryStream, saveCustomizations: true);
			memoryStream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			destToolbarsManager.LoadFromBinary(memoryStream);
		}

		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (caption == null && (int)groupBorderStyle == 0 && !ShouldSerializeContextualTabGroups() && !ShouldSerializeTag() && !ShouldSerializeApplicationMenu() && !ShouldSerializeGroupSettings() && !ShouldSerializeIsMinimized() && !ShouldSerializeQuickAccessToolbar() && !ShouldSerializeTabs() && !visible && !ShouldSerializeTabSettings() && AutoCollapseThresholdHorizontal == -1 && AutoCollapseThresholdVertical == -1 && (appearances == null || !appearances.ShouldSerialize()) && applicationMenuButtonImage == null && reservedKeyTipToolTipText == null && reservedKeyTipToolTipTitle == null && reserveMenuBarKeyTips && !ShouldSerializeTabItemToolbar() && captionInactive == null && !ShouldSerializeAccessibleDescription() && !ShouldSerializeFileMenuButtonCaption() && !ShouldSerializeFileMenuButtonCaptionVisible() && !ShouldSerializeFileMenuStyle() && !ShouldSerializeApplicationMenu2010() && !ShouldSerializeRibbonCustomizationProvider() && !ShouldSerializeAllowAutoHide() && !ShouldSerializeTabItemAreaDisplayStyle() && !ShouldSerializeNotificationBadgeSettings() && !ShouldSerializeCaptionButtonsAppearances() && !ShouldSerializeDefaultCaptionButtonsAppearances() && !ShouldSerializeMaximizedMdiChildFormCaptionButtonsAppearances())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeMultiMonitorDropDownBehavior();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			Caption = null;
			ResetContextualTabGroups();

		internal Size CalculateGroupCaptionSize(RibbonGroup group)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
			AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)137438953471L;
			ResolveGroupCaptionAppearance(group, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			System.Drawing.ContentAlignment contentAlignment = AppearanceData.ContentAlignmentFromHVAlign(((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ImageHAlign, ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ImageVAlign);
			string text = ((group != null) ? group.Caption : "Wj");
			Control ribbonContainer = (Control)(object)RibbonContainer;
			Size size = ((ribbonContainer == null) ? Size.Empty : ImageAndTextUIElement.CalculateTextSize(text, HotkeyPrefix.None, false, (Control)(object)RibbonContainer, ref appearance));
			Size imageSize = ImageSize;
			Size result = ImageAndTextUIElement.CalculateImageAndTextSize(imageSize, size, Size.Empty, Size.Empty, Size.Empty, false, (UIElementBorderStyle)1, (Border3DSide)0, contentAlignment);
			Size dialogBoxLauncherSize = Metrics.DialogBoxLauncherSize;
			if (group == null || group.IsDialogBoxLauncherVisible)
			{
				result.Width += dialogBoxLauncherSize.Width + 2;
				result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, dialogBoxLauncherSize.Height);
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal bool CanHotTrack(RibbonGroup group)
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (ultraToolbarsManager == null || ultraToolbarsManager.IsDesignMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ultraToolbarsManager.CurrentPopupControl != null)
			{
				MenuAgentBase menuAgent = ultraToolbarsManager.CurrentPopupControl.MenuAgent;
				if (menuAgent is RibbonTabMenuAgent)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (menuAgent is RibbonGroupMenuAgent && ((RibbonGroupMenuAgent)menuAgent).Group == group)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (menuAgent is BackStageMenuAgent)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (menuAgent is RibbonAutoHideMenuAgent)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (!ultraToolbarsManager.IsFormActiveInternal)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void DisplayFormCaptionToolTip(SystemButtonId id)
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager == null || ToolbarsManager.ToolTipDisplayStyle == ToolTipDisplayStyle.None)
			{
				return;
			}
			Form form = ((ToolbarsManager != null) ? (ToolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer as Form) : null);
			if (form == null || !form.IsHandleCreated)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = null;
			if (id == SystemButtonId.RibbonDisplayOptions)
			{
				text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("RibbonDisplayOptions");
			}
			else
			{
				try
				{
					IntPtr systemMenuApi = NativeWindowMethods.GetSystemMenuApi(form.Handle, revert: false);
					if (systemMenuApi != IntPtr.Zero)
					{
						StringBuilder lpString = new StringBuilder(100);
						int menuStringApi = NativeWindowMethods.GetMenuStringApi(systemMenuApi, (uint)id, ref lpString, lpString.Capacity, 0u);
						if (menuStringApi > 0)
						{
							text = lpString.ToString();
							int num = text.IndexOf('\t');
							if (num >= 0)
							{
								text = text.Substring(0, num);
							}
							text = Utilities.StripMnemonics(text);
						}
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			if (text != null)
			{
				toolbarsManager.DisplayToolTip(text);
			}
		}

		internal static RibbonLayoutItemDirection GetDirection(Keys keyCode)
		{
			RibbonLayoutItemDirection result = (RibbonLayoutItemDirection)(-1);
			switch (keyCode)
			{
			case Keys.Left:
				result = RibbonLayoutItemDirection.Left;
				break;
			case Keys.Right:
				result = RibbonLayoutItemDirection.Right;
				break;
			case Keys.Up:
				result = RibbonLayoutItemDirection.Above;
				break;
			case Keys.Down:
				result = RibbonLayoutItemDirection.Below;
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		}

		internal UIElement GetRibbonElement(Type elementType, object context)
		{
			IUltraControlElement ribbonContainer = (IUltraControlElement)(object)RibbonContainer;
			ControlUIElementBase val = ((ribbonContainer != null) ? ribbonContainer.MainUIElement : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (context != null)
			{
				return ((UIElement)val).GetDescendant(elementType, context);
			}
			return ((UIElement)val).GetDescendant(elementType);
		}

		internal UIElementBorderWidths GetGroupBorderWidths()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00ac: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UIElementBorderStyle groupBorderStyleResolved = GroupBorderStyleResolved;
			UIElementBorderWidths result = CalculateBorderWidths(groupBorderStyleResolved);
			if ((int)groupBorderStyleResolved == 11 && ToolbarsManager != null && !((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)ToolbarsManager).UseFlatModeResolved)
			{
				((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref result)).Left = ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref result)).Left + 1;
				((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref result)).Right = ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref result)).Right + 2;
			}
			else
			{
				int left = ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref result)).Left;
				((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref result)).Left = left + 1;
				left = ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref result)).Right;
				((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref result)).Right = left + 1;
			}
			switch (Style)
			{
			case RibbonStyle.Scenic:
				((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref result)).Right = ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref result)).Right + 4;
				((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref result)).Top = ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref result)).Top + 4;
				break;
			case RibbonStyle.Office2010:
			{
				int padding = 0;
				UIElementBorderStyle borderStyle = (UIElementBorderStyle)1;
				int groupSeparatorWidthOffice = RibbonMetrics.GetGroupSeparatorWidthOffice2010(out padding, out borderStyle);
				((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref result)).Right = ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref result)).Right + groupSeparatorWidthOffice;
				((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref result)).Top = ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref result)).Top + 1;
				break;
			}
			case RibbonStyle.Office2013:
				((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref result)).Right = ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref result)).Right + 4;
				((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref result)).Top = ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref result)).Top + 1;
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal FormCaptionButtons GetCaptionAreaButtons(bool honorMdiChildActivation, bool isAutoHideState)
		{
			//IL_0091: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0097: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_009f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a5: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00f6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00fc: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			Form form = ToolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer as Form;
			FormCaptionButtons formCaptionButtons = (FormCaptionButtons)0;
			if (AllowAutoHideResolved && !IsOffice2013StyleBackStageOpen)
			{
				formCaptionButtons |= FormCaptionButtons.RibbonDisplayOptions;
			}
			Form form2 = ((form == null) ? null : ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetMdiParent(form));
			if (form != null && (form2 == null || form.WindowState != FormWindowState.Maximized) && ToolbarsManager.IsFormRounded && !ToolbarsManager.HasGlassArea)
			{
				if (!form.ControlBox)
				{
					return formCaptionButtons;
				}
				if (honorMdiChildActivation && form.IsMdiChild && form2 != null && form2.ActiveMdiChild != form && ((int)ToolbarsManager.CurrentToolbarFormBorderStyle == 1 || (int)ToolbarsManager.CurrentToolbarFormBorderStyle == 5))
				{
					return (FormCaptionButtons)0;
				}
				formCaptionButtons |= FormCaptionButtons.Close;
				if (isAutoHideState)
				{
					return formCaptionButtons;
				}
				if (form.MaximizeBox || form.MinimizeBox)
				{
					formCaptionButtons = ((form.WindowState != FormWindowState.Maximized) ? (formCaptionButtons | FormCaptionButtons.Maximize) : (formCaptionButtons | FormCaptionButtons.Restore));
					formCaptionButtons = ((form.WindowState != FormWindowState.Minimized) ? (formCaptionButtons | FormCaptionButtons.Minimize) : (formCaptionButtons | FormCaptionButtons.Restore));
					if (form.HelpButton && (int)ToolbarsManager.CurrentToolbarFormBorderStyle == 6)
					{
						formCaptionButtons |= FormCaptionButtons.ContextHelp;
					}
				}
				else if (form.HelpButton)
				{
					formCaptionButtons |= FormCaptionButtons.ContextHelp;
				}
			}
			return formCaptionButtons;
		}

		internal void GetGroupsThatMatchMnemonic(char charCode, List<RibbonGroup> groupsForThisMnemonic)
		{
			if (VisibleResolved && IsTabPageInView && SelectedTab != null)
			{
				SelectedTab.GetGroupsThatMatchMnemonic(charCode, groupsForThisMnemonic);
			}
		}

		internal void GetTabsThatMatchMnemonic(char charCode, List<RibbonTab> tabsForThisMnemonic)
		{
			if (!VisibleResolved || tabs == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (RibbonTab visibleTab in tabs.VisibleTabs)
			{
				if (visibleTab.IsMnemonic(charCode))
				{
					tabsForThisMnemonic.Add(visibleTab);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void GetToolsThatMatchMnemonic(char charCode, List<IProcessMnemonic> toolsForThisMnemonic)
		{
			if (VisibleResolved && IsTabPageInView && SelectedTab != null)
			{
				SelectedTab.GetToolsThatMatchMnemonic(charCode, toolsForThisMnemonic);
			}
		}

		internal static string GetUniqueKey(KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase keyedCollection, string defaultKey)
		{
			int num = 1;
			string text;
			do
			{
				text = defaultKey + num;
				num++;
			}
			while (keyedCollection.Exists(text));
			return text;
		}

		internal void HookupAllSubObjects()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Tabs.Count; i++)
			{
				Tabs[i].HookupAllSubObjects();
			}
			if (applicationMenu != null)
			{
				applicationMenu.HookupAllSubObjects();
			}
			if (applicationMenu2010 != null)
			{
				applicationMenu2010.HookupAllSubObjects();
			}
			if (quickAccessToolbar != null)
			{
				quickAccessToolbar.HookupAllSubObjects();
			}
			if (tabItemToolbar != null)
			{
				tabItemToolbar.HookupTools();
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (ultraToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				ToolsCollectionBase tools = ultraToolbarsManager.Tools;
				for (int num = tools.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					if (tools[num] is PopupRibbonGroupTool { UnderlyingGroup: null } popupRibbonGroupTool)
					{
						int j = 0;
						for (int count = Tabs.Count; j < count; j++)
						{
							RibbonTab ribbonTab = Tabs[j];
							int k = 0;
							for (int count2 = ribbonTab.Groups.Count; k < count2; k++)
							{
								RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = ribbonTab.Groups[k];
								if (ribbonGroup.GetPopupGroupKey() == popupRibbonGroupTool.Key)
								{
									ribbonGroup.HookUpDeserializedPopupGroup(popupRibbonGroupTool);
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (HasCaptionButtonsAppearances)
			{
				CaptionButtonsAppearances.InitializeOwner(ToolbarsManager);
			}
			if (HasDefaultCaptionButtonsAppearances)
			{
				DefaultCaptionButtonsAppearances.InitializeOwner(ToolbarsManager);
			}
			if (HasMaximizedMdiChildFormCaptionButtonsAppearances)
			{
				MaximizedMdiChildFormCaptionButtonsAppearances.InitializeOwner(ToolbarsManager);
			}
			VerifyContextualTabs();
			DirtyAllMetrics();
			VerifySelectedTab();
		}

		internal void Initialize(UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager)
		{
			this.toolbarsManager = toolbarsManager;
			if (this.toolbarsManager != null)
			{
				if (quickAccessToolbar != null)
				{
					quickAccessToolbar.Initialize(this);
				}
				if (contextualTabGroups != null)
				{
					contextualTabGroups.Initialize(this);
				}
				if (applicationMenu != null)
				{
					applicationMenu.Initialize(this);
				}
				if (applicationMenu2010 != null)
				{
					applicationMenu2010.Initialize(this);
				}
				if (tabItemToolbar != null)
				{
					tabItemToolbar.Initialize(this);
				}
				if (groupSettings != null)
				{
					groupSettings.Initialize(this);
				}
				if (tabs != null)
				{
					tabs.Initialize(this);
				}
				if (tabSettings != null)
				{
					tabSettings.Initialize(this);
				}
				if (appearances != null && this.toolbarsManager != null)
				{
					appearances.Appearances = this.toolbarsManager.Appearances;
				}
				VerifyContextualTabs();
				VerifySelectedTab();
				Metrics.Dirty(RibbonMetricsFlags.AllMetrics);
			}
		}

		internal bool IsSystemMenuVisibleInCaption(bool honorMdiChildActivation)
		{
			if (toolbarsManager != null && toolbarsManager.IsFormRounded)
			{
				if (!(toolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer is Form { ShowIcon: not false } form))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (IsOnInactiveMdiChild)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!form.ControlBox)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!visible)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (FileMenuButtonStyleResolved != FileMenuButtonStyle.Orb && IsCaptionAreaVisible)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void InvalidateApplicationMenuButton()
		{
			UIElement ribbonElement = GetRibbonElement(typeof(ApplicationMenuButtonUIElementBase));
			if (ribbonElement != null)
			{
				ribbonElement.Invalidate();
			}
			if (applicationMenu != null && applicationMenu.IsOpen)
			{
				UIElement descendant = ((UIElement)applicationMenu.MenuAgent.PopupControl.GetControlUIElement()).GetDescendant(typeof(ApplicationMenuButtonUIElementBase));
				if (descendant != null)
				{
					descendant.Invalidate();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void MarkInheritedItems()
		{
			if (tabs != null && tabs.Count > 0)
			{
				hasInheritedTabs = true;
				for (int i = 0; i < tabs.Count; i++)
				{
					tabs[i].Inherited = true;
				}
			}
			if (contextualTabGroups != null && contextualTabGroups.Count > 0)
			{
				hasInheritedContextualTabGroups = true;
				for (int j = 0; j < contextualTabGroups.Count; j++)
				{
					contextualTabGroups[j].Inherited = true;
				}
			}
			if (quickAccessToolbar != null && quickAccessToolbar.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				quickAccessToolbar.Inherited = true;
			}
			if (applicationMenu != null)
			{
				applicationMenu.MarkInheritedItems();
			}
		}

		internal void MergeMdiChild(Ribbon childRibbon)
		{
			UltraToolbarsDockArea ribbonContainer = RibbonContainer;
			MergeMdiChildTabs(childRibbon);
			ribbonContainer?.ReparentContainedControls(SelectedTab, takeOwnership: true);
			if (HasApplicationMenu || childRibbon.HasApplicationMenu)
			{
				ApplicationMenu.MergeMdiChild(childRibbon.ApplicationMenu);
			}
			if (HasApplicationMenu2010 || childRibbon.HasApplicationMenu2010)
			{
				ApplicationMenu2010.MergeMdiChild(childRibbon.ApplicationMenu2010);
			}
			if (HasQuickAccessToolbar || childRibbon.HasQuickAccessToolbar)
			{
				QuickAccessToolbar.MergeMdiChildToolbar(childRibbon.QuickAccessToolbar);
			}
			if (HasTabItemToolbar || childRibbon.HasTabItemToolbar)
			{
				TabItemToolbar.MergeMdiChildToolbar(childRibbon.TabItemToolbar);
			}
			DirtyAllMetrics();
		}

		internal void OnCustomizeModeBegin()
		{
			if (quickAccessToolbar != null)
			{
				quickAccessToolbar.OnCustomizeModeBegin();
			}
			if (tabItemToolbar != null)
			{
				tabItemToolbar.OnCustomizeModeBegin();
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Tabs.Count; i++)
			{
				Tabs[i].OnCustomizeModeBegin();
			}
			if (IsDesignMode)
			{
				Metrics.Dirty(RibbonMetricsFlags.QatSizeChanged);
				Metrics.Dirty(RibbonMetricsFlags.TabItemAreaHeight);
				DirtyTabManager(TabManagerChangeType.Collection | TabManagerChangeType.AllMetrics);
				Tabs.DirtyVisibleTabs();
			}
		}

		internal void OnCustomizeModeEnd()
		{
			if (IsDesignMode)
			{
				Metrics.Dirty(RibbonMetricsFlags.QatSizeChanged);
				Tabs.DirtyVisibleTabs();
				Metrics.Dirty(RibbonMetricsFlags.TabItemAreaHeight);
				DirtyTabManager(TabManagerChangeType.Collection | TabManagerChangeType.AllMetrics);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Tabs.Count; i++)
			{
				Tabs[i].OnCustomizeModeEnd();
			}
			if (tabItemToolbar != null)
			{
				tabItemToolbar.OnCustomizeModeEnd();
			}
			if (quickAccessToolbar != null)
			{
				quickAccessToolbar.OnCustomizeModeEnd();
			}
		}

		internal void OnFormCaptionButtonClicked(SystemButtonId id)
		{
			if (id == SystemButtonId.RibbonDisplayOptions)
			{
				OnRibbonDisplayOptionsButtonClick();
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(ToolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer is Form form) || (!form.TopLevel && form.MdiParent == null) || !form.IsHandleCreated)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (id == SystemButtonId.Close)
				{
					ToolbarsManager.PopupManager.CloseAllPopups();
				}
				try
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.PostMessageApi(new HandleRef(form, form.Handle), 274, new IntPtr((int)id), IntPtr.Zero);
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					switch (id)
					{
					case SystemButtonId.Close:
						form.Close();
						break;
					case SystemButtonId.Maximize:
						form.WindowState = FormWindowState.Maximized;
						break;
					case SystemButtonId.Minimize:
						form.WindowState = FormWindowState.Minimized;
						break;
					case SystemButtonId.Restore:
						form.WindowState = FormWindowState.Normal;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsFormCaptionButtonEnabled(SystemButtonId id)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			Form form = ToolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer as Form;
			if (id == SystemButtonId.RibbonDisplayOptions)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (form != null && (form.TopLevel || form.IsMdiChild))
			{
				switch (id)
				{
				case SystemButtonId.Close:
					flag = form.ControlBox;
					break;
				case SystemButtonId.Minimize:
					flag = form.MinimizeBox;
					break;
				case SystemButtonId.Maximize:
					flag = form.MaximizeBox;
					break;
				case SystemButtonId.Restore:
					if (form.WindowState == FormWindowState.Minimized)
					{
						flag = form.MinimizeBox;
					}
					else if (form.WindowState == FormWindowState.Maximized)
					{
						flag = form.MaximizeBox;
					}
					break;
				case SystemButtonId.ContextHelp:
					flag = form.HelpButton;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (flag && id != SystemButtonId.ContextHelp)
			{
				try
				{
					IntPtr systemMenuApi = NativeWindowMethods.GetSystemMenuApi(form.Handle, revert: false);
					uint menuStateApi = NativeWindowMethods.GetMenuStateApi(systemMenuApi, (uint)id, 0u);
					if (menuStateApi == uint.MaxValue)
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					else if ((menuStateApi & 3) != 0)
					{
						flag = false;
					}
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
				}
			}
			return flag;
		}

		internal void OnRibbonContainerResized()
		{
			if (refreshingDockAreaSize)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = isInOnRibbonContainerResized;
			isInOnRibbonContainerResized = true;
			try
			{
				int ribbonContainerExtent = RibbonContainerExtent;
				if (ribbonContainerExtent != lastRibbonContainerExtent)
				{
					lastRibbonContainerExtent = ribbonContainerExtent;
					Metrics.Dirty(RibbonMetricsFlags.CaptionAreaHeight);
					for (int i = 0; i < Tabs.Count; i++)
					{
						RibbonTab ribbonTab = Tabs[i];
						if (ribbonTab != SelectedTab)
						{
							ribbonTab.ScrollPosition = 0;
						}
					}
				}
				if (HasApplicationMenu2010 && ApplicationMenu2010.IsOpen && ApplicationMenu2010.MenuAgent is BackStageMenuAgent backStageMenuAgent && IsDesignMode)
				{
					backStageMenuAgent.RecalculateDropdownSize();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				isInOnRibbonContainerResized = flag;
			}
		}

		internal void ProcessManagerPropertyChange(PropChangeInfo pci)
		{
			if (toolbarsManager == null || pci.PropId.Equals(PropertyIds.Ribbon) || !(pci.PropId is PropertyIds) || ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)toolbarsManager).IsUpdating)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch ((PropertyIds)(object)pci.PropId)
			{
			case PropertyIds.Appearance:
				if (pci.Trigger == null || IsFontDataChange(pci.Trigger))
				{
					DirtyAllMetrics();
				}
				break;
			case PropertyIds.Style:
			case PropertyIds.ImageSizeLarge:
			case PropertyIds.ImageSizeSmall:
				DirtyAllMetrics();
				break;
			case PropertyIds.UseLargeImagesOnToolbar:
				Metrics.Dirty(RibbonMetricsFlags.QatSizeChanged);
				break;
			case PropertyIds.Tools:
				Metrics.OnToolsChanged(pci);
				break;
			}
		}

		internal bool ProcessNavigationKey(Keys keyCode)
		{
			if (itemWithFocus == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (keyCode)
			{
			case Keys.Tab:
			case Keys.Left:
			case Keys.Up:
			case Keys.Right:
			case Keys.Down:
			{
				RibbonItem ribbonItem = ((keyCode == Keys.Tab) ? ProcessTabKey(itemWithFocus, this) : ProcessArrowKey(keyCode, itemWithFocus));
				if (ribbonItem != null)
				{
					SetItemWithFocus(ribbonItem);
				}
				return true;
			}
			case Keys.Return:
			case Keys.Space:
				if (itemWithFocus == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				switch (itemWithFocus.ItemType)
				{
				case RibbonItemType.ApplicationMenu:
					OnApplicationMenuButtonClick();
					return true;
				case RibbonItemType.SystemMenu:
					ToolbarsManager.ShowSystemMenu(showApplicationMenuIfVisible: false, null);
					return true;
				case RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDropDownButton:
					if (itemWithFocus.Context is RibbonGroup ribbonGroup)
					{
						ribbonGroup.DropDown();
						if (ribbonGroup.IsGroupPopupOpen)
						{
							ribbonGroup.GroupMenuAgent.ItemWithFocus = ribbonGroup.GroupMenuAgent.GroupLayout.GetFirstActivatableItem(includeDialogBoxLauncher: true);
						}
						return true;
					}
					break;
				case RibbonItemType.TabItemToolbarTool:
				case RibbonItemType.QatTool:
				case RibbonItemType.RibbonTool:
				case RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDialogBoxLauncher:
					if (itemWithFocus.Context is ToolBase { EnabledResolved: not false } toolBase)
					{
						return toolBase.OnEnterKeyPressed();
					}
					break;
				case RibbonItemType.TabItem:
					if (!(itemWithFocus.Context is RibbonTab ribbonTab))
					{
						break;
					}
					if (!IsMinimized_Legacy)
					{
						ClearItemWithFocus();
						return true;
					}
					SelectedTab = ribbonTab;
					if (IsMinimized_Legacy && SelectedTab == ribbonTab)
					{
						DropDown();
						if (IsTabPopupOpen && TabMenuAgent.ItemWithFocus == null)
						{
							TabMenuAgent.ItemWithFocus = SelectedTab.GetFirstActivatableItem(includeDialogBoxLauncher: true);
						}
					}
					return true;
				}
				break;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal RibbonItem ProcessTabKey(RibbonItem itemWithFocus, object navigationSource)
		{
			if (itemWithFocus == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			bool flag = (Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Shift) == Keys.Shift;
			List<RibbonTabOperation> list = new List<RibbonTabOperation>((IEnumerable<RibbonTabOperation>)Enum.GetValues(typeof(RibbonTabOperation)));
			if (flag)
			{
				list.Reverse();
			}
			RibbonTabOperation startingTabOperation = GetStartingTabOperation(itemWithFocus.ItemType);
			int count = list.Count;
			int num = list.IndexOf(startingTabOperation) % count;
			TabItemAreaDisplayStyle tabItemAreaDisplayStyleResolved = TabItemAreaDisplayStyleResolved;
			object context = itemWithFocus.Context;
			object obj = context;
			RibbonTab ribbonTab = navigationSource as RibbonTab;
			bool flag2 = false;
			bool flag3 = false;
			if (ribbonTab == null)
			{
				if (navigationSource is Ribbon)
				{
					flag2 = true;
					ribbonTab = SelectedTab;
				}
				else
				{
					ribbonTab = null;
					if (navigationSource is RibbonGroup)
					{
						flag3 = true;
					}
				}
			}
			RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = context as RibbonGroup;
			int i = num;
			for (int num2 = num + count; i < num2; i++)
			{
				RibbonTabOperation ribbonTabOperation = list[i % count];
				switch (ribbonTabOperation)
				{
				case RibbonTabOperation.FileOrSystemMenu:
					if (i != num && flag2)
					{
						if (FileMenuStyleResolved == FileMenuStyle.ApplicationMenu)
						{
							return new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.ApplicationMenu, this);
						}
						if (IsSystemMenuVisibleInCaption(honorMdiChildActivation: true))
						{
							return new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.SystemMenu, this);
						}
					}
					break;
				case RibbonTabOperation.TopQatTool:
				case RibbonTabOperation.BottomQatTool:
					if (flag2 && (ribbonTabOperation != RibbonTabOperation.TopQatTool || IsQatAboveRibbon) && (ribbonTabOperation != RibbonTabOperation.BottomQatTool || IsQatBelowRibbon))
					{
						ToolBase startingTool2 = null;
						if (obj is ToolBase && ((ToolBase)obj).Owner is QuickAccessToolbar)
						{
							startingTool2 = obj as ToolBase;
						}
						RibbonItem ribbonItem2 = CreateQatItem(!flag, startingTool2, canBeOnTop: true, canBeOnBottom: true);
						if (ribbonItem2 != null)
						{
							return ribbonItem2;
						}
						obj = null;
					}
					break;
				case RibbonTabOperation.DialogBoxLauncherInGroup:
				{
					RibbonGroup ribbonGroup4 = obj as RibbonGroup;
					if (i != num || obj != context)
					{
						if (ribbonGroup4 == null && ribbonTab != null)
						{
							obj = (ribbonGroup4 = ribbonTab.GetPreviousRibbonGroup(null, visibleOnly: true));
							if (ribbonGroup == null)
							{
								ribbonGroup = ribbonGroup4;
							}
						}
						if (ribbonGroup4 != null && !ribbonGroup4.Layout.IsCollapsed && ribbonGroup4.IsDialogBoxLauncherActivatable)
						{
							return new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDialogBoxLauncher, ribbonGroup4);
						}
					}
					else if (obj is ToolBase)
					{
						obj = null;
					}
					if (!flag && ribbonGroup4 != null)
					{
						if (!flag3)
						{
							obj = ribbonGroup4.Tab.GetNextRibbonGroup(ribbonGroup4, visibleOnly: true);
						}
						if (obj == null && ribbonTab != null)
						{
							obj = ribbonGroup4.Tab.GetNextRibbonGroup(null, visibleOnly: true);
						}
						if (obj != null && obj != ribbonGroup)
						{
							i = list.IndexOf(RibbonTabOperation.GroupOnSelectedTab) - 1;
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				case RibbonTabOperation.GroupOnSelectedTab:
				{
					RibbonGroup ribbonGroup3 = obj as RibbonGroup;
					if (i != num || obj != context)
					{
						if (ribbonGroup3 == null && ribbonTab != null)
						{
							obj = (ribbonGroup3 = ribbonTab.GetNextRibbonGroup(null, visibleOnly: true));
							if (ribbonGroup == null)
							{
								ribbonGroup = ribbonGroup3;
							}
						}
						if (ribbonGroup3 != null && ribbonGroup3.Layout.IsCollapsed && !flag3)
						{
							return new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDropDownButton, ribbonGroup3);
						}
					}
					else if (obj is ToolBase)
					{
						obj = null;
					}
					if (flag && ribbonGroup3 != null)
					{
						if (!flag3)
						{
							obj = ribbonGroup3.Tab.GetPreviousRibbonGroup(ribbonGroup3, visibleOnly: true);
						}
						if (obj == null && ribbonTab != null)
						{
							obj = ribbonGroup3.Tab.GetPreviousRibbonGroup(null, visibleOnly: true);
						}
						if (obj != null && obj != ribbonGroup)
						{
							i = list.IndexOf(RibbonTabOperation.DialogBoxLauncherInGroup) - 1;
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				case RibbonTabOperation.RibbonGroupTool:
				{
					ToolBase toolBase = null;
					RibbonGroup ribbonGroup2;
					if (obj is ToolBase && ((ToolBase)obj).Owner is RibbonGroup)
					{
						toolBase = obj as ToolBase;
						ribbonGroup2 = toolBase.OwningRibbonGroup;
					}
					else
					{
						ribbonGroup2 = obj as RibbonGroup;
						if (ribbonGroup2 == null || (ribbonGroup2.Layout.IsCollapsed && !flag3))
						{
							break;
						}
					}
					RibbonToolLayoutItem startingItem = ((toolBase != null) ? ribbonGroup2.Layout.FindToolLayoutItem(toolBase) : null);
					RibbonToolLayoutItem ribbonToolLayoutItem = ((!flag) ? ribbonGroup2.Layout.GetNextToolLayoutItem(startingItem, requireSelectable: true, requireVisible: true) : ribbonGroup2.Layout.GetPrevToolLayoutItem(startingItem, requireSelectable: true, requireVisible: true));
					if (ribbonToolLayoutItem != null)
					{
						return new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.RibbonTool, ribbonToolLayoutItem.Tool);
					}
					obj = ribbonGroup2;
					break;
				}
				case RibbonTabOperation.SelectedTab:
					if (i != num && flag2 && tabItemAreaDisplayStyleResolved == TabItemAreaDisplayStyle.Visible && ribbonTab != null)
					{
						return new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.TabItem, ribbonTab);
					}
					break;
				case RibbonTabOperation.TabItemTool:
					if (flag2 && IsTabItemToolbarVisible)
					{
						ToolBase startingTool = null;
						if (obj is ToolBase && ((ToolBase)obj).Owner is RibbonTabItemToolbar)
						{
							startingTool = obj as ToolBase;
						}
						RibbonItem ribbonItem = CreateTabItemToolbarItem(!flag, startingTool);
						if (ribbonItem != null)
						{
							return ribbonItem;
						}
						obj = null;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

					Color borderColor = (((int)ToolbarsManager.StyleResolved != 2) ? MSColors.PopupMenuBorder : MSColors.ToolbarGradientDark);
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor = borderColor;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFBuL);
				}
				break;
			case 0:
			case 3:
			{
				Color color = (((int)ToolbarsManager.StyleResolved == 4) ? UltraToolbarsManager.LightenColor(ToolbarsManager.DefaultBackColor) : ToolbarsManager.DefaultBackColor);
				if ((long)((ulong)requestedProps & 1uL) > 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)1))
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = color;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEuL);
				}
				if ((long)((ulong)requestedProps & 0x40000000uL) > 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)4))
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor = color;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFBFFFFFFFuL);
				}
				break;
			}
			case 5:
				break;
			}
		}

		internal void ResolveRibbonAreaAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ResolutionOrderInfo resOrder = StyleUtils.GetResolutionOrder(ToolbarsManager);
			UIRole role = StyleUtils.GetRole(ToolbarsManager, StyleUtils.Role.Ribbon, out resOrder);
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleBefore && role != null)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseControlInfo && HasRibbonAreaAppearance)
			{
				RibbonAreaAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleAfter && role != null)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 1uL) != 0L)
			{
				if (IsOffice2013StyleBackStageOpen)
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = Office2013ColorTable.Colors.ApplicationMenu2010ContentAreaBackGroundColor;
				}
				else
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = Color.Transparent;
				}
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps ^ 1uL);
			}
		}

		internal void ResolveTabAreaAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00bb: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((long)((ulong)requestedProps & 1uL) > 0L && IsOffice2013StyleBackStageOpen)
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = Color.Transparent;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEuL);

			UIRole role = StyleUtils.GetRole(ToolbarsManager, StyleUtils.Role.RibbonTabItemArea, out resOrder);
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleBefore && role != null)

			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleAfter && role != null)

				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if ((long)((ulong)requestedProps & 1uL) > 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)1))

					AppearancePropFlags requestedProps2 = (AppearancePropFlags)1;
					ResolveCaptionAreaAppearance(DrawCaptionAsActive, resolveAsGlass: false, ref appearance, ref requestedProps2);
				}
				else
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = Color.Transparent;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEuL);
				}
			}

		internal void SetItemWithFocus(RibbonItem newItemWithFocus)
		{
			RibbonItem ribbonItem = itemWithFocus;
			itemWithFocus = newItemWithFocus;
			if (ribbonItem != null)
			{
				ribbonItem.Deactivate();
				ribbonItem.Invalidate();
			}
			if (newItemWithFocus != null)
			{
				newItemWithFocus.Activate();
				newItemWithFocus.Invalidate();
			}
		}

		internal void SetNestedItemWithFocus(RibbonItem newItemWithFocus, bool bringIntoView)
		{
			RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = null;
			switch (newItemWithFocus.ItemType)
			{
			default:
				SetItemWithFocus(newItemWithFocus);
				return;
			case RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDropDownButton:
				((RibbonGroup)newItemWithFocus.Context).Tab.SetNestedItemWithFocus(newItemWithFocus, bringIntoView);
				return;
			case RibbonItemType.RibbonTool:
				if (!(newItemWithFocus.Context is ToolBase { OwnerIsRibbonGroup: not false } toolBase))
				{
					SetItemWithFocus(newItemWithFocus);
					return;
				}
				ribbonGroup = toolBase.OwningRibbonGroup;
				break;
			case RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDialogBoxLauncher:
				ribbonGroup = newItemWithFocus.Context as RibbonGroup;
				break;
			}
			if (ribbonGroup == null)
			{
				SetItemWithFocus(newItemWithFocus);
			}
			else
			{
				ribbonGroup.SetNestedItemWithFocus(newItemWithFocus, bringIntoView);
			}
		}

		internal void SetSelectedTab(RibbonTab tab, bool expandRibbonIfCollapsed)
		{
			SetSelectedTab(tab, expandRibbonIfCollapsed, forceSkipEvents: false);
		}

		internal void SetSelectedTab(RibbonTab tab, bool expandRibbonIfCollapsed, bool forceSkipEvents)
		{
			bool flag = isSettingSelectingTab;
			isSettingSelectingTab = true;
			try
			{
				RibbonTab ribbonTab = SelectedTab;
				if (DisplayModeResolved == RibbonDisplayMode.Full || IsTabPopupOpen || IsAutoHidePopupOpen || forceSkipEvents)
				{
					InitializeTabManagerSelectedTab((ITabItem)(object)tab, forceSkipEvents);
					if ((object)tab == TabManager.SelectedTabItem)
					{
						selectedTab = tab;
						if (ribbonTab != null && ribbonTab != tab)
						{
							ribbonTab.HideContainedControls();
						}
						UIElement ribbonElement = GetRibbonElement(typeof(RibbonTabAreaUIElement));
						if (ribbonElement != null)
						{
							ribbonElement.DirtyChildElements();
						}
					}
				}
				else if (selectedTab != tab)
				{
					UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
					if (ultraToolbarsManager != null)
					{
						BeforeRibbonTabSelectedEventArgs e = new BeforeRibbonTabSelectedEventArgs(tab);
						ultraToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.BeforeRibbonTabSelected, e);
						if (ultraToolbarsManager.EnforceOffice2007Resolution || !e.Cancel)
						{
							selectedTab = tab;
							ultraToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.AfterRibbonTabSelected, new RibbonTabEventArgs(tab));
						}
					}
					else
					{
						selectedTab = tab;
					}
				}
				if (selectedTab == tab && ribbonTab != tab && !ToolbarsManager.Loading)
				{
					BringIntoView(tab, canThrowExceptions: false, selectTabAndDropDown: false);
				}
				if (expandRibbonIfCollapsed && IsMinimized_Legacy && (tabMenuAgent == null || (!tabMenuAgent.IsOpening && !tabMenuAgent.IsOpen)))
				{
					DropDown();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				isSettingSelectingTab = flag;
			}
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.SelectedTab);
		}

		internal void SelectTabViaDesigner(ITabItem tabItem)
		{
			InitializeTabManagerSelectedTab(tabItem, ignoreSelectedTabEvents: false);
			if (TabManager.SelectedTabItem != null && toolbarsManager != null && toolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				toolbarsManager.CustomizeDialog.OnTabClicked(SelectedTab);
			}
		}

		internal bool ToggleItemWithFocus()
		{
			if (itemWithFocus == null)
			{
				RibbonItem ribbonItem = null;
				if (!IsMinimized_Legacy && Tabs.VisibleTabsCount > 0 && SelectedTab != null)
				{
					ribbonItem = new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.TabItem, SelectedTab);
				}
				if (ribbonItem == null)
				{
					ribbonItem = ((FileMenuStyleResolved == FileMenuStyle.ApplicationMenu) ? new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.ApplicationMenu, this) : ((!IsSystemMenuVisibleInCaption(honorMdiChildActivation: true)) ? CreateQatItem(first: true, null, canBeOnTop: true, canBeOnBottom: true) : new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.SystemMenu, this)));
				}
				if (ribbonItem == null)
				{
					ribbonItem = CreateTabItemToolbarItem(first: true, null);
				}
				SetItemWithFocus(ribbonItem);
				return itemWithFocus != null;
			}
			SetItemWithFocus(null);
			return true;
		}

		internal void VerifyContextualTabs()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < ContextualTabGroups.Count; i++)
			{
				ContextualTabGroup contextualTabGroup = ContextualTabGroups[i];
				for (int num = contextualTabGroup.Tabs.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					if (contextualTabGroup.Tabs[num].Index < 0 || contextualTabGroup.Tabs[num].ContextualTabGroup != contextualTabGroup)
					{
						contextualTabGroup.Tabs.RemoveAt(num);
					}
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < Tabs.Count; j++)
			{
				RibbonTab ribbonTab = Tabs[j];
				if (ribbonTab.ContextualTabGroup != null)
				{
					if (ribbonTab.ContextualTabGroup.Index < 0 || ribbonTab.ContextualTabGroup.Ribbon != this)
					{
						ribbonTab.ContextualTabGroup = null;
					}
					else if (ribbonTab.ContextualTabGroupIndex < 0)
					{
						ribbonTab.ContextualTabGroup.Tabs.Add(ribbonTab);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void VerifySelectedTab()
		{
			RibbonTab ribbonTab = SelectedTab;
			if (SelectedTab == null || SelectedTab.Ribbon != this || SelectedTab.Index < 0 || SelectedTab.Disposed)
			{
				ribbonTab = ((Tabs.VisibleTabsCount <= 0) ? null : ((RibbonTab)(object)TabManager.FirstVisibleTabItem));
			}
			else if (!SelectedTab.VisibleResolved)
			{
				if (IsDesignMode)
				{
					ribbonTab = (RibbonTab)(object)TabManager.GetNextVisibleTabItem((ITabItem)(object)SelectedTab, false);
					if (ribbonTab == null || ribbonTab == DesignerAddTab)
					{
						ribbonTab = (RibbonTab)(object)TabManager.GetPreviousVisibleTabItem((ITabItem)(object)SelectedTab, false);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					ribbonTab = (RibbonTab)(object)TabManager.FirstVisibleTabItem;
				}
			}
			if (ribbonTab == DesignerAddTab)
			{
				ribbonTab = null;
			}
			SelectedTab = ribbonTab;
		}

		private void BringIntoView(RibbonGroup group, bool canThrowExceptions)
		{
			Exception ex = null;
			if (group == null)
			{
				ex = new ArgumentNullException("group");
			}
			else if (group.Ribbon != this)
			{
				ex = new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Ribbon_SpecifiedItemDoesNotBelongToRibbon"));
			}
			else if (!group.VisibleResolved)
			{
				ex = new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Ribbon_SpecifiedGroupIsHidden"));
			}
			else if (!VisibleResolved)
			{
				ex = new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Ribbon_MustBeVisible"));
			}
			else if ((group.Tab == null || !group.Tab.VisibleResolved) && group.UnderlyingGroup == null)
			{
				ex = new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Ribbon_TabIsHidden"));
			}
			if (ex != null)
			{
				if (canThrowExceptions)
				{
					throw ex;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				UIElement itemElement = (group.Layout.IsCollapsed ? group.DropDownButtonUIElement : group.UIElement);
				RibbonLayoutItemBase layout = group.Layout;
				BringIntoView(itemElement, layout, group, null);
			}
		}

		private void BringIntoView(ToolBase tool, bool canThrowExceptions)
		{
			RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = tool?.OwningRibbonGroup;
			Exception ex = null;
			if (tool == null)
			{
				ex = new ArgumentNullException("tool");
			}
			else if (ribbonGroup == null || ribbonGroup.Ribbon != this)
			{
				ex = new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Ribbon_SpecifiedItemDoesNotBelongToRibbon"));
			}
			else if (!tool.VisibleResolved)
			{
				ex = new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Ribbon_ToolIsHidden"));
			}
			else if (!VisibleResolved)
			{
				ex = new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Ribbon_MustBeVisible"));
			}
			else if (!ribbonGroup.VisibleResolved)
			{
				ex = new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Ribbon_ContainingGroupIsHidden"));
			}
			else if ((ribbonGroup.Tab == null || !ribbonGroup.Tab.VisibleResolved) && ribbonGroup.UnderlyingGroup == null)
			{
				ex = new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Ribbon_TabIsHidden"));
			}
			if (ex != null)
			{
				if (canThrowExceptions)
				{
					throw ex;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				UIElement uIElement = tool.UIElement;
				RibbonLayoutItemBase layoutItem = null;
				BringIntoView(uIElement, layoutItem, ribbonGroup, tool);
			}
		}

		private void BringIntoView(UIElement itemElement, RibbonLayoutItemBase layoutItem, RibbonGroup group, ToolBase tool)
		{
			bool flag = group.Tab == SelectedTab;
			int currentPagerPosition = (flag ? CurrentGroupAreaScrollPosition : 0);
			Metrics.VerifyTabLayout(group.Tab, force: false);
			if (itemElement == null && tool != null)
			{
				RibbonGroupLayoutItem ribbonGroupLayoutItem = (group.Layout.IsCollapsed ? group.GroupMenuAgent.GroupLayout : group.Layout);
				ribbonGroupLayoutItem.CalculateItemPositions();
				layoutItem = ribbonGroupLayoutItem.FindToolLayoutItem(tool);
			}
			int scrollPosition = BringIntoView(itemElement, layoutItem, typeof(RibbonGroupAreaUIElement), null, currentPagerPosition, flag);
			group.Tab.ScrollPosition = scrollPosition;
			if (group.Tab != SelectedTab && group.OwningPopupTool == null)
			{
				SelectedTab = group.Tab;
				if (UIElement != null)
				{
					UIElement.VerifyChildElements();
				}
			}
			if (group.Tab == SelectedTab)
			{
				if (IsMinimized_Legacy && !IsTabPopupOpen)
				{
					DropDown();
				}
				if (IsTabPageInView && group.Layout.IsCollapsed && tool != null)
				{
					group.DropDown();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				group.Tab.ScrollPosition = 0;
			}
		}

		private int BringIntoView(UIElement itemElement, RibbonLayoutItemBase layoutItem, Type contentElementType, object contentElementContext, int currentPagerPosition, bool updatePagerElement)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (itemElement != null)
			{
				Rectangle rect = itemElement.Rect;
				Rectangle clipRect = itemElement.ClipRect;
				if (clipRect.Width == rect.Width)
				{
					return currentPagerPosition;
				}
				num = ((clipRect.X != rect.X) ? (rect.Left - clipRect.Left) : (rect.Right - clipRect.Right));
			}
			UIElement uIElement = ToolbarsManager.GetUIElement(contentElementType, contentElementContext);
			if (uIElement != null)
			{
				uIElement.VerifyChildElements();
				if (uIElement.GetAncestor(typeof(RibbonPagerAreaUIElement)) is RibbonPagerAreaUIElement ribbonPagerAreaUIElement)
				{
					if (num == 0)
					{
						Rectangle lastPosition = layoutItem.LastPosition;
						num = ((lastPosition.Left >= ((UIElement)ribbonPagerAreaUIElement).Rect.Left) ? (lastPosition.Right - ((UIElement)ribbonPagerAreaUIElement).Rect.Right + Metrics.PagerButtonExtentResolved) : (lastPosition.Left - ((UIElement)ribbonPagerAreaUIElement).Rect.Left + -Metrics.PagerButtonExtentResolved));
					}
					if (num != 0)
					{
						if (currentPagerPosition == 0)
						{
							currentPagerPosition += Metrics.PagerButtonExtentResolved;
						}
						currentPagerPosition += num;
						if (updatePagerElement)
						{
							ribbonPagerAreaUIElement.Position = currentPagerPosition;
							((UIElement)ribbonPagerAreaUIElement).DirtyChildElements();
							((UIElement)ribbonPagerAreaUIElement).VerifyChildElements();
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return currentPagerPosition;
		}

		private void BringIntoView(RibbonTab tab, bool canThrowExceptions)
		{
			BringIntoView(tab, canThrowExceptions, selectTabAndDropDown: false);
		}

		private void BringIntoView(RibbonTab tab, bool canThrowExceptions, bool selectTabAndDropDown)
		{
			if (RibbonContainer == null || !((Control)(object)RibbonContainer).IsHandleCreated)
			{
				return;
			}
			Exception ex = null;
			if (tab == null)
			{
				ex = new ArgumentNullException("tab");
			}
			else if (tab.Ribbon != this)
			{
				ex = new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Ribbon_SpecifiedItemDoesNotBelongToRibbon"));
			}
			else if (!tab.VisibleResolved)
			{
				ex = new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Ribbon_SpecifiedTabIsHidden"));
			}
			else if (!VisibleResolved)
			{
				ex = new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Ribbon_MustBeVisible"));
			}
			if (ex != null)
			{
				if (!canThrowExceptions)
				{
					return;
				}
				throw ex;
			}
			UIElement uIElement = TabManager.GetUIElement((ITabItem)(object)tab);
			int num = 0;
			bool flag = true;
			if (uIElement != null)
			{
				Rectangle rect = uIElement.Rect;
				Rectangle clipRect = uIElement.ClipRect;
				if (clipRect.Width != rect.Width)
				{
					num = ((clipRect.X != rect.X) ? (rect.Left - clipRect.Left) : (rect.Right - clipRect.Right));
				}
				else
				{
					flag = false;
				}
			}
			if (flag && GetRibbonElement(typeof(RibbonTabItemAreaUIElement)) is RibbonTabItemAreaUIElement ribbonTabItemAreaUIElement)
			{
				((UIElement)ribbonTabItemAreaUIElement).VerifyChildElements();
				if (((UIElement)ribbonTabItemAreaUIElement).GetAncestor(typeof(RibbonPagerAreaUIElement)) is RibbonPagerAreaUIElement ribbonPagerAreaUIElement)
				{
					if (num != 0)
					{
						if (ribbonPagerAreaUIElement.Position == 0)
						{
							ribbonPagerAreaUIElement.Position += Metrics.PagerButtonExtentResolved;
						}
						ribbonPagerAreaUIElement.Position += num;
					}
					else
					{
						int num2 = 0;
						IList visibleTabs = Tabs.VisibleTabs;
						int interTabSpacingResolved = TabManager.InterTabSpacingResolved;
						for (int i = 0; i < visibleTabs.Count; i++)
						{
							RibbonTab ribbonTab = (RibbonTab)visibleTabs[i];
							if (ribbonTab.VisibleResolved)
							{
								if (ribbonTab == tab)
								{
									break;
								}
								num2 += TabManager.GetTabItemSize((ITabItem)(object)ribbonTab).Width;
								num2 += interTabSpacingResolved;
							}
						}
						if (num2 < ribbonPagerAreaUIElement.Position)
						{
							ribbonPagerAreaUIElement.Position = num2;
						}
						else
						{
							ribbonPagerAreaUIElement.Position = num2 - ((UIElement)ribbonPagerAreaUIElement).Rect.Width + TabManager.GetTabItemSize((ITabItem)(object)tab).Width + Metrics.PagerButtonExtentResolved * 2;
						}
					}
					((UIElement)ribbonPagerAreaUIElement).DirtyChildElements();
					((UIElement)ribbonPagerAreaUIElement).VerifyChildElements();
				}
			}
			if (selectTabAndDropDown)
			{
				if (tab != SelectedTab)
				{
					SelectedTab = tab;
				}
				if (IsMinimized_Legacy && tab == SelectedTab)
				{
					DropDown();
				}
			}
		}

		private RibbonItem CreateQatItem(bool first, ToolBase startingTool, bool canBeOnTop, bool canBeOnBottom)
		{
			if (!QuickAccessToolbar.VisibleResolvedInternal)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (canBeOnTop == IsQatAboveRibbon || canBeOnBottom == IsQatBelowRibbon)
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = (first ? QuickAccessToolbar.GetNextTool(startingTool, visibleToolsOnly: true, selectableToolsOnly: true) : QuickAccessToolbar.GetPreviousTool(startingTool, visibleToolsOnly: true, selectableToolsOnly: true));
				if (toolBase != null)
				{
					return new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.QatTool, toolBase);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private RibbonItem CreateTabItemToolbarItem(bool first, ToolBase startingTool)
		{
			if (IsTabItemToolbarVisible)
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = (first ? TabItemToolbar.GetNextTool(startingTool, visibleToolsOnly: true, selectableToolsOnly: true) : TabItemToolbar.GetPreviousTool(startingTool, visibleToolsOnly: true, selectableToolsOnly: true));
				if (toolBase != null)
				{
					return new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.TabItemToolbarTool, toolBase);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void DirtyTabManager(TabManagerChangeType changeType)
		{
			if (tabManager != null && changeType != TabManagerChangeType.None)
			{
				if ((changeType & TabManagerChangeType.Font) != TabManagerChangeType.None)
				{
					TabManager.DirtyFont();
				}
				bool flag = (changeType & TabManagerChangeType.Invalidate) != 0;
				bool flag2 = (changeType & TabManagerChangeType.Collection) != 0;
				bool flag3 = (changeType & TabManagerChangeType.AllMetrics) != 0;
				if (flag || flag2 || flag3)
				{
					TabManager.Dirty(flag, flag2, flag3);
				}
				if ((changeType & TabManagerChangeType.Font) != TabManagerChangeType.None)
				{
					Metrics.Dirty(RibbonMetricsFlags.TabFontChanged);
				}
			}
		}

		private ToolBase GetIntersectingQatTool(Rectangle rect, bool returnLastToolIfNoIntersection)
		{
			Rectangle qatRect;
			UltraToolbarBase.ToolbarToolRow[] qatRows = GetQatRows(out qatRect);
			int num = rect.Left + rect.Width / 2;
			ToolBase toolBase = null;
			if (IsQatAboveRibbon && num >= qatRect.Right)
			{
				Rectangle rect2 = qatRect;
				rect2.X = qatRect.Right;
				if (Style == RibbonStyle.Fluent)
				{
					rect2.X += 9;
					rect2.X++;
				}
				rect2.Width = Metrics.QatCustomizeButtonWidth;
				if ((rect2.X <= num && rect2.Right >= num) || RibbonContainerLayoutItem.RectangleIntersectsWith(rect, rect2, Orientation.Horizontal))
				{
					toolBase = QuickAccessToolbar.QuickCustomizeTool;
				}
			}
			else if (qatRows != null && qatRows.Length != 0)
			{
				num -= qatRect.Left;
				toolBase = qatRows[0].GetToolAtOffset(num, selectableToolsOnly: true);
			}
			if (returnLastToolIfNoIntersection && toolBase == null)
			{
				toolBase = QuickAccessToolbar.GetPreviousTool(null, visibleToolsOnly: true, selectableToolsOnly: true);
			}
			return toolBase;
		}

		private static string GetMergedParentTabGroupKey(ContextualTabGroup childTabGroup)
		{
			return "_mdichild.merge.contextualtabgroup.key_" + ((IKeyedSubObjectEx)childTabGroup).KeyLowercaseInterned;
		}

		internal static string GetMergedParentTabKey(RibbonTab childTab)
		{
			string text = ((IKeyedSubObjectEx)childTab.ContextualTabGroup)?.KeyLowercaseInterned;
			return "_mdichild.merge.ribbontab.key_" + text + "_" + ((IKeyedSubObjectEx)childTab).KeyLowercaseInterned;
		}

		private ContextualTabGroup GetParentTabGroupToMergeWith(ContextualTabGroup childTabGroup)
		{
			if (childTabGroup == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string key = childTabGroup.Key;
			int num = ContextualTabGroups.IndexOf(key);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				return ContextualTabGroups[num];
			}
			key = GetMergedParentTabGroupKey(childTabGroup);
			num = ContextualTabGroups.IndexOf(key);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				return ContextualTabGroups[num];
			}
			ContextualTabGroup contextualTabGroup = new ContextualTabGroup(key, childTabGroup.Caption, isMdiMergeContextualTabGroup: true);
			contextualTabGroup.InitializeMdiMergeTabGroupFromChild(childTabGroup);
			ContextualTabGroups.InternalAdd(contextualTabGroup, allowMdiTabReservedKeyName: true);
			return contextualTabGroup;
		}

		private RibbonTab GetParentTabToMergeWith(RibbonTab childTab)
		{
			int num;
			RibbonTab ribbonTab;
			if (!ToolbarsManager.EnforceOffice2007Resolution && !childTab.ToolbarsManager.EnforceOffice2007Resolution)
			{
				num = Tabs.IndexOf(childTab.Key);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					ribbonTab = Tabs[num];
					ContextualTabGroup contextualTabGroup = ribbonTab.ContextualTabGroup;
					ContextualTabGroup contextualTabGroup2 = childTab.ContextualTabGroup;
					string text = ((IKeyedSubObjectEx)contextualTabGroup)?.KeyLowercaseInterned;
					string text2 = ((IKeyedSubObjectEx)contextualTabGroup2)?.KeyLowercaseInterned;
					if (text == text2)
					{
						return ribbonTab;
					}
				}
			}
			string mergedParentTabKey = GetMergedParentTabKey(childTab);
			if ((ToolbarsManager == null || ToolbarsManager.HasBeenRibbonCustomized) && HasNonAutogenerateMergeTabKeys && NonAutogenerateMergeTabKeys.Contains(mergedParentTabKey))
			{
				return null;
			}
			ContextualTabGroup parentTabGroupToMergeWith = GetParentTabGroupToMergeWith(childTab.ContextualTabGroup);
			if (parentTabGroupToMergeWith != null && parentTabGroupToMergeWith.IsMdiMergeContextualTabGroup)
			{
				parentTabGroupToMergeWith.InternalSetUnderlyingTabGroup(childTab.ContextualTabGroup);
			}
			num = Tabs.IndexOf(mergedParentTabKey);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				ribbonTab = new RibbonTab(mergedParentTabKey, childTab.Caption, isMdiMergeTab: true);
				Tabs.InternalAdd(ribbonTab, allowMdiTabReservedKeyName: true);
				parentTabGroupToMergeWith?.Tabs.InternalAdd(ribbonTab, allowMdiTabReservedKeyName: true);
			}
			else
			{
				ribbonTab = Tabs[num];
			}
			ribbonTab.InitializeMdiMergeTabFromChild(childTab);
			return ribbonTab;
		}

		private UltraToolbarBase.ToolbarToolRow[] GetQatRows(out Rectangle qatRect)
		{
			Metrics.AdjustQatWidthIfNecessary();
			qatRect = Metrics.CalculateQatRect();
			return UltraToolbarBase.ToolAreaInformation.FromToolbar(QuickAccessToolbar, qatRect).ToolbarMetrics.GetToolRows();
		}

		private RibbonTabOperation GetStartingTabOperation(RibbonItemType type)
		{
			switch (type)
			{
			case RibbonItemType.ApplicationMenu:
			case RibbonItemType.SystemMenu:
				return RibbonTabOperation.FileOrSystemMenu;
			case RibbonItemType.QatTool:
				if (IsQatBelowRibbon)
				{
					return RibbonTabOperation.BottomQatTool;
				}
				return RibbonTabOperation.TopQatTool;
			case RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDialogBoxLauncher:
				return RibbonTabOperation.DialogBoxLauncherInGroup;
			case RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDropDownButton:
				return RibbonTabOperation.GroupOnSelectedTab;
			case RibbonItemType.RibbonTool:
				return RibbonTabOperation.RibbonGroupTool;
			default:
				return RibbonTabOperation.SelectedTab;
			case RibbonItemType.TabItemToolbarTool:
				return RibbonTabOperation.TabItemTool;
			}
		}

		private static TabManagerChangeType GetTabChangeType(PropertyIds property, PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo)
		{
			//IL_006c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0071: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0072: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0074: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008e: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_008e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0094: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			switch (property)
			{
			case PropertyIds.Appearance:
			case PropertyIds.HotTrackAppearance:
			case PropertyIds.HotTrackSelectedAppearance:
			case PropertyIds.SelectedAppearance:
			case PropertyIds.HotTrackTabItemAppearance:
			case PropertyIds.SelectedTabItemAppearance:
			case PropertyIds.TabItemAppearance:
			case PropertyIds.ActiveTabItemAppearance:
				if (propChangeInfo.Trigger == null || IsFontDataChange(propChangeInfo))
				{
					return TabManagerChangeType.AllMetrics | TabManagerChangeType.Invalidate | TabManagerChangeType.Font;
				}
				if (propChangeInfo != null && propChangeInfo.PropId is AppearancePropIds)
				{
					AppearancePropIds val = (AppearancePropIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId;
					switch (val - 5)
					{
					default:
						if ((int)val != 1001)
						{
							break;
						}
						goto case 0;
					case 0:
					case 1:
					case 2:
					case 3:
					case 4:
						return TabManagerChangeType.AllMetrics | TabManagerChangeType.Invalidate;
					}
				}
				return TabManagerChangeType.Invalidate;
			default:
				return TabManagerChangeType.None;
			}
		}

		private static bool IsFontDataChange(PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo)
		{
			//IL_004a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0050: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0052: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0054: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (propChangeInfo == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (propChangeInfo.PropId is FontDataPropIds)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (propChangeInfo.Source is AppearanceBase && propChangeInfo.Trigger != null)
			{
				return IsFontDataChange(propChangeInfo.Trigger);
			}
			if (!(propChangeInfo.PropId is AppearancePropIds))
			{
				return false;
			}
			AppearancePropIds val = (AppearancePropIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId;
			if ((int)val != 4)
			{
				return (int)val == 1001;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void MergeMdiChildTabs(Ribbon childRibbon)
		{
			if (childRibbon.ToolbarsManager != ToolbarsManager.ActiveMdiChildManager)
			{
				return;
			}
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList(Tabs);
			foreach (RibbonTab item in (IEnumerable)childRibbon.Tabs)
			{
				RibbonTab parentTabToMergeWith = GetParentTabToMergeWith(item);
				if (parentTabToMergeWith != null)
				{
					parentTabToMergeWith.MergeMdiChildTab(item);
					arrayList.Remove(parentTabToMergeWith);
				}
			}
			bool flag = ToolbarsManager == null || ToolbarsManager.HasBeenRibbonCustomized;
			foreach (RibbonTab item2 in arrayList)
			{
				if (flag && item2.ShouldSerializeRibbonCustomizationMergedTabKey())
				{
					int num = childRibbon.Tabs.IndexOf(item2.RibbonCustomizationMergedTabKey);
					if (num >= 0)
					{
						item2.MergeMdiChildTab(childRibbon.Tabs[num]);
						continue;
					}
				}
				foreach (RibbonGroup item3 in (IEnumerable)item2.Groups)
				{
					if (flag && item3.ShouldSerializeRibbonCustomizationMergedGroupKey() && item3.ShouldSerializeRibbonCustomizationMergedTabKey())
					{
						int num2 = childRibbon.Tabs.IndexOf(item3.RibbonCustomizationMergedTabKey);
						if (num2 >= 0)
						{
							RibbonTab ribbonTab2 = childRibbon.Tabs[num2];
							int num3 = ribbonTab2.Groups.IndexOf(item3.RibbonCustomizationMergedGroupKey);
							if (num3 >= 0)
							{
								item3.MergeMdiChildGroup(ribbonTab2.Groups[num3]);
								continue;
							}
						}
					}
					if (item3.HasTools)
					{
						item3.Tools.MergeMdiChildTools(null);
					}
				}
			}
			if (Tabs.Count > 1)
			{
				Tabs.Sort(new RibbonTabMergeOrderComparer());
			}
		}

		private void OnSelectedTabItemChanging(object sender, SelectedTabItemChangingEventArgs e)
		{
			if (HasApplicationMenu2010 && ApplicationMenu2010.IsOpen)
			{
				ApplicationMenu2010.CloseDropDown();
				if (ApplicationMenu2010.IsOpen)
				{
					((CancelEventArgs)(object)e).Cancel = true;
					return;
				}
			}
			if (suppressTabManagerSelectEvents)
			{
				CloseAllOpenSubmenus();
				return;
			}
			if (((CancelableTabItemEventArgs)e).TabItem != null && (object)((CancelableTabItemEventArgs)e).TabItem == DesignerAddTab)
			{
				((CancelEventArgs)(object)e).Cancel = true;
				RibbonTab tab = Tabs.Add(GetUniqueKey(Tabs, "ribbon"));
				SetSelectedTab(tab, expandRibbonIfCollapsed: false);
				return;
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (ultraToolbarsManager == null)
			{
				((CancelEventArgs)(object)e).Cancel = true;
				return;
			}
			if (!ultraToolbarsManager.ExitEditMode())
			{
				((CancelEventArgs)(object)e).Cancel = true;
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if ((object)((CancelableTabItemEventArgs)e).TabItem != selectedTab)
			{
				BeforeRibbonTabSelectedEventArgs e2 = new BeforeRibbonTabSelectedEventArgs(((CancelableTabItemEventArgs)e).TabItem as RibbonTab);
				ultraToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.BeforeRibbonTabSelected, e2);
				if (!ultraToolbarsManager.EnforceOffice2007Resolution)
				{
					((CancelEventArgs)(object)e).Cancel = e2.Cancel;
				}
				flag = ((CancelEventArgs)(object)e).Cancel;
			}
			if (ToolbarsManager.MdiParentManagerInternal != null || flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			CloseAllOpenSubmenus();
			if (ToolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture != this)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(null, setOn: false, clearToolBeingEdited: true);
				ToolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture = null;
			}
			else
			{
				ToolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(null, setOn: false, clearToolBeingEdited: true, clearToolbarWithCaptureIfNecessary: false);
			}
			if (!(TabManager.SelectedTabItem is RibbonTab ribbonTab))
			{
				return;
			}
			ribbonTab.HideContainedControls();

			{
				UIElement uIElement = TabManager.GetUIElement((ITabItem)(object)ribbonTab);

		}

		private RibbonItem ProcessArrowKey(Keys keyCode, RibbonItem itemWithFocus)
		{
			//IL_0190: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0195: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0197: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_019a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_019c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01a0: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (itemWithFocus == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			RibbonItem ribbonItem = null;
			FileMenuStyle fileMenuStyleResolved = FileMenuStyleResolved;
			bool flag = fileMenuStyleResolved == FileMenuStyle.ApplicationMenu || fileMenuStyleResolved == FileMenuStyle.ApplicationMenu2010;
			bool flag2 = TabItemAreaDisplayStyleResolved == TabItemAreaDisplayStyle.Visible && Tabs.VisibleTabs.Count > 0;
			switch (itemWithFocus.ItemType)
			{
			case RibbonItemType.ApplicationMenu:
			case RibbonItemType.SystemMenu:
				switch (keyCode)
				{
				case Keys.Left:
					if (Metrics.DoesApplicationMenuIntersectTabItemArea())
					{
						ribbonItem = CreateTabItemToolbarItem(first: false, null);
						if (ribbonItem == null && Tabs.VisibleTabsCount > 0)
						{
							ribbonItem = new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.TabItem, tabManager.LastSelectableTabItem);
						}
					}
					if (ribbonItem == null)
					{
						ribbonItem = CreateQatItem(first: false, null, canBeOnTop: true, canBeOnBottom: false);
					}
					break;
				case Keys.Right:
					if (Style == RibbonStyle.Scenic || Style == RibbonStyle.Office2013 || Style == RibbonStyle.Office2010)
					{
						if (Tabs.VisibleTabs.Count > 0 && TabItemAreaDisplayStyleResolved == TabItemAreaDisplayStyle.Visible)
						{
							ribbonItem = new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.TabItem, tabManager.FirstSelectableTabItem);
						}
						break;
					}
					ribbonItem = CreateQatItem(first: true, null, canBeOnTop: true, canBeOnBottom: false);
					if (ribbonItem == null && Metrics.DoesApplicationMenuIntersectTabItemArea())
					{
						if (Tabs.VisibleTabsCount > 0)
						{
							ribbonItem = new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.TabItem, TabManager.FirstSelectableTabItem);
						}
						if (ribbonItem == null)
						{
							ribbonItem = CreateTabItemToolbarItem(first: true, null);
						}
					}
					break;
				case Keys.Down:
				{
					if (toolbarsManager != null)
					{
						ToolbarStyle styleResolved = toolbarsManager.StyleResolved;
						if ((int)styleResolved == 8 || (int)styleResolved == 9)
						{
							OnApplicationMenuButtonClick();
							return null;
						}
					}
					RibbonTab ribbonTab6 = SelectedTab;
					if (IsTabPageInView && ribbonTab6 != null)
					{
						ribbonItem = ribbonTab6.GetFirstActivatableItem(includeDialogBoxLauncher: true);
					}
					if (ribbonItem == null)
					{
						ribbonItem = CreateQatItem(first: true, null, canBeOnTop: false, canBeOnBottom: true);
					}
					break;
				}
				}
				break;
			case RibbonItemType.QatTool:
			{
				ToolBase toolBase2 = itemWithFocus.Context as ToolBase;
				switch (keyCode)
				{
				case Keys.Left:
				case Keys.Right:
				{
					bool flag4 = keyCode == Keys.Left;
					ribbonItem = CreateQatItem(!flag4, toolBase2, canBeOnTop: true, canBeOnBottom: true);
					if (ribbonItem != null)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (Style == RibbonStyle.Fluent)
					{
						if (FileMenuStyleResolved == FileMenuStyle.ApplicationMenu)
						{
							ribbonItem = new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.ApplicationMenu, this);
						}
						else if (IsSystemMenuVisibleInCaption(honorMdiChildActivation: true))
						{
							ribbonItem = new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.SystemMenu, this);
						}
					}
					if (ribbonItem == null)
					{
						ribbonItem = CreateQatItem(!flag4, null, canBeOnTop: true, canBeOnBottom: true);
					}
					break;
				}
				case Keys.Up:
				{
					if (!IsQatBelowRibbon)
					{
						break;
					}
					Rectangle qatRect2;
					UltraToolbarBase.ToolbarToolRow[] qatRows2 = GetQatRows(out qatRect2);
					if (qatRows2 == null || qatRows2.Length == 0)
					{
						break;
					}
					int toolOffset2 = qatRows2[0].GetToolOffset(toolBase2);
					Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(qatRect2.Left + toolOffset2, qatRect2.Top, toolBase2.WidthResolved, qatRect2.Height);
					if (SelectedTab != null && IsTabPageInView)
					{
						RibbonGroup groupFromOffset = Metrics.GetGroupFromOffset(SelectedTab, rectangle.Left + rectangle.Width / 2);
						if (groupFromOffset != null)
						{

		private void ProcessPropChange(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (propChange == null || !(propChange.PropId is PropertyIds))
			{
				return;
			}
			PropertyIds propertyIds = (PropertyIds)(object)propChange.PropId;
			if (propChange.Source == tabs && propChange.Trigger != null && ProcessTabItemPropChange(propChange.Trigger))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (propChange.Source is RibbonTabCollection && propChange.Trigger == null)
			{
				DirtyVisibleTabs();
			}
			else if (propChange.Source is ApplicationMenu && propChange.Trigger == null)
			{
				if (propertyIds == PropertyIds.Visible)
				{
					Metrics.Dirty(RibbonMetricsFlags.ApplicationMenuVisibility);
				}
			}
			else if (propChange.Source is ContextualTabGroupCollection && propChange.Trigger == null)
			{
				DirtyVisibleTabs();
			}
			else if (propChange.Source is ContextualTabGroup)
			{
				if (propertyIds == PropertyIds.Visible)
				{
					DirtyVisibleTabs();
					ContextualTabGroups.DirtyVisibleTabGroups();
				}
			}
			else if (propChange.Source is QuickAccessToolbar)
			{
				switch (propertyIds)
				{
				case PropertyIds.Visible:
				case PropertyIds.Location:
					Metrics.Dirty(RibbonMetricsFlags.QatLocationChanged);
					break;
				case PropertyIds.Settings:
					ProcessPropChange(propChange.Trigger);
					break;
				}
			}
			else if (propChange.Source is QuickAccessToolbarSettings)
			{
				switch (propertyIds)
				{
				case PropertyIds.PaddingTop:
				case PropertyIds.PaddingBottom:
				case PropertyIds.PaddingLeft:
				case PropertyIds.PaddingRight:
				case PropertyIds.ToolSpacing:
				case PropertyIds.UseLargeImages:
					Metrics.Dirty(RibbonMetricsFlags.QatSizeChanged);
					break;
				}
			}
			else if (propChange.Source == groupSettings)
			{
				if ((propertyIds == PropertyIds.ToolAppearance || propertyIds == PropertyIds.Appearance) && (propChange.Trigger == null || IsFontDataChange(propChange.Trigger)))
				{
					DirtyAllMetrics();
				}
				else if (propertyIds == PropertyIds.CaptionAppearance && (propChange.Trigger == null || IsFontDataChange(propChange.Trigger)))
				{
					Metrics.Dirty(RibbonMetricsFlags.GroupCaptionAppearance);
				}
				else if (propertyIds == PropertyIds.CanCollapse)
				{
					InvalidateGroupLayouts(invalidateItems: true);
				}
			}
			else if (propChange.Source == tabSettings)
			{
				if ((propertyIds == PropertyIds.TabItemAppearance || propertyIds == PropertyIds.Appearance) && (propChange.Trigger == null || IsFontDataChange(propChange.Trigger)) && tabManager != null)
				{
					tabManager.DirtyFont();
				}
			}
			else if (propChange.Source == appearances)
			{
				if ((propertyIds == PropertyIds.CaptionAreaAppearance || propertyIds == PropertyIds.CaptionAreaActiveAppearance) && IsFontDataChange(propChange.Trigger))
				{
					Metrics.Dirty(RibbonMetricsFlags.RibbonCaptionChanged);
				}
			}
			else if (propChange.Source == tabItemToolbar)
			{
				Metrics.Dirty(RibbonMetricsFlags.MaxAvailableTabAreaSize);
			}
			else
			{
				ProcessPropChange(propChange.Trigger);
			}
		}

		private bool ProcessTabItemPropChange(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			//IL_0088: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0090: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00aa: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_00aa: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b0: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (!(propChange.Source is RibbonTab tab))
			{
				return false;
			}
			PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo = propChange.FindTrigger(null);
			if (propChangeInfo.PropId is PropertyIds)
			{
				switch ((PropertyIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId)
				{
				case PropertyIds.Visible:
					DirtyVisibleTabs();
					break;
				case PropertyIds.ContextualTabGroup:
					DirtyVisibleTabs();
					if (ToolbarsManager == null || !ToolbarsManager.Loading)
					{
						DirtyTabItem(tab, invalidate: true, textChanged: false, imageChanged: true);
					}
					break;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(propChangeInfo.PropId is AppearancePropIds))
				{
					return false;
				}
				AppearancePropIds val = (AppearancePropIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId;
				switch (val - 5)
				{
				default:
					if ((int)val == 1001)
					{
						DirtyTabItem(tab, invalidate: true, textChanged: true, imageChanged: true);
					}
					else
					{
						DirtyTabItem(tab, invalidate: true, textChanged: false, imageChanged: false);
					}
					break;
				case 0:
				case 1:
					DirtyTabItem(tab, invalidate: true, textChanged: true, imageChanged: false);
					break;
				case 2:
				case 3:
				case 4:
					DirtyTabItem(tab, invalidate: true, textChanged: false, imageChanged: true);
					break;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void RefreshDockAreaSize()
		{
			if (refreshingDockAreaSize)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = refreshingDockAreaSize;
			refreshingDockAreaSize = true;
			try
			{
				RibbonContainer?.RefreshDockAreaSize();
			}
			finally
			{
				refreshingDockAreaSize = flag;
			}
		}

		private void ResolveDefaultToolAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			if (HasGroupSettings)
			{
				if (GroupSettings.HasToolAppearance)
				{
					GroupSettings.ToolAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
				if (GroupSettings.HasAppearance)
				{
					GroupSettings.Appearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
			}
			if (ToolbarsManager.HasAppearance)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.Appearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			}
		}

		{
