		IKeyTipProvider[] IKeyTipContainer.GetKeyTipProviders()
		{
			List<IKeyTipProvider> list = new List<IKeyTipProvider>();
			if (TabItemAreaDisplayStyleResolved == TabItemAreaDisplayStyle.Visible)
			{
				if (tabs != null)
				{
					foreach (RibbonTab item in (IEnumerable)tabs)
					{
						if (item.VisibleResolved)
						{
							list.Add(item);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else if (selectedTab != null)
			{
				list.AddRange(((IKeyTipContainer)selectedTab).GetKeyTipProviders());
			}
			ApplicationMenuBase resolvedFileMenu = GetResolvedFileMenu();
			if (resolvedFileMenu != null)
			{
				list.Add(resolvedFileMenu);
			}
			foreach (UltraToolbar toolbar in ToolbarsManager.Toolbars)
			{
				if (toolbar.VisibleResolved)
				{
					list.Add(toolbar);
				}
			}
			if (quickAccessToolbar != null && QuickAccessToolbar.VisibleResolved)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < QuickAccessToolbar.Tools.Count; i++)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase = QuickAccessToolbar.Tools[i];
					if (toolBase.IsVisible(considerBumpedStatus: false))
					{
						list.Add(toolBase);
					}
				}
				if (QuickAccessToolbar.ToolsHaveBeenBumped)
				{
					list.Add(QuickAccessToolbar.QuickCustomizeTool);
				}
			}
			if (IsTabItemToolbarVisible)
			{
				foreach (ToolBase tool in TabItemToolbar.Tools)
				{
					list.AddRange(tool.GetKeyTipProviders());
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		internal AccessibleObject Navigate(RibbonAccessibleChildItem ribbonAccessibleChildItem, AccessibleNavigation navdir)
		{
			int num = (int)ribbonAccessibleChildItem;
			switch (navdir)
			{
			case AccessibleNavigation.Next:
				num++;
				break;
			case AccessibleNavigation.Previous:
				num--;
				break;
			case AccessibleNavigation.Up:
			case AccessibleNavigation.Down:
			case AccessibleNavigation.Left:
			case AccessibleNavigation.Right:
				return null;
			case AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild:
			case AccessibleNavigation.LastChild:
				return null;
			}
			int num2 = AccessibilityObject.GetChildCount() - 1;
			if (num < 0 || num > num2)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return AccessibilityObject.GetChild(num);
		}

					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ImageBackground = null;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFEFFFuL);
				}
				if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x800000000uL) != 0L)
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ImageBackgroundDisabled = null;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFF7FFFFFFFFuL);
				}
				break;
			case CaptionButtonAppearanceResolutionPhase.Final:
				if (phaseInfo.IsMaximizedMdiChild)
				{
					if (((ulong)requestedProps & 1uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)1))
					{
						if ((int)styleResolved == 4)
						{
							((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = UltraToolbarsManager.LightenColor(ToolbarsManager.DefaultBackColor);
						}
						else if (MSColors != null)
						{
							((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = Color.Transparent;
						}
						else
						{
							((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = ToolbarsManager.DefaultBackColor;
						}
						requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEuL);
					}
				}
				else if ((long)((ulong)requestedProps & 1uL) > 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)1))
				{
					if (phaseInfo.DrawAsPressed)
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = Office2007ColorTable.Colors.RibbonCaptionButtonPressedGradientDark;
					}
					else if (phaseInfo.DrawAsActive)
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = Office2007ColorTable.Colors.RibbonCaptionButtonHotTrackedGradientDark;
					}
					else
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = Color.Transparent;
					}
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEuL);
				}
				if ((long)((ulong)requestedProps & 0x4000000uL) > 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)67108864))
				{
					if (phaseInfo.DrawAsPressed)
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor2 = Office2007ColorTable.Colors.RibbonCaptionButtonPressedGradientLight;
					}
					else if (phaseInfo.DrawAsActive)
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor2 = Office2007ColorTable.Colors.RibbonCaptionButtonHotTrackedGradientLight;
					}
					else
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor2 = Color.Transparent;
					}
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFBFFFFFFuL);
				}
				if (((ulong)requestedProps & 2uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)2))
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ForeColor = ToolbarsManager.DefaultForeColor;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFDuL);
				}
				if (phaseInfo.IsMaximizedMdiChild)
				{
					if (((ulong)requestedProps & 4uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)4))
					{
						if (mSColors != null)
						{
							((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor = mSColors.ToolBorder;
						}
						else
						{
							((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor = ToolbarsManager.DefaultForeColor;
						}
						requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFBuL);
					}
				}
				else if ((long)((ulong)requestedProps & 4uL) > 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)4))
				{
					if (phaseInfo.DrawAsPressed)
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor = Office2007ColorTable.Colors.RibbonCaptionButtonPressedBorderColor;
					}
					else if (phaseInfo.DrawAsActive)
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor = Office2007ColorTable.Colors.RibbonCaptionButtonHotTrackedBorderColor;
					}
					else
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor = Color.Transparent;
					}
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFBuL);
				}
				if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x40uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)64))
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ImageHAlign = (HAlign)2;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFBFuL);
				}
				if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x80uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)128))
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ImageVAlign = (VAlign)2;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFF7FuL);
				}
				if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x10uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)16))
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).TextHAlign = (HAlign)2;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEFuL);
				}
				if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x20uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)32))
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).TextVAlign = (VAlign)2;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFDFuL);
				}
				if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x10000000uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)268435456))
				{
					if (phaseInfo.DrawAsPressed || phaseInfo.DrawAsActive)
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackGradientStyle = (GradientStyle)25;
					}
					else
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackGradientStyle = (GradientStyle)1;
					}
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFEFFFFFFFuL);
				}
				if ((long)((ulong)requestedProps & 0x1000000000uL) > 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)68719476736L))
				{
					if (phaseInfo.DrawAsPressed)
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor2 = Office2007ColorTable.Colors.RibbonCaptionButtonPressedBorderColor2;
					}
					else if (phaseInfo.DrawAsActive)
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor2 = Office2007ColorTable.Colors.RibbonCaptionButtonHotTrackedBorderColor2;
					}
					else
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor2 = Color.Transparent;
					}
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFEFFFFFFFFFuL);
				}
				if ((long)((ulong)requestedProps & 0x40000000uL) > 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)1073741824))
				{
					if (phaseInfo.DrawAsPressed)
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor3DBase = Office2007ColorTable.Colors.RibbonCaptionButtonPressedBorderInner;
					}
					else if (phaseInfo.DrawAsActive)
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor3DBase = Office2007ColorTable.Colors.RibbonCaptionButtonHotTrackedBorderInner;
					}
					else
					{
						((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor3DBase = Color.Transparent;
					}
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFBFFFFFFFuL);
				}
				if ((0x80000000uL & (ulong)requestedProps) != 0L)
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ThemedElementAlpha = (Alpha)3;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps ^ 0x80000000uL);
				}
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFC1FFFF7uL);
				break;
			case CaptionButtonAppearanceResolutionPhase.Initial:
				break;
			}
		}

		private CaptionButtonsAppearances GetCaptionButtonsAppearances(int index)
		{
			int captionButtonsAppearancesPropertyCount = CaptionButtonsAppearancesPropertyCount;
			if (index < 0 || index >= captionButtonsAppearancesPropertyCount)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CreateCaptionButtonsAppearancesHolderArray(captionButtonsAppearancesPropertyCount);
			if (captionButtonsAppearancesHolder[index] == null)
			{
				captionButtonsAppearancesHolder[index] = new CaptionButtonsAppearances(ToolbarsManager);
				captionButtonsAppearancesHolder[index].SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			return captionButtonsAppearancesHolder[index];
		}

		internal void CreateCaptionButtonsAppearancesHolderArray(int propertyCount)
		{
			if (captionButtonsAppearancesHolder == null)
			{
				captionButtonsAppearancesHolder = new CaptionButtonsAppearances[propertyCount];
			}
		}

		internal bool GetHasCaptionButtonsAppearances(int index)
		{
			int captionButtonsAppearancesPropertyCount = CaptionButtonsAppearancesPropertyCount;
			if (index < 0 || index >= captionButtonsAppearancesPropertyCount)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (captionButtonsAppearancesHolder == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			CaptionButtonsAppearances captionButtonsAppearances = captionButtonsAppearancesHolder[index];
			if (captionButtonsAppearances != null)
			{
				if (!captionButtonsAppearances.HasCloseButtonAppearances && !captionButtonsAppearances.HasContextHelpButtonAppearances && !captionButtonsAppearances.HasDefaultButtonAppearances && !captionButtonsAppearances.HasMaximizeButtonAppearances && !captionButtonsAppearances.HasMinimizeButtonAppearances && !captionButtonsAppearances.HasRestoreButtonAppearances && !captionButtonsAppearances.HasRibbonDisplayOptionsButtonAppearances)
				{
					return captionButtonsAppearances.Tag != null;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool GetShouldSerializeCaptionButtonsAppearances(int index)
		{
			int captionButtonsAppearancesPropertyCount = CaptionButtonsAppearancesPropertyCount;
			if (index < 0 || index >= captionButtonsAppearancesPropertyCount)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (GetHasCaptionButtonsAppearances(index))
			{
				return captionButtonsAppearancesHolder[index].ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void ResetCaptionButtonsAppearances(int index)
		{
			int captionButtonsAppearancesPropertyCount = CaptionButtonsAppearancesPropertyCount;
			if (index >= 0 && index < captionButtonsAppearancesPropertyCount && GetHasCaptionButtonsAppearances(index))
			{
				captionButtonsAppearancesHolder[index].Reset();
			}
		}

		internal void DisposeCaptionButtonsAppearances()
		{
			if (captionButtonsAppearancesHolder == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int captionButtonsAppearancesPropertyCount = CaptionButtonsAppearancesPropertyCount;
			for (int i = 0; i < captionButtonsAppearancesPropertyCount; i++)
			{
				CaptionButtonsAppearances captionButtonsAppearances = captionButtonsAppearancesHolder[i];
				if (captionButtonsAppearances != null)
				{
					captionButtonsAppearances.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					captionButtonsAppearances.Dispose();
					captionButtonsAppearancesHolder[i] = null;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal enum RibbonItemType
	{
		TabItem,
		TabItemToolbarTool,
		QatTool,
		ApplicationMenu,
		SystemMenu,
		RibbonTool,
		RibbonGroupDialogBoxLauncher,
		RibbonGroupDropDownButton
	}
	internal class RibbonItem
	{
		private WeakReference context;

		private RibbonItemType itemType;

		internal AccessibleObject AccessibleObject
		{
			get
			{
				switch (ItemType)
				{
				case RibbonItemType.TabItemToolbarTool:
				case RibbonItemType.QatTool:
				case RibbonItemType.RibbonTool:
					if (!(Context is ToolBase toolBase))
					{
						return null;
					}
					return toolBase.AccessibilityObject;
				case RibbonItemType.TabItem:
				{
					object obj = Context;
					ITabItem val = (ITabItem)((obj is ITabItem) ? obj : null);
					if (val == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return val.AccessibilityObject;
				}
				case RibbonItemType.ApplicationMenu:
				{
					UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager2 = GetToolbarsManager();
					if (toolbarsManager2 != null)
					{
						return toolbarsManager2.Ribbon.ApplicationMenu.ApplicationMenuButtonAccessibilityObject;
					}
					break;
				}
				case RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDialogBoxLauncher:
					if (Context is RibbonGroup ribbonGroup2)
					{
						return ribbonGroup2.DialogBoxLauncherAccessiblilityObject;
					}
					break;
				case RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDropDownButton:
					if (Context is RibbonGroup ribbonGroup)
					{
						return ribbonGroup.RibbonGroupButtonAccessiblilityObject;
					}
					break;
				case RibbonItemType.SystemMenu:
				{
					UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = GetToolbarsManager();
					if (toolbarsManager != null && toolbarsManager.CaptionSystemMenu != null)
					{
						return toolbarsManager.CaptionSystemMenu.AccessibilityObject;
					}
					break;
				}
				default:
					return null;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal RibbonItemType ItemType => itemType;

		internal object Context
		{
			get
			{
				if (context == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return context.Target;
			}
		}

		internal RibbonItem(RibbonItemType type, object context)
		{
			itemType = type;
			this.context = new WeakReference(context);
		}

		internal void Invalidate()
		{
			if (Context is RibbonTab)
			{
				if (Context is RibbonTab { Ribbon: not null } ribbonTab)
				{
					ribbonTab.Ribbon.TabManager.InvalidateTabItem((ITabItem)(object)(Context as RibbonTab));
				}
			}
			else if (Context is ToolBase)
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = Context as ToolBase;
				if (toolBase is QatQuickCustomizeTool && ((QuickAccessToolbar)toolBase.OwningToolbarInternal).Location == QuickAccessToolbarLocation.AboveRibbon)
				{
					((QuickAccessToolbar)toolBase.OwningToolbarInternal).Ribbon?.DirtyRibbonCaptionElement();
				}
				else
				{
					toolBase?.DirtyOwnerElements();
				}
			}
			else if (ItemType == RibbonItemType.ApplicationMenu)
			{
				if (Context is Ribbon ribbon)
				{
					ribbon.InvalidateApplicationMenuButton();
				}
			}
			else if (ItemType == RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDialogBoxLauncher)
			{
				if (Context is RibbonGroup ribbonGroup)
				{
					ribbonGroup.InvalidateDialogBoxLauncher();
				}
			}
			else if (ItemType == RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDropDownButton)
			{
				if (Context is RibbonGroup ribbonGroup2)
				{
					ribbonGroup2.InvalidateElements();
				}
			}
			else if (ItemType == RibbonItemType.SystemMenu && Context is Ribbon && Context is Ribbon ribbon2)
			{
				ribbon2.InvalidateApplicationMenuButton();
			}
		}

		internal void Deactivate()
		{
			SetActiveHelper(isActive: false);
		}

		internal void Activate()
		{
			SetActiveHelper(isActive: true);
		}

		private void SetActiveHelper(bool isActive)
		{
			if (!isActive)
			{
				if (ItemType == RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDialogBoxLauncher || ItemType == RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDropDownButton)
				{
					if (!(Context is RibbonGroup ribbonGroup))
					{
						return;
					}
					if (ItemType == RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDialogBoxLauncher)
					{
						ribbonGroup.SetDialogBoxLauncherForceMouseOver(forceMouseOver: false);
						return;
					}
					ribbonGroup.SetDropDownButtonForceMouseOver(forceMouseOver: false);
					if (ribbonGroup.IsGroupPopupOpen)
					{
						ribbonGroup.GroupMenuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay: false);
					}
				}
				else if (Context is ToolBase)
				{
					if (Context is ToolBase { ToolbarsManager: { } toolbarsManager } toolBase)
					{
						toolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(toolBase, setOn: false, toolBase.IsToolInEditMode, clearToolbarWithCaptureIfNecessary: true);
					}
				}
				else if (Context is RibbonTab)
				{
					Ribbon ribbon = ((Context is RibbonTab ribbonTab) ? ribbonTab.Ribbon : null);
					if (ribbon != null && ribbon.IsMinimized_Legacy && !ribbon.IsTabPageInView)
					{
						ribbon.InitializeTabManagerSelectedTab(null, ignoreSelectedTabEvents: true);
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager2 = GetToolbarsManager();
			if (Context is RibbonTab)
			{
				RibbonTab ribbonTab2 = Context as RibbonTab;
				Ribbon ribbon2 = ribbonTab2?.Ribbon;
				if (ribbon2 != null)
				{
					if (ribbon2.IsMinimized_Legacy && !ribbon2.IsTabPageInView)
					{
						ribbon2.InitializeTabManagerSelectedTab((ITabItem)(object)ribbonTab2, ribbonTab2 == ribbon2.SelectedTab, allowMinimizeRibbonDropDown: false);
					}
					else
					{
						ribbon2.SelectedTab = ribbonTab2;
						if (ribbon2.IsTabPopupOpen && ribbon2.TabMenuAgent.ItemWithFocus == null)
						{
							ribbon2.TabMenuAgent.ItemWithFocus = ribbon2.SelectedTab.GetFirstActivatableItem(includeDialogBoxLauncher: true);
						}
					}
					toolbarsManager2.InternalSetActiveTool(null, setOn: false, clearToolBeingEdited: false, clearToolbarWithCaptureIfNecessary: true);
				}
			}
			else if (Context is ToolBase)
			{
				if (Context is ToolBase { ToolbarsManager: not null } toolBase2)
				{
					toolBase2.ToolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(toolBase2, setOn: true, clearToolBeingEdited: false, clearToolbarWithCaptureIfNecessary: true);
					toolBase2.BringIntoView();
					if (toolBase2.CanEnterEditMode)
					{
						toolBase2.EnterEditMode(viaMouse: false);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				toolbarsManager2?.InternalSetActiveTool(null, setOn: false, clearToolBeingEdited: false, clearToolbarWithCaptureIfNecessary: true);
				if (ItemType == RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDialogBoxLauncher || ItemType == RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDropDownButton)
				{
					if (Context is RibbonGroup ribbonGroup2)
					{
						if (ItemType == RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDialogBoxLauncher)
						{
							ribbonGroup2.SetDialogBoxLauncherForceMouseOver(forceMouseOver: true);
						}
						else
						{
							ribbonGroup2.SetDropDownButtonForceMouseOver(forceMouseOver: true);
							ribbonGroup2.BringIntoView();
						}
						toolbarsManager2.NotifyAccessibilityFocusChange();
					}
				}
				else if (ItemType == RibbonItemType.ApplicationMenu || ItemType == RibbonItemType.SystemMenu)
				{
					toolbarsManager2.NotifyAccessibilityFocusChange();
				}
			}
			toolbarsManager2?.NotifyAccessibilityFocusChange();
		}

		private UltraToolbarsManager GetToolbarsManager()
		{
			if (Context is RibbonGroup)
			{
				if (Context is RibbonGroup ribbonGroup)
				{
					return ribbonGroup.ToolbarsManager;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (Context is Ribbon)
				{
					return ((Ribbon)Context).ToolbarsManager;
				}
				if (Context is ToolBase)
				{
					if (Context is ToolBase toolBase)
					{
						return toolBase.ToolbarsManager;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (Context is RibbonTab)
					{
						return ((RibbonTab)Context).ToolbarsManager;
					}
					if (Context is ApplicationMenuBase)
					{
						return ((ApplicationMenuBase)Context).Ribbon.ToolbarsManager;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return itemType.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is RibbonItem ribbonItem && ribbonItem.itemType == itemType)
			{
				return object.Equals(context, ribbonItem.context);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				return itemType.ToString();
			}
			return itemType.ToString() + " - " + context.ToString();
		}
	}
	public class RibbonButtonGroupUIElement : UIElement
	{
		private ButtonGroupLayoutItem layoutItem;

		public string ButtonGroup => layoutItem.ButtonGroup;

		private MicrosoftColorTable ColorTable => ToolbarsManager?.MSColors;

		internal bool HasOnlyButtons
		{
			get
			{
				if (layoutItem == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return layoutItem.HasOnlyButtons;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsOffice2007
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0013: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return (int)toolbarsManager.StyleResolved == 5;
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldDrawRoundedBorders
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0034: Expected I4, but got Unknown
				if (Utilities.IsHighContrast)
				{
					return false;
				}
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				ToolbarStyle styleResolved = toolbarsManager.StyleResolved;
				switch (styleResolved - 5)
				{
				case 0:
				case 2:
				case 3:
					return true;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}
		}

		private UltraToolbarsManager ToolbarsManager
		{
			get
			{
				if (((UIElement)this).ControlElement == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ((UIElement)this).ControlElement.UltraControl as UltraToolbarsManager;
			}
		}

		public override UIElementBorderStyle BorderStyle
		{
			get
			{
				if (!ShouldDrawRoundedBorders)
				{
					return (UIElementBorderStyle)4;
				}
				return (UIElementBorderStyle)10;
			}
		}

		protected override bool ClipSelf
		{
			get
			{
				if (ShouldDrawRoundedBorders)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return ((UIElement)this).ClipSelf;
			}
		}

		public override Region Region
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (ShouldDrawRoundedBorders)
				{
					return DrawUtility.CreateBorderRegion(((UIElement)this).Rect, ((UIElement)this).BorderStyle);
				}
				return ((UIElement)this).Region;
			}
		}

		public override UIRole UIRole
		{
			get
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return StyleUtils.GetRole(toolbarsManager, StyleUtils.Role.RibbonGroupItemButtonGroup);
			}
		}

		internal RibbonButtonGroupUIElement(UIElement parent, ButtonGroupLayoutItem layoutItem)
			: base(parent)
		{
			Initialize(layoutItem);
		}

		internal void Initialize(ButtonGroupLayoutItem layoutItem)
		{

	internal class RibbonToolLayoutItem : RibbonLayoutItemBase
	{
		private ToolBase tool;

		private static Size UncachedSize = new Size(-1, -1);

		private Size cachedPreferredSize = UncachedSize;

		private Size cachedMinimumSize = UncachedSize;

		private int toolMetricsVersion;

		private int toolbarsMetricsVersion;

		private Size sizeAdjustment = Size.Empty;

		private bool HasMetricsChanged
		{
			get
			{
				if (tool.SharedProps.MetricsVersion != toolMetricsVersion)
				{
					return true;
				}
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = tool.ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager != null)
				{
					return toolbarsManager.ToolMetricsVersion != toolbarsMetricsVersion;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal Size SizeAdjustment
		{
			get
			{
				return sizeAdjustment;
			}
			set
			{
				sizeAdjustment = value;
			}
		}

		public ToolBase Tool => tool;

		protected override bool IsVisible => tool.VisibleResolved;

		protected override Size MinimumSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (cachedMinimumSize == UncachedSize || HasMetricsChanged)
				{
					cachedMinimumSize = PreferredSize;
					if (tool.ShouldSerializeWidthProperties)
					{
						cachedMinimumSize.Width = tool.MinWidthResolved;
					}
					cachedMinimumSize += sizeAdjustment;
				}
				return cachedMinimumSize;
			}
		}

		protected override Size PreferredSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (cachedPreferredSize == UncachedSize || HasMetricsChanged)
				{
					Size size = tool.CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstance();
					int num = tool.CalculateWidthResolved(useCalculateLogicalSize: false);
					if (num > 0)
					{
						size.Width = num;
					}
					UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManagerInControl = tool.ToolbarsManagerInControl;
					if (toolbarsManagerInControl != null)
					{
						Ribbon ribbon = toolbarsManagerInControl.Ribbon;
						if (ToolBase.RibbonToolSizeInfo.Large.Equals(tool.CurrentToolSizeInfo))
						{
							size.Height = ribbon.Metrics.GroupToolAreaHeight;
						}
						else if (size.Height > ribbon.Metrics.SmallGroupToolHeight)
						{
							size.Height = ribbon.Metrics.SmallGroupToolHeight;
						}
						toolbarsMetricsVersion = toolbarsManagerInControl.ToolMetricsVersion;
					}
					toolMetricsVersion = tool.SharedProps.MetricsVersion;
					cachedPreferredSize = size;
					cachedPreferredSize += sizeAdjustment;
				}
				return cachedPreferredSize;
			}
		}

		internal RibbonToolLayoutItem(ToolBase tool)
		{
			this.tool = tool;
		}

		protected internal override void ResetCachedSizes()
		{
			cachedPreferredSize = (cachedMinimumSize = UncachedSize);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "Tool:" + tool.ToString();
		}
	}

		internal RibbonLayoutItemBase FindClosestLayoutItem(RibbonLayoutItemBase startingItem, Type requiredLayoutItemType, RibbonLayoutItemDirection direction, bool requireSelectable, bool wrap)
		{
			Rectangle startingRect;
			if (startingItem != null)
			{
				startingRect = startingItem.LastPosition;
			}
			else
			{
				Rectangle rectangle = base.LastPosition;
				startingRect = direction switch
				{
					RibbonLayoutItemDirection.Below => new Rectangle(rectangle.Left, rectangle.Top - 1, rectangle.Width, 1), 
					RibbonLayoutItemDirection.Left => new Rectangle(rectangle.Right, rectangle.Top, 1, rectangle.Height), 
					RibbonLayoutItemDirection.Right => new Rectangle(rectangle.Left - 1, rectangle.Top, 1, rectangle.Height), 
					_ => new Rectangle(rectangle.Left, rectangle.Bottom, rectangle.Width, 1), 
				};
			}
			RibbonLayoutItemBase ribbonLayoutItemBase = FindClosestLayoutItem(startingItem, requiredLayoutItemType, startingRect, direction, requireSelectable);
			if (startingItem != null && ribbonLayoutItemBase == null && wrap)
			{
				Rectangle rectangle2 = base.LastPosition;
				switch (direction)
				{
				default:
					startingRect.Y = rectangle2.Bottom;
					startingRect.Height = 1;
					break;
				case RibbonLayoutItemDirection.Below:
					startingRect.Y = rectangle2.Top - 1;
					startingRect.Height = 1;
					break;
				case RibbonLayoutItemDirection.Left:
					startingRect.X = rectangle2.Right;
					startingRect.Width = 1;
					break;
				case RibbonLayoutItemDirection.Right:
					startingRect.X = rectangle2.Left - 1;
					startingRect.Width = 1;
					break;
				}
				ribbonLayoutItemBase = FindClosestLayoutItem(startingItem, requiredLayoutItemType, startingRect, direction, requireSelectable);
			}
			return ribbonLayoutItemBase;
		}

		internal RibbonLayoutItemBase FindClosestLayoutItem(RibbonLayoutItemBase itemToExclude, Type requiredLayoutItemType, Rectangle startingRect, RibbonLayoutItemDirection direction, bool requireSelectable)
		{
			RibbonLayoutItemBase ribbonLayoutItemBase = null;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = Items.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				RibbonLayoutItemBase ribbonLayoutItemBase2 = Items[i] as RibbonLayoutItemBase;
				if (ribbonLayoutItemBase2 != null)
				{
					if (ribbonLayoutItemBase2 == itemToExclude)
					{
						ribbonLayoutItemBase2 = null;
					}
					else if (!(requiredLayoutItemType == null) && !requiredLayoutItemType.IsAssignableFrom(ribbonLayoutItemBase2.GetType()))
					{
						ribbonLayoutItemBase2 = ((!(ribbonLayoutItemBase2 is RibbonContainerLayoutItem)) ? null : ((RibbonContainerLayoutItem)ribbonLayoutItemBase2).FindClosestLayoutItem(itemToExclude, requiredLayoutItemType, startingRect, direction, requireSelectable));
					}
					else
					{
						bool flag = true;
						if (requireSelectable && ribbonLayoutItemBase2 is RibbonToolLayoutItem ribbonToolLayoutItem)
						{
							flag = ribbonToolLayoutItem.Tool.EnabledResolved && ribbonToolLayoutItem.Tool.CanActivate;
						}
						if (flag && !((ILayoutItem)ribbonLayoutItemBase2).IsVisible)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						if (flag)
						{
							Rectangle rect = ribbonLayoutItemBase2.LastPosition;
							switch (direction)
							{
							case RibbonLayoutItemDirection.Above:
								flag = rect.Top < startingRect.Top && RectangleIntersectsWith(rect, startingRect, Orientation.Horizontal);
								break;
							case RibbonLayoutItemDirection.Below:
								flag = rect.Bottom > startingRect.Bottom && RectangleIntersectsWith(rect, startingRect, Orientation.Horizontal);
								break;
							case RibbonLayoutItemDirection.Left:
								flag = rect.Left < startingRect.Left && RectangleIntersectsWith(rect, startingRect, Orientation.Vertical);
								break;
							case RibbonLayoutItemDirection.Right:
								flag = rect.Right > startingRect.Right && RectangleIntersectsWith(rect, startingRect, Orientation.Vertical);
								break;
							}
						}
						if (!flag)
						{
							ribbonLayoutItemBase2 = null;
						}
					}
				}
				if (ribbonLayoutItemBase2 == null)

					}
				}
				string text = (toolBase.HasInstanceProps ? toolBase.InstanceProps.ButtonGroup : string.Empty);
				string text2 = (toolBase2.HasInstanceProps ? toolBase2.InstanceProps.ButtonGroup : string.Empty);
				int index = toolBase.Index;

		internal override Rectangle GetContentRect(Rectangle rect)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UIElementBorderWidths groupBorderWidths = Group.Ribbon.GetGroupBorderWidths();
			rect.X += ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref groupBorderWidths)).Left;
			rect.Width -= ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref groupBorderWidths)).Left + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref groupBorderWidths)).Right;
			rect.Y += ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref groupBorderWidths)).Top;
			rect.Height -= ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref groupBorderWidths)).Bottom + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref groupBorderWidths)).Top;
			rect.Height -= group.Ribbon.Metrics.DefaultGroupCaptionHeight;
			return rect;
		}

		protected override void InitializeLayoutItems()
		{
			int num = group.Tools.Count;
			if (group.Tools.NewToolPlaceHolder != null)
			{
				num++;
			}
			ToolBase[] array = new ToolBase[num];
			group.Tools.CopyTo(array, 0);
			if (group.Tools.NewToolPlaceHolder != null)
			{
				array[num - 1] = group.Tools.NewToolPlaceHolder;
			}
			if (array.Length != 0 && !IsCollapsed)
			{
				if (group.LayoutDirection == RibbonGroupToolLayoutDirection.Vertical)
				{
					InitializeLayoutItemsVertical(this, array, layoutPhase, Group.LayoutAlignmentResolved);
				}
				else
				{
					InitializeLayoutItemsHorizontal(this, array, layoutPhase, Group.LayoutAlignmentResolved);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.Items.Clear();
			}
		}

		private void DirtyLayoutIfNecessary()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = group.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null || toolbarsManager.ToolLayoutVersion != layoutMetricsVersion)
			{
				layoutMetricsVersion = toolbarsManager.ToolLayoutVersion;

		private static void AlignVerticalLayoutItems(RibbonContainerLayoutItem container, int numberOfItemsInColumn, RibbonGroupLayoutAlignment alignment)
		{
			if (numberOfItemsInColumn <= 0 || numberOfItemsInColumn >= 3 || alignment == RibbonGroupLayoutAlignment.Near)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = container.Items.Count - numberOfItemsInColumn;
			if (alignment == RibbonGroupLayoutAlignment.Center)
			{
				if (numberOfItemsInColumn == 1)
				{
					RibbonLayoutItemBase ribbonLayoutItemBase = (RibbonLayoutItemBase)(object)container.Items[num];
					if (ribbonLayoutItemBase.Constraint.SpanY == 1)
					{
						ribbonLayoutItemBase.Constraint.SpanY = 3;
					}
					return;
				}
				RibbonContainerLayoutItem ribbonContainerLayoutItem = new RibbonContainerLayoutItem(Orientation.Vertical);
				ribbonContainerLayoutItem.Constraint.OriginX = ((RibbonLayoutItemBase)(object)container.Items[num]).Constraint.OriginX;
				ribbonContainerLayoutItem.Constraint.OriginY = 0;
				ribbonContainerLayoutItem.Constraint.SpanY = 0;
				ribbonContainerLayoutItem.Constraint.WeightY = 1f;
				ribbonContainerLayoutItem.Constraint.Fill = (FillType)2;
				for (int i = 0; i < numberOfItemsInColumn; i++)
				{
					ribbonContainerLayoutItem.Add(RibbonPlaceholderLayoutItem.CreateVerticalFillPlaceholder(0));
					int num2 = i + num;
					RibbonLayoutItemBase ribbonLayoutItemBase2 = (RibbonLayoutItemBase)(object)container.Items[num2];
					ribbonLayoutItemBase2.Constraint.Reset();
					ribbonLayoutItemBase2.Constraint.OriginX = 0;
					ribbonLayoutItemBase2.Constraint.Anchor = (AnchorType)1;
					ribbonContainerLayoutItem.Add(ribbonLayoutItemBase2);
				}
				ribbonContainerLayoutItem.Add(RibbonPlaceholderLayoutItem.CreateVerticalFillPlaceholder(0));
				for (int j = 0; j < numberOfItemsInColumn; j++)
				{
					container.Items.RemoveAt(num);
				}
				container.Add(ribbonContainerLayoutItem);
				return;
			}
			if (numberOfItemsInColumn == 1)
			{
				RibbonLayoutItemBase ribbonLayoutItemBase3 = (RibbonLayoutItemBase)(object)container.Items[num];
				if (ribbonLayoutItemBase3.Constraint.SpanY != 1)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			int num3 = 3 - numberOfItemsInColumn;
			for (int k = 0; k < numberOfItemsInColumn; k++)
			{
				((RibbonLayoutItemBase)(object)container.Items[k + num]).Constraint.OriginY = k + num3;
			}
		}

		internal void OnLayoutItemOutOfView()
		{
			foreach (ToolBase tool in Group.Tools)
			{
				if (tool is ControlContainerTool controlContainerTool && controlContainerTool.ToolWithContainedControl == controlContainerTool)
				{
					controlContainerTool.Control.Location = base.LastPosition.Location;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ResetToolsToPreferredSize()
		{
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = group.Tools.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = group.Tools[i];
				toolBase.SetCurrentToolSize(toolBase.PreferredRibbonToolSizeInfoResolved);
			}
			if (group.Tools.NewToolPlaceHolder != null)
			{
				group.Tools.NewToolPlaceHolder.SetCurrentToolSize(group.Tools.NewToolPlaceHolder.PreferredRibbonToolSizeInfoResolved);
			}
		}

		internal void SetIsCollapsed(bool isCollapsed)
		{
			this.isCollapsed = isCollapsed;
		}

	internal class ButtonGroupLayoutItem : RibbonContainerLayoutItem
	{
		private bool hasOnlyButtons = true;

		private string group;

		internal const int ButtonOnlyOverlap = 1;

		internal bool HasOnlyButtons => hasOnlyButtons;

		public string ButtonGroup => group;

		private ButtonGroupLayoutItem()
			: base(Orientation.Horizontal)
		{
		}

		internal static ButtonGroupLayoutItem CreateButtonGroupLayoutItem(ToolBase[] tools, int startIndex, Hashtable oldLayoutItems, out int endIndex)
		{
			string buttonGroup = tools[startIndex].InstanceProps.ButtonGroup;
			ButtonGroupLayoutItem buttonGroupLayoutItem = ((oldLayoutItems != null) ? (oldLayoutItems[buttonGroup] as ButtonGroupLayoutItem) : null);
			if (buttonGroupLayoutItem == null)
			{
				buttonGroupLayoutItem = new ButtonGroupLayoutItem();
			}
			buttonGroupLayoutItem.Items.Clear();
			buttonGroupLayoutItem.InvalidateLayout();
			buttonGroupLayoutItem.hasOnlyButtons = true;
			buttonGroupLayoutItem.group = buttonGroup;
			endIndex = tools.Length;
			for (int i = startIndex; i < tools.Length; i++)
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = tools[i];
				if (!toolBase.HasInstanceProps || toolBase.InstanceProps.ButtonGroup != buttonGroup)
				{
					endIndex = i;
					break;
				}
				if (toolBase.VisibleResolved)
				{
					if (!(toolBase is ButtonTool) && !(toolBase is PopupToolBase))
					{
						buttonGroupLayoutItem.hasOnlyButtons = false;
					}
					RibbonToolLayoutItem ribbonToolLayoutItem = oldLayoutItems[toolBase] as RibbonToolLayoutItem;
					if (ribbonToolLayoutItem == null)
					{
						ribbonToolLayoutItem = new RibbonToolLayoutItem(toolBase);
					}
					else
					{
						ribbonToolLayoutItem.Constraint.Reset();
					}
					buttonGroupLayoutItem.Add(ribbonToolLayoutItem);
				}
			}
			if (buttonGroupLayoutItem.hasOnlyButtons)
			{
				Size sizeAdjustment = new Size(-1, 0);
				int j = 0;
				for (int num = buttonGroupLayoutItem.Items.Count - 1; j < num; j++)
				{
					if (buttonGroupLayoutItem.Items[j] is RibbonToolLayoutItem ribbonToolLayoutItem2)
					{
						ribbonToolLayoutItem2.SizeAdjustment = sizeAdjustment;
					}
				}
			}
			return buttonGroupLayoutItem;
		}

		internal override void AddLayoutItems(Hashtable layoutItems)
		{
			base.AddLayoutItems(layoutItems);
			layoutItems.Add(ButtonGroup, this);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "ButtonGroup:" + group;
		}
	}

		private int layoutMetricsVersion = -1;

		private RibbonTabResizeHistory resizeHistoryIncrease;

		private int lastGroupIndexIncreased = int.MaxValue;

		private int lastGroupToolIndexIncreased = -1;

		private RibbonTabResizeHistory resizeHistoryDecrease;

		private int lastGroupIndexDecreased = -1;

		private int lastGroupToolIndexDecreased = int.MaxValue;

		private int lastExtent = -1;

		private int cachedPreferredExtent;

		internal const bool DebugResizeOperations = false;

		internal RibbonGroupMenuAgent GroupMenuAgent => groupMenuAgent;

		internal RibbonLayoutPhase LayoutPhase
		{
			get
			{
				return layoutPhase;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != layoutPhase)
				{
					layoutPhase = value;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (tab.VisibleResolved)
				{
					return groupMenuAgent != null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected override Size MinimumSize
		{
			get
			{
				DirtyLayoutIfNecessary();
				return base.MinimumSize;
			}
		}

		protected override Size PreferredSize
		{
			get
			{
				DirtyLayoutIfNecessary();
				return base.PreferredSize;
			}
		}

		internal RibbonTabPageLayoutItem(RibbonTab tab)
			: this(tab, null)
		{
		}

		internal RibbonTabPageLayoutItem(RibbonTab tab, RibbonGroupMenuAgent groupMenuAgent)
			: base(Orientation.Horizontal)

			this.groupMenuAgent = groupMenuAgent;
		}

		private void DirtyLayoutIfNecessary()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = tab.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null || toolbarsManager.ToolLayoutVersion != layoutMetricsVersion)
			{
				layoutMetricsVersion = toolbarsManager.ToolLayoutVersion;
				InvalidateLayoutItems();
			}
		}

		private void ResetGroupPhase()
		{
			layoutPhase = RibbonLayoutPhase.PreferredSize;
			if (groupMenuAgent == null)
			{
				RibbonGroupCollection groups = tab.Groups;
				for (int i = 0; i < groups.Count; i++)
				{
					RibbonGroupLayoutItem layout = groups[i].Layout;
					layout.ResetToolsToPreferredSize();
					layout.LayoutPhase = RibbonLayoutPhase.PreferredSize;
					layout.InvalidateLayoutItems();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				RibbonGroupLayoutItem groupLayout = groupMenuAgent.GroupLayout;
				groupLayout.ResetToolsToPreferredSize();
				groupLayout.LayoutPhase = RibbonLayoutPhase.PreferredSize;
				groupLayout.InvalidateLayoutItems();
			}
			if (resizeHistoryIncrease != null)
			{
				resizeHistoryIncrease.Clear();
			}
			if (resizeHistoryDecrease != null)
			{
				resizeHistoryDecrease.Clear();
			}
		}

		private GroupPhaseChangeAction ResizeGroup(RibbonGroupLayoutItem layout)
		{
			if (!layout.Group.VisibleResolved)
			{
				return null;
			}
			switch (LayoutPhase)
			{
			case RibbonLayoutPhase.CollapsingExpandingGallery:
			{
				ToolsCollection tools = layout.Group.Tools;
				int num = ((lastGroupToolIndexDecreased <= tools.Count - 1) ? (lastGroupToolIndexDecreased - 1) : (tools.Count - 1));
				SingleToolSizeChangeAction result = null;
				for (int num2 = num; num2 >= 0; num2--)
				{
					if (tools[num2] is PopupGalleryTool { ShowPreviewInRibbon: not false } popupGalleryTool && popupGalleryTool.CurrentToolSizeInfo is PopupGalleryTool.GalleryPreviewToolSizeInfo && popupGalleryTool.VisibleResolved)
					{
						ToolBase.ToolSizeInfo smallerToolSizeInfo = popupGalleryTool.GetSmallerToolSizeInfo(popupGalleryTool.CurrentToolSizeInfo);
						if (smallerToolSizeInfo != null && !(smallerToolSizeInfo is PopupGalleryTool.GalleryPreviewToolSizeInfo))
						{
							RibbonToolLayoutItem tool = layout.FindToolLayoutItem(popupGalleryTool);
							result = new SingleToolSizeChangeAction(tool, smallerToolSizeInfo, layout, layoutPhase, resizeHistoryDecrease);
							lastGroupToolIndexDecreased = num2;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				return result;
			}
			case RibbonLayoutPhase.CollapsingExpandingLargeTools2:
			case RibbonLayoutPhase.CollapsingExpandingLargeTools:
			{
				LayoutItemsCollection items = layout.Items;
				List<RibbonToolLayoutItem> list2 = new List<RibbonToolLayoutItem>();
				ReduceLargeToolsHelper(layout, list2);
				if (list2.Count > 0)
				{
					ToolBase.ToolSizeInfo[] array3 = new ToolBase.ToolSizeInfo[list2.Count];
					RibbonToolLayoutItem[] array4 = list2.ToArray();
					for (int k = 0; k < array3.Length; k++)
					{
						ToolBase tool3 = array4[k].Tool;
						array3[k] = tool3.GetSmallerToolSizeInfo(tool3.CurrentToolSizeInfo);
					}
					return new MultiToolSizeChangeAction(array4, array3, layout, LayoutPhase, resizeHistoryDecrease);
				}
				break;
			}
			case RibbonLayoutPhase.ReducingPreviewItems:
			{
				ToolsCollection tools3 = layout.Group.Tools;
				int num4 = ((lastGroupToolIndexDecreased <= tools3.Count - 1) ? (lastGroupToolIndexDecreased - 1) : (tools3.Count - 1));
				SingleToolSizeChangeAction result2 = null;
				for (int num5 = num4; num5 >= 0; num5--)
				{
					if (tools3[num5] is PopupGalleryTool { ShowPreviewInRibbon: not false } popupGalleryTool3 && popupGalleryTool3.CurrentToolSizeInfo is PopupGalleryTool.GalleryPreviewToolSizeInfo && popupGalleryTool3.VisibleResolved)
					{
						ToolBase.ToolSizeInfo smallerToolSizeInfo2 = popupGalleryTool3.GetSmallerToolSizeInfo(popupGalleryTool3.CurrentToolSizeInfo);
						if (smallerToolSizeInfo2 is PopupGalleryTool.GalleryPreviewToolSizeInfo)
						{
							RibbonToolLayoutItem tool4 = layout.FindToolLayoutItem(popupGalleryTool3);
							result2 = new SingleToolSizeChangeAction(tool4, smallerToolSizeInfo2, layout, layoutPhase, resizeHistoryDecrease);
							lastGroupToolIndexDecreased = num5;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				return result2;
			}
			case RibbonLayoutPhase.RemovingToolCaptions:
			{
				LayoutItemsCollection items2 = layout.Items;
				int num6 = ((lastGroupToolIndexDecreased <= items2.Count - 1) ? (lastGroupToolIndexDecreased - 1) : (items2.Count - 1));
				List<RibbonToolLayoutItem> list3 = new List<RibbonToolLayoutItem>();
				if (layout.Group.LayoutDirection == RibbonGroupToolLayoutDirection.Horizontal)
				{
					if (num6 >= 0)
					{
						RemoveToolCaptionsHelper(list3, (ILayoutItem)(object)layout);
						lastGroupToolIndexDecreased = 0;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					for (int num7 = num6; num7 >= 0; num7--)
					{
						RibbonLayoutItemBase ribbonLayoutItemBase = (RibbonLayoutItemBase)(object)items2[num7];
						if (!(ribbonLayoutItemBase is RibbonToolSeparatorLayoutItem))
						{
							RemoveToolCaptionsHelper(list3, (ILayoutItem)(object)ribbonLayoutItemBase);
							if (list3.Count != 0)
							{
								int originX = ribbonLayoutItemBase.Constraint.OriginX;
								lastGroupToolIndexDecreased = num7;
								for (int num8 = num7 - 1; num8 >= 0; num8--)
								{
									RibbonLayoutItemBase ribbonLayoutItemBase2 = (RibbonLayoutItemBase)(object)items2[num8];
									if (ribbonLayoutItemBase2.Constraint.OriginX != originX)
									{
										break;
									}
									RemoveToolCaptionsHelper(list3, (ILayoutItem)(object)ribbonLayoutItemBase2);
									lastGroupToolIndexDecreased = num8;
								}
								break;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (list3.Count > 0)
				{
					ToolBase.ToolSizeInfo[] array5 = new ToolBase.ToolSizeInfo[list3.Count];
					for (int l = 0; l < array5.Length; l++)
					{
						array5[l] = ToolBase.RibbonToolSizeInfo.ImageOnly;
					}
					return new MultiToolSizeChangeAction(list3.ToArray(), array5, layout, LayoutPhase, resizeHistoryDecrease);
				}
				break;
			}
			case RibbonLayoutPhase.IncreasingPreviewItems:
			{
				ToolsCollection tools2 = layout.Group.Tools;
				int num3 = ((lastGroupToolIndexIncreased >= 0) ? lastGroupToolIndexIncreased : 0);
				for (int j = num3; j < tools2.Count; j++)
				{
					if (tools2[j] is PopupGalleryTool { ShowPreviewInRibbon: not false } popupGalleryTool2 && popupGalleryTool2.CurrentToolSizeInfo is PopupGalleryTool.GalleryPreviewToolSizeInfo && popupGalleryTool2.VisibleResolved)
					{
						ToolBase.ToolSizeInfo largerToolSizeInfo = popupGalleryTool2.GetLargerToolSizeInfo(popupGalleryTool2.CurrentToolSizeInfo);
						if (largerToolSizeInfo is PopupGalleryTool.GalleryPreviewToolSizeInfo)
						{
							RibbonToolLayoutItem tool2 = layout.FindToolLayoutItem(popupGalleryTool2);
							lastGroupToolIndexIncreased = j;
							return new SingleToolSizeChangeAction(tool2, largerToolSizeInfo, layout, layoutPhase, resizeHistoryIncrease);
						}
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case RibbonLayoutPhase.CollapseRibbonGroup:
			{
				if (layout.IsCollapsed || !layout.Group.SettingsResolved.CanCollapse || lastGroupToolIndexDecreased <= 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				List<RibbonToolLayoutItem> list = new List<RibbonToolLayoutItem>();
				GetToolLayoutItems(list, (ILayoutItem)(object)layout);
				lastGroupToolIndexDecreased = 0;
				if (list.Count > 0)
				{
					RibbonToolLayoutItem[] array = list.ToArray();
					ToolBase.ToolSizeInfo[] array2 = new ToolBase.ToolSizeInfo[array.Length];
					for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
					{
						array2[i] = array[i].Tool.PreferredRibbonToolSizeInfoResolved;
					}
					return new CollapsedGroupChangeAction(array, array2, layout, LayoutPhase, resizeHistoryDecrease, isCollapsed: true);
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void ReduceLargeToolsHelper(RibbonContainerLayoutItem layout, List<RibbonToolLayoutItem> tools)
		{
			int num = -1;
			if (layout.ReduceLargeToolsLastStartIndex < 0)
			{
				layout.ReduceLargeToolsLastStartIndex = layout.Items.Count;
			}
			int num2 = layout.ReduceLargeToolsLastStartIndex - 1;
			for (int num3 = num2; num3 >= 0; num3--)
			{
				ILayoutItem val = layout.Items[num3];
				if (val is RibbonToolLayoutItem ribbonToolLayoutItem && !(ribbonToolLayoutItem.Tool.CurrentToolSizeInfo is PopupGalleryTool.GalleryPreviewToolSizeInfo) && ToolBase.RibbonToolSizeInfo.Large.Equals(ribbonToolLayoutItem.Tool.CurrentToolSizeInfo) && ribbonToolLayoutItem.Tool.GetSmallerToolSizeInfo(ribbonToolLayoutItem.Tool.CurrentToolSizeInfo) != null)
				{
					if (tools.Count == 0)
					{
						num = num3;
					}
					tools.Add(ribbonToolLayoutItem);
				}
				else
				{
					tools.Clear();
					if (val is RibbonContainerLayoutItem layout2)
					{
						ReduceLargeToolsHelper(layout2, tools);
						if (tools.Count == 3)
						{
							layout.ReduceLargeToolsLastStartIndex = num3;
							return;
						}
					}
				}
				if (tools.Count == 3)
				{
					layout.ReduceLargeToolsLastStartIndex = num;
					return;
				}
			}
			tools.Clear();
		}

		private void RemoveToolCaptionsHelper(List<RibbonToolLayoutItem> toolList, ILayoutItem layoutItem)
		{
			if (layoutItem is RibbonToolLayoutItem { Tool: var tool } ribbonToolLayoutItem)
			{
				if (tool != null && ToolBase.RibbonToolSizeInfo.Normal.Equals(tool.CurrentToolSizeInfo) && tool.GetSmallerToolSizeInfo(tool.CurrentToolSizeInfo) != null)
				{
					toolList.Add(ribbonToolLayoutItem);
				}
			}
			else if (layoutItem is RibbonContainerLayoutItem ribbonContainerLayoutItem)
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = ribbonContainerLayoutItem.Items.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					RemoveToolCaptionsHelper(toolList, ribbonContainerLayoutItem.Items[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		private void GetToolLayoutItems(List<RibbonToolLayoutItem> toolList, ILayoutItem layoutItem)
		{
			if (layoutItem is RibbonToolLayoutItem item)
			{
				toolList.Add(item);
			}
			else if (layoutItem is RibbonContainerLayoutItem ribbonContainerLayoutItem)
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = ribbonContainerLayoutItem.Items.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					GetToolLayoutItems(toolList, ribbonContainerLayoutItem.Items[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void SetCurrentExtent(int extent)
		{
			DirtyLayoutIfNecessary();
			if (resizeHistoryIncrease == null || resizeHistoryDecrease == null)
			{
				resizeHistoryIncrease = new RibbonTabResizeHistory(this);
				resizeHistoryDecrease = new RibbonTabResizeHistory(this);
				layoutMetricsVersion--;
			}
			if (base.AreLayoutItemsDirty)
			{
				lastGroupIndexDecreased = -1;
				lastGroupToolIndexDecreased = -1;
				lastGroupIndexIncreased = -1;
				lastGroupToolIndexIncreased = -1;
				resizeHistoryIncrease.Clear();
				resizeHistoryDecrease.Clear();
				VerifyLayoutItems();
				ResetGroupPhase();
				ResetCachedSizes();
				cachedPreferredExtent = MinimumSize.Width;
				resizeHistoryIncrease.CurrentExtent = cachedPreferredExtent;
				resizeHistoryIncrease.NextLargerExtent = -1;
				resizeHistoryDecrease.CurrentExtent = cachedPreferredExtent;
				resizeHistoryDecrease.NextLargerExtent = -1;
				lastExtent = cachedPreferredExtent;
			}
			if (extent == lastExtent)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = lastExtent;
			lastExtent = extent;
			Ribbon ribbon = tab.Ribbon;
			if (ribbon == null || ribbon.IsDesignMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			DrawUtility.BeginGraphicsCaching();
			try
			{
				if (extent <= cachedPreferredExtent)
				{
					if (resizeHistoryIncrease.CanUndo())
					{
						while (resizeHistoryIncrease.CanUndo())
						{
							resizeHistoryIncrease.Undo();
						}
					}
					if (extent < resizeHistoryDecrease.CurrentExtent)
					{
						while (resizeHistoryDecrease.CurrentExtent > extent && layoutPhase > RibbonLayoutPhase.MinimumSize)
						{
							if (resizeHistoryDecrease.CanRedo())
							{
								resizeHistoryDecrease.Redo();
								continue;
							}
							while (lastGroupIndexDecreased >= 0)
							{
								if (!(base.Items[lastGroupIndexDecreased] is RibbonGroupLayoutItem ribbonGroupLayoutItem))
								{
									lastGroupIndexDecreased--;
									lastGroupToolIndexDecreased = int.MaxValue;
									continue;
								}
								ActionHistory.ActionBase actionBase = ResizeGroup(ribbonGroupLayoutItem);
								if (actionBase == null)
								{
									ribbonGroupLayoutItem.ResetReduceLargeToolsLastStartIndex();
									lastGroupIndexDecreased--;
									lastGroupToolIndexDecreased = int.MaxValue;
									if (ribbonGroupLayoutItem.LayoutPhase == LayoutPhase)
									{
										continue;
									}
									actionBase = new GroupPhaseChangeAction(ribbonGroupLayoutItem, layoutPhase, resizeHistoryDecrease);
								}
								int currentExtent = resizeHistoryDecrease.CurrentExtent;
								resizeHistoryDecrease.PerformAction(RibbonTabResizeHistory.NewOperationContextId, actionBase);
								if (resizeHistoryDecrease.CurrentExtent >= currentExtent && (actionBase is MultiToolSizeChangeAction || actionBase is SingleToolSizeChangeAction))
								{
									resizeHistoryDecrease.Undo();
									resizeHistoryDecrease.ClearRedo();
								}
								if (resizeHistoryDecrease.CurrentExtent >= extent)
								{
									continue;
								}
								ribbonGroupLayoutItem.ResetReduceLargeToolsLastStartIndex();
								return;
							}
							resizeHistoryDecrease.PerformAction(RibbonTabResizeHistory.NewOperationContextId, new RibbonTabPhaseChangeAction(this, layoutPhase - 1, resizeHistoryDecrease));
							lastGroupIndexDecreased = base.Items.Count - 1;
							lastGroupToolIndexDecreased = int.MaxValue;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						while (resizeHistoryDecrease.NextLargerExtent <= extent && resizeHistoryDecrease.CanUndo())
						{
							resizeHistoryDecrease.Undo();
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (layoutPhase > RibbonLayoutPhase.MaximumSize)
					{
						return;
					}
					if (resizeHistoryDecrease.CanUndo())
					{
						while (resizeHistoryDecrease.CanUndo())
						{
							resizeHistoryDecrease.Undo();
						}
					}
					if (extent > resizeHistoryIncrease.CurrentExtent)
					{
						while (resizeHistoryIncrease.NextLargerExtent < extent && layoutPhase < RibbonLayoutPhase.MaximumSize)
						{
							if (resizeHistoryIncrease.CanRedo())
							{
								if (resizeHistoryIncrease.NextLargerExtent > extent)
								{
									break;
								}
								resizeHistoryIncrease.Redo();
								continue;
							}
							if (layoutPhase == RibbonLayoutPhase.PreferredSize && groupMenuAgent != null)
							{
								break;
							}
							while (lastGroupIndexIncreased >= 0 && lastGroupIndexIncreased < base.Items.Count)
							{
								if (!(base.Items[lastGroupIndexIncreased] is RibbonGroupLayoutItem ribbonGroupLayoutItem2))
								{
									lastGroupIndexIncreased++;
									lastGroupToolIndexIncreased = -1;
									continue;
								}
								ActionHistory.ActionBase actionBase2 = ResizeGroup(ribbonGroupLayoutItem2);
								if (actionBase2 == null)
								{
									lastGroupIndexIncreased++;
									lastGroupToolIndexIncreased = -1;
									if (ribbonGroupLayoutItem2.LayoutPhase == LayoutPhase)
									{
										continue;
									}
									actionBase2 = new GroupPhaseChangeAction(ribbonGroupLayoutItem2, layoutPhase, resizeHistoryIncrease);
								}
								resizeHistoryIncrease.PerformAction(RibbonTabResizeHistory.NewOperationContextId, actionBase2);
								if (resizeHistoryIncrease.CurrentExtent <= extent)
								{
									continue;
								}
								resizeHistoryIncrease.Undo();
								return;
							}
							resizeHistoryIncrease.PerformAction(RibbonTabResizeHistory.NewOperationContextId, new RibbonTabPhaseChangeAction(this, layoutPhase + 1, resizeHistoryIncrease));
							lastGroupIndexIncreased = 0;
							lastGroupToolIndexIncreased = -1;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						while (resizeHistoryIncrease.CurrentExtent > extent && resizeHistoryIncrease.CanUndo())
						{
							resizeHistoryIncrease.Undo();
						}
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				DrawUtility.EndGraphicsCaching();
			}
		}

		protected override void InitializeLayoutItems()
		{
			base.Items.Clear();
			int num = ((GroupMenuAgent == null) ? 1 : 0);
			int num2 = ((GroupMenuAgent == null) ? 1 : 0);
			if (groupMenuAgent == null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < tab.Groups.Count; i++)
				{
					RibbonLayoutItemBase layout = tab.Groups[i].Layout;
					layout.Constraint.Fill = (FillType)3;
					layout.Constraint.Anchor = (AnchorType)1;
					layout.Constraint.Insets.Initialize(num, num2, num, num2);
					Add(layout);
				}
				if (tab.CanBeModified && tab.Ribbon != null && tab.Ribbon.IsDesignMode && tab.ToolbarsManager.Customizing && tab.ToolbarsManager.CustomizeDialog.ShouldDisplayRibbonAddButtons)
				{
					Add(new NewRibbonGroupLayoutItem(tab));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				RibbonLayoutItemBase groupLayout = groupMenuAgent.GroupLayout;
				groupLayout.Constraint.Fill = (FillType)3;
				groupLayout.Constraint.Anchor = (AnchorType)1;
				groupLayout.Constraint.Insets.Initialize(num, num2, num, num2);
				Add(groupLayout);
			}
			if (base.Items.Count > 0)
			{
				Add(RibbonPlaceholderLayoutItem.CreateHorizontalFillPlaceholder());
			}
		}

		internal override void LayoutContainer(Rectangle layoutRect, UIElement layoutElement, ArrayList oldElements)
		{
			DirtyLayoutIfNecessary();
			base.LayoutContainer(layoutRect, layoutElement, oldElements);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "Tab:" + tab.ToString();
		}
	}
	internal class NewRibbonGroupLayoutItem : RibbonLayoutItemBase
	{
		private RibbonTab tab;

		protected override bool IsVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (tab.Ribbon != null && tab.Ribbon.IsDesignMode)
				{
					return tab.Ribbon.ToolbarsManager.Customizing;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected override Size MinimumSize
		{
			get
			{
				Size result = Size.Empty;
				if (tab.Ribbon != null && tab.Ribbon.ToolbarsManager != null)
				{
					result = tab.Ribbon.ToolbarsManager.NewRibbonGroupButtonSize;
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		protected override Size PreferredSize => MinimumSize;

		internal RibbonTab Tab => tab;

		internal NewRibbonGroupLayoutItem(RibbonTab tab)
		{
			this.tab = tab;
			base.Constraint.Fill = (FillType)2;
		}

		protected internal override void ResetCachedSizes()
		{
		}
	}
	internal enum RibbonLayoutPhase
	{
		MinimumSize,
		CollapseRibbonGroup,
		RemovingToolCaptions,
		CollapsingExpandingLargeTools2,
		CollapsingExpandingGallery,
		CollapsingExpandingLargeTools,
		RemoveSeparators,
		ReduceRowCount,
		ReducingPreviewItems,
		PreferredSize,
		IncreasingPreviewItems,
		MaximumSize
	}
	internal abstract class ActionHistory
	{
		internal abstract class ActionBase
		{
			private ActionHistory actionHistory;

			internal ActionHistory ActionHistory => actionHistory;

			internal ActionBase(ActionHistory actionHistory)
			{
				if (actionHistory == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				this.actionHistory = actionHistory;
			}

			internal abstract bool CanPerform(object context);

			internal abstract bool Perform(object context, out ActionBase undoAction);
		}

		private class ActionsCollection
		{
			private readonly int MAX_ITEMS;

			private List<ActionBase> stack;

			internal int Count => stack.Count;

			internal ActionsCollection(int maxItems)
			{
				if (maxItems < 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
				}
				MAX_ITEMS = ((maxItems > 0) ? maxItems : int.MaxValue);
				stack = new List<ActionBase>();
			}

			internal void Push(ActionBase action)
			{
				stack.Add(action);
				if (Count > MAX_ITEMS)
				{
					stack.RemoveAt(0);
				}
			}

			internal ActionBase Peek()
			{
				return stack[Count - 1];
			}

			internal ActionBase Pop()
			{
				ActionBase result = Peek();
				stack.RemoveAt(Count - 1);
				return result;
			}

			internal void Clear()
			{
				stack.Clear();
			}
		}

		private ActionsCollection undoActions;

		private ActionsCollection redoActions;

		private bool isPerformingAction;

		private ActionsCollection UndoActions
		{
			get
			{
				if (undoActions == null)
				{
					undoActions = new ActionsCollection(MaxUndoDepth);
				}
				return undoActions;
			}
		}

		private bool HasUndoActions
		{
			get
			{
				if (undoActions != null)
				{
					return undoActions.Count > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private ActionsCollection RedoActions
		{
			get
			{
				if (redoActions == null)
				{
					redoActions = new ActionsCollection(MaxUndoDepth);
				}
				return redoActions;
			}
		}

		private bool HasRedoActions
		{
			get
			{
				if (redoActions != null)
				{
					return redoActions.Count > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private ActionBase UndoActionOnQueue
		{
			get
			{
				if (!HasUndoActions)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return UndoActions.Peek();
			}
		}

		private ActionBase RedoActionOnQueue
		{
			get
			{
				if (!HasRedoActions)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return RedoActions.Peek();
			}
		}

		protected virtual object UndoContext => null;

		protected virtual object RedoContext => null;

		protected virtual int MaxUndoDepth => 100;

		internal ActionHistory()
		{
		}

		internal bool CanUndo()
		{
			return UndoActionOnQueue?.CanPerform(UndoContext) ?? false;
		}

		internal bool CanRedo()
		{
			return RedoActionOnQueue?.CanPerform(RedoContext) ?? false;
		}

		internal void Clear()
		{
			ClearUndo();
			ClearRedo();
		}

		internal void ClearRedo()
		{
			if (HasRedoActions)
			{
				RedoActions.Clear();
				redoActions = null;
			}
		}

		internal void ClearUndo()
		{
			if (HasUndoActions)
			{
				UndoActions.Clear();
				undoActions = null;
			}
		}

		internal bool Undo()
		{
			if (HasUndoActions)
			{
				return UndoRedoHelper(UndoContext, UndoActions, RedoActions);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool Redo()
		{
			if (HasRedoActions)
			{
				return UndoRedoHelper(RedoContext, RedoActions, UndoActions);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool UndoRedoHelper(object actionContext, ActionsCollection xxStack, ActionsCollection yyStack)
		{
			ActionBase actionBase = xxStack.Pop();
			while (!actionBase.CanPerform(actionContext) && xxStack.Count > 0)
			{
				actionBase = xxStack.Pop();
			}
			return PerformActionHelper(actionContext, actionBase, yyStack);
		}

		private bool PerformActionHelper(object actionContext, ActionBase action, ActionsCollection undoList)
		{
			bool flag = isPerformingAction;
			isPerformingAction = true;
			try
			{
				ActionBase undoAction;
				bool flag2 = action.Perform(actionContext, out undoAction);
				if (flag2)
				{
					if (undoAction != null)
					{
						undoList.Push(undoAction);
					}
					else
					{
						Clear();
					}
				}
				return flag2;
			}
			finally
			{
				isPerformingAction = flag;
			}
		}

		internal bool PerformAction(object actionContext, ActionBase action)
		{
			return PerformActionHelper(actionContext, action, UndoActions);
		}
	}

			{
				undoAction = new RibbonTabPhaseChangeAction(tabLayout, tabLayout.LayoutPhase, base.TabActionHistory);

			undoAction = null;
			return false;

	internal class GroupPhaseChangeAction : RibbonPhaseAction
	{
		private RibbonGroupLayoutItem layout;

		private int extentAfter = -1;

		private int nextLargerExtent = -1;

		internal RibbonGroupLayoutItem Layout => layout;

		internal int ExtentAfter
		{
			get
			{
				return extentAfter;
			}
			set
			{
				extentAfter = value;
			}
		}

		internal int NextLargerExtent
		{
			get
			{
				return nextLargerExtent;
			}
			set
			{
				nextLargerExtent = value;
			}
		}

		internal GroupPhaseChangeAction(RibbonGroupLayoutItem layout, RibbonLayoutPhase phase, RibbonTabResizeHistory actionHistory)
			: base(phase, actionHistory)
		{
			this.layout = layout;
		}

		protected virtual GroupPhaseChangeAction CreateUndoAction(object context)
		{
			return new GroupPhaseChangeAction(layout, layout.LayoutPhase, base.TabActionHistory);
		}

		internal void InvalidateLayoutIfNecessary(RibbonLayoutPhase previousPhase, object actionContext)
		{
			if (actionContext == RibbonTabResizeHistory.NewOperationContextId && GetType() == typeof(GroupPhaseChangeAction))
			{
				switch (base.Phase)
				{
				case RibbonLayoutPhase.CollapseRibbonGroup:
				case RibbonLayoutPhase.RemovingToolCaptions:
				case RibbonLayoutPhase.CollapsingExpandingLargeTools2:
				case RibbonLayoutPhase.CollapsingExpandingGallery:
				case RibbonLayoutPhase.CollapsingExpandingLargeTools:
				case RibbonLayoutPhase.ReducingPreviewItems:
				case RibbonLayoutPhase.IncreasingPreviewItems:
					return;
				}
			}
			switch (base.Phase)
			{
			case RibbonLayoutPhase.ReduceRowCount:
				if (layout.Group.LayoutDirection == RibbonGroupToolLayoutDirection.Horizontal)
				{
					layout.InvalidateLayoutItems(resetReduceLargeToolsLastStartIndex: false);
					base.TabActionHistory.TabLayout.InvalidateLayout();
				}
				else if (previousPhase < RibbonLayoutPhase.ReduceRowCount)
				{
					layout.InvalidateLayoutItems(resetReduceLargeToolsLastStartIndex: false);
					base.TabActionHistory.TabLayout.InvalidateLayout();
				}
				break;
			case RibbonLayoutPhase.RemovingToolCaptions:
			case RibbonLayoutPhase.CollapsingExpandingGallery:
			case RibbonLayoutPhase.RemoveSeparators:
				layout.InvalidateLayoutItems(resetReduceLargeToolsLastStartIndex: false);
				base.TabActionHistory.TabLayout.InvalidateLayout();
				break;
			case RibbonLayoutPhase.PreferredSize:
			case RibbonLayoutPhase.IncreasingPreviewItems:
				layout.InvalidateLayout(recursive: true);
				base.TabActionHistory.TabLayout.InvalidateLayout();
				break;
			case RibbonLayoutPhase.CollapsingExpandingLargeTools:
				if (previousPhase < RibbonLayoutPhase.CollapsingExpandingLargeTools)
				{
					layout.InvalidateLayout(recursive: true);
				}
				else
				{
					layout.InvalidateLayoutItems(resetReduceLargeToolsLastStartIndex: false);
				}
				base.TabActionHistory.TabLayout.InvalidateLayout();
				break;
			case RibbonLayoutPhase.CollapsingExpandingLargeTools2:
				layout.InvalidateLayoutItems(resetReduceLargeToolsLastStartIndex: false);
				base.TabActionHistory.TabLayout.InvalidateLayout();
				break;
			case RibbonLayoutPhase.CollapseRibbonGroup:
				if (previousPhase >= RibbonLayoutPhase.CollapseRibbonGroup)
				{
					layout.InvalidateLayoutItems(resetReduceLargeToolsLastStartIndex: false);
					base.TabActionHistory.TabLayout.InvalidateLayout();
				}
				break;
			case RibbonLayoutPhase.ReducingPreviewItems:
				if (previousPhase < RibbonLayoutPhase.ReducingPreviewItems)
				{
					layout.InvalidateLayoutItems(resetReduceLargeToolsLastStartIndex: false);
				}
				else
				{
					layout.InvalidateLayout(recursive: true);
				}
				base.TabActionHistory.TabLayout.InvalidateLayout();
				break;
			case RibbonLayoutPhase.MinimumSize:
			case RibbonLayoutPhase.MaximumSize:
				break;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void PerformAction(object context)
		{
		}

		internal override bool CanPerform(object context)
		{
			return true;
		}

		internal override bool Perform(object context, out ActionHistory.ActionBase undoAction)
		{
			if (CanPerform(context))
			{
				RibbonLayoutPhase layoutPhase = layout.LayoutPhase;
				GroupPhaseChangeAction groupPhaseChangeAction = CreateUndoAction(context);
				groupPhaseChangeAction.ExtentAfter = base.TabActionHistory.CurrentExtent;
				groupPhaseChangeAction.NextLargerExtent = ((base.TabActionHistory.NextLargerExtent < 0) ? base.TabActionHistory.CurrentExtent : base.TabActionHistory.NextLargerExtent);
				undoAction = groupPhaseChangeAction;
				PerformAction(context);
				layout.LayoutPhase = base.Phase;
				InvalidateLayoutIfNecessary(layoutPhase, context);
				int width;
				int num;
				if (context == RibbonTabResizeHistory.NewOperationContextId)
				{
					width = ((ILayoutItem)base.TabActionHistory.TabLayout).MinimumSize.Width;
					num = ((width != base.TabActionHistory.CurrentExtent) ? Math.Max(width, base.TabActionHistory.CurrentExtent) : Math.Max(base.TabActionHistory.NextLargerExtent, width));
					if (groupPhaseChangeAction.NextLargerExtent < num)
					{
						groupPhaseChangeAction.NextLargerExtent = num;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					width = ExtentAfter;
					num = NextLargerExtent;
				}
				base.TabActionHistory.CurrentExtent = width;
				base.TabActionHistory.NextLargerExtent = num;
				return true;
			}
			undoAction = null;
			return false;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Format("Group phase change. Group='" + layout.Group.ToString() + "' Phase=" + base.Phase);
		}
	}
	internal class SingleToolSizeChangeAction : GroupPhaseChangeAction
	{
		private RibbonToolLayoutItem tool;

		private ToolBase.ToolSizeInfo size;

		internal SingleToolSizeChangeAction(RibbonToolLayoutItem tool, ToolBase.ToolSizeInfo size, RibbonGroupLayoutItem layout, RibbonLayoutPhase phase, RibbonTabResizeHistory actionHistory)
			: base(layout, phase, actionHistory)
		{
			this.tool = tool;
			this.size = size;
		}

		internal override bool CanPerform(object context)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override GroupPhaseChangeAction CreateUndoAction(object context)
		{
			return new SingleToolSizeChangeAction(tool, tool.Tool.CurrentToolSizeInfo, base.Layout, base.Layout.LayoutPhase, base.TabActionHistory);
		}

		protected override void PerformAction(object context)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (context == RibbonTabResizeHistory.NewOperationContextId)
			{
				RibbonLayoutPhase ribbonLayoutPhase = base.Phase;
				if (ribbonLayoutPhase == RibbonLayoutPhase.CollapsingExpandingGallery)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				tool.Tool.SetCurrentToolSize(size);
				tool.ResetCachedSizes();
				return;
			}
			Size preferredSize = ((ILayoutItem)tool).PreferredSize;
			ToolBase.ToolSizeInfo currentToolSizeInfo = tool.Tool.CurrentToolSizeInfo;
			tool.Tool.SetCurrentToolSize(size);
			tool.ResetCachedSizes();
			if (tool.Tool.CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstance().Width > preferredSize.Width)
			{
				tool.Tool.SetCurrentToolSize(currentToolSizeInfo);
				tool.ResetCachedSizes();
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Format("Single Tool Size Change. Tool='" + tool.ToString() + "' Phase=" + base.Phase);
		}
	}
	internal class MultiToolSizeChangeAction : GroupPhaseChangeAction
	{
		private RibbonToolLayoutItem[] tools;

		private ToolBase.ToolSizeInfo[] sizes;

		protected RibbonToolLayoutItem[] Tools => tools;

		protected ToolBase.ToolSizeInfo[] Sizes => sizes;

		internal MultiToolSizeChangeAction(RibbonToolLayoutItem[] tools, ToolBase.ToolSizeInfo[] sizes, RibbonGroupLayoutItem layout, RibbonLayoutPhase phase, RibbonTabResizeHistory actionHistory)
			: base(layout, phase, actionHistory)
		{
			this.tools = tools;
			this.sizes = sizes;
		}

		internal override bool CanPerform(object context)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override GroupPhaseChangeAction CreateUndoAction(object context)
		{
			ToolBase.ToolSizeInfo[] array = new ToolBase.ToolSizeInfo[sizes.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = tools[i].Tool.CurrentToolSizeInfo;
			}
			return new MultiToolSizeChangeAction(tools, array, base.Layout, base.Layout.LayoutPhase, base.TabActionHistory);
		}

		protected override void PerformAction(object context)
		{
			//IL_005d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0063: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00b5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00bc: Expected O, but got Unknown
			for (int i = 0; i < sizes.Length; i++)
			{
				RibbonToolLayoutItem ribbonToolLayoutItem = tools[i];
				ribbonToolLayoutItem.Tool.SetCurrentToolSize(sizes[i]);
				if (base.Layout.Items.Contains((ILayoutItem)(object)ribbonToolLayoutItem))
				{
					ribbonToolLayoutItem.ResetCachedSizes();
					continue;
				}
				foreach (ILayoutItem item in (IEnumerable)base.Layout.Items)
				{
					ILayoutItem val = item;
					if (val is RibbonToolLayoutItem)
					{
						RibbonToolLayoutItem ribbonToolLayoutItem2 = (RibbonToolLayoutItem)(object)val;
						if (ribbonToolLayoutItem2.Tool == ribbonToolLayoutItem.Tool)
						{
							ribbonToolLayoutItem2.ResetCachedSizes();
							break;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (!(val is RibbonContainerLayoutItem))
						{
							continue;
						}
						RibbonContainerLayoutItem ribbonContainerLayoutItem = (RibbonContainerLayoutItem)(object)val;
						foreach (ILayoutItem item2 in (IEnumerable)ribbonContainerLayoutItem.Items)
						{
							ILayoutItem val2 = item2;
							if (val2 is RibbonToolLayoutItem ribbonToolLayoutItem3 && ribbonToolLayoutItem3.Tool == ribbonToolLayoutItem.Tool)
							{
								ribbonToolLayoutItem3.ResetCachedSizes();
								break;
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Format("Multi Tool Size Change. Tool Count='" + tools.Length + "' Phase=" + base.Phase);
		}
	}
	internal class CollapsedGroupChangeAction : MultiToolSizeChangeAction
	{
		private bool isCollapsed;

		internal CollapsedGroupChangeAction(RibbonToolLayoutItem[] tools, ToolBase.ToolSizeInfo[] sizes, RibbonGroupLayoutItem layout, RibbonLayoutPhase phase, RibbonTabResizeHistory actionHistory, bool isCollapsed)
			: base(tools, sizes, layout, phase, actionHistory)
		{
			this.isCollapsed = isCollapsed;
		}

		internal override bool CanPerform(object context)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override GroupPhaseChangeAction CreateUndoAction(object context)
		{
			ToolBase.ToolSizeInfo[] array = new ToolBase.ToolSizeInfo[base.Sizes.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = base.Tools[i].Tool.CurrentToolSizeInfo;
			}
			return new CollapsedGroupChangeAction(base.Tools, array, base.Layout, base.Layout.LayoutPhase, base.TabActionHistory, base.Layout.IsCollapsed);
		}

		protected override void PerformAction(object context)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Sizes.Length; i++)
			{
				base.Tools[i].Tool.SetCurrentToolSize(base.Sizes[i]);
				base.Tools[i].ResetCachedSizes();
			}
			if (!isCollapsed || base.Layout == base.Layout.Group.Layout)
			{
				base.Layout.SetIsCollapsed(isCollapsed);
			}
			if (isCollapsed && !base.Layout.Group.IsGroupPopupOpen)
			{
				base.Layout.Group.HideContainedControls();
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Format("Collapse Group Size Change. Tool Count='" + base.Tools.Length + "' Phase=" + base.Phase);
		}
	}
