	internal abstract class RibbonMenuAgentBase : MenuAgentBase
	{
		private UltraToolbarsDockArea dockArea;

		private RibbonItem itemWithFocus;

		protected abstract object RootToolOwner { get; }

		protected internal abstract UIElementBorderStyle BorderStyleRegion { get; }

		internal UltraToolbarsDockArea DockArea => dockArea;

		internal RibbonItem ItemWithFocus
		{
			get
			{
				return itemWithFocus;
			}
			set
			{
				RibbonItem ribbonItem = itemWithFocus;
				itemWithFocus = value;
				if (ribbonItem != null)
				{
					ribbonItem.Deactivate();
					ribbonItem.Invalidate();
				}
				if (itemWithFocus != null)
				{
					itemWithFocus.Activate();
					itemWithFocus.Invalidate();
				}
			}
		}

		internal override bool AreTransitionsEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.ToolbarsManager != null)
				{
					return (base.ToolbarsManager.TransitionAreasResolved & ToolbarTransitionAreas.RibbonTools) != 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal override UIElementBorderStyle DropDownBorderStyle => (UIElementBorderStyle)1;

		internal override Corners DropDownRoundedCorners => (Corners)0;

		protected internal override PopupStyle PopupStyle => PopupStyle.Toolbar;

		protected override bool ShouldFadeOnClose => true;

		protected override bool ShowSupplementalDropShadows => false;

		protected RibbonMenuAgentBase(UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager)
			: base(toolbarsManager)
		{
		}

		private void DisposeDockArea()
		{
			if (dockArea != null)
			{
				dockArea.ReparentContainedControls(takeOwnership: false);
				((Control)(object)dockArea).Hide();
				((Component)(object)dockArea).Dispose();
				dockArea = null;
			}
		}

		internal virtual void PerformCleanup()
		{
			if (itemWithFocus != null)
			{
				itemWithFocus.Deactivate();
				itemWithFocus = null;
			}
			if (base.ToolbarsManager.ActiveTool != null && ContainsTool(base.ToolbarsManager.ActiveTool))
			{
				base.ToolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(null, setOn: false, clearToolBeingEdited: false);
			}
			if (base.ToolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture == RootToolOwner)
			{
				base.ToolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture = null;
			}
			DisposeDockArea();
		}

		protected internal override void AfterDropDown()
		{
			CreateDropShadows();
			base.AfterDropDown();
		}

		protected internal override void BeforeDropDown(ref bool cancel)
		{
			base.ToolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(null, setOn: false, clearToolBeingEdited: true);
			if (base.ToolbarsManager != null && base.ToolbarsManager.IsInEditMode)
			{
				cancel = true;
			}
			base.BeforeDropDown(ref cancel);
		}

		protected override void DropDownBegin()
		{
			base.DropDownBegin();
			if (dockArea != null)
			{
				dockArea.ReparentContainedControls(takeOwnership: true);
			}
		}

		protected override void DropDownFailed()
		{
			base.DropDownFailed();
			PerformCleanup();
		}

		protected internal override PopupControlBase GetPopupControl()
		{
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0062: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_011a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_012e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DisposeDockArea();
			RibbonMenuControl ribbonMenuControl = RibbonMenuControl.Create(this);
			((Control)(object)ribbonMenuControl).Size = CalculateRequiredDropDownSize();
			dockArea = new UltraToolbarsDockArea(this);
			((Control)(object)dockArea).Name = "DockArea";
			dockArea.ToolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			UIElementBorderWidths val = DrawUtility.CalculateBorderWidths(DropDownBorderStyle, DropDownBorderSides, ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)base.ToolbarsManager).UseFlatModeResolved);
			if (((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Bottom == 0 && ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Left == 0 && ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Right == 0 && ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Top == 0)
			{
				((Control)(object)dockArea).Dock = DockStyle.Fill;
			}
			else
			{
				((Control)(object)dockArea).Anchor = AnchorStyles.Top | AnchorStyles.Bottom | AnchorStyles.Left | AnchorStyles.Right;
				Rectangle clientRectangle = ((Control)(object)ribbonMenuControl).ClientRectangle;
				Rectangle bounds = new Rectangle(clientRectangle.X + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Left, clientRectangle.Y + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Top, clientRectangle.Width - (((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Left + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Right), clientRectangle.Height - (((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Top + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Bottom));
				((Control)(object)dockArea).Bounds = bounds;
			}
			((Control)(object)ribbonMenuControl).Controls.Add((Control)(object)dockArea);
			if (DrawUtility.IsRoundedBorderStyle(BorderStyleRegion))
			{
				((Control)(object)ribbonMenuControl).Region = DrawUtility.CreateBorderRegion(((Control)(object)ribbonMenuControl).ClientRectangle, BorderStyleRegion);
			}
			return ribbonMenuControl;
		}

		protected internal override void OnPendingDropDownCancelled()
		{
			base.OnPendingDropDownCancelled();
			PerformCleanup();
		}

		protected internal override void OnPopupClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			PerformCleanup();
			base.OnPopupClosed(sender, e);
		}

		protected internal override bool ProcessNavigationKey(Keys keyCode)
		{
			if ((keyCode == Keys.Return || keyCode == Keys.Space) && ItemWithFocus != null)
			{
				RibbonItemType itemType = ItemWithFocus.ItemType;
				if ((itemType == RibbonItemType.RibbonTool || itemType == RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDialogBoxLauncher) && ItemWithFocus.Context is ToolBase { EnabledResolved: not false } toolBase)
				{
					return toolBase.OnEnterKeyPressed();
				}
			}
			return base.ProcessNavigationKey(keyCode);
		}

		protected internal override void ResolveMenuAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, object context)
		{
		}
	}
	internal class RibbonTabMenuAgent : RibbonMenuAgentBase
	{
		private Ribbon ribbon;

		internal Ribbon Ribbon => ribbon;

		internal RibbonTab Tab => Ribbon.SelectedTab;

		protected internal override UIElementBorderStyle BorderStyleRegion => ribbon.Metrics.TabPageBorderStyle;

		protected internal override bool OkToDropDown
		{
			get
			{
				if (Tab != null)
				{
					return ribbon.IsMinimized_Legacy;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected override object RootToolOwner => Tab;

		internal override UIRole UIRole
		{
			get
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
				if (ultraToolbarsManager == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return StyleUtils.GetRole(ultraToolbarsManager, StyleUtils.Role.RibbonTabPageDropDown);
			}
		}

		internal RibbonTabMenuAgent(Ribbon ribbon)
			: base(ribbon.ToolbarsManager)
		{
			this.ribbon = ribbon;
		}

		protected internal override void AfterDropDown()
		{
			base.ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.AfterRibbonTabDropDown, new RibbonTabEventArgs(Tab));
			base.AfterDropDown();
		}

		protected internal override void BeforeDropDown(ref bool cancel)
		{
			BeforeRibbonTabDropDownEventArgs e = new BeforeRibbonTabDropDownEventArgs(Tab);
			base.ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.BeforeRibbonTabDropDown, e);
			if (!base.ToolbarsManager.EnforceOffice2007Resolution)
			{
				cancel = e.Cancel;
			}
			if (!cancel)
			{
				if (Ribbon.IsMinimized_Legacy)
				{
					Ribbon.OnBeforeTabMenuDropDown();
				}
				if (Tab != null)
				{
					Tab.BringIntoView();
				}
			}
			base.BeforeDropDown(ref cancel);
		}

		internal override void CalculateRequiredDropDownSize(out Size minSize, out Size preferredMinSize, out Size preferredSize, out Size maxSize)
		{
			preferredSize = (preferredMinSize = (maxSize = new Size(ribbon.RibbonContainerExtent, ribbon.Metrics.TabPageHeight)));
			minSize = Size.Empty;
		}

		internal override bool ContainsTool(ToolBase tool)
		{
			if (tool != null && tool.IsRootTool)
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = Tab.Groups.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					if (Tab.Groups[i].DialogBoxLauncherTool == tool)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			if (tool != null && tool.OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
			{
				return tool.IsWithinOwner(Tab);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override void OnPopupClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPopupClosed(sender, e);
			UIElement ribbonElement = Ribbon.GetRibbonElement(typeof(RibbonTabAreaUIElement));
			if (ribbonElement != null)
			{
				ribbonElement.DirtyChildElements(true);
			}
			if (base.ToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				base.ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.AfterRibbonTabCloseUp, new RibbonTabEventArgs(Tab));
			}
		}

		internal override void PerformCleanup()
		{
			base.PerformCleanup();
			if (base.ToolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture == Tab)
			{
				base.ToolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture = null;
			}
			Ribbon.OnAfterTabMenuCloseUp();
		}

		protected internal override bool ProcessMnemonic(char charCode)
		{
			List<IProcessMnemonic> list = new List<IProcessMnemonic>();
			Ribbon.GetToolsThatMatchMnemonic(charCode, list);
			List<RibbonGroup> list2 = new List<RibbonGroup>();
			Ribbon.GetGroupsThatMatchMnemonic(charCode, list2);
			List<RibbonTab> list3 = new List<RibbonTab>();
			Ribbon.GetTabsThatMatchMnemonic(charCode, list3);
			int totalMatchingItems = list.Count + list2.Count + list3.Count;
			if (base.ToolbarsManager.ProcessMnemonicForTools(list, totalMatchingItems))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (base.ToolbarsManager.ProcessMnemonicForGroups(list2))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.ToolbarsManager.ProcessMnemonicForTabs(list3);
		}

		protected internal override bool ProcessNavigationKey(Keys keyCode)
		{
			switch (keyCode)
			{
			case Keys.Tab:
			case Keys.Left:
			case Keys.Up:
			case Keys.Right:
			case Keys.Down:
			{
				RibbonItem ribbonItem = base.ItemWithFocus;
				RibbonItem ribbonItem2 = ribbonItem;
				if (ribbonItem != null && ribbonItem.Context is ToolBase && !((ToolBase)ribbonItem.Context).IsWithinOwner(Tab))
				{
					ribbonItem = null;
				}
				if (ribbonItem == null)
				{
					if (keyCode != Keys.Tab && keyCode != Keys.Down)
					{
						return Ribbon.ProcessNavigationKey(keyCode);
					}
					ribbonItem2 = Tab.GetFirstActivatableItem(includeDialogBoxLauncher: true);
				}
				else
				{
					RibbonLayoutItemDirection direction = Ribbon.GetDirection(keyCode);
					if (direction == (RibbonLayoutItemDirection)(-1))
					{
						ribbonItem2 = Ribbon.ProcessTabKey(ribbonItem, Tab);
						if (ribbonItem2 == null && direction == RibbonLayoutItemDirection.Above)
						{
							ribbonItem2 = ribbonItem;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						ribbonItem2 = RibbonTab.ProcessArrowKey(keyCode, ribbonItem);
						if (ribbonItem2 == null && keyCode == Keys.Up)
						{
							ribbonItem2 = null;
						}
					}
				}
				base.ItemWithFocus = ribbonItem2;
				return true;
			}
			case Keys.Return:
			case Keys.Space:
				if (base.ItemWithFocus != null)
				{
					RibbonItemType itemType = base.ItemWithFocus.ItemType;
					if (itemType == RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDropDownButton && base.ItemWithFocus.Context is RibbonGroup ribbonGroup)
					{
						ribbonGroup.DropDown();
						return true;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			return base.ProcessNavigationKey(keyCode);
		}
	}

				base.ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.BeforeToolDropdown, e2);
				if (!PopupTool.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea || !base.ToolbarsManager.EnforceOffice2007Resolution)
				{
					cancel = e2.Cancel;
				}
			}
			base.BeforeDropDown(ref cancel);
		}

		internal override void CalculateRequiredDropDownSize(out Size minSize, out Size preferredMinSize, out Size preferredSize, out Size maxSize)
		{
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			TabLayout.SetCurrentExtent(GetWidthConstraint(base.DefaultContext));
			Size preferredSize2 = ((ILayoutItem)TabLayout).PreferredSize;
			UIElementBorderWidths val = DrawUtility.CalculateBorderWidths(DropDownBorderStyle, DropDownBorderSides, ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)base.ToolbarsManager).UseFlatModeResolved);
			preferredSize2.Width += ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Left + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Right;
			preferredSize2.Height += ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Top + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Bottom;
			preferredSize = (preferredMinSize = (maxSize = preferredSize2));
			minSize = Size.Empty;
		}

		internal override bool ContainsTool(ToolBase tool)

			{
				return true;

			{
				return tool.IsWithinOwner(Group);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override void OnPopupClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPopupClosed(sender, e);
			group.InvalidateElements();
			if (base.ToolbarsManager != null)

				if (PopupTool == null)
				{
					base.ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.AfterRibbonGroupCloseUp, new RibbonGroupEventArgs(Group));

				}
			}
		}

		internal override void PerformCleanup()
		{
			base.PerformCleanup();
			if (PopupTool != null)
			{
				UltraToolbarsDockArea ultraToolbarsDockArea = ((Group != null && Group.Ribbon != null) ? Group.Ribbon.RibbonContainer : null);
				if (ultraToolbarsDockArea != null)
				{
					ultraToolbarsDockArea.ReparentContainedControls(takeOwnership: true);
					ultraToolbarsDockArea.DirtyChildElements();
				}
			}
			TabLayout.InvalidateLayoutItems();
			TabLayout.Items.Clear();
			GroupLayout.InvalidateLayoutItems();
			GroupLayout.Items.Clear();
		}

		protected internal override bool ProcessMnemonic(char charCode)
		{
			List<IProcessMnemonic> list = new List<IProcessMnemonic>();
			Group.GetToolsThatMatchMnemonic(charCode, list);
			return base.ToolbarsManager.ProcessMnemonicForTools(list, list.Count);
		}

		protected internal override bool ProcessNavigationKey(Keys keyCode)
		{
			switch (keyCode)
			{
			case Keys.Tab:
			case Keys.Left:
			case Keys.Up:
			case Keys.Right:
			case Keys.Down:
			{
				RibbonItem ribbonItem = base.ItemWithFocus;
				if (ribbonItem == null)
				{
					if (keyCode != Keys.Tab && keyCode != Keys.Down)
					{
						Ribbon ribbon = Group.Ribbon;
						if (ribbon != null)
						{
							if (!ribbon.IsMinimized_Legacy)
							{
								return ribbon.ProcessNavigationKey(keyCode);
							}
							if (ribbon.IsTabPopupOpen)
							{
								return ribbon.TabMenuAgent.ProcessNavigationKey(keyCode);
							}
						}
						return false;
					}
					ribbonItem = GroupLayout.GetFirstActivatableItem(includeDialogBoxLauncher: true);
				}
				else
				{
					RibbonLayoutItemDirection direction = Ribbon.GetDirection(keyCode);
					ribbonItem = ((direction != (RibbonLayoutItemDirection)(-1)) ? GetRelatedRibbonItem(Group, GroupLayout, ribbonItem, direction, requireSelectable: true, wrap: true) : Group.Ribbon.ProcessTabKey(ribbonItem, Group));
				}
				base.ItemWithFocus = ribbonItem;
				return true;
			}
			case Keys.Return:
			case Keys.Space:
				if (base.ItemWithFocus != null)
				{
					RibbonItemType itemType = base.ItemWithFocus.ItemType;
					if ((itemType == RibbonItemType.RibbonTool || itemType == RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDialogBoxLauncher) && base.ItemWithFocus.Context is ToolBase { EnabledResolved: not false } toolBase)
					{
						return toolBase.OnEnterKeyPressed();
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			return base.ProcessNavigationKey(keyCode);
		}

		internal static RibbonItem GetRelatedRibbonItem(RibbonGroup ribbonGroup, RibbonGroupLayoutItem ribbonGroupLayoutItem, RibbonItem ribbonItem, RibbonLayoutItemDirection direction, bool requireSelectable, bool wrap)
		{
			if (ribbonItem.ItemType == RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDialogBoxLauncher)
			{
				if (direction == RibbonLayoutItemDirection.Above)
				{
					RibbonToolLayoutItem ribbonToolLayoutItem = ribbonGroupLayoutItem.FindClosestToolLayoutItem(null, direction, requireSelectable, wrap: false);
					ribbonItem = ((ribbonToolLayoutItem == null) ? null : new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.RibbonTool, ribbonToolLayoutItem.Tool));
				}
			}
			else if (ribbonItem.Context is ToolBase tool)
			{
				RibbonToolLayoutItem startingItem = ribbonGroupLayoutItem.FindToolLayoutItem(tool);
				RibbonToolLayoutItem ribbonToolLayoutItem2 = ribbonGroupLayoutItem.FindClosestToolLayoutItem(startingItem, direction, requireSelectable, wrap);
				if (ribbonToolLayoutItem2 == null && (!requireSelectable || ribbonGroup.IsDialogBoxLauncherActivatable) && direction == RibbonLayoutItemDirection.Below)
				{
					ribbonItem = new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDialogBoxLauncher, ribbonGroup);
				}
				else if (ribbonToolLayoutItem2 != null)
				{
					ribbonItem = new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.RibbonTool, ribbonToolLayoutItem2.Tool);
				}
				else if (direction == RibbonLayoutItemDirection.Above)
				{
					ribbonItem = null;
				}
			}
			return ribbonItem;
		}
	}

		}

			UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			ultraToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.AfterAutoHideRibbonDropDown, EventArgs.Empty);
			base.AfterDropDown();
			if (ultraToolbarsManager.RegionSet)
			{
				Form form = UltraToolbarsManager.FindFormHelper((Control)(object)base.PopupControl);
				if (form != null && ultraToolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer is Form form2)
				{
					form.Region = form2.Region;
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override void BeforeDropDown(ref bool cancel)
		{
			CancelEventArgs e = new CancelEventArgs();
			base.ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.BeforeAutoHideRibbonDropDown, e);
			cancel = e.Cancel;
			base.BeforeDropDown(ref cancel);
		}

		internal override void CalculateRequiredDropDownSize(out Size minSize, out Size preferredMinSize, out Size preferredSize, out Size maxSize)
		{
			preferredSize = (preferredMinSize = (maxSize = new Size(((Control)(object)ribbon.RibbonContainer).Width, ribbon.Metrics.GetRibbonHeight(isAutoHideRibbonPopup: true))));
			minSize = Size.Empty;
		}

		internal override bool ContainsTool(ToolBase tool)
		{
			RibbonTab selectedTab = Ribbon.SelectedTab;
			if (selectedTab == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (tool != null && tool.IsRootTool)
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = selectedTab.Groups.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					if (selectedTab.Groups[i].DialogBoxLauncherTool == tool)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			if (tool != null && tool.OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
			{
				return tool.IsWithinOwner(selectedTab);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override PopupControlBase GetPopupControl()
		{
			PopupControlBase result = base.GetPopupControl();
			base.DockArea.Initialize(DockedPosition.Top);
			return result;
		}

		protected internal override void OnPopupClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Form form = UltraToolbarsManager.FindFormHelper((Control)(object)base.PopupControl);
			if (form != null)
			{
				form.Region = null;
			}
			base.OnPopupClosed(sender, e);
			base.ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.AfterAutoHideRibbonCloseUp, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		internal override void PerformCleanup()
		{
			base.PerformCleanup();
			base.ToolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture = null;
			ribbon.DisposeTabManager();
		}

		protected internal override bool ProcessMnemonic(char charCode)
		{
			List<IProcessMnemonic> list = new List<IProcessMnemonic>();
			Ribbon.GetToolsThatMatchMnemonic(charCode, list);
			List<RibbonGroup> list2 = new List<RibbonGroup>();
			Ribbon.GetGroupsThatMatchMnemonic(charCode, list2);
			List<RibbonTab> list3 = new List<RibbonTab>();
			Ribbon.GetTabsThatMatchMnemonic(charCode, list3);
			int totalMatchingItems = list.Count + list2.Count + list3.Count;
			if (base.ToolbarsManager.ProcessMnemonicForTools(list, totalMatchingItems))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (base.ToolbarsManager.ProcessMnemonicForGroups(list2))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.ToolbarsManager.ProcessMnemonicForTabs(list3);
		}
	}

		{
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

		protected override bool ProcessDialogKey(Keys keyData)
		{
			Keys keys = keyData & ~(Keys.Shift | Keys.Control | Keys.Alt);
			switch (keys)
			{
			case Keys.Escape:
				if (base.MenuAgent.IsOpen)
				{
					return base.MenuAgent.ToolbarsManager.ProcessEscapeKey(passToPopupContainer: false);
				}
				break;
			case Keys.Return:
			case Keys.Left:
			case Keys.Up:
			case Keys.Right:
			case Keys.Down:
				return base.MenuAgent.ToolbarsManager.ProcessNavigationKey(keys, passToPopupContainer: false);
			}
			return ((Control)(object)this).ProcessDialogKey(keyData);
		}
	}

		internal bool IsScrollButtonVisible(bool leftTop, Size sizeAvailable, bool isFlatMode)
		{
			if (ContentElement == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (leftTop)
			{
				return Position > 0;
			}
			int contentExtent = ContentExtent;
			if (IsScrollButtonVisible(leftTop: true, sizeAvailable, isFlatMode))
			{
				if (Orientation == Orientation.Vertical)
				{
					sizeAvailable.Height -= ribbon.Metrics.PagerButtonExtentResolved;
				}
				else
				{
					sizeAvailable.Width -= ribbon.Metrics.PagerButtonExtentResolved;
				}
			}
			int num = ((Orientation != Orientation.Vertical) ? sizeAvailable.Width : sizeAvailable.Height);
			if (num >= contentExtent - Position)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Position > 0 && contentExtent - (num + Position) <= ribbon.Metrics.PagerButtonExtentResolved)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void ProcessScrollButtonClick(RibbonPagerButtonUIElement scrollButton)
		{
			if (scrollButton == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = Position;
			int num2 = num;
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = scrollButton == leftTopScrollElement;
			int pagerButtonExtentResolved = this.ribbon.Metrics.PagerButtonExtentResolved;
			int num3 = ((Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal) ? ((UIElement)this).Rect.Width : ((UIElement)this).Rect.Height);
			num3 -= pagerButtonExtentResolved * 2;
			if (flag2)
			{
				num2 -= num3;
			}
			else
			{
				flag = true;
				num2 = ((Position >= pagerButtonExtentResolved) ? (num2 + num3) : (pagerButtonExtentResolved + num3));
			}
			if (!flag && num2 <= pagerButtonExtentResolved)
			{
				num2 = 0;
			}
			SetPosition(num2);
			if (Position != num)
			{
				((UIElement)this).DirtyChildElements(true);
				Ribbon ribbon = (Ribbon)((UIElement)this).GetContext(typeof(Ribbon));
				if (ribbon != null && ribbon.ShouldSerializeContextualTabGroups())
				{
					ribbon.DirtyRibbonCaptionElement();
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetPosition(int newPosition)
		{
			if (position != newPosition)
			{
				if (ContentElement == null)
				{
					position = newPosition;
				}
				else
				{
					newPosition = Math.Min(MaxScrollPosition, newPosition);
					newPosition = Math.Max(0, newPosition);
					position = newPosition;
				}
				if (scrollHandler != null)
				{
					scrollHandler(position);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			((ArrayList)(object)((UIElement)this).ChildElements).Clear();
			Rectangle rectInsideBorders = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
			ControlUIElementBase controlElement = ((UIElement)this).ControlElement;
			if (controlElement == null)
			{
				((ArrayList)(object)((UIElement)ContentAreaElement).ChildElements).Clear();
				return;
			}
			bool flag = Orientation == Orientation.Vertical;
			int pagerButtonExtentResolved = ribbon.Metrics.PagerButtonExtentResolved;
			bool isFlatMode = controlElement.UltraControl.IsFlatMode;
			if (IsScrollButtonVisible(leftTop: true, rectInsideBorders.Size, isFlatMode))
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					((UIElement)LeftTopScrollElement).Rect = new Rectangle(rectInsideBorders.X, rectInsideBorders.Y, rectInsideBorders.Width, pagerButtonExtentResolved);
					rectInsideBorders.Height -= pagerButtonExtentResolved;
					rectInsideBorders.Y += pagerButtonExtentResolved;
				}
				else
				{
					((UIElement)LeftTopScrollElement).Rect = new Rectangle(rectInsideBorders.X, rectInsideBorders.Y, pagerButtonExtentResolved, rectInsideBorders.Height);
					rectInsideBorders.Width -= pagerButtonExtentResolved;
					rectInsideBorders.X += pagerButtonExtentResolved;
				}
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)LeftTopScrollElement);
			}
			else if ((object)controlElement.ElementWithMouseCapture == LeftTopScrollElement)
			{
				controlElement.TerminateCapture();
			}
			if (IsPinButtonVisible)
			{
				RibbonContentAreaPinButtonUIElement ribbonContentAreaPinButtonUIElement = PinElement;
				Size size = TouchUtilities.AdjustForTouchMode(((UIElement)this).Control, ribbon.ToolbarsManager.TouchMetricsEnabledResolved, ribbonContentAreaPinButtonUIElement.DefaultSize);
				((UIElement)PinElement).Rect = new Rectangle(rectInsideBorders.Right - size.Width - 1, rectInsideBorders.Bottom - size.Height - 1, size.Width, size.Height);
				if (flag)
				{
					rectInsideBorders.Height -= size.Height;
				}
				else
				{
					rectInsideBorders.Width -= size.Width;
				}
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)ribbonContentAreaPinButtonUIElement);
			}
			if (IsScrollButtonVisible(leftTop: false, rectInsideBorders.Size, isFlatMode))
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					((UIElement)RightBottomScrollElement).Rect = new Rectangle(rectInsideBorders.X, rectInsideBorders.Bottom - pagerButtonExtentResolved, rectInsideBorders.Width, pagerButtonExtentResolved);
					rectInsideBorders.Height -= pagerButtonExtentResolved;
				}
				else
				{
					((UIElement)RightBottomScrollElement).Rect = new Rectangle(rectInsideBorders.Right - pagerButtonExtentResolved, rectInsideBorders.Y, pagerButtonExtentResolved, rectInsideBorders.Height);
					rectInsideBorders.Width -= pagerButtonExtentResolved;
				}
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)RightBottomScrollElement);
			}
			else if ((object)controlElement.ElementWithMouseCapture == RightBottomScrollElement)
			{
				controlElement.TerminateCapture();
			}
			((UIElement)ContentAreaElement).Rect = rectInsideBorders;
			((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Insert(0, (UIElement)(object)ContentAreaElement);
		}

		public class RibbonTabConverter : ExpandableObjectConverter
		{
			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					ConstructorInfo constructor = value.GetType().GetConstructor(new Type[1] { typeof(string) });
					RibbonTab ribbonTab = (RibbonTab)value;
					return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[1] { ribbonTab.Key }, isComplete: false);
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		[PermissionSet(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Name = "linkcheck", Unrestricted = true)]
		public sealed class ContextualTabGroupUITypeEditor : UITypeEditor
		{
			private IWindowsFormsEditorService edSvc;

			public override UITypeEditorEditStyle GetEditStyle(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				return UITypeEditorEditStyle.DropDown;
			}

			public override object EditValue(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IServiceProvider provider, object value)
			{
				if (context != null && context.Instance != null && provider != null)
				{
					edSvc = (IWindowsFormsEditorService)provider.GetService(typeof(IWindowsFormsEditorService));
					if (edSvc != null)
					{
						ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
						if (!(context.Instance is RibbonTab { Ribbon: var ribbon } ribbonTab))
						{
							return value;
						}
						if (ribbon == null)
						{
							return value;
						}
						arrayList.Add(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NoneLiteral"));
						foreach (ContextualTabGroup item in (IEnumerable)ribbon.ContextualTabGroups)
						{
							arrayList.Add(item);
						}
						object[] items = arrayList.ToArray();
						object contextualTabGroup = ribbonTab.ContextualTabGroup;
						DropDownListBox dropDownListBox = new DropDownListBox(items, contextualTabGroup);
						dropDownListBox.Click += OnListClick;
						edSvc.DropDownControl(dropDownListBox);
						if (dropDownListBox.SelectedItem != null && dropDownListBox.WasItemClicked)
						{
							value = dropDownListBox.SelectedItem as ContextualTabGroup;
						}
					}
				}
				return value;
			}

			private void OnListClick(object sender, EventArgs e)
			{
				if (edSvc != null)
				{
					edSvc.CloseDropDown();
				}
			}
		}

		public class RibbonTabItemAccessibleObject : TabItemAccessibleObject
		{
			private Ribbon ribbon;

			public RibbonTabItemAccessibleObject(Ribbon ribbon, ITabItem tabItem)
				: base(tabItem, ribbon.TabManager)
			{
				this.ribbon = ribbon;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
			{
				if (ribbon.IsMinimized_Legacy && ribbon.IsTabPageInView)
				{
					return ribbon.RibbonGroupAreaAccessibilityObject;
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override int GetChildCount()
			{
				if (ribbon.IsMinimized_Legacy && ribbon.IsTabPageInView)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return 0;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				switch (navdir)
				{
				case AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild:
				case AccessibleNavigation.LastChild:
					return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).GetChild(0);
				case AccessibleNavigation.Next:
				{
					int num = ribbon.Tabs.VisibleTabs.Count - 1;
					if (num >= 0)
					{
						object obj = ribbon.Tabs.VisibleTabs[num];
						ITabItem val = (ITabItem)((obj is ITabItem) ? obj : null);
						if (val == ((TabItemAccessibleObject)this).TabItem)
						{
							return ribbon.RibbonTabPagerButtonLeftAccessibilityObject;
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				}
				return ((TabItemAccessibleObject)this).Navigate(navdir);
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public RibbonTab AttachedParentTab
		{
			get
			{
				if (cachedAttachedParentTab == null)
				{
					UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
					if (toolbarsManager == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					UltraToolbarsManager mdiParentManager = toolbarsManager.MdiParentManager;
					if (mdiParentManager == null || mdiParentManager.ActiveMdiChildManager != toolbarsManager)
					{
						return null;
					}
					foreach (RibbonTab item in (IEnumerable)mdiParentManager.Ribbon.Tabs)
					{
						if (item.UnderlyingTab == this)
						{
							cachedAttachedParentTab = item;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (cachedAttachedParentTab == null)
					{
						string text = KeyLowercaseInterned;
						foreach (RibbonTab item2 in (IEnumerable)mdiParentManager.Ribbon.Tabs)
						{
							if (item2.KeyLowercaseInterned == text)
							{
								cachedAttachedParentTab = item2;
								break;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				return cachedAttachedParentTab;
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_RibbonTab_P_Caption")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Appearance")]
		[DefaultValue(null)]
		[Localizable(true)]
		public string Caption
		{
			get
			{
				return caption;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != caption)
				{
					VerifyCanBeModified();
					caption = value;
					DirtyTabItem(invalidate: true, textChanged: true, imageChanged: false);
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Caption);
				}
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_RibbonTab_P_ContextualTabGroup")]
		[DefaultValue(null)]
		[Editor(typeof(ContextualTabGroupUITypeEditor), typeof(UITypeEditor))]
		public ContextualTabGroup ContextualTabGroup
		{
			get
			{
				return contextualTabGroup;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != contextualTabGroup)
				{
					if (value != null && value.Ribbon != Ribbon)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("RibbonTab_TabAndGroupMustBelongToSameInstance"));
					}
					VerifyCanBeModified();
					if (ContextualTabGroupIndex >= 0)
					{
						contextualTabGroup.Tabs.RemoveAt(ContextualTabGroupIndex);
					}
					contextualTabGroup = value;
					if (contextualTabGroup != null && base.PrimaryCollection != null && ContextualTabGroupIndex < 0)
					{
						contextualTabGroup.Tabs.Add(this);
					}
					contextualTabGroupKey = value?.Key;
					if (!base.Disposed)
					{
						NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ContextualTabGroup);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		bool IKeyTipProvider.IsVisible
		{
			get
			{
				UIElement uIElement = UIElement;
				if (uIElement == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return !uIElement.ClipRect.Size.IsEmpty;
			}

		string IKeyTipProvider.KeyTipValue => KeyTip;

		Point IKeyTipProvider.Location
		{
			get
			{
				UIElement uIElement = UIElement;
				if (uIElement == null)
				{
					return Point.Empty;
				}
				ImageAndTextUIElement val = (ImageAndTextUIElement)(object)((uIElement is ImageAndTextUIElement) ? uIElement : null);
				TextUIElementBase val2 = null;
				if (val != null)
				{
					val2 = (TextUIElementBase)(object)val.TextElement;
				}
				if (val2 == null)
				{
					Rectangle rectangle = uIElement.Control.RectangleToScreen(uIElement.Rect);
					return new Point((rectangle.Left + rectangle.Right) / 2, rectangle.Bottom);
				}
				using Graphics graphics = uIElement.Control.CreateGraphics();
				using Font font = Ribbon.TabProvider.CreateMetricsFont();
				FontFamily fontFamily = font.FontFamily;
				int cellDescent = fontFamily.GetCellDescent(font.Style);
				int emHeight = fontFamily.GetEmHeight(font.Style);
				float height = font.GetHeight(graphics);
				int num = (int)Math.Ceiling(height * (float)cellDescent / (float)emHeight);
				Rectangle rectangle2 = ((UIElement)val2).Control.RectangleToScreen(((UIElement)val2).Rect);
				return new Point((rectangle2.Left + rectangle2.Right) / 2, rectangle2.Bottom - num);
			}
		}

		char IKeyTipProvider.Mnemonic => Utilities.GetFirstMnemonicChar(Caption);

		Control IKeyTipProvider.OwningControl
		{
			get
			{
				Ribbon ribbon = Ribbon;
				if (ribbon == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (ribbon.DisplayModeResolved == RibbonDisplayMode.AutoHide && ribbon.IsAutoHidePopupOpen)
				{
					return (Control)(object)ribbon.AutoHideMenuAgent.DockArea;
				}
				return (Control)(object)ribbon.RibbonContainer;
			}
		}

		public RibbonTab(string key)
			: this(key, key)
		{
		}

		public RibbonTab(string key, string caption)
			: base(key)
		{
			this.caption = caption;
		}

		protected RibbonTab(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "Caption":
					caption = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), caption);
					break;
				case "ContextualTabGroup":
					contextualTabGroup = (ContextualTabGroup)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ContextualTabGroup), contextualTabGroup);
					break;
				case "ContextualTabGroupKey":
					contextualTabGroupKey = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), contextualTabGroupKey);
					break;
				case "GroupSettings":
					groupSettings = (RibbonGroupSettings)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(RibbonGroupSettings), groupSettings);
					break;
				case "Settings":
					settings = (RibbonTabSettings)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(RibbonTabSettings), settings);
					break;
				case "Groups":
					groups = (RibbonGroupCollection)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(RibbonGroupCollection), groups);
					break;
				case "Visible":
					visible = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), visible);
					break;
				case "Key":
					Key = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), Key);
					break;
				case "Tag":
					DeserializeTag(current);
					break;
				case "KeyTip":
					keyTip = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), keyTip);
					break;
				case "MergeOrder":
					mergeOrder = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), mergeOrder);
					break;
				case "IsMdiMergeTab":
					isMdiMergeTab = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), isMdiMergeTab);
					break;
				case "IsStockItem":
					IsStockItem = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), false);
					break;
				case "RibbonCustomizedImage":
					ribbonCustomizedImage = Utils.DeserializeObjectProperty(current);
					break;
				case "RibbonCustomizedStockImage":
					ribbonCustomizedStockImage = Utils.DeserializeObjectProperty(current);
					break;
				case "RibbonCustomizationMergedTabKey":
					ribbonCustomizationMergedTabKey = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), ribbonCustomizationMergedTabKey);
					break;
				case "NonAutogenerateMergeGroupKeys":
					if (UltraToolbarsManager.UsingBinaryFormat)
					{
						nonAutogenerateMergeGroupKeys = (List<string>)Utils.DeserializeObjectProperty(current);
					}
					else
					{
						nonAutogenerateMergeGroupKeys = new List<string>((string[])Utils.DeserializeObjectProperty(current));
					}
					break;
				case "NotificationBadgeSettings":
					notificationBadgeSettings = (ToolNotificationBadgeSettings)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ToolNotificationBadgeSettings), null);
					((SubObjectBase)(object)notificationBadgeSettings).SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public void ResetGroups()
		{
			if (Ribbon != null && Ribbon.IsDesignMode && hasInheritedGroups)
			{
				for (int num = groups.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					if (!groups[num].Inherited)
					{
						groups.RemoveAt(num);
					}
				}
			}
			else if (groups != null)
			{
				groups.Clear();
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public RibbonTab CloneForRibbonCustomization(List<string> excludedToolKeys)
		{
			RibbonTab ribbonTab = new RibbonTab(Key);
			if (caption != null)
			{
				ribbonTab.caption = caption;
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				ribbonTab.Tag = Tag;
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeGroupSettings())
			{
				ribbonTab.groupSettings = (RibbonGroupSettings)groupSettings.Clone(this);
				ribbonTab.groupSettings.SubObjectPropChanged += ribbonTab.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (keyTip != null)
			{
				ribbonTab.keyTip = keyTip;
			}
			if (!visible)
			{
				ribbonTab.visible = visible;
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeSettings())
			{
				ribbonTab.settings = settings.Clone(this);
				ribbonTab.settings.SubObjectPropChanged += ribbonTab.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeRibbonCustomizedImage())
			{
				if (ribbonCustomizedImage is string)
				{
					ribbonTab.ribbonCustomizedImage = ((string)ribbonCustomizedImage).Clone();
				}
				else if (ribbonCustomizedImage is Image)
				{
					ribbonTab.ribbonCustomizedImage = ((Image)ribbonCustomizedImage).Clone();
				}
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeRibbonCustomizedStockImage())
			{
				if (ribbonCustomizedStockImage is string)
				{
					ribbonTab.ribbonCustomizedStockImage = ((string)ribbonCustomizedStockImage).Clone();
				}
				else if (ribbonCustomizedStockImage is Image)
				{
					ribbonTab.ribbonCustomizedStockImage = ((Image)ribbonCustomizedStockImage).Clone();
				}
			}
			ribbonTab.isMdiMergeTab = isMdiMergeTab;
			ribbonTab.underlyingTab = underlyingTab;
			if (HasGroups)
			{
				foreach (RibbonGroup item in (IEnumerable)groups)
				{
					int num = ribbonTab.Groups.Add(item.CloneForRibbonCustomization(excludedToolKeys));
					ribbonTab.Groups[num].SynchronizeRibbonCustomizationMergedKeys();
				}
			}
			return ribbonTab;
		}

		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (caption == null && visible && contextualTabGroup == null && !ShouldSerializeGroups() && !ShouldSerializeTag() && !ShouldSerializeGroupSettings() && !ShouldSerializeSettings() && keyTip == null && mergeOrder == 0)
			{
				return ShouldSerializeNotificationBadgeSettings();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			Caption = null;
			Visible = true;
			ContextualTabGroup = null;
			ResetTag();
			ResetGroupSettings();
			ResetGroups();
			ResetSettings();
			KeyTip = null;
			MergeOrder = 0;
			ResetNotificationBadgeSettings();
		}

				}
				else
				{
					ribbonCustomizationMergedTabKey = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private RibbonGroup GetParentGroupToMergeWith(RibbonGroup childGroup)
		{

				ribbonGroup.InitializeMdiMergeGroupFromChild(childGroup);

				return ribbonGroup;
			}

				}
			}
		}

		{

		private static void ResolveTabItemAppearancePhase(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, AppearanceResolutionPhase phase, RibbonTabSettings settings, bool tabItem, bool tab)
		{
			switch (phase)
			{
			case AppearanceResolutionPhase.Active:
				if (tabItem && settings != null && settings.HasActiveTabItemAppearance)
				{
					settings.ActiveTabItemAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
				break;

			}
			}

		internal void InternalSetUnderlyingTab(RibbonTab underlyingMdiChildTab)
		{

			{

				underlyingTab = underlyingMdiChildTab;
				HookUnderlyingTab();

					ParentCollection.DirtyVisibleTabs();
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsMnemonic(char charCode)
		{

				return false;

		internal bool IsVisible(bool considerCustomizeMode)
		{
			if (considerCustomizeMode)
			{
				Ribbon ribbon = Ribbon;
				if (ribbon != null && ribbon.Customizing && ribbon.IsDesignMode)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (!visible)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsHiddenByMdiMerge)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ContextualTabGroup != null && !ContextualTabGroup.VisibleResolved)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void MergeMdiChildTab(RibbonTab childTab)
		{
			if (childTab.ToolbarsManager != ToolbarsManager.ActiveMdiChildManager)
			{
				return;
			}
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList(Groups);
			if (IsMdiMergeTab)
			{
				InternalSetUnderlyingTab(childTab);
			}
			if (childTab.HasGroups)
			{
				foreach (RibbonGroup item in (IEnumerable)childTab.Groups)
				{
					RibbonGroup parentGroupToMergeWith = GetParentGroupToMergeWith(item);
					if (parentGroupToMergeWith != null)
					{
						parentGroupToMergeWith.MergeMdiChildGroup(item);
						arrayList.Remove(parentGroupToMergeWith);
					}
				}
			}
			bool flag = ToolbarsManager == null || ToolbarsManager.HasBeenRibbonCustomized;
			foreach (RibbonGroup item2 in arrayList)
			{
				if (flag && item2.ShouldSerializeRibbonCustomizationMergedGroupKey() && item2.ShouldSerializeRibbonCustomizationMergedTabKey())
				{
					int num = childTab.Ribbon.Tabs.IndexOf(item2.RibbonCustomizationMergedTabKey);
					if (num >= 0)
					{
						RibbonTab ribbonTab = childTab.Ribbon.Tabs[num];
						int num2 = ribbonTab.Groups.IndexOf(item2.RibbonCustomizationMergedGroupKey);
						if (num2 >= 0)
						{
							item2.MergeMdiChildGroup(ribbonTab.Groups[num2]);
							continue;
						}
					}
				}
				if (item2.HasTools)
				{
					item2.Tools.MergeMdiChildTools(null);
				}
			}
			if (HasGroups && Groups.Count > 1)
			{
				Groups.Sort(new RibbonGroupMergeOrderComparer());
			}
		}

		internal static RibbonItem ProcessArrowKey(Keys keyCode, RibbonItem itemWithFocus)
		{
			if (itemWithFocus == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			RibbonItem ribbonItem = null;
			switch (itemWithFocus.ItemType)
			{
			case RibbonItemType.RibbonTool:
			case RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDropDownButton:
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = itemWithFocus.Context as ToolBase;
				RibbonGroup ribbonGroup3 = ((toolBase == null) ? (itemWithFocus.Context as RibbonGroup) : toolBase.OwningRibbonGroup);
				if (ribbonGroup3 == null)
				{
					break;
				}

				RibbonLayoutItemDirection direction = Ribbon.GetDirection(keyCode);

				{
					break;
				}

				{

					if (ribbonToolLayoutItem3 != null)
					{
						ribbonItem = new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.RibbonTool, ribbonToolLayoutItem3.Tool);
					}
				}
				if (ribbonItem != null)
				{
					break;
				}
				switch (keyCode)
				{
				case Keys.Left:
				case Keys.Right:
				{
					Rectangle startingRect = ribbonToolLayoutItem2?.LastPosition ?? ribbonGroup3.Layout.LastPosition;
					startingRect.Width = 1;
					RibbonGroupLayoutItem ribbonGroupLayoutItem = ribbonGroup3.Tab.Layout.FindClosestLayoutItem(ribbonGroup3.Layout, typeof(RibbonGroupLayoutItem), direction, requireSelectable: false, wrap: true) as RibbonGroupLayoutItem;
					while (ribbonGroupLayoutItem != null && ribbonGroupLayoutItem.Group != ribbonGroup3)
					{
						if (ribbonGroupLayoutItem.IsCollapsed)
						{
							ribbonItem = new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDropDownButton, ribbonGroupLayoutItem.Group);
						}
						else
						{
							startingRect.X = ((keyCode == Keys.Left) ? ribbonGroupLayoutItem.LastPosition.Right : (ribbonGroupLayoutItem.LastPosition.Left - 1));
							RibbonToolLayoutItem ribbonToolLayoutItem4 = ribbonGroupLayoutItem.FindClosestToolLayoutItem(null, startingRect, direction, requireSelectable: true);
							if (ribbonToolLayoutItem4 != null)
							{
								ribbonItem = new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.RibbonTool, ribbonToolLayoutItem4.Tool);
							}
							else if (itemWithFocus.ItemType == RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDropDownButton && ribbonGroupLayoutItem.Group.IsDialogBoxLauncherActivatable)
							{
								ribbonItem = new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDialogBoxLauncher, ribbonGroupLayoutItem.Group);
							}
						}
						if (ribbonItem != null)
						{
							break;
						}
						ribbonGroupLayoutItem = ribbonGroup3.Tab.Layout.FindClosestLayoutItem(ribbonGroupLayoutItem, typeof(RibbonGroupLayoutItem), direction, requireSelectable: false, wrap: true) as RibbonGroupLayoutItem;
					}
					if (ribbonItem == null && ribbonToolLayoutItem2 != null)
					{
						RibbonToolLayoutItem ribbonToolLayoutItem5 = ribbonGroup3.Layout.FindClosestToolLayoutItem(ribbonToolLayoutItem2, direction, requireSelectable: true, wrap: true);
						if (ribbonToolLayoutItem5 != null)
						{
							ribbonItem = new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.RibbonTool, ribbonToolLayoutItem5.Tool);
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				case Keys.Down:
					if (!ribbonGroup3.Layout.IsCollapsed && ribbonGroup3.IsDialogBoxLauncherActivatable)
					{
						ribbonItem = new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDialogBoxLauncher, ribbonGroup3);
					}
					break;
				}
				break;
			}
			case RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDialogBoxLauncher:
			{
				RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = itemWithFocus.Context as RibbonGroup;
				switch (keyCode)
				{
				case Keys.Left:
				case Keys.Right:

							{
								ribbonItem = new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.RibbonGroupDialogBoxLauncher, ribbonGroup2);
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				case Keys.Up:
				{
					RibbonToolLayoutItem ribbonToolLayoutItem = ribbonGroup.Layout.FindClosestToolLayoutItem(null, RibbonLayoutItemDirection.Above, requireSelectable: true, wrap: false);
					if (ribbonToolLayoutItem != null)
					{
						ribbonItem = new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.RibbonTool, ribbonToolLayoutItem.Tool);
					}
					break;
				}
				}
				break;
			}
			}

		internal void SetNestedItemWithFocus(RibbonItem newItemWithFocus, bool bringIntoView)
		{
			if (Ribbon.IsMinimized_Legacy)

				{
					if (Ribbon.SelectedTab != null)
					{
						Ribbon.SetSelectedTab(this, expandRibbonIfCollapsed: true);
					}
					if (!Ribbon.IsTabPopupOpen)
					{
						Ribbon.SetNestedItemWithFocus(new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.TabItem, this), bringIntoView);
						return;

				}
				if (Ribbon.IsTabPopupOpen)
				{
					Ribbon.TabMenuAgent.ItemWithFocus = newItemWithFocus;

			}

			}
		}

		protected override void OnAddedToCollection(KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase primaryCollection)
		{
			if (primaryCollection is RibbonTabCollection ribbonTabCollection)
			{
				base.OnAddedToCollection(primaryCollection);
				parentCollection = ribbonTabCollection;
				Initialize();
				if (contextualTabGroupKey != null)
				{
					InitializeSerializedObjectsFromKey();
				}
				if (contextualTabGroup != null && ContextualTabGroupIndex < 0)
				{
					contextualTabGroup.Tabs.Add(this);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			UnhookUnderlyingTab();
			if (contextualTabGroup != null && !contextualTabGroup.Disposed)
			{
				ContextualTabGroup = null;
			}
			if (groups != null)
			{
				groups.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				groups.Dispose();
			}
			if (HasSettings)
			{
				settings.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				settings.Dispose();
			}
			if (HasGroupSettings)
			{
				groupSettings.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				groupSettings.Dispose();
			}
			parentCollection = null;
			cachedAttachedParentTab = null;
			if (notificationBadgeSettings != null)
			{
				((SubObjectBase)(object)notificationBadgeSettings).SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				((DisposableObject)(object)notificationBadgeSettings).Dispose();
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnRemovedFromCollection(KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase primaryCollection)
		{
			if (primaryCollection == parentCollection)
			{
				parentCollection = null;
			}
			base.OnRemovedFromCollection(primaryCollection);
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			PropertyIds propertyIds;
			if (propChange.Source == groups)
			{
				propertyIds = PropertyIds.Groups;
			}
			else if (propChange.Source != groupSettings)
			{
				propertyIds = ((propChange.Source == settings) ? PropertyIds.Settings : ((notificationBadgeSettings != propChange.Source) ? ((PropertyIds)(-1)) : PropertyIds.NotificationBadgeSettings));
			}
			else
			{
				ProcessGroupSettingsChange(propChange.Trigger);
				propertyIds = PropertyIds.GroupSettings;
			}
			NotifyPropChange(propertyIds, propChange);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Format("{0}[ {1} ] - {2}", Inherited ? "*" : string.Empty, Key, Caption);
		}

		void ITabItem.ResolveAppearance(TabState state, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			//IL_0003: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ResolveTabItemAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, state);
		}

		void IDeserializationCallback.OnDeserialization(object sender)
		{
			if (groupSettings != null)
			{
				groupSettings.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (groups != null)
			{
				groups.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (settings != null)
			{
				settings.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			OnDeserialization(sender);
		}

		bool IKeyTipProvider.Activate()
		{
			BringIntoView();
			bool flag = Ribbon.SelectedTab != this;
			Ribbon.SetItemWithFocus(new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.TabItem, this));
			Ribbon.SetSelectedTab(this, expandRibbonIfCollapsed: true);
			if (flag && Ribbon.SelectedTab == this)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = Ribbon.UIElement;
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					uIElement.VerifyChildElements();
				}
			}
			return Ribbon.SelectedTab == this;
		}

		bool IKeyTipProvider.Equals(IKeyTipProvider provider)
		{
			return this == provider;
		}

		{

		}

		{
			if (Ribbon.IsTabPopupOpen)
			{
				Ribbon.TabMenuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay: false, shouldHideAssociatedKeyTips: false);
			}
		}

		IKeyTipProvider[] IKeyTipContainer.GetKeyTipProviders()
		{
			List<IKeyTipProvider> list = new List<IKeyTipProvider>();
			List<IKeyTipProvider> list2 = new List<IKeyTipProvider>();
			foreach (RibbonGroup item in (IEnumerable)Groups)
			{
				list.AddRange(item.Tools.GetKeyTipProviders());
				ButtonTool dialogBoxLauncherTool = item.DialogBoxLauncherTool;
				if (dialogBoxLauncherTool != null)
				{
					list.Add(new DialogBoxLauncherKeyTipProvider(dialogBoxLauncherTool, item));
				}
				if (item.Layout.IsCollapsed)
				{
					list2.Add(item);
				}
			}
			IKeyTipProvider[] array = new IKeyTipProvider[list.Count + list2.Count];
			list.CopyTo(array, 0);
			list2.CopyTo(array, list.Count);
			return array;
		}

				if (name == "Settings")

				}
			}
		}

		private ToolBase[] GetMdiTools()
		{
			int num = 0;
			bool flag = MinimizeWindowTool != null;
			bool flag2 = RestoreWindowTool != null;
			bool flag3 = CloseWindowTool != null;
			int num2 = 0;
			if (flag)
			{
				num++;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				num++;
			}
			if (flag3)
			{
				num++;
			}
			ToolBase[] array = new ToolBase[num];
			if (flag)
			{
				array[num2++] = MinimizeWindowTool;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				array[num2++] = RestoreWindowTool;
			}
			if (flag3)
			{
				array[num2++] = CloseWindowTool;
			}
			return array;
		}

		internal ToolBase GetNextTool(ToolBase startAtTool, bool visibleToolsOnly, bool selectableToolsOnly)
		{
			ToolBase toolBase = null;
			ButtonTool pinButtonTool = GetPinButtonTool(visibleToolsOnly, selectableToolsOnly);
			if (startAtTool == null && pinButtonTool != null)
			{
				return pinButtonTool;
			}
			if (base.Tools.Count > 0)
			{
				toolBase = base.Tools.GetNextTool(startAtTool, visibleToolsOnly, selectableToolsOnly, recentlyUsedToolsOnly: false, wrapAround: false);
			}
			if (toolBase == null)
			{
				ToolBase[] mdiTools = GetMdiTools();
				for (int i = 0; i < mdiTools.Length; i++)
				{
					if (startAtTool == mdiTools[i])
					{
						startAtTool = null;
					}
					else if (startAtTool == null || startAtTool.Index >= 0)
					{
						ToolBase toolBase2 = mdiTools[i];
						if ((!visibleToolsOnly || toolBase2.VisibleResolved) && (!selectableToolsOnly || (toolBase2.CanActivate && toolBase2.EnabledResolved)))
						{
							toolBase = toolBase2;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return toolBase;
		}

		internal ToolBase GetPreviousTool(ToolBase startAtTool, bool visibleToolsOnly, bool selectableToolsOnly)
		{
			ToolBase toolBase = null;
			ButtonTool pinButtonTool = GetPinButtonTool(visibleToolsOnly, selectableToolsOnly);
			if (pinButtonTool != null && startAtTool == pinButtonTool)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (startAtTool == null || startAtTool.Index < 0)
			{
				ToolBase[] mdiTools = GetMdiTools();
				for (int num = mdiTools.Length - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					if (startAtTool == mdiTools[num])
					{
						startAtTool = null;
					}
					else if (startAtTool == null)
					{
						ToolBase toolBase2 = mdiTools[num];
						if ((!visibleToolsOnly || toolBase2.VisibleResolved) && (!selectableToolsOnly || (toolBase2.CanActivate && toolBase2.EnabledResolved)))
						{
							toolBase = toolBase2;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (toolBase == null && base.Tools.Count > 0)
			{
				toolBase = base.Tools.GetPreviousTool(startAtTool, visibleToolsOnly, selectableToolsOnly, recentlyUsedToolsOnly: false, wrapAround: false);
			}
			if (toolBase == null && pinButtonTool != null)
			{
				return pinButtonTool;
			}
			return toolBase;
		}

		private void LayoutToolbar()
		{
			layingOutToolbar = true;
			int num = ((ToolbarsManager != null) ? ToolbarsManager.ToolLayoutVersion : toolLayoutVersion);
			if (toolLayoutVersion != num)
			{
				toolLayoutVersion = num;
				int num2 = int.MaxValue;
				Control ribbonContainer = (Control)(object)ribbon.RibbonContainer;
				if (ribbonContainer != null)
				{
					int num3 = ribbon.RibbonContainerExtent - ribbon.TabItemElementHorizontalInsetLeft;
					int minAvailableTabAreaWidth = ribbon.Metrics.MinAvailableTabAreaWidth;
					int val = num3 - minAvailableTabAreaWidth;
					num2 = Math.Min(num2, val);
				}
				AdjustToolWidths(num2);
				Rectangle overallArea = new Rectangle(0, 0, num2, int.MaxValue);
				Size size = ToolAreaInformation.FromToolbar(this, overallArea).ToolbarMetrics.Size;
				if (cachedSize != size)
				{
					ribbon.Metrics.Dirty(Ribbon.RibbonMetricsFlags.MaxAvailableTabAreaSize);
					cachedSize = size;
				}
			}
			layingOutToolbar = false;
		}

	[Serializable]
	public abstract class RibbonTabCollectionBase : KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase, ISerializable, IDeserializationCallback
	{
		private object owner;

		private int initialCapacity = 3;

		protected override int InitialCapacity => initialCapacity;

		public override bool IsReadOnly => false;

		public override bool AllowEmptyKeys => false;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected override bool PreventSerialization => Count == 0;

		internal object Owner => owner;

		public RibbonTab this[int index] => GetItem(index) as RibbonTab;

		public RibbonTab this[string key] => GetItem(key) as RibbonTab;

		internal RibbonTabCollectionBase(object owner)
		{
			Initialize(owner);
		}

		protected RibbonTabCollectionBase(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.Value is RibbonTab)
				{
					RibbonTab ribbonTab = (RibbonTab)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(RibbonTab), null);
					if (ribbonTab != null)
					{
						List.Add(ribbonTab);
					}
					continue;
				}
				string name = current.Name;
				if (!(name == "Count"))
				{
					if (name == "Tag")
					{
						DeserializeTag(current);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					initialCapacity = Math.Max(initialCapacity, (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), initialCapacity));
				}
			}
		}

		protected override object[] CreateArray()
		{
			return new RibbonTab[Count];
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			RibbonTab[] array = All as RibbonTab[];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i].SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			InternalClear();
			owner = null;
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (propChange.Source is RibbonTab)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.RibbonTab, propChange);
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnSubObjectPropChanged(propChange);
			}
		}

		public int Add(RibbonTab tab)
		{
			return InternalAdd(tab, tab.IsMdiMergeTab);
		}

		public void AddRange(RibbonTab[] tabs)
		{
			if (tabs == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("tabs");
			}
			foreach (RibbonTab ribbonTab in tabs)
			{
				ValidateKeyInternal(ribbonTab.Key);
				AddTabHelper(ribbonTab, Count, notify: false, validateKey: true);
			}
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.RibbonTab);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			ClearHelper(notify: true);
		}

		internal void ClearHelper(bool notify)
		{
			if (Count > 0)
			{
				VerifyNotReadOnly();
				RibbonTab[] array = All as RibbonTab[];
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					array[i].SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				InternalClear();
				for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
				{
					OnRemoved(array[j]);
				}
				if (notify)
				{
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.RibbonTab);
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual void OnRemoved(RibbonTab tab)
		{
		}

		public void Remove(string key)
		{
			int index = IndexOf(key);
			RemoveAt(index);
		}

		public void Remove(RibbonTab tab)
		{
			int index = IndexOf(tab);
			RemoveAt(index);
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			VerifyNotReadOnly();
			RibbonTab ribbonTab = this[index];
			ribbonTab.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			InternalRemoveAt(index);
			OnRemoved(ribbonTab);
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.RibbonTab);
		}

		internal int AddTabHelper(RibbonTab tab, int index, bool notify, bool validateKey)
		{
			VerifyNotReadOnly();
			if (tab == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("tab");
			}
			if (validateKey)
			{
				ValidateKey(tab.Key, null);
			}
			OnInserting(tab);
			tab.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			List.Insert(index, tab);
			OnInserted(tab);
			if (notify)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.RibbonTab);
			}
			return index;
		}

		internal virtual void Initialize(object owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
		}

		internal int InternalAdd(RibbonTab tab, bool allowMdiTabReservedKeyName)
		{
			if (!allowMdiTabReservedKeyName)
			{
				ValidateKeyInternal(tab.Key);
			}
			return AddTabHelper(tab, Count, notify: true, validateKey: true);
		}

		internal virtual void OnInserting(RibbonTab tab)
		{
		}

		internal virtual void OnInserted(RibbonTab tab)
		{
		}

		internal void VerifyNotReadOnly()
		{
			if (IsReadOnly)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		protected virtual void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnDeserialization(object sender)
		{
		}

		private static void ValidateKeyInternal(string key)
		{
			if (key != null && key.StartsWith("_mdichild.merge.ribbontab.key_"))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("RibbonTabKeyReserved"));
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Count", Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, i.ToString(), this[i]);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				SerializeTag(info);
			}
			GetObjectData(info, context);
		}

		void IDeserializationCallback.OnDeserialization(object sender)
		{
			foreach (RibbonTab item in (IEnumerable)this)
			{
				item.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			OnDeserialization(sender);
		}
	}
	[Serializable]
	[Editor("Infragistics.Win.UltraWinToolbars.RibbonTabCollectionEditor, Infragistics4.Win.v21.1.Design, Version=21.1.20211.24, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=7dd5c3163f2cd0cb", typeof(UITypeEditor))]
	public class RibbonTabCollection : RibbonTabCollectionBase, IList, ICollection, IEnumerable, IProvideUIAutomation
	{
		private class VisibleRibbonTabCollection : IList, ICollection, IEnumerable
		{
			private class RibbonTabSortComparer : IComparer
			{
				private static IComparer instance;

				internal static IComparer Default => instance;

				static RibbonTabSortComparer()
				{
					instance = new RibbonTabSortComparer();
				}

				int IComparer.Compare(object x, object y)
				{
					RibbonTab ribbonTab = x as RibbonTab;
					RibbonTab ribbonTab2 = y as RibbonTab;
					ContextualTabGroup contextualTabGroup = ribbonTab.ContextualTabGroup;
					ContextualTabGroup contextualTabGroup2 = ribbonTab2.ContextualTabGroup;
					if (ribbonTab == ribbonTab2)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					if (ribbonTab.Ribbon.DesignerAddTab == ribbonTab)
					{
						return 1;
					}
					if (ribbonTab.Ribbon.DesignerAddTab == ribbonTab2)
					{
						return -1;
					}
					if (contextualTabGroup != null && contextualTabGroup2 == null)
					{
						return 1;
					}
					if (contextualTabGroup2 != null && contextualTabGroup == null)
					{
						return -1;
					}
					if (contextualTabGroup != null && contextualTabGroup2 != null && contextualTabGroup != contextualTabGroup2)
					{
						RibbonTab firstTab = contextualTabGroup.GetFirstTab(visibleOnly: true);
						RibbonTab firstTab2 = contextualTabGroup2.GetFirstTab(visibleOnly: true);
						if (firstTab == firstTab2)
						{
							return contextualTabGroup.Index.CompareTo(contextualTabGroup2.Index);
						}
						if (firstTab == null)
						{
							return 1;
						}
						if (firstTab2 == null)
						{
							return -1;
						}
						return firstTab.Index.CompareTo(firstTab2.Index);
					}
					return ribbonTab.Index.CompareTo(ribbonTab2.Index);
				}
			}

			private bool isDirty = true;

			private ArrayList list;

			private RibbonTabCollection tabs;

			private int version = int.MinValue;

			private ArrayList List
			{
				get
				{
					VerifySortOrder();
					return list;
				}
			}

			internal int Version => version;

			public int Count => List.Count;

			bool ICollection.IsSynchronized => false;

			object ICollection.SyncRoot => list.SyncRoot;

			public bool IsFixedSize => false;

			public bool IsReadOnly => false;

			public object this[int index]
			{
				get
				{
					return List[index];
				}
				set
				{
				}
			}

			internal VisibleRibbonTabCollection(RibbonTabCollection tabs)
			{
				list = new ArrayList(3);
				this.tabs = tabs;
			}

			private void BumpVersion()
			{
				if (version == int.MaxValue)
				{
					version = int.MinValue;
				}
				else
				{
					version++;
				}
			}

			internal void DirtySortOrder()
			{
				isDirty = true;
			}

			private void VerifySortOrder()
			{
				ArrayList arrayList = list;
				if (isDirty)
				{
					isDirty = false;
					BumpVersion();
					arrayList.Clear();
					arrayList.AddRange(tabs);
					if (tabs.Ribbon.DesignerAddTab != null)
					{
						arrayList.Add(tabs.Ribbon.DesignerAddTab);
					}
					arrayList.Sort(RibbonTabSortComparer.Default);
				}
			}

			IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
			{
				return List.GetEnumerator();
			}

			void ICollection.CopyTo(Array array, int index)
			{
				List.CopyTo(array, index);
			}

			public int Add(object value)
			{
				return List.Add(value);
			}

			public void Clear()
			{
				List.Clear();
			}

			public bool Contains(object value)
			{
				return List.Contains(value);
			}

			public int IndexOf(object value)
			{
				return List.IndexOf(value);
			}

			public void Insert(int index, object value)
			{
				List.Insert(index, value);
			}

			public void Remove(object value)
			{
				List.Remove(value);
			}

			public void RemoveAt(int index)
			{
				List.RemoveAt(index);
			}
		}

				IRawElementProviderFragment parent = ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)this).GetParent();

					return false;

				return false;

				return Utilities.GetMarshallingControl(((FragmentUIAProviderStub)this).GetParent());
			}

			public override IRawElementProviderFragment GetParent()
			{
				Ribbon ribbon = RibbonTabCollection.Ribbon;
				if (ribbon != null)
				{
					UIElement uIElement = ribbon.UIElement;
					if (uIElement != null)
					{
						UIElement descendant = uIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(RibbonTabItemAreaUIElement));
						if (descendant != null)
						{
							IProvideUIAutomation ancestor = (IProvideUIAutomation)(object)descendant.GetAncestor(typeof(RibbonPagerContentAreaUIElement));
							if (ancestor == null)
							{
								return null;
							}
							return ancestor.UIAutomationProvider;
						}
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override IRawElementProviderFragment GetFirstChild()
			{
				if (TabStubList.Count == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return tabStubList[0].Provider;
			}

			public override IRawElementProviderFragment GetLastChild()
			{
				int count = TabStubList.Count;
				if (count == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return tabStubList[count - 1].Provider;
			}

			public override IRawElementProviderFragment NavigateChildren(FragmentUIAProviderStub childStub, bool forward)
			{
				int num = TabStubList.IndexOf(childStub);
				if (num != -1)
				{
					num += (forward ? 1 : (-1));
					if (num >= 0 && num < tabStubList.Count)
					{
						return tabStubList[num].Provider;
					}
				}
				return ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)this).NavigateChildren(childStub, forward);
			}

			private void SynchronizeTabStubs()
			{
				VisibleRibbonTabCollection visibleRibbonTabCollection = RibbonTabCollection.VisibleTabs as VisibleRibbonTabCollection;
				if (visibleRibbonTabCollection.Version == currentVersion)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (tabStubList == null)
				{
					tabStubList = new List<FragmentUIAProviderStub>();
				}
				tabStubList.Clear();
				ContextualTabGroupCollection contextualTabGroups = RibbonTabCollection.Ribbon.ContextualTabGroups;
				foreach (ContextualTabGroup item in (IEnumerable)contextualTabGroups)
				{
					item.AutomationProviderStub.ClearStubs();
				}
				ContextualTabGroup contextualTabGroup2 = null;
				foreach (RibbonTab item2 in (IEnumerable)visibleRibbonTabCollection)
				{
					ContextualTabGroup contextualTabGroup3 = item2.ContextualTabGroup;
					if (contextualTabGroup3 != null)
					{
						contextualTabGroup3.AutomationProviderStub.AddTabStub(item2.AutomationProviderStub);
						if (contextualTabGroup3 != contextualTabGroup2)
						{
							tabStubList.Add((FragmentUIAProviderStub)(object)contextualTabGroup3.AutomationProviderStub);
							contextualTabGroup2 = contextualTabGroup3;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						tabStubList.Add((FragmentUIAProviderStub)(object)item2.AutomationProviderStub);
					}
				}
				currentVersion = visibleRibbonTabCollection.Version;
			}
		}

		private VisibleRibbonTabCollection visibleTabs;

		private int visibleTabsCount = -1;

		internal const string DefaultRibbonTabKey = "ribbon";

		private bool isInCollectionEditorChange;

		private Ribbon ribbon;

		private RibbonTabCollectionUiaProviderStub uiaProviderStub;

		internal bool IsInCollectionEditorChange

		private bool AutoSelectFirstTab
		{
			get
			{
				if (Ribbon.ToolbarsManager != null && !Ribbon.ToolbarsManager.Initializing)
				{
					return !isInCollectionEditorChange;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public Ribbon Ribbon => ribbon;

		internal IList VisibleTabs => visibleTabs;

			get

					CalcVisibleTabCount();

		internal RibbonTabCollection(Ribbon owner)
			: base(owner)

			visibleTabs = new VisibleRibbonTabCollection(this);
		}

		protected RibbonTabCollection(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			visibleTabs = new VisibleRibbonTabCollection(this);
		}

		internal override void Initialize(object owner)
		{
			ribbon = owner as Ribbon;
			base.Initialize(owner);
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				base[i].Initialize();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDeserialization(object sender)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				((IKeyedSubObject)base[i]).OnAddedToCollection((KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase)this);
			}
			DirtyVisibleTabs();
			base.OnDeserialization(sender);
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			RibbonTab[] array = All as RibbonTab[];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i].SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			DisposeCollectionItems();
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		internal override void OnInserting(RibbonTab tab)
		{
			if (tab.Ribbon != null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("RibbonTab_TabMemberOfDifferentRibbon"));
			}
		}

		internal override void OnInserted(RibbonTab tab)
		{
			((IKeyedSubObject)tab).OnAddedToCollection((KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase)this);
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = Ribbon.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager != null && toolbarsManager.Initialized)
			{
				tab.HookupAllSubObjects();
			}
			DirtyVisibleTabs();
			if (1 == Count && Ribbon.SelectedTab == null && AutoSelectFirstTab)
			{
				Ribbon.SelectedTab = tab;
			}
			Ribbon ribbon = Ribbon;
			string mergedParentTabKey = Ribbon.GetMergedParentTabKey(tab);
			if (ribbon.NonAutogenerateMergeTabKeys.Contains(mergedParentTabKey))
			{
				ribbon.NonAutogenerateMergeTabKeys.Remove(mergedParentTabKey);
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager2 = ribbon.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager2 == null || toolbarsManager2.ActiveMdiChildManager == null || !toolbarsManager2.RibbonCustomizationInProgress || !tab.HasGroups)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (RibbonGroup item in (IEnumerable)tab.Groups)
			{
				if (!item.HasTools)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (ToolBase tool in item.Tools)
				{
					if (!tool.DelayUnderlyingToolHookup)
					{
						continue;
					}
					int num = toolbarsManager2.ActiveMdiChildManager.Tools.IndexOf(tool.Key);
					if (num >= 0)
					{
						ToolBase toolBase = toolbarsManager2.ActiveMdiChildManager.Tools[num];
						if (toolBase.UnderlyingToolTypeID == tool.UnderlyingToolTypeID)
						{
							tool.InternalSetUnderlyingTool(toolBase);
							tool.DelayUnderlyingToolHookup = false;
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void OnRemoved(RibbonTab tab)
		{
			if (Ribbon == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DirtyVisibleTabs();
			if (!isInCollectionEditorChange)
			{
				Ribbon.RemoveTabFromContextualTabGroup(tab);
				if (tab == Ribbon.SelectedTab)
				{
					Ribbon.VerifySelectedTab();
				}
			}
			Ribbon ribbon = Ribbon;
			string mergedParentTabKey = Ribbon.GetMergedParentTabKey(tab);
			if (ribbon.ToolbarsManager != null && ribbon.ToolbarsManager.RibbonCustomizationInProgress && !ribbon.NonAutogenerateMergeTabKeys.Contains(mergedParentTabKey))
			{
				ribbon.NonAutogenerateMergeTabKeys.Add(mergedParentTabKey);
			}
		}

		public RibbonTab Add(string key)
		{
			ValidateKey(key, null);
			RibbonTab ribbonTab = new RibbonTab(key);
			AddTabHelper(ribbonTab, Count, notify: true, validateKey: false);
			return ribbonTab;
		}

		private void CalcVisibleTabCount()
		{
			int num = 0;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (base[i].VisibleResolved)
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			if (Ribbon.DesignerAddTab != null)
			{
				num++;
			}
			visibleTabsCount = num;
		}

		internal void DirtyVisibleTabs()
		{
			visibleTabsCount = -1;
			visibleTabs.DirtySortOrder();
			if (Ribbon != null)
			{
				Ribbon.Metrics.Dirty(Ribbon.RibbonMetricsFlags.TabVisibility);
				Ribbon.VerifySelectedTab();
			}
		}

		public void Insert(int index, RibbonTab tab)
		{
			AddTabHelper(tab, index, notify: true, validateKey: true);
		}

		public RibbonTab Insert(int index, string key)
		{
			ValidateKey(key, null);
			RibbonTab ribbonTab = new RibbonTab(key);
			AddTabHelper(ribbonTab, index, notify: true, validateKey: false);
			return ribbonTab;
		}

		public void InsertRange(int index, RibbonTab[] tabs)
		{
			if (tabs == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("tabs");
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < tabs.Length; i++)
			{
				AddTabHelper(tabs[i], index + i, notify: false, validateKey: true);
			}
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.RibbonTab);
		}

		internal void RepositionTab(RibbonTab tab, RibbonTab relativeTab, RelativePosition relativePosition)
		{
			//IL_005a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (tab.Ribbon != Ribbon || (relativeTab != null && relativeTab.Ribbon != Ribbon))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("RibbonTab_TabMemberOfDifferentRibbon"));
			}
			List.Remove(tab);
			int num = -1;
			num = relativeTab?.Index ?? (Count - 1);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = 0;
			}
			else if ((int)relativePosition == 1)
			{
				num++;
			}
			List.Insert(num, tab);
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.RibbonTab);
		}

		internal void Sort(IComparer comparer)
		{
			Utilities.SortMerge(List, comparer);
			visibleTabs.DirtySortOrder();
		}

		int IList.Add(object value)
		{
			int count = Count;
			((IList)this).Insert(count, value);
			return count;
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("value");
			}
			if (!(value is RibbonTab tab))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("InvalidArgumentType", "value", "RibbonTab"));
			}
			Insert(index, tab);
		}

		void IList.Remove(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("value");
			}
			if (!(value is RibbonTab tab))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("InvalidArgumentType", "value", "RibbonTab"));
			}
			Remove(tab);
		}

		bool IList.Contains(object value)
		{
			return Contains(value);
		}
	}
	public class ContextualTabsCollection : RibbonTabCollectionBase
	{
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public ContextualTabGroup ContextualTabGroup => (ContextualTabGroup)base.Owner;

		internal ContextualTabsCollection(ContextualTabGroup owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			ClearHelper(notify: false);
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		internal override void OnInserting(RibbonTab tab)
		{
			if (tab.Ribbon != ContextualTabGroup.Ribbon)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("RibbonTab_TabAndContextualTabNotInRibbon"));
			}
		}

		internal override void OnRemoved(RibbonTab tab)
		{
			if (ContextualTabGroup.ParentCollection == null || !ContextualTabGroup.ParentCollection.IsInCollectionEditorChange)
			{
				tab.ContextualTabGroup = null;
			}
			base.OnRemoved(tab);
		}

		internal override void OnInserted(RibbonTab tab)
		{
			if (tab.ToolbarsManager == ContextualTabGroup.ToolbarsManager && ContextualTabGroup.ToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				tab.ContextualTabGroup = ContextualTabGroup;
			}
			base.OnInserted(tab);
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class NonInheritedRibbonTabs : ICollection, IEnumerable
	{
		private class NonInheritedRibbonTabEnumerator : IEnumerator
		{
			private NonInheritedRibbonTabs collection;

			private int currentIndex = -1;

			public object Current
			{
				get
				{
					if (currentIndex == -1)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return collection[currentIndex];
				}
			}

			public NonInheritedRibbonTabEnumerator(NonInheritedRibbonTabs collection)
			{
				this.collection = collection;
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				if (currentIndex < collection.Count - 1)
				{
					currentIndex++;
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				currentIndex = -1;
			}
		}

		private RibbonTabCollectionBase ribbonTabs;

		public int Count
		{
			get
			{
				int num = 0;
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = ribbonTabs.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					if (!ribbonTabs[i].Inherited)
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		public bool IsSynchronized => ribbonTabs.IsSynchronized;

		public object SyncRoot => ribbonTabs.SyncRoot;

		public RibbonTab this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = ribbonTabs.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					RibbonTab ribbonTab = ribbonTabs[i];
					if (!ribbonTab.Inherited)
					{
						if (index == 0)
						{
							return ribbonTab;
						}
						index--;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public NonInheritedRibbonTabs(RibbonTabCollectionBase ribbonTabs)
		{
			this.ribbonTabs = ribbonTabs;
		}

		public void CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = ribbonTabs.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				RibbonTab ribbonTab = ribbonTabs[i];
				if (!ribbonTab.Inherited)
				{
					array.SetValue(ribbonTab, index++);
				}
			}
		}

		public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new NonInheritedRibbonTabEnumerator(this);
		}

		public void AddRange(RibbonTab[] ribbonTabs)
		{
			this.ribbonTabs.AddRange(ribbonTabs);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			for (int num = ribbonTabs.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (!ribbonTabs[num].Inherited)
				{
					ribbonTabs.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}
	}

		{
			ResetTag();

				appearances.Reset();
			}
		}

		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				if (appearances != null)
				{
					return appearances.ShouldSerialize();
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
