		internal RibbonTabSettings Clone(object newOwner)
		{
			RibbonTabSettings ribbonTabSettings = new RibbonTabSettings(newOwner);
			ribbonTabSettings.InitializeFrom(this);
			return ribbonTabSettings;
		}

		internal void Initialize(object owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
			if (ToolbarsManager != null && appearances != null)
			{
				appearances.Appearances = ToolbarsManager.Appearances;
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeFrom(RibbonTabSettings settings)
		{
			if (settings.ShouldSerializeActiveTabItemAppearance())
			{
				ActiveTabItemAppearance = settings.ActiveTabItemAppearance;
			}
			if (settings.ShouldSerializeAppearance())
			{
				Appearance = settings.Appearance;
			}
			if (settings.ShouldSerializeClientAreaAppearance())
			{
				ClientAreaAppearance = settings.ClientAreaAppearance;
			}
			if (settings.ShouldSerializeHotTrackSelectedTabItemAppearance())
			{
				HotTrackSelectedTabItemAppearance = settings.HotTrackSelectedTabItemAppearance;
			}
			if (settings.ShouldSerializeHotTrackTabItemAppearance())
			{
				HotTrackTabItemAppearance = settings.HotTrackTabItemAppearance;
			}
			if (settings.ShouldSerializeSelectedAppearance())
			{
				SelectedAppearance = settings.SelectedAppearance;
			}
			if (settings.ShouldSerializeSelectedTabItemAppearance())
			{
				SelectedTabItemAppearance = settings.SelectedTabItemAppearance;
			}
			if (settings.ShouldSerializeTabItemAppearance())
			{
				TabItemAppearance = settings.TabItemAppearance;
			}
			if (settings.ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				Tag = settings.Tag;
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyCanBeModified()
		{
			if (owner is RibbonTab)
			{
				((RibbonTab)owner).VerifyCanBeModified();
			}
			if (owner is ContextualTabGroup)
			{
				((ContextualTabGroup)owner).VerifyCanBeModified();
			}
		}

		void IDeserializationCallback.OnDeserialization(object sender)
		{
			if (appearances != null)
			{
				((SubObjectBase)(object)appearances).SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				appearances.Initialize((AppearancesCollection)null, AppearanceManagerPropIds);
			}
			OnDeserialization(sender);
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			if (appearances != null && appearances.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Appearances", appearances);
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
			GetObjectData(info, context);
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (appearances != null)
			{
				((SubObjectBase)(object)appearances).SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				((DisposableObject)(object)appearances).Dispose();
			}
			owner = null;
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (propChange.Source == appearances)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(propChange.PropId, propChange.Trigger);
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnSubObjectPropChanged(propChange);
			}
		}

		{
			return string.Empty;
		}

				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Appearance, propChange);
			}
			else if (HasEditAppearance && editAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChange.Source)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.EditAppearance, propChange);
			}
			else if (HasHotTrackAppearance && hotTrackAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChange.Source)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.HotTrackAppearance, propChange);
			}
			else if (HasPressedAppearance && pressedAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChange.Source)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.PressedAppearance, propChange);
			}
			else if (HasToolAppearance && toolAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChange.Source)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ToolAppearance, propChange);

			else if (HasHotTrackPressedAppearance && hotTrackPressedAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChange.Source)
			{

			}

		private void DisposeAppearanceHolder(ref AppearanceHolder appearanceHolder)
		{
			if (appearanceHolder != null)

		protected internal virtual void Initialize(object owner)
		{
			bool flag = ToolbarsManager != null;
			this.owner = owner;
			if (!flag && ToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				if (appearanceHolder != null)
				{
					appearanceHolder.Collection = ToolbarsManager.Appearances;
					appearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				if (editAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					editAppearanceHolder.Collection = ToolbarsManager.Appearances;
					editAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				if (hotTrackAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					hotTrackAppearanceHolder.Collection = ToolbarsManager.Appearances;
					hotTrackAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				if (pressedAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					pressedAppearanceHolder.Collection = ToolbarsManager.Appearances;
					pressedAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				if (toolAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					toolAppearanceHolder.Collection = ToolbarsManager.Appearances;
					toolAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				if (hotTrackPressedAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					hotTrackPressedAppearanceHolder.Collection = ToolbarsManager.Appearances;
					hotTrackPressedAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual void InitializeFrom(SettingsBase settings)
		{
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0040: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0054: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_007e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0083: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0072: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_009c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a6: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00d2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00d7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ba: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c4: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (settings != null)
			{
				if (settings.HasAppearance)
				{
					Appearance = (AppearanceBase)settings.Appearance.Clone();
				}
				if (settings.HasEditAppearance)
				{
					EditAppearance = (AppearanceBase)settings.EditAppearance.Clone();
				}
				if (settings.HasHotTrackAppearance)
				{
					HotTrackAppearance = (AppearanceBase)settings.HotTrackAppearance.Clone();
				}
				if (settings.HasPressedAppearance)
				{
					PressedAppearance = (AppearanceBase)settings.PressedAppearance.Clone();
				}
				showToolTips = settings.showToolTips;
				if (settings.HasToolAppearance)
				{
					ToolAppearance = (AppearanceBase)settings.ToolAppearance.Clone();
				}
				if (settings.HasHotTrackPressedAppearance)
				{
					HotTrackPressedAppearance = (AppearanceBase)settings.HotTrackPressedAppearance.Clone();
				}
				toolDisplayStyle = settings.toolDisplayStyle;
				useLargeImages = settings.useLargeImages;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeAppearance() && !ShouldSerializeEditAppearance() && !ShouldSerializeHotTrackAppearance() && !ShouldSerializePressedAppearance() && !ShouldSerializeTag() && !ShouldSerializeToolAppearance() && !ShouldSerializeUseLargeImages() && !ShouldSerializeShowToolTips() && !ShouldSerializeToolDisplayStyle())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeHotTrackPressedAppearance();
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void VerifyCanBeModified()
		{
			if (owner is UltraToolbarBase ultraToolbarBase)
			{
				ultraToolbarBase.VerifyCanBeModified();
			}
			if (owner is RibbonGroup)
			{
				((RibbonGroup)owner).VerifyCanBeModified();
			}
			if (owner is RibbonTab)
			{
				((RibbonTab)owner).VerifyCanBeModified();
			}
			if (owner is ContextualTabGroup)
			{
				((ContextualTabGroup)owner).VerifyCanBeModified();
			}
		}

	[Serializable]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]
	public sealed class SharedProps : ToolPropsBase, ISerializable, IToolsCollectionOwner
	{
		internal class CategoryTypeConverter : StringConverter
		{
			public override bool GetStandardValuesSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				return true;
			}

			public override StandardValuesCollection GetStandardValues(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				if (context != null && context.Instance is SharedProps)
				{
					UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ((SharedProps)context.Instance).ToolbarsManager;
					if (toolbarsManager != null)
					{
						List<string> list = new List<string>();
						foreach (ToolBase tool in toolbarsManager.Tools)
						{
							string categoryResolved = tool.CategoryResolved;
							if (!list.Contains(categoryResolved))
							{
								list.Add(categoryResolved);
							}
						}
						list.Sort(StringComparer.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase);
						return new StandardValuesCollection(list);
					}
				}
				return base.GetStandardValues(context);
			}
		}

					VerifyCanBeModified();
					accessibleDescription = value;
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.AccessibleDescription);
				}
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_SharedProps_P_MergeType")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Appearance")]
		public MenuMergeType MergeType
		{
			get
			{
				return mergeType;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == mergeType)
				{
					return;
				}
				VerifyCanBeModified();
				if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(MenuMergeType), value))
				{
					throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_46"));
				}
				if (value == MenuMergeType.MergeItems)
				{
					ToolBase tool = Tool;
					if (tool != null)
					{
						ToolBase underlyingTool = tool.UnderlyingTool;
						if (underlyingTool != null && !(underlyingTool is PopupMenuTool))
						{
							throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_InvalidEnumArgumentException_MergeItemsCanOnlyBeUsedOnPopupMenuTools"));
						}
					}
				}
				mergeType = value;
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.MergeType);
			}
		}

		internal ParsedFormattedTextValue FormattedDescriptionOnMenu => formattedDescriptionOnMenu;

		internal bool IsShowInCustomizerInitialized => showInCustomizerInitialized;

		internal string ShortcutString
		{
			get
			{
				Shortcut shortcutResolved = Tool.ShortcutResolved;
				if (shortcutResolved == Shortcut.None)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				if (!ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(shortcutString) && shortcutResolved == shortcutStringValue)
				{
					return shortcutString;
				}
				try
				{
					shortcutString = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetLocalizedShortcutString(shortcutResolved);
					shortcutStringValue = shortcutResolved;
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return shortcutString;
			}
		}

		{
			get

				if (rootTool != null)
				{
					return rootTool.ToolbarsManager;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				if (rootTool == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return rootTool.ToolbarsManager;
			}
		}

		internal SharedProps()
		{
		}

		private SharedProps(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "AccessibleDescription":
					accessibleDescription = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), accessibleDescription);
					break;
				case "AccessibleName":
					accessibleName = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), accessibleName);
					break;
				case "AccessibleRole":
					accessibleRole = (AccessibleRole)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(AccessibleRole), accessibleRole);
					break;
				case "AllowMultipleInstances":
					allowMultipleInstances = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), allowMultipleInstances);
					allowMultipleInstancesInitialized = true;
					break;
				case "Category":
					category = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), category);
					break;
				case "CustomizedShortcut":
					customizedShortcut = (Shortcut)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(Shortcut), customizedShortcut);
					break;
				case "CustomizerCaption":
					customizerCaption = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), customizerCaption);
					break;
				case "CustomizerDescription":
					customizerDescription = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), customizerDescription);
					break;
				case "Enabled":
					enabled = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), enabled);
					break;
				case "IsShortcutCustomized":
					isShortcutCustomized = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), isShortcutCustomized);
					break;
				case "MergeOrder":
					mergeOrder = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), mergeOrder);
					break;
				case "MergeType":
					mergeType = (MenuMergeType)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(MenuMergeType), mergeType);
					break;
				case "Shortcut":
					shortcut = (Shortcut)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(Shortcut), shortcut);
					break;
				case "ShowInCustomizer":
					showInCustomizer = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), showInCustomizer);
					showInCustomizerInitialized = true;
					break;
				case "Spring":
					spring = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), spring);
					break;
				case "ToolTipText":
					toolTipText = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), toolTipText);
					break;
				case "ToolTipTextFormatted":
					toolTipTextFormatted = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), toolTipTextFormatted);
					break;
				case "ToolTipTitle":
					toolTipTitle = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), toolTipTitle);
					break;
				case "Visible":
					visible = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), visible);
					break;
				case "StatusText":
					statusText = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), statusText);
					break;
				case "DescriptionOnMenu":
					descriptionOnMenu = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), descriptionOnMenu);
					formattedDescriptionOnMenu = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ParseFormattedText(descriptionOnMenu, throwError: false);
					break;
				case "Priority":
					priority = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), priority);
					break;
				case "PopularCommand":
					popularCommand = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), popularCommand);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
			if (ShouldSerializeAccessibleDescription())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "AccessibleDescription", accessibleDescription);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeAccessibleName())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "AccessibleName", accessibleName);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeAccessibleRole())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "AccessibleRole", accessibleRole);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeAllowMultipleInstances())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "AllowMultipleInstances", allowMultipleInstances);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeCategory())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Category", category);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeCustomizerCaption())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "CustomizerCaption", customizerCaption);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeCustomizerDescription())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "CustomizerDescription", customizerDescription);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeEnabled())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Enabled", enabled);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeMergeOrder())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MergeOrder", mergeOrder);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeMergeType())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MergeType", mergeType);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeShortcut())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Shortcut", shortcut);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeShowInCustomizer())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ShowInCustomizer", showInCustomizer);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeSpring())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Spring", spring);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeToolTipText())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ToolTipText", toolTipText);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeToolTipTextFormatted())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ToolTipTextFormatted", toolTipTextFormatted);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeToolTipTitle())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ToolTipTitle", toolTipTitle);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeVisible())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Visible", visible);
			}
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "CustomizedShortcut", customizedShortcut);
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "IsShortcutCustomized", isShortcutCustomized);
			if (ShouldSerializeStatusText())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "StatusText", statusText);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeDescriptionOnMenu())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "DescriptionOnMenu", descriptionOnMenu);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializePriority())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Priority", priority);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializePopularCommand())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "PopularCommand", popularCommand);
			}
		}

		internal override void Initialize(ToolBase tool)
		{
			rootTool = tool;
			base.Initialize(tool);
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			base.OnDispose();
			rootTool = null;
			if (toolInstances != null)
			{
				toolInstances.ClearInternal();
				toolInstances = null;
			}
			if (extraSharedProps == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < extraSharedProps.Length; i++)
			{
				if (extraSharedProps[i] is IDisposable disposable)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
				extraSharedProps[i] = null;
			}
			extraSharedProps = null;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerializeAccessibleDescription()
		{
			if (accessibleDescription != null)
			{
				return accessibleDescription.Length > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetAccessibleDescription()
		{
			AccessibleDescription = null;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerializeAccessibleName()
		{
			if (accessibleName != null)
			{
				return accessibleName.Length > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetAccessibleName()
		{
			AccessibleName = null;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerializeAccessibleRole()
		{
			return accessibleRole != AccessibleRole.Default;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetAccessibleRole()
		{
			AccessibleRole = AccessibleRole.Default;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerializeAllowMultipleInstances()
		{
			if (rootTool != null)
			{
				return allowMultipleInstances != rootTool.DefaultAllowMultipleInstances;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetAllowMultipleInstances()
		{
			if (rootTool != null)
			{
				AllowMultipleInstances = rootTool.DefaultAllowMultipleInstances;
			}
			else
			{
				allowMultipleInstances = true;
			}
			allowMultipleInstancesInitialized = false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerializeCategory()

			return !ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(category);
		}

		{
			Category = string.Empty;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]

		internal void RemoveToolInstancesHelper(bool leaveOneInstance)
		{
			if (rootTool == null || toolInstances == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			object[] all = toolInstances.All;
			int num = 0;
			object[] array = all;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = (ToolBase)array[i];
				int num2 = 0;
				if (toolBase.InstanceProps != null && toolBase.OwnerIsMenu && !toolBase.OwningMenu.IsRootTool)
				{
					num2 = toolBase.OwningMenu.Tools.Count;
				}
				if (toolBase.InstanceProps != null && toolBase.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)
				{
					num2 = toolBase.OwningApplicationMenuArea.Tools.Count;
				}
			}
			object[] array2 = all;
			for (int j = 0; j < array2.Length; j++)
			{
				ToolBase toolBase2 = (ToolBase)array2[j];
				if (toolBase2.IsRootTool || toolBase2.OwnerIsNull || (toolBase2.InstanceProps != null && toolBase2.OwnerIsMenu && !toolBase2.OwningMenu.IsRootTool) || (toolBase2.InstanceProps != null && toolBase2.OwnerIsRibbonGroup && toolBase2.OwningRibbonGroup.UnderlyingGroup != null))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (num > 0 || !leaveOneInstance)
				{
					if (toolBase2.OwnerIsMenu && toolBase2.OwningMenu.IsRootTool)
					{
						toolBase2.ParentCollection.Remove(toolBase2);
					}
					else if (toolBase2.OwnerIsToolbarBase)
					{
						toolBase2.ParentCollection.RemoveHelper(toolBase2, honorReadOnlyStatus: false);
					}
					else if (toolBase2.OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
					{
						toolBase2.ParentCollection.RemoveHelper(toolBase2, honorReadOnlyStatus: false);
					}
					else if (toolBase2.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)
					{
						toolBase2.ParentCollection.Remove(toolBase2);
					}
				}
				num++;
			}
		}

		internal void ResetCustomizedShortcut()
		{
			customizedShortcut = Shortcut.None;
			isShortcutCustomized = false;
		}

		internal void SetExtraSharedProps(object extraSharedProps, int extraSharedPropsIndex, int totalExtraSharedProps)
		{

		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeAccessibleDescription() && !ShouldSerializeAccessibleName() && !ShouldSerializeAccessibleRole() && !ShouldSerializeAllowMultipleInstances() && !ShouldSerializeCategory() && !ShouldSerializeCustomizerDescription() && !ShouldSerializeCustomizerCaption() && !ShouldSerializeEnabled() && !ShouldSerializeMergeOrder() && !ShouldSerializeMergeType() && !ShouldSerializePriority() && !ShouldSerializeShortcut() && !ShouldSerializeShowInCustomizer() && !ShouldSerializeSpring() && !ShouldSerializeToolTipText() && !ShouldSerializeToolTipTextFormatted() && !ShouldSerializeToolTipTitle() && !ShouldSerializeDescriptionOnMenu() && !ShouldSerializeStatusText() && !ShouldSerializePopularCommand() && customizedShortcut == Shortcut.None)
			{
				return ShouldSerializeVisible();
			}
			return true;
		}

	internal abstract class SpecialCommandMenuItemBase : MenuItemBase
	{
		private bool activated;

		protected internal override bool CanActivate => true;

		protected internal override bool DisplayImage => false;

		protected internal override bool DrawAsActive => activated;

		protected internal override bool Enabled => true;

		protected internal override ImageList ImageList => null;

		protected internal override bool IsOpen => false;

		protected internal override bool IsPopup => false;

		protected internal override bool RecentlyUsed => true;

		protected internal override string ShortcutText => string.Empty;

		internal SpecialCommandMenuItemBase()
		{
		}

		protected internal override void Activate()
		{
			base.Activate();
			if (Enabled)
			{
				activated = true;
				base.MenuAgent.CloseOpenSubmenuTools(null, delay: true);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void Deactivate()
		{
			base.Deactivate();
			activated = false;
		}

		protected internal override void DropDown(Control owningControl, Point point, Rectangle exclusionRect, DropDownPosition dropDownPosition, bool delay, bool closeIfAlreadyOpen, bool alignRight, bool autocloseDropdown)
		{
		}

		protected internal override Size GetTextSize()
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
			AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)65011720;
			ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, DrawAsActive);
			return GetTextSize(ref appearance);
		}

		protected internal override Size GetTextSize(ref AppearanceData appearance)
		{
			string text = Text;
			return MeasureString(ref appearance, null, text);
		}

		protected internal override void ResolveAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, bool drawAsActive)
		{
			if ((base.MenuAgent.ShouldShowImages(this) || base.MenuAgent.ShouldShowAddRemoveCheckColumn(this)) && ((ulong)requestedProps & 0x10uL) != 0L)
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).TextHAlign = (HAlign)1;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEFuL);
			}
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x20uL) != 0L)
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).TextVAlign = (VAlign)2;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFDFuL);
			}
			ToolbarsManager.ResolvePopupItemAppearance(base.MenuAgent.TearawayTool, UIRole, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, DrawAsActive, this);
		}
	}

		protected override bool OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e, bool adjustableArea, ref UIElement captureMouseForElement)

			return false;
		}

		}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)this).Rect;
			rect.Inflate(-1, -1);
			((ArrayList)(object)((UIElement)this).ChildElements).Clear();
			int num = 0;
			if (MenuAgent.ShouldShowImages(MenuItem) || MenuAgent.ShouldShowAddRemoveCheckColumn(MenuItem))
			{
				num = MenuItem.GetImageRect((UIElement)(object)this).Width + MenuAgent.Metrics.MenuitemTextPaddingLeft - 1;
				if (MenuAgent.ShouldShowImages(MenuItem))
				{
					num += MenuAgent.Metrics.MenuitemImagePaddingLeft + MenuAgent.Metrics.MenuitemImagePaddingRight;
				}
			}
			rect.X += num;
			rect.Width -= num;
			((UIElement)TextElement).Rect = rect;
			((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)TextElement);
		}
	}

		}

		public UltraToolbarsManager ToolbarsManager
		{
			get
			{
				if (tool == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return tool.ToolbarsManager;
			}
		}

		public override Region Region
		{
			get
			{
				if (ShouldDrawRoundedBorders)
				{
					return DrawUtility.CreateBorderRegion(((UIElement)this).Rect, (UIElementBorderStyle)10, (Corners)15);
				}
				return ((UIElement)this).Region;
			}
		}

		public override UIRole UIRole
		{
			get
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = Tool;
				if (toolBase != null)
				{
					if (toolBase.OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
					{
						return toolBase.UIRoleOnRibbonGroups;
					}
					return toolBase.UIRoleOnToolbars;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		{

				return false;
			}
		}

		internal void Initialize(PopupToolBase tool)
		{
			this.tool = tool;
			((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext = tool;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override int GetNonClientHitTestCode(Point point)
		{
			return 1;
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e, bool adjustableArea, ref UIElement captureMouseForElement)
		{
			if (e.Button == MouseButtons.Left && tool != null && tool.EnabledResolved)
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager != null && !toolbarsManager.Customizing)
				{
					if (tool.IsOpen)
					{
						tool.CloseDropDown();
					}
					else
					{
						ControlUIElementBase controlElement = ((UIElement)this).ControlElement;
						Control control = ((controlElement != null) ? ((UIElement)controlElement).Control : null);
						if (control != null && control.IsHandleCreated)
						{
							Rectangle rectangle = control.RectangleToScreen(((UIElement)this).Rect);
							Point dropDownPoint = tool.GetDropDownPoint(rectangle);
							tool.DropDown(control, dropDownPoint, rectangle, (DropDownPosition)0, delay: false, closeIfAlreadyOpen: true, tool.ToolbarsManager.RightAlignedMenusResolved, autocloseDropdown: true, null);
							((UIElement)this).Invalidate();
						}
					}
					return true;
				}
			}
			return ((UIElement)this).OnMouseDown(e, adjustableArea, ref captureMouseForElement);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseHover()
		{
			if (Tool != null && Tool.ShouldDisplayToolTip)
			{
				bool immediateToolTipDisplayMode = ToolbarsManager.ImmediateToolTipDisplayMode;
				if (!immediateToolTipDisplayMode)
				{
					ToolbarsManager.ImmediateToolTipDisplayMode = true;
				}
				Tool.DisplayToolTip();
				if (!immediateToolTipDisplayMode)
				{
					ToolbarsManager.ImmediateToolTipDisplayMode = false;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave()
		{
			Tool.ForceDrawAsActive = false;
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager != null && !toolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				Tool.HideToolTip();
				if (ActiveBorders)
				{
					if (toolbarsManager.ActiveTool == tool)
					{
						toolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(tool, setOn: false, clearToolBeingEdited: false);
					}
					((UIElement)this).Invalidate();
				}
			}
			((UIElement)this).OnMouseLeave();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager != null && !toolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				if (toolbarsManager.IsInEditMode)
				{
					toolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(tool, setOn: true, clearToolBeingEdited: false);
				}
				else if (ActiveBorders)
				{
					toolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(tool, setOn: true, clearToolBeingEdited: true);
					((UIElement)this).Invalidate();
					if (toolbarsManager.ActiveTool == null || toolbarsManager.ActiveTool == tool)
					{
						ToolbarsManager.AllowToolbarCaptureRelease = false;
						try
						{
							if (Tool.OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
							{
								if (Tool.OwningToolbarInternal.QuickCustomizeTool != null && Tool.OwningToolbarInternal.QuickCustomizeTool.IsOpen)
								{
									if (Tool != Tool.OwningToolbarInternal.QuickCustomizeTool)
									{
										Tool.OwningToolbarInternal.QuickCustomizeTool.MenuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay: true);
									}
								}
								else
								{
									Tool.OwningToolbarInternal.CloseOpenSubmenuTools(Tool, delay: true);
								}
							}
						}
						finally
						{
							ToolbarsManager.AllowToolbarCaptureRelease = true;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			((UIElement)this).OnMouseEnter();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager != null && !toolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				Tool.DisplayToolTip();
			}
			((UIElement)this).OnMouseMove(e);
		}

		protected override void DrawBorders(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0040: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0069: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UIElementButtonStyle buttonStyle = ButtonStyle;
			if ((int)buttonStyle != 17)
			{
				if ((int)buttonStyle != 21)
				{
					if ((int)buttonStyle == 23 && !Utilities.IsHighContrast)
					{
						if (ShouldDrawRoundedBorders)
						{
							DrawUtility.DrawOffice2010ButtonBorders(ref drawParams, ButtonState, Tool.EnabledResolved, (Corners)15);
						}
						return;
					}
				}
				else if (!Utilities.IsHighContrast)
				{
					if (ShouldDrawRoundedBorders)
					{
						DrawUtility.DrawScenicRibbonButtonBorders(ref drawParams, ButtonState, (Corners)15);
					}
					return;
				}
				((UIElement)this).DrawBorders(ref drawParams);
			}
			else if (ShouldDrawRoundedBorders)
			{
				DrawUtility.DrawOffice2007RibbonButtonBorders(ref drawParams, ButtonState, Tool.EnabledResolved, (Corners)15);
			}
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_0043: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager != null)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager2 = ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager2 != null)
				{
					ToolbarStyle styleResolved = toolbarsManager2.StyleResolved;
					switch (styleResolved - 5)
					{
					case 0:
					case 2:
					case 3:
					case 4:
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				object context = ((!flag) ? null : ((object)new ToolBase.ResolveAppearanceRibbonButtonInfo(ButtonType, ButtonState)));
				Tool.ResolveAppearance(editArea: false, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, Tool.DrawAsActive, Tool.IsPressed, context);
			}
			((UIElement)this).InitAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		private class StateButtonToolExtraSharedProps : SubObjectBase
		{
			private StateButtonTool owningTool;

			internal bool isChecked;

			internal string optionSetKey = string.Empty;

			internal StateButtonMenuDisplayStyle menuDisplayStyle;

			internal StateButtonToolbarDisplayStyle toolbarDisplayStyle;

			internal bool Checked
			{
				get
				{
					return isChecked;
				}
				set
				{
					if (value != isChecked)
					{
						owningTool.VerifyCanBeModified();
						if (value || owningTool.OptionSet == null || owningTool.OptionSet.AllowAllUp)
						{
							isChecked = value;
							owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Checked);
						}
					}
				}
			}

			internal bool CheckedInternal
			{
				get
				{
					return isChecked;
				}
				set
				{
					isChecked = value;
				}
			}

			internal StateButtonMenuDisplayStyle MenuDisplayStyle
			{
				get
				{
					return menuDisplayStyle;
				}
				set
				{
					if (value != menuDisplayStyle)
					{
						owningTool.VerifyCanBeModified();
						if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(StateButtonMenuDisplayStyle), value))
						{
							throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("value", (int)value, typeof(StateButtonMenuDisplayStyle));
						}
						menuDisplayStyle = value;
						owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.MenuDisplayStyle);
					}
				}
			}

			internal OptionSet OptionSet
			{
				get
				{
					if (ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(optionSetKey))
					{
						return null;
					}
					UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = owningTool.ToolbarsManager;
					if (toolbarsManager == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					int num = toolbarsManager.OptionSets.IndexOf(optionSetKey);
					if (num >= 0)
					{
						return toolbarsManager.OptionSets[num];
					}
					return null;
				}
				set
				{
					if ((value == null && !ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(optionSetKey)) || (value != null && value.Key != optionSetKey))
					{
						owningTool.VerifyCanBeModified();
						BeforeOptionSetKeyChange();
						if (value == null)
						{
							optionSetKey = string.Empty;
						}
						else
						{
							optionSetKey = value.Key;
							AfterOptionSetKeyChange();
						}
						owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.OptionSet);
					}
				}
			}

			internal string OptionSetKey
			{
				get
				{
					return optionSetKey;
				}
				set
				{
					if (value != optionSetKey)
					{
						owningTool.VerifyCanBeModified();
						BeforeOptionSetKeyChange();
						optionSetKey = value;
						AfterOptionSetKeyChange();
						owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.OptionSet);
					}
				}
			}

			internal StateButtonToolbarDisplayStyle ToolbarDisplayStyle
			{
				get
				{
					return toolbarDisplayStyle;
				}
				set
				{
					if (value != toolbarDisplayStyle)
					{
						owningTool.VerifyCanBeModified();
						if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(StateButtonToolbarDisplayStyle), value))
						{
							throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("value", (int)value, typeof(StateButtonToolbarDisplayStyle));
						}
						toolbarDisplayStyle = value;
						owningTool.DirtyMetrics();
						owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.StateButtonToolbarDisplayStyle);
					}
				}
			}

			internal StateButtonToolExtraSharedProps(StateButtonTool owningTool)
			{
				this.owningTool = owningTool;
			}

			private void AfterOptionSetKeyChange()
			{
				if (owningTool.ToolbarsManager != null && optionSetKey != null && optionSetKey.Length > 0)
				{
					owningTool.SynchronizeOptionSetToolsCollection();
				}
			}

			private void BeforeOptionSetKeyChange()
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = owningTool.ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager != null && optionSetKey != null && optionSetKey.Length > 0)
				{
					int num = toolbarsManager.OptionSets.IndexOf(optionSetKey);
					if (num >= 0)
					{
						toolbarsManager.OptionSets[num].Tools.Remove(owningTool.SharedProps.Tool);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected StateButtonTool(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "Checked":
					SerializedProps.isChecked = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), SerializedProps.isChecked);
					break;
				case "MenuDisplayStyle":
					SerializedProps.menuDisplayStyle = (StateButtonMenuDisplayStyle)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(StateButtonMenuDisplayStyle), SerializedProps.menuDisplayStyle);
					break;
				case "OptionSetKey":
					SerializedProps.optionSetKey = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), SerializedProps.optionSetKey);
					break;
				case "ToolbarDisplayStyle":
					SerializedProps.toolbarDisplayStyle = (StateButtonToolbarDisplayStyle)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(StateButtonToolbarDisplayStyle), SerializedProps.toolbarDisplayStyle);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

			ResetChecked();
			ResetOptionSet();
			ResetMenuDisplayStyle();
			ResetToolbarDisplayStyle();
		}

		internal void SynchronizeOptionSetToolsCollection()
		{
			if (base.ToolbarsManager != null && base.SharedProps.Tool != null)
			{
				OptionSet optionSet = ExtraSharedProps.OptionSet;
				if (optionSet != null && !optionSet.Tools.Exists(Key))
				{
					optionSet.Tools.Add(base.SharedProps.Tool);
				}
			}
		}

		private GlyphToolUIElement GetGlyphToolUIElement(ToolBase tool, UIElement parentElement, UIElement previousElement, bool drawAsActive, bool drawAsPressed)
		{
			GlyphToolUIElement glyphToolUIElement = null;
			if (previousElement != null && ((object)previousElement).GetType() == typeof(GlyphToolUIElement))
			{
				if (previousElement.GetContext() is ToolBase { UnderlyingTool: not null } toolBase && toolBase.UnderlyingTool.GetType() == GetType())
				{
					glyphToolUIElement = previousElement as GlyphToolUIElement;
				}
				if (glyphToolUIElement == null || ((UIElement)glyphToolUIElement).Parent != parentElement)
				{
					glyphToolUIElement = new GlyphToolUIElement(parentElement, this);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				glyphToolUIElement = new GlyphToolUIElement(parentElement, this);
			}
			return glyphToolUIElement;
		}

		protected override void OnAddedToCollection(KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase collection)
		{
			base.OnAddedToCollection(collection);
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager != null && toolbarsManager.Initialized)
			{
				SynchronizeOptionSetToolsCollection();
			}
		}

		protected internal override Size CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstance()
		{
			Size result = base.CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstance();
			if (ShouldDrawAsGlyph)
			{
				result.Width += GlyphSize.Width + 10;
				result.Height = Math.Max(GlyphSize.Height + 10, result.Height);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected internal override ToolBase Clone(bool cloneNewInstance)
		{
			StateButtonTool stateButtonTool = new StateButtonTool(Key);
			stateButtonTool.InitializeFrom(this, cloneNewInstance);
			return stateButtonTool;
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		protected override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
			if (ShouldSerializeChecked())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Checked", Checked);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeMenuDisplayStyle())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MenuDisplayStyle", MenuDisplayStyle);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeToolbarDisplayStyle())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ToolbarDisplayStyle", ToolbarDisplayStyle);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeOptionSetKey())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "OptionSetKey", OptionSetKey);
			}
		}

		protected internal override UIElement GetRibbonToolUIElement(ToolBase tool, UIElement parentElement, UIElement previousElement, bool drawAsActive, bool drawAsPressed)
		{
			ButtonUIElementBase val = null;
			val = (ButtonUIElementBase)(object)((!ShouldDrawAsGlyph) ? ((GlyphToolUIElement)/*isinst with value type is only supported in some contexts*/) : GetGlyphToolUIElement(tool, parentElement, previousElement, drawAsActive, drawAsPressed));
			val.InitializeCheckState(Checked ? CheckState.Checked : CheckState.Unchecked);
			return (UIElement)(object)val;
		}

		protected internal override UIElement GetToolbarUIElement(ToolBase tool, UIElement parentElement, UIElement previousElement, bool drawAsActive, bool drawAsPressed)
		{
			ButtonUIElementBase val = null;
			val = (ButtonUIElementBase)(object)((!ShouldDrawAsGlyph) ? ((GlyphToolUIElement)/*isinst with value type is only supported in some contexts*/) : GetGlyphToolUIElement(tool, parentElement, previousElement, drawAsActive, drawAsPressed));
			val.InitializeCheckState(Checked ? CheckState.Checked : CheckState.Unchecked);
			return (UIElement)(object)val;
		}

		protected internal override Type GetToolbarUIElementType()
		{
			if (ShouldDrawAsGlyph)
			{
				return typeof(GlyphToolUIElement);
			}
			return base.GetToolbarUIElementType();
		}

		protected internal override Type GetRibbonToolUIElementType()
		{
			if (ShouldDrawAsGlyph)
			{
				return typeof(GlyphToolUIElement);
			}
			return base.GetRibbonToolUIElementType();
		}

		protected internal override void Initialize(ToolsCollectionBase parentCollection)
		{
			base.Initialize(parentCollection);
			if (serializedProps != null)
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.isChecked = serializedProps.isChecked;
				ExtraSharedProps.menuDisplayStyle = serializedProps.menuDisplayStyle;
				ExtraSharedProps.optionSetKey = serializedProps.optionSetKey;
				ExtraSharedProps.toolbarDisplayStyle = serializedProps.toolbarDisplayStyle;
				serializedProps = null;
			}
			SynchronizeOptionSetToolsCollection();
		}

		protected internal override void InitializeFrom(ToolBase sourceTool, bool cloneNewInstance)
		{
			base.InitializeFrom(sourceTool, cloneNewInstance);
			StateButtonTool stateButtonTool = sourceTool as StateButtonTool;
			if (!cloneNewInstance && stateButtonTool != null)
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.isChecked = stateButtonTool.ExtraSharedProps.Checked;
				ExtraSharedProps.optionSetKey = stateButtonTool.ExtraSharedProps.OptionSetKey;
				ExtraSharedProps.menuDisplayStyle = stateButtonTool.ExtraSharedProps.MenuDisplayStyle;
				ExtraSharedProps.toolbarDisplayStyle = stateButtonTool.ExtraSharedProps.ToolbarDisplayStyle;
			}
			SynchronizeOptionSetToolsCollection();
		}

		protected internal override void OnShortcutKeyPressed()
		{
			Checked = !Checked;
		}

		internal override void OnToolbarsManagerInitialized()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			int num = toolbarsManager.OptionSets.IndexOf(OptionSetKey);
			if (num >= 0 && !toolbarsManager.OptionSets[num].Tools.Exists(Key))
			{
				toolbarsManager.OptionSets[num].Tools.Add(this);
			}
			base.OnToolbarsManagerInitialized();
		}

		protected internal override void OnToolClick()
		{
			Checked = !Checked;
		}

		protected override ToolBaseUiaProviderStub CreateUIAutomationStub()
		{
			return new StateButtonToolUiaProviderStub(this);
		}

				case 61728:
					if (!form.IsMdiChild && form.WindowState == FormWindowState.Maximized && !form.MaximizeBox)
					{
						return false;
					}
					return form.WindowState != FormWindowState.Normal;
				case 61472:
					if (form.MinimizeBox)
					{
						return form.WindowState != FormWindowState.Minimized;
					}
					return false;
				case 61488:
					if (form.MaximizeBox)
					{
						return form.WindowState != FormWindowState.Maximized;
					}
					return false;

				break;
			case 61472:
				MaintainCaptionCache(2, caption);

		}

			if (base.OwnerIsMenuInternal || base.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)
			{
				return base.CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstance();
			}
			if (base.Owner is RibbonTabItemToolbar)
			{
				return new Size(22, 22);
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager != null && (int)toolbarsManager.StyleResolved == 1)

		protected override void ResolveAppearancePhase(ref ResolveAppearancePhaseInfo phaseInfo, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ResolveCaptionButtonAppearancePhaseInfo phaseInfo2 = ResolveCaptionButtonAppearancePhaseInfo.FromResolveAppearancePhaseInfo(phaseInfo, isMaximizedMdiChild: true, (SystemButtonId)MenuID, ButtonStyle);
			if (phaseInfo.Phase == AppearanceResolutionPhase.HotTrack && phaseInfo.DrawAsPressed)
			{
				phaseInfo2.SetPhase(CaptionButtonAppearanceResolutionPhase.Pressed);
				base.ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.ResolveCaptionButtonAppearancePhase(ref phaseInfo2, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, resolveDefaults: false);
				phaseInfo2.SetPhase(CaptionButtonAppearanceResolutionPhase.HotTrack);
			}
			base.ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.ResolveCaptionButtonAppearancePhase(ref phaseInfo2, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, resolveDefaults: false);
			base.ResolveAppearancePhase(ref phaseInfo, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		internal override void ResolveAppearancePhaseDefaults(ref ResolveAppearancePhaseInfo phaseInfo, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			//IL_00aa: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b1: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			AppearanceResolutionPhase phase = phaseInfo.Phase;
			if (phase == AppearanceResolutionPhase.Final && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)256) && ((Enum)requestedProps).HasFlag((Enum)(object)(AppearancePropFlags)256))
			{
				Image image = null;
				switch (menuID)
				{
				case 61472:
				case 61488:
				case 61536:
				case 61728:
				case 61824:
					image = base.ToolbarsManager.GetCaptionButtonImage((SystemButtonId)menuID, isMdiChild: true, base.Owner is RibbonTabItemToolbar);
					break;
				}
				if (image != null)
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).Image = image;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps ^ 0x100uL);
				}
			}
			if ((int)ButtonStyle == 20)
			{
				phase = phaseInfo.Phase;
				if (phase == AppearanceResolutionPhase.ToolOwner)
				{
					ButtonUIElementBase.ResolveWindowsVistaButtonAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, Enabled, phaseInfo.DrawAsPressed, false, false, phaseInfo.DrawAsActive);
					return;
				}
			}
			base.ResolveAppearancePhaseDefaults(ref phaseInfo, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		private void MaintainCaptionCache(int index, string caption)
		{
			Monitor.Enter(typeof(SystemActionTool));
			try
			{
				if (caption == null || caption.Length < 1)
				{
					if (s_cachedWindowCaptions[index] != null)
					{
						base.SharedProps.Caption = s_cachedWindowCaptions[index];
					}
					return;
				}
				s_cachedWindowCaptions[index] = caption;
				if (index == 0)
				{
					s_cachedCloseWindowTooltip = base.ToolTipTextResolved;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				Monitor.Exit(typeof(SystemActionTool));
			}
		}

		private void OnClickPosted(bool shortcutKeyPressed)
		{
			Form form = Form;
			if (form == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Form form2 = base.ToolbarsManager.FindForm();
			if (form2 == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool isMdiChild = form.IsMdiChild;
			try
			{
				if (menuID != 61504 && menuID != 61536)
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.SendMessageApi(form.Handle, 274, new IntPtr(menuID), IntPtr.Zero);
					return;
				}
				if (menuID == 61504)
				{
					if (!isMdiChild)
					{
						return;
					}
					Form mdiParent = form.MdiParent;
					int num = 0;
					Form[] mdiChildren = mdiParent.MdiChildren;
					foreach (Form form3 in mdiChildren)
					{
						if (form3.Visible)
						{
							num++;
						}
					}
					if (num < 2)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				NativeWindowMethods.SendMessageApi(form.Handle, 274, new IntPtr(menuID), shortcutKeyPressed ? new IntPtr(-1) : IntPtr.Zero);
				if (isMdiChild)
				{
					base.ToolbarsManager.VerifyActiveMdiChildHasChanged(form);
					NativeWindowMethods.SendMessageApi(form2.Handle, 11, NativeWindowMethods.TRUE, IntPtr.Zero);
					NativeWindowMethods.RedrawWindowApi(form2.Handle, IntPtr.Zero, IntPtr.Zero, 1671u);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				switch (menuID)
				{
				case 61536:
					if (isMdiChild)
					{
						base.ToolbarsManager.RestoreMenus();
						form.Close();
						base.ToolbarsManager.VerifyActiveMdiChildHasChanged(form);
					}
					else
					{
						form.Close();
					}
					break;
				case 61728:
					form.WindowState = FormWindowState.Normal;
					break;
				case 61472:
					form.WindowState = FormWindowState.Minimized;
					break;
				case 61488:
					form.WindowState = FormWindowState.Maximized;
					break;
				}
			}
			base.ToolbarsManager.ProcessingSysCommand = false;
		}
	}

	internal sealed class SystemMenuTool : PopupMenuTool

		internal override bool DisplayDropDownArrow => false;

		{
			get

				if (base.OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
				{
					return false;

			}
		}

		protected internal override bool IsVisibleOnRibbonGroup => false;

		internal override UIRole MenuUIRole => StyleUtils.GetRole(base.ToolbarsManagerInControl, StyleUtils.Role.SystemMenu);

		internal override bool OverlapMenuBorders => false;

		public override UIRole UIRoleOnToolbars => StyleUtils.GetRole(base.ToolbarsManagerInControl, StyleUtils.Role.ToolbarItemSystemMenu);

		internal SystemMenuSource MenuSource => menuSource;

		internal object ActualOwner => owner;

		internal SystemMenuTool(object owner, IntPtr hMenu, SystemMenuSource menuSource)
			: base(string.Empty)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
			this.hMenu = hMenu;
			this.menuSource = menuSource;
			base.SharedProps.InternalSetRootTool(this);
		}

		protected internal override Size CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstance()
		{
			if (base.OwnerIsMenuInternal || base.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)
			{
				return base.CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstance();
			}
			if (menuSource == SystemMenuSource.DockWithinContainerForm)
			{
				Size smallIconSize = SystemInformation.SmallIconSize;
				smallIconSize.Width += 4;
				smallIconSize.Height += 4;
				return smallIconSize;
			}
			return new Size(16, 16);
		}

		protected internal override ToolBase Clone(bool cloneNewInstance)
		{
			SystemMenuTool systemMenuTool = new SystemMenuTool(owner, hMenu, menuSource);
			systemMenuTool.InitializeFrom(this, cloneNewInstance);
			return systemMenuTool;
		}

		protected override void OnPopulate()
		{
			PopuplateMenu(forceReload: true);
		}

		protected override void ResolveAppearancePhase(ref ResolveAppearancePhaseInfo phaseInfo, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			if (phaseInfo.Phase != AppearanceResolutionPhase.HotTrack && phaseInfo.Phase != AppearanceResolutionPhase.Pressed)
			{
				base.ResolveAppearancePhase(ref phaseInfo, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			}
		}

		internal override void ResolveAppearancePhaseDefaults(ref ResolveAppearancePhaseInfo phaseInfo, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			if (phaseInfo.Phase == AppearanceResolutionPhase.HotTrack || phaseInfo.Phase == AppearanceResolutionPhase.Pressed)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (phaseInfo.Phase == AppearanceResolutionPhase.Tool && base.OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
			{
				if (((ulong)requestedProps & 1uL) != 0L)
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = Color.Transparent;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps ^ 1uL);
				}
				if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x4000000uL) != 0L)
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor2 = Color.Transparent;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps ^ 0x4000000uL);
				}
				if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x10000000uL) != 0L)
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackGradientStyle = (GradientStyle)1;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps ^ 0x10000000uL);
				}
			}
			base.ResolveAppearancePhaseDefaults(ref phaseInfo, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		private void AddItemHelper(ref NativeWindowMethods.MENUITEMINFO mii, int position, IntPtr textbuff, bool separatorFound)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			string text2 = string.Empty;
			if (mii.cch != 0)
			{
				NativeWindowMethods.GetMenuStringApi(hMenu, (uint)position, textbuff, 2048, 1024);
				text = Marshal.PtrToStringAuto(textbuff);
				int num = text.IndexOf('\t');
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					text2 = text.Substring(num + 1);
					text = text.Substring(0, num);
				}
			}
			ToolBase toolBase;
			if (mii.hSubMenu != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				toolBase = new SystemMenuTool(this, mii.hSubMenu, menuSource);
				toolBase.SharedProps.Caption = text;
			}
			else
			{
				toolBase = new SystemActionTool(position.ToString(), this, (int)mii.wID, (mii.fState & 8) == 8, text);
			}
			base.Tools.AddHelper(toolBase, honorReadOnlyStatus: false, -1);
			if (text2.Length > 0)
			{
				toolBase.SharedProps.Shortcut = Utilities.ParseShortcutString(text2);
				if (toolBase.SharedProps.Shortcut == Shortcut.None && toolBase is SystemActionTool)
				{
					switch ((int)mii.wID)
					{
					case 61536:
						toolBase.SharedProps.Shortcut = Shortcut.CtrlF4;
						break;
					case 61504:
						toolBase.SharedProps.Shortcut = Shortcut.CtrlF6;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (toolBase.SharedProps.Shortcut != Shortcut.None)
				{
					toolBase.SharedProps.InitializeShortcutString(text2);
				}
			}
			toolBase.SharedProps.Enabled = (mii.fState & 3) != 3;
			toolBase.InstanceProps.IsFirstInGroup = separatorFound;
			GetItemImageHelper(toolBase, ref mii);
		}

		private static void GetItemImageHelper(ToolBase menuItemTool, ref NativeWindowMethods.MENUITEMINFO mii)
		{
			switch (mii.hbmpItem.ToInt32())
			{
			case 8:
			case 9:
			case 10:
			case 11:
				return;
			}
			Bitmap bitmap = null;
			if (menuItemTool is SystemActionTool { IsChecked: not false })
			{
				if (mii.hbmpChecked != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					bitmap = Image.FromHbitmap(mii.hbmpChecked);
				}
			}
			else if (mii.hbmpUnchecked != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				bitmap = Image.FromHbitmap(mii.hbmpUnchecked);
			}
			if (bitmap == null && (mii.fType & 4) == 4)
			{
				bitmap = Image.FromHbitmap(mii.dwTypeData);
			}
			if (bitmap == null && mii.hbmpItem != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				bitmap = Image.FromHbitmap(mii.hbmpItem);
			}
			if (bitmap != null)
			{
				menuItemTool.SharedProps.AppearancesSmall.Appearance.Image = bitmap;
			}
		}

		private bool GetSystemMenuItemEnabledState(NativeWindowMethods.MENUITEMINFO info, Form form)
		{
			bool result = (info.fState & 3) != 3;
			if (form == null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			switch (info.wID)
			{
			case 61536u:
				return result;
			case 61488u:
				if (!form.MaximizeBox)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return form.WindowState != FormWindowState.Maximized;
			case 61472u:
				if (!form.MinimizeBox)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return form.WindowState != FormWindowState.Minimized;
			case 61456u:
				return form.WindowState == FormWindowState.Normal;
			case 61504u:
				return result;
			case 61728u:
				return form.WindowState != FormWindowState.Normal;
			case 61440u:
				switch (form.FormBorderStyle)
				{
				case FormBorderStyle.FixedSingle:
				case FormBorderStyle.Fixed3D:
				case FormBorderStyle.FixedDialog:
					return false;
				default:
					return form.WindowState == FormWindowState.Normal;
				}
			default:
				return result;
			}
		}

		internal void PopuplateMenu(bool forceReload)
		{
			if (forceReload)
			{
				base.Tools.ClearInternal();
			}
			else if (base.Tools.Count > 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				int menuItemCountApi = NativeWindowMethods.GetMenuItemCountApi(hMenu);
				if (menuItemCountApi < 1)
				{
					return;
				}
				IntPtr intPtr = Marshal.AllocCoTaskMem(2048);
				IntPtr intPtr2 = Marshal.AllocCoTaskMem(2048);
				Form form = base.ToolbarsManagerInControl.FindForm();
				if (form != null)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < menuItemCountApi; i++)
					{
						NativeWindowMethods.MENUITEMINFO mii = new NativeWindowMethods.MENUITEMINFO
						{
							cch = 2048u,
							dwTypeData = intPtr,
							fState = 0u,
							fMask = 3u,
							cbSize = (uint)Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(NativeWindowMethods.MENUITEMINFO))
						};
						NativeWindowMethods.GetMenuItemInfoApi(hMenu, (uint)i, byPosition: true, ref mii);
						uint num = 3u;
						if (mii.wID != 0)
						{
							if (GetSystemMenuItemEnabledState(mii, form))
							{
								mii.fState &= ~num;
							}
							else
							{
								mii.fState |= num;
							}
							NativeWindowMethods.SetMenuItemInfoApi(hMenu, (uint)i, byPosition: true, ref mii);
						}
					}
				}
				NativeWindowMethods.SendMessageApi(base.ToolbarsManagerInControl.DockWithinContainer.Handle, 279, hMenu, new IntPtr(65536));
				bool separatorFound = false;
				for (int j = 0; j < menuItemCountApi; j++)
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.MENUITEMINFO mii2 = new NativeWindowMethods.MENUITEMINFO
					{
						cch = 2048u,
						dwTypeData = intPtr,
						fState = 0u,
						fMask = 63u,
						cbSize = (uint)Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(NativeWindowMethods.MENUITEMINFO))
					};
					NativeWindowMethods.GetMenuItemInfoApi(hMenu, (uint)j, byPosition: true, ref mii2);
					if ((mii2.fType & 0x800) == 2048)
					{
						separatorFound = true;
						continue;
					}
					AddItemHelper(ref mii2, j, intPtr2, separatorFound);
					separatorFound = false;
				}
				Marshal.FreeCoTaskMem(intPtr);
				Marshal.FreeCoTaskMem(intPtr2);
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}
	}

	public class TaskPaneSplitterUIElement : SplitterUIElement
	{
		private int lastDelta = int.MinValue;

		private UltraTaskPaneToolbar TaskPaneToolbar
		{
			get
			{
				if (((UIElement)this).parentElement == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ((TaskPaneToolbarUIElement)(object)((UIElement)this).parentElement).Toolbar;
			}
		}

		private bool IsVerticalSplitterBar => ((AdjustableUIElement)this).SupportsLeftRightAdjustments;

		protected override bool AdjustForControlPosition
		{
			get
			{
				DockedPosition dockedPosition = TaskPaneToolbar.DockedPosition;
				if (dockedPosition == DockedPosition.Bottom || dockedPosition == DockedPosition.Right)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override UIElementBorderStyle BorderStyle => (UIElementBorderStyle)1;

		protected override bool DrawAdjustmentBarWhileSizing => false;

		public override bool Enabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(((UIElement)this).Parent is TaskPaneToolbarUIElement { Toolbar: not null } taskPaneToolbarUIElement) || !taskPaneToolbarUIElement.Toolbar.AllowResizeResolved)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return ((UIElement)this).Enabled;
			}
			set
			{
				((UIElement)this).Enabled = value;
			}
		}

		public TaskPaneSplitterUIElement(TaskPaneToolbarUIElement taskPaneElement, bool vertical)
			: base((UIElement)(object)taskPaneElement, vertical)
		{
		}

		private void OnNewDelta(int newDelta)
		{
			UltraTaskPaneToolbar taskPaneToolbar = TaskPaneToolbar;
			if (taskPaneToolbar != null && newDelta != lastDelta)
			{
				int internalDockedContentExtent = taskPaneToolbar.InternalDockedContentExtent;
				internalDockedContentExtent = ((taskPaneToolbar.DockedPosition != DockedPosition.Top && taskPaneToolbar.DockedPosition != DockedPosition.Left) ? (internalDockedContentExtent - (newDelta - ((lastDelta != int.MinValue) ? lastDelta : 0))) : (internalDockedContentExtent + (newDelta - ((lastDelta != int.MinValue) ? lastDelta : 0))));
				lastDelta = newDelta;
				taskPaneToolbar.DockedContentExtent = internalDockedContentExtent;
				taskPaneToolbar.DockArea.RefreshDockAreaSize();
				((UIElement)this).Control.Update();
			}
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			if (UltraToolbarsManager.ShouldSetAppearanceProperty(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (AppearancePropFlags)65536))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColorAlpha = (Alpha)3;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFEFFFFuL);
			}
			((SplitterUIElement)this).InitAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		public override void ApplyAdjustment(Point delta)
		{
			if (TaskPaneToolbar != null)
			{
				TaskPaneToolbar.OnResizeEnd();
			}
		}

		public override void GetAdjustmentRange(Point point, out UIElementAdjustmentRangeParams range)
		{
			((SplitterUIElement)this).GetAdjustmentRange(point, ref range);
			UltraTaskPaneToolbar taskPaneToolbar = TaskPaneToolbar;
			UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = taskPaneToolbar?.ToolbarsManager;
			if (taskPaneToolbar != null && ultraToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				Rectangle innerDockedControlsBounds = ultraToolbarsManager.InnerDockedControlsBounds;
				switch (taskPaneToolbar.DockedPosition)
				{
				case DockedPosition.Left:
					range.maxDeltaRight = Math.Min(taskPaneToolbar.MaximumDockedExtent, innerDockedControlsBounds.Width);
					range.maxDeltaLeft = Math.Min(0, taskPaneToolbar.MinimumDockedExtent - taskPaneToolbar.Height);
					break;
				case DockedPosition.Right:
					range.maxDeltaLeft = -Math.Min(taskPaneToolbar.MaximumDockedExtent, innerDockedControlsBounds.Width);
					range.maxDeltaRight = Math.Max(0, taskPaneToolbar.Height - taskPaneToolbar.MinimumDockedExtent);
					break;
				case DockedPosition.Top:
					range.maxDeltaDown = Math.Min(taskPaneToolbar.MaximumDockedExtent, innerDockedControlsBounds.Height);
					range.maxDeltaUp = Math.Min(0, taskPaneToolbar.MinimumDockedExtent - taskPaneToolbar.Height);
					break;
				case DockedPosition.Bottom:
					range.maxDeltaUp = -Math.Min(taskPaneToolbar.MaximumDockedExtent, innerDockedControlsBounds.Height);
					range.maxDeltaDown = Math.Max(0, taskPaneToolbar.Height - taskPaneToolbar.MinimumDockedExtent);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnElementAdjustmentStart(bool isUpDownAdjustment, bool initialUpDownAdjustmentPointInBottomBorder, bool isLeftRightAdjustment, bool initialLeftRightAdjustmentPointInRightBorder)
		{
			lastDelta = int.MinValue;
			((AdjustableUIElement)this).OnElementAdjustmentStart(isUpDownAdjustment, initialUpDownAdjustmentPointInBottomBorder, isLeftRightAdjustment, initialLeftRightAdjustmentPointInRightBorder);
			TaskPaneToolbar.OnResizeBegin();
		}

		protected override void OnNewDeltaX(int newDeltaX)
		{
			((AdjustableUIElement)this).OnNewDeltaX(newDeltaX);
			OnNewDelta(newDeltaX);
		}

		protected override void OnNewDeltaY(int newDeltaY)
		{
			((AdjustableUIElement)this).OnNewDeltaY(newDeltaY);
			OnNewDelta(newDeltaY);
		}

		public override Cursor GetAdjustableCursor(Point point)
		{
			if (IsVerticalSplitterBar)
			{
				return Cursors.SizeWE;
			}
			return Cursors.SizeNS;
		}

		protected override void OnCaptureAborted()
		{
			if (TaskPaneToolbar != null)
			{
				TaskPaneToolbar.OnResizeEnd();
			}
			((AdjustableUIElement)this).OnCaptureAborted();
		}
	}

			public bool SyncControlWithName(bool allowUpdateControlName)
			{
				if (controlName == null)
				{
					if (allowUpdateControlName)
					{
						if (Control != null)
						{
							controlName = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetName(Control);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						Control = null;
					}
					return true;
				}
				if (control != null && ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetName(control) == controlName)
				{
					return true;
				}
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = owningTool.ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager != null && toolbarsManager.Initialized)
				{
					Control controlFromName = toolbarsManager.GetControlFromName(controlName);
					if (controlFromName != null)
					{
						Control = controlFromName;
						return true;
					}
				}
				Control = null;
				return false;
			}

				ToolBase toolBeingDisplayed = toolInstance.ToolBeingDisplayed;
				if (toolBeingDisplayed.OwningToolbar is UltraTaskPaneToolbar ultraTaskPaneToolbar && ultraTaskPaneToolbar.SelectedTaskPaneTool == toolBeingDisplayed)
				{
					ultraTaskPaneToolbar.EnsureSelectedToolControlIsParented();

			}
		}

	[Serializable]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(TaskPaneToolbarConverter))]
	public class UltraTaskPaneToolbar : UltraToolbar, IToolsCollectionOwner, IDeserializationCallback
	{
		[Serializable]
		internal class HistoryList : ICloneable, ISerializable
		{
			private string[] items;

			private const int PositionDefault = -1;

			private int position = -1;

			private const int CountDefault = 0;

			private int count;

			private const int MaxDepthDefault = 0;

			private int maxDepth;

			private const int DefaultCapacity = 16;

			public bool CanMoveBack => position > 0;

			public bool CanMoveForward => position < count - 1;

			public int Capacity
			{
				get
				{
					return items.Length;
				}
				set
				{
					if (items != null && value == items.Length)
					{
						return;
					}
					if (value < count)
					{
						throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
					}
					if (value > 0)
					{
						string[] destinationArray = new string[value];
						if (count > 0)
						{
							Array.Copy(items, 0, destinationArray, 0, count);
						}
						items = destinationArray;
					}
					else
					{
						items = new string[16];
					}
				}
			}

			public int Count => count;

			public string CurrentItem
			{
				get
				{
					if (position >= 0)
					{
						return items[position];
					}
					return null;
				}
			}

			public int MaxDepth
			{
				get
				{
					return maxDepth;
				}
				set
				{
					if (maxDepth < 0)
					{
						throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
					}
					maxDepth = value;
					EnforceMaxDepth();
				}
			}

			internal HistoryList()
				: this(16)
			{
			}

			internal HistoryList(int capacity)
			{
				Capacity = capacity;
			}

			protected HistoryList(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			{
				SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
					switch (current.Name)
					{
					case "Items":
						items = (string[])Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string[]), items);
						break;
					case "MaxDepth":
						maxDepth = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), maxDepth);
						break;
					case "Count":
						count = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), count);
						break;
					case "Position":
						position = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), position);
						break;
					}
				}
				if (items == null)
				{
					items = new string[16];
				}
			}

			public int Add(string item)
			{
				if (position == count - 1 && count == items.Length)
				{
					EnsureCapacity(count + 1);
				}
				else if (position < count - 1)
				{
					Array.Clear(items, position + 1, count - 1 - position);
					count = position + 1;
				}
				position++;
				count = position + 1;
				items[position] = item;
				EnforceMaxDepth();
				return position;
			}

			public void Clear()
			{
				Array.Clear(items, 0, count);
				count = 0;
			}

			public object Clone()
			{
				HistoryList historyList = new HistoryList();
				historyList.items = (string[])items.Clone();
				historyList.count = count;
				historyList.maxDepth = maxDepth;
				historyList.position = position;
				return historyList;
			}

			private void EnforceMaxDepth()
			{
				if (maxDepth != 0 && maxDepth < count)
				{
					int val = count - maxDepth;
					int num = Math.Min(position, val);
					string[] destinationArray = new string[maxDepth];
					Array.Copy(items, num, destinationArray, 0, Math.Min(maxDepth, count - num));
					position -= num;
					items = destinationArray;
					count = maxDepth;
				}
			}

			private void EnsureCapacity(int min)
			{
				if (items.Length < min)
				{
					int num = ((items.Length == 0) ? 16 : (items.Length * 2));
					if (num < min)
					{
						num = min;
					}
					Capacity = num;
				}
			}

			public void MoveBack()
			{
				if (position > 0)
				{
					position--;
				}
			}

			public void MoveForward()
			{
				if (position < count - 1)
				{
					position++;
				}
			}

			public void TrimToSize()
			{
				Capacity = count;
			}

			public void Remove(string text, bool removeDuplicateConsecutiveItems)
			{
				if (count == 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				int num = 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					bool flag = items[i] == text;
					if (!flag && removeDuplicateConsecutiveItems && num > 0)
					{
						flag = items[num - 1] == items[i];
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						items[i] = null;
						if (position == i)
						{
							position = num;
						}
						continue;
					}
					if (i != num)
					{
						items[num] = items[i];
					}
					if (position == i)
					{
						position = num;
					}
					num++;
				}
				count = num;
				if (position > count - 1)
				{
					position = count - 1;
				}
			}

			void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			{
				if (items.Length != 0)
				{
					Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Items", items);
				}
				if (maxDepth != 0)
				{
					Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MaxDepth", maxDepth);
				}
				if (count != 0)
				{
					Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Count", count);
				}
				if (position != -1)
				{
					Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Position", position);
				}
			}
		}

			{
				UltraTaskPaneToolbar ultraTaskPaneToolbar = ((context == null) ? null : (context.Instance as UltraTaskPaneToolbar));
				if (ultraTaskPaneToolbar == null)
				{
					return new object[0];

				List<ToolBase> list = new List<ToolBase>();

					if (tool.VisibleResolved)
					{
						list.Add(tool);
						if (tool == ultraTaskPaneToolbar.SelectedTaskPaneTool)
						{
							currentEntry = tool;
						}
					}
				}
				return list.ToArray();
			}

				return selectedEntry;
			}
		}

		public class TaskPaneToolbarConverter : ToolbarConverter
		{
			private static bool FilterOutProperty(PropertyDescriptor pd)
			{
				string displayName = pd.DisplayName;
				if (displayName == "IsMainMenuBar")
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
			{
				PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = base.GetProperties(context, value, attributes);
				int num = 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < properties.Count; i++)
				{
					if (!FilterOutProperty(properties[i]))
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
				PropertyDescriptor[] array = new PropertyDescriptor[num];
				int num2 = 0;
				for (int j = 0; j < properties.Count; j++)
				{
					if (!FilterOutProperty(properties[j]))
					{
						array[num2] = properties[j];
						num2++;
					}
				}

		public class UltraTaskPaneToolbarUiaProviderStub : UltraToolbarBaseUiaProviderStub
		{
			internal UltraTaskPaneToolbar TaskPaneToolbar => base.Toolbar.OwningTaskPaneToolbar;

			internal UltraTaskPaneToolbarUiaProviderStub(UIElement toolbarUIElement)
				: base(toolbarUIElement)
			{
			}

			public override Rectangle GetBoundingRectangle()
			{
				UIElement uIElement = ((UIElementUIAProviderStub)this).UIElement;
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					UIElement descendant = uIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(ToolbarUIElement));
					if (descendant != null)
					{
						return descendant.Control.RectangleToScreen(descendant.Rect);
					}
				}
				return Rectangle.Empty;
			}

			protected override List<FragmentUIAProviderStub> GetOrderedChildStubList()
			{
				return GetExtraToolStubs();
			}

			public override IRawElementProviderFragment GetParent()
			{
				IProvideUIAutomation uIElement = (IProvideUIAutomation)(object)base.Toolbar.OwningTaskPaneToolbar.UIElement;
				if (uIElement == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return uIElement.UIAutomationProvider;
			}

			private List<FragmentUIAProviderStub> GetExtraToolStubs()
			{
				List<FragmentUIAProviderStub> list = new List<FragmentUIAProviderStub>();
				ToolBase[] extraTools = TaskPaneToolbar.HeaderToolbar.ExtraTools;
				foreach (ToolBase toolBase in extraTools)
				{
					list.Add((FragmentUIAProviderStub)(object)toolBase.AutomationProviderStub);
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_UltraTaskPaneToolbar_P_HomeTaskPaneTool")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(TaskPaneToolPropertyTypeConverter))]
		[Editor(typeof(TaskPaneToolPropertyUITypeEditor), typeof(UITypeEditor))]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public ToolBase HomeTaskPaneTool
		{
			get
			{
				return homeTaskPaneTool;
			}
			set
			{
				if (homeTaskPaneTool == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (value != null && !(value is TaskPaneTool) && !(value.UnderlyingTool is TaskPaneTool) && (!(value is MdiMergePlaceholderTool) || value.UnderlyingTool != null))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_125", "HomeTaskPaneTool"));
				}
				if (value != null)
				{
					int num = base.Tools.IndexOf(value.Key);
					if (num < 0 && ToolbarsManager != null)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_126"));
					}
					value = base.Tools[num];
				}
				homeTaskPaneTool = value;
				homeTaskPaneToolKey = null;
				VerifyNavigateButtonState();
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.HomeTaskPaneTool);
			}
		}

		public bool ShowHomeButtonResolved
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_003c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0044: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4

				//IL_0048: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4

				if (ToolbarsManager == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!ToolbarsManager.IsDesignMode && !HasMultipleVisibleTaskPaneTools)
				{
					return false;
				}
				ToolbarStyle styleResolved = ToolbarsManager.StyleResolved;
				if ((int)styleResolved == 1 || (int)styleResolved == 4)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_UltraTaskPaneToolbar_P_ToolResizeMode")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		public TaskPaneToolResizeMode ToolResizeMode
		{
			get
			{
				return toolResizeMode;
			}
			set
			{
				if (toolResizeMode != value)
				{
					VerifyCanBeModified();
					if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(TaskPaneToolResizeMode), value))
					{
						throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("ToolResizeMode", (int)value, typeof(TaskPaneToolResizeMode));
					}
					toolResizeMode = value;
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ToolResizeMode);
				}
			}
		}

					closeButtonTool = new ToolbarCloseButtonTool(this);

				return closeButtonTool;
			}
		}

		internal bool WasEnterInvokedForContentControl => wasEnterInvokedForContentControl;

		internal string HeaderMenuCaption
		{

					return null;

				return SelectedToolHeaderCaption;
			}
		}

		internal string HeaderLabelCaption
		{
			get
			{
				if (!ShowHeaderLabelInToolbar)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (ToolbarsManager != null && ToolbarsManager.IsDesignMode && base.Tools.Count == 0)
				{
					return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NewToolPlaceHolderCaption");

				return SelectedToolHeaderCaption;

		internal static string HeaderMenuToolToolTipText => Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("TaskPaneNavigationMenuToolTip");

		internal UltraToolbar HeaderToolbar
		{
			get
			{
				if (headerToolbar == null)
				{
					headerToolbar = new UltraToolbar(this);
					headerToolbar.InternalSetToolbarSettings(base.Settings);
