		internal int HeaderToolbarHeight
		{
			get
			{
				if (cachedHeaderHeight != 0)
				{
					return cachedHeaderHeight;
				}
				int height = HeaderToolbar.Height;
				if (ToolbarsManager != null && ToolbarsManager.MSColors != null)
				{
					return Math.Max(25, height);
				}
				return height;
			}
		}

		internal int HeaderAreaHeight
		{
			get
			{
				int num = HeaderToolbarHeight + 1;
				if (ShowNavigationArea)
				{
					num += NavigationAreaHeight;
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		internal int InternalDockedContentExtent => dockedContentExtent;

		internal int NavigationAreaHeight => NavigateHomeTool.MinimumSize.Height;

		internal int NavigationAreaWidth
		{
			get
			{
				int num = 0;
				if (ShowNextPreviousButtons)
				{
					num += 2 + NavigatePreviousTool.CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstanceHelper().Width;
					if (NavigateNextTool.IsFirstInGroupResolved)
					{
						num += 8;
					}
					num += 2 + NavigateNextTool.CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstanceHelper().Width;
				}
				if (ShowHomeButtonResolved)
				{
					if (num != 0 && NavigateHomeTool.IsFirstInGroupResolved)
					{
						num += 8;
					}
					num += 2 + NavigateHomeTool.CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstanceHelper().Width;
				}
				return num + 8;
			}
		}

		internal TaskPaneNavigationTool NavigateHomeTool
		{
			get
			{
				if (navigateHomeTool == null)
				{
					navigateHomeTool = new TaskPaneNavigationTool(this, TaskPaneNavigationToolType.Home);
					navigateHomeTool.InstanceProps.IsFirstInGroup = true;
					navigateHomeTool.SharedProps.Enabled = CanNavigateToHomeTool;
				}
				return navigateHomeTool;
			}
		}

		internal TaskPaneNavigationTool NavigatePreviousTool
		{
			get
			{
				if (navigatePreviousTool == null)
				{
					navigatePreviousTool = new TaskPaneNavigationTool(this, TaskPaneNavigationToolType.Back);
					navigatePreviousTool.InstanceProps.IsFirstInGroup = true;
					navigatePreviousTool.SharedProps.Enabled = History.CanMoveBack;
				}
				return navigatePreviousTool;
			}
		}

		internal TaskPaneNavigationTool NavigateNextTool
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_004f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0055: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_005d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0063: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if (navigateNextTool == null)
				{
					navigateNextTool = new TaskPaneNavigationTool(this, TaskPaneNavigationToolType.Forward);
					navigateNextTool.InstanceProps.IsFirstInGroup = true;
					navigateNextTool.SharedProps.Enabled = History.CanMoveForward;
				}
				if (ToolbarsManager != null)
				{
					if ((int)ToolbarsManager.StyleResolved == 1 || (int)ToolbarsManager.StyleResolved == 4)
					{
						navigateNextTool.InstanceProps.IsFirstInGroup = false;
					}
					else
					{
						navigateNextTool.InstanceProps.IsFirstInGroup = true;
					}
				}
				return navigateNextTool;
			}
		}

		internal TaskPaneToolbarLabelTool NavigationLabelTool
		{
			get
			{
				if (navigationLabelTool == null)
				{
					navigationLabelTool = new TaskPaneToolbarLabelTool(this);
					navigationLabelTool.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					navigationLabelTool.SharedProps.Spring = true;
				}
				return navigationLabelTool;
			}
		}

		internal TaskPaneToolbarMenuTool NavigationMenuTool
		{
			get
			{
				if (navigationMenuTool == null)
				{
					navigationMenuTool = new TaskPaneToolbarMenuTool(this);
					navigationMenuTool.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					navigationMenuTool.SharedProps.Spring = true;
					DockedPosition dockedPosition = base.DockedPosition;
					if (dockedPosition == DockedPosition.Top || dockedPosition == DockedPosition.Bottom)
					{
						navigationMenuTool.SharedProps.MaxWidth = 200;
					}
					navigationMenuTool.InstanceProps.IsFirstInGroup = true;
					navigationMenuTool.InternalSetTools(base.Tools);
				}
				return navigationMenuTool;
			}
		}

		internal int MaximumDockedExtent
		{
			get
			{
				if (dockedContentExtentMax == 0)
				{
					return int.MaxValue;
				}
				int num = 0;
				DockedPosition dockedPosition = base.DockedPosition;
				if (dockedPosition == DockedPosition.Top || dockedPosition == DockedPosition.Bottom)
				{
					num += HeaderToolbarHeight;
				}
				if (AllowResize)
				{
					num += 3;
				}
				return num + dockedContentExtentMax;
			}
		}

		internal int MinimumDockedExtent
		{
			get
			{
				int num = dockedContentExtentMin;
				switch (base.DockedPosition)
				{
				case DockedPosition.Top:
				case DockedPosition.Bottom:
					num += HeaderToolbarHeight;
					break;
				case DockedPosition.Left:
				case DockedPosition.Right:
					num = Math.Max(num, MinimumHeaderToolbarWidth);
					if (ShowNavigationArea)
					{
						num = Math.Max(num, NavigationAreaWidth);
					}
					break;
				}
				if (AllowResize)
				{
					num += 3;
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		internal UltraPagerContentControl PagerContentControl
		{
			get
			{
				if (ToolbarsManager == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ToolbarsManager.GetToolbarPagerControl(this);
			}
		}

		internal PagerInfo PagerInfo
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0090: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_009a: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_00a7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00b1: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_00c2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00c7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00c8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00ca: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00f4: Expected I4, but got Unknown
				if (pagerInfo == null)
				{
					pagerInfo = new PagerInfo();
					pagerInfo.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					pagerInfo.PositionInfoChanged += OnPagerPositionChanged;
					pagerInfo.Scrolling += OnPagerScrolling;
					pagerInfo.PagerControlResize += OnPagerInitializeControlSize;
					pagerInfo.PaintContentArea += OnPagerContentAreaPaint;
					pagerInfo.ScrollButtonResolveCallback = new ResolveAppearanceCallback(OnResolvePagerScrollButtonAppearance);
					pagerInfo.HotTrackScrollButtonResolveCallback = new ResolveAppearanceCallback(OnResolvePagerHotTrackScrollButtonAppearance);
				}
				if (ToolbarsManager != null)
				{
					ToolbarStyle styleResolved = ToolbarsManager.StyleResolved;
					switch (styleResolved - 1)
					{
					case 0:
						pagerInfo.DisplayStyle = PagerDisplayStyle.Standard;
						break;
					case 3:
						pagerInfo.DisplayStyle = PagerDisplayStyle.OfficeXP;
						break;
					case 1:
						pagerInfo.DisplayStyle = PagerDisplayStyle.Office2003;
						break;
					case 2:
						pagerInfo.DisplayStyle = PagerDisplayStyle.VisualStudio2005;
						break;
					case 4:
						pagerInfo.DisplayStyle = PagerDisplayStyle.Office2007;
						break;
					case 6:
						pagerInfo.DisplayStyle = PagerDisplayStyle.ScenicRibbon;
						break;
					case 7:
						pagerInfo.DisplayStyle = PagerDisplayStyle.Office2010;
						break;
					case 8:
						pagerInfo.DisplayStyle = PagerDisplayStyle.Office2013;
						break;
					case 5:
						pagerInfo.DisplayStyle = PagerDisplayStyle.WindowsVista;
						break;
					}
				}
				return pagerInfo;
			}
		}

		internal bool ShowHeaderLabelInToolbar
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_002c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_002e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0030: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if (!AllowNavigationViaMenuResolved)

					return true;

				if (ToolbarsManager == null)

					return true;
				}
				if (ShowInsertNewToolMessage)
				{
					return true;
				}
				ToolbarStyle styleResolved = ToolbarsManager.StyleResolved;
				if ((int)styleResolved == 1 || (int)styleResolved == 4)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		{

				return false;
			}

					return false;
				}
				return !ShowNavigationArea;
			}
		}

		internal bool ShowNavigationArea
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Top || base.DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Bottom)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (ToolbarsManager == null || ToolbarsManager.MSColors == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!ShowHomeButtonResolved)
				{
					return ShowNextPreviousButtons;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal bool ShowNextPreviousButtonInToolbar

		private int ActualDockedExtent
		{
			get
			{
				int num = InternalDockedContentExtent;
				if (AllowResize)
				{
					num += 3;
				}
				DockedPosition dockedPosition = base.DockedPosition;
				if (dockedPosition == DockedPosition.Top || dockedPosition == DockedPosition.Bottom)
				{
					num += HeaderToolbarHeight;
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		private bool CanNavigateToHomeTool => homeTaskPaneTool != null;

		private bool HasMultipleVisibleTaskPaneTools
		{
			get
			{
				int num = 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < base.Tools.Count; i++)
				{
					if (base.Tools[i].VisibleResolved)
					{
						num++;
						if (num > 1)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				if (history == null)
				{
					history = new HistoryList();
				}
				return history;
			}
		}

		private int MinimumHeaderToolbarWidth
		{
			get
			{
				if (cachedMinimumHeaderWidth != 0)
				{
					return cachedMinimumHeaderWidth;
				}
				return CalculateMinimumHeaderToolbarWidth();
			}
		}

		private string SelectedToolHeaderCaption
		{
			get
			{
				if (selectedTaskPaneTool == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (selectedTaskPaneTool.UnderlyingTool is TaskPaneTool { HeaderCaption: not null } taskPaneTool)
				{
					return taskPaneTool.HeaderCaption;
				}
				return selectedTaskPaneTool.CaptionResolved;
			}
		}

		public override int Height
		{
			get

				switch (base.DockedPosition)

				case DockedPosition.Top:
				case DockedPosition.Bottom:
				case DockedPosition.Left:
				case DockedPosition.Right:
				case DockedPosition.Floating:
					return ActualDockedExtent;
				default:
					return 100;
				}
			}
		}

		private Size CalculateFloatingSizeHelper(Size floatingContentSize)
		{
			floatingContentSize.Height += HeaderAreaHeight;
			floatingContentSize.Width = Math.Max(floatingContentSize.Width, MinimumHeaderToolbarWidth);
			if (ShowNavigationArea)
			{
				floatingContentSize.Width = Math.Max(floatingContentSize.Width, NavigationAreaWidth);
			}
			return floatingContentSize;
		}

		private int CalculateMinimumHeaderToolbarWidth()
		{
			//IL_0085: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0090: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00eb: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f1: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			int num = 0;
			int toolSpacingResolved = base.SettingsResolved.ToolSpacingResolved;
			ToolBase[] extraTools = HeaderToolbar.ExtraTools;
			foreach (ToolBase toolBase in extraTools)
			{
				if (!toolBase.IsVisible(considerBumpedStatus: false))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (num > 0)
				{
					num += toolSpacingResolved;
					if (toolBase.IsFirstInGroupResolved)
					{
						num += 6;
					}
				}
				num = ((!toolBase.SpringResolved) ? (num + toolBase.WidthResolved) : (num + toolBase.MinimumSize.Width));
			}
			UIElementBorderWidths val = ToolbarsManager.CalculateBorderWidths(base.SettingsResolved.BorderStyleDockedResolved, Border3DSide.Left | Border3DSide.Right);
			num += 1 + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Left + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Right;
			if (HeaderToolbar.GrabHandleWidth > 0)
			{
				num += 4 + HeaderToolbar.GrabHandleWidth;
			}
			num += base.SettingsResolved.PaddingLeftResolved + base.SettingsResolved.PaddingRightResolved;
			if (ToolbarsManager != null && (int)ToolbarsManager.StyleResolved == 1)
			{
				num += 2;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private ToolBase FindTaskPaneToolHelper(ToolBase toolToIgnore, string preferredToolKey, bool ignoreMdiPlaceHolders)
		{
			if (preferredToolKey != null)
			{
				foreach (ToolBase tool in base.Tools)
				{
					if (tool.VisibleResolved && tool != toolToIgnore && (!ignoreMdiPlaceHolders || !(tool is MdiMergePlaceholderTool)) && tool.Key == preferredToolKey)
					{
						return tool;
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (ToolBase tool2 in base.Tools)
			{
				if (tool2.VisibleResolved && tool2 != toolToIgnore && (!ignoreMdiPlaceHolders || !(tool2 is MdiMergePlaceholderTool)))
				{
					return tool2;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void OnPagerInitializeControlSize(object sender, PagerControlResizeEventArgs e)
		{
			if (SelectedTaskPaneTool == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			TaskPaneTool taskPaneTool = ((SelectedTaskPaneTool is TaskPaneTool) ? (SelectedTaskPaneTool as TaskPaneTool) : (SelectedTaskPaneTool.UnderlyingTool as TaskPaneTool));
			if (taskPaneTool == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (taskPaneTool.ResizeModeResolved == TaskPaneToolResizeMode.AutoSizeBothDimensions)
			{
				if (e.Orientation == Orientation.Vertical)
				{
					e.NewControlSize = new Size(e.NewControlSize.Width, e.AvailableSize.Height);
				}
				else
				{
					e.NewControlSize = new Size(e.AvailableSize.Width, e.NewControlSize.Height);
				}
			}
			TaskPaneToolResizeEventArgs e2 = new TaskPaneToolResizeEventArgs(taskPaneTool, e.Control, e.AvailableSize, e.NewControlSize);
			taskPaneTool.ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.TaskPaneToolResize, e2);
			e.NewControlSize = e2.NewControlSize;
		}

		private static bool ContainsSelectableControl(Control control)
		{
			if (control == null || !control.HasChildren || !control.Visible || !control.Enabled)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (Control control2 in control.Controls)
			{
				if (control2.CanSelect)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (control2.HasChildren && ContainsSelectableControl(control2))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SetSelectedTaskPaneTool(ToolBase newTool, bool allowCancel)
		{
			SetSelectedTaskPaneTool(newTool, allowCancel, IsActive);
		}

		private void SetSelectedTaskPaneTool(ToolBase newTool, bool allowCancel, bool activateControl)
		{
			if (newTool != null)
			{
				newTool = newTool.ToolBeingDisplayed;
			}
			bool flag = newTool != SelectedTaskPaneTool;
			if (flag && newTool != null && selectedTaskPaneTool != null && newTool.Key == selectedTaskPaneTool.Key)
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				selectedTaskPaneToolKey = null;
				if (newTool != null && !(newTool is TaskPaneTool) && !(newTool.UnderlyingTool is TaskPaneTool) && (!(newTool is MdiMergePlaceholderTool) || newTool.UnderlyingTool != null))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_125", "SelectedTaskPaneTool"));
				}
				if (newTool != null)
				{
					int num = base.Tools.IndexOf(newTool.Key);
					if (num < 0 && ToolbarsManager != null)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_126"));
					}
					newTool = base.Tools[num];
				}
				if (ToolbarsManager != null)
				{
					BeforeTaskPaneToolSelectedEventArgs e = new BeforeTaskPaneToolSelectedEventArgs(newTool, this);
					ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.BeforeTaskPaneToolSelected, e);
					if (e.Cancel && allowCancel)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				UltraPagerContentControl pagerContentControl = PagerContentControl;
				pagerContentControl?.SuspendLayout();
				if (selectedTaskPaneTool != null && (selectedTaskPaneTool is TaskPaneTool || selectedTaskPaneTool.UnderlyingTool is TaskPaneTool))
				{
					selectedTaskPaneTool.SetToolWithContainedControl(takeControlOwnership: false, ToolbarsManager.GetToolbarDockArea(this));
				}
				selectedTaskPaneTool = newTool;
				AddToHistory(newTool);
				VerifyNavigateButtonState();
				EnsureSelectedToolControlIsParented();
				pagerContentControl?.ResumeLayout(performLayout: true);
			}
			if (activateControl)
			{
				Activate(honorAutoActivate: true);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (ToolbarsManager != null)
				{
					ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.AfterTaskPaneToolSelected, new TaskPaneToolbarEventArgs(this));
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.SelectedTaskPaneTool);
			}
		}

		private void VerifyNavigateButtonState()
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				NavigateHomeTool.SharedProps.Enabled = CanNavigateToHomeTool;
				switch (NavigationButtonStyleResolved)
				{
				case NavigationButtonStyle.Linear:
					NavigatePreviousTool.SharedProps.Enabled = SelectedTaskPaneTool != null && base.Tools.GetPreviousTool(SelectedTaskPaneTool, visibleToolsOnly: true, selectableToolsOnly: true, recentlyUsedToolsOnly: false, wrapAround: false) != null;
					NavigateNextTool.SharedProps.Enabled = SelectedTaskPaneTool != null && base.Tools.GetNextTool(SelectedTaskPaneTool, visibleToolsOnly: true, selectableToolsOnly: true, recentlyUsedToolsOnly: false, wrapAround: false) != null;
					break;
				case NavigationButtonStyle.History:
					NavigateNextTool.SharedProps.Enabled = History.CanMoveForward;
					NavigatePreviousTool.SharedProps.Enabled = History.CanMoveBack;
					break;
				case NavigationButtonStyle.None:
					NavigateNextTool.SharedProps.Enabled = false;
					NavigatePreviousTool.SharedProps.Enabled = false;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void Activate(bool honorAutoActivate)
		{
			//IL_005e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0064: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_006b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0071: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (selectedTaskPaneTool != null && selectedTaskPaneTool.Control != null && !selectedTaskPaneTool.Control.ContainsFocus)
			{
				TaskPaneTool taskPaneTool = ((selectedTaskPaneTool is TaskPaneTool) ? selectedTaskPaneTool : selectedTaskPaneTool.UnderlyingTool) as TaskPaneTool;
				if (!honorAutoActivate || ((int)taskPaneTool.AutoActivateControl != 2 && ((int)taskPaneTool.AutoActivateControl == 1 || selectedTaskPaneTool.Control.CanSelect || ContainsSelectableControl(selectedTaskPaneTool.Control))))
				{
					ToolbarsManagerUtilities.FocusControl(selectedTaskPaneTool.Control);
				}
			}
		}

		internal override UltraToolbarBase Clone()
		{
			UltraToolbar ultraToolbar = new UltraTaskPaneToolbar(Key);
			ultraToolbar.InitializeFrom(this);
			return ultraToolbar;
		}

		internal Size EnforceFloatingSizeMinMax(Size currentSize, Size newSize)
		{
			int headerAreaHeight = HeaderAreaHeight;
			newSize.Height -= headerAreaHeight;
			currentSize.Height -= headerAreaHeight;
			if (floatingContentSizeMax.Width > 0)
			{
				newSize.Width = Math.Min(newSize.Width, Math.Max(currentSize.Width, floatingContentSizeMax.Width));
			}
			if (floatingContentSizeMax.Height > 0)
			{
				newSize.Height = Math.Min(newSize.Height, Math.Max(currentSize.Height, floatingContentSizeMax.Height));
			}
			if (floatingContentSizeMin.Width > 0)
			{
				newSize.Width = Math.Max(newSize.Width, Math.Min(currentSize.Width, floatingContentSizeMin.Width));
			}
			if (floatingContentSizeMin.Height > 0)
			{
				newSize.Height = Math.Max(newSize.Height, Math.Min(currentSize.Height, floatingContentSizeMin.Height));
			}
			newSize.Width = Math.Max(newSize.Width, MinimumHeaderToolbarWidth);
			if (ShowNavigationArea)
			{
				newSize.Width = Math.Max(newSize.Width, NavigationAreaWidth);
			}
			if (newSize.Height < 0)
			{
				newSize.Height = 0;
			}
			newSize.Height += headerAreaHeight;
			return newSize;
		}

		internal void EnsureSelectedToolControlIsParented()
		{
			UltraPagerContentControl pagerContentControl = PagerContentControl;
			if (pagerContentControl == null || ToolbarsManager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (selectedTaskPaneTool == null)
			{
				if (pagerInfo.Control != null)
				{
					ToolbarsManager.ReparentControl(pagerInfo.Control, null, null);
				}
			}
			else if (pagerInfo.Control != selectedTaskPaneTool.Control && selectedTaskPaneTool.ToolWithContainedControl != selectedTaskPaneTool)
			{
				if (pagerInfo.Control != null)
				{
					ToolbarsManager.ReparentControl(pagerInfo.Control, null, null);
				}
				if (selectedTaskPaneTool is TaskPaneTool || selectedTaskPaneTool.UnderlyingTool is TaskPaneTool)
				{
					selectedTaskPaneTool.SetToolWithContainedControl(takeControlOwnership: true, ToolbarsManager.GetToolbarDockArea(this));
				}
			}
		}

			//IL_0098: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

		internal bool IsToolDisplayedInNavigationArea(ToolBase tool)
		{
			TaskPaneNavigationTool taskPaneNavigationTool = ((tool is MdiMergePlaceholderTool) ? tool.UnderlyingTool : tool) as TaskPaneNavigationTool;
			switch (taskPaneNavigationTool.ToolType)
			{
			case TaskPaneNavigationToolType.Home:
				return !ShowHomeButtonInToolbar;
			case TaskPaneNavigationToolType.Back:
			case TaskPaneNavigationToolType.Forward:
				return !ShowNextPreviousButtonInToolbar;
			default:
				return true;
			}
		}

		}

		internal void ProcessNavigationButton(TaskPaneNavigationToolType toolType)
		{
			bool flag = NavigationButtonStyle == NavigationButtonStyle.Linear;
			ToolBase toolBase = null;
			switch (toolType)
			{
			case TaskPaneNavigationToolType.Home:
				if (CanNavigateToHomeTool)
				{
					toolBase = homeTaskPaneTool;
				}
				break;
			case TaskPaneNavigationToolType.Back:
				if (flag)
				{
					if (SelectedTaskPaneTool != null)
					{
						toolBase = base.Tools.GetPreviousTool(SelectedTaskPaneTool, visibleToolsOnly: true, selectableToolsOnly: true, recentlyUsedToolsOnly: false, wrapAround: false);
					}
				}
				else if (History.CanMoveBack)
				{
					History.MoveBack();
					toolBase = base.Tools[History.CurrentItem];
				}
				break;
			case TaskPaneNavigationToolType.Forward:
				if (flag)
				{
					if (SelectedTaskPaneTool != null)
					{
						toolBase = base.Tools.GetNextTool(SelectedTaskPaneTool, visibleToolsOnly: true, selectableToolsOnly: true, recentlyUsedToolsOnly: false, wrapAround: false);
					}
				}
				else if (History.CanMoveForward)
				{
					History.MoveForward();
					toolBase = base.Tools[History.CurrentItem];
				}
				break;
			}
			if (toolBase != null)
			{
				SetSelectedTaskPaneTool(toolBase, allowCancel: true, activateControl: true);
			}
		}

		internal void ReparentPagerControl(UltraToolbarsDockArea dockArea, bool createIfNull)
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager == null || ToolbarsManager.IsDesignMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (dockArea == null && createIfNull)
			{
				createIfNull = false;
			}
			UltraPagerContentControl ultraPagerContentControl = PagerContentControl;
			if (ultraPagerContentControl == null)
			{
				if (createIfNull)
				{
					ultraPagerContentControl = ToolbarsManager.CreateToolbarPagerControl(this);
				}
				if (ultraPagerContentControl == null)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (dockArea != null)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.ReparentControl(ultraPagerContentControl, (Control)(object)dockArea, null);
			}
		}

		internal void ResolveNavigationAreaAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			UIRole role = StyleUtils.GetRole(toolbarsManager, StyleUtils.Role.TaskPaneNavigationButtonArea);
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleBefore)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);

			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseControlInfo)

				{
					UnderlyingTaskPaneToolbar.NavigationButtonAreaAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
				if (HasNavigationButtonAreaAppearance)
				{
					NavigationButtonAreaAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleAfter)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			MicrosoftColorTable mSColors = toolbarsManager.MSColors;
			if (mSColors != null && UltraToolbarsManager.ShouldSetAppearanceProperty(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (AppearancePropFlags)1))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = mSColors.TaskPaneNavigationArea;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEuL);

		internal void ResolveTaskPaneAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ad: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b3: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ResolutionOrderInfo resolutionOrder = StyleUtils.GetResolutionOrder(toolbarsManager);
			UIRole uIRole = UIRole;
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleBefore)
			{
				uIRole.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseControlInfo)
			{
				if (UnderlyingTaskPaneToolbar != null && UnderlyingTaskPaneToolbar.HasAppearance)
				{
					UnderlyingTaskPaneToolbar.Appearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
				if (HasAppearance)
				{
					Appearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleAfter)
			{
				uIRole.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (UltraToolbarsManager.ShouldSetAppearanceProperty(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (AppearancePropFlags)1))
			{
				MicrosoftColorTable mSColors = toolbarsManager.MSColors;
				if (mSColors != null)
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = mSColors.TaskPaneContentArea;
				}
				else if ((int)ToolbarsManager.StyleResolved == 4)
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = XPItemColor.MenuDroppedBackColor;
				}
				else
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = SystemColors.Control;
				}
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEuL);
			}
		}

		internal override Size CalculateFloatingWindowSize()
		{
			Size result = base.FloatingSize;
			if (result.IsEmpty)
			{
				if (floatingContentSize.IsEmpty)
				{
					result = new Size(200, 350);
					if (floatingContentSizeMax.Width > 0)
					{
						result.Width = Math.Min(result.Width, floatingContentSizeMax.Width);
					}
					if (floatingContentSizeMax.Height > 0)
					{
						result.Height = Math.Min(result.Height, floatingContentSizeMax.Height);
					}
					if (floatingContentSizeMin.Width > 0)
					{
						result.Width = Math.Max(result.Width, floatingContentSizeMin.Width);
					}
					if (floatingContentSizeMin.Height > 0)
					{
						result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, floatingContentSizeMin.Height);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					result = floatingContentSize;
				}
				result = CalculateFloatingSizeHelper(result);
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal override Size GetMinimumFloatingSize()
		{
			Size result = FloatingContentSizeMin;
			result.Height += HeaderAreaHeight;
			result.Width = Math.Max(result.Width, MinimumHeaderToolbarWidth);
			result.Height += 8;
			result.Width += 6;
			return result;
		}

		internal override void Initialize(object owner)
		{
			base.Initialize(owner);
			if (ToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				if (appearanceHolder != null)
				{
					appearanceHolder.Collection = ToolbarsManager.Appearances;
				}
				if (activeCaptionAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					activeCaptionAppearanceHolder.Collection = ToolbarsManager.Appearances;
				}
				if (hotTrackScrollButtonAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					hotTrackScrollButtonAppearanceHolder.Collection = ToolbarsManager.Appearances;
				}
				if (scrollButtonAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					scrollButtonAppearanceHolder.Collection = ToolbarsManager.Appearances;
				}
				if (navigationButtonAreaAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					navigationButtonAreaAppearanceHolder.Collection = ToolbarsManager.Appearances;
				}
			}
			InitializeSerializedToolsFromKey();
			VerifyNavigateButtonState();
		}

		internal override void InternalSetFloatingSize(Size size)
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				Size size2 = size;
				size2.Height = Math.Max(0, size2.Height - HeaderToolbarHeight);
				floatingContentSize = size2;
			}
			base.InternalSetFloatingSize(size);
		}

		internal override void InternalSetToolbarSettings(ToolbarSettings settings)
		{
			base.InternalSetToolbarSettings(settings);
			if (headerToolbar != null)
			{
				headerToolbar.InternalSetToolbarSettings(settings);
			}
		}

		internal override void MergeWithChildToolbar(UltraToolbar childToolbar)
		{
			if (base.IsMdiMergeToolbar && childToolbar is UltraTaskPaneToolbar ultraTaskPaneToolbar)
			{
				InternalSetNavigationMenuSettings(ultraTaskPaneToolbar.NavigationMenuSettings);
			}
			base.MergeWithChildToolbar(childToolbar);
		}

		{
			base.OnAddedToCollection(primaryCollection);
			if (base.PrimaryCollection == primaryCollection)

				InitializeSerializedToolsFromKey();
				VerifyNavigateButtonState();
			}
		}

		internal override void OnAfterMdiMergeChildTools()
		{
			base.OnAfterMdiMergeChildTools();
			SetSelectedTaskPaneTool(FindTaskPaneToolHelper(null, History.CurrentItem, ignoreMdiPlaceHolders: false), allowCancel: false);
			HomeTaskPaneTool = FindTaskPaneToolHelper(null, HomeTaskPaneToolKey, ignoreMdiPlaceHolders: false);
			VerifyNavigateButtonState();
		}

		internal override void OnAfterMdiMergeDisconnect()
		{
			base.OnAfterMdiMergeDisconnect();
			VerifyNavigateButtonState();
		}

		internal override void OnAfterSetUnderlyingToolbar()
		{
			base.OnAfterSetUnderlyingToolbar();
			if (UnderlyingToolbar == null && base.IsMdiMergeToolbar)
			{
				InternalSetNavigationMenuSettings(null);
			}
		}

		internal override void OnBeforeMdiMerge()
		{
			base.OnBeforeMdiMerge();
			if (snapShotMdiMergedHistoryList == null)
			{
				snapShotMdiMergedHistoryList = History.Clone() as HistoryList;
			}
			snapShotNonMdiMergeHistoryList = History;
			history = snapShotMdiMergedHistoryList;
		}

		internal override void OnBeforeMdiMergeDisconnect()
		{
			base.OnBeforeMdiMergeDisconnect();
			history = snapShotNonMdiMergeHistoryList;
			SetSelectedTaskPaneTool(FindTaskPaneToolHelper(null, History.CurrentItem, ignoreMdiPlaceHolders: true), allowCancel: false);
			HomeTaskPaneTool = FindTaskPaneToolHelper(null, HomeTaskPaneToolKey, ignoreMdiPlaceHolders: true);
			VerifyNavigateButtonState();
		}

		internal override void OnBeforeSetUnderlyingToolbar()
		{
			base.OnBeforeSetUnderlyingToolbar();
			if (UnderlyingToolbar != null)
			{
				HeaderToolbar.InternalSetToolbarSettings(null);
				if (UnderlyingToolbar is UltraTaskPaneToolbar ultraTaskPaneToolbar && NavigationMenuSettings == ultraTaskPaneToolbar.NavigationMenuSettings)
				{
					InternalSetNavigationMenuSettings(null);
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void OnBeforeToolRemovedFromCollection(ToolBase tool, ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
			History.Remove(tool.Key, removeDuplicateConsecutiveItems: true);
			if (tool == SelectedTaskPaneTool)
			{
				ToolBase newTool = FindTaskPaneToolHelper(tool, history.CurrentItem, ignoreMdiPlaceHolders: false);
				SetSelectedTaskPaneTool(newTool, allowCancel: false);
			}
			if (tool == HomeTaskPaneTool)
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = FindTaskPaneToolHelper(tool, null, ignoreMdiPlaceHolders: false);
				HomeTaskPaneTool = toolBase;
			}
			base.OnBeforeToolRemovedFromCollection(tool, toolsCollection);
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			DisposeAppearanceHolder(ref activeCaptionAppearanceHolder);
			DisposeAppearanceHolder(ref appearanceHolder);
			DisposeAppearanceHolder(ref hotTrackScrollButtonAppearanceHolder);
			DisposeAppearanceHolder(ref navigationButtonAreaAppearanceHolder);
			DisposeAppearanceHolder(ref scrollButtonAppearanceHolder);
			if (pagerInfo != null)
			{
				pagerInfo.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				pagerInfo.PositionInfoChanged -= OnPagerPositionChanged;
				pagerInfo.Scrolling -= OnPagerScrolling;
				pagerInfo.PagerControlResize -= OnPagerInitializeControlSize;
				pagerInfo.PaintContentArea -= OnPagerContentAreaPaint;
				pagerInfo.Dispose();
				pagerInfo = null;
			}
			if (closeButtonTool != null)
			{
				closeButtonTool.Dispose();
				closeButtonTool = null;
			}
			if (navigateHomeTool != null)
			{
				navigateHomeTool.Dispose();
				navigateHomeTool = null;
			}
			if (navigatePreviousTool != null)
			{
				navigatePreviousTool.Dispose();
				navigatePreviousTool = null;
			}
			if (navigateNextTool != null)
			{
				navigateNextTool.Dispose();
				navigateNextTool = null;
			}
			if (headerToolbar != null)
			{
				headerToolbar.Dispose();
				headerToolbar = null;
			}
			homeTaskPaneTool = null;
			selectedTaskPaneTool = null;
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (propChange.PropId is PropertyIds)
			{
				PropertyIds propertyIds = (PropertyIds)(object)propChange.PropId;
				if (propertyIds == PropertyIds.DockedPosition)
				{
					DockedPosition dockedPosition = base.DockedPosition;
					if (dockedPosition == DockedPosition.Top || dockedPosition == DockedPosition.Bottom)
					{
						NavigationMenuTool.SharedProps.MaxWidth = 200;
					}
					else
					{
						NavigationMenuTool.SharedProps.ResetMaxWidth();
					}
				}
			}
			base.OnObjectPropChanged(propChange);
		}

		internal override void OnResizeBegin()
		{
			cachedHeaderHeight = HeaderToolbarHeight;
			cachedMinimumHeaderWidth = CalculateMinimumHeaderToolbarWidth();
			base.OnResizeBegin();
		}

		internal override void OnResizeEnd()
		{
			cachedMinimumHeaderWidth = 0;
			cachedHeaderHeight = 0;
			base.OnResizeEnd();
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (propChange.Source == navigationMenuTool && (PropertyIds)(object)propChange.PropId == PropertyIds.MenuSettings)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.TaskPaneToolbarNavigationMenuSettings, propChange);
			}
			else if (propChange.Source != headerToolbar && propChange.Source != navigationMenuTool && propChange.Source != navigationLabelTool && propChange.Source != pagerInfo)
			{
				if (HasAppearance && propChange.Source == appearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
				{
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Appearance, propChange);
				}
				else if (HasActiveCaptionAppearance && propChange.Source == activeCaptionAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
				{
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ActiveCaptionAppearance, propChange);
				}
				else if (HasNavigationButtonAreaAppearance && propChange.Source == navigationButtonAreaAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
				{
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.NavigationButtonAreaAppearance, propChange);
				}
				else if (HasScrollButtonAppearance && propChange.Source == scrollButtonAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
				{
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ScrollButtonAppearance, propChange);
				}
				else if (HasHotTrackScrollButtonAppearance && propChange.Source == hotTrackScrollButtonAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
				{
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.HotTrackScrollButtonAppearance, propChange);
				}
				else
				{
					base.OnSubObjectPropChanged(propChange);
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void OnUnderlyingToolbarPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo)
		{
			//IL_013e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (ToolbarsManager == null || !ToolbarsManager.Initialized || !(propChangeInfo.Source is UltraToolbar))
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraTaskPaneToolbar ultraTaskPaneToolbar = propChangeInfo.Source as UltraTaskPaneToolbar;
			switch ((PropertyIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId)
			{
			case PropertyIds.DockedContentExtent:
				if (ultraTaskPaneToolbar != null)
				{
					DockedContentExtent = ultraTaskPaneToolbar.DockedContentExtent;
				}
				break;
			case PropertyIds.DockedContentExtentMin:
				if (ultraTaskPaneToolbar != null)
				{
					DockedContentExtentMin = ultraTaskPaneToolbar.DockedContentExtentMin;
				}
				break;
			case PropertyIds.DockedContentExtentMax:
				if (ultraTaskPaneToolbar != null)
				{
					DockedContentExtentMax = ultraTaskPaneToolbar.DockedContentExtentMax;
				}
				break;
			case PropertyIds.FloatingContentSize:
				if (ultraTaskPaneToolbar != null)
				{
					FloatingContentSize = ultraTaskPaneToolbar.FloatingContentSize;
				}
				break;
			case PropertyIds.FloatingContentSizeMin:
				if (ultraTaskPaneToolbar != null)
				{
					FloatingContentSizeMin = ultraTaskPaneToolbar.FloatingContentSizeMin;
				}
				break;
			case PropertyIds.FloatingContentSizeMax:
				if (ultraTaskPaneToolbar != null)
				{
					FloatingContentSizeMax = ultraTaskPaneToolbar.FloatingContentSizeMax;
				}
				break;
			case PropertyIds.SelectedTaskPaneTool:
				if (ultraTaskPaneToolbar != null)
				{
					SelectedTaskPaneToolKey = ultraTaskPaneToolbar.SelectedTaskPaneToolKey;
				}
				break;
			case PropertyIds.HomeTaskPaneTool:
				if (ultraTaskPaneToolbar != null)
				{
					HomeTaskPaneToolKey = ultraTaskPaneToolbar.HomeTaskPaneToolKey;
				}
				break;
			case PropertyIds.AllowResize:
				if (ultraTaskPaneToolbar != null)
				{
					AllowResize = ultraTaskPaneToolbar.AllowResize;
				}
				break;
			case PropertyIds.NavigationButtonStyle:

		public override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeAppearance() && !ShouldSerializeNavigationButtonAreaAppearance() && !ShouldSerializeActiveCaptionAppearance() && !ShouldSerializeScrollButtonAppearance() && !ShouldSerializeHotTrackScrollButtonAppearance() && !ShouldSerializeAllowResize() && !ShouldSerializeDockedContentExtent() && !ShouldSerializeDockedContentExtentMax() && !ShouldSerializeDockedContentExtentMin() && !ShouldSerializeNavigationButtonStyle() && !ShouldSerializeNavigationMenuSettings() && !ShouldSerializeShowHomeButton() && !ShouldSerializeToolResizeMode() && !ShouldSerializeAllowNavigationViaMenu() && !ShouldSerializeFloatingContentSize() && !ShouldSerializeFloatingContentSizeMax() && !ShouldSerializeFloatingContentSizeMin())
			{
				return base.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return true;
		}

		void IDeserializationCallback.OnDeserialization(object sender)
		{
			if (appearanceHolder != null)
			{
				appearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (activeCaptionAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				activeCaptionAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (hotTrackScrollButtonAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				hotTrackScrollButtonAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (scrollButtonAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				scrollButtonAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (navigationButtonAreaAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				navigationButtonAreaAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (headerToolbar != null)
			{
				headerToolbar.InternalSetToolbarSettings(base.Settings);
			}
			if (serializedMenuSettings != null)
			{
				NavigationMenuTool.InternalSetMenuSettings(serializedMenuSettings, initializeOwner: true);
				serializedMenuSettings = null;
			}
			OnDeserialization(sender);
		}

					result.Height += 4;

		private Point GetToolbarDragOffset(Point dragPoint)
		{
			return new Point(Math.Max(20, toolbar.CalculateFloatingWindowSize().Width / 2), 4 + toolbar.HeaderToolbarHeight / 2);
		}

		internal void InitializeElement(UltraTaskPaneToolbar toolbar)
		{
			this.toolbar = toolbar;
			((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext = toolbar;
		}

		internal void ProcessDoubleClick()
		{
			UltraToolbar ultraToolbar = Toolbar;
			if (ultraToolbar == null || ToolbarsManager == null || (!ToolbarsManager.IsDesignMode && (!((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)ToolbarsManager).Enabled || ToolbarsManager.LockToolbars || (ultraToolbar.DockedPosition != DockedPosition.Floating && !ultraToolbar.SettingsResolved.AllowFloatingResolved))))
			{
				return;
			}
			ToolbarsManager.OnDragToolbarEnd();
			if ((lastMouseUpOrDownButton & MouseButtons.Left) != MouseButtons.Left)
			{
				return;
			}
			ToolbarModifiedEventArgs e;
			if (ultraToolbar.DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Floating)
			{
				if (ultraToolbar.RestoreLastDockedPosition() || ultraToolbar.SetNewDockedPosition())
				{
					e = new ToolbarModifiedEventArgs(ultraToolbar, ToolbarChangeType.Docked);
					ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.ToolbarModified, e);
				}
				return;
			}
			ultraToolbar.DockedPosition = DockedPosition.Floating;
			e = new ToolbarModifiedEventArgs(ultraToolbar, ToolbarChangeType.Undocked);
			if (ultraToolbar.FloatingLocation != Point.Empty)
			{
				FloatingToolbarWindowBase floatingWindow = ToolbarsManager.GetFloatingWindow(ultraToolbar);
				if (floatingWindow != null)
				{
					floatingWindow.Location = ultraToolbar.FloatingLocation;
				}
			}
			ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.ToolbarModified, e);
		}

		private void SaveMouseButton(MouseButtons mouseButtons)
		{
			lastMouseUpOrDownButton = MouseButtons.None;
			if ((mouseButtons & MouseButtons.Left) == MouseButtons.Left)
			{
				lastMouseUpOrDownButton |= MouseButtons.Left;
			}
			if ((mouseButtons & MouseButtons.Right) == MouseButtons.Right)
			{
				lastMouseUpOrDownButton |= MouseButtons.Right;
			}
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			toolbar.ResolveTaskPaneAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			((UIElement)this).InitAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		protected override void OnAfterDraw(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager != null && toolbarsManager.Customizing && toolbarsManager.CustomizeDialog != null && toolbarsManager.CustomizeDialog.SelectedObject == Toolbar)
			{
				toolbarsManager.PopupManager.CloseAllPopups();
				toolbarsManager.DrawToolSelectionRect(Rectangle.Inflate(((UIElement)this).Rect, -1, -1), ref drawParams);
			}
			((UIElement)this).OnAfterDraw(ref drawParams);
		}

		protected override void OnDoubleClick(bool adjustableArea)
		{
			ProcessDoubleClick();
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e, bool adjustableArea, ref UIElement captureMouseForElement)
		{
			SaveMouseButton(e.Button);
			if ((!ToolbarsManager.LockToolbars || Toolbar.DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Floating) && (e.Button & MouseButtons.Left) == MouseButtons.Left && ((UIElement)this).GetAncestor(typeof(UltraToolbarsDockAreaUIElement)) is UltraToolbarsDockAreaUIElement { IsPopupArea: false } ultraToolbarsDockAreaUIElement)
			{
				captureMouseForElement = (UIElement)(object)ultraToolbarsDockAreaUIElement;
				Point toolbarDragOffset = GetToolbarDragOffset(new Point(e.X, e.Y));
				UltraToolbar ultraToolbar = ((Toolbar.OwningTaskPaneToolbar == null) ? Toolbar : Toolbar.OwningTaskPaneToolbar);
				ultraToolbarsDockAreaUIElement.OnDragToolbarBegin(ultraToolbar);
				ToolbarsManager.OnDragToolbarBegin(ultraToolbar, toolbarDragOffset);
				return true;
			}
			return ((UIElement)this).OnMouseDown(e, adjustableArea, ref captureMouseForElement);
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseUp(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			SaveMouseButton(e.Button);
			return ((UIElement)this).OnMouseUp(e);
		}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			((ArrayList)(object)((UIElement)this).ChildElements).Clear();
			Rectangle rectInsideBorders = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
			if (rectInsideBorders.Width <= 0 || rectInsideBorders.Height <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (IsSplitterElementNeeded)
			{
				Rectangle rect;
				switch (toolbar.DockedPosition)
				{
				case DockedPosition.Left:
					rect = new Rectangle(rectInsideBorders.Right - 3, rectInsideBorders.Top, 3, rectInsideBorders.Height);
					rectInsideBorders.Width -= 3;
					break;
				case DockedPosition.Right:
					rect = new Rectangle(rectInsideBorders.Left, rectInsideBorders.Top, 3, rectInsideBorders.Height);
					rectInsideBorders.Width -= 3;
					rectInsideBorders.X += 3;
					break;
				case DockedPosition.Top:
					rect = new Rectangle(rectInsideBorders.Left, rectInsideBorders.Bottom - 3, rectInsideBorders.Width, 3);
					rectInsideBorders.Height -= 3;
					break;
				case DockedPosition.Bottom:
					rect = new Rectangle(rectInsideBorders.Left, rectInsideBorders.Top, rectInsideBorders.Width, 3);
					rectInsideBorders.Height -= 3;
					rectInsideBorders.Y += 3;
					break;
				default:
					rect = Rectangle.Empty;
					break;
				}
				if (!rect.Size.IsEmpty)
				{
					((UIElement)SplitterElement).Rect = rect;
					((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)SplitterElement);
					if (rectInsideBorders.Width <= 0 || rectInsideBorders.Height <= 0)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			ToolbarUIElement toolbarElement = ToolbarElement;
			toolbarElement.InitializeElement(toolbar.HeaderToolbar);
			Rectangle rect2 = rectInsideBorders;
			toolbar.HeaderToolbar.AdjustToolWidths(rectInsideBorders.Width);
			rect2.Height = Math.Min(toolbar.HeaderToolbarHeight, rectInsideBorders.Height);
			((UIElement)toolbarElement).Rect = rect2;
			((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)toolbarElement);
			rectInsideBorders.Height -= rect2.Height;
			rectInsideBorders.Y += rect2.Height;
			if (toolbar.ShowNavigationArea)
			{
				NavigationButtonAreaUIElement navigationButtonAreaUIElement = NavigationAreaElement;
				((UIElement)navigationButtonAreaUIElement).Rect = new Rectangle(rectInsideBorders.X, rectInsideBorders.Y, toolbar.NavigationAreaWidth, toolbar.NavigationAreaHeight);
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)navigationButtonAreaUIElement);
				rectInsideBorders.Height -= ((UIElement)navigationButtonAreaUIElement).Rect.Height;
				rectInsideBorders.Y += ((UIElement)navigationButtonAreaUIElement).Rect.Height;
			}
			rectInsideBorders.Height--;
			rectInsideBorders.Y++;
			toolbar.ReparentPagerControl(ToolbarsManager.GetToolbarDockArea(toolbar), createIfNull: true);
			if ((object)toolbar.DockArea != ((UIElement)this).Control)
			{
				PagerElement.Initialize(null);
			}
			else
			{
				PagerElement.Initialize(toolbar.PagerInfo);
			}
			((UIElement)PagerElement).Rect = rectInsideBorders;
			((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)PagerElement);
		}

		protected override bool WantsInputNotification(UIElementInputType inputType, Point point)
		{
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (toolbar != null && toolbar.PreventMouseInputNotification(inputType))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ((UIElement)this).WantsInputNotification(inputType, point);
		}

		protected override IRawElementProviderFragment CreateUIAutomationProvider()
		{
			return ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)new TaskPaneToolbarUIElementUiaProviderStub((UIElement)(object)this)).Provider;
		}

	public abstract class TearawayToolBase : PopupToolBase
	{
		private class TearawayToolBaseExtraSharedProps : SubObjectBase
		{
			private TearawayToolBase owningTool;

			internal bool allowTearaway;

			internal bool AllowTearaway
			{
				get
				{
					return allowTearaway;
				}
				set
				{
					if (allowTearaway != value)
					{
						owningTool.VerifyCanBeModified();
						allowTearaway = value;
						owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.AllowTearaway);
					}
				}
			}

			internal TearawayToolBaseExtraSharedProps(TearawayToolBase owningTool)
			{
				this.owningTool = owningTool;
			}
		}

		private UltraToolbar tearawayToolbar;

		private bool destroyTearawayToolbarOnClose;

		private DefaultableBoolean serializedAllowTearaway;

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_TearawayToolBase_P_AllowTearaway")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		public bool AllowTearaway
		{
			get
			{
				if (this is PopupMenuTool && IsMdiMergeTool && UnderlyingTool != null && UnderlyingTool != this)
				{
					return ((TearawayToolBase)UnderlyingTool).AllowTearaway;
				}
				return ExtraSharedProps.AllowTearaway;
			}
			set
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.AllowTearaway = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool AllowTearawayResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (!AllowTearaway)
				{
					return false;
				}
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManagerInControl = base.ToolbarsManagerInControl;
				if (toolbarsManagerInControl != null && toolbarsManagerInControl.EnforceOffice2007Resolution)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsTearawayToolbarCreated => tearawayToolbar != null;

		internal UltraToolbar TearawayToolbar
		{
			get
			{
				if (tearawayToolbar == null || tearawayToolbar.Disposed || tearawayToolbar.ToolbarsManager == null)
				{
					if (base.ToolbarsManagerInControl == null)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_37"));
					}
					string text = "tearaway_" + Key + "_";
					int num = 1;
					while (base.ToolbarsManagerInControl.Toolbars.Exists(text + num))
					{
						num++;
					}
					tearawayToolbar = new UltraToolbar(text + num, base.ToolBeingDisplayed, ToolbarType.Tearaway);
					tearawayToolbar.Text = base.CaptionResolved;
					base.ToolbarsManagerInControl.Toolbars.Add(tearawayToolbar);
					OnTearawayToolbarCreated();
					TearawayToolbarCreatedEventArgs e = new TearawayToolbarCreatedEventArgs(tearawayToolbar, destroyOnClose: false);
					base.ToolbarsManagerInControl.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.TearawayToolbarCreated, e);
					destroyTearawayToolbarOnClose = e.DestroyOnClose;
				}
				return tearawayToolbar;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		protected override int ExtraSharedPropsCount => base.ExtraSharedPropsCount + 1;

		private TearawayToolBaseExtraSharedProps ExtraSharedProps
		{
			get
			{
				TearawayToolBaseExtraSharedProps tearawayToolBaseExtraSharedProps = GetExtraSharedProps(base.ExtraSharedPropsCount) as TearawayToolBaseExtraSharedProps;
				if (tearawayToolBaseExtraSharedProps == null)
				{
					tearawayToolBaseExtraSharedProps = new TearawayToolBaseExtraSharedProps(this);
					SetExtraSharedProps(tearawayToolBaseExtraSharedProps, base.ExtraSharedPropsCount);
				}
				return tearawayToolBaseExtraSharedProps;
			}
		}

		protected TearawayToolBase(string key)
			: base(key)
		{
		}

		protected TearawayToolBase(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			//IL_005e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0055: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				string name = current.Name;
				if (!(name == "AllowTearaway"))
				{
					continue;
				}
				bool succeeded;
				bool flag = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), false, out succeeded);
				if (succeeded)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						serializedAllowTearaway = (DefaultableBoolean)1;
					}
					else
					{
						serializedAllowTearaway = (DefaultableBoolean)2;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		protected override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
			if (ShouldSerializeAllowTearaway())
			{
				info.AddValue("AllowTearaway", AllowTearaway);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void Initialize(ToolsCollectionBase parentCollection)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0025: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4

			base.Initialize(parentCollection);

			{
				ExtraSharedProps.allowTearaway = true;
			}
			else if ((int)serializedAllowTearaway == 2)

				ExtraSharedProps.allowTearaway = false;
			}
			serializedAllowTearaway = (DefaultableBoolean)0;
		}

		protected internal override void InitializeFrom(ToolBase sourceTool, bool cloneNewInstance)
		{
			base.InitializeFrom(sourceTool, cloneNewInstance);

		{
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			if (base.ToolBeingDisplayed.InstanceDisplaysImage && val != null && val.ImageAndTextElement.ImageElement != null)

		{
			//IL_007d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0083: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (!base.ToolBeingDisplayed.InstanceDisplaysText || (base.ToolBeingDisplayed.IsLargeRibbonTool && ((PopupToolBase)base.ToolBeingDisplayed).DisplayDropDownArrow))
			{
				UIElement descendant = base.ToolBeingDisplayed.UIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(TextUIElement));
				if (descendant != null)
				{
					return descendant.Rect;
				}
				return base.GetTextArea();
			}
			ImageAndTextButtonUIElementBase val = (ImageAndTextButtonUIElementBase)base.ToolBeingDisplayed.UIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(ImageAndTextButtonUIElementBase));
			if (val != null && val.ImageAndTextElement.TextElement != null)

				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "CharacterCasing":
					SerializedProps.characterCasing = (CharacterCasing)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(CharacterCasing), SerializedProps.characterCasing);
					break;
				case "MaxLength":
					SerializedProps.maxLength = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), SerializedProps.maxLength);
					break;
				case "PasswordChar":
					SerializedProps.passwordChar = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), SerializedProps.passwordChar);
					break;
				case "Text":
					SerializedProps.text = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), SerializedProps.text);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		{

			internal AppearanceHolder editAppearanceHolder;

			internal AppearanceBase EditAppearance
			{
				get
				{
					//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					//IL_0013: Expected O, but got Unknown
					if (editAppearanceHolder == null)
					{
						editAppearanceHolder = new AppearanceHolder();
						editAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					}
					ToolbarsManagerUtilities.SetAppearanceHolderCollection(editAppearanceHolder, owningTool.ToolbarsManager);
					return editAppearanceHolder.Appearance;
				}
				set
				{
					//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					//IL_0036: Expected O, but got Unknown
					if (editAppearanceHolder == null || !editAppearanceHolder.HasAppearance || value != editAppearanceHolder.Appearance)
					{
						if (editAppearanceHolder == null)
						{
							editAppearanceHolder = new AppearanceHolder();
							editAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
						}
						ToolbarsManagerUtilities.SetAppearanceHolderCollection(editAppearanceHolder, owningTool.ToolbarsManager);
						editAppearanceHolder.Appearance = value;
						owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.EditAppearance);
					}
				}
			}

			internal bool HasEditAppearance
			{
				get
				{
					if (editAppearanceHolder != null)
					{
						return editAppearanceHolder.HasAppearance;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			internal bool Locked
			{
				get
				{
					return locked;
				}
				set
				{
					if (value != locked)
					{
						owningTool.VerifyCanBeModified();
						locked = value;
						owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Locked);
					}
				}
			}

			internal VerticalDisplayStyle VerticalDisplayStyle
			{
				get
				{
					return verticalDisplayStyle;
				}
				set
				{
					if (value != verticalDisplayStyle)
					{
						owningTool.VerifyCanBeModified();
						if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(VerticalDisplayStyle), value))
						{
							throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_51"));
						}
						verticalDisplayStyle = value;
						owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.VerticalDisplayStyle);
					}
				}
			}

			internal TextEditorToolBaseExtraSharedProps(TextEditorToolBase owningTool)
			{
				this.owningTool = owningTool;
			}

			internal bool ShouldSerializeEditAppearance()
			{
				if (HasEditAppearance)
				{
					return editAppearanceHolder.ShouldSerialize();
				}
				return false;
			}

			internal void ResetEditAppearance()
			{
				if (HasEditAppearance)

					editAppearanceHolder.Reset();
					owningTool.CallNotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.EditAppearance);
				}
			}

					owningTool.OnSubObjectPropChanged(propChange);
				}
			}

		private TextEditorToolBaseExtraSharedProps ExtraSharedProps
		{
			get
			{
				TextEditorToolBaseExtraSharedProps textEditorToolBaseExtraSharedProps = GetExtraSharedProps(base.ExtraSharedPropsCount) as TextEditorToolBaseExtraSharedProps;
				if (textEditorToolBaseExtraSharedProps == null)
				{
					textEditorToolBaseExtraSharedProps = ((base.SharedProps.RootTool == null) ? new TextEditorToolBaseExtraSharedProps(this) : new TextEditorToolBaseExtraSharedProps(base.SharedProps.RootTool as TextEditorToolBase));
					textEditorToolBaseExtraSharedProps.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					SetExtraSharedProps(textEditorToolBaseExtraSharedProps, base.ExtraSharedPropsCount);
				}
				return textEditorToolBaseExtraSharedProps;
			}

		protected TextEditorToolBase(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			//IL_0066: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0070: Expected O, but got Unknown
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "EditAppearance":
					SerializedProps.editAppearanceHolder = (AppearanceHolder)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(AppearanceHolder), null);
					break;
				case "Locked":
					SerializedProps.locked = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), SerializedProps.locked);
					break;
				case "VerticalDisplayStyle":
					SerializedProps.verticalDisplayStyle = (VerticalDisplayStyle)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(VerticalDisplayStyle), SerializedProps.verticalDisplayStyle);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeEditAppearance()
		{
			if (base.IsRootTool)

			}
			return false;

		public void ResetEditAppearance()
		{

		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeLocked()
		{
			if (base.IsRootTool)

				return ExtraSharedProps.Locked;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetLocked()
		{
			Locked = false;
		}

		protected internal bool ShouldSerializeVerticalDisplayStyle()
		{
			if (base.IsRootTool && ExtraSharedProps.VerticalDisplayStyle != VerticalDisplayStyle.ShowAsButton)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetVerticalDisplayStyle()
		{
			VerticalDisplayStyle = VerticalDisplayStyle.ShowAsButton;
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			if (base.IsRootTool)
			{
				ResetEditAppearance();
				ResetLocked();
				ResetVerticalDisplayStyle();
			}
			base.Reset();
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, SerializationFormatter = true)]
		protected override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
			if (ShouldSerializeEditAppearance())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "EditAppearance", ExtraSharedProps.editAppearanceHolder);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeLocked())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Locked", Locked);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeVerticalDisplayStyle())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "VerticalDisplayStyle", VerticalDisplayStyle);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void Initialize(ToolsCollectionBase parentCollection)
		{
			base.Initialize(parentCollection);
			if (serializedProps != null)
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.editAppearanceHolder = serializedProps.editAppearanceHolder;
				ExtraSharedProps.locked = serializedProps.locked;
				ExtraSharedProps.verticalDisplayStyle = serializedProps.verticalDisplayStyle;
				if (ExtraSharedProps.editAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					ExtraSharedProps.editAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				serializedProps = null;
			}
			if (base.ToolbarsManager != null && ExtraSharedProps.editAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.editAppearanceHolder.Collection = base.ToolbarsManager.Appearances;
			}
		}

		protected internal override void InitializeFrom(ToolBase sourceTool, bool cloneNewInstance)
		{
			base.InitializeFrom(sourceTool, cloneNewInstance);
			if (sourceTool is TextEditorToolBase textEditorToolBase && !cloneNewInstance)
			{
				if (textEditorToolBase.ExtraSharedProps.editAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					ExtraSharedProps.editAppearanceHolder = textEditorToolBase.ExtraSharedProps.editAppearanceHolder.Clone();
				}
				ExtraSharedProps.locked = textEditorToolBase.ExtraSharedProps.Locked;
				ExtraSharedProps.verticalDisplayStyle = textEditorToolBase.ExtraSharedProps.VerticalDisplayStyle;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (ExtraSharedProps.editAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				ExtraSharedProps.editAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				ExtraSharedProps.editAppearanceHolder.Collection = null;
				ExtraSharedProps.editAppearanceHolder = null;
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (HasEditAppearance && propChange.Source == ExtraSharedProps.editAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.EditAppearance, propChange);
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnSubObjectPropChanged(propChange);
			}
		}

		protected override void ResolveAppearancePhase(ref ResolveAppearancePhaseInfo phaseInfo, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ResolutionOrderInfo resolutionOrder = phaseInfo.ResolutionOrder;
			if (phaseInfo.Phase == AppearanceResolutionPhase.Initial && !base.IsVertical && phaseInfo.EditArea)
			{
				if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseControlInfo && HasEditAppearance)
				{
					EditAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFEFFuL);
			}
			base.ResolveAppearancePhase(ref phaseInfo, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}
	}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (appearanceHolder != null)
			{
				appearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				appearanceHolder.Collection = null;
				appearanceHolder = null;
			}
			if (appearanceOnMenuHolder != null)
			{
				appearanceOnMenuHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				appearanceOnMenuHolder.Collection = null;
				appearanceOnMenuHolder = null;
			}
			if (appearanceOnToolbarHolder != null)
			{
				appearanceOnToolbarHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				appearanceOnToolbarHolder.Collection = null;
				appearanceOnToolbarHolder = null;
			}
			if (hotTrackAppearanceHolder != null)
			{

	public abstract class UltraToolbarBase : KeyedSubObjectBase, ISerializable, IToolsCollectionOwner, INotificationBadgeSettingsOwner, IProvideUIAutomation
	{
		internal struct ToolAreaInformation
		{
			public Rectangle ToolArea;

			public Rectangle GrabHandleArea;

			public Point FirstToolLocation;

			public ToolbarMetrics ToolbarMetrics;

			public Rectangle NavigationToolbarButtonArea;

			public Rectangle NavigationToolbarRecentFilesButtonArea;

			internal static ToolAreaInformation FromToolbar(UltraToolbarBase toolbar, Rectangle overallArea)
			{
				//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				ToolAreaInformation result = default(ToolAreaInformation);
				Rectangle toolArea = overallArea;
				UltraToolbar ultraToolbar = toolbar as UltraToolbar;
				if (!toolbar.IsFloating)
				{
					UIElementBorderWidths val = toolbar.CalculateBorderWidths(toolbar.BorderStyleDockedResolved);
					if (((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Left == ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Right && ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Top == ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Bottom)
					{
						toolArea.Inflate(new Size(-((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Left, -((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Top));
					}
					else
					{
						if (((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Left > 0)
						{
							toolArea.Width -= ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Left;
							toolArea.Offset(((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Left, 0);
						}
						if (((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Top > 0)
						{
							toolArea.Height -= ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Top;
							toolArea.Offset(0, ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Top);
						}
						if (((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Right > 0)
						{
							toolArea.Width -= ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Right;
						}
						if (((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Bottom > 0)
						{
							toolArea.Height -= ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Bottom;
						}
					}
				}
				result.ToolArea = toolArea;
				result.GrabHandleArea = default(Rectangle);
				int paddingLeftResolved = toolbar.PaddingLeftResolved;
				int paddingTopResolved = toolbar.PaddingTopResolved;
				int paddingRightResolved = toolbar.PaddingRightResolved;
				int paddingBottomResolved = toolbar.PaddingBottomResolved;
				int num = paddingTopResolved + paddingBottomResolved;
				int num2 = paddingLeftResolved + paddingRightResolved;
				bool isFloating = toolbar.IsFloating;
				result.FirstToolLocation = new Point(result.ToolArea.X, result.ToolArea.Y);
				if (toolbar.IsVertical)
				{
					result.ToolArea.X += paddingBottomResolved;
					result.ToolArea.Y += paddingLeftResolved;
					result.ToolArea.Width -= num;
					result.ToolArea.Height -= num2;
					result.FirstToolLocation = new Point(result.ToolArea.Right, result.ToolArea.Y);
				}
				else
				{
					if (ultraToolbar == null || ultraToolbar.TearawayToolOwner == null || !ultraToolbar.TearawayToolOwner.IsControlContainer)
					{
						result.ToolArea.X += paddingLeftResolved;
						result.ToolArea.Y += paddingTopResolved;
						result.ToolArea.Width -= num2;
						result.ToolArea.Height -= num;
					}
					result.FirstToolLocation = new Point(result.ToolArea.X, result.ToolArea.Y);
				}
				result.NavigationToolbarButtonArea = default(Rectangle);
				if (toolbar.NavigationToolbarButtonAreaWidth > 0)
				{
					result.ToolArea.X += 3;
					result.NavigationToolbarButtonArea.X = result.ToolArea.X;
					result.NavigationToolbarButtonArea.Width = toolbar.NavigationToolbarButtonAreaWidth;
					int num3 = result.ToolArea.Height - (toolbar.NavigationToolbarButtonAreaHeight + 4 + 3);
					result.NavigationToolbarButtonArea.Y = result.ToolArea.Y + 4 + num3 / 2;
					result.NavigationToolbarButtonArea.Height = toolbar.NavigationToolbarButtonAreaHeight;
					result.ToolArea.X += toolbar.NavigationToolbarButtonAreaWidth;
					result.ToolArea.Width -= toolbar.NavigationToolbarButtonAreaWidth + 3;
					result.FirstToolLocation = result.ToolArea.Location;
					result.ToolArea.Height += 7;
				}
				result.NavigationToolbarRecentFilesButtonArea = default(Rectangle);
				if (toolbar.NavigationToolbarRecentHistoryButtonWidth > 0)
				{
					int num4 = 0;
					if (toolbar is NavigationToolbar)
					{
						num4 = ((NavigationToolbar)toolbar).Settings.RecentHistoryButtonOffsetResolved;
					}
					result.NavigationToolbarRecentFilesButtonArea.X = result.ToolArea.X + num4;
					result.NavigationToolbarRecentFilesButtonArea.Width = toolbar.NavigationToolbarRecentHistoryButtonWidth;
					int num5 = result.NavigationToolbarButtonArea.Height - 23;
					result.NavigationToolbarRecentFilesButtonArea.Y = result.NavigationToolbarButtonArea.Y + num5 / 2;
					result.NavigationToolbarRecentFilesButtonArea.Height = toolbar.NavigationToolbarRecentHistoryButtonHeight;
					result.ToolArea.X += toolbar.NavigationToolbarRecentHistoryButtonWidth + num4 + 2;
					result.ToolArea.Width -= toolbar.NavigationToolbarRecentHistoryButtonWidth + num4 + 2;
					result.FirstToolLocation = result.ToolArea.Location;
				}
				if (toolbar.GrabHandleWidth > 0)
				{
					if (toolbar.IsVertical)
					{
						result.GrabHandleArea.X = result.ToolArea.X;
						result.GrabHandleArea.Width = result.ToolArea.Width;
						result.GrabHandleArea.Y = toolArea.Y + 3;
						result.GrabHandleArea.Height = toolbar.ToolbarsManager.GetResolvedVerticalToolbarGrabHandleHeight(toolbar);
						int num6 = 4 + result.GrabHandleArea.Bottom - toolArea.Top;
						result.FirstToolLocation.Y += num6;
						result.ToolArea.Y += num6;
						result.ToolArea.Height -= num6;
					}
					else
					{
						result.GrabHandleArea.X = toolArea.X + 3;
						result.GrabHandleArea.Width = toolbar.ToolbarsManager.GetResolvedHorizontalToolbarGrabHandleWidth(toolbar);
						result.GrabHandleArea.Y = result.ToolArea.Y;
						result.GrabHandleArea.Height = result.ToolArea.Height;
						int num7 = 4 + result.GrabHandleArea.Right - toolArea.Left;
						result.FirstToolLocation.X += num7;
						result.ToolArea.X += num7;
						result.ToolArea.Width -= num7;
					}
				}
				if (isFloating && ultraToolbar != null)
				{
					result.ToolbarMetrics = toolbar.GetMetrics(ultraToolbar.FloatingSizeWithoutPadding, Size.Empty);
				}
				else if (toolbar.IsVertical)
				{
					result.ToolbarMetrics = toolbar.GetMetrics(new Size(result.ToolArea.Size.Height, result.ToolArea.Size.Width), Size.Empty);
				}
				else
				{
					result.ToolbarMetrics = toolbar.GetMetrics(result.ToolArea.Size, Size.Empty);
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		internal sealed class ToolbarMetrics
		{
			private UltraToolbarBase toolbar;

			private List<ToolbarToolRow> toolRows;

			internal Size Size
			{
				get
				{
					//IL_019f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					//IL_01a5: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4

					//IL_01d4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					//IL_01d9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					Size empty = Size.Empty;
					for (int i = 0; i < toolRows.Count; i++)
					{
						ToolbarToolRow toolbarToolRow = toolRows[i];
						Size size = toolbarToolRow.Size;
						empty.Height += size.Height;
						empty.Width = Math.Max(empty.Width, size.Width);
