						{
							empty.Height += 5;
						}
					}
					int num = ((toolbar.NavigationToolbarButtonAreaHeight != 0) ? (toolbar.NavigationToolbarButtonAreaHeight + 4 + 3) : 0);
					if (empty.Height == 0)
					{
						if (toolbar.NavigationToolbarButtonAreaHeight > 0)
						{
							empty.Height = num;
						}
						else
						{
							empty.Height = 16;
						}
					}
					else if (empty.Height < num)
					{
						empty.Height = num;
					}
					if (empty.Width == 0 && Toolbar.ToolbarsManager.Customizing)
					{
						empty.Width += 16;
					}
					empty.Width += Toolbar.GrabHandleWidth + toolbar.PaddingLeftResolved + toolbar.PaddingRightResolved;
					empty.Height += toolbar.PaddingTopResolved + toolbar.PaddingBottomResolved;
					if (toolbar.GrabHandleWidth > 0)
					{
						empty.Width += 4;
					}
					if (toolbar.NavigationToolbarButtonAreaWidth > 0)
					{
						empty.Width += 3;
					}
					if ((int)toolbar.ToolbarsManager.StyleResolved == 1)
					{
						empty.Width += 2;
					}
					if (!toolbar.IsFloating)
					{
						UIElementBorderWidths val = Toolbar.CalculateBorderWidths(toolbar.BorderStyleDockedResolved);
						empty.Width += 1 + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Left + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Right;
						empty.Height += ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Top + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Bottom;
					}
					return empty;
				}
			}

			internal UltraToolbarBase Toolbar => toolbar;

			internal ToolbarMetrics(UltraToolbarBase toolbar, Size cachedSize, Size delta)
			{
				this.toolbar = toolbar;
				toolRows = new List<ToolbarToolRow>(10);
				CalculateFloatingMetrics(cachedSize, delta);
			}

			internal void CalculateFloatingMetrics(Size cachedSize, Size delta)
			{
				try
				{
					DrawUtility.BeginGraphicsCaching();
					int num = ((toolbar != null && toolbar.ToolbarsManager != null) ? 3 : 6);
					int num2 = (toolbar.IsFloating ? num : 0);
					Size size;
					if (cachedSize == Size.Empty)
					{
						size = SystemInformation.VirtualScreen.Size;
						size.Width -= num2;
						size.Height -= num;
						if (Toolbar == null || Toolbar.ShowFloatingWindowCaption)
						{
							if (Toolbar != null && Toolbar.ToolbarsManager != null)
							{
								size.Height -= Toolbar.ToolbarsManager.FloatingToolbarCaptionHeight;
							}
							else
							{
								size.Height -= SystemInformation.ToolWindowCaptionHeight;
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						size = cachedSize;
						size.Width = Math.Min(size.Width + delta.Width, SystemInformation.VirtualScreen.Size.Width - num2);
						int num3 = SystemInformation.VirtualScreen.Size.Height - num;
						if (Toolbar == null || Toolbar.ShowFloatingWindowCaption)
						{
							num3 = ((Toolbar == null || Toolbar.ToolbarsManager == null) ? (num3 - SystemInformation.ToolWindowCaptionHeight) : (num3 - Toolbar.ToolbarsManager.FloatingToolbarCaptionHeight));
						}
						size.Height = Math.Min(size.Height + delta.Height, num3);
					}
					int num4 = 0;
					bool flag = false;
					for (int i = 0; i < toolbar.Tools.Count; i++)
					{
						ToolBase toolBase = toolbar.Tools[i];
						if (toolBase.VisibleResolved && (toolBase.IsFirstInGroupResolved || !flag))
						{
							num4++;
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					if (num4 == 0)
					{
						if (Toolbar.QuickCustomizeToolWidth <= 0 && Toolbar.CloseWindowTool == null && Toolbar.Tools.NewToolPlaceHolder == null && Toolbar.ExtraTools.Length == 0 && Toolbar.SystemMenuToolSize.Width <= 0 && Toolbar.RibbonPinButtonTool == null)
						{
							toolRows.Clear();
							return;
						}
						num4 = 1;
					}
					ToolGroup[] array = new ToolGroup[num4];
					int num5 = 0;
					int num6 = 0;
					int num7 = 0;
					int num8 = 0;
					int num9 = 0;
					if (!flag)
					{
						array[0] = new ToolGroup(this, null);
						num6 = array[0].NarrowestToolWidth;
						num8 = array[0].ShortestToolHeight;
						num7 = array[0].WidestToolWidth;
						num9 = array[0].TallestToolHeight;
					}
					else
					{
						flag = false;
						for (int j = 0; j < toolbar.Tools.Count; j++)
						{
							ToolBase toolBase2 = toolbar.Tools[j];
							if (toolBase2.VisibleResolved && (toolBase2.IsFirstInGroupResolved || !flag))
							{
								flag = true;
								array[num5] = new ToolGroup(this, toolBase2);
								num6 = ((num6 != 0) ? Math.Min(num6, array[num5].NarrowestToolWidth) : array[num5].NarrowestToolWidth);
								num8 = ((num8 != 0) ? Math.Min(num8, array[num5].ShortestToolHeight) : array[num5].ShortestToolHeight);
								num7 = ((num7 != 0) ? Math.Max(num7, array[num5].WidestToolWidth) : array[num5].WidestToolWidth);
								num9 = ((num9 != 0) ? Math.Max(num9, array[num5].TallestToolHeight) : array[num5].TallestToolHeight);
								num5++;
							}
						}
					}
					int num10 = size.Width;
					if (Toolbar.RestrictToolToToolbarWidth && num7 > num10)
					{
						num7 = num10;
					}
					CalculateFloatingMetricsHelper(array, Math.Max(num7, num10));
					if (delta.Height != 0)
					{
						if (delta.Height > 0)
						{
							while (num10 > num7 && Size.Height < size.Height - num8 / 2)
							{
								num10 = Math.Max(num7, num10 - num6);
								CalculateFloatingMetricsHelper(array, num10);
							}
						}
						if (delta.Height < 0)
						{
							while (toolRows.Count > 1 && Size.Height >= size.Height + num8 / 2)
							{
								num10 = Math.Min(SystemInformation.VirtualScreen.Width - num2, num10 + num6);
								CalculateFloatingMetricsHelper(array, num10);
								if (num10 >= SystemInformation.VirtualScreen.Width - num2)
								{
									break;
								}
							}
						}
					}
					Size size2 = Size;
					size2.Width -= toolbar.PaddingLeftResolved + toolbar.PaddingRightResolved;
					size2.Height -= toolbar.PaddingTopResolved + toolbar.PaddingBottomResolved;
					if (size2.Width > num10)
					{
						CalculateFloatingMetricsHelper(array, size2.Width + 1);
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					DrawUtility.EndGraphicsCaching();
				}
			}

			private void CalculateFloatingMetricsHelper(ToolGroup[] toolGroups, int maxWidth)
			{
				toolRows.Clear();
				for (int i = 0; i < toolGroups.Length; i++)
				{
					toolGroups[i].CalculateMetrics(maxWidth);
				}
			}

			internal ToolBase GetToolAbove(ToolBase startAtTool, bool selectableToolsOnly, bool wrapAround)
			{
				if (toolRows == null || toolRows.Count < 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				int targetOffset = 0;
				ToolBase toolBase = null;
				ToolbarToolRow toolbarToolRow = null;
				for (int num = toolRows.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					ToolbarToolRow toolbarToolRow2 = toolRows[num];
					if (startAtTool != null)
					{
						if (toolbarToolRow == null && toolbarToolRow2.Contains(startAtTool))
						{
							toolbarToolRow = toolbarToolRow2;
							targetOffset = toolbarToolRow.GetToolOffset(startAtTool);
							continue;
						}
						if (toolbarToolRow == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
					}
					toolBase = toolbarToolRow2.GetToolAtOffset(targetOffset, selectableToolsOnly);
					if (toolBase != null)
					{
						return toolBase;
					}
				}
				if (wrapAround && startAtTool != null)
				{
					return GetToolAbove(null, selectableToolsOnly, wrapAround: false);
				}
				return null;
			}

			internal ToolBase GetToolBelow(ToolBase startAtTool, bool selectableToolsOnly, bool wrapAround)
			{
				if (toolRows == null || toolRows.Count < 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				int targetOffset = 0;
				ToolBase toolBase = null;
				ToolbarToolRow toolbarToolRow = null;
				for (int i = 0; i < toolRows.Count; i++)
				{
					ToolbarToolRow toolbarToolRow2 = toolRows[i];
					if (startAtTool != null)
					{
						if (toolbarToolRow == null && toolbarToolRow2.Contains(startAtTool))
						{
							toolbarToolRow = toolbarToolRow2;
							targetOffset = toolbarToolRow.GetToolOffset(startAtTool);
							continue;
						}
						if (toolbarToolRow == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
					}
					toolBase = toolbarToolRow2.GetToolAtOffset(targetOffset, selectableToolsOnly);
					if (toolBase != null)
					{
						return toolBase;
					}
				}
				if (wrapAround && startAtTool != null)
				{
					return GetToolBelow(null, selectableToolsOnly, wrapAround: false);
				}
				return null;
			}

			internal ToolbarToolRow[] GetToolRows()
			{
				return toolRows.ToArray();
			}

			internal ToolbarToolRow GetLastToolRow()
			{
				if (toolRows.Count > 0)
				{
					return toolRows[toolRows.Count - 1];
				}
				return InternalAddRow();
			}

			internal ToolbarToolRow InternalAddRow()
			{
				ToolbarToolRow toolbarToolRow = new ToolbarToolRow(this);
				toolRows.Add(toolbarToolRow);
				return toolbarToolRow;
			}
		}

		internal sealed class ToolGroup
		{
			private ToolbarMetrics metrics;

			private Size[] toolSizes;

			private ToolBase[] tools;

			private int narrowestToolWidth;

			private int widestToolWidth;

			private int shortestToolHeight;

			private int tallestToolHeight;

			private bool isLastGroup;

			internal int NarrowestToolWidth => narrowestToolWidth;

			internal int ShortestToolHeight => shortestToolHeight;

			internal Size SingleRowSize
			{
				get
				{
					Size empty = Size.Empty;
					if (toolSizes != null && toolSizes.Length != 0)
					{
						int toolSpacingResolved = metrics.Toolbar.ToolSpacingResolved;
						for (int i = 0; i < toolSizes.Length; i++)
						{
							Size size = toolSizes[i];
							empty.Width += size.Width;
							empty.Height = Math.Max(empty.Height, size.Height);
							if (i > 0)
							{
								empty.Width += toolSpacingResolved;
							}
						}
					}
					return empty;
				}
			}

			internal int TallestToolHeight => tallestToolHeight;

			internal int WidestToolWidth => widestToolWidth;

			internal ToolGroup(ToolbarMetrics metrics, ToolBase firstVisibleTool)
			{
				this.metrics = metrics;
				int num = 0;
				int num2 = Math.Max(0, this.metrics.Toolbar.Tools.IndexOf(firstVisibleTool));
				bool flag = true;
				bool flag2 = true;
				for (int i = 0; i < this.metrics.Toolbar.Tools.Count; i++)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase = this.metrics.Toolbar.Tools[i];
					if (!toolBase.VisibleResolved)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (i < num2)
					{
						flag2 = false;
						i = num2 - 1;
						continue;
					}
					if (toolBase.IsFirstInGroupResolved && toolBase != firstVisibleTool)
					{
						flag = false;
						break;
					}
					num++;
				}
				isLastGroup = flag;
				int num3 = 0;
				int num4 = 0;
				Size size = Size.Empty;
				Size size2 = Size.Empty;
				Size size3 = Size.Empty;
				if (this.metrics.Toolbar.RibbonPinButtonTool != null)
				{
					size3 = this.metrics.Toolbar.RibbonPinButtonTool.CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstanceHelper();
					num3++;
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					size = this.metrics.Toolbar.SystemMenuToolSize;
					if (size.Width > 0)
					{
						num3++;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					num4 = this.metrics.Toolbar.QuickCustomizeToolWidth;
					if (num4 > 0)
					{
						num3++;
					}
					if (this.metrics.Toolbar.CloseWindowTool != null)
					{
						size2 = this.metrics.Toolbar.CloseWindowTool.CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstanceHelper();
						num3++;
						if (this.metrics.Toolbar.RestoreWindowTool != null)
						{
							num3++;
						}
						if (this.metrics.Toolbar.MinimizeWindowTool != null)
						{
							num3++;
						}
					}
					num3 += this.metrics.Toolbar.ExtraTools.Length;
				}
				toolSizes = new Size[num + num3];
				tools = new ToolBase[num + num3];
				int num5 = 0;
				if (size.Width > 0)
				{
					tools[0] = this.metrics.Toolbar.ToolbarsManager.SystemMenu;
					toolSizes[0].Width = size.Width;
					toolSizes[0].Height = size.Height;
					MaintainToolSizeRangeHelper(toolSizes[0]);
					num5++;
				}
				if (size3.Width > 0)
				{
					tools[num5] = this.metrics.Toolbar.RibbonPinButtonTool;
					toolSizes[num5].Width = size3.Width;
					toolSizes[num5].Height = size3.Height;
					MaintainToolSizeRangeHelper(toolSizes[num5]);
					num5++;
				}
				for (int j = num2; j < this.metrics.Toolbar.Tools.Count; j++)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase = this.metrics.Toolbar.Tools[j];
					if (toolBase.VisibleResolved)
					{
						if (toolBase.IsFirstInGroupResolved && toolBase != firstVisibleTool)
						{
							break;
						}
						tools[num5] = toolBase;
						toolSizes[num5].Height = toolBase.Height;
						toolSizes[num5].Width = toolBase.WidthResolved;
						MaintainToolSizeRangeHelper(toolSizes[num5]);
						num5++;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					ToolBase[] extraTools = this.metrics.Toolbar.ExtraTools;
					foreach (ToolBase toolBase in extraTools)
					{
						tools[num5] = toolBase;
						toolSizes[num5].Height = toolBase.Height;
						toolSizes[num5].Width = toolBase.WidthResolved;
						MaintainToolSizeRangeHelper(toolSizes[num5]);
						num5++;
					}
				}
				int num6 = -1;
				if (num4 > 0)
				{
					tools[num5] = this.metrics.Toolbar.QuickCustomizeTool;
					num6 = num5;
					num5++;
				}
				if (size2.Width > 0)
				{
					if (this.metrics.Toolbar.MinimizeWindowTool != null)
					{
						tools[num5] = this.metrics.Toolbar.MinimizeWindowTool;
						toolSizes[num5] = size2;
						num5++;
					}
					if (this.metrics.Toolbar.RestoreWindowTool != null)
					{
						tools[num5] = this.metrics.Toolbar.RestoreWindowTool;
						toolSizes[num5] = size2;
						num5++;
					}
					tools[num5] = this.metrics.Toolbar.CloseWindowTool;
					toolSizes[num5] = size2;
					num5++;
					MaintainToolSizeRangeHelper(size2);
				}
				if (num6 >= 0)
				{
					toolSizes[num6].Width = num4;
					toolSizes[num6].Height = Math.Max(22, tallestToolHeight);
					MaintainToolSizeRangeHelper(toolSizes[num6]);
				}
			}

			internal void CalculateMetrics(int maxWidth)
			{
				bool needsHorizontalSeparator = false;
				if (toolSizes == null || toolSizes.Length == 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				ToolbarToolRow toolbarToolRow = metrics.GetLastToolRow();
				if (toolbarToolRow.Size.Width > 0 && toolbarToolRow.Size.Width + SingleRowSize.Width > maxWidth)
				{
					toolbarToolRow = metrics.InternalAddRow();
				}
				bool restrictToolToToolbarWidth = metrics.Toolbar.RestrictToolToToolbarWidth;
				for (int i = 0; i < toolSizes.Length; i++)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase = tools[i];
					Size toolSize = toolSizes[i];
					if (toolbarToolRow.Size.Width != 0)
					{
						int num = ((!isLastGroup || i != toolSizes.Length - 1) ? metrics.Toolbar.QuickCustomizeToolWidth : 0);
						num += metrics.Toolbar.ToolSpacingResolved;
						if (toolbarToolRow.Size.Width + toolSize.Width + num > maxWidth)
						{
							if (!(toolBase is QuickCustomizeToolBase))
							{
								toolbarToolRow = metrics.InternalAddRow();
							}
						}
						else if (toolBase is SystemActionTool && toolBase == metrics.Toolbar.MinimizeWindowTool && toolbarToolRow.Size.Width + 3 * toolSize.Width > maxWidth)
						{
							toolbarToolRow = metrics.InternalAddRow();
						}
					}
					if (restrictToolToToolbarWidth)
					{
						toolSize.Width = Math.Min(toolSize.Width, maxWidth);
					}
					toolbarToolRow.InternalAddTool(toolBase, toolSize, needsHorizontalSeparator);
					needsHorizontalSeparator = false;
				}
			}

			private void MaintainToolSizeRangeHelper(Size toolSize)
			{
				if (narrowestToolWidth == 0)
				{
					narrowestToolWidth = toolSize.Width;
				}
				else
				{
					narrowestToolWidth = Math.Min(narrowestToolWidth, toolSize.Width);
				}
				if (shortestToolHeight == 0)
				{
					shortestToolHeight = toolSize.Height;
				}
				else
				{
					shortestToolHeight = Math.Min(shortestToolHeight, toolSize.Height);
				}
				if (widestToolWidth == 0)
				{
					widestToolWidth = toolSize.Width;
				}
				else
				{
					widestToolWidth = Math.Max(widestToolWidth, toolSize.Width);
				}
				if (tallestToolHeight == 0)
				{
					tallestToolHeight = toolSize.Height;
				}
				else
				{
					tallestToolHeight = Math.Max(tallestToolHeight, toolSize.Height);
				}
			}
		}

		internal sealed class ToolbarToolRow
		{
			private ToolbarMetrics metrics;

			private Size size = Size.Empty;

			private ArrayList tools;

			private bool needsHorizontalSeparator;

			internal bool NeedsHorizontalSeparator => needsHorizontalSeparator;

			internal Size Size => size;

			internal ToolbarToolRow(ToolbarMetrics metrics)
			{
				this.metrics = metrics;
				tools = new ArrayList(this.metrics.Toolbar.Tools.Count);
			}

			internal bool Contains(ToolBase tool)
			{
				if (tools == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return tools.Contains(tool);
			}

			internal ToolBase GetToolAtOffset(int targetOffset, bool selectableToolsOnly)
			{
				if (tools == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				int num = 0;
				int num2 = 0;
				int num3 = 0;
				ToolBase toolBase = null;
				foreach (ToolBase tool in tools)
				{
					if (num != 0 && tool.IsFirstInGroupResolved)
					{
						num += 6;
					}
					num2 = tool.WidthResolved + metrics.Toolbar.ToolSpacingResolved;
					if (!selectableToolsOnly || (tool.CanActivate && tool.EnabledResolved))
					{
						if (num + num2 > targetOffset)
						{
							if (num > targetOffset && toolBase != null && num - targetOffset > targetOffset - num3)
							{
								return toolBase;
							}
							return tool;
						}
						toolBase = tool;
						num3 = num + num2;
					}
					num += num2;
				}
				return toolBase;
			}

			internal int GetToolOffset(ToolBase tool)
			{
				if (tools == null || tool == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				int num = 0;
				foreach (ToolBase tool2 in tools)
				{
					if (num != 0 && tool2.IsFirstInGroupResolved)
					{
						num += 6;
					}
					if (tool2 == tool)
					{
						return num;
					}
					num += tool2.WidthResolved + metrics.Toolbar.ToolSpacingResolved;
				}
				return 0;
			}

			internal ToolBase[] GetTools()
			{
				ToolBase[] array = new ToolBase[tools.Count];
				for (int i = 0; i < tools.Count; i++)
				{
					array[i] = tools[i] as ToolBase;
				}
				return array;
			}

			internal void InternalAddTool(ToolBase tool, Size toolSize, bool needsHorizontalSeparator)
			{
				this.needsHorizontalSeparator |= needsHorizontalSeparator;
				size.Width += toolSize.Width;
				if (tools.Count > 0 && !(tool is QuickCustomizeTool))
				{
					size.Width += metrics.Toolbar.ToolSpacingResolved;
				}
				if (tools.Count != 0 && tool.IsFirstInGroupResolved)
				{
					size.Width += 6;
				}
				if (tool is SystemActionTool && tool == metrics.Toolbar.MinimizeWindowTool)
				{
					ref Size reference = ref size;
					reference.Width = reference.Width;
				}
				if (!metrics.Toolbar.IsMainMenuBarInternal)
				{
					if (metrics.Toolbar.TearawayToolOwnerInternal == null)
					{
						size.Height = Math.Max(toolSize.Height, size.Height);
					}
					else if (metrics.Toolbar.TearawayToolOwnerInternal is PopupControlContainerTool)
					{
						size.Height = Math.Max(toolSize.Height, size.Height);
					}
					else
					{
						size.Height = Math.Max(toolSize.Height, size.Height);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					size.Height = Math.Max(toolSize.Height, size.Height);
				}
				tools.Add(tool);
			}
		}

		public class ToolbarAccessibleObject : AccessibleObjectWrapper
		{
			private UltraToolbarBase toolbar;

			public override Rectangle Bounds
			{
				get
				{
					UIElement uIElement = toolbar.UIElement;
					if (uIElement == null)
					{
						return Rectangle.Empty;
					}
					return uIElement.Control.RectangleToScreen(uIElement.Rect);
				}
			}

			public override string DefaultAction => null;

			public override string Description => toolbar.AccessibleDescription;

			public override string Help => null;

			public override string Name
			{
				get
				{
					string name = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name;
					if (name != null && name.Length > 0)
					{
						return name;
					}
					name = toolbar.AccessibleName;
					if (name != null && name.Length > 0)
					{
						return name;
					}
					return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AccessibleName_Toolbar");
				}
				set
				{
					((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name = value;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Parent => toolbar.AccessibleParent;

			public override AccessibleRole Role
			{
				get
				{
					if (toolbar.IsMainMenuBarInternal)
					{
						return AccessibleRole.MenuBar;
					}
					return AccessibleRole.ToolBar;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleStates State
			{
				get
				{
					AccessibleStates accessibleStates = AccessibleStates.Focused | AccessibleStates.Focusable;
					if (!toolbar.IsFloating && !toolbar.ToolbarsManager.LockToolbars && !(toolbar is NavigationToolbar))
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Moveable;
					}
					if (!toolbar.VisibleResolved)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Invisible;
					}
					return accessibleStates;
				}
			}

			public UltraToolbarBase Toolbar => toolbar;

			public ToolbarAccessibleObject(UltraToolbarBase toolbar)
			{
				this.toolbar = toolbar;
			}

			public override void DoDefaultAction()
			{
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
			{
				if (index >= 0 && index < toolbar.Tools.Count)
				{
					return toolbar.Tools[index].AccessibilityObject;
				}
				index -= toolbar.Tools.Count;
				if (toolbar.MinimizeWindowTool != null)
				{
					if (index == 0)
					{
						return toolbar.MinimizeWindowTool.AccessibilityObject;
					}
					index--;
				}
				if (toolbar.RestoreWindowTool != null)
				{
					if (index == 0)
					{
						return toolbar.RestoreWindowTool.AccessibilityObject;
					}
					index--;
				}
				if (toolbar.CloseWindowTool != null)
				{
					if (index == 0)
					{
						return toolbar.CloseWindowTool.AccessibilityObject;
					}
					index--;
				}
				if (toolbar is NavigationToolbar navigationToolbar)
				{
					switch (index)
					{
					case 0:
						return navigationToolbar.BackButtonAccessibleObject;
					case 1:
						return navigationToolbar.ForwardButtonAccessibleObject;
					case 2:
						return navigationToolbar.RecentHistoryButtonAccessibleObject;
					}
					index -= 3;
				}
				if (toolbar.QuickCustomizeTool == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return toolbar.QuickCustomizeTool.AccessibilityObject;
			}

			public override int GetChildCount()
			{
				int num = toolbar.Tools.Count;
				if (toolbar.MinimizeWindowTool != null)
				{
					num++;
				}
				if (toolbar.RestoreWindowTool != null)
				{
					num++;
				}
				if (toolbar.CloseWindowTool != null)
				{
					num++;
				}
				if (toolbar is NavigationToolbar)
				{
					num += 3;
				}
				if (toolbar.ShowQuickCustomizeTool)
				{
					num++;
				}
				return num;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetFocused()
			{
				return null;
			}

			protected override Control GetMarshallingControl()
			{
				return toolbar.ToolbarsManager?.DockWithinContainer;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetSelected()
			{
				return null;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject HitTest(int x, int y)
			{
				return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).HitTest(x, y);
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				return toolbar.Navigate(navdir);
			}

			public override void Select(AccessibleSelection flags)
			{
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public virtual int Width
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0140: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0146: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_015b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0161: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0166: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				try
				{
					DrawUtility.BeginGraphicsCaching();
					if (Tools == null)
					{
						return MinimumWidth;
					}
					int toolSpacingResolved = ToolSpacingResolved;
					int width = 0;
					int num = 0;
					for (int i = 0; i < Tools.Count; i++)
					{
						ToolBase toolBase = Tools[i];
						if (!toolBase.VisibleResolved)
						{
							continue;
						}
						width += toolBase.WidthResolved;
						num++;
						if (num > 1)
						{
							if (toolBase.IsFirstInGroupResolved)
							{
								width += 6;
							}
							width += toolSpacingResolved;
						}
					}
					ToolBase[] extraTools = ExtraTools;
					for (int j = 0; j < extraTools.Length; j++)
					{
						if (width > 0)
						{
							if (extraTools[j].IsFirstInGroupResolved)
							{
								width += 6;
							}
							width += toolSpacingResolved;
						}
						num++;
						width += extraTools[j].WidthResolved;
					}
					if (CloseWindowTool != null)
					{
						num++;
						Size size = CloseWindowTool.CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstance();
						width += size.Width;
						width = width;
						if (RestoreWindowTool != null)
						{
							width += size.Width;
							num++;
						}
						if (MinimizeWindowTool != null)
						{
							width += size.Width;
							num++;
						}
					}
					if (num == 0)
					{
						return MinimumWidth;
					}
					AddRequiredToolbarWidth(ref width);
					if (GrabHandleWidth > 0)
					{
						width += 4;
					}
					if (NavigationToolbarButtonAreaWidth > 0)
					{
						width += 3;
					}
					if ((int)ToolbarsManager.StyleResolved == 1)
					{
						width += 2;
					}
					if (!IsFloating)
					{
						UIElementBorderWidths val = ToolbarsManager.CalculateBorderWidths(BorderStyleDockedResolved, Border3DSide.Left | Border3DSide.Right);
						width += 1 + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Left + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Right;
					}
					return width;
				}
				finally
				{
					DrawUtility.EndGraphicsCaching();
				}
			}
		}

		public UltraToolbarBase()
		{
		}

		protected UltraToolbarBase(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "AccessibleDescription":
					accessibleDescription = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), accessibleDescription);
					break;
				case "AccessibleName":
					accessibleName = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), accessibleName);
					break;
				case "Key":
					Key = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), Key);
					break;
				case "Tag":
					DeserializeTag(current);
					break;
				case "Tools":
					tools = (ToolsCollection)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ToolsCollection), null);
					break;
				case "ToolsHaveBeenBumped":
					toolsHaveBeenBumped = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), toolsHaveBeenBumped);
					break;
				case "NotificationBadgeSettings":
					notificationBadgeSettings = (ToolNotificationBadgeSettings)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ToolNotificationBadgeSettings), null);
					((SubObjectBase)(object)notificationBadgeSettings).SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeAccessibleDescription())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "AccessibleDescription", accessibleDescription);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeAccessibleName())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "AccessibleName", accessibleName);
			}
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Key", Key);
			if (ShouldSerializeTools())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Tools", tools);
			}
			if (ToolsHaveBeenBumped)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ToolsHaveBeenBumped", ToolsHaveBeenBumped);
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
			if (ShouldSerializeNotificationBadgeSettings())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "NotificationBadgeSettings", notificationBadgeSettings);
			}
			GetObjectData(info, context);
		}

		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();

			if (text != null && text.Length > 0)

				stringBuilder.Append("[");
				stringBuilder.Append(Key);
				stringBuilder.Append("]");
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

			{
				((SubObjectBase)(object)notificationBadgeSettings).SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				((DisposableObject)(object)notificationBadgeSettings).Dispose();
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		internal void AdjustToolWidths(int extent)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = 0;
			if (ToolbarsManager.Customizing && !BumpToolsWhenCustomizing)
			{
				return;
			}
			num2 = 0;
			num3 = 0;
			int count = Tools.Count;
			ToolBase[] extraTools = ExtraTools;
			count += extraTools.Length;
			if (count < 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			int[] array = new int[count];
			int[] array2 = new int[count];
			ToolBase[] array3 = new ToolBase[count];
			List<ToolBase> list;
			int num5;
			try
			{
				Tools.CopyTo(array3, 0);
				int count2 = Tools.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < extraTools.Length; i++)
				{
					array3[count2++] = extraTools[i];
				}
				list = null;
				for (int j = 0; j < array3.Length; j++)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase = array3[j];
					toolBase.BumpedFromToolbar = false;
					toolBase.SpringWidth = 0;
					if (toolBase.VisibleResolved)
					{
						array[j] = toolBase.WidthResolved;
					}
					else
					{
						array[j] = 0;
					}
					if (array[j] <= 0 || !toolBase.SpringResolved)
					{
						continue;
					}
					num2++;
					array2[j] = toolBase.MinWidthResolved;
					int num4 = array[j] - array2[j];
					if (num4 > 0)
					{
						if (list == null)
						{
							list = new List<ToolBase>(5);
						}
						list.Add(toolBase);
						num3 += num4;
					}
				}
				num = Width;
				if (num == extent || IsBumpedToolsToolbar)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (num < extent)
				{
					if (!FillEntireRowResolved || num2 <= 0)
					{
						return;
					}
					num5 = extent - num;
					if (toolsHaveBeenBumped)
					{
						num5 += QuickCustomizeTool.CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstanceHelper().Width;
					}
					int val = Math.Min(num5, num5 / num2 + 1);
					do
					{
						int num6 = 0;
						for (int k = 0; k < array3.Length; k++)
						{
							ToolBase toolBase2 = array3[k];
							if (!toolBase2.VisibleResolved || !toolBase2.SpringResolved)
							{
								continue;
							}
							int num7 = ((array3[k].SpringWidth != 0) ? (array3[k].SpringWidth + Math.Min(val, num5)) : (array[k] + Math.Min(val, num5)));
							if (array3[k].LimitSpringUsingMaxWidth)
							{
								int maxWidthResolved = array3[k].MaxWidthResolved;
								if (maxWidthResolved > 0)
								{
									if (array3[k].SpringWidth == maxWidthResolved)
									{
										continue;
									}
									num7 = Math.Max(array[k], Math.Min(num7, maxWidthResolved));
									if (num7 < maxWidthResolved)
									{
										num6++;
									}
								}
								else
								{
									num6++;
								}
							}
							else
							{
								num6++;
							}
							num5 -= num7 - array[k];
							toolBase2.SpringWidth = num7;
						}
						if (num6 == 0)
						{
							break;
						}
						if (num5 > 0)
						{
							val = Math.Min(num5, num5 / num6 + 1);
						}
					}
					while (num5 > 0);
					return;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (!ShowQuickCustomizeTool)
				{
					toolsHaveBeenBumped = true;
					if (ShowQuickCustomizeTool)
					{
						num += QuickCustomizeToolWidth;
					}
				}
				toolsHaveBeenBumped = false;
			}
			num5 = num - extent;
			int num8 = 0;
			if (!WrapTools && !SortToolsByIndex)
			{
				for (int l = 0; l < array3.Length; l++)

							if (toolBase3.IsFirstInGroupResolved)
							{

							}

						}
					}
					else
					{
						toolsHaveBeenBumped = true;
						if (toolBase3.IsFirstInGroupResolved)
						{

						}

						if (num9 < 1)

					}
				}
			}

			}

			list2.Sort(DefaultToolComparer);

		}

		{
			if (this is UltraTaskPaneToolbar && excludeTool != ((UltraTaskPaneToolbar)this).NavigationMenuTool && ((UltraTaskPaneToolbar)this).NavigationMenuTool.IsMenuAgentCreated)

				((UltraTaskPaneToolbar)this).NavigationMenuTool.CloseDropDown(delay);

			{
				OwningTaskPaneToolbar.NavigationMenuTool.CloseDropDown(delay);
			}
			if (quickCustomizeTool != null && quickCustomizeTool != excludeTool && quickCustomizeTool.IsOpen)
			{
				quickCustomizeTool.MenuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay);
			}
			if (this is UltraToolbar { ShowSystemMenu: not false } ultraToolbar && ultraToolbar.ToolbarsManager.SystemMenu != null && ultraToolbar.ToolbarsManager.SystemMenu != excludeTool && ultraToolbar.ToolbarsManager.SystemMenu.IsOpen)
			{
				ultraToolbar.ToolbarsManager.SystemMenu.MenuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay);
			}
			foreach (ToolBase tool in Tools)
			{
				if (!tool.Equals(excludeTool) && tool.PopupTool != null)
				{
					PopupToolBase popupTool = tool.PopupTool;
					if (popupTool.IsMenuAgentCreated)
					{
						popupTool.MenuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal int GetMaxToolHeight(bool considerBumpedStatus)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (ToolBase tool in Tools)
			{
				if (tool.IsVisible(considerBumpedStatus))
				{
					num = Math.Max(num, tool.Height);
				}
			}
			ToolBase[] extraTools = ExtraTools;
			for (int i = 0; i < extraTools.Length; i++)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, extraTools[i].Height);
			}
			if (CloseWindowTool != null)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, CloseWindowTool.CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstance().Height);
			}
			if (NavigationToolbarButtonAreaHeight > 0)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, NavigationToolbarButtonAreaHeight + 4 + 3);
			}
			if (num == 0)
			{
				return Math.Max(QuickCustomizeToolMinHeight, 16);
			}
			return Math.Max(QuickCustomizeToolMinHeight, num);
		}

		internal virtual void MergeMdiChildToolbar(UltraToolbarBase toolbar)
		{
			if (toolbar == null)
			{
				Tools.MergeMdiChildTools(null);
			}
			else if (HasTools || toolbar.HasTools)
			{
				Tools.MergeMdiChildTools(toolbar.Tools);
			}
			if (TearawayToolOwnerInternal != null && TearawayToolOwnerInternal.PopupTool != null)
			{
				switch (ToolbarType)
				{
				case ToolbarType.Popup:
					TearawayToolOwnerInternal.PopupTool.ReattachPopupToolbarOnMerge((UltraToolbar)this);
					break;
				case ToolbarType.Tearaway:
					((TearawayToolBase)TearawayToolOwnerInternal.PopupTool).ReattachTearawayToolbar((UltraToolbar)this);
					break;
				}
			}
			if (ShouldReparentContainedControlsOnMerge)
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				toolbarsManager.GetToolbarDockArea(this)?.ReparentContainedControls(this, takeOwnership: true);
			}
			OnAfterMdiMergeChildTools();
		}

		internal virtual bool PreventMouseInputNotification(UIElementInputType inputType)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			switch (inputType - 1)
			{
			case 0:
			case 4:
			case 5:
			case 6:
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager == null || toolbarsManager.IsDesignMode || toolbarsManager.IsInResize || !AreTransitionsEnabled)
				{
					break;
				}
				switch (ToolbarType)
				{
				case ToolbarType.Popup:
				case ToolbarType.ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar:
					return false;
				case ToolbarType.QuickAccessToolbar:
				case ToolbarType.TabItemAreaToolbar:
					return toolbarsManager.CurrentPopupControl != null;
				case ToolbarType.Standard:
				case ToolbarType.Tearaway:
					if (toolbarsManager.CurrentPopupControl != null)
					{
						return toolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture != this;
					}
					return false;
				case ToolbarType.TaskPaneHeader:
					return toolbarsManager.CurrentPopupControl != null;
				default:
					return true;
				}
			}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ProcessNavigationKey(ToolBase toolWithFocus, Keys keyCode)
		{
			return ProcessNavigationKey(toolWithFocus, keyCode, wrapAround: true);
		}

		internal bool ProcessNavigationKey(ToolBase toolWithFocus, Keys keyCode, bool wrapAround)
		{
			if (this is UltraToolbar ultraToolbar)
			{
				if (toolWithFocus != null && toolWithFocus == ultraToolbar.TearawayToolOwner)
				{
					toolWithFocus = null;
				}
				if (toolWithFocus != null && toolWithFocus.OwnerInternal != this && toolWithFocus.OwnerInternal != ultraToolbar.TearawayToolOwner)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			Keys keys = keyCode;
			if (keyCode == Keys.Tab)
			{
				if ((Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Control) == Keys.Control)
				{
					return false;
				}
				keyCode = (((Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Shift) != Keys.Shift) ? Keys.Right : Keys.Left);
				if (toolWithFocus != null && toolWithFocus.Editor != null && toolWithFocus.Editor.IsInEditMode)
				{
					UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
					bool allowToolbarCaptureRelease = toolbarsManager?.AllowToolbarCaptureRelease ?? false;
					if (toolbarsManager != null)
					{
						toolbarsManager.AllowToolbarCaptureRelease = false;
					}
					try
					{
						if (!toolWithFocus.ExitEditMode(forceExit: false, applyChanges: true))
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						if (toolbarsManager != null)
						{
							toolbarsManager.AllowToolbarCaptureRelease = allowToolbarCaptureRelease;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			ToolBase toolBase = null;
			switch (keyCode)
			{
			case Keys.Return:
				if (toolWithFocus != null && toolWithFocus.EnabledResolved)
				{
					return toolWithFocus.OnEnterKeyPressed();
				}
				break;
			case Keys.Left:
			case Keys.Right:
			{
				if (IsVertical)
				{
					if (toolWithFocus != null && toolWithFocus.PopupTool != null)
					{
						return OpenPopupViaKey(toolWithFocus.PopupTool);
					}
					return ActivateToolAboveOrBelowViaKey(toolWithFocus, keyCode == Keys.Right);
				}
				bool flag = ActivateToolLeftOrRightViaKey(toolWithFocus, keyCode == Keys.Left, wrapAround);
				if (flag && keys == Keys.Tab && ToolbarsManager.ActiveTool != null && ToolbarsManager.ActiveTool != toolWithFocus && ToolbarsManager.ActiveTool.CanEnterEditMode)
				{
					ToolbarsManager.ActiveTool.EnterEditMode();
				}
				return flag;
			}
			case Keys.Up:
			case Keys.Down:
				if (!IsVertical)
				{
					if (toolWithFocus != null && toolWithFocus.PopupTool != null)
					{
						return OpenPopupViaKey(toolWithFocus.PopupTool);
					}
					if (toolWithFocus != null && toolWithFocus.CanEnterEditMode && toolWithFocus.EnterEditMode())
					{
						if (toolWithFocus.Editor.IsInEditMode && toolWithFocus.Editor.SupportsDropDown)
						{
							toolWithFocus.Editor.DropDown();
						}
						return true;
					}
					if (ActivateToolAboveOrBelowViaKey(toolWithFocus, keyCode == Keys.Up))
					{
						return true;
					}
					return ToolbarsManager.ActivateNextControl(keyCode == Keys.Up);
				}
				toolBase = ((keyCode != Keys.Up) ? Tools.GetNextTool(toolWithFocus, visibleToolsOnly: true, selectableToolsOnly: true, recentlyUsedToolsOnly: false, wrapAround: true) : Tools.GetPreviousTool(toolWithFocus, visibleToolsOnly: true, selectableToolsOnly: true, recentlyUsedToolsOnly: false, wrapAround: true));
				break;
			}
			if (toolBase != null)
			{
				return ActivateToolViaKey(toolWithFocus, toolBase);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ActivateToolAboveOrBelowViaKey(ToolBase toolWithFocus, bool above)
		{
			if (!(this is UltraToolbar ultraToolbar) || !IsFloating)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ToolBase toolBase = null;
			ToolbarMetrics metrics = GetMetrics(ultraToolbar.FloatingSize, Size.Empty);
			if (metrics != null)
			{
				if (metrics.GetToolRows().Length != 0 && (toolWithFocus == null || metrics.GetToolRows().Length > 1))
				{
					toolBase = ((!above) ? metrics.GetToolBelow(toolWithFocus, selectableToolsOnly: true, wrapAround: false) : metrics.GetToolAbove(toolWithFocus, selectableToolsOnly: true, wrapAround: false));
				}
				if (toolBase == null)
				{
					if (ultraToolbar.RootToolbars != null)
					{
						UltraToolbarBase[] rootToolbars = ultraToolbar.RootToolbars;
						foreach (UltraToolbarBase ultraToolbarBase in rootToolbars)
						{
							if (ultraToolbarBase.QuickCustomizeTool != null && ultraToolbarBase.QuickCustomizeTool.IsOpen)
							{
								if (ultraToolbarBase.QuickCustomizeTool.MenuAgent.MenuItems.Count > 0)
								{
									ToolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(null, setOn: false, clearToolBeingEdited: true);
									ultraToolbarBase.QuickCustomizeTool.MenuAgent.MenuItems[0].Activate();
								}
								return true;
							}
						}
					}
					toolBase = ((!above) ? metrics.GetToolBelow(null, selectableToolsOnly: true, wrapAround: false) : metrics.GetToolAbove(null, selectableToolsOnly: true, wrapAround: false));
				}
			}
			if (toolBase != null)
			{
				return ActivateToolViaKey(toolWithFocus, toolBase);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ActivateToolLeftOrRightViaKey(ToolBase toolWithFocus, bool left, bool wrapAround)
		{
			ToolBase toolBase = null;
			toolBase = ((!left) ? Tools.GetNextTool(toolWithFocus, visibleToolsOnly: true, selectableToolsOnly: true, recentlyUsedToolsOnly: false, wrapAround: false) : Tools.GetPreviousTool(toolWithFocus, visibleToolsOnly: true, selectableToolsOnly: true, recentlyUsedToolsOnly: false, wrapAround: false));
			if (toolBase == null && !wrapAround)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (toolBase == null)
			{
				if (this is UltraToolbar { RootToolbars: not null, RootToolbars: var rootToolbars })
				{
					foreach (UltraToolbarBase ultraToolbarBase in rootToolbars)
					{
						if (ultraToolbarBase.QuickCustomizeTool != null && ultraToolbarBase.QuickCustomizeTool.IsOpen)
						{
							if (ultraToolbarBase.QuickCustomizeTool.MenuAgent.MenuItems.Count > 0)
							{
								ToolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(null, setOn: false, clearToolBeingEdited: true);
								ultraToolbarBase.QuickCustomizeTool.MenuAgent.MenuItems[0].Activate();
							}
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				toolBase = ((!left) ? Tools.GetNextTool(null, visibleToolsOnly: true, selectableToolsOnly: true, recentlyUsedToolsOnly: false, wrapAround: false) : Tools.GetPreviousTool(null, visibleToolsOnly: true, selectableToolsOnly: true, recentlyUsedToolsOnly: false, wrapAround: false));
			}
			if (toolBase != null)
			{
				return ActivateToolViaKey(toolWithFocus, toolBase);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ActivateToolViaKey(ToolBase toolWithFocus, ToolBase toolToFocus)
		{
			if (toolToFocus != null && toolToFocus != toolWithFocus)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.AllowToolbarCaptureRelease = false;
				ToolbarsManager.MenuAnimationEnabled = false;
				try
				{
					PopupToolBase popupToolBase = null;
					if (toolWithFocus != null)
					{
						popupToolBase = toolWithFocus.PopupTool;
					}
					if (popupToolBase != null && popupToolBase.IsOpen)
					{
						popupToolBase.CloseDropDown();
					}
					ToolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(toolToFocus, setOn: true, clearToolBeingEdited: true);
					if (AutoDropDownMode && toolToFocus.IsActiveTool && this == ToolbarsManager.ToolbarWithCapture && toolToFocus != null && toolToFocus.PopupTool != null)
					{
						toolToFocus.PopupTool.DropDown();
						if (toolToFocus.PopupTool.IsOpen)
						{
							((UltraControlBase)toolToFocus.PopupTool.MenuAgent.PopupControl).Update();
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					ToolbarsManager.AllowToolbarCaptureRelease = true;
					ToolbarsManager.MenuAnimationEnabled = true;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void AddRequiredToolbarWidth(ref int width)
		{
			width += GrabHandleWidth + SystemMenuToolSize.Width + QuickCustomizeToolWidth + PaddingLeftResolved + PaddingRightResolved + NavigationToolbarButtonAreaWidth;
		}

		private static bool OpenPopupViaKey(PopupToolBase popupTool)
		{
			if (popupTool != null && !popupTool.IsOpen)
			{
				if (popupTool is PopupControlContainerTool { ShowAsDropDownControl: not false })
				{
					return false;
				}
				popupTool.DropDown();
				if (popupTool.IsOpen)
				{
					if (!(popupTool.UnderlyingTool is PopupMenuTool) && UltraToolbarsManager.ShouldActivateToolControlAndForm(popupTool))
					{
						try
						{
							UIPermission uIPermission = null;
							if (DisposableObject.HasSamePublicKey(popupTool.GetType()))
							{
								uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
								if (Utilities.CanAssert)
								{
									uIPermission.Assert();
								}
							}
							Form form = UltraToolbarsManager.FindFormHelper((Control)(object)popupTool.MenuAgent.PopupControl);
							if (form != null)
							{
								ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ActivateForm(form);
							}
							if (popupTool.IsControlContainer && popupTool.Control != null)
							{
								ToolbarsManagerUtilities.FocusControl(popupTool.Control);
							}
						}
						catch (SecurityException)
						{
						}
					}
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		AllowDuplicates IToolsCollectionOwner.AllowDuplicateKeysInCollection(ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
			return AllowDuplicates.Always;
		}

		bool IToolsCollectionOwner.AllowEmptyKeysInCollection(ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)

		}

		void IToolsCollectionOwner.OnToolAddedToCollection(ToolBase tool, ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
			OnToolAddedToCollection(tool, toolsCollection);
		}

		void IToolsCollectionOwner.OnBeforeToolRemovedFromCollection(ToolBase tool, ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
			if (tool.UnderlyingTool is ControlContainerTool controlContainerTool && controlContainerTool.ToolWithContainedControl == tool)
			{
				tool.SetToolWithContainedControl(takeControlOwnership: false, null);
			}
			OnBeforeToolRemovedFromCollection(tool, toolsCollection);
		}

		void IToolsCollectionOwner.OnToolRemovedFromCollection(ToolBase tool, ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
		}

		bool IToolsCollectionOwner.CanAddTool(ToolBase tool, ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
			return tool != null;
		}

		public class ToolbarConverter : ExpandableObjectConverter
		{
			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					ConstructorInfo constructor = value.GetType().GetConstructor(new Type[1] { typeof(string) });
					UltraToolbar ultraToolbar = (UltraToolbar)value;
					return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[1] { ultraToolbar.Key }, isComplete: false);
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		internal override bool VisibleResolvedInternal
		{
			get
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager == null)
				{
					return IsVisible;
				}
				if (base.Inherited && DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Floating && toolbarsManager.IsDesignMode)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (IsHiddenByMdiMerge)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (IsMdiMergeToolbar && UnderlyingToolbar == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!(this is UltraTaskPaneToolbar) && !IsBumpedToolsToolbar && toolbarsManager.EnforceOffice2007Resolution)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (OwningTaskPaneToolbar != null && !OwningTaskPaneToolbar.VisibleResolved)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (tearawayToolOwner != null)
				{
					if (tearawayToolOwner.IsMdiMergeTool && tearawayToolOwner.UnderlyingTool == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (tearawayToolOwner.IsControlContainer && tearawayToolOwner.Control == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return IsVisible;
			}
		}

		internal override bool CanBeDragged
		{
			get
			{
				if (OwningTaskPaneToolbar != null)
				{
					return OwningTaskPaneToolbar.CanBeDragged;
				}
				if (IsBumpedToolsToolbar)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (ToolbarsManager == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)ToolbarsManager).Enabled)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Floating)
				{
					return true;
				}
				ToolbarSettingsResolved settingsResolved = SettingsResolved;
				if (!settingsResolved.FillEntireRowResolved)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (settingsResolved.AllowFloatingResolved)
				{
					return true;
				}
				UltraToolbarsDockArea dockArea = DockArea;
				if (dockArea == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (dockArea.DockRows.Count > 1)
				{
					return true;
				}
				switch (DockedPosition)
				{
				case DockedPosition.Left:
					if (!settingsResolved.AllowDockRightResolved && !settingsResolved.AllowDockTopResolved)
					{
						return settingsResolved.AllowDockBottomResolved;
					}
					return true;
				case DockedPosition.Right:
					if (!settingsResolved.AllowDockLeftResolved && !settingsResolved.AllowDockTopResolved)
					{
						return settingsResolved.AllowDockBottomResolved;
					}
					return true;
				case DockedPosition.Bottom:
					if (!settingsResolved.AllowDockRightResolved && !settingsResolved.AllowDockTopResolved)
					{
						return settingsResolved.AllowDockLeftResolved;
					}
					return true;
				case DockedPosition.Top:
					if (!settingsResolved.AllowDockRightResolved && !settingsResolved.AllowDockLeftResolved)
					{
						return settingsResolved.AllowDockBottomResolved;
					}
					return true;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}
		}

		internal ToolbarCloseButtonTool CloseToolbarTool
		{
			get
			{
				if (OwningTaskPaneToolbar == null || !SettingsResolved.AllowHidingResolved)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return OwningTaskPaneToolbar.CloseButtonTool;
			}
		}

		internal override SystemActionTool CloseWindowTool
		{
			get
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
				if (!IsMainMenuBar)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (toolbarsManager.SystemMenu == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (toolbarsManager.ShowMdiButtonsInRibbon)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (closeWindowTool == null)
				{
					closeWindowTool = new SystemActionTool("", this, 61536, isChecked: false, null);
				}
				return closeWindowTool;
			}
		}

		internal UltraToolbarsDockArea DockArea => ToolbarsManager?.GetToolbarDockArea(this);

		internal override ToolBase[] ExtraTools
		{
			get
			{
				int num = 0;
				if (CloseToolbarTool != null)
				{
					num++;
				}
				if (base.Tools.NewToolPlaceHolder != null)
				{
					num++;
				}
				if (OwningTaskPaneToolbar != null)
				{
					if (OwningTaskPaneToolbar.ShowNavigationMenuInToolbar)
					{
						num++;
					}
					if (OwningTaskPaneToolbar.ShowHeaderLabelInToolbar)
					{
						num++;
					}
					if (OwningTaskPaneToolbar.ShowNextPreviousButtonInToolbar)
					{
						num += 2;
					}
					if (OwningTaskPaneToolbar.ShowHomeButtonInToolbar)
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
				if (IsBumpedToolsToolbar && MainRootToolbar is QuickAccessToolbar && ToolbarsManager != null && !ToolbarsManager.IsDesignMode)
				{
					num++;
				}
				ToolBase[] array = new ToolBase[num];
				int num2 = 0;
				if (OwningTaskPaneToolbar != null)
				{
					if (OwningTaskPaneToolbar.ShowNextPreviousButtonInToolbar)
					{
						array[num2++] = OwningTaskPaneToolbar.NavigatePreviousTool;
						array[num2++] = OwningTaskPaneToolbar.NavigateNextTool;
					}
					if (OwningTaskPaneToolbar.ShowHomeButtonInToolbar)
					{
						array[num2++] = OwningTaskPaneToolbar.NavigateHomeTool;
					}
					if (OwningTaskPaneToolbar.ShowHeaderLabelInToolbar)
					{
						array[num2++] = OwningTaskPaneToolbar.NavigationLabelTool;
					}
					if (OwningTaskPaneToolbar.ShowNavigationMenuInToolbar)
					{
						array[num2++] = TaskPaneToolbarMenu;
					}
				}
				if (CloseToolbarTool != null)
				{
					array[num2++] = CloseToolbarTool;
				}
				if (base.Tools.NewToolPlaceHolder != null)
				{
					array[num2++] = base.Tools.NewToolPlaceHolder;
				}
				if (IsBumpedToolsToolbar && MainRootToolbar is QuickAccessToolbar && ToolbarsManager != null && !ToolbarsManager.IsDesignMode)
				{
					array[num2++] = ((QuickAccessToolbar)MainRootToolbar).GetQatCustomizeMenuTool(this);
				}
				return array;
			}
		}

		internal Size FloatingSizeWithoutPadding
		{
			get
			{
				Size result = FloatingSize;
				ToolbarSettingsResolved settingsResolved = SettingsResolved;
				result.Width -= settingsResolved.PaddingLeftResolved + settingsResolved.PaddingRightResolved;
				result.Height -= settingsResolved.PaddingTopResolved + settingsResolved.PaddingBottomResolved;
				return result;
			}
		}

		internal override int GrabHandleWidth
		{
			get
			{
				if (ToolbarsManager.LockToolbars || dockedPosition == DockedPosition.Floating || SettingsResolved.GrabHandleStyleResolved == GrabHandleStyle.None)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (IsVertical)
				{
					return 3 + ToolbarsManager.GetResolvedVerticalToolbarGrabHandleHeight(this);
				}
				return 3 + ToolbarsManager.GetResolvedHorizontalToolbarGrabHandleWidth(this);
			}
		}

				{
					return true;

		protected UltraToolbar(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "Settings":
					toolbarSettings = (ToolbarSettings)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ToolbarSettings), null);
					break;
				case "DockedColumn":
					dockedColumn = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), dockedColumn);
					break;
				case "DockedPosition":
					dockedPosition = (DockedPosition)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(DockedPosition), dockedPosition);
					break;
				case "DockedColumnWhenLastDocked":
					dockedColumnWhenLastDocked = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), dockedColumnWhenLastDocked);
					break;
				case "DockedRow":
					dockedRow = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), dockedRow);
					break;
				case "DockedRowWhenLastDocked":
					dockedRowWhenLastDocked = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), dockedRowWhenLastDocked);
					break;
				case "FloatingLocation":
					floatingLocation = (Point)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(Point), floatingLocation);
					break;
				case "FloatingSize":
					floatingSize = (Size)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(Size), floatingSize);
					break;
				case "IsMainMenuBar":
					isMainMenuBar = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), isMainMenuBar);
					break;
				case "IsMdiMergeToolbar":
					isMdiMergeToolbar = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), isMdiMergeToolbar);
					break;
				case "IsStockToolbar":
					isStockToolbar = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), isStockToolbar);
					break;
				case "PositionWhenLastDocked":
					positionWhenLastDocked = (DockedPosition)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(DockedPosition), positionWhenLastDocked);
					break;
				case "ShowInToolbarList":
					showInToolbarList = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), showInToolbarList);
					break;
				case "TargetPositionInDockedRow":
					targetPositionInDockedRow = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), targetPositionInDockedRow);
					break;
				case "TearawayToolOwner":
					tearawayToolOwner = (ToolBase)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ToolBase), null);
					break;
				case "ToolbarType":
					toolbarType = (ToolbarType)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ToolbarType), toolbarType);
					break;
				case "Visible":
					visible = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), visible);
					break;
				case "Text":
					text = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), text);
					break;
				case "KeyTip":
					keyTip = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), keyTip);
					break;
				case "ReturnToRelativeLocation":
					returnToRelativeLocation = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), returnToRelativeLocation);
					break;
				case "RelativeHiddenToolbars":
					relativeHiddenToolbars = (ArrayList)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ArrayList), relativeHiddenToolbars);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		protected override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
			if (ShouldSerializeSettings())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Settings", toolbarSettings);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeDockedColumn())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "DockedColumn", dockedColumn);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeDockedPosition())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "DockedPosition", dockedPosition);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeDockedRow())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "DockedRow", dockedRow);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeFloatingLocation())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "FloatingLocation", floatingLocation);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeFloatingSize())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "FloatingSize", floatingSize);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeIsMainMenuBar())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "IsMainMenuBar", isMainMenuBar);
			}
			if (isMdiMergeToolbar)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "IsMdiMergeToolbar", isMdiMergeToolbar);
			}
			if (!isStockToolbar)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "IsStockToolbar", isStockToolbar);
			}
			if (positionWhenLastDocked != DockedPosition.Floating)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "PositionWhenLastDocked", positionWhenLastDocked);
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "DockedRowWhenLastDocked", dockedRowWhenLastDocked);
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "DockedColumnWhenLastDocked", dockedColumnWhenLastDocked);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeShowInToolbarList())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ShowInToolbarList", showInToolbarList);
			}
			if (tearawayToolOwner != null)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "TearawayToolOwner", tearawayToolOwner);
			}
			if (toolbarType != ToolbarType.Standard)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ToolbarType", toolbarType);
			}
			if (targetPositionInDockedRow != 0)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "TargetPositionInDockedRow", targetPositionInDockedRow);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeVisible())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Visible", visible);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeText())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Text", text);
			}
			if (keyTip != null)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "KeyTip", keyTip);
			}
			if (relativeHiddenToolbars != null)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "RelativeHiddenToolbars", relativeHiddenToolbars);
			}
			if (returnToRelativeLocation)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ReturnToRelativeLocation", returnToRelativeLocation);
			}
		}

		internal override void RefreshDockAreaContents()
		{
			if (dockedPosition == DockedPosition.Floating)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.GetFloatingWindow(this)?.DirtyChildElements();
			}
			else
			{
				ToolbarsManager.GetToolbarDockArea(this)?.DirtyChildElements();
			}
		}

		internal override void ResolveDefaultAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003c: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			if (ToolbarType == ToolbarType.Standard && !IsMainMenuBar && Utilities.IsHighContrast)
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager != null)
				{
					ToolbarStyle styleResolved = toolbarsManager.StyleResolved;
					switch (styleResolved - 7)
					{
					case 0:
					case 1:
					case 2:
						if (((ulong)requestedProps & 4uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)4))
						{
							((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor = SystemColors.ControlDark;
							requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFBuL);
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			base.ResolveDefaultAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		internal override void SaveDockedPosition()
		{
			if (dockedPosition != DockedPosition.Floating)
			{
				positionWhenLastDocked = dockedPosition;
				dockedRowWhenLastDocked = dockedRow;
				dockedColumnWhenLastDocked = dockedColumn;
			}
		}

		public override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeDockedColumn() && !ShouldSerializeDockedPosition() && !ShouldSerializeDockedRow() && !ShouldSerializeFloatingLocation() && !ShouldSerializeFloatingSize() && !ShouldSerializeIsMainMenuBar() && IsStockToolbar && KeyTip == null && !ShouldSerializeSettings() && !ShouldSerializeShowInToolbarList() && !ShouldSerializeText())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeVisible();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			string text = Key;
			if (text != null && text.Length > 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("[");
				stringBuilder.Append(Key);
				stringBuilder.Append("] - ");
			}
			stringBuilder.Append(Text);
			if (IsMainMenuBar)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(" (main menu)");
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

				return (INotificationBadgeSettingsOwner)(object)MainRootToolbar;
			}
			return base.GetNotificationSettingsOwnerParent();
		}
