		public override void Reset()
		{
			base.Reset();
			ResetText();
			ResetDockedColumn();
			ResetDockedPosition();
			ResetDockedRow();
			ResetFloatingLocation();
			ResetFloatingSize();
			ResetIsMainMenuBar();
			ResetShowInToolbarList();
			ResetVisible();
			ResetSettings();
			KeyTip = null;
			IsStockToolbar = true;
		}

		public void ResetState()
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				CancelableToolbarEventArgs e = new CancelableToolbarEventArgs(this);
				ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.BeforeToolbarReset, e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			base.Tools.ResetCustomizations();
			if (base.UIElement != null)
			{
				base.UIElement.Parent.DirtyChildElements();
			}
			if (ToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.AfterToolbarReset, new ToolbarEventArgs(this));
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			InternalSetUnderlyingToolbar(null);
			if (toolbarSettings != null)
			{
				toolbarSettings.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				toolbarSettings.Dispose();
				toolbarSettings = null;
			}
			if (closeWindowTool != null)
			{
				closeWindowTool.Dispose();
				closeWindowTool = null;
			}
			if (restoreWindowTool != null)
			{
				restoreWindowTool.Dispose();
				restoreWindowTool = null;
			}
			if (minimizeWindowTool != null)
			{
				minimizeWindowTool.Dispose();
				minimizeWindowTool = null;
			}
			mainRootToolbar = null;
			tearawayToolOwner = null;
			taskPaneToolbar = null;
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (propChange.Source == toolbarSettings)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ToolbarSettings, propChange);
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnSubObjectPropChanged(propChange);
			}
		}

		internal virtual Size CalculateFloatingWindowSize()
		{
			return GetMetrics(FloatingSizeWithoutPadding, Size.Empty).Size;
		}

		internal void ClearRelativeHiddenToolbars()
		{
			if (relativeHiddenToolbars != null)
			{
				relativeHiddenToolbars.Clear();
			}
		}

		internal override UltraToolbarBase Clone()
		{
			UltraToolbar ultraToolbar = new UltraToolbar(Key);
			ultraToolbar.InitializeFrom(this);
			return ultraToolbar;
		}

		internal RelativeHiddenToolbarInfo GetRelativeHiddenToolbarInfo(UltraToolbar toolbar)
		{
			if (relativeHiddenToolbars == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (RelativeHiddenToolbarInfo relativeHiddenToolbar in relativeHiddenToolbars)
			{
				if (relativeHiddenToolbar.Toolbar == toolbar)
				{
					return relativeHiddenToolbar;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal override UltraToolbarBase[] GetToolbarPickerRootToolbars()
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)ToolbarsManager.StyleResolved == 1 || DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Floating)
			{
				return new UltraToolbar[1] { this };
			}
			if (rootToolbars != null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (OwningTaskPaneToolbar != null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UltraToolbarsDockArea toolbarDockArea = ToolbarsManager.GetToolbarDockArea(this);
			if (toolbarDockArea == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DockRow dockRow = null;
			try
			{
				return toolbarDockArea.DockRows[DockedRow]?.Toolbars.ToArray();
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				if (ToolbarsManager == null)
				{
					throw;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal override void GetToolsThatMatchMnemonic(char charCode, List<IProcessMnemonic> toolsForThisMnemonic)
		{
			if (Visible)
			{
				base.GetToolsThatMatchMnemonic(charCode, toolsForThisMnemonic);
			}
		}

		internal override void HookupTools()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (relativeHiddenToolbars != null)
			{
				for (int num = relativeHiddenToolbars.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					RelativeHiddenToolbarInfo relativeHiddenToolbarInfo = (RelativeHiddenToolbarInfo)relativeHiddenToolbars[num];
					if (!relativeHiddenToolbarInfo.Initialize(toolbarsManager))
					{
						relativeHiddenToolbars.RemoveAt(num);
					}
				}
			}
			if (tearawayToolOwner is TearawayToolBase tearawayToolBase)
			{
				tearawayToolBase.ReattachTearawayToolbar(this);
			}
			base.HookupTools();
		}

		internal override void Initialize(object owner)
		{
			base.Initialize(owner);
			if (toolbarSettings != null)
			{
				toolbarSettings.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				toolbarSettings.Initialize(this);
			}
		}

		internal override void InitializeFrom(UltraToolbarBase toolbarBase)
		{
			if (toolbarBase is UltraToolbar ultraToolbar)
			{
				base.InitializeFrom(ultraToolbar);
				text = ultraToolbar.text;
				dockedColumn = ultraToolbar.dockedColumn;
				dockedPosition = ultraToolbar.dockedPosition;
				dockedRow = ultraToolbar.dockedRow;
				floatingLocation = ultraToolbar.floatingLocation;
				floatingSize = ultraToolbar.floatingSize;
				isMainMenuBar = ultraToolbar.isMainMenuBar;
				isStockToolbar = ultraToolbar.isStockToolbar;
				Key = base.Key;
				showInToolbarList = ultraToolbar.showInToolbarList;
				visible = ultraToolbar.visible;
				if (!isMainMenuBar && ultraToolbar.ToolbarsManager != null && ultraToolbar.ToolbarsManager.MdiParentManagerInternal != null)
				{
					dockedColumn += 5000;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InternalClearSettingsMember()
		{
			toolbarSettings = null;
		}

		internal void InternalClearSettingsResolvedMember()
		{
			toolbarSettingsResolved = null;
		}

		internal override void InternalSetDockedColumn(int dockedColumn, bool clearSnapShotValues)
		{
			this.dockedColumn = dockedColumn;
			if (clearSnapShotValues)
			{
				dockedColumnSnapShot = -1;
				targetPositionInDockedRowSnapShot = -1;
			}
		}

		internal override void InternalSetDockedRow(int dockedRow, bool clearSnapShotValues)
		{
			this.dockedRow = dockedRow;
			if (clearSnapShotValues)
			{
				dockedRowSnapShot = -1;
				dockedColumnSnapShot = -1;
				targetPositionInDockedRowSnapShot = -1;
			}
		}

		internal void InternalSetFloatingLocation(Point location)
		{
			floatingLocation = location;
		}

		internal virtual void InternalSetFloatingSize(Size size)
		{
			floatingSize = size;
		}

		internal virtual void InternalSetToolbarSettings(ToolbarSettings settings)
		{
			if (toolbarSettings != null)
			{
				toolbarSettings.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			toolbarSettings = settings;
		}

		internal void InternalSetUnderlyingToolbar(UltraToolbar underlyingToolbar)
		{
			if (this.underlyingToolbar != underlyingToolbar)
			{
				OnBeforeSetUnderlyingToolbar();
				this.underlyingToolbar = underlyingToolbar;
				OnAfterSetUnderlyingToolbar();
			}
		}

		internal void InternalSetVisible(bool newVisibleValue, bool bypassDockUpdateForMergedToolbars)
		{
			if (newVisibleValue == visible)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ToolbarsManager != null && ToolbarsManager.Initialized && IsMainMenuBar)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_55"));
			}
			bool visibleResolved = base.VisibleResolved;
			visible = newVisibleValue;
			if (ToolbarsManager != null && ToolbarsManager.Initialized)
			{
				if (!bypassDockUpdateForMergedToolbars || !IsMdiMergeToolbar || !IsHiddenByMdiMerge)
				{
					if (base.VisibleResolved)
					{
						ToolbarsManager.AddToolbarToDockArea(this, returnToRelativeLocation);
					}
					else
					{
						if (visibleResolved)
						{
							OnBeforeRemovedFromDockArea();
						}
						ToolbarsManager.RemoveToolbarFromDockArea(this);
					}
				}
				if (!IsHiddenByMdiMerge)
				{
					ToolbarModifiedEventArgs e = ((!visible) ? new ToolbarModifiedEventArgs(this, ToolbarChangeType.Closed) : new ToolbarModifiedEventArgs(this, ToolbarChangeType.Opened));
					ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.ToolbarModified, e);
				}
			}
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Visible);
		}

		internal virtual void MergeWithChildToolbar(UltraToolbar childToolbar)
		{
			if (IsMdiMergeToolbar)
			{
				InternalSetToolbarSettings(childToolbar.Settings);
			}
			InternalSetUnderlyingToolbar(childToolbar);
		}

		internal virtual void OnAfterMdiMergeDisconnect()
		{
		}

		internal virtual void OnAfterSetUnderlyingToolbar()
		{
			if (underlyingToolbar != null)
			{
				if (IsMdiMergeToolbar)
				{
					InternalSetVisible(underlyingToolbar.Visible, bypassDockUpdateForMergedToolbars: true);
				}
				underlyingToolbar.SubObjectPropChanged += ToolbarsManager.ChildToolbarPropChangeHandler;
				underlyingToolbar.SubObjectPropChanged += OnUnderlyingToolbarPropChanged;
			}
			else if (isMdiMergeToolbar)
			{
				isHiddenByMdiMerge = true;
				ToolbarsManager.DestroyFloatingWindowForToolbar(this);
				ToolbarsManager.DestroyPagerControlForToolbar(this);
				if (DockedPosition != DockedPosition.Floating)
				{
					ToolbarsManager.RemoveToolbarFromDockArea(this);
				}
				InternalClearSettingsMember();
				InternalClearSettingsResolvedMember();
			}
		}

		internal virtual void OnBeforeMdiMerge()
		{
			if (IsMdiMergeToolbar)
			{
				if (dockedRowMergedSnapShot != -1)
				{
					dockedRow = dockedRowMergedSnapShot;
				}
				if (dockedColumnMergedSnapShot != -1)
				{
					dockedColumn = dockedColumnMergedSnapShot;
				}
				if (targetPositionInDockedRowMergedSnapShot != -1)
				{
					targetPositionInDockedRow = targetPositionInDockedRowMergedSnapShot;
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual void OnBeforeMdiMergeDisconnect()
		{
			if (IsMdiMergeToolbar)
			{
				dockedColumnMergedSnapShot = dockedColumn;
				dockedRowMergedSnapShot = dockedRow;
				targetPositionInDockedRowMergedSnapShot = targetPositionInDockedRow;
			}
		}

		internal virtual void OnBeforeSetUnderlyingToolbar()
		{
			if (underlyingToolbar != null)
			{
				underlyingToolbar.SubObjectPropChanged -= ToolbarsManager.ChildToolbarPropChangeHandler;
				underlyingToolbar.SubObjectPropChanged -= OnUnderlyingToolbarPropChanged;
				if (Settings == underlyingToolbar.Settings)
				{
					InternalClearSettingsMember();
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void OnBeforeToolRemovedFromCollection(ToolBase tool, ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
		}

		internal override void OnCustomizeModeBegin()
		{
			dockedColumnSnapShot = dockedColumn;
			dockedRowSnapShot = dockedRow;
			targetPositionInDockedRowSnapShot = targetPositionInDockedRow;
		}

		internal override void OnCustomizeModeEnd()
		{
			if (dockedRowSnapShot != -1)
			{
				dockedRow = dockedRowSnapShot;
			}
			if (dockedColumnSnapShot != -1)
			{
				dockedColumn = dockedColumnSnapShot;
			}
			if (targetPositionInDockedRowSnapShot != -1)
			{
				targetPositionInDockedRow = targetPositionInDockedRowSnapShot;
			}
			dockedRowSnapShot = -1;
			dockedColumnSnapShot = -1;
			targetPositionInDockedRowSnapShot = -1;
		}

		internal override void OnResizeBegin()
		{
		}

		internal override void OnResizeEnd()
		{
		}

		internal override void OnToolAddedToCollection(ToolBase tool, ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
		}

		internal virtual void OnUnderlyingToolbarPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo)
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager != null && ToolbarsManager.Initialized && propChangeInfo.Source is UltraToolbar)
			{
				UltraToolbar ultraToolbar = propChangeInfo.Source as UltraToolbar;
				switch ((PropertyIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId)
				{
				case PropertyIds.DockedColumn:
					DockedColumn = ultraToolbar.DockedColumn;
					break;
				case PropertyIds.DockedPosition:
					DockedPosition = ultraToolbar.DockedPosition;
					break;
				case PropertyIds.DockedRow:
					DockedRow = ultraToolbar.DockedRow;
					break;
				case PropertyIds.FloatingLocation:
					InternalSetFloatingLocation(ultraToolbar.FloatingLocation);
					break;
				case PropertyIds.FloatingSize:
					InternalSetFloatingSize(ultraToolbar.FloatingSize);
					break;
				case PropertyIds.ShowInToolbarList:
					ShowInToolbarList = ultraToolbar.ShowInToolbarList;
					break;
				case PropertyIds.Text:
					Text = ultraToolbar.Text;
					break;
				case PropertyIds.Visible:
					InternalSetVisible(ultraToolbar.Visible, bypassDockUpdateForMergedToolbars: false);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveRelativeHiddenToolbarInfo(UltraToolbar toolbar)
		{
			if (relativeHiddenToolbars == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < relativeHiddenToolbars.Count; i++)
			{
				RelativeHiddenToolbarInfo relativeHiddenToolbarInfo = (RelativeHiddenToolbarInfo)relativeHiddenToolbars[i];
				if (relativeHiddenToolbarInfo.Toolbar == toolbar)
				{
					relativeHiddenToolbars.RemoveAt(i);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveRelativeHiddenToolbarReferencesFromOtherToolbars(ToolbarsCollection toolbars)
		{
			foreach (UltraToolbar toolbar in toolbars)
			{
				if (this != toolbar)
				{
					toolbar.RemoveRelativeHiddenToolbarInfo(this);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ResetToolDockedSettings()
		{
			InternalClearBumpedFlag();
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Tools.Count; i++)
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = base.Tools[i];
				toolBase.BumpedFromToolbar = false;
				toolBase.SpringWidth = 0;
			}
		}

		internal bool RestoreLastDockedPosition()
		{
			if (positionWhenLastDocked != DockedPosition.Floating)
			{
				Reposition(positionWhenLastDocked, dockedRowWhenLastDocked, dockedColumnWhenLastDocked);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool SetNewDockedPosition()
		{
			UltraToolbarsDockArea ultraToolbarsDockArea = null;
			if (SettingsResolved.AllowDockTopResolved)
			{
				ultraToolbarsDockArea = ToolbarsManager.GetValidDockArea(DockedPosition.Top);
			}
			if (ultraToolbarsDockArea == null && SettingsResolved.AllowDockLeftResolved)
			{
				ultraToolbarsDockArea = ToolbarsManager.GetValidDockArea(DockedPosition.Left);
			}
			if (ultraToolbarsDockArea == null && SettingsResolved.AllowDockRightResolved)
			{
				ultraToolbarsDockArea = ToolbarsManager.GetValidDockArea(DockedPosition.Right);
			}
			if (ultraToolbarsDockArea == null && SettingsResolved.AllowDockBottomResolved)
			{
				ultraToolbarsDockArea = ToolbarsManager.GetValidDockArea(DockedPosition.Bottom);
			}
			if (ultraToolbarsDockArea == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DockRow item = new DockRow(ultraToolbarsDockArea);
			int count = ultraToolbarsDockArea.DockRows.Count;
			ultraToolbarsDockArea.DockRows.Add(item);
			Reposition(ultraToolbarsDockArea.DockedPosition, count, 0);
			return true;
		}

		internal void SetDockedPosition(DockedPosition newDockedPosition)
		{
			SetDockedPosition(newDockedPosition, calledFromDockAreaAddToolbar: false);
		}

		internal override void SetDockedPosition(DockedPosition newDockedPosition, bool calledFromDockAreaAddToolbar)
		{
			bool flag = newDockedPosition != dockedPosition;
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(DockedPosition), newDockedPosition))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_56"));
			}
			if (calledFromDockAreaAddToolbar)
			{
				dockedPosition = newDockedPosition;
			}
			else
			{
				if (ToolbarsManager != null)
				{
					ToolbarsManager.RemoveToolbarFromDockArea(this);
				}
				dockedPosition = newDockedPosition;
				if (ToolbarsManager != null)
				{
					ToolbarsManager.AddToolbarToDockArea(this);
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.DockedPosition);
			}
		}

		private void AddRelativeHiddenToolbarInfo(RelativeHiddenToolbarInfo relativeInfo)
		{
			if (relativeHiddenToolbars == null)
			{
				relativeHiddenToolbars = new ArrayList();
			}
			relativeHiddenToolbars.Add(relativeInfo);
		}

		private RelativeHiddenToolbarLocation GetReltiveHiddenToolbarLocation(int fromToolbarDockedRow, int fromToolbarDockedColumn)
		{
			if (dockedRow < fromToolbarDockedRow)
			{
				return RelativeHiddenToolbarLocation.HiddenToolbarIsMoreOutside;
			}
			if (dockedRow == fromToolbarDockedRow)
			{
				if (dockedColumn < fromToolbarDockedColumn)
				{
					return RelativeHiddenToolbarLocation.HiddenToolbarIsOnSameRowWithLowerColumn;
				}
				return RelativeHiddenToolbarLocation.HiddenToolbarIsOnSameRowWithHigherColumn;
			}
			return RelativeHiddenToolbarLocation.HiddenToolbarIsMoreInside;
		}

		private void OnBeforeRemovedFromDockArea()
		{
			if (DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Floating)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				foreach (UltraToolbar toolbar in ToolbarsManager.Toolbars)
				{
					if (toolbar != this && toolbar.DockedPosition == DockedPosition && toolbar.VisibleResolved)
					{
						toolbar.AddRelativeHiddenToolbarInfo(new RelativeHiddenToolbarInfo(this, GetReltiveHiddenToolbarLocation(toolbar.dockedRow, toolbar.dockedColumn)));
						AddRelativeHiddenToolbarInfo(new RelativeHiddenToolbarInfo(toolbar, toolbar.GetReltiveHiddenToolbarLocation(dockedRow, dockedColumn)));
						returnToRelativeLocation = true;
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			UltraToolbarsDockArea dockArea = DockArea;
			if (dockArea == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < dockArea.DockRows.Count; i++)
			{
				DockRow dockRow = dockArea.DockRows[i];
				foreach (UltraToolbarBase toolbar2 in dockRow.Toolbars)
				{
					if (toolbar2 is UltraToolbar ultraToolbar && this != ultraToolbar)
					{
						ultraToolbar.AddRelativeHiddenToolbarInfo(new RelativeHiddenToolbarInfo(this, GetReltiveHiddenToolbarLocation(ultraToolbar.dockedRow, ultraToolbar.dockedColumn)));
						AddRelativeHiddenToolbarInfo(new RelativeHiddenToolbarInfo(ultraToolbar, ultraToolbar.GetReltiveHiddenToolbarLocation(dockedRow, dockedColumn)));
						returnToRelativeLocation = true;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		bool IToolsCollectionOwner.CollectionIsReadOnly(ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
			if (tearawayToolOwner == null)
			{
				return rootToolbars != null;
			}
			return true;
		}

		void IToolsCollectionOwner.OnToolAddedToCollection(ToolBase tool, ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager != null && tool.UnderlyingTool is ControlContainerTool { ToolWithContainedControl: null })
			{
				UltraToolbarsDockArea toolbarDockArea = ToolbarsManager.GetToolbarDockArea(this);
				if (toolbarDockArea != null)
				{
					tool.SetToolWithContainedControl(takeControlOwnership: true, toolbarDockArea);
				}
			}
			OnToolAddedToCollection(tool, toolsCollection);
		}

		bool IKeyTipProvider.Activate()
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager != null && ToolbarsManager.HasRibbon && ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.VisibleResolved)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.SetItemWithFocus(null);
			}
			return true;
		}

		bool IKeyTipProvider.Equals(IKeyTipProvider provider)
		{
			return this == provider;
		}

		IKeyTipContainer IKeyTipProvider.GetContainer()
		{
			return this;
		}

		void IKeyTipContainer.Deactivate()
		{
		}

		IKeyTipProvider[] IKeyTipContainer.GetKeyTipProviders()
		{
			List<IKeyTipProvider> list = new List<IKeyTipProvider>();
			foreach (ToolBase tool in base.Tools)
			{
				list.AddRange(tool.GetKeyTipProviders());
			}
			if (base.ToolsHaveBeenBumped)
			{
				list.Add(base.QuickCustomizeTool);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		protected override FragmentUIAProviderStub GetAutomationProvider()
		{
			if (IsHiddenByMdiMerge && ToolbarsManager.MdiParentManagerInternal != null)
			{
				UltraToolbarBase ultraToolbarBase = (IsMainMenuBarInternal ? ToolbarsManager.MdiParentManagerInternal.MainMenuBar : ToolbarsManager.MdiParentManagerInternal.Toolbars[Key]);
				if (ultraToolbarBase != null)
				{
					UIElement uIElement = ultraToolbarBase.UIElement;
					if (uIElement != null)
					{
						return (FragmentUIAProviderStub)(object)CreateUIAutomationStub(uIElement);
					}
				}
			}
			return base.GetAutomationProvider();
		}
	}
	internal class MdiParentMainMenuBar : UltraToolbarBase
	{
		private UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager;

		private MdiParentMainMenuBarSettings settings;

		private SystemActionTool closeWindowTool;

		private SystemActionTool restoreWindowTool;

		private SystemActionTool minimizeWindowTool;

		internal override bool AllowCustomizeResolved => false;

		public override UltraToolbarsManager ToolbarsManager => toolbarsManager;

		public override UIRole UIRole => StyleUtils.GetRole(toolbarsManager, StyleUtils.Role.MdiParentMenuBar);

		internal override AccessibleObject AccessibleParent => ((Control)(object)DockArea)?.AccessibilityObject;

		internal override bool CanBeDragged => false;

		internal override ToolbarSettingsBase SettingsInternal => settings;

		internal override bool IsMainMenuBarInternal => true;

		internal override ToolbarType ToolbarType => ToolbarType.MdiParentMenuBar;

		internal override Type UIElementType => typeof(ToolbarUIElement);

		internal override SystemActionTool CloseWindowTool
		{
			get
			{
				if (ToolbarsManager == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (ToolbarsManager.SystemMenu == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (closeWindowTool == null)
				{
					closeWindowTool = new SystemActionTool("", this, 61536, isChecked: false, null);
				}
				return closeWindowTool;
			}
		}

		internal override SystemActionTool MinimizeWindowTool
		{
			get
			{
				if (ToolbarsManager == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (ToolbarsManager.SystemMenu == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (ToolbarsManager.ActiveMdiChildForm == null || ToolbarsManager.ActiveMdiChildForm.WindowState != FormWindowState.Maximized || (!ToolbarsManager.ActiveMdiChildForm.MinimizeBox && !ToolbarsManager.ActiveMdiChildForm.MaximizeBox))
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (minimizeWindowTool == null)
				{
					minimizeWindowTool = new SystemActionTool("", this, 61472, isChecked: false, null);
				}
				return minimizeWindowTool;
			}
		}

		internal override SystemActionTool RestoreWindowTool
		{
			get
			{
				if (ToolbarsManager == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (ToolbarsManager.SystemMenu == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (ToolbarsManager.ActiveMdiChildForm == null || ToolbarsManager.ActiveMdiChildForm.WindowState != FormWindowState.Maximized || (!ToolbarsManager.ActiveMdiChildForm.MinimizeBox && !ToolbarsManager.ActiveMdiChildForm.MaximizeBox))
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (restoreWindowTool == null)
				{
					restoreWindowTool = new SystemActionTool("", this, 61728, isChecked: false, null);
				}
				return restoreWindowTool;
			}
		}

		internal override bool ShowSystemMenu
		{
			get
			{
				if (ToolbarsManager == null || ToolbarsManager.Customizing || ToolbarsManager.ActiveMdiChildForm == null || ToolbarsManager.SystemMenuToolbar != this)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return ToolbarsManager.SystemMenu != null;
			}
		}

		internal override Size SystemMenuToolSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (!ShowSystemMenu)
				{
					return Size.Empty;
				}
				return ToolbarsManager.SystemMenu.CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstanceHelper();
			}
		}

		internal UltraToolbarsDockArea DockArea => toolbarsManager.Ribbon.RibbonContainer;

		internal MdiParentMainMenuBar(UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager)
		{
			this.toolbarsManager = toolbarsManager;
			settings = new MdiParentMainMenuBarSettings(this);
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (settings != null)
			{
				settings.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				settings.Dispose();
				settings = null;
			}
			if (closeWindowTool != null)
			{
				closeWindowTool.Dispose();
				closeWindowTool = null;
			}
			if (restoreWindowTool != null)
			{
				restoreWindowTool.Dispose();
				restoreWindowTool = null;
			}
			if (minimizeWindowTool != null)
			{
				minimizeWindowTool.Dispose();
				minimizeWindowTool = null;
			}
			toolbarsManager = null;
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		internal override void AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(AccessibleEvents accEvent, int childID)
		{
			DockArea?.AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(accEvent, childID);
		}

		internal override UltraToolbarBase Clone()
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		internal override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
		{
			return DockArea?.NavigateToolbar(this, navdir);
		}

	internal enum RelativeHiddenToolbarLocation
	{
		HiddenToolbarIsMoreOutside,
		HiddenToolbarIsOnSameRowWithHigherColumn,
		HiddenToolbarIsOnSameRowWithLowerColumn,
		HiddenToolbarIsMoreInside
	}
	[Serializable]
	internal sealed class RelativeHiddenToolbarInfo : ISerializable
	{
		private UltraToolbar toolbar;

		private string deserializedToolbarKey;

		private RelativeHiddenToolbarLocation relativeLocation;

		public RelativeHiddenToolbarLocation RelativeLocation => relativeLocation;

		public UltraToolbar Toolbar => toolbar;

		public RelativeHiddenToolbarInfo(UltraToolbar toolbar, RelativeHiddenToolbarLocation relativeLocation)
		{
			this.toolbar = toolbar;
			this.relativeLocation = relativeLocation;
		}

		private RelativeHiddenToolbarInfo(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				string name = current.Name;
				if (!(name == "RelativeLocation"))
				{
					if (name == "ToolbarKey")
					{
						deserializedToolbarKey = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), deserializedToolbarKey);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					relativeLocation = (RelativeHiddenToolbarLocation)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(RelativeHiddenToolbarLocation), relativeLocation);
				}
			}
		}

		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "RelativeLocation", RelativeLocation);
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ToolbarKey", Toolbar.Key);
		}

		public bool Initialize(UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager)
		{
			int num = toolbarsManager.Toolbars.IndexOf(deserializedToolbarKey);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			toolbar = toolbarsManager.Toolbars[num];
			return true;
		}
	}

					return text;
				}
				return Toolbar.Key;
			}
		}

		public override UIRole UIRole
		{
			get
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager != null)

				}
				return null;

			: this(toolbar)
		{
			this.isFirstInGroup = isFirstInGroup;
		}

		protected internal override void Activate()
		{
			base.Activate();
			if (Enabled && CanActivate)
			{
				activated = true;
			}
		}

		protected internal override void Deactivate()
		{
			base.Deactivate();
			activated = false;
		}

		protected internal override void DropDown(Control owningControl, Point point, Rectangle exclusionRect, DropDownPosition dropDownPosition, bool delay, bool closeIfAlreadyOpen, bool alignRight, bool autocloseDropdown)
		{
		}

		protected internal override void OnClick()
		{
			if (!Toolbar.VisibleResolved || Toolbar.SettingsResolved.AllowHidingResolved)
			{
				if (Toolbar.UnderlyingToolbar != null)
				{
					Toolbar.UnderlyingToolbar.InternalSetVisible(!Toolbar.VisibleResolved, bypassDockUpdateForMergedToolbars: false);
				}
				else
				{
					Toolbar.InternalSetVisible(!Toolbar.VisibleResolved, bypassDockUpdateForMergedToolbars: false);
				}
			}
			base.MenuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay: false);
		}

		protected override UIElement GetMenuUIElement(UIElement parentElement, UIElement previousElement)
		{
			if (previousElement == null)
			{
				return (UIElement)(object)new ToolbarListMenuItemUIElement(parentElement, this);
			}
			((ToolbarListMenuItemUIElement)(object)previousElement).InitializeElement(this, parentElement);
			return previousElement;
		}

		protected internal override Type GetMenuUIElementType()
		{
			return typeof(ToolbarListMenuItemUIElement);
		}

		protected internal override Size GetTextSize()
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
			AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)65011720;
			ToolbarsManager.ResolvePopupAppearance(null, UIRole, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			return GetTextSize(ref appearance);
		}

		protected internal override Size GetTextSize(ref AppearanceData appearance)
		{
			string text = Text;
			return MeasureString(ref appearance, null, text);
		}

		protected internal override int IncrementClickCount()
		{
			return 0;
		}

		internal override bool IsSameMenuItem(MenuItemBase menuItem)
		{
			if (menuItem is ToolbarListMenuItem toolbarListMenuItem)
			{
				return toolbarListMenuItem.toolbar == toolbar;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override void ResolveAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, bool drawAsActive)
		{
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x10uL) != 0L)
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).TextHAlign = (HAlign)1;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEFuL);
			}
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x20uL) != 0L)
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).TextVAlign = (VAlign)2;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFDFuL);
			}
			ToolbarsManager.ResolvePopupItemAppearance(null, UIRole, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, drawAsActive, this);
		}
	}

	internal class ToolbarPickerControl : UserControl
	{
		public delegate void OnSelectionChangedEventHandler(object sender, EventArgs e);

		private CheckBox chSelected;

		private ToolBar tbarDisplay;

		private Container components;

		private ToolBar toolbar;

		internal bool Selected => chSelected.Checked;

		internal ToolBar Toolbar => toolbar;

		public event OnSelectionChangedEventHandler OnSelectionChanged;

		public ToolbarPickerControl()

		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && components != null)
			{
				components.Dispose();
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		private void InitializeComponent()
		{
			this.chSelected = new System.Windows.Forms.CheckBox();
			this.tbarDisplay = new System.Windows.Forms.ToolBar();
			base.SuspendLayout();
			this.chSelected.Location = new System.Drawing.Point(8, 4);
			this.chSelected.Name = "chSelected";
			this.chSelected.Size = new System.Drawing.Size(224, 16);
			this.chSelected.TabIndex = 0;
			this.chSelected.Text = "Toolbar ?";
			this.chSelected.CheckedChanged += new System.EventHandler(chSelected_CheckedChanged);
			this.tbarDisplay.Anchor = System.Windows.Forms.AnchorStyles.Top | System.Windows.Forms.AnchorStyles.Left | System.Windows.Forms.AnchorStyles.Right;
			this.tbarDisplay.BorderStyle = System.Windows.Forms.BorderStyle.FixedSingle;
			this.tbarDisplay.Divider = false;
			this.tbarDisplay.Dock = System.Windows.Forms.DockStyle.None;
			this.tbarDisplay.DropDownArrows = true;
			this.tbarDisplay.Location = new System.Drawing.Point(24, 28);
			this.tbarDisplay.Name = "tbarDisplay";
			this.tbarDisplay.ShowToolTips = true;
			this.tbarDisplay.Size = new System.Drawing.Size(208, 38);
			this.tbarDisplay.TabIndex = 1;
			this.tbarDisplay.Resize += new System.EventHandler(tbarDisplay_Resize);
			base.Controls.AddRange(new System.Windows.Forms.Control[2] { this.tbarDisplay, this.chSelected });
			base.Name = "ToolbarPickerControl";
			base.Size = new System.Drawing.Size(240, 72);
			base.ResumeLayout(false);
		}

		private void chSelected_CheckedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.OnSelectionChanged != null)
			{
				this.OnSelectionChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		private void tbarDisplay_Resize(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (tbarDisplay.Bottom + 3 > base.Height)
			{
				base.Height = tbarDisplay.Bottom + 3;
			}
		}

		internal void Initialize(ToolBar toolbar)
		{
			this.toolbar = toolbar;
			InitToolbar(toolbar);
			if (toolbar.Site != null)
			{
				chSelected.Text = toolbar.Site.Name;
			}
			else
			{
				chSelected.Text = toolbar.Name;
			}
		}

		private static ToolBarButton CloneToolbarButton(ToolBarButton existingButton)
		{
			ToolBarButton toolBarButton = new ToolBarButton();
			toolBarButton.DropDownMenu = existingButton.DropDownMenu;
			toolBarButton.Enabled = existingButton.Enabled;
			toolBarButton.ImageIndex = existingButton.ImageIndex;
			toolBarButton.ImageKey = existingButton.ImageKey;
			toolBarButton.PartialPush = existingButton.PartialPush;
			toolBarButton.Pushed = existingButton.Pushed;
			toolBarButton.Style = existingButton.Style;
			toolBarButton.Tag = existingButton.Tag;
			toolBarButton.Text = existingButton.Text;
			toolBarButton.ToolTipText = existingButton.ToolTipText;
			toolBarButton.Visible = existingButton.Visible;
			return toolBarButton;
		}

		private void InitToolbar(ToolBar toolbar)
		{
			tbarDisplay.ImageList = toolbar.ImageList;
			tbarDisplay.ButtonSize = toolbar.ButtonSize;
			tbarDisplay.DropDownArrows = toolbar.DropDownArrows;
			tbarDisplay.TextAlign = toolbar.TextAlign;
			tbarDisplay.Wrappable = toolbar.Wrappable;
			foreach (ToolBarButton button in toolbar.Buttons)
			{
				tbarDisplay.Buttons.Add(CloneToolbarButton(button));
			}
		}
	}

			QuickCustomizeTool.CloseToolbarPickerMenu();
		}

		protected internal override void OnPopupClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			QuickCustomizeTool.IsSubMenuAnimationActive = true;
			base.OnPopupClosed(sender, e);
			QuickCustomizeTool.CloseToolbarPickerMenu();
		}

		protected internal override bool ProcessLeftArrowKey()
		{
			CloseDropDown(delay: false);
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override void ResolveMenuAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, object context)
		{
			base.ToolbarsManager.ResolvePopupAppearance(QuickCustomizeTool, UIRole, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}
	}

			}
		}

		protected internal override void CloseDropDown(bool delay)
		{
			if (base.MenuAgent is ToolbarPickerMenuAgent toolbarPickerMenuAgent && toolbarPickerMenuAgent.QuickCustomizeTool.AddRemoveButtonsToolbar == toolbar)
			{
				toolbarPickerMenuAgent.QuickCustomizeTool.CloseAddRemoveButtonsMenu();
				UIElement uIElement = base.UIElement;
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					uIElement.DirtyChildElements();
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override void Deactivate()
		{
			base.Deactivate();
			activated = false;
		}

		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			tool.DropDownAddRemoveButtonsMenu(Toolbar, owningControl, point, exclusionRect, dropDownPosition, delay, closeIfAlreadyOpen, alignRight: false, autocloseDropdown);
		}

		}

	[Serializable]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(ToolbarsCollectionConverter))]
	[Editor(typeof(ToolbarsCollectionUITypeEditor), typeof(UITypeEditor))]
	public class ToolbarsCollection : KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase, ISerializable, IEnumerable<UltraToolbar>, IEnumerable
	{
		public class ToolbarEnumerator : DisposableObjectEnumeratorBase
		{
			public UltraToolbar Current => (UltraToolbar)((IEnumerator)this).Current;

			public ToolbarEnumerator(ToolbarsCollection toolbars)
				: base(toolbars)
			{
			}
		}

		public sealed class ToolbarsCollectionUITypeEditor : UITypeEditor
		{
			public override UITypeEditorEditStyle GetEditStyle(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				return UITypeEditorEditStyle.None;
			}
		}

		public class ToolbarsCollectionConverter : TypeConverter
		{
			public override bool GetPropertiesSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				return true;
			}

			public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
			{
				PropertyDescriptorCollection result = null;
				if (value is ToolbarsCollection { Count: >0 } toolbarsCollection)
				{
					PropertyDescriptor[] array = new PropertyDescriptor[toolbarsCollection.Count];
					int num = 0;
					int length = (toolbarsCollection.Count - 1).ToString().Length;
					foreach (UltraToolbar item in toolbarsCollection)
					{
						StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
						string text = num.ToString();
						if (text.Length < length)
						{
							stringBuilder.Append(new string(' ', length - text.Length));
						}
						stringBuilder.Append(text);
						string key = item.Key;
						if (key != null && key.Length > 0)
						{
							stringBuilder.Append(" - ");
							stringBuilder.Append(key);
						}
						array[num] = new ToolbarPropertyDescriptor(item, stringBuilder.ToString());
						num++;
					}
					result = new PropertyDescriptorCollection(array);
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		private class ToolbarPropertyDescriptor : PropertyDescriptor
		{
			private UltraToolbar toolbar;

			public override string Category => typeof(UltraToolbar).Name;

			public override Type ComponentType => typeof(UltraToolbar);

			public override bool IsReadOnly => false;

			public override Type PropertyType => typeof(UltraToolbar);

			public ToolbarPropertyDescriptor(UltraToolbar toolbar, string name)
				: base(name, null)
			{
				this.toolbar = toolbar;
			}

			public override bool CanResetValue(object component)
			{
				return true;
			}

			public override object GetValue(object component)
			{
				return toolbar;
			}

			public override void ResetValue(object component)
			{
				toolbar.Reset();
			}

			public override void SetValue(object component, object value)
			{
			}

			public override bool ShouldSerializeValue(object component)
			{
				return true;
			}
		}

		private class ToolbarDockOrderComparer : IComparer
		{
			int IComparer.Compare(object x, object y)
			{
				UltraToolbar ultraToolbar = x as UltraToolbar;
				UltraToolbar ultraToolbar2 = y as UltraToolbar;
				if (ultraToolbar == null && ultraToolbar2 == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (ultraToolbar == null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (ultraToolbar2 == null)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				if (ultraToolbar.DockedPosition != ultraToolbar2.DockedPosition)
				{
					return ((int)ultraToolbar.DockedPosition).CompareTo((int)ultraToolbar2.DockedPosition);
				}
				if (ultraToolbar.DockedRow != ultraToolbar2.DockedRow)
				{
					return ultraToolbar.DockedRow.CompareTo(ultraToolbar2.DockedRow);
				}
				if (ultraToolbar.DockedColumn != ultraToolbar2.DockedColumn)
				{
					return ultraToolbar.DockedColumn.CompareTo(ultraToolbar2.DockedColumn);
				}
				return ultraToolbar.Index.CompareTo(ultraToolbar2.Index);
			}
		}

		private int initialCapacity = 10;

		private UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager;

		internal const string MDI_MAIN_MENU_RESERVED_KEY = "_mdi.mainmenu.reserved.key_";

		internal const string MDI_CHILD_TOOLBAR_RESERVED_KEY = "_mdichild.toolbar.reserved.key_";

		internal const string MDI_CHILD_TOOLBAR_TYPE_COLLISION_KEY = "_mdichild.merge.collision.key_";

		public override object[] All
		{
			set
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		public override bool AllowDuplicateKeys => false;

		public override bool AllowEmptyKeys => false;

		public UltraToolbar this[int index] => (UltraToolbar)base.GetItem(index);

		public UltraToolbar this[string key] => (UltraToolbar)base.GetItem(key);

		protected override int InitialCapacity => initialCapacity;

		public override bool IsReadOnly => false;

		public UltraToolbarsManager ToolbarsManager => toolbarsManager;

		internal ToolbarsCollection(UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager)
		{
			this.toolbarsManager = toolbarsManager;
		}

		protected ToolbarsCollection(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.Value is UltraToolbar)
				{
					UltraToolbar ultraToolbar = (UltraToolbar)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(UltraToolbar), null);
					if (ultraToolbar != null)
					{
						List.Add(ultraToolbar);
					}
					continue;
				}
				string name = current.Name;
				if (!(name == "Count"))
				{
					if (name == "Tag")
					{
						DeserializeTag(current);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					initialCapacity = Math.Max(initialCapacity, (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), initialCapacity));
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Count", Count);
			bool flag = context.Context is bool && (bool)context.Context;
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				if (flag || this[i].IsStockToolbar)
				{
					Utils.SerializeProperty(info, i.ToString(), this[i]);
				}
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
		}

		IEnumerator<UltraToolbar> IEnumerable<UltraToolbar>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				yield return this[i];
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public int Add(UltraToolbar toolbar)
		{
			if (toolbar == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_57"));
			}
			if (toolbar.ToolbarsManager != null && toolbar.ToolbarsManager != ToolbarsManager)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CantAddExternalToolbar"));
			}
			int result = InternalAdd(toolbar, allowMdiMainMenuReservedKeyName: false);
			if (ToolbarsManager != null && ToolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				ToolbarModifiedEventArgs e = new ToolbarModifiedEventArgs(toolbar, ToolbarChangeType.Created);
				ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.ToolbarModified, e);
			}
			return result;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void AddRange(UltraToolbar[] toolbars)
		{
			foreach (UltraToolbar toolbar in toolbars)
			{
				Add(toolbar);
			}
		}

		public UltraToolbar AddToolbar(string key)
		{
			ValidateKeyDoesNotExist(key);
			UltraToolbar ultraToolbar = new UltraToolbar(key);
			InternalAdd(ultraToolbar, allowMdiMainMenuReservedKeyName: false);
			return ultraToolbar;
		}

		public void AddToolbarRange(string[] keys)
		{
			foreach (string key in keys)
			{
				AddToolbar(key);
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			ToolbarEnumerator toolbarEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (toolbarEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					UltraToolbar current = toolbarEnumerator.Current;
					if (!current.Tools.IsReadOnly)
					{
						current.Tools.Clear();
					}
					ToolbarsManager.RemoveToolbarFromDockArea(current);
					ToolbarsManager.DestroyFloatingWindowForToolbar(current);
					ToolbarsManager.DestroyPagerControlForToolbar(current);
					current.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = toolbarEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			InternalClear();
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Toolbars);
		}

		public ToolbarEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new ToolbarEnumerator(this);
		}

		public void Remove(UltraToolbar toolbar)
		{
			if (toolbar == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_58"));
			}
			InternalRemove(toolbar);
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			if (index > Count || index < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_8"));
			}
			UltraToolbar ultraToolbar = this[index];
			if (ultraToolbar != null)
			{
				InternalRemove(ultraToolbar);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Empty;
		}

		internal void AddToolbarsToDockAreas()
		{
			UltraToolbar[] array = (UltraToolbar[])All;
			Array.Sort(array, new ToolbarDockOrderComparer());
			UltraToolbar[] array2 = array;
			foreach (UltraToolbar ultraToolbar in array2)
			{
				if (ultraToolbar.VisibleResolved)
				{
					toolbarsManager.AddToolbarToDockArea(ultraToolbar);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void Initialize(UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager)
		{
			this.toolbarsManager = toolbarsManager;
			ToolbarEnumerator toolbarEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (toolbarEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					UltraToolbar current = toolbarEnumerator.Current;
					current.Initialize(this);
					if (current.IsMdiMergeToolbar)
					{
						current.IsHiddenByMdiMerge = true;
					}
					current.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = toolbarEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		internal int InternalAdd(UltraToolbar toolbar, bool allowMdiMainMenuReservedKeyName)
		{
			if (toolbar.IsMainMenuBar && ToolbarsManager.MainMenuBar != null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_59"));
			}
			if (!allowMdiMainMenuReservedKeyName && (object)((IKeyedSubObjectEx)toolbar).KeyLowercaseInterned == "_mdi.mainmenu.reserved.key_")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_60"));
			}
			if (!allowMdiMainMenuReservedKeyName && (object)((IKeyedSubObjectEx)toolbar).KeyLowercaseInterned == "_mdichild.toolbar.reserved.key_")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_60"));
			}
			string keyLowercaseInterned = ((IKeyedSubObjectEx)toolbar).KeyLowercaseInterned;
			if (!allowMdiMainMenuReservedKeyName && keyLowercaseInterned != null && keyLowercaseInterned.Length > "_mdichild.merge.collision.key_".Length && string.Compare(keyLowercaseInterned, 0, "_mdichild.merge.collision.key_", 0, "_mdichild.merge.collision.key_".Length, ignoreCase: true) == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_60"));
			}
			toolbar.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			int result = InternalAdd(toolbar);
			if (ToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				if (ToolbarsManager.Initialized)
				{
					toolbar.HookupTools();
				}
				if (toolbar.ToolbarType == ToolbarType.Standard && toolbar.VisibleResolved)
				{
					ToolbarsManager.AddToolbarToDockArea(toolbar);
				}
			}
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Toolbars);
			return result;
		}

		internal void InternalRemove(UltraToolbar toolbar)
		{
			if (toolbar != null)
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
				ToolbarsManager.RemoveToolbarFromDockArea(toolbar);
				toolbar.Tools.ClearInternal();
				toolbar.ClearRelativeHiddenToolbars();
				toolbar.RemoveRelativeHiddenToolbarReferencesFromOtherToolbars(this);
				ToolbarsManager.DestroyFloatingWindowForToolbar(toolbar);
				ToolbarsManager.DestroyPagerControlForToolbar(toolbar);
				InternalRemove((IKeyedSubObject)toolbar);
				toolbar.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				if (toolbar.TearawayToolOwner is TearawayToolBase tearawayToolBase)
				{
					tearawayToolBase.ClearTearawayToolbar();
				}
				if (ultraToolbarsManager != null)
				{
					ToolbarModifiedEventArgs e = new ToolbarModifiedEventArgs(toolbar, ToolbarChangeType.Destroyed);
					ultraToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.ToolbarModified, e);
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Toolbars);
			}
		}

		protected override object[] CreateArray()
		{
			return new UltraToolbar[Count];
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			ToolbarEnumerator toolbarEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (toolbarEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					UltraToolbar current = toolbarEnumerator.Current;
					current.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					current.Dispose();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = toolbarEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			InternalClear();
			toolbarsManager = null;
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Toolbars, propChange);
		}
	}
	public abstract class ToolbarSettingsBase : SettingsBase
	{
		private int paddingTop = -1;

		private int paddingBottom = -1;

		private int paddingLeft = -1;

		private int paddingRight = -1;

		private int toolSpacing = -1;

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_ToolbarSettings_P_PaddingTop")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Appearance")]
		public int PaddingTop
		{
			get
			{
				return paddingTop;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != paddingTop)
				{
					VerifyCanBeModified();
					paddingTop = value;
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.PaddingTop);
				}
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_ToolbarSettings_P_PaddingBottom")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Appearance")]
		public int PaddingBottom
		{
			get
			{
				return paddingBottom;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != paddingBottom)
				{
					VerifyCanBeModified();
					paddingBottom = value;
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.PaddingBottom);
				}
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_ToolbarSettings_P_PaddingLeft")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Appearance")]
		public int PaddingLeft
		{
			get
			{
				return paddingLeft;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != paddingLeft)
				{
					VerifyCanBeModified();
					paddingLeft = value;
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.PaddingLeft);

			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_ToolbarSettings_P_PaddingRight")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Appearance")]
		public int PaddingRight
		{
			get
			{
				return paddingRight;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != paddingRight)
				{
					VerifyCanBeModified();
					paddingRight = value;
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.PaddingRight);
				}
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_ToolbarSettings_P_ToolSpacing")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Appearance")]
		public int ToolSpacing
		{
			get
			{
				return toolSpacing;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != toolSpacing)
				{
					VerifyCanBeModified();
					toolSpacing = value;
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ToolSpacing);
				}
			}
		}

		internal ToolbarSettingsBase(object owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected ToolbarSettingsBase(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "PaddingTop":
					paddingTop = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), paddingTop);
					break;
				case "PaddingBottom":
					paddingBottom = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), paddingBottom);
					break;
				case "PaddingLeft":
					paddingLeft = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), paddingLeft);
					break;
				case "PaddingRight":
					paddingRight = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), paddingRight);
					break;
				case "ToolSpacing":
					toolSpacing = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), toolSpacing);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		protected override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
			if (ShouldSerializePaddingTop())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "PaddingTop", paddingTop);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializePaddingBottom())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "PaddingBottom", paddingBottom);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializePaddingLeft())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "PaddingLeft", paddingLeft);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializePaddingRight())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "PaddingRight", paddingRight);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeToolSpacing())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ToolSpacing", toolSpacing);
			}
		}

		protected internal bool ShouldSerializePaddingTop()
		{
			return paddingTop != -1;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetPaddingTop()
		{
			PaddingTop = -1;
		}

		protected internal bool ShouldSerializePaddingBottom()
		{
			return paddingBottom != -1;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetPaddingBottom()
		{
			PaddingBottom = -1;
		}

		protected internal bool ShouldSerializePaddingLeft()
		{
			return paddingLeft != -1;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetPaddingLeft()
		{
			PaddingLeft = -1;
		}

		protected internal bool ShouldSerializePaddingRight()
		{
			return paddingRight != -1;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetPaddingRight()
		{
			PaddingRight = -1;
		}

		protected internal bool ShouldSerializeToolSpacing()
		{
			return toolSpacing != -1;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetToolSpacing()
		{
			ToolSpacing = -1;
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			base.Reset();
			ResetPaddingBottom();
			ResetPaddingLeft();
			ResetPaddingRight();
			ResetPaddingTop();
			ResetToolSpacing();
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializePaddingBottom() && !ShouldSerializePaddingLeft() && !ShouldSerializePaddingRight() && !ShouldSerializePaddingTop())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeToolSpacing();
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			base.Reset();
			ResetAllowCustomize();
			ResetAllowDockBottom();
			ResetAllowDockLeft();
			ResetAllowDockRight();
			ResetAllowDockTop();
			ResetAllowFloating();
			ResetAllowHiding();
			ResetBorderStyleDocked();
			ResetDockedAppearance();
			ResetFillEntireRow();
			ResetFloatingAppearance();
			ResetGrabHandleStyle();
			ResetCaptionPlacement();
			ResetToolOrientation();
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (dockedAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				dockedAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				dockedAppearanceHolder = null;
			}
			if (floatingAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				floatingAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				floatingAppearanceHolder = null;
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (HasDockedAppearance && dockedAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChange.Source)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.DockedAppearance, propChange);
			}
			else if (HasFloatingAppearance && floatingAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChange.Source)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.FloatingAppearance, propChange);
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnSubObjectPropChanged(propChange);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void Initialize(object owner)
		{
			base.Initialize(owner);
			if (base.ToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				if (dockedAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					dockedAppearanceHolder.Collection = base.ToolbarsManager.Appearances;
					dockedAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				if (floatingAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					floatingAppearanceHolder.Collection = base.ToolbarsManager.Appearances;
					floatingAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeAllowCustomize() && !ShouldSerializeAllowDockBottom() && !ShouldSerializeAllowDockLeft() && !ShouldSerializeAllowDockRight() && !ShouldSerializeAllowDockTop() && !ShouldSerializeAllowFloating() && !ShouldSerializeAllowHiding() && !ShouldSerializeBorderStyleDocked() && !ShouldSerializeDockedAppearance() && !ShouldSerializeFillEntireRow() && !ShouldSerializeFloatingAppearance() && !ShouldSerializeGrabHandleStyle() && !ShouldSerializeCaptionPlacement())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeToolOrientation();
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

		public GrabHandleStyle GrabHandleStyleResolved
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0099: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_009e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00b6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00b8: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_00bc: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00bf: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_00cb: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00cd: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00f3: Expected I4, but got Unknown
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = toolbar.ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager == null)
				{
					return GrabHandleStyle.None;
				}
				GrabHandleStyle grabHandleStyle = (GrabHandleStyle)StyleUtils.GetCachedPropertyVal(toolbarsManager, StyleUtils.CustomProperty.GrabHandleStyle, GrabHandleStyle.Default, GrabHandleStyle.Default, GrabHandleStyle.Default);
				ResolutionOrderInfo resolutionOrder = StyleUtils.GetResolutionOrder(toolbarsManager);
				if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleBefore && grabHandleStyle != GrabHandleStyle.Default)
				{
					return grabHandleStyle;
				}
				if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseControlInfo)
				{
					if (toolbar.Settings.GrabHandleStyle != GrabHandleStyle.Default)
					{
						return toolbar.Settings.GrabHandleStyle;
					}
					if (toolbarsManager.ToolbarSettings.GrabHandleStyle != GrabHandleStyle.Default)
					{
						return toolbarsManager.ToolbarSettings.GrabHandleStyle;
					}
				}
				if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleAfter && grabHandleStyle != GrabHandleStyle.Default)
				{
					return grabHandleStyle;
				}
				ToolbarStyle styleResolved = toolbarsManager.StyleResolved;
				if (toolbar.OwningTaskPaneToolbar != null && toolbarsManager.MSColors == null)
				{
					return GrabHandleStyle.None;
				}
				if ((int)styleResolved == 4)
				{
					return GrabHandleStyle.OfficeXP;
				}
				if ((int)styleResolved == 9)
				{
					return GrabHandleStyle.Office2013;
				}
				if (toolbarsManager.MSColors != null)
				{
					switch (styleResolved - 2)
					{
					case 0:
					case 3:
					case 5:
					case 6:
					case 7:
						return GrabHandleStyle.Office2003;
					default:
						if (!toolbar.IsMainMenuBarInternal)
						{
							return GrabHandleStyle.Office2003;
						}
						return GrabHandleStyle.None;
					}
				}
				return GrabHandleStyle.Office2000;
			}
		}

		private static bool ResolveDefaultableBoolean(DefaultableBoolean primaryBool, DefaultableBoolean secondaryBool, bool defaultBool)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

		protected override bool ContinueDescendantSearch(Type type, object[] contexts)
		{
			if (contexts == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			UltraToolbarBase ultraToolbarBase = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < contexts.Length; i++)
			{
				ultraToolbarBase = ((!(contexts[i] is ToolBase)) ? (contexts[i] as UltraToolbarBase) : ((ToolBase)contexts[i]).OwningToolbarInternal);
				if (ultraToolbarBase == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (ultraToolbarBase == ToolbarInternal)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (ultraToolbarBase.RootToolbars != null)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < ultraToolbarBase.RootToolbars.Length; j++)
					{
						if (ultraToolbarBase.RootToolbars[j] == ToolbarInternal)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				if (ToolbarInternal.RootToolbars != null)
				{
					for (int k = 0; k < ToolbarInternal.RootToolbars.Length; k++)
					{
						if (ToolbarInternal.RootToolbars[k] == ultraToolbarBase)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				if (ultraToolbarBase.UnderlyingToolbar != ToolbarInternal)
				{
					return ultraToolbarBase == ToolbarInternal.UnderlyingToolbar;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return true;
		}
