						{
							rect.X = rectInsideBorders.Right - num5;
							rect.Y = rectInsideBorders.Y;
							rect.Height = Math.Max(22, rectInsideBorders.Height);
						}
						else
						{
							rect.Height = toolBase.Height;
						}
						if (rect.Height < size.Height)
						{
							rect.Offset(0, (size.Height - rect.Height) / 2);
						}
						firstToolLocation.X = rect.Right;
					}
					previousElement.Rect = rect;
					((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add(previousElement);
					if (toolBase.AlignRightOnToolbar || list.Count > 0)
					{
						list.Add(previousElement);
					}
					if (!(toolBase is QuickCustomizeTool))
					{
						num4++;
					}
				}
				if (list.Count > 0)
				{
					Size empty = Size.Empty;
					if (isVertical)
					{
						if (toolArea.Bottom <= firstToolLocation.Y)
						{
							return;
						}
						empty.Height = toolArea.Bottom - firstToolLocation.Y;
					}
					else
					{
						if (toolArea.Right <= firstToolLocation.X)
						{
							return;
						}
						empty.Width = toolArea.Right - firstToolLocation.X;
					}
					foreach (UIElement item in list)
					{
						item.Offset(empty.Width, empty.Height, false);
					}
				}
				if ((!flag && (!ToolbarsManager.Customizing || (ToolbarsManager.CustomizeDialog != null && !ToolbarsManager.CustomizeDialog.ExpandToolbarsToDisplayAllTools)) && !ToolbarInternal.WrapTools) || ToolbarInternal.OwningTaskPaneToolbar != null)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (isVertical)
				{
					firstToolLocation.X -= size.Height;
				}
				else
				{
					firstToolLocation.Y += size.Height;
				}
			}
			UltraToolbarBase ultraToolbarBase = Toolbar;
			if (ultraToolbarBase == null && ToolbarInternal is NavigationToolbar)
			{
				ultraToolbarBase = ToolbarInternal;
			}
			if (ultraToolbarBase != null && num4 == 0 && ToolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				EmptyToolbarToolUIElement emptyToolbarToolUIElement = (EmptyToolbarToolUIElement)UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)childElements, typeof(EmptyToolbarToolUIElement), true);
				if (emptyToolbarToolUIElement == null)
				{
					emptyToolbarToolUIElement = new EmptyToolbarToolUIElement((UIElement)(object)this, ultraToolbarBase);
				}
				else
				{
					emptyToolbarToolUIElement.InitializeElement(ultraToolbarBase);
				}
				if (isVertical)
				{
					rect.X = toolAreaInformation.FirstToolLocation.X - 16;
					rect.Y = toolAreaInformation.FirstToolLocation.Y;
				}
				else
				{
					rect.X = toolAreaInformation.FirstToolLocation.X;
					rect.Y = toolAreaInformation.FirstToolLocation.Y;
				}
				rect.Width = 16;
				if (rect.Right > rectInsideBorders.Right)
				{
					rect.Width = rectInsideBorders.Right - rect.X;
				}
				else if (rect.Width < rectInsideBorders.Width && isVertical)
				{
					rect.X = rectInsideBorders.X + (rectInsideBorders.Width - rect.Width) / 2;
				}
				rect.Height = 16;
				if (rect.Bottom > rectInsideBorders.Bottom)
				{
					rect.Height = rectInsideBorders.Bottom - rect.Y;
				}
				else if (rect.Height < rectInsideBorders.Height && !isVertical)
				{
					rect.Y += (rectInsideBorders.Height - rect.Height) / 2;
				}
				((UIElement)emptyToolbarToolUIElement).Rect = rect;
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)emptyToolbarToolUIElement);
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeElement(UltraToolbarBase toolbar)
		{
			((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext = toolbar;
		}

		internal void ProcessDoubleClick()
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraToolbar ultraToolbar = Toolbar;
			if (ultraToolbar == null || ultraToolbar.IsBumpedToolsToolbar)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ultraToolbar.OwningTaskPaneToolbar != null)
			{
				ultraToolbar = ultraToolbar.OwningTaskPaneToolbar;
			}
			if (!ToolbarsManager.IsDesignMode && (!((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)ToolbarsManager).Enabled || ToolbarsManager.LockToolbars || (ultraToolbar.DockedPosition != DockedPosition.Floating && !ultraToolbar.SettingsResolved.AllowFloatingResolved)))
			{
				return;
			}
			ToolbarsManager.OnDragToolbarEnd();
			if ((lastMouseUpOrDownButton & MouseButtons.Left) != MouseButtons.Left)
			{
				return;
			}
			ToolbarModifiedEventArgs e;
			if (ultraToolbar.DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Floating)
			{
				if (ultraToolbar.RestoreLastDockedPosition() || ultraToolbar.SetNewDockedPosition())
				{
					e = new ToolbarModifiedEventArgs(ultraToolbar, ToolbarChangeType.Docked);
					ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.ToolbarModified, e);
				}
				return;
			}
			ultraToolbar.DockedPosition = DockedPosition.Floating;
			e = new ToolbarModifiedEventArgs(ultraToolbar, ToolbarChangeType.Undocked);
			if (ultraToolbar.FloatingLocation != Point.Empty)
			{
				FloatingToolbarWindowBase floatingWindow = ToolbarsManager.GetFloatingWindow(ultraToolbar);
				if (floatingWindow != null)
				{
					floatingWindow.Location = ultraToolbar.FloatingLocation;
				}
			}
			ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.ToolbarModified, e);
		}

		internal static Point GetToolbarDragOffset(UltraToolbar toolbarBeingDragged, UIElement toolbarElement, Point dragPoint)
		{
			if (toolbarBeingDragged.DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Floating)
			{
				return new Point(Math.Max(20, toolbarBeingDragged.FloatingSize.Width / 2), 4 + toolbarBeingDragged.ToolbarsManager.FloatingToolbarCaptionHeight / 2);
			}
			if (toolbarBeingDragged.IsVertical)
			{
				return new Point(toolbarBeingDragged.CalculateFloatingWindowSize().Width / 2, Math.Min(toolbarBeingDragged.ToolbarsManager.FloatingToolbarCaptionHeight / 2, dragPoint.Y - toolbarElement.Rect.Y));
			}
			if (toolbarBeingDragged.SettingsResolved.FillEntireRowResolved)
			{
				Size size = toolbarBeingDragged.CalculateFloatingWindowSize();
				size.Width = Math.Max(10, size.Width);
				return new Point(Math.Min(size.Width, (dragPoint.X - toolbarElement.Rect.X) * size.Width / Math.Max(1, toolbarElement.Rect.Width)), dragPoint.Y - toolbarElement.Rect.Y);
			}
			return new Point(dragPoint.X - toolbarElement.Rect.X, dragPoint.Y - toolbarElement.Rect.Y);
		}

		private void SaveMouseButton(MouseButtons mouseButtons)
		{
			lastMouseUpOrDownButton = MouseButtons.None;
			if ((mouseButtons & MouseButtons.Left) == MouseButtons.Left)
			{
				lastMouseUpOrDownButton |= MouseButtons.Left;
			}
			if ((mouseButtons & MouseButtons.Right) == MouseButtons.Right)
			{
				lastMouseUpOrDownButton |= MouseButtons.Right;
			}
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]
	[DefaultProperty("SharedProps")]
	[DesignerSerializer("Infragistics.Win.UltraWinToolbars.ToolCodeDomSerializer, Infragistics4.Win.v21.1.Design, Version=21.1.20211.24, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=7dd5c3163f2cd0cb", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=2.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	public abstract class ToolBase : KeyedSubObjectBase, IComparable, IKeyTipProvider, IProcessMnemonic, INotificationBadgeProvider, INotificationBadgeSettingsOwner
	{
		protected internal enum AppearanceResolutionPhase
		{
			Initial,
			HotTrack,
			Pressed,
			Tool,
			ToolOwner,
			Final
		}

		public class ToolAccessibleObject : AccessibleObjectWrapper
		{
			private ToolBase tool;

			public override Rectangle Bounds => tool.Bounds;

			public override string DefaultAction => tool.DefaultActionInternal;

			public override string Description
			{
				get
				{
					string text = null;
					if (tool.UnderlyingTool != null)
					{
						text = tool.UnderlyingTool.SharedProps.AccessibleDescription;
						if (text != null && text.Length > 0)
						{
							return text;
						}
					}
					text = tool.ToolTipTextResolved;
					if (text != null && text.Length > 0)
					{
						return text;
					}
					return tool.CaptionAsToolTip;
				}
			}

			public override string KeyboardShortcut => tool.KeyboardShortcut;

			public override string Name
			{
				get
				{
					string name = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name;
					if (name != null && name.Length > 0)
					{
						return name;
					}
					if (tool.UnderlyingTool != null)
					{
						name = tool.UnderlyingTool.SharedProps.AccessibleName;
						if (name != null && name.Length > 0)
						{
							return name;
						}
						if (tool.UnderlyingTool is QuickCustomizeTool)
						{
							return tool.ToolTipTextResolved;
						}
					}
					return tool.CaptionAsToolTip;
				}
				set
				{
					((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name = value;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Parent
			{
				get
				{
					object ownerInternal = tool.OwnerInternal;
					if (ownerInternal is PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool)
					{
						return popupMenuTool.AccessibilityObject;
					}
					if (ownerInternal is UltraToolbarBase ultraToolbarBase)
					{
						return ultraToolbarBase.AccessibilityObject;
					}
					object owner = tool.Owner;
					if (owner is RibbonGroup ribbonGroup)
					{
						return ribbonGroup.RibbonGroupAccessiblilityObject;
					}
					if (owner is ApplicationMenuAreaBase applicationMenuAreaBase)
					{
						return applicationMenuAreaBase.AccessibilityObject;
					}
					return null;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleRole Role => tool.AccessibleRoleResolved;

			public override AccessibleStates State => tool.AccessibleState;

			public override string Value
			{
				get
				{
					return tool.AccessibleValue;
				}
				set
				{
					tool.AccessibleValue = value;
				}
			}

			public ToolBase Tool => tool;

			public ToolAccessibleObject(ToolBase tool)
			{
				this.tool = tool;
			}

			public override void DoDefaultAction()
			{
				tool.DoDefaultActionInternal();
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
			{
				return tool.GetAccessibleChild(index);
			}

			public override int GetChildCount()
			{
				return tool.AccessibleChildCount;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetFocused()
			{
				AccessibleObject focusedAccessibleObject = tool.ToolbarsManagerInControl.GetFocusedAccessibleObject();
				for (AccessibleObject accessibleObject = focusedAccessibleObject; accessibleObject != null; accessibleObject = accessibleObject.Parent)
				{
					if (accessibleObject == ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).AccessibleObject)
					{
						return focusedAccessibleObject;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			protected override Control GetMarshallingControl()
			{
				return tool.ToolbarsManagerInControl?.DockWithinContainer;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetSelected()
			{
				AccessibleObject selectedAccessibleObject = tool.ToolbarsManagerInControl.GetSelectedAccessibleObject();
				for (AccessibleObject accessibleObject = selectedAccessibleObject; accessibleObject != null; accessibleObject = accessibleObject.Parent)
				{
					if (accessibleObject == ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).AccessibleObject)
					{
						return selectedAccessibleObject;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject HitTest(int x, int y)
			{
				return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).HitTest(x, y);
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				return tool.Navigate(navdir);
			}

			public override void Select(AccessibleSelection flags)
			{
				if (!tool.EnabledResolved || !tool.VisibleResolved)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (tool.OwnerIsMenuInternal)
				{
					PopupMenuTool owningMenuInternal = tool.OwningMenuInternal;
					if (!owningMenuInternal.IsMenuAgentCreated || !owningMenuInternal.IsOpen)
					{
						return;
					}
					ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem = owningMenuInternal.MenuAgent.ActiveMenuItem as ToolMenuItem;
					if ((flags & (AccessibleSelection.TakeFocus | AccessibleSelection.TakeSelection | AccessibleSelection.ExtendSelection | AccessibleSelection.AddSelection)) != AccessibleSelection.None)
					{
						if (toolMenuItem != null && toolMenuItem.Tool == tool)
						{
							return;
						}
						owningMenuInternal.MenuAgent.CloseOpenSubmenuTools(null, delay: false);
						{
							foreach (ToolMenuItem menuItem in owningMenuInternal.MenuAgent.GetMenuItems(Tool))
							{
								if (menuItem.Tool == tool)
								{
									menuItem.Activate();
									break;
								}
							}
							return;
						}
					}
					if ((flags & AccessibleSelection.RemoveSelection) != AccessibleSelection.None && toolMenuItem != null && toolMenuItem.Tool == tool)
					{
						owningMenuInternal.MenuAgent.CloseOpenSubmenuTools(null, delay: false);
						toolMenuItem.Deactivate();
					}
					return;
				}
				UIElement uIElement = tool.UIElement;
				if (uIElement == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				UltraToolbarBase ultraToolbarBase = null;
				RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = null;
				if (!tool.OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
				{
					return;
				}
				ultraToolbarBase = tool.OwningToolbarInternal;
				if ((ultraToolbarBase != null && !ultraToolbarBase.VisibleResolved) || tool.BumpedFromToolbar)
				{
					return;
				}
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManagerInControl = tool.ToolbarsManagerInControl;
				ribbonGroup = tool.OwningRibbonGroup;
				if (ribbonGroup != null && !toolbarsManagerInControl.Ribbon.VisibleResolved)
				{
					return;
				}
				if ((flags & (AccessibleSelection.TakeFocus | AccessibleSelection.TakeSelection | AccessibleSelection.ExtendSelection | AccessibleSelection.AddSelection)) != AccessibleSelection.None)
				{
					if (tool.IsActiveTool)
					{
						return;
					}
					toolbarsManagerInControl.PopupManager.CloseAllPopups();
					if (ultraToolbarBase != null)
					{
						if ((flags & AccessibleSelection.TakeFocus) != AccessibleSelection.None)
						{
							toolbarsManagerInControl.AllowToolbarCaptureRelease = true;
							toolbarsManagerInControl.ToolOwnerWithCapture = ultraToolbarBase;
						}
						else if (toolbarsManagerInControl.ToolOwnerWithCapture != ultraToolbarBase && toolbarsManagerInControl.ToolOwnerWithCapture != null)
						{
							toolbarsManagerInControl.AllowToolbarCaptureRelease = true;
							toolbarsManagerInControl.ToolOwnerWithCapture = null;
						}
					}
					else if (ribbonGroup != null)
					{
						if ((flags & AccessibleSelection.TakeFocus) != AccessibleSelection.None)
						{
							toolbarsManagerInControl.AllowToolbarCaptureRelease = true;
							toolbarsManagerInControl.ToolOwnerWithCapture = ribbonGroup;
						}
						else if (toolbarsManagerInControl.ToolOwnerWithCapture != ribbonGroup && toolbarsManagerInControl.ToolOwnerWithCapture != null)
						{
							toolbarsManagerInControl.AllowToolbarCaptureRelease = true;
							toolbarsManagerInControl.ToolOwnerWithCapture = null;
						}
					}
					toolbarsManagerInControl.InternalSetActiveTool(tool, setOn: true, clearToolBeingEdited: true);
				}
				else if ((flags & AccessibleSelection.RemoveSelection) != AccessibleSelection.None && tool.IsActiveTool)
				{
					toolbarsManagerInControl.InternalSetActiveTool(null, setOn: false, clearToolBeingEdited: true);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal struct ResolveAppearancePhaseInfo
		{
			private AppearanceResolutionPhase phase;

			private UltraToolbarsManager manager;

			private SettingsBase ownerSettings;

			private ResolutionOrderInfo resolutionOrder;

			private UIRole uiRole;

			private UIRole ownerUIRole;

			private bool editArea;

			private bool drawAsActive;

			private bool drawAsPressed;

			private bool largeImages;

			private ToolBase tool;

			private object context;

			public AppearanceResolutionPhase Phase => phase;

			public UltraToolbarsManager Manager => manager;

			public MenuSettings MenuSettings => ownerSettings as MenuSettings;

			public ToolbarSettings ToolbarSettings => ownerSettings as ToolbarSettings;

			internal ToolbarSettingsBase ToolbarSettingsBase => ownerSettings as ToolbarSettingsBase;

			public SettingsBase OwnerSettings => ownerSettings;

			internal SettingsBase OwnerParentSettings
			{
				get
				{
					SettingsBase result = null;
					if (Manager != null)
					{
						if (ownerSettings is RibbonGroupSettings && ownerSettings.Owner is RibbonGroup)
						{
							RibbonTab tab = ((RibbonGroup)ownerSettings.Owner).Tab;
							if (tab != null && tab.HasGroupSettings)
							{
								result = tab.GroupSettings;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							result = null;
						}
					}
					return result;
				}
			}

			internal SettingsBase OwnerGrandparentSettings
			{
				get
				{
					SettingsBase result = null;
					if (Manager != null)
					{
						if (ownerSettings is RibbonGroupSettings && ownerSettings.Owner is RibbonGroup)
						{
							RibbonTab tab = ((RibbonGroup)ownerSettings.Owner).Tab;
							if (tab != null && tab.ContextualTabGroup != null && tab.ContextualTabGroup.HasGroupSettings)
							{
								result = tab.ContextualTabGroup.GroupSettings;
							}
						}
						else if (ownerSettings is MenuSettings && tool.UltimateOwner is NavigationMenu)
						{
							result = Manager.Ribbon.ApplicationMenu2010.ContentArea.Settings;
						}
					}
					return result;
				}
			}

			public SettingsBase ManagerSettings
			{
				get
				{
					SettingsBase result = null;
					if (Manager != null)
					{
						if (ownerSettings is MenuSettings)
						{
							result = Manager.MenuSettings;
						}
						else if (ownerSettings is ToolbarSettings)
						{
							result = Manager.ToolbarSettings;
						}
						else if (ownerSettings is MiniToolbarSettings)
						{
							result = Manager.ToolbarSettings;
						}
						else if (ownerSettings is RibbonGroupSettings)
						{
							result = manager.Ribbon.GroupSettings;
						}
						else if (ownerSettings is QuickAccessToolbarSettings)
						{
							result = null;
						}
						else if (ownerSettings is RibbonTabItemToolbarSettings)
						{
							result = null;
						}
						else if (ownerSettings is ApplicationMenuAreaSettings)
						{
							result = Manager.MenuSettings;
						}
						else if (ownerSettings is ApplicationMenuFooterToolbarSettings)
						{
							result = null;
						}
						else if (ownerSettings is MdiParentMainMenuBarSettings)
						{
							result = null;
						}
						else if (ownerSettings == null)
						{
							result = null;
						}
						else if (ownerSettings is NavigationToolbarSettings)
						{
							result = null;
						}
					}
					return result;
				}
			}

			public ResolutionOrderInfo ResolutionOrder => resolutionOrder;

			public UIRole UIRole => uiRole;

			public UIRole OwnerUIRole => ownerUIRole;

			public bool EditArea => editArea;

			public bool DrawAsActive => drawAsActive;

			public bool DrawAsPressed => drawAsPressed;

			public bool UseLargeImages => largeImages;

			internal object Context => context;

			internal ResolveAppearancePhaseInfo(UIRole uiRole, UIRole ownerUIRole, UltraToolbarsManager manager, SettingsBase ownerSettings, ResolutionOrderInfo resolutionOrder, bool editArea, bool drawAsActive, bool drawAsPressed, bool largeImages, ToolBase tool, object context)
			{
				//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				phase = AppearanceResolutionPhase.Initial;
				this.manager = manager;
				this.ownerSettings = ownerSettings;
				this.resolutionOrder = resolutionOrder;
				this.editArea = editArea;
				this.drawAsActive = drawAsActive;
				this.drawAsPressed = drawAsPressed;
				this.largeImages = largeImages;
				this.uiRole = uiRole;
				this.ownerUIRole = ownerUIRole;
				this.context = context;
				this.tool = tool;
			}

			internal void SetPhase(AppearanceResolutionPhase phase)
			{
				this.phase = phase;
			}
		}

		protected internal abstract class ToolSizeInfo
		{
			private const byte UseLargeImagesFlag = 1;

			private const byte DisplayImageFlag = 2;

			private const byte DisplayTextFlag = 4;

			private byte flags;

			private TextPlacement captionPlacement;

			public bool UseLargeImages => (flags & 1) != 0;

			public bool DisplayImage => (flags & 2) != 0;

			public bool DisplayText => (flags & 4) != 0;

			public TextPlacement CaptionPlacement => captionPlacement;

			internal ToolSizeInfo(bool useLargeImages, bool displayImage, bool displayText, TextPlacement captionPlacement)
			{
				//IL_003d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_003f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (useLargeImages)
				{
					flags |= 1;
				}
				if (displayImage)
				{
					flags |= 2;
				}
				if (displayText)
				{
					flags |= 4;
				}
				this.captionPlacement = captionPlacement;
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (obj == this)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (obj is ToolSizeInfo toolSizeInfo && toolSizeInfo.flags == flags)
				{
					return toolSizeInfo.captionPlacement == captionPlacement;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return flags;
			}
		}

		internal class ToolIndexComparer : IComparer<ToolBase>
		{
			private static IComparer<ToolBase> instance;

			internal static IComparer<ToolBase> Instance => instance;

			static ToolIndexComparer()
			{
				instance = new ToolIndexComparer();
			}

			private ToolIndexComparer()
			{
			}

			int IComparer<ToolBase>.Compare(ToolBase toolx, ToolBase tooly)
			{
				if (toolx == tooly)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (toolx == null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (tooly == null)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				if (tooly.Index <= toolx.Index)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return 1;
			}
		}

		internal class LargeRibbonButtonTextInfoCache
		{
			private HotkeyPrefix hotkeyPrefix;

			private GdiDrawStringFlags drawStringFlags;

			private int lineCount;

			private string line1;

			private string line2;

			private Size line1Size = Size.Empty;

			private Size line2Size = Size.Empty;

			private Size totalTextSize = Size.Empty;

			public int LineCount => lineCount;

			public string Line1 => line1;

			public string Line2 => line2;

			public Size Line1Size => line1Size;

			public Size Line2Size => line2Size;

			public Size TotalTextSize => totalTextSize;

			internal LargeRibbonButtonTextInfoCache(ToolBase tool, Graphics g, Font font, Size dropDownArrowSize, GdiDrawStringFlags drawStringFlags)
				: this(tool.CaptionResolved, tool.ImageSizeResolved, g, font, dropDownArrowSize, tool.HotkeyPrefix, drawStringFlags)
			{
			}//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)


			internal LargeRibbonButtonTextInfoCache(string caption, Size imageSize, Graphics g, Font font, Size dropDownArrowSize)
				: this(caption, imageSize, g, font, dropDownArrowSize, HotkeyPrefix.Hide, (GdiDrawStringFlags)0)
			{
			}

			internal LargeRibbonButtonTextInfoCache(string caption, Size imageSize, Graphics g, Font font, Size dropDownArrowSize, HotkeyPrefix hotkeyPrefix, GdiDrawStringFlags drawStringFlags)
			{
				//IL_0030: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				this.hotkeyPrefix = hotkeyPrefix;
				this.drawStringFlags = drawStringFlags;
				int width = imageSize.Width;
				CalculateTextInfo(caption, g, font, width, dropDownArrowSize);
			}

			private void CalculateTextInfo(string text, Graphics g, Font font, int minWidth, Size dropDownArrowSize)
			{
				//IL_005c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_011e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0200: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_01ad: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0171: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (text == null)
				{
					text = string.Empty;
				}
				text = text.Replace(Environment.NewLine, " ");
				text = text.Trim();
				SizeF empty = SizeF.Empty;
				bool flag = false;
				string[] array = null;
				using StringFormat stringFormat = new StringFormat();
				stringFormat.FormatFlags |= StringFormatFlags.LineLimit;
				stringFormat.HotkeyPrefix = hotkeyPrefix;
				SizeF sizeF = DrawUtility.MeasureString(g, text, font, PointF.Empty, stringFormat, drawStringFlags);
				if (sizeF.Width <= (float)minWidth)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					array = SplitWithSeparators(text);
					if (array.Length <= 1)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					lineCount = 1;
					line1 = text;
					line2 = null;
					line1Size = Size.Ceiling(sizeF);
					line2Size = Size.Ceiling(DrawUtility.MeasureString(g, "Wj", font));
					empty = sizeF;
					empty.Height = DrawUtility.MeasureString(g, "Wj\r\nWj", font).Height;
					totalTextSize = Size.Ceiling(empty);
					return;
				}
				int width = dropDownArrowSize.Width;
				int num = 1;
				int num2 = array.Length - 1;
				string text2 = array[0];
				string text3 = string.Empty;
				SizeF value = DrawUtility.MeasureString(g, text2, font, PointF.Empty, stringFormat, drawStringFlags);
				SizeF value2 = dropDownArrowSize;
				int num3 = (int)Math.Ceiling(value.Width);
				int num4 = width;
				for (int num5 = array.Length - 1; num5 > 0; num5--)
				{
					if (num3 <= num4)
					{
						text2 += array[num];
						value = DrawUtility.MeasureString(g, text2, font, PointF.Empty, stringFormat, drawStringFlags);
						num3 = (int)Math.Ceiling(value.Width);
						num++;
					}
					else
					{
						text3 = array[num2] + text3;
						value2 = DrawUtility.MeasureString(g, text3, font, PointF.Empty, stringFormat, drawStringFlags);
						value2.Width += width;
						num4 = (int)Math.Ceiling(value2.Width);
						num2--;
					}
				}
				int num6 = Math.Max(num3, num4);
				empty = DrawUtility.MeasureString(g, text, font, num6, stringFormat, drawStringFlags);
				if (num4 > num3)
				{
					empty.Width = num6;
				}
				if (empty.Width < (float)minWidth)
				{
					empty.Width = minWidth;
				}
				lineCount = 2;
				line1 = text2;
				line2 = text3;
				line1Size = Size.Ceiling(value);
				line2Size = Size.Ceiling(value2);
				totalTextSize = Size.Ceiling(empty);
			}

			private void Clear()
			{
				lineCount = 0;
				line1 = null;
				line2 = null;
				line1Size = Size.Empty;
				line2Size = Size.Empty;
				line2Size = Size.Empty;
			}

			private static string[] SplitWithSeparators(string text)
			{
				List<string> list = new List<string>();
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				char[] array = text.ToCharArray();
				char[] array2 = array;
				for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
				{
					char c = array2[i];
					switch (c)
					{
					case ' ':
						list.Add(stringBuilder.ToString());
						list.Add(c.ToString());
						stringBuilder.Length = 0;
						break;
					case '-':
						stringBuilder.Append(c);
						list.Add(stringBuilder.ToString());
						stringBuilder.Length = 0;
						break;
					default:
						stringBuilder.Append(c);
						break;
					}
				}
				list.Add(stringBuilder.ToString());
				return list.ToArray();
			}
		}

					}
					if (ownerInternal is PopupMenuTool)
					{
						PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool = (PopupMenuTool)ownerInternal;
						return popupMenuTool.SettingsResolved.ToolDisplayStyleResolved;
					}
					ApplicationMenuAreaBase owningApplicationMenuAreaBase = toolBase.OwningApplicationMenuAreaBase;
					if (owningApplicationMenuAreaBase != null)
					{
						return owningApplicationMenuAreaBase.SettingsResolved.ToolDisplayStyleResolved;
					}
				}
				return ToolDisplayStyle.DefaultForToolType;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public virtual Size DefaultSize
		{
			get
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager != null && toolbarsManager.TouchMetricsEnabledResolved)
				{
					return toolbarsManager.ImageSizeTouchSmall;
				}
				return new Size(16, 16);
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public bool EnabledResolved
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_014f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0155: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				ToolBase toolBase = UnderlyingTool;
				if (toolBase == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (this is SystemActionTool systemActionTool)
				{
					return systemActionTool.Enabled;
				}
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager != null && toolbarsManager.EnforceOffice2007Resolution)
				{
					if (ContainsAllDisabledItems)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (OwnerIsRibbonGroup && IsHiddenByMdiMerge && !AlwaysHiddenByMdiMerge)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				if ((toolbarsManager == null || toolbarsManager.IsDesignMode || !toolbarsManager.Customizing || toolbarsManager.CustomizeDialog is QuickToolCustomizer) && !toolBase.SharedProps.Enabled)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (IsControlContainer && toolbarsManager != null && !toolbarsManager.IsDesignMode && !(toolBase is PopupColorPickerTool) && Control == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (toolbarsManager != null && ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)toolbarsManager).Enabled)
				{
					if (OwnerIsRibbonGroup && toolbarsManager.EnforceOffice2007Resolution && !IsVisible(considerBumpedStatus: true, enforceResolution: false))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if ((Owner is QuickAccessToolbar || this is RibbonPinButtonTool) && !toolbarsManager.IsDesignMode)
					{
						Ribbon ribbon = toolbarsManager.Ribbon;
						if (ribbon != null && ribbon.FileMenuStyleResolved == FileMenuStyle.ApplicationMenu2010 && ribbon.HasApplicationMenu2010 && ribbon.ApplicationMenu2010.DisableQAT && ribbon.ApplicationMenu2010.IsOpen)
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
					if (this is RibbonPinButtonTool && Owner is RibbonTabItemToolbar && (int)toolbarsManager.StyleResolved == 8)
					{
						Ribbon ribbon2 = toolbarsManager.Ribbon;
						if ((ribbon2.HasApplicationMenu2010 && ribbon2.ApplicationMenu2010.IsOpen) || (ribbon2.HasApplicationMenu && ribbon2.ApplicationMenu.IsOpen))
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public int Height => CalculateHeightResolved(useCalculateLogicalSize: true);

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public int Index
		{
			get
			{
				if (parentCollection != null)
				{
					if (index >= 0 && index < parentCollection.Count && this == parentCollection.GetItem(index))
					{
						return index;
					}
					index = parentCollection.IndexOf(this);
					return index;
				}
				return -1;
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_ToolBase_P_Key")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Data")]
		[MergableProperty(false)]
		public override string Key
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Key;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_64"));
				}
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager != null && !toolbarsManager.IsDesignMode)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_54"));
				}
				if (Key.Equals(value))
				{
					return;
				}
				VerifyCanBeModified();
				ToolBase rootTool = SharedProps.RootTool;
				if (rootTool != null)
				{
					toolbarsManager?.Tools.ValidateKeyChange(rootTool, value);
				}
				base.Key = value;
				if (rootTool != null)
				{
					if (!IsRootTool)
					{
						rootTool.InternalSetKey(value);
					}
					foreach (ToolBase toolInstance in SharedProps.ToolInstances)
					{
						toolInstance.InternalSetKey(value);
					}
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Key);
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public bool SpringResolved
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_00a4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00aa: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				UltraToolbarBase owningToolbarInternal = OwningToolbarInternal;
				if ((owningToolbarInternal == null || owningToolbarInternal.OwningTaskPaneToolbar == null) && !OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
				{
					UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
					if (toolbarsManager.Customizing && (toolbarsManager.CustomizeDialog == null || toolbarsManager.CustomizeDialog.ExpandToolbarsToDisplayAllTools))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				if (!CanSetToolWidth)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (underlyingTool != null && underlyingTool != this)
				{
					return underlyingTool.SpringResolved;
				}
				if (this is TaskPaneToolbarMenuTool && owningToolbarInternal != null && owningToolbarInternal.OwningTaskPaneToolbar != null && owningToolbarInternal.OwningTaskPaneToolbar.ShowHeaderLabelInToolbar)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (instanceProps != null && instanceProps.ShouldSerializeSpring())
				{
					if ((int)instanceProps.Spring == 2)
					{
						return false;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return SharedProps.Spring;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public UIElement UIElement
		{
			get
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				object owner = Owner;
				object ownerInternal = OwnerInternal;
				if (ownerInternal is PopupMenuTool || owner is ApplicationMenuAreaBase)
				{
					return toolbarsManager.GetUIElement(typeof(PopupMenuItemUIElement), this);
				}
				if (ownerInternal is UltraToolbarBase)
				{
					if (IsOnVerticalToolbar)
					{
						return toolbarsManager.GetUIElement(GetVerticalToolbarUIElementType(), this);
					}
					return toolbarsManager.GetUIElement(GetToolbarUIElementType(), this);
				}
				if (owner is RibbonGroup)
				{
					return toolbarsManager.GetUIElement(GetRibbonToolUIElementType(), this);
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public virtual ToolBase UnderlyingTool
		{
			get
			{
				if (this is PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool)
				{
					if (!popupMenuTool.IsMdiChildMenu)
					{
						return this;
					}
					if (underlyingTool == null && !IsRootTool && sharedProps != null && sharedProps.RootTool != null && sharedProps.RootTool != this)
					{
						return sharedProps.RootTool.UnderlyingTool;
					}
				}
				if (underlyingTool != null)
				{
					return underlyingTool;
				}
				if (IsMdiMergeTool)
				{
					if (Tag is ToolsCollectionBase.MergeToolData mergeToolData)
					{
						return mergeToolData.ChildTool;
					}
					return null;
				}
				return this;
			}
		}

		internal bool AlignRightOnToolbar
		{

					return true;

		internal bool AlwaysHiddenByMdiMerge
		{
			get
			{
				MdiMergeState mdiMergeState = MdiMergeState;
				if (sharedProps != null && sharedProps.RootTool != null)
				{
					mdiMergeState = sharedProps.RootTool.MdiMergeState;
				}
				return (mdiMergeState & MdiMergeState.ReplacedByMdiMerge) == MdiMergeState.ReplacedByMdiMerge;
			}
		}

		internal bool AreTransitionsEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				ToolbarTransitionAreas toolbarTransitionAreas = ((ToolbarsManagerInControl != null) ? ToolbarsManagerInControl.TransitionAreasResolved : ToolbarTransitionAreas.None);
				switch (toolbarTransitionAreas)
				{
				case ToolbarTransitionAreas.None:
					return false;
				case ToolbarTransitionAreas.All:
					return true;
				default:
				{
					object owner = Owner;
					object ownerInternal = OwnerInternal;
					if (ownerInternal is PopupMenuTool || owner is ApplicationMenuAreaBase)
					{
						return (toolbarTransitionAreas & ToolbarTransitionAreas.MenuItems) != 0;
					}
					if (owner is RibbonGroup)
					{
						return (toolbarTransitionAreas & ToolbarTransitionAreas.RibbonTools) != 0;
					}
					if (!(ownerInternal is UltraToolbarBase ultraToolbarBase))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (ultraToolbarBase is QuickAccessToolbar || ultraToolbarBase is RibbonTabItemToolbar)
					{
						return (toolbarTransitionAreas & ToolbarTransitionAreas.RibbonTools) != 0;
					}
					if (ultraToolbarBase is ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar)
					{
						return (toolbarTransitionAreas & ToolbarTransitionAreas.MenuItems) != 0;
					}
					if (ultraToolbarBase.IsMainMenuBarInternal)
					{
						return (toolbarTransitionAreas & ToolbarTransitionAreas.MainMenuTools) != 0;
					}
					return (toolbarTransitionAreas & ToolbarTransitionAreas.ToolbarTools) != 0;
				}
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual bool DrawAsActive
		{
			get
			{
				if (!EnabledResolved)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (this is SystemMenuTool)
				{
					if (!OwnerIsMenuInternal)
					{
						return OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea;
					}
					return true;
				}
				if (ForceDrawAsActive)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (UltimateOwner is NavigationMenu navigationMenu && navigationMenu.ApplicationMenu2010.MenuAgent is BackStageMenuAgent { HasKeyNavigationManager: not false } backStageMenuAgent && backStageMenuAgent.KeyNavigationManager.IsFocused(this))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return IsActiveTool;
			}
		}

		internal virtual IKeyTipProvider DropDownKeyTipProvider => null;

		internal bool ForceDrawAsActive
		{
			get
			{
				return ToolBeingDisplayed.forceDrawAsActive;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ToolBeingDisplayed != this)
				{
					ToolBeingDisplayed.ForceDrawAsActive = value;
				}
				else
				{
					if (forceDrawAsActive == value)
					{
						return;
					}
					forceDrawAsActive = value;
					UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManagerInControl = ToolbarsManagerInControl;
					if (toolbarsManagerInControl != null)
					{
						if (forceDrawAsActive)
						{
							toolbarsManagerInControl.ToolForcedToDrawAsActive = this;
						}
						else if (toolbarsManagerInControl.ToolForcedToDrawAsActive == this)
						{
							toolbarsManagerInControl.ToolForcedToDrawAsActive = null;
						}
					}
					if (UIElement != null)
					{
						UIElement.DirtyChildElements();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal ParsedFormattedTextValue FormattedDescriptionOnMenuResolved
		{

				}
				return SharedProps.FormattedDescriptionOnMenu;
			}
		}

		internal bool HasFocus
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsActiveTool)
				{
					UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManagerInControl = ToolbarsManagerInControl;
					if (toolbarsManagerInControl.ToolWithFocus == this && toolbarsManagerInControl.IsFormActiveInternal)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				if (OwnerIsMenuInternal && OwningMenuInternal.MenuAgent != null && OwningMenuInternal.MenuAgent.ActiveMenuItem != null && OwningMenuInternal.ToolbarsManagerInControl.CurrentPopupControl == OwningMenuInternal.MenuAgent.PopupControl && this == OwningMenuInternal.MenuAgent.ActiveMenuItem.Tool)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal HotkeyPrefix HotkeyPrefix
		{
			get
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManagerInControl = ToolbarsManagerInControl;
				if (toolbarsManagerInControl != null && toolbarsManagerInControl.HasRibbon && toolbarsManagerInControl.Ribbon.VisibleResolved)
				{
					if (OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
					{
						return HotkeyPrefix.Hide;
					}
					if (Owner is RibbonTabItemToolbar || Owner is MiniToolbar || Owner is QuickAccessToolbar || Owner is UltraToolbar)
					{
						return HotkeyPrefix.Hide;
					}
				}
				return toolbarsManagerInControl?.HotkeyPrefix ?? HotkeyPrefix.Show;
			}
		}

		internal ImageList ImageList
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsMdiMergeTool && UnderlyingToolRaw != null)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase = null;
					try
					{
						toolBase = AttachToUnderlyingTool();
						return UnderlyingToolRaw.ImageList;
					}
					finally
					{
						toolBase?.AttachToUnderlyingTool();
					}
				}
				object ownerInternal = OwnerInternal;
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
				if (ownerInternal is PopupMenuTool || ownerInternal is ApplicationMenuAreaBase)
				{
					return toolbarsManager.GetImageList(UseLargeImagesOnMenuResolved);
				}
				if (ownerInternal is UltraToolbarBase)
				{
					return toolbarsManager.GetImageList(UseLargeImagesOnToolbarResolved);
				}
				if (ownerInternal is RibbonGroup)
				{
					bool largeImages = RibbonToolSizeInfo.Large.Equals(CurrentToolSizeInfo);
					return toolbarsManager.GetImageList(largeImages);
				}
				if (ownerInternal is UltraToolbarsManager)
				{
					return toolbarsManager.GetImageList(largeImages: false);
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal Size ImageSizeResolved
		{
			get
			{
				bool flag = ((CurrentToolSizeInfo != null) ? CurrentToolSizeInfo.UseLargeImages : ((!OwnerIsMenuInternal) ? UseLargeImagesOnToolbarResolved : UseLargeImagesOnMenuResolved));
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManagerInControl = ToolbarsManagerInControl;
				if (toolbarsManagerInControl != null)
				{
					if (IsOnQat && toolbarsManagerInControl.EnforceOffice2007Resolution)
					{
						return new Size(16, 16);
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						return toolbarsManagerInControl.ImageSizeSmallResolved;
					}
					return toolbarsManagerInControl.ImageSizeLargeResolved;
				}
				return new Size(16, 16);
			}
		}

		internal bool IsFirstVisibleTool
		{
			get
			{
				if (!VisibleResolved)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (parentCollection != null)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < parentCollection.Count; i++)
					{
						ToolBase toolBase = parentCollection[i];
						if (toolBase.VisibleResolved)
						{
							return toolBase == this;
						}
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsDesignMode => ToolbarsManager?.IsDesignMode ?? false;

		internal virtual bool IsLabelHeader => false;

		protected internal virtual bool IsHiddenByMdiMerge
		{
			get
			{
				ToolBase unsynchronizedTool = UnsynchronizedTool;
				if (unsynchronizedTool != this)
				{
					return unsynchronizedTool.IsHiddenByMdiMerge;
				}
				bool flag = (MdiMergeState & MdiMergeState.HiddenByMdiMerge) == MdiMergeState.HiddenByMdiMerge;
				if (flag && (!OwnerIsToolbarInternal || OwningToolbarInternal.ToolbarType != ToolbarType.Tearaway))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (IsMdiMergeTool && UnderlyingToolRaw == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (IsRootTool)
				{
					return flag;
				}
				if (sharedProps != null && sharedProps.RootTool != null)
				{
					return (sharedProps.RootTool.MdiMergeState & MdiMergeState.HiddenByMdiMerge) == MdiMergeState.HiddenByMdiMerge;
				}
				return false;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value)
				{
					MdiMergeState |= MdiMergeState.HiddenByMdiMerge;
				}
				else
				{
					MdiMergeState &= ~MdiMergeState.ReplacedByMdiMerge;
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsInstanceInherited
		{
			get
			{
				return isInstanceInherited;
			}
			set
			{
				isInstanceInherited = value;
				if (IsRootTool)
				{
					ToolsCollection toolInstances = SharedProps.ToolInstances;
					int i = 0;
					for (int count = toolInstances.Count; i < count; i++)
					{
						toolInstances[i].IsInstanceInherited = value;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsOnBackStage => UltimateOwner is NavigationMenu;

		internal bool IsOnQat
		{
			get
			{
				if (Owner is QuickAccessToolbar)
				{
					return true;
				}
				UltraToolbarBase owningToolbarInternal = OwningToolbarInternal;
				if (owningToolbarInternal != null && owningToolbarInternal.IsBumpedToolsToolbar)
				{
					if (!(owningToolbarInternal.MainRootToolbar is QuickAccessToolbar))
					{
						if (owningToolbarInternal.RootToolbars != null && owningToolbarInternal.RootToolbars.Length != 0)
						{
							return owningToolbarInternal.RootToolbars[0] is QuickAccessToolbar;
						}
						return false;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsOnVerticalToolbar
		{
			get
			{
				if (OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
				{
					return OwningToolbarInternal.IsVertical;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsOrientationSwitched => IsArrangedVertically != IsVertical;

			get
			{
				return isSerializing;
			}

				isSerializing = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsToolInEditMode
		{
			get
			{
				if (ToolbarsManager == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Editor == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!Editor.IsInEditMode)
				{
					return false;
				}
				ToolEditorAreaUIElement toolEditorAreaUIElement = Editor.ElementBeingEdited.OwnerContext as ToolEditorAreaUIElement;
				ToolBase tool = toolEditorAreaUIElement.Tool;
				if (tool != null && tool.SharedProps == SharedProps)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (tool != null && tool.IsMdiMergeTool)
				{
					tool = tool.UnderlyingTool;
				}
				if (tool != null)
				{
					return tool.SharedProps == SharedProps;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal LargeRibbonButtonTextInfoCache LargeRibbonButtonTextInfo
		{
			get
			{
				if (AttachedParentTool != null)
				{
					return AttachedParentTool.LargeRibbonButtonTextInfo;
				}
				if (!IsLargeRibbonTool)
				{
					largeRibbonButtonTextInfo = null;
				}
				return largeRibbonButtonTextInfo;
			}
			set
			{
				if (AttachedParentTool != null)

		internal virtual bool InstanceDisplaysImageInternal
		{
			get
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = UnderlyingTool;
				if (toolBase == null)
				{
					toolBase = this;
				}
				if (CurrentToolSizeInfo != null)
				{
					return CurrentToolSizeInfo.DisplayImage;
				}
				object owner = Owner;
				object ownerInternal = OwnerInternal;
				if (this is SystemActionTool || this is SystemMenuTool || this is TaskPaneToolbarLabelTool)
				{
					if (ownerInternal is PopupMenuTool || owner is ApplicationMenuAreaBase)
					{
						return toolBase.DefaultInstanceDisplaysImageOnMenus;
					}
					if (ownerInternal is UltraToolbarBase)
					{
						return toolBase.DefaultInstanceDisplaysImageOnToolbars;
					}
					return false;
				}
				if (ownerInternal is UltraToolbarBase && IsVertical)
				{
					PopupToolBase popupTool = PopupTool;
					if (popupTool != null && popupTool.DisplayDropDownArrowSegmented)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				switch (DisplayStyleResolved)
				{
				case ToolDisplayStyle.TextOnlyAlways:
					return false;
				case ToolDisplayStyle.ImageAndText:
					return true;
				case ToolDisplayStyle.TextOnlyInMenus:
					if (ownerInternal is PopupMenuTool || owner is ApplicationMenuAreaBase)
					{
						return false;
					}
					break;
				case ToolDisplayStyle.ImageOnlyOnToolbars:
					if (ownerInternal is UltraToolbarBase)
					{
						return true;
					}
					break;
				}
				if (ownerInternal is PopupMenuTool || owner is ApplicationMenuArea)
				{
					return toolBase.DefaultInstanceDisplaysImageOnMenus;
				}
				if (ownerInternal is NavigationMenu)
				{
					return toolBase.DefaultInstanceDisplaysImageOnNavigationMenu;
				}
				if (ownerInternal is UltraToolbarBase)
				{
					return toolBase.DefaultInstanceDisplaysImageOnToolbars;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

				case ToolDisplayStyle.ImageOnlyOnToolbars:
					if (ultraToolbarBase != null)

					}

				}
				if (ultraToolbarBase != null)
				{
					return toolBase.DefaultInstanceDisplaysTextOnToolbars;

		internal string KeyboardShortcut
		{
			get
			{
				if (!EnabledResolved || !VisibleResolved)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (!OwnerIsMenuInternal || !OwningMenuInternal.IsOpen || ToolbarsManagerInControl.CurrentPopupControl.MenuAgent != OwningMenuInternal.MenuAgent)
				{
					if (ShortcutResolved != Shortcut.None && UnderlyingTool != null)
					{
						return UnderlyingTool.SharedProps.ShortcutString;
					}
					return null;
				}
				if (InstanceProps == null || !InstanceDisplaysText)
				{
					return null;
				}
				string captionResolved = CaptionResolved;
				int num = captionResolved.IndexOf('&');
				if (num < 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				for (int num2 = num; num2 < captionResolved.Length - 2; num2 = num)
				{
					char c = captionResolved[num2 + 1];
					if (char.IsLetterOrDigit(c))
					{
						return new string(c, 1);
					}
					num = captionResolved.IndexOf('&', num2 + 2);
					if (num <= num2)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

				return ribbonToolSize;
			}
		}

		private RibbonToolSize PreferredSizeOnRibbonResolved
		{
			get
			{
				RibbonToolSize ribbonToolSize = (ShouldSerializeRibbonCustomizedPreferredSize() ? RibbonCustomizedPreferredSize : ((HasInstanceProps && instanceProps.ShouldSerializePreferredSizeOnRibbon()) ? instanceProps.PreferredSizeOnRibbon : ((!OwnerIsRibbonGroup || OwningRibbonGroup.PreferredToolSize == RibbonToolSize.Default) ? DefaultPreferredSizeOnRibbon : OwningRibbonGroup.PreferredToolSize)));
				if (ribbonToolSize == RibbonToolSize.Default)
				{
					ribbonToolSize = RibbonToolSize.Normal;
				}
				RibbonToolSize minimumSizeOnRibbonResolved = MinimumSizeOnRibbonResolved;
				if (minimumSizeOnRibbonResolved != ribbonToolSize)
				{
					switch (minimumSizeOnRibbonResolved)
					{
					case RibbonToolSize.Large:
						ribbonToolSize = RibbonToolSize.Large;
						break;
					case RibbonToolSize.Normal:
						if (ribbonToolSize == RibbonToolSize.ImageOnly)
						{
							ribbonToolSize = RibbonToolSize.Normal;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				return ribbonToolSize;
			}
		}

		protected ToolBase(string key)
		{
			if ((key == null || key.Length < 1) && !IsSpecialTool)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_64"));
			}
			base.Key = key;
		}

		int IComparable.CompareTo(object obj)
		{
			return CompareTo(obj as ToolBase);
		}

		protected virtual int CompareTo(ToolBase tool)
		{
			if (tool == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (tool == this)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int priority = tool.SharedProps.Priority;
			int priority2 = SharedProps.Priority;
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			if (tool.InstanceProps != null)
			{
				num = tool.ClickCount;
			}
			if (InstanceProps != null)
			{
				num2 = ClickCount;
			}
			ToolSortingPrecedence toolSortingPrecedence = ToolbarsManagerInControl.ToolSortingPrecedence;
			if (toolSortingPrecedence == ToolSortingPrecedence.PriorityBeforeUsageData || toolSortingPrecedence == ToolSortingPrecedence.PriorityOnly)
			{
				if (priority2 < priority)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (priority2 > priority)
				{
					return 1;
				}
			}
			if (toolSortingPrecedence == ToolSortingPrecedence.PriorityBeforeUsageData || toolSortingPrecedence == ToolSortingPrecedence.UsageDataBeforePriority)
			{
				if (num2 < num)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (num2 > num)
				{
					return 1;
				}
			}
			if (toolSortingPrecedence == ToolSortingPrecedence.UsageDataBeforePriority)
			{
				if (priority2 < priority)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (priority2 > priority)
				{
					return 1;
				}
			}
			if (tool.Index <= Index)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return 1;
		}

		protected ToolBase(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			//IL_04db: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_04ea: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_0506: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0515: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_051a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_07e5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_07ea: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "InstanceProps":
					instanceProps = (InstanceProps)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(InstanceProps), null);
					break;
				case "CustomizedCaption":

					break;
				case "CustomizedImage":
					customizedImage = (Image)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(Image), customizedImage);
					break;

		bool IKeyTipProvider.Activate()
		{
			if (!VisibleResolved)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
			{
				OwningRibbonGroup.Ribbon.SetNestedItemWithFocus(new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.RibbonTool, this), BringIntoViewOnKeyTipActivate);
			}
			if (OwningToolbarInternal is QuickAccessToolbar quickAccessToolbar)
			{
				quickAccessToolbar.Ribbon.SetNestedItemWithFocus(new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.QatTool, this), BringIntoViewOnKeyTipActivate);
			}
			if (OwningToolbarInternal is RibbonTabItemToolbar ribbonTabItemToolbar)
			{
				ribbonTabItemToolbar.Ribbon.SetNestedItemWithFocus(new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.TabItemToolbarTool, this), BringIntoViewOnKeyTipActivate);
			}
			return OnKeyTipActivate();
		}

		bool IKeyTipProvider.Equals(IKeyTipProvider provider)
		{
			if (provider == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (this == provider)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (GetType() != provider.GetType())
			{
				return false;
			}
			ToolBase toolBase = (ToolBase)provider;
			if (isClonedTool && ClonedFromTool == toolBase)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (toolBase.isClonedTool && toolBase.ClonedFromTool == this)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		IKeyTipContainer IKeyTipProvider.GetContainer()
		{
			return GetKeyTipContainer();
		}

		Rectangle INotificationBadgeProvider.GetNotificationBadgeBounds()
		{
			return NotificationBadgeBounds();
		}

		protected override void OnAddedToCollection(KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase collection)
		{
			if (collection is ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollectionBase && (!(toolsCollectionBase.Owner is QuickAccessToolbar) || ((QuickAccessToolbar)toolsCollectionBase.Owner).ContextMenuTools != toolsCollectionBase || !IsRootTool) && (toolsCollectionBase.OwnerIsToolbarsManager || toolsCollectionBase.OwnerIsPopupMenu || toolsCollectionBase.OwnerIsToolbar || toolsCollectionBase.Owner is RibbonGroup || toolsCollectionBase.Owner is ApplicationMenuAreaBase))
			{
				base.OnAddedToCollection(collection);
				parentCollection = toolsCollectionBase;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			UnhookUnderlyingTool();
			if (sharedProps != null)
			{
				if (IsRootTool)
				{
					sharedProps.Dispose();
				}
				sharedProps.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				sharedProps = null;
			}
			if (instanceProps != null)
			{
				instanceProps.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				instanceProps.Dispose();
				instanceProps = null;
			}
			clonedFromTool = null;
			attachedParentTool = null;
			parentCollection = null;
			unCustomizedParentCollection = null;
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			string text = Key;
			if (text != null && text.Length > 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("[");
				stringBuilder.Append(Key);
				stringBuilder.Append("] - ");
			}
			stringBuilder.Append(GetType().Name);
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected override void OnRemovedFromCollection(KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase collection)
		{
			base.OnRemovedFromCollection(collection);
			if (this is PopupToolBase popupToolBase)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollectionBase = collection as ToolsCollection;
				if (toolsCollectionBase != null)
				{
					UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = toolsCollectionBase.ToolbarsManager;
					if (toolbarsManager != null)
					{
						Ribbon ribbon = (toolbarsManager.HasRibbon ? toolbarsManager.Ribbon : null);
						if (ribbon != null && toolsCollectionBase != null && toolsCollectionBase.ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.HasApplicationMenu2010)
						{
							ApplicationMenu2010 applicationMenu = toolsCollectionBase.ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.ApplicationMenu2010;
							if (popupToolBase.IsOnBackStage)
							{
								flag = applicationMenu.BackStageManager.RemovePopupToolFromActiveContentList(popupToolBase);
							}
							else if (popupToolBase.IsRootTool)
							{
								int i = 0;
								for (int count = popupToolBase.SharedProps.ToolInstances.Count; i < count; i++)
								{
									PopupToolBase popupToolBase2 = popupToolBase.SharedProps.ToolInstances[i] as PopupToolBase;
									if (popupToolBase2.IsOnBackStage && applicationMenu.BackStageManager.RemovePopupToolFromActiveContentList(popupToolBase2))
									{
										flag = true;
									}
								}
								if (flag && applicationMenu.IsOpen)
								{
									applicationMenu.DirtyUIElement();
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (collection == parentCollection)
			{
				if (parentCollection != null && parentCollection.UnCustomizedTools != null && parentCollection.UnCustomizedTools.Contains(this))
				{
					CacheUnCustomizedInfo(parentCollection);
				}
				parentCollection = null;
			}
		}

		internal void SetToolWithContainedControl(bool takeControlOwnership, UltraToolbarsDockArea dockArea)
		{
			if (UnderlyingTool == null || !UnderlyingTool.IsControlContainer)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_66"));
			}
			ToolBase tool = null;
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null && dockArea != null)
			{
				toolbarsManager = dockArea.ToolbarsManager;
			}
			if (toolbarsManager == null || !toolbarsManager.Initializing)
			{
				if (toolbarsManager != null)
				{
					tool = ((!takeControlOwnership) ? toolbarsManager.InternalSetToolWithControlHelper(null, SharedProps.RootTool, dockArea) : toolbarsManager.InternalSetToolWithControlHelper(this, SharedProps.RootTool, dockArea));
				}
				if (IsContainedControlShared)
				{
					InternalSetToolWithContainedControl(tool);
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public ToolBase AttachToUnderlyingTool()
		{
			if (!IsMdiMergeTool)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ToolBase underlyingToolRaw = UnderlyingToolRaw;
			if (underlyingToolRaw == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ToolBase result = underlyingToolRaw.InternalAttach(this);
			if (underlyingTool != null && underlyingTool != underlyingToolRaw)
			{
				underlyingTool.InternalAttach(this);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void BringIntoView()
		{
			if (OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
			{
				OwningRibbonGroup.Ribbon.BringIntoView(this);
			}
			else if (OwnerIsMenuInternal)
			{
				OwningMenuInternal.BringIntoView(this);
			}
			else if (OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)
			{
				OwningApplicationMenuArea.ApplicationMenu.BringIntoView(this);
			}
			else if (OwningToolbarInternal is ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar)
			{
				((ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar)OwningToolbarInternal).ApplicationMenu.BringIntoView(this);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void DirtyMetrics()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager != null && !toolbarsManager.Loading)
			{
				ToolBase rootTool = SharedProps.RootTool;
				if (rootTool != null && rootTool.IsRootTool)
				{
					ToolBase parentRootTool = toolbarsManager.GetParentRootTool(rootTool);
					if (parentRootTool != this)
					{
						parentRootTool.SharedProps.BumpMetricsVersion();
					}
				}
			}
			SharedProps.BumpMetricsVersion();
		}

		internal virtual void AddMenuItems(ToolBase tool, MenuItemsCollection menuItems, MenuItemBase[] oldMenuItems)

		internal int CalculateHeightResolved(bool useCalculateLogicalSize)
		{
			if (UnderlyingTool != null)
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = null;
				try
				{
					toolBase = AttachToUnderlyingTool();

					if (toolBase2.IsOrientationSwitched && toolBase2.CanSetToolWidth)
					{
						int num = 0;
						if (toolBase2.SpringWidth > 0)
						{
							num = toolBase2.SpringWidth;
						}
						else if (toolBase2.instanceProps != null && toolBase2.instanceProps.ShouldSerializeWidth())
						{
							num = toolBase2.instanceProps.Width;
						}
						else if (toolBase2.SharedProps.ShouldSerializeWidth())
						{
							num = toolBase2.SharedProps.Width;
						}

							return Math.Max(num, toolBase2.MinWidthResolved);

			return 0;
		}

		internal bool EnterEditMode(EnterEditModeSource source, bool throwExceptions, bool ensureToolIsActive)
		{
			if (ToolbarsManagerInControl == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!CanEnterEditMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsToolInEditMode)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ensureToolIsActive)
			{
				VerifyOwnerElements();
				IsActiveTool = true;
				if (!IsActiveTool)
				{
					if (throwExceptions)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_49"));
					}
					return false;
				}
			}
			UIElement val = UIElement;
			if (throwExceptions && val == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_50"));
			}
			if (val != null)
			{
				val = val.GetDescendant(typeof(EmbeddableUIElementBase));
			}
			if (val != null)
			{
				EmbeddableEditorBase editor = Editor;
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManagerInControl = ToolbarsManagerInControl;
				bool flag = toolbarsManagerInControl.IsSharedToolEditor(editor);
				if (!flag)
				{
					toolbarsManagerInControl.HookEditorEvents(editor);
				}
				ToolBase toolEnteringEditMode = toolbarsManagerInControl.ToolEnteringEditMode;
				toolbarsManagerInControl.ToolEnteringEditMode = this;
				bool flag2 = false;
				try
				{
					flag2 = editor.EnterEditMode((EmbeddableUIElementBase)(object)((val is EmbeddableUIElementBase) ? val : null));
				}
				finally
				{
					toolbarsManagerInControl.ToolEnteringEditMode = toolEnteringEditMode;
				}
				if (!flag2)
				{
					if (!flag)
					{
						toolbarsManagerInControl.UnhookEditorEvents(editor);
					}
				}
				else if (editor.IsInEditMode && editor.SupportsSelectableText && source != EnterEditModeSource.ClickOnEditor)
				{
					editor.SelectionStart = 0;
					editor.SelectionLength = editor.TextLength;
				}
				if (flag2 && editor.IsInEditMode && OwnerIsMenuInternal && OwningMenuInternal.IsOpen)
				{
					(OwningMenuInternal.MenuAgent?.GetMenuItemFromTool(this))?.Activate();
				}
				if (flag2 && editor.IsInEditMode && OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea && OwningApplicationMenuArea.ApplicationMenu.IsOpen)
				{
					(OwningApplicationMenuArea.ApplicationMenu.MenuAgent?.GetMenuItemFromTool(this))?.Activate();
				}
			}
			return IsToolInEditMode;
		}

		internal bool ExitEditMode(bool forceExit, bool applyChanges)
		{
			if (!IsToolInEditMode)
			{
				return true;
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManagerInControl = ToolbarsManagerInControl;
			if (toolbarsManagerInControl != null && toolbarsManagerInControl.IsInBeforeExitEditMode)
			{
				if (forceExit)
				{
					toolbarsManagerInControl.IsForceExitRequested = true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (Editor.IsDroppedDown && (OwnerIsMenuInternal || OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea))
			{
				Editor.CloseUp();
			}
			if (!IsToolInEditMode)
			{
				return true;
			}
			bool isToolExitingEditMode = false;
			if (toolbarsManagerInControl != null)
			{
				isToolExitingEditMode = toolbarsManagerInControl.IsToolExitingEditMode;
				toolbarsManagerInControl.IsToolExitingEditMode = true;
			}
			try
			{
				return Editor.ExitEditMode(forceExit, applyChanges);
			}
			finally
			{
				if (toolbarsManagerInControl != null)
				{
					toolbarsManagerInControl.IsToolExitingEditMode = isToolExitingEditMode;
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual void GetKeyTipLocationInfo(out Point location, out System.Drawing.ContentAlignment alignment)
		{
			location = Point.Empty;
			alignment = System.Drawing.ContentAlignment.TopLeft;
			ToolBase toolBeingDisplayed = ToolBeingDisplayed;
			UIElement uIElement = toolBeingDisplayed.UIElement;
			if (uIElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle rectangle = uIElement.Control.RectangleToScreen(uIElement.Rect);
			int y = rectangle.Y;
			int num = int.MinValue;
			if (toolBeingDisplayed.OwnerIsMenu || toolBeingDisplayed.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea || toolBeingDisplayed.OwningToolbarInternal is ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar || toolBeingDisplayed.IsOnBackStage)
			{
				y = (rectangle.Top + rectangle.Bottom) / 2;
			}
			else if (toolBeingDisplayed.OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
			{
				RibbonGroup owningRibbonGroup = toolBeingDisplayed.OwningRibbonGroup;
				RibbonGroupLayoutItem currentToolLayout = owningRibbonGroup.GetCurrentToolLayout(onlyIfOpen: false);
				if (currentToolLayout != null)
				{
					y = owningRibbonGroup.GetKeyTipCenterLine(currentToolLayout.GetKeyTipToolRowNumber(toolBeingDisplayed));
					if (toolBeingDisplayed.CurrentToolSizeInfo.Equals(RibbonToolSizeInfo.Large))
					{
						num = (rectangle.Left + rectangle.Right) / 2;
						alignment = System.Drawing.ContentAlignment.MiddleCenter;
					}
					else
					{
						alignment = System.Drawing.ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft;
					}
				}
			}
			if (num == int.MinValue)
			{
				Rectangle imageRect = GetImageRect();
				if (imageRect.IsEmpty || toolBeingDisplayed.OwningToolbarInternal is ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar)
				{
					num = (rectangle.Left + rectangle.Right) / 2;
				}
				else
				{
					num = (imageRect.Left + imageRect.Right) / 2;
					if (toolBeingDisplayed.OwnerIsApplicationMenu2010ContentArea)
					{
						y = rectangle.Top - 2;
						num = imageRect.Right;
						alignment = System.Drawing.ContentAlignment.TopCenter;
					}
					else if (toolBeingDisplayed.IsOnBackStage && uIElement is PopupMenuItemUIElement popupMenuItemUIElement)
					{
						popupMenuItemUIElement.GetImageRect(out var hasImage);
						if (hasImage)
						{
							alignment = System.Drawing.ContentAlignment.BottomLeft;
						}
						else
						{
							num = imageRect.Left;
							alignment = System.Drawing.ContentAlignment.BottomRight;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			location = new Point(num, y);
		}

				{
					((ImageAndTextButtonUIElement)buttonToolUIElement).Image = image;
					if (OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
					{
						ToolbarStyle styleResolved = toolbarsManagerInControl.StyleResolved;
						switch (styleResolved - 1)
						{
						case 0:
						case 6:
						case 7:
						case 8:
							((ImageAndTextButtonUIElement)buttonToolUIElement).ImagePadding = new Size(2, 2);
							break;
						case 3:
							((ImageAndTextButtonUIElement)buttonToolUIElement).ImagePadding = new Size(0, 2);
							break;
						default:
							((ImageAndTextButtonUIElement)buttonToolUIElement).ImagePadding = new Size(1, 2);
							break;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						((ImageAndTextButtonUIElement)buttonToolUIElement).ImagePadding = new Size(2, 2);
					}
					((ImageAndTextButtonUIElement)buttonToolUIElement).ReserveShadowSpace = toolbarsManagerInControl.ShouldToolImagesReserveShadowSpace;
					if (this is SystemActionTool)
					{
						((ImageAndTextButtonUIElement)buttonToolUIElement).ScaleImage = (ScaleImage)0;
					}
					else
					{
						((ImageAndTextButtonUIElement)buttonToolUIElement).ScaledImageSize = ImageSizeResolved;
						((ImageAndTextButtonUIElement)buttonToolUIElement).ScaleImage = (ScaleImage)(toolbarsManagerInControl.ShouldScaleImage(image.Size, ((ImageAndTextButtonUIElement)buttonToolUIElement).ScaledImageSize) ? 1 : 0);
					}
					((ImageUIElementBase)((ImageAndTextButtonUIElementBase)buttonToolUIElement).ImageAndTextElement.ImageElement).ColorMaps = tool.GetColorRemapTable(((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).Image, isOnToolbar: true, isHotTracked);
				}
			}
			return (UIElement)(object)buttonToolUIElement;
		}

		internal int IncrementClickCount()
		{
			if (OwnerIsToolbarInternal && OwningToolbarInternal.RootToolbars != null && ClonedFromTool != null && ClonedFromTool.InstanceProps != null)
			{
				int result = ClonedFromTool.IncrementClickCount();
				if (ClonedFromTool.OwningToolbarInternal is UltraToolbar toolbarBase)
				{
					ToolbarsManager.GetToolbarDockArea(toolbarBase)?.MakeRoomJustClickedTool(ClonedFromTool);
				}
				return result;
			}
			return ++clickCount;
		}

		protected internal virtual void InitializeFrom(ToolBase sourceTool, bool cloneNewInstance)
		{
			//IL_013d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0142: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0149: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_014e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_02f8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_02fd: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!isCopyingToolSettings && !sourceTool.isCopyingToolSettings)
			{
				clonedFromTool = sourceTool;
				if (cloneNewInstance)
				{
					isClonedTool = true;
				}
				if (cloneNewInstance)
				{
					underlyingTool = sourceTool.underlyingTool;

				if (cloneNewInstance && !sourceTool.isCloningForRootTool)
				{
					InternalSetSharedProps(sourceTool.SharedProps);
				}
				else
				{
					InternalSetSharedProps(sourceTool.SharedProps.Clone(this), sourceTool.isCloningForRootTool);
				}
				if (sourceTool.isCloningForMenuInstance)
				{
					InternalSetInstanceProps(sourceTool.InstanceProps);
				}
				else if (sourceTool.instanceProps != null && !sourceTool.isCloningForRootTool)
				{
					InternalSetInstanceProps(sourceTool.instanceProps.Clone(this));
				}
			}
			else

					SharedProps.InitializeFrom(sourceTool.SharedProps);
				}

					InstanceProps.InitializeFrom(sourceTool.InstanceProps);

				else if (HasInstanceProps)

		{

				this.instanceProps.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;

		internal void InternalSetUnderlyingTool(ToolBase underlyingMdiChildTool)
		{
			if ((underlyingMdiChildTool != null && underlyingMdiChildTool.ToolbarsManager != ToolbarsManager.ActiveMdiChildManager) || underlyingMdiChildTool == underlyingTool)
			{
				return;
			}
			OnBeforeSetUnderlyingTool(underlyingMdiChildTool);
			if (underlyingMdiChildTool == null)
			{
				if (IsRootTool)
				{
					foreach (ToolBase toolInstance in SharedProps.ToolInstances)
					{
						if (!toolInstance.IsRootTool)
						{
							toolInstance.InternalSetUnderlyingTool(null);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ToolTypeID toolTypeIDFromType = ToolTypeID.GetToolTypeIDFromType(underlyingMdiChildTool.GetType());
				if (underlyingToolTypeID == null)
				{
					underlyingToolTypeID = toolTypeIDFromType;
				}
				if (underlyingToolTypeID != toolTypeIDFromType)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			UnhookUnderlyingTool();
			underlyingTool = underlyingMdiChildTool;
			if (underlyingTool != null)
			{
				if (IsRootTool)
				{
					foreach (ToolBase toolInstance2 in SharedProps.ToolInstances)
					{
						if (!toolInstance2.IsRootTool && toolInstance2.IsMdiMergeTool)
						{
							toolInstance2.VerifyUnderlyingToolOnMerge();
						}
					}
				}
				else if (IsMdiMergeTool)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase = ToolbarsManager.MergedTools[((IKeyedSubObjectEx)underlyingTool).KeyLowercaseInterned, UnderlyingToolTypeID];
					PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool = this as PopupMenuTool;
					if (toolBase == null || (popupMenuTool != null && popupMenuTool.IsReplacedByMdiChildMenu))
					{
						ToolBase toolBase2 = ToolbarsManager.Tools[((IKeyedSubObjectEx)underlyingTool).KeyLowercaseInterned];
						if (toolBase2 != null && toolBase2.UnderlyingToolTypeID == UnderlyingToolTypeID)
						{
							toolBase = toolBase2;
						}
					}
					if (toolBase != null)
					{
						InternalSetSharedProps(toolBase.SharedProps);
					}
					if (underlyingTool.AttachedParentTool == null)
					{
						AttachToUnderlyingTool();
					}
					if (!underlyingTool.IsRootTool)
					{
						InternalSetInstanceProps(underlyingTool.InstanceProps);
					}
				}
				HookUnderlyingTool();
			}
			else if (this is MdiMergePlaceholderTool && instanceProps != null && instanceProps.Tool != null && !(instanceProps.Tool is MdiMergePlaceholderTool))
			{
				InternalSetInstanceProps(null);
			}
		}

		internal void InternalSetSharedProps(SharedProps sharedProps, bool isForRootTool)
		{
			if (this.sharedProps != sharedProps)
			{
				if (this.sharedProps != null)
				{
					this.sharedProps.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				this.sharedProps = sharedProps;
				if (!isForRootTool)
				{
					if (this.sharedProps.ToolInstances.IndexOf(this) < 0)
					{
						this.sharedProps.ToolInstances.AddHelper(this, honorReadOnlyStatus: false, -1);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					this.sharedProps.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
			}
			if (UnderlyingTool is PopupMenuTool && !IsMdiMergeTool)
			{
				PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool = this as PopupMenuTool;
				if (IsRootTool || popupMenuTool.HasToolsCollectionBeenCreated)
				{
					popupMenuTool.HookupToolsSharedProps();
				}
			}
			else if (OwnerIsToolbarInternal && UnderlyingTool is ControlContainerTool { ToolWithContainedControl: null })
			{
				UltraToolbarsDockArea toolbarDockArea = ToolbarsManager.GetToolbarDockArea(OwningToolbarInternal);
				if (toolbarDockArea != null)
				{
					SetToolWithContainedControl(takeControlOwnership: true, toolbarDockArea);
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsMnemonic(char charCode)
		{
			if (!EnabledResolved || InstanceProps == null || !InstanceDisplaysText || !VisibleResolved)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Control.IsMnemonic(charCode, CaptionResolved);
		}

		internal bool IsSameLogicalTool(ToolBase toolToCompare)
		{
			if (toolToCompare == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (GetType() != toolToCompare.GetType())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (UnderlyingToolTypeID != toolToCompare.UnderlyingToolTypeID)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (sharedProps != toolToCompare.sharedProps)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ToolbarsManager == toolToCompare.ToolbarsManager;
		}

		internal bool IsShortcutKey(int keyCode, Keys modifierKeys)
		{
			Shortcut shortcutResolved = ShortcutResolved;
			if (shortcutResolved == Shortcut.None || !EnabledResolved)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (((uint)modifierKeys & (uint)shortcutResolved) != (uint)modifierKeys)
			{
				return false;
			}
			shortcutResolved = (Shortcut)((int)shortcutResolved & (int)(~modifierKeys));
			return shortcutResolved == (Shortcut)keyCode;
		}
