		}

		private bool IsVisible(bool considerBumpedStatus, bool enforceResolution)
		{
			//IL_011a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0120: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_01fd: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0203: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_01cb: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01d1: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_01e7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01ed: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (IsMdiMergeTool)
			{
				if (UnderlyingToolRaw == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Owner is QuickAccessToolbar quickAccessToolbar && quickAccessToolbar.IsMergedContextMenuToolHidden(this))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (IsHiddenByMdiMerge && (AlwaysHiddenByMdiMerge || !ToolbarsManagerInControl.EnforceOffice2007Resolution || !OwnerIsRibbonGroup))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!IsVisibleOnToolbars && OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (RequiresOffice2007Support && !toolbarsManager.SupportsOffice2007ViewStyle)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!IsVisibleOnRibbonGroup && OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (enforceResolution && OwnerIsRibbonGroup && toolbarsManager.EnforceOffice2007Resolution)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!SharedProps.Visible)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!IsVisibleOnMenus && OwnerIsMenuInternal)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (toolbarsManager.Customizing && (toolbarsManager.CustomizeDialog == null || toolbarsManager.CustomizeDialog.ExpandToolbarsToDisplayAllTools))
			{
				if (considerBumpedStatus && OwnerIsToolbarInternal && OwningToolbarInternal.BumpToolsWhenCustomizing && !OwningToolbarInternal.IsBumpedToolsToolbar)
				{
					return !bumpedFromToolbar;
				}
				return true;
			}
			if ((int)CustomizedVisible == 2 && OwnerIsToolbar && OwningToolbar.TearawayToolOwner == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (considerBumpedStatus && BumpedFromToolbar)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ToolBase toolBase = UnderlyingTool;
			if (toolBase != null && toolBase.InstanceProps != null)
			{
				if (toolBase.OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
				{
					if (toolBase.IsVertical && !toolBase.IsVisibleOnVerticalToolbars)
					{
						return false;
					}
					UltraToolbarBase owningToolbarInternal = toolBase.OwningToolbarInternal;
					if (owningToolbarInternal.IsBumpedToolsToolbar && owningToolbarInternal.MainRootToolbar != null && owningToolbarInternal.MainRootToolbar.QuickCustomizeTool != null && !owningToolbarInternal.MainRootToolbar.QuickCustomizeTool.IsOpen && !owningToolbarInternal.MainRootToolbar.QuickCustomizeTool.IsOpening)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				if (ShouldSerializeRibbonCustomizedVisibility())
				{
					return (int)RibbonCustomizedVisibility == 1;
				}
				if (toolBase.instanceProps.ShouldSerializeVisible() && (int)toolBase.instanceProps.Visible == 2)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (toolBase != null)
			{
				if (ShouldSerializeRibbonCustomizedVisibility())
				{
					return (int)RibbonCustomizedVisibility == 1;
				}
				if (toolBase.SharedProps.ShouldSerializeVisible() && !toolBase.SharedProps.Visible)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (toolBase.ToolbarsManager == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (considerBumpedStatus)
				{
					return !BumpedFromToolbar;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool IsVisibleOnMenu(PopupMenuTool tool)
		{
			if (this is NewToolPlaceHolderTool)
			{
				return true;
			}
			TaskPaneTool taskPaneTool = this as TaskPaneTool;
			if (tool is TaskPaneToolbarMenuTool)
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = UnderlyingTool;
				if (taskPaneTool == null)
				{
					if (this is MdiMergePlaceholderTool)
					{
						if (toolBase != null)
						{
							return toolBase is TaskPaneTool;
						}
						return true;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (taskPaneTool != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return IsVisibleOnMenus;
		}

		internal virtual bool IsVisibleOnToolbar(UltraToolbarBase toolbar)
		{
			if (toolbar == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (toolbar.OwningTaskPaneToolbar != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return IsVisibleOnToolbars;
		}

		internal bool IsWithinOwner(object owner)
		{
			if (owner != null)
			{
				object obj = OwnerInternal;
				if (owner.Equals(obj))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (owner is RibbonTab && OwnerIsRibbonGroup && owner.Equals(OwningRibbonGroup.Tab))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (owner is Ribbon)
				{
					if (OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
					{
						if (!(OwningToolbarInternal is QuickAccessToolbar))
						{
							return OwningToolbarInternal is RibbonTabItemToolbar;
						}
						return true;
					}
				}
				if (obj is RibbonGroup ribbonGroup)
				{
					obj = ribbonGroup.OwningPopupTool;
				}
				ToolBase toolBase = obj as ToolBase;
				if (toolBase == null && obj is UltraToolbarBase { IsBumpedToolsToolbar: not false } ultraToolbarBase)
				{
					toolBase = ultraToolbarBase.MainRootToolbar.QuickCustomizeTool;
				}
				if (toolBase != null && toolBase.IsWithinOwner(owner))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		}

		internal ToolsCollectionBase.MergeToolData MergeWithChildInstanceTool(MenuMergeType mergeType, ToolBase childTool, List<ToolBase> parentTools, ref int parentToolsIndex)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			switch (mergeType)
			{
			case MenuMergeType.Add:
				IsHiddenByMdiMerge = false;
				if (IsMdiMergeTool)
				{
					InternalSetUnderlyingTool(childTool);
				}
				else
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				break;
			case MenuMergeType.MergeItems:
				IsHiddenByMdiMerge = false;
				break;
			case MenuMergeType.Replace:
				if (IsMdiMergeTool)
				{
					IsHiddenByMdiMerge = false;
					if (this is MdiMergePlaceholderTool)
					{
						InternalSetInstanceProps(childTool.InstanceProps);
					}
					InternalSetUnderlyingTool(childTool);
				}
				else
				{
					IsHiddenByMdiMerge = true;
					flag = true;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (parentToolsIndex < parentTools.Count - 1)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase = parentTools[parentToolsIndex + 1];
					if (ToolsCollectionBase.ToolMergeComparer.Instance.Compare(this, toolBase) == 0)
					{
						parentToolsIndex++;
						return toolBase.MergeWithChildInstanceTool(mergeType, childTool, parentTools, ref parentToolsIndex);
					}
				}
				bool flag2 = mergeType == MenuMergeType.Replace;
				ToolBase toolBase2 = (flag2 ? this : null);
				if (flag2)
				{
					toolBase2.WasReplacedDuringMerge = true;
				}
				return new ToolsCollectionBase.MergeToolData(childTool, toolBase2, mergeType, flag2);
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal virtual void MergeWithChildRootTool(MenuMergeType mergeType, ToolBase childRootTool, out bool isMergeToolRequired)
		{
			switch (mergeType)
			{
			case MenuMergeType.Add:
				isMergeToolRequired = true;
				break;
			case MenuMergeType.MergeItems:
				isMergeToolRequired = false;
				break;
			case MenuMergeType.Remove:
				IsHiddenByMdiMerge = true;
				isMergeToolRequired = false;
				break;
			default:
				MdiMergeState |= MdiMergeState.ReplacedByMdiMerge;
				isMergeToolRequired = true;
				break;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnActivate()
		{
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			ToolBase toolBeingDisplayed = ToolBeingDisplayed;
			if (!toolBeingDisplayed.OwnerIsMenuInternal && toolBeingDisplayed.AreTransitionsEnabled && (int)toolBeingDisplayed.ToolbarsManager.StyleResolved == 6)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = toolBeingDisplayed.UIElement;
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					uIElement.InitiateTransition(UltraToolbarsManager.DefaultTransitionSettings, (UIElementTransitionType)0);
				}
			}
			if (toolBeingDisplayed.OwnerIsToolbarBase)
			{
				toolBeingDisplayed.OwningToolbarBase.OnToolActivated(toolBeingDisplayed);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnDeactivate()
		{
			if (Editor != null && Editor.IsInEditMode)
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = ((UIElement)Editor.ElementBeingEdited).GetContext(typeof(ToolBase)) as ToolBase;
				if (toolBase == this)
				{
					ExitEditMode(forceExit: true, applyChanges: true);
				}
			}
			if (!OwnerIsMenuInternal && AreTransitionsEnabled)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = UIElement;
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					uIElement.InitiateTransition(UltraToolbarsManager.DefaultTransitionSettings, (UIElementTransitionType)0);
				}
			}
			DirtyOwnerElements();
		}

		protected internal virtual bool OnMnemonicPressed()
		{
			PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool = this as PopupMenuTool;
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (popupMenuTool != null && !popupMenuTool.DisplayDropDownArrowSegmented && toolbarsManager.ActiveTool != this)
			{
				toolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(this, setOn: true, clearToolBeingEdited: true);
				if (toolbarsManager.ActiveTool != this)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
				{
					toolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture = OwningToolbarInternal;
				}
				else if (OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
				{
					toolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture = OwningRibbonGroup;
				}
				else if (OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)
				{
					toolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture = OwningApplicationMenuArea;
				}
			}
			OnToolClick();
			return true;
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnValueChanged()
		{
			if (Editor == null || !Editor.IsInEditMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			ToolBase toolBase = ((UIElement)Editor.ElementBeingEdited).GetContext(typeof(ToolBase)) as ToolBase;
			if (toolBase == this)
			{
				if (UnderlyingTool is ComboBoxTool comboBoxTool)
				{
					comboBoxTool?.InternalSetText(Editor.CurrentEditText);
					comboBoxTool.Value = Editor.Value;
				}
				else if (Editor.IsValid)
				{
					EditValue = Editor.Value;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ResolveAppearanceHelper(bool resolveAsMenu, bool resolveAsToolbar, bool editArea, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, bool drawAsActive, bool drawAsPressed, bool largeImages, object context)
		{
			UIRole val = null;
			val = (resolveAsMenu ? UIRoleOnMenus : (resolveAsToolbar ? UIRoleOnToolbars : ((!OwnerIsRibbonGroup) ? UIRoleOnMenus : UIRoleOnRibbonGroups)));
			ResolveAppearanceHelper(resolveAsMenu, resolveAsToolbar, editArea, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, drawAsActive, drawAsPressed, largeImages, context, val, null);
		}

		internal void ResolveAppearanceHelper(bool resolveAsMenu, bool resolveAsToolbar, bool editArea, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, bool drawAsActive, bool drawAsPressed, bool largeImages, object context, UIRole role, MenuItemBase menuItem)
		{
			//IL_01ad: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01cb: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_024f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0251: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0253: Expected I8, but got Unknown
			ToolbarSettingsBase toolbarSettingsBase = null;
			SettingsBase settingsBase = null;
			RibbonGroupSettings ribbonGroupSettings = null;
			if (resolveAsMenu)
			{
				settingsBase = OwnerSettings as MenuSettings;
				if (settingsBase == null)
				{
					settingsBase = OwnerSettings as ApplicationMenuAreaSettings;
				}
			}
			else if (resolveAsToolbar)
			{
				if (OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
				{
					toolbarSettingsBase = OwningToolbarInternal.SettingsInternal;
				}
			}
			else if (OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
			{
				ribbonGroupSettings = OwnerSettings as RibbonGroupSettings;
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManagerInControl = ToolbarsManagerInControl;
			if (editArea)
			{
				UIRole uIRoleForEditArea = UIRoleForEditArea;
				if (uIRoleForEditArea != null)
				{
					role = uIRoleForEditArea;
				}
			}
			if (role == null)
			{
				role = (resolveAsMenu ? StyleUtils.GetRole(toolbarsManagerInControl, StyleUtils.Role.MenuItem) : (resolveAsToolbar ? StyleUtils.GetRole(toolbarsManagerInControl, StyleUtils.Role.ToolbarItem) : ((!OwnerIsRibbonGroup) ? StyleUtils.GetRole(toolbarsManagerInControl, StyleUtils.Role.MenuItem) : StyleUtils.GetRole(toolbarsManagerInControl, StyleUtils.Role.RibbonGroupItem))));
			}
			if (resolveAsMenu && settingsBase == null)
			{
				toolbarsManagerInControl.ResolvePopupItemAppearance(null, role, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, drawAsActive, menuItem);
				return;
			}
			ToolBase toolBase = UnderlyingTool;
			if (toolBase == null)
			{
				if (OwnerIsToolbarInternal && !resolveAsMenu)
				{
					toolbarsManagerInControl.ResolveToolbarAppearance(OwningToolbarInternal, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
				else if (resolveAsMenu)
				{
					toolbarsManagerInControl.ResolvePopupItemAppearance(null, role, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, drawAsActive, menuItem);
				}
				return;
			}
			ToolBase toolBase2 = null;
			if (IsMdiMergeTool)
			{
				toolBase2 = AttachToUnderlyingTool();
			}
			UIRole val = null;
			val = ((menuItem == null || menuItem.MenuAgent == null) ? OwnerUIRoleInternal : menuItem.MenuAgent.UIRole);
			UltraToolbarBase owningToolbarInternal = OwningToolbarInternal;
			SettingsBase ownerSettings;
			if (settingsBase != null)
			{
				ownerSettings = settingsBase;
			}
			else if (resolveAsMenu || owningToolbarInternal == null || !(owningToolbarInternal.TearawayToolOwnerInternal is PopupMenuTool))
			{
				ownerSettings = ((toolbarSettingsBase != null) ? toolbarSettingsBase : ((ribbonGroupSettings != null) ? ribbonGroupSettings : ((!OwnerIsToolbarsManager) ? OwnerSettings : null)));
			}
			else
			{
				PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool = owningToolbarInternal.TearawayToolOwnerInternal as PopupMenuTool;
				ownerSettings = popupMenuTool.Settings;
			}
			ResolveAppearancePhaseInfo phaseInfo = new ResolveAppearancePhaseInfo(role, val, toolbarsManagerInControl, ownerSettings, StyleUtils.GetResolutionOrder(toolbarsManagerInControl), editArea, drawAsActive, drawAsPressed, largeImages, this, context);
			try
			{
				AppearancePropFlags val2 = (AppearancePropFlags)((long)requestedProps & 0x2000000L);
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFDFFFFFFuL);
				if ((long)requestedProps != 0L)
				{
					phaseInfo.SetPhase(AppearanceResolutionPhase.Initial);
					toolBase.ResolveAppearancePhase(ref phaseInfo, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
				if (drawAsActive && (long)requestedProps != 0L)
				{
					phaseInfo.SetPhase(AppearanceResolutionPhase.HotTrack);
					toolBase.ResolveAppearancePhase(ref phaseInfo, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
				if (drawAsPressed && (long)requestedProps != 0L)
				{
					phaseInfo.SetPhase(AppearanceResolutionPhase.Pressed);
					toolBase.ResolveAppearancePhase(ref phaseInfo, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
				if ((long)requestedProps != 0L)
				{
					phaseInfo.SetPhase(AppearanceResolutionPhase.Tool);
					toolBase.ResolveAppearancePhase(ref phaseInfo, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)(long)(requestedProps | val2);
				if ((long)requestedProps != 0L)
				{
					phaseInfo.SetPhase(AppearanceResolutionPhase.ToolOwner);
					toolBase.ResolveAppearancePhase(ref phaseInfo, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
				if ((long)requestedProps != 0L)
				{
					phaseInfo.SetPhase(AppearanceResolutionPhase.Final);
					toolBase.ResolveAppearancePhase(ref phaseInfo, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				toolBase2?.AttachToUnderlyingTool();
			}
		}

		internal bool VerifyUnderlyingToolOnMerge()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null || toolbarsManager.ActiveMdiChildManager == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!IsMdiMergeTool)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (underlyingToolTypeID == null && this is PopupMenuTool { IsReplacedByMdiChildMenu: not false })
			{
				underlyingToolTypeID = ToolTypeID.GetToolTypeIDFromType(GetType());
				CacheInstanceIDInfo();
			}
			if (underlyingTool != null && underlyingTool.ToolbarsManager == toolbarsManager.ActiveMdiChildManager)
			{
				return true;
			}
			ToolBase toolBase = GetUnderlyingTool();
			if (toolBase == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ToolTypeID toolTypeIDFromType = ToolTypeID.GetToolTypeIDFromType(toolBase.GetType());
			if (toolTypeIDFromType != underlyingToolTypeID)
			{
				return false;
			}
			OnBeforeSetUnderlyingTool(toolBase);
			underlyingTool = toolBase;
			if (!underlyingTool.IsRootTool && underlyingTool.HasInstanceProps && !isClonedTool)
			{
				InternalSetInstanceProps(underlyingTool.instanceProps);
			}
			HookUnderlyingTool();
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
		{
			ToolBase toolBeingDisplayed = ToolBeingDisplayed;
			if (toolBeingDisplayed.Owner is RibbonGroup ribbonGroup && (navdir == AccessibleNavigation.Down || navdir == AccessibleNavigation.Up || navdir == AccessibleNavigation.Left || navdir == AccessibleNavigation.Right))
			{
				RibbonLayoutItemDirection direction = (RibbonLayoutItemDirection)(-1);
				switch (navdir)
				{
				case AccessibleNavigation.Down:
					direction = RibbonLayoutItemDirection.Below;
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Left:
					direction = RibbonLayoutItemDirection.Left;
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Right:
					direction = RibbonLayoutItemDirection.Right;
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Up:
					direction = RibbonLayoutItemDirection.Above;
					break;
				}
				RibbonGroupLayoutItem currentToolLayout = ribbonGroup.GetCurrentToolLayout(onlyIfOpen: true);
				RibbonItem ribbonItem = new RibbonItem(RibbonItemType.RibbonTool, toolBeingDisplayed);
				RibbonItem relatedRibbonItem = RibbonGroupMenuAgent.GetRelatedRibbonItem(ribbonGroup, currentToolLayout, ribbonItem, direction, requireSelectable: false, wrap: false);
				if (relatedRibbonItem == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (relatedRibbonItem.ItemType == RibbonItemType.RibbonTool)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase = relatedRibbonItem.Context as ToolBase;
					return toolBase.AccessibilityObject;
				}
				return ribbonGroup.DialogBoxLauncherAccessiblilityObject;
			}
			if (toolBeingDisplayed.Owner is ApplicationMenuAreaBase applicationMenuAreaBase)
			{
				int num = -1;
				switch (navdir)
				{
				case AccessibleNavigation.Down:
				case AccessibleNavigation.Next:
					num = Index + 1;
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Left:
				case AccessibleNavigation.Right:
					return null;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Up:
				case AccessibleNavigation.Previous:
					num = Index - 1;
					break;
				}
				if (num >= 0 && num < applicationMenuAreaBase.Tools.Count)
				{
					return applicationMenuAreaBase.Tools[num].AccessibilityObject;
				}
			}
			if (toolBeingDisplayed.Owner is NavigationToolbar navigationToolbar && (navdir == AccessibleNavigation.Left || navdir == AccessibleNavigation.Previous) && toolBeingDisplayed.Index == 0)
			{
				return navigationToolbar.RecentHistoryButtonAccessibleObject;
			}
			switch (navdir)
			{
			case AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild:
				if (toolBeingDisplayed.AccessibleChildCount > 0)
				{
					return toolBeingDisplayed.GetAccessibleChild(0);
				}
				return null;
			case AccessibleNavigation.LastChild:
			{
				int accessibleChildCount = toolBeingDisplayed.AccessibleChildCount;
				if (accessibleChildCount > 0)
				{
					return toolBeingDisplayed.GetAccessibleChild(accessibleChildCount - 1);
				}
				return null;
			}
			case AccessibleNavigation.Down:
				if (toolBeingDisplayed.IsArrangedVertically || toolBeingDisplayed.OwnerIsMenuInternal || toolBeingDisplayed.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)
				{
					navdir = AccessibleNavigation.Next;
				}
				break;
			case AccessibleNavigation.Left:
				if (!toolBeingDisplayed.IsArrangedVertically && !toolBeingDisplayed.OwnerIsMenuInternal && !toolBeingDisplayed.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)
				{
					navdir = AccessibleNavigation.Previous;
				}
				break;
			case AccessibleNavigation.Right:
				if (!toolBeingDisplayed.IsArrangedVertically && !toolBeingDisplayed.OwnerIsMenuInternal && !toolBeingDisplayed.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)
				{
					navdir = AccessibleNavigation.Next;
				}
				break;
			case AccessibleNavigation.Up:
				if (toolBeingDisplayed.IsArrangedVertically || toolBeingDisplayed.OwnerIsMenuInternal || toolBeingDisplayed.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)
				{
					navdir = AccessibleNavigation.Previous;
				}
				break;
			}
			bool flag = this is QuickCustomizeToolBase;
			switch (navdir)
			{
			case AccessibleNavigation.Next:
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					return null;
				}
				int num4 = toolBeingDisplayed.Index;
				for (int i = num4 + 1; i < toolBeingDisplayed.parentCollection.Count; i++)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase2 = toolBeingDisplayed.parentCollection[i];
					if (toolBase2.bumpedFromToolbar == toolBeingDisplayed.bumpedFromToolbar)
					{
						UIElement uIElement2 = toolBase2.UIElement;
						if (uIElement2 != null && !uIElement2.Rect.IsEmpty)
						{
							return toolBase2.AccessibilityObject;
						}
					}
				}
				if (!toolBeingDisplayed.bumpedFromToolbar && toolBeingDisplayed.OwnerIsToolbarInternal && toolBeingDisplayed.OwningToolbarInternal.ShowQuickCustomizeTool && !toolBeingDisplayed.OwningToolbarInternal.IsFloating)
				{
					return toolBeingDisplayed.OwningToolbarInternal.QuickCustomizeTool.AccessibilityObject;
				}
				break;
			}
			case AccessibleNavigation.Previous:
			{
				int num2 = toolBeingDisplayed.Index;
				ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollectionBase = toolBeingDisplayed.parentCollection;
				num2 = ((!flag) ? toolBeingDisplayed.Index : toolsCollectionBase.Count);
				for (int num3 = num2 - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase2 = toolsCollectionBase[num3];
					if (toolBase2.bumpedFromToolbar == toolBeingDisplayed.bumpedFromToolbar)
					{
						UIElement uIElement = toolBase2.UIElement;
						if (uIElement != null && !uIElement.Rect.IsEmpty)
						{
							return toolBase2.AccessibilityObject;
						}
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal AccessibleObject NavigateInternal(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
		{
			return Navigate(navdir);
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo = propChange.FindTrigger(null);
			if (propChangeInfo.PropId is PropertyIds)
			{
				switch ((PropertyIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId)
				{
				case PropertyIds.DisplayStyle:
				case PropertyIds.MinWidth:
				case PropertyIds.Width:
				case PropertyIds.Spring:
				case PropertyIds.Visible:
				case PropertyIds.IsFirstInGroup:
				case PropertyIds.MaxWidth:
				case PropertyIds.Caption:
				case PropertyIds.MinimumSizeOnRibbon:
				case PropertyIds.PreferredSizeOnRibbon:
				case PropertyIds.ButtonGroup:
				case PropertyIds.DescriptionOnMenu:
					DirtyMetrics();
					break;
				}
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (propChange.Source == sharedProps)
			{
				if (propChange.PropId is PropertyIds && toolbarsManager != null)
				{
					bool flag = false;
					switch ((PropertyIds)(object)propChange.PropId)
					{
					case PropertyIds.Visible:
						if (!sharedProps.Visible)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
						break;
					case PropertyIds.Enabled:
						if (!sharedProps.Enabled)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
						break;
					}
					if (flag && toolbarsManager != null)
					{
						ToolBase activeTool = toolbarsManager.ActiveTool;
						if (activeTool != null && activeTool.UnderlyingTool != null && activeTool.UnderlyingTool.IsSameLogicalTool(sharedProps.RootTool))
						{
							toolbarsManager.ActiveTool = null;
						}
					}
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.SharedProps, propChange);
			}
			else
			{
				if (propChange.Source != instanceProps)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (propChange.PropId is PropertyIds && toolbarsManager != null)
				{
					bool flag2 = false;
					PropertyIds propertyIds = (PropertyIds)(object)propChange.PropId;
					if (propertyIds == PropertyIds.Visible)
					{
						if (!VisibleResolved)
						{
							flag2 = true;
						}
						if (OwnerIsMenu)
						{
							PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool = ((AttachedParentTool != null) ? AttachedParentTool.OwningMenu : (OwningMenu.AttachedParentTool as PopupMenuTool));
							if (popupMenuTool != null && popupMenuTool.SharedProps != null && popupMenuTool.SharedProps.RootTool is PopupMenuTool)
							{
								((PopupMenuTool)popupMenuTool.SharedProps.RootTool).Tools.BumpVersion();
							}
						}
					}
					if (flag2 && toolbarsManager != null)
					{
						ToolBase activeTool2 = toolbarsManager.ActiveTool;

		protected virtual Rectangle NotificationBadgeBounds()
		{
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0040: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			UIElement uIElement = ToolBeingDisplayed.UIElement;
			if (uIElement == null)
			{
				return Rectangle.Empty;
			}
			Rectangle result = uIElement.Rect;
			uIElement.VerifyChildElements();
			DisplayArea preferredDisplayArea = ((INotificationBadgeProvider)this).NotificationBadgeSettingsResolved.PreferredDisplayArea;
			switch ((int)preferredDisplayArea)
			{
			case 0:
			case 1:
			{
				Rectangle imageArea = GetImageArea();
				if (imageArea != Rectangle.Empty)
				{
					result = imageArea;
					break;
				}
				Rectangle textArea2 = GetTextArea();
				if (textArea2 != Rectangle.Empty)
				{
					result = textArea2;
				}
				break;
			}
			case 2:
			{
				Rectangle textArea = GetTextArea();
				if (textArea != Rectangle.Empty)
				{
					result = textArea;
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void CacheInstanceIDInfo()
		{
			if ((underlyingToolOwnerType == ToolOwnerType.None || underlyingToolOwnerType == ToolOwnerType.ToolbarsManager) && underlyingTool != null && !underlyingTool.IsRootTool && underlyingTool.InstanceProps != null)
			{
				object parentCollectionOwner = underlyingTool.ParentCollectionOwner;
				underlyingToolOwnerType = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetToolOwnerType(parentCollectionOwner);
				ToolsCollection tools;
				switch (underlyingToolOwnerType)
				{
				default:
					return;
				case ToolOwnerType.ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar:
					tools = ((ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar)parentCollectionOwner).Tools;
					break;
				case ToolOwnerType.ApplicationMenuLeftArea:
				case ToolOwnerType.ApplicationMenuRightArea:
					tools = ((ApplicationMenuArea)parentCollectionOwner).Tools;
					break;
				case ToolOwnerType.MiniToolbar:
				case ToolOwnerType.NavigationToolbar:
				case ToolOwnerType.QuickAccessToolbar:
				case ToolOwnerType.RibbonTabItemToolbar:
					tools = ((UltraToolbarBase)parentCollectionOwner).Tools;
					break;
				case ToolOwnerType.PopupMenu:
					underlyingToolOwnerKey = ((IKeyedSubObjectEx)parentCollectionOwner).KeyLowercaseInterned;
					tools = ((PopupMenuTool)parentCollectionOwner).Tools;
					break;
				case ToolOwnerType.RibbonGroup:
				{
					RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = (RibbonGroup)parentCollectionOwner;
					underlyingToolOwnerKey = ((IKeyedSubObjectEx)ribbonGroup.Tab).KeyLowercaseInterned + "\b" + ((IKeyedSubObjectEx)ribbonGroup).KeyLowercaseInterned;
					tools = ribbonGroup.Tools;
					break;
				}
				case ToolOwnerType.Toolbar:
					underlyingToolOwnerKey = ((IKeyedSubObjectEx)parentCollectionOwner).KeyLowercaseInterned;
					tools = ((UltraToolbar)parentCollectionOwner).Tools;
					break;
				case ToolOwnerType.ApplicationMenu2010NavigationMenu:
					tools = ((NavigationMenu)parentCollectionOwner).Tools;
					break;
				case ToolOwnerType.ToolbarsManager:
					return;
				}
				underlyingToolOwnerOccurrence = tools.GetOccurrenceNumber(underlyingTool);
			}
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		private void EnsureInstancePropsIsUniqueInParent()
		{
			if (parentCollection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ToolBase item in parentCollection)
			{
				if (item != this)
				{
					_ = item.HasInstanceProps;
				}
			}
		}

		private UIElement GetOwnerElement()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UIElement result = null;
			if (OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
			{
				if (IsSpecialTool && OwningToolbarInternal.IsFloating)
				{
					FloatingToolbarWindowBase floatingWindow = toolbarsManager.GetFloatingWindow(OwningToolbarInternal as UltraToolbar);
					if (floatingWindow != null)
					{
						result = (UIElement)(object)floatingWindow.UIElement;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					result = toolbarsManager.GetUIElement(OwningToolbarInternal.UIElementType, OwnerInternal);
				}
			}
			else if (OwnerIsMenuInternal)
			{
				result = toolbarsManager.GetUIElement(typeof(PopupMenuItemAreaUIElement), OwnerInternal);
			}
			else if (OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
			{
				result = toolbarsManager.GetUIElement(typeof(RibbonGroupUIElement), OwnerInternal);
			}
			else if (OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)
			{
				result = toolbarsManager.GetUIElement(typeof(MenuItemAreaUIElement), OwnerInternal);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private ToolBase GetUnderlyingTool()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager activeMdiChildManager = ToolbarsManager.ActiveMdiChildManager;
			if (underlyingToolOwnerType == ToolOwnerType.None || underlyingToolOwnerType == ToolOwnerType.ToolbarsManager)
			{
				int num = activeMdiChildManager.Tools.IndexOf(Key);
				if (0 <= num)
				{
					return activeMdiChildManager.Tools[num];
				}
				return null;
			}
			ToolsCollection tools;
			switch (underlyingToolOwnerType)
			{
			case ToolOwnerType.ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar:
				tools = activeMdiChildManager.Ribbon.ApplicationMenu.FooterToolbar.Tools;
				break;
			case ToolOwnerType.ApplicationMenuLeftArea:
				tools = activeMdiChildManager.Ribbon.ApplicationMenu.ToolAreaLeft.Tools;
				break;
			case ToolOwnerType.ApplicationMenuRightArea:
				tools = activeMdiChildManager.Ribbon.ApplicationMenu.ToolAreaRight.Tools;
				break;
			case ToolOwnerType.MiniToolbar:
				tools = activeMdiChildManager.MiniToolbar.Tools;
				break;
			case ToolOwnerType.NavigationToolbar:
				tools = activeMdiChildManager.NavigationToolbar.Tools;
				break;
			case ToolOwnerType.PopupMenu:
			{
				int num5 = activeMdiChildManager.Tools.IndexOf(underlyingToolOwnerKey);
				if (num5 < 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (!(activeMdiChildManager.Tools[num5] is PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool))
				{
					return null;
				}
				tools = popupMenuTool.Tools;
				break;
			}
			case ToolOwnerType.QuickAccessToolbar:
				tools = activeMdiChildManager.Ribbon.QuickAccessToolbar.Tools;
				break;
			case ToolOwnerType.RibbonGroup:
			{
				string[] array = underlyingToolOwnerKey.Split('\b');
				if (array.Length != 2)
				{
					return null;
				}
				string text = array[0];
				string text2 = array[1];
				int num3 = activeMdiChildManager.Ribbon.Tabs.IndexOf(text);
				if (num3 < 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				RibbonTab ribbonTab = activeMdiChildManager.Ribbon.Tabs[num3];
				int num4 = ribbonTab.Groups.IndexOf(text2);
				if (num4 < 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				tools = ribbonTab.Groups[num4].Tools;
				break;
			}
			case ToolOwnerType.RibbonTabItemToolbar:
				tools = activeMdiChildManager.Ribbon.TabItemToolbar.Tools;
				break;
			case ToolOwnerType.Toolbar:
			{
				int num2 = activeMdiChildManager.Toolbars.IndexOf(underlyingToolOwnerKey);
				if (num2 < 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				tools = activeMdiChildManager.Toolbars[num2].Tools;
				break;
			}
			case ToolOwnerType.ApplicationMenu2010NavigationMenu:
				tools = activeMdiChildManager.Ribbon.ApplicationMenu2010.NavigationMenu.Tools;
				break;
			default:
				return null;
			}
			return tools.GetOccurrenceOfTool(((IKeyedSubObjectEx)this).KeyLowercaseInterned, underlyingToolOwnerOccurrence);
		}

		private void HookUnderlyingTool()
		{
			if (underlyingTool != null)
			{
				underlyingTool.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				CacheInstanceIDInfo();
			}
		}

		private void ResolveToolLevelAppearanceHelper(AppearanceResolutionPhase phase, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, bool largeImages, bool onMenu, bool onRibbonGroup, bool drawAsPressed = false)
		{
			bool onToolbar = !onMenu && !onRibbonGroup;
			if (InstanceProps != null && (long)requestedProps != 0L)
			{
				InstanceProps.MergeAppearance(phase, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, largeImages, onMenu, onToolbar, onRibbonGroup, drawAsPressed);
			}
			if ((long)requestedProps != 0L)
			{
				SharedProps.MergeAppearance(phase, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, largeImages, onMenu, onToolbar, onRibbonGroup, drawAsPressed);
			}
			if (InstanceProps != null && (long)requestedProps != 0L)
			{
				InstanceProps.MergeAppearance(phase, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, largeImages, onMenu: false, onToolbar: false, onRibbonGroup: false, drawAsPressed);
			}
			if ((long)requestedProps != 0L)
			{
				SharedProps.MergeAppearance(phase, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, largeImages, onMenu: false, onToolbar: false, onRibbonGroup: false, drawAsPressed);
			}
			if (largeImages && (long)requestedProps != 0L)
			{
				ResolveToolLevelAppearanceHelper(phase, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, largeImages: false, onMenu, onRibbonGroup, drawAsPressed);
			}
		}

		private void UnhookUnderlyingTool()
		{
			if (underlyingTool != null)
			{
				cachedMergeOrder = underlyingTool.MergeOrderResolved;
				if (underlyingTool.IsControlContainer && underlyingTool.IsContainedControlShared)
				{
					SetToolWithContainedControl(takeControlOwnership: false, null);
				}
				underlyingTool.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				if (underlyingTool.instanceProps == instanceProps)
				{
					InternalSetInstanceProps(null);
				}
				underlyingTool = null;
			}
		}

					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFEFFFFFFFuL);
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private void ResolveBackStageItemsAppearance(AppearanceResolutionPhase phase, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, bool enabledResolved)
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0034: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0053: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (IsOnBackStage)
			{
				bool isPressed = IsPressed;
				bool flag = phase == AppearanceResolutionPhase.HotTrack && !isPressed;
				if ((int)ButtonStyle == 21)
				{
					ButtonUIElementBase.ResolveScenicRibbonButtonAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, enabledResolved, isPressed, isPressed, isPressed, flag);
				}
				else if ((int)ButtonStyle == 23)
				{
					ButtonUIElementBase.ResolveOffice2010ButtonAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, enabledResolved, isPressed, isPressed, isPressed, flag);
				}
				else if ((int)ButtonStyle == 25)
				{
					ButtonUIElementBase.ResolveOffice2013ButtonAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, enabledResolved, isPressed, isPressed, isPressed, flag);
				}
				else
				{
					ButtonUIElementBase.ResolveOffice2007RibbonButtonAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, enabledResolved, isPressed, isPressed, isPressed, flag);
				}
			}
		}

		bool IProcessMnemonic.Activate()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManagerInControl = ToolbarsManagerInControl;
			if (toolbarsManagerInControl == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
			{
				toolbarsManagerInControl.ToolOwnerWithCapture = OwningRibbonGroup;
			}
			else if (OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)
			{
				toolbarsManagerInControl.ToolOwnerWithCapture = OwningApplicationMenuArea;
			}
			else
			{
				toolbarsManagerInControl.ToolOwnerWithCapture = OwningToolbarInternal;
			}
			toolbarsManagerInControl.InternalSetActiveTool(this, setOn: true, clearToolBeingEdited: true);
			return this == toolbarsManagerInControl.ActiveTool;
		}

		bool IProcessMnemonic.ProcessMnemonic()
		{
			return OnMnemonicPressed();
		}

		protected virtual ToolBaseUiaProviderStub CreateUIAutomationStub()
		{
			return new ToolBaseUiaProviderStub(this);
		}

	internal class ToolMenuItem : MenuItemBase
	{
		private ToolBase tool;

		internal override AccessibleRole AccessibleRole
		{
			get
			{
				if (this is SpecialToolMenuItem || this is ListToolMenuItem)
				{
					return base.AccessibleRole;
				}
				return tool.AccessibleRoleResolved;
			}
		}

		internal override AccessibleStates AccessibleState
		{
			get
			{
				if (this is SpecialToolMenuItem || this is ListToolMenuItem)
				{
					return base.AccessibleState;
				}
				return tool.AccessibleState;
			}
		}

		protected override string AccessibleValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (this is SpecialToolMenuItem || this is ListToolMenuItem)
				{
					return base.AccessibleValue;
				}
				return tool.AccessibleValue;
			}
			set
			{
				tool.AccessibleValue = value;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool CanActivate => tool.CanActivate;

		protected internal override bool CanDisplayToolTip
		{
			get
			{
				if (Tool != null)
				{
					return Tool.ShouldDisplayToolTip;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal override string DefaultAction => tool.DefaultActionInternal;

		protected internal override bool DisplayImage => Tool.InstanceDisplaysImage;

		protected internal override bool DisplayText => Tool.InstanceDisplaysText;

		protected internal override bool DrawAsActive => Tool.DrawAsActive;

		protected internal override bool DrawAsPressed => Tool?.UnderlyingTool.IsPressed ?? false;

		protected internal override bool DrawStateUsingCheckmark
		{
			get
			{
				if (Tool == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Tool.UnderlyingTool is StateButtonTool { MenuDisplayStyle: var menuDisplayStyle } stateButtonTool)
				{
					switch (menuDisplayStyle)
					{
					case StateButtonMenuDisplayStyle.DisplayCheckmark:
						return true;
					case StateButtonMenuDisplayStyle.DisplayToolImage:
						if (!HasImage())
						{
							return !stateButtonTool.OwnerIsApplicationMenu2010NavigationMenu;
						}
						return false;
					default:
						return false;
					}
				}
				if (Tool.IsOnBackStage)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Tool.UnderlyingTool is PopupToolBase { DropDownArrowStyle: DropDownArrowStyle.SegmentedStateButton })
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (DrawAsPressed && !HasImage())
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal override IKeyTipProvider DropDownKeyTipProvider => tool.DropDownKeyTipProvider;

		protected internal override EmbeddableEditorBase Editor => Tool.Editor;

		protected internal override bool Enabled => Tool.EnabledResolved;

		internal override ParsedFormattedTextValue FormattedDescriptionOnMenu => Tool.FormattedDescriptionOnMenuResolved;

		protected internal override HotkeyPrefix HotkeyPrefix => Tool.HotkeyPrefix;

		internal override string KeyboardShortcut => tool.KeyboardShortcut;

		protected internal override ImageList ImageList => Tool.ImageList;

		protected internal override bool IsBeingCustomized
		{
			get
			{
				if (ToolbarsManager == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return ToolbarsManager.CustomizingTool(Tool);
			}
			set
			{
				if (value && ToolbarsManager != null)
				{
					ToolbarsManager.ToolBeingCustomized = Tool;
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool IsCheckedAsVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (tool is StateButtonTool stateButtonTool)
				{
					return stateButtonTool.CheckedInternal;
				}
				if (tool is PopupToolBase popupToolBase)
				{
					if (popupToolBase.DropDownArrowStyleResolved == DropDownArrowStyle.SegmentedStateButton)
					{
						return popupToolBase.Checked;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool IsFirstInGroup
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.MenuAgent is AddRemoveButtonsAgent)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Tool.IsLabelHeader)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return Tool.IsFirstInGroupResolved;
			}
		}

		internal override bool IsLabelHeader => Tool.IsLabelHeader;

		protected internal override bool IsOpen
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsPopup)
				{
					return false;
				}
				PopupToolBase popupToolBase = null;
				if (Tool != null)
				{
					popupToolBase = Tool.PopupTool;
				}
				return popupToolBase?.IsOpen ?? false;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool IsPopup
		{
			get
			{
				if (Tool != null)
				{
					return Tool.PopupTool != null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected internal override DropDownArrowStyle DropDownArrowStyle
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsPopup)
				{
					return Tool.PopupTool.DropDownArrowStyleResolved;
				}
				return base.DropDownArrowStyle;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool RecentlyUsed => Tool.RecentlyUsedResolved;

		internal override bool SupportsTrailingSeparators => !Tool.IsLabelHeader;

		protected internal override string ShortcutText => Tool.SharedProps.ShortcutString;

		protected internal override string Text
		{
			get
			{
				if (tool.UnderlyingTool != null && tool.UnderlyingTool is ListTool)
				{
					return "(" + tool.CaptionResolved + ")";
				}
				return tool.CaptionResolved;
			}
		}

		protected internal override ToolBase Tool => tool;

		public override UIRole UIRole
		{
			get
			{
				if (tool != null)
				{
					return tool.UIRoleOnMenus;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected internal override Size Padding
		{
			get
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = Tool;
				if (toolBase != null && toolBase.OwnerIsApplicationMenu2010NavigationMenu)
				{
					if (toolBase is PopupToolBase)
					{
						return new Size(0, 8);
					}
					return new Size(0, 6);
				}
				return base.Padding;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool ActivatesTool => true;

		public ToolMenuItem(ToolBase tool)
		{
			this.tool = tool;
		}

		protected internal override void Activate()
		{
			base.Activate();
			if (ToolbarsManager != null && Enabled && CanActivate && ActivatesTool)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(Tool, setOn: true, clearToolBeingEdited: false);
			}
		}

		protected internal override AccessibleObject CreateAccessibilityInstance()
		{
			if (tool == null || this is SpecialToolMenuItem || this is ListToolMenuItem)
			{
				return base.CreateAccessibilityInstance();
			}
			return tool.AccessibilityObject;
		}

		protected internal override void Deactivate()
		{
			if (Enabled && ToolbarsManager != null && Tool != ToolbarsManager.ToolBeingEdited)
			{
				base.Deactivate();
				if (ActivatesTool)
				{
					ToolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(Tool, setOn: false, clearToolBeingEdited: false);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override void DisplayCustomizeContextMenu(Point location)
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager.CustomizeDialog != null)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.CustomizeDialog.DisplayToolContextMenu(Tool, location);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void DisplayToolTip()
		{
			if (Tool != null)
			{
				Tool.DisplayToolTip();
			}
		}

		internal override void DoDefaultAction()
		{
			if (Enabled)
			{
				tool.DoDefaultActionInternal();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void DropDown(Control owningControl, Point point, Rectangle exclusionRect, DropDownPosition dropDownPosition, bool delay, bool closeIfAlreadyOpen, bool alignRight, bool autocloseDropdown)
		{
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			PopupToolBase popupToolBase = null;
			if (Tool != null)
			{
				popupToolBase = Tool.PopupTool;
			}
			popupToolBase?.DropDown(owningControl, point, exclusionRect, dropDownPosition, delay, closeIfAlreadyOpen, alignRight, autocloseDropdown, null);
		}

		protected internal override void HideToolTip()
		{
			if (Tool != null)
			{
				Tool.HideToolTip();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void OnClick()
		{
			Tool.OnToolClick();
		}

		internal override IKeyTipProvider[] GetKeyTipProviders()
		{
			ToolBase underlyingTool = Tool.UnderlyingTool;
			if (underlyingTool != null)
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = null;
				try
				{
					toolBase = Tool.AttachToUnderlyingTool();
					return underlyingTool.GetKeyTipProviders();
				}
				finally
				{
					toolBase?.AttachToUnderlyingTool();
				}
			}
			return Tool.GetKeyTipProviders();
		}

		protected override UIElement GetMenuUIElement(UIElement parentElement, UIElement previousElement)
		{
			if (previousElement == null || !(previousElement is PopupMenuItemUIElement) || ((object)previousElement).GetType() != GetMenuUIElementType())
			{
				UIElement val = null;
				if (Tool != null)
				{
					val = Tool.GetMenuUIElement(Tool, parentElement, this);
				}
				if (val == null)
				{
					val = (UIElement)(object)new PopupMenuItemUIElement(parentElement, this);
				}
				return val;
			}
			((PopupMenuItemUIElement)(object)previousElement).InitializeElement(this, parentElement);
			return previousElement;
		}

		protected internal override Type GetMenuUIElementType()
		{
			if (Tool != null)
			{
				return Tool.GetMenuUIElementType();
			}
			return typeof(PopupMenuItemUIElement);
		}

		protected internal override Size GetTextSize()
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
			AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)65011720;
			ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, DrawAsActive);
			return GetTextSize(ref appearance);
		}

		protected internal override Size GetTextSize(ref AppearanceData appearance)
		{
			return MeasureString(ref appearance, null, Tool.CaptionResolved);
		}

		protected internal override int IncrementClickCount()
		{
			return Tool.IncrementClickCount();
		}

		internal override bool IsSameMenuItem(MenuItemBase menuItem)
		{
			ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem = menuItem as ToolMenuItem;
			if (toolMenuItem != null && tool != null && toolMenuItem.Tool != null && toolMenuItem.Tool.IsSameLogicalTool(tool))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (toolMenuItem != null)
			{
				return tool == toolMenuItem.Tool;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override bool ProcessEnterKey()
		{
			if (tool != null && tool.CanEnterEditMode && !tool.IsToolInEditMode)
			{
				if (tool.EnterEditMode())
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (tool != null && tool.IsToolInEditMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return base.ProcessEnterKey();
		}

		protected internal override void ResolveAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, bool drawAsActive)
		{
			Tool.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, drawAsActive, DrawAsPressed);
		}

		private bool HasImage()
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
			AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)256;
			ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, drawAsActive: false);
			return ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).Image != null;
		}

		private void ResolveToolAppearance(ToolNotificationBadgeSettings toolSettings, ref AppearanceData resolvedData, ref AppearancePropFlags flags)
		{
			if (toolSettings == null || (!toolSettings.HasAppearanceLarge && !toolSettings.HasAppearanceSmall && !((NotificationBadgeSettings)toolSettings).HasAppearance))
			{
				return;
			}
			ToolBase toolBase = OwnerTool;
			if (toolBase != null)
			{
				if (toolBase.UseLargeImages)
				{
					if (toolSettings.HasAppearanceLarge)
					{
						toolSettings.AppearanceLarge.MergeData(ref resolvedData, ref flags);
					}
					if (toolSettings.HasAppearanceSmall)
					{
						toolSettings.AppearanceSmall.MergeData(ref resolvedData, ref flags);
					}
				}
				else if (toolSettings.HasAppearanceSmall)
				{
					toolSettings.AppearanceSmall.MergeData(ref resolvedData, ref flags);
				}
			}
			((NotificationBadgeSettings)toolSettings).Appearance.MergeData(ref resolvedData, ref flags);
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		public ToolNotificationBadgeSettings NotificationBadgeSettings
		{
			get
			{
				if (notificationBadgeSettings == null)
				{
					notificationBadgeSettings = new ToolNotificationBadgeSettings();
					((SubObjectBase)(object)notificationBadgeSettings).SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				return notificationBadgeSettings;
			}
			set
			{
				if (notificationBadgeSettings != value)
				{
					if (notificationBadgeSettings != null)
					{
						((SubObjectBase)(object)notificationBadgeSettings).SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					}
					notificationBadgeSettings = value;
					if (notificationBadgeSettings != null)
					{
						((SubObjectBase)(object)notificationBadgeSettings).SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					}
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.NotificationBadgeSettings);
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public bool HasNotificationBadgeSettings => notificationBadgeSettings != null;

		[Localizable(true)]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Appearance")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_ToolPropsBase_P_NotificationBadgeText")]
		public string NotificationBadgeText
		{
			get
			{
				return notificationBadgeText;
			}
			set
			{
				if (NotificationBadgeText != value)
				{
					VerifyCanBeModified();
					notificationBadgeText = value;
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.NotificationBadgeText);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal abstract ToolBase Tool { get; }

		protected internal abstract UltraToolbarsManager ToolbarsManager { get; }

		internal ToolPropsBase()
		{
		}

		protected ToolPropsBase(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "AppearancesSmall":
					appearancesSmall = (ToolAppearances)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ToolAppearances), null);
					break;
				case "AppearancesLarge":
					appearancesLarge = (ToolAppearances)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ToolAppearances), null);
					break;
				case "Caption":
					caption = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), caption);
					break;
				case "DisplayStyle":
					displayStyle = (ToolDisplayStyle)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ToolDisplayStyle), displayStyle);
					break;
				case "MaxWidth":
					maxWidth = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), maxWidth);
					break;
				case "MinWidth":
					minWidth = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), minWidth);
					break;
				case "Tag":
					DeserializeTag(current);
					break;
				case "Width":
					width = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), width);
					break;
				case "KeyTip":
					keyTip = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), keyTip);
					break;
				case "NotificationBadgeText":
					notificationBadgeText = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), notificationBadgeText);
					break;
				case "NotificationBadgeSettings":
					notificationBadgeSettings = (ToolNotificationBadgeSettings)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ToolNotificationBadgeSettings), null);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeAppearancesSmall())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "AppearancesSmall", appearancesSmall);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeAppearancesLarge())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "AppearancesLarge", appearancesLarge);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeCaption())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Caption", caption);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeDisplayStyle())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "DisplayStyle", displayStyle);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeMaxWidth())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MaxWidth", maxWidth);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeMinWidth())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MinWidth", minWidth);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeWidth())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Width", width);
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
			if (ShouldSerializeKeyTip())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "KeyTip", keyTip);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeNotificationBadgeText())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "NotificationBadgeText", notificationBadgeText);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeNotificationBadgeSettings())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "NotificationBadgeSettings", notificationBadgeSettings);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (appearancesSmall != null)
			{
				appearancesSmall.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				appearancesSmall.Dispose();
			}
			if (appearancesLarge != null)
			{
				appearancesLarge.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				appearancesLarge.Dispose();
			}
			if (notificationBadgeSettings != null)
			{
				((SubObjectBase)(object)notificationBadgeSettings).SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				((DisposableObject)(object)notificationBadgeSettings).Dispose();
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (appearancesSmall == propChange.Source)
			{
				DirtyMetricsIfNeeded(propChange);
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.AppearancesSmall, propChange);
			}
			else if (appearancesLarge == propChange.Source)
			{
				DirtyMetricsIfNeeded(propChange);
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.AppearancesLarge, propChange);
			}
			else if (notificationBadgeSettings == propChange.Source)
			{
				DirtyMetricsIfNeeded(propChange);
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.NotificationBadgeSettings, propChange);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Empty;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeAppearancesSmall()
		{
			if (appearancesSmall != null)
			{
				return appearancesSmall.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetAppearancesSmall()
		{
			if (appearancesSmall != null)
			{
				appearancesSmall.Reset();
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.AppearancesSmall);
			}
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeAppearancesLarge()
		{
			if (appearancesLarge != null)
			{
				return appearancesLarge.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetAppearancesLarge()
		{
			if (appearancesLarge != null)
			{
				appearancesLarge.Reset();
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.AppearancesLarge);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		protected internal bool ShouldSerializeCaption()
		{
			return !ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(caption);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetCaption()
		{
			Caption = string.Empty;
		}

		protected internal bool ShouldSerializeDisplayStyle()
		{
			return displayStyle != ToolDisplayStyle.Default;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetDisplayStyle()
		{
			DisplayStyle = ToolDisplayStyle.Default;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerializeKeyTip()
		{
			return keyTip != null;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetKeyTip()
		{
			KeyTip = null;
		}

		protected internal bool ShouldSerializeMaxWidth()
		{
			if (Tool != null && Tool.ShouldSerializeWidthProperties)
			{
				return maxWidth != -1;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetMaxWidth()
		{
			if (Tool.ShouldSerializeWidthProperties)
			{
				MaxWidth = -1;
			}
		}

		protected internal bool ShouldSerializeMinWidth()
		{
			if (Tool != null)
			{
				return minWidth != -1;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetMinWidth()
		{
			if (Tool.ShouldSerializeWidthProperties)
			{
				MinWidth = -1;
			}
		}

		protected internal bool ShouldSerializeWidth()
		{
			if (Tool != null && Tool.ShouldSerializeWidthProperties)
			{
				return width >= 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetWidth()
		{
			if (Tool.ShouldSerializeWidthProperties)
			{
				Width = -1;
			}
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeNotificationBadgeSettings()
		{
			if (notificationBadgeSettings != null)
			{
				return ((NotificationBadgeSettings)notificationBadgeSettings).ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ResetNotificationBadgeSettings()
		{
			NotificationBadgeSettings = null;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		protected internal bool ShouldSerializeNotificationBadgeText()
		{
			return !ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(NotificationBadgeText);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetNotificationBadgeText()
		{
			NotificationBadgeText = null;
		}

		public virtual void Reset()
		{
			ResetAppearancesSmall();
			ResetAppearancesLarge();
			ResetCaption();
			ResetDisplayStyle();
			ResetMaxWidth();
			ResetMinWidth();
			ResetTag();
			ResetWidth();
			ResetKeyTip();
			ResetNotificationBadgeText();
			ResetNotificationBadgeSettings();
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeAppearancesSmall() && !ShouldSerializeAppearancesLarge() && !ShouldSerializeCaption() && !ShouldSerializeDisplayStyle() && !ShouldSerializeMaxWidth() && !ShouldSerializeMinWidth() && !ShouldSerializeTag() && !ShouldSerializeKeyTip() && !ShouldSerializeWidth() && !ShouldSerializeNotificationBadgeText())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeNotificationBadgeSettings();
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void BumpToolMetricsVersion()
		{
			if (this is SharedProps)
			{
				((SharedProps)this).BumpMetricsVersion();
			}
			else if (Tool != null)
			{
				Tool.SharedProps.BumpMetricsVersion();
			}
		}

		internal virtual void Initialize(ToolBase tool)
		{
			if (appearancesSmall != null)
			{
				appearancesSmall.Initialize(this);
				appearancesSmall.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (appearancesLarge != null)
			{
				appearancesLarge.Initialize(this);
				appearancesLarge.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (notificationBadgeSettings != null)
			{
				((SubObjectBase)(object)notificationBadgeSettings).SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeFrom(ToolPropsBase sourceProps)
		{
			if (sourceProps.HasAppearancesSmall)
			{
				AppearancesSmall.InitializeFrom(sourceProps.AppearancesSmall);
			}
			if (sourceProps.HasAppearancesLarge)
			{
				AppearancesLarge.InitializeFrom(sourceProps.AppearancesLarge);
			}
			displayStyle = sourceProps.DisplayStyle;
			if (sourceProps.Tool == null || sourceProps.Tool.ShouldSerializeWidthProperties)
			{
				maxWidth = sourceProps.MaxWidth;
				minWidth = sourceProps.MinWidth;
				width = sourceProps.Width;
			}
			caption = sourceProps.Caption;
			InitializeTag(sourceProps.Tag);
			notificationBadgeText = sourceProps.NotificationBadgeText;
			if (sourceProps.HasNotificationBadgeSettings)
			{
				notificationBadgeSettings = (ToolNotificationBadgeSettings)((NotificationBadgeSettings)sourceProps.notificationBadgeSettings).Clone();
				((SubObjectBase)(object)notificationBadgeSettings).SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
		}

		internal void MergeAppearance(ToolBase.AppearanceResolutionPhase phase, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, bool largeImages, bool onMenu, bool onToolbar, bool onRibbonGroup, bool drawAsPressed)
		{
			ToolAppearances toolAppearances = ((!largeImages) ? (HasAppearancesSmall ? AppearancesSmall : null) : (HasAppearancesLarge ? AppearancesLarge : null));
			switch (phase)
			{
			case ToolBase.AppearanceResolutionPhase.Tool:
				if (onMenu)
				{
					if (toolAppearances != null && toolAppearances.HasAppearanceOnMenu)
					{
						toolAppearances.AppearanceOnMenu.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
					}
				}
				else if (onToolbar)
				{
					if (toolAppearances != null && toolAppearances.HasAppearanceOnToolbar)
					{
						toolAppearances.AppearanceOnToolbar.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
					}
				}
				else if (onRibbonGroup)
				{
					if (toolAppearances != null && toolAppearances.HasAppearanceOnRibbonGroup)
					{
						toolAppearances.AppearanceOnRibbonGroup.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
					}
				}
				else if (toolAppearances != null && toolAppearances.HasAppearance)
				{
					toolAppearances.Appearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
				break;
			case ToolBase.AppearanceResolutionPhase.HotTrack:
				if (drawAsPressed)
				{
					if (onMenu)
					{
						if (toolAppearances != null && toolAppearances.HasHotTrackPressedAppearanceOnMenu)
						{
							toolAppearances.HotTrackPressedAppearanceOnMenu.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
						}
					}
					else if (onToolbar)
					{
						if (toolAppearances != null && toolAppearances.HasHotTrackPressedAppearanceOnToolbar)
						{
							toolAppearances.HotTrackPressedAppearanceOnToolbar.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
						}
					}
					else if (onRibbonGroup)
					{
						if (toolAppearances != null && toolAppearances.HasHotTrackPressedAppearanceOnRibbonGroup)
						{
							toolAppearances.HotTrackPressedAppearanceOnRibbonGroup.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
						}
					}
					else if (toolAppearances != null && toolAppearances.HasHotTrackPressedAppearance)
					{
						toolAppearances.HotTrackPressedAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
					}
				}
				else if (onMenu)
				{
					if (toolAppearances != null && toolAppearances.HasHotTrackAppearanceOnMenu)
					{
						toolAppearances.HotTrackAppearanceOnMenu.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
					}
				}
				else if (onToolbar)
				{
					if (toolAppearances != null && toolAppearances.HasHotTrackAppearanceOnToolbar)
					{
						toolAppearances.HotTrackAppearanceOnToolbar.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
					}
				}
				else if (onRibbonGroup)
				{
					if (toolAppearances != null && toolAppearances.HasHotTrackAppearanceOnRibbonGroup)
					{
						toolAppearances.HotTrackAppearanceOnRibbonGroup.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
					}
				}
				else if (toolAppearances != null && toolAppearances.HasHotTrackAppearance)
				{
					toolAppearances.HotTrackAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
				break;
			case ToolBase.AppearanceResolutionPhase.Pressed:
				if (onMenu)
				{
					if (toolAppearances != null && toolAppearances.HasPressedAppearanceOnMenu)
					{
						toolAppearances.PressedAppearanceOnMenu.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
					}
				}
				else if (onToolbar)
				{
					if (toolAppearances != null && toolAppearances.HasPressedAppearanceOnToolbar)
					{
						toolAppearances.PressedAppearanceOnToolbar.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
					}
				}
				else if (onRibbonGroup)
				{
					if (toolAppearances != null && toolAppearances.HasPressedAppearanceOnRibbonGroup)
					{
						toolAppearances.PressedAppearanceOnRibbonGroup.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
					}
				}
				else if (toolAppearances != null && toolAppearances.HasPressedAppearance)
				{
					toolAppearances.PressedAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyCanBeModified()
		{
			if (Tool != null)
			{
				Tool.VerifyCanBeModified();
			}
		}

		private void DirtyMetricsIfNeeded(PropChangeInfo change)
		{
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo = change.FindTrigger(null);
			if (propChangeInfo.PropId is AppearancePropIds)
			{
				AppearancePropIds val = (AppearancePropIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId;
				if ((int)val == 9 || (int)val == 1001)
				{
					BumpToolMetricsVersion();
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class ToolsCollectionBase : KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase, IProvideUIAutomation
	{
		internal class MergeToolData
		{
			private ToolBase childTool;

			private ToolBase parentTool;

			private bool isToolBeingReplaced;

			private MenuMergeType mergeType;

			internal ToolBase ChildTool => childTool;

			internal ToolBase ParentTool => parentTool;

				this.parentTool = parentTool;
				this.mergeType = mergeType;
			}

			internal MergeToolData(ToolBase childTool, ToolBase parentTool, MenuMergeType mergeType, bool isToolBeingReplaced)
			{

				this.parentTool = parentTool;
				this.mergeType = mergeType;
				this.isToolBeingReplaced = isToolBeingReplaced;
			}
		}

		internal class ToolMergeComparer : IComparer<ToolBase>
		{
			public static readonly ToolMergeComparer Instance = new ToolMergeComparer();

			private ToolMergeComparer()
			{
			}

			public int Compare(ToolBase tool1, ToolBase tool2)
			{
				if (tool1 == null || tool2 == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if ((object)((IKeyedSubObjectEx)tool1).KeyLowercaseInterned == ((IKeyedSubObjectEx)tool2).KeyLowercaseInterned)
				{
					ToolTypeID underlyingToolTypeID = tool1.UnderlyingToolTypeID;
					ToolTypeID underlyingToolTypeID2 = tool2.UnderlyingToolTypeID;
					if (underlyingToolTypeID != underlyingToolTypeID2)
					{
						if (underlyingToolTypeID == null)
						{
							return -1;
						}
						if (underlyingToolTypeID2 == null)
						{
							return 1;
						}
						if (underlyingToolTypeID.Index < underlyingToolTypeID2.Index)
						{
							return -1;
						}
						if (underlyingToolTypeID.Index > underlyingToolTypeID2.Index)
						{
							return 1;
						}
					}
					int ownerOccurrence = tool1.OwnerOccurrence;
					int ownerOccurrence2 = tool2.OwnerOccurrence;
					if ((tool1 is PopupMenuTool && tool1.IsMdiMergeTool) || (tool2 is PopupMenuTool && tool2.IsMdiMergeTool && tool1.OwnerInternal != tool2.OwnerInternal))
					{
						return 0;
					}
					if (ownerOccurrence < ownerOccurrence2)
					{
						return -1;
					}
					if (ownerOccurrence > ownerOccurrence2)
					{
						return 1;
					}
					return 0;
				}
				return string.Compare(((IKeyedSubObjectEx)tool1).KeyLowercaseInterned, ((IKeyedSubObjectEx)tool2).KeyLowercaseInterned, ignoreCase: false, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
			}
		}

		private class ToolMergeOrderComparer : IComparer<ToolBase>
		{
			public static readonly ToolMergeOrderComparer Instance = new ToolMergeOrderComparer();

			private ToolMergeOrderComparer()
			{
			}

			int IComparer<ToolBase>.Compare(ToolBase tool1, ToolBase tool2)
			{
				if (tool1 == null || tool2 == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				int mergeOrderResolved = tool1.MergeOrderResolved;
				int mergeOrderResolved2 = tool2.MergeOrderResolved;
				if (mergeOrderResolved < mergeOrderResolved2)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (mergeOrderResolved > mergeOrderResolved2)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				bool wasInstanceCreatedToHostChildTool = tool1.WasInstanceCreatedToHostChildTool;
				bool wasInstanceCreatedToHostChildTool2 = tool2.WasInstanceCreatedToHostChildTool;
				if (wasInstanceCreatedToHostChildTool != wasInstanceCreatedToHostChildTool2)
				{
					if (wasInstanceCreatedToHostChildTool2)
					{
						return -1;
					}
					if (wasInstanceCreatedToHostChildTool)
					{
						return 1;
					}
				}
				int num = tool1.OwnerIndex;
				int num2 = tool2.OwnerIndex;
				if (num < 0)
				{
					num = 10000;
				}
				if (num2 < 0)
				{
					num2 = 10000;
				}
				if (num < num2)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (num > num2)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				bool flag = tool1 is MdiMergePlaceholderTool;
				bool flag2 = tool2 is MdiMergePlaceholderTool;
				if (flag || flag2)
				{
					if (flag && tool1.Tag is MergeToolData mergeToolData && mergeToolData.ParentTool == tool2)
					{
						return 1;
					}
					if (flag2 && tool2.Tag is MergeToolData mergeToolData2 && mergeToolData2.ParentTool == tool1)
					{
						return -1;
					}
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		private class AddReplacmentsComparer : IComparer
		{
			public int Compare(object x, object y)
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = x as ToolBase;
				ToolBase toolBase2 = y as ToolBase;
				if ((object)((IKeyedSubObjectEx)toolBase).KeyLowercaseInterned == ((IKeyedSubObjectEx)toolBase2).KeyLowercaseInterned)
				{
					bool flag = toolBase.IsMdiMergeTool || toolBase.UnderlyingToolRaw != null || toolBase.WasReplacedDuringMerge;
					bool flag2 = toolBase2.IsMdiMergeTool || toolBase2.UnderlyingToolRaw != null || toolBase2.WasReplacedDuringMerge;
					if (flag != flag2)
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							return -1;
						}
						return 1;
					}
				}
				int index = toolBase.Index;
				int index2 = toolBase2.Index;
				if (index < index2)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (index > index2)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		private class MergedToolsAddedComparer : IComparer<ToolBase>
		{
			private List<ToolBase> parentTools;

			internal MergedToolsAddedComparer(List<ToolBase> parentTools)
			{
				this.parentTools = parentTools;
			}

			public int Compare(ToolBase tool1, ToolBase tool2)
			{
				int num = parentTools.IndexOf(tool1);
				int num2 = parentTools.IndexOf(tool2);
				if (num < num2)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (num > num2)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

					PropertyDescriptor[] array = new PropertyDescriptor[toolsCollectionBase.Count];
					int num = 0;
					int length = (toolsCollectionBase.Count - 1).ToString().Length;
					foreach (ToolBase item in toolsCollectionBase)
					{
						StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
						string text = num.ToString();
						if (text.Length < length)
						{
							stringBuilder.Append(new string(' ', length - text.Length));
						}
						stringBuilder.Append(text);
						string key = item.Key;
						if (key != null && key.Length > 0)
						{
							stringBuilder.Append(" - ");
							stringBuilder.Append(key);
						}
						array[num] = new ToolPropertyDescriptor(item, stringBuilder.ToString());
						num++;
					}
					result = new PropertyDescriptorCollection(array);
				}
				return result;
			}

		protected ToolsCollectionBase(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.ObjectType.IsSubclassOf(typeof(ToolBase)) || current.Value is ToolBase)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase = (ToolBase)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ToolBase), null);
					if (toolBase != null)
					{
						List.Add(toolBase);
					}
					continue;
				}
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "Count":
					initialCapacity = Math.Max(initialCapacity, (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), initialCapacity));
					break;
				case "UnCustomizedTools":
					unCustomizedTools = (ArrayList)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ArrayList), null);
					break;
				case "Tag":
					DeserializeTag(current);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		protected void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Count", Count);
			bool flag = context.Context is bool && (bool)context.Context;
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (flag)
			{
				if (unCustomizedTools != null)
				{
					Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "UnCustomizedTools", unCustomizedTools);
				}
				flag2 = true;
			}
			else if (unCustomizedTools != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < unCustomizedTools.Count; i++)
				{
					Utils.SerializeProperty(info, i.ToString(), unCustomizedTools[i]);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				flag2 = true;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < Count; j++)
				{
					Utils.SerializeProperty(info, j.ToString(), this[j]);
				}
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual int Add(ToolBase tool)
		{
			if (tool == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_70"));
			}
			return AddHelper(tool, honorReadOnlyStatus: true, -1);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void AddRange(ToolBase[] tools)
		{
			if (tools == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("tools");
			}
			foreach (ToolBase tool in tools)
			{
				Add(tool);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void Clear()
		{
			if (IsReadOnly)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_71"));
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (unCustomizedTools != null && toolbarsManager != null && !toolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				ClearUnCustomizedTools();
			}
			clearingCollection = true;
			try
			{
				LogicallyRemoveAllTools();
				InternalClear();
				if (keyDictionary != null)
				{
					keyDictionary.Clear();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				clearingCollection = false;
			}
			if (!synchronizingPopupMenuToolsCollection)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Tools);
			}
		}
