		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void Insert(int index, ToolBase tool)
		{
			if (tool == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_70"));
			}
			AddHelper(tool, honorReadOnlyStatus: true, index);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public ToolBase InsertToolForRibbonCustomization(int index, ToolBase tool, bool clone, List<string> excludedToolKeys)
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager != null && !ToolbarsManager.RibbonCustomizationInProgress)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ToolBase toolBase = (clone ? tool.CloneTool() : tool);
			if (toolBase is PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool && excludedToolKeys != null)
			{
				foreach (string excludedToolKey in excludedToolKeys)
				{
					int num = popupMenuTool.Tools.IndexOf(excludedToolKey);
					if (num >= 0)
					{
						popupMenuTool.Tools.RemoveAt(num);
					}
				}
			}
			if (toolBase is MdiMergePlaceholderTool mdiMergePlaceholderTool)
			{
				mdiMergePlaceholderTool.InstanceProps.CopyMergeProps(tool.InstanceProps);
				index = ((index < 0) ? Count : index);
				InternalInsert(index, toolBase);
				if (ToolbarsManager != null)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase2 = tool.UnderlyingTool;
					UltraToolbarsManager activeMdiChildManager = ToolbarsManager.ActiveMdiChildManager;
					if (activeMdiChildManager != null && (toolBase2 == null || toolBase2.ToolbarsManager != activeMdiChildManager))
					{
						int num2 = activeMdiChildManager.Tools.IndexOf(toolBase.Key);
						if (num2 >= 0)
						{
							toolBase2 = activeMdiChildManager.Tools[num2];
						}
					}
					toolBase.InternalSetUnderlyingTool(toolBase2);
				}
				else
				{
					mdiMergePlaceholderTool.DelayUnderlyingToolHookup = true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				index = AddHelper(toolBase, honorReadOnlyStatus: false, index);
			}
			toolBase = this[index];
			toolBase.Initialize(this);
			toolBase.IsStockItem = !clone & tool.IsStockItem;
			CacheMdiMergeToolsPositionsAndOccurrences(CloneIntoList(), forceCaching: true);
			return toolBase;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void Remove(ToolBase tool)
		{
			RemoveHelper(tool, honorReadOnlyStatus: true);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			if (IsReadOnly)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_72"));
			}
			EnsurePopupMenuToolsCollectionInSync();
			if (index >= Count || index < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_8"));
			}
			ToolBase toolBase = this[index];
			if (toolBase != null)
			{
				LogicallyRemoveTool(toolBase, notifyListeners: true);
			}
		}

		protected internal int AddHelper(ToolBase tool, bool honorReadOnlyStatus, int insertAtIndex)
		{
			if (honorReadOnlyStatus && IsReadOnly)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_73"));
			}
			if (tool.Key == null || tool.Key.Length < 1)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_74"));
			}
			if (allowDuplicates == AllowDuplicates.AllowMergePlaceholderDuplicates && !tool.IsMdiMergeTool)
			{
				string keyLowercaseInterned = ((IKeyedSubObjectEx)tool).KeyLowercaseInterned;
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase = this[i];
					if (!toolBase.IsMdiMergeTool && keyLowercaseInterned == ((IKeyedSubObjectEx)toolBase).KeyLowercaseInterned)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("KeyAlreadyExists"));
					}
				}
			}
			int num = 0;
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager2 = tool.ToolbarsManager;
			if (!HookedUp)
			{
				if (insertAtIndex <= -1)
				{
					num = ((tool.ParentCollection == null || (owner != null && !owner.CloneToolsWhenAddedToCollection(this))) ? InternalAdd(tool) : InternalAdd(tool.Clone(cloneNewInstance: true)));
				}
				else
				{
					if (tool.ParentCollection != null && (owner == null || owner.CloneToolsWhenAddedToCollection(this)))
					{
						InternalAdd(tool.Clone(cloneNewInstance: true), insertAtIndex);
					}
					else
					{
						InternalAdd(tool, insertAtIndex);
					}
					num = insertAtIndex;
				}
			}
			else if (OwnerIsToolbarsManager)
			{
				if (toolbarsManager2 != null)
				{
					if (toolbarsManager != null && toolbarsManager2 != toolbarsManager)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_76"));
					}
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_75"));
				}
				ValidateKeyIsntUsed(tool.Key);
				tool.SharedProps.InternalSetRootTool(tool);
				if (insertAtIndex > -1)
				{
					InternalAdd(tool, insertAtIndex);
					num = insertAtIndex;
				}
				else
				{
					num = InternalAdd(tool);
				}
				if (!(tool is PopupMenuTool))
				{
					tool.InternalSetInstanceProps(null);
				}
				if (tool is PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool && !ToolbarsManager.Initializing)
				{
					popupMenuTool.Tools.HookUpTools();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (toolbarsManager != null && toolbarsManager2 != null && toolbarsManager2 != toolbarsManager)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_76"));
				}
				if (!owner.CloneToolsWhenAddedToCollection(this) || tool is SystemActionTool || tool is SystemMenuTool)
				{
					if (insertAtIndex > -1)
					{
						InternalAdd(tool, insertAtIndex);
						num = insertAtIndex;
					}
					else
					{
						num = InternalAdd(tool);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					ToolBase rootTool = owner.ToolbarsManager.GetRootTool(tool);
					if (rootTool == null)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_77"));
					}
					OnAboutToModifyCollection();
					tool.InternalSetSharedProps(rootTool.SharedProps);
					ToolBase toolBase2 = tool.Clone(cloneNewInstance: true);
					int indexOfTool = GetIndexOfTool(tool);
					ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollectionBase = ToolsCollectionToSynchronizeWith;
					if (toolsCollectionBase == null && OwningPopupMenu != null && !OwningPopupMenu.IsRootTool)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_78"));
					}
					if (toolsCollectionBase == null)
					{
						toolsCollectionBase = this;
					}
					if (!tool.AllowMultipleInstancesResolved && !OwnerIsTemporaryToolbar)
					{
						tool.SharedProps.RemoveToolInstancesHelper(leaveOneInstance: false);
						if (indexOfTool > -1 && insertAtIndex > -1 && insertAtIndex > indexOfTool)
						{
							insertAtIndex--;
						}
					}
					num = ((insertAtIndex <= -1) ? toolsCollectionBase.InternalAdd(toolBase2) : toolsCollectionBase.InternalAdd(toolBase2, insertAtIndex));
					if (toolBase2.SharedProps.ToolInstances.IndexOf(toolBase2) < 0)
					{
						toolBase2.SharedProps.ToolInstances.AddHelper(toolBase2, honorReadOnlyStatus: false, -1);
					}
					SynchronizeUnCustomizedToolsOnAdd(toolBase2);
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			ToolEnumerator toolEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (toolEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					ToolBase current = toolEnumerator.Current;
					current.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					current.Dispose();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = toolEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			InternalClear();
			if (keyDictionary != null)
			{
				keyDictionary.Clear();
				keyDictionary = null;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Tools, propChange);
			if ((!(this is RootToolsCollection) && !(this is MergedToolsCollection)) || !(propChange.Source is ToolBase toolBase))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ToolBase toolInstance in toolBase.SharedProps.ToolInstances)
			{
				if (toolInstance.OwnerIsMenuInternal)
				{
					toolInstance.OwningMenuInternal.Tools.BumpVersion();
				}
				toolInstance.OwningApplicationMenuAreaBase?.Tools.BumpVersion();
			}
		}

		internal void BumpVersion()
		{
			if (ToolsCollectionToSynchronizeWith == null)
			{
				version++;
			}
		}

		internal void CacheMdiMergeToolsPositionsAndOccurrences(IList<ToolBase> parentTools, bool forceCaching)
		{
			int num = 0;
			Dictionary<string, int> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, int>();
			for (int i = 0; i < parentTools.Count; i++)
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = parentTools[i];
				if (toolBase.IsMdiMergeTool)
				{
					if (0 <= toolBase.CachedOwnerIndex)
					{
						toolBase.CachedOwnerIndex += num;
					}
					else
					{
						num++;
					}
					string keyLowercaseInterned = ((IKeyedSubObjectEx)toolBase).KeyLowercaseInterned;
					if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(keyLowercaseInterned, out var value))
					{
						value = 0;
					}
					if (0 <= toolBase.CachedOwnerOccurrence)
					{
						toolBase.CachedOwnerOccurrence += value;
					}
					else
					{
						dictionary[keyLowercaseInterned] = value + 1;
					}
					if (forceCaching)
					{
						toolBase.ForceCacheMdiMergeToolPositionInOwner();
					}
					else
					{
						toolBase.CacheMdiMergeToolPositionInOwner();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void CacheUnCustomizedToolInfoOnTools()
		{
			if (unCustomizedTools == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ToolBase unCustomizedTool in unCustomizedTools)
			{
				if (unCustomizedTool.Index < 0)
				{
					unCustomizedTool.CacheUnCustomizedInfo(this);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ChangeIndexOf(ToolBase tool, int newIndex)
		{
			EnsurePopupMenuToolsCollectionInSync();
			if (OwnerIsPopupMenu && !(Owner is PopupMenuTool))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_79"));
			}
			ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollectionToSynchronizeWith = ToolsCollectionToSynchronizeWith;
			if (toolsCollectionToSynchronizeWith == null && OwningPopupMenu != null && !OwningPopupMenu.IsRootTool)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_78"));
			}
			if (toolsCollectionToSynchronizeWith != null)
			{
				toolsCollectionToSynchronizeWith.ChangeIndexOf(toolsCollectionToSynchronizeWith[tool.Index], newIndex);
				return;
			}
			if (tool == null || !Exists(tool.Key))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_80"));
			}
			if (newIndex < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_81"));
			}
			if (Count != 1)
			{
				OnAboutToModifyCollection();
				int num = IndexOf(tool);
				if (num != newIndex)
				{
					InternalRemoveAt(num);
					InternalInsert(newIndex, tool);
				}
				BumpVersion();
				if (!synchronizingPopupMenuToolsCollection)
				{
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Tools);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ClearInternal()
		{
			clearingCollection = true;
			try
			{
				if (!(owner is SystemMenuTool))
				{
					LogicallyRemoveAllTools();
				}
				InternalClear();
				if (keyDictionary != null)
				{
					keyDictionary.Clear();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				clearingCollection = false;
			}
			if (!synchronizingPopupMenuToolsCollection)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Tools);
			}
		}

		internal bool ContainsOffice2007Tool()
		{
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = this[i];
				if (toolBase != null && toolBase.RequiresOffice2007Support)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ContainsVisibleTools(bool considerBumpedStatus)
		{
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (this[i].IsVisible(considerBumpedStatus))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (this is ToolsCollection { NewToolPlaceHolder: not null })
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void DisconnectMergedTools()
		{
			ToolEnumerator toolEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (toolEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					ToolBase current = toolEnumerator.Current;
					if (current.IsRootTool)
					{
						foreach (ToolBase toolInstance in current.SharedProps.ToolInstances)
						{
							toolInstance.CacheMdiMergeToolPositionInOwner();
						}
					}
					if (current is PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool)
					{
						popupMenuTool.IsReplacedByMdiChildMenu = false;
						if (popupMenuTool.HasToolsCollectionBeenCreated)
						{
							popupMenuTool.Tools.DisconnectMergedTools();
							if (OwnerIsToolbarsManager)
							{
								popupMenuTool.Tools.BumpVersion();
							}
						}
					}
					current.OnMergeDisconnect();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = toolEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		internal int GetIndexOfTool(ToolBase tool)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				if (this[i].SharedProps == tool.SharedProps)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		internal ToolBase GetToolThatContainsControl(Control containedControl)
		{
			if (containedControl == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_13"));
			}
			ToolEnumerator toolEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (toolEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					ToolBase current = toolEnumerator.Current;
					if (!current.IsControlContainer)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (current.IsContainedControlShared)
					{
						if (current.Control == containedControl)
						{
							return current.ToolWithContainedControl;
						}
						continue;
					}
					if (current.Control == containedControl)
					{
						return current;
					}
					foreach (ToolBase toolInstance in current.SharedProps.ToolInstances)
					{
						if (toolInstance.Control == containedControl)
						{
							return toolInstance;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = toolEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal int GetOccurrenceNumber(ToolBase tool)
		{
			int num = 1;
			string keyLowercaseInterned = ((IKeyedSubObjectEx)tool).KeyLowercaseInterned;
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = this[i];
				if (toolBase == tool)
				{
					return num;
				}
				if ((object)keyLowercaseInterned == ((IKeyedSubObjectEx)toolBase).KeyLowercaseInterned)
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return 0;
		}

		internal ToolBase GetOccurrenceOfTool(string keyLowercaseInterned, int occurrenceNumber)
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = this[i];
				if ((object)keyLowercaseInterned == ((IKeyedSubObjectEx)toolBase).KeyLowercaseInterned)
				{
					num++;
					if (num == occurrenceNumber)
					{
						return toolBase;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal ToolBase GetToolWithShortcut(int keyCode, Keys modifierKeys)
		{
			ToolEnumerator toolEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (toolEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					ToolBase current = toolEnumerator.Current;
					if (current.IsHiddenByMdiMerge || current.UnderlyingTool == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (current.IsShortcutKey(keyCode, modifierKeys))
					{
						return current;
					}
					if (current is SystemMenuTool systemMenuTool)
					{
						ToolBase toolWithShortcut = systemMenuTool.Tools.GetToolWithShortcut(keyCode, modifierKeys);
						if (toolWithShortcut != null)
						{
							return toolWithShortcut;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = toolEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal ToolBase GetUnsynchronizedTool(int toolIndex, bool lookInUnCustomizedToolsList)
		{
			ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollectionBase = ToolsCollectionToSynchronizeWith ?? this;
			if (lookInUnCustomizedToolsList)
			{
				return (ToolBase)toolsCollectionBase.unCustomizedTools[toolIndex];
			}
			if (toolIndex >= toolsCollectionBase.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return toolsCollectionBase[toolIndex];
		}

		internal int InternalAdd(ToolBase tool)
		{
			return InternalAdd(tool, -1);
		}

		internal int InternalAdd(ToolBase tool, int insertAtIndex)
		{
			if (!owner.CanAddTool(tool, this))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_82"));
			}
			if (tool != null && !OwnerIsToolbarsManager && !OwnerIsSharedProps && !tool.CanAddToCollection(this))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_82"));
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (tool != null && tool.RequiresOffice2007Support && OwnerIsToolbarsManager && !toolbarsManager.Initializing && !toolbarsManager.SupportsOffice2007ViewStyle)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_Exception_2"));
			}
			tool.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			OnAboutToModifyCollection();
			int num = 0;
			if (insertAtIndex > -1)
			{
				List.Insert(insertAtIndex, tool);
				num = insertAtIndex;
			}
			else
			{
				num = List.Add(tool);
			}
			tool.OnReAddedToCollection(this);
			if (KeyDictionary != null)
			{
				keyDictionary.Add(tool.Key, tool);
			}
			BumpVersion();
			if (!synchronizingPopupMenuToolsCollection && !OwnerIsSharedProps)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Tools);
			}
			owner.OnToolAddedToCollection(tool, this);
			return num;
		}

		internal int InternalInsertAt(ToolBase tool, int index, bool honorReadOnlyStatus)
		{
			if (tool == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_70"));
			}
			if (index < 0 || index > Count)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_83"));
			}
			return AddHelper(tool, honorReadOnlyStatus, index);
		}

		internal bool InternalRemove(ToolBase tool, bool notifyListeners)
		{
			if (tool == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			OnAboutToModifyCollection();
			if (tool.ParentCollection != this)
			{
				if (tool.ParentCollection != null && (OwnerIsPopupMenu || OwnerIsToolbar))
				{
					int occurrenceNumber = tool.ParentCollection.GetOccurrenceNumber(tool);
					tool = GetOccurrenceOfTool(((IKeyedSubObjectEx)tool).KeyLowercaseInterned, occurrenceNumber);
					if (tool == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				else if (!Contains(tool))
				{
					int num = IndexOf(tool.Key);
					if (num < 0)
					{
						return false;
					}
					tool = this[num];
				}
			}
			owner.OnBeforeToolRemovedFromCollection(tool, this);
			InternalRemove(tool);
			if (KeyDictionary != null)
			{
				keyDictionary.Remove(tool.Key);
			}
			BumpVersion();
			SynchronizeUnCustomizedToolsOnRemove(tool);
			tool.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			if (notifyListeners && !synchronizingPopupMenuToolsCollection)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Tools);
			}
			if (tool is PopupToolBase)
			{
				((PopupToolBase)tool).RemoveDescendantTearawayToolbars();
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager != null && tool is TearawayToolBase && ((TearawayToolBase)tool).IsTearawayToolbarCreated)
			{
				toolbarsManager.Toolbars.Remove(((TearawayToolBase)tool).TearawayToolbar);
			}
			owner.OnToolRemovedFromCollection(tool, this);
			return true;
		}

		internal void Initialize(IToolsCollectionOwner owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
			if (this.owner != null)
			{
				allowDuplicates = this.owner.AllowDuplicateKeysInCollection(this);
			}
			else
			{
				allowDuplicates = AllowDuplicates.Never;
			}
			if (keyDictionary != null)
			{
				keyDictionary.Clear();
			}
			bool flag = this is RootToolsCollection || this is MergedToolsCollection;
			List<ToolBase> list = new List<ToolBase>();
			ToolEnumerator toolEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (toolEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					ToolBase current = toolEnumerator.Current;
					if (current is PopupMenuTool && flag)
					{
						list.Add(current);
					}
					current.Initialize(this);
					current.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					if (KeyDictionary != null)
					{
						keyDictionary.Add(current.Key, current);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = toolEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			foreach (ToolBase item in list)
			{
				item.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool = (PopupMenuTool)item;
				popupMenuTool.HookupDeserializedToolsInstance();
				popupMenuTool.InitializeTools(this);
				item.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (unCustomizedTools == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ToolBase unCustomizedTool in unCustomizedTools)
			{
				unCustomizedTool.Initialize(this);
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager != null)
				{
					ToolBase rootTool = toolbarsManager.GetRootTool(unCustomizedTool);
					if (rootTool != null)
					{
						unCustomizedTool.InternalSetSharedProps(rootTool.SharedProps);
						unCustomizedTool.SharedProps.InternalSetRootTool(rootTool);
					}
				}
				unCustomizedTool.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
		}

		internal void MergeAuxiliaryMdiChildTools()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null || !toolbarsManager.HasBeenRibbonCustomized)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager activeMdiChildManager = ToolbarsManager.ActiveMdiChildManager;
			if (activeMdiChildManager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IComparer<ToolBase> instance = ToolMergeComparer.Instance;
			RootToolsCollection tools = activeMdiChildManager.Tools;
			List<ToolBase> parentTools = CloneIntoList();
			foreach (ToolBase item in List)
			{
				if (!item.IsMdiMergeTool || item.UnderlyingTool != item || item.WasReplacedDuringMerge)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (ToolBase item2 in tools)
				{
					if (instance.Compare(item, item2) == 0)
					{
						int parentToolsIndex = -1;
						MenuMergeType mergeType = UltraToolbarsManager.ResolveMergeType(item, item2);
						item.MergeWithChildInstanceTool(mergeType, item2, parentTools, ref parentToolsIndex);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void MergeMdiChildTools(ToolsCollection childToolsCollection)
		{
			if (ToolsCollectionToSynchronizeWith != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (childToolsCollection != null && childToolsCollection.ToolbarsManager != toolbarsManager.ActiveMdiChildManager)
			{
				return;
			}
			IComparer<ToolBase> instance = ToolMergeComparer.Instance;
			List<ToolBase> list = CloneIntoList(useUnCustomizedList: true);
			if (list.Count > 1)
			{
				Utilities.SortMergeGeneric<ToolBase>(list, instance);
			}
			List<ToolBase> list2;
			List<MergeToolData> list3;
			if (childToolsCollection == null)
			{
				list2 = new List<ToolBase>();
				list3 = new List<MergeToolData>(list.Count);
			}
			else
			{
				list2 = childToolsCollection.CloneIntoList();
				list3 = new List<MergeToolData>(list2.Count);
			}
			if (list2.Count > 1)
			{
				list2.Sort(instance);
			}
			bool flag = OwnerIsPopupMenu && OwningPopupMenu.IsReplacedByMdiChildMenu;
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = list[i];
				if (flag)
				{
					toolBase.IsHiddenByMdiMerge = true;
				}
				else if (!(toolBase is PopupMenuTool { IsReplacedByMdiChildMenu: not false }))
				{
					toolBase.IsHiddenByMdiMerge = toolBase.IsMdiMergeTool;
				}
			}
			int j = 0;
			foreach (ToolBase item in list2)
			{
				if (toolbarsManager.HasBeenRibbonCustomized)
				{
					if (OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
					{
						RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = Owner as RibbonGroup;
						if (ribbonGroup.HasNonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys && ribbonGroup.NonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys.Contains(item.Key))
						{
							continue;
						}
					}
					else if (Owner is QuickAccessToolbar { HasNonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys: not false } quickAccessToolbar && quickAccessToolbar.NonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys.Contains(item.Key))
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				if (item is PopupControlContainerToolBase popupControlContainerToolBase)
				{
					popupControlContainerToolBase.CleanupForMerge();
				}
				for (; j < list.Count && instance.Compare(list[j], item) < 0; j++)
				{
				}
				ToolBase toolBase2 = ((j < list.Count) ? list[j] : null);
				if (toolBase2 is PopupRibbonGroupTool)
				{
					toolBase2 = null;
				}
				MergeToolData mergeToolData = null;
				if (toolBase2 != null && instance.Compare(toolBase2, item) == 0)
				{
					MenuMergeType mergeType = UltraToolbarsManager.ResolveMergeType(toolBase2, item);
					mergeToolData = toolBase2.MergeWithChildInstanceTool(mergeType, item, list, ref j);
					j++;
				}
				else
				{
					MenuMergeType mergeType2 = item.SharedProps.MergeType;
					switch (mergeType2)
					{
					case MenuMergeType.Default:
					case MenuMergeType.Add:
					case MenuMergeType.MergeItems:
					case MenuMergeType.Replace:
						mergeToolData = new MergeToolData(item, null, mergeType2);
						break;
					}
				}
				if (mergeToolData != null)
				{
					list3.Add(mergeToolData);
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				AddReplacementsForTools(replaceCustomizedTools: false, list3);
			}
			if (unCustomizedTools != null)
			{
				AddReplacementsForTools(replaceCustomizedTools: true, list3);
			}
			List<ToolBase> list4 = new List<ToolBase>();
			for (int k = 0; k < list3.Count; k++)
			{
				MergeToolData mergeToolData2 = list3[k];
				ToolBase childTool = mergeToolData2.ChildTool;
				ToolBase toolBase3 = childTool.CreateMergeInstanceTool(toolbarsManager, mergeToolData2);
				if (toolBase3 != null)
				{
					childTool.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					list.Add(toolBase3);
					list4.Add(toolBase3);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count > 1)
			{
				Utilities.SortMergeGeneric<ToolBase>(list, (IComparer<ToolBase>)ToolMergeOrderComparer.Instance);
			}
			if (unCustomizedTools != null && list4.Count > 1)
			{
				Utilities.SortMergeGeneric<ToolBase>(list4, (IComparer<ToolBase>)new MergedToolsAddedComparer(list));
			}
			for (int l = 0; l < list4.Count; l++)
			{
				ToolBase toolBase4 = list4[l];
				MergeToolData mergeToolData3 = (MergeToolData)toolBase4.Tag;
				int index = Count;
				if (unCustomizedTools != null)
				{
					if (mergeToolData3.IsToolBeingReplaced)
					{
						index = mergeToolData3.ParentTool.Index + 1;
					}
					else
					{
						index = 0;
						int num = list.IndexOf(toolBase4);
						for (int num2 = num - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
						{
							ToolBase toolBase5 = list[num2];
							if (toolBase5.VisibleResolved)
							{
								int num3 = List.IndexOf(toolBase5);
								if (num3 >= 0)
								{
									index = num3 + 1;
									break;
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				InternalInsert(index, toolBase4);
				toolBase4.InternalSetUnderlyingTool(mergeToolData3.ChildTool);
				toolBase4.Tag = null;
			}
			ArrayList arrayList = unCustomizedTools ?? List;
			arrayList.Clear();
			arrayList.AddRange(list);
			if (unCustomizedTools != null)
			{
				foreach (ToolBase item2 in List)
				{
					if (item2.IsMdiMergeTool && item2.UnderlyingToolRaw == null)
					{
						ToolBase rootTool = toolbarsManager.GetRootTool(item2);
						if (rootTool != null && rootTool.GetType() == item2.GetType() && rootTool.UnderlyingToolTypeID == item2.UnderlyingToolTypeID && rootTool.UnderlyingToolRaw != null)
						{
							InstanceProps instanceProps = (item2.HasInstanceProps ? item2.InstanceProps : null);
							item2.InternalSetUnderlyingTool(rootTool.UnderlyingToolRaw);
							item2.InternalSetInstanceProps(instanceProps);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			MergeAuxiliaryMdiChildTools();
			CacheMdiMergeToolsPositionsAndOccurrences(list, forceCaching: false);
			BumpVersion();
		}

		internal void ResetCustomizations()
		{
			ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollectionToSynchronizeWith = ToolsCollectionToSynchronizeWith;
			if (toolsCollectionToSynchronizeWith != null)
			{
				toolsCollectionToSynchronizeWith.ResetCustomizations();
			}
			else
			{
				if (isResettingCustomizations)
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					isResettingCustomizations = true;
					if (unCustomizedTools != null)
					{
						List.Clear();
						List.AddRange(unCustomizedTools);
						foreach (ToolBase unCustomizedTool in unCustomizedTools)
						{
							unCustomizedTool.OnReAddedToCollection(this);
						}
						ClearUnCustomizedTools();
					}
					ToolEnumerator toolEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
					try
					{
						while (toolEnumerator.MoveNext())
						{
							ToolBase current = toolEnumerator.Current;
							current.ResetCachePositionInOwner();
							current.ResetState();
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						IDisposable disposable = toolEnumerator as IDisposable;
						if (disposable != null)
						{
							disposable.Dispose();
						}
					}
					BumpVersion();
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Tools);
				}
				finally
				{
					isResettingCustomizations = false;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveHelper(ToolBase tool, bool honorReadOnlyStatus)
		{
			RemoveHelper(tool, honorReadOnlyStatus, allowRemoveForTemporaryToolbar: false);
		}

		internal void RemoveHelper(ToolBase tool, bool honorReadOnlyStatus, bool allowRemoveForTemporaryToolbar)
		{
			if (honorReadOnlyStatus && IsReadOnly)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_72"));
			}
			if (tool == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_84"));
			}
			LogicallyRemoveTool(tool, notifyListeners: true, allowRemoveForTemporaryToolbar);
		}

		internal bool IsKeyInUnCustomizedList(string key)
		{
			if (unCustomizedTools == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (IKeyedSubObjectEx unCustomizedTool in unCustomizedTools)
			{
				if (string.Compare(unCustomizedTool.KeyLowercaseInterned, key, ignoreCase: true, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) == 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void ValidateKeyChange(ToolBase rootTool, string newKey)
		{
			ValidateKeyDoesNotExist(newKey, rootTool);
			if (KeyDictionary != null && rootTool.SharedProps.RootTool == rootTool)
			{
				if (keyDictionary.Contains(rootTool.Key))
				{
					keyDictionary.Remove(rootTool.Key);
				}
				keyDictionary.Add(newKey, rootTool);
			}
		}

		private void AddReplacementsForTools(bool replaceCustomizedTools, List<MergeToolData> requiredMergeToolsData)
		{
			RootToolsCollection rootToolsCollection = ToolbarsManager.ActiveMdiChildManager?.Tools;
			ArrayList arrayList = unCustomizedTools ?? List;
			ArrayList arrayList2 = arrayList;
			ArrayList arrayList3 = ((!replaceCustomizedTools) ? new ArrayList(arrayList) : new ArrayList(List));
			if (arrayList3.Count < 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			arrayList3.Sort(new AddReplacmentsComparer());
			BitArray bitArray = new BitArray(arrayList2.Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < arrayList3.Count; i++)
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = (ToolBase)arrayList3[i];
				if (toolBase is PopupMenuTool || !toolBase.IsHiddenByMdiMerge || toolBase.IsMdiMergeTool)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (ToolbarsManager.HasBeenRibbonCustomized)
				{
					if (OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
					{
						RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = Owner as RibbonGroup;
						if (ribbonGroup.HasNonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys && ribbonGroup.NonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys.Contains(toolBase.Key))
						{
							continue;
						}
					}
					else if (Owner is QuickAccessToolbar { HasNonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys: not false } quickAccessToolbar && quickAccessToolbar.NonAutogenerateMergeToolKeys.Contains(toolBase.Key))
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				bool flag = false;
				for (int j = 0; j < arrayList2.Count; j++)
				{
					if (!bitArray[j])
					{
						ToolBase toolBase2 = (ToolBase)arrayList2[j];
						if (toolBase2.IsMdiMergeTool && toolBase2.UnderlyingToolTypeID == toolBase.UnderlyingToolTypeID && (object)((IKeyedSubObjectEx)toolBase2).KeyLowercaseInterned == ((IKeyedSubObjectEx)toolBase).KeyLowercaseInterned)
						{
							toolBase2.IsHiddenByMdiMerge = false;
							flag = (bitArray[j] = true);
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				if (flag || IsReplacementToolAlreadyInAddList(toolBase, requiredMergeToolsData))
				{
					continue;
				}
				ToolBase toolBase3 = null;
				if (rootToolsCollection != null)
				{
					int num = rootToolsCollection.IndexOf(toolBase.Key);
					if (num >= 0)
					{
						ToolBase toolBase4 = rootToolsCollection[num];
						if (toolBase4 != null && toolBase4.GetType() == toolBase.GetType())
						{
							MenuMergeType menuMergeType = UltraToolbarsManager.ResolveMergeType(toolBase, toolBase4);
							if (menuMergeType == MenuMergeType.Replace)
							{
								toolBase3 = toolBase4;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (toolBase3 != null)
				{
					toolBase.WasReplacedDuringMerge = true;
					requiredMergeToolsData.Add(new MergeToolData(toolBase3, toolBase, MenuMergeType.Replace, isToolBeingReplaced: true));
				}
			}
		}

		private void ClearUnCustomizedTools()
		{
			if (unCustomizedTools == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ToolBase unCustomizedTool in unCustomizedTools)
			{
				unCustomizedTool.ClearUnCustomizedCache();
			}
			unCustomizedTools = null;
		}

		internal List<ToolBase> CloneIntoList()
		{
			return CloneIntoList(useUnCustomizedList: false);
		}

		internal List<ToolBase> CloneIntoList(bool useUnCustomizedList)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = ((useUnCustomizedList && unCustomizedTools != null) ? unCustomizedTools : List);
			List<ToolBase> list = new List<ToolBase>(arrayList.Count);
			foreach (ToolBase item in arrayList)
			{
				list.Add(item);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static bool IsReplacementToolAlreadyInAddList(ToolBase tool, List<MergeToolData> requiredMergeToolsData)
		{
			foreach (MergeToolData requiredMergeToolsDatum in requiredMergeToolsData)
			{
				if (requiredMergeToolsDatum.ParentTool == tool && requiredMergeToolsDatum.IsToolBeingReplaced)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SynchronizeUnCustomizedToolsOnAdd(ToolBase toolAdded)
		{
			if (!synchronizeUnCustomizedTools)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (unCustomizedTools == null || toolbarsManager == null || toolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = List.IndexOf(toolAdded);
			int num2 = -1;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				for (int num3 = num - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
				{
					ToolBase value = List[num3] as ToolBase;
					num2 = unCustomizedTools.IndexOf(value);
					if (num2 >= 0)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			num2++;
			if (num2 >= unCustomizedTools.Count)
			{
				unCustomizedTools.Add(toolAdded);
			}
			else
			{
				unCustomizedTools.Insert(num2, toolAdded);
			}
		}

		private void SynchronizeUnCustomizedToolsOnRemove(ToolBase toolRemoved)
		{
			if (synchronizeUnCustomizedTools)
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
				if (unCustomizedTools != null && toolbarsManager != null && !toolbarsManager.Customizing && unCustomizedTools.Contains(toolRemoved))
				{
					unCustomizedTools.Remove(toolRemoved);
				}
			}
		}

		private void EnsurePopupMenuToolsCollectionInSync()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null || toolbarsManager.Initializing || toolbarsManager.Loading || synchronizingPopupMenuToolsCollection || clearingCollection)
			{
				return;
			}
			ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollectionToSynchronizeWith = ToolsCollectionToSynchronizeWith;
			if (toolsCollectionToSynchronizeWith == null || toolsCollectionToSynchronizeWith == this)
			{
				return;
			}
			toolsCollectionToSynchronizeWith.EnsurePopupMenuToolsCollectionInSync();
			if (Version == toolsCollectionToSynchronizeWith.Version && List.Count == toolsCollectionToSynchronizeWith.List.Count)
			{
				return;
			}
			synchronizingPopupMenuToolsCollection = true;
			try
			{
				List<ToolBase> list = new List<ToolBase>(Count + 1);
				int num = Math.Max(toolsCollectionToSynchronizeWith.Count, Count);
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase = null;
					ToolBase toolBase2 = null;
					if (toolsCollectionToSynchronizeWith.Count > i)
					{
						toolBase = toolsCollectionToSynchronizeWith[i];
					}
					if (Count > i)
					{
						toolBase2 = this[i];
					}
					if (toolBase2 != null && toolBase != null && toolBase2.IsSameLogicalTool(toolBase) && toolBase2.HasSameInstanceProps(toolBase))
					{
						if (!toolBase2.HasInstanceProps)
						{
							toolBase2.InternalSetInstanceProps(toolBase.InstanceProps);
						}
						toolBase2.IsHiddenByMdiMerge = toolBase.IsHiddenByMdiMerge;
						continue;
					}
					bool flag = false;
					if (toolBase != null)
					{
						for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
						{
							ToolBase toolBase3 = list[j];
							if (toolBase3.IsSameLogicalTool(toolBase) && toolBase3.HasSameInstanceProps(toolBase))
							{
								List.Insert(i, toolBase3);
								list.RemoveAt(j);
								flag = true;
								toolBase3.IsHiddenByMdiMerge = toolBase.IsHiddenByMdiMerge;
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (toolBase2 != null)
					{
						int num2;
						for (num2 = i; num2 < Count; num2++)
						{
							toolBase2 = this[i];
							if (toolBase != null && toolBase2.IsSameLogicalTool(toolBase) && toolBase2.HasSameInstanceProps(toolBase))
							{
								flag = true;
								break;
							}
							list.Add(toolBase2);
							List.RemoveAt(i);
							num2--;
						}
					}
					if (!flag && toolBase != null)
					{
						ToolBase toolBase4 = toolBase.CloneForMenuInstance();
						if (OwnerIsPopupMenu)
						{
							toolBase4.IsStockItem = OwningPopupMenu.IsStockItem;
						}
						InternalAdd(toolBase4);
					}
				}
				for (int k = 0; k < list.Count; k++)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase5 = list[k];
					toolBase5.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				version = toolsCollectionToSynchronizeWith.Version;
				synchronizingPopupMenuToolsCollection = false;
			}
		}

		private void LogicallyRemoveTool(ToolBase tool, bool notifyListeners)
		{
			LogicallyRemoveTool(tool, notifyListeners, allowRemoveForTemporaryToolbar: false);
		}

		private void LogicallyRemoveTool(ToolBase tool, bool notifyListeners, bool allowRemoveForTemporaryToolbar)
		{
			if (OwnerIsToolbarsManager)
			{
				RemoveToolFromAllInstanceCollections(tool);
			}
			else
			{
				if (tool.HasSharedProps && tool.SharedProps.HasToolInstances)
				{
					tool.SharedProps.ToolInstances.InternalRemove(tool, notifyListeners: false);
				}
				if (tool is PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool)
				{
					popupMenuTool.VerifySettingsToolOwner();
				}
			}
			if (Owner is PopupToolBase { IsToolsContainer: not false } popupToolBase && (!OwnerIsTemporaryToolbar || allowRemoveForTemporaryToolbar))
			{
				ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollectionBase = ToolsCollectionToSynchronizeWith;
				if (toolsCollectionBase == null && OwningPopupMenu != null && !OwningPopupMenu.IsRootTool)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_78"));
				}
				if (toolsCollectionBase == null)
				{
					toolsCollectionBase = this;
				}
				bool flag = toolsCollectionBase.InternalRemove(tool, notifyListeners: false);
				for (int num = tool.SharedProps.ToolInstances.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase = tool.SharedProps.ToolInstances[num];
					if (toolBase.HasSameInstanceProps(tool))
					{
						tool.SharedProps.ToolInstances.InternalRemove(toolBase, notifyListeners: false);
					}
				}
				if (popupToolBase.IsOpen)
				{
					popupToolBase.RefreshDropDownContents();
				}
				else
				{
					foreach (PopupToolBase toolInstance in popupToolBase.SharedProps.ToolInstances)
					{
						if (toolInstance != null && toolInstance.IsOpen)
						{
							toolInstance.RefreshDropDownContents();
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				if (flag && notifyListeners)
				{
					toolsCollectionBase.NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Tools);
				}
				return;
			}
			bool ownerIsApplicationMenuArea = OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea;
			bool ownerIsBackStageMenuArea = OwnerIsBackStageMenuArea;
			if (ownerIsApplicationMenuArea || ownerIsBackStageMenuArea)
			{
				ApplicationMenuBase applicationMenuBase = null;
				if (ownerIsApplicationMenuArea)
				{
					applicationMenuBase = OwningApplicationMenuArea.ApplicationMenu;
				}
				else if (ownerIsBackStageMenuArea)
				{
					applicationMenuBase = OwningBackStageArea.ApplicationMenu2010;
				}
				bool flag2 = InternalRemove(tool, notifyListeners: false);
				if (applicationMenuBase.IsOpen)
				{
					applicationMenuBase.RefreshDropDownContents();
				}
				if (flag2 && notifyListeners)
				{
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Tools);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				InternalRemove(tool, notifyListeners);
			}
		}

		private void LogicallyRemoveAllTools()
		{
			object[] all = All;
			for (int num = all.Length - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				ToolBase tool = all[num] as ToolBase;
				LogicallyRemoveTool(tool, notifyListeners: false);
			}
		}

		private void OnAboutToModifyCollection()
		{
			VerifyUncustomizedToolsCached(onlyWhenCustomizing: true);
		}

		internal void VerifyUncustomizedToolsCached(bool onlyWhenCustomizing)
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (synchronizingPopupMenuToolsCollection || toolbarsManager == null || (onlyWhenCustomizing && !toolbarsManager.Customizing) || toolbarsManager.IsDesignMode || unCustomizedTools != null || (!OwnerIsToolbar && ((!OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea && !OwnerIsPopupMenu && !OwnerIsRibbonGroup) || ToolsCollectionToSynchronizeWith != null)))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Count == 0)
			{
				unCustomizedTools = new ArrayList(10);
				return;
			}
			unCustomizedTools = List.Clone() as ArrayList;
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				if (!this[i].IsMdiMergeTool)
				{
					this[i].CachePositionInOwner();
				}
				else
				{
					this[i].CacheMdiMergeToolPositionInOwner();
				}
			}
		}

		private static void RemoveToolFromAllInstanceCollections(ToolBase rootTool)
		{
			object[] all = rootTool.SharedProps.ToolInstances.All;
			object[] array = all;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = (ToolBase)array[i];
				if (!toolBase.IsRootTool)
				{
					ToolsCollectionBase parentCollection = toolBase.ParentCollection;
					if (parentCollection != null && parentCollection.Owner is UltraTaskPaneToolbar)
					{
						parentCollection.RemoveHelper(toolBase, honorReadOnlyStatus: false);
					}
					else if (toolBase.OwnerIsMenuInternal && toolBase.OwningMenuInternal.IsRootTool)
					{
						parentCollection.Remove(toolBase);
					}
					else if (toolBase.OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
					{
						parentCollection.RemoveHelper(toolBase, honorReadOnlyStatus: false);
					}
					else if (toolBase.OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
					{
						parentCollection.RemoveHelper(toolBase, honorReadOnlyStatus: false);
					}
					else if (toolBase.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)
					{
						parentCollection.Remove(toolBase);
					}
					else if (toolBase.OwnerIsApplicationMenu2010NavigationMenu)
					{
						parentCollection.Remove(toolBase);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void ValidateKeyIsntUsed(string key)
		{
			if (keyDictionary != null)
			{
				if (keyDictionary.Contains(key))
				{
					ValidateKeyDoesNotExist(key);
				}
				return;
			}
			if (Count < 40)
			{
				ValidateKeyDoesNotExist(key);
				return;
			}
			int num = IndexOf(key);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				ValidateKeyDoesNotExist(key);
			}
		}
	}

	[Serializable]
	public class ToolsCollection : ToolsCollectionBase, ISerializable
	{
		private NewToolPlaceHolderTool newToolPlaceHolder;

		internal NewToolPlaceHolderTool NewToolPlaceHolder
		{
			get
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager == null || !toolbarsManager.Customizing || !toolbarsManager.CustomizeDialog.ShouldDisplayNewToolPlaceHolder(base.Owner))
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (base.OwnerIsOptionSet || base.OwnerIsSharedProps || base.OwnerIsToolbarsManager)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (base.OwnerIsToolbar && !((UltraToolbarBase)base.Owner).CanBeModified)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (base.OwnerIsPopupMenu && toolbarsManager.IsDesignMode && ((ToolBase)base.Owner).InheritedResolved)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (base.OwnerIsRibbonGroup && !((RibbonGroup)base.Owner).CanBeModified)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (base.OwnerIsToolbar && ((UltraToolbarBase)base.Owner).OwningTaskPaneToolbar != null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (base.OwnerIsToolbar && ((UltraToolbarBase)base.Owner).IsBumpedToolsToolbar)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (base.OwnerIsToolbar && ((UltraToolbarBase)base.Owner).ToolbarType == ToolbarType.ControlContainerHostForPopupMenu)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (newToolPlaceHolder == null)
				{
					newToolPlaceHolder = new NewToolPlaceHolderTool(this);
				}
				return newToolPlaceHolder;
			}
		}

		internal ToolsCollection(IToolsCollectionOwner owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
			if (!base.OwnerIsToolbar)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraToolbarBase ultraToolbarBase = base.Owner as UltraToolbarBase;
			if (ultraToolbarBase.TearawayToolOwnerInternal != null && ultraToolbarBase.TearawayToolOwnerInternal.UnderlyingTool != null && ultraToolbarBase.TearawayToolOwnerInternal.UnderlyingTool is PopupControlContainerToolBase)
			{
				AddHelper(ultraToolbarBase.TearawayToolOwnerInternal, honorReadOnlyStatus: false, -1);
			}
			else
			{
				if (!ultraToolbarBase.BumpedToolsOnly || ultraToolbarBase.RootToolbars == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				UltraToolbarBase[] rootToolbars = ultraToolbarBase.RootToolbars;
				foreach (UltraToolbarBase ultraToolbarBase2 in rootToolbars)
				{
					foreach (ToolBase tool in ultraToolbarBase2.Tools)
					{
						if (tool.BumpedFromToolbar)
						{
							AddHelper(tool, honorReadOnlyStatus: false, -1);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

			: base(info, context)
		{
		}

		internal IKeyTipProvider[] GetKeyTipProviders()
		{
			List<IKeyTipProvider> list = new List<IKeyTipProvider>();
			ToolEnumerator toolEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (toolEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					ToolBase current = toolEnumerator.Current;
					list.AddRange(current.GetKeyTipProviders());
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = toolEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal ToolBase GetNextTool(ToolBase startAtTool, bool visibleToolsOnly, bool selectableToolsOnly, bool recentlyUsedToolsOnly, bool wrapAround)
		{
			int num = -1;
			if (startAtTool != null)
			{
				if (startAtTool is SystemMenuTool)
				{
					num = 0;
				}
				else
				{
					if (startAtTool is QuickCustomizeToolBase)
					{
						if (wrapAround)
						{
							return GetNextTool(null, visibleToolsOnly, selectableToolsOnly, recentlyUsedToolsOnly, wrapAround: false);
						}
						return null;
					}
					num = IndexOf(startAtTool) + 1;
				}
			}
			UltraToolbarBase ultraToolbarBase = base.Owner as UltraToolbarBase;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				if (ultraToolbarBase != null && ultraToolbarBase.ShowSystemMenu)
				{
					return base.ToolbarsManager.SystemMenu;
				}
				num = 0;
			}
			for (int i = num; i < Count; i++)
			{
				if ((!visibleToolsOnly || base[i].VisibleResolved) && (!selectableToolsOnly || (base[i].EnabledResolved && base[i].CanActivate)) && (!recentlyUsedToolsOnly || base[i].RecentlyUsedResolved))
				{
					return base[i];
				}
			}
			if (ultraToolbarBase != null && ultraToolbarBase.ShowQuickCustomizeTool)
			{
				return ultraToolbarBase.QuickCustomizeTool;
			}
			if (wrapAround && num > 0)
			{
				return GetNextTool(null, visibleToolsOnly, selectableToolsOnly, recentlyUsedToolsOnly, wrapAround: false);
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal ToolBase GetPreviousTool(ToolBase startAtTool, bool visibleToolsOnly, bool selectableToolsOnly, bool recentlyUsedToolsOnly, bool wrapAround)
		{
			int num = Count - 1;
			UltraToolbarBase ultraToolbarBase = base.Owner as UltraToolbarBase;
			if (startAtTool != null)
			{
				if (startAtTool is SystemMenuTool)
				{
					if (wrapAround)
					{
						return GetPreviousTool(null, visibleToolsOnly, selectableToolsOnly, recentlyUsedToolsOnly, wrapAround: false);
					}
					return null;
				}
				if (!(startAtTool is QuickCustomizeToolBase))
				{
					num = IndexOf(startAtTool) - 1;
				}
			}
			else if (ultraToolbarBase != null && ultraToolbarBase.ShowQuickCustomizeTool)
			{
				return ultraToolbarBase.QuickCustomizeTool;
			}
			for (int num2 = num; num2 >= 0; num2--)
			{
				if ((!visibleToolsOnly || base[num2].VisibleResolved) && (!selectableToolsOnly || (base[num2].EnabledResolved && base[num2].CanActivate)) && (!recentlyUsedToolsOnly || base[num2].RecentlyUsedResolved))
				{
					return base[num2];
				}
			}
			if (ultraToolbarBase != null && ultraToolbarBase.ShowSystemMenu)
			{
				return base.ToolbarsManager.SystemMenu;
			}
			if (wrapAround && num < Count - 1)
			{
				return GetPreviousTool(null, visibleToolsOnly, selectableToolsOnly, recentlyUsedToolsOnly, wrapAround: false);
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void HookUpTools()
		{
			CacheUnCustomizedToolInfoOnTools();
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = base[i];
				ToolBase rootTool = toolbarsManager.GetRootTool(toolBase);
				if (rootTool != null)
				{
					toolBase.InternalSetSharedProps(rootTool.SharedProps);
					continue;
				}
				try
				{
					ToolBase toolBase2 = toolBase.CloneForRootTool();
					toolBase2.SharedProps.InitializeFrom(toolBase.SharedProps);
					toolbarsManager.Tools.Add(toolBase2);
					rootTool = toolbarsManager.Tools[toolBase.Key];
					if (rootTool != null)
					{
						toolBase.InternalSetSharedProps(rootTool.SharedProps);
						continue;
					}
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
				RemoveAt(i);
				i--;
			}
		}

		internal int VisibleIndexOf(ToolBase tool)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(tool);
			for (int num2 = num - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
			{
				if (!base[num2].IsVisible(considerBumpedStatus: false))
				{
					num--;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private ToolBase InsertToolHelper(int index, string key, bool isMergedToolKey)
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = base.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null)
			{
				if (base.OwnerIsToolbar)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_85"));
				}
				if (base.OwnerIsPopupMenu)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_86"));
				}
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_87"));
			}
			ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollectionBase = (isMergedToolKey ? ((ToolsCollectionBase)toolbarsManager.MergedTools) : ((ToolsCollectionBase)toolbarsManager.Tools));
			int num = toolsCollectionBase.IndexOf(key);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_10", key));
			}
			return base[InternalInsertAt(toolsCollectionBase[num], index, honorReadOnlyStatus: true)];
		}
	}

	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class NonInheritedTools : ICollection, IEnumerable
	{
		private class NonInheritedToolEnumerator : IEnumerator
		{
			private NonInheritedTools collection;

			private int collectionVersion;

			private int currentIndex = -1;

			public object Current
			{
				get
				{
					_ = collectionVersion;
					_ = collection.tools.Version;
					if (currentIndex == -1)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return collection[currentIndex];
				}
			}

			public NonInheritedToolEnumerator(NonInheritedTools collection)
			{
				this.collection = collection;
				collectionVersion = this.collection.tools.Version;
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				_ = collectionVersion;
				_ = collection.tools.Version;
				if (currentIndex < collection.Count - 1)
				{
					currentIndex++;
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				currentIndex = -1;
				collectionVersion = collection.tools.Version;
			}
		}

		private ToolsCollectionBase tools;

		private int cachedCount;

		private int cachedCountVersion = -1;

		public int Count
		{
			get
			{
				if (cachedCountVersion != tools.Version)
				{
					cachedCount = 0;
					int i = 0;
					for (int count = tools.Count; i < count; i++)
					{
						if (!tools[i].IsInstanceInherited)
						{
							cachedCount++;
						}
					}
				}
				return cachedCount;
			}
		}

		public bool IsSynchronized => tools.IsSynchronized;

		public object SyncRoot => tools.SyncRoot;

		public ToolBase this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = tools.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase = tools[i];
					if (!toolBase.IsInstanceInherited)
					{
						if (index == 0)
						{
							return toolBase;
						}
						index--;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public NonInheritedTools(ToolsCollectionBase tools)
		{
			this.tools = tools;
		}

		public void CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = tools.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = tools[i];
				if (!toolBase.IsInstanceInherited)
				{
					array.SetValue(toolBase, index++);
				}
			}
		}

		public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new NonInheritedToolEnumerator(this);
		}

		public void AddRange(ToolBase[] tools)
		{
			this.tools.AddRange(tools);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			for (int num = tools.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (!tools[num].IsInstanceInherited)
				{
					tools.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}
	}

		private static void GetSeparatorColors(ControlUIElementBase controlElement, out Color color1, out Color color2)
		{
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0033: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004f: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = ((controlElement != null) ? (controlElement.UltraControl as UltraToolbarsManager) : null);
			if (ultraToolbarsManager == null)
			{
				color1 = SystemColors.ControlDark;
				color2 = SystemColors.ControlLightLight;
				return;
			}
			ToolbarStyle styleResolved = ultraToolbarsManager.StyleResolved;
			Color color3;
			Color color4;
			switch (styleResolved - 1)
			{
			case 1:
			case 2:
			case 4:
				color3 = ultraToolbarsManager.MSColors.SeparatorDark;
				color4 = ultraToolbarsManager.MSColors.SeparatorLight;
				break;
			default:
				color3 = SystemColors.ControlDark;
				color4 = SystemColors.ControlLightLight;
				break;
			}
			color1 = (Color)StyleUtils.GetCachedPropertyVal(ultraToolbarsManager, StyleUtils.CustomProperty.RibbonToolSeparatorColor, Color.Empty, Color.Empty, color3);
			color2 = (Color)StyleUtils.GetCachedPropertyVal(ultraToolbarsManager, StyleUtils.CustomProperty.RibbonToolSeparatorColor2, Color.Empty, Color.Empty, color4);
		}

		protected override void DrawBackColor(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
		}

		protected override void DrawBorders(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)this).Rect;
			Point empty = Point.Empty;
			Point empty2 = Point.Empty;
			empty.X = rect.Left + rect.Width / 2 - 1;
			empty.Y = rect.Top + 4;
			empty2.X = empty.X;
			empty2.Y = rect.Bottom - 4;
			GetSeparatorColors(((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).ControlElement, out var color, out var color2);
			Pen pen = ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).GetPen((PenType)0, color);
			Pen pen2 = ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).GetPen((PenType)13, color2);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(pen, empty, empty2);
			empty.X++;
			empty2.X++;
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(pen2, empty, empty2);
		}

		protected override void DrawImageBackground(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
		}

	internal sealed class ToolTypeID
	{
		private static List<ToolTypeID> toolTypes;

		private string typeAsString;

		private Type type;

		private int index;

		private static List<ToolTypeID> ToolTypes
		{
			get
			{
				if (toolTypes == null)
				{
					toolTypes = new List<ToolTypeID>(20);
					int num = 0;
					toolTypes.Add(new ToolTypeID(typeof(ButtonTool), num++));
					toolTypes.Add(new ToolTypeID(typeof(ComboBoxTool), num++));
					toolTypes.Add(new ToolTypeID(typeof(ControlContainerTool), num++));
					toolTypes.Add(new ToolTypeID(typeof(FontListTool), num++));
					toolTypes.Add(new ToolTypeID(typeof(LabelTool), num++));
					toolTypes.Add(new ToolTypeID(typeof(ListTool), num++));
					toolTypes.Add(new ToolTypeID(typeof(MdiWindowListTool), num++));
					toolTypes.Add(new ToolTypeID(typeof(PopupColorPickerTool), num++));
					toolTypes.Add(new ToolTypeID(typeof(PopupControlContainerTool), num++));
					toolTypes.Add(new ToolTypeID(typeof(PopupMenuTool), num++));
					toolTypes.Add(new ToolTypeID(typeof(StateButtonTool), num++));
					toolTypes.Add(new ToolTypeID(typeof(TextBoxTool), num++));
					toolTypes.Add(new ToolTypeID(typeof(TaskPaneTool), num++));
					toolTypes.Add(new ToolTypeID(typeof(MaskedEditTool), num++));
					toolTypes.Add(new ToolTypeID(typeof(ProgressBarTool), num++));
				}
				return toolTypes;
			}
		}

		internal int Index => index;

		internal Type Type => type;

		private ToolTypeID(Type type, int index)
		{
			this.type = type;
			this.index = index;
		}

		private ToolTypeID(string typeAsString, int index)
		{
			this.typeAsString = typeAsString;
			this.index = index;
		}

		internal static ToolTypeID GetToolTypeIDFromString(string typeAsString)
		{
			Monitor.Enter(typeof(ToolTypeID));
			try
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < ToolTypes.Count; i++)
				{
					if (typeAsString.Equals(ToolTypes[i].ToString()))
					{
						return ToolTypes[i];
					}
				}
				ToolTypeID toolTypeID = new ToolTypeID(typeAsString, ToolTypes.Count);
				ToolTypes.Add(toolTypeID);
				return toolTypeID;
			}
			finally
			{
				Monitor.Exit(typeof(ToolTypeID));
			}
		}

		internal static ToolTypeID GetToolTypeIDFromType(Type type)
		{
			if (type == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			Monitor.Enter(typeof(ToolTypeID));
			try
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < ToolTypes.Count; i++)
				{
					ToolTypeID toolTypeID = ToolTypes[i];
					if (toolTypeID.Type == type)
					{
						return toolTypeID;
					}
					if (toolTypeID.Type == null)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				string text = null;
				if (flag)
				{
					text = type.ToString();
					for (int i = 0; i < ToolTypes.Count; i++)
					{
						ToolTypeID toolTypeID = ToolTypes[i];
						if (toolTypeID.Type == null && text.Equals(toolTypeID.ToString()))
						{
							toolTypeID.InternalSetType(type);
							return toolTypeID;
						}
					}
				}
				ToolTypeID toolTypeID2 = new ToolTypeID(type, ToolTypes.Count);
				if (text != null)
				{
					toolTypeID2.InternalSetTypeAsString(text);
				}
				ToolTypes.Add(toolTypeID2);
				return toolTypeID2;
			}
			finally
			{
				Monitor.Exit(typeof(ToolTypeID));
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		internal void InternalSetType(Type type)
		{
			this.type = type;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		internal void InternalSetTypeAsString(string typeAsString)
		{
			this.typeAsString = typeAsString;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (typeAsString != null)
			{
				return typeAsString;
			}
			return type.ToString();
		}
	}
	public class ToolUIElement : UIElement
	{
		private ToolBase tool;

		public override UIElementBorderStyle BorderStyle
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0028: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager != null)
				{
					if (tool.DrawAsActive && ActiveBorders)
					{
						if ((int)toolbarsManager.StyleResolved != 1)
						{
							return (UIElementBorderStyle)4;
						}
						return (UIElementBorderStyle)8;
					}
					return (UIElementBorderStyle)1;
				}
				return (UIElementBorderStyle)0;
			}
		}

		public override UIRole UIRole
		{
			get
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = tool;
				if (toolBase != null)
				{
					if (toolBase.OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
					{
						return toolBase.UIRoleOnRibbonGroups;
					}
					return toolBase.UIRoleOnToolbars;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected override INotificationBadgeProvider NotificationBadgeProvider => (INotificationBadgeProvider)(object)tool;

		public ToolBase Tool => tool;

		public UltraToolbarsManager ToolbarsManager => tool.ToolbarsManager;

		protected internal virtual bool ActiveBorders
		{
			get
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
				if (toolbarsManager == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (toolbarsManager.ToolBeingEdited != null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (toolbarsManager.ActiveTool != tool)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (toolbarsManager.ToolbarWithCapture != null)
				{
					if (tool.OwnerIsToolbarInternal && tool.OwningToolbarInternal == toolbarsManager.ToolbarWithCapture)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (tool.OwnerIsToolbarInternal && tool.OwningToolbarInternal.ToolbarType == ToolbarType.Popup)
					{
						return true;
					}
					return false;
				}
				if (toolbarsManager.RibbonGroupWithCapture != null)
				{
					if (tool.OwnerIsRibbonGroup && tool.OwningRibbonGroup == toolbarsManager.RibbonGroupWithCapture)
					{
						return true;
					}
					return false;
				}
				if (toolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture != null && tool.IsWithinOwner(toolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return toolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture == null;
			}
		}

		internal ToolUIElement(UIElement parent, ToolBase tool)
			: base(parent)
		{
			InitializeElement(tool);
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			tool.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, tool.DrawAsActive, tool.IsPressed);
		}

		protected override void OnClick()
		{
			((UIElement)this).OnClick();
			if (ToolbarsManager != null && !ToolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				tool.IncrementClickCount();
				if (ToolbarsManager.ActiveTool != tool)
				{
					ToolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(tool, setOn: true, clearToolBeingEdited: true, clearToolbarWithCaptureIfNecessary: true);
				}
				if (ToolbarsManager.ActiveTool == tool)
				{
					tool.OnToolClick();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDoubleClick(bool adjustableArea)
		{
			((UIElement)this).OnClick();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter()
		{
			((UIElement)this).OnMouseEnter();
			if (ToolbarsManager != null && !ToolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.InternalSetActiveTool(tool, setOn: true, clearToolBeingEdited: false);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave()
		{
			((UIElement)this).OnMouseLeave();
			tool.ForceDrawAsActive = false;
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager != null && !toolbarsManager.Customizing && toolbarsManager.ToolBeingEdited == null)
			{
				ToolBase activeTool = toolbarsManager.ActiveTool;
				if (activeTool == tool || activeTool == tool.UnderlyingTool)
				{
					tool.DeactivateToolUnlessOwnerHasCapture();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeElement(ToolBase tool)
		{
			((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext = tool;
			this.tool = tool;
		}
	}

			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_013e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0144: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_0138: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if ((int)isOutermostDockArea == 0)
				{
					if (dockedPosition == DockedPosition.Floating)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (toolbarsManager == null || !toolbarsManager.Initialized)
					{
						return false;
					}
					Control dockWithinContainer = toolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer;
					if (dockWithinContainer == null || dockWithinContainer.IsDisposed || ((Control)this).IsDisposed)
					{
						return false;
					}
					int priorityLevel = ((IDockingArea)this).PriorityLevel;
					DockStyle dock = Dock;
					bool flag = true;
					if (dockWithinContainer is ScrollableControl)
					{
						ScrollableControl scrollableControl = (ScrollableControl)dockWithinContainer;
						switch (dock)
						{
						case DockStyle.Left:
							flag = scrollableControl.DockPadding.Left <= 2;
							break;
						case DockStyle.Right:
							flag = scrollableControl.DockPadding.Right <= 2;
							break;
						case DockStyle.Top:
							flag = scrollableControl.DockPadding.Top <= 2;
							break;
						case DockStyle.Bottom:
							flag = scrollableControl.DockPadding.Bottom <= 2;
							break;
						}
					}
					int i = 0;
					for (int count = dockWithinContainer.Controls.Count; i < count; i++)
					{
						Control control = dockWithinContainer.Controls[i];
						if (control != null && control.Visible && control.Dock == dock)
						{
							int priorityLevel2 = DockingAreaManager.GetPriorityLevel(control);
							if (priorityLevel2 > priorityLevel)
							{
								flag = false;
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					isOutermostDockArea = (DefaultableBoolean)(flag ? 1 : 2);
				}
				return (int)isOutermostDockArea == 1;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsRibbonVisibleInDockArea
		{
			get
			{
				if (toolbarsManager != null && DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Top)
				{
					if (!toolbarsManager.HasRibbon || !toolbarsManager.Ribbon.VisibleResolved)
					{
						return toolbarsManager.IsFormRounded;

		}

		protected override bool IsPointDesignTimeActive(Point pt)
		{
			if (toolbarsManager == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!toolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				return ((UltraControlBase)this).IsPointDesignTimeActive(pt);
			}
			if (toolbarsManager.HasRibbon && toolbarsManager.Ribbon.TabManager.IsDragging)
			{
				return true;
			}
			UIElement val = ((UIElement)ControlElement).ElementFromPoint(pt);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return ((UltraControlBase)this).IsPointDesignTimeActive(pt);
			}
			while (val != null)
			{
				if (val is ToolbarUIElement || val is ToolbarsDesignerButtonUIElement || val is RibbonTabItemUIElement || val is RibbonGroupUIElement || val is TaskPaneToolbarUIElement || val is ApplicationMenuButtonUIElementBase || val is ContextualTabGroupCaptionUIElement || val is RibbonPagerButtonUIElement || val is NewRibbonGroupButtonUIElement || val is RibbonGroupButtonUIElement || val is QatQuickCustomizeToolUIElement || val is ApplicationMenuBackButtonUIElement)
				{
					return true;
				}
				val = val.Parent;
			}
			return ((UltraControlBase)this).IsPointDesignTimeActive(pt);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (toolbarsManager == null)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)this).OnMouseDown(e);
				return;
			}
			toolbarsManager.LeftButtonDownOnMenuItem = false;
			if ((IsParentedOnBackStage && toolbarsManager.Customizing && toolbarsManager.ProcessMenuMouseDownWhileCustomizing(ControlElement, e)) || (toolbarsManager.Customizing && toolbarsManager.ProcessToolbarMouseDownWhileCustomizing(ControlElement, e)))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (toolbarsManager.IsInHotkeyMode)
			{
				switch (e.Button)
				{
				case MouseButtons.Left:
					toolbarsManager.HotkeyModeExitPendingForLeftClick = true;
					break;
				case MouseButtons.Middle:
				{
					UltraToolbar ultraToolbar = toolbarsManager.ToolbarFromPoint(((Control)this).PointToScreen(e.Location));
					if (ultraToolbar == null || ultraToolbar != toolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture)
					{
						toolbarsManager.ExitHotkeyMode();
					}
					break;
				}
				case MouseButtons.Right:
					toolbarsManager.ExitHotkeyMode();
					break;
				}
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnMouseDown(e);
			if (toolbarsManager.HotkeyModeExitPendingForLeftClick)
			{
				toolbarsManager.ExitHotkeyMode();
				toolbarsManager.HotkeyModeExitPendingForLeftClick = false;
			}
			if (ControlUIElementBase.ControlElementWithMouseCapture == null)
			{
				ToolbarsManagerUtilities.SetControlCapture((Control)(object)this, capture: false);
			}
			if (toolbarsManager.ToolbarWithCapture != null)
			{
				UltraToolbarBase ultraToolbarBase = toolbarsManager.ToolbarBaseFromPoint(Control.MousePosition);
				if (ultraToolbarBase == toolbarsManager.ToolbarWithCapture)
				{
					ignoreNextMouseClick = true;
				}
				else if (toolbarsManager.ToolbarWithCapture is QuickAccessToolbar || toolbarsManager.ToolbarWithCapture is MiniToolbar || toolbarsManager.ToolbarWithCapture is RibbonTabItemToolbar)
				{
					UIElement val = ((UIElement)ControlElement).ElementFromPoint(new Point(e.X, e.Y), (UIElementInputType)4);
					if (val != null && val.GetContext(typeof(ToolBase)) != null)
					{
						ignoreNextMouseClick = true;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (toolbarsManager.RibbonGroupWithCapture != null)
			{
				RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = toolbarsManager.RibbonGroupFromPoint(Control.MousePosition);
				if (ribbonGroup == toolbarsManager.RibbonGroupWithCapture)
				{
					ignoreNextMouseClick = true;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPaint(PaintEventArgs pe)
		{
			if (cachedPaint != null)
			{
				pe.Graphics.DrawImageUnscaled(cachedPaint, Point.Empty);
				ClearCachedPaint();
				((UltraControlBase)this).Invalidate();
				return;
			}
			SetDockAreaColorProps();
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnPaint(pe);
			if (DockRows.Count == 1)
			{
				DockRow dockRow = DockRows[0];
				if (dockRow != null && dockRow.Toolbars.Count == 1)
				{
					UltraToolbarBase ultraToolbarBase = dockRow.Toolbars[0];
					ToolBase toolBase = null;
					PopupControlContainerToolBase popupControlContainerToolBase = null;
					if (ultraToolbarBase.TearawayToolOwnerInternal != null)
					{
						toolBase = ultraToolbarBase.TearawayToolOwnerInternal;
						if (toolBase != null)
						{
							popupControlContainerToolBase = toolBase.UnderlyingTool as PopupControlContainerToolBase;
						}
					}
					if (popupControlContainerToolBase != null && popupControlContainerToolBase.IsControlContainer && (isPopupArea || !popupControlContainerToolBase.IsContainedControlShared) && (popupControlContainerToolBase.ToolWithContainedControl != popupControlContainerToolBase || !popupControlContainerToolBase.IsContainedControlShared))
					{
						popupControlContainerToolBase.PopupToolbar.Tools[0].SetToolWithContainedControl(takeControlOwnership: true, this);
						if (firstPaint && UltraToolbarsManager.ShouldActivateToolControlAndForm(popupControlContainerToolBase))
						{
							Form form = UltraToolbarsManager.FindFormHelper((Control)(object)this);
							if (form != null && form != ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ActiveForm)
							{
								ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ActivateForm(form);
							}
							if (!popupControlContainerToolBase.Control.ContainsFocus)
							{
								ToolbarsManagerUtilities.FocusControl(popupControlContainerToolBase.Control);
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			firstPaint = false;
		}

		protected override void OnParentChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnParentChanged(e);
			if (floatingFormClosingHandler != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					uIPermission.Assert();
				}
				if (dockedPosition == DockedPosition.Floating && !parentIsBackStage && ((Control)this).Parent != null)
				{
					Form form = ((Control)this).FindForm();
					if (form != null)
					{
						floatingFormClosingHandler = OnFloatingFormClosing;
						form.Closing += floatingFormClosingHandler;
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}

			}
		}

		[UIPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Window = UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows)]
		protected override bool ProcessMnemonic(char charCode)

		}

		protected override void SetBoundsCore(int x, int y, int width, int height, BoundsSpecified specified)
		{
			Rectangle? rectangle = newBounds;
			try
			{
				newBounds = new Rectangle(x, y, width, height);
				if ((specified & BoundsSpecified.Size) != BoundsSpecified.None || specified == BoundsSpecified.None)
				{
					Size currentSize = new Size(width, height);
					RefreshDockAreaSize(ref currentSize);
					if (DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Bottom)
					{
						y -= currentSize.Height - height;
					}
					else if (DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Right)
					{
						x -= currentSize.Width - width;
					}
					width = currentSize.Width;
					height = currentSize.Height;
				}
				((Control)this).SetBoundsCore(x, y, width, height, specified);
			}
			finally
			{
				newBounds = rectangle;
			}
		}

			}
		}

		private void CreateSubclasser()
		{
			if (subclasser != null || ((Control)this).IsDisposed || ((Control)this).Disposing || !((Control)this).IsHandleCreated || ((Component)this).DesignMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				PermissionSet permissionSet = new PermissionSet(null);
				permissionSet.AddPermission(new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode));
				permissionSet.AddPermission(new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.SafeTopLevelWindows));
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					permissionSet.Assert();
				}
				CreateSubClasserHelper();
				PermissionSet.RevertAssert();
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private void CreateSubClasserHelper()
		{
			subclasser = new DockAreaSubClasser(this);
		}

		private int GetRowFromOffset(int offset, UltraToolbarBase toolbar, int currentRowIndex, out bool insertNewRow)
		{
			if (dockRows == null || dockRows.Count == 0)
			{
				insertNewRow = true;
				return 0;
			}
			insertNewRow = false;
			RowCol toolbarPositionInDockArea = GetToolbarPositionInDockArea(toolbar);
			bool flag = toolbarPositionInDockArea.Row >= 0 && toolbarPositionInDockArea.Col >= 0;
			bool fillEntireRowResolved = toolbar.FillEntireRowResolved;
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < dockRows.Count; i++)
			{
				DockRow dockRow = dockRows[i];
				if (dockRow == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				int cachedLogicalHeight = dockRow.CachedLogicalHeight;
				if (offset <= num + cachedLogicalHeight)
				{
					bool fillEntireRowResolved2 = dockRow.Toolbars[0].FillEntireRowResolved;
					int num2 = num + cachedLogicalHeight / 2;
					bool flag2 = flag && i == currentRowIndex;
					bool flag3 = flag && i > currentRowIndex;
					if (!fillEntireRowResolved2 && flag2 && dockRow.Toolbars.Count > 1)
					{
						if (num + 2 >= offset)
						{
							insertNewRow = true;
							return i;
						}
						if (num + cachedLogicalHeight - 1 < offset)
						{
							insertNewRow = true;
							return i + 1;
						}
						return i;
					}
					if (fillEntireRowResolved && fillEntireRowResolved2)
					{
						if (flag2)
						{
							return i;
						}
						int num3 = ((offset >= num2) ? (i + 1) : i);
						insertNewRow = !flag || num3 != currentRowIndex;
						return num3;
					}
					if (!fillEntireRowResolved && fillEntireRowResolved2)
					{
						int num4 = ((offset <= num2) ? i : (i + 1));
						insertNewRow = !flag || currentRowIndex != num4;
						if (!insertNewRow && DockRows[currentRowIndex].Toolbars.Count > 1)
						{
							insertNewRow = true;
						}
						return num4;
					}
					if (fillEntireRowResolved && !fillEntireRowResolved2)
					{
						int num5 = ((offset <= num2) ? i : (i + 1));
						insertNewRow = !flag || currentRowIndex != num5;
						return num5;
					}
					if (!fillEntireRowResolved && !fillEntireRowResolved2)
					{
						if (flag2)
						{
							return i;
						}
						int num6 = (flag3 ? ((num + 2 > offset) ? (i - 1) : i) : ((num + cachedLogicalHeight - 2 < offset) ? (i + 1) : i));
						insertNewRow = !flag || (num6 != i && num6 != currentRowIndex);
						if (num6 < 0)
						{
							num6 = 0;
						}
						return num6;
					}
				}
				num += cachedLogicalHeight;
			}
			insertNewRow = true;
			if (offset > num)
			{
				return DockRows.Count;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		private RowCol GetToolbarPositionInDockArea(UltraToolbarBase toolbar)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < DockRows.Count; i++)
			{
				DockRow dockRow = DockRows[i];
				if (dockRow == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < dockRow.Toolbars.Count; j++)
				{
					if (dockRow.Toolbars[j].Equals(toolbar))
					{
						return new RowCol(i, j);
					}
				}
			}
			return new RowCol(-1, -1);
		}

		private void InitControlStyles()
		{
			if (toolbarsManager != null)

				((Control)this).Font = toolbarsManager.MenuFont;

			((Control)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.Selectable, value: false);
			((Control)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.ContainerControl, value: true);
			((Control)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.OptimizedDoubleBuffer, value: false);
			((Control)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.ResizeRedraw, value: true);
			((Control)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.UserMouse, value: true);
			((Control)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.StandardClick, value: true);
			((Control)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.StandardDoubleClick, value: true);
			((Control)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.FixedHeight, value: true);
			((Control)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.FixedWidth, value: true);
			((Control)this).TabStop = false;
			SetDockAreaColorProps();

			{

				}
				else

					((Control)this).AccessibleRole = AccessibleRole.Grouping;
				}
			}
		}

		private void SnapShotToolBarLocations()
		{
			if (toolbarLocations != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			foreach (DockRow dockRow in DockRows)
			{
				num += dockRow.Toolbars.Count;
			}
			toolbarLocations = new ToolbarLocation[num];
			int num2 = 0;
			UIElementEnumerator enumerator2 = ((UIElement)ControlElement).ChildElements.GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator2.MoveNext())
				{
					UIElement current2 = enumerator2.Current;
					UltraToolbarBase ultraToolbarBase = current2.GetContext(typeof(UltraToolbarBase), false) as UltraToolbarBase;
					UIElement val = current2;
					if (ultraToolbarBase is UltraToolbar && ultraToolbarBase != null && num2 < toolbarLocations.Length)
					{
						toolbarLocations[num2] = new ToolbarLocation(ultraToolbarBase.DockedRowInternal, ultraToolbarBase, val.Rect);
						num2++;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (enumerator2 is IDisposable disposable)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		internal Control GetParentForHiddenContainedControls(bool shouldCreate)
		{
			if (parentForHiddenContainedControls == null && shouldCreate)
