		}

		internal void AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(AccessibleEvents accEvent, int childID)
		{
			if (!((Control)this).IsDisposed && !((Control)this).Disposing && ((Control)this).IsHandleCreated)
			{
				AccessibilityNotifyClientsDelayed(accEvent, childID);
			}
		}

		private void AccessibilityNotifyClientsDelayed(AccessibleEvents accEvent, int childID)
		{
			if (((Control)this).IsDisposed || ((Control)this).Disposing || !((Control)this).IsHandleCreated)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (accEvent == accessiblePendingEventId && childID == accessiblePendingChildId)
			{
				accessiblePendingEventId = AccessibleEvents.HelpChange;
				accessiblePendingChildId = -2;
			}
			if (accEvent == AccessibleEvents.Focus)
			{
				AccessibleObject accessibleObject = null;
				if (this.accessibleObject != null)
				{
					accessibleObject = this.accessibleObject.GetFocused();
				}
				if (lastFocusedAccessibleObject != null && lastFocusedAccessibleObject == accessibleObject)
				{
					return;
				}
				lastFocusedAccessibleObject = accessibleObject;
			}
			((Control)this).AccessibilityNotifyClients(accEvent, childID);
		}

		internal void AdjustClientRect(ref Rectangle clientBounds)
		{
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if (ultraToolbarsManager != null && (!IsAutoHideRibbon || (int)ultraToolbarsManager.CurrentToolbarFormBorderStyle == 2))
			{
				switch (DockedPosition)
				{
				case DockedPosition.Top:
				case DockedPosition.Bottom:
					RemoveResizeBordersFromRect(ref clientBounds, ultraToolbarsManager, checkLeft: true, checkRight: true);
					break;
				case DockedPosition.Left:
					RemoveResizeBordersFromRect(ref clientBounds, ultraToolbarsManager, checkLeft: true, checkRight: false);
					break;
				case DockedPosition.Right:
					RemoveResizeBordersFromRect(ref clientBounds, ultraToolbarsManager, checkLeft: false, checkRight: true);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal RowCol AddToolbar(UltraToolbar toolbar, bool restoreOldPosition)
		{
			if (!restoreOldPosition)
			{
				return AddToolbar(toolbar, toolbar.DockedRow, toolbar.DockedColumn);
			}
			int num = 0;
			int col = toolbar.DockedColumn;
			bool flag = true;
			bool exclusiveOnRow = true;
			int num2 = 0;
			while (flag && num2 < DockRows.Count)
			{
				DockRow dockRow = DockRows[num2];
				foreach (UltraToolbarBase toolbar2 in dockRow.Toolbars)
				{
					if (!(toolbar2 is UltraToolbar ultraToolbar))
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (toolbar == ultraToolbar)
					{
						continue;
					}
					RelativeHiddenToolbarInfo relativeHiddenToolbarInfo = ultraToolbar.GetRelativeHiddenToolbarInfo(toolbar);
					if (relativeHiddenToolbarInfo == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					switch (relativeHiddenToolbarInfo.RelativeLocation)
					{
					case RelativeHiddenToolbarLocation.HiddenToolbarIsMoreOutside:
						flag = false;
						if (num == 0)
						{
							num = num2 - 1;
						}
						break;
					case RelativeHiddenToolbarLocation.HiddenToolbarIsOnSameRowWithLowerColumn:
						flag = false;
						num = num2;
						col = ultraToolbar.DockedColumn;
						exclusiveOnRow = false;
						break;
					case RelativeHiddenToolbarLocation.HiddenToolbarIsOnSameRowWithHigherColumn:
						num = num2;
						col = ultraToolbar.DockedColumn + 1;
						exclusiveOnRow = false;
						break;
					case RelativeHiddenToolbarLocation.HiddenToolbarIsMoreInside:
						num = num2 + 1;
						break;
					}
				}
				num2++;
			}
			return AddToolbar(toolbar, num, col, refreshDockAreaSize: true, exclusiveOnRow);
		}

		internal RowCol AddToolbar(UltraToolbarBase toolbar, int row, int col)
		{
			return AddToolbar(toolbar, row, col, refreshDockAreaSize: true, exclusiveOnRow: false);
		}

		internal RowCol AddToolbar(UltraToolbarBase toolbar, int row, int col, bool refreshDockAreaSize, bool exclusiveOnRow)
		{
			RowCol toolbarPositionInDockArea = GetToolbarPositionInDockArea(toolbar);
			if (toolbarPositionInDockArea.Row != -1 && toolbarPositionInDockArea.Col != -1)
			{
				return toolbarPositionInDockArea;
			}
			DockRow dockRow = null;
			int num = -1;
			int num2 = -1;
			while (true)
			{
				if (row < 0 || row >= dockRows.Count)
				{
					dockRow = new DockRow(this);
					dockRows.Add(dockRow);
					num = dockRows.Count - 1;
					break;
				}
				if (dockRows[row].Toolbars.Count == 0)
				{
					dockRow = dockRows[row];
					num = row;
					break;
				}
				if (exclusiveOnRow || dockRows[row].Toolbars[0].FillEntireRowResolved || (toolbar.FillEntireRowResolved && dockRows[row].Toolbars.Count > 0) || (toolbarsManager.Customizing & (toolbar.Width + dockRows[row].TotalToolbarWidth > LogicalWidth)))
				{
					if (toolbar.InitialDockPending)
					{
						row++;
						continue;
					}
					dockRow = new DockRow(this);
					dockRows.Insert(row, dockRow);
					num = row;
					for (int i = num + 1; i < dockRows.Count; i++)
					{
						DockRow dockRow2 = DockRows[i];
						if (dockRow2 != null)
						{
							for (int j = 0; j < dockRow2.Toolbars.Count; j++)
							{
								dockRow2.Toolbars[j].InternalSetDockedRow(i);
							}
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				dockRow = dockRows[row];
				num = row;
				break;
			}
			if (toolbar.InitialDockPending)
			{
				toolbar.InitialDockPending = false;
			}
			if (col > -1)
			{
				if (col < dockRow.Toolbars.Count)
				{
					dockRow.Toolbars.Insert(col, toolbar);
					num2 = col;
					for (int k = num2 + 1; k < dockRow.Toolbars.Count; k++)
					{
						dockRow.Toolbars[k].InternalSetDockedColumn(k);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					dockRow.Toolbars.Add(toolbar);
					num2 = dockRow.Toolbars.Count - 1;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				dockRow.Toolbars.Add(toolbar);
				num2 = dockRow.Toolbars.Count - 1;
			}
			toolbar.SetDockedPosition(dockedPosition, calledFromDockAreaAddToolbar: true);
			if (refreshDockAreaSize)
			{
				RefreshDockAreaSize();
			}
			if (!repositioningToolbar)
			{
				dockRow.CalculateMetrics();
				((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).VerifyChildElements(true);
				ReparentContainedControls(toolbar, takeOwnership: true);
			}
			return new RowCol(num, num2);
		}

		internal void CachePaint()
		{
			if (!((Control)this).IsHandleCreated)
			{
				return;
			}
			Form form = ToolbarsManager.FindForm();
			if (form != null && form.IsHandleCreated)
			{
				try
				{
					int num = (int)NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowLong(form.Handle, -20);
					if ((num & 0x2000000) == 33554432)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
				}
			}
			if (((Control)this).Size.Width > 0 && ((Control)this).Size.Height > 0)
			{
				Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(((Control)this).Size.Width, ((Control)this).Size.Height);
				Utilities.DrawControlToBitmap((Control)(object)this, bitmap, ((Control)this).ClientRectangle);
				cachedPaint = bitmap;
			}
		}

				((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).DirtyChildElements();
			}
		}

			}

					num12 = ((!isVertical) ? originalRect2.Y : originalRect2.X);

		internal int DockRowIndexFromDragPoint(Point point, UltraToolbar toolbar, int currentRowIndex, out bool insertNewRow)
		{
			Point point2 = ((Control)this).PointToClient(point);
			int num;
			switch (dockedPosition)
			{
			case DockedPosition.Right:
				num = ((Control)this).ClientRectangle.Right - point2.X;
				break;
			case DockedPosition.Left:
				num = point2.X;
				if (ContainsResizingArea)
				{
					num -= toolbarsManager.RoundedFormBorderWidth;
				}
				break;
			case DockedPosition.Bottom:
				num = ((Control)this).ClientRectangle.Bottom - point2.Y;
				break;
			case DockedPosition.Top:
				num = point2.Y;
				if (toolbarsManager != null)
				{
					if (IsRibbonVisibleInDockArea)
					{
						num -= toolbarsManager.Ribbon.Metrics.GetRibbonHeight(IsAutoHideRibbon);
					}
					if (IsNavigationToolbarVisibleInDockArea)
					{
						num -= toolbarsManager.NavigationToolbar.Height;
					}
				}
				break;
			default:
				num = point2.Y;
				break;
			}
			return GetRowFromOffset(num, toolbar, currentRowIndex, out insertNewRow);
		}

		internal void EnsureAllToolsAreVisibleWhileCustomizing()
		{
			if (DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Floating || toolbarsManager == null || !toolbarsManager.Customizing || !toolbarsManager.CustomizeDialog.ExpandToolbarsToDisplayAllTools)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				DrawUtility.BeginGraphicsCaching();
				bool flag = false;
				int num = ((!IsVertical) ? ((Control)this).ClientRectangle.Width : ((Control)this).ClientRectangle.Height);
				for (int i = 0; i < DockRows.Count; i++)
				{
					DockRow dockRow = DockRows[i];
					if (dockRow == null || dockRow.Toolbars.Count <= 0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					int num2 = 0;
					int num3 = 0;
					for (int j = 0; j < dockRow.Toolbars.Count; j++)
					{
						UltraToolbarBase ultraToolbarBase = dockRow.Toolbars[j];
						if (ultraToolbarBase == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
						num3 = ultraToolbarBase.Width;
						if (num2 > 0 && num3 + num2 > num)
						{
							DockRow dockRow2 = new DockRow(this);
							dockRow2.Toolbars.AddRange(dockRow.Toolbars.GetRange(j, dockRow.Toolbars.Count - j));
							dockRow.Toolbars.RemoveRange(j, dockRow.Toolbars.Count - j);
							dockRows.Insert(i + 1, dockRow2);
							flag = true;
							for (int k = 0; k < dockRow2.Toolbars.Count; k++)
							{
								dockRow2.Toolbars[k].TargetPositionInDockedRow = 0;
							}
							break;
						}
						num2 += num3;
						ultraToolbarBase.InternalSetDockedRow(i, clearSnapShotValues: false);
						ultraToolbarBase.InternalSetDockedColumn(j, clearSnapShotValues: false);
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					RefreshDockAreaSize();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				DrawUtility.EndGraphicsCaching();
			}
		}

		internal UltraToolbarBase GetToolbarAtIndex(int index)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (DockRow dockRow in DockRows)
			{
				num = dockRow.Toolbars.Count;
				if (index < num)
				{
					return dockRow.Toolbars[index];
				}
				index -= num;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void Initialize(DockedPosition dockedPosition)
		{
			this.dockedPosition = dockedPosition;
			switch (dockedPosition)
			{
			case DockedPosition.Top:
				((Control)this).Dock = DockStyle.Top;
				break;
			case DockedPosition.Bottom:
				((Control)this).Dock = DockStyle.Bottom;
				break;
			case DockedPosition.Left:
				((Control)this).Dock = DockStyle.Left;
				break;
			case DockedPosition.Right:
				((Control)this).Dock = DockStyle.Right;
				break;
			case DockedPosition.Floating:
				((Control)this).Dock = DockStyle.Fill;
				break;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_93"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_94"));
			}
		}

		internal void InvalidateNonClientAreas()
		{
			if (mainElement != null)
			{
				mainElement.InvalidateResizeAreas();
			}
			if (IsRibbonVisibleInDockArea)
			{
				toolbarsManager.Ribbon.DirtyRibbonCaptionElement();
			}
		}

		internal bool IsDragOverPoint(Point point, UltraToolbar toolbarBeingDragged)
		{
			if (((Control)this).IsDisposed || ((Control)this).Disposing)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!((Control)this).IsHandleCreated)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Rectangle rectangle = ((Control)this).RectangleToScreen(((Control)this).ClientRectangle);
			switch (dockedPosition)
			{
			case DockedPosition.Top:
			case DockedPosition.Bottom:
				rectangle.Inflate(0, 20);
				break;
			case DockedPosition.Left:
			case DockedPosition.Right:
				rectangle.Inflate(20, 0);
				break;
			}
			return rectangle.Contains(point);
		}

		internal void MakeRoomJustClickedTool(ToolBase tool)
		{
			if (DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Floating || !(tool.OwningToolbarInternal is UltraToolbar ultraToolbar) || ultraToolbar.DockedPosition != DockedPosition)
			{
				return;
			}
			DockRow dockRow = DockRows[ultraToolbar.DockedRow];
			if (dockRow == null || dockRow.Toolbars.Count < 2)
			{
				DirtyChildElements();
				return;
			}
			int width = tool.CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstanceHelper().Width;
			bool flag = true;
			for (int num = dockRow.Toolbars.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (dockRow.Toolbars[num] is UltraToolbar ultraToolbar2)
				{
					if (ultraToolbar2 == ultraToolbar)
					{
						flag = false;
						if (num != dockRow.Toolbars.Count - 1)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
					else if (ultraToolbar2.TargetPositionInDockedRow > 0)
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							ultraToolbar2.TargetPositionInDockedRow += width;
						}
						else
						{
							ultraToolbar2.TargetPositionInDockedRow = Math.Max(0, ultraToolbar2.TargetPositionInDockedRow - width);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			DirtyChildElements();
		}

		internal AccessibleObject NavigateToolbar(UltraToolbarBase toolbarBase, AccessibleNavigation navdir)
		{
			switch (navdir)
			{
			case AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild:
			{
				UIElement val2 = null;
				for (int i = 0; i < toolbarBase.Tools.Count; i++)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase = toolbarBase.Tools[i];
					val2 = toolBase.UIElement;
					if (val2 != null && !val2.Rect.IsEmpty)
					{
						return toolBase.AccessibilityObject;
					}
				}
				if (toolbarBase.ShowQuickCustomizeTool)
				{
					return toolbarBase.QuickCustomizeTool.AccessibilityObject;
				}
				return null;
			}
			case AccessibleNavigation.LastChild:
			{
				if (toolbarBase.ShowQuickCustomizeTool)
				{
					return toolbarBase.QuickCustomizeTool.AccessibilityObject;
				}
				UIElement val3 = null;
				for (int num2 = toolbarBase.Tools.Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase = toolbarBase.Tools[num2];
					val3 = toolBase.UIElement;
					if (val3 != null && !val3.Rect.IsEmpty)
					{
						return toolBase.AccessibilityObject;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
			default:
			{
				if (!(toolbarBase is UltraToolbar ultraToolbar))
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (ultraToolbar.DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Floating)
				{
					return null;
				}
				RowCol toolbarPositionInDockArea = GetToolbarPositionInDockArea(ultraToolbar);
				if (toolbarPositionInDockArea.Row < 0 || toolbarPositionInDockArea.Col < 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				int count = DockRows.Count;
				int count2 = DockRows[toolbarPositionInDockArea.Row].Toolbars.Count;
				int num = -1;
				int val = -1;
				switch (navdir)
				{
				case AccessibleNavigation.Down:
					switch (ultraToolbar.DockedPosition)
					{
					case DockedPosition.Bottom:
						navdir = AccessibleNavigation.Up;
						break;
					case DockedPosition.Left:
					case DockedPosition.Right:
						navdir = AccessibleNavigation.Right;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Up:
					switch (ultraToolbar.DockedPosition)
					{
					case DockedPosition.Bottom:
						navdir = AccessibleNavigation.Down;
						break;
					case DockedPosition.Left:
					case DockedPosition.Right:
						navdir = AccessibleNavigation.Left;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Left:
					switch (ultraToolbar.DockedPosition)
					{
					case DockedPosition.Right:
						navdir = AccessibleNavigation.Down;
						break;
					case DockedPosition.Left:
						navdir = AccessibleNavigation.Up;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Right:
					switch (ultraToolbar.DockedPosition)
					{
					case DockedPosition.Right:
						navdir = AccessibleNavigation.Up;
						break;
					case DockedPosition.Left:
						navdir = AccessibleNavigation.Down;
						break;
					}
					break;
				}
				switch (navdir)
				{
				case AccessibleNavigation.Next:
					if (toolbarPositionInDockArea.Col < count2 - 1)
					{
						num = toolbarPositionInDockArea.Row;
						val = toolbarPositionInDockArea.Col + 1;
						break;
					}
					switch (ultraToolbar.DockedPosition)
					{
					case DockedPosition.Bottom:
					case DockedPosition.Right:
						if (toolbarPositionInDockArea.Row > 0)
						{
							num = toolbarPositionInDockArea.Row - 1;
							val = 0;
						}
						break;
					case DockedPosition.Top:
					case DockedPosition.Left:
						if (toolbarPositionInDockArea.Row < count - 1)
						{
							num = toolbarPositionInDockArea.Row + 1;
							val = 0;
						}
						break;
					}
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Previous:
					if (toolbarPositionInDockArea.Col > 0)
					{
						num = toolbarPositionInDockArea.Row;
						val = toolbarPositionInDockArea.Col - 1;
						break;
					}
					switch (ultraToolbar.DockedPosition)
					{
					case DockedPosition.Bottom:
					case DockedPosition.Right:
						if (toolbarPositionInDockArea.Row < count - 1)
						{
							num = toolbarPositionInDockArea.Row + 1;
							val = DockRows[num].Toolbars.Count - 1;
						}
						break;
					case DockedPosition.Top:
					case DockedPosition.Left:
						if (toolbarPositionInDockArea.Row > 0)
						{
							num = toolbarPositionInDockArea.Row - 1;
							val = DockRows[num].Toolbars.Count - 1;
						}
						break;
					}
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Down:
					if (toolbarPositionInDockArea.Row < count - 1)
					{
						num = toolbarPositionInDockArea.Row + 1;
						val = toolbarPositionInDockArea.Col;
					}
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Up:
					if (toolbarPositionInDockArea.Row > 0)
					{
						num = toolbarPositionInDockArea.Row - 1;
						val = toolbarPositionInDockArea.Col;
					}
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Left:
					if (toolbarPositionInDockArea.Col > 0)
					{
						num = toolbarPositionInDockArea.Row;
						val = toolbarPositionInDockArea.Col - 1;
					}
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Right:
					if (toolbarPositionInDockArea.Col < count2 - 1)
					{
						num = toolbarPositionInDockArea.Row;
						val = toolbarPositionInDockArea.Col + 1;
					}
					break;
				}
				if (num >= 0 && num < count)
				{
					val = Math.Min(Math.Max(0, val), DockRows[num].Toolbars.Count - 1);
					return DockRows[num].Toolbars[val].AccessibilityObject;
				}
				return null;
			}
			}
		}

		internal void OnBeginCustomizing()
		{
			if (DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Floating)
			{
				GetToolbarAtIndex(0)?.RefreshDockAreaContents();
				return;
			}
			foreach (DockRow dockRow in DockRows)
			{
				if (dockRow == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (UltraToolbarBase toolbar in dockRow.Toolbars)
				{
					toolbar.OnCustomizeModeBegin();
				}
			}
			if (((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement != null)
			{
				((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
			}
			if (IsRibbonVisibleInDockArea && toolbarsManager != null)
			{
				toolbarsManager.Ribbon.OnCustomizeModeBegin();
			}
			RefreshDockAreaSize();
		}

		internal void OnEndCustomizing()
		{
			if (DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Floating)
			{
				GetToolbarAtIndex(0)?.RefreshDockAreaContents();
				return;
			}
			List<UltraToolbar> list = new List<UltraToolbar>();
			for (int i = 0; i < DockRows.Count; i++)
			{
				DockRow dockRow = DockRows[i];
				if (dockRow != null)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < dockRow.Toolbars.Count; j++)
					{
						UltraToolbar ultraToolbar = dockRow.Toolbars[j] as UltraToolbar;
						ultraToolbar.OnCustomizeModeEnd();
						list.Add(ultraToolbar);
					}
				}
			}
			list.Sort(new DockedRowColSortComparer());
			DockRows.Clear();
			int num = -1;
			DockRow dockRow2 = null;
			for (int k = 0; k < list.Count; k++)
			{
				UltraToolbar ultraToolbar2 = list[k];
				if (num != ultraToolbar2.DockedRowInternal)
				{
					num = ultraToolbar2.DockedRowInternal;
					dockRow2 = new DockRow(this);
					DockRows.Add(dockRow2);
				}
				dockRow2.Toolbars.Add(ultraToolbar2);
				ultraToolbar2.InternalSetDockedRow(DockRows.Count - 1);
				ultraToolbar2.InternalSetDockedColumn(dockRow2.Toolbars.Count - 1);
			}
			if (((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement != null)
			{
				((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
			}
			if (IsRibbonVisibleInDockArea && toolbarsManager != null)
			{
				toolbarsManager.Ribbon.OnCustomizeModeEnd();
			}
			if (IsRibbonVisibleInDockArea && toolbarsManager != null)
			{
				toolbarsManager.Ribbon.OnCustomizeModeEnd();
			}
			RefreshDockAreaSize();
		}

		internal void RecreateControlElement()
		{
			if (mainElement != null)
			{
				((ArrayList)(object)((UIElement)mainElement).ChildElements).Clear();
				((DisposableObject)(object)mainElement).Dispose();
				mainElement = null;
			}
			mainElement = new UltraToolbarsDockAreaUIElement(this, isPopupArea);
			((UIElement)mainElement).Rect = ((Control)this).ClientRectangle;
		}

		internal void RefreshDockAreaSize()
		{
			Size currentSize = ((Control)this).Size;
			RefreshDockAreaSize(ref currentSize);
			bool flag = isUpdatingDockAreaSize;
			try
			{
				isUpdatingDockAreaSize = true;
				((Control)this).Size = currentSize;
			}
			finally
			{
				isUpdatingDockAreaSize = flag;
			}
		}

		internal void RefreshDockAreaSize(ref Size currentSize)
		{
			//IL_00bd: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (((Control)this).IsDisposed || ((Control)this).Disposing)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = ToolbarsManager;
			if ((ultraToolbarsManager != null && (ultraToolbarsManager.Initializing || ultraToolbarsManager.FormWindowState == FormWindowState.Minimized)) || ((Component)(object)this).GetService(typeof(IDesignerHost)) is IDesignerHost { Loading: not false } || (isUpdatingDockAreaSize && currentSize == requestedDockAreaSize))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (toolbarsManager != null)
			{
				((Control)this).Font = toolbarsManager.MenuFont;
			}
			if (DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Floating)
			{
				if (UltraToolbarsManager.FindFormHelper((Control)(object)this) is FloatingToolbarWindowBase floatingToolbarWindowBase)
				{
					floatingToolbarWindowBase.SetWindowSize();
				}
				return;
			}
			bool flag = ((DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Left || DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Right) ? true : false);
			try
			{
				isOutermostDockArea = (DefaultableBoolean)0;
				DrawUtility.BeginGraphicsCaching();
				if (IsRibbonVisibleInDockArea)
				{
					toolbarsManager.Ribbon.OnRibbonContainerResized();
				}
				int num = 0;
				if (IsRibbonVisibleInDockArea)
				{
					num += toolbarsManager.Ribbon.Metrics.GetRibbonHeight(IsAutoHideRibbon);
				}
				if (IsMdiParentMenuBarInDockArea)
				{
					num += toolbarsManager.MdiParentMainMenuBar.Height;
				}
				if (IsNavigationToolbarVisibleInDockArea)
				{
					if (toolbarsManager != null && toolbarsManager.HasNavigationToolbar && DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Top)
					{
						int extent = ClientAreaRect.Width - 20;
						ultraToolbarsManager.NavigationToolbar.AdjustToolWidths(extent);
					}
					num += toolbarsManager.NavigationToolbar.Height;
				}
				if (toolbarsManager != null && !toolbarsManager.HideToolbarsResolved)
				{
					foreach (DockRow dockRow2 in DockRows)
					{
						if (dockRow2 is DockRow dockRow)
						{
							dockRow.CalculateMetrics();
							num += dockRow.CachedLogicalHeight + dockRow.Padding;
						}
					}
					if (DisplayDesignerButtons)
					{
						num += Math.Max(toolbarsManager.NewToolbarButtonSize.Height, toolbarsManager.ShowRibbonButtonSize.Height);
					}
				}
				int num2 = 0;
				if (ContainsResizingArea)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						num2 = toolbarsManager.RoundedFormBorderWidth;
					}
					else if (DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Bottom && toolbarsManager.ShouldIncludeResizeArea(DockedPosition.Bottom))
					{
						num2 = toolbarsManager.RoundedFormBorderWidth;
					}
				}
				else if (toolbarsManager == null || (initialResizeAreaExtent != 0 && toolbarsManager.IsFormRounded && toolbarsManager.ShouldIncludeResizeArea(DockedPosition) && IsOutermostDockArea))
				{
					num2 = InitialResizeAreaExtent;
				}
				initialResizeAreaExtent = num2;
				num += num2;
				requestedDockAreaSize = (flag ? new Size(num, currentSize.Height) : new Size(currentSize.Width, num));
				if (flag)
				{
					currentSize.Width = num;
				}
				else
				{
					currentSize.Height = num;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				DrawUtility.EndGraphicsCaching();
			}
		}

		private static void RemoveResizeBordersFromRect(ref Rectangle clientBounds, UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager, bool checkLeft, bool checkRight)
		{
			if (checkLeft)
			{
				UltraToolbarsDockArea validDockArea = toolbarsManager.GetValidDockArea(DockedPosition.Left);
				if (validDockArea != null && validDockArea.ContainsResizingArea)
				{
					clientBounds.X += toolbarsManager.RoundedFormBorderWidth;
					clientBounds.Width -= toolbarsManager.RoundedFormBorderWidth;
				}
			}
			if (checkRight)
			{
				UltraToolbarsDockArea validDockArea2 = toolbarsManager.GetValidDockArea(DockedPosition.Right);
				if (validDockArea2 != null && validDockArea2.ContainsResizingArea)
				{
					clientBounds.Width -= toolbarsManager.RoundedFormBorderWidth;
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool RemoveToolbar(UltraToolbar toolbar)
		{
			return RemoveToolbar(toolbar, refreshDockAreaSize: true);
		}

		internal bool RemoveToolbar(UltraToolbarBase toolbar, bool refreshDockAreaSize)
		{
			if (!repositioningToolbar)
			{
				ReparentContainedControls(toolbar, takeOwnership: false);
				if (toolbar is UltraToolbar ultraToolbar && ultraToolbar.DockedPosition == DockedPosition)
				{
					toolbarsManager.DestroyPagerControlForToolbar(ultraToolbar, this);
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < DockRows.Count; i++)
			{
				DockRow dockRow = DockRows[i];
				if (dockRow == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < dockRow.Toolbars.Count; j++)
				{
					if (!dockRow.Toolbars[j].Equals(toolbar))
					{
						continue;
					}
					dockRow.Toolbars.RemoveAt(j);
					for (int k = j; k < dockRow.Toolbars.Count; k++)
					{
						dockRow.Toolbars[k].InternalSetDockedColumn(k);
					}
					if (dockRow.CalculateSingleRowLogicalHeight() == 0)
					{
						if (refreshDockAreaSize)
						{
							RefreshDockAreaSize();
						}
						if (dockRow.Toolbars.Count < 1)
						{
							DockRows.RemoveAt(i);
							for (int l = i; l < dockRows.Count; l++)
							{
								DockRow dockRow2 = DockRows[l];
								if (dockRow2 != null)
								{
									for (int m = 0; m < dockRow2.Toolbars.Count; m++)
									{
										dockRow2.Toolbars[m].InternalSetDockedRow(l);
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void ReparentContainedControls(bool takeOwnership)
		{
			foreach (DockRow dockRow in DockRows)
			{
				foreach (UltraToolbarBase toolbar in dockRow.Toolbars)
				{
					ReparentContainedControls(toolbar, takeOwnership);
				}
			}
			if (OwningMenuAgent is RibbonTabMenuAgent)
			{
				ReparentContainedControls(((RibbonTabMenuAgent)OwningMenuAgent).Tab, takeOwnership);
			}
			else if (OwningMenuAgent is RibbonGroupMenuAgent)
			{
				ReparentContainedControls(((RibbonGroupMenuAgent)OwningMenuAgent).Group.Tools, takeOwnership);
			}
			else if (IsRibbonVisibleInDockArea && toolbarsManager != null)
			{
				ReparentContainedControls(toolbarsManager.Ribbon.SelectedTab, takeOwnership);
				if (toolbarsManager.Ribbon.HasTabItemToolbar)
				{
					ReparentContainedControls(toolbarsManager.Ribbon.TabItemToolbar, takeOwnership);
				}
			}
			if (IsNavigationToolbarVisibleInDockArea)
			{
				ReparentContainedControls(toolbarsManager.NavigationToolbar.Tools, takeOwnership);
			}
		}

		internal void ReparentContainedControls(UltraToolbarBase toolbar, bool takeOwnership)
		{
			ReparentContainedControls(toolbar.Tools, takeOwnership);
		}

		internal void ReparentContainedControls(RibbonTab tab, bool takeOwnership)
		{
			if (tab == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < tab.Groups.Count; i++)
			{
				RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = tab.Groups[i];
				if ((!takeOwnership || !ribbonGroup.Layout.IsCollapsed || ribbonGroup.IsGroupPopupOpen || ribbonGroup.IsGroupPopupOpening) && (!takeOwnership || ribbonGroup.VisibleResolved))
				{
					ReparentContainedControls(ribbonGroup.Tools, takeOwnership);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ReparentContainedControls(ToolsCollectionBase tools, bool takeOwnership)
		{
			ReparentContainedControls(tools, takeOwnership, this);
		}

		internal static void ReparentContainedControls(ToolsCollectionBase tools, bool takeOwnership, UltraToolbarsDockArea dockArea)
		{
			foreach (ToolBase tool in tools)
			{
				if (!tool.IsControlContainer)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (tool.UnderlyingTool is PopupControlContainerToolBase)
				{
					PopupControlContainerToolBase popupControlContainerToolBase = null;
					if (tools.OwnerIsToolbar)
					{
						UltraToolbarBase ultraToolbarBase = tools.Owner as UltraToolbarBase;
						if (ultraToolbarBase.TearawayToolOwnerInternal != null)
						{
							popupControlContainerToolBase = ultraToolbarBase.TearawayToolOwnerInternal.UnderlyingTool as PopupControlContainerToolBase;
						}
					}
					if (popupControlContainerToolBase == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				if (takeOwnership)
				{
					tool.SetToolWithContainedControl(takeControlOwnership: true, dockArea);
				}
				else if (tool.ToolWithContainedControl == tool || !tool.IsContainedControlShared)
				{
					tool.SetToolWithContainedControl(takeControlOwnership: false, null);
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool RepositionToolbar(UltraToolbarBase toolbar, int newDockRow, int newDockColumn, bool exclusiveOnRow)
		{
			RowCol toolbarPositionInDockArea = GetToolbarPositionInDockArea(toolbar);
			if (toolbarPositionInDockArea.Row == newDockRow && toolbarPositionInDockArea.Col == newDockColumn)
			{
				if (!exclusiveOnRow && !toolbar.FillEntireRowResolved)
				{
					return true;
				}
				DockRow dockRow = DockRows[toolbarPositionInDockArea.Row];
				if (dockRow.Toolbars.Count == 1 && dockRow.Toolbars[0] == toolbar)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (toolbarPositionInDockArea.Row >= 0)
			{
				repositioningToolbar = true;
			}
			RowCol rowCol = new RowCol(-1, -1);
			try
			{
				if (toolbarPositionInDockArea.Row >= 0 && toolbarPositionInDockArea.Row < newDockRow && DockRows[toolbarPositionInDockArea.Row].Toolbars.Count == 1)
				{
					newDockRow--;
				}
				RemoveToolbar(toolbar, refreshDockAreaSize: false);
				rowCol = AddToolbar(toolbar, newDockRow, newDockColumn, refreshDockAreaSize: true, exclusiveOnRow);
			}
			finally
			{
				repositioningToolbar = false;
			}
			toolbar.InternalSetDockedRow(rowCol.Row);
			toolbar.InternalSetDockedColumn(rowCol.Col);
			return true;
		}

		internal void ResetTransparentRegion()
		{
			if (transparentRegion != null)
			{
				transparentRegion.Dispose();
				transparentRegion = null;
			}
		}

		internal void SetDockAreaColorProps()
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (toolbarsManager != null)
			{
				AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
				AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)3;
				toolbarsManager.ResolveDockAreaAppearance(this, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				if (dockedPosition == DockedPosition.Floating && ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor.A == 0 && !IsControlContainerHostForPopupMenu)
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = SystemColors.Control;
				}
				Color backColor = ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor;
				if (backColor.A < byte.MaxValue && ((ISupportGlass)this).HasTransparentRegion)
				{
					backColor = Color.FromArgb(backColor.R, backColor.G, backColor.B);
				}
				((Control)(object)this).BackColor = backColor;
				((Control)(object)this).ForeColor = ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ForeColor;
				((UltraControlBase)this).AlphaBlendMode = ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)toolbarsManager).AlphaBlendMode;
			}
		}

		void ISupportGlass.UpdateTransparentRegion()
		{
			if (toolbarsManager == null || !toolbarsManager.IsGlassSupportedResolved || ((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement == null)
			{
				ClearTransparentRegion();
				return;
			}
			Rectangle rectangle = CalculateGlassRect();
			if (rectangle != Rectangle.Empty)
			{
				transparentRegion = new Region(rectangle);
			}
			else
			{
				ClearTransparentRegion();
			}
		}

		internal Rectangle CalculateGlassRect()
		{
			//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0042: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0067: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01cf: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_018d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00bd: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0101: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0107: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (toolbarsManager == null || toolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer == null || ControlElement == null || !(toolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer is Form))
			{
				return Rectangle.Empty;
			}
			if ((int)toolbarsManager.StyleResolved == 9)
			{
				return Rectangle.Empty;
			}
			Rectangle result = Rectangle.Empty;
			Rectangle bounds = ((UIElement)ControlElement).Control.Bounds;
			FormDisplayStyle formDisplayStyleResolved = toolbarsManager.FormDisplayStyleResolved;
			if (toolbarsManager.HasRibbon && toolbarsManager.Ribbon.VisibleResolved && toolbarsManager.Ribbon.RibbonContainer != null && this == toolbarsManager.Ribbon.RibbonContainer && ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ShouldToolbarsManagerRenderCustomGlassArea(formDisplayStyleResolved))
			{
				int captionAreaHeight = toolbarsManager.Ribbon.Metrics.CaptionAreaHeight;
				result = new Rectangle(bounds.X, bounds.Y, bounds.Width, captionAreaHeight);
				if ((int)toolbarsManager.StyleResolved == 8 && ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.IsTabAreaVisible)
				{
					result.Height += toolbarsManager.Ribbon.Metrics.TabItemAreaElementHeight;
				}
			}
			else if (toolbarsManager.HasNavigationToolbar && toolbarsManager.NavigationToolbar.VisibleResolved && this == toolbarsManager.NavigationToolbar.NavigationToolbarContainer)
			{
				int num = toolbarsManager.NavigationToolbar.Height;
				if (ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ShouldToolbarsManagerRenderCustomGlassArea(formDisplayStyleResolved))
				{
					num += toolbarsManager.Ribbon.Metrics.CaptionAreaHeight;
				}
				result = new Rectangle(bounds.X, bounds.Y, bounds.Width, num);
			}
			else if (ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ShouldToolbarsManagerRenderCustomGlassArea(formDisplayStyleResolved) && Dock == DockStyle.Top)
			{
				int captionAreaHeight2 = toolbarsManager.Ribbon.Metrics.CaptionAreaHeight;
				result = new Rectangle(bounds.X, bounds.Y, bounds.Width, captionAreaHeight2);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void OnGestureStarting(GestureStartingEventArgs e)
		{
			if (EventManager.IsEnabled(ToolbarEventIds.GestureStarting))
			{
				((UltraControlBase)this).OnGestureStarting(e);
			}
			if (!((IGestureConsumer)this).GesturesEnabled)
			{
				return;
			}
			prevTouchPoint = null;
			CurrentGestureArea = GestureAreaType.None;
			gestureContext = null;
			if (GetGestureContainerUIElement(e.Location, startingGesture: true) != null)
			{
				prevTouchPoint = ((Control)this).PointToScreen(e.Location);
				if (!(toolbarsManager.CurrentPopupControl is BackStageViewControl) && (object)toolbarsManager.CurrentPopupControl != ((Control)this).Parent)
				{
					toolbarsManager.PopupManager.CloseAllPopups();

		private void DoTouchScroll(PanGestureEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!prevTouchPoint.HasValue)
			{
				return;
			}
			Point value = ((Control)this).PointToScreen(e.Location);
			switch (CurrentGestureArea)
			{
			case GestureAreaType.RibbonTabItemArea:
			case GestureAreaType.RibbonGroupArea:
			{
				int num7 = prevTouchPoint.Value.X - value.X;
				if (num7 != 0 && GetGestureContainerUIElement(CurrentGestureArea) is RibbonPagerAreaUIElement ribbonPagerAreaUIElement)
				{
					ribbonPagerAreaUIElement.Position += num7;
					((UIElement)ribbonPagerAreaUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
					prevTouchPoint = value;
					((GestureEventArgs)e).Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			}
			case GestureAreaType.GalleryPreviewArea:
			{
				int num5 = prevTouchPoint.Value.Y - value.Y;
				if (num5 == 0 || !(GetGestureContainerUIElement(CurrentGestureArea) is GalleryPreviewItemAreaUIElement) || !(gestureContext is PopupGalleryTool { PreviewInfo: var previewInfo } popupGalleryTool))
				{
					break;
				}
				num5 /= popupGalleryTool.ItemSizeInPreviewResolved.Height / 1;
				if (num5 != 0)
				{
					int num6 = previewInfo.CurrentRow + num5;
					if (num6 < 0)
					{
						num6 = 0;
					}
					else if (num6 >= previewInfo.TotalRows)
					{
						num6 = previewInfo.TotalRows - 1;
					}
					previewInfo.CurrentRow = num6;
					prevTouchPoint = value;
					((GestureEventArgs)e).Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			}
			case GestureAreaType.BackStage:
			{
				int num = 5;
				int num2 = prevTouchPoint.Value.X - value.X;
				int num3 = prevTouchPoint.Value.Y - value.Y;
				bool flag = Math.Abs(num2) > num;
				bool flag2 = Math.Abs(num3) > num;
				if (!(flag || flag2) || !(toolbarsManager.Ribbon.ApplicationMenu2010.MenuAgent.PopupControl is BackStageViewControl backStageViewControl))
				{
					break;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					Infragistics.Win.Misc.ScrollProperties horizontalScrollProperties = backStageViewControl.ScrollPanel.HorizontalScrollProperties;
					int num4 = horizontalScrollProperties.Value + num2;
					if (num4 < horizontalScrollProperties.Minimum)
					{
						num4 = horizontalScrollProperties.Minimum;
					}
					else if (num4 > horizontalScrollProperties.Maximum)
					{
						num4 = horizontalScrollProperties.Maximum;
					}
					horizontalScrollProperties.Value = num4;
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					Infragistics.Win.Misc.ScrollProperties horizontalScrollProperties = backStageViewControl.ScrollPanel.VerticalScrollProperties;
					int num4 = horizontalScrollProperties.Value + num3;
					if (num4 < horizontalScrollProperties.Minimum)
					{
						num4 = horizontalScrollProperties.Minimum;
					}
					else if (num4 > horizontalScrollProperties.Maximum)
					{
						num4 = horizontalScrollProperties.Maximum;
					}
					horizontalScrollProperties.Value = num4;
				}
				prevTouchPoint = value;
				((GestureEventArgs)e).Handled = true;
				break;
			}
			case GestureAreaType.MenuArea:
				break;
			}
		}

		internal UIElement GetGestureContainerUIElement(Point location, bool startingGesture)
		{
			if (mainElement == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UIElement val = ((UIElement)mainElement).ElementFromPoint(location);
			if (val != null)
			{
				UIElement ancestor = val.GetAncestor(typeof(GalleryPreviewItemAreaUIElement));
				if (ancestor != null)
				{
					if (startingGesture)
					{
						CurrentGestureArea = GestureAreaType.GalleryPreviewArea;
						gestureContext = ancestor.GetContext();
					}
					return ancestor;
				}
				ancestor = val.GetAncestor(typeof(RibbonPagerAreaUIElement));
				if (ancestor != null)
				{
					if (startingGesture)
					{
						if (ancestor.GetAncestor(typeof(RibbonTabPageUIElement)) != null)
						{
							CurrentGestureArea = GestureAreaType.RibbonGroupArea;
						}
						else
						{
							CurrentGestureArea = GestureAreaType.RibbonTabItemArea;
						}
					}
					return ancestor;
				}
				ancestor = val.GetAncestor(typeof(BackStageMainUIElement));
				if (ancestor != null)
				{
					if (startingGesture)
					{
						CurrentGestureArea = GestureAreaType.BackStage;
					}
					return ancestor;
				}
			}
			if (startingGesture)
			{
				CurrentGestureArea = GestureAreaType.None;
				gestureContext = null;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private UIElement GetGestureContainerUIElement(GestureAreaType gestureArea)
		{
			if (mainElement == null || gestureArea == GestureAreaType.None)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (toolbarsManager == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UIElement result = null;
			switch (gestureArea)
			{
			case GestureAreaType.RibbonTabItemArea:
			case GestureAreaType.RibbonGroupArea:
			case GestureAreaType.GalleryPreviewArea:
			{
				if (!IsRibbonVisibleInDockArea && !isPopupArea)
				{
					return null;
				}
				UIElement controlUIElement = (UIElement)(object)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement;
				if (controlUIElement == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				switch (gestureArea)
				{
				case GestureAreaType.RibbonGroupArea:
				{
					UIElement descendant2 = controlUIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(RibbonTabPageUIElement));
					if (descendant2 == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return descendant2.GetDescendant(typeof(RibbonPagerAreaUIElement));
				}
				case GestureAreaType.RibbonTabItemArea:
				{
					UIElement descendant = controlUIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(RibbonTabItemAreaUIElement));
					if (descendant == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return descendant.GetAncestor(typeof(RibbonPagerAreaUIElement));
				}
				case GestureAreaType.GalleryPreviewArea:
					return controlUIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(GalleryPreviewItemAreaUIElement), gestureContext);
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void AdjustToolbarsBasedOnNewPositions(int[] positions)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < toolbars.Count; i++)
			{
				toolbars[i]?.AdjustToolWidths(positions[i + 1] - positions[i]);
			}
		}

		private void AdjustToolbarWidths(int extraWidth, int firstToolbarInRow, int lastToolbarInRow)
		{
			for (int num = lastToolbarInRow; num >= firstToolbarInRow; num--)
			{
				if (toolbars[num].ToolsHaveBeenBumped)
				{
					int width = toolbarPositions[num].Width;
					toolbars[num].AdjustToolWidths(width + extraWidth);
					int width2 = toolbars[num].Width;
					if (width != width2)
					{
						int num2 = width2 - width;
						WidenToolbarInPhysicalRow(num, num2, lastToolbarInRow);
						extraWidth -= num2;
						if (extraWidth <= 0)
						{
							return;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			for (int num3 = lastToolbarInRow; num3 >= firstToolbarInRow; num3--)
			{
				if (toolbars[num3].ToolsHaveBeenBumped)
				{
					WidenToolbarInPhysicalRow(num3, extraWidth, lastToolbarInRow);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void WidenToolbarInPhysicalRow(int toolbarIndex, int extraWidth, int lastToolbarInPhysicalRow)
		{
			toolbarPositions[toolbarIndex].Width += extraWidth;
			for (int i = toolbarIndex + 1; i <= lastToolbarInPhysicalRow; i++)
			{
				toolbarPositions[i].X += extraWidth;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			ultraToolbarsDockArea = null;
			toolbars.Clear();
		}

	internal class DockedRowColSortComparer : IComparer<UltraToolbar>
	{
		int IComparer<UltraToolbar>.Compare(UltraToolbar toolbarX, UltraToolbar toolbarY)
		{
			if (toolbarX.DockedRow < toolbarY.DockedRow)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (toolbarX.DockedRow > toolbarY.DockedRow)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (toolbarX.DockedColumn < toolbarY.DockedColumn)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (toolbarX.DockedColumn > toolbarY.DockedColumn)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return 0;
		}
	}

		{

			{
				int captionAreaPaddingTopResolved = ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.Metrics.CaptionAreaPaddingTopResolved;
				if (clientPt.Y < 2 + captionAreaPaddingTopResolved)
				{
					UIElement val = ((UIElement)this).ElementFromPoint(clientPt, false, (UIElementInputType)0);
					if (val is QatTopAreaUIElement)
					{
						clientPt.Y = 2 + captionAreaPaddingTopResolved;
					}
				}
			}
			return clientPt;
		}

		protected override void OnAfterDraw(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager != null && ToolbarsManager.Customizing && ToolbarsManager.ToolBeingResized != null)
			{
				ToolbarsManager.OnDrawToolResizeRect(((UIElement)this).Control, ref drawParams);
			}

		protected override void OnCaptureAborted()
		{
			if (toolbarBeingDragged != null && ToolbarsManager != null && ToolbarsManager.IsToolbarBeingDragged(toolbarBeingDragged))
			{
				ToolbarsManager.OnDragToolbarEnd();
			}
			toolbarBeingDragged = null;
			if (ToolbarsManager != null && ToolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				if (ToolbarsManager.ToolBeingDragged != null)
				{
					ToolbarsManager.OnDragToolEnd();
				}
				if (ToolbarsManager.ToolBeingResized != null)
				{
					ToolbarsManager.OnResizeToolEnd();
				}
			}
			((ControlUIElementBase)this).OnCaptureAborted();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter()
		{
			if (ToolbarsManager == null || ToolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ultraToolbarsDockArea.DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Floating && ultraToolbarsDockArea.DockRows.Count == 1 && ultraToolbarsDockArea.DockRows[0].Toolbars.Count == 1)
			{
				UltraToolbarBase ultraToolbarBase = ultraToolbarsDockArea.DockRows[0].Toolbars[0];
				if (ultraToolbarBase != null && ultraToolbarBase.RootToolbars != null)
				{
					UltraToolbarBase[] rootToolbars = ultraToolbarBase.RootToolbars;
					foreach (UltraToolbarBase ultraToolbarBase2 in rootToolbars)
					{
						if (ultraToolbarBase2 != null && ultraToolbarBase2.QuickCustomizeTool != null && ultraToolbarBase2.QuickCustomizeTool.IsOpen)
						{
							ToolbarsManager.DropdownCloseupManager.CancelPendingCloseup(ultraToolbarBase2.QuickCustomizeTool.MenuAgent);
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			((UIElement)this).OnMouseEnter();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (toolbarBeingDragged != null && ToolbarsManager != null && ToolbarsManager.IsToolbarBeingDragged(toolbarBeingDragged))
			{
				if ((object)((UIElement)this).ControlElement.ElementWithMouseCapture == this)
				{
					ToolbarsManager.OnDragToolbarMove();
				}
				else
				{
					ToolbarsManager.OnDragToolbarEnd();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				toolbarBeingDragged = null;
			}
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseUp(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (toolbarBeingDragged != null && ToolbarsManager != null && ToolbarsManager.IsToolbarBeingDragged(toolbarBeingDragged))
			{
				ToolbarsManager.OnDragToolbarEnd();
			}
			toolbarBeingDragged = null;
			return ((UIElement)this).OnMouseUp(e);
		}

					if (ultraToolbarsDockArea.OwningMenuAgent != null && ultraToolbarsDockArea.OwningMenuAgent is RibbonMenuAgentBase)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					if (toolBase != null && toolBase.IsToolInEditMode && val is EditorWithTextDisplayTextUIElement)
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					if (val != null && val.GetAncestor(typeof(RibbonCaptionButtonUIElement)) != null)
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					if (val != null)

						{
							flag = false;
						}
						UltraToolbarBase ultraToolbarBase = val.GetContext(typeof(UltraToolbarBase)) as UltraToolbarBase;
						if (ultraToolbarBase is MdiParentMainMenuBar)

		}

		protected void PositionChildElementsFloating()
		{
			UIElementsCollection childElements = ((UIElement)this).ChildElements;
			((UIElement)this).childElementsCollection = null;
			if (ultraToolbarsDockArea.OwningMenuAgent is RibbonTabMenuAgent)

				}
				ribbonTabPageUIElement.Initialize(ribbonTabMenuAgent.Ribbon.SelectedTab);
				((UIElement)ribbonTabPageUIElement).Rect = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)ribbonTabPageUIElement);
				return;
			}
			if (ultraToolbarsDockArea.OwningMenuAgent is RibbonGroupMenuAgent)
			{
				RibbonGroupMenuAgent ribbonGroupMenuAgent = ultraToolbarsDockArea.OwningMenuAgent as RibbonGroupMenuAgent;
				RibbonTabPageUIElement ribbonTabPageUIElement2 = (RibbonTabPageUIElement)UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)childElements, typeof(RibbonTabPageUIElement), true, (object)ribbonGroupMenuAgent.Group);
				if (ribbonTabPageUIElement2 == null)
				{
					ribbonTabPageUIElement2 = new RibbonTabPageUIElement((UIElement)(object)this);
				}
				ribbonTabPageUIElement2.Initialize(ribbonGroupMenuAgent.Group.Tab, ribbonGroupMenuAgent);
				((UIElement)ribbonTabPageUIElement2).Rect = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)ribbonTabPageUIElement2);
				return;
			}
			if (ultraToolbarsDockArea.OwningMenuAgent is BackStageMenuAgent)
			{
				BackStageMenuAgent backStageMenuAgent = ultraToolbarsDockArea.OwningMenuAgent as BackStageMenuAgent;
				BackStageMainUIElement backStageMainUIElement = (BackStageMainUIElement)UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)childElements, typeof(BackStageMainUIElement), true);
				if (backStageMainUIElement == null)
				{
					backStageMainUIElement = new BackStageMainUIElement((UIElement)(object)this, backStageMenuAgent.ApplicationMenu2010);
				}
				((UIElement)backStageMainUIElement).Rect = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)backStageMainUIElement);
				return;
			}

			UIElement val;
			if (ultraToolbarBase is UltraTaskPaneToolbar)
			{
				val = (UIElement)(object)(TaskPaneToolbarUIElement)UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)childElements, typeof(TaskPaneToolbarUIElement), true);

				}

				{

				}
			}

				if (val == null)

		private void InitBorderElement(int index, int hitTestCode, Rectangle rect)
		{
			if (resizeAreas == null)
			{
				resizeAreas = new UltraToolbarsDockAreaResizeUIElement[5];
			}
			if (resizeAreas[index] == null)
			{
				resizeAreas[index] = new UltraToolbarsDockAreaResizeUIElement((UIElement)(object)this, ultraToolbarsDockArea, hitTestCode);
			}
			((UIElement)resizeAreas[index]).Rect = rect;
		}

		internal void InvalidateResizeAreas()
		{
			if (resizeAreas == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < resizeAreas.Length; i++)
			{
				if (resizeAreas[i] != null)
				{
					((UIElement)resizeAreas[i]).Invalidate();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnDragToolbarBegin(UltraToolbar toolbar)
		{
			toolbarBeingDragged = toolbar;
		}

		internal void TransferToolbarDragCapture(UltraToolbarsDockAreaUIElement dockAreaToReceiveCapture)
		{
			if (toolbarBeingDragged != null && (object)this == ControlUIElementBase.ControlElementWithMouseCapture && dockAreaToReceiveCapture != null)
			{
				UltraToolbar toolbar = toolbarBeingDragged;
				toolbarBeingDragged = null;
				((ControlUIElementBase)this).TerminateCapture();
				dockAreaToReceiveCapture.OnDragToolbarBegin(toolbar);
				((ControlUIElementBase)dockAreaToReceiveCapture).CaptureMouseForElement((UIElement)(object)dockAreaToReceiveCapture);
			}
		}

		private void UnInitBorderElement(int index)
		{
			if (resizeAreas != null && resizeAreas[index] != null)
			{
				((DisposableObject)(object)resizeAreas[index]).Dispose();
				resizeAreas[index] = null;
			}
		}

		internal delegate void MouseHookEventHandler(object sender, MouseHookEventArgs e);

		internal sealed class MouseHookEventArgs : EventArgs
		{
			private int hookCode;

			private int messageId;

			private Point point;

			private IntPtr hwnd;

			private bool eatMessage;

			public int HookCode => hookCode;

			public int MessageId => messageId;

			public IntPtr Hwnd => hwnd;

			public Point Point => point;

			public bool EatMessage
			{
				get
				{
					return eatMessage;
				}
				set
				{
					eatMessage = value;
				}
			}

			public MouseHookEventArgs(int hookCode, int messageId, Point point, IntPtr hwnd)
			{
				this.hookCode = hookCode;
				this.messageId = messageId;
				this.point = point;
				this.hwnd = hwnd;
			}
		}

		private class EditorOwner : EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase
		{
			private UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager;

			public override bool DesignMode => ((Component)(object)toolbarsManager).DesignMode;

			internal EditorOwner(UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager)
			{
				this.toolbarsManager = toolbarsManager;
			}

			public override void AccessibilityNotifyClients(object ownerContext, AccessibleEvents eventId)
			{
				toolbarsManager.NotifyAccessibilityClients(eventId);
			}

			public override bool AreTouchMetricsEnabled(object ownerContext)
			{
				if (toolbarsManager == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return toolbarsManager.TouchMetricsEnabledResolved;
			}

			public override DefaultableBoolean DrawAsActive(object ownerContext)
			{
				//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				ToolBase tool = GetTool(ownerContext);
				if (tool != null)
				{
					if (!tool.DrawAsActive)
					{
						return (DefaultableBoolean)2;
					}
					return (DefaultableBoolean)1;
				}
				return ((EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)this).DrawAsActive(ownerContext);
			}

			public override bool EnterEditModeOnClick(object ownerContext)
			{
				return false;
			}

			public override bool GetAutoEdit(object ownerContext)
			{
				if (toolbarsManager.Customizing)
				{
					return false;
				}
				ToolBase tool = GetTool(ownerContext);
				if (tool != null && tool.UnderlyingTool is ComboBoxTool comboBoxTool)
				{
					return comboBoxTool.AutoComplete;
				}
				return ((EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)this).GetAutoEdit(ownerContext);
			}

			public override CharacterCasing GetCharacterCasing(object ownerContext)

		private class ToolListComparer : IComparer<ToolBase>
		{
			public static readonly ToolListComparer Instance = new ToolListComparer();

			private ToolListComparer()
			{
			}

			int IComparer<ToolBase>.Compare(ToolBase tool1, ToolBase tool2)
			{
				if ((object)((IKeyedSubObjectEx)tool1).KeyLowercaseInterned == ((IKeyedSubObjectEx)tool2).KeyLowercaseInterned)
				{
					ToolTypeID underlyingToolTypeID = tool1.UnderlyingToolTypeID;
					ToolTypeID underlyingToolTypeID2 = tool2.UnderlyingToolTypeID;
					if (underlyingToolTypeID == underlyingToolTypeID2)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					if (underlyingToolTypeID == null)
					{
						if (underlyingToolTypeID2 == null)
						{
							return 0;
						}
						return -1;
					}
					if (underlyingToolTypeID2 == null)
					{
						return 1;
					}
					if (underlyingToolTypeID.Index < underlyingToolTypeID2.Index)
					{
						return -1;
					}
					if (underlyingToolTypeID.Index > underlyingToolTypeID2.Index)
					{
						return 1;
					}
					return 0;
				}
				return string.Compare(((IKeyedSubObjectEx)tool1).KeyLowercaseInterned, ((IKeyedSubObjectEx)tool2).KeyLowercaseInterned, ignoreCase: false, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
			}
		}

		private class KeyDownInfo
		{
			private char[] characters;

			private DeadKeyInfo currentDeadKeyInfo;

			private IntPtr wParam;

			public char[] Characters => characters;

			public KeyDownInfo(char[] characters, IntPtr wParam, DeadKeyInfo currentDeadKeyInfo)
			{
				this.characters = characters;
				this.wParam = wParam;
				this.currentDeadKeyInfo = currentDeadKeyInfo;
			}

			public void RestoreDeadKeys()
			{
				try
				{
					if (characters.Length != 0 && previousDeadKeyInfo != null)
					{
						DeadKeyInfo deadKeyInfo;
						char[] array = NativeWindowMethods.VKeyToAscii(wParam, out deadKeyInfo);
						bool flag;
						if (deadKeyInfo != null)
						{
							flag = true;
							deadKeyInfo.RestoreState();
						}
						else if (array.Length != characters.Length)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
						else
						{
							flag = false;
							for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
							{
								if (array[i] != characters[i])
								{
									flag = true;
									break;
								}
							}
						}
						if (flag)
						{
							previousDeadKeyInfo.RestoreState();
						}
						previousDeadKeyInfo = null;
					}
					else if (currentDeadKeyInfo != null)
					{
						currentDeadKeyInfo.RestoreState();
						previousDeadKeyInfo = currentDeadKeyInfo;
					}
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
				}
			}
		}

		private class MouseHookManager
		{
			private bool hookfailed;

			private IntPtr hookHandle = IntPtr.Zero;

			private NativeWindowMethods.HookProc hookProc;

			internal MouseHookManager()
			{
				hookProc = HookProc;
			}

			internal void SetHook()
			{
				if (hookfailed || hookHandle != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					hookHandle = NativeWindowMethods.SetWindowsHookExApi(7, hookProc, IntPtr.Zero, NativeWindowMethods.GetCurrentThreadIdApi());
				}
				catch
				{
					hookfailed = true;
				}
			}

			internal void ReleaseHook()
			{
				if (hookfailed || hookHandle == IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.UnhookWindowsHookExApi(hookHandle);
					hookHandle = IntPtr.Zero;
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}

			private IntPtr HookProc(int ncode, IntPtr wparam, IntPtr lparam)
			{
				NativeWindowMethods.MOUSEHOOKSTRUCT mOUSEHOOKSTRUCT = (NativeWindowMethods.MOUSEHOOKSTRUCT)Marshal.PtrToStructure(lparam, typeof(NativeWindowMethods.MOUSEHOOKSTRUCT));
				MouseHookEventArgs e = new MouseHookEventArgs(ncode, wparam.ToInt32(), mOUSEHOOKSTRUCT.pt.Point, mOUSEHOOKSTRUCT.hwnd);
				RaiseMouseHookEvent(e);
				if (e.EatMessage && ncode >= 0)
				{
					return (IntPtr)1;
				}
				return NativeWindowMethods.CallNextHookExApi(hookHandle, ncode, wparam, lparam);
			}
		}

		[SuppressUnmanagedCodeSecurity]
		[ComVisible(false)]
		[SecurityCritical]
		private class MdiClientSubClasser : NativeWindow
		{
			private UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager;

			private bool active;

			private MdiClient mdiClient;

			private bool isInMdiDestroy;

			internal MdiClientSubClasser(UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager, MdiClient mdiClient)
			{
				this.toolbarsManager = toolbarsManager;
				this.mdiClient = mdiClient;
				AssignHandle(mdiClient.Handle);
				active = true;
			}

			internal void Deactivate()
			{
				active = false;
				UnhookControlEvents();
			}

			[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, UnmanagedCode = true)]
			protected override void WndProc(ref Message m)
			{
				if (active)
				{
					switch (m.Msg)
					{
					case 545:
					case 546:
						if (toolbarsManager.ProcessingSysCommand || toolbarsManager.systemMenu == null || toolbarsManager.dockWithinContainer == null)
						{
							break;
						}
						try
						{
							IntPtr parentApi = NativeWindowMethods.GetParentApi(m.HWnd);
							if ((m.Msg == 546 && toolbarsManager.ActiveMdiChildForm != null && toolbarsManager.ActiveMdiChildForm.Handle == m.WParam) || (m.Msg == 545 && toolbarsManager.ActiveMdiChildForm != null && toolbarsManager.ActiveMdiChildForm.Handle != m.WParam))
							{
								break;
							}
							toolbarsManager.ProcessingSysCommand = true;
							toolbarsManager.RestoreMenus();
							bool flag = isInMdiDestroy;
							if (m.Msg == 545)
							{
								isInMdiDestroy = true;
							}
							try
							{
								base.WndProc(ref m);
							}
							finally
							{
								isInMdiDestroy = flag;
							}
							toolbarsManager.ProcessingSysCommand = false;
							NativeWindowMethods.SendMessageApi(parentApi, 11, NativeWindowMethods.TRUE, IntPtr.Zero);
							NativeWindowMethods.RedrawWindowApi(parentApi, IntPtr.Zero, IntPtr.Zero, 1671u);
							return;
						}
						catch
						{
						}
						finally
						{
							toolbarsManager.ProcessingSysCommand = false;
						}
						break;
					case 560:
						if (toolbarsManager.SystemMenuToolbar != null)
						{
							foreach (Control control in mdiClient.Controls)
							{
								if (control is Form { IsHandleCreated: false, WindowState: FormWindowState.Maximized } form)
								{
									toolbarsManager.AddMaximizedMdiChildForm(form);
								}
							}
						}

					mdiClient.HandleCreated += OnControlHandleCreated;
					mdiClient.Disposed += OnControlDisposed;
				}

			}

			private void UnhookControlEvents()
			{

				mdiClient.Disposed -= OnControlDisposed;

				mdiClient.ControlRemoved -= OnMdiClientControlRemoved;

			{

			}

			}

			internal void OnMaximizedMdiChildrenCollectionCreated()
			{

				mdiClient.ControlRemoved += OnMdiClientControlRemoved;
			}

			private void OnMdiClientControlRemoved(object sender, ControlEventArgs e)
			{

			}

			private void OnMdiClientDisposed(object sender, EventArgs e)
			{

				toolbarsManager.ClearMaximizedMdiChildren();
			}
		}

		[SuppressUnmanagedCodeSecurity]
		[ComVisible(false)]
		[SecurityCritical]
		private class MdiParentSubClasser : NativeWindow
		{
			private UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager;

			private bool active;

			private Form form;

			internal MdiParentSubClasser(UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager, Form form)
			{
				IntPtr intPtr = form.Handle;
				this.form = form;
				this.toolbarsManager = toolbarsManager;
				AssignHandle(intPtr);
				active = true;
			}

			internal void Deactivate()
			{
				active = false;
				UnhookControlEvents();
				form = null;
			}

			[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, UnmanagedCode = true)]
			protected override void WndProc(ref Message m)
			{
				if (active)
				{
					int msg = m.Msg;
					if ((msg == 15 || msg == 20 || msg == 133) && toolbarsManager.PreventMdiParentPaintProcessing)
					{
						if (m.Msg != 15)
						{
							if (m.Msg == 133)
							{
								toolbarsManager.UpdateMdiParentInvalidationFlags(WmPaintEvents.WM_NCPAINT);
								if (NativeWindowMethods.IsDWMCompositionEnabled)
								{
									base.WndProc(ref m);
								}
							}
							else if (m.Msg == 20)
							{
								toolbarsManager.UpdateMdiParentInvalidationFlags(WmPaintEvents.WM_ERASEBKGND);
							}
						}
						else if (m.WParam == IntPtr.Zero)
						{
							NativeWindowMethods.PAINTSTRUCT lpPaint = default(NativeWindowMethods.PAINTSTRUCT);
							NativeWindowMethods.BeginPaint(m.HWnd, out lpPaint);
							NativeWindowMethods.EndPaint(m.HWnd, ref lpPaint);
						}
						m.Result = IntPtr.Zero;
						return;
					}
				}
				base.WndProc(ref m);
			}

			protected override void OnHandleChange()
			{
				if (active && form != null && !form.IsDisposed && !form.IsHandleCreated)
				{
					form.HandleCreated += OnControlHandleCreated;
					form.Disposed += OnControlDisposed;
				}
				base.OnHandleChange();
			}

			private void UnhookControlEvents()
			{
				form.HandleCreated -= OnControlHandleCreated;
				form.Disposed -= OnControlDisposed;
			}

			private void OnControlDisposed(object sender, EventArgs e)
			{
				UnhookControlEvents();
			}

			private void OnControlHandleCreated(object sender, EventArgs e)
			{
				UnhookControlEvents();
				AssignHandle(form.Handle);
			}
		}

			private Size CalculateMinSize()
			{
				Size size = default(Size);
				Size size2 = default(Size);
				Control.ControlCollection controls = form.Controls;
				int count = controls.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					Control control = controls[i];
					if (control.Visible)
					{
						switch (control.Dock)
						{
						case DockStyle.Left:
							size.Width += control.Size.Width;
							break;
						case DockStyle.Right:
							size2.Width += control.Size.Width;
							break;
						case DockStyle.Top:
							size.Height += control.Size.Height;
							break;
						case DockStyle.Bottom:
							size2.Height += control.Size.Height;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				Size result = default(Size);
				int roundedFormBorderWidth = toolbarsManager.RoundedFormBorderWidth;
				result.Width = Math.Max(size.Width, size2.Width) + roundedFormBorderWidth;
				result.Height = Math.Max(size.Height, size2.Height) + roundedFormBorderWidth;
				int minimumCaptionAreaWidth = toolbarsManager.Ribbon.Metrics.MinimumCaptionAreaWidth;
				result.Width = Math.Max(result.Width, minimumCaptionAreaWidth);
				return result;
			}

			private bool GetDesignSurfaceLoadedEventInfo(out object designSurface, out EventInfo loadedEvent, out Delegate loadedEventHandler)
			{
				designSurface = null;
				loadedEvent = null;
				loadedEventHandler = null;
				try
				{
					IDesignerHost designerHost = DesignerHost;
					if (designerHost == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					Type type = Type.GetType("System.ComponentModel.Design.DesignSurface,System.Design");
					if (type == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					designSurface = designerHost.GetService(type);
					if (designSurface == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					Type type2 = Type.GetType("System.ComponentModel.Design.LoadedEventHandler,System.Design");
					loadedEvent = type.GetEvent("Loaded");
					MethodInfo method = GetType().GetMethod("OnDesignSurfaceLoaded", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
					if (type2 == null || loadedEvent == null || method == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					loadedEventHandler = Delegate.CreateDelegate(type2, this, method);
					return true;
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}

			private Size GetNonClientSize(Size clientSize)
			{
				NativeWindowMethods.RECT lpRect = new NativeWindowMethods.RECT(0, 0, clientSize.Width, clientSize.Height);
				try
				{
					int dwStyle = (int)NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowLong(form.Handle, -16).ToInt64();
					int dwExStyle = (int)NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowLong(form.Handle, -20).ToInt64();
					NativeWindowMethods.AdjustWindowRectExApi(ref lpRect, dwStyle, FormHasMenu, dwExStyle);
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
					return Size.Empty;
				}
				Size size = lpRect.Rect.Size;
				return new Size(size.Width - clientSize.Width, size.Height - clientSize.Height);
			}

				}
			}

			{
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = e.Member as PropertyDescriptor;
				if (e.Component == form && propertyDescriptor != null && propertyDescriptor.Name == "ClientSize")
				{
					IDesignerHost designerHost = DesignerHost;
					if (designerHost == null || !designerHost.InTransaction)
					{
						FixSizeOnNextWindowPosChanging();
					}
				}
			}

			{

				}
			}

			}
