		private class MessageFilterManager : IMessageFilter
		{
			[ThreadStatic]
			private static MessageFilterManager instance;

			private List<WeakReference> managerList;

			private bool isMessageFilterActive;

			private Message _previousMessage;

			private long _previousMessageTime = long.MinValue;

			private static MessageFilterManager Instance
			{
				get
				{
					if (instance == null)
					{
						instance = new MessageFilterManager();
					}
					return instance;
				}
			}

			internal static void AddManager(UltraToolbarsManager manager)
			{
				Instance.AddToolbarManager(manager);
			}

			internal static void RemoveManager(UltraToolbarsManager manager)
			{
				Instance.RemoveToolbarManager(manager);
			}

			private MessageFilterManager()
			{
			}

			private void AddToolbarManager(UltraToolbarsManager manager)
			{
				if (managerList == null)
				{
					managerList = new List<WeakReference>();
				}
				bool flag = false;
				for (int num = managerList.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = (UltraToolbarsManager)ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetWeakReferenceTarget(managerList[num]);
					if (ultraToolbarsManager == null)
					{
						managerList.RemoveAt(num);
					}
					else if (((object)ultraToolbarsManager).Equals((object)manager))
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					managerList.Add(new WeakReference(manager));
				}
				if (isMessageFilterActive)
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					SecurityPermission securityPermission = new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode);
					if (Utilities.CanAssert)
					{
						securityPermission.Assert();
					}
					Utilities.AddMessageFilter((IMessageFilter)this);
					isMessageFilterActive = true;
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}

			private void RemoveToolbarManager(UltraToolbarsManager manager)
			{
				if (managerList == null || managerList.Count == 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				for (int num = managerList.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = (UltraToolbarsManager)ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetWeakReferenceTarget(managerList[num]);
					if (ultraToolbarsManager == null)
					{
						managerList.RemoveAt(num);
					}
					else if (((object)ultraToolbarsManager).Equals((object)manager))
					{
						managerList.RemoveAt(num);
					}
				}
				if (!isMessageFilterActive || managerList.Count != 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					SecurityPermission securityPermission = new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode);
					if (Utilities.CanAssert)
					{
						securityPermission.Assert();
					}
					Utilities.RemoveMessageFilter((IMessageFilter)this);
					isMessageFilterActive = false;
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}

			bool IMessageFilter.PreFilterMessage(ref Message msg)
			{
				return PreFilterMessageHelper(ref msg);
			}

			private bool PreFilterMessageHelper(ref Message msg, UltraToolbarsManager manager = null)
			{
				if (managerList == null || managerList.Count == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				long messageTimeApi = NativeWindowMethods.GetMessageTimeApi();
				bool flag = ignoreDuplicateKeydownMessages && _previousMessage == msg && _previousMessageTime == messageTimeApi;
				if (!flag)
				{
					_previousMessage = msg;
					_previousMessageTime = messageTimeApi;
				}
				switch (msg.Msg)
				{
				case 256:
				case 260:
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						return false;
					}
					DeadKeyInfo deadKeyInfo;
					char[] characters = NativeWindowMethods.VKeyToAscii(msg.WParam, out deadKeyInfo);
					KeyDownInfo keyDownInfo = new KeyDownInfo(characters, msg.WParam, deadKeyInfo);
					bool flag2 = ((manager != null) ? ProcessMessage(ref msg, manager, keyDownInfo) : ProcessMessage(ref msg, keyDownInfo));
					if (!flag2)
					{
						keyDownInfo.RestoreDeadKeys();
					}
					else
					{
						NativeWindowMethods.VKeyToAscii(msg.WParam, useZeroScanCode: true, out deadKeyInfo);
					}
					return flag2;
				}
				case 123:
				case 161:
				case 164:
				case 167:
				case 257:
				case 261:
				case 513:
				case 516:
				case 519:
				case 522:
					if (manager == null)
					{
						return ProcessMessage(ref msg);
					}
					return ProcessMessage(ref msg, manager, null);
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}

			private bool ProcessMessage(ref Message msg)
			{
				return ProcessMessage(ref msg, null);
			}

			private bool ProcessMessage(ref Message msg, KeyDownInfo keyDownInfo)
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager[] array = VerifyManagerList();
				try
				{
					if (array.Length == 0)
					{
						return false;
					}
					Control control = array[0].ActiveControlOfActiveForm;
					bool flag = false;
					if (control == null)
					{
						bool flag2 = default(bool);
						control = WPFInteropUtilities.GetActiveWinFormsControl(ref flag2);
						flag = flag2 && control == null;
					}
					VeryifyManagerList(array);
					Control control2 = control;
					while (control != null)
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
						{
							UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = array[i];
							if (ultraToolbarsManager == null || ultraToolbarsManager.dockWithinContainer != control)
							{
								continue;
							}
							KeyDownInfo currentKeyDownInfo = ultraToolbarsManager.currentKeyDownInfo;
							try
							{
								ultraToolbarsManager.currentKeyDownInfo = keyDownInfo;
								if (((IMessageFilter)ultraToolbarsManager).PreFilterMessage(ref msg))
								{
									return true;
								}
							}
							finally
							{
								ultraToolbarsManager.currentKeyDownInfo = currentKeyDownInfo;
							}
							array[i] = null;
							break;
						}
						control = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetParent(control);
					}
					control = control2;
					Control lastCheckedContainer = null;
					while (control != null)
					{
						UltraToolbarsManager mgrToSkip = null;
						for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
						{
							UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager2 = array[j];
							if (ultraToolbarsManager2 == null || ultraToolbarsManager2.dockWithinContainer != control)
							{
								continue;
							}
							KeyDownInfo currentKeyDownInfo2 = ultraToolbarsManager2.currentKeyDownInfo;
							try
							{
								ultraToolbarsManager2.currentKeyDownInfo = keyDownInfo;
								if (((IMessageFilter)ultraToolbarsManager2).PreFilterMessage(ref msg))
								{
									return true;
								}
							}
							finally
							{
								ultraToolbarsManager2.currentKeyDownInfo = currentKeyDownInfo2;
							}
							array[j] = null;
							mgrToSkip = ultraToolbarsManager2;
							break;
						}
						if (IsMessageHandledBySiblingToolbarManager(ref msg, control, lastCheckedContainer, mgrToSkip, array, keyDownInfo))
						{
							return true;
						}
						if (control is Form && ((Form)control).Modal)
						{
							return false;
						}
						lastCheckedContainer = control;
						Control parent = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetParent(control);
						if (parent == null)
						{
							if (control is Form)
							{
								control = GetActiveControl(ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetOwner((Form)control));
								lastCheckedContainer = null;
							}
							else
							{
								control = null;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							control = parent;
						}
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						for (int k = 0; k < array.Length; k++)
						{
							UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager3 = array[k];
							if (ultraToolbarsManager3 == null || !WPFInteropUtilities.IsControlOnActiveWpfWindow(ultraToolbarsManager3.DockWithinContainer, false))
							{
								continue;
							}
							KeyDownInfo currentKeyDownInfo3 = ultraToolbarsManager3.currentKeyDownInfo;
							try
							{
								ultraToolbarsManager3.currentKeyDownInfo = keyDownInfo;
								if (((IMessageFilter)ultraToolbarsManager3).PreFilterMessage(ref msg))
								{
									return true;
								}
							}
							finally
							{
								ultraToolbarsManager3.currentKeyDownInfo = currentKeyDownInfo3;
							}
							array[k] = null;
						}
					}
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
				}
				return false;
			}

			internal bool ProcessMessage(ref Message msg, UltraToolbarsManager manager, KeyDownInfo keyDownInfo)
			{
				if (managerList == null || managerList.Count == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				UltraToolbarsManager[] array = VerifyManagerList();
				if (array.Length == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				VeryifyManagerList(array);
				int num = Array.IndexOf(array, manager);
				if (num == -1)
				{
					return false;
				}
				KeyDownInfo currentKeyDownInfo = manager.currentKeyDownInfo;
				try
				{
					manager.currentKeyDownInfo = keyDownInfo;
					if (((IMessageFilter)manager).PreFilterMessage(ref msg))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					manager.currentKeyDownInfo = currentKeyDownInfo;
				}
				return false;
			}

			private static bool IsMessageHandledBySiblingToolbarManager(ref Message msg, Control container, Control lastCheckedContainer, UltraToolbarsManager mgrToSkip, UltraToolbarsManager[] mgrList, KeyDownInfo keyDownInfo)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < mgrList.Length; i++)
				{
					UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = mgrList[i];
					if (ultraToolbarsManager == mgrToSkip || ultraToolbarsManager == null || !IsSiblingToolbarManagerContainer(ultraToolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer, container, lastCheckedContainer))
					{
						continue;
					}
					mgrList[i] = null;
					KeyDownInfo currentKeyDownInfo = ultraToolbarsManager.currentKeyDownInfo;
					try
					{
						if (mgrToSkip != null)
						{
							ultraToolbarsManager.currentKeyDownInfo = mgrToSkip.currentKeyDownInfo;
						}
						else
						{
							ultraToolbarsManager.currentKeyDownInfo = keyDownInfo;
						}
						if (((IMessageFilter)ultraToolbarsManager).PreFilterMessage(ref msg))
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						ultraToolbarsManager.currentKeyDownInfo = currentKeyDownInfo;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}

			private static bool IsSiblingToolbarManagerContainer(Control mgrContainer, Control container, Control lastContainerChecked)
			{
				try
				{
					UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
					if (Utilities.CanAssert)
					{
						uIPermission.Assert();
					}
					while (mgrContainer != null)
					{
						if (mgrContainer == lastContainerChecked)
						{
							return false;
						}
						Form form = mgrContainer as Form;
						if (mgrContainer == container)
						{
							return true;
						}
						if (form != null && form.IsMdiChild)
						{
							return false;
						}
						mgrContainer = mgrContainer.Parent;
					}
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
				}
				return false;
			}

			internal static bool ProcessPreFilterMessage(ref Message msg, UltraToolbarsManager manager = null)
			{
				return Instance.PreFilterMessageHelper(ref msg, manager);
			}

			private UltraToolbarsManager[] VerifyManagerList()
			{
				List<UltraToolbarsManager> list = new List<UltraToolbarsManager>();
				for (int num = managerList.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = (UltraToolbarsManager)ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetWeakReferenceTarget(managerList[num]);
					if (ultraToolbarsManager == null)
					{
						managerList.RemoveAt(num);
					}
					else
					{
						list.Insert(0, ultraToolbarsManager);
					}
				}
				return list.ToArray();
			}

			private static void VeryifyManagerList(UltraToolbarsManager[] mgrList)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < mgrList.Length; i++)
				{
					UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = mgrList[i];
					if (ultraToolbarsManager != null)
					{
						if (!ultraToolbarsManager.isEnabled)
						{
							mgrList[i] = null;
						}
						else if (ultraToolbarsManager.dockWithinContainer != null && !ultraToolbarsManager.dockWithinContainer.Visible)
						{
							mgrList[i] = null;
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public class DockAreaAccessibleObject : UltraControlAccessibleObject
		{
			private UltraToolbarsDockArea dockArea;

			public override Rectangle Bounds => ((AccessibleObject)this).Bounds;

			public override string DefaultAction => ((Control.ControlAccessibleObject)this).DefaultAction;

			public override string Name
			{
				get
				{
					string name = ((Control.ControlAccessibleObject)this).Name;
					if (name != null && name.Length > 0)
					{
						return name;
					}
					name = null;
					switch (dockArea.DockedPosition)
					{
					case DockedPosition.Top:
						name = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AccessibleName_DockTop");
						break;
					case DockedPosition.Left:
						name = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AccessibleName_DockLeft");
						break;
					case DockedPosition.Right:
						name = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AccessibleName_DockRight");
						break;
					case DockedPosition.Bottom:
						name = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AccessibleName_DockBottom");
						break;
					}
					return name;
				}
				set
				{
					((Control.ControlAccessibleObject)this).Name = value;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleStates State => AccessibleStates.None;

			public UltraToolbarsDockArea DockArea => dockArea;

			public DockAreaAccessibleObject(UltraToolbarsDockArea dockArea)
				: base((Control)(object)dockArea)
			{
				this.dockArea = dockArea;
			}

			public override void DoDefaultAction()
			{
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
			{
				try
				{
					if (index < dockArea.ToolbarCount)
					{
						return dockArea.GetToolbarAtIndex(index).AccessibilityObject;
					}
					index -= dockArea.ToolbarCount;
					if (dockArea.ToolbarsManager.HasFocusedAccessibleObject())
					{
						if (index == 0)
						{
							return dockArea.ToolbarsManager.GetFocusedAccessibleObject();
						}
						index--;
					}
					if (dockArea.IsRibbonVisibleInDockArea)
					{
						if (index == 0)
						{
							return dockArea.ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.AccessibilityObject;
						}
						index--;
					}
					else if (DockArea.OwningMenuAgent is RibbonMenuAgentBase)
					{
						if (index == 0)
						{
							if (DockArea.OwningMenuAgent is RibbonTabMenuAgent)
							{
								return dockArea.ToolbarsManager.Ribbon.RibbonGroupAreaAccessibilityObject;
							}
							if (DockArea.OwningMenuAgent is RibbonGroupMenuAgent ribbonGroupMenuAgent)
							{
								return ribbonGroupMenuAgent.Group.RibbonGroupAccessiblilityObject;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							index--;
						}
					}
					if (dockArea.IsNavigationToolbarVisibleInDockArea)
					{
						if (index == 0)
						{
							return dockArea.ToolbarsManager.NavigationToolbar.AccessibilityObject;
						}
						index--;
					}
					return ((UltraControlAccessibleObject)this).GetChild(index);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (ex == null)
					{
						throw;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override int GetChildCount()
			{
				int num = dockArea.ToolbarCount;
				if (dockArea.DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Top && dockArea.ToolbarsManager.HasFocusedAccessibleObject())
				{
					num++;
				}
				if (dockArea.IsRibbonVisibleInDockArea)
				{
					num++;
				}
				else if (DockArea.OwningMenuAgent is RibbonMenuAgentBase)
				{
					num++;
				}
				if (dockArea.IsNavigationToolbarVisibleInDockArea)
				{
					num++;
				}
				return num + ((UltraControlAccessibleObject)this).GetChildCount();
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetFocused()
			{
				AccessibleObject focusedAccessibleObject = dockArea.ToolbarsManager.GetFocusedAccessibleObject();
				if (focusedAccessibleObject != null)
				{
					return focusedAccessibleObject;
				}
				return ((UltraControlAccessibleObject)this).GetFocused();
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetSelected()
			{
				return dockArea.ToolbarsManager.GetSelectedAccessibleObject();
			}

			public override AccessibleObject HitTest(int x, int y)
			{
				return ((UltraControlAccessibleObject)this).HitTest(x, y);
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				if (navdir == AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild || navdir == AccessibleNavigation.LastChild)
				{
					int childCount = ((AccessibleObject)(object)this).GetChildCount();
					if (childCount == 0)
					{
						return null;
					}
					if (navdir == AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild)
					{
						return ((AccessibleObject)(object)this).GetChild(0);
					}
					int num = childCount - 1;
					AccessibleObject child = ((AccessibleObject)(object)this).GetChild(num);
					if (child == dockArea.ToolbarsManager.GetFocusedAccessibleObject())
					{
						num--;
						if (num < 0)
						{
							return null;
						}
						child = ((AccessibleObject)(object)this).GetChild(num);
					}
					return child;
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override void Select(AccessibleSelection flags)
			{
			}
		}

		private class MdiTabStopHelper
		{
			private Hashtable oldTabStops;

			private MdiTabStopHelper(Form mdiForm)
			{
				Form[] mdiChildren = mdiForm.MdiChildren;
				oldTabStops = new Hashtable(mdiChildren.Length);
				foreach (Form form in mdiChildren)
				{
					if (form != mdiForm.ActiveMdiChild)
					{
						oldTabStops.Add(form, form.TabStop);
						form.TabStop = false;
					}
				}
			}

			internal static MdiTabStopHelper PrepareTabStops(Form mdiForm)
			{
				if (mdiForm != null && mdiForm.IsMdiContainer)
				{
					return new MdiTabStopHelper(mdiForm);
				}
				return null;
			}

			public void Restore()
			{
				IDictionaryEnumerator enumerator = oldTabStops.GetEnumerator();
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					Form form = (Form)enumerator.Key;
					bool tabStop = (bool)enumerator.Value;
					if (!form.Disposing && !form.IsDisposed)
					{
						form.TabStop = tabStop;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private class LoadEventWatcher : IDisposable
		{
			private Form form;

			private bool wasloadFired;

			private UserControl userControl;

			public bool WasLoadFired => wasloadFired;

			public LoadEventWatcher(UltraToolbarsManager manager)
			{
				form = manager.FindForm();
				if (form != null)
				{
					form.Load += OnLoad;
					return;
				}
				userControl = manager.FindContainer() as UserControl;
				if (userControl != null)
				{
					userControl.Load += OnLoad;
				}
			}

			void IDisposable.Dispose()
			{
				if (form != null)
				{
					form.Load -= OnLoad;
				}
				if (userControl != null)
				{
					userControl.Load -= OnLoad;
				}
			}

			private void OnLoad(object sender, EventArgs e)
			{
				wasloadFired = true;
			}
		}

		public override ISite Site
		{
			get
			{
				return ((Component)this).Site;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					UnhookDesignerEvents();
					UnregisterDockWithinContainer();
				}
				((Component)this).Site = value;
				if (value != null && value.DesignMode && value.GetService(typeof(IDesignerHost)) is IDesignerHost { Loading: false, Container: not null } designerHost && designerHost.Container.Components.Count > 0 && designerHost.Container.Components[0] is ContainerControl containerControl)
				{
					onManagerAddedAfterLoadCallPending = true;
					containerControl.BeginInvoke(new MethodInvoker(OnManagerAddedAfterLoad));
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public UltraToolbarsManager ActiveMdiChildManager
		{
			get
			{
				return activeMdiChildManager;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == this)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_119"));
				}
				if (mdiMergeable)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_118"));
				}
				if (value != null && value.MdiMergeable)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_118"));
				}
				SetRedraw(setRedrawOn: false);
				try
				{
					UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = activeMdiChildManager;
					bool flag = value != null && value.HasRibbon && value.Ribbon.VisibleResolved;
					InternalSetActiveMdiChildManager(value, calledFromMdiChildActivate: false);
					if (flag && !value.Ribbon.VisibleResolved)
					{
						value.SynchronizeFormBorderStyle(initializing: false);
						for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
						{
							value.dockAreas[i]?.RefreshDockAreaSize();
						}
					}
					if (ultraToolbarsManager != null)
					{
						if (ultraToolbarsManager.MdiParentManagerInternal == this)
						{
							ultraToolbarsManager.InternalSetMdiParentManager(null);
						}
						ultraToolbarsManager.DirtyAllElements();
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					SetRedraw(setRedrawOn: true);
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public ToolBase ActiveTool
		{
			get
			{
				if (GestureInProgress)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (activeTool != null && MdiParentManagerInternal != null && activeTool.ToolbarsManagerInControl == this)
				{
					return activeTool;
				}
				if (MdiParentManagerInternal != null && IsMdiMerged)
				{
					return MdiParentManagerInternal.ActiveTool;
				}
				return activeTool;
			}
			set
			{
				if (MdiParentManagerInternal != null && IsMdiMerged)
				{
					MdiParentManagerInternal.ActiveTool = value;
				}
				else
				{
					if (activeTool == value)
					{
						return;
					}
					if (value != null)
					{
						if (value.AttachedParentTool != null && value.AttachedParentTool.ToolbarsManager == this)
						{
							ActiveTool = value.AttachedParentTool;
							return;
						}
						if (value.ToolbarsManager != this)
						{
							throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_96"));
						}
						if (value.IsRootTool || value.InstanceProps == null)
						{
							throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_114"));
						}
						if (value.UIElement == null)
						{
							throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_50"));
						}
						if (value.OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
						{
							if (value.OwningRibbonGroup != toolOwnerWithCapture)
							{
								toolOwnerWithCapture = null;
							}
						}
						else if (value.OwningToolbarInternal != toolOwnerWithCapture)
						{
							toolOwnerWithCapture = null;
						}
					}
					InternalSetActiveTool(value, value != null, clearToolBeingEdited: true);
				}
			}
		}

				//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0031: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4

						appearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += SubObjectPropChangeHandler;

					ToolbarsManagerUtilities.SetAppearanceHolderCollection(appearanceHolder, this);

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_UltraToolbarsManager_P_DockWithinContainer")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(DockWithinContainerConverter))]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		public Control DockWithinContainer
		{
			get
			{
				return dockWithinContainer;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == dockWithinContainer)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (containerSetOnAncestorForm)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_112"));
				}
				if (value != null)
				{
					try
					{
						VerifyNotAlreadyManaged(value);
					}
					catch
					{
						if (((Component)this).DesignMode)
						{
							return;
						}
						throw;
					}
					if (EnforceOffice2007Resolution && (!(value is Form form) || (!IsDesignMode && !form.TopLevel)))
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DockWithinContainerNotTopLevelForm"));
					}
				}
				Control control = FindContainer();
				Control control2 = GetParentForHiddenContainedControls();
				if (control2 == control)
				{
					control2 = null;
				}
				else
				{
					control2.Parent = null;
				}
				if (dockWithinContainer != null)
				{
					if (!((Component)this).DesignMode)
					{
						ForceExitEditMode();
					}
					UnhookFormEvents();
					DestroyDockingAreas();
					UnregisterDockWithinContainer();
					if (IsFormRounded)
					{
						bool flag = forceStandardDisplayStyle;
						forceStandardDisplayStyle = true;
						try
						{
							SynchronizeFormBorderStyle(initializing: false);
						}
						finally
						{
							forceStandardDisplayStyle = flag;
						}
					}
					dockWithinContainer = null;
				}
				else if (!initializing)
				{
					DestroyDockingAreas();
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
				{
					UltraToolbarsDockArea ultraToolbarsDockArea = dockAreas[i];
					if (ultraToolbarsDockArea != null)
					{
						Control parentForHiddenContainedControls = ultraToolbarsDockArea.GetParentForHiddenContainedControls(shouldCreate: false);
						if (parentForHiddenContainedControls == control2)
						{
							ultraToolbarsDockArea.ClearParentForHiddenContainedControls();
						}
					}
				}
				InitializeDockWithinContainer(value);
				if (Initialized && value != null)
				{
					CheckForFillControl(value);
					if (ShouldCreateDockingAreas)
					{
						CreateDockingAreas(value);
					}
					InitializeDockAreaToolbars();
					control = GetParentForHiddenContainedControls();
					if (value is Form { IsHandleCreated: false } form2)
					{
						HookEndInitForm(form2);
					}
				}
				else if (value != null)
				{
					control = FindContainer();
				}
				if (control2 != null)
				{
					if (control != null)
					{
						control.SuspendLayout();
						for (int num = control2.Controls.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
						{
							Control control3 = control2.Controls[num];
							control3.Parent = control;
						}
						control.ResumeLayout(performLayout: false);
					}
					control2.Dispose();
				}
				CheckIfMdiClientSubclasserNeeded(FindForm());
				if (ribbon != null)
				{
					ribbon.Metrics.Dirty(Ribbon.RibbonMetricsFlags.DockWithinContainer);
				}
				SynchronizeFormBorderStyle(initializing: false);
				SyncAssociatedObjectsEnabledState();
				SyncAssociatedObjectsVisibleState();
				if (value != null)
				{
					if (!value.IsHandleCreated)
					{
						InstallHook();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					RemoveHook();
				}
				((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.DockWithinContainer);
				if (value != null)
				{
					AddMessageFilter();
				}
				else
				{
					RemoveMessageFilter();
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public Type DockWithinContainerBaseType
		{
			get
			{
				return dockWithinContainerBaseType;
			}
			set
			{
				dockWithinContainerBaseType = value;
			}
		}

				//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

		internal UltraToolbarsManager MdiParentManagerInternal
		{
			get
			{
				return mdiParentManager;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == mdiParentManager)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (value == this)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_119"));
				}
				if (mdiMergeable)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_118"));
				}
				if (mdiParentManager != null)
				{
					if (mdiParentManager.MdiMergeable)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_118"));
					}
					mdiParentManager.ActiveMdiChildManager = null;
				}
				if (value != null)
				{
					value.ActiveMdiChildManager = this;
				}

		internal bool DesignModeBeginInitCalled
		{
			get

				return designModeBeginInitCalled;
			}
			set

				if (designModeBeginInitCalled)
				{
					return;
				}
				designModeBeginInitCalled = true;
				if (toolbars != null && toolbars.Count > 0)
				{
					hasInheritedToolbars = true;
					foreach (UltraToolbar toolbar in toolbars)
					{
						toolbar.Inherited = true;
						if (toolbar.DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Floating)
						{
							RemoveToolbarFromDockArea(toolbar);
						}
					}
				}
				if (ribbon != null)
				{
					ribbon.MarkInheritedItems();
				}
				if (miniToolbar != null)
				{
					miniToolbar.Inherited = true;
				}
				if (tools != null && tools.Count > 0)
				{
					hasInheritedTools = true;
					foreach (ToolBase tool in tools)
					{
						tool.Inherited = true;
						tool.IsInstanceInherited = true;
					}
				}
				if (optionSets != null && optionSets.Count > 0)
				{
					hasInheritedOptionSets = true;
					foreach (OptionSet optionSet in optionSets)
					{
						optionSet.Inherited = true;
					}
				}
				if (dockWithinContainer != null)
				{
					containerSetOnAncestorForm = true;
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool HideToolbarsResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (((Component)this).DesignMode)
				{
					return HideToolbars;
				}
				if (HasMdiParentManagerBeenSet)
				{
					return true;
				}
				Form form = FindForm();
				if (form != null && form == DockWithinContainer)
				{
					try
					{
						UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
						if (Utilities.CanAssert)
						{
							uIPermission.Assert();
						}
						Form mdiParent = form.MdiParent;
						if (mdiParent == null)
						{
							return false;
						}
						if (MdiParentManagerInternal != null && IsMdiMerged)
						{
							return true;
						}
						if (MdiMergeable)
						{
							UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = FromForm(mdiParent);
							if (ultraToolbarsManager != null && ultraToolbarsManager.MdiMergeable)
							{
								return true;
							}
						}
					}
					catch (SecurityException)
					{
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal Rectangle InnerDockedControlsBounds
		{
			get
			{
				if (DockWithinContainer == null)
				{
					return Rectangle.Empty;
				}
				Control control = DockWithinContainer;
				Rectangle displayRectangle = control.DisplayRectangle;
				int num2;
				int num3;
				int num4;
				int num = (num2 = (num3 = (num4 = -1)));
				foreach (Control control2 in control.Controls)
				{
					if (!control2.Visible)
					{
						continue;
					}
					switch (control2.Dock)
					{
					case DockStyle.Left:
						if (num == -1 || control2.Right > num)
						{
							num = control2.Right;
						}
						break;
					case DockStyle.Right:
						if (num2 == -1 || control2.Left < num2)
						{
							num2 = control2.Left;
						}
						break;
					case DockStyle.Top:
						if (num3 == -1 || control2.Bottom > num3)
						{
							num3 = control2.Bottom;
						}
						break;
					case DockStyle.Bottom:
						if (num4 == -1 || control2.Top < num4)
						{
							num4 = control2.Top;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				if (num == -1)
				{
					num = displayRectangle.Left;
				}
				if (num2 == -1)
				{
					num2 = displayRectangle.Right;
				}
				if (num3 == -1)
				{
					num3 = displayRectangle.Top;
				}
				if (num4 == -1)
				{
					num4 = displayRectangle.Bottom;
				}
				return Rectangle.FromLTRB(num, num3, num2, num4);
			}
		}

		internal bool IsGlassSupportedResolved
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_002d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0039: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0044: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				Form form = DockWithinContainer as Form;
				if (IsDockWithinContainerBeingDesigned || !NativeWindowMethods.IsDWMCompositionEnabled || form == null || form.IsMdiChild || (int)FormDisplayStyleResolved == 2)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if ((int)StyleResolved == 9)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if ((int)FormDisplayStyleResolved == 4)
				{
					switch (form.FormBorderStyle)
					{
					case FormBorderStyle.FixedSingle:
					case FormBorderStyle.Fixed3D:
					case FormBorderStyle.FixedDialog:
					case FormBorderStyle.FixedToolWindow:
						return false;
					}
				}
				if (Application.VisualStyleState != VisualStyleState.ClientAndNonClientAreasEnabled)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return IsGlassSupported;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsTabbedMdi
		{
			get
			{
				if (mdiParentManager != null)
				{
					return mdiParentManager.IsTabbedMdi;
				}
				ITabbedMdiManager val = null;
				if (dockWithinContainer != null)
				{
					Form form = FindForm();
					if (form != null && form.IsMdiChild)
					{
						form = form.MdiParent;
					}
					if (form != null && form.IsMdiContainer)
					{
						val = MdiParentManager.GetTabbedMdiManager(form);
					}
				}
				if (val != tabbedMdiManager)
				{
					if (tabbedMdiManager != null)
					{
						tabbedMdiManager.EnabledChanging -= OnTabbedMdiManagerEnabledChanging;
						tabbedMdiManager.EnabledChanged -= OnTabbedMdiManagerEnabledChanged;
					}
					tabbedMdiManager = val;
					if (tabbedMdiManager != null)
					{
						tabbedMdiManager.EnabledChanging += OnTabbedMdiManagerEnabledChanging;
						tabbedMdiManager.EnabledChanged += OnTabbedMdiManagerEnabledChanged;
					}
				}
				if (tabbedMdiManager != null)
				{
					return tabbedMdiManager.Enabled;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

					return false;

					showRibbonButtonSize = new Size(Math.Max(size.Width, size2.Width), Math.Max(size.Height, size2.Height));
				}
				return showRibbonButtonSize;
			}
		}

		internal ToolBase ToolBeingCustomized
		{
			get
			{
				return toolBeingCustomized;
			}
			set
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = toolBeingCustomized;
				if (value != null && customizeDialog != null && !customizeDialog.AllowToolCustomization)
				{
					value = null;
				}
				if (value != null && value.OwnerIsRibbonGroup && !CanCustomizerAffectRibbon)
				{
					value = null;
				}
				if (value != null && value.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea && !CanCustomizerAffectRibbon)
				{
					value = null;
				}
				toolBeingCustomized = value;
				if (toolBeingCustomized != null && toolBeingCustomized.UIElement != null)
				{
					toolBeingCustomized.UIElement.Invalidate(false);
				}
				if (toolBase != null && toolBase.UIElement != null)
				{
					toolBase.UIElement.Invalidate(false);
				}
				if (customizeDialog != null)
				{
					customizeDialog.OnNewCustomizeToolSelected(value, Control.MousePosition);
				}
			}
		}

		internal object ToolOwnerWithCapture
		{
			get
			{
				if (mdiParentManager != null)
				{
					return mdiParentManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture;
				}
				return toolOwnerWithCapture;
			}
			set
			{
				if (mdiParentManager != null)
				{
					UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = null;
					if (value is RibbonGroup)
					{
						ultraToolbarsManager = ((RibbonGroup)value).ToolbarsManager;
					}
					else if (value is UltraToolbarBase)
					{
						ultraToolbarsManager = ((UltraToolbarBase)value).ToolbarsManager;
					}
					mdiParentManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture = value;
				}
				else
				{
					if (value == null && !AllowToolbarCaptureRelease)
					{
						return;
					}
					UltraToolbarBase ultraToolbarBase = toolOwnerWithCapture as UltraToolbarBase;
					RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = toolOwnerWithCapture as RibbonGroup;
					object obj = toolOwnerWithCapture;
					if (value == null)
					{
						HideNonRecentlyUsedItems = true;
						if (ultraToolbarBase != null)
						{
							ultraToolbarBase.IsMenuAnimationActive = true;
							ultraToolbarBase.CloseOpenSubmenuTools(null);
						}
						else
						{
							ribbonGroup?.CloseAllOpenSubmenus(null);
						}
					}
					else if (value is UltraToolbarBase && ((UltraToolbarBase)value).IsBumpedToolsToolbar)
					{
						return;
					}
					toolOwnerWithCapture = value;
					if (toolOwnerWithCapture is UltraToolbarBase)
					{
						((UltraToolbarBase)toolOwnerWithCapture).AutoDropDownMode = false;
					}
					if (toolOwnerWithCapture != obj)
					{
						if (obj is UltraToolbarBase)
						{
							ultraToolbarBase.AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(AccessibleEvents.SystemMenuEnd, -1);
						}
						else if (obj is RibbonGroup)
						{
							((RibbonGroup)obj).AccessibilityNotifyClients(AccessibleEvents.SystemMenuEnd, -1);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal ToolBase ToolWithFocus
		{
			get
			{
				if (toolBeingEdited != null)
				{
					return toolBeingEdited;
				}
				if (CurrentPopupControl != null && CurrentPopupControl.MenuAgent is RibbonMenuAgentBase ribbonMenuAgentBase)
				{
					if (ribbonMenuAgentBase.ItemWithFocus == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return ribbonMenuAgentBase.ItemWithFocus.Context as ToolBase;
				}
				if (HasRibbon && Ribbon.ItemWithFocus != null)
				{
					return Ribbon.ItemWithFocus.Context as ToolBase;
				}
				ControlContainerTool controlContainerTool = activeTool as ControlContainerTool;
				if (ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ContainsFocus(controlContainerTool) && controlContainerTool.OwningToolbarInternal != null && controlContainerTool.OwningToolbarInternal.IsBumpedToolsToolbar)
				{
					return controlContainerTool;
				}
				if (toolOwnerWithCapture == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return activeTool;
			}
		}

		internal Blend GradientBlend
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if ((int)StyleResolved == 3 && ThemesActive)
				{
					if (gradientBlend == null)
					{
						gradientBlend = new Blend();
						float[] factors = new float[5] { 0f, 0.1f, 0.35f, 1f, 1f };
						float[] positions = new float[5] { 0f, 0.5f, 0.6f, 0.95f, 1f };
						gradientBlend.Factors = factors;
						gradientBlend.Positions = positions;
					}
					return gradientBlend;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal List<ToolBase> CachedToolsList
		{
			get
			{
				if (cachedToolsVersion != Tools.Version)
				{
					cachedTools = new List<ToolBase>(Tools.Count);
					foreach (ToolBase tool in Tools)
					{
						cachedTools.Add(tool);
					}
					cachedTools.Sort(ToolListComparer.Instance);
					cachedToolsVersion = Tools.Version;
				}
				return cachedTools;
			}
		}

			{

				if (isFormActive != lastIsFormActive)
				{
					lastIsFormActive = isFormActive;

				}
				return isFormActive;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool IsFormActive
		{
			get
			{
				Form form = FindForm();
				if (form != null)
				{
					return Utilities.IsFormOrOwnedFormActive(form, (IEnumerable)floatingWindows);
				}
				return WPFInteropUtilities.IsControlOnActiveWpfWindow(dockWithinContainer, true);
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsNotifyIconOwnerFormActive
		{
			get
			{
				try
				{
					UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
					if (Utilities.CanAssert)
					{
						uIPermission.Assert();
					}
					for (Form form = Form.ActiveForm; form != null; form = form.Owner)
					{
						if (form is NotifyIconOwnerForm)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool TouchMetricsEnabledResolved
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0038: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if ((int)touchEnabled != 0)
				{
					return (int)touchEnabled == 1;
				}
				if ((int)cachedTouchProviderTouchEnabled == 0)
				{
					cachedTouchProviderTouchEnabled = (DefaultableBoolean)(TouchProviderManager.AreTouchMetricsEnabled(dockWithinContainer) ? 1 : 2);
				}
				return (int)cachedTouchProviderTouchEnabled == 1;
			}
		}

		private Size ResolvedImageSizeTouchSmall
		{
			get
			{
				if (resolvedImageTouchSizeSmall.IsEmpty)
				{
					Size touchElementSize = TouchUtilities.GetTouchElementSize(DockWithinContainer, (TouchElementSizes)2);
					resolvedImageTouchSizeSmall = new Size(Math.Max(touchElementSize.Width, imageSizeTouchSmall.Width), Math.Max(touchElementSize.Height, imageSizeTouchSmall.Height));
				}
				return resolvedImageTouchSizeSmall;
			}
		}

		private Size ResolvedImageSizeTouchLarge
		{
			get
			{
				if (resolvedImageTouchSizeLarge.IsEmpty)
				{
					Size touchElementSize = TouchUtilities.GetTouchElementSize(DockWithinContainer, (TouchElementSizes)2);
					resolvedImageTouchSizeLarge = new Size(Math.Max(touchElementSize.Width, imageSizeTouchLarge.Width), Math.Max(touchElementSize.Height, imageSizeTouchLarge.Height));
				}
				return resolvedImageTouchSizeLarge;
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_UltraToolbarsManager_P_GesturesEnabled")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Touch")]
		public DefaultableBoolean GesturesEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				return gesturesEnabled;
			}
			set
			{
				//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0035: Expected I4, but got Unknown
				if (value != gesturesEnabled)
				{
					if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(DefaultableBoolean), value))
					{
						throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("GesturesEnabled", (int)value, typeof(DefaultableBoolean));
					}
					gesturesEnabled = value;
					((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.GesturesEnabled);
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public bool GesturesEnabledResolved
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if ((int)gesturesEnabled != 0)
				{
					return (int)gesturesEnabled == 1;
				}
				return UltraControlBase.GesturesEnabled;
			}
		}

		internal static event MouseHookEventHandler MouseHook
		{
			add
			{
				lock (typeof(DropDownManager))
				{
					if (mouseHookDelegate == null)
					{
						mouseHookDelegate = value;
					}
					else
					{
						mouseHookDelegate = (MouseHookEventHandler)Delegate.Combine(mouseHookDelegate, value);
					}
					if (mouseHookManager == null)
					{
						mouseHookManager = new MouseHookManager();
					}
					mouseHookManager.SetHook();
				}
			}
			remove
			{
				lock (typeof(DropDownManager))
				{
					if (mouseHookDelegate != null)
					{
						mouseHookDelegate = (MouseHookEventHandler)Delegate.Remove(mouseHookDelegate, value);
					}
					if (mouseHookDelegate == null && mouseHookManager != null)
					{
						mouseHookManager.ReleaseHook();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private bool LoadComponentSettingsFromXmlHelper()
		{
			bool result = false;
			string xmlData = Settings.XmlData;
			if (xmlData != null && xmlData.Length != 0)
			{
				using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
				StreamWriter streamWriter = new StreamWriter(memoryStream);
				streamWriter.Write(xmlData);
				streamWriter.Flush();
				memoryStream.Position = 0L;
				try
				{
					LoadFromXml(memoryStream);
					result = true;
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void LoadFromXml(Stream stream)
		{
			LoadFromXmlHelper(stream);
		}

		public void LoadFromXml(string filename)
		{
			FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(filename, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
			try
			{
				LoadFromXmlHelper(fileStream);
			}
			finally
			{
				fileStream.Close();
			}
		}

		private void LoadFromXmlHelper(Stream stream)
		{
			SoapFormatter soapFormatter = new SoapFormatter();
			soapFormatter.AssemblyFormat = FormatterAssemblyStyle.Simple;
			IFormatter formatter = soapFormatter;
			UsingBinaryFormat = false;
			LoadHelper(stream, formatter);
		}

		private void SaveComponentSettingsAsXmlHelper(MemoryStream ms)
		{
			SaveAsXml(ms, saveCustomizations: true);
			ms.Position = 0L;
			StreamReader streamReader = new StreamReader(ms);
			Settings.XmlData = streamReader.ReadToEnd();
			((System.Configuration.SettingsBase)(object)Settings).Save();
		}

		public void SaveAsXml(Stream stream, bool saveCustomizations)
		{
			SaveAsXmlHelper(stream, saveCustomizations);
		}

		public void SaveAsXml(string filename, bool saveCustomizations)
		{
			FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(filename, FileMode.Create, FileAccess.Write);
			try
			{
				SaveAsXmlHelper(fileStream, saveCustomizations);
			}
			finally
			{
				fileStream.Close();
			}
		}

		private void SaveAsXmlHelper(Stream stream, bool saveCustomizations)
		{
			UsingBinaryFormat = false;
			SoapFormatter soapFormatter = new SoapFormatter(null, new StreamingContext(StreamingContextStates.Persistence, saveCustomizations));
			soapFormatter.AssemblyFormat = FormatterAssemblyStyle.Simple;
			IFormatter formatter = soapFormatter;
			SaveHelper(stream, formatter);
		}

		internal static Control GetActiveControl(Form form)
		{
			if (form == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Control control = form;
			while (control is IContainerControl)
			{
				Control activeControl = ((IContainerControl)control).ActiveControl;
				if (activeControl == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				control = activeControl;
			}
			return control;
		}

		internal void FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds id, EventArgs e)
		{
			PopupToolBase popupToolBase = null;
			if (id == ToolbarEventIds.ToolClick && ToolbarWithCapture != null && ToolbarWithCapture.QuickCustomizeTool != null && ToolbarWithCapture.QuickCustomizeTool.IsOpen)
			{
				popupToolBase = ToolbarWithCapture.QuickCustomizeTool;
			}
			try
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = null;
				bool flag = true;
				if (e is CancelableToolEventArgs)
				{
					toolBase = ((CancelableToolEventArgs)e).Tool;
				}
				else if (e is ToolEventArgs)
				{
					toolBase = ((ToolEventArgs)e).Tool;
				}
				else if (e is ToolKeyEventArgs)
				{
					toolBase = ((ToolKeyEventArgs)e).Tool;
				}
				else if (e is ToolKeyPressEventArgs)
				{
					toolBase = ((ToolKeyPressEventArgs)e).Tool;
				}
				else
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					if (toolBase == null || (toolBase.ToolbarsManager == null && id != ToolbarEventIds.AfterToolDragEnd) || toolBase.IsSpecialTool || toolBase.IsMdiMergeTool)
					{
						return;
					}
					if (toolBase.ToolbarsManager != this && id != ToolbarEventIds.AfterToolDragEnd)
					{
						if (ActiveMdiChildManager == toolBase.ToolbarsManager)
						{
							toolBase.ToolbarsManager.FireEvent(id, e);
						}
						return;
					}
				}
				if (!EventManager.CanFireEvent(id) || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(ToolbarEventIds), id))
				{
					return;
				}
				EventManager.IncrementInProgress(id);
				try
				{
					switch (id)
					{
					case ToolbarEventIds.AfterComponentReset:
						OnAfterComponentReset(e);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.AfterCustomizeDialogClosed:
						OnAfterCustomizeDialogClosed(e);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.AfterToolActivate:
						OnAfterToolActivate(e as ToolEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.AfterToolDeactivate:
						OnAfterToolDeactivate(e as ToolEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.AfterToolbarReset:
						OnAfterToolbarReset(e as ToolbarEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.AfterToolCloseup:
						OnAfterToolCloseup(e as ToolDropdownEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.AfterToolDropdown:
						OnAfterToolDropdown(e as ToolDropdownEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.BeforeComponentReset:
						OnBeforeComponentReset(e as CancelEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.BeforeDisplayCustomizeDialog:
						OnBeforeDisplayCustomizeDialog(e as BeforeDisplayCustomizeDialogEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.BeforeDisplayMoreItemsDialog:
						OnBeforeDisplayMoreItemsDialog(e as CancelableToolEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.BeforeToolActivate:
						OnBeforeToolActivate(e as CancelableToolEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.BeforeToolbarListDropdown:
						OnBeforeToolbarListDropdown(e as BeforeToolbarListDropdownEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.BeforeToolbarReset:
						OnBeforeToolbarReset(e as CancelableToolbarEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.BeforeToolDropdown:
						OnBeforeToolDropdown(e as BeforeToolDropdownEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.MouseEnterElement:
						((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).OnMouseEnterElement((UIElementEventArgs)(object)((e is UIElementEventArgs) ? e : null));
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.MouseLeaveElement:
						((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).OnMouseLeaveElement((UIElementEventArgs)(object)((e is UIElementEventArgs) ? e : null));
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.TearawayToolbarCreated:
						OnTearawayToolbarCreated(e as TearawayToolbarCreatedEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.ToolbarModified:
						OnToolbarModified(e as ToolbarModifiedEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.ToolClick:
						OnToolClick(e as ToolClickEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.ToolDoubleClick:
						OnToolDoubleClick(e as ToolEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.ToolKeyDown:
						OnToolKeyDown(e as ToolKeyEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.ToolKeyPress:
						OnToolKeyPress(e as ToolKeyPressEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.ToolKeyUp:
						OnToolKeyUp(e as ToolKeyEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.ToolValueChanged:
						OnToolValueChanged(e as ToolEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.BeforeTaskPaneToolSelected:
						OnBeforeTaskPaneToolSelected(e as BeforeTaskPaneToolSelectedEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.AfterTaskPaneToolSelected:
						OnAfterTaskPaneToolSelected(e as TaskPaneToolbarEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.TaskPaneToolResize:
						OnTaskPaneToolResize(e as TaskPaneToolResizeEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.AfterToolDragEnd:
						OnAfterToolDragEnd(e as AfterToolDragEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.BeforeToolDragBegin:
						OnBeforeToolDragBegin(e as CancelableToolEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.BeforeShortcutKeyProcessed:
						OnBeforeShortcutKeyProcessed(e as BeforeShortcutKeyProcessedEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.BeforeToolExitEditMode:
						OnBeforeToolExitEditMode(e as BeforeToolExitEditModeEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.BeforeToolEnterEditMode:
						OnBeforeToolEnterEditMode(e as BeforeToolEnterEditModeEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.AfterToolExitEditMode:
						OnAfterToolExitEditMode(e as AfterToolExitEditModeEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.AfterToolEnterEditMode:
						OnAfterToolEnterEditMode(e as AfterToolEnterEditModeEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.ToolEditError:
						OnToolEditError(e as ToolEditErrorEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.BeforeRibbonTabSelected:
						OnBeforeRibbonTabSelected(e as BeforeRibbonTabSelectedEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.AfterRibbonTabSelected:
						OnAfterRibbonTabSelected(e as RibbonTabEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.GalleryToolActiveItemChange:
						OnGalleryToolActiveItemChange(e as GalleryToolItemEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.GalleryToolFilterChange:
						OnGalleryToolFilterChange(e as GalleryToolFilterChangeEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.GalleryToolItemClick:
						OnGalleryToolItemClick(e as GalleryToolItemEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.AfterApplicationMenuCloseUp:
						OnAfterApplicationMenuCloseUp(e);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.AfterApplicationMenuDropDown:
						OnAfterApplicationMenuDropDown(e);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.BeforeApplicationMenuDropDown:
						OnBeforeApplicationMenuDropDown(e as CancelEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.QuickAccessToolbarModified:
						OnQuickAccessToolbarModified(e as QuickAccessToolbarModifiedEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.AfterRibbonGroupCloseUp:
						OnAfterRibbonGroupCloseUp(e as RibbonGroupEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.AfterRibbonGroupDropDown:
						OnAfterRibbonGroupDropDown(e as RibbonGroupEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.BeforeRibbonGroupDropDown:
						OnBeforeRibbonGroupDropDown(e as BeforeRibbonGroupDropDownEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.AfterRibbonTabCloseUp:
						OnAfterRibbonTabCloseUp(e as RibbonTabEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.AfterRibbonTabDropDown:
						OnAfterRibbonTabDropDown(e as RibbonTabEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.BeforeRibbonTabDropDown:
						OnBeforeRibbonTabDropDown(e as BeforeRibbonTabDropDownEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.AfterMiniToolbarHidden:
						OnAfterMiniToolbarHidden(e as AfterMiniToolbarHiddenEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.AfterMiniToolbarShown:
						OnAfterMiniToolbarShown(e as AfterMiniToolbarShownEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.BeforeMiniToolbarShown:
						OnBeforeMiniToolbarShown(e as BeforeMiniToolbarShownEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.AfterNavigation:
						OnAfterNavigation(e as AfterNavigationEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.BeforeNavigation:
						OnBeforeNavigation(e as BeforeNavigationEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.AfterApplicationMenu2010Displayed:
						OnAfterApplicationMenu2010Displayed(e);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.AfterApplicationMenu2010Closed:
						OnAfterApplicationMenu2010Closed(e);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.BeforeApplicationMenu2010Displayed:
						OnBeforeApplicationMenu2010Displayed(e as BeforeApplicationMenu2010DisplayedEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.BeforeApplicationMenu2010Closed:
						OnBeforeApplicationMenu2010Closed(e as BeforeApplicationMenu2010ClosedEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.BeforeRibbonCustomizationDialogDisplayed:
						OnBeforeRibbonCustomizationDialogDisplayed(e as BeforeRibbonCustomizationDialogDisplayedEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.AfterRibbonCustomizationDialogClosed:
						OnAfterRibbonCustomizationDialogClosed(e as AfterRibbonCustomizationDialogClosedEventArgs);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.LoadHelperComplete:
						OnLoadHelperComplete(e);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.Restored:
						OnRestored(e);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.AfterAutoHideRibbonCloseUp:
						OnAfterAutoHideRibbonCloseUp(e);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.AfterAutoHideRibbonDropDown:
						OnAfterAutoHideRibbonDropDown(e);
						break;
					case ToolbarEventIds.BeforeAutoHideRibbonDropDown:
						OnBeforeAutoHideRibbonDropDown(e as CancelEventArgs);
						break;
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					EventManager.DecrementInProgress(id);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (popupToolBase != null && !popupToolBase.Disposed && popupToolBase.MenuAgent != null)
				{
					popupToolBase.MenuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay: false);
				}
				if (id == ToolbarEventIds.ToolClick)
				{
					ClearRibbonItemWithFocus();
					ExitHotkeyMode();
					if (ribbon != null && ribbon.IsTabPopupOpen)
					{
						ribbon.TabMenuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay: false);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnDesignerHostTransactionClose(object sender, DesignerTransactionCloseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!e.TransactionCommitted || dockWithinContainer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Control control in dockWithinContainer.Controls)
			{
				if (control is UltraToolbarsDockArea { ToolbarsManager: null } ultraToolbarsDockArea)
				{
					ultraToolbarsDockArea.ToolbarsManager = this;
				}
				DirtyAllElements();
			}
		}

		private void OnDesignerHostTransactionClosing(object sender, DesignerTransactionCloseEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		public override void BeginUpdate()
		{
			((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).BeginUpdate();
			if (dockAreas == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraToolbarsDockArea[] array = dockAreas;
			foreach (UltraToolbarsDockArea ultraToolbarsDockArea in array)
			{
				if (ultraToolbarsDockArea != null)
				{
					((UltraControlBase)ultraToolbarsDockArea).BeginUpdate();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override ComponentRole CreateComponentRole()
		{
			return (ComponentRole)(object)new UltraToolbarsManagerRole(this);
		}

		protected override void ChangeControlsEnabledState()
		{
			SyncAssociatedObjectsEnabledState();
		}

		protected override void ChangeControlsVisibleState()
		{
			SyncAssociatedObjectsVisibleState();
		}

		protected override void DirtyChildElements()
		{
			DirtyChildElements(delegateToMdiParent: true);
		}

		private void DirtyChildElements(bool delegateToMdiParent)
		{
			if (delegateToMdiParent && MdiParentManagerInternal != null && IsMdiMerged)
			{
				((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)MdiParentManagerInternal).DirtyChildElements();
			}
			else
			{
				if (isInDirtyChildElements)
				{
					return;
				}
				isInDirtyChildElements = true;
				ResetCachedResolvedStyle();
				try
				{
					DrawUtility.BeginGraphicsCaching();
					if (dockWithinContainer == null || ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).IsUpdating)
					{
						return;
					}
					for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
					{
						if (dockAreas[i] != null)
						{
							dockAreas[i].DirtyChildElements();
						}
					}
					if (HasRibbon)
					{
						Ribbon.ApplicationMenu2010.DirtyUIElement();
					}
					if (floatingWindows != null)
					{
						foreach (FloatingToolbarWindowBase floatingWindow in floatingWindows)
						{
							floatingWindow.DirtyChildElements();
						}
					}
					if (miniToolbarDesigner != null)
					{
						miniToolbarDesigner.UpdateDesigner();
					}
					foreach (PopupControlBase popupControl in PopupControls)
					{
						if (popupControl != null && popupControl.ControlElement != null)
						{
							popupControl.MenuAgent.RecalculateDropdownSize();
							((UIElement)popupControl.ControlElement).DirtyChildElements();
							if (((Control)(object)popupControl).Controls.Count > 0 && ((Control)(object)popupControl).Controls[0].GetType() == typeof(UltraToolbarsDockArea))
							{
								((UltraToolbarsDockArea)(object)((Control)(object)popupControl).Controls[0]).DirtyChildElements();
							}
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					DrawUtility.EndGraphicsCaching();
					isInDirtyChildElements = false;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				if (saveSettings)
				{
					SaveComponentSettings();
				}
				PopupManager.CloseAllPopups();
				isDisposing = true;
				if (tools != null && tools.Count > 0)
				{
					foreach (ToolBase tool in tools)
					{
						tool.OnToolbarManagerDisposing();
						foreach (ToolBase toolInstance in tool.SharedProps.ToolInstances)
						{
							toolInstance.OnToolbarManagerDisposing();
						}
					}
				}
				if (quickToolCustomizer != null)
				{
					quickToolCustomizer.Dispose();
					quickToolCustomizer = null;
				}
				if (glowManager != null)
				{
					((DisposableObject)(object)glowManager).Dispose();
					glowManager = null;
				}
				DropdownCloseupManager.Dispose();
				if (floatingToolbarFadeTimer != null)
				{
					floatingToolbarFadeTimer.Enabled = false;
					floatingToolbarFadeTimer.Tick -= OnFloatingToolbarFadeTimer;
					floatingToolbarFadeTimer.Dispose();
					floatingToolbarFadeTimer = null;
				}
				SetNonManagedActiveMdiChildForm(null);
				RemoveMessageFilter();
				try
				{
					SecurityPermission securityPermission = new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode);
					if (Utilities.CanAssert)
					{
						securityPermission.Assert();
					}
					DeactivateMdiSubClassers();
					DeactivateFormSubClasser(delay: true);
					CodeAccessPermission.RevertAssert();
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
				try
				{
					DisposeUserPrefChanged();
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				if (contextMenuUltras != null)
				{
					foreach (DictionaryEntry contextMenuUltra in contextMenuUltras)
					{
						if (contextMenuUltra.Value is ContextMenuUltraData { Menu: not null } contextMenuUltraData)
						{
							contextMenuUltraData.Menu.Opening -= OnContextMenuPopup;
							contextMenuUltraData.Menu.Dispose();
						}
					}
					contextMenuUltras.Clear();
					contextMenuUltras = null;
				}
				if (toolbarListMenuAgent != null)
				{
					toolbarListMenuAgent.Dispose();
					toolbarListMenuAgent = null;
				}
				ClearBitmapCache(disposing: true);
				if (textEditor != null)
				{
					UnhookEditorEvents((EmbeddableEditorBase)(object)textEditor);
					((DisposableObject)(object)textEditor).Dispose();
					textEditor = null;
				}
				if (editorWithCombo != null)
				{
					UnhookEditorEvents((EmbeddableEditorBase)(object)editorWithCombo);
					((DisposableObject)(object)editorWithCombo).Dispose();
					editorWithCombo = null;
				}
				if (fontEditor != null)
				{
					UnhookEditorEvents((EmbeddableEditorBase)(object)fontEditor);
					((DisposableObject)(object)fontEditor).Dispose();
					fontEditor = null;
				}
				if (toolTip != null)
				{
					((DisposableObject)(object)toolTip).Dispose();
					toolTip = null;
				}
				if (toolTipDisplayModeDelayTimer != null)
				{
					toolTipDisplayModeDelayTimer.Enabled = false;
					toolTipDisplayModeDelayTimer.Tick -= ToolTipDisplayModeDelayTimerExpired;
					toolTipDisplayModeDelayTimer.Dispose();
					toolTipDisplayModeDelayTimer = null;
				}
				UnhookFormEvents();
				UnhookDesignerEvents();
				UnhookEndInitForm();
				UnhookEndInitUserControl();
				if (dockWithinContainer != null)
				{
					UnregisterDockWithinContainer();
					dockWithinContainer = null;
				}
				DestroyFloatingWindows();
				DestroyToolbarPagerControls();
				if (customizeToolCopyCursor != null)
				{
					customizeToolCopyCursor.Dispose();
					customizeToolCopyCursor = null;
				}
				if (customizeToolMoveCursor != null)
				{
					customizeToolMoveCursor.Dispose();
					customizeToolMoveCursor = null;
				}
				if (customizeToolNoDropCursor != null)
				{
					customizeToolNoDropCursor.Dispose();
					customizeToolNoDropCursor = null;
				}
				if (customizeToolResizeCursorEW != null)
				{
					customizeToolResizeCursorEW.Dispose();
					customizeToolResizeCursorEW = null;
				}
				if (customizeToolResizeCursorNS != null)
				{
					customizeToolResizeCursorNS.Dispose();
					customizeToolResizeCursorNS = null;
				}
				if (systemMenuImage != null)
				{
					systemMenuImage.Dispose();
					systemMenuImage = null;
				}
				if (systemMenuImageStream != null)
				{
					systemMenuImageStream.Close();
					systemMenuImageStream = null;
				}
				if (designerHostTransactionCloseHooked)
				{
					IDesignerHost designerHost = DesignerHost;
					if (designerHost != null)
					{
						designerHost.TransactionClosing -= OnDesignerHostTransactionClosing;
						designerHost.TransactionClosed -= OnDesignerHostTransactionClose;
					}
				}
				XPThemes.ThemeChanged -= OnThemeChanged;
				Office2007ColorSchemeChangedNotifier.ColorSchemeChanged -= OnOffice2007ColorSchemeChanged;
				WindowsVistaColorTable.ColorSchemeChanged -= OnOffice2007ColorSchemeChanged;
				if (menuExpandButton2003 != null)
				{
					menuExpandButton2003.Dispose();
					menuExpandButton2003 = null;
				}
				if (IsMdiMerged && !MdiMergeable)
				{
					if (ActiveMdiChildManager != null)
					{
						ActiveMdiChildManager = null;
					}
					else if (MdiParentManagerInternal != null)
					{
						MdiParentManagerInternal = null;
					}
				}
				ClearTopLeftCornerRegionCache();
				if (tabbedMdiManager != null)
				{
					tabbedMdiManager.EnabledChanging -= OnTabbedMdiManagerEnabledChanging;
					tabbedMdiManager.EnabledChanged -= OnTabbedMdiManagerEnabledChanged;
					tabbedMdiManager = null;
				}
				if (captionSystemMenuImage != null)
				{
					captionSystemMenuImage.Dispose();
					captionSystemMenuImage = null;
				}
				if (captionSystemMenuStream != null)
				{
					captionSystemMenuStream.Close();
					captionSystemMenuStream = null;
				}
				if (restorePointStream != null)
				{
					restorePointStream.Close();
					restorePointStream.Dispose();
					restorePointStream = null;
				}
				if (ribbon != null)
				{
					ribbon.Metrics.UnhookUserPreferenceChanged();
				}
				isDisposed = true;
				RemoveHook();
			}
			else
			{
				RemoveHook();
			}
			((UltraStylableComponent)this).Dispose(disposing);
			if (disposing)
			{
				((EventHandler)((UltraComponentBase)this).Events[EVENT_DISPOSED])?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		public override void EndUpdate(bool invalidate)
		{
			((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).EndUpdate(invalidate);
			if (invalidate)
			{
				if (ribbon != null)
				{
					ribbon.DirtyAllMetrics();
				}
				((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).DirtyChildElements();
			}
			if (dockAreas == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraToolbarsDockArea[] array = dockAreas;
			foreach (UltraToolbarsDockArea ultraToolbarsDockArea in array)
			{
				if (ultraToolbarsDockArea != null)
				{
					((UltraControlBase)ultraToolbarsDockArea).EndUpdate(invalidate);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void InvalidateControls()
		{
			if (dockWithinContainer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
			{
				if (dockAreas[i] != null)
				{
					((UltraControlBase)dockAreas[i]).Invalidate();
				}
			}
			if (floatingWindows != null)
			{
				foreach (FloatingToolbarWindowBase floatingWindow in floatingWindows)
				{
					((UltraControlBase)floatingWindow.DockArea).Invalidate();
				}
			}
			if (toolbarPagerControlsList == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UltraPagerContentControl value in toolbarPagerControlsList.Values)
			{
				value.Invalidate();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnterElement(UIElementEventArgs e)
		{
			if (EventManager.CanFireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.MouseEnterElement))
			{
				EventManager.IncrementInProgress(ToolbarEventIds.MouseEnterElement);
				try
				{
					((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).OnMouseEnterElement(e);
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					EventManager.DecrementInProgress(ToolbarEventIds.MouseEnterElement);
					throw;
				}
				EventManager.DecrementInProgress(ToolbarEventIds.MouseEnterElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeaveElement(UIElementEventArgs e)
		{
			if (EventManager.CanFireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.MouseLeaveElement))
			{
				EventManager.IncrementInProgress(ToolbarEventIds.MouseLeaveElement);
				try
				{
					((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).OnMouseLeaveElement(e);
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					EventManager.DecrementInProgress(ToolbarEventIds.MouseLeaveElement);
					throw;
				}
				EventManager.DecrementInProgress(ToolbarEventIds.MouseLeaveElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0209: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_020e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_020f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0212: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0214: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0216: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (e.ChangeInfo.Source == this)
			{
				if (ribbon != null)
				{
					ribbon.ProcessManagerPropertyChange(e.ChangeInfo);
				}
				if (e.ChangeInfo.PropId is PropertyIds)
				{
					if (settingsSequence < 2147483646)
					{
						settingsSequence++;
					}
					else
					{
						settingsSequence = 1;
					}
					switch ((PropertyIds)(object)e.ChangeInfo.PropId)
					{
					case PropertyIds.Appearance:
					case PropertyIds.Enabled:
					case PropertyIds.GrabHandleStyle:
					case PropertyIds.Style:
					case PropertyIds.LockToolbars:
					case PropertyIds.ShowQuickCustomizeButton:
					case PropertyIds.UseLargeImagesOnToolbar:
					case PropertyIds.ImageTransparentColor:
					case PropertyIds.ToolbarSettings:
					case PropertyIds.DockAreaAppearance:
					case PropertyIds.DockAreaVerticalAppearance:
					case PropertyIds.HorizontalToolbarGrabHandleWidth:
					case PropertyIds.VerticalToolbarGrabHandleHeight:
						StyleUtils.DirtyCachedPropertyVals(this);
						ForceExitEditMode();
						((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).DirtyChildElements();
						RefreshPreferredViewStyleOnSiblingComponents();
						break;
					case PropertyIds.ImageSizeLarge:
					case PropertyIds.ImageSizeSmall:
					case PropertyIds.HorizontalToolbarGrabHandleAppearance:
					case PropertyIds.VerticalToolbarGrabHandleAppearance:
						((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).DirtyChildElements();
						break;
					case PropertyIds.TouchEnabled:
					case PropertyIds.ImageSizeTouchLarge:
					case PropertyIds.ImageSizeTouchSmall:
						OnTouchModeChanged();
						break;
					case PropertyIds.AlwaysShowMenusExpanded:
						StyleUtils.DirtyCachedPropertyVals(this);
						break;
					case PropertyIds.Office2007UICompatibility:
						if (!Initializing)
						{
							ResetCachedResolvedStyle();
							Ribbon.Metrics.Dirty(Ribbon.RibbonMetricsFlags.AllMetrics);
							ForceExitEditMode();
							PopupManager.CloseAllPopups();
							((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).DirtyChildElements();
							SynchronizeFormBorderStyle(initializing: false);
							RefreshPreferredViewStyleOnSiblingComponents();
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				else if (e.ChangeInfo.PropId is UltraControlPropIds)
				{
					((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).DirtyChildElements();
					UltraControlPropIds val = (UltraControlPropIds)(object)e.ChangeInfo.PropId;
					if ((int)val == 11 || (int)val == 6)
					{
						SynchronizeToolbarFormBorderStyle();
					}
				}
			}
			if (IsDesignMode)
			{
				PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo = e.ChangeInfo.FindTrigger(null);
				if (propChangeInfo.PropId is PropertyIds)
				{
					PropertyIds propertyIds = (PropertyIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId;
					if (propertyIds == PropertyIds.SelectedTab || propertyIds == PropertyIds.ActiveContentTool)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			((UltraComponentBase)this).OnPropertyChanged(e);
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeAlwaysShowMenusExpanded()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			return (int)alwaysShowMenusExpanded > 0;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetAlwaysShowMenusExpanded()
		{
			AlwaysShowMenusExpanded = (DefaultableBoolean)0;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeAppearance()
		{
			if (HasAppearance)
			{
				return appearanceHolder.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetAppearance()
		{
			if (HasAppearance)
			{
				appearanceHolder.Reset();
				((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.Appearance);

		private int GetRoundedFormBorderWidth(FormWindowState windowState)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (HasGlassArea)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if ((int)StyleResolved == 9 && windowState != FormWindowState.Maximized)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (IsFormRounded)
			{
				return XPThemes.FrameBorderSize.Width;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		private void OnTabbedMdiManagerEnabledChanging(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
		}

		private void OnTabbedMdiManagerEnabledChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ITabbedMdiManager val = (ITabbedMdiManager)((sender is ITabbedMdiManager) ? sender : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Form form = FindForm();
			if (form == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (form.IsMdiChild && mdiParentManager == null)
			{
				if (ribbon != null)
				{
					ribbon.Metrics.Dirty(Ribbon.RibbonMetricsFlags.CaptionAreaHeight);
				}
				UpdateFormRegion();
				DirtyAllElements();
			}
			else
			{
				if (!form.IsMdiContainer)
				{
					return;
				}
				Form[] mdiChildren = form.MdiChildren;
				foreach (Form form2 in mdiChildren)
				{
					UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = FromForm(form2);
					if (ultraToolbarsManager != null)
					{
						if (ultraToolbarsManager.ribbon != null)
						{
							ultraToolbarsManager.ribbon.Metrics.Dirty(Ribbon.RibbonMetricsFlags.CaptionAreaHeight);
						}
						ultraToolbarsManager.UpdateFormRegion();
						ultraToolbarsManager.DirtyAllElements();
					}
				}
			}
		}
