		public void CreateRestorePoint()
		{
			CreateRestorePoint(asynchronous: false);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void CreateRestorePoint(bool asynchronous)
		{
			if (asynchronous)
			{
				try
				{
					Thread thread = new Thread(CreateRestorePointHelper);
					thread.Start();
					return;
				}
				catch
				{
					CreateRestorePointHelper();
					return;
				}
			}
			CreateRestorePointHelper();
		}

		private void CreateRestorePointHelper()
		{
			//IL_0188: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (HasRestorePoint)
			{
				restorePointStream.Close();
				restorePointStream.Dispose();
			}
			if (ribbon != null)
			{
				foreach (RibbonTab item in (IEnumerable)ribbon.Tabs)
				{
					item.IsStockItem = true;
					if (!item.HasGroups)
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (RibbonGroup item2 in (IEnumerable)item.Groups)
					{
						item2.IsStockItem = true;
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (ToolBase tool in Tools)
			{
				foreach (ToolBase toolInstance in tool.SharedProps.ToolInstances)
				{
					if (toolInstance.RibbonCustomizedSmallImage != null)
					{
						toolInstance.RibbonCustomizedStockSmallImage = toolInstance.RibbonCustomizedSmallImage;
						toolInstance.RibbonCustomizedSmallImage = null;
					}
					if (toolInstance.RibbonCustomizedLargeImage != null)
					{
						toolInstance.RibbonCustomizedStockLargeImage = toolInstance.RibbonCustomizedLargeImage;
						toolInstance.RibbonCustomizedLargeImage = null;
					}
					if (toolInstance.ShouldSerializeRibbonCustomizedPreferredSize())
					{
						toolInstance.InstanceProps.PreferredSizeOnRibbon = toolInstance.RibbonCustomizedPreferredSize;
						toolInstance.RibbonCustomizedPreferredSize = RibbonToolSize.Default;
					}
					if (toolInstance.ShouldSerializeRibbonCustomizedMinimumSize())
					{
						toolInstance.InstanceProps.MinimumSizeOnRibbon = toolInstance.RibbonCustomizedMinimumSize;
						toolInstance.RibbonCustomizedMinimumSize = RibbonToolSize.Default;
					}
					if (toolInstance.ShouldSerializeRibbonCustomizedVisibility())
					{
						toolInstance.InstanceProps.Visible = toolInstance.RibbonCustomizedVisibility;
						toolInstance.RibbonCustomizedVisibility = (DefaultableBoolean)0;
					}
					toolInstance.IsStockItem = true;
				}
			}
			restorePointStream = new MemoryStream();
			SaveAsBinary(restorePointStream, saveCustomizations: true);
			if (activeMdiChildManager != null)
			{
				activeMdiChildManager.CreateRestorePointHelper();
			}
		}

		public void Customize()
		{
			//IL_0208: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0212: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_014f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0159: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (DockWithinContainer == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_104"));
			}
			if (EnforceOffice2007Resolution && !IsDesignMode)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ChangeUseCustomizeWhenCompatibilityIsEnabled"));
			}
			CustomizeDialog customizeDialog = null;
			try
			{
				customizeDialog = CreateCustomizeDialog();
			}
			catch
			{
				BeforeDisplayCustomizeDialogEventArgs e = new BeforeDisplayCustomizeDialogEventArgs(null);
				FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.BeforeDisplayCustomizeDialog, e);
				return;
			}
			if (customizeDialog == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (((Component)this).DesignMode)
			{
				customizeDialog.UseAppStyling = false;
			}
			else
			{
				customizeDialog.UseAppStyling = ((UltraStylableComponent)this).ComponentRole.Enabled;
			}
			this.customizeDialog = customizeDialog.ToolCustomizer;
			bool flag = false;
			int num = floatingToolbarFadeDelay;
			ForceExitEditMode();
			try
			{
				customizing = true;
				RefreshStatusBar();
				DockWithinContainer.SuspendLayout();
				for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
				{
					if (dockAreas[i] != null)
					{
						dockAreas[i].OnBeginCustomizing();
					}
				}
				DockWithinContainer.ResumeLayout(performLayout: true);
				flag = true;
				NotifyCustomizeModeChange();
				toolOwnerWithCapture = null;
				InternalSetActiveTool(null, setOn: true, clearToolBeingEdited: true);
				((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).DirtyChildElements();
				customizeDialog.StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterParent;
				BeforeDisplayCustomizeDialogEventArgs e2 = new BeforeDisplayCustomizeDialogEventArgs(customizeDialog);
				FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.BeforeDisplayCustomizeDialog, e2);
				if (e2.Cancel)
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					bool flag2 = false;
					try
					{
						SecurityPermission securityPermission = new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode);
						if (Utilities.CanAssert)
						{
							securityPermission.Assert();
						}
						flag2 = true;
						DropDownManager.ActivationChanged += new ActivationChangedEventHandler(OnActivationChanged);
					}
					catch
					{
					}
					finally
					{
						if (flag2)
						{
							CodeAccessPermission.RevertAssert();
						}
					}
					customizeDialog.ExcludedShortcuts = e2.ExcludedShortcuts;
					MouseHook += OnMouseHookMessageReceived;
					this.customizeDialog.OnEnterCustomizeMode(this);
					bool isDesignMode = IsDesignMode;
					try
					{
						if (isDesignMode)
						{
							Utilities.EnterNativeMessageFilterMode();
						}
						if (((Component)(object)this).GetService(typeof(IUIService)) is IUIService iUIService)
						{
							iUIService.ShowDialog(customizeDialog);
						}
						else
						{
							customizeDialog.ShowDialog(FindContainer());
						}
					}
					catch
					{
					}
					finally
					{
						if (isDesignMode)
						{
							Utilities.ExitNativeMessageFilterMode();
						}
					}
					this.customizeDialog.OnExitCustomizeMode();
					FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.AfterCustomizeDialogClosed, new EventArgs());
				}
				finally
				{
					DropDownManager.ActivationChanged -= new ActivationChangedEventHandler(OnActivationChanged);
					MouseHook -= OnMouseHookMessageReceived;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				customizing = false;
				toolBeingCustomized = null;
				menuItemBeingCustomized = null;
				if (this.customizeDialog != null)
				{
					this.customizeDialog.Dispose();
				}
				this.customizeDialog = null;
				if (flag)
				{
					DockWithinContainer.SuspendLayout();
					for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++)
					{
						if (dockAreas[j] != null)
						{
							dockAreas[j].OnEndCustomizing();
						}
					}
					DockWithinContainer.ResumeLayout(performLayout: true);
				}
				NotifyCustomizeModeChange();
				CloseAllOpenToolbarSubmenus();
				((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).DirtyChildElements();
				RefreshStatusBar();
				if (floatingToolbarFadeDelay != num && !((Component)this).DesignMode)
				{
					CheckFloatingToolbarFadeTimerState();
					NotifyFloatingWindowsOfToolbarFadeTimerChange();
				}
				customizeDialog?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public string[] GetCategories()
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>(Tools.Count);
			for (ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollectionBase = Tools; toolsCollectionBase != null; toolsCollectionBase = ((toolsCollectionBase == MergedTools) ? null : MergedTools))
			{
				foreach (ToolBase item in toolsCollectionBase)
				{
					if (!item.IsHiddenByMdiMerge && !ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(item.CategoryResolved) && !list.Contains(item.CategoryResolved))
					{
						list.Add(item.CategoryResolved);
					}
				}
			}
			list.TrimExcess();
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public ToolBase[] GetCategoryTools(string requestedCategory)
		{
			List<ToolBase> list = new List<ToolBase>(Tools.Count);
			for (ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollectionBase = Tools; toolsCollectionBase != null; toolsCollectionBase = ((toolsCollectionBase == MergedTools) ? null : MergedTools))
			{
				foreach (ToolBase item in toolsCollectionBase)
				{
					if (!item.IsHiddenByMdiMerge && item.CategoryResolved != null && item.CategoryResolved.Length > 0 && string.Compare(item.CategoryResolved, requestedCategory, ignoreCase: true, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) == 0)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
			}
			list.TrimExcess();
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public void RefreshMerge()
		{
			if (!IsMdiMerged)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (MdiParentManagerInternal != null)
			{
				MdiParentManagerInternal.RefreshMerge();
			}
			else
			{
				if (ActiveMdiChildManager == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				SetRedraw(setRedrawOn: false);
				try
				{
					ActiveTool = null;
					RibbonTab ribbonTab = null;
					if (HasRibbon && Ribbon.VisibleResolved)
					{
						ribbonTab = Ribbon.SelectedTab;
					}
					InternalSetActiveMdiChildManager(ActiveMdiChildManager, MdiMergeable, remergeIfUnchanged: true);
					if (ribbonTab != null && !ribbonTab.IsHiddenByMdiMerge && Ribbon.VisibleResolved)
					{
						Ribbon.SelectedTab = ribbonTab;
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					SetRedraw(setRedrawOn: true);
				}
			}
		}

		public void ResetState()
		{
			ResetUsageData();
			object[] all = Toolbars.All;
			object[] array = all;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				UltraToolbar ultraToolbar = (UltraToolbar)array[i];
				if (!ultraToolbar.IsStockToolbar)
				{
					Toolbars.Remove(ultraToolbar);
				}
				else
				{
					ultraToolbar.Tools.ResetCustomizations();
				}
			}
			foreach (ToolBase tool in Tools)
			{
				tool.ResetState();
				foreach (ToolBase toolInstance in tool.SharedProps.ToolInstances)
				{
					toolInstance.ResetState();
				}
			}
			DirtyAllElements();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool Restore(UltraToolbarsManager manager)
		{
			if (!HasRestorePoint)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = manager.ForceControlNameToExtraSharedProps;
			try
			{
				manager.ForceControlNameToExtraSharedProps = true;
				restorePointStream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
				manager.LoadFromBinary(restorePointStream);
				manager.FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.Restored, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
			finally
			{
				manager.ForceControlNameToExtraSharedProps = flag;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void ShowPopupHelper(PopupToolBase popupTool, Point screenPoint, Rectangle exclusionRect, DropDownPosition dropdownPosition, Control sourceControl, Control owner)
		{
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ShowPopupHelper(popupTool, screenPoint, exclusionRect, dropdownPosition, sourceControl, owner, RightAlignedMenusResolved, showMiniToolbar: false);
		}

		internal void ShowPopupHelper(PopupToolBase popupTool, Point screenPoint, Rectangle exclusionRect, DropDownPosition dropdownPosition, Control sourceControl, Control owner, bool alignRight, bool showMiniToolbar)
		{
			//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0098: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0158: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0162: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			bool flag = ShouldMdiParentPopupTool(popupTool);
			if (flag)
			{
				ToolBase rootTool = popupTool.SharedProps.RootTool;
				if (GetParentRootTool(rootTool) is PopupToolBase popupToolBase && popupToolBase != rootTool)
				{
					popupToolBase.ToolbarsManager.ShowPopupHelper(popupToolBase, screenPoint, exclusionRect, dropdownPosition, sourceControl, owner, alignRight, showMiniToolbar);
					return;
				}
			}
			toolOwnerWithCapture = null;
			ForceExitEditMode();
			InternalSetActiveTool(null, setOn: false, clearToolBeingEdited: true);
			Form form = null;
			form = ((sourceControl == null) ? FindFormHelper(owner) : FindFormHelper(sourceControl));
			if (form != null && form.IsMdiChild)
			{
				ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ActivateForm(form);
				if (!flag && ShouldMdiParentPopupTool(popupTool))
				{
					ShowPopupHelper(popupTool, screenPoint, exclusionRect, dropdownPosition, sourceControl, owner, alignRight, showMiniToolbar);
					return;
				}
			}
			if (popupTool.IsHiddenByMdiMerge)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (owner == null && popupControls != null && popupControls.Count != 0)
			{
				owner = (Control)(object)popupControls[popupControls.Count - 1];
			}
			if (owner == null)
			{
				owner = ((MdiParentManagerInternal == null || !IsMdiMerged) ? DockWithinContainer : MdiParentManagerInternal.DockWithinContainer);
				if (owner == null)
				{
					owner = sourceControl;
				}
				if (owner == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_120"));
				}
			}
			popupTool.DropDown(exclusionRect: (!exclusionRect.IsEmpty) ? exclusionRect : new Rectangle(screenPoint.X - 1, screenPoint.Y - 1, 1, 1), owningControl: owner, point: screenPoint, dropDownPosition: dropdownPosition, delay: false, closeIfAlreadyOpen: false, alignRight: alignRight, autocloseDropdown: true, sourceControl: sourceControl, splitMonitorAction: popupTool.GetSplitMonitorAction(), showMiniToolbar: showMiniToolbar);
		}

		public void ShowPopup(string popupToolKey, Point screenPoint, Control sourceControl, Rectangle exclusionRect, DropDownPosition dropdownPosition, Control owner, bool alignRight, bool showMiniToolbar)
		{
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0103: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (MdiParentManagerInternal != null && IsMdiMerged)
			{
				MdiParentManagerInternal.ShowPopup(popupToolKey, screenPoint, sourceControl, exclusionRect, dropdownPosition, owner, alignRight, showMiniToolbar);
				return;
			}
			ToolBase toolBase = null;
			int num = Tools.IndexOf(popupToolKey);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				toolBase = Tools[num];
			}
			if ((toolBase == null || toolBase.PopupTool == null || toolBase.IsHiddenByMdiMerge) && mergedTools != null)
			{
				string text = string.Intern(popupToolKey.ToLower(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture));
				for (int i = 0; i < mergedTools.Count; i++)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase2 = mergedTools[i];
					if ((object)text == ((IKeyedSubObjectEx)toolBase2).KeyLowercaseInterned && toolBase2.PopupTool != null)
					{
						toolBase = toolBase2;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (toolBase == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_11", popupToolKey));
			}
			toolBase.AttachToUnderlyingTool();
			PopupToolBase popupTool = toolBase.PopupTool;
			if (popupTool == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_12", popupToolKey));
			}
			ShowPopupHelper(popupTool, screenPoint, exclusionRect, dropdownPosition, sourceControl, owner, alignRight, showMiniToolbar);
		}

		public void ShowToolbarListPopup(Point screenPoint, ToolBase tool)
		{
			Control dropDownOwner = null;
			if (tool != null && popupControls != null)
			{
				for (int num = PopupControls.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					PopupControlBase popupControlBase = PopupControls[num];
					if (popupControlBase != null && popupControlBase.MenuAgent != null && popupControlBase.MenuAgent.ContainsTool(tool))
					{
						dropDownOwner = (Control)(object)popupControlBase;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			ShowToolbarListPopup(screenPoint, tool, dropDownOwner);
		}

		internal void ShowToolbarListPopup(Point screenPoint, ToolBase tool, Control dropDownOwner)
		{
			bool hideToolbarItems = Toolbars.Count == 0 && Ribbon.VisibleResolved;
			if (tool != null && tool.OwnerIsPopup)
			{
				hideToolbarItems = true;
			}
			bool hideRibbonItems = !Ribbon.VisibleResolved || Ribbon.TabItemAreaDisplayStyle != TabItemAreaDisplayStyle.Visible;
			bool hideQatItems = !Ribbon.QuickAccessToolbar.VisibleResolved;
			bool hideQatAddRemove = tool == null || !Ribbon.QuickAccessToolbar.VisibleResolved;
			ShowToolbarListPopup(screenPoint, tool, dropDownOwner, hideToolbarItems, hideQatItems, hideQatAddRemove, hideRibbonItems);
		}

		private void ShowToolbarListPopup(Point screenPoint, ToolBase tool, Control dropDownOwner, bool hideToolbarItems, bool hideQatItems, bool hideQatAddRemove, bool hideRibbonItems)
		{
			if (toolbarListMenuAgent != null && toolbarListMenuAgent.IsOpen)
			{
				toolbarListMenuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay: false);
			}
			if ((tool is SystemMenuTool && ((SystemMenuTool)tool).MenuSource == SystemMenuSource.DockWithinContainerForm) || (Ribbon.HasApplicationMenu2010 && Ribbon.ApplicationMenu2010.IsOpen && !Ribbon.ApplicationMenu2010.ShowDefaultContextMenu))
			{
				return;
			}
			BeforeToolbarListDropdownEventArgs e = new BeforeToolbarListDropdownEventArgs(screenPoint, tool);
			e.ShowCustomizeMenuItem = !hideToolbarItems & IsCustomizeOptionEnabled(RuntimeCustomizationOptions.AllowCustomizeDialog);
			e.ShowLockToolbarsMenuItem = !hideToolbarItems & IsCustomizeOptionEnabled(RuntimeCustomizationOptions.AllowToolbarLocking);
			e.ShowToolbarMenuItems = !hideToolbarItems;
			e.ShowQuickAccessToolbarAddRemoveMenuItem = tool != null && !tool.IsSpecialTool && tool.CanAddToQuickAccessToolbar && !hideQatAddRemove;
			e.ShowMinimizeRibbonMenuItem = !hideRibbonItems;
			e.ShowQuickAccessToolbarPositionMenuItem = !hideQatItems;
			IRibbonCustomizationProvider ribbonCustomizationProvider = Ribbon.RibbonCustomizationProvider;
			bool flag = Ribbon.VisibleResolved && Ribbon.RibbonCustomizationProvider != null;
			e.ShowCustomizeRibbonMenuItem = flag && ribbonCustomizationProvider.AllowRibbonCustomizationResolved;
			e.ShowCustomizeQuickAccessToolbarMenuItem = flag && ribbonCustomizationProvider.AllowQATCustomizationResolved && Ribbon.QuickAccessToolbar.VisibleResolvedInternal;
			if (EnforceOffice2007Resolution)
			{
				bool flag2 = (e.ShowToolbarMenuItems = false);
				bool showCustomizeMenuItem = (e.ShowLockToolbarsMenuItem = flag2);
				e.ShowCustomizeMenuItem = showCustomizeMenuItem;
				showCustomizeMenuItem = (e.ShowMinimizeRibbonMenuItem = true);
				e.ShowQuickAccessToolbarPositionMenuItem = showCustomizeMenuItem;
				e.ShowQuickAccessToolbarAddRemoveMenuItem = tool != null && !tool.IsSpecialTool;
			}
			FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.BeforeToolbarListDropdown, e);
			if (e.Cancel)
			{
				if (tool is PopupRibbonGroupTool && tool.ToolbarsManager != null)
				{
					PopupRibbonGroupTool popupRibbonGroupTool = tool as PopupRibbonGroupTool;
					if (popupRibbonGroupTool.Group.UnderlyingGroup != null)
					{
						popupRibbonGroupTool.Group.UnderlyingGroup.RemoveRootPopupGroupTool(onlyIfNotInQat: true);
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			if (EnforceOffice2007Resolution)
			{
				bool flag2 = (e.ShowToolbarMenuItems = false);
				bool showCustomizeMenuItem = (e.ShowLockToolbarsMenuItem = flag2);
				e.ShowCustomizeMenuItem = showCustomizeMenuItem;
				showCustomizeMenuItem = (e.ShowMinimizeRibbonMenuItem = true);
				e.ShowQuickAccessToolbarPositionMenuItem = showCustomizeMenuItem;
				e.ShowQuickAccessToolbarAddRemoveMenuItem = tool != null && !tool.IsSpecialTool;
			}
			bool isFirstInGroup = false;
			ToolbarListMenuAgent.MenuItems.Clear();
			if (e.ShowQuickAccessToolbarAddRemoveMenuItem)
			{
				toolbarListMenuAgent.MenuItems.Add(new QuickAccessToolbarAddRemoveMenuItem(isFirstInGroup, tool));
				isFirstInGroup = true;
			}
			if (e.ShowToolbarMenuItems)
			{
				int num = 0;
				foreach (UltraToolbar toolbar in Toolbars)
				{
					if (!toolbar.IsMainMenuBar && toolbar.ShowInToolbarList && toolbar.SettingsResolved.AllowHidingResolved && !toolbar.IsHiddenByMdiMerge)
					{
						ToolbarListMenuItem menuItem = new ToolbarListMenuItem(toolbar, isFirstInGroup);
						isFirstInGroup = false;
						toolbarListMenuAgent.MenuItems.Add(menuItem);
						num++;
					}
				}
				if (num > 0)
				{
					isFirstInGroup = true;
				}
			}
			if (flag && e.ShowCustomizeQuickAccessToolbarMenuItem && ribbonCustomizationProvider.AllowQATCustomizationResolved)
			{
				toolbarListMenuAgent.MenuItems.Add(new CustomizeQATMenuItem(isFirstInGroup: true, hasContextMenuTools: false));
				isFirstInGroup = false;
			}
			if (e.ShowQuickAccessToolbarPositionMenuItem)
			{
				toolbarListMenuAgent.MenuItems.Add(new QuickAccessToolbarPositionMenuItem(isFirstInGroup));
				isFirstInGroup = !e.ShowMinimizeRibbonMenuItem;
			}
			if (flag && e.ShowCustomizeRibbonMenuItem && ribbonCustomizationProvider.AllowRibbonCustomizationResolved)
			{
				toolbarListMenuAgent.MenuItems.Add(new CustomizeRibbonMenuItem(isFirstInGroup: true));
				isFirstInGroup = false;
			}
			if (e.ShowMinimizeRibbonMenuItem)
			{
				toolbarListMenuAgent.MenuItems.Add(new MinimizeRibbonMenuItem(isFirstInGroup));
				isFirstInGroup = true;
			}
			if (e.ShowLockToolbarsMenuItem)
			{
				toolbarListMenuAgent.MenuItems.Add(new LockToolbarsMenuItem(isFirstInGroup));
				isFirstInGroup = false;
			}
			if (e.ShowCustomizeMenuItem)
			{
				toolbarListMenuAgent.MenuItems.Add(new CustomizeMenuItem(isFirstInGroup));
			}
			if (!toolbarListMenuAgent.OkToDropDown)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (dropDownOwner == null || (dropDownOwner is UltraToolbarsDockArea && ((UltraToolbarsDockArea)(object)dropDownOwner).DockedPosition != DockedPosition.Floating))
			{
				dropDownOwner = DockWithinContainer;
				PopupManager.CloseAllPopups();
			}
			else
			{
				for (int num2 = PopupControls.Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
				{
					PopupControlBase popupControlBase = PopupControls[num2];
					if ((object)popupControlBase == dropDownOwner || ((Control)(object)popupControlBase).Contains(dropDownOwner))
					{
						popupControlBase.MenuAgent.CancelPendingSubmenuDropDowns();
						break;
					}
					popupControlBase.MenuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay: false);
				}
			}
			ForceExitEditMode();
			toolOwnerWithCapture = null;
			toolbarListMenuAgent.DropDown(dropDownOwner, screenPoint, RightAlignedMenusResolved ? new Rectangle(screenPoint.X, screenPoint.Y, 1, 1) : new Rectangle(screenPoint.X - 1, screenPoint.Y - 1, 1, 1), (DropDownPosition)(RightAlignedMenusResolved ? 1 : 2), delay: false, closeIfAlreadyOpen: true, RightAlignedMenusResolved, autocloseDropdown: true);
			if (activeTool != null)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = activeTool.UIElement;
				InternalSetActiveTool(null, setOn: false, clearToolBeingEdited: true);
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					ButtonToolUIElement buttonToolUIElement = uIElement as ButtonToolUIElement;
					if (buttonToolUIElement == null)
					{
						buttonToolUIElement = uIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(ButtonToolUIElement)) as ButtonToolUIElement;
					}
					buttonToolUIElement?.ClearMouseOver();
				}
			}
			NotifyAccessibilityFocusChange();
		}

		public ToolBase ToolFromPoint(Point point)
		{
			try
			{
				ControlUIElementBase val = DockAreaElementFromScreenPoint(point);
				if (val != null)
				{
					Control control = ((UIElement)val).Control;
					if (control == null || control.IsDisposed || control.Disposing)
					{
						return null;
					}
					Point point2 = control.PointToClient(point);
					UIElement val2 = ((UIElement)val).ElementFromPoint(point2);
					object context = val2.GetContext(typeof(ToolBase), true);
					return context as ToolBase;
				}
				foreach (PopupControlBase popupControl in PopupControls)
				{
					ControlUIElementBase controlElement = popupControl.ControlElement;
					if (controlElement == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					Control control = ((UIElement)controlElement).Control;
					if (control != null && !control.IsDisposed && !control.Disposing)
					{
						Point point3 = control.PointToClient(point);
						UIElement val3 = ((UIElement)controlElement).ElementFromPoint(point3);
						while (val3 != null && ((object)val3).GetType() != typeof(PopupMenuItemUIElement))
						{
							val3 = val3.Parent;
						}
						if (val3 != null && ((object)val3).GetType() == typeof(PopupMenuItemUIElement))
						{
							return ((PopupMenuItemUIElement)(object)val3).MenuItem.Tool;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
			return null;
		}

		}

		public UltraToolbarBase ToolbarBaseFromPoint(Point point)
		{
			try
			{
				ControlUIElementBase val = DockAreaElementFromScreenPoint(point);
				if (val != null)
				{
					Control control = ((UIElement)val).Control;
					if (control != null && !control.IsDisposed && !control.Disposing)
					{
						Point point2 = control.PointToClient(point);
						UIElement val2 = ((UIElement)val).ElementFromPoint(point2);
						UltraToolbarBase ultraToolbarBase = null;
						while (val2 != null)
						{
							if (val2 is ToolbarUIElement)
							{
								ultraToolbarBase = ((ToolbarUIElement)(object)val2).ToolbarInternal;
							}
							else if (val2 is TaskPaneToolbarUIElement)
							{
								ultraToolbarBase = ((TaskPaneToolbarUIElement)(object)val2).Toolbar;
							}
							if (ultraToolbarBase != null)
							{
								break;
							}
							val2 = val2.Parent;
						}
						if (ultraToolbarBase != null && ultraToolbarBase.OwningTaskPaneToolbar != null)
						{
							return ultraToolbarBase.OwningTaskPaneToolbar;
						}
						return ultraToolbarBase;
					}
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public UIElement UIElementFromPoint(Point point)
		{
			try
			{
				ControlUIElementBase val = DockAreaElementFromScreenPoint(point);
				if (val != null)
				{
					Control control = ((UIElement)val).Control;
					if (control != null && !control.IsDisposed && !control.Disposing)
					{
						Point point2 = control.PointToClient(point);
						return ((UIElement)val).ElementFromPoint(point2);
					}
				}
				for (int num = PopupControls.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					PopupControlBase popupControlBase = PopupControls[num];
					if (popupControlBase != null)
					{
						ControlUIElementBase controlElement = popupControlBase.ControlElement;
						if (controlElement != null)
						{
							Control control = ((UIElement)controlElement).Control;
							if (control != null && !control.IsDisposed && !control.Disposing && control.RectangleToScreen(((UIElement)controlElement).Rect).Contains(point))
							{
								Point point3 = control.PointToClient(point);
								return ((UIElement)controlElement).ElementFromPoint(point3);
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static bool UnRegisterCustomToolType(Guid toolID)
		{
			if (!ToolTypes.Contains(toolID))
			{
				return false;
			}
			try
			{
				Monitor.Enter(ToolTypes);
				try
				{
					ToolTypes.Remove(toolID);
				}
				finally
				{
					Monitor.Exit(ToolTypes);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(Application.ExecutablePath))
				{
					throw ex;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool ActivateNextControl(bool up)
		{
			bool result = false;
			Control control = DockWithinContainer;
			Form form = control as Form;
			try
			{
				result = ((form == null || !form.IsMdiContainer || form.ActiveMdiChild == null) ? control.SelectNextControl(null, !up, tabStopOnly: true, nested: true, wrap: true) : form.ActiveMdiChild.SelectNextControl(null, !up, tabStopOnly: true, nested: true, wrap: true));
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal void AddToolbarToDockArea(UltraToolbar toolbar)
		{
			AddToolbarToDockArea(toolbar, restoreOldPosition: false);
		}

		internal void AddToolbarToDockArea(UltraToolbar toolbar, bool restoreOldPosition)
		{
			if (((Component)this).DesignMode && dockWithinContainer == null)
			{
				if (!onManagerAddedAfterLoadCallPending && (dockAreas[0] != null || dockAreas[1] != null || dockAreas[2] != null || dockAreas[3] != null) && !(((Component)(object)this).GetService(typeof(IDesignerHost)) is IDesignerHost { Loading: not false }))
				{
					DestroyDockingAreas();
				}
				return;
			}
			if (toolbar.DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Floating)
			{
				toolbar.ResetToolDockedSettings();
				if (IsToolbarBeingDragged(toolbar) && floatingWindowBeingDragged != null)
				{
					floatingWindowBeingDragged.DockArea.ReparentContainedControls(toolbar, takeOwnership: true);
					if (toolbar is UltraTaskPaneToolbar)
					{
						floatingWindowBeingDragged.DockArea.DirtyChildElements();
						((Control)(object)floatingWindowBeingDragged.DockArea).PerformLayout();
					}
					floatingWindowBeingDragged.ShowNoActivate();
					return;
				}
				FloatingToolbarWindowBase floatingWindow = GetFloatingWindow(toolbar);
				if (floatingWindow != null)
				{
					return;
				}
				floatingWindow = CreateFloatingToolbarWindow(toolbar);
				if (floatingWindow != null)
				{
					floatingWindow.Closed += OnFloatingWindowClosed;
					floatingWindow.Disposed += OnFloatingWindowDisposed;
					FloatingWindows.Add(floatingWindow);
					floatingWindow.DockArea.AddToolbar(toolbar, 0, 0);
					if (IsToolbarBeingDragged(toolbar))
					{
						floatingWindowBeingDragged = floatingWindow;
					}
					if (toolbar is UltraTaskPaneToolbar)
					{
						((UltraTaskPaneToolbar)toolbar).ReparentPagerControl(floatingWindow.DockArea, createIfNull: true);
					}
					floatingWindow.ShowNoActivate();
				}
				return;
			}
			int dockedPosition = (int)toolbar.DockedPosition;
			if (dockAreaToolbarsInitialized && dockAreas[dockedPosition] != null && !initializing)
			{
				RowCol rowCol = dockAreas[dockedPosition].AddToolbar(toolbar, restoreOldPosition);
				toolbar.RemoveRelativeHiddenToolbarReferencesFromOtherToolbars(Toolbars);
				toolbar.InternalSetDockedRow(rowCol.Row);
				toolbar.InternalSetDockedColumn(rowCol.Col);
				if (toolbar is UltraTaskPaneToolbar && IsToolbarBeingDragged(toolbar))
				{
					dockAreas[dockedPosition].ReparentContainedControls(toolbar, takeOwnership: true);
					dockAreas[dockedPosition].DirtyChildElements();
				}
			}
		}

		private Size CalculateDesignerButtonSize(string text)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0030: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
			AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)137438953471L;
			ResolveDesignerButtonAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			Size size = ImageAndTextUIElement.CalculateTextSize(text, HotkeyPrefix.None, false, (Control)(object)GetValidDockArea(DockedPosition.Top), ref appearance, (MeasureStringDelegate)null);
			System.Drawing.ContentAlignment contentAlignment = AppearanceData.ContentAlignmentFromHVAlign(((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ImageHAlign, ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ImageVAlign);
			return ImageAndTextUIElement.CalculateButtonImageAndTextSize(Size.Empty, size, Size.Empty, Size.Empty, Size.Empty, false, (UIElementButtonStyle)14, (UIElementButtonType)0, Border3DSide.All, contentAlignment);
		}

		internal static bool CanControlBeDockWithinContainer(object controlCandidate, bool allowNullControl)
		{
			if (controlCandidate == null)
			{
				return allowNullControl;
			}
			if (!(controlCandidate is Control))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (controlCandidate is IDockingArea)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (controlCandidate is ManagedContainerControlBase)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(controlCandidate is IContainerControl) && !(controlCandidate is ScrollableControl))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (UltraFormManager.GetIToolbarsManagerFromForm(controlCandidate as Form) != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return FromContainer(controlCandidate as Control) == null;
		}

		}

		internal void CloseAllOpenToolbarSubmenus()
		{
			foreach (UltraToolbar toolbar in Toolbars)
			{
				toolbar.CloseOpenSubmenuTools(null);
			}
			if (HasRibbon)
			{
				Ribbon.CloseAllPopups();
			}
		}

		internal void CloseAllSubmenus(object owner)
		{
			if (!OwnerIsPopup(owner))
			{
				CloseAllOpenToolbarSubmenus();
			}
			else if (owner is UltraToolbar)
			{
				((UltraToolbar)owner).CloseOpenSubmenuTools(null);
			}
			else if (owner is PopupToolBase)
			{
				PopupToolBase popupToolBase = owner as PopupToolBase;
				if (popupToolBase.IsMenuAgentCreated)
				{
					popupToolBase.MenuAgent.CloseOpenSubmenuTools(null, delay: false);
				}
			}
			else if (owner is RibbonGroup)
			{
				RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = (RibbonGroup)owner;
				if (ribbonGroup.Ribbon != null && ribbonGroup.Ribbon.HasTabMenuAgent && ribbonGroup.Ribbon.TabMenuAgent.IsOpen)
				{
					ribbonGroup.Ribbon.CloseAllOpenSubmenus();
				}
				else
				{
					ribbonGroup.CloseAllOpenSubmenus(null, delay: false);
				}
			}
			else if (owner is ApplicationMenuAreaBase)
			{
				ApplicationMenuAreaBase applicationMenuAreaBase = (ApplicationMenuAreaBase)owner;
				if (applicationMenuAreaBase.FileMenu.IsMenuAgentCreated)
				{
					applicationMenuAreaBase.FileMenu.MenuAgent.CloseOpenSubmenuTools(null, delay: false);
				}
			}
			else if (owner is ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar)
			{
				ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar applicationMenuFooterToolbar = (ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar)owner;
				if (applicationMenuFooterToolbar.ApplicationMenu.IsMenuAgentCreated)
				{
					applicationMenuFooterToolbar.ApplicationMenu.MenuAgent.CloseOpenSubmenuTools(null, delay: false);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static Region CreateRoundedRegion(Rectangle rect, Corners corners, bool fileMenuButtonVisible)
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0005: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			Region region = ((!fileMenuButtonVisible || (int)corners != 1) ? DrawUtility.CreateBorderRegion(rect, (UIElementBorderStyle)13, corners) : new Region(rect));
			if (fileMenuButtonVisible && (corners & 1) == 1)
			{
				int width = Ribbon.RibbonMetrics.ApplicationMenuButtonSize.Width;
				int num = width / 2 - 4;
				using GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
				graphicsPath.AddEllipse(rect.Left, rect.Top, width, width);
				using Region region2 = new Region(graphicsPath);
				region2.Union(new Rectangle(rect.Left + num, rect.Top, rect.Width, rect.Height));
				region2.Union(new Rectangle(rect.Left, rect.Top + num, rect.Width, rect.Height));
				region.Intersect(region2);
			}
			return region;
		}

		internal UltraPagerContentControl CreateToolbarPagerControl(UltraTaskPaneToolbar toolbar)
		{
			if (toolbar == null || toolbar.Disposed)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UltraPagerContentControl ultraPagerContentControl = GetToolbarPagerControl(toolbar);
			if (ultraPagerContentControl == null)
			{
				ultraPagerContentControl = new UltraPagerContentControl();
				ToolbarPagerControlList.Add(toolbar, ultraPagerContentControl);
				toolbar.OnPagerControlCreated(ultraPagerContentControl);
			}
			return ultraPagerContentControl;
		}

		internal static Color DarkenColor(Color color, int amount)
		{
			return Color.FromArgb(color.A, Math.Max(color.R - amount, 0), Math.Max(color.G - amount, 0), Math.Max(color.B - amount, 0));
		}

		internal bool DisplayToolTip(ToolBase tool)
		{
			PopupControlBase currentPopupControl = CurrentPopupControl;
			if (currentPopupControl != null && currentPopupControl.MenuAgent != null && !currentPopupControl.MenuAgent.ContainsTool(tool) && (currentPopupControl.MenuAgent != Ribbon.ApplicationMenu2010.BackStageMenuAgent || !tool.IsOnBackStage) && (!(tool.Owner is MiniToolbar) || currentPopupControl.MenuAgent.PopupTool == null || currentPopupControl.MenuAgent.PopupTool.UltimateOwner is MiniToolbar))
			{
				return false;
			}
			string toolTipTextResolved = tool.ToolTipTextResolved;
			string toolTipTitleResolved = tool.ToolTipTitleResolved;
			string toolTipTextFormattedResolved = tool.ToolTipTextFormattedResolved;
			string shortcutString = tool.SharedProps.ShortcutString;
			bool suppressShortcuts = tool is LabelTool;
			Rectangle exclusionRect = Rectangle.Empty;
			Point point = (point = Cursor.Position);
			point.Offset(0, 20);
			if (tool.OwnerIsRibbonGroup || tool.OwnerIsRibbonTabItemToolbarInternal)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = tool.UIElement;
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					UIElement ancestor = uIElement.GetAncestor(typeof(RibbonAreaUIElement));
					if (ancestor == null)
					{
						ancestor = uIElement.GetAncestor(typeof(RibbonTabPageUIElement));
					}
					if (ancestor == null)
					{
						ancestor = uIElement.GetAncestor(typeof(RibbonGroupUIElement));
					}
					Control control = uIElement.Control;
					if (control != null)
					{
						if (ancestor != null)
						{
							exclusionRect = control.RectangleToScreen(ancestor.Rect);
							point = control.PointToScreen(new Point(uIElement.Rect.Left, ancestor.Rect.Bottom + 5));
						}
						else
						{
							point = control.PointToScreen(uIElement.Rect.Location);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return DisplayToolTipHelper(toolTipTextResolved, toolTipTitleResolved, toolTipTextFormattedResolved, shortcutString, suppressShortcuts, exclusionRect, point);
		}

		internal bool DisplayToolTip(string toolTipText)
		{
			if (!ShowToolTipsResolved)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return DisplayToolTipHelper(toolTipText, null, null, null, suppressShortcuts: false);
		}

		internal bool DisplayToolTipHelper(string toolTipText, string toolTipTitle, string toolTipTextFormatted, string shortCutString, bool suppressShortcuts)
		{
			Rectangle empty = Rectangle.Empty;
			Point position = Cursor.Position;
			position.Offset(0, 20);
			return DisplayToolTipHelper(toolTipText, toolTipTitle, toolTipTextFormatted, shortCutString, suppressShortcuts, empty, position);
		}

		internal bool DisplayToolTipHelper(string toolTipText, string toolTipTitle, string toolTipTextFormatted, string shortCutString, bool suppressShortcuts, Rectangle exclusionRect, Point point)
		{
			if (IsDesignMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsDisposed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (GestureInProgress)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ToolBeingEdited != null && !CanHotTrackWhileInEditMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ToolTipDisplayStyle == ToolTipDisplayStyle.None)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			string text = toolTipText;
			if (ToolTipDisplayStyle == ToolTipDisplayStyle.Formatted && toolTipTextFormatted != null && toolTipTextFormatted.Length > 0)
			{
				flag = true;
				text = toolTipTextFormatted;
			}
			if ((text == null || text.Length == 0) && (toolTipTitle == null || toolTipTitle.Length == 0))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (toolTipDisplayModeDelayTimer != null)
			{
				toolTipDisplayModeDelayTimer.Enabled = false;
			}
			bool flag2 = toolTipTitle != null && toolTipTitle.Length > 0;
			if (ShowShortcutsInToolTips && shortCutString != null && shortCutString.Length > 0 && !suppressShortcuts)
			{
				if (flag || flag2)
				{
					toolTipTitle = $"{toolTipTitle} ({shortCutString})";
				}
				else
				{
					text = $"{text} ({shortCutString})";
				}
			}
			InitializeToolTip(text, toolTipTitle, flag);
			if (exclusionRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				ToolTip.Show(point, 0, true, true, true, Rectangle.Empty, false, false, RightAlignedMenusResolved);
			}
			else
			{
				ToolTip.Show(point, 0, true, true, true, exclusionRect, false, true);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void InitializeToolTip(string toolTipText, string toolTipTitle, bool isFormatted)
		{
			//IL_0063: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0068: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0069: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0097: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			if (!isFormatted)
			{
				string text = toolTipText.Trim();
				if (text.IndexOf(" ") < 0 && !toolTipText.EndsWith(" "))
				{
					ToolTip.RightMargin = 1;
				}
				else if (IsClearTypeEnabled())
				{
					ToolTip.RightMargin = 5;
				}
				else
				{
					ToolTip.RightMargin = 0;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ToolTip.RightMargin = 0;
			}
			ToolbarStyle styleResolved = StyleResolved;
			switch ((int)styleResolved)
			{
			case 5:
			case 6:
			case 7:
			case 8:
				ToolTip.DisplayStyle = (ToolTipDisplayStyle)3;
				ToolTip.BorderStyle = (ToolTipBorderStyle)0;
				break;
			case 0:
			case 1:
			case 2:
			case 3:
			case 4:
				ToolTip.DisplayStyle = (ToolTipDisplayStyle)0;
				ToolTip.BorderStyle = (ToolTipBorderStyle)2;
				break;
			case 9:
				ToolTip.DisplayStyle = (ToolTipDisplayStyle)5;
				ToolTip.BorderStyle = (ToolTipBorderStyle)1;
				break;
			default:
				ToolTip.DisplayStyle = (ToolTipDisplayStyle)0;
				ToolTip.BorderStyle = (ToolTipBorderStyle)2;
				break;
			}
			ToolTip.ToolTipTitle = toolTipTitle;
			ToolTip.ToolTipText = toolTipText;
			ToolTip.ToolTipTextStyle = (ToolTipTextStyle)((!isFormatted) ? 1 : 2);
			ToolTip.InitialDelay = 0;
			ToolTip.AutoPopDelay = 0;
			ToolTip.Font = SystemFonts.MenuFont;
			try
			{
				ToolTip.Owner = FindFormHelper(DockWithinContainer);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsClearTypeEnabled()
		{
			try
			{
				return SystemInformation.FontSmoothingType == 2;
			}
			catch (NotSupportedException)
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal void DockAreaInitialized(UltraToolbarsDockArea dockArea)
		{
			if (dockArea.DockedPosition != DockedPosition.Floating)
			{
				dockAreas[(int)dockArea.DockedPosition] = dockArea;
				if (!Initializing)
				{
					AddToolbarsToDockArea(dockArea.DockedPosition);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void DragToolCancelled()

				ToolDragPointInfo.DragCancelled = true;
				OnDragToolEnd();
			}
		}

		internal static void DrawToolDragInsertionPoint(bool drawVerticalInsertionPoint, bool drawAtFarEnd, UIElement element, ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			Rectangle rect = element.Rect;
			int num = 0;
			Point[] array;
			Point[] array2;
			if (drawVerticalInsertionPoint)
			{
				array = new Point[2]
				{
					new Point(rect.Left + 3, rect.Top),
					new Point(rect.Left + 3, rect.Bottom)
				};
				array2 = new Point[8]
				{
					new Point(rect.Left, rect.Top),
					new Point(rect.Left + 5, rect.Top),
					new Point(rect.Left + 1, rect.Top + 1),
					new Point(rect.Left + 4, rect.Top + 1),
					new Point(rect.Left, rect.Bottom - 1),
					new Point(rect.Left + 5, rect.Bottom - 1),
					new Point(rect.Left + 1, rect.Bottom - 2),
					new Point(rect.Left + 4, rect.Bottom - 2)
				};
				if (drawAtFarEnd)
				{
					for (num = 0; num < 2; num++)
					{
						array[num].Offset(rect.Width - 6, 0);
					}
					for (num = 0; num < 8; num++)
					{
						array2[num].Offset(rect.Width - 6, 0);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				array = new Point[2]
				{
					new Point(rect.Left, rect.Top + 3),
					new Point(rect.Right, rect.Top + 3)
				};
				array2 = new Point[8]
				{
					new Point(rect.Left, rect.Top),
					new Point(rect.Left, rect.Top + 5),
					new Point(rect.Left + 1, rect.Top + 1),
					new Point(rect.Left + 1, rect.Top + 4),
					new Point(rect.Right - 1, rect.Top),
					new Point(rect.Right - 1, rect.Top + 5),
					new Point(rect.Right - 2, rect.Top + 1),
					new Point(rect.Right - 2, rect.Top + 4)
				};
				if (drawAtFarEnd)
				{
					for (num = 0; num < 2; num++)
					{
						array[num].Offset(0, rect.Height - 6);
					}
					for (num = 0; num < 8; num++)
					{
						array2[num].Offset(0, rect.Height - 6);
					}
				}
			}
			Pen pen = Utilities.CreatePen(SystemColors.ControlText, 2f);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(pen, array[0], array[1]);
			pen.Dispose();
			for (num = 0; num < 8; num += 2)
			{
				((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(SystemPens.ControlText, array2[num], array2[num + 1]);
			}
		}

		internal void DrawToolSelectionRect(UIElement element, ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams, ToolBase associatedTool)
		{
			Rectangle rect = element.Rect;
			rect.Inflate(-1, -1);

			}
		}

		internal void DrawToolSelectionRect(Rectangle rect, ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)

			{

				((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawRectangle(pen, rect);
				pen.Dispose();
			}
		}

		internal void EnsureComponentIsSelectedInDesigner()
		{
			if (((Component)(object)this).GetService(typeof(ISelectionService)) is ISelectionService selectionService && selectionService.PrimarySelection != this)
			{
				selectionService.SetSelectedComponents(new object[1] { this }, SelectionTypes.Replace);
			}
		}

		internal void EnterCustomizeMode(IToolbarCustomizer dlg)
		{
			//IL_00be: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c8: Expected O, but got Unknown
			customizeDialog = dlg;
			customizing = true;
			RefreshStatusBar();
			DockWithinContainer.SuspendLayout();
			for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
			{
				if (dockAreas[i] != null)
				{
					dockAreas[i].OnBeginCustomizing();
				}
			}
			foreach (FloatingToolbarWindowBase floatingWindow in FloatingWindows)
			{
				if (dlg.ShouldDisplayNewToolPlaceHolder(floatingWindow.Toolbar))
				{
					floatingWindow.DockArea.OnBeginCustomizing();
				}
			}
			DockWithinContainer.ResumeLayout(performLayout: true);
			DockWithinContainer.PerformLayout();
			NotifyCustomizeModeChange();
			toolOwnerWithCapture = null;
			InternalSetActiveTool(null, setOn: true, clearToolBeingEdited: true);
			DropDownManager.ActivationChanged += new ActivationChangedEventHandler(OnActivationChanged);
			MouseHook += OnMouseHookMessageReceived;
			dlg.OnEnterCustomizeMode(this);
		}

		internal bool ExitEditMode()
		{
			ToolBase toolBase = ActiveTool;
			if (toolBase != null && toolBase.IsToolInEditMode && !toolBase.ExitEditMode(forceExit: false, applyChanges: false))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void ExitCustomizeMode(IToolbarCustomizer dlg)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Expected O, but got Unknown
			customizeDialogBeingExited = dlg;
			try
			{
				DropDownManager.ActivationChanged -= new ActivationChangedEventHandler(OnActivationChanged);
				MouseHook -= OnMouseHookMessageReceived;
				if (customizeDialogHasCapture)
				{
					SetCustomizeDialogCapture(setOn: false);
				}
				customizing = false;
				toolBeingCustomized = null;
				menuItemBeingCustomized = null;
				customizeDialog = null;
				if (DockWithinContainer != null)
				{
					DockWithinContainer.SuspendLayout();
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
				{
					if (dockAreas[i] != null)
					{
						dockAreas[i].OnEndCustomizing();
					}
				}
				foreach (FloatingToolbarWindowBase floatingWindow in FloatingWindows)
				{
					if (dlg.ShouldDisplayNewToolPlaceHolder(floatingWindow.Toolbar))
					{
						floatingWindow.DockArea.OnEndCustomizing();
					}
				}
				if (DockWithinContainer != null)
				{
					DockWithinContainer.ResumeLayout(performLayout: true);
					DockWithinContainer.PerformLayout();
				}
				NotifyCustomizeModeChange();
				CloseAllOpenToolbarSubmenus();
				if (IsDesignMode && ribbon.HasApplicationMenu2010)
				{
					ApplicationMenu2010 applicationMenu = ribbon.ApplicationMenu2010;
					if (applicationMenu.IsOpen)
					{
						applicationMenu.CloseDropDown();
					}
				}
				((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).DirtyChildElements();
				RefreshStatusBar();
				dlg.OnExitCustomizeMode();
			}
			finally
			{
				customizeDialogBeingExited = null;
			}
		}

		internal void ExitHotkeyMode()
		{
			ExitHotkeyMode(clearActiveTool: true);
		}

		private void ExitHotkeyMode(bool clearActiveTool)
		{
			if (!isInHotkeyMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			isInHotkeyMode = false;
			if (clearActiveTool)
			{
				ToolOwnerWithCapture = null;
				if (activeTool != null)
				{
					InternalSetActiveTool(null, setOn: false, clearToolBeingEdited: false);
				}
			}
			RefreshActiveTool();
			DirtyAllElements();
		}

		internal ContainerControl FindContainer()
		{
			Form form = FindForm();
			if (form != null)
			{
				return form;
			}
			if (dockWithinContainer == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (dockWithinContainer is ContainerControl)
			{
				return dockWithinContainer as ContainerControl;
			}
			if (IsDesignMode)
			{
				ContainerControl containerControl = null;
				IDesignerHost designerHost = DesignerHost;
				for (int i = 0; i < designerHost.Container.Components.Count; i++)
				{
					containerControl = designerHost.Container.Components[i] as ContainerControl;
					if (containerControl != null)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				if (containerControl == null)
				{
					return containerControl;
				}
			}
			try
			{
				UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					uIPermission.Assert();
				}
				for (Control parent = dockWithinContainer.Parent; parent != null; parent = parent.Parent)
				{
					if (parent is ContainerControl && !(parent is SplitContainer) && !(parent is ToolStripContainer))
					{
						return parent as ContainerControl;
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal Form FindForm()
		{
			return FindFormHelper(dockWithinContainer);
		}

		internal static Form FindFormHelper(Control controlOnForm)
		{
			if (controlOnForm == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (controlOnForm is Form)
			{
				return controlOnForm as Form;
			}
			try
			{
				UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					uIPermission.Assert();
				}
				return controlOnForm.FindForm();
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal void ForceExitEditMode()
		{
			ForceExitEditMode(onlyIfFormIsInActive: false);
		}

		internal void ForceExitEditMode(bool onlyIfFormIsInActive)
		{
			if (activeTool != null)
			{
				if (activeTool.Editor != null && activeTool.Editor.IsInEditMode && (!onlyIfFormIsInActive || !IsEditorOnActiveForm(activeTool.Editor)))
				{
					activeTool.ExitEditMode(forceExit: true, applyChanges: false);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (ToolbarWithCapture == null || ToolbarWithCapture.QuickCustomizeTool == null || !ToolbarWithCapture.QuickCustomizeTool.IsOpen || !(ToolbarWithCapture.QuickCustomizeTool.MenuAgent is QuickCustomizeAgentBase { BumpedToolsToolbar: not null } quickCustomizeAgentBase))
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (ToolBase tool in quickCustomizeAgentBase.BumpedToolsToolbar.Tools)
				{
					if (tool.Editor != null && tool.Editor.IsInEditMode && (!onlyIfFormIsInActive || !IsEditorOnActiveForm(tool.Editor)))
					{
						tool.ExitEditMode(forceExit: true, applyChanges: false);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ForwardKeyDownToEditor(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			editorWantedLastKeyDown = false;
			if (ToolBeingEdited != null && ToolBeingEdited.Editor != null && ToolBeingEdited.Editor.IsInEditMode && !ToolBeingEdited.Editor.Focused && !e.Handled)
			{
				EmbeddableEditorBase editor = ToolBeingEdited.Editor;
				OnEditor_KeyDown(editor, e);
				if (!e.Handled && editor.IsInputKey(e.KeyData))
				{
					editorWantedLastKeyDown = true;
					((EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)editorOwner).RaiseKeyDown(e);
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ForwardKeyPressToEditor(KeyPressEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ToolBeingEdited != null && ToolBeingEdited.Editor != null && ToolBeingEdited.Editor.IsInEditMode && !ToolBeingEdited.Editor.Focused && !e.Handled)
			{
				OnEditor_KeyPress(ToolBeingEdited.Editor, e);
				if (!e.Handled)
				{
					((EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)editorOwner).RaiseKeyPress(e);
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ForwardKeyUpToEditor(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!editorWantedLastKeyDown)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ToolBeingEdited != null && ToolBeingEdited.Editor != null && ToolBeingEdited.Editor.IsInEditMode && !ToolBeingEdited.Editor.Focused && !e.Handled)
			{
				OnEditor_KeyUp(ToolBeingEdited.Editor, e);
				if (!e.Handled)
				{
					((EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)editorOwner).RaiseKeyUp(e);
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
			editorWantedLastKeyDown = false;
		}

		}

		internal ToolBase GetControlContainerTool(Control containedControl)
		{
			if (containedControl == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (ToolBase tool in Tools)
			{
				if (!tool.IsControlContainer)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (tool.Control == containedControl)
				{
					return tool;
				}
				if (tool.IsContainedControlShared)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (ToolBase toolInstance in tool.SharedProps.ToolInstances)
				{
					if (toolInstance.Control == containedControl)
					{
						return toolInstance;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal Control GetControlFromName(string name)
		{
			Control control = FindContainer();
			if (control == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetControlFromNameHelper(name, control);
		}

		private Control GetControlFromNameHelper(string name, Control parentControl)
		{
			if (name == ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetName(parentControl))
			{
				return parentControl;
			}
			foreach (Control control in parentControl.Controls)
			{
				Control controlFromNameHelper = GetControlFromNameHelper(name, control);
				if (controlFromNameHelper != null)
				{
					return controlFromNameHelper;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal ImageList GetImageList(bool largeImages)
		{
			ImageList imageList;

				result = ImageListSmallResolved;

		internal ToolBase GetParentRootTool(ToolBase rootTool)
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager mdiParentManagerInternal = MdiParentManagerInternal;
			if (mdiParentManagerInternal == null)
			{
				return rootTool;
			}
			ToolBase toolBase = null;
			if (mdiParentManagerInternal.Tools.Exists(rootTool.Key))
			{
				toolBase = mdiParentManagerInternal.Tools[rootTool.Key];
				if (toolBase.UnderlyingToolRaw != rootTool)
				{
					toolBase = null;
				}
			}
			if (toolBase == null && mdiParentManagerInternal.MergedTools.Exists(rootTool.Key))
			{
				toolBase = mdiParentManagerInternal.MergedTools[rootTool.Key];
				if (toolBase.UnderlyingTool != rootTool)
				{
					toolBase = null;
				}
			}
			if (toolBase == null)
			{
				return rootTool;
			}
			return toolBase;
		}

		internal UltraToolbarsDockArea GetToolbarDockArea(UltraToolbarBase toolbarBase)
		{
			if (toolbarBase is QuickAccessToolbar)
			{
				return Ribbon.RibbonContainer;
			}
			if (toolbarBase is ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar applicationMenuFooterToolbar)
			{
				return applicationMenuFooterToolbar.ApplicationMenu.FooterDockArea;
			}
			if (toolbarBase is MiniToolbar miniToolbar)
			{
				return miniToolbar.DockArea;
			}
			if (toolbarBase is RibbonTabItemToolbar)
			{
				return Ribbon.RibbonContainer;
			}
			if (toolbarBase is NavigationToolbar navigationToolbar)
			{
				return navigationToolbar.NavigationToolbarContainer;
			}
			UltraToolbar ultraToolbar = toolbarBase as UltraToolbar;
			if (ultraToolbar == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (ultraToolbar.OwningTaskPaneToolbar != null)
			{
				ultraToolbar = ultraToolbar.OwningTaskPaneToolbar;
			}
			if (ultraToolbar.ToolbarType == ToolbarType.ControlContainerHostForPopupMenu)
			{
				if (!(ultraToolbar.TearawayToolOwner is PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return popupMenuTool.ControlContainerHost;
			}
			if (ultraToolbar.DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Floating)
			{
				return GetFloatingWindow(ultraToolbar)?.DockArea;
			}
			return dockAreas[(int)ultraToolbar.DockedPosition];
		}

		internal Size GetToolImageSize(ToolBase tool)
		{
			if (tool == null)
			{
				return Size.Empty;
			}
			if (tool.OwnerIsMenuInternal)
			{
				return ImageSizeMenuResolved;
			}
			if (tool.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)
			{
				if (tool.OwningApplicationMenuArea.SettingsResolved.UseLargeImagesResolved)
				{
					return ImageSizeLargeResolved;
				}
				return ImageSizeSmallResolved;
			}
			return ImageSizeToolbarResolved;
		}

		internal ColorMap GetTransparentColorMap(object image, bool toolbar, DefaultableBoolean smallImageList)
		{
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (image == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Color color = ImageTransparentColorResolved;
			if (!(image is Image))
			{
				ImageList imageList = null;
				imageList = (((int)smallImageList != 1) ? (((int)smallImageList != 2) ? ((!toolbar) ? ImageListMenuResolved : ImageListToolbarResolved) : ((TouchMetricsEnabledResolved && imageListTouchLarge != null && imageListTouchLarge.Images.Count > 0) ? imageListTouchLarge : ((imageListLarge == null || imageListLarge.Images.Count <= 0) ? imageListSmall : imageListLarge))) : ((TouchMetricsEnabledResolved && imageListTouchSmall != null && imageListTouchSmall.Images.Count > 0) ? imageListTouchSmall : ((imageListSmall == null || imageListSmall.Images.Count <= 0) ? imageListLarge : imageListSmall)));
				if (imageList != null && imageList.TransparentColor != Color.Transparent)
				{
					color = imageList.TransparentColor;
				}
			}
			if (color == Color.Transparent)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ColorMap colorMap = new ColorMap();
			colorMap.NewColor = Color.Transparent;
			colorMap.OldColor = color;
			return colorMap;
		}

			return GetTransparentColorMapTable(image, toolbar, (DefaultableBoolean)0);
		}

		internal ColorMap[] GetTransparentColorMapTable(object image, bool toolbar, DefaultableBoolean smallImageList)
		{
			//IL_0003: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ColorMap transparentColorMap = GetTransparentColorMap(image, toolbar, smallImageList);
			if (transparentColorMap == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new ColorMap[1] { transparentColorMap };
		}

		internal AccessibleObject GetFocusedAccessibleObject()
		{
			if (!IsFormActiveInternal)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ToolBase toolBase = ActiveTool;
			if (toolBase != null && toolBase.Editor != null && toolBase.Editor.IsInEditMode && toolBase.AccessibilityObject.GetChildCount() > 0)
			{
				AccessibleObject child = toolBase.AccessibilityObject.GetChild(0);
				if (child != null)
				{
					child = child.GetFocused();
					if (child != null)
					{
						return child;
					}
				}
			}
			if (IsToolbarListMenuAgentOpen)
			{
				MenuItemBase activeMenuItem = ToolbarListMenuAgent.ActiveMenuItem;
				if (activeMenuItem != null)
				{
					return activeMenuItem.AccessibilityObject;
				}
			}
			PopupControlBase currentPopupControl = CurrentPopupControl;
			if (currentPopupControl != null)
			{
				MenuAgentBase menuAgent = currentPopupControl.MenuAgent;
				if (menuAgent != null)
				{
					MenuItemBase activeMenuItem2 = menuAgent.ActiveMenuItem;
					if (activeMenuItem2 != null)
					{
						if (activeMenuItem2 is GalleryToolMenuItem)
						{
							return activeMenuItem2.AccessibilityObject.GetFocused();
						}
						return activeMenuItem2.AccessibilityObject;
					}
					if (menuAgent is RibbonMenuAgentBase ribbonMenuAgentBase)
					{
						if (ribbonMenuAgentBase.ItemWithFocus == null)
						{
							return null;
						}
						return ribbonMenuAgentBase.ItemWithFocus.AccessibleObject;
					}
				}
			}
			if (ObjectWithFocus is Ribbon)
			{
				if (Ribbon.ItemWithFocus == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return Ribbon.ItemWithFocus.AccessibleObject;
			}
			if (ToolOwnerWithCapture == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			toolBase = ActiveTool;
			if (toolBase != null && toolBase.HasFocus)
			{
				return toolBase.AccessibilityObject;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal FloatingToolbarWindowBase GetFloatingWindow(UltraToolbar toolbar)
		{
			if (floatingWindows != null)
			{
				foreach (FloatingToolbarWindowBase floatingWindow in FloatingWindows)
				{
					if (floatingWindow.Toolbar == toolbar)
					{
						return floatingWindow;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal Point GetFloatingWindowLocation(UltraToolbar toolbar)
		{
			Point empty = Point.Empty;
			if (toolbarBeingDragged == toolbar)
			{
				empty = (toolbarCapturePoint = Control.MousePosition);
				empty.Offset(-toolbarDragOffset.X, -toolbarDragOffset.Y);
			}
			else
			{
				empty = toolbar.FloatingLocation;
				if (empty == Point.Empty)
				{
					ContainerControl containerControl = FindContainer();
					if (containerControl != null && !containerControl.IsDisposed && !containerControl.Disposing && containerControl.IsHandleCreated)
					{
						Point point = containerControl.PointToScreen(Point.Empty);
						point.X += containerControl.Size.Width / 3;
						point.Y += containerControl.Size.Height / 3;
						int count = FloatingWindows.Count;
						point.X += count * (FloatingToolbarCaptionHeight + 2);
						point.Y += count * (FloatingToolbarCaptionHeight + 2);
						empty = point;
						toolbar.InternalSetFloatingLocation(empty);
					}
				}
			}
			return empty;
		}

				{

					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal ToolBase GetRootTool(ToolBase tool)
		{
			if (tool.IsMdiMergeTool && !(tool is PopupMenuTool { IsReplacedByMdiChildMenu: not false }))
			{
				ToolTypeID toolTypeID = tool.UnderlyingToolTypeID;
				if (toolTypeID == null)
				{
					toolTypeID = ToolTypeID.GetToolTypeIDFromType(tool.GetType());
				}
				return MergedTools[((IKeyedSubObjectEx)tool).KeyLowercaseInterned, toolTypeID];
			}
			int num = Tools.IndexOf(tool.Key);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				return Tools[num];
			}
			return null;
		}

		}

		internal string GetIdentifierForDropDownForm(MenuAgentBase agent)
		{
			if (agent == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			PopupToolBase popupTool = agent.PopupTool;
			PopupControlBase popupControl = agent.PopupControl;
			if (popupTool != null && popupControl != null)
			{
				int num = PopupControls.IndexOf(popupControl);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					string text = popupTool.CaptionResolved;
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
					{
						text = popupTool.ToolTipTextResolved;
						if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
						{
							text = popupTool.Key;
						}
					}
					return $"{text} - {num}";
				}
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		internal int GetResolvedHorizontalToolbarGrabHandleWidth(UltraToolbarBase toolbarBase)
		{
			int num = 3;
			if (toolbarBase is UltraToolbar ultraToolbar && ultraToolbar.SettingsResolved.GrabHandleStyleResolved == GrabHandleStyle.Office2013)
			{
				num = 5;
			}
			if (!StyleUtils.GetCachedPropertyVal(this, StyleUtils.CustomProperty.HorizontalToolbarGrabHandleWidth, out var val))
			{
				val = StyleUtils.CachePropertyValue(this, StyleUtils.CustomProperty.HorizontalToolbarGrabHandleWidth, horizontalToolbarGrabHandleWidth, 0, num);
			}
			if (TouchMetricsEnabledResolved)
			{
				return Math.Max((int)val, TouchUtilities.GetTouchElementSize(DockWithinContainer, (TouchElementSizes)2).Width);
			}
			return (int)val;
		}

			{
				val = StyleUtils.CachePropertyValue(this, StyleUtils.CustomProperty.VerticalToolbarGrabHandleHeight, verticalToolbarGrabHandleHeight, 0, num);
			}
			if (TouchMetricsEnabledResolved)
			{
				return Math.Max((int)val, TouchUtilities.GetTouchElementSize(DockWithinContainer, (TouchElementSizes)2).Width);
			}
			return (int)val;
		}

		internal UIElement GetUIElement(Type type, object context)
		{
			UIElement val = null;
			ToolBase toolBase = context as ToolBase;
			UltraToolbarBase ultraToolbarBase = context as UltraToolbarBase;
			PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool = context as PopupMenuTool;
			RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = context as RibbonGroup;
			if (toolBase != null)
			{
				if (mdiParentManager != null && IsMdiMerged && toolBase.AttachedParentTool != null)
				{
					return mdiParentManager.GetUIElement(type, toolBase.AttachedParentTool);
				}
				ultraToolbarBase = toolBase.OwningToolbarInternal;
				popupMenuTool = toolBase.OwningMenuInternal;
				ribbonGroup = toolBase.OwningRibbonGroup;
			}
			if (ultraToolbarBase != null)
			{
				if (ultraToolbarBase.RootToolbars != null)
				{
					QuickCustomizeToolBase quickCustomizeToolBase = null;
					for (int i = 0; i < ultraToolbarBase.RootToolbars.Length; i++)
					{
						if (ultraToolbarBase.RootToolbars[i].QuickCustomizeTool != null && (ultraToolbarBase.RootToolbars[i].QuickCustomizeTool.IsOpen || ultraToolbarBase.RootToolbars[i].QuickCustomizeTool.IsOpening))
						{
							quickCustomizeToolBase = ultraToolbarBase.RootToolbars[i].QuickCustomizeTool;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (quickCustomizeToolBase != null)
					{
						UltraToolbarsDockArea bumpedToolsDockArea = ((QuickCustomizeAgentBase)quickCustomizeToolBase.MenuAgent).BumpedToolsDockArea;
						if (bumpedToolsDockArea != null)
						{
							val = ((UIElement)bumpedToolsDockArea.ControlElement).GetDescendant(type, context);
							if (val != null)
							{
								return val;
							}
						}
						if (quickCustomizeToolBase.MenuAgent.PopupControl is QuickCustomizePopupControl { UIElement: { } uIElement })
						{
							val = ((UIElement)uIElement).GetDescendant(type, context);
							if (val != null)
							{
								return val;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (ultraToolbarBase.IsFloating)
				{
					if (ultraToolbarBase is MiniToolbar miniToolbar)
					{
						MiniToolbarWindow miniToolbarWindow = ((miniToolbarDesigner == null) ? miniToolbar.Window : miniToolbarDesigner.MiniToolbarWindow);
						if (miniToolbarWindow == null)
						{
							return null;
						}
						UltraToolbarsDockArea dockArea = miniToolbarWindow.DockArea;
						if (dockArea == null)
						{
							return null;
						}
						val = ((UIElement)dockArea.ControlElement).GetDescendant(type, context);
						if (val != null)
						{
							return val;
						}
						val = ((UIElement)miniToolbarWindow.UIElement).GetDescendant(type, context);
						if (val != null)
						{
							return val;
						}
						return null;
					}
					FloatingToolbarWindowBase floatingWindow = GetFloatingWindow(ultraToolbarBase as UltraToolbar);
					if (floatingWindow != null)
					{
						val = ((UIElement)floatingWindow.DockArea.ControlElement).GetDescendant(type, context);
						if (val != null)
						{
							return val;
						}
						val = ((UIElement)floatingWindow.UIElement).GetDescendant(type, context);
						if (val != null)
						{
							return val;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (ultraToolbarBase is UltraToolbar ultraToolbar && dockAreas[(int)ultraToolbar.DockedPosition] != null)
					{
						val = ((UIElement)dockAreas[(int)ultraToolbar.DockedPosition].ControlElement).GetDescendant(type, context);
						if (val != null)
						{
							return val;
						}
					}
					if (ultraToolbarBase is QuickAccessToolbar)
					{
						IUltraControlElement ribbonContainer = (IUltraControlElement)(object)Ribbon.RibbonContainer;
						if (ribbonContainer != null && ribbonContainer.MainUIElement != null)
						{
							val = ((UIElement)ribbonContainer.MainUIElement).GetDescendant(type, context);
						}
						return val;
					}
					if (ultraToolbarBase is RibbonTabItemToolbar)
					{
						UltraToolbarsDockArea ultraToolbarsDockArea = Ribbon.RibbonContainer;
						if (Ribbon.DisplayModeResolved == RibbonDisplayMode.AutoHide && Ribbon.IsAutoHidePopupOpen)
						{
							ultraToolbarsDockArea = Ribbon.AutoHideMenuAgent.DockArea;
						}
						IUltraControlElement val2 = (IUltraControlElement)(object)ultraToolbarsDockArea;
						if (val2 != null && val2.MainUIElement != null)
						{
							val = ((UIElement)val2.MainUIElement).GetDescendant(type, context);
						}
						return val;
					}
					if (ultraToolbarBase is ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar)
					{
						foreach (PopupControlBase popupControl in PopupControls)
						{
							if (popupControl is ApplicationMenuControl)
							{
								val = ((UIElement)popupControl.ControlElement).GetDescendant(type, context);
								if (val != null)
								{
									return val;
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (ribbonGroup != null)
			{
				UltraToolbarsDockArea ultraToolbarsDockArea2 = Ribbon.RibbonContainer;
				if (Ribbon.DisplayModeResolved == RibbonDisplayMode.AutoHide && Ribbon.IsAutoHidePopupOpen)
				{
					ultraToolbarsDockArea2 = Ribbon.AutoHideMenuAgent.DockArea;
				}
				if (ultraToolbarsDockArea2 != null)
				{
					val = ((UIElement)((IUltraControlElement)ultraToolbarsDockArea2).MainUIElement).GetDescendant(type, context);
				}
				if (val != null)
				{
					return val;
				}
				int j = 0;
				for (int count = PopupControls.Count; j < count; j++)
				{
					PopupControlBase popupControlBase = PopupControls[j];
					if (popupControlBase is RibbonMenuControl)
					{
						val = ((UIElement)popupControlBase.ControlElement).GetDescendant(type, context);
						if (val != null)
						{
							return val;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (popupMenuTool == null)
			{
				for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
				{
					if (dockAreas[k] != null)
					{
						val = ((UIElement)dockAreas[k].ControlElement).GetDescendant(type, context);
						if (val != null)
						{
							return val;
						}
					}
				}
				Ribbon ribbon = this.ribbon;
				if (ribbon != null && ribbon.DisplayModeResolved == RibbonDisplayMode.AutoHide && ribbon.IsAutoHidePopupOpen)
				{
					val = ((UIElement)ribbon.AutoHideMenuAgent.DockArea.ControlElement).GetDescendant(type, context);
					if (val != null)
					{
						return val;
					}
				}
				foreach (FloatingToolbarWindowBase floatingWindow2 in FloatingWindows)
				{
					val = ((UIElement)floatingWindow2.DockArea.ControlElement).GetDescendant(type, context);
					if (val != null)
					{
						return val;
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (PopupControlBase popupControl2 in PopupControls)
			{
				if (popupControl2 == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				val = ((UIElement)popupControl2.ControlElement).GetDescendant(type, context);
				if (val != null)
				{
					return val;
				}
				if (((Control)(object)popupControl2).Controls.Count <= 0 || (!(((Control)(object)popupControl2).Controls[0] is UltraToolbarsDockArea) && !(((Control)(object)popupControl2).Controls[0] is UltraPanel)))
				{
					continue;
				}
				UltraToolbarsDockArea ultraToolbarsDockArea3 = ((Control)(object)popupControl2).Controls[0] as UltraToolbarsDockArea;
				if (ultraToolbarsDockArea3 == null && ((Control)(object)popupControl2).Controls[0] is UltraPanel ultraPanel && ((Control)(object)ultraPanel.ClientArea).Controls.Count > 0)
				{
					ultraToolbarsDockArea3 = ((Control)(object)ultraPanel.ClientArea).Controls[0] as UltraToolbarsDockArea;
				}
				if (ultraToolbarsDockArea3 != null)
				{
					val = ((UIElement)ultraToolbarsDockArea3.ControlElement).GetDescendant(type, context);
					if (val != null)
					{
						return val;
					}
				}
			}
			return val;
		}

		internal void HideToolTip(ToolBase tooltipTool)
		{
			if (tooltipTool != null && tooltipTool.OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
			{
				if (toolTipDisplayModeDelayTimer != null)
				{
					toolTipDisplayModeDelayTimer.Enabled = false;
				}
				immediateToolTipDisplayMode = false;
			}
			HideToolTip(!ImmediateToolTipDisplayMode);
		}

		internal void HideToolTip()
		{
			HideToolTip(!ImmediateToolTipDisplayMode);
		}

		private void HideToolTip(bool dispose)
		{
			if (toolTip == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (HasRibbon && Ribbon.HasKeyTipManager)
			{
				Ribbon.KeyTipManager.DisplayingToolTip = false;
			}
			ToolTip val = toolTip;
			if (!dispose)
			{
				val.Hide();
				return;
			}
			toolTip = null;
			val.Hide();
			if (DockWithinContainer == null || DockWithinContainer.Disposing || !DockWithinContainer.IsHandleCreated)
			{
				DisposeToolTipHelper(val);
				return;
			}
			DockWithinContainer.BeginInvoke(new DisposeToolTipDelegate(DisposeToolTipHelper), val);
		}
