		internal void InternalSetActiveTool(ToolBase tool, bool setOn, bool clearToolBeingEdited)
		{
			InternalSetActiveTool(tool, setOn, clearToolBeingEdited, clearToolbarWithCaptureIfNecessary: false);
		}

		internal void InternalSetActiveTool(ToolBase tool, bool setOn, bool clearToolBeingEdited, bool clearToolbarWithCaptureIfNecessary)
		{
			if (setOn && tool != null && !tool.EnabledResolved)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (clearToolBeingEdited && toolBeingEdited != null)
			{
				if (toolBeingEdited.Editor != null)
				{
					bool flag = false;
					if (clearToolbarWithCaptureIfNecessary)
					{
						if (toolBeingEdited.OwnerIsToolbarInternal && ToolbarWithCapture != null && toolBeingEdited.OwningToolbarInternal == ToolbarWithCapture)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
						else if (toolBeingEdited.OwnerIsRibbonGroup && RibbonGroupWithCapture != null && toolBeingEdited.OwningRibbonGroup == RibbonGroupWithCapture)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					if (toolBeingEdited.ExitEditMode(forceExit: false, applyChanges: true) && flag)
					{
						ToolOwnerWithCapture = null;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (clearToolbarWithCaptureIfNecessary && ToolbarWithCapture != null && toolBeingEdited.OwningToolbarInternal == ToolbarWithCapture)
					{
						ToolOwnerWithCapture = null;
					}
					else if (clearToolbarWithCaptureIfNecessary && RibbonGroupWithCapture != null && toolBeingEdited.OwningRibbonGroup == RibbonGroupWithCapture)
					{
						ToolOwnerWithCapture = null;
					}
					toolBeingEdited = null;
				}
			}
			if (((Component)this).DesignMode && !Customizing)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (toolBeingEdited != null && toolBeingEdited != tool)
			{
				if (setOn && CanHotTrackWhileInEditMode)
				{
					ToolForcedToDrawAsActive = tool;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if ((setOn && IsToolbarListMenuAgentOpen) || (setOn && ToolbarBeingDragged != null) || (setOn && isUnhidingTearawayDropdown))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (setOn && tool != null && CurrentPopupControl != null && tool.OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
				{
					PopupControlBase currentPopupControl = CurrentPopupControl;
					if (!(currentPopupControl.MenuAgent is RibbonTabMenuAgent) && !(currentPopupControl.MenuAgent is RibbonAutoHideMenuAgent))
					{
						if (currentPopupControl.MenuAgent is RibbonGroupMenuAgent)
						{
							if (tool.OwningRibbonGroup != ((RibbonGroupMenuAgent)currentPopupControl.MenuAgent).Group)
							{
								return;
							}
						}
						else if (currentPopupControl.MenuAgent == null || currentPopupControl.MenuAgent.PopupTool != tool)
						{
							return;
						}
					}
				}
				if (setOn && ToolbarWithCapture is QuickAccessToolbar && tool != null && CurrentPopupControl != null && !(CurrentPopupControl is BackStageViewControl) && CurrentPopupControl.MenuAgent.PopupTool != tool && (tool.Owner is QuickAccessToolbar || (tool.OwnerIsToolbarInternal && tool.OwningToolbarInternal.IsBumpedToolsToolbar && tool.OwningToolbarInternal.MainRootToolbar is QuickAccessToolbar && CurrentPopupControl.MenuAgent.PopupTool != null && CurrentPopupControl.MenuAgent.PopupTool.Owner == tool.Owner)))
				{
					return;
				}
				RibbonItem ribbonItem = null;
				if (CurrentPopupControl != null)
				{
					if (CurrentPopupControl.MenuAgent is RibbonMenuAgentBase ribbonMenuAgentBase)
					{
						ribbonItem = ribbonMenuAgentBase.ItemWithFocus;
					}
				}
				else if (HasRibbon)
				{
					ribbonItem = ribbon.ItemWithFocus;
				}
				if (ribbonItem != null)
				{
					if (!setOn && ribbonItem.Context is ToolBase)
					{
						return;
					}
					ToolBase toolBase = ribbonItem.Context as ToolBase;
					if (setOn && (toolBase == null || toolBase != tool))
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				if (setOn && tool != null && tool.OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
				{
					if (tool.OwningToolbarInternal.MainRootToolbar != null && tool.OwningToolbarInternal.MainRootToolbar.QuickCustomizeTool != null && tool.OwningToolbarInternal.MainRootToolbar.QuickCustomizeTool.IsOpen)
					{
						MenuItemBase menuItemFromTool = tool.OwningToolbarInternal.MainRootToolbar.QuickCustomizeTool.MenuAgent.GetMenuItemFromTool(tool);
						tool.OwningToolbarInternal.MainRootToolbar.QuickCustomizeTool.MenuAgent.CloseOpenSubmenuTools(menuItemFromTool, delay: true);
					}
					if (tool.OwningToolbarInternal is ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar applicationMenuFooterToolbar)
					{
						applicationMenuFooterToolbar.ApplicationMenu.MenuAgent.CloseOpenSubmenuTools(null, delay: true);
					}
				}
				if (ToolOwnerWithCapture != null && setOn)
				{
					object obj = tool?.UltimateOwner;
					if ((obj == null || !(obj is UltraToolbar) || (((UltraToolbar)obj).TearawayToolOwner == null && ((UltraToolbar)obj).RootToolbars == null)) && (!(obj is ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar) || !(ToolOwnerWithCapture is ApplicationMenuArea)) && (!(obj is ApplicationMenuArea) || !(ToolOwnerWithCapture is ApplicationMenuArea) || obj == ToolOwnerWithCapture) && (obj == null || !tool.IsWithinOwner(ToolOwnerWithCapture)))
					{
						if (!clearToolbarWithCaptureIfNecessary)
						{
							return;
						}
						ToolOwnerWithCapture = null;
					}
				}
				if (setOn)
				{
					if (activeTool == tool)
					{
						return;
					}
					if (tool != null && !tool.IsSpecialTool)
					{
						CancelableToolEventArgs e = new CancelableToolEventArgs(tool);
						FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.BeforeToolActivate, e);
						if (e.Cancel)
						{
							return;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (tool != null && activeTool != tool)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (activeTool != null)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase2 = activeTool;
					activeTool.OnDeactivate();
					if (!toolBase2.IsSpecialTool)
					{
						FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.AfterToolDeactivate, new ToolEventArgs(toolBase2));
					}
				}
				if (setOn)
				{
					if (tool != null && tool.OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
					{
						DropdownCloseupManager.CancelPendingDropdownRequest();
					}
					activeTool = tool;
					if (activeTool != null)
					{
						activeTool.OnActivate();
					}
					if (tool != null && !tool.IsSpecialTool)
					{
						FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.AfterToolActivate, new ToolEventArgs(tool));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					activeTool = null;
				}
				if (tool != null)
				{
					tool.AttachToUnderlyingTool();
					if (tool.OwnerIsMenuInternal)
					{
						UIElement uIElement = tool.UIElement;
						if (uIElement != null)
						{
							uIElement.DirtyChildElements();
						}
					}
					else if (tool.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)
					{
						tool.DirtyOwnerElements();
					}
					else if (tool.OwnerIsToolbarInternal || tool.OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
					{
						tool.DirtyOwnerElements();
					}
				}
				RefreshStatusBar();
				NotifyAccessibilityFocusChange();
			}
		}

		internal void InternalSetMdiParentManager(UltraToolbarsManager mdiParentManager)
		{
			this.mdiParentManager = mdiParentManager;
			if (this.mdiParentManager != null)
			{
				hasMdiParentManagerBeenSet = true;
				hasBeenMergedAtLeastOnce = true;
				return;
			}
			foreach (ToolBase tool in Tools)
			{
				tool.InternalDetach();
				foreach (ToolBase toolInstance in tool.SharedProps.ToolInstances)
				{
					toolInstance.InternalDetach();
				}
			}
			if (ribbon != null)
			{
				ribbon.OnMdiParentManagerDetached();
			}
		}

		internal void InternalSetToolBeingEdited(ToolBase tool)
		{
			toolBeingEdited = tool;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		internal ToolBase InternalSetToolWithControlHelper(ToolBase tool, ToolBase rootTool, UltraToolbarsDockArea dockArea)
		{
			if (rootTool == null || rootTool.Control == null || !rootTool.IsControlContainer)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (tool != null && tool.SharedProps != rootTool.SharedProps)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ToolBase toolWithContainedControl;
			if (rootTool.IsContainedControlShared)
			{
				toolWithContainedControl = rootTool.ToolWithContainedControl;
			}
			else
			{
				if (tool == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				toolWithContainedControl = tool.ToolWithContainedControl;
			}
			ToolBase toolBase = tool;
			if (toolBase != null)
			{
				if (toolBase is TaskPaneTool || toolBase.UnderlyingTool is TaskPaneTool)
				{
					if (toolBase.OwningToolbar is UltraTaskPaneToolbar { SelectedTaskPaneTool: not null } ultraTaskPaneToolbar && toolBase.IsSameLogicalTool(ultraTaskPaneToolbar.SelectedTaskPaneTool))
					{
						ultraTaskPaneToolbar.ReparentPagerControl(dockArea, createIfNull: true);
						ReparentControl(toolBase.Control, ultraTaskPaneToolbar.PagerContentControl, rootTool);
					}
					else
					{
						toolBase = null;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					UIElement uIElement = toolBase.UIElement;
					if (uIElement == null)
					{
						if (dockArea == null || dockArea.OwningMenuAgent == null || !dockArea.OwningMenuAgent.IsOpening)
						{
							dockArea = null;
						}
					}
					else if (dockArea != null)
					{
						if ((object)uIElement.Control != dockArea && !dockArea.IsControlContainerHostForPopupMenu)
						{
							return toolWithContainedControl;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						dockArea = uIElement.Control as UltraToolbarsDockArea;
					}
					if (dockArea == null)
					{
						toolBase = null;
					}
					else
					{
						Point location = ((toolBase.Control != null) ? toolBase.Control.Location : Point.Empty);
						if (toolBase != null && toolBase.PopupTool is PopupControlContainerToolBase && toolBase.Control != null && !IsDesignMode)
						{
							location = ((!toolBase.IsOnBackStage) ? Point.Empty : new Point(-10000, -10000));
						}
						else if (toolBase is ControlContainerTool && toolBase.IsVertical)
						{
							location = new Point(-10000, -10000);
						}
						ReparentControl(toolBase.Control, (Control)(object)dockArea, rootTool, location);
						if (uIElement != null && (toolBase != toolWithContainedControl || toolBase is ControlContainerTool))
						{
							uIElement.DirtyChildElements();
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (toolBase == null)
			{
				ReparentControl(rootTool.Control, null, rootTool);
			}
			return toolBase;
		}

		internal bool IsCustomizeOptionEnabled(RuntimeCustomizationOptions option)
		{
			if (IsDesignMode)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (EnforceOffice2007Resolution)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return (runtimeCustomizationOptions & option) == option;
		}

		private static bool IsFormActiveHelper(Form form)
		{
			try
			{
				UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					uIPermission.Assert();
				}
				Form activeForm = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ActiveForm;
				if (activeForm == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (form == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (form == activeForm)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (form.TopLevelControl != activeForm)
				{
					return false;
				}
				Form form2 = (activeForm.IsMdiContainer ? activeForm.ActiveMdiChild : null);
				for (Control control = form; control != null; control = control.Parent)
				{
					if (control == form2)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (control is Form && ((Form)control).IsMdiChild && control != form2)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (control.Parent == activeForm)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsSharedToolEditor(EmbeddableEditorBase editor)
		{
			if ((object)editor != textEditor && (object)editor != editorWithCombo)
			{
				return (object)editor == fontEditor;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool IsTaskPaneToolbarActive(UltraTaskPaneToolbar toolbar)
		{
			if (toolbar == null || !toolbar.VisibleResolved)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!toolbar.WasEnterInvokedForContentControl)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsInEditMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (toolbar != LastActiveTaskPane)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return IsToolbarFormActiveHelper(toolbar);
		}

		internal static Color LightenColor(Color color)
		{
			return LightenColor(color, 5);
		}

		internal static Color LightenColor(Color color, int amount)
		{
			return Color.FromArgb(color.A, Math.Min(color.R + amount, 255), Math.Min(color.G + amount, 255), Math.Min(color.B + amount, 255));
		}

		internal Size MeasureString(ref AppearanceData appearance, Font font, string stringToMeasure)

		}

		internal Size MeasureString(ref AppearanceData appearance, Font font, string stringToMeasure, bool isVertical, HotkeyPrefix hotkeyPrefix)
		{

		}

		internal Size MeasureString(ref AppearanceData appearance, Font font, string stringToMeasure, bool isVertical, HotkeyPrefix hotkeyPrefix, ToolBase tool, StringFormat format = null)
		{
			//IL_006a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0085: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0075: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0078: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0079: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Graphics cachedGraphics = DrawUtility.GetCachedGraphics(DockWithinContainer);
			bool flag = false;
			Font font2 = font;
			if (font2 == null)
			{
				font2 = ((DockWithinContainer != null) ? MenuFont : Control.DefaultFont);
			}
			Font font3 = ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).CreateFont(font2);
			if (font3 == null)
			{
				font3 = font2;
			}
			else
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (format == null)
			{
				format = new StringFormat();
			}
			format.HotkeyPrefix = hotkeyPrefix;
			Size result;
			if (tool == null || !tool.IsLargeRibbonTool)
			{
				GdiDrawStringFlags val = GdiDrawStringFlags;
				if (isVertical)
				{
					val = (GdiDrawStringFlags)(val | 1);
				}
				result = Size.Ceiling(DrawUtility.MeasureString(cachedGraphics, stringToMeasure, font3, 10000, format, val));
			}
			else
			{
				Size dropDownArrowSize = ((tool is PopupToolBase popupToolBase) ? GetArrowBitmap(ArrowUIElement.ArrowOrientation.Down, popupToolBase.ArrowSize).Size : Size.Empty);
				tool.LargeRibbonButtonTextInfo = new ToolBase.LargeRibbonButtonTextInfoCache(tool, cachedGraphics, font3, dropDownArrowSize, GdiDrawStringFlags);
				result = tool.LargeRibbonButtonTextInfo.TotalTextSize;
			}
			result.Width += 3;
			if (font3.Bold)
			{
				result.Width += 7;
			}
			DrawUtility.ReleaseCachedGraphics(cachedGraphics);
			format.Dispose();
			if (flag)
			{
				font3.Dispose();
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal void NotifyAccessibilityClients(AccessibleEvents eventID)
		{
			if (dockAreas == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraToolbarsDockArea[] array = dockAreas;
			foreach (UltraToolbarsDockArea ultraToolbarsDockArea in array)
			{
				if (ultraToolbarsDockArea != null && ultraToolbarsDockArea.DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Top)
				{
					ultraToolbarsDockArea.AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(eventID, ultraToolbarsDockArea.ToolbarCount);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnCustomizeDialogMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (toolBeingDragged != null)

				OnDragToolMove();
			}
			else if (toolBeingResized != null)

				OnResizeToolMove();

			}
		}

		internal void OnCustomizeDialogMouseUp(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (toolBeingDragged != null)
			{
				OnDragToolEnd();
			}
			else if (toolBeingResized != null)
			{
				OnResizeToolEnd();
			}
			else if (toolbarBeingDragged != null)
			{
				OnDragToolbarEnd();
			}
		}

		internal void OnDragTearawayBegin(TearawayToolBase tearaway, Point tearawayDragOffset, Rectangle tearawayDragThreshholdRect)
		{
			holdToolbarWithCapture = ToolbarWithCapture;
			toolOwnerWithCapture = null;
			InternalSetActiveTool(null, setOn: true, clearToolBeingEdited: true);
			this.tearawayDragOffset = tearawayDragOffset;
			tearawayBeingDragged = tearaway;
			tearawayCapturePoint = Control.MousePosition;
			this.tearawayDragThreshholdRect = tearawayDragThreshholdRect;
			tearawayDragIsPending = true;
			DropDownManager.SuspendAutoCloseUp();
			FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.ToolbarModified, new ToolbarModifiedEventArgs(tearaway.TearawayToolbar, ToolbarChangeType.StartDrag));
			if (Customizing && CustomizeDialog != null)
			{
				CustomizeDialog.DragItemStart(DragItemType.TearawayToolbar);
			}
			HideToolTip(dispose: false);
		}

		internal void OnDragTearawayMove()
		{
			Point empty = Point.Empty;
			if (tearawayBeingDragged == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Point mousePosition = Control.MousePosition;
			if (mousePosition == tearawayCapturePoint)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (tearawayDragIsPending)
			{
				if (!tearawayDragThreshholdRect.Contains(mousePosition))
				{
					tearawayDragIsPending = false;
					HideToolTip();
					UltraToolbar tearawayToolbar = tearawayBeingDragged.TearawayToolbar;
					if (!tearawayToolbar.VisibleResolved || tearawayToolbar.DockedPosition != DockedPosition.Floating)
					{
						tearawayToolbar.SetDockedPosition(DockedPosition.Floating);
					}
					empty = mousePosition;
					empty.Offset(-tearawayDragOffset.X, -tearawayDragOffset.Y);
					GetFloatingWindow(tearawayToolbar).Location = empty;
					if (!tearawayToolbar.VisibleResolved)
					{
						tearawayToolbar.Visible = true;
					}
					tearawayBeingDragged.MenuAgent.HideDropDown();
					GetToolbarDockArea(tearawayToolbar)?.ReparentContainedControls(tearawayToolbar, takeOwnership: true);
				}
			}
			else if ((tearawayBeingDragged.OwnerIsMenuInternal || tearawayBeingDragged.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea || tearawayBeingDragged.OwnerIsToolbarInternal) && tearawayDragThreshholdRect.Contains(mousePosition))
			{
				UltraToolbar tearawayToolbar2 = tearawayBeingDragged.TearawayToolbar;
				isUnhidingTearawayDropdown = true;
				try
				{
					ActivateFormInternal();
					tearawayToolbar2.Visible = false;
					tearawayBeingDragged.MenuAgent.UnHideDropDown();
				}
				finally
				{
					isUnhidingTearawayDropdown = false;
				}
				tearawayDragIsPending = true;
			}
			else
			{
				empty = mousePosition;
				empty.Offset(-tearawayDragOffset.X, -tearawayDragOffset.Y);
				GetFloatingWindow(tearawayBeingDragged.TearawayToolbar).Location = empty;
			}
		}

		internal void OnDragTearawayEnd()
		{
			Cursor.Current = Cursors.Default;
			DropDownManager.ResumeAutoCloseUp();
			FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.ToolbarModified, new ToolbarModifiedEventArgs(tearawayBeingDragged.TearawayToolbar, ToolbarChangeType.EndDrag));
			if (tearawayBeingDragged.MenuAgent.IsDropDownHidden)
			{
				PopupManager.CloseAllPopups(onlyCloseLeafContiguousPopupChain: true);
				toolOwnerWithCapture = null;
			}
			else
			{
				toolOwnerWithCapture = holdToolbarWithCapture;
				if (tearawayBeingDragged.MenuAgent.PopupControl != null && ((Control)(object)tearawayBeingDragged.MenuAgent.PopupControl).IsHandleCreated)
				{
					((UltraControlBase)tearawayBeingDragged.MenuAgent.PopupControl).Invalidate();
				}
			}
			if (tearawayBeingDragged.OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
			{
				tearawayBeingDragged.OwningToolbarInternal.SaveDockedPosition();
			}
			tearawayBeingDragged = null;
			if (Customizing && CustomizeDialog != null)
			{
				CustomizeDialog.DragItemEnd(DragItemType.TearawayToolbar);
			}
		}

		internal void OnDragToolBegin(ToolBase tool)
		{
			if (customizeDialog == null || inOnDragToolBegin)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				inOnDragToolBegin = true;
				SetCustomizeDialogCapture(setOn: true);
				if (tool != null && (!tool.OwnerIsToolbarInternal || !tool.OwningToolbarInternal.IsBumpedToolsToolbar) && (!toolDragIsPending || tool != toolBeingDragged))
				{
					if (toolBeingDragged != null)
					{
						OnDragToolEnd();
					}
					toolBeingDragged = tool;
					toolCapturePoint = Control.MousePosition;
					toolDragIsPending = true;
					UpdateToolDragPointInfo(Control.MousePosition);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				inOnDragToolBegin = false;
			}
		}

		internal void OnDragToolMove()
		{
			if (toolBeingDragged == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Point mousePosition = Control.MousePosition;
			if (mousePosition == toolCapturePoint)
			{
				return;
			}
			UpdateToolDragPointInfo(mousePosition);
			if (toolDragIsPending)
			{
				int num = 2;
				if (new Rectangle(toolbarCapturePoint.X - num, toolbarCapturePoint.Y - num, num * 2, num * 2).Contains(mousePosition))
				{
					return;
				}
				toolDragIsPending = false;
				SetToolDragCursor(mousePosition);
				PopupToolBase popupTool = toolBeingDragged.PopupTool;
				if (popupTool != null && popupTool.IsOpen)
				{
					popupTool.CloseDropDown(delay: false);
				}
				try
				{
					if (Customizing && CustomizeDialog != null)
					{
						CustomizeDialog.DragItemStart(DragItemType.Tool);
					}
					CancelableToolEventArgs e = new CancelableToolEventArgs(toolBeingDragged);
					FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.BeforeToolDragBegin, e);
					if (e.Cancel)
					{
						ToolDragPointInfo.DragCancelled = true;
						OnDragToolEnd();
					}
					else
					{
						HideToolTip(dispose: false);
					}
					return;
				}
				catch
				{
					ToolDragPointInfo.DragCancelled = true;
					OnDragToolEnd();
					return;
				}
			}
			if (toolBeingDragged != null && toolBeingDragged.IsVisibleOnMenus)
			{
				PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool = ((ToolDragPointInfo.VToolUnderDragPoint == null) ? null : (ToolDragPointInfo.VToolUnderDragPoint.Tool as PopupMenuTool));
				UltraTaskPaneToolbar ultraTaskPaneToolbar = null;
				if (ToolDragPointInfo.VToolUnderDragPoint != null && ToolDragPointInfo.VToolUnderDragPoint.OwnerIsToolbar)
				{
					ultraTaskPaneToolbar = ToolDragPointInfo.VToolUnderDragPoint.OwningToolbar.OwningTaskPaneToolbar;
				}
				if (popupMenuTool != null && toolBeingDragged.IsVisibleOnMenu(popupMenuTool) && !popupMenuTool.IsOpen)
				{
					CloseAllSubmenus(popupMenuTool.OwnerInternal);
					IPopupElement popupElement = popupMenuTool.UIElement as IPopupElement;
					if (popupMenuTool.OwnerIsToolbarInternal && popupMenuTool.OwningToolbarInternal != null && popupMenuTool.OwningToolbarInternal.AllowCustomizeResolved)
					{
						if (popupElement != null && popupMenuTool.OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
						{
							Rectangle rectangle = popupMenuTool.UIElement.Control.RectangleToScreen(popupMenuTool.UIElement.Rect);
							if (popupMenuTool.IsArrangedVertically)
							{
								rectangle.Inflate(0, -Math.Min(5, rectangle.Height / 3));
							}
							else
							{
								rectangle.Inflate(-Math.Min(5, rectangle.Width / 3), 0);
							}
							if (rectangle.Contains(mousePosition) || ultraTaskPaneToolbar != null)
							{
								popupElement.ShowDropdown(delay: false);
							}
						}
					}
					else if (popupMenuTool.OwnerIsMenuInternal && popupElement != null)
					{
						popupElement.ShowDropdown(delay: false);
					}
					else if (popupMenuTool.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea && CanCustomizerAffectRibbon && popupElement != null)
					{
						popupElement.ShowDropdown(delay: false);
					}
					else if (popupMenuTool.OwnerIsRibbonGroup && CanCustomizerAffectRibbon && popupElement != null)
					{
						Rectangle rectangle2 = popupMenuTool.UIElement.Control.RectangleToScreen(popupMenuTool.UIElement.Rect);
						rectangle2.Inflate(-Math.Min(5, rectangle2.Width / 3), 0);
						if (rectangle2.Contains(mousePosition))
						{
							popupElement.ShowDropdown(delay: false);
						}
					}
				}
				if (popupMenuTool == null && ToolDragPointInfo.VToolUnderDragPoint != null)
				{
					CloseAllSubmenus(ToolDragPointInfo.VToolUnderDragPoint.Owner);
				}
			}
			SetToolDragCursor(mousePosition);
		}

		internal void OnDragToolEnd()
		{
			Cursor.Current = Cursors.Default;
			bool flag = false;
			ToolDragAction dragAction = ToolDragAction.Copy;
			ToolBase tool = null;
			if (!ToolDragPointInfo.IsOverToolBeingDragged && !ToolDragPointInfo.DragCancelled)
			{
				bool flag2 = (Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Control) != Keys.Control;
				ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollectionBase = (toolBeingDragged.IsRootTool ? null : toolBeingDragged.ParentCollection);
				if (toolsCollectionBase != null && ((((Component)this).DesignMode && toolBeingDragged.InstanceProps != null && toolBeingDragged.InstanceProps.IsFirstInGroup && flag2) || (!((Component)this).DesignMode && toolBeingDragged.IsFirstInGroupResolved && flag2)))
				{
					if (((Component)this).DesignMode)
					{
						toolBeingDragged.InstanceProps.IsFirstInGroup = false;
					}
					else
					{
						toolBeingDragged.CustomizedIsFirstInGroup = (DefaultableBoolean)2;
					}
					int num = toolsCollectionBase.IndexOf(toolBeingDragged);
					if (num + 1 < toolsCollectionBase.Count)
					{
						if (((Component)this).DesignMode)
						{
							toolsCollectionBase[num + 1].InstanceProps.IsFirstInGroup = true;
						}
						else
						{
							toolsCollectionBase[num + 1].CustomizedIsFirstInGroup = (DefaultableBoolean)1;
						}
					}
				}
				if (ToolDragPointInfo.VToolContainingInsertionPoint != null && !ToolDragPointInfo.IsOverNoDropZone)
				{
					bool drawInsertionPointAtFarEnd = ToolDragPointInfo.DrawInsertionPointAtFarEnd;
					ToolsCollectionBase parentCollection = ToolDragPointInfo.VToolContainingInsertionPoint.ParentCollection;
					int num2 = ((ToolDragPointInfo.VToolContainingInsertionPoint.IsTool && !(ToolDragPointInfo.VToolContainingInsertionPoint.Tool is NewToolPlaceHolderTool)) ? parentCollection.IndexOf(ToolDragPointInfo.VToolContainingInsertionPoint.Tool) : parentCollection.Count);
					if (drawInsertionPointAtFarEnd)
					{
						num2++;
					}
					if ((!(ToolBeingDragged is PopupMenuTool) || ((PopupMenuTool)ToolBeingDragged).Tools != parentCollection) && parentCollection != null)
					{
						if (toolsCollectionBase == parentCollection)
						{
							int num3 = toolsCollectionBase.IndexOf(toolBeingDragged);
							int num4 = ((num3 < num2) ? (num2 - 1) : num2);
							if (!toolBeingDragged.AllowMultipleInstancesResolved)
							{
								flag2 = true;
							}
							ToolBase tool2 = ToolDragPointInfo.VToolContainingInsertionPoint.Tool;
							if (tool2 != null)
							{
								string buttonGroup = tool2.InstanceProps.ButtonGroup;
								string buttonGroup2 = toolBeingDragged.InstanceProps.ButtonGroup;
								if (string.Compare(buttonGroup, buttonGroup2, ignoreCase: true) != 0)
								{
									toolBeingDragged.InstanceProps.ButtonGroup = buttonGroup;
								}
							}
							if (flag2)
							{
								toolsCollectionBase.ChangeIndexOf(toolBeingDragged, num4);
							}
							else
							{
								parentCollection.InternalInsertAt(toolBeingDragged, num2, honorReadOnlyStatus: false);
							}
							flag = true;
							dragAction = ((!flag2) ? ToolDragAction.Copy : ToolDragAction.Move);
							tool = (flag2 ? toolBeingDragged : parentCollection[num2]);
							if (ToolDragPointInfo.VToolContainingInsertionPoint.IsTool && !ToolDragPointInfo.DrawInsertionPointAtFarEnd && ToolDragPointInfo.VToolContainingInsertionPoint.Tool.IsFirstInGroupResolved)
							{
								if (((Component)this).DesignMode)
								{
									parentCollection[num4].InstanceProps.IsFirstInGroup = true;
									ToolDragPointInfo.VToolContainingInsertionPoint.Tool.InstanceProps.IsFirstInGroup = false;
								}
								else
								{
									parentCollection[num4].CustomizedIsFirstInGroup = (DefaultableBoolean)1;
									ToolDragPointInfo.VToolContainingInsertionPoint.Tool.CustomizedIsFirstInGroup = (DefaultableBoolean)2;
								}
							}
							RefreshToolCollectionDropDownContents(toolsCollectionBase);
							ToolBeingCustomized = parentCollection[flag2 ? num4 : num2];
						}
						else
						{
							bool flag3 = true;
							try
							{
								num2 = parentCollection.InternalInsertAt(toolBeingDragged, num2, honorReadOnlyStatus: false);
							}
							catch (Exception ex)
							{
								flag3 = false;
								UltraMessageBoxManager.Show(ex.Message, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DragToolErrorTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation);
							}
							if (flag3)
							{
								flag = true;
								dragAction = ((!flag2) ? ToolDragAction.Copy : ToolDragAction.Move);
								tool = parentCollection[num2];
								if (ToolDragPointInfo.VToolContainingInsertionPoint.IsTool && !ToolDragPointInfo.DrawInsertionPointAtFarEnd && ToolDragPointInfo.VToolContainingInsertionPoint.Tool.IsFirstInGroupResolved)
								{
									if (((Component)this).DesignMode)
									{
										parentCollection[num2].InstanceProps.IsFirstInGroup = true;
										ToolDragPointInfo.VToolContainingInsertionPoint.Tool.InstanceProps.IsFirstInGroup = false;
									}
									else
									{
										parentCollection[num2].CustomizedIsFirstInGroup = (DefaultableBoolean)1;
										ToolDragPointInfo.VToolContainingInsertionPoint.Tool.CustomizedIsFirstInGroup = (DefaultableBoolean)2;
									}
								}
								RefreshToolCollectionDropDownContents(parentCollection);
								ToolBeingCustomized = parentCollection[num2];
								ToolBase tool3 = ToolDragPointInfo.VToolContainingInsertionPoint.Tool;
								if (tool3 != null)
								{
									string buttonGroup3 = tool3.InstanceProps.ButtonGroup;
									string buttonGroup4 = ToolBeingCustomized.InstanceProps.ButtonGroup;
									if (string.Compare(buttonGroup3, buttonGroup4, ignoreCase: true) != 0)
									{
										ToolBeingCustomized.InstanceProps.ButtonGroup = buttonGroup3;
									}
								}
								if (flag2 && toolsCollectionBase != null && toolBeingDragged.AllowMultipleInstancesResolved)
								{
									toolsCollectionBase.RemoveHelper(toolBeingDragged, honorReadOnlyStatus: false, allowRemoveForTemporaryToolbar: true);
									RefreshToolCollectionDropDownContents(toolsCollectionBase);
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else if (!toolDragIsPending && flag2 && toolsCollectionBase != null)
				{
					flag = true;
					dragAction = ToolDragAction.Remove;
					tool = toolBeingDragged;
					toolsCollectionBase.RemoveHelper(toolBeingDragged, honorReadOnlyStatus: false, allowRemoveForTemporaryToolbar: true);
					RefreshToolCollectionDropDownContents(toolsCollectionBase);
				}
			}
			if (toolBeingDragged.ParentCollection == null && Customizing && CustomizeDialog != null)
			{
				CustomizeDialog.OnNewCustomizeToolSelected(null, Control.MousePosition);
			}
			toolBeingDragged = null;
			toolDragPointInfo = null;
			bool flag4 = !toolDragIsPending;
			toolDragIsPending = false;
			SetCustomizeDialogCapture(setOn: false);
			if (flag4)
			{
				if (Customizing && CustomizeDialog != null)
				{
					CustomizeDialog.DragItemEnd(DragItemType.Tool);
				}
			}
			else if (Customizing && CustomizeDialog is QuickToolCustomizer)
			{
				ExitCustomizeMode(CustomizeDialog);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				AfterToolDragEventArgs e = new AfterToolDragEventArgs(tool, dragAction);
				FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.AfterToolDragEnd, e);
			}
			((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).DirtyChildElements();
		}

		internal void OnDragToolbarBegin(UltraToolbar toolbar, Point toolbarDragOffset)
		{
			if ((!((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).Enabled && !((Component)this).DesignMode) || (toolbar != null && !toolbar.CanBeDragged))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (dockAreas != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < dockAreas.Length; i++)
				{
					if (dockAreas[i] != null)
					{
						dockAreas[i].ClearLocationSnaphot();
					}
				}
			}
			toolbar.ClearRelativeHiddenToolbars();
			if (!IsFormActiveInternal)
			{
				ActivateFormInternal();
			}
			InternalSetActiveTool(null, setOn: true, clearToolBeingEdited: true, clearToolbarWithCaptureIfNecessary: true);
			if (!IsInEditMode)
			{
				this.toolbarDragOffset = toolbarDragOffset;
				toolbarBeingDragged = toolbar;
				toolbarCapturePoint = Control.MousePosition;
				toolbarLastDragPoint = toolbarCapturePoint;
				originalCapturePoint = toolbarCapturePoint;
				toolbarDragTypeFourWay = true;
				if (toolbar.DockedPosition != DockedPosition.Floating)
				{
					toolbarDragTypePending = true;
				}
				else
				{
					toolbarDragTypePending = false;
				}
				toolbarDragStartDragEventFired = false;
				floatingWindowBeingDragged = GetFloatingWindow(toolbar);
				if (Customizing && customizeDialog != null)
				{
					SetCustomizeDialogCapture(setOn: true);
				}
				if (floatingWindowBeingDragged != null)
				{
					floatingWindowBeingDragged.OnFloatingToolbarFadeTimer();
				}
				Cursor.Current = Cursors.SizeAll;
				GetToolbarDockArea(toolbar)?.ReparentContainedControls(toolbar, takeOwnership: true);
				if (toolbar.DockedPosition != DockedPosition.Floating)
				{
					holdToolbarTargetPositionInDockRow = toolbar.TargetPositionInDockedRow;
				}
				else
				{
					holdToolbarTargetPositionInDockRow = -1;
				}
				if (!toolbarDragTypePending)
				{
					NotifyToolbarDragStart();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnDragToolbarMove()
		{
			bool flag = isInOnDragToolbarMove;
			isInOnDragToolbarMove = true;
			try
			{
				DrawUtility.BeginGraphicsCaching();
				OnDragToolbarMoveHelper();
			}
			finally
			{
				isInOnDragToolbarMove = flag;
				DrawUtility.EndGraphicsCaching();
			}
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		private void VerifyDockedRows()
		{
			if (dockAreas == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraToolbarsDockArea[] array = dockAreas;
			foreach (UltraToolbarsDockArea ultraToolbarsDockArea in array)
			{
				if (ultraToolbarsDockArea == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				int num = 0;
				foreach (UltraToolbar toolbar in Toolbars)
				{
					if (toolbar.VisibleResolved && toolbar.DockedPosition == ultraToolbarsDockArea.DockedPosition)
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
				int num2 = 0;
				foreach (DockRow dockRow in ultraToolbarsDockArea.DockRows)
				{
					num2 += dockRow.Toolbars.Count;
				}
			}
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		private void OutputDockedRowState(string message)
		{
			if (dockAreas == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraToolbarsDockArea[] array = dockAreas;
			foreach (UltraToolbarsDockArea ultraToolbarsDockArea in array)

					if (toolbar.DockedPosition == ultraToolbarsDockArea.DockedPosition)

					}

				for (int j = 0; j < ultraToolbarsDockArea.DockRows.Count; j++)
				{
					DockRow dockRow = ultraToolbarsDockArea.DockRows[j];
					foreach (UltraToolbarBase toolbar2 in dockRow.Toolbars)
					{
					}
					Rectangle[] cachedToolbarPositions = dockRow.CachedToolbarPositions;
					for (int k = 0; k < cachedToolbarPositions.Length - 1; k++)
					{
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnDragToolbarMoveHelper()
		{
			if (toolbarBeingDragged == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Point mousePosition = Control.MousePosition;
			Screen screen = Utilities.ScreenFromPoint(mousePosition);
			if (screen != null)
			{
				Rectangle workingArea = screen.WorkingArea;
				workingArea.Inflate(-5, -5);
				if (!workingArea.Contains(mousePosition))
				{
					mousePosition.X = Math.Min(Math.Max(workingArea.Left, mousePosition.X), workingArea.Right);
					mousePosition.Y = Math.Min(Math.Max(workingArea.Top, mousePosition.Y), workingArea.Bottom);
				}
			}
			bool flag = (((Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Control) == 0) ? (toolbarBeingDragged.DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Floating) : (toolbarBeingDragged.DockedPosition != DockedPosition.Floating));
			if (!flag && (mousePosition == toolbarCapturePoint || mousePosition == toolbarLastDragPoint))
			{
				return;
			}
			toolbarLastDragPoint = mousePosition;
			if (toolbarDragTypePending)
			{
				Size doubleClickSize = ScaledSystemInformation.GetDoubleClickSize(DockWithinContainer);
				if (!new Rectangle(originalCapturePoint.X - 4 * doubleClickSize.Width, originalCapturePoint.Y - 4 * doubleClickSize.Height, 8 * doubleClickSize.Width, 8 * doubleClickSize.Height).Contains(mousePosition))
				{
					toolbarDragTypePending = false;
					NotifyToolbarDragStart();
					bool flag2 = false;
					if (toolbarBeingDragged.UIElement.Control is UltraToolbarsDockArea ultraToolbarsDockArea && toolbarBeingDragged.DockedRow < ultraToolbarsDockArea.DockRows.Count)
					{
						DockRow dockRow = ultraToolbarsDockArea.DockRows[toolbarBeingDragged.DockedRow];
						if (dockRow.Toolbars.Count > 1)
						{
							for (int i = 0; i < dockRow.Toolbars.Count; i++)
							{
								UltraToolbarBase ultraToolbarBase = dockRow.Toolbars[i];
								if (ultraToolbarBase != null && ultraToolbarBase.ToolsHaveBeenBumped)
								{
									flag2 = true;
									break;
								}
							}
						}
					}
					if (flag2)
					{
						if (toolbarBeingDragged.IsVertical)
						{
							if (Math.Abs(originalCapturePoint.X - mousePosition.X) <= doubleClickSize.Width + 1)
							{
								Cursor.Current = Cursors.SizeNS;
								toolbarDragTypeFourWay = false;
							}
						}
						else if (Math.Abs(originalCapturePoint.Y - mousePosition.Y) <= doubleClickSize.Height + 1)
						{
							Cursor.Current = Cursors.SizeWE;
							toolbarDragTypeFourWay = false;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (!toolbarDragStartDragEventFired)
			{
				Size size = new Size(1, 1);
				if (!new Rectangle(originalCapturePoint.X - size.Width, originalCapturePoint.Y - size.Height, 2 * size.Width, 2 * size.Height).Contains(mousePosition))
				{
					FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.ToolbarModified, new ToolbarModifiedEventArgs(toolbarBeingDragged, ToolbarChangeType.StartDrag));
					toolbarDragStartDragEventFired = true;
				}
			}
			UltraToolbarsDockArea ultraToolbarsDockArea2 = (((Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Control) != Keys.None) ? null : ((!toolbarDragTypeFourWay) ? GetToolbarDockArea(toolbarBeingDragged) : DockAreaFromDragPoint(mousePosition)));
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			bool flag3 = false;
			bool flag4 = false;
			if (ultraToolbarsDockArea2 != null)
			{
				if (ultraToolbarsDockArea2.DockedPosition == toolbarBeingDragged.DockedPosition)
				{
					flag3 = true;
				}
				else
				{
					if (toolbarDragTypePending)
					{
						NotifyToolbarDragStart();
					}
					toolbarDragTypePending = false;
					if ((Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Control) != Keys.None)
					{
						flag3 = false;
					}
					else
					{
						switch (ultraToolbarsDockArea2.DockedPosition)
						{
						case DockedPosition.Left:
							flag3 = toolbarBeingDragged.SettingsResolved.AllowDockLeftResolved;
							break;
						case DockedPosition.Top:
							flag3 = toolbarBeingDragged.SettingsResolved.AllowDockTopResolved;
							break;
						case DockedPosition.Right:
							flag3 = toolbarBeingDragged.SettingsResolved.AllowDockRightResolved;
							break;
						case DockedPosition.Bottom:
							flag3 = toolbarBeingDragged.SettingsResolved.AllowDockBottomResolved;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			DockedPosition dockedPosition = toolbarBeingDragged.DockedPosition;
			bool insertNewRow = false;
			DockedPosition dockedPosition2;
			if (ultraToolbarsDockArea2 != null && flag3)
			{
				Point point = ((Control)(object)ultraToolbarsDockArea2).PointToClient(mousePosition);
				Point point2 = mousePosition;
				point.Offset(-toolbarDragOffset.X, -toolbarDragOffset.Y);
				point2.Offset(-toolbarDragOffset.X, -toolbarDragOffset.Y);
				if (toolbarDragTypeFourWay)
				{
					num = ultraToolbarsDockArea2.DockRowIndexFromDragPoint(mousePosition, toolbarBeingDragged, toolbarBeingDragged.DockedRow, out insertNewRow);
					num2 = ((!(num == -1 || insertNewRow)) ? ultraToolbarsDockArea2.DockColumnIndexFromDragPoint(toolbarBeingDragged, point2, num, toolbarBeingDragged.DockedRow, toolbarBeingDragged.DockedColumn) : 0);
					if (num != toolbarBeingDragged.DockedRow || num2 != toolbarBeingDragged.DockedColumn || insertNewRow)
					{
						if (toolbarDragTypePending)
						{
							NotifyToolbarDragStart();
						}
						toolbarDragTypePending = false;
						ultraToolbarsDockArea2.ClearLocationSnaphot();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num = toolbarBeingDragged.DockedRow;
					num2 = toolbarBeingDragged.DockedColumn;
				}
				dockedPosition2 = ultraToolbarsDockArea2.DockedPosition;
				if (toolbarBeingDragged.IsVertical)
				{
					toolbarBeingDragged.TargetPositionInDockedRow = point.Y;
				}
				else
				{
					toolbarBeingDragged.TargetPositionInDockedRow = point.X;
				}
				((num < ultraToolbarsDockArea2.DockRows.Count) ? ultraToolbarsDockArea2.DockRows[num] : null)?.CalculateMetrics();
			}
			else
			{
				if (toolbarBeingDragged.DockedPosition != DockedPosition.Floating)
				{
					if (toolbarDragTypePending)
					{
						NotifyToolbarDragStart();
					}
					toolbarDragTypePending = false;
					if (!toolbarBeingDragged.SettingsResolved.AllowFloatingResolved)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				dockedPosition2 = DockedPosition.Floating;
			}
			if (toolbarBeingDragged != null && toolbarBeingDragged.DockedPosition != DockedPosition.Floating && toolbarBeingDragged.InitialDockPending)
			{
				toolbarBeingDragged.InitialDockPending = false;
			}
			if (!flag4)
			{
				RepositionToolbar(toolbarBeingDragged, dockedPosition2, num, num2, insertNewRow, resetUserDragPosition: false);
				if (ultraToolbarsDockArea2 != null)
				{
					((UltraControlBase)ultraToolbarsDockArea2).Update();
				}
				if (toolbarBeingDragged != null && (toolbarBeingDragged.DockedPosition != dockedPosition2 || toolbarBeingDragged.DockedRow != num || toolbarBeingDragged.DockedColumn != num2) && IsDesignMode)
				{
					((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyDesignEnvironmentOfChange();
				}
			}
			if (toolbarBeingDragged != null && toolbarBeingDragged.DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Floating && floatingWindowBeingDragged != null)
			{
				floatingWindowBeingDragged.OnFloatingToolbarFadeTimer();
				Point location = floatingWindowBeingDragged.Location;
				location.Offset(mousePosition.X - toolbarCapturePoint.X, mousePosition.Y - toolbarCapturePoint.Y);
				toolbarCapturePoint.Offset(mousePosition.X - toolbarCapturePoint.X, mousePosition.Y - toolbarCapturePoint.Y);
				floatingWindowBeingDragged.Location = location;
			}
			if (toolbarBeingDragged != null)
			{
				if (ultraToolbarsDockArea2 != null)
				{
					TransferToolbarDragMouseCapture(ultraToolbarsDockArea2);
				}
				if (dockedPosition != toolbarBeingDragged.DockedPosition)
				{
					ToolbarModifiedEventArgs e = ((toolbarBeingDragged.DockedPosition != DockedPosition.Floating) ? new ToolbarModifiedEventArgs(toolbarBeingDragged, ToolbarChangeType.Docked) : new ToolbarModifiedEventArgs(toolbarBeingDragged, ToolbarChangeType.Undocked));
					FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.ToolbarModified, e);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnDragToolbarEnd()
		{
			if (dockAreas != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < dockAreas.Length; i++)
				{
					if (dockAreas[i] != null)
					{
						dockAreas[i].ClearLocationSnaphot();
					}
				}
			}
			if (toolbarBeingDragged == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			FloatingToolbarWindowBase floatingToolbarWindowBase = floatingWindowBeingDragged;
			if (floatingWindowBeingDragged != null)
			{
				if (toolbarBeingDragged.DockedPosition != DockedPosition.Floating)
				{
					floatingWindowBeingDragged.DockArea.RemoveToolbar(toolbarBeingDragged);
					floatingWindowBeingDragged.Close();
					floatingWindowBeingDragged.Dispose();
					floatingToolbarWindowBase = null;
				}
				floatingWindowBeingDragged = null;
			}
			if (toolbarDragTypePending)
			{
				toolbarBeingDragged = null;
				floatingToolbarWindowBase?.OnFloatingToolbarFadeTimer();
				return;
			}
			UltraToolbar ultraToolbar = toolbarBeingDragged;
			if (ultraToolbar.DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Floating && holdToolbarTargetPositionInDockRow > -1)
			{
				ultraToolbar.TargetPositionInDockedRow = holdToolbarTargetPositionInDockRow;
			}
			toolbarBeingDragged = null;
			GetToolbarDockArea(ultraToolbar)?.ReparentContainedControls(ultraToolbar, takeOwnership: true);
			if (toolbarDragStartDragEventFired)
			{
				FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.ToolbarModified, new ToolbarModifiedEventArgs(ultraToolbar, ToolbarChangeType.EndDrag));
			}
			ultraToolbar.SaveDockedPosition();
			if (floatingToolbarWindowBase != null)
			{
				floatingToolbarWindowBase.OnFloatingToolbarFadeTimer();
				ultraToolbar.InternalSetFloatingLocation(floatingToolbarWindowBase.Location);
			}
			NotifyToolbarDragEnd();
		}

		internal void OnDrawToolResizeRect(Control control, ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			if (toolBeingResized != null && !(toolResizeLastRect == Rectangle.Empty) && control != null && !control.IsDisposed && !control.Disposing && control.RectangleToScreen(control.DisplayRectangle).Contains(toolResizeLastRect))
			{
				Rectangle rect = control.RectangleToClient(toolResizeLastRect);
				rect.Offset(1, 1);
				rect.Width -= 2;
				rect.Height -= 2;
				DrawToolSelectionRect(rect, ref drawParams);
			}
		}

		internal void OnEnforceOffice2007ResolutionChanged()
		{
			if (Initializing)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool enforceOffice2007Resolution = EnforceOffice2007Resolution;
			Hashtable hashtable = null;
			if (enforceOffice2007Resolution)
			{
				hashtable = new Hashtable();
				foreach (UltraToolbar toolbar in Toolbars)
				{
					if (enforceOffice2007Resolution && !toolbar.VisibleResolved)
					{
						hashtable.Add(toolbar, new Point(toolbar.DockedColumn, toolbar.DockedRow));
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (UltraToolbar toolbar2 in Toolbars)
			{
				if (enforceOffice2007Resolution && !toolbar2.VisibleResolved)
				{
					RemoveToolbarFromDockArea(toolbar2);
				}
				else if (!enforceOffice2007Resolution && toolbar2.VisibleResolved)
				{
					AddToolbarToDockArea(toolbar2);
				}
			}
			if (hashtable == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (DictionaryEntry item in hashtable)
			{
				UltraToolbar ultraToolbar = (UltraToolbar)item.Key;
				Point point = (Point)item.Value;
				ultraToolbar.InternalSetDockedColumn(point.X);
				ultraToolbar.InternalSetDockedRow(point.Y);
			}
		}

		internal void OnResizeToolBegin(ToolBase tool, ToolResizeEdges toolResizeInitialEdge)
		{
			if (toolResizeInitialEdge != ToolResizeEdges.Undefined && customizeDialog != null)
			{
				SetCustomizeDialogCapture(setOn: true);
				toolBeingResized = tool;
				toolResizeLastRect = (toolResizeInitialRect = tool.UIElement.Control.RectangleToScreen(tool.UIElement.Rect));
				this.toolResizeInitialEdge = toolResizeInitialEdge;
				toolBeingResized.UIElement.Invalidate(true);
				Rectangle empty = Rectangle.Empty;
				empty = ((this.toolResizeInitialEdge != ToolResizeEdges.Left && this.toolResizeInitialEdge != ToolResizeEdges.Right) ? new Rectangle(toolResizeInitialRect.X + 1, toolResizeInitialRect.Y + 1, toolResizeInitialRect.Width - 1, toolResizeInitialRect.Height - 1) : new Rectangle(toolResizeInitialRect.X + 1, toolResizeInitialRect.Y + 1, toolResizeInitialRect.Width - 1, toolResizeInitialRect.Height - 1));
				ControlPaint.DrawReversibleFrame(empty, SystemColors.Control, FrameStyle.Thick);
			}
		}

		internal void OnResizeToolMove()
		{
			if (toolBeingResized == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Point mousePosition = Control.MousePosition;
			Rectangle rectangle = toolResizeLastRect;
			Rectangle rectangle2 = toolResizeLastRect;
			int num = 0;
			if (toolResizeInitialEdge == ToolResizeEdges.Left)
			{
				num = toolResizeLastRect.Right - mousePosition.X;
			}
			if (toolResizeInitialEdge == ToolResizeEdges.Right)
			{
				num = mousePosition.X - toolResizeLastRect.Left;
			}
			if (toolResizeInitialEdge == ToolResizeEdges.Top)
			{
				num = toolResizeLastRect.Bottom - mousePosition.Y;
			}
			if (toolResizeInitialEdge == ToolResizeEdges.Bottom)
			{
				num = mousePosition.Y - toolResizeLastRect.Top;
			}
			if (toolBeingResized.OwnerIsMenuInternal && toolResizeInitialEdge == ToolResizeEdges.Left && mousePosition.X > toolResizeInitialRect.X)
			{
				rectangle2 = toolResizeInitialRect;
			}
			else if (num < toolBeingResized.MinWidthResolved)
			{
				if (toolResizeInitialEdge == ToolResizeEdges.Left)
				{
					rectangle2.X = rectangle2.Right - toolBeingResized.MinWidthResolved;
					rectangle2.Width = toolBeingResized.MinWidthResolved;
				}
				else if (toolResizeInitialEdge == ToolResizeEdges.Right)
				{
					rectangle2.Width = toolBeingResized.MinWidthResolved;
				}
				else if (toolResizeInitialEdge == ToolResizeEdges.Top)
				{
					rectangle2.Y = rectangle2.Bottom - toolBeingResized.MinWidthResolved;
					rectangle2.Height = toolBeingResized.MinWidthResolved;
				}
				else
				{
					rectangle2.Height = toolBeingResized.MinWidthResolved;
				}
			}
			else if (num > toolBeingResized.MaxWidthResolved && toolBeingResized.MaxWidthResolved > 0)
			{
				if (toolResizeInitialEdge == ToolResizeEdges.Left)
				{
					rectangle2.X = rectangle2.Right - toolBeingResized.MaxWidthResolved;
					rectangle2.Width = toolBeingResized.MaxWidthResolved;
				}
				else if (toolResizeInitialEdge == ToolResizeEdges.Right)
				{
					rectangle2.Width = toolBeingResized.MaxWidthResolved;
				}
				else if (toolResizeInitialEdge == ToolResizeEdges.Top)
				{
					rectangle2.Y = rectangle2.Bottom - toolBeingResized.MaxWidthResolved;
					rectangle2.Height = toolBeingResized.MaxWidthResolved;
				}
				else
				{
					rectangle2.Height = toolBeingResized.MaxWidthResolved;
				}
			}
			else if (toolBeingResized.OwnerIsToolbarInternal && !toolBeingResized.IsOrientationSwitched)
			{
				Rectangle rectangle3 = toolBeingResized.UIElement.Control.RectangleToScreen(toolBeingResized.UIElement.Control.DisplayRectangle);
				if (toolResizeInitialEdge == ToolResizeEdges.Left && mousePosition.X < rectangle3.Left)
				{
					rectangle2.X = rectangle3.Left;
					rectangle2.Width = toolResizeInitialRect.Right - rectangle3.Left;
				}
				else if (toolResizeInitialEdge == ToolResizeEdges.Right && mousePosition.X > rectangle3.Right)
				{
					rectangle2.Width = rectangle3.Right - rectangle2.Left;
				}
				else if (toolResizeInitialEdge == ToolResizeEdges.Top && mousePosition.Y < rectangle3.Top)
				{
					rectangle2.Y = rectangle3.Top;
					rectangle2.Height = toolResizeInitialRect.Bottom - rectangle3.Top;
				}
				else if (toolResizeInitialEdge == ToolResizeEdges.Bottom && mousePosition.Y > rectangle3.Bottom)
				{
					rectangle2.Height = rectangle3.Bottom - rectangle2.Top;
				}
				else if (toolResizeInitialEdge == ToolResizeEdges.Left)
				{
					rectangle2.X = rectangle2.Right - num;
					rectangle2.Width = num;
				}
				else if (toolResizeInitialEdge == ToolResizeEdges.Right)
				{
					rectangle2.Width = num;
				}
				else if (toolResizeInitialEdge == ToolResizeEdges.Top)
				{
					rectangle2.Y = rectangle2.Bottom - num;
					rectangle2.Height = num;
				}
				else
				{
					rectangle2.Height = num;
				}
			}
			else if (toolResizeInitialEdge == ToolResizeEdges.Left)
			{
				rectangle2.X = rectangle2.Right - num;
				rectangle2.Width = num;
			}
			else if (toolResizeInitialEdge == ToolResizeEdges.Right)
			{
				rectangle2.Width = num;
			}
			else if (toolResizeInitialEdge == ToolResizeEdges.Top)
			{
				rectangle2.Y = rectangle2.Bottom - num;
				rectangle2.Height = num;
			}
			else
			{
				rectangle2.Height = num;
			}
			if (!rectangle2.Equals(rectangle))
			{
				Rectangle empty = Rectangle.Empty;
				empty = ((toolResizeInitialEdge == ToolResizeEdges.Left) ? new Rectangle(rectangle.X + 1, rectangle.Y + 1, rectangle.Width - 1, rectangle.Height - 1) : ((toolResizeInitialEdge == ToolResizeEdges.Right) ? new Rectangle(rectangle.X, rectangle.Y + 1, rectangle.Width, rectangle.Height - 1) : ((toolResizeInitialEdge != ToolResizeEdges.Top) ? new Rectangle(rectangle.X + 1, rectangle.Y, rectangle.Width - 1, rectangle.Height) : new Rectangle(rectangle.X + 1, rectangle.Y + 1, rectangle.Width - 1, rectangle.Height - 1))));
				ControlPaint.DrawReversibleFrame(empty, SystemColors.Control, FrameStyle.Thick);
				Rectangle empty2 = Rectangle.Empty;
				empty2 = ((toolResizeInitialEdge == ToolResizeEdges.Left) ? new Rectangle(rectangle2.X + 1, rectangle2.Y + 1, rectangle2.Width - 1, rectangle2.Height - 1) : ((toolResizeInitialEdge == ToolResizeEdges.Right) ? new Rectangle(rectangle2.X, rectangle2.Y + 1, rectangle2.Width, rectangle2.Height - 1) : ((toolResizeInitialEdge != ToolResizeEdges.Top) ? new Rectangle(rectangle2.X + 1, rectangle2.Y + 1, rectangle2.Width - 1, rectangle2.Height - 1) : new Rectangle(rectangle2.X + 1, rectangle2.Y + 1, rectangle2.Width - 1, rectangle2.Height - 1))));
				ControlPaint.DrawReversibleFrame(empty2, SystemColors.Control, FrameStyle.Thick);
				toolResizeLastRect = rectangle2;
			}
		}

		internal void OnResizeToolEnd()
		{
			Cursor.Current = Cursors.Default;
			Rectangle empty = Rectangle.Empty;
			empty = ((toolResizeInitialEdge == ToolResizeEdges.Left) ? new Rectangle(toolResizeLastRect.X + 1, toolResizeLastRect.Y + 1, toolResizeLastRect.Width - 1, toolResizeLastRect.Height - 1) : ((toolResizeInitialEdge == ToolResizeEdges.Right) ? new Rectangle(toolResizeLastRect.X, toolResizeLastRect.Y + 1, toolResizeLastRect.Width, toolResizeLastRect.Height - 1) : ((toolResizeInitialEdge != ToolResizeEdges.Top) ? new Rectangle(toolResizeLastRect.X + 1, toolResizeLastRect.Y, toolResizeLastRect.Width - 1, toolResizeLastRect.Height) : new Rectangle(toolResizeLastRect.X + 1, toolResizeLastRect.Y + 1, toolResizeLastRect.Width - 1, toolResizeLastRect.Height - 1))));
			ControlPaint.DrawReversibleFrame(empty, SystemColors.Control, FrameStyle.Thick);
			if (toolResizeInitialEdge == ToolResizeEdges.Left || toolResizeInitialEdge == ToolResizeEdges.Right)
			{
				int num = 0;
				num = (toolBeingResized.OwnerIsToolbarInternal ? (toolResizeLastRect.Width - toolResizeInitialRect.Width) : ((!(toolBeingResized.UIElement.GetContext(typeof(MenuItemBase), true) is MenuItemBase menuItemBase)) ? (toolResizeLastRect.Width - toolResizeInitialRect.Width) : (toolResizeLastRect.Width - toolResizeInitialRect.Width + menuItemBase.MenuAgent.GetMenuItemWidthDelta(menuItemBase))));
				toolBeingResized.UnderlyingTool.InstanceProps.Width = toolBeingResized.ResizableExtentResolved + num;
			}
			else
			{
				toolBeingResized.UnderlyingTool.InstanceProps.Width = toolBeingResized.ResizableExtentResolved + (toolResizeLastRect.Height - toolResizeInitialRect.Height);
			}
			if (toolBeingResized.OwnerIsMenuInternal)
			{
				toolBeingResized.OwningMenuInternal.MenuAgent.RecalculateDropdownSize();
			}
			toolBeingResized = null;
			toolResizeLastRect = Rectangle.Empty;
			SetCustomizeDialogCapture(setOn: false);
			((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).DirtyChildElements();
		}

		internal void OnRibbonVisibleChanged()

			if (CanInitializeRoundedForm)

				ForceExitEditMode();
				((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).DirtyChildElements();
				SynchronizeFormBorderStyle(initializing: false);
				if (!Initializing)
				{
					RefreshPreferredViewStyleOnSiblingComponents();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnTaskPaneContentControlLeave(UltraTaskPaneToolbar toolbar)
		{
			if (toolbar != null && toolbar == LastActiveTaskPane)
			{
				LastActiveTaskPane = null;
				VerifyActiveTaskPaneToolbar();
			}
		}

		internal void OnTaskPaneContentControlEnter(UltraTaskPaneToolbar toolbar)
		{
			LastActiveTaskPane = toolbar;
		}

		internal static bool OwnerIsPopup(object owner)
		{
			if (owner is RibbonGroup ribbonGroup)
			{
				if (ribbonGroup.Ribbon.HasTabMenuAgent && ribbonGroup.Ribbon.TabMenuAgent.IsOpen)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (ribbonGroup.IsGroupPopupOpen)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (ribbonGroup.OwningPopupTool != null)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (owner is ApplicationMenuArea || owner is ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (owner is NavigationMenu)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(owner is PopupToolBase))
			{
				if (owner is UltraToolbar)
				{
					return ((UltraToolbar)owner).ToolbarType == ToolbarType.Popup;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void PerformExitEditModeTasks()
		{
			if (ToolBeingEdited != null)
			{
				FontListTool fontListTool = ToolBeingEdited.UnderlyingTool as FontListTool;
				EmbeddableEditorBase editor = ToolBeingEdited.Editor;
				FontNameEditor val = (FontNameEditor)(object)((editor is FontNameEditor) ? editor : null);
				if (fontListTool != null && val != null)
				{
					fontListTool.MruItems.All = ((EditorWithCombo)val).MRUList;
				}
			}
		}

		internal static bool PointInToolResizeArea(ToolResizeEdges resizeArea, Rectangle toolRect, Point point)
		{
			if (resizeArea == ToolResizeEdges.Undefined)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Rectangle empty = Rectangle.Empty;
			int num = 5;
			List<int> list = new List<int>(4);
			if ((resizeArea & ToolResizeEdges.Top) == ToolResizeEdges.Top)
			{
				list.Add(1);
			}
			if ((resizeArea & ToolResizeEdges.Bottom) == ToolResizeEdges.Bottom)
			{
				list.Add(2);
			}
			if ((resizeArea & ToolResizeEdges.Left) == ToolResizeEdges.Left)
			{
				list.Add(4);
			}
			if ((resizeArea & ToolResizeEdges.Right) == ToolResizeEdges.Right)
			{
				list.Add(8);
			}
			foreach (int item in list)
			{
				empty = toolRect;
				switch (item)
				{
				case 1:
					empty.Height = num;
					break;
				case 2:
					empty.Y = empty.Bottom - num;
					empty.Height = num;
					break;
				case 4:
					empty.Width = num;
					break;
				case 8:
					empty.X = empty.Right - num;
					empty.Width = num;
					break;
				}
				if (empty.Contains(point))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ProcessCtrlTabNavigation()
		{
			if (ToolBeingResized == null && !Customizing && ToolbarBeingDragged == null && ToolBeingDragged == null && tearawayBeingDragged == null)
			{
				object objectWithFocus = ObjectWithFocus;
				if (objectWithFocus == null && LastActiveTaskPane != null && IsTaskPaneToolbarActive(LastActiveTaskPane))
				{
					objectWithFocus = LastActiveTaskPane;
				}
				if (objectWithFocus != null && (Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Control) == Keys.Control)
				{
					object obj = null;
					obj = ((objectWithFocus is Ribbon) ? ((object)Ribbon) : ((object)((!(objectWithFocus is ToolBase)) ? (objectWithFocus as UltraToolbarBase) : GetRootToolbar((ToolBase)objectWithFocus))));
					if (obj != null)
					{
						bool flag = (Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Shift) == 0;
						ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList(Toolbars);
						if (HasNavigationToolbar && NavigationToolbar.VisibleResolved)
						{
							arrayList.Add(NavigationToolbar);
						}
						if (HasRibbon && Ribbon.VisibleResolved)
						{
							arrayList.Add(Ribbon);
						}
						int count = arrayList.Count;
						int num = arrayList.IndexOf(obj);
						int num2 = (flag ? 1 : (-1));
						num += num2 + count;
						for (int i = 0; i < count - 1; i++)
						{
							object obj2 = arrayList[num % count];
							if (obj2 is UltraToolbarBase ultraToolbarBase)
							{
								if (ultraToolbarBase.VisibleResolved)
								{
									ToolBase nextTool = ultraToolbarBase.Tools.GetNextTool(null, visibleToolsOnly: true, selectableToolsOnly: true, recentlyUsedToolsOnly: true, wrapAround: false);
									if (nextTool != null)
									{
										if (obj is Ribbon)
										{
											((Ribbon)obj).ClearItemWithFocus();
										}
										CloseAllOpenToolbarSubmenus();
										if (ultraToolbarBase is UltraTaskPaneToolbar)
										{
											ToolOwnerWithCapture = null;
											ActiveTool = null;
											((UltraTaskPaneToolbar)ultraToolbarBase).Activate(honorAutoActivate: false);
										}
										else
										{
											ToolOwnerWithCapture = ultraToolbarBase;
											ActiveTool = nextTool;
										}
										return true;
									}
								}
							}
							else if (obj2 is Ribbon)
							{
								Ribbon.ToggleItemWithFocus();
								return true;
							}
							num += num2;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ProcessMenuMouseDownWhileCustomizing(ControlUIElementBase controlElement, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (controlElement == null || !Customizing)
			{
				return true;
			}
			Control control = ((UIElement)controlElement).Control;
			if (control == null || control.IsDisposed || control.Disposing)
			{
				return true;
			}
			Point point = new Point(e.X, e.Y);
			UIElement val = ((UIElement)controlElement).ElementFromPoint(point);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (control is ApplicationMenuControl)
			{
				UIElement ancestor = val.GetAncestor(typeof(ApplicationMenuButtonUIElementBase));
				if (ancestor != null)
				{
					Ribbon.ApplicationMenu.MenuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay: false);
					return true;
				}
			}
			MenuItemBase menuItemBase = null;
			while ((object)val != controlElement)
			{
				menuItemBase = val.GetContext(typeof(MenuItemBase), false) as MenuItemBase;
				if (menuItemBase != null)
				{
					break;
				}
				val = val.Parent;
			}
			if (menuItemBase is GalleryToolFilterMenuItem)
			{
				menuItemBase.IsBeingCustomized = true;
			}
			if (menuItemBase == null || menuItemBase.Tool == null || menuItemBase.ParentCollection == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (menuItemBase.Tool.IsSpecialTool || !menuItemBase.Tool.CanBeModified)
			{
				if (menuItemBase.Tool is NewToolPlaceHolderTool && Customizing)
				{
					Point screenPt = control.PointToScreen(new Point(e.X, e.Y));
					CustomizeDialog.DisplayNewToolContextMenu(menuItemBase.Tool as NewToolPlaceHolderTool, screenPt);
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (menuItemBeingCustomized != null && !menuItemBeingCustomized.Disposed && menuItemBeingCustomized.ParentCollection != null)
			{
				menuItemBeingCustomized.IsBeingCustomized = false;
			}
			menuItemBase.IsBeingCustomized = true;
			menuItemBeingCustomized = menuItemBase;
			if (menuItemBase is GalleryToolMenuItem)
			{
				UIElement val2 = ((UIElement)controlElement).ElementFromPoint(point);
				if (val2.GetAncestor(typeof(PopupGalleryFilterBarUIElement)) is PopupGalleryFilterBarUIElement popupGalleryFilterBarUIElement)
				{
					if (((UIElement)popupGalleryFilterBarUIElement).GetContext(typeof(PopupGalleryTool)) is PopupGalleryTool popupGalleryTool)
					{
						popupGalleryTool.ShowFilterListPopup(control, ((UIElement)popupGalleryFilterBarUIElement).Rect, activateFirstItem: true);
					}
				}
				else if (customizeDialog != null)
				{
					if (val2.GetContext(typeof(GalleryToolItem)) is GalleryToolItem item)
					{
						customizeDialog.OnGalleryItemClicked(item);
					}
					else if (val2.GetContext(typeof(GalleryToolItemGroup)) is GalleryToolItemGroup galleryToolItemGroup && galleryToolItemGroup != galleryToolItemGroup.GalleryTool.DefaultGroup)
					{
						customizeDialog.OnGalleryGroupClicked(galleryToolItemGroup);
					}
				}
			}
			if (IsDesignMode && menuItemBase.Tool.UnderlyingTool is PopupToolBase { IsOnBackStage: not false } && e.Button == MouseButtons.Left)
			{
				menuItemBase.OnClick();
			}
			if (menuItemBase.Tool != null && menuItemBase.Tool.UnderlyingTool is PopupMenuTool && e.Button == MouseButtons.Left)
			{
				menuItemBase.MenuAgent.CloseOpenSubmenuTools(menuItemBase, delay: false);
			}
			else
			{
				menuItemBase.MenuAgent.CloseOpenSubmenuTools(null, delay: false);
			}
			val.Parent.Invalidate();
			if (e.Button == MouseButtons.Right)
			{
				Point location = control.PointToScreen(new Point(e.X, e.Y));
				menuItemBase.DisplayCustomizeContextMenu(location);
			}
			if (menuItemBase.Tool != null && menuItemBase.Tool.UnderlyingTool is PopupMenuTool && e.Button == MouseButtons.Left)
			{
				if (menuItemBase.IsOpen)
				{
					menuItemBase.CloseDropDown(delay: false);
				}
				else
				{
					Rectangle rect;
					if (IsNonOffice2000Style)
					{
						if (val.GetAncestor(typeof(PopupMenuControlUIElement)) is PopupMenuControlUIElement popupMenuControlUIElement)
						{
							rect = ((UIElement)popupMenuControlUIElement).Rect;
							rect.Inflate(-1, -1);
						}
						else
						{
							rect = val.Rect;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						rect = val.Rect;
					}
					Point p = new Point(rect.Right, val.Rect.Top);
					menuItemBase.DropDown((Control)(object)menuItemBase.MenuAgent.PopupControl, control.PointToScreen(p), control.RectangleToScreen(rect), (DropDownPosition)2, delay: false, closeIfAlreadyOpen: false, alignRight: false, !Customizing);
				}
			}
			else if (IsDesignMode && menuItemBase is TaskPaneToolMenuItem && menuItemBase.Tool != null && menuItemBase.GetImageRect(val).Contains(point))
			{
				menuItemBase.OnClick();
			}
			UIElement val3 = ((UIElement)controlElement).ElementFromPoint(point);
			if (val3 != null && val3.GetAncestor(typeof(ScrollBarUIElement)) != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (e.Button == MouseButtons.Left)
			{
				if (val.PointInAdjustableArea(point))
				{
					OnResizeToolBegin(menuItemBase.Tool, ElementEdgeContainingPoint(val, point));
				}
				else
				{
					OnDragToolBegin(menuItemBase.Tool);
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool ProcessToolbarMouseDownWhileCustomizing(ControlUIElementBase controlElement, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_06f3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_06ee: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_070c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_06fb: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (controlElement == null || !Customizing)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Control control = ((UIElement)controlElement).Control;
			if (control == null || control.IsDisposed || control.Disposing)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Point point = new Point(e.X, e.Y);
			UIElement val = ((UIElement)controlElement).ElementFromPoint(point);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (CanCustomizerAffectRibbon)
			{
				UIElement ancestor = val.GetAncestor(typeof(ApplicationMenuButtonUIElementBase));
				if (ancestor != null)
				{
					ApplicationMenuAgentBase applicationMenuAgentBase = null;
					ApplicationMenuBase resolvedFileMenu = ribbon.GetResolvedFileMenu();
					if (resolvedFileMenu != null)
					{
						applicationMenuAgentBase = resolvedFileMenu.MenuAgent;
					}
					if (applicationMenuAgentBase != null)
					{
						if (applicationMenuAgentBase.IsOpen)
						{
							applicationMenuAgentBase.CloseDropDown(delay: false);
						}
						else
						{
							CloseAllOpenToolbarSubmenus();
							applicationMenuAgentBase.DropDown(ancestor.Rect);
						}
						return true;
					}
				}
				if (val.GetAncestor(typeof(ApplicationMenuBackButtonUIElement)) != null)
				{
					ribbon.ApplicationMenu2010.CloseDropDown();
				}
				if (val.GetAncestor(typeof(RibbonTabItemUIElement)) is RibbonTabItemUIElement ribbonTabItemUIElement)
				{
					Ribbon.SelectTabViaDesigner(((TabItemUIElement)ribbonTabItemUIElement).TabItem);
					if ((object)((TabItemUIElement)ribbonTabItemUIElement).TabItem == Ribbon.DesignerAddTab)
					{
						return true;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}
			UltraToolbar ultraToolbar = null;
			if (control is FloatingToolbarWindow)
			{
				if (e.Button != MouseButtons.Left)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (val is FloatingToolbarCaptionAreaUIElement || val.GetAncestor(typeof(FloatingToolbarCaptionAreaUIElement)) != null)
				{
					PopupManager.CloseAllPopups();
				}
				if (val is TextUIElement)
				{
					val = val.Parent;
				}
				if (!(val is FloatingToolbarCaptionAreaUIElement))
				{
					return false;
				}
				ultraToolbar = ((FloatingToolbarWindow)control).Toolbar;
			}
			if (e.Button == MouseButtons.Left)
			{
				if (val is GrabHandleUIElement)
				{
					ultraToolbar = ((GrabHandleUIElement)(object)val).Toolbar;
				}
				else if (val is ToolbarUIElement)
				{
					ultraToolbar = ((ToolbarUIElement)(object)val).Toolbar;
				}
				else if (val is TaskPaneToolbarUIElement)
				{
					ultraToolbar = ((TaskPaneToolbarUIElement)(object)val).Toolbar;
				}
				else if (val is ToolSeparatorUIElement || val is PagerContentAreaUIElement || val is NavigationButtonAreaUIElement || val is NavigationToolSeparatorUIElement)
				{
					ultraToolbar = val.GetContext(typeof(UltraToolbar)) as UltraToolbar;
				}
			}
			if (ultraToolbar != null)
			{
				if (ultraToolbar.OwningTaskPaneToolbar != null)
				{
					ultraToolbar = ultraToolbar.OwningTaskPaneToolbar;
				}
				if (!ultraToolbar.CanBeModified)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!ultraToolbar.CanBeDragged)
				{
					return false;
				}
				Point point2 = ToolbarUIElement.GetToolbarDragOffset(ultraToolbar, ultraToolbar.UIElement, point);
				OnDragToolbarBegin(ultraToolbar, point2);
				return true;
			}
			ToolBase toolBase = null;
			while ((object)val != controlElement)
			{
				toolBase = val.GetContext(typeof(ToolBase), false) as ToolBase;
				if (toolBase != null)
				{
					break;
				}
				val = val.Parent;
			}
			if (toolBase == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (toolBase.OwnerIsToolbarsManager)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (toolBase is QatQuickCustomizeTool && !Ribbon.QuickAccessToolbar.ToolsHaveBeenBumped)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (toolBase.IsSpecialTool && !(toolBase is TaskPaneToolbarMenuTool) && !(toolBase is QatQuickCustomizeTool))
			{
				if (toolBase is TaskPaneToolbarLabelTool && ((TaskPaneToolbarLabelTool)toolBase).OwningTaskPaneToolbar.ShowInsertNewToolMessage)
				{
					CloseAllOpenToolbarSubmenus();
					toolBase = ((TaskPaneToolbarLabelTool)toolBase).OwningTaskPaneToolbar.Tools.NewToolPlaceHolder;
				}
				if ((e.Button == MouseButtons.Left && CustomizeDialog != null && toolBase != null && toolBase.OwnerIsToolbarInternal && toolBase.OwningToolbarInternal.OwningTaskPaneToolbar != null) || (toolBase.OwnerIsMenuInternal && toolBase.OwningMenuInternal is TaskPaneToolbarMenuTool))
				{
					CustomizeDialog.SetCapture(capture: true);
				}
				if (toolBase is NewToolPlaceHolderTool)
				{
					Point screenPt = val.Control.PointToScreen(new Point(e.X, e.Y));
					CustomizeDialog.DisplayNewToolContextMenu(toolBase as NewToolPlaceHolderTool, screenPt);
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (toolBase.OwnerIsToolbarInternal && !toolBase.OwningToolbarInternal.AllowCustomizeResolved)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (toolBase.OwnerIsRibbonGroup && !CanCustomizerAffectRibbon)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (toolBase.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea && !CanCustomizerAffectRibbon)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = true;
			if (toolBase != null && (toolBase.IsSpecialTool || !toolBase.CanBeModified))
			{
				ToolBeingCustomized = null;
			}
			else
			{
				ToolBeingCustomized = toolBase;
				if (toolBase is PopupGalleryTool && customizeDialog != null)
				{
					UIElement val2 = ((UIElement)controlElement).ElementFromPoint(point);
					if (val2.GetContext(typeof(GalleryToolItem)) is GalleryToolItem item)
					{
						customizeDialog.OnGalleryItemClicked(item);
						flag = false;
					}
					else if (val2.GetAncestor(typeof(GalleryPreviewUIElement)) != null)
					{
						if (val2.GetAncestor(typeof(GalleryPreviewButtonUIElement)) is GalleryPreviewButtonUIElement galleryPreviewButtonUIElement)
						{
							if (!(galleryPreviewButtonUIElement is GalleryPreviewDropDownButtonUIElement))
							{
								flag = false;
								((ButtonUIElementBase)galleryPreviewButtonUIElement).PerformClick();
							}
						}
						else
						{
							flag = false;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			PopupToolBase popupToolBase = toolBase as PopupToolBase;
			if (flag && (popupToolBase is PopupMenuTool || toolBase is QatQuickCustomizeTool))
			{
				if (e.Button == MouseButtons.Right && !toolBase.IsSpecialTool)
				{
					if (!OwnerIsPopup(popupToolBase.OwnerInternal))
					{
						CloseAllOpenToolbarSubmenus();
					}
					Point pt = control.PointToScreen(new Point(e.X, e.Y));
					if (CustomizeDialog != null)
					{
						CustomizeDialog.DisplayToolContextMenu(popupToolBase, pt);
					}
				}
				if (e.Button == MouseButtons.Left)
				{
					if (popupToolBase.IsOpen)
					{
						popupToolBase.CloseDropDown(delay: false);
					}
					else
					{
						if (!OwnerIsPopup(popupToolBase.OwnerInternal))
						{
							CloseAllOpenToolbarSubmenus();
						}
						Control control2 = null;
						control2 = popupToolBase.GetDropDownOwner(control);
						Rectangle rectangle = control.RectangleToScreen(val.Rect);
						bool flag2 = !popupToolBase.OverlapMenuBorders;
						Point point3 = ((popupToolBase.OwningToolbarInternal != null && popupToolBase.OwningToolbarInternal.OwningTaskPaneToolbar != null) ? ((!flag2) ? control.PointToScreen(new Point(val.Rect.Right - popupToolBase.MenuAgent.CalculateRequiredDropDownSize().Width, val.Rect.Bottom - 1)) : control.PointToScreen(new Point(val.Rect.Right - popupToolBase.MenuAgent.CalculateRequiredDropDownSize().Width, val.Rect.Bottom))) : (popupToolBase.IsArrangedVertically ? ((!flag2) ? control.PointToScreen(new Point(val.Rect.X + 1, val.Rect.Top)) : control.PointToScreen(new Point(val.Rect.X, val.Rect.Top))) : ((!flag2) ? control.PointToScreen(new Point(val.Rect.X, val.Rect.Bottom - 1)) : control.PointToScreen(new Point(val.Rect.X, val.Rect.Bottom)))));
						DropDownPosition val3 = ((!popupToolBase.IsArrangedVertically) ? ((DropDownPosition)0) : ((DropDownPosition)1));
						if (!flag2)
						{
							rectangle = PopupToolUIElement.GetMenuDropDownExclusionRect(rectangle, val3);
						}
						popupToolBase.DropDown(control2, point3, rectangle, val3, delay: false, closeIfAlreadyOpen: true, alignRight: false, !Customizing, null);
					}
				}
				if (e.Button == MouseButtons.Left && !toolBase.IsSpecialTool)
				{
					OnDragToolBegin(popupToolBase);
				}
				else if (e.Button == MouseButtons.Left && CustomizeDialog != null && toolBase is TaskPaneToolbarMenuTool)
				{
					CustomizeDialog.SetCapture(capture: true);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (!OwnerIsPopup(toolBase.OwnerInternal))
				{
					CloseAllOpenToolbarSubmenus();
				}
				if (e.Button == MouseButtons.Right)
				{
					Point pt2 = val.Control.PointToScreen(new Point(e.X, e.Y));
					if (CustomizeDialog != null)
					{
						CustomizeDialog.DisplayToolContextMenu(toolBase, pt2);
					}
				}
				if (e.Button == MouseButtons.Left)
				{
					if (val.PointInAdjustableArea(point))
					{
						OnResizeToolBegin(toolBase, ElementEdgeContainingPoint(val, point));
					}
					else
					{
						OnDragToolBegin(toolBase);
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static void RaiseMouseHookEvent(MouseHookEventArgs e)
		{
			if (mouseHookDelegate != null)
			{
				mouseHookDelegate(null, e);
			}
		}

		internal void RefreshActiveTool()
		{
			if (!IsFormActiveInternal)
			{
				return;
			}
			Point mousePosition = Control.MousePosition;
			for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
			{
				UltraToolbarsDockArea ultraToolbarsDockArea = dockAreas[i];
				if (ultraToolbarsDockArea == null || !((Control)(object)ultraToolbarsDockArea).IsHandleCreated || ultraToolbarsDockArea.ControlElement == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				Point point = ((Control)(object)ultraToolbarsDockArea).PointToClient(mousePosition);
				if (!((Control)(object)ultraToolbarsDockArea).ClientRectangle.Contains(point))
				{
					continue;
				}
				UIElement val = ((UIElement)ultraToolbarsDockArea.ControlElement).ElementFromPoint(point);
				if (val != null)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase = (ToolBase)val.GetContext(typeof(ToolBase));
					if (toolBase != null)
					{
						ImmediateToolTipDisplayMode = false;
						toolBase.DisplayToolTip();
						InternalSetActiveTool(toolBase, setOn: true, clearToolBeingEdited: false);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RefreshEnteredElementsOnDockAreas()
		{
			UltraToolbarsDockArea[] array = GetDockAreas();
			if (array != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					ToolbarsManagerUtilities.RefreshLastElementEntered((Control)(object)array[i]);
				}
			}
			foreach (FloatingToolbarWindowBase floatingWindow in FloatingWindows)
			{
				ToolbarsManagerUtilities.RefreshLastElementEntered(floatingWindow);
				if (floatingWindow != null)
				{
					ToolbarsManagerUtilities.RefreshLastElementEntered((Control)(object)floatingWindow.DockArea);
				}
			}
		}

		private void RefreshStatusBar()
		{
			if (IsDesignMode || DockWithinContainer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			string statusText = null;
			if (Customizing)
			{
				statusText = string.Empty;
			}
			else
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = ActiveTool;
				if (toolBase != null && toolBase.ToolbarsManager == this)
				{
					statusText = toolBase.StatusTextResolved;
				}
				else
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			foreach (Control control in DockWithinContainer.Controls)
			{
				IStatusBar val = (IStatusBar)(object)((control is IStatusBar) ? control : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					val.AutoSense = flag;
					if (!flag)
					{
						val.StatusText = statusText;
					}
					val.ToolbarsManager = (IToolbarsManager)(object)this;
				}
			}
		}

		private void RefreshPreferredViewStyleOnSiblingComponents()
		{
			if (!Initialized || DockWithinContainer == null || !DockWithinContainer.IsHandleCreated)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Control control in DockWithinContainer.Controls)
			{
				IStatusBar val = (IStatusBar)(object)((control is IStatusBar) ? control : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					val.ToolbarsManager = (IToolbarsManager)(object)this;
				}
			}
			if (dockWithinContainer is Form && !((Form)dockWithinContainer).IsMdiChild && (IsTabbedMdi || tabbedMdiManager != null) && tabbedMdiManager != null)
			{

			}
		}

		internal void RemoveToolbarFromDockArea(UltraToolbar toolbar)
		{
			if (toolbar.DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Floating)
			{
				FloatingToolbarWindowBase floatingWindow = GetFloatingWindow(toolbar);
				if (floatingWindow == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (IsToolbarBeingDragged(toolbar))
				{
					TransferToolbarDragMouseCapture(GetToolbarDockArea(toolbar));
					floatingWindow.DockArea.ReparentContainedControls(toolbar, takeOwnership: false);
					if (toolbar.DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Floating)
					{
						DestroyPagerControlForToolbar(toolbar, floatingWindow.DockArea);
					}
					try
					{
						if (floatingWindow == ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ActiveForm)
						{
							ActivateFormInternal();
						}
					}
					catch
					{
						ActivateFormInternal();
					}
					floatingWindow.Hide();
				}
				else
				{
					toolbar.InternalSetFloatingLocation(floatingWindow.Location);
					toolbar.InternalSetFloatingSize(((Control)(object)floatingWindow.DockArea).Size);
					floatingWindow.DockArea.RemoveToolbar(toolbar);
					floatingWindow.Close();
					floatingWindow.Dispose();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				int dockedPosition = (int)toolbar.DockedPosition;
				if (dockAreas[dockedPosition] != null)
				{
					dockAreas[dockedPosition].RemoveToolbar(toolbar);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static bool ShouldActivateToolControlAndForm(ToolBase tool)
		{
			if (tool is TaskPaneTool)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (tool != null && WPFInteropUtilities.GetWpfWindow(tool.ToolbarsManagerInControl.DockWithinContainer) != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(tool is PopupControlContainerTool popupControlContainerTool))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (popupControlContainerTool != null && popupControlContainerTool.Control != null && !popupControlContainerTool.Control.CanSelect && !popupControlContainerTool.Control.HasChildren)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void ReparentControl(Control control, Control newParent, ToolBase rootTool)
