				ReparentControl(control, newParent, rootTool, control.Location);
			}
		}

		internal void ReparentControl(Control control, Control newParent, ToolBase rootTool, Point location)
		{
			if (((Component)this).DesignMode || ((IsDisposed || isDisposing) && dockWithinContainer == null && newParent == null) || (control != null && control.IsDisposed))
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = newParent != null;
			MdiTabStopHelper mdiTabStopHelper = null;
			try
			{
				Control parent = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetParent(control);
				if (parent == newParent)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = ((MdiParentManagerInternal != null && IsMdiMerged) ? MdiParentManagerInternal : this);
					mdiTabStopHelper = MdiTabStopHelper.PrepareTabStops(ultraToolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer as Form);
					control.Visible = false;
				}
				if (parent != null)
				{
					Control parent2 = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetParent(parent);
					if (parent2 != null)
					{
						IContainerControl containerControl = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetContainerControl(parent2);
						if (containerControl != null && (containerControl.ActiveControl == control || control.Contains(containerControl.ActiveControl)))
						{
							try
							{
								containerControl.ActiveControl = parent;
							}
							catch (SecurityException)
							{
							}
						}
					}
					ToolbarsManagerUtilities.SetParent(control, null);
				}
				if (control != null && control.IsDisposed)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					control.Visible = false;
					newParent = ((rootTool != null) ? rootTool.UnderlyingTool.ToolbarsManager.GetParentForHiddenContainedControls() : GetParentForHiddenContainedControls());
				}
				if (newParent != null)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						newParent.SuspendLayout();
					}
					Form form = FindFormHelper(newParent);
					if (flag)
					{
						form?.SuspendLayout();
					}
					control.Dock = DockStyle.None;
					if (!control.IsHandleCreated)
					{
						IntPtr handle = control.Handle;
						control.CreateControl();
					}
					control.Location = location;
					ToolbarsManagerUtilities.SetParent(control, newParent);
					if (flag)
					{
						bool visible = rootTool?.VisibleResolved ?? true;
						control.Visible = visible;
					}
					if (control is TreeView)
					{
						NativeWindowMethods.ResetTreeTooltips(control as TreeView);
					}
					if (control is TreeView)
					{
						NativeWindowMethods.ResetTreeTooltips(control as TreeView);
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						return;
					}
					bool performLayout = newParent is UltraPagerContentControl;
					if (form != null)
					{
						newParent.ResumeLayout(performLayout);
						if (!flag)
						{
							return;
						}
						form.ResumeLayout(performLayout: false);
						if (toolbarBeingDragged == null && !isInMdiChildActivate && !isInitializingDockAreasAfterBecommingInactiveMdiChild && ShouldActivateToolControlAndForm(rootTool))
						{
							bool flag2 = activatingFormInReparent;
							activatingFormInReparent = true;
							try
							{
								Form form2 = (form.IsMdiChild ? form.MdiParent : form);
								ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ActivateForm(form2);
								return;
							}
							finally
							{
								activatingFormInReparent = flag2;
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						newParent.ResumeLayout(performLayout);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					control.Parent = null;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				mdiTabStopHelper?.Restore();
			}
		}

		internal void RepositionToolbar(UltraToolbar toolbar, DockedPosition newDockPosition, int newDockRow, int newDockColumn, bool exclusiveOnRow, bool resetUserDragPosition)
		{
			if (resetUserDragPosition)
			{
				toolbar.TargetPositionInDockedRow = 0;
			}
			if (newDockPosition != toolbar.DockedPosition)
			{
				toolbar.InternalSetDockedRow(newDockRow);
				toolbar.InternalSetDockedColumn(newDockColumn);
				toolbar.DockedPosition = newDockPosition;
			}
			else if (dockAreaToolbarsInitialized && toolbar.DockedPosition != DockedPosition.Floating)
			{
				UltraToolbarsDockArea ultraToolbarsDockArea = dockAreas[(int)toolbar.DockedPosition];
				if (ultraToolbarsDockArea != null)
				{
					ultraToolbarsDockArea.RepositionToolbar(toolbar, newDockRow, newDockColumn, exclusiveOnRow);
					((UIElement)ultraToolbarsDockArea.ControlElement).DirtyChildElements();
				}
			}
		}

		internal static MenuMergeType ResolveMergeType(ToolBase parentTool, ToolBase childTool)
		{
			MenuMergeType menuMergeType = childTool.SharedProps.MergeType;
			if (menuMergeType == MenuMergeType.Default)
			{
				menuMergeType = parentTool.SharedProps.MergeType;
			}
			if (menuMergeType == MenuMergeType.Default)
			{
				menuMergeType = childTool.DefaultMergeType;
			}
			return menuMergeType;
		}

			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleBefore)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseControlInfo)
			{
				if ((dockedPosition == DockedPosition.Left || dockedPosition == DockedPosition.Right) && HasDockAreaVerticalAppearance)
				{
					DockAreaVerticalAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
				if (HasDockAreaAppearance)
				{
					DockAreaAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleAfter)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 1uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)1) && MSColors != null)
			{
				if (HasRibbon && Ribbon.IsOffice2013StyleBackStageOpen)
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = Office2013ColorTable.Colors.ApplicationMenu2010ContentAreaBackGroundColor;
				}
				else
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = MSColors.DockAreaGradientDark;
				}
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEuL);
			}
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x4000000uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)67108864) && MSColors != null)
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor2 = MSColors.DockAreaGradientLight;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFBFFFFFFuL);
			}
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x10000000uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)268435456) && MSColors != null)
			{
				if (HasRibbon && Ribbon.IsOffice2013StyleBackStageOpen)
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackGradientStyle = (GradientStyle)1;
				}
				else
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackGradientStyle = (GradientStyle)3;
				}
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFEFFFFFFFuL);
			}
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x200000000uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)8589934592L) && MSColors != null)
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackGradientAlignment = (GradientAlignment)2;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFDFFFFFFFFuL);
			}
			ResolveAppearance(role, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		internal void RestoreMenus()
		{
			if (cachedParentMenu != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				try
				{
					lastRestoredParentMenu = cachedParentMenu;
					NativeWindowMethods.SetMenuApi(FindContainer().Handle, cachedParentMenu);
					((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).DirtyChildElements();
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				cachedParentMenu = IntPtr.Zero;
			}
			cachedMdiChildWindowState = FormWindowState.Normal;
			if (systemMenu != null)
			{
				systemMenu = null;
				if (ActiveTool != null && ActiveTool.UnderlyingTool is SystemActionTool)
				{
					ActiveTool = null;
				}
			}
			if (systemMenuImage != null)
			{
				systemMenuImage.Dispose();
				systemMenuImage = null;
			}
			if (systemMenuImageStream != null)
			{
				systemMenuImageStream.Close();
				systemMenuImageStream = null;
			}
		}

		internal static bool ShouldSetAppearanceProperty(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, AppearancePropFlags appearanceProperty)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet(appearanceProperty))
			{

		}

		internal bool ShouldDisplayInsertionPoint(ToolBase tool, UIElement element)
		{
			if (Customizing && CustomizeDialog.ShouldDisplayInsertionPoint(tool, element))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (IsToolBeingDragged() && (tool == null || ToolBeingDragged != tool) && !ToolDragPointInfo.IsOverNoDropZone && ToolDragPointInfo.VToolContainingInsertionPoint != null)
			{
				return ToolDragPointInfo.VToolContainingInsertionPoint.UIElement == element;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ShouldIncludeResizeArea(DockedPosition position)
		{
			if (position != DockedPosition.Bottom)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (FormWindowState != FormWindowState.Maximized)
			{
				return true;
			}
			Form form = FindForm();
			if (form == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (form.IsMdiChild)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return !IsFullScreen(form.Bounds);
		}

		internal bool ShouldScaleImage(Size imageSize, Size requiredSize)
		{
			if (imageSize == requiredSize)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (imageSize.Width > requiredSize.Width && imageSize.Height > requiredSize.Height)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (requiredSize == ImageSizeLargeResolved)
			{
				Size imageSizeSmallResolved = ImageSizeSmallResolved;
				if (imageSize.Width <= imageSizeSmallResolved.Width && imageSize.Height <= imageSizeSmallResolved.Height)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ShowSystemMenu(bool showApplicationMenuIfVisible, Form form)
		{
			if (HasRibbon)
			{
				if (form != null && form.WindowState == FormWindowState.Minimized)
				{
					Rectangle exclusionRect = form.RectangleToScreen(new Rectangle(Point.Empty, form.Size));
					CaptionSystemMenu.DropDown(form, exclusionRect.Location, exclusionRect, (DropDownPosition)3, delay: false, closeIfAlreadyOpen: true, RightAlignedMenusResolved, autocloseDropdown: true, null);
					return true;
				}
				if (ribbon.DisplayModeResolved == RibbonDisplayMode.AutoHide)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (showApplicationMenuIfVisible && Ribbon.FileMenuButtonStyleResolved == FileMenuButtonStyle.Orb)
				{
					Ribbon.ApplicationMenu.MenuAgent.DropDown();
					return true;
				}
				if (Ribbon.IsSystemMenuVisibleInCaption(honorMdiChildActivation: true) || (!showApplicationMenuIfVisible && Ribbon.IsCaptionAreaVisible))
				{
					SystemMenuTool systemMenuTool = CaptionSystemMenu;
					UIElement val = systemMenuTool?.UIElement;
					Control control = null;
					Rectangle r = Rectangle.Empty;
					if (val != null)
					{
						control = val.Control;
						r = val.Rect;
					}
					else
					{
						UIElement ribbonElement = Ribbon.GetRibbonElement(typeof(RibbonCaptionAreaUIElement));
						if (ribbonElement != null)
						{
							control = ribbonElement.Control;
							r = ribbonElement.RectInsideBorders;
							r.Width = Ribbon.RibbonMetrics.SystemMenuIconSize.Width;
						}
					}
					if (control != null && control.IsHandleCreated)
					{
						if (systemMenuTool == null)
						{
							return false;
						}
						Rectangle rectangle = control.RectangleToScreen(r);
						Point dropDownPoint = systemMenuTool.GetDropDownPoint(rectangle);
						systemMenuTool.DropDown(control, dropDownPoint, rectangle, (DropDownPosition)0, delay: false, closeIfAlreadyOpen: true, RightAlignedMenusResolved, autocloseDropdown: true, null);
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void RefreshGlass()
		{
			//IL_00a7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0056: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_005f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0066: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (Initializing || Loading)
			{
				delayedRefreshGlassRequired = true;
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(DockWithinContainer is Form { IsHandleCreated: not false } form))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (IsGlassSupportedResolved)
				{
					if (HasRibbon && Ribbon.IsOnGlassArea && (((int)StyleResolved != 8 && (int)StyleResolved != 9) || Ribbon.IsTabAreaVisible))
					{
						ExtendGlassIntoRibbon(form.Handle);
					}
					else if (HasNavigationToolbar && NavigationToolbar.IsOnGlassArea)
					{
						ExtendGlassIntoNavigationToolbar(form.Handle);
					}
					else if (ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ShouldToolbarsManagerRenderCustomGlassArea(FormDisplayStyleResolved))
					{
						ExtendGlassIntoCaption(form.Handle);
					}
					else
					{
						RemoveGlass(form.Handle);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					RemoveGlass(form.Handle);
				}
				UpdateFormRegion();
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyActiveMdiChildHasChanged(Form previousActiveMdiChild)
		{
			if (DockWithinContainer is Form { IsMdiContainer: not false, ActiveMdiChild: var activeMdiChild } form)
			{
				if (previousActiveMdiChild != null && !previousActiveMdiChild.IsDisposed && !previousActiveMdiChild.Disposing && form.ActiveMdiChild == previousActiveMdiChild)
				{
					CheckMdiChildWindowState();
				}
				else if (activeMdiChild == null)
				{
					CheckMdiChildWindowState();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyFloatingWindowVisibility(bool show)
		{
			ShowFloatingWindows(show);
		}

		{
			Form form = FindForm();
			if (form == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ActivateForm(form);
			return true;
		}

		protected internal virtual AccessibleObject CreateAccessibilityInstance(object relatedObject)
		{
			if (relatedObject is ToolBase)
			{
				return (relatedObject as ToolBase).CreateAccessibilityInstance();
			}
			if (relatedObject is QuickAccessToolbar)
			{
				return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new QuickAccessToolbar.QuickAccessToolbarAccessibleObject(relatedObject as QuickAccessToolbar)).AccessibleObject;
			}
			if (relatedObject is RibbonTabItemToolbar)
			{
				return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new RibbonTabItemToolbar.RibbonTabItemToolbarAccessibleObject(relatedObject as RibbonTabItemToolbar)).AccessibleObject;
			}
			if (relatedObject is UltraToolbar)
			{
				return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new UltraToolbarBase.ToolbarAccessibleObject(relatedObject as UltraToolbar)).AccessibleObject;
			}
			if (relatedObject is UltraToolbarsDockArea)
			{
				return (AccessibleObject)(object)new DockAreaAccessibleObject(relatedObject as UltraToolbarsDockArea);
			}
			if (relatedObject is NavigationToolbar)
			{
				return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new UltraToolbarBase.ToolbarAccessibleObject(relatedObject as NavigationToolbar)).AccessibleObject;
			}
			if (relatedObject is ApplicationMenuControl)
			{
				return new ApplicationMenuControl.ApplicationMenuControlAccessibleObject(relatedObject as ApplicationMenuControl);
			}
			if (relatedObject is ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar)
			{
				return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar.ApplicationMenuFooterToolbarAccessibleObject(relatedObject as ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar)).AccessibleObject;
			}
			if (relatedObject is Ribbon)
			{
				return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new Ribbon.RibbonAccessibleObject(relatedObject as Ribbon)).AccessibleObject;
			}
			if (relatedObject is ApplicationMenuLeftArea)
			{
				return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new ApplicationMenuLeftArea.ApplicationMenuLeftAreaAccessibleObject(relatedObject as ApplicationMenuLeftArea)).AccessibleObject;
			}
			if (relatedObject is ApplicationMenuRightArea)
			{
				return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new ApplicationMenuRightArea.ApplicationMenuRightAreaAccessibleObject(relatedObject as ApplicationMenuRightArea)).AccessibleObject;
			}
			if (relatedObject is NavigationMenu)
			{
				return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new NavigationMenu.NavigationMenuAccessibleObject(relatedObject as NavigationMenu)).AccessibleObject;
			}
			if (relatedObject is MiniToolbar)
			{
				return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new MiniToolbar.MiniToolbarAccessibleObject(relatedObject as MiniToolbar)).AccessibleObject;
			}
			if (relatedObject is object[])
			{
				object[] array = relatedObject as object[];
				if (array[0] is Ribbon.RibbonAccessibleObjectContext)
				{
					switch ((Ribbon.RibbonAccessibleObjectContext)array[0])
					{
					case Ribbon.RibbonAccessibleObjectContext.CaptionArea:
						return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new Ribbon.RibbonCaptionAreaAccessibleObject(array[1] as Ribbon)).AccessibleObject;
					case Ribbon.RibbonAccessibleObjectContext.CaptionButton:
						return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new Ribbon.RibbonCaptionButtonAccessibleObject(array[1] as Ribbon, (int)array[2])).AccessibleObject;
					case Ribbon.RibbonAccessibleObjectContext.TabItemArea:
						return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new Ribbon.RibbonTabItemAreaAccessibleObject(array[1] as Ribbon)).AccessibleObject;
					case Ribbon.RibbonAccessibleObjectContext.GroupArea:
						return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new Ribbon.RibbonGroupAreaAccessibleObject(array[1] as Ribbon)).AccessibleObject;
					case Ribbon.RibbonAccessibleObjectContext.TabItemAreaPagerButton:
						return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new Ribbon.RibbonTabPagerButtonAccessibleObject(array[1] as Ribbon, (ScrollButton)array[2])).AccessibleObject;
					case Ribbon.RibbonAccessibleObjectContext.GroupAreaPagerButton:
						return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new Ribbon.RibbonGroupAreaPagerButtonAccessibleObject(array[1] as Ribbon, (ScrollButton)array[2])).AccessibleObject;
					case Ribbon.RibbonAccessibleObjectContext.DialogBoxLauncher:
						return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new RibbonGroup.DialogBoxLauncherAccessibleObject(array[1] as RibbonGroup)).AccessibleObject;
					case Ribbon.RibbonAccessibleObjectContext.RibbonGroup:
						return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new RibbonGroup.RibbonGroupAccessibleObject(array[1] as RibbonGroup)).AccessibleObject;
					case Ribbon.RibbonAccessibleObjectContext.RibbonGroupButton:
						return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new RibbonGroup.RibbonGroupButtonAccessibleObject(array[1] as RibbonGroup)).AccessibleObject;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void AddMaximizedMdiChildForm(Form form)
		{
			if (maximizedMdiChildren == null)
			{
				maximizedMdiChildren = new Dictionary<Form, object>();
				if (mdiClientSubClasser != null)
				{
					((MdiClientSubClasser)mdiClientSubClasser).OnMaximizedMdiChildrenCollectionCreated();
				}
			}
			if (!maximizedMdiChildren.ContainsKey(form))
			{
				form.Disposed += OnMaximizedMdiChildFormDisposed;
				maximizedMdiChildren.Add(form, null);
			}
		}

		internal void AddMessageFilter()
		{
			if (!messageFilterActive && !((Component)this).DesignMode && !Initializing)
			{
				try
				{
					MessageFilterManager.AddManager(this);
					messageFilterActive = true;
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddToolbarsToDockArea(DockedPosition targetDockArea)
		{
			List<UltraToolbar> list = null;
			foreach (UltraToolbar toolbar in Toolbars)
			{
				if (!toolbar.VisibleResolved || toolbar.DockedPosition != targetDockArea)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (targetDockArea == DockedPosition.Floating)
				{
					AddToolbarToDockArea(toolbar);
					toolbar.SaveDockedPosition();
					continue;
				}
				if (list == null)
				{
					list = new List<UltraToolbar>(Toolbars.Count);
				}
				list.Add(toolbar);
			}
			if (list != null && list.Count >= 1)
			{
				AddToolbarsToDockArea(list);
			}
		}

		private void AddToolbarsToDockArea(List<UltraToolbar> toolbarList)
		{
			if (toolbarList.Count > 1)
			{
				toolbarList.Sort(delegate(UltraToolbar toolbar1, UltraToolbar toolbar2)
				{
					if (toolbar1 == toolbar2)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					int num3 = toolbar1.DockedPosition - toolbar2.DockedPosition;
					if (num3 != 0)
					{
						return num3;
					}
					if (toolbar1.DockedRow >= 0 && toolbar2.DockedRow >= 0)
					{
						num3 = toolbar1.DockedRow - toolbar2.DockedRow;
						if (num3 != 0)
						{
							return num3;
						}
						num3 = toolbar1.DockedColumn - toolbar2.DockedColumn;
						if (num3 != 0)
						{
							return num3;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (toolbar1.DockedRow == -1 && toolbar2.DockedRow >= 0)
						{
							return 1;
						}
						if (toolbar1.DockedRow >= 0 && toolbar2.DockedRow == -1)
						{
							return -1;
						}
					}
					num3 = toolbar1.Index - toolbar2.Index;
					return (num3 != 0) ? num3 : 0;
				});
			}
			DockedPosition dockedPosition = (DockedPosition)(-1);
			int num = 0;
			foreach (UltraToolbar toolbar in toolbarList)
			{
				if (toolbar.DockedPosition != dockedPosition)
				{
					num = 0;
					dockedPosition = toolbar.DockedPosition;
				}
				if (toolbar.DockedRow >= 0)
				{
					toolbar.InternalSetDockedRow(toolbar.DockedRow + num);
				}
				int num2 = Math.Max(0, toolbar.DockedRow);
				AddToolbarToDockArea(toolbar);
				toolbar.SaveDockedPosition();
				num += toolbar.DockedRow - num2;
			}
		}

				}
			}
		}

		private void CheckIfMdiClientSubclasserNeeded(Form form)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (form != null && form == dockWithinContainer && form.IsMdiContainer && !form.Disposing && !form.IsDisposed && form.IsHandleCreated && !((Component)this).DesignMode)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				if (mdiClientSubClasser == null)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			else if (mdiClientSubClasser != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				PermissionSet permissionSet = new PermissionSet(null);
				permissionSet.AddPermission(new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode));
				permissionSet.AddPermission(new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.SafeTopLevelWindows));
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					permissionSet.Assert();
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					DeactivateMdiSubClassers();
				}
				else
				{
					CreateMdiSubClassers(form);
				}
				PermissionSet.RevertAssert();
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private void CheckFormSystemMenu()
		{
			if (!(DockWithinContainer is Form { IsHandleCreated: not false } form))
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				IntPtr systemMenuApi = NativeWindowMethods.GetSystemMenuApi(form.Handle, revert: false);
				if (systemMenuApi != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					InitializeSystemMenu(systemMenuApi, form, ref captionSystemMenu, ref captionSystemMenuImage, ref captionSystemMenuStream, Ribbon.TabItemToolbar, SystemMenuSource.DockWithinContainerForm);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private void CheckMdiChildWindowState()
		{
			Form activeMdiChildForm = ActiveMdiChildForm;
			if (activeMdiChildForm == null || SystemMenuToolbar == null)
			{
				RestoreMenus();
				((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).DirtyChildElements();
			}
			else
			{
				if (activeMdiChildForm.WindowState == cachedMdiChildWindowState)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (ribbon != null && (cachedMdiChildWindowState == FormWindowState.Maximized || activeMdiChildForm.WindowState == FormWindowState.Maximized))
				{
					ribbon.OnMdiChildMaximizedStateChanged();
				}
				cachedMdiChildWindowState = activeMdiChildForm.WindowState;
				if (activeMdiChildForm.WindowState == FormWindowState.Maximized)
				{
					try
					{
						IntPtr systemMenuApi = NativeWindowMethods.GetSystemMenuApi(activeMdiChildForm.Handle, revert: false);
						if (systemMenuApi != IntPtr.Zero)
						{
							InitializeSystemMenu(systemMenuApi);
						}
						Form form = FindForm();
						if (form.Handle != IntPtr.Zero)
						{
							cachedParentMenu = NativeWindowMethods.GetMenuApi(form.Handle);
							if (cachedParentMenu != IntPtr.Zero)
							{
								bool flag = !processingSysCommand && NativeWindowMethods.IsWindowVisibleApi(activeMdiChildForm.Handle);
								if (flag)
								{
									NativeWindowMethods.SendMessageApi(form.Handle, 11, NativeWindowMethods.FALSE, IntPtr.Zero);
								}
								NativeWindowMethods.SetMenuApi(form.Handle, IntPtr.Zero);
								if (flag)
								{
									NativeWindowMethods.SendMessageApi(form.Handle, 11, NativeWindowMethods.TRUE, IntPtr.Zero);
									NativeWindowMethods.RedrawWindowApi(form.Handle, IntPtr.Zero, IntPtr.Zero, 1671u);
								}
							}
						}
						return;
					}
					catch
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				RestoreMenus();
				cachedMdiChildWindowState = activeMdiChildForm.WindowState;
			}
		}

		private void ClearBitmapCache(bool disposing)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < 140; i++)
			{
				if (!disposing)
				{
					switch ((CachedBitmapIndex)i)
					{
					case CachedBitmapIndex.CloseWindow:
					case CachedBitmapIndex.RestoreWindow:
					case CachedBitmapIndex.MinimizeWindow:
					case CachedBitmapIndex.MaximizeWindow:
					case CachedBitmapIndex.DefaultForm:
					case CachedBitmapIndex.ContextHelp:
						continue;
					}
				}
				if (cachedBitmaps[i] != null)
				{
					cachedBitmaps[i].Dispose();
					cachedBitmaps[i] = null;
				}
				if (cachedBitmapStreams[i] != null)
				{
					cachedBitmapStreams[i].Close();
					cachedBitmapStreams[i] = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private void CorrectMaximizedMdiChildSize(Form mdiParent)
		{
			if (maximizedMdiChildren == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Form activeMdiChild = mdiParent.ActiveMdiChild;
			if (activeMdiChild == null || !maximizedMdiChildren.ContainsKey(activeMdiChild))
			{
				return;
			}
			RemoveMaximizedMdiChildForm(activeMdiChild);
			Control parent = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetParent(activeMdiChild);
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				NativeWindowMethods.SendMessageApi(parent.Handle, 5, IntPtr.Zero, NativeWindowMethods.EncodeSize(parent.Size));
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
		}

		private void CreateMdiSubClassers(Form form)
		{
			if (mdiClientSubClasser == null)
			{
				foreach (Control control in form.Controls)
				{
					if (control is MdiClient)
					{
						mdiClientSubClasser = new MdiClientSubClasser(this, control as MdiClient);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (mdiClientSubClasser != null && mdiParentSubClasser == null)
			{
				mdiParentSubClasser = new MdiParentSubClasser(this, form);
			}
		}

			DeactivateFormSubClasser(delay: false);
		}

			}
		}

		private void DeactivateMdiSubClassers()
		{
			if (this.mdiClientSubClasser is MdiClientSubClasser mdiClientSubClasser)
			{
				this.mdiClientSubClasser = null;
				mdiClientSubClasser.Deactivate();
			}
			if (this.mdiParentSubClasser is MdiParentSubClasser mdiParentSubClasser)
			{
				this.mdiParentSubClasser = null;
				mdiParentSubClasser.Deactivate();
			}
		}

		private ControlUIElementBase DockAreaElementFromScreenPoint(Point screenPoint)
		{
			IntPtr intPtr = WindowFromPoint(screenPoint);
			if (customizeDialog != null && customizeDialog.IsPointOverCustomizer(screenPoint))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (FloatingWindows != null)
			{
				foreach (FloatingToolbarWindowBase floatingWindow in FloatingWindows)
				{
					if (floatingWindow != null && !floatingWindow.IsDisposed && !floatingWindow.Disposing && (floatingWindow.Handle == intPtr || IsDescendantOf(intPtr, floatingWindow.Handle)))
					{
						if (((Control)(object)floatingWindow.DockArea).RectangleToScreen(((UIElement)floatingWindow.DockArea.ControlElement).Rect).Contains(screenPoint))
						{
							return floatingWindow.DockArea.ControlElement;
						}
						if (floatingWindow.RectangleToScreen(((UIElement)floatingWindow.UIElement).Rect).Contains(screenPoint))
						{
							return (ControlUIElementBase)(object)floatingWindow.UIElement;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (PopupControlBase popupControl in PopupControls)
			{
				if (((Control)(object)popupControl).Controls.Count == 1 && ((Control)(object)popupControl).Controls[0].GetType() == typeof(UltraToolbarsDockArea) && ((Control)(object)popupControl).Controls[0] is UltraToolbarsDockArea { IsDisposed: false, Disposing: false } ultraToolbarsDockArea && ((Control)(object)popupControl).Controls[0].RectangleToScreen(((UIElement)ultraToolbarsDockArea.ControlElement).Rect).Contains(screenPoint))
				{
					return ultraToolbarsDockArea.ControlElement;
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
			{
				if (dockAreas[i] == null || ((Control)(object)dockAreas[i]).IsDisposed || ((Control)(object)dockAreas[i]).Disposing || !((Control)(object)dockAreas[i]).IsHandleCreated || !((Control)(object)dockAreas[i]).RectangleToScreen(((UIElement)dockAreas[i].ControlElement).Rect).Contains(screenPoint))
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (PopupControlBase popupControl2 in PopupControls)
				{
					if (!((Control)(object)popupControl2).IsDisposed && (((Control)(object)popupControl2).Handle == intPtr || IsDescendantOf(intPtr, ((Control)(object)popupControl2).Handle)))
					{
						return null;
					}
				}
				if (((Control)(object)dockAreas[i]).Handle == intPtr || IsDescendantOf(intPtr, ((Control)(object)dockAreas[i]).Handle))
				{
					return dockAreas[i].ControlElement;
				}
			}
			if (HasMiniToolbar)
			{
				Form window = miniToolbar.Window;
				if (window != null && window.IsHandleCreated && (window.Handle == intPtr || IsDescendantOf(intPtr, window.Handle)) && ((Control)(object)miniToolbar.DockArea).RectangleToScreen(((UIElement)miniToolbar.DockArea.ControlElement).Rect).Contains(screenPoint))
				{
					return miniToolbar.DockArea.ControlElement;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void CreateDockingAreas(Control control)
		{
			IDesignerHost designerHost = DesignerHost;
			UltraToolbarsDockArea[] array = new UltraToolbarsDockArea[4];
			string text = "_" + control.Name + DOCK_AREA_NAME_SUFFIX;
			if (designerHost != null)
			{
				ComponentCollection components = designerHost.Container.Components;
				string text2 = text;
				int num = 1;
				while (components[text + "Left"] != null || components[text + "Right"] != null || components[text + "Top"] != null || components[text + "Bottom"] != null)
				{
					text = text2 + num++ + "_";
				}
			}
			if (!IsDockAreaValid(dockAreas[2], control))
			{
				if (designerHost != null)
				{
					array[0] = designerHost.CreateComponent(typeof(UltraToolbarsDockArea), text + "Left") as UltraToolbarsDockArea;
				}
				else
				{
					array[0] = new UltraToolbarsDockArea();
				}
				array[0].Initialize(DockedPosition.Left);
				array[0].ToolbarsManager = this;
			}
			if (!IsDockAreaValid(dockAreas[3], control))
			{
				if (designerHost != null)
				{
					array[1] = designerHost.CreateComponent(typeof(UltraToolbarsDockArea), text + "Right") as UltraToolbarsDockArea;
				}
				else
				{
					array[1] = new UltraToolbarsDockArea();
				}
				array[1].Initialize(DockedPosition.Right);
				array[1].ToolbarsManager = this;
			}
			if (!IsDockAreaValid(dockAreas[0], control))
			{
				if (designerHost != null)
				{
					array[2] = designerHost.CreateComponent(typeof(UltraToolbarsDockArea), text + "Top") as UltraToolbarsDockArea;
				}
				else
				{
					array[2] = new UltraToolbarsDockArea();
				}
				array[2].Initialize(DockedPosition.Top);
				array[2].ToolbarsManager = this;
			}
			if (!IsDockAreaValid(dockAreas[1], control))
			{
				if (designerHost != null)
				{
					array[3] = designerHost.CreateComponent(typeof(UltraToolbarsDockArea), text + "Bottom") as UltraToolbarsDockArea;
				}
				else
				{
					array[3] = new UltraToolbarsDockArea();
				}
				array[3].Initialize(DockedPosition.Bottom);
				array[3].ToolbarsManager = this;
			}
			control.Controls.AddRange((Control[])(object)array);
		}

		private static bool DefaultableBooleanToBool(DefaultableBoolean defaultableBoolean, bool defaultValue)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)defaultableBoolean == 0)

				return defaultValue;
			}
			if ((int)defaultableBoolean == 2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void DestroyDockingAreas()
		{
			IDesignerHost designerHost = DesignerHost;
			DesignerTransaction designerTransaction = null;
			if (designerHost != null)
			{
				designerTransaction = designerHost.CreateTransaction();
			}
			try
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
				{
					UltraToolbarsDockArea ultraToolbarsDockArea = dockAreas[i];
					if (ultraToolbarsDockArea == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (designerHost != null)
					{
						ultraToolbarsDockArea.ToolbarsManager = null;
						designerHost.DestroyComponent((IComponent)ultraToolbarsDockArea);
					}
					else
					{
						ultraToolbarsDockArea.ReparentContainedControls(takeOwnership: false);
						if (dockWithinContainer != null)
						{
							dockWithinContainer.Controls.Remove((Control)(object)ultraToolbarsDockArea);
						}
						ultraToolbarsDockArea.ToolbarsManager = null;
						((Component)(object)ultraToolbarsDockArea).Dispose();
					}
					dockAreas[i] = null;
				}
				designerTransaction?.Commit();
			}
			catch
			{
				designerTransaction?.Cancel();
			}
		}

		internal void DestroyFloatingWindowForToolbar(UltraToolbar toolbar)
		{
			FloatingToolbarWindowBase floatingWindow = GetFloatingWindow(toolbar);
			if (floatingWindow != null)
			{
				toolbar.InternalSetFloatingLocation(floatingWindow.Location);
				floatingWindow.Closed -= OnFloatingWindowClosed;
				floatingWindow.Disposed -= OnFloatingWindowDisposed;
				floatingWindow.Close();
				floatingWindow.Dispose();
				floatingWindows.Remove(floatingWindow);
			}
		}

		private void DestroyFloatingWindows()
		{
			if (floatingWindows != null && floatingWindows.Count > 0)
			{
				FloatingToolbarWindowBase[] array = floatingWindows.ToArray();
				floatingWindows.Clear();
				FloatingToolbarWindowBase[] array2 = array;
				foreach (FloatingToolbarWindowBase floatingToolbarWindowBase in array2)
				{
					floatingToolbarWindowBase.Closed -= OnFloatingWindowClosed;
					floatingToolbarWindowBase.Disposed -= OnFloatingWindowDisposed;
					floatingToolbarWindowBase.Close();
					floatingToolbarWindowBase.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

				UltraPagerContentControl[] array2 = array;

		private void DisconnectMergedTools()
		{
			Tools.DisconnectMergedTools();
			foreach (ToolBase mergedTool in MergedTools)
			{
				foreach (ToolBase toolInstance in mergedTool.SharedProps.ToolInstances)
				{
					toolInstance.CacheMdiMergeToolPositionInOwner();
					if (toolInstance.UnderlyingTool is PopupControlContainerToolBase popupControlContainerToolBase)
					{
						popupControlContainerToolBase.CleanupForMerge();
					}
				}
				if (mergedTool is PopupToolBase popupToolBase)
				{
					popupToolBase.RemoveMenuAgent();
				}
				mergedTool.InternalSetUnderlyingTool(null);
				mergedTool.IsHiddenByMdiMerge = false;
			}
			foreach (UltraToolbar toolbar in Toolbars)
			{
				toolbar.OnBeforeMdiMergeDisconnect();
			}
			foreach (UltraToolbar toolbar2 in Toolbars)
			{
				toolbar2.InternalSetUnderlyingToolbar(null);
				toolbar2.IsHiddenByMdiMerge = false;
				toolbar2.DisconnectMergedItems();
			}
			foreach (UltraToolbar toolbar3 in Toolbars)
			{
				toolbar3.OnAfterMdiMergeDisconnect();
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < FloatingWindows.Count; i++)
			{
				FloatingToolbarWindowBase floatingToolbarWindowBase = FloatingWindows[i];
				if (floatingToolbarWindowBase != null && !floatingToolbarWindowBase.Toolbar.VisibleResolved)
				{
					DestroyFloatingWindowForToolbar(floatingToolbarWindowBase.Toolbar);
					i--;
				}
			}
			if (HasRibbon)
			{
				Ribbon.DisconnectMergedItems();
			}
			if (HasMiniToolbar)
			{
				MiniToolbar.DisconnectMergedItems();
			}
			if (HasNavigationToolbar)
			{
				NavigationToolbar.DisconnectMergedItems();
			}
			BumpToolLayoutVersion();
		}

				userPreferenceChangedTracker.Dispose();
				userPreferenceChangedTracker = null;
			}
		}

		private UltraToolbarsDockArea DockAreaFromDragPoint(Point point)
		{
			if (LockToolbars)
			{
				return null;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
			{
				UltraToolbarsDockArea ultraToolbarsDockArea = dockAreas[i];
				if (ultraToolbarsDockArea != null && ultraToolbarsDockArea.IsDragOverPoint(point, toolbarBeingDragged))
				{
					return ultraToolbarsDockArea;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static ToolResizeEdges ElementEdgeContainingPoint(UIElement element, Point point)
		{
			if (!(element is IProvideToolElementResizeInfo provideToolElementResizeInfo))
			{
				return ToolResizeEdges.Undefined;
			}
			if (provideToolElementResizeInfo.CanResizeWidth && PointInToolResizeArea(ToolResizeEdges.Left, element.Rect, point))
			{
				return ToolResizeEdges.Left;
			}
			if (provideToolElementResizeInfo.CanResizeWidth && PointInToolResizeArea(ToolResizeEdges.Right, element.Rect, point))
			{
				return ToolResizeEdges.Right;
			}
			if (provideToolElementResizeInfo.CanResizeHeight && PointInToolResizeArea(ToolResizeEdges.Top, element.Rect, point))
			{
				return ToolResizeEdges.Top;
			}
			if (provideToolElementResizeInfo.CanResizeHeight && PointInToolResizeArea(ToolResizeEdges.Bottom, element.Rect, point))
			{
				return ToolResizeEdges.Bottom;
			}
			return ToolResizeEdges.Undefined;
		}

		internal bool EnterHotkeyMode()
		{
			if (isInHotkeyMode)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (toolBeingEdited != null && !ExitEditMode())
			{
				return false;
			}
			isInHotkeyMode = true;
			DirtyAllElements();
			return true;
		}

		private void EvaluateToolbarVisibility()
		{
			bool hideToolbarsResolved = HideToolbarsResolved;
			if (!Initialized || hideToolbarsResolved == lastHideToolbarsSetting)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (hideToolbarsResolved)
			{
				ForceExitEditMode();
				if (popupManager != null)
				{
					popupManager.CloseAllPopups();
				}
				ShowFloatingWindows(show: false);
			}
			else
			{
				ShowFloatingWindows(show: true);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
			{
				dockAreas[i]?.RefreshDockAreaSize();
			}
			lastHideToolbarsSetting = hideToolbarsResolved;
		}

		private void ExtendGlass(IntPtr handle, int height)
		{
			if (!(handle == IntPtr.Zero) && !IsDesignMode)
			{
				NativeWindowMethods.MARGINS pMargins = new NativeWindowMethods.MARGINS(0, 0, height, 0);
				int num = NativeWindowMethods.DwmExtendFrameIntoClientAreaApi(handle, ref pMargins);
				haveExtendedGlass = num == 0;
				isInitialGlassExtension = false;
				lastGlassExtensionHeight = pMargins.Top;
			}
		}

		private void ExtendGlassIntoCaption(IntPtr handle)
		{
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!(handle == IntPtr.Zero) && !IsDesignMode && ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ShouldToolbarsManagerRenderCustomGlassArea(FormDisplayStyleResolved))
			{
				ExtendGlass(handle, Ribbon.Metrics.CaptionAreaHeight);
			}
		}

		private void ExtendGlassIntoNavigationToolbar(IntPtr handle)
		{
			if (!(handle == IntPtr.Zero) && !IsDesignMode && HasNavigationToolbar && NavigationToolbar.IsOnGlassArea)
			{
				int height = NavigationToolbar.Height + (HasRibbon ? Ribbon.Metrics.CaptionAreaHeight : 0);
				ExtendGlass(handle, height);
			}
		}

		private void ExtendGlassIntoRibbon(IntPtr handle)
		{
			//IL_0059: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0061: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0063: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0065: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (handle == IntPtr.Zero || IsDesignMode || !HasRibbon)
			{
				return;
			}
			int height = Ribbon.RibbonContainer.CalculateGlassRect().Height;
			if (height <= lastGlassExtensionHeight || !Ribbon.IsOnGlassArea)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = -1;
			if (isInitialGlassExtension)
			{
				FormDisplayStyle val = initialFormDisplayStyle;
				if ((int)val == 3 || (int)val == 4)
				{
					num = 1;
				}
			}
			ExtendGlass(handle, num + height);
		}

		private static bool ForceRecreateHandle(Form control)
		{
			try
			{
				BindingFlags invokeAttr = BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.InvokeMethod;
				control.GetType().InvokeMember("RecreateHandle", invokeAttr, null, control, null);
				return true;
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
			catch (MissingMethodException)
			{
			}
			control.ShowInTaskbar = !control.ShowInTaskbar;
			control.ShowInTaskbar = !control.ShowInTaskbar;
			return false;
		}

		internal static void ForwardMouseHookMessageToFloatingWindow(MouseHookEventArgs e, FloatingToolbarWindowBase floatingWindow)
		{
			if (floatingWindow != null && !floatingWindow.IsDisposed && !floatingWindow.Disposing)
			{
				Point point = floatingWindow.PointToClient(e.Point);
				MouseEventArgs e2 = new MouseEventArgs(GetMouseButtonFromMouseMessage(e.MessageId), 1, point.X, point.Y, 0);
				switch (GetMouseActionFromMouseMessage(e))
				{
				case MouseAction.MouseDown:
					floatingWindow.ForwardMouseDownMessage(e2);
					break;
				case MouseAction.MouseUp:
					floatingWindow.ForwardMouseUpMessage(e2);
					break;
				case MouseAction.MouseMove:
					floatingWindow.ForwardMouseMoveMessage(e2);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal Control[] GetAvailableContainers()
		{
			IDesignerHost designerHost = DesignerHost;
			if (designerHost == null)
			{
				return new Control[0];
			}
			int count = designerHost.Container.Components.Count;
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			Control[] array = new Control[count];
			UltraToolbarsManager[] array2 = new UltraToolbarsManager[count];
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (!(designerHost.Container.Components[i] is Control control))
				{
					if (designerHost.Container.Components[i] is UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager && ultraToolbarsManager != this)
					{
						array2[num2] = ultraToolbarsManager;
						num2++;
					}
				}
				else if (!(control is IDockingArea) && (control is IContainerControl || control is ContainerControl))
				{
					array[num] = control;
					num++;
				}
			}
			int num3 = 0;
			for (int j = 0; j < num2; j++)
			{
				for (int k = 0; k < num; k++)
				{
					if (array2[j].DockWithinContainer == array[k])
					{
						array[k] = null;
						num3++;
					}
				}
			}
			int num4 = 0;
			int num5 = num - num3;
			Control[] array3 = new Control[num5];
			if (num5 > 0)
			{
				for (int l = 0; l < num; l++)
				{
					if (array[l] != null)
					{
						array3[num4] = array[l];
						num4++;
					}
				}
			}
			return array3;
		}

		internal Image GetArrowBitmap(ArrowUIElement.ArrowOrientation orientation, ArrowUIElement.ArrowSize size)
		{
			return GetCachedBitmap(size switch
			{
				ArrowUIElement.ArrowSize.Medium => orientation switch
				{
					ArrowUIElement.ArrowOrientation.Down => CachedBitmapIndex.ArrowDownMedium, 
					ArrowUIElement.ArrowOrientation.Left => CachedBitmapIndex.ArrowLeftMedium, 
					ArrowUIElement.ArrowOrientation.Up => CachedBitmapIndex.ArrowUpMedium, 
					_ => CachedBitmapIndex.ArrowRightMedium, 
				}, 
				ArrowUIElement.ArrowSize.ExtraLarge => orientation switch
				{
					ArrowUIElement.ArrowOrientation.Down => CachedBitmapIndex.ArrowDownExtraLarge, 
					ArrowUIElement.ArrowOrientation.Left => CachedBitmapIndex.ArrowLeftExtraLarge, 
					ArrowUIElement.ArrowOrientation.Up => CachedBitmapIndex.ArrowUpExtraLarge, 
					_ => CachedBitmapIndex.ArrowRightExtraLarge, 
				}, 
				ArrowUIElement.ArrowSize.Large => orientation switch
				{
					ArrowUIElement.ArrowOrientation.Down => CachedBitmapIndex.ArrowDownLarge, 
					ArrowUIElement.ArrowOrientation.Left => CachedBitmapIndex.ArrowLeftLarge, 
					ArrowUIElement.ArrowOrientation.Up => CachedBitmapIndex.ArrowUpLarge, 
					_ => CachedBitmapIndex.ArrowRightLarge, 
				}, 
				_ => orientation switch
				{
					ArrowUIElement.ArrowOrientation.Down => CachedBitmapIndex.ArrowDownSmall, 
					ArrowUIElement.ArrowOrientation.Left => CachedBitmapIndex.ArrowLeftSmall, 
					ArrowUIElement.ArrowOrientation.Up => CachedBitmapIndex.ArrowUpSmall, 
					_ => CachedBitmapIndex.ArrowRightSmall, 
				}, 
			});
		}

		internal Image GetArrowBitmap(bool upArrow)
		{
			return GetCachedBitmap(upArrow ? CachedBitmapIndex.ArrowUp : CachedBitmapIndex.ArrowDown);
		}

				Type typeFromHandle = typeof(UltraToolbarsManager);
				cachedBitmapStreams[(int)index] = typeFromHandle.Module.Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(typeFromHandle, name);
				Stream stream = cachedBitmapStreams[(int)index];
				if (stream != null)
				{
					cachedBitmaps[(int)index] = Image.FromStream(stream);
					switch (index)
					{
					case CachedBitmapIndex.ChevronDownLarge:
					case CachedBitmapIndex.ChevronDownSmall:
					case CachedBitmapIndex.ArrowDownSmall:
					case CachedBitmapIndex.ArrowDownMedium:
					case CachedBitmapIndex.ArrowDownExtraLarge:
					case CachedBitmapIndex.ArrowDownLarge:
						cachedBitmaps[(int)index].RotateFlip(RotateFlipType.Rotate90FlipNone);
						break;
					case CachedBitmapIndex.ArrowLeftSmall:
					case CachedBitmapIndex.ArrowLeftMedium:
					case CachedBitmapIndex.ArrowLeftExtraLarge:
					case CachedBitmapIndex.ArrowLeftLarge:
						cachedBitmaps[(int)index].RotateFlip(RotateFlipType.Rotate180FlipNone);
						break;
					case CachedBitmapIndex.ArrowUpSmall:
					case CachedBitmapIndex.ArrowUpMedium:
					case CachedBitmapIndex.ArrowUpExtraLarge:
					case CachedBitmapIndex.ArrowUpLarge:
						cachedBitmaps[(int)index].RotateFlip(RotateFlipType.Rotate270FlipNone);
						break;
					case CachedBitmapIndex.QuickCustomizeVertSmall2003:
					case CachedBitmapIndex.QuickCustomizeVertLarge2003:
					case CachedBitmapIndex.QuickCustomizeVertBumpedSmall2003:
					case CachedBitmapIndex.QuickCustomizeVertBumpedLarge2003:
						cachedBitmaps[(int)index].RotateFlip(RotateFlipType.Rotate90FlipX);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return cachedBitmaps[(int)index];
		}

		internal static MouseButtons GetMouseButtonFromMouseMessage(int messageID)
		{
			switch (messageID)
			{
			case 161:
			case 162:
			case 163:
			case 513:
			case 514:
			case 515:
				return MouseButtons.Left;
			case 167:
			case 168:
			case 169:
			case 519:
			case 520:
			case 521:
				return MouseButtons.Middle;
			case 164:
			case 165:
			case 166:
			case 516:
			case 517:
			case 518:
				return MouseButtons.Right;
			case 160:
			case 512:
				return MouseButtons.None;
			default:
				return MouseButtons.Left;
			}
		}

		internal static MouseAction GetMouseActionFromMouseMessage(MouseHookEventArgs e)
		{
			switch (e.MessageId)
			{
			case 161:
			case 164:
			case 167:
			case 513:
			case 516:
			case 519:
				return MouseAction.MouseDown;
			case 162:
			case 165:
			case 168:
			case 514:
			case 517:
			case 520:
				return MouseAction.MouseUp;
			case 160:
			case 512:
				return MouseAction.MouseMove;
			case 163:
			case 166:
			case 169:
			case 515:
			case 518:
			case 521:
				if (e.HookCode == 0)
				{
					return MouseAction.MouseDoubleClick;
				}
				return MouseAction.MouseUp;
			default:
				return MouseAction.MouseDown;
			}
		}

		private Control GetParentForHiddenContainedControls()
		{
			if (IsDisposed || IsDisposing)
			{
				return FindContainer();
			}
			if (GetParentForHiddenContainedControlsHelper(DockedPosition.Top, out var parent))
			{
				return parent;
			}
			if (GetParentForHiddenContainedControlsHelper(DockedPosition.Left, out parent))
			{
				return parent;
			}
			if (GetParentForHiddenContainedControlsHelper(DockedPosition.Bottom, out parent))
			{
				return parent;
			}
			if (GetParentForHiddenContainedControlsHelper(DockedPosition.Right, out parent))
			{
				return parent;
			}
			return FindContainer();
		}

		private bool GetParentForHiddenContainedControlsHelper(DockedPosition dockedPosition, out Control parent)
		{
			parent = null;
			UltraToolbarsDockArea ultraToolbarsDockArea = dockAreas[(int)dockedPosition];
			if (ultraToolbarsDockArea == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (((Control)(object)ultraToolbarsDockArea).IsDisposed || ((Control)(object)ultraToolbarsDockArea).Disposing)
			{
				return false;
			}
			parent = ultraToolbarsDockArea.GetParentForHiddenContainedControls(shouldCreate: true);
			return true;
		}

		private UltraToolbarBase GetRootToolbar(ToolBase tool)
		{
			if (tool == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (tool.OwnerIsMenu)
			{
				return GetRootToolbar(tool.OwningMenu);
			}
			if (tool.OwnerIsToolbar && tool.OwningToolbar.ToolbarType == ToolbarType.Popup && tool.OwningToolbar.TearawayToolOwner != null)
			{
				return GetRootToolbar(tool.OwningToolbar.TearawayToolOwner);
			}
			if (tool.OwnerIsToolbar && tool.OwningToolbar.OwningTaskPaneToolbar != null)
			{
				return tool.OwningToolbar.OwningTaskPaneToolbar;
			}
			if (tool.OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
			{
				return tool.OwningToolbarInternal;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void GetToolbarControls(List<ToolBar> toolbars, Control.ControlCollection controls)
		{
			foreach (Control control in controls)
			{
				if (control is ToolBar item)
				{
					toolbars.Add(item);
				}
				if (control.Controls.Count > 0)
				{
					GetToolbarControls(toolbars, control.Controls);
				}
			}
		}

		private ToolBase GetToolbarToolToActivate(out UltraToolbar owningToolbar)
		{
			owningToolbar = MainMenuBar;
			if (owningToolbar != null)
			{
				ToolBase nextTool = owningToolbar.Tools.GetNextTool(null, visibleToolsOnly: true, selectableToolsOnly: true, recentlyUsedToolsOnly: false, wrapAround: false);
				if (nextTool is SystemMenuTool)
				{
					ToolBase nextTool2 = owningToolbar.Tools.GetNextTool(nextTool, visibleToolsOnly: true, selectableToolsOnly: true, recentlyUsedToolsOnly: false, wrapAround: false);
					if (nextTool2 != null)
					{
						return nextTool2;
					}
				}
				if (nextTool != null)
				{
					return nextTool;
				}
			}
			DockedPosition[] array = new DockedPosition[4]
			{
				DockedPosition.Top,
				DockedPosition.Right,
				DockedPosition.Bottom,
				DockedPosition.Left
			};
			DockedPosition[] array2 = array;
			foreach (DockedPosition dockedPosition in array2)
			{
				ToolBase nextTool = GetToolbarToolToActivate(GetValidDockArea(DockedPosition.Top), out owningToolbar);
				if (nextTool != null)
				{
					return nextTool;
				}
			}
			if (floatingWindows == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (FloatingToolbarWindowBase floatingWindow in floatingWindows)
			{
				owningToolbar = floatingWindow.Toolbar;
				ToolBase nextTool = owningToolbar.Tools.GetNextTool(null, visibleToolsOnly: true, selectableToolsOnly: true, recentlyUsedToolsOnly: false, wrapAround: false);
				if (!(nextTool is SystemMenuTool))
				{
					return nextTool;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private ToolBase GetToolbarToolToActivate(UltraToolbarsDockArea dockArea, out UltraToolbar owningToolbar)
		{
			owningToolbar = null;
			if (dockArea == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<DockRow> dockRows = dockArea.DockRows;
			if (dockRows == null || dockRows.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			using (List<DockRow>.Enumerator enumerator = dockRows.GetEnumerator())
			{
				if (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					DockRow current = enumerator.Current;
					foreach (UltraToolbarBase toolbar in current.Toolbars)
					{
						owningToolbar = toolbar as UltraToolbar;
						if (owningToolbar != null)
						{
							ToolBase nextTool = owningToolbar.Tools.GetNextTool(null, visibleToolsOnly: true, selectableToolsOnly: true, recentlyUsedToolsOnly: false, wrapAround: false);
							if (!(nextTool is SystemMenuTool))
							{
								return nextTool;
							}
						}
					}
					return null;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal bool HasFocusedAccessibleObject()
		{
			if (!IsFormActiveInternal)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ToolBase toolBase = ActiveTool;
			if (toolBase != null && toolBase.Editor != null && toolBase.Editor.IsInEditMode)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (IsToolbarListMenuAgentOpen)
			{
				MenuItemBase activeMenuItem = ToolbarListMenuAgent.ActiveMenuItem;
				if (activeMenuItem != null)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			PopupControlBase currentPopupControl = CurrentPopupControl;
			if (currentPopupControl != null)
			{
				MenuAgentBase menuAgent = currentPopupControl.MenuAgent;
				if (menuAgent != null)
				{
					MenuItemBase activeMenuItem2 = menuAgent.ActiveMenuItem;
					if (activeMenuItem2 != null)
					{
						if (activeMenuItem2 is GalleryToolMenuItem galleryToolMenuItem)
						{
							if (galleryToolMenuItem.GalleryTool.ActiveItem == null)
							{
								return galleryToolMenuItem.GalleryTool.IsFilterBarActive;
							}
							return true;
						}
						return true;
					}
					if (menuAgent is RibbonMenuAgentBase ribbonMenuAgentBase)
					{
						if (ribbonMenuAgentBase.ItemWithFocus != null)
						{
							return ribbonMenuAgentBase.ItemWithFocus.AccessibleObject != null;
						}
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			if (ObjectWithFocus is Ribbon)
			{
				if (Ribbon.ItemWithFocus != null)
				{
					return Ribbon.ItemWithFocus.AccessibleObject != null;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (ToolOwnerWithCapture == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			toolBase = ActiveTool;
			if (toolBase != null && toolBase.HasFocus)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void HookComponentChangeService()
		{
			if (!hookedIntoComponentChangeService && ((Component)(object)this).GetService(typeof(IComponentChangeService)) is IComponentChangeService componentChangeService)
			{
				hookedIntoComponentChangeService = true;
				componentChangeService.ComponentRemoving += OnComponentRemoving;
				componentChangeService.ComponentRename += OnComponentRename;
				componentChangeService.ComponentAdded += OnComponentAdded;
				componentChangeService.ComponentChanged += OnComponentChanged;
				componentChangeService.ComponentChanging += OnComponentChanging;
			}
		}

		internal void HookEditorEvents(EmbeddableEditorBase editor)
		{
			//IL_0086: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0090: Expected O, but got Unknown
			editor.AfterEnterEditMode += OnEditor_AfterEnterEditMode;
			editor.AfterExitEditMode += OnEditor_AfterExitEditMode;
			editor.BeforeEnterEditMode += OnEditor_BeforeEnterEditMode;
			editor.KeyDown += OnEditor_KeyDown;
			editor.KeyPress += OnEditor_KeyPress;
			editor.KeyUp += OnEditor_KeyUp;
			editor.ValueChanged += OnEditor_ValueChanged;
			editor.BeforeExitEditMode += new BeforeExitEditModeEventHandler(OnEditor_BeforeExitEditMode);
			if (editor.SupportsDropDown)
			{
				editor.BeforeDropDown += OnEditor_BeforeDropDown;
				editor.AfterDropDown += OnEditor_AfterDropdown;
				editor.AfterCloseUp += OnEditor_AfterCloseup;
				editor.SelectionChanged += OnEditor_SelectionChanged;
			}
		}

		private void HookFormEvents()
		{
			if (initializing)
			{
				return;
			}
			ContainerControl containerControl = FindContainer();
			UnhookFormEvents();
			hookedContainerControl = containerControl;
			if (dockWithinContainer != null)
			{
				dockWithinContainer.Resize += OnDockWithinContainerResized;
			}
			if (containerControl != null)
			{
				containerControl.Layout += OnFormLayout;
				containerControl.Move += OnFormMove;
				containerControl.Resize += OnFormResize;
				containerControl.Paint += OnFormPaint;
				containerControl.ParentChanged += OnFormParentChanged;
				containerControl.PaddingChanged += OnFormPaddingChanged;
				containerControl.SizeChanged += OnContainerSizeChanged;
			}
			if (containerControl is Form form)
			{
				form.Activated += OnFormActivated;
				form.Closed += OnFormClosed;
				form.Deactivate += OnFormDeactivate;
				form.MdiChildActivate += OnFormMdiChildActivated;
				form.MenuStart += OnFormMenuStart;
				form.SizeChanged += OnFormSizeChanged;
				form.LocationChanged += OnFormLocationChanged;
				form.Disposed += OnFormDisposed;
				form.Load += OnModalFormLoad;
				form.TextChanged += OnFormTextChanged;
				try
				{
					UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
					if (Utilities.CanAssert)
					{
						uIPermission.Assert();
					}
					if (form.MdiParent != null)
					{
						HookMdiParentEvents(form.MdiParent);
					}
					CodeAccessPermission.RevertAssert();
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
				}
				cachedFormWindowState = form.WindowState;
				OnFormTextChanged(form, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
			else
			{
				object wpfWindow = WPFInteropUtilities.GetWpfWindow((Control)containerControl);
				if (wpfWindow != null)
				{
					WPFInteropUtilities.AddEventHanderViaReflection(wpfWindow, "Activated", (object)this, "OnFormActivated", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic, new Type[2]
					{
						typeof(object),
						typeof(EventArgs)
					}, new ParameterModifier[0]);
					WPFInteropUtilities.AddEventHanderViaReflection(wpfWindow, "Closed", (object)this, "OnFormClosed", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic, new Type[2]
					{
						typeof(object),
						typeof(EventArgs)
					}, new ParameterModifier[0]);
					WPFInteropUtilities.AddEventHanderViaReflection(wpfWindow, "Deactivated", (object)this, "OnFormDeactivate", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic, new Type[2]
					{
						typeof(object),
						typeof(EventArgs)
					}, new ParameterModifier[0]);
					WPFInteropUtilities.AddEventHanderViaReflection(wpfWindow, "Loaded", (object)this, "OnFormLoad", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic, new Type[2]
					{
						typeof(object),
						typeof(EventArgs)
					}, new ParameterModifier[0]);
					WPFInteropUtilities.AddEventHanderViaReflection(wpfWindow, "LocationChanged", (object)this, "OnFormLocationChanged", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic, new Type[2]
					{
						typeof(object),
						typeof(EventArgs)
					}, new ParameterModifier[0]);
					WPFInteropUtilities.AddEventHanderViaReflection(wpfWindow, "SizeChanged", (object)this, "OnFormSizeChanged", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic, new Type[2]
					{
						typeof(object),
						typeof(EventArgs)
					}, new ParameterModifier[0]);
				}
			}
		}

		private void HookActiveMdiChildEvents(Form activeMdiChild)
		{
			UnhookActiveMdiChildEvents();
			if (activeMdiChild != null)
			{
				activeMdiChild.Resize += OnActiveMdiChildResize;
				activeMdiChild.Disposed += OnActiveMdiChildDisposed;
				activeMdiChild.Closed += OnActiveMdiChildClosed;
				activeMdiChild.TextChanged += OnActiveMdiChildTextChanged;
				hookedActiveMdiChild = activeMdiChild;
			}
		}

		private void HookEndInitForm(Form form)
		{
			UnhookEndInitForm();
			hookedEndInitForm = form;
			if (form == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			form.Load += OnFormLoad;
			form.HandleCreated += OnFormHandleCreated;
			form.MdiChildActivate += OnFormMdiChildActivated;
			try
			{
				UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					uIPermission.Assert();
				}
				HookMdiParentEvents(form.MdiParent);
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
		}

		private void HookEndInitUserControl(UserControl userControl)
		{
			UnhookEndInitUserControl();
			hookedUserControl = userControl;
			if (userControl != null)
			{
				userControl.Load += OnFormLoad;
				userControl.HandleCreated += OnFormHandleCreated;
			}
		}

		private void HookMdiParentEvents(Form mdiParent)
		{
			UnhookMdiParentEvents();
			if (mdiParent != null)
			{
				hookedMdiParent = mdiParent;
				hookedMdiParent.MdiChildActivate += OnMdiParentFormActivationChanged;
				hookedMdiParent.Activated += OnMdiParentFormActivationChanged;
				hookedMdiParent.Deactivate += OnMdiParentFormActivationChanged;
			}
		}

		private void HookOwnedFormDeactivateEvent()
		{
			if (!IsFormActiveInternal)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				Form activeForm = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ActiveForm;
				if (activeForm != null && activeForm != activeOwnedForm && activeForm != FindForm())
				{
					if (activeOwnedForm != null)
					{
						activeOwnedForm.Deactivate -= OnOwnedFormDeactivate;
					}
					activeOwnedForm = activeForm;
					activeOwnedForm.Deactivate += OnOwnedFormDeactivate;
				}
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
		}

		private void HookupAllSubObjects()
		{
			foreach (ToolBase tool in Tools)
			{
				tool.SharedProps.InternalSetRootTool(tool);
				tool.OnToolbarsManagerInitialized();
			}
			foreach (ToolBase mergedTool in MergedTools)
			{
				mergedTool.OnToolbarsManagerInitialized();
			}
			foreach (UltraToolbar toolbar in Toolbars)
			{
				toolbar.HookupTools();
			}
			if (HasMiniToolbar)
			{
				MiniToolbar.HookupTools();
			}
			if (HasRibbon)
			{
				Ribbon.HookupAllSubObjects();
			}
			if (HasNavigationToolbar)
			{
				NavigationToolbar.HookupTools();
			}
		}

		private void HookupDeserializedObjects()
		{
			if (appearanceHolder != null)
			{
				appearanceHolder.Collection = Appearances;
				appearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (dockAreaAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				dockAreaAppearanceHolder.Collection = Appearances;
				dockAreaAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (dockAreaVerticalAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				dockAreaVerticalAppearanceHolder.Collection = Appearances;
				dockAreaVerticalAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (horizontalToolbarGrabHandleAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				horizontalToolbarGrabHandleAppearanceHolder.Collection = Appearances;
				horizontalToolbarGrabHandleAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (verticalToolbarGrabHandleAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				verticalToolbarGrabHandleAppearanceHolder.Collection = Appearances;
				verticalToolbarGrabHandleAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (menuSettings != null)
			{
				menuSettings.Initialize(this);
			}
			if (toolbarSettings != null)
			{
				toolbarSettings.Initialize(this);
			}
			if (mergedTools != null)
			{
				foreach (ToolBase mergedTool in mergedTools)
				{
					if (mergedTool is PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool)
					{
						popupMenuTool.HookupToolsSharedProps();
					}
					mergedTool.SharedProps.InternalSetRootTool(mergedTool);
				}
			}
			OptionSets.Initialize(this);
			Tools.Initialize(this);
			MergedTools.Initialize(this);
			Toolbars.Initialize(this);
			if (ribbon != null)
			{
				ribbon.Initialize(this);
			}
			if (navigationToolbar != null)
			{
				navigationToolbar.Initialize(this);
			}
			if (miniToolbar != null)
			{
				miniToolbar.Initialize(this);
			}
			HookupAllSubObjects();
			if (ActiveMdiChildManager != null && IsMdiMerged)
			{
				MergeMdiChild(ActiveMdiChildManager);
			}
			if (notificationBadgeSettings != null)
			{
				((SubObjectBase)(object)notificationBadgeSettings).SubObjectPropChanged += SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			Toolbars.AddToolbarsToDockAreas();
		}

		private void Initialize()
		{
			try
			{
				InitUserPreferenceChanged();
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private void InitializeDockWithinContainer(Control newDockWithinContainer)
		{
			if (dockWithinContainer != newDockWithinContainer)
			{
				dockWithinContainer = newDockWithinContainer;
				if (IsDesignMode)
				{
					dockWithinContainerBaseType = newDockWithinContainer?.GetType();
				}
				DockingAreaManager.RegisterDockingAreaParent(dockWithinContainer);
				HookComponentChangeService();
				HookFormEvents();
				if (IsDesignMode)
				{
					VerifyDesignerDesignModeState();
				}
			}
		}

		private void InitializeDockAreaToolbars()
		{
			try
			{
				DrawUtility.BeginGraphicsCaching();
				dockAreaToolbarsInitialized = true;
				for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
				{
					AddToolbarsToDockArea((DockedPosition)i);
				}
				foreach (FloatingToolbarWindowBase floatingWindow in FloatingWindows)
				{
					if (floatingWindow.Toolbar is UltraTaskPaneToolbar)
					{
						floatingWindow.DockArea.ReparentContainedControls(takeOwnership: true);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				DrawUtility.EndGraphicsCaching();
			}
		}

		private void InitializeFrom(UltraToolbarsStreamer uts)
		{
			//IL_01dc: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01e1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_02ff: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0304: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0323: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0328: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0353: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0358: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_04f2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_04f7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0590: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0595: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (appearances != null)
			{
				((SubObjectBase)(object)appearances).SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				((DisposableObject)(object)appearances).Dispose();
			}
			appearances = uts.appearances;
			if (uts.appearances != null)
			{
				appearances.Initialize((IImageListProvider)(object)this);
				((SubObjectBase)(object)appearances).SubObjectPropChanged += SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (appearanceHolder != null)
			{
				appearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				appearanceHolder.Reset();
			}
			appearanceHolder = uts.appearanceHolder;
			if (uts.appearanceHolder != null)

		private void InitializeSystemMenu(IntPtr hMenu, Form form, ref SystemMenuTool systemMenu, ref Image systemMenuImage, ref Stream systemMenuImageStream, UltraToolbarBase systemMenuToolbar, SystemMenuSource menuSource)
		{
			if (systemMenuImage != null)
			{
				systemMenuImage.Dispose();
				systemMenuImage = null;
			}
			if (systemMenuImageStream != null)
			{
				systemMenuImageStream.Close();
				systemMenuImageStream = null;
			}
			if (systemMenuToolbar == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Icon icon = form.Icon;
			if (icon != null)
			{
				Size size = ((systemMenuToolbar == null) ? ImageSizeToolbarResolved : ((systemMenuToolbar.ToolbarType != ToolbarType.TabItemAreaToolbar) ? (systemMenuToolbar.UseLargeImagesResolved ? ImageSizeLargeResolved : ImageSizeSmallResolved) : SystemInformation.SmallIconSize));
				try
				{
					bool flag = true;
					if (icon.Size != size)
					{
						try
						{
							Icon icon2 = new Icon(icon, size);
							if (icon2.Size != icon.Size)
							{
								systemMenuImage = icon2.ToBitmap();
								flag = false;
							}
							if (icon2 != icon)
							{
								icon2.Dispose();
							}
						}
						catch
						{
						}
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						systemMenuImageStream = new MemoryStream();
						icon.Save(systemMenuImageStream);
						systemMenuImageStream.Position = 0L;
						try
						{
							systemMenuImage = Image.FromStream(systemMenuImageStream);
						}
						catch
						{
							systemMenuImageStream.Close();
							systemMenuImageStream = null;
							Icon icon3 = null;
							if (icon.Size.Width > 16)
							{
								try
								{
									icon3 = new Icon(icon, new Size(16, 16));
								}
								catch
								{
								}
							}
							if (icon3 != null)
							{
								systemMenuImage = icon3.ToBitmap();
								icon3.Dispose();
							}
							else
							{
								systemMenuImage = icon.ToBitmap();
							}
						}
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			try
			{
				if (systemMenu == null || systemMenu.OwnerInternal != systemMenuToolbar || !(systemMenu.Handle == hMenu))
				{
					systemMenu = new SystemMenuTool(systemMenuToolbar, hMenu, menuSource);
					systemMenu.PopuplateMenu(forceReload: false);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (systemMenu != null)
				{
					if (systemMenuImage != null)
					{
						systemMenu.SharedProps.AppearancesSmall.Appearance.Image = systemMenuImage;
					}
					else
					{
						systemMenu.SharedProps.AppearancesSmall.Appearance.Image = GetCachedBitmap(CachedBitmapIndex.DefaultForm);
					}
				}
				((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).DirtyChildElements();
			}
		}

		private void InvalidateOverlayControl()
		{
			if (!IsDesignMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				Type type = Type.GetType("System.Windows.Forms.Design.ISelectionUIService, System.Design");
				if (type == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				object service = ((Component)(object)this).GetService(type);
				if (service == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					MethodInfo method = type.GetMethod("SyncSelection");
					if (method != null)
					{
						method.Invoke(service, new object[0]);
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (((Component)(object)this).GetService(typeof(ISelectionService)) is ISelectionService selectionService && selectionService.GetComponentSelected(DockWithinContainer))
				{
					object[] components = new object[1] { DockWithinContainer };
					bool flag = selectionService.PrimarySelection == DockWithinContainer;
					selectionService.SetSelectedComponents(components, SelectionTypes.Remove);
					selectionService.SetSelectedComponents(components, SelectionTypes.Add);
					if (flag)
					{
						selectionService.SetSelectedComponents(components, SelectionTypes.Click);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InvalidateToolbar(UltraToolbar toolbar)
		{
			if (toolbar == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraToolbar toolbarBase = ((toolbar.OwningTaskPaneToolbar == null) ? toolbar : toolbar.OwningTaskPaneToolbar);
			UltraToolbarsDockArea toolbarDockArea = GetToolbarDockArea(toolbarBase);
			if (toolbarDockArea == null || !((Control)(object)toolbarDockArea).Visible || !((Control)(object)toolbarDockArea).IsHandleCreated)
			{
				return;
			}
			UIElement mainUIElement = (UIElement)(object)((IUltraControlElement)toolbarDockArea).MainUIElement;
			if (mainUIElement != null)
			{
				mainUIElement = mainUIElement.GetDescendant(toolbar.UIElementType, (object)toolbar);
				if (mainUIElement != null)
				{
					mainUIElement.Invalidate(false);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool IsEditorOnActiveForm(EmbeddableEditorBase editor)
		{
			if (!IsFormActiveInternal)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!editor.IsInEditMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			EmbeddableUIElementBase elementBeingEdited = editor.ElementBeingEdited;
			Control control = ((elementBeingEdited == null) ? null : ((UIElement)elementBeingEdited).Control);
			if (control == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Utilities.IsActiveFormRelated(control);
		}

		private static bool IsDescendantOf(IntPtr potentialDescendant, IntPtr potentialAncestor)
		{
			try
			{
				UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					uIPermission.Assert();
				}
				Control control = Control.FromHandle(potentialDescendant);
				Control control2 = Control.FromHandle(potentialAncestor);
				if (control == null || control2 == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (control.InvokeRequired || control2.InvokeRequired)
				{
					return false;
				}
				Control parent = control.Parent;
				while (parent != null && parent.Handle != potentialAncestor)
				{
					parent = parent.Parent;
				}
				if (parent != null)
				{
					return parent.Handle == potentialAncestor;
				}
				return false;
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool IsDockAreaValid(UltraToolbarsDockArea dockArea, Control parent)
		{
			if (dockArea == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (dockArea.ToolbarsManager != this)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (((Control)(object)dockArea).IsDisposed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!parent.Controls.Contains((Control)(object)dockArea))
			{
				((Control)(object)dockArea).Parent = parent;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool IsFullScreen(Rectangle clientRect)
		{
			Screen screen = Utilities.ScreenFromRectangle(clientRect);
			return Rectangle.Intersect(screen.Bounds, clientRect).Height == screen.Bounds.Height;
		}

		private void LoadHelper(Stream stream, IFormatter formatter)
		{
			UltraToolbarsStreamer ultraToolbarsStreamer = null;
			Control control = dockWithinContainer;
			control?.SuspendLayout();
			bool designerChangeNotificationsEnabled = ((IUltraComponent)this).DesignerChangeNotificationsEnabled;
			((IUltraComponent)this).DesignerChangeNotificationsEnabled = false;

			{

					ReparentContainedControls(takeOwnership: false);

				}

					throw new ApplicationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_108")), innerException);
				}

				loadVersion++;
				if (ultraToolbarsStreamer != null)
				{
					if (captionSystemMenu != null)
					{
						captionSystemMenu.Dispose();
						captionSystemMenu = null;
					}
					if (systemMenu != null)
					{
						systemMenu.Dispose();
						systemMenu = null;
					}
					foreach (UltraToolbar toolbar in toolbars)
					{
						RemoveToolbarFromDockArea(toolbar);
					}
					InitializeFrom(ultraToolbarsStreamer);
				}
				if (Initializing)
				{
					deserializedObjectsNeedToBeHookedUp = true;
				}
				else
				{
					deserializedObjectsNeedToBeHookedUp = false;
					HookupDeserializedObjects();
				}
				DelayedRefreshGlass();
				lastHideToolbarsSetting = !HideToolbarsResolved;
				EvaluateToolbarVisibility();
				ResetCachedResolvedStyle();
