				{
					SynchronizeFormBorderStyle(initializing: false);
				}
				UltraToolbarsDockArea[] array = dockAreas;
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					array[i]?.RecreateControlElement();
				}
				((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).DirtyChildElements();
			}
			finally
			{
				loading = false;
				if (HasRibbon)
				{
					ribbon.RefreshDockAreaSize();
				}
				UltraToolbarsDockArea[] array2 = dockAreas;
				for (int j = 0; j < array2.Length; j++)
				{
					array2[j]?.RefreshDockAreaSize();
				}
				if (control != null)
				{
					try
					{
						ReparentContainedControls(takeOwnership: true);
					}
					catch
					{
					}
					control.ResumeLayout(performLayout: true);
				}
				if (customizing)
				{
					NotifyCustomizeModeChange();
				}
				((IUltraComponent)this).DesignerChangeNotificationsEnabled = designerChangeNotificationsEnabled;
				((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyDesignEnvironmentOfChange();
				FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.LoadHelperComplete, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		private void MergeMdiChild(UltraToolbarsManager childToolbarsManager)
		{
			bool isUpdating = ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).IsUpdating;
			if (!isUpdating)
			{
				((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).BeginUpdate();
			}
			bool flag = isMergingMdiChild;
			isMergingMdiChild = true;
			try
			{
				MergeMdiChildRootTools(childToolbarsManager);
				MergeMdiChildToolbars(childToolbarsManager);
				MergeMdiChildToolbarTools();
				MergeMdiChildMenuTools();
				if (HasRibbon || childToolbarsManager.HasRibbon)
				{
					Ribbon.MergeMdiChild(childToolbarsManager.Ribbon);
				}
				if (HasMiniToolbar || childToolbarsManager.HasMiniToolbar)
				{
					MiniToolbar.MergeMdiChildToolbar(childToolbarsManager.MiniToolbar);
				}
				if (HasNavigationToolbar || childToolbarsManager.HasNavigationToolbar)
				{
					NavigationToolbar.MergeMdiChildToolbar(childToolbarsManager.NavigationToolbar);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				isMergingMdiChild = flag;
				if (!isUpdating)
				{
					((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).EndUpdate();
				}
			}
			foreach (FloatingToolbarWindowBase floatingWindow in FloatingWindows)
			{
				if (floatingWindow != null && floatingWindow.Toolbar != null && floatingWindow.Toolbar.DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Floating)
				{
					floatingWindow.SetWindowSize();
				}
				if (!floatingWindow.Visible && floatingWindow.Toolbar.VisibleResolved && floatingWindow.Toolbar.DockedPosition == DockedPosition.Floating)
				{
					floatingWindow.ShowNoActivate();
				}
			}
			BumpToolLayoutVersion();
		}

		private void MergeMdiChildRootTools(UltraToolbarsManager childToolbarsManager)
		{
			IComparer<ToolBase> instance = ToolListComparer.Instance;
			List<ToolBase> cachedToolsList = CachedToolsList;
			List<ToolBase> cachedToolsList2 = childToolbarsManager.CachedToolsList;
			List<ToolBase> list = MergedTools.CloneIntoList();
			if (list.Count > 1)
			{
				list.Sort(instance);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < cachedToolsList.Count; i++)
			{
				cachedToolsList[i].ResetParentMergeState();
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
			{
				list[j].IsHiddenByMdiMerge = true;
			}
			int k = 0;
			int l = 0;
			foreach (ToolBase item in cachedToolsList2)
			{
				for (; k < cachedToolsList.Count && instance.Compare(cachedToolsList[k], item) < 0; k++)
				{
				}
				ToolBase toolBase = ((k < cachedToolsList.Count) ? cachedToolsList[k] : null);
				bool isMergeToolRequired = false;
				if (toolBase != null && instance.Compare(toolBase, item) == 0)
				{
					MenuMergeType mergeType = ResolveMergeType(toolBase, item);
					toolBase.MergeWithChildRootTool(mergeType, item, out isMergeToolRequired);
					k++;
				}
				else
				{
					switch (item.SharedProps.MergeType)
					{
					case MenuMergeType.Default:
					case MenuMergeType.Add:
					case MenuMergeType.MergeItems:
					case MenuMergeType.Replace:
						isMergeToolRequired = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (isMergeToolRequired)
				{
					for (; l < list.Count && instance.Compare(list[l], item) < 0; l++)
					{
					}
					ToolBase toolBase2 = ((l < list.Count) ? list[l] : null);
					ToolBase toolBase3 = null;
					toolBase3 = ((toolBase2 == null || instance.Compare(toolBase2, item) != 0) ? item.CreateMergeRootTool(this) : toolBase2);
					if (toolBase3 != null)
					{
						toolBase3.InternalSetUnderlyingTool(item);
						toolBase3.IsHiddenByMdiMerge = false;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void MergeMdiChildToolbars(UltraToolbarsManager childToolbarsManager)
		{
			foreach (UltraToolbar toolbar in Toolbars)
			{
				toolbar.OnBeforeMdiMerge();
			}
			List<UltraToolbar> list = new List<UltraToolbar>();
			foreach (UltraToolbar toolbar2 in childToolbarsManager.Toolbars)
			{
				if (toolbar2.IsMainMenuBar || toolbar2.ToolbarType != ToolbarType.Standard)
				{
					continue;
				}
				int num = Toolbars.IndexOf(toolbar2.Key);
				UltraToolbar ultraToolbar = ((num < 0) ? null : Toolbars[num]);
				bool flag = false;
				bool flag2 = false;
				string key = null;
				if (ultraToolbar != null)
				{
					flag = ultraToolbar.IsTaskPaneToolbar != toolbar2.IsTaskPaneToolbar;
					flag2 = ultraToolbar.IsMainMenuBar;
					int num2 = -1;
					if (flag)
					{
						key = "_mdichild.merge.collision.key_" + toolbar2.Key;
						num2 = Toolbars.IndexOf(key);
					}
					else if (flag2)
					{
						key = "_mdichild.toolbar.reserved.key_";
						num2 = Toolbars.IndexOf(key);
					}
					if (0 <= num2)
					{
						ultraToolbar = Toolbars[num2];
						ultraToolbar.MergeWithChildToolbar(toolbar2);
						continue;
					}
				}
				if (ultraToolbar == null || flag2 || flag)
				{
					ultraToolbar = (UltraToolbar)toolbar2.Clone();
					list.Add(ultraToolbar);
					ultraToolbar.IsMdiMergeToolbar = true;
					ultraToolbar.InitialDockPending = true;
					if (flag || flag2)
					{
						ultraToolbar.Key = key;
						Toolbars.InternalAdd(ultraToolbar, allowMdiMainMenuReservedKeyName: true);
					}
					else
					{
						Toolbars.Add(ultraToolbar);
					}
				}
				ultraToolbar.MergeWithChildToolbar(toolbar2);
			}
			UltraToolbar mainMenuBar = childToolbarsManager.MainMenuBar;
			if (mainMenuBar != null)
			{
				UltraToolbar mainMenuBar2 = MainMenuBar;
				if (mainMenuBar2 != null)
				{
					mainMenuBar2.IsHiddenByMdiMerge = false;
					if (mainMenuBar2.IsMdiMergeToolbar)
					{
						mainMenuBar2.InternalSetUnderlyingToolbar(mainMenuBar);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					UltraToolbar ultraToolbar2 = mainMenuBar.Clone() as UltraToolbar;
					list.Add(ultraToolbar2);
					ultraToolbar2.IsMdiMergeToolbar = true;
					ultraToolbar2.Key = "_mdi.mainmenu.reserved.key_";
					Toolbars.InternalAdd(ultraToolbar2, allowMdiMainMenuReservedKeyName: true);
					ultraToolbar2.MergeWithChildToolbar(mainMenuBar);
				}
			}
			List<UltraToolbar> list2 = new List<UltraToolbar>();
			List<UltraToolbar> list3 = new List<UltraToolbar>();
			foreach (UltraToolbar toolbar3 in Toolbars)
			{
				if (!toolbar3.IsMdiMergeToolbar)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (toolbar3.UnderlyingToolbar == null || toolbar3.UnderlyingToolbar.ToolbarsManager != ActiveMdiChildManager)
				{
					toolbar3.IsHiddenByMdiMerge = true;
					continue;
				}
				toolbar3.IsHiddenByMdiMerge = false;
				if (toolbar3.VisibleResolved)
				{
					if (list.Contains(toolbar3))
					{
						list3.Add(toolbar3);
					}
					else
					{
						list2.Add(toolbar3);
					}
				}
			}
			AddToolbarsToDockArea(list2);
			AddToolbarsToDockArea(list3);
		}

		private void MergeMdiChildToolbarTools()
		{
			if (MainMenuBar != null)
			{
				MainMenuBar.MergeMdiChildToolbar(ActiveMdiChildManager.MainMenuBar);
			}
			foreach (UltraToolbar toolbar in Toolbars)
			{
				if (!toolbar.IsMainMenuBar)
				{
					toolbar.MergeMdiChildToolbar(toolbar.UnderlyingToolbar);
				}
			}
		}

		private void MergeMdiChildMenuTools()
		{
			foreach (ToolBase mergedTool in MergedTools)
			{
				if (mergedTool is PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool && mergedTool.UnderlyingTool is PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool2)
				{
					popupMenuTool.Tools.MergeMdiChildTools(popupMenuTool2.Tools);
				}
			}
			foreach (ToolBase tool in Tools)
			{
				if (!(tool is PopupMenuTool { IsHiddenByMdiMerge: false } popupMenuTool3))
				{
					continue;
				}
				PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool4 = popupMenuTool3.UnderlyingTool as PopupMenuTool;
				if (popupMenuTool4 == popupMenuTool3)
				{
					popupMenuTool4 = null;
				}
				if (popupMenuTool4 == null && ActiveMdiChildManager != null && !(MergedTools[((IKeyedSubObjectEx)tool).KeyLowercaseInterned, ToolTypeID.GetToolTypeIDFromType(tool.GetType())] is PopupMenuTool { IsHiddenByMdiMerge: false }))
				{
					int num = ActiveMdiChildManager.Tools.IndexOf(popupMenuTool3.Key);
					if (num >= 0)
					{
						popupMenuTool4 = ActiveMdiChildManager.Tools[num] as PopupMenuTool;
					}
				}
				if (popupMenuTool4 != null)
				{
					MenuMergeType menuMergeType = ResolveMergeType(popupMenuTool3, popupMenuTool4);
					if (menuMergeType == MenuMergeType.MergeItems || menuMergeType == MenuMergeType.Replace)
					{
						popupMenuTool3.InternalSetUnderlyingTool(popupMenuTool4);
						popupMenuTool3.Tools.MergeMdiChildTools(popupMenuTool4.Tools);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					popupMenuTool3.Tools.MergeMdiChildTools(null);
				}
			}
		}

		{
			if (((Component)(object)this).GetService(typeof(IComponentChangeService)) is IComponentChangeService componentChangeService)
			{
				componentChangeService.OnComponentChanged(changedValue, null, null, null);
			}
		}

		private void NotifyToolbarDragStart()
		{
			if (!waitingToSendToolbarDragStart)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				if (Customizing && CustomizeDialog != null)
				{
					CustomizeDialog.DragItemStart(DragItemType.Toolbar);
				}
				HideToolTip(dispose: false);
				waitingToSendToolbarDragStart = false;
			}
			catch
			{
				OnDragToolbarEnd();
			}
		}

		private void NotifyToolbarDragEnd()
		{
			if (!waitingToSendToolbarDragStart)
			{
				waitingToSendToolbarDragStart = true;
				if (Customizing && CustomizeDialog != null)
				{
					CustomizeDialog.DragItemEnd(DragItemType.Toolbar);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void NotifyCustomizeModeChange()
		{
			NotifyToolsOfCustomizeModeChange();
			if (HasRibbon)
			{
				if (customizing)
				{
					Ribbon.OnCustomizeModeBegin();
				}
				else
				{
					Ribbon.OnCustomizeModeEnd();
				}
			}
		}

		private void NotifyToolsOfCustomizeModeChange()
		{
			NotifyToolsOfCustomizeModeChangeHelper(Tools);
			if (mergedTools != null)
			{
				NotifyToolsOfCustomizeModeChangeHelper(mergedTools);
			}
		}

		private void NotifyToolsOfCustomizeModeChangeHelper(ToolsCollectionBase tools)
		{
			foreach (ToolBase tool in tools)
			{
				if (customizing)
				{
					tool.OnCustomizeModeBegin();
				}
				else
				{
					tool.OnCustomizeModeEnd();
				}
				foreach (ToolBase toolInstance in tool.SharedProps.ToolInstances)
				{
					if (customizing)
					{
						toolInstance.OnCustomizeModeBegin();
					}
					else
					{
						toolInstance.OnCustomizeModeEnd();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnComponentAdded(object sender, ComponentEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Component is IStatusBar && dockWithinContainer != null && dockWithinContainer.IsHandleCreated)
			{
				dockWithinContainer.BeginInvoke(new MethodInvoker(RefreshPreferredViewStyleOnSiblingComponents));
			}
		}

		private void OnComponentChanged(object sender, ComponentChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Component == DockWithinContainer && DockWithinContainer != null)
			{
				if ((e.Member == null || e.Member.Name == "Text") && ribbon != null)
				{
					ribbon.OnFormCaptionChanged();
				}
				return;
			}
			if (e.Component is ToolBase { IsRootTool: false } toolBase)
			{
				NotifyDesignEnvironmentOfComponentChanged(toolBase.Owner);
				return;
			}
			object component = e.Component;
			ValueList val = (ValueList)((component is ValueList) ? component : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ToolBase tool in Tools)
			{
				if (!(tool is ComboBoxTool comboBoxTool) || comboBoxTool.ValueList != val)
				{
					continue;
				}
				{
					foreach (ToolBase toolInstance in tool.SharedProps.ToolInstances)
					{
						NotifyDesignEnvironmentOfComponentChanged(toolInstance.Owner);
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnComponentChanging(object sender, ComponentChangingEventArgs e)
		{
			PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = e.Member as PropertyDescriptor;
			if (e.Component == this && propertyDescriptor != null && !typeof(UltraToolbarsManager).IsAssignableFrom(propertyDescriptor.ComponentType) && !propertyDescriptor.ComponentType.IsAssignableFrom(typeof(UltraToolbarsManager)))
			{
				((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyDesignEnvironmentOfChange();
			}
			else
			{
				if (e.Component == this)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (e.Component is ToolBase toolBase)
				{
					if (Tools.Contains(toolBase))
					{
						((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyDesignEnvironmentOfChange();
					}
					else if (!toolBase.IsRootTool)
					{
						NotifyDesignEnvironmentOfComponentChanging(toolBase.Owner);
					}
					return;
				}
				object component = e.Component;
				ValueList val = (ValueList)((component is ValueList) ? component : null);
				if (val == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (ToolBase tool in Tools)
				{
					if (!(tool is ComboBoxTool comboBoxTool) || comboBoxTool.ValueList != val)
					{
						continue;
					}
					{
						foreach (ToolBase toolInstance in tool.SharedProps.ToolInstances)
						{
							NotifyDesignEnvironmentOfComponentChanging(toolInstance.Owner);
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnComponentRemoving(object sender, ComponentEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Component != this)
			{
				return;
			}
			UnhookDesignerEvents();
			UnhookFormEvents();
			bool flag = false;
			try
			{
				Type type = Type.GetType("System.ComponentModel.Design.UndoEngine, System.Design, Version=2.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a", throwOnError: false);
				if (type != null)
				{
					object service = ((Component)(object)this).GetService(type);
					if (service != null)
					{
						PropertyInfo property = type.GetProperty("Enabled");
						if (property != null && !(bool)property.GetValue(service, new object[0]))
						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				UnhookDockAreas();
			}
			else
			{
				DestroyDockingAreas();
			}
			UnregisterDockWithinContainer();
			if (IsFormRounded && DockWithinContainer != null && DockWithinContainer.IsHandleCreated && !DockWithinContainer.Disposing && DockWithinContainer is Form)
			{
				bool flag2 = forceStandardDisplayStyle;
				forceStandardDisplayStyle = true;
				try
				{
					SynchronizeFormBorderStyle(initializing: false);
				}
				finally
				{
					forceStandardDisplayStyle = flag2;
				}
			}
			dockWithinContainer = null;
		}

		private void OnContextMenuPopup(object sender, CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(sender is ContextMenuStrip contextMenuStrip))
			{
				return;
			}
			NotifyIcon notifyIcon = null;
			Control control = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetContextMenuSourceControl(contextMenuStrip);
			string text = null;
			if (control != null)
			{
				text = GetContextMenuUltra(control);
				if (text == null)
				{
					for (Control parent = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetParent(control); parent != null; parent = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetParent(parent))
					{
						text = GetContextMenuUltra(parent);
						if (text != null)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else if (contextMenuUltras != null)
			{
				foreach (DictionaryEntry contextMenuUltra in contextMenuUltras)
				{
					if (contextMenuUltra.Value is ContextMenuUltraData contextMenuUltraData && contextMenuUltraData.Menu == contextMenuStrip)
					{
						text = contextMenuUltraData.Key;
						control = contextMenuUltra.Key as Control;
						if (control == null)
						{
							notifyIcon = contextMenuUltra.Key as NotifyIcon;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (text == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			PopupManager.CloseAllPopups(onlyCloseLeafContiguousPopupChain: false, onlyCloseDropDowns: true);
			try
			{
				if (notifyIcon != null)
				{
					ShowPopupForNotifyIcon(text, Control.MousePosition);
					return;
				}
				bool showMiniToolbar;
				Point screenPoint;
				if (contextMenuShiftF10KeyPending)
				{
					showMiniToolbar = false;
					Rectangle rectangle = control.RectangleToScreen(control.ClientRectangle);
					screenPoint = new Point((rectangle.Left + rectangle.Right) / 2, (rectangle.Top + rectangle.Bottom) / 2);
				}
				else
				{
					showMiniToolbar = (MiniToolbar.AutoShow & MiniToolbarAutoShow.OnContextMenuClick) != 0;
					screenPoint = Control.MousePosition;
				}
				if (contextMenuShiftF10KeyPending)
				{
					EnterHotkeyMode();
				}
				ShowPopup(text, screenPoint, control, showMiniToolbar);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private void OnEditor_AfterEnterEditMode(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			editorWantedLastKeyDown = false;
			EmbeddableEditorBase val = (EmbeddableEditorBase)((sender is EmbeddableEditorBase) ? sender : null);
			if (val == null || !val.IsInEditMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!val.CanFocus)
			{
				UIElement elementBeingEdited = (UIElement)(object)val.ElementBeingEdited;
				if (elementBeingEdited != null)
				{
					try
					{
						if (DisposableObject.HasSamePublicKey(elementBeingEdited.Control.GetType()))
						{
							Form form = FindFormHelper(elementBeingEdited.Control);
							if (form != null)
							{
								ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ActivateForm(form);
							}
							if (elementBeingEdited.Control is UltraToolbarsDockArea { IsParentedOnBackStage: not false } ultraToolbarsDockArea)
							{
								Utilities.FocusControlWithoutScrollingIntoView((Control)(object)ultraToolbarsDockArea);
							}
							else
							{
								ToolbarsManagerUtilities.FocusControl(elementBeingEdited.Control);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							elementBeingEdited.Control.FindForm().Activate();
							elementBeingEdited.Control.Focus();
						}
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
				}
				if (!val.IsInEditMode)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (((UIElement)val.ElementBeingEdited).GetContext(typeof(ToolBase)) is ToolBase toolBase)
			{
				FontNameEditor val2 = (FontNameEditor)(object)((val is FontNameEditor) ? val : null);
				if (toolBase is FontListTool fontListTool && val2 != null)
				{
					((EditorWithCombo)val2).MRUList = fontListTool.MruItems.All;
				}

		private void OnEditor_AfterExitEditMode(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{

			if (toolBase != null && CurrentPopupControl == null && AllowToolbarCaptureRelease)

				{

					if (control != null && control.CanSelect)
					{
						control.Select();
					}
					else
					{
						Form form = DockWithinContainer as Form;
						try

							if (form != null && form.IsMdiContainer && form.ActiveMdiChild != null)

							}

							}
						}
						catch (SecurityException)

						}
					}
				}
			}
			else if (uIElement != null)

		private void OnEditor_KeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			EmbeddableEditorBase val = (EmbeddableEditorBase)((sender is EmbeddableEditorBase) ? sender : null);
			ToolBase toolBase = ((val == null || val.ElementBeingEdited == null) ? null : (((UIElement)val.ElementBeingEdited).GetContext(typeof(ToolBase)) as ToolBase));
			ToolKeyEventArgs e2 = new ToolKeyEventArgs(ActiveTool, e.KeyData);
			FireEvent(ToolbarEventIds.ToolKeyDown, e2);
			if (e2.Handled)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
				return;
			}
			IEmbeddableTextBoxListener val2 = (IEmbeddableTextBoxListener)(object)((val is IEmbeddableTextBoxListener) ? val : null);
			if (val2 != null)
			{
				val2.OnKeyDown(e);
			}
			if (e.KeyCode == Keys.Escape)
			{
				if (val == null || !val.IsInEditMode || val.IsDroppedDown || val.IsInputKey(e.KeyData))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (toolBase != null && val == toolBase.Editor)
				{
					toolBase.ExitEditMode(forceExit: false, applyChanges: false);
				}
				else
				{
					val.ExitEditMode(false, false);
				}
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			if (e.KeyCode == Keys.Return && val != null && toolBase != null)
			{
				toolBase.IncrementClickCount();
				toolBase.OnToolClick();
				e.Handled = true;
				if ((toolBase.OwnerIsMenuInternal || toolBase.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea) && !toolBase.IsOnBackStage)
				{
					PopupManager.CloseAllPopups(onlyCloseLeafContiguousPopupChain: true);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnFormParentChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(dockWithinContainer is Form) || !(sender is Form form))
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					uIPermission.Assert();
				}
				if (mdiParentManager != null)
				{
					if (MdiMergeable && form.MdiParent == null)
					{
						InternalSetMdiParentManager(null);
						ResetToStandaloneManager();
					}
					return;
				}
				Form mdiParent = form.MdiParent;
				if (MdiMergeable && hookedMdiParent != null && mdiParent == null)
				{
					ResetToStandaloneManager();
				}
				HookMdiParentEvents(mdiParent);
				if (!(form.Parent is MdiClient) || !form.Parent.IsHandleCreated || mdiParent == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = FromForm(mdiParent);
				if (ultraToolbarsManager != null)
				{
					if (MdiMergeable && ultraToolbarsManager.MdiMergeable)
					{
						mdiParentManager = ultraToolbarsManager;
						hasMdiParentManagerBeenSet = true;
					}
					ultraToolbarsManager.OnNewMdiChildInitializing(this, form.Parent.Handle);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			finally
			{
				if (hookedEndInitForm == null)
				{
					if (form.IsHandleCreated)
					{
						SynchronizeFormBorderStyle(initializing: false);
					}
					else
					{
						form.HandleCreated += OnFormHandleCreatedAfterParentChange;
					}
				}
			}
		}

				}
			}
			if (control == null || !(control is ContainerControl))
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (UltraFormManager.GetIToolbarsManagerFromForm(control as Form) != null)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (!flag && FromContainer(control) != null)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				bool flag2 = false;
				bool flag3 = false;
				try
				{
					string name = Registry.CurrentUser.Name;
					RegistryPermission registryPermission = new RegistryPermission(RegistryPermissionAccess.AllAccess, name);
					if (Utilities.CanAssert)
					{
						registryPermission.Assert();
					}
					flag3 = true;
					RegistryKey registryKey = Registry.CurrentUser.CreateSubKey("Software\\Infragistics\\UltraWinToolbars");
					if (registryKey != null)
					{
						flag2 = Convert.ToBoolean(registryKey.GetValue("SuppressDockWithinContainerResolutionDialog", false));
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				finally
				{
					if (flag3)
					{
						CodeAccessPermission.RevertAssert();
					}
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					return;
				}
				ResolveDockWithinContainerDialog resolveDockWithinContainerDialog = new ResolveDockWithinContainerDialog(this);
				resolveDockWithinContainerDialog.ShowDialog();
				if (resolveDockWithinContainerDialog.SelectedDockWithinContainer == null)
				{
					DestroyDockingAreas();
					resolveDockWithinContainerDialog.Close();
					return;
				}
				control = resolveDockWithinContainerDialog.SelectedDockWithinContainer;
				resolveDockWithinContainerDialog.Close();
			}
			DesignerTransaction designerTransaction = designerHost.CreateTransaction();
			MemberDescriptor memberDescriptor = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(control)["Controls"];
			IComponentChangeService componentChangeService = designerHost.GetService(typeof(IComponentChangeService)) as IComponentChangeService;
			if (componentChangeService != null && memberDescriptor != null)
			{
				componentChangeService.OnComponentChanging(control, memberDescriptor);
			}
			try
			{
				CheckForFillControl(control);
				if (ShouldCreateDockingAreas)
				{
					CreateDockingAreas(control);
				}
				InitializeDockWithinContainer(control);
				InitializeDockAreaToolbars();
				SynchronizeFormBorderStyle(initializing: false);
				((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.DockWithinContainer);
			}
			finally
			{
				if (componentChangeService != null && memberDescriptor != null)
				{
					componentChangeService.OnComponentChanged(control, memberDescriptor, null, null);
				}
			}
			designerTransaction?.Commit();
		}

		private void OnModalFormLoad(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Form form = sender as Form;
			if (form.Modal && !form.IsDisposed && !form.Disposing)
			{
				if (form.IsHandleCreated)
				{
					form.BeginInvoke(new MethodInvoker(ResetFloatingWindowsEnabledState));
					return;
				}
				form.HandleCreated += OnModalFormHandleCreated;
				form.Disposed += OnModalFormDisposed;
			}
		}

		private void OnModalFormHandleCreated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Form form = sender as Form;
			form.HandleCreated -= OnModalFormHandleCreated;
			form.Disposed -= OnModalFormDisposed;
			form.BeginInvoke(new MethodInvoker(ResetFloatingWindowsEnabledState));
		}

		private void OnModalFormDisposed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Form form = sender as Form;
			form.HandleCreated -= OnModalFormHandleCreated;
			form.Disposed -= OnModalFormDisposed;
		}

		private void OnMouseHookMessageReceived(object sender, MouseHookEventArgs e)
		{
			if ((CustomizeDialog is InPlaceCustomizerBase && e.HookCode != 0) || (customizeDialog != null && !customizeDialog.IsEnabled))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (customizeDialog != null && !((Component)this).DesignMode)
			{
				Form form = FindForm();
				if (form != null && !((Component)this).DesignMode && form.Handle == e.Hwnd)
				{
					e.EatMessage = true;
					Cursor.Current = Cursors.Arrow;
				}
			}
			if (toolBeingDragged != null || toolBeingResized != null || toolbarBeingDragged != null || customizeDialog == null || (ribbon != null && Ribbon.TabManager.IsDragging))
			{
				return;
			}
			MouseAction mouseActionFromMouseMessage = GetMouseActionFromMouseMessage(e);
			ControlUIElementBase val = DockAreaElementFromScreenPoint(e.Point);
			IntPtr handle = WindowFromPoint(e.Point);
			MouseButtons mouseButtonFromMouseMessage = GetMouseButtonFromMouseMessage(e.MessageId);
			if (mouseActionFromMouseMessage == MouseAction.MouseDown)
			{
				if (CustomizeDialog.IsPointOverPopupMenu(e.Point))
				{
					return;
				}
				CustomizeDialog.CloseToolContextMenus();
			}
			if (customizeDialog != null && (customizeDialog.IsCustomizeDialogHandle(handle) || customizeDialog.IsPointOverCustomizer(e.Point) || customizeDialog.IsPointInCurrentOpenSubForm(e.Point)))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (mouseActionFromMouseMessage == MouseAction.MouseMove && ToolBeingDragged == null && ToolBeingResized == null && val != null)
			{
				Control control = ((UIElement)val).Control;
				if (control == null || control.IsDisposed || control.Disposing)
				{
					return;
				}
				UIElement val2 = ((UIElement)val).ElementFromPoint(control.PointToClient(e.Point));
				Point point = control.PointToClient(e.Point);
				if (val2 is GrabHandleUIElement && mouseButtonFromMouseMessage == MouseButtons.Left)
				{
					SetCustomizeDialogCapture(setOn: true);
					Cursor.Current = val2.Cursor;
					return;
				}
				ToolBase toolBase = null;
				while ((object)val2 != val)
				{
					toolBase = val2.GetContext(typeof(ToolBase), false) as ToolBase;
					if (toolBase != null)
					{
						break;
					}
					val2 = val2.Parent;
				}
				if (toolBase != null && CustomizingTool(toolBase) && toolBase.CanSetToolWidth && val2.PointInAdjustableArea(point))
				{
					SetCustomizeDialogCapture(setOn: true);
					Cursor.Current = GetAppropriateResizeCursor(val2, point);
					return;
				}
				if (CustomizeDialogHasCapture && (Control.MouseButtons & MouseButtons.Left) != MouseButtons.Left)
				{
					SetCustomizeDialogCapture(setOn: false);
				}
			}
			if (val != null && Customizing && CustomizeDialog != null)
			{
				Control control2 = ((UIElement)val).Control;
				if (control2 != null && !control2.IsDisposed && !control2.Disposing)
				{
					for (UIElement val3 = ((UIElement)val).ElementFromPoint(control2.PointToClient(e.Point)); val3 != null; val3 = val3.Parent)
					{
						if (val3 is ToolbarUIElement)
						{
							switch (mouseActionFromMouseMessage)
							{
							case MouseAction.MouseDown:
							{
								UltraToolbarBase ultraToolbarBase = ((ToolbarUIElement)(object)val3).ToolbarInternal;
								if (ultraToolbarBase != null && ultraToolbarBase.OwningTaskPaneToolbar != null)
								{
									ultraToolbarBase = ultraToolbarBase.OwningTaskPaneToolbar;
								}
								if (ultraToolbarBase != null && !ultraToolbarBase.IsBumpedToolsToolbar)
								{
									CustomizeDialog.OnToolbarClicked(ultraToolbarBase);
								}
								break;
							}
							case MouseAction.MouseDoubleClick:
								((ToolbarUIElement)(object)val3).ProcessDoubleClick();
								break;
							}
							break;
						}
						if (val3 is FloatingToolbarCaptionAreaUIElement)
						{
							switch (mouseActionFromMouseMessage)
							{
							case MouseAction.MouseDown:
								CustomizeDialog.OnToolbarClicked(((FloatingToolbarWindow)control2).Toolbar);
								break;
							case MouseAction.MouseDoubleClick:
								if (mouseButtonFromMouseMessage == MouseButtons.Left)
								{
									((FloatingToolbarCaptionAreaUIElement)(object)val3).ProcessDoubleClick();
								}
								break;
							}
							break;
						}
						if (val3 is TaskPaneToolbarUIElement)
						{
							switch (mouseActionFromMouseMessage)
							{
							case MouseAction.MouseDown:
								CustomizeDialog.OnToolbarClicked(((TaskPaneToolbarUIElement)(object)val3).Toolbar);
								break;
							case MouseAction.MouseDoubleClick:
								((TaskPaneToolbarUIElement)(object)val3).ToolbarElement.ProcessDoubleClick();
								break;
							}
							break;
						}
						if (val3 is RibbonTabItemUIElement && CanCustomizerAffectRibbon)
						{
							if (mouseActionFromMouseMessage == MouseAction.MouseDown)
							{
								CustomizeDialog.OnTabClicked(((TabItemUIElement)(RibbonTabItemUIElement)(object)val3).TabItem as RibbonTab);
							}
							break;
						}
						if (val3 is RibbonGroupUIElement && CanCustomizerAffectRibbon)
						{
							if (mouseActionFromMouseMessage == MouseAction.MouseDown)
							{
								CustomizeDialog.OnRibbonGroupClicked(((RibbonGroupUIElement)(object)val3).Group);
							}
							break;
						}
						if (val3 is RibbonGroupButtonUIElement && CanCustomizerAffectRibbon)
						{
							if (mouseActionFromMouseMessage == MouseAction.MouseDown)
							{
								CustomizeDialog.OnRibbonGroupClicked(((RibbonGroupButtonUIElement)(object)val3).Group);
							}
							break;
						}
						if (val3 is ContextualTabGroupCaptionUIElement && CanCustomizerAffectRibbon)
						{
							if (mouseActionFromMouseMessage == MouseAction.MouseDown)
							{
								CustomizeDialog.OnContextualTabGroupClicked(((ContextualTabGroupCaptionUIElement)(object)val3).TabGroup);
							}
							break;
						}
						if (val3 is ApplicationMenuButtonUIElementBase && CanCustomizerAffectRibbon)
						{
							if (mouseActionFromMouseMessage == MouseAction.MouseDown)
							{
								CustomizeDialog.OnApplicationMenuButtonClicked();
							}
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (CustomizeDialog is InPlaceCustomizerBase)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				if (val != null && ((UIElement)val).Control != null && ((UIElement)val).Control.IsHandleCreated)
				{
					Point point2 = ((UIElement)val).Control.PointToClient(e.Point);
					UIElement val4 = ((UIElement)val).ElementFromPoint(point2);
					while (val4 != null && val4.GetContext(typeof(ToolBase), false) == null)
					{
						val4 = val4.Parent;
					}
					flag = val4 != null && val4.PointInAdjustableArea(point2);
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (mouseActionFromMouseMessage == MouseAction.MouseDown && val != null)
			{
				Point point3 = ((UIElement)val).Control.PointToClient(e.Point);
				ProcessToolbarMouseDownWhileCustomizing(val, new MouseEventArgs(mouseButtonFromMouseMessage, 1, point3.X, point3.Y, 0));
			}
		}

		private void OnUserPreferenceChanged(object sender, UserPreferenceChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Category != UserPreferenceCategory.Window)
			{
				return;
			}
			Control control = DockWithinContainer;
			if (control != null)
			{
				if (control.InvokeRequired)
				{
					try
					{
						UserPreferenceChangedEventHandler method = OnUserPreferenceChanged;
						control.Invoke(method, sender, e);
						return;
					}
					catch
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				menuFont = null;
				if (ribbon != null)
				{
					ribbon.Metrics.Dirty(Ribbon.RibbonMetricsFlags.UserPreferenceChanged);
					ribbon.DirtyTabManager(Ribbon.TabManagerChangeType.Font);
					for (int i = 0; i < ribbon.Tabs.Count; i++)
					{
						ribbon.Tabs[i].DirtyAllMetrics();
					}
				}
				DirtyAllElements();
				SynchronizeToolbarFormBorderStyle();
			}
			else
			{
				menuFont = SystemInformation.MenuFont;
			}
		}

		internal bool ProcessEscapeKey(bool passToPopupContainer)
		{
			return ProcessEscapeKey(passToPopupContainer, ensureFormIsActive: true);
		}

		internal bool ProcessEscapeKey(bool passToPopupContainer, bool ensureFormIsActive)
		{
			if (ensureFormIsActive && !IsFormActiveInternal)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (toolbarBeingDragged != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (toolBeingEdited != null)
			{
				EmbeddableEditorBase editor = toolBeingEdited.Editor;
				if (editor != null)
				{
					if (editor.IsInputKey(Keys.Escape))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (passToPopupContainer)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (editor.IsInEditMode)
					{
						OnProcessEscapeKey();
						if (editor.IsDroppedDown)
						{
							editor.CloseUp();
							return true;
						}
						toolBeingEdited.ExitEditMode(forceExit: false, applyChanges: false);
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			PopupControlBase currentPopupControl = CurrentPopupControl;
			if (currentPopupControl != null)
			{
				PopupControlContainerAgent containerAgent = currentPopupControl.MenuAgent as PopupControlContainerAgent;
				if (!passToPopupContainer || !ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ContainsFocus(containerAgent))
				{
					OnProcessEscapeKey();
					MenuAgentBase menuAgent = currentPopupControl.MenuAgent;
					PopupToolBase popupToolBase = null;
					if (menuAgent is PopupToolAgentBase)
					{
						popupToolBase = ((PopupToolAgentBase)menuAgent).PopupTool;
					}
					allowToolbarCaptureRelease = false;
					try
					{
						menuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay: false);
					}
					finally
					{
						allowToolbarCaptureRelease = true;
					}
					if (popupToolBase != null && popupToolBase.OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
					{
						popupToolBase.OwningToolbarInternal.AutoDropDownMode = false;
						InternalSetActiveTool(popupToolBase.ToolBeingDisplayed, setOn: true, clearToolBeingEdited: false);
						if (!popupToolBase.OwningToolbarInternal.VisibleResolved && ToolOwnerWithCapture == popupToolBase.OwningToolbarInternal)
						{
							ToolOwnerWithCapture = null;
						}
					}
					else if (popupToolBase != null && popupToolBase.OwnerIsMenu && popupToolBase.OwningMenu.IsOpen)
					{
						(popupToolBase.OwningMenu.MenuAgent?.GetMenuItemFromTool(popupToolBase))?.Activate();
					}
					else if (popupToolBase != null && popupToolBase.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea && popupToolBase.OwningApplicationMenuArea.ApplicationMenu.IsOpen)
					{
						(popupToolBase.OwningApplicationMenuArea.ApplicationMenu.MenuAgent?.GetMenuItemFromTool(popupToolBase))?.Activate();
					}
					else
					{
						InternalSetActiveTool(null, setOn: false, clearToolBeingEdited: true);
					}
					return true;
				}
			}
			else if (ToolOwnerWithCapture != null)
			{
				OnProcessEscapeKey();
				toolOwnerWithCapture = null;
				if (activeTool != null)
				{
					InternalSetActiveTool(null, setOn: false, clearToolBeingEdited: false);
				}
				ExitHotkeyMode(clearActiveTool: false);
				return true;
			}
			if (ObjectWithFocus is Ribbon)
			{
				OnProcessEscapeKey();
				ClearRibbonItemWithFocus();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ProcessMnemonic(char charCode)
		{
			if (!IsFormActiveInternal)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (AreKeyTipsShown)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (toolBeingEdited != null)
			{
				EmbeddableEditorBase editor = toolBeingEdited.Editor;
				if (editor != null && editor.IsInEditMode && Control.ModifierKeys != Keys.Alt)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			PopupControlBase currentPopupControl = CurrentPopupControl;
			if (currentPopupControl != null)
			{
				return currentPopupControl.MenuAgent.ProcessMnemonic(charCode);
			}
			List<IProcessMnemonic> list = null;
			List<RibbonGroup> list2 = null;
			List<RibbonTab> list3 = null;
			if (Control.ModifierKeys != Keys.Alt && Control.ModifierKeys != (Keys.Shift | Keys.Alt))
			{
				if (ToolOwnerWithCapture == null && CurrentPopupControl == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				list = new List<IProcessMnemonic>();
				if (ToolbarWithCapture != null)
				{
					ToolbarWithCapture.GetToolsThatMatchMnemonic(charCode, list);
				}
				else if (RibbonGroupWithCapture != null)
				{
					RibbonGroupWithCapture.GetToolsThatMatchMnemonic(charCode, list);
				}
				else if (ToolOwnerWithCapture is RibbonTab)
				{
					((RibbonTab)ToolOwnerWithCapture).GetToolsThatMatchMnemonic(charCode, list);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				list = new List<IProcessMnemonic>();
				foreach (UltraToolbar toolbar in Toolbars)
				{
					toolbar.GetToolsThatMatchMnemonic(charCode, list);
				}
				if (ribbon != null)
				{
					ribbon.GetToolsThatMatchMnemonic(charCode, list);
					list2 = new List<RibbonGroup>();
					list3 = new List<RibbonTab>();
					ribbon.GetGroupsThatMatchMnemonic(charCode, list2);
					ribbon.GetTabsThatMatchMnemonic(charCode, list3);
				}
			}
			int totalMatchingItems = list.Count + (list2?.Count ?? 0) + (list3?.Count ?? 0);
			if (ProcessMnemonicForTools(list, totalMatchingItems))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ProcessMnemonicForGroups(list2))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ProcessMnemonicForTabs(list3))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ProcessMnemonicForGroups(List<RibbonGroup> groupsForThisMnemonic)
		{
			if (groupsForThisMnemonic != null && groupsForThisMnemonic.Count > 0)
			{
				RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = (RibbonGroup)(ToolOwnerWithCapture = groupsForThisMnemonic[0]);
				return ribbonGroup.OnMnemonicPressed();
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ProcessMnemonicForTabs(List<RibbonTab> tabsForThisMnemonic)
		{
			if (ribbon != null && tabsForThisMnemonic != null && tabsForThisMnemonic.Count > 0)
			{
				int index = 0;
				if (ribbon.SelectedTab != null)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < tabsForThisMnemonic.Count - 1; i++)
					{
						if (tabsForThisMnemonic[i] == ribbon.SelectedTab)
						{
							index = i + 1;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				RibbonTab tab = tabsForThisMnemonic[index];
				ribbon.SetSelectedTab(tab, expandRibbonIfCollapsed: true);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ProcessMnemonicForTools(List<IProcessMnemonic> toolsForThisMnemonic, int totalMatchingItems)
		{
			if (toolsForThisMnemonic.Count > 0)
			{
				if (totalMatchingItems == 1)
				{
					return toolsForThisMnemonic[0].ProcessMnemonic();
				}
				EnterHotkeyMode();
				int num = 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < toolsForThisMnemonic.Count; i++)
				{
					if (toolsForThisMnemonic[i].IsActive)
					{
						num = i + 1;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (num == totalMatchingItems)
				{
					num = 0;
				}
				if (num < toolsForThisMnemonic.Count)
				{
					return toolsForThisMnemonic[num].Activate();
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ProcessNavigationKey(Keys keyCode, bool passToPopupContainer)
		{
			return ProcessNavigationKey(keyCode, passToPopupContainer, ensureFormIsActive: true);
		}

		internal bool ProcessNavigationKey(Keys keyCode, bool passToPopupContainer, bool ensureFormIsActive)
		{
			if (ensureFormIsActive && !IsFormActiveInternal)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (toolBeingEdited != null)
			{
				EmbeddableEditorBase editor = toolBeingEdited.Editor;
				if (editor != null)
				{
					Keys keys = keyCode | Control.ModifierKeys;
					if (editor.IsInputKey(keys))
					{
						if (!editor.CanFocus)
						{
							KeyEventArgs e = new KeyEventArgs(keys);
							ForwardKeyDownToEditor(e);
							return e.Handled;
						}
						return false;
					}
					switch (keyCode)
					{
					case Keys.Return:
					case Keys.Space:
						return false;
					case Keys.Tab:
						if (toolBeingEdited.OwnerIsRibbonGroup && ObjectWithFocus == null)
						{
							return false;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			PopupControlBase currentPopupControl = CurrentPopupControl;
			ToolBase toolWithFocus = ToolWithFocus;
			if (currentPopupControl != null)
			{
				if (passToPopupContainer)
				{
					PopupControlContainerToolBase popupControlContainerToolBase = null;
					if (toolWithFocus != null)
					{
						popupControlContainerToolBase = toolWithFocus.UnderlyingTool as PopupControlContainerToolBase;
					}
					if (popupControlContainerToolBase == null && currentPopupControl.MenuAgent != null)
					{
						PopupToolBase popupTool = currentPopupControl.MenuAgent.PopupTool;
						if (popupTool != null && popupTool.IsControlContainer)
						{
							popupControlContainerToolBase = popupTool.UnderlyingTool as PopupControlContainerToolBase;
						}
					}
					if (popupControlContainerToolBase != null && popupControlContainerToolBase.IsOpen)
					{
						PopupControlContainerAgent containerAgent = currentPopupControl.MenuAgent as PopupControlContainerAgent;
						if (ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ContainsFocus(containerAgent))
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
				}
				QuickCustomizeAgentBase quickCustomizeAgentBase = currentPopupControl.MenuAgent as QuickCustomizeAgentBase;
				bool flag = true;
				if (quickCustomizeAgentBase == null || quickCustomizeAgentBase.BumpedToolsToolbar == null || quickCustomizeAgentBase.ActiveMenuItem != null)
				{
					bool flag2 = false;
					if (quickCustomizeAgentBase == null && currentPopupControl.MenuAgent.PopupStyle == PopupStyle.Toolbar && currentPopupControl.MenuAgent.PopupTool != null && currentPopupControl.MenuAgent.PopupTool.PopupToolbar != null)
					{
						PopupToolBase popupTool2 = currentPopupControl.MenuAgent.PopupTool;
						bool flag3 = true;
						if (popupTool2.OwnerIsMenuInternal && popupTool2.OwningMenuInternal.IsMenuAgentCreated && popupTool2.OwningMenuInternal.IsOpen && popupTool2.OwningMenuInternal.MenuAgent.PopupStyle != PopupStyle.Toolbar)
						{
							flag3 = false;
						}
						else if (popupTool2.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea && popupTool2.OwningApplicationMenuArea.ApplicationMenu.IsOpen)
						{
							flag3 = false;
						}
						flag2 = (flag3 ? (toolWithFocus == null || popupTool2 != toolWithFocus.UnderlyingTool || keyCode == Keys.Down || keyCode == Keys.Up || keyCode == Keys.Tab) : ((toolWithFocus == null || popupTool2 != toolWithFocus.UnderlyingTool) ? (keyCode == Keys.Right) : (keyCode == Keys.Right || keyCode == Keys.Tab)));
					}
					flag = ((!flag2) ? currentPopupControl.MenuAgent.ProcessNavigationKey(keyCode) : currentPopupControl.MenuAgent.PopupTool.PopupToolbar.ProcessNavigationKey(toolWithFocus, keyCode));
				}
				else
				{
					flag = quickCustomizeAgentBase.BumpedToolsToolbar.ProcessNavigationKey(toolWithFocus, keyCode);
				}
				if (!flag && !passToPopupContainer && currentPopupControl != null)
				{
					PopupControlContainerToolBase popupControlContainerToolBase2 = null;
					if (toolWithFocus != null)
					{
						popupControlContainerToolBase2 = toolWithFocus.UnderlyingTool as PopupControlContainerToolBase;
					}
					else if (currentPopupControl.MenuAgent != null)
					{
						PopupToolBase popupTool3 = currentPopupControl.MenuAgent.PopupTool;
						if (popupTool3 != null && popupTool3.IsControlContainer)
						{
							popupControlContainerToolBase2 = popupTool3.UnderlyingTool as PopupControlContainerToolBase;
						}
					}
					if (popupControlContainerToolBase2 != null && popupControlContainerToolBase2.IsOpen)
					{
						PopupControlContainerAgent containerAgent2 = currentPopupControl.MenuAgent as PopupControlContainerAgent;
						if (ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ContainsFocus(containerAgent2))
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
				}
				bool result = true;
				if (!flag && currentPopupControl != null && currentPopupControl.MenuAgent != null)
				{
					return currentPopupControl.MenuAgent.ShouldHandleNavigationKey(keyCode);
				}
				return result;
			}
			if (keyCode == Keys.Tab && (Control.ModifierKeys == Keys.Control || Control.ModifierKeys == (Keys.Shift | Keys.Control)) && ProcessCtrlTabNavigation())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ObjectWithFocus is Ribbon)
			{
				return Ribbon.ProcessNavigationKey(keyCode);
			}
			if (toolWithFocus != null && toolWithFocus.OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
			{
				PopupToolBase popupTool4 = toolWithFocus.PopupTool;
				if (popupTool4 == null || !popupTool4.IsOpen)
				{
					return toolWithFocus.OwningToolbarInternal.ProcessNavigationKey(toolWithFocus, keyCode);
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ProcessPendingInvalidation()
		{
			if (mdiParentInvalidateFlags == WmPaintEvents.None || PreventMdiParentPaintProcessing)
			{
				return;
			}
			WmPaintEvents wmPaintEvents = mdiParentInvalidateFlags;
			mdiParentInvalidateFlags = WmPaintEvents.None;
			if (mdiClientSubClasser == null || DockWithinContainer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				IntPtr mdiParentHandle = MdiParentHandle;
				if (IntPtr.Zero != mdiParentHandle)
				{
					uint num = 1u;
					if ((wmPaintEvents & WmPaintEvents.WM_NCPAINT) == WmPaintEvents.WM_NCPAINT)
					{
						num |= 0x400;
					}
					if ((wmPaintEvents & WmPaintEvents.WM_ERASEBKGND) == WmPaintEvents.WM_ERASEBKGND)
					{
						num |= 4;
					}
					NativeWindowMethods.RedrawWindowApi(mdiParentHandle, IntPtr.Zero, IntPtr.Zero, num);
				}
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
		}

		private void ProcessPreMouseDown(ref Message msg)
		{
			if (ToolOwnerWithCapture == null || IsDesignMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			Form form = FindForm();
			if (form == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Control control = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ControlFromChildHandle(msg.HWnd);
			if (control == null || control.InvokeRequired)
			{
				return;
			}
			Form form2 = null;
			UltraToolbarsDockArea ultraToolbarsDockArea = null;
			while (form2 == null && ultraToolbarsDockArea == null && control != null)
			{
				if (ultraToolbarsDockArea == null)
				{
					ultraToolbarsDockArea = control as UltraToolbarsDockArea;
				}
				form2 = control as Form;
				if (form2 != null)
				{
					break;
				}
				control = ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetParent(control);
			}
			if (form2 == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (form2 != form && ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetMdiParent(form2) != form)
			{
				if (ToolbarsManagerUtilities.GetOwner(form2) != form)
				{
					return;
				}
				IOwnedFormToolbarsShouldDeactivateActiveTool val = (IOwnedFormToolbarsShouldDeactivateActiveTool)(object)((form2 is IOwnedFormToolbarsShouldDeactivateActiveTool) ? form2 : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					if (!val.ShouldDeactivateActiveTool)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				else if (DisposableObject.HasSamePublicKey(form2.GetType()))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (ultraToolbarsDockArea != null && ultraToolbarsDockArea == GetToolbarDockArea(ToolbarWithCapture))
			{
				return;
			}
			ToolOwnerWithCapture = null;
			if (activeTool != null)
			{
				if (toolBeingEdited != null)
				{
					ForceExitEditMode();
				}
				InternalSetActiveTool(null, setOn: false, clearToolBeingEdited: true);
			}
		}

		private static void RefreshToolCollectionDropDownContents(ToolsCollectionBase tools)
		{
			if (tools.Owner.GetType().IsSubclassOf(typeof(PopupToolBase)))
			{
				((PopupToolBase)tools.Owner).RefreshDropDownContents();
			}
			if (tools.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)
			{
				tools.OwningApplicationMenuArea.ApplicationMenu.RefreshDropDownContents();
			}
			if (tools.OwnerIsBackStageMenuArea)
			{
				tools.OwningBackStageArea.ApplicationMenu2010.RefreshDropDownContents();
			}
			if (tools.Owner is UltraTaskPaneToolbar)
			{
				((UltraTaskPaneToolbar)tools.Owner).NavigationMenuTool.RefreshDropDownContents();
			}
			if (tools.Owner.GetType() == typeof(UltraToolbar) && ((UltraToolbar)tools.Owner).ToolbarType == ToolbarType.Popup && ((UltraToolbar)tools.Owner).TearawayToolOwner.UnderlyingTool is TearawayToolBase tearawayToolBase)
			{
				tearawayToolBase.RefreshDropDownContents();
			}
		}

		private void RegisterDockWithinContainer()
		{
			if (dockWithinContainer != null)
			{
				DockingAreaManager.RegisterDockingAreaParent(dockWithinContainer);
			}
		}

		private static bool RegisterToolType(IToolProvider toolProvider, Guid toolID, string customizerDisplayName, string instanceNameBase, bool isCustom)
		{
			if (ToolTypes.Contains(toolID))
			{
				if (ToolTypes[toolID] is ToolDefinition toolDefinition)
				{
					if (toolDefinition.ToolProvider != toolProvider)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException("Tool ID already registered by another tool provider!");
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (toolProvider == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("ToolProvider is null!  You must supply a reference to an object that implemenets IToolProvider.");
			}
			if (ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(instanceNameBase))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(customizerDisplayName))
			{
				customizerDisplayName = toolID.ToString();
			}
			Monitor.Enter(ToolTypes);
			try
			{
				ToolTypes.Add(toolID, new ToolDefinition(toolProvider, toolID, customizerDisplayName, instanceNameBase.Replace(" ", ""), isCustom));
			}
			finally
			{
				Monitor.Exit(ToolTypes);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void RemoveGlass(IntPtr handle)
		{
			if (haveExtendedGlass && !(handle == IntPtr.Zero) && !((Component)this).DesignMode)
			{
				NativeWindowMethods.MARGINS pMargins = new NativeWindowMethods.MARGINS(0, 0, 0, 0);
				NativeWindowMethods.DwmExtendFrameIntoClientAreaApi(handle, ref pMargins);
				haveExtendedGlass = false;
				lastGlassExtensionHeight = -1;
			}
		}

		}

					messageFilterActive = false;
				}
				catch

				}
			}
		}

		private void ReparentContainedControls(bool takeOwnership)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
			{
				if (dockAreas[i] != null)
				{
					if (takeOwnership)
					{
						((UIElement)dockAreas[i].ControlElement).VerifyChildElements(true);
					}
					dockAreas[i].ReparentContainedControls(takeOwnership);
				}
			}
			if (floatingWindows == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (FloatingToolbarWindowBase floatingWindow in floatingWindows)
			{
				if (takeOwnership)
				{
					((UIElement)floatingWindow.DockArea.ControlElement).VerifyChildElements(true);
				}
				floatingWindow.DockArea.ReparentContainedControls(takeOwnership);
			}
		}

		private void ResetDockContainerRedrawState()
		{
			SetRedraw(setRedrawOn: true);
		}

		private void ResetFloatingWindowsEnabledState()
		{
			((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).BeginUpdate();
			foreach (FloatingToolbarWindowBase floatingWindow in FloatingWindows)
			{
				floatingWindow.Enabled = false;
				floatingWindow.Enabled = true;
			}
			((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).EndUpdate();
		}

		private void SaveAsBinaryHelper(Stream stream, bool saveCustomizations)
		{
			UsingBinaryFormat = true;
			BinaryFormatter binaryFormatter = new BinaryFormatter(null, new StreamingContext(StreamingContextStates.Persistence, saveCustomizations));
			binaryFormatter.AssemblyFormat = FormatterAssemblyStyle.Simple;
			IFormatter formatter = binaryFormatter;
			SaveHelper(stream, formatter);
		}

		private void SaveHelper(Stream stream, IFormatter formatter)
		{
			if (floatingWindows != null)
			{
				foreach (FloatingToolbarWindowBase floatingWindow in floatingWindows)
				{
					floatingWindow.Toolbar.InternalSetFloatingLocation(floatingWindow.Location);
					floatingWindow.Toolbar.InternalSetFloatingSize(((Control)(object)floatingWindow.DockArea).Size);
				}
			}
			UltraToolbarsStreamer graph = new UltraToolbarsStreamer(this);
			try
			{
				formatter.Serialize(stream, graph);
			}
			catch (Exception innerException)
			{
				throw new ApplicationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_109")), innerException);
			}
		}

		private void SetNonManagedActiveMdiChildForm(Form childForm)
		{
			HookActiveMdiChildEvents(childForm);
			if (childForm != nonManagedActiveMdiChildForm)
			{
				if (nonManagedActiveMdiChildForm != null)
				{
					nonManagedActiveMdiChildForm.Layout -= OnFormLayout;
					nonManagedActiveMdiChildForm.Closed -= OnMdiChildFormClosed;
				}
				nonManagedActiveMdiChildForm = childForm;
				if (nonManagedActiveMdiChildForm != null)
				{
					nonManagedActiveMdiChildForm.Layout += OnFormLayout;
					nonManagedActiveMdiChildForm.Closed += OnMdiChildFormClosed;
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetRedraw(bool setRedrawOn)
		{
			if (DockWithinContainer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				foreach (Control control in DockWithinContainer.Controls)
				{
					if (control.Visible)
					{
						NativeWindowMethods.SendMessageApi(control.Handle, 11, setRedrawOn ? NativeWindowMethods.TRUE : NativeWindowMethods.FALSE, IntPtr.Zero);
					}
				}
				setRedrawPending = !setRedrawOn;
				ProcessPendingInvalidation();
				if (setRedrawOn)
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.RedrawWindowApi(DockWithinContainer.Handle, IntPtr.Zero, IntPtr.Zero, 1927u);
				}
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
		}

		private void SetToolDragCursor(Point point)
		{
			if (toolBeingDragged == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ToolDragPointInfo.IsOverToolBeingDragged)
			{
				Cursor.Current = CustomizeToolMoveCursor;
				return;
			}
			if (ToolDragPointInfo.IsOverNoDropZone || (ToolDragPointInfo.VToolUnderDragPoint == null && !ToolDragPointInfo.IsOverToolBeingDragged))
			{
				Cursor.Current = CustomizeToolNoDropCursor;
				return;
			}
			if ((Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Control) == Keys.Control)
			{
				if (toolBeingDragged.IsRootTool)
				{
					Cursor.Current = CustomizeToolCopyCursor;
					return;
				}
				if (toolBeingDragged.AllowMultipleInstancesResolved || toolBeingDragged.SharedProps.ToolInstances.Count <= 0)
				{
					Cursor.Current = CustomizeToolCopyCursor;
					return;
				}
			}
			Cursor.Current = CustomizeToolMoveCursor;
		}

		private bool ShouldKeyMessageBeEaten()
		{
			if (CurrentPopupControl != null)
			{
				PopupControlContainerToolBase popupControlContainerToolBase = ActiveTool as PopupControlContainerToolBase;
				if (popupControlContainerToolBase == null && CurrentPopupControl.MenuAgent is PopupControlContainerAgent popupControlContainerAgent)
				{
					popupControlContainerToolBase = popupControlContainerAgent.PopupControlTool;
				}
				if (popupControlContainerToolBase == null && CurrentPopupControl.MenuAgent is BackStageMenuAgent backStageMenuAgent)
				{
					BackStageManager backStageManager = backStageMenuAgent.ApplicationMenu2010.BackStageManager;
					if (backStageManager.HasMenuInfoList && backStageManager.MenuInfoList.Count > 0)
					{
						popupControlContainerToolBase = backStageManager.MenuInfoList[backStageManager.MenuInfoList.Count - 1].Tool as PopupControlContainerToolBase;
					}
				}
				if (popupControlContainerToolBase != null && popupControlContainerToolBase.IsOpen)
				{
					PopupControlContainerAgent containerAgent = popupControlContainerToolBase.MenuAgent as PopupControlContainerAgent;
					if (ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ContainsFocus(containerAgent))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				if (ActiveTool != null && ActiveTool.Editor != null && ActiveTool.Editor.IsInEditMode)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (ActiveTool != null && ActiveTool.UnderlyingTool is ControlContainerTool containerTool && ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ContainsFocus(containerTool))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldMdiParentPopupTool(PopupToolBase popupTool)
		{
			if (popupTool.IsRootTool)
			{
				return MdiParentManagerInternal != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ShowFloatingWindows(bool show)
		{
			if (showingFloatingWindows)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (show)
			{
				if (mdiParentManager != null)
				{
					show = false;
				}
				else if (!((Component)this).DesignMode)
				{
					show = FormWindowState != FormWindowState.Minimized && IsFormActiveInternal;
					Form form = FindForm();
					if (form != null)
					{
						if (show)
						{
							show = form.Visible;
						}
						flag = form.Modal;
					}
				}
			}
			showingFloatingWindows = show;
			try
			{
				if (floatingWindows == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (FloatingToolbarWindowBase floatingWindow in floatingWindows)
				{
					if (show)
					{
						if (floatingWindowBeingDragged != floatingWindow)
						{
							if (!floatingWindow.Visible && flag)
							{
								floatingWindow.Enabled = false;
								floatingWindow.Enabled = true;
							}
							floatingWindow.ShowNoActivate();
						}
					}
					else
					{
						floatingWindow.Toolbar.CancelPendingSubmenuDropDowns();
						floatingWindow.Toolbar.CloseOpenSubmenuTools(null);
						floatingWindow.Visible = false;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				showingFloatingWindows = false;
				CheckFloatingToolbarFadeTimerState();
			}
		}

		private void SyncAssociatedObjectsEnabledState()
		{
			isEnabled = ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).Enabled;
			if (dockWithinContainer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			dockWithinContainer.SuspendLayout();
			try
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
				{
					if (dockAreas[i] != null)
					{
						((Control)(object)dockAreas[i]).Enabled = ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).Enabled;
					}
				}
				DirtyAllElements();
			}
			finally
			{
				dockWithinContainer.ResumeLayout(performLayout: true);
			}
			if (floatingWindows == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (FloatingToolbarWindowBase floatingWindow in floatingWindows)
			{
				floatingWindow.Enabled = ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).Enabled;
			}
		}

		internal void SyncAssociatedObjectsVisibleState()
		{
			if (dockWithinContainer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			dockWithinContainer.SuspendLayout();
			try
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
				{
					if (dockAreas[i] != null)
					{
						((Control)(object)dockAreas[i]).Visible = ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).Visible;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				dockWithinContainer.ResumeLayout(performLayout: true);
			}
			ShowFloatingWindows(((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).Visible);
		}

		private bool ToggleFirstMenuItemFocus()
		{
			if (CurrentPopupControl != null && !(CurrentPopupControl is RibbonMenuControl))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (HasRibbon && Ribbon.VisibleResolved)
			{
				Ribbon.ToggleItemWithFocus();
				return true;
			}
			UltraToolbar owningToolbar;
			ToolBase toolbarToolToActivate = GetToolbarToolToActivate(out owningToolbar);
			if (toolbarToolToActivate == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			_ = ActiveTool;
			if (toolbarToolToActivate == ActiveTool)
			{
				ToolOwnerWithCapture = null;
				InternalSetActiveTool(null, setOn: false, clearToolBeingEdited: false);
			}
			else
			{
				owningToolbar.AutoDropDownMode = false;
				ToolOwnerWithCapture = owningToolbar;
				InternalSetActiveTool(toolbarToolToActivate, setOn: true, clearToolBeingEdited: false);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void ToggleFloatingWindowEnabledSettings()
		{
			if (floatingWindows == null || floatingWindows.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (FloatingToolbarWindowBase floatingWindow in floatingWindows)
			{
				floatingWindow.Enabled = false;
				floatingWindow.Enabled = true;
			}
		}

		private void ToolTipDisplayModeDelayTimerExpired(object source, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (ToolTipDisplayModeDelayTimer.Enabled)
			{
				ToolTipDisplayModeDelayTimer.Enabled = false;
				ToolBase toolBase = ToolFromPoint(Control.MousePosition);
				if (toolBase == null || !toolBase.ShouldDisplayToolTip)
				{
					immediateToolTipDisplayMode = false;
					HideToolTip(dispose: true);
				}
			}
		}

		private void TransferToolbarDragMouseCapture(UltraToolbarsDockArea dockAreaUnderMouse)
		{
			if (dockAreaUnderMouse == null || !((Control)(object)dockAreaUnderMouse).Capture || ToolbarBeingDragged == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraToolbarsDockAreaUIElement ultraToolbarsDockAreaUIElement = dockAreaUnderMouse.ControlElement as UltraToolbarsDockAreaUIElement;
			UltraToolbarsDockArea[] array = GetDockAreas();
			foreach (UltraToolbarsDockArea ultraToolbarsDockArea in array)
			{
				if (ultraToolbarsDockArea != null && ultraToolbarsDockArea.ControlElement != null && (object)ultraToolbarsDockArea.ControlElement != ultraToolbarsDockAreaUIElement)
				{
					ultraToolbarsDockAreaUIElement.TransferToolbarDragCapture(ultraToolbarsDockArea.ControlElement as UltraToolbarsDockAreaUIElement);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool TryProcessShortcut(int keyCode, Keys modifierKeys)
		{
			if (IsFormActiveInternal)
			{

		private void UpdateToolDragPointInfo(Point dragPoint, VirtualTool vtoolUnderPoint, VirtualTool vtoolContainingInsertionPoint, bool drawInsertionPointAtFarEnd, bool isOverToolBeingDragged, bool isOverNoDropZone)
		{

			ToolDragPointInfo.VToolContainingInsertionPoint = vtoolContainingInsertionPoint;
			ToolDragPointInfo.DrawInsertionPointAtFarEnd = drawInsertionPointAtFarEnd;
			ToolDragPointInfo.IsOverToolBeingDragged = isOverToolBeingDragged;
			ToolDragPointInfo.IsOverNoDropZone = isOverNoDropZone;

			{
				if (vToolContainingInsertionPoint != null && vToolContainingInsertionPoint.UIElement != null)

				}

				{
					ToolDragPointInfo.VToolContainingInsertionPoint.UIElement.Parent.Invalidate();
				}
			}
			else if (ToolDragPointInfo.DrawInsertionPointAtFarEnd != drawInsertionPointAtFarEnd2 && ToolDragPointInfo.VToolContainingInsertionPoint != null && ToolDragPointInfo.VToolContainingInsertionPoint.UIElement != null)
			{

			}
		}

		private void VerifyActiveTaskPaneToolbar()
		{
			if (IsTaskPaneToolbarActive(LastActiveTaskPane))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UltraToolbar toolbar in Toolbars)
			{
				if (toolbar is UltraTaskPaneToolbar { WasEnterInvokedForContentControl: not false } ultraTaskPaneToolbar && IsToolbarFormActiveHelper(ultraTaskPaneToolbar))
				{
					LastActiveTaskPane = ultraTaskPaneToolbar;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void VerifyDesignerDesignModeState()
		{
			IDesignerHost designerHost = DesignerHost;
			if (designerHost != null && designerHost.GetDesigner((IComponent)this) is IUltraToolbarsManagerDesigner ultraToolbarsManagerDesigner)

			}
		}

		private void VerifyRedrawOn()
		{
			if (!setRedrawPending)
			{
				return;
			}
			SetRedraw(setRedrawOn: true);
			if (ActiveMdiChildManager != null)
			{
				Form form = ActiveMdiChildManager.FindForm();
				if (form != null && form.WindowState == FormWindowState.Maximized)
				{
					form.ResumeLayout(performLayout: true);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool HideRibbonKeyTips()
		{
			if (AreKeyTipsShown)
			{
				PopupControlBase currentPopupControl = CurrentPopupControl;
				if (currentPopupControl == null || (!(currentPopupControl is PopupMenuControl) && !(currentPopupControl is ApplicationMenuControl)))
				{
					Ribbon.KeyTipManager.HideKeyTips();
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

						{
							if (ToolbarSettings.HasFloatingAppearance)
							{
								ToolbarSettings.FloatingAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
							}
						}
						else if (ToolbarSettings.HasDockedAppearance)
						{
							ToolbarSettings.DockedAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (!(toolbar is MiniToolbar) && ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseControlInfo)
			{
				ResolveToolbarAppearanceManagerSettings(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleAfter)
			{
				val.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			ResolveToolbarAppearanceDefaults(toolbar, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		internal void ResolveToolbarAppearanceManagerSettings(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			if (ToolbarSettings.HasAppearance)
			{
				ToolbarSettings.Appearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo)
		{
			if (!Initialized)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!Loading && !isActiveMdiChildManagerChanging && !IsDisposed && !IsDisposing)
			{
				((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).DirtyChildElements();
			}
			if (propChangeInfo.Source == toolbarSettings)
			{
				((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.ToolbarSettings, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (propChangeInfo.Source == menuSettings)
			{
				((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.MenuSettings, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (HasAppearance && propChangeInfo.Source == appearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.Appearance, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (propChangeInfo.Source == appearances)
			{
				((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.Appearances, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (HasDockAreaAppearance && propChangeInfo.Source == dockAreaAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.DockAreaAppearance, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (HasDockAreaVerticalAppearance && propChangeInfo.Source == dockAreaVerticalAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.DockAreaVerticalAppearance, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (HasHorizontalToolbarGrabHandleAppearance && propChangeInfo.Source == horizontalToolbarGrabHandleAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.HorizontalToolbarGrabHandleAppearance, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (HasVerticalToolbarGrabHandleAppearance && propChangeInfo.Source == verticalToolbarGrabHandleAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.VerticalToolbarGrabHandleAppearance, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else
			{
				if (propChangeInfo.Source == toolbars)
				{
					((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.Toolbars, propChangeInfo);
					if (floatingWindows == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo2 = propChangeInfo.FindPropId(PropertyIds.FloatingLocation);
					if (propChangeInfo2 == null || !(propChangeInfo2.Source is UltraToolbar ultraToolbar))
					{
						return;
					}
					{
						foreach (FloatingToolbarWindowBase floatingWindow in floatingWindows)
						{
							if (floatingWindow.Toolbar == ultraToolbar)
							{
								floatingWindow.Location = ultraToolbar.FloatingLocation;
								break;
							}
						}
						return;
					}
				}
				if (propChangeInfo.Source == tools)
				{
					((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.Tools, propChangeInfo);
				}
				else if (propChangeInfo.Source == optionSets)
				{
					((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.OptionSets, propChangeInfo);
				}
				else if (propChangeInfo.Source == mergedTools)
				{
					((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.MergedTools, propChangeInfo);
				}
				else if (propChangeInfo.Source == ribbon)
				{
					((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.Ribbon, propChangeInfo);
				}
				else if (propChangeInfo.Source == miniToolbar)
				{
					((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.MiniToolbar, propChangeInfo);
				}
				else if (propChangeInfo.Source == navigationToolbar)
				{
					((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.NavigationToolbar, propChangeInfo);
				}
				else if (propChangeInfo.Source == notificationBadgeSettings)
				{
					((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.NotificationBadgeSettings, propChangeInfo);
				}
			}
		}

		void ICodeDomSerializableEX.AfterDeserializationCompleted(IDesignerSerializationManager manager)
		{
			foreach (ToolBase tool in Tools)
			{
				if (tool is ControlContainerTool controlContainerTool)
				{
					controlContainerTool.SyncControlWithName();
				}
				else if (tool is PopupControlContainerTool popupControlContainerTool)
				{
					popupControlContainerTool.SyncControlWithName();
				}
			}
		}

		bool IExtenderProvider.CanExtend(object extendee)
		{
			if (extendee is NotifyIcon)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(extendee is Control))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_UltraToolbarsManager_M_GetContextMenuUltra")]
		[DefaultValue(null)]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(ContextMenuUltraConverter))]
		public string GetContextMenuUltra(Component component)
		{
			if (!ContextMenuUltras.Contains(component))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ((ContextMenuUltraData)ContextMenuUltras[component]).Key;
		}

		public void SetContextMenuUltra(Component component, string menuKey)
		{
			if (component == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			if (!((IExtenderProvider)this).CanExtend((object)component))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("component");
			}
			bool flag = menuKey == null || menuKey.Length == 0 || menuKey == NoneLiteral;
			ContextMenuUltraData contextMenuUltraData = null;
			if (ContextMenuUltras.Contains(component))
			{
				contextMenuUltraData = (ContextMenuUltraData)ContextMenuUltras[component];
			}
			if (contextMenuUltraData != null)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					ContextMenuUltras.Remove(component);
					if (contextMenuUltraData.Menu != null)
					{
						contextMenuUltraData.Menu.Opening -= OnContextMenuPopup;
						contextMenuUltraData.Menu.Dispose();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					contextMenuUltraData.Key = menuKey;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					return;
				}
				ContextMenuStrip contextMenuStrip = null;
				if (!IsDesignMode)
				{
					contextMenuStrip = new ContextMenuStrip();
					contextMenuStrip.Opening += OnContextMenuPopup;
				}
				ContextMenuUltras.Add(component, new ContextMenuUltraData(menuKey, contextMenuStrip));
				try
				{
					if (component is Control control)
					{
						control.ContextMenuStrip = contextMenuStrip;
					}
					else if (component is NotifyIcon notifyIcon)
					{
						notifyIcon.ContextMenuStrip = contextMenuStrip;
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
		}

		void IToolsCollectionOwner.OnToolRemovedFromCollection(ToolBase tool, ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection)
		{
			if (tool is StateButtonTool stateButtonTool && !ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(stateButtonTool.OptionSetKey) && OptionSets.Exists(stateButtonTool.OptionSetKey))
			{
				OptionSets[stateButtonTool.OptionSetKey].Tools.Remove(stateButtonTool);
			}
			if (ribbon != null && tool != null)
			{
				int num = ribbon.QuickAccessToolbar.ContextMenuTools.IndexOf(tool.Key);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					ribbon.QuickAccessToolbar.ContextMenuTools.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}

		void ISupportInitialize.EndInit()
		{
			try
			{

			}
			finally
			{

			}
		}

		string[] IPopupItemProvider.GetPopupList()
		{
			if (Tools.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<string> list = new List<string>(tools.Count);
			foreach (ToolBase tool in Tools)
			{
				if (tool is IPopupItem)
				{
					list.Add(tool.Key);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		IPopupItem IPopupItemProvider.GetPopupItem(string key)
		{
			if (!Tools.Exists(key))
			{
				return null;
			}
			ToolBase toolBase = GetParentRootTool(Tools[key]);
			if (toolBase.IsHiddenByMdiMerge)
			{
				int num = MergedTools.IndexOf(key);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					toolBase = MergedTools[num];
				}
			}
			IPopupItem val = (IPopupItem)(object)((toolBase is IPopupItem) ? toolBase : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				return val;
			}
			ToolBase underlyingTool = toolBase.UnderlyingTool;
			return (IPopupItem)(object)((underlyingTool is IPopupItem) ? underlyingTool : null);
		}

		string IPopupItemProvider.VerifyPopupItemKey(string key)
		{
			if (!Tools.Exists(key))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return key;
		}

		private bool InstallHook()
		{
			if (!(dockWithinContainer is Form))
			{
				return false;
			}
			try
			{
				InstallHookUnsafe();
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		private void RemoveHook()
		{
			try
			{
				RemoveHookUnsafe();
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private void InstallHookUnsafe()
		{
			Monitor.Enter(HookSyncObject);
			try
			{
				if (hookHandle != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					RemoveHookUnsafe();
				}
				if (hookCallBack == null)
				{
					hookCallBack = HookProc;
				}
				Application.ThreadExit += OnApplicationThreadExit;
				hookHandle = NativeWindowMethods.SetWindowsHookExApi(4, hookCallBack, IntPtr.Zero, NativeWindowMethods.GetCurrentThreadIdApi());
			}
			finally
			{
				Monitor.Exit(HookSyncObject);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveHookUnsafe()
		{
			Monitor.Enter(HookSyncObject);
			try
			{
				if (!(hookHandle == IntPtr.Zero))
				{
					Application.ThreadExit -= OnApplicationThreadExit;
					NativeWindowMethods.UnhookWindowsHookExApi(hookHandle);
					hookHandle = IntPtr.Zero;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				Monitor.Exit(HookSyncObject);
			}
		}

		private IntPtr HookProc(int ncode, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam)
		{
			//IL_0055: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			NativeWindowMethods.CWPSTRUCT cWPSTRUCT = (NativeWindowMethods.CWPSTRUCT)Marshal.PtrToStructure(lParam, typeof(NativeWindowMethods.CWPSTRUCT));
			int message = cWPSTRUCT.message;
			if (message == 131 && cWPSTRUCT.wparam == IntPtr.Zero && ToolbarsManagerUtilities.ControlFromHandle(cWPSTRUCT.hwnd) is Form form && form == dockWithinContainer)
			{
				if ((int)FormDisplayStyleResolved != 3)
				{
					CheckIfFormSubclasserNeeded();
					dockWithinContainer.BeginInvoke(new SynchronizeFormDisplayStyleDelegate(SynchronizeFormBorderStyle), false);
				}
				IntPtr result = NativeWindowMethods.CallNextHookExApi(hookHandle, ncode, wParam, lParam);
				RemoveHook();
				return result;
			}
			return NativeWindowMethods.CallNextHookExApi(hookHandle, ncode, wParam, lParam);
		}

		private void OnApplicationThreadExit(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			RemoveHook();
		}

		internal int AdjustHeightForTouchMode(int extent, bool useLargeTouchSize)
		{
			if (TouchMetricsEnabledResolved)
			{
				extent = Math.Max(extent, (useLargeTouchSize ? ResolvedImageSizeTouchLarge : ResolvedImageSizeTouchSmall).Height);
			}
			return extent;
		}

		internal int AdjustWidthForTouchMode(int extent, bool useLargeTouchSize)
		{
			if (TouchMetricsEnabledResolved)
			{
				extent = Math.Max(extent, (useLargeTouchSize ? ResolvedImageSizeTouchLarge : ResolvedImageSizeTouchSmall).Width);
			}
			return extent;
		}

		internal int AdjustWidthForTouchMode(int extent, TouchElementSizes elementSizes)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (TouchMetricsEnabledResolved)
			{
				return Math.Max(extent, TouchUtilities.GetTouchElementSize(DockWithinContainer, elementSizes).Width);
			}
			return extent;
		}

		internal Size AdjustSizeForTouchMode(Size size, bool useLargeTouchSize)
		{
			return AdjustSizeForTouchMode(size, useLargeTouchSize, adjustWidth: true, adjustHeight: true);
		}

		internal Size AdjustSizeForTouchMode(Size size, bool useLargeTouchSize, bool adjustWidth, bool adjustHeight)
		{
			if (TouchMetricsEnabledResolved)
			{
				Size size2 = (useLargeTouchSize ? ResolvedImageSizeTouchLarge : ResolvedImageSizeTouchSmall);
				if (adjustWidth)
				{
					size.Width = Math.Max(size.Width, size2.Width);
				}
				if (adjustHeight)
				{
					size.Height = Math.Max(size.Height, size2.Height);
				}
			}
			return size;
		}

		internal Size AdjustSizeForTouchMode(Size size, TouchElementSizes elementSizes)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (TouchMetricsEnabledResolved)

				Size touchElementSize = TouchUtilities.GetTouchElementSize(DockWithinContainer, elementSizes);
				return new Size(Math.Max(size.Width, touchElementSize.Width), Math.Max(size.Height, touchElementSize.Height));
			}
			return size;
		}
