	internal class PopupManager
	{
		private UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager;

		internal PopupManager(UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager)
		{
			this.toolbarsManager = toolbarsManager;
		}

		internal void CloseAllPopups()
		{
			CloseAllPopups(onlyCloseLeafContiguousPopupChain: false);
		}

		internal void CloseAllPopups(bool onlyCloseLeafContiguousPopupChain)
		{
			CloseAllPopups(onlyCloseLeafContiguousPopupChain, onlyCloseDropDowns: false);
		}

		internal void CloseAllPopups(bool onlyCloseLeafContiguousPopupChain, bool onlyCloseDropDowns)
		{
			toolbarsManager.ForceExitEditMode();
			if (toolbarsManager.PopupControls.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			PopupControlBase popupControlBase = null;
			if (onlyCloseLeafContiguousPopupChain)
			{
				for (int num = toolbarsManager.PopupControls.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					popupControlBase = toolbarsManager.PopupControls[num];
					if (popupControlBase == null || popupControlBase.MenuAgent == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					Control owningControlForDropDown = popupControlBase.MenuAgent.OwningControlForDropDown;
					if (!(owningControlForDropDown is PopupControlBase) && !(owningControlForDropDown is UltraToolbarsDockArea))
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				popupControlBase = toolbarsManager.PopupControls[0];
			}
			if (popupControlBase != null && popupControlBase.MenuAgent != null)
			{
				popupControlBase.MenuAgent.CloseDropDown(delay: false, shouldHideAssociatedKeyTips: true, onlyCloseDropDowns);
			}
		}

		internal void PopupOpened(MenuAgentBase agent, PopupToolBase popupTool)
		{
			toolbarsManager.OnPopupOpening(popupTool);
			if (popupTool != null)
			{
				if (popupTool.OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
				{
					toolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture = popupTool.OwningToolbarInternal;
					popupTool.OwningToolbarInternal.AutoDropDownMode = true;
				}
				else if (popupTool.OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
				{
					toolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture = popupTool.OwningRibbonGroup;
				}
				else if (popupTool.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)
				{
					toolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture = popupTool.OwningApplicationMenuArea;
				}
			}
			toolbarsManager.PopupControls.Add(agent.PopupControl);
			if (toolbarsManager.TransitionAreasResolved != ToolbarTransitionAreas.None)
			{
				RefreshLastElementEnteredHelper(agent);
			}
			popupTool?.DirtyOwnerElements();
		}

		internal void PopupClosed(MenuAgentBase agent, PopupToolBase popupTool)
		{
			toolbarsManager.ForceExitEditMode();
			if (toolbarsManager.PopupControls.Contains(agent.PopupControl))
			{
				toolbarsManager.PopupControls.Remove(agent.PopupControl);
			}
			if (toolbarsManager.TransitionAreasResolved != ToolbarTransitionAreas.None)
			{
				RefreshLastElementEnteredHelper(agent);
			}
			if (agent is PopupToolAgentBase { SourceControl: not null })
			{
				toolbarsManager.ExitHotkeyMode();
			}
			if (popupTool != null && !(agent is GalleryToolFilterListMenuAgent))
			{
				if (popupTool.OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
				{
					ToolBase toolBeingDisplayed = popupTool.ToolBeingDisplayed;
					UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = toolBeingDisplayed.ToolbarsManager;
					if (ultraToolbarsManager != null && ultraToolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture != null && ultraToolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture.Equals(popupTool.OwningToolbarInternal))
					{
						ultraToolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture = null;
					}
				}
				else if (popupTool.OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
				{
					if (popupTool.ToolbarsManager != null && popupTool.ToolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture != null && popupTool.ToolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture.Equals(popupTool.OwningRibbonGroup))
					{
						toolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture = null;
					}
				}
				else if (popupTool.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea && popupTool.ToolbarsManager != null && popupTool.ToolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture != null && popupTool.ToolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture.Equals(popupTool.OwningApplicationMenuArea))
				{
					toolbarsManager.ToolOwnerWithCapture = null;
				}
				popupTool.DirtyOwnerElements();
			}
			if (toolbarsManager.PopupControls.Count > 0)
			{
				toolbarsManager.PopupControls[toolbarsManager.PopupControls.Count - 1]?.MenuAgent.RefreshDropShadows();
			}
			if (toolbarsManager.PopupControls.Count > 0 && !toolbarsManager.IsFormActiveInternal && !UltraToolbarsManager.IsNotifyIconOwnerFormActive && !toolbarsManager.Customizing)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				if (toolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer == null)
				{
					foreach (PopupControlBase popupControl in toolbarsManager.PopupControls)
					{
						if (popupControl.MenuAgent != null && popupControl.MenuAgent.OwningControlForDropDown != null)
						{
							flag = Utilities.IsFormActive(UltraToolbarsManager.FindFormHelper(popupControl.MenuAgent.OwningControlForDropDown));
							if (flag)
							{
								break;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (!toolbarsManager.IsCustomizerToolbarManager && !flag)
				{
					CloseAllPopups();
				}
			}
			if (toolbarsManager.PopupControls.Count != 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ToolBase tool in toolbarsManager.Tools)
			{
				if (tool.UnderlyingTool is MdiWindowListTool mdiWindowListTool)
				{
					mdiWindowListTool.ListToolItems.ClearHelper(notifyListeners: false);
				}
			}
			foreach (ToolBase mergedTool in toolbarsManager.MergedTools)
			{
				if (mergedTool.UnderlyingTool is MdiWindowListTool mdiWindowListTool2)
				{
					mdiWindowListTool2.ListToolItems.ClearHelper(notifyListeners: false);
				}
			}
		}

		private void RefreshLastElementEnteredHelper(MenuAgentBase agent)
		{
			if (agent != null)
			{
				if (agent.OwningControlForDropDown == toolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer)
				{
					toolbarsManager.RefreshEnteredElementsOnDockAreas();
				}
				else if (agent.OwningControlForDropDown is RibbonMenuControl)
				{
					ToolbarsManagerUtilities.RefreshLastElementEntered(agent.OwningControlForDropDown);
				}
			}
		}
	}

				//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_001c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if ((int)toolbarsManager.StyleResolved == 5)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if ((int)toolbarsManager.StyleResolved == 6)
				{
					return 2;
				}
				if (toolbarsManager.IsNonOffice2000Style)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		internal int TearawayStripHeight
		{
			get
			{
				int num = 7;
				if (toolbarsManager != null)
				{
					return toolbarsManager.AdjustWidthForTouchMode(num, (TouchElementSizes)2);
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		internal virtual int PaddingBetweenMenuItems => 0;

		{
			this.toolbarsManager = toolbarsManager;
		}

		{
		}

	internal class DropdownCloseupManager
	{
		private System.Windows.Forms.Timer delayTimer;

		private DropDownRequest pendingDropdownRequest;

		private List<MenuAgentBase> pendingCloseups = new List<MenuAgentBase>(3);

		private UltraToolbarsManager manager;

		private System.Windows.Forms.Timer DelayTimer
		{
			get
			{
				if (delayTimer == null)
				{
					delayTimer = Utilities.CreateTimer();
					delayTimer.Enabled = false;
					delayTimer.Tick += DelayTimerExpired;
				}
				return delayTimer;
			}
		}

		internal DropdownCloseupManager(UltraToolbarsManager manager)
		{
			this.manager = manager;
		}

		internal void AddCloseupRequest(MenuAgentBase menuAgent)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (MenuAgentBase pendingCloseup in pendingCloseups)
			{
				if (pendingCloseup.Equals(menuAgent))
				{
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				pendingCloseups.Add(menuAgent);
			}
			StartTimer();
		}

		internal void AddDropdownRequest(DropDownRequest dropdownRequest)
		{
			pendingDropdownRequest = dropdownRequest;
			StartTimer(dropdownRequest.menuAgent.AutoDropDownDelay);
		}

		internal void CancelPendingCloseup(MenuAgentBase menuAgent)
		{
			foreach (MenuAgentBase pendingCloseup in pendingCloseups)
			{
				if (pendingCloseup.Equals(menuAgent))
				{
					pendingCloseups.Remove(menuAgent);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void CancelPendingDropdownRequest()
		{
			pendingDropdownRequest = null;
		}

		internal void CancelPendingDropdownRequest(MenuAgentBase menuAgent)
		{
			if (pendingDropdownRequest != null && pendingDropdownRequest.menuAgent == menuAgent)
			{
				pendingDropdownRequest = null;
			}
		}

		internal void ClearPendingRequests()
		{
			DelayTimer.Enabled = false;
			ProcessCloseups();
			pendingDropdownRequest = null;
		}

		internal void Dispose()
		{
			if (delayTimer != null)
			{
				delayTimer.Enabled = false;
				delayTimer.Tick -= DelayTimerExpired;
				delayTimer.Dispose();
				delayTimer = null;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsCloseUpPending(MenuAgentBase menuAgent)
		{
			foreach (MenuAgentBase pendingCloseup in pendingCloseups)
			{
				if (pendingCloseup.Equals(menuAgent))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool IsDropdownPending(MenuAgentBase menuAgent)
		{
			if (pendingDropdownRequest != null)
			{
				return pendingDropdownRequest.menuAgent == menuAgent;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void DelayTimerExpired(object source, EventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0150: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_017d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!DelayTimer.Enabled)
			{
				return;
			}
			DelayTimer.Enabled = false;
			if (pendingCloseups.Count == 1)
			{
				try
				{
					PopupControlBase currentPopupControl = manager.CurrentPopupControl;
					if (currentPopupControl != null && currentPopupControl.MenuAgent is PopupControlContainerAgent && currentPopupControl.MenuAgent == pendingCloseups[0])
					{
						Point mousePosition = Control.MousePosition;
						Control control = null;
						try
						{
							control = ((Control)(object)currentPopupControl).FindForm();
						}
						catch
						{
						}
						if (control == null)
						{
							control = (Control)(object)currentPopupControl;
						}
						if (control == null || control.IsDisposed || control.Disposing)
						{
							return;
						}
						if (control.RectangleToScreen(control.ClientRectangle).Contains(mousePosition))
						{
							((PopupControlContainerAgent)currentPopupControl.MenuAgent).InvalidateParentMenuItem(recursive: true);
							pendingCloseups.Clear();
							pendingDropdownRequest = null;
							return;
						}
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			ProcessCloseups();
			if (pendingDropdownRequest != null)
			{
				if (!pendingDropdownRequest.menuAgent.IsOpen)
				{
					if (manager.AreKeyTipsShown)
					{
						manager.Ribbon.KeyTipManager.HideKeyTips();
					}
					pendingDropdownRequest.menuAgent.DropDown(pendingDropdownRequest.owningControl, pendingDropdownRequest.point, pendingDropdownRequest.exclusionRect, pendingDropdownRequest.dropDownPosition, delay: false, pendingDropdownRequest.closeIfAlreadyOpen, pendingDropdownRequest.alignRight, pendingDropdownRequest.autocloseDropdown, pendingDropdownRequest.splitMonitorAction, pendingDropdownRequest.showMiniToolbar);
				}
				pendingDropdownRequest = null;
			}
			else
			{
				manager.ImmediateToolTipDisplayMode = true;
			}
		}

		private void ProcessCloseups()
		{
			MenuAgentBase[] array = pendingCloseups.ToArray();
			MenuAgentBase[] array2 = array;
			foreach (MenuAgentBase menuAgentBase in array2)
			{
				menuAgentBase.CloseDropDown(delay: false);
			}
			pendingCloseups.Clear();
		}

		private void StartTimer()
		{
			StartTimer(500);
		}

		private void StartTimer(int delay)
		{
			if (!DelayTimer.Enabled)
			{
				DelayTimer.Interval = delay;
				DelayTimer.Enabled = true;
			}
		}
	}

	internal class VirtualTool
	{
		private ToolBase tool;

		private IProvideToolCustomizeInfo placeholderTool;

		private bool isTool;

		internal bool DrawInsertionPointVertically
		{
			get
			{
				if (isTool)
				{
					if (OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
					{
						return OwningRibbonGroup.LayoutDirection == RibbonGroupToolLayoutDirection.Horizontal;
					}
					if (OwnerIsToolbar)
					{
						return !OwningToolbar.IsVertical;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsTool => isTool;

		internal bool OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea
		{
			get
			{
				if (isTool)
				{
					return tool.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea;
				}
				return placeholderTool.Owner is ApplicationMenuArea;
			}
		}

		internal bool OwnerIsMenu
		{
			get
			{
				if (isTool)
				{
					return tool.OwnerIsMenuInternal;
				}
				return placeholderTool.OwnerIsMenu;
			}
		}

		internal bool OwnerIsToolbar
		{
			get
			{
				if (isTool)
				{
					return tool.OwnerIsToolbarInternal;
				}
				if (placeholderTool.Owner is UltraToolbarBase)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return placeholderTool.OwnerIsToolbar;
			}
		}

		internal bool OwnerIsRibbonGroup
		{
			get
			{
				if (isTool)
				{
					return tool.OwnerIsRibbonGroup;
				}
				return placeholderTool.Owner is RibbonGroup;
			}
		}

		internal bool OwnerIsApplicationMenu2010NavigationMenu
		{
			get
			{
				if (isTool)
				{
					return tool.OwnerIsApplicationMenu2010NavigationMenu;
				}
				return placeholderTool.Owner is NavigationMenu;
			}
		}

		internal NavigationMenu OwningApplicationMenu2010NavigationMenu
		{
			get
			{
				if (isTool)
				{
					return tool.OwningApplicationMenu2010NavigationMenu;
				}
				return placeholderTool.Owner as NavigationMenu;
			}
		}

		internal ApplicationMenuArea OwningApplicationMenuArea
		{
			get
			{
				if (isTool)
				{
					return tool.OwningApplicationMenuArea;
				}
				return placeholderTool.Owner as ApplicationMenuArea;
			}
		}

		internal PopupMenuTool OwningMenu
		{
			get
			{
				if (isTool)
				{
					return tool.OwningMenuInternal;
				}
				return placeholderTool.OwningMenu;
			}
		}

		internal UltraToolbarBase OwningToolbar
		{
			get
			{
				if (isTool)
				{
					return tool.OwningToolbarInternal;
				}
				if (placeholderTool.Owner is UltraToolbarBase)
				{
					return placeholderTool.Owner as UltraToolbarBase;
				}
				return placeholderTool.OwningToolbar;
			}
		}

		internal RibbonGroup OwningRibbonGroup
		{
			get
			{
				if (isTool)
				{
					return tool.OwningRibbonGroup;
				}
				return placeholderTool.Owner as RibbonGroup;
			}
		}

		internal object Owner
		{
			get
			{
				if (isTool)
				{
					return tool.OwnerInternal;
				}
				return placeholderTool.Owner;
			}
		}

		internal ToolsCollectionBase ParentCollection
		{
			get
			{
				if (isTool)
				{
					return tool.ParentCollection;
				}
				if (placeholderTool.OwnerIsMenu)
				{
					return placeholderTool.OwningMenu.Tools;
				}
				if (OwnerIsRibbonGroup)
				{
					return OwningRibbonGroup.Tools;
				}
				if (Owner is UltraToolbarBase)
				{
					return ((UltraToolbarBase)Owner).Tools;
				}
				if (OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)
				{
					return OwningApplicationMenuArea.Tools;
				}
				if (OwnerIsApplicationMenu2010NavigationMenu)
				{
					return OwningApplicationMenu2010NavigationMenu.Tools;
				}
				return placeholderTool.OwningToolbar.Tools;
			}
		}

		internal ToolBase Tool => tool;

		internal UIElement UIElement
		{
			get
			{
				if (isTool)
				{
					return tool.UIElement;
				}
				return placeholderTool.UIElement;
			}
		}

		internal VirtualTool(object obj)
		{
			tool = obj as ToolBase;
			placeholderTool = obj as IProvideToolCustomizeInfo;
			isTool = tool != null;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (tool != null)
			{
				return $"VirtualTool - Tool='{tool}'";
			}
			if (placeholderTool != null)
			{
				return $"VirtualTool - PlaceHolder='{placeholderTool}'";
			}
			return "VirtualTool";
		}
	}

					useLargeImagesOnToolbar = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), useLargeImagesOnToolbar);
					break;
				case "VerticalToolbarGrabHandleAppearance":
					verticalToolbarGrabHandleAppearanceHolder = (AppearanceHolder)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(AppearanceHolder), null);
					break;
				case "VerticalToolbarGrabHandleHeight":
					verticalToolbarGrabHandleHeight = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), verticalToolbarGrabHandleHeight);
					break;
				case "ToolTipDisplayStyle":
					toolTipDisplayStyle = (ToolTipDisplayStyle)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ToolTipDisplayStyle), toolTipDisplayStyle);
					break;
				case "TransitionAreas":
					transitionAreas = (ToolbarTransitionAreas)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ToolbarTransitionAreas), transitionAreas);
					break;
				case "AutoGenerateKeyTips":
					autoGenerateKeyTips = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), autoGenerateKeyTips);
					break;
				case "Office2007UICompatibility":
					office2007UICompatibility = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), office2007UICompatibility);
					break;
				case "MiniToolbar":
					miniToolbar = (MiniToolbar)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(MiniToolbar), miniToolbar);
					break;
				case "NavigationToolbar":
					navigationToolbar = (NavigationToolbar)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(NavigationToolbar), navigationToolbar);
					break;
				case "ToolSortingPrecedence":
					toolSortingPrecedence = (ToolSortingPrecedence)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ToolSortingPrecedence), toolSortingPrecedence);
					break;
				case "NotificationBadgeSettings":
					notificationBadgeSettings = (ToolNotificationBadgeSettings)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ToolNotificationBadgeSettings), notificationBadgeSettings);
					break;
				case "MultiMonitorDropDownBehavior":

				}
			}
		}

		internal static Form ActiveForm
		{

			{

				{
					UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
					if (Utilities.CanAssert)
					{

					}
					Form form = Form.ActiveForm;
					while (form != null && (form.Disposing || form.IsDisposed))
					{
						form = form.Owner;
					}
					if (form == null || form.Disposing || form.IsDisposed)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return form;
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
		}

		{

			{
				form.Activate();
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				if (!form.Visible || !form.IsHandleCreated)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (form.IsMdiChild)
				{
					if (!(GetParent(form) is MdiClient mdiClient))
					{
						return;
					}
					try
					{
						NativeWindowMethods.SendMessageApi(mdiClient.Handle, 546, form.Handle, IntPtr.Zero);
						return;
					}
					catch (SecurityException)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				try
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.SetForegroundWindowApi(form.Handle);
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
				}
			}
		}

		{
			Size result = default(Size);

			result.Height = (int)Math.Min(num2, 2147483647L);

		private static bool ContainsFocus(Control containedControl)
		{
			if (containedControl != null && containedControl.IsHandleCreated)
			{
				if (containedControl.ContainsFocus)
				{
					return true;
				}
				try
				{
					Form form = UltraToolbarsManager.FindFormHelper(containedControl);
					if (form == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (!form.TopLevel)
					{
						form = form.TopLevelControl as Form;
						if (form == null)
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
					IntPtr handle = form.Handle;
					IntPtr intPtr = NativeWindowMethods.GetFocusApi();
					while (intPtr != IntPtr.Zero && !(intPtr == handle))
					{
						IntPtr parentApi = NativeWindowMethods.GetParentApi(intPtr);
						IntPtr windowLong = NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowLong(intPtr, -8);
						if (parentApi != IntPtr.Zero)
						{
							intPtr = parentApi;
							continue;
						}
						if (windowLong != IntPtr.Zero)
						{
							intPtr = windowLong;
							continue;
						}
						return false;
					}
					for (Control control = UltraToolbarsManager.GetActiveControl(form); control != null; control = control.Parent)
					{
						if (control == containedControl)
						{
							return true;
						}
						if (control == form)
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static int CalculateDistanceFromRect(Rectangle rect, Point location)
		{
			if (rect.Contains(location))
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int val = rect.Left - location.X;
			val = Math.Max(val, rect.Top - location.Y);
			val = Math.Max(val, location.X - rect.Right + 1);
			return Math.Max(val, location.Y - rect.Bottom + 1);
		}

		internal static Rectangle GetImageAreaRectForOfficeXP(Rectangle menuItemAreaRectInsideBorders, MenuAgentBase menuAgent, object context)
		{
			Rectangle result = menuItemAreaRectInsideBorders;
			if (menuAgent.ShouldShowImages(context))
			{
				result.Width = menuAgent.GetImageSize(context).Width + (menuAgent.Metrics.MenuitemImagePaddingLeft + menuAgent.Metrics.MenuitemImagePaddingRight);
			}
			else
			{
				result.Width = 0;
			}
			if (menuAgent.IncludePaddingAroundMenuItems)
			{
				result.Width += menuAgent.Metrics.PaddingAroundMenuitem;
			}
			if (menuAgent.ShouldShowAddRemoveCheckColumn(context))
			{
				result.Width += 2 + menuAgent.ToolbarsManager.CheckMarkElementSize.Width;
			}
			if (menuAgent.IncludePaddingAroundMenuItems)
			{
				result.Y += menuAgent.Metrics.PaddingAroundMenuitem;
				result.Height -= 2 * menuAgent.Metrics.PaddingAroundMenuitem;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal static int InterpolateValue(int sourceRangeStart, int sourceRangeEnd, int sourceValue, int destinationRangeStart, int destinationRangeEnd, bool ensureInRange)
		{
			if (sourceRangeStart == sourceRangeEnd || destinationRangeStart == destinationRangeEnd)
			{
				return destinationRangeStart;
			}
			int num = sourceRangeEnd - sourceRangeStart;
			int num2 = sourceValue - sourceRangeStart;
			double num3 = (double)num2 / (double)num;
			int num4 = destinationRangeEnd - destinationRangeStart;
			int num5 = (int)Math.Round(num3 * (double)num4);
			int num6 = destinationRangeStart + num5;
			if (ensureInRange)
			{
				int val = Math.Min(destinationRangeStart, destinationRangeEnd);
				int val2 = Math.Max(destinationRangeStart, destinationRangeEnd);
				num6 = Math.Max(num6, val);
				num6 = Math.Min(num6, val2);
			}
			return num6;
		}

		internal static int InterpolateValueInverted(int sourceRangeStart, int sourceRangeEnd, int sourceValue, int destinationRangeStart, int destinationRangeEnd, bool ensureInRange)
		{
			return InterpolateValue(sourceRangeEnd, sourceRangeStart, sourceValue, destinationRangeStart, destinationRangeEnd, ensureInRange);
		}

		}

		internal static ParsedFormattedTextValue ParseFormattedText(string rawText, bool throwError)
		{
			if (rawText == null || rawText.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Exception ex = default(Exception);
			ParsedFormattedTextValue result = ParsedFormattedTextValue.Parse((object)rawText, (ValueType)3, ref ex);
			if (ex == null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (throwError)
			{
				throw ex;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static void SetControlCapture(Control control, bool capture)
		{
			if (control.Capture == capture)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!capture)
			{
				control.Capture = capture;
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				control.Capture = capture;
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				try
				{
					if (control.IsHandleCreated)
					{
						NativeWindowMethods.SetCaptureApi(control.Handle);
					}
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
				}
			}
		}

		internal static void ValidateKeyTip(ref string keyTip)
		{
			if (keyTip != null)
			{
				if (keyTip.Length > 3)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("KeyTipTooLong"), "value");
				}
				if (keyTip.Length == 0)
				{
					keyTip = null;
				}
			}
		}

			if ((flag2 || flag) && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)268435456) && ((ulong)requestedProps & 0x10000000uL) != 0L)
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackGradientStyle = (GradientStyle)2;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps ^ 0x10000000uL);
			}
		}

		public static string GetLocalizedShortcutString(Shortcut shortcut)
		{
			if (Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentCulture.TwoLetterISOLanguageName != "en")
			{
				return Utilities.GetLocalizedShortcutString(shortcut);
			}
			return TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(typeof(Keys)).ConvertToString((Keys)shortcut);
		}

		public static ToolOwnerType GetToolOwnerType(object toolOwner)
		{
			if (toolOwner == null)
			{
				return ToolOwnerType.None;
			}
			if (toolOwner is UltraToolbarsManager)
			{
				return ToolOwnerType.ToolbarsManager;
			}
			if (toolOwner is UltraToolbar)
			{
				return ToolOwnerType.Toolbar;
			}
			if (toolOwner is PopupMenuTool)
			{
				return ToolOwnerType.PopupMenu;
			}
			if (toolOwner is RibbonGroup)
			{
				return ToolOwnerType.RibbonGroup;
			}
			if (toolOwner is ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar)
			{
				return ToolOwnerType.ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar;
			}
			if (toolOwner is ApplicationMenuLeftArea)
			{
				return ToolOwnerType.ApplicationMenuLeftArea;
			}
			if (toolOwner is ApplicationMenuRightArea)
			{
				return ToolOwnerType.ApplicationMenuRightArea;
			}
			if (toolOwner is MiniToolbar)
			{
				return ToolOwnerType.MiniToolbar;
			}
			if (toolOwner is NavigationToolbar)
			{
				return ToolOwnerType.NavigationToolbar;
			}
			if (toolOwner is QuickAccessToolbar)
			{
				return ToolOwnerType.QuickAccessToolbar;
			}
			if (toolOwner is RibbonTabItemToolbar)
			{
				return ToolOwnerType.RibbonTabItemToolbar;
			}
			if (toolOwner is NavigationMenu)
			{
				return ToolOwnerType.ApplicationMenu2010NavigationMenu;
			}
			return ToolOwnerType.None;
		}

		public static bool DrawRegionedAreaForGlass(ISupportGlass glassDockArea, UIElement element, ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			if (glassDockArea == null || !glassDockArea.HasTransparentRegion)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Region transparentRegion = glassDockArea.TransparentRegion;
			using (Region region = element.Region)
			{
				region.Xor(transparentRegion);
				RectangleF bounds = region.GetBounds(((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics);
				Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle((int)bounds.Left, (int)bounds.Top, (int)bounds.Width, (int)bounds.Height);
				((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).DrawBackColor(rectangle);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static void PopulateMenuItemsCollection(MenuItemsCollection menuItems, ToolsCollection tools, MenuItemBase[] oldMenuItems)
		{
			foreach (ToolBase tool in tools)
			{
				if (tool.VisibleResolved)
				{
					ToolBase underlyingTool = tool.UnderlyingTool;
					if (underlyingTool == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					underlyingTool.AddMenuItems(tool, menuItems, oldMenuItems);
				}
			}
			ToolBase newToolPlaceHolder = tools.NewToolPlaceHolder;
			newToolPlaceHolder?.AddMenuItems(newToolPlaceHolder, menuItems, oldMenuItems);
			if (menuItems.Count < 1)
			{
				EmptyMenuItem menuItem = new EmptyMenuItem(tools.Owner);
				menuItems.Add(menuItem);
			}
		}

		internal static bool DrawRegionedBackgroundImageForGlass(ISupportGlass glassDockArea, UIElement element, ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			//IL_005c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

				((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).DrawImageBackground(ref drawParams.AppearanceData, rectangle2, rectangle, ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Element.Enabled);

		{

			}

		public static bool ShouldToolbarsManagerRenderCustomGlassArea(FormDisplayStyle formDisplayStyle)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4

		internal static SplitMonitorAction ResolveSplitMonitorAction(MultiMonitorDropDownBehavior multiMonitorBehavior, SplitMonitorAction defaultSplitMonitorAction)
		{
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (multiMonitorBehavior == MultiMonitorDropDownBehavior.Default)

	internal class ControlContainerToolMenuItem : ToolMenuItem
	{
		internal const int RightPadding = 7;

		internal const int TopPadding = 4;

		private bool isInSetSizeInternal;

		private Size originalControlSize;

		protected internal override bool AllowResize => true;

		protected internal override bool DisplayImage
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.MenuAgent.IsControlContainer)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return base.DisplayImage;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool DisplayText => Tool.InstanceDisplaysText;

		protected internal override bool DrawAsActive => false;

		protected internal override EmbeddableEditorBase Editor => null;

		protected internal override bool Enabled => Tool.EnabledResolved;

		internal override bool IsActive => Tool.DrawAsActive;

		protected internal override ImageList ImageList => Tool.ImageList;

		protected internal override VAlign ImageVerticalAlignment => (VAlign)1;

		protected internal override bool IsBeingCustomized
		{
			get
			{
				return ToolbarsManager.CustomizingTool(Tool);
			}
			set
			{
				ToolbarsManager.ToolBeingCustomized = Tool;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool IsOpen => false;

		protected internal override bool IsPopup => false;

		protected internal override Size MaximumSize
		{
			get
			{
				Control control = GetControl();
				if (control == null)
				{
					return base.Size;
				}
				Size maximumSize = control.MaximumSize;
				bool flag = maximumSize.Width == 0;
				bool flag2 = maximumSize.Height == 0;
				Size sizeBasedOnControlSize = GetSizeBasedOnControlSize(maximumSize);
				Size size = base.CachedSize;
				Size size2 = SystemInformation.VirtualScreen.Size;
				if (flag)
				{
					sizeBasedOnControlSize.Width = size2.Width;
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					sizeBasedOnControlSize.Height = size2.Height;
				}
				return new Size(Math.Max(sizeBasedOnControlSize.Width, size.Width), Math.Max(sizeBasedOnControlSize.Height, size.Height));
			}
		}

		protected internal override Size MinimumSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (originalControlSize.IsEmpty)
				{
					Control control = GetControl();
					if (control != null)
					{
						originalControlSize = control.Size;
					}
				}
				return GetSizeBasedOnControlSize(originalControlSize);
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool RecentlyUsed => Tool.RecentlyUsedResolved;

		protected internal override string ShortcutText => string.Empty;

		protected internal override Size Size
		{
			get
			{
				Control control = GetControl();
				if (control == null)
				{
					return base.Size;
				}
				if (originalControlSize.IsEmpty)
				{
					originalControlSize = control.Size;
				}
				Size sizeBasedOnControlSize = GetSizeBasedOnControlSize(control.Size);
				int widthConstraint = base.MenuAgent.GetWidthConstraint(this);
				if (sizeBasedOnControlSize.Width > widthConstraint)
				{
					sizeBasedOnControlSize.Width = widthConstraint;
				}
				return sizeBasedOnControlSize;
			}
		}

		protected internal override string Text => string.Empty;

		public ControlContainerToolMenuItem(ToolBase tool)
			: base(tool)
		{
		}

		protected internal override void DisplayCustomizeContextMenu(Point location)
		{
			if (!base.MenuAgent.IsControlContainer)
			{
				base.DisplayCustomizeContextMenu(location);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void DropDown(Control owningControl, Point point, Rectangle exclusionRect, DropDownPosition dropDownPosition, bool delay, bool closeIfAlreadyOpen, bool alignRight, bool autocloseDropdown)
		{
		}

		protected internal override void OnClick()
		{
		}

		protected internal override Size GetTextSize()
		{
			return Tool.CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstanceHelper();
		}

		protected internal override Size GetTextSize(ref AppearanceData appearance)
		{
			return Tool.CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstanceHelper();
		}

		protected internal override int IncrementClickCount()
		{
			return Tool.IncrementClickCount();
		}

		internal override void SetSizeInternal(Size newSize)
		{
			if (isInSetSizeInternal)
			{
				return;
			}
			isInSetSizeInternal = true;
			try
			{
				Control control = GetControl();
				MenuAgentBase menuAgent = base.MenuAgent;
				if (control != null)
				{
					Size sizeBasedOnControlSize = GetSizeBasedOnControlSize(control.Size);
					Size size = newSize - sizeBasedOnControlSize;
					control.Size += size;
				}
				base.SetSizeInternal(newSize);
			}
			finally
			{
				isInSetSizeInternal = false;
			}
		}

		protected internal override Size GetTextAreaSize(int widthConstraint)
		{
			return Tool.CalculateLogicalSizeOfToolInstanceHelper();
		}

		private Control GetControl()
		{
			ToolBase toolBase = Tool;
			if (toolBase == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Tool.Control;
		}

		private Size GetSizeBasedOnControlSize(Size controlSize)
		{
			Size nonTextAreaSize = GetNonTextAreaSize();
			nonTextAreaSize.Height = Math.Max(controlSize.Height + 4, nonTextAreaSize.Height);
			nonTextAreaSize.Width += controlSize.Width + 7;
			return nonTextAreaSize;
		}

		internal void ResetCache()
		{
			Control control = GetControl();
			if (control != null)
			{
				control.Size = originalControlSize;
			}
			originalControlSize = Size.Empty;
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Win.UltraWinToolbars.Design
{
	public class ContextMenuUltraConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool GetStandardValuesSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override bool GetStandardValuesExclusive(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override StandardValuesCollection GetStandardValues(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			list.Add(null);
			if (context == null)
			{
				return new StandardValuesCollection(list);
			}
			Control control = context.Instance as Control;
			UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = null;
			foreach (Attribute attribute in context.PropertyDescriptor.Attributes)
			{
				if (attribute is ExtenderProvidedPropertyAttribute extenderProvidedPropertyAttribute && extenderProvidedPropertyAttribute.Provider is UltraToolbarsManager)
				{
					ultraToolbarsManager = extenderProvidedPropertyAttribute.Provider as UltraToolbarsManager;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (ultraToolbarsManager == null)
			{
				if (control == null)
				{
					return new StandardValuesCollection(list);
				}
				Control control2 = null;
				if (control2 == null)
				{
					while (control.Parent != null)
					{
						control = control.Parent;
						control2 = control;
						ultraToolbarsManager = UltraToolbarsManager.FromContainer(control2);
						if (ultraToolbarsManager != null)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (ultraToolbarsManager == null)
			{
				return new StandardValuesCollection(list);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < ultraToolbarsManager.Tools.Count; i++)
			{
				if (ultraToolbarsManager.Tools[i] is PopupToolBase)
				{
					list.Add(ultraToolbarsManager.Tools[i].Key);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count > 1)
			{
				list.Sort();
			}
			return new StandardValuesCollection(list);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(string) && value == null)
			{
				return UltraToolbarsManager.NoneLiteral;
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}

		private void CustomizeDialogConvertTool_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (toolToConvert == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			txtToolToConvertKey.Text = toolToConvert.Key;
			bool excludeStockTypes = !toolToConvert.ToolbarsManager.ShowBuiltInToolTypesInCustomizer;
			InitializeToolTypeList(cboToolToConvertType, null, toolToConvert, excludeStockTypes: false);
			InitializeToolTypeList(cboDestinationType, toolToConvert, null, excludeStockTypes);
			lvwToolInstances.Items.Clear();
			foreach (ToolBase toolInstance in toolToConvert.SharedProps.ToolInstances)
			{
				ListViewItem listViewItem = new ListViewItem();
				if ((toolInstance.OwnerIsMenuInternal && !toolInstance.OwningMenuInternal.IsRootTool) || (toolInstance.OwnerIsToolbarInternal && toolInstance.OwningToolbarInternal.IsBumpedToolsToolbar))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (toolInstance.OwnerIsMenuInternal)
				{
					listViewItem.Text = string.Format(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ConvertToolDlg_OwnerDescriptionMenu"), toolInstance.OwningMenuInternal.Key);
				}
				else if (toolInstance.OwnerIsToolbarInternal)
				{
					listViewItem.Text = string.Format(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ConvertToolDlg_OwnerDescriptionToolbar"), toolInstance.OwningToolbarInternal.Key);
				}
				else
				{
					if (toolInstance.OwnerIsNull)
					{
						continue;
					}
					listViewItem.Text = string.Format(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ConvertToolDlg_OwnerDescriptionOther"), toolInstance.OwnerInternal.GetType().Name);
				}
				listViewItem.SubItems.Add(toolInstance.Index.ToString());
				listViewItem.Tag = toolInstance;
				lvwToolInstances.Items.Add(listViewItem);
			}
			btnOk.Enabled = cboDestinationType.Items.Count > 0;
		}

		private static void InitializeToolTypeList(ComboBox combo, ToolBase toolToExclude, ToolBase defaultTool, bool excludeStockTypes)
		{
			combo.Items.Clear();
			IDictionaryEnumerator enumerator = UltraToolbarsManager.ToolTypes.GetEnumerator();
			object selectedItem = null;
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				if (UltraToolbarsManager.ToolTypes[enumerator.Key] is ToolDefinition toolDefinition && !(toolDefinition.ToolID == UltraToolbarsManager.TASKPANE_TOOLID) && !DesignerUtilities.GetPlacementInfo(toolDefinition).ToolType.IsSubclassOf(typeof(TaskPaneTool)) && (!excludeStockTypes || toolDefinition.IsCustom) && (toolToExclude == null || !DesignerUtilities.IsSameToolType(toolToExclude, toolDefinition)))
				{
					combo.Items.Add(toolDefinition);
					if (defaultTool != null && DesignerUtilities.IsSameToolType(defaultTool, toolDefinition))
					{
						selectedItem = toolDefinition;
					}
				}
			}
			if (combo.Items.Count > 0)
			{
				combo.Sorted = true;
			}
			combo.SelectedItem = selectedItem;
			if (combo.SelectedIndex == -1 && combo.Items.Count > 0)
			{
				combo.SelectedIndex = 0;
			}
		}

		private void btnOk_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ConvertToolType(toolToConvert, cboDestinationType.SelectedItem as ToolDefinition);
		}

		private void btnCancel_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Close();
		}

		public static void ConvertToolType(ToolBase toolToConvert, ToolDefinition toolDefinition)
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = toolToConvert.ToolbarsManager;
			ToolBase rootTool = toolToConvert.SharedProps.RootTool;
			if (toolDefinition == null || rootTool == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string key = Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
			string key2 = rootTool.Key;
			ToolBase toolBase = toolDefinition.ToolProvider.CreateToolInstance(toolDefinition.ToolID, key);
			((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)toolbarsManager).BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				toolbarsManager.Tools.Add(toolBase);
				toolBase.CopyToolSettings(rootTool);
				foreach (ToolBase toolInstance in rootTool.SharedProps.ToolInstances)
				{
					if (!toolInstance.IsRootTool && (!toolInstance.OwnerIsMenuInternal || toolInstance.OwningMenuInternal.IsRootTool) && (!toolInstance.OwnerIsToolbarInternal || !toolInstance.OwningToolbarInternal.IsBumpedToolsToolbar) && toolInstance.ParentCollection != null && toolInstance.ParentCollection is ToolsCollection toolsCollection)
					{
						ToolBase toolBase2 = toolsCollection.InsertTool(toolInstance.Index + 1, toolBase.Key);
						toolBase2.CopyToolSettings(toolInstance);
					}
				}
				toolbarsManager.Tools.Remove(rootTool);
				toolBase.Key = key2;
			}
			finally
			{
				((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)toolbarsManager).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		private void cboDestinationType_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ToolDefinition toolDefinition = cboDestinationType.SelectedItem as ToolDefinition;
			ToolPlacementInfo placementInfo = DesignerUtilities.GetPlacementInfo(toolDefinition);
			bool flag = placementInfo.ToolId == UltraToolbarsManager.TASKPANE_TOOLID || toolToConvert is TaskPaneTool || (!placementInfo.ToolType.IsSubclassOf(toolToConvert.GetType()) && ((placementInfo.IsVisibleOnMenus != toolToConvert.IsVisibleOnMenus || placementInfo.IsVisibleOnToolbars != toolToConvert.IsVisibleOnToolbars || placementInfo.IsVisibleOnVerticalToolbars != toolToConvert.IsVisibleOnVerticalToolbars || placementInfo.IsVisibleOnRibbonGroup != toolToConvert.IsVisibleOnRibbonGroup) ? true : false));
			lvwToolInstances.BeginUpdate();
			bool flag2 = false;
			foreach (ListViewItem item in lvwToolInstances.Items)
			{
				bool flag3 = true;
				if (flag)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase = item.Tag as ToolBase;
					flag3 = ((placementInfo.IsVisibleOnMenus && (toolBase.OwnerIsMenuInternal || toolBase.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)) ? placementInfo.IsVisibleOnMenus : ((toolBase.OwnerIsRibbonGroup && placementInfo.IsVisibleOnRibbonGroup) || (toolBase.IsArrangedVertically ? placementInfo.IsVisibleOnVerticalToolbars : (toolBase.OwnerIsToolbarInternal && placementInfo.IsVisibleOnToolbars))));
				}
				if (flag3)
				{
					item.ImageIndex = -1;
					continue;
				}
				item.ImageIndex = 0;
				flag2 = true;
			}
			lvwToolInstances.EndUpdate();
			if (flag2)
			{
				string value = ((!placementInfo.IsVisibleOnMenus) ? Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ConvertToolDlg_NotVisibleOnMenus") : ((!placementInfo.IsVisibleOnToolbars) ? Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ConvertToolDlg_NotVisibleOnToolbars") : ((!placementInfo.IsVisibleOnVerticalToolbars) ? Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ConvertToolDlg_NotVisibleOnVertToolbars") : (placementInfo.IsVisibleOnRibbonGroup ? null : Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ConvertToolDlg_NotVisibleOnRibbonGroup")))));
				errorProvider1.SetError(cboDestinationType, value);
			}
			else
			{
				errorProvider1.SetError(cboDestinationType, null);
			}
		}

		private void InitializeDialogStrings()
		{
			lblNewToolType.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ConvertToolDlg_NewToolType");
			lblCurrentToolType.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ConvertToolDlg_CurrentToolType");
			lblToolKey.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ConvertToolDlg_ToolKey");
			lblInstances.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ConvertToolDlg_ToolInstances");
			lvwColumnOwner.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ConvertToolDlg_OwnerColumn");

			btnCancel.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ConvertToolDlg_Cancel");
			btnOk.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ConvertToolDlg_OK");
		}

		private void CustomizeDialogExistingTool_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			DesignerUtilities.LoadCategoriesIntoControl(sourceManager, cboCategoryList, addUnassignedEntry: true, addAllCommandsEntry: true);
			cboCategoryList.SelectedIndex = 0;
			RefreshToolList();
			InitializeToolTypeCombo(cboToolType);
			isInitializing = false;
		}

		private void InitializeToolTypeCombo(ComboBox cbo)
		{
			cbo.Items.Clear();
			foreach (ToolWrapper item in lstExistingTools.Items)
			{
				Type type = item.Tool.GetType();
				bool flag = false;
				foreach (ToolTypeWrapper item2 in cbo.Items)
				{
					if (item2.ToolType == type)
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					cbo.Items.Add(new ToolTypeWrapper(type.Name, type));
				}
			}
			if (cbo.Items.Count > 0)
			{
				cbo.Sorted = true;
				cbo.Sorted = false;
			}
			cbo.Items.Insert(0, new ToolTypeWrapper(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeToolTypeAllTypes"), null));
			cbo.SelectedIndex = 0;
		}

		private void InitializeDialogStrings()
		{
			Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ExistingToolDlg_Title");
			btnClose.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ExistingToolDlg_Close");
			btnInsert.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ExistingToolDlg_Insert");
			lblCategory.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ExistingToolDlg_Category");
			lblToolType.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ExistingToolDlg_ToolType");
		}

		private void btnClose_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Close();
		}

		private void btnInsert_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			string[] array = new string[lstExistingTools.SelectedItems.Count];
			int num = 0;
			foreach (ToolWrapper selectedItem in lstExistingTools.SelectedItems)
			{
				array[num++] = selectedItem.Tool.Key;
			}
			int count = collectionToUpdate.Count;
			collectionToUpdate.InsertToolRange(startingIndex, array);
			startingIndex += array.Length;
			startingIndex -= array.Length + count - collectionToUpdate.Count;
			customizer.OnExistingToolsInserted(collectionToUpdate);
		}

		private void lstExistingTools_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			btnInsert.Enabled = lstExistingTools.SelectedItems.Count > 0;
		}

		private void cboToolType_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!isInitializing)
			{
				RefreshToolList();
			}
		}

		private void cboCategoryList_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!isInitializing)
			{
				RefreshToolList();
			}
		}

		private void RefreshToolList()
		{
			lstExistingTools.BeginUpdate();
			Type limitToType = ((cboToolType.SelectedItem == null) ? null : ((ToolTypeWrapper)cboToolType.SelectedItem).ToolType);
			lstExistingTools.Sorted = false;
			lstExistingTools.Items.Clear();
			DesignerUtilities.AddCollectionToolsToList(sourceCollection, lstExistingTools.Items, cboCategoryList.SelectedItem as CategoryWrapper, addSeparatorEntries: false, honorShowInCustomizer: false, skipMdiMergeTools: true, limitToType, ensureVisibleOnMenus, ensureVisibleOnToolbars, ensureVisibleOnVerticalToolbars, ensureVisibleOnRibbonGroup, ensureVisibleOnQat, taskPaneFilterMode);
			if (lstExistingTools.Items.Count > 0)
			{
				lstExistingTools.Sorted = true;
			}
			lstExistingTools.EndUpdate();
		}

	internal class DesignerUtilities
	{
		private class ToolbarsManagerTypeDescriptorContext : ITypeDescriptorContext, IServiceProvider
		{
			private UltraToolbarsManager manager;

			private ToolBase tool;

			IContainer ITypeDescriptorContext.Container => null;

			object ITypeDescriptorContext.Instance => tool;

			PropertyDescriptor ITypeDescriptorContext.PropertyDescriptor => null;

			public ToolbarsManagerTypeDescriptorContext(UltraToolbarsManager manager, ToolBase tool)
			{
				this.manager = manager;
				this.tool = tool;
			}

			void ITypeDescriptorContext.OnComponentChanged()
			{
			}

			bool ITypeDescriptorContext.OnComponentChanging()
			{
				return false;
			}

			object IServiceProvider.GetService(Type serviceType)
			{
				return ((Component)(object)manager).Site.GetService(serviceType);
			}
		}

		private class TypeEditorContext : ITypeDescriptorContext, IServiceProvider, IWindowsFormsEditorService
		{
			private IComponent component;

			private object instance;

			private PropertyDescriptor pd;

			private IComponentChangeService componentChangeService;

			private IComponentChangeService ComponentChangeService
			{
				get
				{
					if (componentChangeService == null)
					{
						componentChangeService = ((IServiceProvider)this).GetService(typeof(IComponentChangeService)) as IComponentChangeService;
					}
					return componentChangeService;
				}
			}

			IContainer ITypeDescriptorContext.Container
			{
				get
				{
					if (component == null || component.Site == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return component.Site.Container;
				}
			}

			object ITypeDescriptorContext.Instance => instance;

			PropertyDescriptor ITypeDescriptorContext.PropertyDescriptor => pd;

			internal TypeEditorContext(object instance, PropertyDescriptor pd, IComponent component)
			{
				this.instance = instance;
				this.pd = pd;
				this.component = component;
			}

			void ITypeDescriptorContext.OnComponentChanged()
			{
				if (ComponentChangeService != null)
				{
					ComponentChangeService.OnComponentChanged(component, null, null, null);
				}
			}

			bool ITypeDescriptorContext.OnComponentChanging()
			{
				if (ComponentChangeService != null)
				{
					ComponentChangeService.OnComponentChanging(component, null);
				}
				return true;
			}

			object IServiceProvider.GetService(Type serviceType)
			{
				object obj = null;
				if (serviceType.IsAssignableFrom(GetType()) && serviceType.IsInterface)
				{
					obj = this;
				}
				if (obj == null && component.Site != null)
				{
					obj = component.Site.GetService(serviceType);
				}
				return obj;
			}

			void IWindowsFormsEditorService.CloseDropDown()
			{
			}

			void IWindowsFormsEditorService.DropDownControl(Control control)
			{
			}

			DialogResult IWindowsFormsEditorService.ShowDialog(Form dialog)
			{
				if (((IServiceProvider)this).GetService(typeof(IUIService)) is IUIService iUIService)
				{
					return iUIService.ShowDialog(dialog);
				}
				return dialog.ShowDialog(null);
			}
		}

		internal static PopupMenuTool CreateEditToolPopupMenu(UltraToolbarsManager manager, bool isDesignMode, UltraToolbarsManager managerBeingDesigned)
		{
			PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool = new PopupMenuTool("context_menu");
			manager.Tools.Add(popupMenuTool);
			ButtonTool tool = new ButtonTool("reset");
			manager.Tools.Add(tool);
			popupMenuTool.Tools.AddTool("reset");
			popupMenuTool.Tools["reset"].SharedProps.Caption = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeDlgReset");
			tool = new ButtonTool("delete");
			manager.Tools.Add(tool);
			popupMenuTool.Tools.AddTool("delete");
			popupMenuTool.Tools["delete"].SharedProps.Caption = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeDlgDelete");
			TextBoxTool tool2 = new TextBoxTool("name");
			manager.Tools.Add(tool2);
			popupMenuTool.Tools.AddTool("name");
			popupMenuTool.Tools["name"].SharedProps.Caption = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeDlgName");
			popupMenuTool.Tools["name"].InstanceProps.IsFirstInGroup = true;
			if (isDesignMode)
			{
				int num = manager.Tools.IndexOf("control_list_menu");
				if (num < 0)
				{
					CreateControlListPopupMenu(manager);
				}
				ToolBase toolBase = popupMenuTool.Tools.AddTool("control_list_menu");
				toolBase.InstanceProps.IsFirstInGroup = true;
			}
			if (managerBeingDesigned.CanCustomizerAffectRibbon)
			{
				int num2 = manager.Tools.IndexOf("min_ribbon_size_menu");
				if (num2 < 0)
				{
					CreateRibbonSizePopupMenus(manager);
				}
				ToolBase toolBase2 = popupMenuTool.Tools.AddTool("pref_ribbon_size_menu");
				toolBase2.InstanceProps.IsFirstInGroup = true;
				popupMenuTool.Tools.AddTool("min_ribbon_size_menu");
				int num3 = manager.Tools.IndexOf("button_group_tool");
				if (num3 < 0)
				{
					ComboBoxTool comboBoxTool = new ComboBoxTool("button_group_tool");
					comboBoxTool.DropDownStyle = (DropDownStyle)0;
					comboBoxTool.SharedProps.DisplayStyle = ToolDisplayStyle.ImageAndText;
					comboBoxTool.SharedProps.Caption = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeDlgButtonGroup");

				((StateButtonTool)popupMenuTool.Tools["default_style"]).SharedProps.Visible = visible;
				((StateButtonTool)popupMenuTool.Tools["text_only_always"]).SharedProps.Visible = visible;
				((StateButtonTool)popupMenuTool.Tools["text_only_in_menus"]).SharedProps.Visible = visible;
				((StateButtonTool)popupMenuTool.Tools["image_and_text"]).SharedProps.Visible = visible;
				((TextBoxTool)popupMenuTool.Tools["name"]).EditValue = toolBeingEdited.CaptionResolved;
				((StateButtonTool)popupMenuTool.Tools["begin_a_group"]).Checked = toolBeingEdited.IsFirstInGroupResolved;
				((StateButtonTool)popupMenuTool.Tools["recently_used"]).Checked = toolBeingEdited.RecentlyUsedResolved;
				popupMenuTool.Tools["recently_used"].SharedProps.Visible = !ownerIsRibbonGroup && !isOnQat;

				if (popupMenuTool.Tools.Exists("control_list_menu"))

					ListTool listTool3 = internalToolbarsManager.Tools["list_controls_tool"] as ListTool;
					listTool3.ListToolItems.Clear();
					if (flag)

						ITypeDescriptorContext context = new ToolbarsManagerTypeDescriptorContext(toolBeingEdited.ToolbarsManager, toolBeingEdited);
						ICollection collection = null;
						PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(typeof(ControlContainerTool))["Control"];
						if (propertyDescriptor != null)
						{
							TypeConverter converter = propertyDescriptor.Converter;
							if (converter != null)
							{
								collection = converter.GetStandardValues(context);
							}
						}

						{
							collection = new object[0];
						}

							Control control = item as Control;
							string text = ((control == null) ? Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NoneLiteral") : (TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(item)["Name"].GetValue(item) as string));
							ListToolItem listToolItem = listTool3.ListToolItems.Add(null, text, control == toolBeingEdited.Control);
							listToolItem.Tag = control;
							if (control == toolBeingEdited.Control && listTool3.SelectedItem != listToolItem)
							{
								listTool3.SelectedItemIndex = listToolItem.Index;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (popupMenuTool.Tools.Exists("edit_image"))
				{
					bool flag2 = toolBeingEdited.InstanceDisplaysImage && toolBeingEdited.ToolbarsManagerInControl.IsCustomizeOptionEnabled(RuntimeCustomizationOptions.AllowImageEditing);
					bool enabled2 = flag2;
					bool enabled3 = false;
					if (flag2)
					{
						AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
						AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)256;
						toolBeingEdited.ResolveAppearance(editArea: false, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, drawAsActive: false, drawAsPressed: false);
						enabled2 = ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)256);
						if (flag2)
						{
							try
							{
								IDataObject dataObject = Clipboard.GetDataObject();
								if (dataObject != null && dataObject.GetDataPresent(DataFormats.Bitmap))
								{
									enabled3 = true;
								}
							}
							catch
							{
							}
						}

					popupMenuTool.Tools["paste_image"].SharedProps.Enabled = enabled3;

		internal static bool ProcessEditToolPopupMenuClick(ToolBase toolBeingEdited, bool designMode, ToolClickEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_03c3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (e.Tool.Key == "reset")
			{
				toolBeingEdited.ResetState();
			}
			else if (e.Tool.Key == "delete")
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = toolBeingEdited.ToolbarsManager;
				toolBeingEdited.Delete();
				toolbarsManager.ToolBeingCustomized = null;
			}
			else if (e.Tool.Key == "default_style" || e.Tool.Key == "text_only_always" || e.Tool.Key == "text_only_in_menus" || e.Tool.Key == "image_and_text")
			{
				ToolDisplayStyle toolDisplayStyle = ToolDisplayStyle.Default;
				if (e.Tool.Key == "default_style")
				{
					toolDisplayStyle = (((StateButtonTool)e.Tool).Checked ? ToolDisplayStyle.DefaultForToolType : toolDisplayStyle);
				}
				else if (e.Tool.Key == "text_only_always")
				{
					toolDisplayStyle = (((StateButtonTool)e.Tool).Checked ? ToolDisplayStyle.TextOnlyAlways : toolDisplayStyle);
				}
				else if (e.Tool.Key == "text_only_in_menus")
				{
					toolDisplayStyle = (((StateButtonTool)e.Tool).Checked ? ToolDisplayStyle.TextOnlyInMenus : toolDisplayStyle);
				}
				else if (e.Tool.Key == "image_and_text")
				{
					toolDisplayStyle = (((StateButtonTool)e.Tool).Checked ? ToolDisplayStyle.ImageAndText : toolDisplayStyle);
				}
				if (designMode)
				{
					if (toolBeingEdited.SharedProps.DisplayStyle == ToolDisplayStyle.Default)
					{
						if (toolBeingEdited.InstanceProps.DisplayStyle == ToolDisplayStyle.Default)
						{
							toolBeingEdited.SharedProps.DisplayStyle = toolDisplayStyle;
						}
						else
						{
							toolBeingEdited.InstanceProps.DisplayStyle = toolDisplayStyle;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						toolBeingEdited.SharedProps.DisplayStyle = toolDisplayStyle;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					toolBeingEdited.CustomizedDisplayStyle = toolDisplayStyle;
				}
				if (toolBeingEdited.OwnerIsToolbarInternal && toolBeingEdited.OwningToolbarInternal != null)
				{
					toolBeingEdited.OwningToolbarInternal.RefreshDockAreaContents();
				}
			}
			else if (e.Tool.Key == "begin_a_group")
			{
				if (designMode)
				{
					toolBeingEdited.InstanceProps.IsFirstInGroup = ((StateButtonTool)e.Tool).Checked;
				}
				else
				{
					toolBeingEdited.CustomizedIsFirstInGroup = (DefaultableBoolean)(((StateButtonTool)e.Tool).Checked ? 1 : 2);
				}
				if (toolBeingEdited.OwnerIsMenuInternal && toolBeingEdited.OwningMenuInternal != null)
				{
					toolBeingEdited.OwningMenuInternal.RefreshDropDownContents();
				}
				else if (toolBeingEdited.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea)
				{
					toolBeingEdited.OwningApplicationMenuArea.ApplicationMenu.RefreshDropDownContents();
				}
				else if (toolBeingEdited.OwnerIsToolbarInternal && toolBeingEdited.OwningToolbarInternal != null)
				{
					toolBeingEdited.OwningToolbarInternal.RefreshDockAreaContents();
				}
			}
			else if (e.Tool.Key == "recently_used")
			{
				if (designMode)
				{
					toolBeingEdited.InstanceProps.RecentlyUsed = ((StateButtonTool)e.Tool).Checked;
				}
				else
				{
					toolBeingEdited.CustomizedRecentlyUsed = (DefaultableBoolean)(((StateButtonTool)e.Tool).Checked ? 1 : 2);
				}
			}
			else if (e.Tool.Key == "convert_tool_type")
			{
				if (toolBeingEdited.ToolbarsManager != null)
				{
					CustomizeDialogConvertTool customizeDialogConvertTool = new CustomizeDialogConvertTool(toolBeingEdited);
					UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager2 = toolBeingEdited.ToolbarsManager;
					bool designerChangeNotificationsEnabled = ((IUltraComponent)toolbarsManager2).DesignerChangeNotificationsEnabled;
					((IUltraComponent)toolbarsManager2).DesignerChangeNotificationsEnabled = false;
					try
					{
						ShowDialog(toolBeingEdited.ToolbarsManager, customizeDialogConvertTool, useCustomizer: true);
					}
					finally
					{
						((IUltraComponent)toolbarsManager2).DesignerChangeNotificationsEnabled = designerChangeNotificationsEnabled;
					}
					customizeDialogConvertTool.Dispose();
				}
			}
			else if (e.Tool.Key == "edit_image")
			{
				Image toolImage = GetToolImage(toolBeingEdited);
				using (toolImage)
				{
					CustomizeDialogImageEditor customizeDialogImageEditor = ((toolImage == null) ? new CustomizeDialogImageEditor(toolBeingEdited.ToolbarsManager.GetToolImageSize(toolBeingEdited), isEmbedded: true) : new CustomizeDialogImageEditor(toolImage, isEmbedded: true));
					customizeDialogImageEditor.MaximumImageSize = toolBeingEdited.ToolbarsManagerInControl.ImageSizeLargeResolved;
					customizeDialogImageEditor.ToolbarStyle = toolBeingEdited.ToolbarsManagerInControl.StyleResolved;
					if (toolBeingEdited.ToolbarsManagerInControl.CustomizeDialog is CustomizeDialog customizeDialog)
					{
						customizeDialogImageEditor.UseAppStyling = customizeDialog.UseAppStyling;
					}
					IWin32Window win32Window;
					if (toolBeingEdited.ToolbarsManagerInControl.CustomizeDialog == null)
					{
						win32Window = toolBeingEdited.ToolbarsManagerInControl.CustomizeDialog.DialogOwner;
					}
					else
					{
						IWin32Window dockWithinContainer = toolBeingEdited.ToolbarsManagerInControl.DockWithinContainer;
						win32Window = dockWithinContainer;
					}
					IWin32Window win32Window2 = win32Window;
					DropDownManager.SuspendAutoCloseUp();
					try
					{
						ShowDialog(toolBeingEdited.ToolbarsManagerInControl, customizeDialogImageEditor, useCustomizer: true);
					}
					finally
					{
						DropDownManager.ResumeAutoCloseUp();
					}
					if (customizeDialogImageEditor.IsModified && DialogResult.Yes == UltraMessageBoxManager.Show(win32Window2, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeImg_SaveChanges"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeImg_Title"), MessageBoxButtons.YesNo, MessageBoxIcon.Question))
					{
						toolBeingEdited.CustomizedImage = customizeDialogImageEditor.Image;
					}
					customizeDialogImageEditor.Dispose();
				}
			}
			else if (e.Tool.Key == "copy_image")
			{
				try
				{
					Image toolImage2 = GetToolImage(toolBeingEdited);
					Image image = null;
					ImageAttributes imageAttributes = null;
					if (toolImage2 != null)
					{
						try
						{
							imageAttributes = new ImageAttributes();
							ColorMap colorMap = new ColorMap();
							colorMap.OldColor = Color.FromArgb(0, 0, 0, 0);
							colorMap.NewColor = Color.White;
							imageAttributes.SetRemapTable(new ColorMap[1] { colorMap });
							image = DrawUtility.CopyImage(toolImage2, imageAttributes);
							if (image != null)
							{
								Clipboard.SetDataObject(image, copy: true);
							}
						}
						finally
						{
							imageAttributes?.Dispose();
							image?.Dispose();
							toolImage2.Dispose();
						}
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			else if (e.Tool.Key == "paste_image")
			{
				try
				{
					IDataObject dataObject = Clipboard.GetDataObject();
					Image customizedImage = dataObject.GetData(DataFormats.Bitmap) as Image;
					toolBeingEdited.CustomizedImage = customizedImage;
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			else if (e.Tool.Key == "reset_image")
			{
				toolBeingEdited.CustomizedImage = null;
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(e.Tool.Key == "desc_on_menu_tool"))
				{
					return false;
				}
				ShowUITypeEditor(toolBeingEdited.SharedProps, "DescriptionOnMenu", (IComponent)toolBeingEdited.ToolbarsManagerInControl);
			}
			if (toolBeingEdited.UIElement != null)
			{
				toolBeingEdited.UIElement.Parent.DirtyChildElements(true);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool ProcessEditToolPopupMenuCloseUp(ToolBase toolBeingEdited, bool designMode, ToolDropdownEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Tool.Key != "context_menu")
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = e.Tool.ToolbarsManager;
			if (!(toolbarsManager.Tools["context_menu"] is PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (designMode)
			{
				if (toolBeingEdited.SharedProps.ShouldSerializeCaption())
				{
					toolBeingEdited.SharedProps.Caption = ((TextBoxTool)popupMenuTool.Tools["name"]).EditValue.ToString();
				}
				else if (toolBeingEdited.InstanceProps.ShouldSerializeCaption())
				{
					toolBeingEdited.InstanceProps.Caption = ((TextBoxTool)popupMenuTool.Tools["name"]).EditValue.ToString();
				}
				else
				{
					toolBeingEdited.SharedProps.Caption = ((TextBoxTool)popupMenuTool.Tools["name"]).EditValue.ToString();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				toolBeingEdited.CustomizedCaption = ((TextBoxTool)popupMenuTool.Tools["name"]).EditValue.ToString();
				toolBeingEdited.ToolbarsManager?.DirtyAllElements();
			}
			int num = popupMenuTool.Tools.IndexOf("button_group_tool");
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				ComboBoxTool comboBoxTool = (ComboBoxTool)popupMenuTool.Tools[num];
				object editValue = comboBoxTool.EditValue;
				toolBeingEdited.InstanceProps.ButtonGroup = editValue?.ToString();
				if (toolBeingEdited.UIElement != null)
				{
					toolBeingEdited.UIElement.Parent.DirtyChildElements(true);
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static void InitializeNewToolPopupMenu(UltraToolbarsManager internalToolbarsManager, UltraToolbarsManager managerBeingDesigned, bool createIfMenuIsNull)
		{
			PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool = null;
			if (createIfMenuIsNull)
			{
				int num = internalToolbarsManager.Tools.IndexOf("new_tool_menu");
				popupMenuTool = ((num < 0) ? CreateNewToolPopupMenu(internalToolbarsManager) : (internalToolbarsManager.Tools[num] as PopupMenuTool));
			}
			else
			{
				popupMenuTool = internalToolbarsManager.Tools["new_tool_menu"] as PopupMenuTool;
			}
			if (popupMenuTool != null)
			{
				internalToolbarsManager.Tools["insert_existing_tool"].SharedProps.Enabled = managerBeingDesigned.Tools.Count > 0;
			}
		}

		internal static bool ProcessNewToolPopupMenuClick(UltraToolbarsManager managerBeingDesigned, IToolbarCustomizer customizer, ToolBase sourceTool, ToolClickEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Tool.Key == "insert_new_tool")
			{
				CustomizeDialogNewTool customizeDialogNewTool = new CustomizeDialogNewTool(managerBeingDesigned, customizer, string.Empty, sourceTool.OwnerIsMenuInternal || sourceTool.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea || sourceTool.OwnerIsApplicationMenu2010NavigationMenu, sourceTool.OwnerIsToolbarInternal, sourceTool.IsArrangedVertically, sourceTool.OwnerIsRibbonGroup, sourceTool.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea || sourceTool.OwnerIsApplicationMenu2010NavigationMenu, sourceTool.IsOnQat, (sourceTool.OwnerInternal is TaskPaneToolbarMenuTool) ? TaskPaneFilterMode.OnlyIncludeTaskPaneTools : TaskPaneFilterMode.OnlyIncludeNonTaskPaneTools);
				DropDownManager.SuspendAutoCloseUp();
				bool designerChangeNotificationsEnabled = ((IUltraComponent)managerBeingDesigned).DesignerChangeNotificationsEnabled;
				((IUltraComponent)managerBeingDesigned).DesignerChangeNotificationsEnabled = false;
				try
				{
					ShowDialog(managerBeingDesigned, customizeDialogNewTool, useCustomizer: true);
				}
				finally
				{
					DropDownManager.ResumeAutoCloseUp();
					((IUltraComponent)managerBeingDesigned).DesignerChangeNotificationsEnabled = designerChangeNotificationsEnabled;
				}
				customizeDialogNewTool.Dispose();
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(e.Tool.Key == "insert_existing_tool"))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (sourceTool.OwnerIsToolbarInternal && sourceTool.OwningToolbarInternal.IsBumpedToolsToolbar && sourceTool.ClonedFromTool != null)
				{
					sourceTool = sourceTool.ClonedFromTool;
				}
				CustomizeDialogExistingTool customizeDialogExistingTool = new CustomizeDialogExistingTool(customizer, sourceTool);
				DropDownManager.SuspendAutoCloseUp();
				bool designerChangeNotificationsEnabled2 = ((IUltraComponent)managerBeingDesigned).DesignerChangeNotificationsEnabled;
				((IUltraComponent)managerBeingDesigned).DesignerChangeNotificationsEnabled = false;
				try
				{
					ShowDialog(managerBeingDesigned, customizeDialogExistingTool, useCustomizer: true);
				}
				finally
				{
					DropDownManager.ResumeAutoCloseUp();
					((IUltraComponent)managerBeingDesigned).DesignerChangeNotificationsEnabled = designerChangeNotificationsEnabled2;
				}
				customizeDialogExistingTool.Dispose();
			}
			return true;
		}

			{
				object obj = ((!(e.Tool.Key == "small_image_tool")) ? toolBeingEdited.SharedProps.AppearancesLarge.Appearance : toolBeingEdited.SharedProps.AppearancesSmall.Appearance);
				ShowUITypeEditor(obj, "Image", (IComponent)toolBeingEdited.ToolbarsManagerInControl);
				return true;

			if (e.Tool.Key == "clear_small_image_tool" || e.Tool.Key == "clear_large_image_tool")

				val.Image = null;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

					toolBeingEdited.InstanceProps.PreferredSizeOnRibbon = ribbonToolSize;
				}
				else
				{
					toolBeingEdited.InstanceProps.MinimumSizeOnRibbon = ribbonToolSize;
				}
				return true;

			return false;
		}

		internal static void AddCollectionToolsToList(ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection, ListBox listBox, CategoryWrapper selectedCategory, bool isDesignMode)

		}

		internal static void AddCollectionToolsToList(ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection, ListBox listBox, CategoryWrapper selectedCategory, bool isDesignMode, bool addSeparatorEntries)
		{
			AddCollectionToolsToList(toolsCollection, listBox.Items, selectedCategory, addSeparatorEntries, !isDesignMode, !isDesignMode, null, allowDerivedTypes: false, ensureVisibleOnMenus: false, ensureVisibleOnToolbars: false, ensureVisibleOnVerticalToolbars: false, ensureVisibleOnRibbonGroup: false, ensureVisibleOnQat: false, ensureNotInherited: false, TaskPaneFilterMode.IgnoreTaskPaneInfo);
		}

		internal static void AddCollectionToolsToList(ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection, IList list, CategoryWrapper selectedCategory, bool addSeparatorEntries, bool honorShowInCustomizer, bool skipMdiMergeTools, Type limitToType, bool ensureVisibleOnMenus, bool ensureVisibleOnToolbars, bool ensureVisibleOnVerticalToolbars, bool ensureVisibleOnRibbonGroup, bool ensureVisibleOnQat, TaskPaneFilterMode taskPaneFilterMode)
		{
			AddCollectionToolsToList(toolsCollection, list, selectedCategory, addSeparatorEntries, honorShowInCustomizer, skipMdiMergeTools, limitToType, allowDerivedTypes: false, ensureVisibleOnMenus, ensureVisibleOnToolbars, ensureVisibleOnVerticalToolbars, ensureVisibleOnRibbonGroup, ensureVisibleOnQat, ensureNotInherited: false, taskPaneFilterMode);
		}

		internal static void AddCollectionToolsToList(ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollection, IList list, CategoryWrapper selectedCategory, bool addSeparatorEntries, bool honorShowInCustomizer, bool skipMdiMergeTools, Type limitToType, bool allowDerivedTypes, bool ensureVisibleOnMenus, bool ensureVisibleOnToolbars, bool ensureVisibleOnVerticalToolbars, bool ensureVisibleOnRibbonGroup, bool ensureVisibleOnQat, bool ensureNotInherited, TaskPaneFilterMode taskPaneFilterMode)
		{
			ToolWrapper toolWrapper = null;
			int num = 0;
			ValueListItemsCollection val = (ValueListItemsCollection)((list is ValueListItemsCollection) ? list : null);
			foreach (ToolBase item in toolsCollection)
			{
				if (limitToType != null)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase = (item.IsMdiMergeTool ? item.UnderlyingTool : item);
					if (toolBase == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (allowDerivedTypes)
					{
						if (!limitToType.IsAssignableFrom(toolBase.GetType()))
						{
							continue;
						}
					}
					else if (toolBase.GetType() != limitToType)
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				if ((ensureVisibleOnMenus && !item.IsVisibleOnMenus) || (ensureVisibleOnToolbars && !item.IsVisibleOnToolbars) || (ensureVisibleOnVerticalToolbars && !item.IsVisibleOnVerticalToolbars) || (ensureVisibleOnRibbonGroup && !item.IsVisibleOnRibbonGroup) || (ensureVisibleOnQat && !item.CanAddToQuickAccessToolbar))
				{
					continue;
				}
				switch (taskPaneFilterMode)
				{
				case TaskPaneFilterMode.OnlyIncludeNonTaskPaneTools:
					if (item is TaskPaneTool)
					{
						continue;
					}
					break;
				case TaskPaneFilterMode.OnlyIncludeTaskPaneTools:
					if (!(item is TaskPaneTool))
					{
						continue;
					}
					break;
				}
				if (skipMdiMergeTools && (item.IsHiddenByMdiMerge || (item.IsMdiMergeTool && item.UnderlyingTool == null)))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (honorShowInCustomizer)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase2 = null;
					toolBase2 = ((!item.IsMdiMergeTool) ? item : item.UnderlyingTool);
					if (toolBase2 == null || !toolBase2.SharedProps.ShowInCustomizer || !toolBase2.SharedProps.Visible)
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				if ((!ensureNotInherited || !item.InheritedResolved) && (!item.RequiresOffice2007Support || item.ToolbarsManager == null || item.ToolbarsManager.SupportsOffice2007ViewStyle) && (selectedCategory == null || selectedCategory.Type == CategoryType.AllCommands || (selectedCategory.Type == CategoryType.UnassignedCommands && (item.CategoryResolved == null || item.CategoryResolved.Length == 0)) || (selectedCategory.Type == CategoryType.UserDefined && string.Compare(item.CategoryResolved, selectedCategory.ToString(), ignoreCase: true, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) == 0)))
				{
					if (num > 0 && addSeparatorEntries && item.IsFirstInGroupResolved)
					{
						toolWrapper = new ToolWrapper(item, isSeparator: true);
						list.Add(toolWrapper);
					}
					toolWrapper = new ToolWrapper(item);
					if (val != null)
					{
						val.Add((object)toolWrapper);
					}
					else
					{
						list.Add(toolWrapper);
					}
					num++;
				}
			}
		}

		internal static int FindCategoryInListControl(CategoryType categoryType, string category, Control control)
		{
			int count;
			if (control is UltraComboEditor)
			{
				count = ((DisposableObjectCollectionBase)(object)((UltraComboEditor)(object)control).Items).Count;
			}
			else if (control is ComboBox)
			{
				count = ((ComboBox)control).Items.Count;
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(control is ListBox))
				{
					return -1;
				}
				count = ((ListBox)control).Items.Count;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				CategoryWrapper categoryWrapper = null;
				categoryWrapper = ((control is UltraComboEditor) ? (((UltraComboEditor)(object)control).Items[i].DataValue as CategoryWrapper) : ((!(control is ComboBox)) ? (((ListBox)control).Items[i] as CategoryWrapper) : (((ComboBox)control).Items[i] as CategoryWrapper)));
				if (categoryWrapper != null)
				{
					if (categoryType == CategoryType.AllCommands && categoryWrapper.Type == CategoryType.AllCommands)
					{
						return i;
					}
					if (categoryType == CategoryType.UnassignedCommands && categoryWrapper.Type == CategoryType.UnassignedCommands)
					{
						return i;
					}
					if (string.Compare(categoryWrapper.Text, category, ignoreCase: true, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) == 0)
					{
						return i;
					}
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		internal static void LoadCategoriesIntoControl(UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager, Control control, bool addUnassignedEntry, bool addAllCommandsEntry)
		{
			CategoryWrapper categoryWrapper = null;
			int num = -1;
			ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollectionBase = toolbarsManager.Tools;
			bool flag = false;
			while (toolsCollectionBase != null)
			{
				foreach (ToolBase item in toolsCollectionBase)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase = null;
					toolBase = ((!item.IsMdiMergeTool) ? item : item.UnderlyingTool);
					if (!toolbarsManager.IsDesignMode && (toolBase == null || !toolBase.SharedProps.ShowInCustomizer || !toolBase.SharedProps.Visible || item.IsHiddenByMdiMerge || (item.IsMdiMergeTool && item.UnderlyingTool == null)))
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (!ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(item.CategoryResolved))
					{
						num = FindCategoryInListControl(CategoryType.UserDefined, item.CategoryResolved, control);
						if (num < 0)
						{
							categoryWrapper = new CategoryWrapper(item.CategoryResolved, CategoryType.UserDefined);
							if (control is UltraComboEditor)
							{
								((UltraComboEditor)(object)control).Items.Add((object)categoryWrapper);
							}
							else if (control is ComboBox)
							{
								((ComboBox)control).Items.Add(categoryWrapper);
							}
							else
							{
								((ListBox)control).Items.Add(categoryWrapper);
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				toolsCollectionBase = ((toolsCollectionBase == toolbarsManager.MergedTools) ? null : toolbarsManager.MergedTools);
			}
			if (addUnassignedEntry && (toolbarsManager.IsDesignMode || flag))
			{
				categoryWrapper = new CategoryWrapper(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeCategoryUnassigned"), CategoryType.UnassignedCommands);
				if (control is UltraComboEditor)
				{
					((UltraComboEditor)(object)control).Items.Insert(0, (object)categoryWrapper, categoryWrapper.ToString());
				}
				else if (control is ComboBox)
				{
					((ComboBox)control).Items.Insert(0, categoryWrapper);
				}
				else
				{
					((ListBox)control).Items.Insert(0, categoryWrapper);
				}
			}
			if (addAllCommandsEntry)
			{
				categoryWrapper = new CategoryWrapper(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeCategoryAllCommands"), CategoryType.AllCommands);
				if (control is UltraComboEditor)
				{
					((UltraComboEditor)(object)control).Items.Insert(0, (object)categoryWrapper, categoryWrapper.ToString());
				}
				else if (control is ComboBox)
				{
					((ComboBox)control).Items.Insert(0, categoryWrapper);
				}
				else
				{
					((ListBox)control).Items.Insert(0, categoryWrapper);
				}
			}
		}

		}

		internal static void ProcessDrawItem(UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager, Font baseFont, object sender, DrawItemEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0be9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0bef: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00a9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00af: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0113: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0122: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0134: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0139: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_013b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_013e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0158: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_0cfa: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0d00: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0231: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0237: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_02b4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_02ba: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0734: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_05bc: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_05c2: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_06f1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_06f7: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0814: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_081a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0841: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_088f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_08c1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0a3b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_099c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_09a2: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0b3b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0b41: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (e.Index == -1)
			{
				return;
			}
			ToolWrapper toolWrapper;
			if (sender is UltraComboEditor)
			{
				toolWrapper = ((UltraComboEditor)sender).Items[e.Index].DataValue as ToolWrapper;
			}
			else if (sender is ComboBox)
			{
				toolWrapper = ((ComboBox)sender).Items[e.Index] as ToolWrapper;
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(sender is ListBox))
				{
					return;
				}
				toolWrapper = ((ListBox)sender).Items[e.Index] as ToolWrapper;
			}
			if (toolWrapper == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ToolBase tool = toolWrapper.Tool;
			if (tool == null || tool.ToolbarsManager == null || tool.OwnerIsNull)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle bounds = e.Bounds;
			if ((int)toolbarsManager.StyleResolved == 1)
			{
				bounds.Width = 4 + toolbarsManager.ImageSizeSmallResolved.Width;
			}
			else
			{
				bounds.Width = toolbarsManager.Metrics.PaddingAroundMenuitem + toolbarsManager.Metrics.MenuBorderThickness + toolbarsManager.ImageSizeSmallResolved.Width + (toolbarsManager.Metrics.MenuitemImagePaddingLeft + toolbarsManager.Metrics.MenuitemImagePaddingRight);
			}
			AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
			AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)69055021063L;
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			bool flag3 = false;
			bool flag4 = false;
			bool flag5 = false;
			ToolbarStyle styleResolved = toolbarsManager.StyleResolved;
			switch (styleResolved - 5)
			{
			case 0:
				flag = true;
