		internal static DialogResult ShowDialog(UltraToolbarsManager manager, Form dialog, bool useCustomizer)
		{
			if (useCustomizer && manager.CustomizeDialog != null)
			{
				return manager.CustomizeDialog.ShowDialog(dialog);
			}
			if (((Component)(object)manager).Site == null && manager.DockWithinContainer != null)
			{
				return dialog.ShowDialog(manager.DockWithinContainer);
			}
			return ((((Component)(object)manager).Site == null) ? null : (((Component)(object)manager).Site.GetService(typeof(IUIService)) as IUIService))?.ShowDialog(dialog) ?? dialog.ShowDialog();
		}

		internal static bool IsPointOverControl(Control control, Point screenPt)
		{
			if (control != null && control.IsHandleCreated)
			{
				return control.DisplayRectangle.Contains(control.PointToClient(screenPt));
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool IsToolDefinitionValid(ToolDefinition toolDefinition, bool ensureVisibleOnMenus, bool ensureVisibleOnToolbars, bool ensureVisibleOnVerticalToolbars, bool ensureVisibleOnRibbonGroup, bool ensureVisibleOnApplicationMenuArea, bool ensureVisibleOnQat, bool ensureDoesNotRequireOffice2007Support, TaskPaneFilterMode taskPaneFilterMode)
		{
			if (!ensureVisibleOnMenus && !ensureVisibleOnToolbars && !ensureVisibleOnVerticalToolbars && !ensureVisibleOnRibbonGroup && !ensureVisibleOnApplicationMenuArea)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (toolDefinition == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ToolPlacementInfo placementInfo = GetPlacementInfo(toolDefinition);
			if (placementInfo == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ensureVisibleOnMenus && !placementInfo.IsVisibleOnMenus)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ensureVisibleOnToolbars && !placementInfo.IsVisibleOnToolbars)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ensureVisibleOnVerticalToolbars && !placementInfo.IsVisibleOnVerticalToolbars)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ensureVisibleOnRibbonGroup && !placementInfo.IsVisibleOnRibbonGroup)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ensureDoesNotRequireOffice2007Support && placementInfo.RequiresOffice2007Support)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ensureVisibleOnQat && !placementInfo.IsVisibleOnQat)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return taskPaneFilterMode switch
			{
				TaskPaneFilterMode.OnlyIncludeNonTaskPaneTools => !typeof(TaskPaneTool).IsAssignableFrom(placementInfo.ToolType), 
				TaskPaneFilterMode.OnlyIncludeTaskPaneTools => typeof(TaskPaneTool).IsAssignableFrom(placementInfo.ToolType), 
				_ => true, 
			};
		}

		internal static bool IsSameToolType(ToolBase tool, ToolDefinition toolDefinition)
		{
			if (tool == null || toolDefinition == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (toolDefinition.ToolID == UltraToolbarsManager.BUTTON_TOOLID)
			{
				return tool.GetType() == typeof(ButtonTool);
			}
			if (toolDefinition.ToolID == UltraToolbarsManager.COMBOBOX_TOOLID)
			{
				return tool.GetType() == typeof(ComboBoxTool);
			}
			if (toolDefinition.ToolID == UltraToolbarsManager.CONTROLCONTAINER_TOOLID)
			{
				return tool.GetType() == typeof(ControlContainerTool);
			}
			if (toolDefinition.ToolID == UltraToolbarsManager.FONTLIST_TOOLID)
			{
				return tool.GetType() == typeof(FontListTool);
			}
			if (toolDefinition.ToolID == UltraToolbarsManager.LABEL_TOOLID)
			{
				return tool.GetType() == typeof(LabelTool);
			}
			if (toolDefinition.ToolID == UltraToolbarsManager.LIST_TOOLID)
			{
				return tool.GetType() == typeof(ListTool);
			}
			if (toolDefinition.ToolID == UltraToolbarsManager.MDIWINDOWLIST_TOOLID)
			{
				return tool.GetType() == typeof(MdiWindowListTool);
			}
			if (toolDefinition.ToolID == UltraToolbarsManager.POPUPCOLORLIST_TOOLID)
			{
				return tool.GetType() == typeof(PopupColorPickerTool);
			}
			if (toolDefinition.ToolID == UltraToolbarsManager.POPUPCONTROLCONTAINER_TOOLID)
			{
				return tool.GetType() == typeof(PopupControlContainerTool);
			}
			if (toolDefinition.ToolID == UltraToolbarsManager.POPUPMENU_TOOLID)
			{
				return tool.GetType() == typeof(PopupMenuTool);
			}
			if (toolDefinition.ToolID == UltraToolbarsManager.STATEBUTTON_TOOLID)
			{
				return tool.GetType() == typeof(StateButtonTool);
			}
			if (toolDefinition.ToolID == UltraToolbarsManager.TEXTBOX_TOOLID)
			{
				return tool.GetType() == typeof(TextBoxTool);
			}
			if (toolDefinition.ToolID == UltraToolbarsManager.TASKPANE_TOOLID)
			{
				return tool.GetType() == typeof(TaskPaneTool);
			}
			if (toolDefinition.ToolID == UltraToolbarsManager.PROGRESSBAR_TOOLID)
			{
				return tool.GetType() == typeof(ProgressBarTool);
			}
			if (toolDefinition.ToolID == UltraToolbarsManager.MASKEDEDIT_TOOLID)
			{
				return tool.GetType() == typeof(MaskedEditTool);
			}
			if (toolDefinition.ToolID == UltraToolbarsManager.POPUPGALLERY_TOOLID)
			{
				return tool.GetType() == typeof(PopupGalleryTool);
			}
			ToolPlacementInfo placementInfo = GetPlacementInfo(toolDefinition);
			if (placementInfo == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return tool.GetType() == placementInfo.ToolType;
		}

		internal static ToolPlacementInfo GetPlacementInfo(ToolDefinition toolDefinition)
		{
			if (toolDefinition == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (toolPlacementTable == null)
			{
				toolPlacementTable = new Hashtable();
			}
			ToolPlacementInfo toolPlacementInfo = toolPlacementTable[toolDefinition.ToolID] as ToolPlacementInfo;
			if (toolPlacementInfo == null)
			{
				toolPlacementInfo = ToolPlacementInfo.CreatePlacementInfo(toolDefinition);
				toolPlacementTable.Add(toolDefinition.ToolID, toolPlacementInfo);
			}
			return toolPlacementInfo;
		}

		private static Image GetToolImage(ToolBase tool)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (tool == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Image image = null;
			AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
			AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)256;
			tool.ResolveAppearance(editArea: false, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, drawAsActive: false, drawAsPressed: false);
			if (((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)256))
			{
				image = ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).GetImage(tool.ImageList);
				if (image != null)
				{
					using ImageAttributes imageAttributes = new ImageAttributes();
					ColorMap[] colorRemapTable = tool.GetColorRemapTable(((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).Image, tool.OwnerIsToolbarInternal, isHotTracked: false);
					if (colorRemapTable != null && colorRemapTable.Length != 0)
					{
						imageAttributes.SetRemapTable(colorRemapTable);
					}
					image = DrawUtility.CopyImage(image, imageAttributes);
				}
			}
			return image;
		}

		private static void ShowUITypeEditor(object obj, string propertyName, IComponent component)
		{
			PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(obj)[propertyName];
			if (propertyDescriptor == null || !(propertyDescriptor.GetEditor(typeof(UITypeEditor)) is UITypeEditor uITypeEditor))
			{
				return;
			}
			ITypeDescriptorContext typeDescriptorContext = new TypeEditorContext(obj, propertyDescriptor, component);
			if (uITypeEditor.GetEditStyle(typeDescriptorContext) == UITypeEditorEditStyle.Modal)
			{
				object value = propertyDescriptor.GetValue(obj);
				object obj2 = uITypeEditor.EditValue(typeDescriptorContext, typeDescriptorContext, value);
				if (!object.Equals(obj2, value))
				{
					propertyDescriptor.SetValue(obj, obj2);
				}
			}
		}
	}

					return false;
				}
				return base.IsEnabled;
			}
		}

		private Control Container
		{
			get
			{
				if (dockWithinContainer == null && !base.IsDisposed)
				{
					dockWithinContainer = new Form();
					dockWithinContainer.MouseDown += OnDockWithinContainerMouseDown;
					dockWithinContainer.MouseUp += OnDockWithinContainerMouseUp;
					dockWithinContainer.MouseMove += OnDockWithinContainerMouseMove;
				}
				return dockWithinContainer;
			}
		}

		protected IUltraToolbarsManagerDesigner Designer => designer;

		protected override bool IsDesignMode => true;

		protected override Control ControlToReceiveCapture => DockWithinContainer;

		protected override Control DockWithinContainer => Container;

		protected internal override UltraToolbarsManager ManagerBeingDesigned => designer.Component as UltraToolbarsManager;

		protected InPlaceCustomizerBase(IUltraToolbarsManagerDesigner designer)
		{
			this.designer = designer;
		}

		public override void DragItemStart(DragItemType itemType)
		{
			((IToolbarCustomizer)this).CloseToolContextMenus();
			OnAfterCloseToolContextMenusForItemDrag();
			dragTransaction = (GetService(typeof(IDesignerHost)) as IDesignerHost)?.CreateTransaction("UltraToolbarsManager Drag");
			if (GetService(typeof(IComponentChangeService)) is IComponentChangeService componentChangeService)
			{
				try
				{
					componentChangeService.OnComponentChanging(ManagerBeingDesigned, null);
					componentChangeService.OnComponentChanged(ManagerBeingDesigned, null, null, null);
				}
				catch
				{
					dragTransaction.Cancel();
					dragTransaction = null;
					throw;
				}
			}
			base.DragItemStart(itemType);
		}

		public override void DragItemEnd(DragItemType itemType)
		{
			if (dragTransaction != null)
			{
				dragTransaction.Commit();
				dragTransaction = null;
			}
			base.DragItemEnd(itemType);
		}

		public override bool IsCustomizeDialogHandle(IntPtr handle)
		{
			if (dockWithinContainer != null && dockWithinContainer.IsHandleCreated && dockWithinContainer.Handle == handle)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.IsCustomizeDialogHandle(handle);
		}

		public override void Dispose()
		{
			if (dockWithinContainer != null)
			{
				dockWithinContainer.Dispose();
				dockWithinContainer = null;
			}
			base.Dispose();
		}

		protected object GetService(Type serviceType)
		{
			if (designer.Component == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return designer.Component.Site?.GetService(serviceType);
		}

		internal void EnterCustomizeMode()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = ManagerBeingDesigned;
			ultraToolbarsManager.EnterCustomizeMode(this);
			InvalidateOverlayControl();
		}

		internal void ExitCustomizeMode()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = ManagerBeingDesigned;
			if (ultraToolbarsManager.Customizing && ultraToolbarsManager.CustomizeDialog == this)
			{
				ultraToolbarsManager.ExitCustomizeMode(this);
			}
			InvalidateOverlayControl();
		}

		private void OnDockWithinContainerMouseDown(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			ManagerBeingDesigned.OnCustomizeDialogMouseDown(e);
		}

		private void OnDockWithinContainerMouseUp(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			ManagerBeingDesigned.OnCustomizeDialogMouseUp(e);
		}

		private void OnDockWithinContainerMouseMove(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			ManagerBeingDesigned.OnCustomizeDialogMouseMove(e);
		}

		private void InvalidateOverlayControl()
		{
			Type type = Type.GetType("System.Windows.Forms.Design.ISelectionUIService, System.Design");
			if (type == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			object service = GetService(type);
			if (service == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				MethodInfo method = type.GetMethod("SyncSelection");
				if (method != null)
				{
					method.Invoke(service, new object[0]);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnAfterCloseToolContextMenusForItemDrag()
		{
		}

		public override DialogResult ShowDialog(Form form)
		{
			return DesignerUtilities.ShowDialog(ManagerBeingDesigned, form, useCustomizer: false);
		}
	}
	internal class InPlaceCustomizer : InPlaceCustomizerBase
	{
		private bool areHooksDisabled;

		private MenuCommand oldDeleteCommand;

		private MenuCommand oldMoveLeftCommand;

		private MenuCommand oldMoveRightCommand;

		private MenuCommand oldMoveUpCommand;

		private MenuCommand oldMoveDownCommand;

		private MenuCommand oldCancelCommand;

		private MenuCommand oldDefaultActionCommand;

		private const string MenuCommandsClassName = "System.Windows.Forms.Design.MenuCommands, System.Design, Version=2.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a";

		public override bool IsEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (areHooksDisabled)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return base.IsEnabled;
			}
		}

		public override bool ShouldDisplayDesignerButtons => !base.Designer.IsInheritedReadOnly;

		public override bool ShouldDisplayToolbarList => !base.Designer.IsInheritedReadOnly;

		internal bool AreNativeHooksDisabled
		{
			get
			{
				return areHooksDisabled;
			}
			set
			{
				areHooksDisabled = value;
			}
		}

		internal InPlaceCustomizer(IUltraToolbarsManagerDesigner designer)
			: base(designer)
		{
		}

		public override void DragItemEnd(DragItemType itemType)
		{
			RestoreMenuCommand(ref oldDeleteCommand);
			RestoreMenuCommand(ref oldCancelCommand);
			base.DragItemEnd(itemType);
		}

		public override bool IsPointInCurrentOpenSubForm(Point screenPt)
		{
			IntPtr handle = NativeWindowMethods.WindowFromPointApi(screenPt);
			Form form = Control.FromChildHandle(handle)?.FindForm();

			{

			return base.IsPointInCurrentOpenSubForm(screenPt);
		}

		public override void OnApplicationMenuButtonClicked()
		{
			Ribbon ribbon = ManagerBeingDesigned.Ribbon;
			switch (ribbon.FileMenuStyleResolved)
			{
			case FileMenuStyle.ApplicationMenu:
				base.LastSelectedObject = ribbon.ApplicationMenu;
				break;
			case FileMenuStyle.ApplicationMenu2010:
				base.LastSelectedObject = ribbon.ApplicationMenu2010;
				break;
			case FileMenuStyle.None:
				base.LastSelectedObject = null;
				break;
			}
			base.OnApplicationMenuButtonClicked();
		}

		private void RemoveAndStoreMenuCommand(string className, string fieldName, ref MenuCommand command)
		{
			try
			{
				Type type = Type.GetType(className);
				if (!(type == null))
				{
					FieldInfo field = type.GetField(fieldName, BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public);
					if (!(field == null))
					{
						CommandID commandId = (CommandID)field.GetValue(null);
						RemoveAndStoreMenuCommand(commandId, ref command);
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}

		private void RemoveAndStoreMenuCommand(CommandID commandId, ref MenuCommand command)
		{
			if (command != null)
			{
				Debugger.Break();
			}
			if (GetService(typeof(IMenuCommandService)) is IMenuCommandService menuCommandService)
			{
				command = menuCommandService.FindCommand(commandId);
				if (command != null)
				{
					menuCommandService.RemoveCommand(command);
				}
			}
		}

		private void RestoreMenuCommand(ref MenuCommand command)
		{
			if (command != null)
			{
				if (GetService(typeof(IMenuCommandService)) is IMenuCommandService menuCommandService)
				{
					menuCommandService.AddCommand(command);
				}
				command = null;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnAfterCloseToolContextMenusForItemDrag()
		{
			RemoveAndStoreMenuCommand(StandardCommands.Delete, ref oldDeleteCommand);
			RemoveAndStoreMenuCommand("System.Windows.Forms.Design.MenuCommands, System.Design, Version=2.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a", "KeyCancel", ref oldCancelCommand);
			base.OnAfterCloseToolContextMenusForItemDrag();
		}

		protected override void OnToolContextMenuCloseup(object sender, ToolDropdownEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnToolContextMenuCloseup(sender, e);
			if (e.Tool.OwnerIsToolbarsManager)
			{
				RestoreMenuCommand(ref oldDeleteCommand);
				RestoreMenuCommand(ref oldMoveDownCommand);
				RestoreMenuCommand(ref oldMoveLeftCommand);
				RestoreMenuCommand(ref oldMoveRightCommand);
				RestoreMenuCommand(ref oldMoveUpCommand);
				RestoreMenuCommand(ref oldCancelCommand);
				RestoreMenuCommand(ref oldDefaultActionCommand);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnToolContextMenuDropDown(object sender, ToolDropdownEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Tool.OwnerIsToolbarsManager)
			{
				RemoveAndStoreMenuCommand(StandardCommands.Delete, ref oldDeleteCommand);
				RemoveAndStoreMenuCommand("System.Windows.Forms.Design.MenuCommands, System.Design, Version=2.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a", "KeyMoveDown", ref oldMoveDownCommand);
				RemoveAndStoreMenuCommand("System.Windows.Forms.Design.MenuCommands, System.Design, Version=2.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a", "KeyMoveLeft", ref oldMoveLeftCommand);
				RemoveAndStoreMenuCommand("System.Windows.Forms.Design.MenuCommands, System.Design, Version=2.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a", "KeyMoveRight", ref oldMoveRightCommand);
				RemoveAndStoreMenuCommand("System.Windows.Forms.Design.MenuCommands, System.Design, Version=2.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a", "KeyMoveUp", ref oldMoveUpCommand);
				RemoveAndStoreMenuCommand("System.Windows.Forms.Design.MenuCommands, System.Design, Version=2.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a", "KeyCancel", ref oldCancelCommand);
				RemoveAndStoreMenuCommand("System.Windows.Forms.Design.MenuCommands, System.Design, Version=2.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a", "KeyDefaultAction", ref oldDefaultActionCommand);
			}
			base.OnToolContextMenuDropDown(sender, e);
		}

		protected override void OnKeyboardHookCallback(object sender, KeyHookEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnKeyboardHookCallback(sender, e);
			if (!ShouldProcessKeyHookMessage(e) || e.EventType != KeyEventType.KeyDown)
			{
				return;
			}
			Keys keyData = e.KeyData;
			if (keyData != Keys.Delete)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (SelectedObject is ToolBase)
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = SelectedObject as ToolBase;
				if (toolBase.CanBeModified)
				{
					base.LastSelectedObject = null;
					toolBase.Delete();
					ManagerBeingDesigned.ToolBeingCustomized = null;
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
			else if (SelectedObject is UltraToolbar)
			{
				UltraToolbar ultraToolbar = SelectedObject as UltraToolbar;
				if (ultraToolbar.CanBeModified)
				{
					base.LastSelectedObject = null;
					if (ultraToolbar.ParentCollection != null)
					{
						ultraToolbar.ParentCollection.Remove(ultraToolbar);
					}
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
			else if (SelectedObject is RibbonTab)
			{
				RibbonTab ribbonTab = SelectedObject as RibbonTab;
				if (!ribbonTab.CanBeModified)
				{
					return;
				}
				base.LastSelectedObject = null;
				RibbonTabCollection parentCollection = ribbonTab.ParentCollection;
				if (parentCollection != null)
				{
					int index = ribbonTab.Index;
					parentCollection.RemoveAt(index);
					index = Math.Min(index, parentCollection.Count - 1);
					if (index >= 0)
					{
						parentCollection.Ribbon.SelectedTab = parentCollection[index];
					}
				}
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(SelectedObject is RibbonGroup))
				{
					return;
				}
				RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = SelectedObject as RibbonGroup;
				if (ribbonGroup.CanBeModified)
				{
					base.LastSelectedObject = null;
					if (ribbonGroup.ParentCollection != null)
					{
						ribbonGroup.ParentCollection.Remove(ribbonGroup);
					}
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public class Office2007UICompatibilityButtonUIElement : ToolbarsDesignerButtonUIElement
	{
		public Office2007UICompatibilityButtonUIElement(UIElement parent)
			: base(parent)
		{
		}

		protected override bool ButtonClick()
		{
			if (((UIElement)this).ControlElement.UltraControl is UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager)
			{
				try
				{
					ultraToolbarsManager.Office2007UICompatibility = !ultraToolbarsManager.Office2007UICompatibility;
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					UltraMessageBoxManager.Show(ex.Message, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ErrorMessageCaption"));
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class NewRibbonGroupButtonUIElement : ImageAndTextButtonExUIElement
	{
		private RibbonTab tab;

		private MouseButtons lastMouseDown;

		public NewRibbonGroupButtonUIElement(UIElement parent, RibbonTab tab)
			: base(parent)
		{
			Initialize(tab);
		}

		internal void Initialize(RibbonTab tab)
		{
			this.tab = tab;
			((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext = tab;
		}

		protected override bool ButtonClick()
		{
			if (lastMouseDown != MouseButtons.Left)
			{
				return false;
			}
			lastMouseDown = MouseButtons.None;
			if (((UIElement)this).ControlElement.UltraControl is UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager && tab != null)
			{
				RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = tab.Groups.Add(Ribbon.GetUniqueKey(tab.Groups, "ribbonGroup"));
				if (ultraToolbarsManager.Customizing)
				{
					ultraToolbarsManager.ToolBeingCustomized = null;
					ultraToolbarsManager.CustomizeDialog.OnRibbonGroupClicked(ribbonGroup);
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			if (((UIElement)this).Control is UltraToolbarsDockArea { ToolbarsManager: not null })
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager.ResolveDesignerButtonAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			}
			((ButtonUIElementBase)this).InitAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e, bool adjustableArea, ref UIElement captureMouseForElement)
		{
			lastMouseDown = e.Button;
			return ((ButtonUIElementBase)this).OnMouseDown(e, adjustableArea, ref captureMouseForElement);
		}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			((ButtonUIElementBase)this).ButtonState = (UIElementButtonState)(((ButtonUIElementBase)this).ButtonState | 2);
			((ImageAndTextButtonExUIElement)this).PositionChildElements();
		}
	}

		private void cmdGetFilename_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ofdLayoutFile.AddExtension = false;
			ofdLayoutFile.CheckFileExists = true;
			ofdLayoutFile.RestoreDirectory = false;
			if (ofdLayoutFile.ShowDialog(this) == DialogResult.OK)
			{
				lvwPopupMenus.Items.Clear();
				lvwToolbars.Items.Clear();
				lvwTools.Items.Clear();
				ilToolImages.Images.Clear();
				ilToolImages.TransparentColor = Color.Transparent;
				if (LoadToolInformation(ofdLayoutFile.FileName))
				{
					txtFilename.Text = ofdLayoutFile.FileName;
				}
				else
				{
					txtFilename.Text = string.Empty;
				}
			}
			VerifyButtons();
		}

		private void buttonBack_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Navigate(forward: false, validateStep: false);
		}

		private void buttonNext_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Navigate(forward: true, validateStep: true);
		}

		private void buttonCancel_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Close();
		}

		private void ImportToolsDialog_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Navigate(WizardStep.ChooseLayout);
		}

		private void lvwTools_ItemCheck(object sender, ItemCheckEventArgs e)
		{
			VerifyButtons();
		}

		private void lvwToolbars_ItemCheck(object sender, ItemCheckEventArgs e)
		{
			ListView listView = sender as ListView;
			ListViewItem listViewItem = listView.Items[e.Index];
			List<ItemCheckEventArgs> argList = checkChangeToolbarList;
			ToolsCollectionBase tools = ((UltraToolbar)listViewItem.Tag).Tools;
			ItemCheckHelper(listView, argList, tools, e);
		}

		private void lvwPopupMenus_ItemCheck(object sender, ItemCheckEventArgs e)
		{
			ListView listView = sender as ListView;
			ListViewItem listViewItem = listView.Items[e.Index];
			List<ItemCheckEventArgs> argList = checkChangeMenuList;
			ToolsCollectionBase tools = ((PopupMenuTool)listViewItem.Tag).Tools;
			ItemCheckHelper(listView, argList, tools, e);
		}

		private void AddToolsToList(ListView list, bool includeMenuTools, bool includeNonMenuTools, bool addToolType)
		{
			//IL_00bf: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			list.BeginUpdate();
			foreach (ToolBase tool in previewManager.Tools)
			{
				if (tool is MdiMergePlaceholderTool || (tool is PopupMenuTool && !includeMenuTools) || (!(tool is PopupMenuTool) && !includeNonMenuTools))
				{
					continue;
				}
				ListViewItem listViewItem = new ListViewItem();
				listViewItem.Text = tool.Key;
				listViewItem.SubItems.Add(tool.CaptionResolved);
				listViewItem.SubItems.Add(tool.CategoryResolved);
				listViewItem.SubItems.Add(tool.SharedProps.ShortcutString);
				if (addToolType)
				{
					listViewItem.SubItems.Add(tool.GetType().Name);
				}
				listViewItem.Tag = tool;
				AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)256;
				AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
				bool resolveAsMenu = tool.OwnerIsMenu || tool.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea;
				bool ownerIsToolbarInternal = tool.OwnerIsToolbarInternal;
				tool.ResolveAppearanceHelper(resolveAsMenu, ownerIsToolbarInternal, editArea: false, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, drawAsActive: false, drawAsPressed: false, largeImages: false, null);
				if (((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).Image != null)
				{
					Image image = ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).GetImage(managerBeingUpdated.ImageListSmall);
					if (image != null)
					{
						if (image is Bitmap && ilToolImages.TransparentColor == Color.Transparent)
						{
							ilToolImages.TransparentColor = ((Bitmap)image).GetPixel(0, image.Height - 1);
						}
						ilToolImages.Images.Add(image);
						listViewItem.ImageIndex = ilToolImages.Images.Count - 1;
					}
				}
				list.Items.Add(listViewItem);
			}
			list.Sort();
			list.EndUpdate();
		}

		private static void AutoSizeColumns(ListView list)
		{
			foreach (ColumnHeader column in list.Columns)
			{
				column.Width = -2;
			}
		}

		private void ChangeToolCheckedState(ToolBase tool, bool newState)
		{
			ListView listView = ((tool is PopupMenuTool) ? lvwPopupMenus : lvwTools);
			foreach (ListViewItem item in listView.Items)
			{
				if (tool.IsSameLogicalTool(item.Tag as ToolBase))
				{
					item.Checked = newState;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void EnsureToolsAreSelected(ToolsCollectionBase tools)
		{
			if (tempSelectedToolsList == null)
			{
				tempSelectedToolsList = new ArrayList(4);
			}
			else
			{
				tempSelectedToolsList.Clear();
			}
			lvwPopupMenus.ItemCheck -= lvwPopupMenus_ItemCheck;
			lvwToolbars.ItemCheck -= lvwToolbars_ItemCheck;
			lvwTools.ItemCheck -= lvwTools_ItemCheck;
			lvwPopupMenus.BeginUpdate();
			lvwToolbars.BeginUpdate();
			lvwTools.BeginUpdate();
			EnsureToolsAreSelectedHelper(tools);
			lvwPopupMenus.EndUpdate();
			lvwToolbars.EndUpdate();
			lvwTools.EndUpdate();
			lvwPopupMenus.ItemCheck += lvwPopupMenus_ItemCheck;
			lvwToolbars.ItemCheck += lvwToolbars_ItemCheck;
			lvwTools.ItemCheck += lvwTools_ItemCheck;
			VerifyButtons();
		}

		private void EnsureToolsAreSelectedHelper(ToolsCollectionBase tools)
		{
			if (tempSelectedToolsList.Contains(tools.Owner))
			{
				return;
			}
			tempSelectedToolsList.Add(tools.Owner);
			foreach (ToolBase tool in tools)
			{
				if (!tool.IsMdiMergeTool)
				{
					ChangeToolCheckedState(tool, newState: true);
					if (tool is PopupMenuTool)
					{
						EnsureToolsAreSelectedHelper(((PopupMenuTool)tool.SharedProps.RootTool).Tools);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private Control GetControl(WizardStep step)
		{
			return step switch
			{
				WizardStep.ChooseLayout => pnlStepChooseLayoutFile, 
				WizardStep.Toolbars => pnlStepToolbarsList, 
				WizardStep.PopupMenus => pnlStepPopupMenuList, 
				WizardStep.Tools => pnlStepToolsList, 
				WizardStep.Importing => pnlStepImporting, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		private void IncrementTask()
		{
			prgImport.PerformStep();
			prgTask.PerformStep();
		}

		private bool IsObjectChecked(object toolOwner)
		{
			ListView listView;
			if (toolOwner is UltraToolbar)
			{
				listView = lvwToolbars;
			}
			else if (toolOwner is PopupMenuTool)
			{
				listView = lvwPopupMenus;
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(toolOwner is ToolBase))
				{
					return false;
				}
				listView = lvwTools;
			}
			foreach (ListViewItem item in listView.Items)
			{
				if (IsSameObject(item.Tag, toolOwner))
				{
					return item.Checked;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsSameObject(object toolOwner, object potentialOwner)
		{
			if (object.Equals(toolOwner, potentialOwner))
			{
				return true;
			}
			ToolBase toolBase = toolOwner as ToolBase;
			ToolBase toolBase2 = potentialOwner as ToolBase;
			if (toolBase != null && toolBase2 != null)
			{
				return toolBase.IsSameLogicalTool(toolBase2);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ItemCheckHelper(ListView list, List<ItemCheckEventArgs> argList, ToolsCollectionBase tools, ItemCheckEventArgs e)
		{
			if (argList.Count == 0)
			{
				argList.Add(e);
				BeginInvoke(new ProcessPendingItemCheckHandler(ProcessPendingListViewChecks), list, argList, tools);
				return;
			}
			for (int num = argList.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				ItemCheckEventArgs e2 = argList[num];
				if (e2.Index == e.Index)
				{
					argList.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
			argList.Add(e);
		}

		private bool LoadLayout(string filename)
		{
			try
			{
				previewManager.LoadFromBinary(filename);
				return true;
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			try
			{
				previewManager.LoadFromXml(filename);
				return true;
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool LoadToolInformation(string filename)
		{
			previewManager.Toolbars.Clear();
			previewManager.Tools.Clear();
			if (!LoadLayout(filename))
			{
				return false;
			}
			((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)previewManager).Visible = false;
			if (previewManager.ShouldSerializeImageTransparentColor())
			{
				ilToolImages.TransparentColor = previewManager.ImageTransparentColor;
			}
			AddToolsToList(lvwTools, includeMenuTools: false, includeNonMenuTools: true, addToolType: true);
			AddToolsToList(lvwPopupMenus, includeMenuTools: true, includeNonMenuTools: false, addToolType: false);
			lvwToolbars.BeginUpdate();
			lvwToolbars.Items.Clear();
			foreach (UltraToolbar toolbar in previewManager.Toolbars)
			{
				ListViewItem listViewItem = new ListViewItem();
				listViewItem.Text = toolbar.Key;
				listViewItem.SubItems.Add(toolbar.Text);
				listViewItem.SubItems.Add(toolbar.IsMainMenuBar ? Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ImportToolsWizard_ToolbarTypeMenubar") : Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ImportToolsWizard_ToolbarTypeToolbar"));
				listViewItem.Tag = toolbar;
				lvwToolbars.Items.Add(listViewItem);
			}
			lvwToolbars.Sort();
			lvwToolbars.EndUpdate();
			AutoSizeColumns(lvwPopupMenus);
			AutoSizeColumns(lvwTools);
			AutoSizeColumns(lvwToolbars);
			if (previewManager.Tools.Count <= 0)
			{
				return previewManager.Toolbars.Count > 0;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void Navigate(bool forward, bool validateStep)
		{
			if (validateStep)
			{
				switch (CurrentStep)
				{
				}
			}
			WizardStep step;
			switch (CurrentStep)
			{
			default:
				return;
			case WizardStep.ChooseLayout:
				if (!forward)
				{
					return;
				}
				step = WizardStep.Toolbars;
				break;
			case WizardStep.Toolbars:
				step = (forward ? WizardStep.PopupMenus : WizardStep.ChooseLayout);
				break;
			case WizardStep.PopupMenus:
				step = ((!forward) ? WizardStep.Toolbars : WizardStep.Tools);
				break;
			case WizardStep.Tools:
				if (forward)
				{
					PerformImport();
					base.DialogResult = DialogResult.OK;
					Close();
					return;
				}
				step = WizardStep.PopupMenus;
				break;
			case WizardStep.Importing:
				if (forward)
				{
					return;
				}
				step = WizardStep.Tools;
				break;
			}
			Navigate(step);
		}

		private void Navigate(WizardStep step)
		{
			CurrentStep = step;
		}

		private void PerformImport()
		{
			UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager = managerBeingUpdated;
			Navigate(WizardStep.Importing);
			Cursor.Current = Cursors.WaitCursor;
			bool designerChangeNotificationsEnabled = ((IUltraComponent)ultraToolbarsManager).DesignerChangeNotificationsEnabled;
			((IUltraComponent)ultraToolbarsManager).DesignerChangeNotificationsEnabled = false;
			((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)previewManager).BeginUpdate();
			((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)ultraToolbarsManager).BeginUpdate();
			prgImport.Value = 0;
			prgImport.Maximum = lvwPopupMenus.CheckedIndices.Count + lvwToolbars.CheckedIndices.Count + lvwTools.CheckedIndices.Count + lvwPopupMenus.CheckedIndices.Count;
			prgTask.Value = 0;
			StartTask(lvwPopupMenus.CheckedIndices.Count + lvwTools.CheckedIndices.Count, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ImportToolsWizard_ImportTaskRootTools"));
			foreach (ListViewItem checkedItem in lvwTools.CheckedItems)
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = checkedItem.Tag as ToolBase;
				if (!ultraToolbarsManager.Tools.Exists(toolBase.Key))
				{
					ultraToolbarsManager.Tools.Add(toolBase.CloneTool());
				}
				IncrementTask();
			}
			foreach (ListViewItem checkedItem2 in lvwPopupMenus.CheckedItems)
			{
				ToolBase toolBase2 = checkedItem2.Tag as ToolBase;
				if (!ultraToolbarsManager.Tools.Exists(toolBase2.Key))
				{
					ultraToolbarsManager.Tools.Add(toolBase2.CloneTool());
				}
				IncrementTask();
			}
			StartTask(lvwPopupMenus.CheckedIndices.Count, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ImportToolsWizard_ImportTaskMenuTools"));
			foreach (ListViewItem checkedItem3 in lvwPopupMenus.CheckedItems)
			{
				PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool = (PopupMenuTool)checkedItem3.Tag;
				if (!(ultraToolbarsManager.Tools[popupMenuTool.Key] is PopupMenuTool))
				{
					continue;
				}
				PopupMenuTool popupMenuTool2 = ultraToolbarsManager.Tools[popupMenuTool.Key] as PopupMenuTool;
				foreach (ToolBase tool in popupMenuTool.Tools)
				{
					if (IsObjectChecked(tool))
					{
						ToolBase toolBase3 = popupMenuTool2.Tools.AddTool(tool.Key);
						toolBase3.CopyToolSettings(tool);
					}
				}
				IncrementTask();
			}
			StartTask(lvwToolbars.CheckedIndices.Count, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ImportToolsWizard_ImportTaskToolbars"));
			foreach (ListViewItem checkedItem4 in lvwToolbars.CheckedItems)
			{
				UltraToolbar ultraToolbar = (UltraToolbar)checkedItem4.Tag;
				UltraToolbar ultraToolbar2;
				if (!ultraToolbarsManager.Toolbars.Exists(ultraToolbar.Key))
				{
					ultraToolbar2 = ultraToolbar.Clone() as UltraToolbar;
					if (ultraToolbarsManager.MainMenuBar != null && ultraToolbar2.IsMainMenuBar)
					{
						ultraToolbar2.IsMainMenuBar = false;
					}
					ultraToolbarsManager.Toolbars.Add(ultraToolbar2);
				}
				else
				{
					ultraToolbar2 = ultraToolbarsManager.Toolbars[ultraToolbar.Key];
				}
				foreach (ToolBase tool2 in ultraToolbar.Tools)
				{
					if (IsObjectChecked(tool2))
					{
						ToolBase toolBase4 = ultraToolbar2.Tools.AddTool(tool2.Key);
						toolBase4.CopyToolSettings(tool2);
					}
				}
				IncrementTask();
			}
			((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)ultraToolbarsManager).EndUpdate();
			((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)previewManager).EndUpdate();
			((IUltraComponent)ultraToolbarsManager).DesignerChangeNotificationsEnabled = designerChangeNotificationsEnabled;
			Cursor.Current = Cursors.Default;
		}

		private void ProcessPendingListViewChecks(ListView list, List<ItemCheckEventArgs> argList, ToolsCollectionBase tools)
		{
			foreach (ItemCheckEventArgs arg in argList)
			{
				if (arg.NewValue == CheckState.Checked)
				{
					EnsureToolsAreSelected(tools);
				}
				else if (arg.NewValue == CheckState.Unchecked)
				{
					UncheckToolHelper(tools);
				}
			}
			argList.Clear();
		}

		private void ShowControl(WizardStep step)
		{
			SuspendLayout();
			Control[] array = new Control[5] { pnlStepChooseLayoutFile, pnlStepPopupMenuList, pnlStepToolbarsList, pnlStepToolsList, pnlStepImporting };
			Control control = GetControl(step);
			Control[] array2 = array;
			foreach (Control control2 in array2)
			{
				if (control == control2)
				{
					control2.BringToFront();
					control2.Enabled = true;
					control2.Visible = true;
					control2.Dock = DockStyle.Fill;
				}
				else
				{
					control2.SendToBack();
					control2.Enabled = false;
					control2.Visible = false;
					control2.Dock = DockStyle.None;
				}
			}
			ResumeLayout();
		}

		private void StartTask(int maxValue, string taskDescription)
		{
			lblTaskProgress.Text = taskDescription;
			lblTaskProgress.Update();
			prgTask.Value = prgTask.Minimum;
			prgTask.Maximum = maxValue;
		}

		private void UncheckToolHelper(ToolsCollectionBase tools)
		{
			if (tempUncheckToolList == null)
			{
				tempUncheckToolList = new ArrayList(3);
			}
			tempUncheckToolList.Add(tools.Owner);
			List<ToolBase> list = new List<ToolBase>(5);
			foreach (ToolBase tool in tools)
			{
				int num = 0;
				foreach (ToolBase toolInstance in tool.SharedProps.ToolInstances)
				{
					if (IsSameObject(toolInstance.OwnerInternal, tools.Owner))
					{
						continue;
					}
					bool flag = false;
					foreach (object tempUncheckTool in tempUncheckToolList)
					{
						if (IsSameObject(toolInstance.OwnerInternal, tempUncheckTool))
						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					if (!toolInstance.IsRootTool && !flag && IsObjectChecked(toolInstance.OwnerInternal))
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
				if (num == 0)
				{
					list.Add(tool);
				}
			}
			foreach (ToolBase item in list)
			{
				ListView listView = ((item is PopupMenuTool) ? lvwPopupMenus : lvwTools);
				for (int num2 = listView.Items.Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
				{
					ToolBase toolBase = listView.Items[num2].Tag as ToolBase;
					if (toolBase.IsSameLogicalTool(item))
					{
						listView.Items[num2].Checked = false;
					}
				}
			}
			tempUncheckToolList.Remove(tools.Owner);
			VerifyButtons();
		}

		private void VerifyButtons()
		{
			buttonNext.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ImportToolsWizard_Next");
			buttonCancel.Enabled = true;
			switch (CurrentStep)
			{
			case WizardStep.ChooseLayout:
				buttonBack.Enabled = false;
				buttonNext.Enabled = txtFilename.Text.Length > 0;
				break;
			case WizardStep.Toolbars:
				buttonBack.Enabled = true;
				buttonNext.Enabled = true;
				break;
			case WizardStep.PopupMenus:
				buttonBack.Enabled = true;
				buttonNext.Enabled = true;
				break;
			case WizardStep.Tools:
				buttonBack.Enabled = true;
				buttonNext.Enabled = lvwPopupMenus.CheckedItems.Count > 0 || lvwToolbars.CheckedItems.Count > 0 || lvwTools.CheckedItems.Count > 0;
				buttonNext.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ImportToolsWizard_Finish");
				break;
			case WizardStep.Importing:
				buttonBack.Enabled = false;
				buttonNext.Enabled = false;
				buttonCancel.Enabled = false;
				break;
			}
		}
	}

	internal class NewToolPlaceHolderTool : ButtonTool
	{
		private class NewToolPlaceHolderInfo : IProvideToolCustomizeInfo
		{
			private NewToolPlaceHolderTool tool;

			bool IProvideToolCustomizeInfo.OwnerIsMenu => tool.OwnerIsMenuInternal;

			bool IProvideToolCustomizeInfo.OwnerIsToolbar => tool.OwnerIsToolbarInternal;

			PopupMenuTool IProvideToolCustomizeInfo.OwningMenu => tool.OwningMenuInternal;

			UltraToolbar IProvideToolCustomizeInfo.OwningToolbar => tool.OwningToolbarInternal as UltraToolbar;

			UIElement IProvideToolCustomizeInfo.UIElement => tool.UIElement;

			object IProvideToolCustomizeInfo.Owner => tool.Owner;

			internal NewToolPlaceHolderInfo(NewToolPlaceHolderTool tool)
			{
				this.tool = tool;
			}
		}

		private ToolsCollection owningCollection;

		private IProvideToolCustomizeInfo virtualTool;

		protected internal override Image DefaultImage => base.ToolbarsManager.InsertToolBitmap;

		protected internal override bool DefaultInstanceDisplaysTextOnToolbars => true;

		protected internal override bool DefaultInstanceDisplaysImageOnToolbars
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.IsOnQat)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool DefaultInstanceDisplaysImageOnMenus => false;

		public override UIRole UIRoleOnMenus => StyleUtils.GetRole(base.ToolbarsManagerInControl, StyleUtils.Role.MenuItemNewToolPlaceHolder);

		public override UIRole UIRoleOnRibbonGroups
		{
			get
			{
				UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManagerInControl = base.ToolbarsManagerInControl;
				if (toolbarsManagerInControl == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return StyleUtils.GetRole(toolbarsManagerInControl, StyleUtils.Role.RibbonGroupItemNewToolPlaceHolder);
			}
		}

		public override UIRole UIRoleOnToolbars => StyleUtils.GetRole(base.ToolbarsManagerInControl, StyleUtils.Role.ToolbarItemNewToolPlaceHolder);

		internal IProvideToolCustomizeInfo VirtualTool
		{
			get
			{
				if (virtualTool == null)
				{
					virtualTool = new NewToolPlaceHolderInfo(this);
				}
				return virtualTool;
			}
		}

		internal NewToolPlaceHolderTool(ToolsCollection owningTools)
			: base("")
		{
			base.SharedProps.Caption = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NewToolPlaceHolderCaption");
			owningCollection = owningTools;
			OnAddedToCollection(owningTools);
			base.SharedProps.InternalSetRootTool(this);
		}

		protected internal override ToolBase Clone(bool cloneNewInstance)
		{
			NewToolPlaceHolderTool newToolPlaceHolderTool = new NewToolPlaceHolderTool(owningCollection);
			newToolPlaceHolderTool.InitializeFrom(this, cloneNewInstance);
			return newToolPlaceHolderTool;
		}

		protected override void ResolveAppearancePhase(ref ResolveAppearancePhaseInfo phaseInfo, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			base.ResolveAppearancePhase(ref phaseInfo, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		internal override bool IsVisibleOnToolbar(UltraToolbarBase toolbar)
		{
			return true;
		}

	[PermissionSet(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Name = "linkcheck", Unrestricted = true)]
	public sealed class OptionSetsCollectionTypeEditor : UITypeEditor
	{
		private IWindowsFormsEditorService edSvc;

		private OptionSetsCollectionTypeEditorForm editorForm;

		public override UITypeEditorEditStyle GetEditStyle(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return UITypeEditorEditStyle.Modal;
		}

		public override object EditValue(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IServiceProvider provider, object value)
		{
			if (context != null && context.Instance != null && provider != null)
			{
				edSvc = (IWindowsFormsEditorService)provider.GetService(typeof(IWindowsFormsEditorService));
				if (edSvc != null)
				{
					if (!(value is OptionSetsCollection optionSetsCollection))
					{
						return value;
					}
					editorForm = new OptionSetsCollectionTypeEditorForm(optionSetsCollection);
					edSvc.ShowDialog(editorForm);
				}
			}
			return value;
		}
	}
	[PermissionSet(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Name = "linkcheck", Unrestricted = true)]
	public sealed class OptionSetTypeEditor : UITypeEditor
	{
		private IWindowsFormsEditorService edSvc;

		private string selectedOptionSet = string.Empty;

		private OptionSetTypeEditorForm editorForm;

		public override UITypeEditorEditStyle GetEditStyle(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return UITypeEditorEditStyle.DropDown;
		}

		public override object EditValue(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IServiceProvider provider, object value)
		{
			if (context != null && context.Instance != null && provider != null)
			{
				edSvc = (IWindowsFormsEditorService)provider.GetService(typeof(IWindowsFormsEditorService));
				if (edSvc != null)
				{
					StateButtonTool stateButtonTool = null;
					if (context.Instance is StateButtonTool)
					{
						stateButtonTool = context.Instance as StateButtonTool;
					}
					else if (context.Instance is CustomizeToolSurrogate)
					{
						stateButtonTool = ((CustomizeToolSurrogate)context.Instance).Tool as StateButtonTool;
					}
					if (stateButtonTool == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					OptionSet optionSet = value as OptionSet;
					UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = stateButtonTool.ToolbarsManager;
					editorForm = new OptionSetTypeEditorForm(toolbarsManager, (optionSet == null) ? string.Empty : optionSet.Key);
					editorForm.TopLevel = false;
					editorForm.Visible = true;
					editorForm.Closing += OnEditorFormClosing;
					edSvc.DropDownControl(editorForm);
					if (!ToolbarsManagerUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(selectedOptionSet))
					{
						value = toolbarsManager.OptionSets[selectedOptionSet];
					}
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		private void OnEditorFormClosing(object sender, CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			if (edSvc != null)
			{
				selectedOptionSet = editorForm.SelectedOptionSet;
				edSvc.CloseDropDown();
			}
		}
	}

		protected override void OnResize(EventArgs e)
		{
			bool flag = isResizing;
			isResizing = true;
			try
			{
				base.OnResize(e);
			}
			finally
			{
				isResizing = flag;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnLayout(LayoutEventArgs e)
		{
			if (isResizing)
			{
				int num = lastWidth;
				SuspendLayout();
				decimal num2 = ((num != 0) ? ((decimal)pnlMenuTools.Width / (decimal)num) : 0.5m);
				pnlMenuTools.Width = Math.Max((int)((decimal)base.Width * num2), 1);
				lastWidth = base.Width;
				ResumeLayout(performLayout: true);
			}
			base.OnLayout(e);
		}

		internal void OnNewToolCreated(ToolBase tool)
		{
			if (tool is PopupMenuTool)
			{
				ValueListItem selectedItem = cboPopupMenus.Items.Add((object)new ToolWrapper(tool, isSeparator: false));
				cboPopupMenus.SelectedItem = selectedItem;
				ResetMenuToolsList(SelectedMenu);
			}
			if (SelectedMenu == null)
			{
				refreshAvailableToolsRequired = true;
			}
			if (tool.IsVisibleOnMenus && tool.IsVisibleOnMenu(SelectedMenu))
			{
				((ListBox)(object)lstAvailableTools).Items.Add(new ToolWrapper(tool, isSeparator: false));
			}
		}

		internal void RefreshLists()
		{
			if (cboPopupMenus.SelectedIndex < 0 && ((DisposableObjectCollectionBase)(object)cboPopupMenus.Items).Count > 0)
			{
				cboPopupMenus.SelectedIndex = 0;
			}
			ToolBase selectedToolInMenu = SelectedToolInMenu;
			int selectedIndex = ((ListControl)(object)lstMenuTools).SelectedIndex;
			((ListBox)(object)lstMenuTools).BeginUpdate();
			int topIndex = ((ListBox)(object)lstMenuTools).TopIndex;
			ResetMenuToolsList(SelectedMenu);
			if (selectedToolInMenu != null)
			{
				((ListControl)(object)lstMenuTools).SelectedIndex = IndexOfTool(((ListBox)(object)lstMenuTools).Items, selectedToolInMenu);
			}
			if (((ListControl)(object)lstMenuTools).SelectedIndex < 0 && ((ListBox)(object)lstMenuTools).Items.Count > 0)
			{
				((ListControl)(object)lstMenuTools).SelectedIndex = Math.Min(selectedIndex, ((ListBox)(object)lstMenuTools).Items.Count - 1);
			}
			if (topIndex >= 0 && topIndex < ((ListBox)(object)lstMenuTools).Items.Count)
			{
				((ListBox)(object)lstMenuTools).TopIndex = topIndex;
			}
			((ListBox)(object)lstMenuTools).EndUpdate();
		}

		internal void Reset()
		{
			PopupMenuTool selectedMenu = SelectedMenu;
			ToolBase selectedToolInMenu = SelectedToolInMenu;
			ResetAvailableToolsList();
			ResetPopupMenuList();
			cboPopupMenus.SelectedIndex = IndexOfTool((IList)cboPopupMenus.Items, selectedMenu);
			ResetMenuToolsList(SelectedMenu);
			((ListControl)(object)lstMenuTools).SelectedIndex = IndexOfTool(((ListBox)(object)lstMenuTools).Items, selectedToolInMenu);
		}

		internal void OnToolDeleted(ToolBase tool)
		{
			((ListControl)(object)lstAvailableTools).SelectedIndex = RemoveToolFromList(((ListBox)(object)lstAvailableTools).Items, tool, ((ListControl)(object)lstAvailableTools).SelectedIndex, logicalComparison: true);
			cboPopupMenus.SelectedIndex = RemoveToolFromList((IList)cboPopupMenus.Items, tool, cboPopupMenus.SelectedIndex, logicalComparison: true);
			ResetMenuToolsList(SelectedMenu);
		}

		private void ResetPopupMenuList()
		{
			cboPopupMenus.Items.Clear();
			DesignerUtilities.AddCollectionToolsToList(toolbarBeingDesigned.Tools, (IList)cboPopupMenus.Items, null, addSeparatorEntries: false, honorShowInCustomizer: false, skipMdiMergeTools: false, typeof(PopupMenuTool), allowDerivedTypes: true, ensureVisibleOnMenus: false, ensureVisibleOnToolbars: false, ensureVisibleOnVerticalToolbars: false, ensureVisibleOnRibbonGroup: false, ensureVisibleOnQat: false, ensureNotInherited: true, TaskPaneFilterMode.OnlyIncludeNonTaskPaneTools);
			if (((DisposableObjectCollectionBase)(object)cboPopupMenus.Items).Count > 0)
			{
				cboPopupMenus.SortStyle = (ValueListSortStyle)1;
			}
		}

		private void ResetAvailableToolsList()
		{
			((ListBox)(object)lstAvailableTools).BeginUpdate();
			((ListBox)(object)lstAvailableTools).Items.Clear();
			DesignerUtilities.AddCollectionToolsToList(toolbarBeingDesigned.Tools, ((ListBox)(object)lstAvailableTools).Items, null, addSeparatorEntries: false, honorShowInCustomizer: false, skipMdiMergeTools: false, null, ensureVisibleOnMenus: true, ensureVisibleOnToolbars: false, ensureVisibleOnVerticalToolbars: false, ensureVisibleOnRibbonGroup: false, ensureVisibleOnQat: false, TaskPaneFilterMode.OnlyIncludeNonTaskPaneTools);
			if (((ListBox)(object)lstAvailableTools).Items.Count > 0)
			{
				((ListBox)(object)lstAvailableTools).Sorted = true;
			}
			((ListBox)(object)lstAvailableTools).EndUpdate();
		}

		private void ResetMenuToolsList(PopupMenuTool menu)
		{
			((ListBox)(object)lstMenuTools).BeginUpdate();
			((ListBox)(object)lstMenuTools).Items.Clear();
			if (menu != null)
			{
				DesignerUtilities.AddCollectionToolsToList(menu.Tools, ((ListBox)(object)lstMenuTools).Items, null, addSeparatorEntries: true, honorShowInCustomizer: false, skipMdiMergeTools: false, null, ensureVisibleOnMenus: false, ensureVisibleOnToolbars: false, ensureVisibleOnVerticalToolbars: false, ensureVisibleOnRibbonGroup: false, ensureVisibleOnQat: false, TaskPaneFilterMode.OnlyIncludeNonTaskPaneTools);
			}
			((ListBox)(object)lstMenuTools).EndUpdate();
		}

		private static int RemoveToolFromList(IList list, ToolBase tool, int selectedIndex, bool logicalComparison)
		{
			int num = IndexOfTool(list, tool, skipSeparator: true, logicalComparison);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				list.RemoveAt(num);
				if (num < selectedIndex)
				{
					selectedIndex--;
				}
			}
			return Math.Min(selectedIndex, list.Count - 1);
		}

		private static int IndexOfTool(IList list, ToolBase tool)
		{
			return IndexOfTool(list, tool, skipSeparator: true, logicalComparison: false);
		}

		private static int IndexOfTool(IList list, ToolBase tool, bool skipSeparator, bool logicalComparison)
		{
			if (list != null && list.Count > 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					ToolWrapper toolWrapperFromItem = GetToolWrapperFromItem(list[i]);
					if (toolWrapperFromItem != null && toolWrapperFromItem.Tool != null && (!skipSeparator || !toolWrapperFromItem.IsSeparator))
					{
						if (logicalComparison && toolWrapperFromItem.Tool.IsSameLogicalTool(tool))
						{
							return i;
						}
						if (!logicalComparison && toolWrapperFromItem.Tool == tool)
						{
							return i;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private void InitializeDialogStrings()
		{
			((Control)(object)btnNewMenu).Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("PopupMenuDesigner_NewMenu");
			((Control)(object)lblAvailableTools).Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("PopupMenuDesigner_AvailableTools");
			((Control)(object)lblToolInstructions).Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("PopupMenuDesigner_Instructions");
			((Control)(object)lblMenuTools).Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("PopupMenuDesigner_CurrentMenu");
		}

			ResetPopupMenuList();
			ResetMenuToolsList(null);
			ResetAvailableToolsList();
		}

		private void cboPopupMenus_SelectionChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ResetMenuToolsList(SelectedMenu);
			if (refreshAvailableToolsRequired)
			{
				ResetAvailableToolsList();
			}
		}

		private void lstMenuTools_DragOver(object sender, DragEventArgs e)
		{
			if (SelectedMenu == null)
			{
				e.Effect = DragDropEffects.None;
			}
			else
			{
				if (!e.Data.GetDataPresent(typeof(object[])))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (isDraggingWithinMenuList)
				{
					IGListBox val = (IGListBox)((sender is IGListBox) ? sender : null);
					Point point = ((Control)(object)val).PointToClient(new Point(e.X, e.Y));
					int num = val.CalculateInsertionIndex(point);
					if (num == ((ListControl)(object)val).SelectedIndex || num == ((ListControl)(object)val).SelectedIndex + 1 || (num == -1 && ((ListControl)(object)val).SelectedIndex == ((ListBox)(object)val).Items.Count - 1))
					{
						e.Effect = DragDropEffects.None;
					}
					else
					{
						e.Effect = DragDropEffects.Move;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					e.Effect = DragDropEffects.Copy;
				}
			}
		}

		private void lstMenuTools_DragDrop(object sender, DragEventArgs e)
		{
			object[] array = e.Data.GetData(typeof(object[])) as object[];
			PopupMenuTool selectedMenu = SelectedMenu;
			if (array == null || selectedMenu == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IGListBox val = lstMenuTools;
			int num = val.CurrentInsertionIndex;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = selectedMenu.Tools.Count;
			}
			int num2 = num;
			bool flag = false;
			object[] array2 = array;
			foreach (object value in array2)
			{
				if (((ListBox)(object)val).Items.Contains(value))
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (array.Length > 1)
				{
					return;
				}
				int selectedIndex = ((ListControl)(object)val).SelectedIndex;
				ToolWrapper toolWrapper = (ToolWrapper)((ListBox)(object)val).Items[selectedIndex];
				if (selectedIndex != 0 && ((ToolWrapper)((ListBox)(object)val).Items[selectedIndex - 1]).IsSeparator)
				{
					toolWrapper.Tool.InstanceProps.IsFirstInGroup = false;
					if (selectedIndex < ((ListBox)(object)val).Items.Count - 1)
					{
						((ToolWrapper)((ListBox)(object)val).Items[selectedIndex + 1]).Tool.InstanceProps.IsFirstInGroup = true;
					}
				}
				bool flag2 = num != 0 && ((ToolWrapper)((ListBox)(object)val).Items[num - 1]).IsSeparator;
				ToolWrapper toolWrapper2 = ((num == ((ListBox)(object)val).Items.Count) ? null : ((ToolWrapper)((ListBox)(object)val).Items[num]));
				if (flag2)
				{
					toolWrapper2.Tool.InstanceProps.IsFirstInGroup = false;
					toolWrapper.Tool.InstanceProps.IsFirstInGroup = true;
				}
				int num3 = 0;
				for (int j = 0; j < ((ListBox)(object)val).Items.Count; j++)
				{
					ToolWrapper toolWrapper3 = ((ListBox)(object)val).Items[j] as ToolWrapper;
					if (toolWrapper3 == toolWrapper2)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (!toolWrapper3.IsSeparator)
					{
						num3++;
					}
				}
				selectedMenu.Tools.Remove(toolWrapper.Tool);
				if (num > selectedIndex)
				{
					num3--;
					num2--;
				}
				selectedMenu.Tools.InternalInsertAt(toolWrapper.Tool, num3, honorReadOnlyStatus: false);
			}
			else
			{
				bool flag3 = num != 0 && ((ToolWrapper)((ListBox)(object)val).Items[num - 1]).IsSeparator;
				ToolWrapper toolWrapper4 = ((num == ((ListBox)(object)val).Items.Count) ? null : ((ToolWrapper)((ListBox)(object)val).Items[num]));
				if (flag3)
				{
					toolWrapper4.Tool.InstanceProps.IsFirstInGroup = false;
					num--;
				}
				int num4 = num;
				for (int k = 0; k < num; k++)
				{
					ToolWrapper toolWrapper5 = ((ListBox)(object)val).Items[k] as ToolWrapper;
					if (toolWrapper5.IsSeparator)
					{
						num4--;
					}
				}
				bool flag4 = flag3;
				object[] array3 = array;
				foreach (object obj in array3)
				{
					if (obj is ToolWrapper toolWrapper6)
					{
						int index = selectedMenu.Tools.InternalInsertAt(toolWrapper6.Tool, num4++, honorReadOnlyStatus: false);
						if (flag4)
						{
							selectedMenu.Tools[index].InstanceProps.IsFirstInGroup = true;
							flag4 = false;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			int topIndex = ((ListBox)(object)val).TopIndex;
			((ListBox)(object)val).BeginUpdate();
			ResetMenuToolsList(selectedMenu);
			if (topIndex <= ((ListBox)(object)val).Items.Count)
			{
				((ListBox)(object)val).TopIndex = topIndex;
			}
			if (num2 <= ((ListBox)(object)val).Items.Count)
			{
				((ListControl)(object)val).SelectedIndex = num2;
			}
			((ListBox)(object)val).EndUpdate();
		}

		private static ToolWrapper GetToolWrapperFromItem(object item)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (item is ValueListItem)
			{
				return ((ValueListItem)item).DataValue as ToolWrapper;
			}
			if (item is ToolWrapper)
			{
				return (ToolWrapper)item;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void lstMenuTools_QueryContinueDrag(object sender, QueryContinueDragEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!isDraggingWithinMenuList)
			{
				if (!(((ListBox)(object)lstMenuTools).SelectedItem is ToolWrapper { IsSeparator: false }))
				{
					e.Action = DragAction.Cancel;
				}
				toolbarBeingDesigned.PopupManager.CloseAllPopups();
			}
			DragAction action = e.Action;
			if (action == DragAction.Drop || action == DragAction.Cancel)
			{
				isDraggingWithinMenuList = false;
			}
			else
			{
				isDraggingWithinMenuList = true;
			}
		}

			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

	internal class SelectedObjectPropertyTab : PropertyTab
	{
		private class SurrogatePropertyDescriptor : PropertyDescriptor
		{
			private PropertyDescriptor baseDescriptor;

			public override Type ComponentType => baseDescriptor.ComponentType;

			public override bool IsReadOnly => baseDescriptor.IsReadOnly;

			public override Type PropertyType => baseDescriptor.PropertyType;

			public override TypeConverter Converter => new SurrogateTypeConverter(baseDescriptor.Converter);

			public override string DisplayName => baseDescriptor.DisplayName;

			internal PropertyDescriptor OriginalDescriptor => baseDescriptor;

			internal SurrogatePropertyDescriptor(PropertyDescriptor baseDescriptor, Attribute[] attributes)
				: base(baseDescriptor.Name, attributes)
			{
				this.baseDescriptor = baseDescriptor;
			}

			public override bool CanResetValue(object component)
			{
				return baseDescriptor.CanResetValue(GetSelectedObject(component));
			}

			public override object GetValue(object component)
			{
				return baseDescriptor.GetValue(GetSelectedObject(component));
			}

			public override void ResetValue(object component)
			{
				baseDescriptor.ResetValue(GetSelectedObject(component));
			}

			public override void SetValue(object component, object value)
			{
				baseDescriptor.SetValue(GetSelectedObject(component), value);
			}

			public override bool ShouldSerializeValue(object component)
			{
				object selectedObject = GetSelectedObject(component);
				if (selectedObject == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return baseDescriptor.ShouldSerializeValue(selectedObject);
			}

			public override void AddValueChanged(object component, EventHandler handler)
			{
				baseDescriptor.AddValueChanged(GetSelectedObject(component), handler);
			}

			public override void RemoveValueChanged(object component, EventHandler handler)
			{
				baseDescriptor.RemoveValueChanged(GetSelectedObject(component), handler);

			{
				object editor = baseDescriptor.GetEditor(editorBaseType);
				if (editor is UITypeEditor)
				{
					return new SurrogateUITypeEditor(editor as UITypeEditor);
				}
				return editor;
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				return baseDescriptor.ToString();
			}

			private static object GetSelectedObject(object component)
			{
				if (component is UltraToolbarsManager ultraToolbarsManager)
				{
					if (ultraToolbarsManager.Customizing && ultraToolbarsManager.CustomizeDialog != null)
					{
						return ultraToolbarsManager.CustomizeDialog.SelectedObject;
					}
					if (ultraToolbarsManager.CustomizeDialogBeingExited != null)
					{
						return ultraToolbarsManager.CustomizeDialogBeingExited.SelectedObject;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal class SurrogateTypeConverter : TypeConverter
		{
			private TypeConverter original;

			internal SurrogateTypeConverter(TypeConverter original)
			{
				this.original = original;
			}

			public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
			{
				return original.CanConvertFrom(GetActualContext(context), sourceType);

			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)

				return original.CanConvertTo(GetActualContext(context), destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
			{
				return original.ConvertFrom(GetActualContext(context), culture, value);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				return original.ConvertTo(GetActualContext(context), culture, value, destinationType);
			}

			public override object CreateInstance(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IDictionary propertyValues)
			{
				return original.CreateInstance(GetActualContext(context), propertyValues);
			}

			public override bool GetCreateInstanceSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				return original.GetCreateInstanceSupported(GetActualContext(context));
			}

			public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
			{
				return original.GetProperties(GetActualContext(context), value, attributes);
			}

			public override bool GetPropertiesSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				return original.GetPropertiesSupported(GetActualContext(context));
			}

			public override StandardValuesCollection GetStandardValues(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				return original.GetStandardValues(GetActualContext(context));
			}

			public override bool GetStandardValuesExclusive(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				return original.GetStandardValuesExclusive(GetActualContext(context));
			}

			public override bool GetStandardValuesSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				return original.GetStandardValuesSupported(GetActualContext(context));
			}

			public override bool IsValid(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value)
			{
				return original.IsValid(GetActualContext(context), value);
			}

			internal static ITypeDescriptorContext GetActualContext(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				return new SurrogateTypeDescriptorContext(context);
			}
		}

		private class SurrogateTypeDescriptorContext : ITypeDescriptorContext, IServiceProvider
		{
			private ITypeDescriptorContext original;

			public IContainer Container
			{
				get
				{
					if (original == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return original.Container;
				}
			}

			public object Instance => GetActualInstance();

			public PropertyDescriptor PropertyDescriptor
			{
				get
				{
					if (original == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = original.PropertyDescriptor;
					if (propertyDescriptor is SurrogatePropertyDescriptor surrogatePropertyDescriptor)
					{
						return surrogatePropertyDescriptor.OriginalDescriptor;
					}
					return propertyDescriptor;
				}
			}

			internal SurrogateTypeDescriptorContext(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				original = context;
			}

			public void OnComponentChanged()
			{
				if (original != null)
				{
					original.OnComponentChanged();
				}
			}

			public bool OnComponentChanging()
			{
				if (original != null)
				{
					return original.OnComponentChanging();
				}
				return false;
			}

			public object GetService(Type serviceType)
			{
				if (original == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return original.GetService(serviceType);
			}

			private object GetActualInstance()
			{
				if (original != null)
				{
					if (original.Instance is UltraToolbarsManager { Customizing: not false, CustomizeDialog: not null } ultraToolbarsManager)
					{
						return ultraToolbarsManager.CustomizeDialog.SelectedObject;
					}
					return original.Instance;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		private Bitmap bitmap;

		public override Bitmap Bitmap => bitmap;

		public override string TabName => Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CustomizeDlgSelectObjectPropertyTab");

		public SelectedObjectPropertyTab()
		{
			Stream manifestResourceStream = typeof(UltraToolbarsManager).Module.Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(typeof(UltraToolbarsManager), "ToolboxBitmaps.CLR2.UltraToolbarsManager.png");
			bitmap = Image.FromStream(manifestResourceStream) as Bitmap;
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && bitmap != null)
			{
				bitmap.Dispose();
				bitmap = null;
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(object component, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			return GetProperties(null, component, attributes);
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object component, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			if (!(component is UltraToolbarsManager))
			{
				if (component is Control)
				{
					return null;
				}
				TypeConverter converter = TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(component);
				if (converter != null)
				{
					return converter.GetProperties(context, component, attributes);
				}
				return TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(component, attributes);
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager manager = context.Instance as UltraToolbarsManager;
			object selectedObject = GetSelectedObject(manager);
			if (selectedObject == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			TypeConverter converter2 = TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(selectedObject);
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = converter2.GetProperties(null, selectedObject, attributes);
			List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>();
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item2 in properties)
			{
				AttributeCollection attributes2 = item2.Attributes;
				Attribute[] array = new Attribute[attributes2.Count];
				attributes2.CopyTo(array, 0);
				SurrogatePropertyDescriptor item = new SurrogatePropertyDescriptor(item2, array);
				list.Add(item);
			}
			PropertyDescriptor[] properties2 = list.ToArray();
			return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(properties2);
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptor GetDefaultProperty(object component)
		{
			if (component is UltraToolbarsManager manager)
			{
				object selectedObject = GetSelectedObject(manager);
				if (selectedObject == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				PropertyDescriptor defaultProperty = TypeDescriptor.GetDefaultProperty(selectedObject);
				if (defaultProperty == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return new SurrogatePropertyDescriptor(defaultProperty, new Attribute[0]);
			}
			return base.GetDefaultProperty(component);
		}

		private static object GetSelectedObject(UltraToolbarsManager manager)
		{
			if (manager != null && manager.Customizing && manager.CustomizeDialog != null)
			{
				return manager.CustomizeDialog.SelectedObject;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public virtual void OnEnterCustomizeMode(UltraToolbarsManager managerBeingDesigned)
		{
			SecurityPermission securityPermission = new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode);
			try
			{
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					securityPermission.Assert();
				}
				this.managerBeingDesigned = managerBeingDesigned;
				KeyboardHookManager.KeyHook += OnKeyboardHookCallback;
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
		}

		public virtual void OnExitCustomizeMode()
		{
			SecurityPermission securityPermission = new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode);
			try
			{
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					securityPermission.Assert();
				}
				managerBeingDesigned = null;
				KeyboardHookManager.KeyHook -= OnKeyboardHookCallback;
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
		}

		public virtual void SetCapture(bool capture)
		{
			Control controlToReceiveCapture = ControlToReceiveCapture;
			if (controlToReceiveCapture != null)
			{
				ToolbarsManagerUtilities.SetControlCapture(controlToReceiveCapture, capture);
			}
		}

		public virtual void DragItemStart(DragItemType itemType)
		{
			CloseToolContextMenus();
			if (itemType == DragItemType.Toolbar)
			{
				ManagerBeingDesigned.PopupManager.CloseAllPopups();
			}
		}

		public virtual void DragItemEnd(DragItemType itemType)
		{
		}

		public virtual void Dispose()
		{
			isDisposed = true;
			if (ManagerBeingDesigned != null && ManagerBeingDesigned.Customizing && ManagerBeingDesigned.CustomizeDialog == this)
			{
				ManagerBeingDesigned.ExitCustomizeMode(this);
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool ShouldProcessKeyHookMessage(KeyHookEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Handled)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!IsEnabled)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (e.HookCode != 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ManagerBeingDesigned == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IntPtr focus = NativeWindowMethods.GetFocus();
			Control control = Control.FromHandle(focus);
			if (control == null)
			{
				control = Control.FromChildHandle(focus);
			}
			if (control != null && control.InvokeRequired)
			{
				return false;
			}
			while (control != null)
			{
				if (control is TextBox)
				{
					return false;
				}
				control = control.Parent;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual void OnKeyboardHookCallback(object sender, KeyHookEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!ShouldProcessKeyHookMessage(e))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (e.EventType == KeyEventType.KeyDown)
			{
				switch (e.KeyData)
				{
				case Keys.Escape:
					if (ManagerBeingDesigned.ToolBeingDragged != null)
					{
						ManagerBeingDesigned.DragToolCancelled();
					}
					if (InternalManager != null)
					{
						InternalManager.ProcessEscapeKey(passToPopupContainer: true, ensureFormIsActive: false);
					}
					e.Handled = true;
					break;
				case Keys.Return:
				case Keys.Left:
				case Keys.Up:
				case Keys.Right:
				case Keys.Down:
					if (InternalManager != null && InternalManager.ProcessNavigationKey(e.KeyCode, passToPopupContainer: true, ensureFormIsActive: false))
					{
						e.Handled = true;
					}
					break;
				case Keys.ControlKey:
					if (ManagerBeingDesigned.ToolbarBeingDragged != null || ManagerBeingDesigned.ToolBeingDragged != null)
					{
						ToolbarsManagerUtilities.SetCursorPosition(Cursor.Position);
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			else if (e.EventType == KeyEventType.KeyUp)
			{
				Keys keyData = e.KeyData;
				if (keyData == Keys.ControlKey && (ManagerBeingDesigned.ToolbarBeingDragged != null || ManagerBeingDesigned.ToolBeingDragged != null))
				{
					ToolbarsManagerUtilities.SetCursorPosition(Cursor.Position);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class QuickToolCustomizer : ToolbarCustomizerBase

		}

		public override void OnEnterCustomizeMode(UltraToolbarsManager managerBeingDesigned)
		{
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			base.OnEnterCustomizeMode(managerBeingDesigned);
			SecurityPermission securityPermission = new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode);
			try
			{
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					securityPermission.Assert();
				}
				DropDownManager.ActivationChanged += new ActivationChangedEventHandler(OnActivationChanged);
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
		}

		public override void OnExitCustomizeMode()
		{
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			base.OnExitCustomizeMode();
			SecurityPermission securityPermission = new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode);
			try
			{
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					securityPermission.Assert();
				}
				DropDownManager.ActivationChanged -= new ActivationChangedEventHandler(OnActivationChanged);
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
		}

		public override DialogResult ShowDialog(Form form)
