		internal bool EnterQuickCustomizeMode(ToolBase tool)
		{
			if (tool == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraToolbarsManager toolbarsManager = tool.ToolbarsManager;
			if (toolbarsManager == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (tool.IsSpecialTool)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (tool.OwnerIsRibbonGroup && !toolbarsManager.CanCustomizerAffectRibbon)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (tool.OwnerIsApplicationMenuArea && !toolbarsManager.CanCustomizerAffectRibbon)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (tool.OwnerIsToolbarInternal && !tool.OwningToolbarInternal.AllowCustomizeResolved)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SecurityPermission permission = new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode);
			try
			{
				ToolbarsManagerUtilities.VerifyPermission(permission);
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				return false;
			}
			toolbarsManager.EnterCustomizeMode(this);
			toolbarsManager.ToolBeingCustomized = tool;
			toolbarsManager.OnDragToolBegin(tool);
			return toolbarsManager.ToolBeingDragged == tool;
		}

		private void OnActivationChanged(object sender, ActivationChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)e.Type == 1 && ManagerBeingDesigned != null)
			{
				ManagerBeingDesigned.ExitCustomizeMode(this);
			}
		}
	}
	internal abstract class DesignTimeToolbarCustomizerBase : ToolbarCustomizerBase
	{
		private ToolBase toolBeingEdited;

		private NewToolPlaceHolderTool placeHolderTool;

		private bool isProcessingNewToolMenuClick;

		private ToolbarListMenuAgent toolbarListAgent;

		private object lastSelectedObject;

		private UltraToolbarsManager internalToolbarsManager;

		public override bool ExpandToolbarsToDisplayAllTools => true;

		public override object SelectedObject => LastSelectedObject;

		protected override UltraToolbarsManager InternalManager
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0094: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (internalToolbarsManager == null && !base.IsDisposed)
				{
					internalToolbarsManager = new UltraToolbarsManager();
					internalToolbarsManager.IsCustomizerToolbarManager = true;
					internalToolbarsManager.DockWithinContainer = DockWithinContainer;
					internalToolbarsManager.AfterToolCloseup += OnToolContextMenuCloseup;
					internalToolbarsManager.ToolClick += OnToolContextMenuClick;
					internalToolbarsManager.AfterToolDropdown += OnToolContextMenuDropDown;
				}
				if (ManagerBeingDesigned != null)
				{
					internalToolbarsManager.Style = ManagerBeingDesigned.StyleResolved;
					((UltraStylableComponent)internalToolbarsManager).UseAppStyling = ((UltraStylableComponent)ManagerBeingDesigned).ComponentRole.Enabled;
					((UltraStylableComponent)internalToolbarsManager).StyleSetName = ((UltraStylableComponent)ManagerBeingDesigned).ComponentRole.StyleSetNameResolved;
				}
				return internalToolbarsManager;
			}
		}

		protected NewToolPlaceHolderTool PlaceHolderTool
		{
			get
			{
				return placeHolderTool;
			}
			set
			{
				placeHolderTool = value;
				toolBeingEdited = null;
			}
		}

		protected ToolBase ToolBeingEdited
		{
			get
			{
				return toolBeingEdited;
			}
			set
			{
				toolBeingEdited = value;
				placeHolderTool = null;
			}
		}

		protected internal object LastSelectedObject
		{
			get
			{
				return lastSelectedObject;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == lastSelectedObject)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (lastSelectedObject is UltraToolbarBase { Disposed: false, UIElement: not null } ultraToolbarBase)
				{
					ultraToolbarBase.UIElement.Invalidate(false);
				}
				if (lastSelectedObject is RibbonTab)
				{
					((RibbonTab)lastSelectedObject).InvalidateTabItem();
				}
				if (lastSelectedObject is RibbonGroup)
				{
					((RibbonGroup)lastSelectedObject).InvalidateElements();
				}
				if (lastSelectedObject is ApplicationMenu)
				{
					((ApplicationMenu)lastSelectedObject).Ribbon.InvalidateApplicationMenuButton();
				}
				if (lastSelectedObject is ContextualTabGroup)
				{
					((ContextualTabGroup)lastSelectedObject).InvalidateCaption();
				}
				if (value != null && !(value is ToolBase))
				{
					ManagerBeingDesigned.ToolBeingCustomized = null;
				}
				lastSelectedObject = value;
				if (value is UltraToolbarBase && ((UltraToolbarBase)value).UIElement != null)
				{
					((UltraToolbarBase)value).UIElement.Invalidate(false);
				}
				if (lastSelectedObject is RibbonTab)
				{
					((RibbonTab)lastSelectedObject).InvalidateTabItem();
				}
				if (lastSelectedObject is RibbonGroup)
				{
					((RibbonGroup)lastSelectedObject).InvalidateElements();
				}
				if (lastSelectedObject is ApplicationMenu)
				{
					((ApplicationMenu)lastSelectedObject).Ribbon.InvalidateApplicationMenuButton();
				}
				if (lastSelectedObject is ContextualTabGroup)
				{
					((ContextualTabGroup)lastSelectedObject).InvalidateCaption();
				}
				if (value is UltraToolbarBase && ((UltraToolbarBase)value).Inherited)
				{
					lastSelectedObject = null;
				}
				else if (value is ToolBase && ((ToolBase)value).Inherited)
				{
					lastSelectedObject = null;
				}
				else if (value is RibbonGroup && !((RibbonGroup)value).CanBeModified)
				{
					lastSelectedObject = null;
				}
				else if (value is RibbonTab && !((RibbonTab)value).CanBeModified)
				{
					lastSelectedObject = null;
				}
				if (value is ToolBase)
				{
					MiniToolbarDesigner miniToolbarDesigner = ManagerBeingDesigned.MiniToolbarDesigner;
					if (miniToolbarDesigner != null)
					{
						miniToolbarDesigner.ActiveControl = miniToolbarDesigner.MiniToolbarWindow;
					}
				}
				TypeDescriptor.Refresh(ManagerBeingDesigned);
			}
		}

		private ToolbarListMenuAgent ToolbarListAgent
		{
			get
			{
				if (toolbarListAgent == null && !base.IsDisposed && ShouldDisplayToolbarList)
				{
					toolbarListAgent = new ToolbarListMenuAgent(InternalManager);
				}
				return toolbarListAgent;
			}
		}

		protected ToolBase ToolBeingCustomized
		{
			get
			{
				if (toolBeingEdited != null)
				{
					return toolBeingEdited;
				}
				return placeHolderTool;
			}
		}

		protected abstract bool IsDesignMode { get; }

		protected abstract Control DockWithinContainer { get; }

		public override void DisplayNewToolContextMenu(NewToolPlaceHolderTool placeHolder, Point screenPt)
		{
			if (InternalManager != null)
			{
				CloseToolContextMenus();
				ManagerBeingDesigned.ToolBeingCustomized = null;
				PlaceHolderTool = placeHolder;
				DesignerUtilities.InitializeNewToolPopupMenu(InternalManager, ManagerBeingDesigned, createIfMenuIsNull: true);
				InternalManager.ShowPopup("new_tool_menu", screenPt, null, Rectangle.Empty, (DropDownPosition)2, null);
			}
		}

		public override void DisplayToolContextMenu(ToolBase tool, Point pt, Rectangle exclusionRect, DropDownPosition dropdownPosition)
		{
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			((IToolbarCustomizer)this).CloseToolContextMenus();
			if (tool != null && InternalManager != null && tool.CanBeModified)
			{
				ToolBeingEdited = tool;
				DesignerUtilities.InitializeEditToolPopupMenu(InternalManager, ToolBeingEdited, createIfMenuIsNull: true, IsDesignMode);
				InternalManager.ShowPopup("context_menu", pt, null, exclusionRect, dropdownPosition, null);
			}
		}

		public override void DisplayToolbarList(Point screenPt)
		{
			((IToolbarCustomizer)this).CloseToolContextMenus();
			if (!ShouldDisplayToolbarList)
			{
				return;
			}
			ToolbarListAgent.MenuItems.Clear();
			foreach (UltraToolbar toolbar in ManagerBeingDesigned.Toolbars)
			{
				if (!toolbar.IsMainMenuBar)
				{
					ToolbarListAgent.MenuItems.Add(new ToolbarListMenuItem(toolbar));
				}
			}
			ToolbarListAgent.DropDown(DockWithinContainer, screenPt, Rectangle.Empty, (DropDownPosition)2, delay: false, closeIfAlreadyOpen: true, alignRight: false, autocloseDropdown: true);
		}

		public override void OnEnterCustomizeMode(UltraToolbarsManager managerBeingDesigned)
		{
			base.OnEnterCustomizeMode(managerBeingDesigned);
			LastSelectedObject = null;
		}

		public override void OnExitCustomizeMode()
		{
			base.OnExitCustomizeMode();
			LastSelectedObject = null;
		}

		public override void OnExistingToolsInserted(ToolsCollectionBase destination)
		{
			if (destination == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (destination.OwnerIsPopupMenu)
			{
				((PopupMenuTool)destination.Owner).RefreshDropDownContents();
			}
			else if (destination.Owner is UltraTaskPaneToolbar)
			{
				((UltraTaskPaneToolbar)destination.Owner).NavigationMenuTool.RefreshDropDownContents();
			}
			else if (destination.Owner is ApplicationMenuAreaBase)
			{
				((ApplicationMenuAreaBase)destination.Owner).FileMenu.RefreshDropDownContents();
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(destination.Owner is UltraToolbarBase))
				{
					return;
				}
				UltraToolbarBase ultraToolbarBase = destination.Owner as UltraToolbarBase;
				if (!ultraToolbarBase.IsAnyToolOpen || ultraToolbarBase.ToolbarsManager == null || ultraToolbarBase.QuickCustomizeTool == null || !ultraToolbarBase.QuickCustomizeTool.IsOpen)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (ultraToolbarBase is QuickAccessToolbar)
				{
					UltraToolbarsDockArea ribbonContainer = ((QuickAccessToolbar)ultraToolbarBase).Ribbon.RibbonContainer;
					if (ribbonContainer != null)
					{
						((UIElement)((IUltraControlElement)ribbonContainer).MainUIElement).VerifyChildElements();
					}
				}
				ultraToolbarBase.QuickCustomizeTool.RefreshDropDownContents();
				if (!(SelectedObject is ToolBase))
				{
					return;
				}
				ToolBase toolBase = SelectedObject as ToolBase;
				if (!toolBase.OwnerIsToolbarInternal || !toolBase.OwningToolbarInternal.IsBumpedToolsToolbar || toolBase.OwningToolbarInternal.MainRootToolbar != ultraToolbarBase || !(ultraToolbarBase.QuickCustomizeTool.MenuAgent is QuickCustomizeAgentBase { BumpedToolsToolbar: not null } quickCustomizeAgentBase))
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (ToolBase tool in quickCustomizeAgentBase.BumpedToolsToolbar.Tools)
				{
					if (tool.ClonedFromTool == toolBase.ClonedFromTool)
					{
						ToolBeingEdited = tool;
						tool.ToolbarsManager.ToolBeingCustomized = tool;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public override void OnNewToolAdded(ToolBase tool)
		{
			ToolBase toolBase = ToolBeingCustomized;
			if (toolBase != null && toolBase.OwnerIsToolbarInternal && toolBase.OwningToolbarInternal.IsBumpedToolsToolbar)
			{
				toolBase = toolBase.ClonedFromTool;
			}
			if (toolBase != null)
			{
				int num = toolBase.ParentCollection.IndexOf(toolBase);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					num = toolBase.ParentCollection.Count;
				}
				toolBase.ParentCollection.InternalInsertAt(tool, num, honorReadOnlyStatus: false);
				if (toolBase.InstanceProps.IsFirstInGroup)
				{
					toolBase.InstanceProps.IsFirstInGroup = false;
					toolBase.ParentCollection[num].InstanceProps.IsFirstInGroup = true;
				}
				OnExistingToolsInserted(toolBase.ParentCollection);
			}
		}

		public override void OnToolbarsManagerInitialized(UltraToolbarsManager manager)
		{
			LastSelectedObject = null;
			base.OnToolbarsManagerInitialized(manager);
		}

		public override bool ShouldDisplayInsertionPoint(ToolBase tool, UIElement toolElement)
		{
			if (isProcessingNewToolMenuClick && tool != null && tool == ToolBeingCustomized)
			{
				return tool.ParentCollection.GetOccurrenceNumber(tool) == ToolBeingCustomized.ParentCollection.GetOccurrenceNumber(ToolBeingCustomized);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void Dispose()
		{
			if (internalToolbarsManager != null)
			{
				((Component)(object)internalToolbarsManager).Dispose();
				internalToolbarsManager = null;
			}
			base.Dispose();
		}

		protected virtual void OnToolContextMenuDropDown(object sender, ToolDropdownEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Tool.Key == "new_tool_menu")
			{
				DesignerUtilities.InitializeNewToolPopupMenu(InternalManager, ManagerBeingDesigned, createIfMenuIsNull: false);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnToolContextMenuCloseup(object sender, ToolDropdownEventArgs e)
		{
			DesignerUtilities.ProcessEditToolPopupMenuCloseUp(ToolBeingEdited, IsDesignMode, e);
		}

		protected virtual void OnToolContextMenuClick(object sender, ToolClickEventArgs e)
		{
			if (DesignerUtilities.ProcessControlListPopupMenuClick(toolBeingEdited, IsDesignMode, e) || DesignerUtilities.ProcessRibbonSizeMenuClick(toolBeingEdited, IsDesignMode, e) || DesignerUtilities.ProcessToolImagesMenuClick(toolBeingEdited, IsDesignMode, e) || DesignerUtilities.ProcessEditToolPopupMenuClick(toolBeingEdited, IsDesignMode, e))
			{
				return;
			}
			ToolBase toolBeingCustomized = ToolBeingCustomized;
			bool flag = isProcessingNewToolMenuClick;
			isProcessingNewToolMenuClick = true;
			try
			{
				UIElement uIElement = toolBeingCustomized.UIElement;
				if (uIElement != null && uIElement.Parent != null)
				{
					uIElement.Parent.Invalidate(false);
				}
				DesignerUtilities.ProcessNewToolPopupMenuClick(ManagerBeingDesigned, this, toolBeingCustomized, e);
			}
			finally
			{
				isProcessingNewToolMenuClick = flag;
				UIElement uIElement2 = toolBeingCustomized.UIElement;
				if (uIElement2 != null && uIElement2.Parent != null)
				{
					uIElement2.Parent.Invalidate(false);
				}
			}
		}
	}

			((ImageAndTextButtonExUIElement)this).PositionChildElements();
		}
	}

		private void InitializeDialogStrings()
		{
			((Control)(object)btnRemove).Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ToolsEditorControl_Remove");
			((Control)(object)btnAdd).Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ToolsEditorControl_Add");
			((Control)(object)btnReset).Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ToolsEditorControl_Reset");
			((Control)(object)btnModify).Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ToolsEditorControl_Modify");
		}

		private void PopulateList(ToolsCollectionBase tools, ListBox list)
		{
			list.BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				ToolBase toolBase = ((list.SelectedItem != null) ? ((ToolWrapper)list.SelectedItem).Tool : null);
				list.Items.Clear();
				if (tools == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = tools.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					ToolBase tool = tools[i];
					bool flag = true;
					if ((object)list == lstSource)
					{
						FilterToolEventArgs e = new FilterToolEventArgs(tool);
						OnFilterSourceTools(e);
						flag = e.IncludeTool;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						list.Items.Add(new ToolWrapper(tool, isSeparator: false));
					}
				}
				int num = 0;
				if (toolBase != null)
				{
					num = FindToolInListBox(toolBase, list);
				}
				if (num >= 0 && list.Items.Count > 0)
				{
					list.SelectedIndex = num;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				list.EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		private void VerifyButtonEnabled()
		{
			if (!suppressVerify)
			{
				bool enabled = ((ListBox)(object)lstSource).SelectedItem != null;
				bool enabled2 = ((ListBox)(object)lstDestination).SelectedItem != null;
				bool enabled3 = ((ListControl)(object)lstDestination).SelectedIndex > 0;
				bool enabled4 = ((ListControl)(object)lstDestination).SelectedIndex >= 0 && ((ListControl)(object)lstDestination).SelectedIndex < ((ListBox)(object)lstDestination).Items.Count - 1;
				((Control)(object)btnAdd).Enabled = enabled;
				((Control)(object)btnRemove).Enabled = enabled2;
				((Control)(object)btnUp).Enabled = enabled3;
				((Control)(object)btnDown).Enabled = enabled4;
			}
		}

		private static int FindToolInListBox(ToolBase tool, ListBox listBox)
		{
			if (tool == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < listBox.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				ToolWrapper toolWrapper = null;
				if (listBox.Items[i] is ToolWrapper toolWrapper2 && toolWrapper2.Tool.Key.Equals(tool.Key))
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private static void RemoveItemHelper(ListBox list)
		{
			int selectedIndex = list.SelectedIndex;
			if (selectedIndex >= 0)
			{
				list.Items.RemoveAt(selectedIndex);
				list.SelectedIndex = Math.Min(selectedIndex, list.Items.Count - 1);
			}
		}

		private static void MoveItem(ListBox list, bool up)
		{
			list.BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				int num = ((!up) ? 1 : (-1));
				object selectedItem = list.SelectedItem;
				int selectedIndex = list.SelectedIndex;
				list.Items.RemoveAt(selectedIndex);
				list.Items.Insert(selectedIndex + num, selectedItem);
				list.SelectedIndex = selectedIndex + num;
			}
			finally
			{
				list.EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnLoad(EventArgs e)
		{
			VerifyButtonEnabled();
			((Control)(object)btnModify).Visible = showModifyButton;
			((Control)(object)btnReset).Visible = showResetButton;
			((Control)(object)btnModify).Enabled = canModify;
			((Control)(object)btnReset).Enabled = canReset;
			base.OnLoad(e);
		}

		private void OnDrawListBoxItem(object sender, DrawItemEventArgs e)
		{
			ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollectionBase = ((sender == lstDestination) ? destinationTools : sourceTools);
			DesignerUtilities.ProcessDrawItem(toolsCollectionBase.ToolbarsManager, Font, sender, e);
		}

		private void OnMeasureListBoxItem(object sender, MeasureItemEventArgs e)
		{
			ToolsCollectionBase toolsCollectionBase = ((sender == lstDestination) ? destinationTools : sourceTools);
			DesignerUtilities.ProcessMeasureItem(toolsCollectionBase.ToolbarsManager, Font, sender, e);
		}

		private void btnReset_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			OnResetButtonClick(EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		private void btnModify_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			OnModifyButtonClick(EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		private void btn_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			bool flag = suppressVerify;
			suppressVerify = true;
			try
			{
				if (sender == btnAdd)
				{
					btnAdd_Click(sender, e);
				}
				else if (sender == btnRemove)
				{
					btnRemove_Click(sender, e);
				}
				else if (sender == btnUp)
				{
					btnUp_Click(sender, e);
				}
				else if (sender == btnDown)
				{
					btnDown_Click(sender, e);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				suppressVerify = flag;
				VerifyButtonEnabled();
			}
		}

		private void btnAdd_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ToolWrapper toolWrapper = ((ListBox)(object)lstSource).SelectedItem as ToolWrapper;
			int index = ((ListControl)(object)lstDestination).SelectedIndex + 1;
			ToolBase tool = destinationTools.InsertTool(index, toolWrapper.Tool.Key);
			((ListBox)(object)lstDestination).Items.Insert(index, new ToolWrapper(tool));
			if (hideSourceToolOnDestinationAdd)
			{
				RemoveItemHelper((ListBox)(object)lstSource);
			}
		}

		private void btnRemove_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ToolWrapper toolWrapper = ((ListBox)(object)lstDestination).SelectedItem as ToolWrapper;
			destinationTools.Remove(toolWrapper.Tool);
			RemoveItemHelper((ListBox)(object)lstDestination);
			if (hideSourceToolOnDestinationAdd)
			{
				PopulateList(sourceTools, (ListBox)(object)lstSource);
			}
		}

		private void btnUp_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ToolWrapper toolWrapper = ((ListBox)(object)lstDestination).SelectedItem as ToolWrapper;
			int newIndex = destinationTools.IndexOf(toolWrapper.Tool) - 1;
			destinationTools.ChangeIndexOf(toolWrapper.Tool, newIndex);
			MoveItem((ListBox)(object)lstDestination, up: true);
		}

		private void btnDown_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ToolWrapper toolWrapper = ((ListBox)(object)lstDestination).SelectedItem as ToolWrapper;
			int newIndex = destinationTools.IndexOf(toolWrapper.Tool) + 1;
			destinationTools.ChangeIndexOf(toolWrapper.Tool, newIndex);
			MoveItem((ListBox)(object)lstDestination, up: false);
		}

		private void lstDestination_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			VerifyButtonEnabled();
		}

		private void lstSource_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			VerifyButtonEnabled();
		}

		protected virtual void OnResetButtonClick(EventArgs e)
		{
			((EventHandler)base.Events[EVENT_RESETBUTTONCLICK])?.Invoke(this, e);
		}

		protected virtual void OnModifyButtonClick(EventArgs e)
		{
			((EventHandler)base.Events[EVENT_MODIFYBUTTONCLICK])?.Invoke(this, e);
		}

		protected virtual void OnFilterSourceTools(FilterToolEventArgs e)
		{
			((FilterToolEventHandler)base.Events[EVENT_FILTERSOURCETOOLS])?.Invoke(this, e);
		}
	}
	internal class FilterToolEventArgs : ToolEventArgs
	{
		private bool includeTool = true;

		public bool IncludeTool
		{
			get
			{
				return includeTool;
			}
			set
			{
				includeTool = value;
			}
		}

		public FilterToolEventArgs(ToolBase tool)
			: base(tool)
		{
		}
	}
	internal delegate void FilterToolEventHandler(object sender, FilterToolEventArgs e);
}
namespace Infragistics.Win.UltraWinToolbars.Serialization
{
	public class Binder : Binder
	{
		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, SerializationFormatter = true)]
		public override Type BindToType(string assemblyName, string typeName)
		{
			if (assemblyName == null || !assemblyName.StartsWith("Infragistics.Win.UltraWinToolbars"))
			{
				return ((Binder)this).BindToType(assemblyName, typeName);
			}
			Type type = null;
			try
			{
				assemblyName = typeof(UltraToolbarsManager).Assembly.FullName;
			}
			catch
			{
				assemblyName = "Infragistics4.Win.UltraWinToolbars.v21.1";
			}
			type = Type.GetType($"{typeName}, {assemblyName}");
			if (type == null)
			{
				return ((Binder)this).BindToType(assemblyName, typeName);
			}
			return type;
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.Shared
{
	internal sealed class SR
	{
		private static Infragistics.Shared.SR loader;

		private ResourceManager[] resources;

		private SR()
		{
			string text = "Infragistics.Win.UltraWinToolbars.strings";
			string[] array = text.Split(';');
			int num = 0;
			string[] array2 = array;
			foreach (string text2 in array2)
			{
				if (text2 != null && text2.Length > 0)
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			resources = new ResourceManager[num];
			Assembly assembly = GetType().Assembly;
			int num2 = 0;
			string[] array3 = array;
			foreach (string text3 in array3)
			{
				if (text3 != null && text3.Length > 0)
				{
					resources[num2++] = new ResourceManager(text3, assembly);
				}
			}
		}

		private static Infragistics.Shared.SR GetLoader()
		{
			if (loader == null)
			{
				lock (typeof(Infragistics.Shared.SR))
				{
					if (loader == null)
					{
						loader = new Infragistics.Shared.SR();
					}
				}
			}
			return loader;
		}

		public static string GetString(string name)
		{
			return GetString(null, name);
		}

		public static string GetString(string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return GetString(null, name, args);
		}

		public static string GetString(CultureInfo culture, string name)
		{
			return GetString(culture, name, null);
		}

		public static string GetString(CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return GetStringHelper(allowCustomizedStrings: true, culture, name, args);
		}

		private static string GetStringHelper(bool allowCustomizedStrings, CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
		{
			string text = null;
			if (allowCustomizedStrings)
			{
				text = global::ResourceCustomizerLocator.Customizer.GetCustomizedString(name);
			}
			if (text == null)
			{
				Infragistics.Shared.SR sR = GetLoader();
				if (sR == null)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				text = sR.GetString(name, culture);
				if (text == null)
				{
					text = string.Empty;
				}
			}
			if (args != null && args.Length != 0 && text.Length > 2)
			{
				try
				{
					text = string.Format(null, text, args);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return text;
		}

		private string GetString(string name, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			ResourceManager[] array = resources;
			foreach (ResourceManager resourceManager in array)
			{
				string text = resourceManager.GetString(name, culture);
				if (text != null)
				{
					return text;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static string GetUncustomizedString(string name)
		{
			return GetUncustomizedString(null, name);
		}

		public static string GetUncustomizedString(string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return GetUncustomizedString(null, name, args);
		}

		public static string GetUncustomizedString(CultureInfo culture, string name)
		{
			return GetUncustomizedString(culture, name, null);
		}

		public static string GetUncustomizedString(CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return GetStringHelper(allowCustomizedStrings: false, culture, name, args);
		}

		public static object GetObject(string name)
		{
			return GetObject(null, name);
		}

		public static object GetObject(CultureInfo culture, string name)
		{
			return GetLoader()?.GetObject(name, culture);
		}

		private object GetObject(string name, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			ResourceManager[] array = resources;
			foreach (ResourceManager resourceManager in array)
			{
				object obj = resourceManager.GetObject(name, culture);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					return obj;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.All, AllowMultiple = false, Inherited = true)]
	internal sealed class LocalizedCategoryAttribute : CategoryAttribute
	{
		public LocalizedCategoryAttribute(string category)
			: base(category)
		{
		}

		protected override string GetLocalizedString(string value)
		{
			return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetUncustomizedString(null, value);
		}
	}
	[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.All, AllowMultiple = false, Inherited = true)]
	internal sealed class LocalizedDescriptionAttribute : DescriptionAttribute
	{
		private bool loaded;

		public override string Description
		{
			get
			{
				if (!loaded)
				{
					loaded = true;
					base.DescriptionValue = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetUncustomizedString(null, base.Description);
				}
				return base.Description;
			}
		}

		public LocalizedDescriptionAttribute(string description)
			: base(description)
		{
		}
	}

	[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Property | AttributeTargets.Field, AllowMultiple = false, Inherited = true)]
	internal sealed class LocalizedDisplayNameAttribute : DisplayNameAttribute
	{
		private bool loaded;

		private string resourceName;

		private string displayName;

		public override string DisplayName
		{
			get
			{
				if (!loaded)
				{
					loaded = true;
					displayName = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString(null, resourceName);
				}
				return displayName;
			}
		}

		public LocalizedDisplayNameAttribute(string resourceName)
		{
			this.resourceName = resourceName;
		}
	}
